endDes.想起在电子游戏里主角通过啜饮泉水恢复生命的画面，鬼使神差地，你跪在池边，掬起一捧: Recalling the image in video games where the player gains HP by sipping from a spring, you find yourself inexplicably kneeling by the pool, scooping up a handful of water and bringing it to your lips. The cool, sweet taste refreshes your spirit, and you regain some strength.
endDes.你跟着石头发出的旋律哼唱后，奇妙地感到精神一振。: You hum along to the melody emanating from the rock, and strangely enough, you feel instantly invigorated.
endDes.你选择了《御敌枢纽行动指南》《索思学会救援手册》《昴宿机器人与摩托车维修技术》，: You have chosen "The Destroyer Action Guide," "Source Citadel Rescue Manual," and "Tauri Robot and Motorcycle Repair Tech." These practical pieces of knowledge are sure to be helpful.
endDes.你选择了《帝国历史选》《不为人知的蘑菇村童谣》《灿阳剑姬奇谭》这类不常见的书，假: You have chosen uncommon books like "Selection of Empire History," "Unknown Mushroom Village Nursery Rhymes," and "The Legend of the Solar Sword Maiden." If you take them back to the outside world, they should be able to sell for a good price... probably?
endDes.你将书本一一收拾放归书架上。在杂乱书堆的底端，你发现了一枚精美的旧书签，触碰以后: You tidy up the books one by one and return them to the bookshelf. At the bottom of the messy pile of books, you find an exquisite old bookmark. After touching it, a sense of hope for the future seems to flow into your mind.
endDes.指引机器人乖乖跟随你的脚步，为你照亮了前方的路途。: The guiding robot obediently follows you, illuminating the path ahead.
endDes.指引机器人依据命令开始引路。很快，你在它的带领下寻获了一些有用之物。: The guiding robot starts leading the way. Soon, under its guidance, you discover some useful items.
endDes.没有感知到危险的气息，你决定循着光上前察看，却未能发现任何光源。很快，光芒消失，: Without sensing any sign of danger, you decide to move forward toward the light to investigate, but fail to find any source of it. Soon, the light vanishes, leaving only floating specks of dust around.
endDes.你决定先不轻举妄动，在这道温暖的光芒中休息片刻。很快，光芒消失，我们也稍微恢复了: You decide not to act rashly and rest for a moment in this warm glow. Soon, the glow vanishes, and you regain some strength to continue moving forward.
endDes.她时而停驻思考、时而独自徘徊，最终，她转头望向了你——这让你感到一阵眩晕。\\n: She occasionally stops to think and sometimes wanders alone. Finally, she turns her head to look at you — this makes you feel a bout of dizziness. However, it seems that you recall something from that gaze...
endDes.直觉告诉你，这种幻象不可接近。装作从没有与她相见过，你离开了。: Your intuition tells you that this illusion is untouchable. Pretending you have never met her, you walk away.
endDes.你将一枚骰子放了上去，它立刻消失了。片刻之后，另一枚全新的骰子便出现在了你的手中: You place a dice on it, and it vanishes immediately. A moment later, another brand new dice appears in your hand.
endDes.你对着摊开的手出了剪刀，手臂惊愕的停止了晃动，似乎在思考什么。片刻之后，它将一个: You play scissors against its outstretched hand, and the arm jolts to a stunned halt as if lost in thought. After a moment, it slams a small pouch down right in front of you.
endDes.你握住了手，向它表示问候。: You take the hand and greet it.
endDes.想起曾和某位乘员讨论过的帝国传说。“据说在很远的地方有一个发光的大湖，只要带着虔: You recall an imperial legend. "They say there's a vast glowing lake far beyond. Dive into it with a devout wish, and you shall be granted boundless power!" You leap into the water. When you come to again, you lie on the cold floor, holding something tightly in your hand.
endDes.为了保证安全，你选择在原地等待这首曲子结束——不知为何，你确信这首曲子即将终结。: To stay safe, you choose to wait right there until the melody ends — for some reason, you are certain it is drawing to a close. As the music fades away, you regain some strength in this brief respite. It is time to move on.
endDes.你选择寻找乐声的源头。在见到那架无人弹奏的竖琴的瞬间，琴声便停止了，似乎在上一秒: You choose to seek the source of the music. The moment you spot the unplayed harp, the melody stops at once — as if the mysterious player had just left in a flutter of sleeves the second before. Beneath the seat lies a faintly familiar item.
endDes.动用工程学、物理学、电学知识以及恰当的工具和升构能力进行辅助，你们成功地修复了这: Drawing on your knowledge of engineering, physics and electrical engineering, and assisted by proper tools and your Ascension Abilities, you successfully repair the broken cable.
endDes.机会是为勇敢者准备的！\\n像《人猿沃德山》的主角那样，你抓住电缆末端荡过了水坑: Fortune favors the brave! Like the protagonist of "Ward the Ape Man," you grab the end of the cable and swing across the puddle.
endDes.这些书在危机重重的空间中能发挥什么作用呢？保险起见，你决定还是不要横生枝节，直接: What use could these books possibly serve in such a perilous space? To err on the side of caution, you decide not to stir up extra trouble and leave straight away.
endDes.怎么想都觉得自己不会有什么损失，为什么不干脆接受对方的好意呢？: You can't think of any way this could backfire. Why not just accept his kindness?
endDes.免费的背后可能是更加高昂的代价，更何况这个人也太可疑了。保险起见，还是不要理会吧: Free favors often come with a far steeper price. What's more, this person is far too suspicious. To play it safe, you'd better ignore him.
endDes.如同回应一般，他与你双手交握，好像分别多年的至亲终于得到机会问候彼此。不知为何，: As if in answer, he clasps your hands in his, like long-lost kin finally reunited to greet one another. Somehow, your eyelids grow heavy. He releases your hands, and you find a dice has been pressed into your palm.
endDes.直觉告诉你，你无法负担它们带来的后果，不如及时止损。你刚想追问那是什么，就发现青: Your intuition tells you that you cannot bear the consequences they bring; it is better to cut your losses in time. You are just about to press him for what it is, only to find nothing but a glinting object where the young man once stood.
endDes.你想要将这些独特的结晶保管起来，但是结晶投射出数道漆黑的剑影，你匆忙招架，那名神: You try to secure these unique crystals, but they project several pitch-black sword silhouettes. You hastily parry, only to find the mysterious young man has long vanished into the shadows.
endDes.你决定离这个奇怪的扭蛋机远一些。转头没走出两步，你就在脚边发现了一些亮闪闪的东西: You decide to keep your distance from this strange gacha machine. You turn and take no more than two steps before spotting something shiny at your feet.
endDes.你决定试试这个扭蛋机里究竟能扭出什么……随着你转动旋钮，出口里居然落下了两枚扭蛋: You decide to test your luck and see what this gacha machine will dispense... As you turn the knob, two capsules drop out from the slot!
endDes.你打败了扭蛋中冒出的敌人，好在那个危险的扭蛋机也在战斗中被破坏了。从中滚出的扭蛋: You defeat the enemy that emerges from the gacha capsule. Fortunately, the dangerous gacha machine is also destroyed in the fight. The capsules that roll out are not eerie — they appear to be nothing but ordinary toys... You leave this place.
endDes.这一路上你收集了各种各样的增益，或许其中有些是克洛伊中意的？: You've collected all kinds of buffs along the way. Maybe some of them are Chloe's favorites?
endDes.这一路上你收集了不少尘埃，也许克洛伊和你同样需要它……: You've collected quite a bit of Dust along the way. Perhaps Chloe needs it just as much as you do...
endDes.你拒绝了克洛伊的交换条件，而她毫不在意地耸了耸肩。\\n“好吧，无所谓，既然我没: You reject Chloe's offer, and she shrugs indifferently. "Fine, whatever. Since I haven't given you anything, I'll head back just the way I came. But you're in for a rough time. See ya~"
endDes.“我知道了~”\\n克洛伊飞快地飘到你身前，屈起手指弹了一下你的额头！伴随着脑门: "I get it~" Chloe quickly floats in front of you and flicks your forehead with her bent finger. You clearly feel your power strengthen... Couldn't she have used a nicer way to do it? In the blink of an eye, a fierce wind whips up again, and Chloe's figure vanishes.
endDes.“好吧好吧！给你就是了……”\\n克洛伊撇撇嘴、耸耸肩，把一枚骰子硬塞到了你的手: "Fine, fine! I'll give it to you..." Chloe pouts and shrugs, shoving a dice firmly into your hand. In the blink of an eye, a fierce wind whips up again, and Chloe's figure vanishes.
endDes.在仔细考虑了克洛伊提出的条件后，你决定还是不和她进行这种特殊的交易了，她听完转头: After carefully considering Chloe's terms, you decide not to go through with this special deal with her. Upon hearing your answer, she turns and leaves at once. As she departs, you could have sworn you heard a faint "tch"...
endDes.“……”\\n少女对你的回答没有作出任何反应，她只是定定地望着你的双眼……就在你: "..." The girl gives no reaction to your answer; she simply stares deep into your eyes... Just as you start to feel uneasy, her body suddenly shatters, turning into a pile of dust on the ground.
endDes.“……雅莱？雅莱……没错，这是她告诉我的名字。可是，为什么我会在这里——”: "...Jalhay? Jalhay... That's right, that's the name she told me. But, why am I here?"
endDes.你清醒过来——这不是雅莱，而只是散落意识生成的幻觉。你们打败了幻觉中诞生的敌人，: You come to your senses — this is not Jalhay, merely an illusion forged from scattered consciousness. You defeat the enemy born of the hallucination and press onward.
endDes.尽管你打败了“雅莱”身体中出现的敌人，苍白的少女仍旧消失了。但在被你握住手而消散: Even though you defeat the enemy emerging from within "Jalhay," the pale girl still vanishes. Yet in her final moment, she wears a smile that feels familiar to you. It is as if two overlapping voices speak to you... and you hear them clearly. "Thank you."
endDes.你们采取各种方法，绞尽脑汁地进行尝试，最后均未成功。本打算离开这里另找出路，却发: You try every method you can think of, racking your brains to find a way to open the door, yet all attempts end in failure. You prepare to leave and seek another path, only to find the door has been left slightly ajar. Perhaps the effort itself is what makes it beautiful.
endDes.你们果断决定暴力破门！\\n就在向门发起攻击前的瞬间，这扇门却如本来就不存在一样: You resolutely decide to break down the door by force! But in the very instant before you launch your attack, the door vanishes as if it never existed at all, leaving only an empty corridor and the path ahead. ...Maybe even doors are cowards?
endDes.和同伴互相鼓励着，你踏入了黑暗。很快，前方的道路出现了光亮，你们也在共度这段危险: You step into the darkness, encouraging each other. Light soon appears ahead, and you gain courage as you walk this dangerous path together.
endDes.在黑暗之中，有人点起了灯火、支起了简易的营地。你们选择在这里休息一阵，再继续前进: In the darkness, someone lights a lamp and sets up a simple camp. You choose to rest here for a while before moving on.
endDes.片刻之后，机器人便以激光为你指出了正确的路线。出于对雷比斯技术力的信任，你们跟随: Moments later, the robot points out the correct route for you with a laser. Trusting in Rebis's technological prowess, you follow the beam of light and press on.
endDes.片刻之后，机器人的投影中浮现了几件物品的剪影，似乎可以通过触碰的方式选择其中一件: Moments later, silhouettes of several items appear in the robot's projection. It seems you can choose one by touching it to make it real. With this gift in hand, you press onward.
endDes.机器启动，完成了预设的生产流程，一件崭新的可用之物出现在产线出口。: The machine activates and finishes its preset production process. A brand-new usable item appears at the end of the production line.
endDes.拆解了机器的控制系统，那是一种从未见过的结构，但漫长的时光证明了它的可靠性。: You dismantle the machine's control system. It boasts a structure unlike anything you've ever seen, yet the passage of time has long proven its reliability.
endDes.重新编译生产流程，让它来做点有趣的东西。: You recompile the production process and make it create something fun.
endDes.抽屉里放着常用的文具和其他日用品。在这些散落的工具之间，你发现了一些微尘。: The drawer contains stationery and other daily necessities in common use. Among the scattered tools, you spot some fine dust.
endDes.笔记中用熟悉的字迹写着一些日常见闻和对天使计划的理解。有了这本笔记，应该能更深入: The notes, written in familiar handwriting, record daily observations and insights into the Angel Project. With this notebook, you should be able to understand certain things on a deeper level.
endDes.箱子里堆放着一些有用的物品。: There are some useful items in the box.
endDes.抽屉里空无一物，只有一些微尘。: The drawer contains nothing but a few specks of dust.
endDes.笔记上密密麻麻写着字，然而不等你细看，笔记本的形态便变为了一卷被扯坏磁条的录音带: The notebook is covered in dense writing, but before you can look closely, its shape shifts into a damaged cassette tape with a torn magnetic strip... It's probably unplayable now.
endDes.箱子里的物资和装备几乎都已损毁，你没能找到什么有用的东西，只好在整理了一下思绪后: Most of the supplies and gear inside the box are damaged beyond use. You find nothing useful, collect your thoughts, and set off again.
endDes.走到一半时你踩到一块凹陷险些跌落，所幸只是擦伤，你还意外找到了一些尘埃。: Halfway along, you step on a sunken patch and nearly fall. Fortunately, you only get a scrape, and unexpectedly find some dust.
endDes.你慎重地迈出每一步，最终有惊无险地通过了这里。: You take each step carefully and finally pass through safely.
endDes.你试着分析其中一张图纸，虽然没能完全理解，但是得到了不少启发。: You try to analyze one of the blueprints. Though you don't fully understand it, you gain plenty of inspiration.
endDes.你选择了一张可以理解的图纸尝试制造，这耗费了你大量心神，不过你顺利造出了一件可用: You select an understandable blueprint and attempt to craft the item. It takes a great deal of mental effort, but you successfully build a functional item.
endDes.你没有时间在这里研究有的没的，转身离开了。: You have no time to dwell on trivial matters here and turn to leave.
endDes.你鼓起勇气走入驾驶室，在你大胆的尝试下，它竟然被启动了。然而引擎刚刚复苏没多久就: You summon your courage and step into the train cab. After your bold attempts, it actually starts up. But moments after the engine roars back to life, it lets out a heavy, deep sigh, and the cab falls silent once more.
endDes.你进入车厢查看，意外地在座椅底下发现了一份蒙尘的物资。但是你已经拿不下更多东西，: You enter the carriage to look around and unexpectedly find a dusty supply under the seat. But you can no longer carry anything else, forcing you to make a choice.
endDes.保险起见，你打算先在外部看看情况。但是窗玻璃上满是灰尘和划痕，你完全看不清里面的: To be safe, you decide to check the situation from outside first. But the window is covered in dust and scratches, leaving you unable to see anything inside. You have no choice but to leave in regret.
endDes.你循着乐声的方向离去，你感觉路途无比漫长，但你的精神无比亢奋。: You leave following the sound of music. The journey feels endlessly long, yet your spirit is incredibly exhilarated.
endDes.你踏上追寻光芒的道路，虽然沿途布满崎岖坎坷，但那份越来越明亮的光芒，给予你无尽的: You set off on the path in pursuit of the light. Though the journey is fraught with rough and rugged obstacles, the ever-brighter glow ahead grants you endless comfort and peace of mind.
endDes.你尝试独自穿过迷雾，乐声和光芒逐渐消失，陪伴你的唯有漆黑的太阳和无尽的空虚。恐惧: You try to walk through the mist alone. The music and light fade away little by little, leaving only the dark sun and endless emptiness by your side. Fear and cold gnaw at your body, yet deep within your chest, a heart beats with astonishing force, pumping scalding blood to every part of you.
endDes.你闭上了双眼，忘却了周围的一切。黑暗褪去，你发现自己回到了之前的地方。: You close your eyes, letting go of everything around you. The darkness fades, and you find yourself back where you were before.
endDes.你在托盘的左侧放上了一些尘埃。右侧托盘微微倾斜，流出的鲜红液体滋润了你的皮肤——: You place some dust onto the left pan of the balance. The right pan tilts slightly, and the flowing crimson liquid nourishes your skin —
endDes.你在托盘的左侧放上了一大捧尘埃。右侧托盘倾斜，流出的液体溢满了你的手心。: You place a handful of dust onto the left pan of the balance. The right pan tilts, and the flowing liquid fills your palm.
endDes.你在托盘的左侧尽可能多地堆满了尘埃。天平失去了平衡，转瞬便从那手中滑落，鲜红色的: You pile as much dust as you can onto the left pan of the balance. The scale tips out of balance and slips from that hand in an instant, spilling the bright red liquid all over the ground. When you come to your senses, both the balance and the hand have vanished without a trace.
endDes.你握住了手，向它表示关心。: You hold the hand, expressing your care for it.
endDes.魔女对你说：“出乎意料的诠释，即使我也无法阻挡你的华丽。”: The witch says to you: "An unexpected interpretation. Not even I can stand in the way of your magnificence."
endDes.奢华而又优雅，显得异常得体，你以非常优惠的价格把它买了下来。: Luxurious and elegant, it looks exceptionally proper. You buy it at a very favorable price.
endDes.你觉得自己穿的很好，不需要做出改变。: You feel you are well-dressed and see no need for change.
endDes.你疲惫的身体好像比起刚才有所改善，看来这就是它的极限了。: Your exhausted body seems to have improved a little from earlier. It appears this is its limit.
endDes.你得到了一种强烈的启示，感到自己比刚才更加得心应手。这还真是意外之喜。: You receive a powerful revelation, feeling more capable and in control than before. Truly an unexpected blessing.
endDes.……你还以为自己能得到铁盟币，看来它的认知和你有所不同。不过，总比没有好。: ...You thought you'd get BCRL Coins, but its understanding seems to differ from yours. Still, something is better than nothing.
endDes.许愿塔也有做不到的事情。: Even the Wishing Tower has things it cannot do.
endDes.你不想冒风险，巧妙地利用工具拿到了这个箱子，然而里面的物品已经损坏了。但你收获了: You choose not to take the risk and skillfully use tools to retrieve the box. Yet the items inside have already been damaged. But you gain some experience in using tools, so it is not entirely a bad thing.
endDes.哪怕再怎么灵活和小心，你还是不可避免地被机关所伤。箱子里有一件能派上用场的物品，: No matter how agile and careful you are, you inevitably get hurt by the traps. Inside the box is a useful item, making your effort worthwhile.
endDes.真的有必要为了一个箱子冒那么大风险吗？你相信还会有更好的机会。: Is it really worth taking such a big risk just for one box? You believe there will be better opportunities ahead.
endDes.也许是因为早就想这么干，你果断出手揍了它一拳。你的手一阵疼痛，嚎虎箱倒是毫发无伤: Perhaps you have wanted to do this for a long time, so you strike out decisively and punch it. Your hand throbs with pain, while the HowlingBox remains completely unharmed. But it stops singing, and you finally find peace.
endDes.你没法拿它怎么样只能默默忍耐，在它的歌声中，你的思路逐渐涣散，竟然意外地想到一些: You can do nothing about it but endure in silence. As its song lingers on, your thoughts gradually drift, and unexpectedly, some strange ideas cross your mind.
endDes.你交出了一部分尘埃，它让开路并吐出了一大颗骰子！也许它身边的尘埃就是靠这种方式获: You hand over part of your dust, and it steps aside to spit out a large dice! You think resentfully that perhaps it obtained the dust around it in this very way...
endDes.你并不想花精力对付这只想一出是一出的奇怪老虎，惹不起还躲不起吗？: You don't want to waste energy dealing with this weird box. If you can't fight it, you can at least avoid it.
endDes.大嘴一开一合，其中传出了一种几乎仅由嗡鸣声构成的讲述……不可思议地，你理解了它所: Its maw opens and closes, and from it comes a narration composed almost entirely of hums... Incredibly, you understand the story it tells.
endDes.大嘴一开一合，其中传出了一阵可称悠扬美妙的歌声。这歌声镇定了你和其余探索者的心神: Its maw opens and closes, and a melodious and beautiful song flows out from it. The song calms the minds of you and the other explorers.
endDes.传说中认为，敢于把手伸入墙上的大嘴中的人，都是没有做过虚伪和邪恶之事的人。你将手: Legend holds that those who dare to reach their hands into the gaping maw on the wall are free of hypocrisy and evil. You place your hand inside... nothing terrible happens. Instead, you gain some courage.
endDes.你扬起一把灰尘塞进了这张大嘴里……大嘴呆呆地张开，随后缓缓崩解消失了。: You lift a handful of dirt and stuff it into the huge mouth. The mouth gapes blankly, then slowly disintegrates and vanishes.
endDes.你拿起小提琴试着挥舞，琴弦似乎和风声形成共鸣，发出疗愈身心的乐声。然而未等你细听: You pick up the violin and wield it tentatively. The strings resonate with the wind, producing healing melodies. But before you can listen closely, the violin shatters from your rough movement, and something falling out of it cuts your hand.
endDes.奇妙的是，莉薇娅拿起琴的瞬间，琴弦的光芒就变得耀眼。一曲完毕，你不由得精神一振，: Strangely enough, the moment Livia picks up the violin, the strings glow brilliantly. When the melody ends, you feel instantly refreshed, your mind clears, as if guided by some mysterious power.
endDes.这把琴好像有某种魔力，你虽然不熟练，却也在某种无形的辅助下完成了演奏。悠扬的曲子: The violin seems to possess a certain magic. Though unskilled, you complete the performance with some invisible assistance. The melodic tune grants you a touch of inspiration and motivation.
endDes.这样的东西好像派不上用场，你没有触碰它们。: Such a thing seems useless, so you leave it untouched.
endDes.向左转动魔方后，你的前方出现了通往另一空间的道路，隐隐透出危险的气息……但只要跨: After rotating the Cube leftward, a path to another space appears ahead, exuding a faint sense of danger... Yet once you cross this obstacle, the road ahead will grow much smoother.
endDes.你似乎成功规避一场未知的危险，但也为此付出了必要的代价。: You seem to successfully avoid an unknown danger, but you also pay the necessary price for it.
endDes.你迫不及待操作装置，在顺利完成战斗训练后，感觉自己的实力确实有所进益。: You can't wait to operate the device. After successfully completing the combat training, you feel that your strength has truly improved.
endDes.你不打算冒险，留在房间里休息了一会。离开时，也许是睡得太久，总觉得脑子还有点不清: You decide not to take the risk and stay in the room to rest for a while. When you leave, you feel a bit fuzzy-headed, probably from sleeping too long.
endDes.你顺利击败那些失控的机器人，顺手搜集了一些散落的尘埃。: You defeat the runaway robots and collect some scattered dust.
endDes.虽然你找到一个藏身之处，但还是被到处作乱的机器人误伤到。幸运的是，你在藏身之处发: You find a hiding place, but still get injured by the rampaging robots. Fortunately, you discover some dust in your hiding spot.
endDes.雷比斯的机器人们一拥而上，你费了一番力气才赢得胜利。雷比斯爽快地将一枚银台球扔给: Rebis's robots swarm toward you. You struggle for a while before claiming victory. Rebis casually tosses a silver cue ball to you, its glinting silver light seeming to brighten your train of thought.
endDes.几名学会成员与你展开战斗，你费了一番力气才赢得胜利。雷比斯哈哈大笑，毫不吝啬对你: Several Citadel members engage you in battle. You struggle for some time before claiming victory. Rebis laughs heartily and praises you generously, handing you the golden cue ball. Its dazzling golden light grants you a mysterious revelation.
endDes.“诚实守信的年轻人，老夫很欣赏！”这么说着，雷比斯居然亲自上阵！好不容易结束战斗: "Honest and trustworthy, I like that!" With that, Rebis personally steps into the fray! After barely finishing the battle, Rebis tosses two dice before you can even complain, cutting you off.
endDes.雷比斯遗憾地摇摇头，递给你一个红色的台球后离开了。在她离开的下一秒，红色的台球一: Rebis shakes her head regretfully, hands you a red cue ball, then departs. The second she leaves, the red cue ball suddenly explodes, leaving you covered in dust and grime from the powder inside.
endDes.你无意与他们在此作战，选择给一些好处息事宁人。见你如此客气，他们也识相地向你道谢: You have no intention of fighting them here and choose to offer some benefits to settle the matter. Seeing your courtesy, they thank you sensibly and disperse.
endDes.你毫不手软地将他们“教育”了一番，他们向你进行了深刻的忏悔。: You give them a ruthless "lesson," and they offer you a profound confession.
endDes.你正好打算缝补一下破损的衣物，他们见状也利用自己在云岫桥习得的技能，与你进行了一: You happen to plan to mend your tattered clothes. Seeing this, they use the skills they learned at Yunxiu Bridge and strike up a pleasant trade with you.
endDes.从窗户跳下给你造成了严重的伤势，但你也不是全无收获。: Jumping out of the window inflicts severe injuries on you, yet your efforts are not entirely in vain.
endDes.当你将对应的物品嵌入锁孔后，门应声而开，你还在门背后捡到一件好东西。: When you insert the corresponding item into the keyhole, the door opens at once. You also find a valuable item behind the door.
endDes.那些隐藏在阴影中的守卫被你击败，你从他们手中缴获了战利品，大摇大摆地离开。: You defeat the guards lurking in the shadows, seize the spoils from them, and swagger off.
endDes.此人接受了你的馈赠，给了你另一个盒子，你发现里面装着一些尘埃。: He accepts your gift and gives you another box, inside of which you find some dust.
endDes.你吃下了这份食物，结果一阵剧烈的腹痛向你袭来——可能是过期了。但这次遭遇也给了你: You eat the food, only to be seized by a sharp stomachache — it must have expired. Yet this encounter also gives you some insight.
endDes.你感觉到似乎有什么进入了你的脑海，抽走了一丝灵感……但它也给你留下了一些回报。: You feel something slip into your mind, siphoning off a wisp of inspiration... yet it leaves you a reward in return.
endDes.你的挑衅似乎激怒了它，但你在对峙中赢得了胜利。它仓皇逃跑，留下一些没来得及带走的: Your provocation seems to enrage it, but you emerge victorious in the confrontation. It flees in panic, leaving behind some items it had no time to take.
endDes.你用力戳了一下眼球，它剧烈地抖动，流下了许多眼泪。: You poke the eyeball hard. It trembles violently and sheds a flood of tears.
endDes.你拿起左边的钥匙插入锁孔，随着魔方转动，你的面前出现了全新的道路，但似乎失去了一: You pick up the key on the left and insert it into the keyhole. As the Cube rotates, a brand-new path unfolds before you, yet a wisp of inspiration seems to slip away.
endDes.你拿起右边的钥匙插入锁孔，随着魔方转动，你的面前出现了全新的道路，但失去了一部分: You pick up the key on the right and insert it into the keyhole. As the Cube rotates, a brand-new path appears before you, yet part of your dust is lost.
endDes.你不想支付代价，还是放弃比较保险。: You refuse to pay the price; giving up is the safer option.
endDes.你感到手上一沉，镜中的魔方不知何时落入你掌中。你转动魔方，发现镜子里显示出一条长: You feel a sudden weight in your hand — the Cube in the mirror has somehow fallen into your palm. As you rotate it, the mirror reveals a long corridor, which appears to be a shortcut.
endDes.镜子碎裂成无数碎块，无论怎么拼凑也无法复原，里面的魔方更是失去了踪迹。: The mirror shatters into countless shards, impossible to piece back together no matter how you try. The Cube within it has vanished without a trace.
endDes.你把手放在沙漏上想要擦拭灰尘，但是沙漏立刻碎裂了。溢出的结晶投射出一个手持剑刃的: You place your hand on the hourglass to wipe off the dust, but it shatters instantly. The spilled crystals project a blurry phantom wielding a blade, lunging at you.
endDes.这个沙漏总给你诡异的感觉，不要贸然靠近比较好。: The hourglass gives you an eerie feeling all along; it's better not to approach it rashly.
endDes.你靠在石头边休息了一会，旋律环绕在你的耳边，让你的身心都得到了放松。: You lean against the rock to rest for a while. The melody lingers in your ears, relaxing both your body and mind.
endDes.你惊魂未定地逃离了“雅莱”所在的地方，也逃离了她身体中诞生的怪物。: You flee from where "Jalhay" resides, still shaken, escaping the monster born from her body.
endDes.你勇敢地参与了测试战斗，打败了这群怪模怪样的敌人，也就是雷比斯的实验品。只不过她: You defeat Rebis's experimental subjects. Yet her excited demeanor seems rather odd... "You actually took down the prototypes of the Stars series? ...Oh right, it must be because of their terrible names! I'll take that Lissandra's advice and give them a resounding name... 'Tauri'!"
endDes.见你不太愿意配合的样子，雷比斯从口袋里掏出了一枚什么亮晶晶的东西丢给你。\\n“: Seeing you reluctant to cooperate, Rebis pulls something glittering from her pocket and tosses it to you. "This is your pay! I'm paying you in advance! Don't you dare run away, just stand right there!"
endDes.机器人直直向你冲来，一下子把你撞倒在地……实在是太痛了，你有一会儿简直无法行动！: The robot charges straight at you and knocks you to the ground... The pain is so intense that you are completely immobilized for a moment! But Rebis greatly commends your cooperation. She not only heals you but also gives you extra help.
endDes.机器人直直向你冲来！虽然答应雷比斯不会跑，但稍微挪一下应该没关系吧？！\\n你和: The robot charges straight at you! Though you promised Rebis you wouldn't run, surely moving a little won't matter?! The robot brushes past you. Rebis mutters to herself as she recalls the robot, heals you slightly, then pats you on the shoulder and sends you on your way.
endDes.不行，你不能答应雷比斯的无理要求，至少不应该！\\n你们拔腿就跑，把这个危险的实: No, you cannot agree to Rebis's unreasonable demands — at least, you shouldn't! You break into a run, leaving this dangerous experiment and this dangerous person far behind.
endDes.“那么请上前来。我在这里负责保护众人。”\\n她的语气非常平静，你甚至不确信她是: "Then please step forward. I shall protect everyone." Her tone is perfectly calm, and you are not even sure if she recognizes you. You step forward and offer the dust you hold to that light.
endDes.你摇头表示不作参与，丽桑德拉轻轻颔首表示理解。没有再作任何交流，你离开了。: You shake your head to decline participation, and Lissandra nods gently in understanding. Without further exchange, you leave.
endDes.“所得的将比献出的更多”……听起来还不错。你决定献出更多尘埃。: "What you reap shall exceed what you give."... It sounds promising. You decide to offer more dust.
endDes.“离开也是诚实的表现”……既然如此，你的确还有要做的事，不能在这里耽搁更久了。带: "To leave is also an act of honesty."... If that is so, you indeed have things to do and cannot linger here any longer. Taking the dust you have already obtained, you leave.
endDes.你向丽桑德拉寻求更多建议。她微笑着将手轻轻搭在你的肩上，你获得了一些不可思议的力: You ask Lissandra for more advice. She smiles and rests her hand gently on your shoulder, and you gain some incredible power... But when you come to your senses, the worshippers, Lissandra, and the dust you just offered are all gone.
endDes.丽桑德拉对此稍有惊奇。她目送你收集那些尘埃并离开了此处。\\n“相信你许下的一定: Lissandra looks slightly surprised. She watches as you gather the dust and leave this place. "I believe the wish you have made is a sincere one..."
endDes.丽桑德拉对此稍有讶异。她目送你拿走了那颗骰子并离开了此处。\\n“……从未见过的: Lissandra looks slightly surprised. She watches as you take the dice and leave this place. "...An object I have never seen before... Could it be..."
endDes.你冲上前去。达斯廷的目光没有停留在你身上，他只是望向你身后的一片虚无，沉着地发号: You rush forward. Dustin's gaze does not rest on you; he only stares into the emptiness behind you and issues commands calmly. This is an illusion of Dustin, not the man himself. What is he going through?
endDes.理智战胜了冲动，你决定离开这里。就在你转身的瞬间，达斯廷的身影、“天火”以及敌人: Reason prevails over impulse, and you decide to leave this place. The moment you turn around, the figures of Dustin, "Celestial Fire," and the enemies all vanish like spent sparks.
endDes.“你听了我的话，但还是决定留下来吗？……我知道了，我将代表御敌枢纽众先导铭记这次: "You still choose to stay after hearing what I said? ...Very well. I shall remember this brave act on behalf of all the Citadel Vanguards. Let us fight side by side."
endDes.“……多谢你的好意，这些补给我就收下了。我保证我们会再见的，等到回到塞纳诺尼克以: "...Thank you for your kindness. I will take these supplies. I promise we shall meet again, once we return to Senanonic."
endDes.“多谢你们的掩护——现在快走吧，这里交给我！”: "Thanks for covering me — now get out of here! I'll hold this position!"
endDes.“没错，你做得很好。我一定会赶上你的，放心吧，就在不久之后……带上这些补给粮食，: "Yes, you've done well. I will catch up to you soon, rest assured. Take these rations — they will come in handy."
endDes.所有的敌人全部被打倒了，这是一次来之不易的胜利。达斯廷的钢铁躯体似乎骤然松懈了下: All enemies are defeated, and this hard-won victory is secured. Dustin's steel frame suddenly relaxes, then collapses and vanishes... The battle is an illusion, but the experience of fighting side by side is not.
endDes.尘埃是最小化单元的记忆，在这个特殊的空间中，它既是资源，也是武器。你尽可能多地将: Dust is the minimal unit of memory. In this special space, it is both a resource and a weapon. You hand as much dust as possible to Dustin's illusion... There seems to be a smile on that mechanical face. You then suffer a brief lapse of memory, and when you wake up again, you are in a safe place.
endDes.你决定逃走。达斯廷的幻象为你开辟了道路，由于情况紧急，你无暇关注背后的战斗如何发: You decide to flee. Dustin's illusion clears a path for you. Amid the urgency, you have no time to see how the battle unfolds behind you, yet the enemies nearly halt your progress. Keep moving forward.
endDes.火苗顿时变成一种柔和的蓝色，它轻拂你的掌心，留下一片暖意。: The flame instantly turns a soft blue, brushing gently against your palm and leaving a warm sensation.
endDes.火焰剧烈地燃烧着，待它重新恢复平静时，你在里面发现了一枚材质奇异的骰子。: The flame burns fiercely. When it calms down again, you find a dice of strange material within it.
endDes.你担心放错东西会毁坏珍贵的提灯，最终婉拒了她的好意。: You worry that putting the wrong thing in will damage the precious lantern, so you finally decline her kindness.
endDes.这一次火苗变成了艳丽的紫色，一颗火星在你的指尖爆裂开来，你没有受到任何伤害，反倒: The flame turns a vivid purple this time, a spark bursting at your fingertips. You remain unharmed, yet the sensation is utterly strange and wonderful.
endDes.火焰燃烧得无比剧烈，待它重新恢复平静时，你在里面发现了一枚更加精致的骰子。: The flame burns intensely. When it settles again, you find an even more exquisite dice within it.
endDes.虽然很神奇，但你觉得此刻没必要继续往里投入尘埃做更多实验。: As amazing as it is, you decide there's no need to keep putting in dust for further experiments right now.
endDes.你才刚往里投入一小撮尘埃，火焰就迅速变成炫目的金色。它好像一位令人怀念的故旧，温: You've just tossed in a pinch of dust, and the flame instantly turns dazzling gold. It feels like a beloved old friend, gently wrapping around your hand, leaving a lingering warmth that fades very slowly.
endDes.你想把灯罩擦得更亮些，不慎让指尖的零星尘埃掉入火焰。火焰接纳了它们，热度扫过你的: You try to polish the lantern shade to make it brighter, but accidentally let a few specks of dust from your fingertips fall into the flame. The flame accepts them, and a wave of heat brushes over your fingertips.
endDes.你注视着提灯中令人着迷的美丽火焰，感觉获得了前所未有的安宁。随后你告别瓦伦汀，再: You gaze at the mesmerizing, beautiful flame in the lantern, feeling an unparalleled sense of peace. Afterwards, you bid farewell to Valentine and set off on your journey once more.
endDes.你花了少量的尘埃，包浮虽然有些遗憾，但也高兴收下，保证不会令你失望。: You spend a small amount of dust. Though Forton feels a bit regret, he accepts it gladly and promises not to let you down.
endDes.你花了大量的尘埃，包浮对你连连奉承，当下发誓会让你赚到一笔大钱。: You spend a large amount of dust, and Forton lavishes praises on you, vowing on the spot that he will make you a huge fortune.
endDes.你觉得这实在可疑，不顾包浮的苦苦劝说，毅然离开。: You find it highly suspicious, and regardless of Forton's persistent persuasion, you resolutely leave.
endDes.你才不管他的说辞，动用武力强硬取回了属于自己的钱和收益。也许在外面的交易所里你早: You pay no heed to his words, using force to firmly take back what is rightfully yours. Perhaps you have long wanted to do this in the trading center outside, which is why you act so decisively.
endDes.你将信将疑，决定再相信他一次。你又给了他一些尘埃，但也提醒他，要是敢骗你，下次你: You are doubtful, yet decide to trust him one more time. You give him some more dust, but also warn him that if he dares to deceive you, you will show no mercy next time.
endDes.你想要让他马上兑现承诺，但是看了看跟在他身边的保镖，只得自认倒霉离开。: You demand that he fulfill his promise at once, but when you see the bodyguards beside him, you have no choice but to consider yourself unlucky and leave.
endDes.你问包浮喜欢烧烤鱼还是水煮鱼，他瑟瑟发抖表示自己更喜欢做一条活鱼。他交出了你的钱: You ask Forton whether he prefers to be grilled or boiled. He trembles all over and says he would much rather be spared. He hands over your money plus double the interest, begging you to forgive his moment of madness.
endDes.你掂量了一下，发觉自己可能无法胜过那些保镖，只能口头发泄了一下上当的不满。但是失: You weigh the situation and realize you may not be able to overpower the bodyguards, so you can only verbally vent your anger at being deceived. But the shouts of a loser only serve as accompaniment to the laughter of those who have succeeded.
endDes.“要和我一起训练吗？当然可以，不过可能会稍微有点辛苦。如果累了想要停下的话，请随: "Want to train with me? Sure, but it might be a little tough. If you get tired and want to stop, feel free to tell me anytime!" After the strenuous training, you are exhausted and say you are leaving. The knight smiles and bids you farewell, saying she looks forward to seeing you next time.
endDes.“看您的装束，不是领民呢……也不像是外来的旅行者，难道是地表来的客人吗？可是我也: "Judging by your attire, you are not one of the locals... nor do you seem to be a wandering traveler. Could you be a guest from the surface? Yet I have not heard my father mention this..." After exchanging a few simple greetings, you bid the knight farewell and depart from this place.
endDes.你们希望女骑士为你提供战斗上的援助，她答应了。在片刻的思考后，她教授了你独特的战: You ask the knight to provide you with combat assistance, and she agrees. After thinking for a moment, she teaches you her unique combat techniques, hoping they will aid you on your journey.
endDes.你们希望女骑士能分一些物资给你，她爽快地答应了这个请求，交给你很多看起来相当美味: You ask the knight to share some supplies with you, and she readily agrees. She hands you plenty of delicious-looking food... but the moment it touches your hands, it all turns into glimmering dust.
endDes.你需要休息，于是希望女骑士在这期间能为你们站岗放哨。女骑士爽快地答应了你的请求，: You need to rest, so you hope the knight can stand guard for you during this time. She readily agrees to your request and even suggests that you can lean against her. When you wake up, the knight has already vanished. Yet you can still seem to feel the warmth she left behind...
endDes.你情不自禁随着这旋律轻轻晃动身体，好像有一种活力注入了你的身体。: You can't help but sway gently to the melody, as if a surge of vitality has coursed through your body.
endDes.一块石头能对精神和身体健康起到什么帮助？还是算了吧！: What good can a rock do for your mental and physical health? Forget it!

optionDes.我方全体回复20%生命值: All allies heal for 20% of Max HP.
optionDes.我方全体失去25%生命值，获得1个随机金色【推力】: All allies lose 25% of Max HP and gain a random Golden [Ascent].
optionDes.当前行动回合转动次数+1: Gain 1 Rotate attempt in this turn.
optionDes.全队失去50%生命，获得1枚随机<color=#ec731a>橙色</color: All allies lose 50% of Max HP, and gain 1 random <color=#ec731a>Orange</color> [Dice].
optionDes.进入一场战斗，胜利后获得【猩红沙漏】: Enter a battle, and gain [Crimson Hourglass] after victory.
optionDes.失去1个随机<color=#5a8ef9>蓝色</color>【推力】，获得2个: Lose 1 random <color=#5a8ef9>Blue</color> [Ascent], and gain 2 random <color=#5a8ef9>Blue</color> or <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent].
optionDes.失去1个随机<color=#956bf5>紫色</color>【推力】，获得1枚: Lose 1 random <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Ascent], and gain 1 random <color=#5a8ef9>Blue</color> or <color=#956bf5>Purple</color> [Dice].

Specific resonance influences can enhance its stability, and the jet black branches silently summon Chaos Remains.

A "tree" derived from a special resonance deviation at a random location, can lead to a space that should not exist on the map. Specific resonance influences can enhance its stability, the pale body resembles a guidepost for DS.
eventDescribe.通过构析勘探而发现的异常共振结构，与目前已解明的多种结构均不相同，极为危险，亟待: An anomalous resonant structure discovered via Structural Exploration. It differs distinctly from all previously elucidated structures; it bears extreme hazard and calls for urgent research.

desc.开局消耗1点费用，使本场战斗手牌补充冷却时间缩短1秒\\n每次手牌自然补充时，自: At the start of battle, consume 1 Cost to make cards replenish 1 second faster in the battle.\nWhenever a card is replenished over time, increase Margiela's ATK by 1.5%, up to 60%.
desc.使用自身技能牌后，有50%概率生成1张【暗艺】加入手牌: When using self skill cards, there's a 50% chance to generate 1 [Shadowcraft] in your hand.
desc.造成伤害时，若自身攻击力低于目标防御力，造成的最终伤害提高20%: When dealing DMG, if this character's ATK is lower than the target's DEF, deals 20% more Final DMG.
desc.每次我方【爆炸物】爆炸时，自身攻击力+0.5%，上限60%: When an ally [Explosive] is detonated, increase self ATK by 0.5%, up to 60%.
desc.连续打出4张相同卡牌时，抽满手牌，限1次: When playing 4 same cards consecutively, draws to a full hand. This effect can be triggered only once.
desc.自身造成的<color=#B383FF>【变萌】</color>持续时间延长2秒: <color=#B383FF>[Moemoe]</color> inflicted by this character lasts 2 seconds longer.
desc.开局从牌库将1张【冲击剑】加入手牌: Add 1 [Impact Sword] from the deck to your hand at the start of battle.
desc.濒死时<color=#7AB2FF>【无敌】</color>3秒，同时直接使用【: When taking fatal damage, gains <color=#7AB2FF>[Invincible]</color> for 3 seconds, and immediately uses [Finale's Waltz: Red]. This effect can be triggered only once.
desc.每有1张黑卡被【销毁】时，回复生命值最低的队友5%生命值: Whenever a Black card is [Destroyed], heals the ally with the lowest HP for 5% of their Max HP.
desc.自身所有概率触发机制概率+5%: Get a 5% increased chance to trigger all effects.
desc.使用【谜】抽到【负能】时，使我方全体<color=#7AB2FF>【隐形】</c: When drawing [Reverengy] via [Mystic], grant <color=#7AB2FF>[Invisible]</color> to all allies. For each [Reverengy] drawn, the effect lasts 5 more seconds.\nWhenever the deck is emptied and triggers a reshuffle, increase all allies' ATK by 10%, lasting 5 seconds.
desc.使处于<color=#7AB2FF>【隐形】</color>状态下的我方每秒回复: Heal the allies under <color=#7AB2FF>[Invisible]</color> effect for 2% of Max HP per second.
desc.使用【弃牌】指令弃牌时，额外抽1张牌: When using [Discard] action, draw 1 more card.
desc.【压轴好戏】增强为：\\n飞身跳跃射击，对敌方目标造成6段伤害，同时触发<col: Enhance [Grand Finale]:\nLeaps into mid air and fires at the target, dealing DMG over 6 hits and <color=#FFB800>[Electrify]</color> the target.\nEach hit has a 15% chance to randomly generate a [Pet Trick] or [Balloon Show] in your hand.
desc.使用【队长技】时，回复队长5%生命值: When using a [Leader Skill], heal the leader for 5% of Max HP.
desc.【噜啦弹】增强为：\\n针对我方女性目标的特效治疗弹，回复其35%生命值\\n使: Enhance [Lilium]:\nA special healing shell that heals a female ally for 35% of Max HP and increases the target's DEF by 3%. This effect stacks.
desc.生命值越低，造成的最终伤害越高，最高100%: The lower own HP, the higher the Final DMG dealt, up to 100%.
desc.每次使用自身技能牌后，自身攻击力+3%，可叠加: After using Katas's skill card, increase her ATK by 3%. This effect stacks.
desc.使用【能量泡泡糖】后，下1张4费及以上红卡伤害提高100%，可叠加: After using [Energy Bubblegum], the next Red card of 4 Cost and above deals 100% more DMG. This effect stacks.
desc.使用【暗耀斩钢】后，从牌库或弃牌区将1张【链之间】加入手牌\\n若自身为队长时，: After using [Umbral Fulgor], add 1 [Purgatory Unleashed] from the deck or discard pile to your hand.\nIf Katas is the leader, immediately activates [Leader Skill].
desc.对生命值低于50%的敌方，造成的最终伤害提高20%: Deals 20% more Final DMG to enemies with HP below 50%.
desc.【可靠伙伴】增强为：\\n抽1张牌，优先3费以上红卡\\n下1张红卡伤害提高30: Enhance [Trusty Companion]:\nDraws a card, prioritizing a Red one with 3 Cost or higher.\nThe next Red card played deals 30% more damage.
desc.若【旋羽】丢弃的是红卡，这张红卡本场战斗伤害提高20%: If a Red card is discarded by [Plumed Feather], the red card deals 20% more damage during this battle.
desc.使用【强打】后，下1张红卡所需费用-1: Using [Kyoda] reduces the cost of the next Red card played by 1.
desc.使用【强打】后，本场战斗【光害强打】的攻击段数+1，限8次: Using [Kyoda] enables [Kogai Kyoda] to strike one more time during this battle, up to 8 times.
desc.使用【强打】后，我方全体攻击力+0.5%，可叠加: After using [Kyoda], increase all allies' ATK by 0.5%. This effect stacks.
desc.每次使用2费及2费以下红卡后，自身攻击力+2%，上限50%: Whenever a Red card of 2 Cost and below is played, increases this character's ATK by 2%, up to 50%.
desc.自身处于<color=#7AB2FF>【隐形】</color>状态时，每使用1张: When this character is <color=#7AB2FF>[Invisible]</color>, restores 10% of Max HP whenever a Red card is played.
desc.使用【弃牌】指令时，抽1张牌，优先红卡: When using the [Discard] action, draws a card, prioritizing the red ones.
desc.对处于异常状态下的目标，造成的最终伤害提高20%: Deals 20% more Final DMG to targets under abnormal status.
desc.自身造成的<color=#B383FF>【混乱】</color>和<color=: <color=#B383FF>[Confuse]</color> and <color=#FF6666>[Berserk]</color> inflicted by this character last 3 seconds longer.
desc.开局时，从牌库最下方翻开3张牌，选1张加入手牌: Unfolds the bottom 3 cards from your deck at the start of battle, and selects one to add to your hand.
desc.开局前3张手牌的所需费用-1: Reduces the cost of first 3 cards played at the start of battle by 1.
desc.使用【大红按钮】引爆的【爆炸物】造成的最终伤害提高30%: The Final DMG of [Explosive] detonated by [Red Button] increases by 30%.
desc.【爆破作业】追加效果：\\n此卡被卡牌效果丢弃时，被丢弃的那张【爆破作业】本场战: [Demolition] Bonus Effect:\nWhen this card is discarded by a card effect, reduces the cost of the discarded card by 1. This effect stacks.
desc.自身被燃烧时，【普通攻击】触发<color=#FF6666>【点燃】</colo: When this character is ignited, [Basic Attack] <color=#FF6666>[Ignite]</color> the target.
desc.【无明】增强为：\\n重击地面，对范围内敌方造成1段伤害\\n释放大量可燃气体，:
Enhance [Avidya]:
Smites the ground, dealing DMG to enemies in the target area.
Releases a large amount of flammable gas that <color=#FF6666>[Ignite]</color> both allies and enemies alike, and ignited allies have their ATK increased by 3%. This effect stacks.
Afterward, generates an [Element Core: Fire] in your hand.
desc.【普通攻击】和【磁弦脉冲】有30%概率触发三箭齐发: [Basic Attack] and [Pulse Arrow] have a 30% chance to trigger Triple Shot.

desc.【灾月】造成2段伤害，但所需费用+1\\n【队长技】条件调整为：使用【灾月】2次: [Doom Crescent] deals DMG twice but its Cost is increased by 1.\n[Leader Skill] requirement is changed to: Use [Doom Crescent] twice.
desc.【灾月】每造成1段伤害，自身攻击力+0.5%，上限50%\\n特殊伤害效果除外: For each hit dealt by [Doom Crescent], increase self ATK by 0.5%, up to 50%.\nDMG dealt by special effects is excluded.
desc.使用除【灾月】/【狱月】以外的卡牌，有50%概率从弃牌区回收1张【灾月】加入手牌: When using a card other than [Doom Crescent] or [Infernal Crescent], there's a 50% chance to retrieve a [Doom Crescent] from the discard pile to your hand.

desc.当手牌中有4张相同卡牌时，获得4点费用，限3次: When there are 4 identical hand cards, gains 4 Cost. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times.
desc.我方<color=#7AB2FF>【护盾】</color>消失或引爆时，使<co: When allies' <color=#7AB2FF>[Shields]</color> vanish or are detonated, <color=#7AB2FF>[Shield]</color> holder's DEF increases by 1%, 30% max.
desc.使用【巨像战阵】后，本场战斗【战列维持II】所需费用-1\\n使用【巨像战阵II: Using [Colossal Array] reduces the cost of [Hold the Line II] by 1, lasting the entire battle.\nUsing [Colossal Array II] reduces the cost of [Guardian Angel II] by 1, lasting the entire battle.
desc.使用【大地崩震】后，生成1张【震波】加入手牌\\n我方<color=#7AB2F: After using [Earthquake], generate 1 [Shockwave] to your hand.\nWhen allies' <color=#7AB2FF>[Shields]</color> vanish or are detonated, there is a 20% chance to cast 1 [Frost Nova].
desc.对生命值高于50%的敌方，造成的最终伤害提高20%: Deals 20% more Final DMG to enemies with HP above 50%.
desc.使用【陷阵】后，额外获得存活队友数等量的费用: Using [Unyielding Will] gains additional Cost equal to the number of surviving allies.
desc.使用【奇异火花】后，生成1张【果核】加入手牌\\n自身免疫<color=#B38: After using [Strange Spark], generate 1 [Seed] in your hand.\nGain immunity to <color=#B383FF>[Fetter]</color> and <color=#B383FF>[Imprison]</color>.
desc.使用【队长技】时，回复自身5%生命值: When using a [Leader Skill], heals this character for 5% of Max HP.
desc.对处于<color=#7AB2FF>【冻结】</color>/<color=#7: For targets under the <color=#7AB2FF>[Chill]</color>/<color=#7AB2FF>[Frostbite]</color>/<color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color> status, the Final DMG dealt is increased by 20%/30%/50%.

desc.对生命值低于50%的敌方，使我方全体造成的最终伤害提高25%: All allies deal 25% more Final DMG against enemies with HP below 50%.
desc.使用【暗艺】后，下1次【队长技】伤害提高50%，可叠加: After using [Shadowcraft], increase the DMG of the next [Leader Skill] by 50%. This effect stacks.
desc.【弃牌】指令冷却时间缩短1秒: Reduces the cooldown of the [Discard] action by 1 second.
desc.【飞电弹】增强为：\\n从弃牌区回收1张牌加入手牌，优先得意技能牌\\n基于回收:
Enhance [Lightning Shot]:

desc.自身每造成30次<color=#FFB800>【引雷】</color>时，下1次: When Nicola inflicts <color=#FFB800>[Electrify]</color> 30 times, every hit of her next [Basic Attack] inflicts <color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color>, and increase her ATK by 150, lasting 6 seconds.
desc.【链爆雷】爆炸时，有50%概率伤害加倍\\n触发该效果时，有50%概率将【多重装: When [Chained Grenade] explodes, there is a 50% chance for it to deal double DMG.\nWhen this effect is triggered, there is a 50% chance to enhance the effect inflicted by [Multiple Charges] to <color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Blaze]</color> or <color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color>.\nWhen both effects are triggered, there is a 50% chance for [Chained Grenade] to deal 10% more DMG, up to 150%.
desc.静流的水弹对目标造成【湿润】状态\\n使目标受到的电磁伤害增加35%\\n使目标:
Shizuru's water projectile inflicts [Moisture] effect on the target.
Increase the target's Electro DMG taken by 35%.
Reduce the target's Fire DMG dealt by 35%.
Increase the chance of inflicting <color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color> on the target by 10%.
desc.【无常】有33%概率对敌方目标附加随机1种【八苦】状态\\n每存在1种状态，敌方: [Anitya] has a 33% chance to inflict one random [Suffering] status on the target.\nFor each status present, increase the target's Final DMG taken by 8%.\n[Sufferings] include: Birth, Old Age, Illness, Death, Parting of Lovers, Meeting of Foes, Unfulfilled Longings, Blazing of Five Aggregates.
desc.我方场上每存在1个【机械单位】时，我方【机械单位】造成的最终伤害提高10%，上限: For each [Mech Unit] present on ally field, ally [Mech Units] deal 10% more Final DMG, up to 100%.
desc.\"Better better better\"\\n每有1名我方处于<colo: "Better better better"\nGain 0.05 Cost per second for each ally under <color=#FF6666>[Berserk]</color> effect.
desc.【白桦】拟态【尘鸣游鳞】/【昏厄巨象】/【凛川骨龙】时，使我方前排/中排/后排攻: When [White Birch] mimics [Sand Phosphor], [Chaos Behemoth] or [Glacial Skeleton], increase the ATK of allies in front, mid, or rear by 100 respectively, lasting 6 seconds.
desc.【大福号】发射火箭弹时，有15%概率从牌库将1张2费及以上卡牌加入手牌\\n使用: When [The Daifuku] launches a rocket, there is a 15% chance to add a 2+ Cost card from the deck to your hand.\nWhen using a 2+ Cost card, for each Cost above 2, [Katsuobushi Rocket] deals 50% more DMG.
desc.每只【机器狼】持续期间，为我方全体抵御12%伤害，可叠加\\n使用【队长技】或得: Each [Robotic K-9] reduces all allies' DMG taken by 12% when its on the field. This effect stacks.\nWhen using a [Leader Skill] or Ultimate card, gain <color=#7AB2FF>[Invisible]</color> and deploy one more [Robotic K-9], lasting 5 seconds.
desc.敌方每附着1枚【黏胶炸弹】，受到其他爆炸物伤害时，受到的爆炸物伤害增加15%，可: For each [Sticky Bomb] attached to the target, when the target takes DMG from other [Explosives], increase the DMG by 15%, stacking up to 90%.\nWhen this effect is triggered, the owner of that [Explosive] has their ATK increased by 1%, up to 50%.
desc.使用【茶时法则】抽到的卡牌，卡牌持有者攻击力+3%，上限60%: When using the card drawn by [Teatime Principle], increase the card holder's ATK by 3%, up to 60%.
desc.【彗尾姬】跟随期间，目标队友造成的最终伤害提高20%: When followed by [Lady Cometrail], increase the target ally's Final DMG dealt by 20%.
desc.【热应力】/【冷缩力】层数越高，敌方受到的火焰/冰冻伤害越高，最高50%: The more [Thermal Stress] or [Contraction Force] stacks, the more Fire or Frost DMG the enemy takes, up to 50%.
desc.每次自身<color=#7AB2FF>【隐形】</color>时，使自身与自身【: When Ren is <color=#7AB2FF>[Invisible]</color>, grant <color=#FF6666>[Berserk]</color> to her and her [Familiar].\nWhen Ren gains <color=#FF6666>[Berserk]</color>, remove 1 stack of [Inhibition].
desc.每次造成<color=#FF6666>【狂暴】</color>/<color=#: When inflicting <color=#FF6666>[Berserk]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Corrupt]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Injure]</color>, <color=#B383FF>[Confuse]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Scorch]</color> or <color=#B383FF>[Gaze]</color>, increase self ATK by 0.5%, up to 60%.
desc.场上每存在1只【瞵鸦】，每秒获得0.1点费用，可叠加: For each [Jackdaw] on the field, gain 0.1 Cost per second. This effect stacks.
desc.每使用3张自身技能牌，抽1张牌，基于费用移除等量层数的【抑制】: Whenever Ren uses 3 skill cards, draw 1 card, and remove a number of [Inhibition] stacks equal to the Cost of the drawn card.
desc.每有1张【元素新星】/【超新星】/【奇异火花】/【太初之光】被生成时，我方全体攻: Whenever generating 1 [Elemental Nova], [Supernova], [Strange Spark] or [Antediluvian Light], increase all allies' ATK by 3%, up to 60%.
desc.【墨尔斯】存在期间，每有1张【新星】/【元素新星】/【超新星】/【奇异火花】被【: When [Mors] is on the field, whenever 1 [Nova], [Elemental Nova], [Supernova] or [Strange Spark] is [Destroyed], immediately cast 1 [Nova], [Elemental Nova], [Supernova] or [Strange Spark].
desc.【墨尔斯】存在期间：\\n【新星】/【元素新星】所需费用-1\\n【超新星】/【: When [Mors] is on the field, reduce the Cost of [Nova] and [Elemental Nova] by 1, [Supernova] and [Strange Spark] by 2, and [Antediluvian Light] by 3.
desc.【星星】/【月亮】/【太阳】/【塔】持续期间，我方【使魔】/【新星】/【元素新星: When [The Star], [The Moon], [The Sun] or [The Tower] is in effect, increase the Final DMG dealt by ally [Familiars], [Nova], [Elemental Nova], [Supernova], [Strange Spark] and [Antediluvian Light] by 15%, up to 60%.
desc.每收集1枚【松果能量块】，使我方【爆炸物】造成的最终伤害提高5%，上限100%: For each [Pinecone Energy Block] collected, allies' [Explosives] deal 5% more DMG, up to 100%.
desc.每抽到1张带有【爆炸物】/【机械单位】词条的卡牌，【弃牌】指令冷却缩短1秒: For each card drawn with the [Explosive] or [Mech Unit] term, reduce the cooldown for [Discard] action by 1 second.
desc.每次我方造成<color=#FFB800>【轰雷】</color>/<color: Whenever an ally inflicts <color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color> or <color=#FFB800>[Bolt]</color>, heal the ally with the lowest HP for 1% or 3% of Max HP.
desc.每有1个【爆炸物】爆炸时，回复生命值最低的1名我方1%生命值\\n同时使目标防御: For each [Explosive] detonated, heal the ally with the lowest HP for 1% of Max HP, and increase their DEF by 0.5%, up to 50%.
desc.我方造成<color=#7AB2FF>【冻结】</color>/<color=#: When an ally inflicts <color=#7AB2FF>[Chill]</color>, <color=#7AB2FF>[Frostbite]</color>, <color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color> or <color=#7AB2FF>[Megafreeze]</color>, increase self ATK by 0.3%, 0.6%, 1.5% or 3% respectively, up to 99%.
desc.每次召唤【使魔】时，自身攻击力和防御力+2%，上限50%: Whenever summoning a [Familiar], increase self ATK and DEF by 2%, up to 50%.
desc.牌库每有1张卡牌，敌方全体受到的最终伤害增加1%，上限50%: For each card in your deck, all enemies take 1% more Final DMG, up to 50%.
desc.【恶魔】增强为：\\n召唤暗影使魔【倪克斯】和【厄瑞波斯】附身敌方目标，持续10:
Enhance [The Devil]:
Summon the shadow familiars [Nyx] and [Erebus] to possess the enemy, lasting 10 seconds. During this period:
Randomly inflict <color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Blaze]</color> or <color=#7AB2FF>[Frostbite]</color> to the target every second.
Whenever the target is inflicted with a negative effect, deal DMG once to it.
[Nyx] can respond to:
<color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color>, <color=#FFB800>[Bolt]</color>, <color=#FFB800>[Magnetize]</color>, <color=#FFB800>[Paralysis]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Blaze]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Wildfire]</color>, <color=#7AB2FF>[Frostbite]</color>, <color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Slash]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Rend]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Scorch]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Interrupt]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Stun]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Knockback]</color> and <color=#FF6666>[Launch]</color>.
[Erebus] can respond to:
<color=#FF6666>[Erode]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Corrode]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Injure]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Corrupt]</color>, <color=#B383FF>[Confuse]</color>, <color=#B383FF>[Sleep]</color>, <color=#B383FF>[Moemoe]</color>, <color=#B383FF>[Imprison]</color>, <color=#B383FF>[Fetter]</color>, <color=#B383FF>[Curse]</color>, <color=#B383FF>[Gaze]</color> and <color=#B383FF>[Hallucinate]</color>.
[Nyx] and [Erebus] are [Familiars].
[Nyx]'s ATK equals Masaki's ATK.
[Erebus]'s ATK equals Masaki's DEF.
desc.每次成为【教皇】的我方目标，叠加【圣杯】层数\\n每层【圣杯】使目标攻击力和防御: When an ally becomes [The Hierophant], stack [Cups] on them.\nEach stack increases their ATK and DEF by 30, up to 5 stacks.\nWhen another ally becomes [The Hierophant], remove all stacks.
desc.我方造成的<color=#FFB800>【轰雷】</color>有20%概率触发: <color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color> inflicted by allies has a 20% chance to inflict <color=#FFB800>[Bolt]</color>.\nWhenever an ally inflicts <color=#FFB800>[Bolt]</color>, gain 1 Cost.
desc.当前每拥有1点费用，我方全体造成的电磁伤害提高5%，上限100%: For each Cost you own, all allies deal 5% more Electro DMG, up to 100%.
desc.每次我方造成<color=#FFB800>【轰雷】</color>/<color: Whenever an ally inflicts <color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color> or <color=#FFB800>[Bolt]</color>, increase self ATK by 0.5% or 1.5%. up to 99%.
desc.开局时为我方队友叠加1层【凭依】层数\\n每使用3张【龙裔】的卡牌，获得1点费用:
Grant all allies 1 [Investiture] stack at the start of battle.
For every 3 [Dragonborn]'s cards used, gain 1 Cost.
For every 6 cards drawn, trigger <color=#FF6666>[Wildfire]</color> on the enemy field, and get a 45% chance to inflict <color=#FF6666>[Restless]</color> to self.
For every 9 cards added to the discard pile, <color=#FF6666>[Extinction]</color> deals 18% more DMG, up to 360%.
desc.每有1层【凭依】，红卡造成的最终伤害提高3%，上限60%: For each [Investiture] stack allies have, Red cards deal 3% more Final DMG, up to 60%.
desc.每次我方造成<color=#FF6666>【点燃】</color>/<color: When an ally inflicts <color=#FF6666>[Ignite]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Blaze]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Wildfire]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Immolate]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Heartblaze]</color> or <color=#FF6666>[Extinction]</color>, increase self ATK by 0.15%, 0.3%, 0.6%, 1.2%, 1.8% or 3.6% respectively, up to 99%.
desc.每有1名【龙裔】，自然回费速度提高20%，手牌补充冷却时间缩短0.2秒，【弃牌】: For each [Dragonborn] present, Cost recovers 20% faster, cards are replenished 0.2 seconds faster, and [Discard] action cools down 1 second faster.
desc.我方造成<color=#7AB2FF>【冻结】</color>/<color=#: When an ally inflicts <color=#7AB2FF>[Chill]</color>, <color=#7AB2FF>[Frostbite]</color>, <color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color> or <color=#7AB2FF>[Megafreeze]</color>, deal Frost DMG to the enemy with the highest HP over 1, 2, 3 or 4 hits respectively.
desc.【取其精粹】的上限提高至100%: [Keep the Marrow] can stack up to 100%.
desc.每次【凇附极结】造成伤害时，回复生命值最低的1名我方1%生命值: Whenever [Rime Accretion] deals DMG, heal the ally with the lowest HP for 1% of Max HP.
desc.每层【威压】使自身造成的最终伤害增加7%: For each [Pressure] stack, deal 7% more Final DMG.
desc.每14秒触发1次，受到伤害时，展开【机神力场】，使我方全体受到伤害降低49%，持: When taking DMG, deploy [Aegis of Mechanical God] that reduces all allies' DMG taken by 49%, lasting 7 seconds. This effect can be triggered once every 14 seconds.
desc.每次我方造成<color=#FF6666>【撕裂】</color>/<color: Whenever an ally inflicts <color=#FF6666>[Rend]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Slash]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Pierce]</color>, <color=#B383FF>[Corrode]</color> or <color=#FFB800>[Energy Devour]</color>, increase self ATK by 0.5%, up to 98%.
desc.每使用1张2费及以上的红卡/蓝卡/紫卡，随机发射1枚【碎岩者浮游钻】/【穿心者浮: For each 2+ Cost Red, Blue or Purple card used, randomly launch 1 [Rock Breaker Drill] or [Puncture Drone Drill].
desc.任意我方每超过开局生命值上限5%，造成的最终伤害提高1%，上限60%: For every 5% increase over the initial HP limit, our Final DMG is increased by 1%, up to 60%.
desc.每次【流光】造成回复时，同时使目标攻击力+0.5%，上限50%: Each time [Lumino] restores, it simultaneously increases the target's attack power by 0.5%, up to 50%.
desc.【流光宝石】每次触发效果时，有33%概率对敌方全体造成1段混响伤害，同时随机触发: [Lumino Gem]Each time the effect is triggered, there is a 33% chance to deal 1 segment of Reverb DMG to all enemies, while randomly triggering <color=#FFB800>[Lightning]</color>/<color=#FF6666>[Ignite]</color>/<color=#7AB2FF>[Chill]</color>\nThe higher the total HP/average attack power of all allies, the higher the DMG.
desc.每生成1枚【流光宝石】，抽1张牌，优先攻击力最高的我方的技能牌\\n【流光宝石】: For each Luminescent Gemstone generated, draw 1 card, prioritizing the skill card with the highest attack power on our side.\nDuring the duration of the Luminescent Gemstone, the Final DMG dealt by Derivatives is increased by 50%.
desc.每有1张黑卡在牌库/弃牌区/手牌中时，队长攻击力和防御力+15，上限150: For each Black card in the deck/discard pile/hand, the leader's attack and defense increase by 15, up to 150.
desc.每有1张卡牌被生成时，自身生命值上限+5%，上限300%\\n每有1张卡牌被回收: For every card generated, maximum HP +5%, up to 300% \nFor every card recycled, attack and defense +1%, up to 60%
desc.每次获得【钩沉】时，我方造成的负能伤害提高3%，上限60%: Each time you gain [Hook], our Reverengy DMG increases by 3%, up to 60%.
desc.每获得3点【同调】点数，自身攻击力+1%，上限99%\\n同时将此效果的1/3，: For every 3 points of [Synchronization] gained, increase own attack power by 1%, up to 99%\nAt the same time, share one-third of this effect with teammates who have [Symbiosis].
desc.每获得200点【同调】点数，生成1张【茸茸】加入手牌，可超出手牌上限: Every time you gain 200 [Tuning] points, generate 1 [Fluff] and add it to your Cards, which may exceed the hand size.
desc.【钩沉】在手牌中时，手牌上限+1\\n【钩沉】在弃牌区时，每秒获得0.1点费用，: [Dredge]When in hand, hand size +1\n\n[Dredge]When in discard pile zone, gain 0.1 Costs per second, can stack
desc.每【共生】1名未被【共生】的目标，自身造成的最终伤害提高20%，可叠加\\n每【: For each target not linked with Symbiosis, the user's Final DMG is increased by 20%, stackable.\nFor each target already linked with Symbiosis, the target's Final DMG is increased by 20%, stackable.
desc.每次使用【共生】时，立刻获得50点【同调】点数\\n【同调】点数达到100点时，: Each time you use [Symbiosis], immediately gain 50 [Harmony] points.\nWhen [Harmony] points reach 100, generate 1 [Symbiosis] to your Cards, exceeding the hand size, x1.
desc.我方【无人机】有20%概率额外释放1次: Our drone has a 20% chance to be released x1 additionally.
desc.每次牌库抽光触发洗牌时，基于场上【羽栖】数量获得等量费用: Whenever the deck is emptied and triggers a reshuffle
desc.每次牌库抽光触发洗牌时，抽1张牌，优先4费及以上卡牌，同时基于该卡费用使场上所有: Whenever the deck is emptied and triggers a reshuffle

des.希望与勇气的化身，联结世界之人。: Anthem of Hope & Bravery\nThe One Who Connects Worlds
des.在咖啡厅打工的卡塔斯。\\n咒魔剑姬也想当女仆！: Katas in maid dress at a cafe\nJumakenki wants to be a maid!

des.既然对上视线了，\\n那么，决斗！: Since our eyes meet, let's duel!

des.御敌枢纽的英雄。\\n这颗心不再为复仇燃烧，愿它的火焰能为你照亮前路。: Hero of The Destroyer\nSet not revenge on fire\nMay you be guided by the light

des.夏季装扮的亚莉奈。\\n似乎能从她身上闻到阵阵令人陶醉的香气。: Arina in summer outfit\nHer bodyline gives off a tipsy fragrance
des.夏季装扮的弗兰。\\n她的心中尚存如火焰般的热情。: Fran in summer outfit\nHer flaming enthusiasm sweeps over
des.夏季装扮的夏尔（和朱迪）。\\n沙滩太烫，踮起脚尖，眺望远方！: Shire (and Jude) in summer outfit\nOn tiptoe gazing into the distance
des.荒古桦树生物中的强大个体。\\n携来阴翳，携来光芒，携来毁灭。: A strong being in Primitive Chaos Remain\nThe giver of Shadow and Bright, also the bringer of atrocity
des.坚守法律、维护秩序，\\n守护铁路沿线安宁之人。: They who hold onto the rule of law\nThey who safeguard the perimeter of the railway in a lost world
des.澄明数据中心铁安局负责人莱卡吉亚。\\n终有一天，他会去往更为广阔的荒野。: The director of the BCRL Agency at CDCA Bureau\nThe expanse of the wilderness and a new horizon await
des.神盾系统研发者。\\n为了守护云岫桥的安定，为了整顿中心不被破坏！: The lead developer of A.O.S.\nAnything for the safety and continuity of the Reforming Center and Yunxiu Bridge!
des.尚未扛起摄像机的余淞导演。\\n不过，在他实现梦想前，还是别拿他打趣了。: Director Yusong before being a cameraman\nWell, stop teasing him while he's chasing dreams
des.整顿中心配置的普通缝纫机。\\n踩踏板，扯布匹，我们的生活多美丽~: A mundane sewing machine that is commonly seen in the Reforming Center.\nTreadle, Needle, Life without Shadow
des.荒原地区的帝王（前）。\\n说了多少次了，不许叫我汤姆！: King of Wilderness (Formerly)\n"I've told you a million times - DO NOT CALL ME TOM!"
des.活泼可爱的犬亚人小麦。\\n有时开开拖车，有时四处跑腿，为大家带来金色的笑容！: Komugi the happy-go-lucky\nA messenger of golden smile, running errands or driving towing locomotive, you name it.
des.不懈调查、追求事实，\\n叩响真实大门之人。: Fact-check and Investigation\nKnocks on the Door of Truth
des.守护淘金乐园的金子小姐。\\n再度建起的乐园，绝不容许任何人再破坏它。: Miss Gold the Guardian of Onederland\nA wonder park built from scratch, no one shall destroy it!
des.游走于各方之间的神秘角色，人如其名。\\n除去一片羽毛以外，还有什么能证明一只鸟: A walker in the shadow, a feather darkened\nA bird swung by, only the feather remained
des.在淘金大酒店事件中邂逅的“她”。\\n除去一片羽毛以外，还有什么方式能将鸟儿留在: A SHE you encountered in the Onederland Hotel\nWhat else could a bird leave other than a feather?
des.来自阿妮塔的小小探险家。\\n在世界的某个地方，一定能和要找的人相会！: An explorer from Anita\nFated to meet someone in her small yet big adventure
des.爆虫类桦树生物中负责生殖的强大个体。\\n它和它的子嗣总能以潮水之势归来。: A powerful breeding being in B.B.\nThe bringer of the B.B. army!
des.旧时代的淘金者，新时代的经理人。\\n有的时候，他只是期望一个安稳的归处。: The gold digger from the past, the manager in the new era\nA place to rest is where he seeks
des.踏上大冒险之人。\\n财富就在前方，我来，我见，我掷骰！: The one who embarks on a great journey\nFortune lies ahead. I came, I saw- The die is cast.
des.无垠号接待员的特殊装扮。\\n欢迎乘车！: Crew onboard The Eternal\nWelcomes your boarding!
des.娃娃鱼先祖之魂（已被除名）。\\n门可罗雀，愁云惨淡，家贫如洗……: Ancestor of Salamanders (Expelled)\nMishap, Depression\nA Poverty-Stricken Life
des.娃娃鱼先祖之魂。\\n财源广进，喜事临门，黄金滚滚来！: Ancestor of Salamanders\nFortune, Happiness\nAnd Gold, Please Knock on the Door!
des.神奇的可操纵骰子。\\n骰子骰子，顺我心意——: A maneuverable dice of magic\nDice, dice, wish me...
des.“化物”中常见的一种。\\n特征是相当可爱。泥嚎！: A conventional Metaplasia characterized by their loveliness.\nListen - Hello!
des.“化物”中稀有的一种。\\n特征是由多个泥嚎箱子拼接而成。嗷呜！: A rare Metaplasia\nAn ouroboros of Howling Boxes\nListen - Howling!
des.异乡而来的神秘骏城。\\n以“甲铁城”之名，驰骋于轨道之上。: Hayajiro from beyond the horizon\nOn the rails the Iron Fortress bolts into distance
des.被一段丝带所系之人。\\n短暂地从中解放，跃入战场——: The past ribbons behind her\nBreak free from the bound and dive into the battle
des.追求无尽自由之人。\\n束缚这具身体，是为了追求未来。: Seeker of unbounded freedom\nBereft freedom of the present is to earn a future
des.异界而来的神秘存在，\\n拥有被钢铁皮膜包裹的心脏。: The contact of alien creatures from beyond the world\nHeart being surrounded by an iron cage
des.异界而来的神秘存在？\\n或者，它其实曾经是……: The contact of alien creatures from beyond the world\nOr maybe it's the other way around
des.化作“钢之心”的苍叶。\\n贯穿那颗燃烧着的心脏。拯救她。: Aoba caught in the iron cage\nPierce the flaming heart open and save her
des.紧握武器之人。\\n贯穿，钢铁之心！: Piercing gun and Conductor the brave\nDrive bullets into the iron hearts!
des.役使法术之人。\\n这玩意可比武器好使多了！: One who wields magic.\nThis stuff works way better than weapons!
des.解开锁链、直面自身命运之人。\\n现在，我就把钥匙交给你了哦？: One who breaks her chains and faces her destiny head-on.\nNow then, shall I hand you the key?
des.接受记忆、接受全新生活之人。\\n现在，我想要以新的名字活下去。: One who embraces her memories and a brand-new life.\nFrom now on, I wish to live under a new name.
des.仅仅是一位故事讲述者。\\n一个故事的可能是无尽的，但总有人要选出其中一种，将它: Just a simple teller of tales.\nA story may have endless possibilities, but someone must choose one and pass it on.
des.诱惑孩子们前来自己身边的魔女。\\n来呀，我亲爱的，我的唯一……: A witch who lures children to her side.\nCome, my dear... my one and only...
des.步入悲哀终末的魔女。\\n留在这里，留在我的身边。: A witch walking toward a sorrowful end.\nStay here... stay with me.
des.一座由梦与美构建的城市。\\n尽情欢笑吧，直到忘记归途！: A city built from dreams and beauty.\nLaugh freely—until you forget the way home!
des.博览幻象之人。\\n幻象来自真实，真实创造幻象。你看见了什么？: The person who explores illusions.\nIllusions stem from reality, and reality in turn creates illusions. What do you see?
des.攀登真理天梯的学者。\\n路途纵然危险，可不迈开那一步的话，人类终将一无所知。: Scholars are climbing the ladder of truth.\nThe journey is detrimental; However, without taking that step, humanity will ultimately know nothing.
des.于攀登途中坠落的天使。\\n真理如此遥远，以致于她必须亲自以身相试。: The Angel who fell during the ascent.\nTruth is so distant that she must personally test it herself.
des.持有“裂穹”的天使。\\n在她的欢笑中，一切尽化作碎片。: The wielder of Realmbreaker.\nIn her laughter, everything shatters into pieces.
des.失去人类之心的天使。\\n以此为代价，祂换得了什么？: An Angel who has lost the heart of humanity.\nDid the cost yield anything?
des.如暴风般降临的天使。\\n想要赶上她的速度，人类还早了一百年呢！: Like an Angel arriving in a storm.\nIt will take humans another hundred years to catch up with her speed!
des.潜藏无数秘密的装置。\\n深潜其中，研究它，掌握它。: A device filled with countless secrets.\nDive deep into it, study it, master it.
des.与异界来客关系匪浅的机体，\\n有着会吞噬其驾驶者的传说。: A mech closely related to visitors from another world, there is a legend that it will consume its pilot.\n
des.于荒原上等待的观测者。\\n她的话语总是有着重要的意义，而她的缄默有时代表更多。: An observer waiting on the wasteland.\nHer words always carry significant meaning, while her silence sometimes signifies even more.
des.独具慧眼的引领者。\\n跟随她所引导的微光，抵达未知之地……: A uniquely insightful leader.\nFollow the glimmer she guides to reach the Unknown...
des.神秘的存在，很难说那其中究竟是不是有着一颗“心”。\\n然而，你心里一定有答案了: Mysterious existence, it's hard to say whether there is really a "heart" within it.\nHowever, you surely have an answer in your heart, right?
des.揭晓隐秘之人。\\n藏于其中的，必将暴露于外；显示于表的，必将蜕化为里。: Reveal the secret person.\nWhat is hidden inside will inevitably be exposed outside; what is shown on the surface will inevitably transform to the inside.
des.可疑的先知。嘴缝起来了。\\n被称为“布罗斐特”的神秘存在……？: Suspicious prophet. Mouth sewn shut.\nA mysterious presence known as the "Brothet"…?
des.至高无上的“枢纽”。\\n知晓一切，驾驭一切，包括午夜兔。: The supreme "Hub".\nKnowing everything, controlling everything, including Midnight Rabbit.

brief.无垠号一行人受托去铁盟哨站送货，顺便看看在那里执勤的多萝西又做了什么“好事”。话: The Eternal and its crew have been assigned the task of delivering a package to the BCRL Outpost and checking on Dorothy's latest mischiefs. By the way, why does everyone assume that Dorothy must be causing trouble?
brief.一条署名“沙盗团夏尔大人”的消息出现在了列车长收件箱里，附件里还有黑月大酒店的房: You receive a message signed by "Lord Shire of P.U.S." in the inbox, with a room number of Night Chains Hotel. What will she request this time?
brief.今夜，亚莉奈在“荚蒾”等待着你。她的微笑、她调配的饮品，以及手中的“白色佳人”，: Tonight, Arina is waiting for you at "Viburnum." Her smile, her drink, and the "White Lady" in her hand are consistent as usual.
brief.应对亚健康状况的唯一途径就是通过锻炼增强体魄！——道理是这么说，但卡洛琳帮助你获: The only solution to suboptimal health is to strengthen yourself through exercise! However, Caroline's method of aiding in physical enhancement may not be so gentle.
brief.为了从曼德矿场的列车武装的工厂取回送修的武装，你在深夜拜访了那里。苔妮取出两瓶“: You visit the train weapon factory in Mander Mine late at night to retrieve your repaired weapons. Tennie takes out two bottles of "Family Special Beverage" and shares them with you.
brief.星花特意发邮件说希望和你在7号自由港的咖啡厅碰面。平时总是独自解决问题的天才研究: Stella requests a meeting at the cafe in Freeport Ⅶ. This talented researcher typically solves problems independently. What issue has she encountered?
brief.在途径澄明数据中心时，为了完成日常工作而拜访了铁安局。结果这次拜访，却意外成为了: While passing by the CDCA Bureau, you visit the BCRL Agency to complete daily work. As a result, this visit unexpectedly became an opportunity to experience a wonderful day with Lycagia...
brief.应黑月安保部门发出的邀请，你带着波克士一同前往黑月大酒店，参与战斗模拟。然而，看: At the invitation of the Night Chains security department, you and Box go to the Night Chains Hotel to participate in a combat drill. However, amidst what seems like a peaceful task, a small thorn appears.
brief.乌刹娜在无垠号上的表现很好，为了奖励她的认真工作，无垠号向索思学会提交了一封特殊: Ushana behaved well on the Eternal. To reward her diligent work, the Eternal submitted a special outing application to Source Citadel. Ushana is going to the amusement park! But will things really go so smoothly?
brief.这天，你在无垠号上发现了一张写明了时间、地点、以及“请求协助”的纸条。如约到达地: This day, you discovered a note on The Eternal specifying the time, place, and a "request for assistance." After arriving at the location as promised, you met a devil hunter... thus begins your brief collaboration with the devil hunter!

tips.正在环境中生成猫毛: Generating cat hair in the environment.
tips.正在阻止负片中微子溢出车厢: Preventing negative neutrino overflow from the carriage.
tips.列车调度指令传输中: Transmission of train dispatch instructions in progress.

tips.为列车长梦中的那杯完美咖啡调配最佳气压和温度: Adjusting optimal air pressure and temperature for the perfect coffee dreamt by you.
