tips.正在安装录像带监控系统，确保列车安全运行: Installing the monitoring system to ensure safe train operation.
tips.正在启动车载现实稳定装置，确保乘客免受形态污染影响: Initiating onboard reality stabilizer to protect passengers from morphic field pollution.
tips.警告：列车正在接受形态共振按摩，颠簸正常，请勿惊慌！: Warning: The train is undergoing a morphic resonance massage. Bumps are normal, please remain calm!
tips.由于形态共振干扰，列车可能短暂成为旋转木马，请抓紧扶手！: Due to morphic resonance interference, the train may briefly become a carousel, please hold onto the handrail!
tips.由于形态共振影响，列车可能暂时具有弹力，请勿在车厢内模仿袋鼠跳跃！: Due to morphic resonance, the train may temporarily become elastic, please refrain from kangaroo jumping inside the carriage!
tips.由于形态共振，列车将暂时具有海绵特性，请勿拧干！: Due to morphic resonance, the train will temporarily exhibit sponge-like characteristics, do not wring dry!
tips.形态共振波动中，列车可能短暂成为悬挂式过山车，请保持冷静！: During morphic resonance fluctuations, the train may briefly become a suspended roller coaster, please remain calm!
tips.由于形态共振影响，火车可能短暂变成橡皮筋，禁止在车厢内赛跑！: Due to morphic resonance, the train may briefly turn into a rubber band, no races inside the carriage!
tips.形态共振干扰导致列车内部迷宫出现，请勿走失！: Due to morphic resonance interference, a maze may appear inside the train, please do not get lost!
tips.高度形态共振区域，列车可能暂时缩小，请勿吃奶酪！: In highly morphic resonance areas, the train may temporarily shrink, please refrain from eating cheese!
tips.列车正在驶离冷聚变形态共振区域，暂时拥有无限动力，请勿在车厢内洗澡！: The train is leaving the cold fusion morphic resonance area, temporarily having unlimited power. Please refrain from bathing inside the carriage!
tips.形态污染加速波动中，列车暂时变为巨型蛋糕，请勿试图品尝车厢内的座位！: Morphic field pollution is accelerating, causing the train to temporarily transform into a giant cake. Please refrain from attempting to taste the seats inside the carriage!
tips.由于形态共振干扰，列车暂时具备强烈电磁特性，请勿在车厢内用磁铁玩拔河比赛！: Due to morphic resonance interference, the train temporarily exhibits strong electromagnetic properties. Please refrain from playing tug-of-war with magnets inside the carriage!
tips.由于形态污染影响，列车暂时变为巨型乐高积木，请勿在车厢内尝试砌墙！: Due to morphic field pollution, the train temporarily transforms into giant LEGO bricks. Please refrain from attempting to build walls inside the carriage!
tips.由于冷聚变干扰，列车暂时具备雪人制造能力，正在为乘客定制个性雪人。请勿向雪人讲冷: Due to cold fusion interference, the train temporarily gains the ability to create snowmen, customizing personalized snowmen for passengers. Please refrain from telling jokes to the snowmen, as they might actually melt!
tips.列车正在驶入冷聚变形态共振区域，不要讲冷笑话！不要讲冷笑话！不要讲冷笑话！: The train is entering the cold fusion morphic resonance area. Do not tell jokes! Do not tell jokes! Do not tell jokes!
tips.正在重启车载现实稳定装置，列车将短暂拥有极光效果，请勿在车厢内举行假面舞会！: Restarting the onboard reality stabilizer. The train will briefly have aurora effects. Please refrain from holding masquerade parties inside the carriage!
tips.【科伦巴商会】\\n隶属于铁道同盟的大型商会，拥有十数辆在运列车，承担着重要的货: [COLUMBA]\nAffiliated with the B.C.R.L., operates numerous trains and plays a significant role in freight and passenger transport.
tips.【TMT培训学校】\\n为了培训与选拔列车组乘员而建立的学校，从业培训为期一年，: [TMT Training School]\nIt was established to train and select crews, with a one-year vocational training program and strict graduation requirements.
tips.【铁盟】\\n环大陆铁道同盟的简称，拥有所有铁道线路的管理权限，负责铁道铺设、安: [Bonfire City Railways League]\nAbbreviated as the B.C.R.L., it has authority over all railway lines and is responsible for railway construction, security, and other important tasks.
tips.【铁安局】\\n铁盟为了维护铁道沿途与篝火城的安全和秩序设立的具有武装性质的治安: [BCRL Agency]\nIt was established by the B.C.R.L. to maintain the safety and order of the railways along the route to Bonfire City.
tips.【篝火城】\\n基于现实稳定装置的覆盖范围与铁路运输的客观要求建立的要塞型城市。: [Bonfire City]\nA fortress-like city established based on the coverage of the reality stabilizer and the objective requirements of railway transportation.
tips.【共振】\\n“形态共振”的简称，指形态场之间产生的特定频率的震荡。: [Resonance]\nShort for "morphic resonance," refers to the specific frequency oscillations between morphic fields.
tips.【形态污染】\\n本身的形态共振受到外来或者特殊形态场共振影响，进而出现了异化现: [Morphic Field Pollution]\nIt refers to the phenomena of inherent morphic resonance being influenced by external or special morphic field resonance, resulting in anomalies.
tips.【现实稳定装置】\\n人类最伟大的发明之一，巨大的保护装置，通过桦石催化，可以发: [Reality Stabilizer]\nOne of humanity's greatest inventions, it is a massive protective device that, catalyzed by Chaos Stone, emits an enhanced human morphic field to suppress pollution.
tips.【桦树生物】\\n临界之后大量出现在地表的特殊生物体，形态各异，具有威胁性。: [Chaos Remain]\nUnique creatures that appear in large numbers on the surface after the Solstice, each with diverse forms and posing a threat.
tips.【深眠者】\\n遭受形态污染的程度过重的人类个体会被转变为丧失理智的深眠者。: [Deep Sleeper]\nIndividuals who have been heavily affected by morphic field pollution and have lost their sanity.
tips.【升构者】\\n遭受形态污染之后，保留理智并且觉醒了特殊能力的人类个体。: [Ascender]\nHumans who, after being affected by morphic field pollution, retain their sanity and awaken special abilities.
tips.【地卫二】\\n突然出现在星球同步轨道，带来了“临界”灾难的外来天体。: [Morphic Moon]\nA celestial body that suddenly appeared in synchronous orbit around the planet, bring about the catastrophic event known as the 'Solstice.'
tips.【黑月】\\n全名为黑月锁链的世界级大财团。业务范围覆盖现代人的方方面面，势力不: [Night Chains]\nA world-class mega-corporation known as Night Chains. Its business scope covers various aspects of modern life, and its influence is considerable.
tips.【仙女木公司】\\n目前世界排名第一的老牌武器生产商，历史悠久，值得信赖。: [DRYAS CORPORATION]\nThe top-ranked veteran weapon manufacturer in the world, with a long history and a reputation for reliability.

content.亲爱的列车长，\\n感谢您对科伦巴商会的大力支持，相信有您的支持商会发展会越来越: Dear Conductor,\nThank you for your strong support of the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce. With your support, we believe the Chamber will thrive more and more! COLUMBA upholds the philosophy of "mission accomplished" and sends you investment rewards, wishing you continued freedom to drive The Eternal with ease!

desc.人类通过物种独有的形态共振形成了知觉和自我认知的基础——集体潜意识，通常被称为荣: Humans form perception and self-awareness through their species' unique morphic resonance — the collective unconsciousness, often referred to as the Jungian consciousness. After the arrival of Morphic Moon, some individuals have been contaminated by its foreign morphic field to such an extent that the self-defense mechanism of the Jungian consciousness excludes their morphic field, resulting in these individuals losing their human form and cognition. It has been observed that some humans, after becoming Deep Sleepers, exhibit behavior similar to Chaos Remains. Some scientists speculate that Chaos Remains may also possess a collective unconsciousness similar to the Jungian consciousness, which accepts Deep Sleepers. However, this theory lacks evidence.
desc.形态共振是形态场之间进行作用的主要形式。值得一提的是，在地球生物漫长的进化过程中: Morphic resonance is the primary form of interaction between morphic fields. It's worth mentioning that throughout the long evolutionary process of Earth's organisms, some species have evolved strong, collective morphic resonance, which influences the environment to become more habitable. Humans are particularly unique in this aspect. Through morphic resonance, humans form the foundation of perception and self-awareness, known as the collective unconsciousness.
desc.又称“共振污染”或被简称为“污染”。现在的地球环境是地球和其上生物的形态场共同塑: Also known as "resonance pollution" or simply "pollution." The current Earth's environment is the stable form shaped over billions of years by the morphic fields of Earth and its organisms. Therefore, with the arrival of Morphic Moon and its foreign morphic fields, this stable form has been disrupted. This phenomenon, where the originally balanced morphic resonance between objects is disrupted by foreign morphic fields, is called "morphic field pollution." Morphic field pollution has become the most serious environmental crisis facing humanity, surpassing global warming and ozone layer depletion.
desc.人类潜意识集合的总称，人类形态共振的主要来源，在地卫二事件之后才被确认存在，拥有: The collective unconsciousness of humanity, the main source of human morphic resonance, was only confirmed to exist after Morphic Moon incident. It contains all the information of every entity conceptually considered human, with its specific nature and principles still poorly understood. There is evidence that indicates that the Citadel has learned methods to enter and acquire knowledge from it.
desc.尽管升构者形成的原因种类繁多，但其本质都是被外来形态场污染过的人类，且他们产生的: <size=19>Although there are various reasons for the formation of Ascenders, they all share a common essence: Humans contaminated by foreign morphic fields, whose resonance is powerful enough to reshape reality in a short time. The most common cause for ordinary people to become Ascenders is severe morphic field pollution, without being rejected by the Jungian consciousness and turning into Deep Sleepers. However, the reasons for this are currently unknown. There is also a mystery surrounding Ascenders: Why do the abilities evolved by the vast majority of Ascenders have practical utility? One hypothesis suggests that Ascenders are not excluded from the Jungian consciousness because the Jungian consciousness deems their abilities useful, allowing them to become immune bodies against pollution, which is a form of self-evolution of the Jungian consciousness. Those Ascenders without value are abandoned by the Jungian consciousness and become Deep Sleepers. However, this hypothesis also has many inconsistencies, such as some Deep Sleepers having practical ascension abilities. Therefore, there is a niche theory that suggests Ascender's abilities actually originate from the guidance of Morphic Moon.</size>
desc.仅存在于帝国的特殊升构者。其特征为自身出现类似幻想生物的异变，或者衍生出相关的升: Special Ascenders existing only within the Empire. They exhibit characteristics such as spontaneous transformation resembling mythical creatures or the emergence of related Ascension Abilities. The causes are unknown.
desc.潜入人类潜意识集合——意识海获取知识后，潜入者的人格会根据所寻求知识的不同而被完: After infiltrating the collective unconsciousness of humanity — Unbewusstes — to acquire knowledge, the infiltrator's personality will be completely replaced based on the knowledge they seek. These newly transformed beings are referred to as "Angels," and the curse of knowledge manifests as a halo that constantly accompanies them.
desc.升构者使用升构能力时，由桦树空间侵入的负片中微子携带的能量。可以用产生负能的多少: The energy carried by negative neutrinos that invade from the chaos space when Ascenders use their abilities. It can be used as a quantitative standard for the strength of reality-shaping abilities by determining the amount of Reverengy generated, or as a means of attack.
desc.地卫二出现在地球同步轨道，其携带的外来形态共振影响了地球本身的现实稳定，造成了难: Morphic Moon appeared in Earth's synchronous orbit, and its foreign morphic resonance carried an influence that disrupted Earth's own reality stability, causing an enduring catastrophe. This event is referred to as the "Solstice."
desc.隶属于铁道同盟的大型商会，拥有数十辆在运列车，承担着重要的货运与载客职责。: A large chamber of commerce affiliated with B.C.R.L., operates numerous trains and plays a significant role in freight and passenger transport.
desc.全称为TransMemberTest资格证培训学校。由铁盟授权，各商会经办，网点: The full name is the Transport Member Test Certification Training School, authorized by B.C.R.L. and managed by various CoCs. Its branches are distributed in training schools across major Bonfire Cities. It offers training courses tailored to different professions within crews. Candidates are selected by various CoC or railway universities, with relatively low entry requirements but stringent graduation criteria. Despite the challenging prospects for employment within Bonfire Cities, many young people still participate in training and examinations year after year due to the difficulty of obtaining the TMT certification.
desc.西大陆铁路环线西岸的主要港口之一。受到桦树生物活动以及形态污染的影响，如今的航海: One of the primary ports along the Western Continent Railway Loop. Due to Chaos Remains and morphic field pollution, the maritime and fishing industries have seen better days. Nevertheless, Freeport Ⅶ remains a coastal gem.
desc.环大陆铁道同盟的简称，拥有所有铁道线路的管理权限，负责铁道铺设、安保等重要工作的: The abbreviation for Bonfire City Railways League, which holds authority over all railway routes, managing tasks such as railway laying and security.
desc.铁盟为了维护铁道沿途与篝火城的安全和秩序设立的具有武装性质的治安行政机构。: An armed administrative body established by BCRL to ensure safety and orderliness along the line leading to Bonfire City.
desc.基于现实稳定装置的覆盖范围与铁路运输的客观要求建立的要塞型城市。在地卫二到来后的: Fortress-like cities established based on the coverage of the Reality Stabilizer and the requirements of railway transportation. After the arrival of Morphic Moon, residing in Bonfire City means safety and stability.
desc.负责保卫列车组安全的武装乘员，也叫列车护卫队。抵御列车在运行途中遭遇劫匪及桦树生: Armed crew responsible for safeguarding the security of the train, also known as the Train Escort. They fend off attacks from bandits and Chaos Remains during train operations.
desc.72年前观测到的地外天体，曾被称作“未知负片中微子源”，在其抵达地球同步轨道后被: Previously known as the "Unknown Negative Neutrino Source" when observed 72 years ago, it was later termed "Morphic Moon" upon its arrival in Earth's synchronous orbit. The foreign morphic field it carries has disrupted the stability of Earth's intrinsic morphic field resonance, leading to severe environmental damage.
desc.前身为地联航空航天局位于南极的“阿妮塔实验室”，他们是负片中微子以及桦树世界的发: Formerly known as the "Anita Laboratory" of the Earth Union Space Administration located in Antarctica, they were the discoverers and pioneers of Negative Neutrinos and the chaos world, thriving on the unique resource known as "Chaos Stone." As the provider and maintainer of train engines and morphic field stabilizers, Anita Global Energy Corp has powered countless trains with robust engines.
desc.可以发射经强化过的人类本身的形态场，从而压制地卫二带来的污染。篝火城用的现实稳定: Capable of emitting a reinforced human morphic field to suppress the pollution brought by Morphic Moon. Bonfire City utilizes colossal towers as reality stabilizers, generally requiring groups of eight to function. These devices, while vital for ensuring the safety and stability of large urban populations, are immensely large and complex, prone to accidents. However, they play an indispensable role in humanity's redevelopment. Reality stabilizers use Chaos Stone or Chaos Residue as fuel. When these high-power devices are activated, their morphic fields collide with those of Chaos Remain, resulting in aurora-like phenomena. Hence, in the current world, "auroras" are no longer rare sights. The Citadel provided significant technological support during the design process of reality stabilizers.
desc.正式名称为负片中微子生物，经证实来源于桦树空间，后因桦树空间与现实世界的重合，也: Officially known as Negative Neutrino Organisms, they were confirmed to originate from the chaos space. Due to the overlap between the chaos space and the real world, they are widespread in the latter. Research on the ecology of Chaos Remains is still an emerging field, and our understanding is limited. However, it is established that while they vary in species, most are unable to communicate and hold hostility toward humans.
desc.科伦巴商会创立者&现任会长，虽然业内知名度很高但本人相当低调，很少出现在外界场合: The founder and current president of COLUMBA, despite being highly regarded in the industry, maintains a low profile and seldom appears in public.
desc.作为西大陆铁路环线上的新兴商业城市，修格里的工业发展以及城市化进程十分迅速。近年: As a burgeoning commercial hub along the Western Continent Railway Loop, Shoggolith City has experienced rapid industrialization and urbanization. In recent years, iconic skyscrapers have sprung up, showcasing the city's rapid development.
desc.以浮空舰为基地的神秘组织，掌握了世人难以想象的知识与科技，自诩为人类文明的保卫者: A mysterious organization based on an airship, they possess knowledge and technology beyond ordinary comprehension, styling themselves as defenders of human civilization. The birth of [Reality Stabilizer] is closely linked to this organization.
desc.偏振探测器，又称“响立逃”，最为普及的形态污染监测装备。早期，一般民众缺少专业的: <size=20>Polarization detectors, also known as "Flee Alarms," are the most common equipment for monitoring morphic field pollution. Early on, the general public lacked professional means of morphic field pollution detection, so they came up with the method of carrying a portable gaming console for judgment. When stable games display abnormal issues, it indicates that the morphic field pollution level nearby has exceeded a certain standard. Currently, professional organizations use detectors that rely on measuring the energy carried by Negative Neutrinos brought about by resonance pollution to determine the current pollution level. However, these detectors also need to analyze the bugs in the background running game program to determine the current reality shift situation.\nIn conclusion, these detectors are essentially gaming consoles. Some members of the Citadel believe this method is very childish, but whenever asked how they measure morphic field pollution, they remain silent.</size>
desc.活跃于修格里城的地下帮派，以旧时代的地下铁路为基地。: Operating in Shoggolith City, this underground faction utilizes the old underground railways as their base.
desc.世界知名的老牌武器生产商，历史悠久，值得信赖。: The renowned veteran weapon manufacturer, with a rich and illustrious history, is considered a trusted name in the industry.
desc.黑月集团旗下的高端酒店。: A high-end hotel under the umbrella of Night Chains.
desc.名为黑月锁链的商业集团，业务范围涵盖娱乐业方方面面，但有小道消息称，黑月私下也有: A business conglomerate with its fingers in various entertainment pies, rumored to have a shadowy side, dabbling in activities such as assassination, espionage, and arms dealing.
desc.由前“地联”与阿妮塔科技共同开发的多功能仿生机器人，用于辅助人类进行各种技术工作: A multi-functional bionic robot jointly developed by the former Earth Union and Anita Tech to assist humans in various technical tasks.
desc.共振形态等级之一，对应形态偏移等级8-10的桦树生物，可以威胁到一些防备薄弱的篝: One of the resonance form levels, corresponding to Chaos Remains with morphic deviation levels 8-10, poses a threat to some of the less fortified areas of Bonfire City.
desc.从属于修格里城的矿业基地，是修格里城最大的工业原材料产地。: Affiliated with Shoggolith City, the mining base stands as the largest industrial raw material production site in the region.
desc.铁安局下属机动小队的其中一支。: One of the mobile squads under the jurisdiction of BCRL Agency.
desc.曼德矿场负责人，荷塞市长的部下。: The head of Mander Mine, also serving as an aide to Mayor Jose.
desc.铁安局修格里分部的代理局长，多萝西的父亲。: The acting director of BCRL Agency's Shoggolith branch, and Dorothy's father.
desc.在荒原地区“搁浅”于陆地上的船只，原本是阿妮塔的科研船，不知为何出现在距离海岸线: A research vessel belonging to Anita, "stranded" in the Wilderness far from the coastline for unknown reasons.
desc.旧时代的全大陆联合政府，铁盟与阿妮塔都曾是地联的下属部门，如今早已成为历史。: The former global united government, with Bonfire City Railways League and Anita once serving as subordinate departments, now exists only in memory.
desc.地联时代的科技产物，集合了多种工程与建筑功能，篝火城建设时期发挥了极大作用，但现: Technological relics from the Earth Union era, featuring a blend of engineering and architectural functionalities, played a crucial role in the construction of Bonfire City but now lie mostly abandoned.
desc.在荒原上游荡，以拾荒为主要生存手段的团体，意外的算是很强的暴力团伙。: Roaming the wilderness, surviving primarily by scavenging, this group unexpectedly operates as a formidable group.
desc.铁盟的法庭机关，任何涉及铁路的案件都交由该机关审理。: The judicial arm of Bonfire City Railways League, responsible for adjudicating cases related to railway matters.
desc.阿妮塔的发明之一，据说可以在现世世界和桦树空间之间穿梭。: One of Anita's inventions, rumored to facilitate travel between the present world and the chaos space.
desc.共振形态等级之一，对应形态偏移等级6~8的桦树生物，对人类构成威胁的桦树生物大部: One of the resonance form levels, corresponding to Chaos Remain with morphic deviation levels 6-8, constitutes the majority of threatening Chaos Remains to humans.
desc.一种特殊的巨型桦树生物，有着与其余桦树生物不同的行动逻辑，往往会带来巨大的灾害。: A special type of colossal Chaos Remain, exhibiting different behavioral patterns from other Chaos Remains, often causing significant disasters.
desc.西大陆最大的临海港口城市，虽然海运业务减少，但海产品依然供不应求。: The largest seaport city in the Western Continent. This city continues to experience high demand for seafood despite a decline in the sea transportation business.
desc.索思学会在海角城建立的“学社”，也即学会的分部。: The "Climber" established by the Citadel in Cape City as a Citadel branch.
desc.二十多年前建立于此的，为淘金者服务的小镇。: A town established over 20 years ago to serve gold diggers.
desc.原型为谢尔德雷克假说，假说提出了一种广泛存在于世间万物，能塑造万物形态的场态物质: Based on the Sheldrake Hypothesis, which proposes a pervasive field substance capable of shaping all forms in the world. This theory was confirmed 72 years ago following observations of the effects of Negative Neutrino lifeforms.
desc.比起桦石更容易采集的某种次级形态场产物，也因此被称为劣桦石，可作为能源使用。: A secondary morphic field product, easier to harvest than Chaos Stones, referred to as Chaos Residues, used as a source of energy.
desc.形态场失稳区域，处于现实世界和桦树空间叠加状态的区域。: Regions experiencing an overlay of the real world and the chaos space, typically characterized by severe morphic field pollution.
desc.活跃于沙漠戈壁地区的赏金猎人团伙。: A group of bounty hunters active in desert regions.
desc.由帕帕加研究制造的对桦树生物武器，可以使被捕住的桦树生物的能力一段时间内无效。: Weapon manufactured by Papaga specifically to neutralize the abilities of captured Chaos Remains for a limited time.
desc.园丁对于某种强大的、大范围的桦树生物活动现象的总称。: A general term used by Gardener to refer to powerful and widespread activities of Chaos Remains.
desc.负潮现象必然由某个强大的活体桦树生物引发，对这些引发负潮的生物，统称为负潮主。: The phenomenon of ebb tides is inevitably triggered by a powerful living Chaos Remain, collectively referred to as the Ebb Tide Master.
desc.在地卫二到来之后，曾经的统一政府“地球联合宪章”丧失行政能力，变得名存实亡，铁路: After the arrival of Morphic Moon, the once-unified government under the "Earth Union Charter" lost its administrative capacity, becoming virtually defunct. In its place, the City Alliance formed by cities along the railway lines began to govern autonomously. Over the years, the Bonfire City Railways League, in addition to major cities, has incorporated various CoCs. Together with these CoCs, B.C.R.L. undertakes the responsibilities of railway transportation and railway facility maintenance.
desc.在遥远古老的过去，曼杜斯的先祖因为某些原因与同胞决裂，遭到了放逐。他们在某处洞穴: In the distant past, Mundus' ancestors broke away from their kin for unknown reasons and were exiled. They established the first magic academy within a cave. Through their magical research, they eventually connected with an entity beyond the real world — the Wishing Tower. Using its power, Mundus' ancestors reached a place called Mundus Garden, where they founded a nation. For a significant period, they remained isolated from the surface world, having no interaction with it.
desc.虽然叫神茗，但曼度斯口中的神主要指的是曼度斯花园中央的许愿塔。由于这种茶是由许愿: Although called "Divine Tea," in Mundus' parlance, "divine" primarily refers to the Wishing Tower at the center of Mundus Garden. This tea is cultivated by the sage within the Wishing Tower, hence revered as Divine Tea by the people of Mundus.
desc.传说中，为了不让许愿塔的力量被滥用，被帝国魔法学院选出管理许愿塔的贤者，现任塔之: Legend has it that to prevent the misuse of the Wishing Tower's power, a sage selected by the Empire Magic Academy manages the tower. The current Tower Sage is the 73rd in line. In imperial culture, the Tower Sage is a household name, known for granting children's wishes during festivals. He is typically depicted as a grandfatherly figure with a large beard.
desc.除了神出鬼没的流民与拾荒者，这里什么也没有。所幸还有未被风沙掩埋的铁轨，它是这片: Apart from the elusive drifters and marauders, there's nothing here. Fortunately, there are still train tracks not yet buried by the sandstorms; they are the only connection between this desolate land and Bonfire City. However, no train will stop here.
desc.简称北阵，曾经是掌控了北方大陆的超级大国。在世界大战中败于东西联合政权之手，随着: Also known as N.A. for short, Northern Alliance was once a dominant force that governed the northern continent. However, it was defeated by the United East-West Regime during the World War and gradually disintegrated after the establishment of the Earth Union.
desc.铁盟自治后，部分北阵人也想趁机脱离地联恢复独立国家，但未成气候，只有一些原属北阵: Following the autonomy of Bonfire City Railways League, some individuals from Northern Alliance attempted to break away from the Earth Union and establish an independent nation. However, this endeavor failed, resulting in only a few warlords from Northern Alliance forming a revival organization.
desc.地卫二降临后大陆通用的通讯设备，由黑月锁链研发。如今的长距离通讯主要依靠黑月构建: Developed by Night Chains, this communicator has become widely utilized worldwide since the emergence of Morphic Moon. At present, long-distance communication heavily relies on the Negative Neutrino Communication Network constructed by Night Chains. The network employs numerous Night Chains members as base stations, ensuring high stability and minimal interference.
desc.形而上粒子领域重要研究成果的诞生地，研究内容均为机密，谢绝一切参观。: The significant hub for groundbreaking research in the field of metaphysical particles. The research conducted at this facility is highly classified, and no visits are allowed.
desc.建设修格里城时的物资中转站。因其地理位置特殊基础设施完备，修格里城建成后被铁盟作: This location previously served as a transit hub for materials during the construction of Shoggolith City. Due to its strategic positioning and complete infrastructure, it was later repurposed by Bonfire City Railways League as an outpost.
desc.以负片中微子为代表的一系列新发现的微观粒子的总称。这类粒子并不是自然界存在的基本: A general term referring to a series of recently discovered microscopic particles, notably negative neutrinos. These particles are not naturally occurring fundamental particles but are solely associated with anomalous morphic resonance. Consequently, their physical properties are highly correlated with the nature of morphic field.
desc.位于地下的篝火城，知名度假村以及游戏厂商“十合游”的所在地。同时该地也为篝火城的: An underground Bonfire City, also renowned for its resort and game studio, 10rounds Games. This site holds significance as it provides calibration data for the reality stabilizer in Bonfire City.
desc.10 Rounds games。世界知名游戏厂商，办公楼位于澄明数据中心。但只有: 10rounds Games is a globally recognized game developer with its headquarters located in CDCA Bureau. However, only its operational and publishing departments are based there, while the R&D department operates from an undisclosed location.

tipsDesc.遭受形态污染之后，丧失了理智的人类个体。: Individuals who have lost their sanity after being affected by morphic field pollution.
tipsDesc.“形态共振”的简称，形态场之间进行作用的主要形式。: Resonance, short for morphic resonance, is the primary form of interaction between morphic fields.
tipsDesc.物体间原本平衡的形态共振被外来形态场打破的现象，被称为“形态污染”。: The disruption of originally balanced morphic resonance between objects by foreign morphic fields is termed "morphic field pollution."
tipsDesc.人类潜意识集合的总称，人类形态共振的主要来源，在地卫二事件之后才被确认存在，拥有: The collective unconsciousness of humanity, the main source of human morphic resonance, was only confirmed to exist after Morphic Moon incident. It contains all the information of every entity conceptually considered human, with its specific nature and principles still poorly understood.
tipsDesc.遭受形态污染之后，保留理智并且觉醒了特殊能力的人类个体。: Individuals who retain their sanity and awaken special abilities after being affected by morphic field pollution.
tipsDesc.仅存在于帝国的特殊升构者。其特征为自身出现类似幻想生物的异变，或者衍生出相关的升: Special Ascenders existing only within the Empire. They exhibit characteristics such as spontaneous transformation resembling mythical creatures or the emergence of related Ascension Abilities.
tipsDesc.潜入人类潜意识集合——意识海获取知识后，潜入者的人格会根据所寻求知识的不同而被完: After infiltrating the collective unconsciousness of humanity — Unbewusstes — to acquire knowledge, the infiltrator's personality will be completely replaced based on the knowledge they seek. These newly transformed beings are referred to as "Angels."
tipsDesc.从桦树空间侵入的负片中微子所携带的能量，一般用产生负能的多少，来作为升构能力强度: The energy carried by negative neutrinos that invade from the chaos space, generally used to judge the intensity of ascension abilities based on the amount of Reverengy they generate.
tipsDesc.地卫二出现在地球同步轨道，其携带的外来形态共振影响了地球本身的现实稳定，造成了难: Morphic Moon appeared in Earth's synchronous orbit, and its foreign morphic resonance carried an influence that disrupted Earth's own reality stability, causing an enduring catastrophe. This event is referred to as the "Solstice."
tipsDesc.隶属于铁道同盟的大型商会，拥有数十辆在运列车，承担着重要的货运与载客职责。: A large chamber of commerce affiliated with B.C.R.L., operates numerous trains and plays a significant role in freight and passenger transport.
tipsDesc.TMT培训学校。为了培训与选拔列车组乘员而建立的学校，从业培训为期一年，毕业条件: TMT Training School. It was established to train and select crews, with a one-year vocational training program and strict graduation requirements.
tipsDesc.西大陆铁路环线西岸的主要港口之一。受到桦树生物活动以及形态污染的影响，如今的航海: One of the primary ports along the Western Continent Railway Loop. Due to Chaos Remains and morphic field pollution, the maritime and fishing industries have seen better days. Nevertheless, Freeport Ⅶ remains a coastal gem.
tipsDesc.环大陆铁道同盟的简称，拥有所有铁道线路的管理权限，负责铁道铺设、安保等重要工作的: The abbreviation for Bonfire City Railways League, which holds authority over all railway routes, managing tasks such as railway laying and security.
tipsDesc.铁盟为了维护铁道沿途与篝火城的安全和秩序设立的具有武装性质的治安行政机构。: An armed administrative body established by BCRL to ensure safety and orderliness along the line leading to Bonfire City.
tipsDesc.基于现实稳定装置的覆盖范围与铁路运输的客观要求建立的要塞型城市。在地卫二到来后的: Fortress-like cities established based on the coverage of the Reality Stabilizer and the requirements of railway transportation. After the arrival of Morphic Moon, residing in Bonfire City means safety and stability.
tipsDesc.负责保卫列车组安全的武装乘员，也叫列车护卫队。抵御列车在运行途中遭遇劫匪及桦树生: Armed crew responsible for safeguarding the security of the train, also known as the Train Escort. They fend off attacks from bandits and Chaos Remains during train operations.
tipsDesc.72年前被观测到，并于30年前抵达地球同步轨道的地外天体，形态污染灾害的主要成因: An extraterrestrial celestial body observed 72 years ago and reaching Earth's synchronous orbit 30 years ago. The primary cause of the morphic field pollution disaster.
tipsDesc.全球领先的科技巨头，列车引擎以及形态场稳定器的专利方。: The global leader in technology, holding patents for both train engines and morphic field stabilizers.
tipsDesc.人类当代工程奇迹，可以发射强化过的人类本身的形态场，以排斥桦树生物进入及消除形态: A contemporary engineering marvel of humankind, capable of emitting reinforced human morphic fields to repel Chaos Remains and eliminate the effects of morphic field pollution.
tipsDesc.地卫二事件之后大量出现在地表的奇特生物，种类繁多，但大多对人类抱有敌意。: Morphic Moon's appearance in Earth's synchronous orbit brought about a multitude of peculiar creatures on the planet's surface, most of which harbor hostility toward humans.
tipsDesc.科伦巴商会创立者&现任会长，虽然业内知名度很高但本人相当低调，很少出现在外界场合: The founder and current president of COLUMBA, despite being highly regarded in the industry, maintains a low profile and seldom appears in public.
tipsDesc.作为西大陆铁路环线上的新兴商业城市，修格里的工业发展以及城市化进程十分迅速。近年: As a burgeoning commercial hub along the Western Continent Railway Loop, Shoggolith City has experienced rapid industrialization and urbanization. In recent years, iconic skyscrapers have sprung up, showcasing the city's rapid development.
tipsDesc.自古以来知识和科技的探索者、掌握者和监管者，具备许多常人无法理解甚至想象的先进技: Since ancient times, they have been explorers, masters, and overseers of knowledge and technology, possessing advanced techniques beyond the comprehension or imagination of ordinary individuals.
tipsDesc.俗称“响立逃”，用于测试周围环境和物体形态污染程度的小型装置，据说本体其实是个游: Commonly known as "Flee Alarm," it's a small device used to test the extent of environmental and object morphic field pollution. It is said that its true form is a gaming console.
tipsDesc.活跃于修格里城的地下帮派，以旧时代的地下铁路为基地。: Operating in Shoggolith City, this underground faction utilizes the old underground railways as their base.
tipsDesc.世界知名的老牌武器生产商，历史悠久，值得信赖。: The renowned veteran weapon manufacturer, with a rich and illustrious history, is considered a trusted name in the industry.
tipsDesc.黑月集团旗下的高端酒店。: A high-end hotel under the umbrella of Night Chains.
tipsDesc.名为黑月锁链的商业集团，业务范围涵盖娱乐业方方面面，但有小道消息称，黑月私下也有: A business conglomerate with its fingers in various entertainment pies, rumored to have a shadowy side, dabbling in activities such as assassination, espionage, and arms dealing.
tipsDesc.由前“地联”与阿妮塔科技共同开发的多功能仿生机器人，用于辅助人类进行各种技术工作: A multi-functional bionic robot jointly developed by the former Earth Union and Anita Tech to assist humans in various technical tasks.
tipsDesc.共振形态等级之一，对应形态偏移等级8-10的桦树生物，可以威胁到一些防备薄弱的篝: One of the resonance form levels, corresponding to Chaos Remains with morphic deviation levels 8-10, poses a threat to some of the less fortified areas of Bonfire City.
tipsDesc.从属于修格里城的矿业基地，是修格里城最大的工业原材料产地。: Affiliated with Shoggolith City, the mining base stands as the largest industrial raw material production site in the region.
tipsDesc.铁安局下属机动小队的其中一支。: One of the mobile squads under the jurisdiction of BCRL Agency.
tipsDesc.曼德矿场负责人，荷塞市长的部下。: The head of Mander Mine, also serving as an aide to Mayor Jose.
tipsDesc.铁安局修格里分部的代理局长，多萝西的父亲。: The acting director of BCRL Agency's Shoggolith branch, and Dorothy's father.
tipsDesc.在荒原地区“搁浅”于陆地上的船只，原本是阿妮塔的科研船，不知为何出现在距离海岸线: A research vessel belonging to Anita, "stranded" in the Wilderness far from the coastline for unknown reasons.
tipsDesc.旧时代的全大陆联合政府，铁盟与阿妮塔都曾是地联的下属部门，如今早已名存实亡。: The former global united government, with Bonfire City Railways League and Anita once serving as subordinate departments, now exists only in memory.
tipsDesc.地联时代的科技产物，集合了多种工程与建筑功能，篝火城建设时期发挥了极大作用，但现: Technological relics from the Earth Union era, featuring a blend of engineering and architectural functionalities, played a crucial role in the construction of Bonfire City but now lie mostly abandoned.
tipsDesc.在荒原上游荡，以拾荒为主要生存手段的团体，意外的算是很强的暴力团伙。: Roaming the wilderness, surviving primarily by scavenging, this group unexpectedly operates as a formidable group.
tipsDesc.铁盟的法庭机关，任何涉及铁路的案件都交由该机关审理。: The judicial arm of Bonfire City Railways League, responsible for adjudicating cases related to railway matters.
tipsDesc.阿妮塔的发明之一，据说可以在现世世界和桦树空间之间穿梭。: One of Anita's inventions, rumored to facilitate travel between the present world and the chaos space.
tipsDesc.共振形态等级之一，对应形态偏移等级6~8的桦树生物，对人类构成威胁的桦树生物大部: One of the resonance form levels, corresponding to Chaos Remain with morphic deviation levels 6-8, constitutes the majority of threatening Chaos Remains to humans.
tipsDesc.一种特殊的巨型桦树生物，有着与其余桦树生物不同的行动逻辑，往往会带来巨大的灾害。: A special type of colossal Chaos Remain, exhibiting different behavioral patterns from other Chaos Remains, often causing significant disasters.
tipsDesc.西大陆最大的临海港口城市，虽然海运业务减少，但海产品依然供不应求。: The largest seaport city in the Western Continent. This city continues to experience high demand for seafood despite a decline in the sea transportation business.
tipsDesc.学会在海角城建立的“学社”，也即学会的分部。: The "Climber" established by the Citadel in Cape City as a Citadel branch.
tipsDesc.二十多年前建立于此的，为淘金者服务的小镇。: A town established over 20 years ago to serve gold diggers.
tipsDesc.本身的形态共振受到外来或者特殊形态场共振影响，进而出现了异化现象。: Under the influence of external or unique morphic field resonance, it has undergone anomalous transformations.
tipsDesc.比起桦石更容易采集的某种次级形态场产物，也因此被称为劣桦石，可作为能源使用。: A secondary morphic field product, easier to harvest than Chaos Stones, referred to as Chaos Residues, used as a source of energy.
tipsDesc.处于现实世界和桦树空间叠加状态的区域，一般来说形态污染非常严重。: Regions experiencing an overlay of the real world and the chaos space, typically characterized by severe morphic field pollution.
tipsDesc.活跃于沙漠戈壁地区的赏金猎人团伙。: A group of bounty hunters active in desert regions.
tipsDesc.由帕帕加研究制造的对桦树生物武器，可以使被捕住的桦树生物的能力一段时间内无效。: Weapon manufactured by Papaga specifically to neutralize the abilities of captured Chaos Remains for a limited time.
tipsDesc.园丁对于某种强大的、大范围的桦树生物活动现象的总称。: A general term used by Gardener to refer to powerful and widespread activities of Chaos Remains.
tipsDesc.负潮现象必然由某个强大的活体桦树生物引发，对这些引发负潮的生物，统称为负潮主。: The phenomenon of ebb tides is inevitably triggered by a powerful living Chaos Remain, collectively referred to as the Ebb Tide Master.
tipsDesc.偏振探测仪所显示数值的绝对值，代表当前环境形态场与宜居形态场的偏差大小。: The absolute value displayed on the polarization detector, representing the deviation of the current morphic field from a habitable one.
tipsDesc.铁路沿线城市与商会组成的自治组织。: Autonomous organizations composed of cities and CoCs along railway lines.
tipsDesc.在遥远古老的过去，曼杜斯的先祖因为某些原因与同胞决裂，遭到了放逐。他们在某处洞穴: In the distant past, Mundus' ancestors broke away from their kin for unknown reasons and were exiled. They established the first magic academy within a cave. Through their magical research, they eventually connected with an entity beyond the real world — the Wishing Tower. Using its power, Mundus' ancestors reached a place called Mundus Garden, where they founded a nation. For a significant period, they remained isolated from the surface world, having no interaction with it.
tipsDesc.虽然叫神茗，但曼度斯口中的神主要指的是曼度斯花园中央的许愿塔。由于这种茶是由许愿: Although called "Divine Tea," in Mundus' parlance, "divine" primarily refers to the Wishing Tower at the center of Mundus Garden. This tea is cultivated by the sage within the Wishing Tower, hence revered as Divine Tea by the people of Mundus.
tipsDesc.传说中，为了不让许愿塔的力量被滥用，被帝国魔法学院选出管理许愿塔的贤者，现任塔之: Legend has it that to prevent the misuse of the Wishing Tower's power, a sage selected by the Empire Magic Academy manages the tower. The current Tower Sage is the 73rd in line. In imperial culture, the Tower Sage is a household name, known for granting children's wishes during festivals. He is typically depicted as a grandfatherly figure with a large beard.
tipsDesc.除了神出鬼没的流民与拾荒者，这里什么也没有。所幸还有未被风沙掩埋的铁轨，它是这片: Apart from the elusive drifters and marauders, there's nothing here. Fortunately, there are still train tracks not yet buried by the sandstorms; they are the only connection between this desolate land and Bonfire City. However, no train will stop here.

However, it was defeated by the United East-West Regime during the World War and gradually disintegrated after the establishment of the Earth Union.

However, this endeavor failed, resulting in only a few warlords from Northern Alliance forming a revival organization.

At present, long-distance communication heavily relies on the Negative Neutrino Communication Network constructed by Night Chains. The network employs numerous Night Chains members as base stations, ensuring high stability and minimal interference.

These particles are not naturally occurring fundamental particles but are solely associated with anomalous morphic resonance. Consequently, their physical properties are highly correlated with the nature of morphic field.
