tipsDesc.10 Rounds games。世界知名游戏厂商，办公楼位于澄明数据中心。但只有: 10rounds Games is a globally recognized game developer with its headquarters located in CDCA Bureau. However, only its operational and publishing departments are based there, while the R&D department operates from an undisclosed location.

describe.持有治安协力许可的列车长，有维护篝火城周边以及铁路沿线稳定的义务。: The Conductor holding a public security assistance permit is obligated to maintain the stability around Bonfire City and along the railway line.
describe.在列车周边进行战斗演习，模拟可能发生的各种情况，生成新的【战斗记忆体】。: Conduct combat exercises around the train, simulating various situations that may happen, and generate new [Combat Records].
describe.在周边地区巡逻，搜集散逸的思维。完成巡逻可获得【原始思维】。: Patrol the surrounding areas and collect scattered thoughts. Complete the patrol to obtain [Primitive Thinking].
describe.在周边地区巡逻，将思维具现化。完成巡逻可获得【数字化思维】。: Patrol the surrounding areas to materialize thoughts. Complete patrols to obtain [Digital Thinking].
describe.在周边地区巡逻，搜集、提炼可用于装备强化的材料。完成巡逻可获得【星云物质】。: Patrol the surrounding areas to gather and refine materials that can be used to enhance equipments. Complete patrols to obtain [Nebula Matter].

des.学会的贤者在迷宫中捕获的生命体。万物生灭变化无常，透过这只眼睛，可以看透其中奥妙: This life form was captured in the Fabricate by the scholars of the Citadel. All things undergo a constant cycle of birth and death, and through this eye, one can catch a glimpse of the mysteries of existence.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.与追求暗艺和奇异火花的派系不同，制作这把武器的人认为让普通人也能使用魔法的力量才: Unlike the faction that pursues Shadowcraft and Strange Spark, the creator of this weapon believes in empowering ordinary individuals with magical abilities. Even in the hands of a commoner, this weapon possesses devastating power.
des.若将其置于完全的黑暗之中，一种学会也无法完全理解的古老力量便会被召唤出来。其结果: When placed in complete darkness, it summons an ancient power that not even the Citadel can fully comprehend, which often results in catastrophic consequences.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.改造自桦树世界发现的未知科技造物。阿妮塔的技术并不能让其全功率运转，只能随时间逐: This device is an adaptation derived from an enigmatic technological creation discovered in the chaos world. Due to limitations in Anita's technology, it is unable to operate at its fullest capacity, and its energy can only incrementally increase over time. It is estimated that after 34 years of uninterrupted operation, it will emit enough rays to potentially destroy the world, although this is still far from reaching its limit.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.黑月收藏的一件来自神秘东方的古物，从其斩断万物的特性到保存方法，在帝国人看来毫无: An ancient artifact from the mysterious east, collected by Night Chains. Its remarkable ability to cut through anything and its unique preservation methods have garnered widespread belief among the Empire citizens that it possesses the power of magic. However, the origins and principles underlying its magic differ from those of Mundus, and the true secret may only be known to Night Chains.\n [Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.地联研制的明显使用了危险技术的武器，但由于其威力过于恐怖，学会也不敢贸然前往回收: This weapon, developed by the Earth Union, harnesses evidently hazardous technology. Its power is so formidable that even the Citadel refrains from recovering it. The mere presence of this weapon hinders the Earth Union's Jupiter exploration project.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.这是学会少有的纯粹用于破坏的武器，并不需要什么高维、时间线还有形态共振之类的玄乎: This weapon is a rare creation of the Citadel with a singular purpose of destruction. It does not incorporate high-dimensional, timeline, or morphic resonance technology. As long as the temperature is high enough, there is nothing that it cannot melt.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.被没收的拾荒者装甲，涂满了仙人掌汁。拾荒者普遍认为仙人掌在对抗形态污染方面有奇效: Confiscated marauder armor coated in cactus juice. It is widely believed by marauders that cactus works wonders in combating morphic field pollution and can also be used for healing.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.使人放松心情舒缓神经的的符咒，有人将其贴在计算机上后，增强了内存的运行效率。: A talisman that helps people relax and calm their nerves. It was once attached to a computer, enhancing its RAM operation efficiency.
des.被没收的朱迪的发射器，原本的设计并不方便家禽使用，于是改造成了可以挂在雁形目生物: Confiscated from Jude, this launcher was not originally designed to be fowl-friendly and later adopted a structure that could be hung from a goose. While humans can use it too, its efficiency depends on the user's posture.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.可以调动一种被称为“天雷”的神秘电能，原本用作战斗，但也能用来给设备充电。: A charm that harnesses a mysterious energy called "celestial thunder." While primarily used for combat, it can also recharge electronic devices.
des.自动部署到战场，利用上面的八卦镜使战场的风水有利于我方。: Automatically deployed in battle, this drone uses Trigram Mirror to create favorable Fengshui effects on the battlefield.
des.被强力落雷升构能力击中过的深眠木，对一般的深眠者和桦树生物有震慑效果。: DS Wood struck by lightning summoned through an ascension ability, possessing the power to deter ordinary Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains.
des.指挥八架无人机布阵，其阵法的力量能轻易镇压大型桦树生物。\\n【此装备同编队内不: A formation formed by eight drones, its power strong enough to subdue large Chaos Remains with ease.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.高污染地区的居民们猎杀骨龙后用龙骨制成的盔甲，穿上它不仅能克制桦树生物，对荒野中: Armor crafted from the bones of Bone Dragons hunted in the heavily polluted regions. It not only provides protection against Chaos Remains but also deters outlaws.
des.将关于黎明的许愿的魔法回音直接注入到盔甲的材料之中，使得该材料制造的护甲具有了恢: The magical echoes of wishes offered to the dawn are directly infused into the armor-forging material, granting the armor crafted from it inherent life-restoring properties. As this material was only ever produced once in recorded history, it is exceedingly rare.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.一位在云岫桥“悟道”的天才工程师制作的一种工具，可以在墙壁上制造两个相连的传送通: A tool invented by a talented prisoner at Yunxiu Bridge, enabling the creation of two interconnecting portals on walls. However, since the exit was too high above ground level, his escape attempt resulted in severe injury, and his tool was damaged. As a result, the exit portal has been permanently fixed in his cell.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.撰文迷宫的检索装置，其中心的石板被认为来源于迷宫自身的意志，被学会的先贤打捞出来: A retrieval device for the Fabricate, salvaged by the sages of the Citadel, featuring a central tablet believed to embody the will of the Maze itself.
des.用来猎杀大型怪物的大威力左轮枪，一般人难以驾驭。: A high-powered revolver for hunting large monsters, difficult for ordinary people to handle.
des.学会早期用来穿透意识海，试图探测人类深层无意识所制造的装置，在挥动时会干涉人的精: A device designed by the Citadel to delve into Unbewusstes and explore mankind's deep subconscious. When activated, it causes mental interference.
des.一块来自桦树空间的岩石，硬度极高，非常适合用于给对手造成最后一击。: A rock from the chaos space, with extremely high hardness, perfect for delivering the final blow to opponents.
des.模拟脉冲星制造的计时装置，有着超越原子钟的精度，并以每秒一千次自转的频率进行光速: A time-keeper imitating a pulsar, boasting precision surpassing an atomic clock. It emits light-speed pulses at a frequency of a thousand revolutions per second, capable of releasing powerful pulses in a fixed direction after being constrained by the restraint device.
des.学会的科技，帝国的魔法，地联的撮合。三大势力伺候这一把武器。使用者会获得三大势力: Tech from the Citadel, magic from the Empire, mediation from the Earth Union. The three major powers serve this weapon. The user gains combat experience from the three major powers, becoming more courageous with each combat.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.可以使自身变成无限非概率状态，使护甲的原子与宇宙中随机角落的原子互相纠缠，从而把: Able to transit the wearer to a non-probabilistic state, entangling atoms within the armor with particles in random corners of the universe, thus deflecting incoming attacks.
des.来自一个不存在形态共振的世界的神秘科技制品。经过地联科技的简单修复之后能发射出神: A mysterious technological artifact from a world without morphic resonance. After simple repairs by EU Tech, it emits a mysterious signal, but attempts at reverse engineering have failed. Its design does not conform to the laws of physics in this world, but it occasionally receives messages from another world. That world seems to be aware of our existence and is observing us.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.阿妮塔科技在过去研制的一种小型手枪，专门针对恶劣环境中的使用情形开发。特点是结实: A small pistol developed by Anita Tech in the past, specifically for use in harsh environments. It's sturdy, portable, and capable of rapid firing.
des.如何赋予物体加速度一直是学会乐于研究的课题，学会长久以来为了这个目的设计了大量或: How to impart acceleration to objects has long been a subject of study for the Citadel. Over the years, the Citadel has designed numerous devices, large and small, for this purpose. This device is widely regarded as simple, efficient, and easy to produce. Of course, it can also be used as a weapon, as any moving object requires external force to stop.
des.帝国魔法师学徒使用的法杖。: A staff used by apprentice mages of the Empire.
des.黑月执行人所使用的暗器，涂有剧毒。: Used by executors of Night Chains, coated with potent poison.
des.园丁随身携带的一种万用工具，由第一位来到桦树空间探索的园丁先驱者开发雏形，经过数: Carried by Gardener for various tasks, initially developed by pioneer Gardener exploring the chaos space, it has been improved over time to include welding, cutting, and combat functions. To prevent accidental injuries, it must be stored in a wooden case when not in use.
des.召唤自己的祖父年轻时的投影，使其代为承受攻击。但因为祖父悖论的存在，攻击会被排除: Summon a projection of wearer's grandfather in his youth to take the attack on the wearer's behalf. However, due to the grandfather paradox, the attack will be excluded from the world line.\n[This gear is unique.]
des.感觉像是会出现在卡通动画里的拥有夸张效果的电磁铁，据说加装在大型工业车辆前方就能: This equipment seems like an exaggerated electromagnet from animated shows. It is believed to have the ability to propel large vehicles by attaching it to the front of vehicles, generating endless power. Due to its excessive strength, it was deemed hazardous and confiscated by Base Yunxiu Bridge.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.铁盟的制式军队装备，当士兵弹尽粮绝时，至少这把刀还能依靠。: BCRL's standard military equipment. When soldiers run out of ammunition, at least this knife can still be relied upon.
des.一种营养丰富的便携口粮，口味很难说得上好，可以快速恢复食用者战胜敌人后损失的精力: A portable ration with an unsatisfactory taste, it quickly replenishes the energy lost by the consumer after defeating enemies.
des.前超级大国北阵研发的一种武器，应用了被学会列入了《109种会毁灭世界的危险科技》: A former superpower Northern Alliance's weapon developed using nuclear tech listed in the "109 Dangerous Technologies That Could Destroy the World" by the Citadel. It can self-charge rapidly. Its data and other replicas have been retrieved and destroyed by the Citadel.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.一种浓缩过的功能饮料，口味独特，可以快速补充饮用者战胜敌人后失去的能量。: A concentrated functional beverage with a unique taste, it quickly replenishes the energy lost by the consumer after defeating enemies.
des.套在手雷外面的加装组件，使手雷爆炸时会有更大的威力。: A component attached to grenades, enhancing their explosive power when detonated.
des.穿着这种材料的人能在保持理智的情况下得到类似深眠者的形态场，能在释放需要大量能量: Wearing this material, individuals can maintain a morphic field similar to a Deep Sleeper, enabling more efficient energy utilization when releasing energy-consuming abilities.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.黑月为特殊战斗人员制造的护甲，在帝国人看来，这种护甲毫无疑问利用了被帝国称为“魔: An armor designed by Night Chains for specialized combatants. No doubt it incorporates the technology that the Empire calls "magic", but its underlying principles diverge from the mainstream methods prevalent in the Empire.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.黑月收藏的另一件古物，并未检测出任何魔法痕迹或者形态场异常，一度被认为只是普通工: An ancient artifact from Night Chains' collection. No magic traces or morphic field anomalies are detected on it, making it seem like an ordinary handicraft, but it revealed miraculous powers when its owners face mortal peril, guiding them to safety in miraculous ways. Following such interventions, the magatama always broke unexpectedly, and it was always repaired as a normal handicraft.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.说谎遭雷劈，所以能增加引雷几率。: Lying shall be punished by lightning strikes, so it can increase the rate of Electrify.
des.撰文迷宫里巡逻的神秘实体所携带的武器，人类对该实体和这件武器的来源尚且知之甚少。: Weapon carried by mysterious entities patrolling the Fabricate. Humans know little about this entity and the origin of this weapon.
des.地联黄金时期的科技产物，能最大化保护使用者的生命安全。现在的铁盟已经失去了制造这: A technological relic from the Golden Age of the Earth Union, providing maximum protection. BCRL can no longer produce such advanced armor.
des.黑月叛逃人员使用的防具，其上的黑月标志被破坏，代表着其前主人反抗黑月的决心。若前: A headband worn by Night Chains defectors, featuring a defaced Night Chains symbol symbolizing their resolve for rebellion. In the case of a potent Ascender wearing it, their unwavering determination can imprint the headband, resulting in enigmatic protective properties.
des.帝国研究的抵御秘能的材料: Made from special materials developed by the Empire for resisting arcane energies.
des.对学会的贤者们来说，知识就是生命，所以保存知识就是保存自己的生命。于是他们制造了: For the sages of the Citadel, knowledge is life. Thus, safeguarding knowledge is akin to safeguarding life itself. They developed such devices to store their memories and wisdom externally, ensuring that even in the event of fatal bodily harm, their lives would endure beyond their physical existence.
des.一块未知来源的奇异非晶体化石，其内部闪烁着一个仍在运转的完整星系。经过超高倍率的: A peculiar non-crystalline fossil with a galaxy contained within. Microscopic observation reveals the orbit of its stellar system.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.许愿塔的光芒并非来自太阳，按地联科学家的话说其星光来源于一颗B型恒星。而帝国的学: Earth Union scientists propose that the light emanating from the Wishing Tower originates not from the sun, but from a B-type star. Imperial scholars offer a more nuanced perspective, suggesting the presence of a companion star, and they have even harnessed this celestial power to create a magical staff.
des.黑月为特殊战斗人员打造的武器，与古物糜草龙雀有着类似的“魔法”技术。不知是黑月从: A weapon designed by Night Chains for specialized combatants, developed using a similar "magic" technology as the ancient artifact "Kusa Ryujaku." No one knows if Night Chains rediscovered this tech from the artifact, or the skill of crafting such a weapon was never truly lost.
des.使用桦石制造的一种违背现实物理法则的第二类永动机，如果不用大量的能量维持，它会不: Second-type perpetual motion machine made with Chaos Stone. A violation of physical laws, if not supplied with a large amount of energy to sustain it, it will continuously absorb heat from the environment until it melts itself.
des.现实稳定装置中用于给设备紧急降温的工具，后来被现实稳定装置的保安在紧急情况下用于: A device originally designed for cooling the Reality Stabilizer during emergencies, later repurposed by security personnel to quell riots. This device has the ability to make metals brittle, proving effective against non-military armor in combat situations.
des.代号为尼克塔尔的学会先导去世前制造的装置，据说是其理解的宇宙终极难题的答案。但没: This device was crafted by a Citadel sage known as "Nictar" before his passing. Although believed to hold the key to the ultimate mystery of the universe, it has never exhibited any known function besides eradicating all life within its range.
des.ANITA的研究员对球状闪电这一自然现象的研究结果，最终发现球状闪电并不是普通的: Anita researchers studying ball lightning have discovered that it is actually not a standard electrical discharge but rather connected to the collapse of wave functions of elementary particles. This mysterious force can disrupt the structure of matter in an unpredictable manner, even at the particle level. Following the development of this prototype, the Citadel discovered their risky research and confiscated the prototype.
des.学会研究声学的贤者发现的现象，展示了振动频率如何影响振动表面上的驻波模式。后来在: Discovered by a Citadel scholar during his study of acoustics, this phenomenon demonstrates how vibrational frequency influences standing wave patterns on vibrating surfaces. A similar observation was later noted in research on morphic resonance. This device adjusts the user's morphic field to optimize its impact on the target.
des.黑月为特殊战斗人员打造的动力外骨骼，能极大增强防御力和力量，这与黑月一贯的隐秘作: Exoskeletons designed by Night Chains for specialized combatants. These devices significantly enhance the wearer's defense and strength. While this may appear contradictory to Night Chains' typical secretive nature, even they must confront formidable foes directly on occasion.
des.高污染地区的居民们手工制造的陀螺，熟悉自己陀螺运行方式的居民们，能通过陀螺旋转和: A gyroscope crafted by residents living in heavily polluted regions. These individuals, familiar with gyroscope operation, can gauge pollution levels through subtle changes in the gyroscope's rotation and sway.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.10rounds开发的游戏《无垠乱斗》中专用的神秘测试武器，不好说是剑还是枪还是: A mysterious test weapon exclusively used in the game "The Eternal Scuffle" developed by 10rounds. It's hard to say whether it's a sword, a gun, or something else. Never mind that, why not give it a try?\nThis gear is only used for "The Eternal Scuffle," and the gear affixes will change in each session.
des.10rounds开发的游戏《无垠乱斗》中专用的神秘测试护甲装备，会随着玩家的游戏: A mysterious test armor exclusively used in the game "The Eternal Scuffle" developed by 10rounds. It will change its effects as the player's game progress and unlock status evolve... it's basically random! \nThis gear is only used for "The Eternal Scuffle," and the gear affixes will change in each session.
des.10rounds开发的游戏《无垠乱斗》中专用的神秘测试饰物。有的游戏角色穿戴以后: A mysterious test accessory exclusively used in the game "The Eternal Scuffle" developed by 10rounds. Some game characters appear lively and cute when wearing it, while for others, it's better left unworn.\nThis gear is only used for "The Eternal Scuffle," and the gear affixes will change in each session.
des.刚进入曼杜斯时，帝国经历了瘟疫、饥荒、战乱和严寒，后来帝国人战胜了这四种灾难，并: Upon first entering Mundus, the Empire experienced plague, famine, war, and severe cold. Later, the people of the Empire overcame these four disasters and crafted this amulet, symbolizing the sealing of these four calamities. Although the Empire did not rely solely on magic to overcome these disasters, the significance represented by the amulet still endows it with special magical power.
des.包含了一根神秘生物羽毛的魔杖，就有强大的力量。据说世界上还存在另一根用同样羽毛制: A wand containing a mysterious creature's feather, possesses great power. It is said that there is another wand in the world made with the same feather; that one is male, and yours is female. When the two wands meet, they will lose their power.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.一块具有神奇力量的水晶石，据说持有它的人能从中汲取源源不断的力量，因此也被误传为: A crystal stone with magical powers. It is said that the holder can drain a continuous stream of power from it, and thus it has been mistakenly rumored to possess healing and even resurrection abilities.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.多用途使魔护具，可为不同大小、各种外形的使魔提供全面防护。小个儿的可以钻里头，大: Multipurpose familiar armor, providing comprehensive protection for familiars of different sizes and shapes. Small ones can hide inside, large ones can wear it outside!
des.一块具有神奇力量的水晶石，据说持有它的人能从中汲取源源不断的力量，因此也被误传为: A crystal stone with magical power. It is said to allow its holder to drain a continuous source of strength, thus misrepresented as "the person who possesses it will not die." \n[This gear is unique.]
des.10 Rounds 旗下游戏《无垠乱斗》推出的实体娱乐模块，广告语是“为乱斗增添: An physical entertainment module for the game "the Eternal Scuffle" produced by 10rounds, with the slogan "Adding wonderful randomness to the scuffle". This module allows players who own it to gain some "special bonuses" that change periodically in the game.
des.学会曾经生产的一种民用产品，能够自然变得光亮的餐刀，其分子具有巨大的水平方向连接: A civilian product once produced by Source Citadel, a table knife that polishes itself. Its molecules have immense horizontal binding force, thus slowly moving its vertical molecules to the horizontal direction to keep the surface polished. Meanwhile this process makes the blade increasingly sharp until reaching a unimolecular state. Production was discontinued after several accidents.
des.曾被帝国七骑之一使用过、缠绕火焰的魔剑，也是帝国代表正义的图腾，传说其火焰将焚烧: A spell blade in flame, also the totem representing justice for the Empire. Rumored to had been wielded by one of the seven Imperial Knights. Legend has it that its flame only burns the souls of the wicked.
des.将风附着在了盔甲的表面，高速流动的空气能偏转攻击的方向: Attached the wind to the surface of the armor, the high-speed flowing air can deflect the direction of attacks.
des.此非凡钻头乃机械教廷神圣意志的延伸，当它开始轰鸣，即是异端的丧钟敲响——以无可阻: This extraordinary drill is the extension of Mechanical Vatican's sacred will. When it starts to roar, it is the death knell for heresy - rending falsehoods, penetrating resistance with unstoppable spiral force, and executing the unquestionable divine judgment. Earthly barriers are like thin paper before it. The judgment is set, only the spiral remains eternal.\n[This gear is unique.]
des.某位阿妮塔研究员私下制作的物品，食用后会造成身体不适。但身体抵御负能的能力会增强: Made in private by an Anita researcher. Causes sickness after consuming, but increases the user's resistance against Reverengy.
des.具象的生命，一道光。但其制造方法被认为是禁忌中的禁忌，其制造者和资料也早已被封存: A light, a life incarnate. Its crafting method is considered the ultimate taboo. All related information, including its creator, is now sealed in the deepest of the Fabricate.
des.通过重击的方式将知识灌入大脑的装置，但往往以悲剧收场。极少有人能同时扛过物理上的: A device used for imbuing knowledge to human brain through heavy smash, though always results in tragedies. Few people can endure both the physical impact from the device and the mental impact from the influx of knowledge. Now used by Source Citadel as a mere weapon.
des.穿上它代表着接受了成为塔之骑士的命运，并承担起了相应的责任: Wearing it means to accept the fate of a Tower Knight, along with its burden.
des.一位传奇老兵使用的武器，她的形态场影响了这把武器，使用者会逐渐变得像她一样骁勇善: Used by a legendary veteran, whose morphic field influenced this weapon. It will gradually make the user as valiant and skilled in combat as she is.
des.一位健硕的伐木工所使用的工具，他的形态场影响了这一工具，使用者会逐渐变得像他一样: Used by a sturdy lumberjack, whose morphic field influenced this tool. It will gradually make the user as robust and agile as he is.
des.“将这个盾牌放进冰箱需要多少步？”，传闻中，这是不少成功人士青睐的提问，藏着别样: "How many steps are needed to put this shield into a refrigerator?" Such is the rumored question favored by big shots. It embodies their unique consideration.
des.前超级大国北阵研发的一种护甲，当攻击目标失去生命体征时，能够从对方处获得稳定人体: Armor developed by a former superpower Northern Alliance. When the target loses vital signs, it can obtain a stable human body structure's morphic field from the opponent.
des.运用了某种形态场科技，能在战场上回收能量供自己的装备使用。: Utilizes morphic field tech to recover energy on the battlefield for personal equipment use.
des.未知时间线中的地联所制造的武器，任何人使用时都能感到得心应手，在战斗时变得迅捷利: Produced by the EU from an unknown timeline, anyone who uses it feels comfortable and agile in combat.
des.简并黑石制作的护甲，硬度极高，关键时刻能救人一命。: Armor made of Degenerate Blackrock. Extremely hard armor that can save lives in critical moments.
des.借助一位升构者医疗人员的能力制作的手术工具，让不懂医术的普通人也能在战场上进行应: Surgical tool made with the abilities of an Ascender medic. Allows ordinary individuals without medical knowledge to perform emergency surgery on the battlefield.
des.带有生命检测功能，在出现生命危险时能够自动注射肾上腺素恢复装备者的伤口，并在短时: Equipped with a lifesign detection function, it automatically injects adrenaline to the wearer when life-threatening situations occur, temporarily uplifting their spirits and making their movements more agile.
des.这把电击枪的前代型号，使用时会发出勾魂夺魄般的销魂惨叫 —— 也正因这过于神秘的: The predecessor of this stun gun emitted a soul-shattering, spine-tingling scream during use. Precisely because of this overly mysterious situation, it was mandated for improvement. Yet that scream was so deeply etched in memory that people still stubbornly refer to it as X-27, as if the model number still carries the echo of its past.
des.铁盟士兵通用装备之一，结构简朴、造型单一的防暴盾牌，在对人类以及其他人形目标战斗: One of BCRL's standard-issue equipment, characterized by its simple structure and plain design, frequently employed in combat and suppression against human and other humanoid targets.
des.一种可以附着在任何表面的镀层，具有轻盈耐热的特性，作为航天器的涂层材料被研发出来: A coating that can adhere to any surface, known for its lightweight and heat-resistant properties, originally developed as a coating material for spacecraft. Now widely used in Anita's protective suits, equipment, and vehicles, it enhances the defensive capabilities of the objects it covers.
des.可佩戴在胸口，当监测到佩戴者的生命体征处于衰弱状态时立刻释放激活特殊形态场，使佩: Worn on the chest, it activates a special morphic field to protect the wearer from harm when their life signs are detected to be weakening.
des.阿妮塔设计的天气武器，能够增加召唤雷电的几率，由于缺少接地导体导致不能全功率输出: Weather weapon designed by Anita. Increases the chance of summoning lightning, although it cannot output full power due to a lack of grounding conductors. But isn't the user's body an excellent conductor? Just make sure not to cause any step voltage situations.
des.园丁用来从桦树生物体内采集器官以制作桦石装备的器械，能够有效地回收能量。桦树生物: Used by the Gardener to harvest organs from Chaos Remains to create Chaos Stone equipment, it efficiently recovers energy. Scientists assure that as Chaos Remains lack the neural structure of Earth organisms, they do not experience any pain during the organ harvesting process.
des.一种用纯粹形态场编织的非实体纤维，能稳定其覆盖物体的结构，使其维持稳定性，可以尽: Non-physical fibers woven from pure morphic field. Stabilizes the structure of objects it covers, maintaining stability and minimizing damage or worse consequences as much as possible.
des.搭载了阿妮塔指挥系统的高性能无人机，能协调周围无人机的工作效率。: Equipped with the Anita command system, it coordinates the efficiency of surrounding drones' operations.
des.使用桦石制造的一种违背现实物理法则的第二类永动机，同时也是给现实稳定装置降温的技: Second-type perpetual motion machine made with Chaos Stone. A violation of physical laws, also a technology for cooling the reality stabilizer. The higher the machine's power, the colder it becomes.
des.阿妮塔尝试拼凑某个远古制品时的尝试性产物。虽然并未达到复原的目的，但阿妮塔成功制: Experimental product of Anita's attempt to restore ancient artifacts. Although it did not achieve the goal of restoration, Anita successfully produced this almost indestructible armor material. When activated, its surface reflects light similar to that of the distant stars.
des.使用桦石制造的一种磁单极子材料为核心的无人机，能给周围所有的无人机充电。: A drone with a monopole magnetic core made from Chaos Stone, capable of charging all surrounding drones.
des.阿妮塔尝试解析某种从桦树空间中取得的未知遗留技术的试作品。能在特定共振要求下发射: This prototype is the outcome of Anita's efforts to analyze a technological creation of unknown origin from the chaos space. Under specific resonance conditions, it can emit a unique energy beam capable of eradicating either a portion or the entirety of its target's existence.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.一把出现了异常状况的阿妮塔空间定位锚，被改造成了一把矛的样子，可以随时随地召唤来: Originally an Anita spatial anchor, this device underwent anomalies that led to its modification into a spear. It serves the purpose of summoning supplies whenever and wherever necessary. Occasionally, it summons items bearing the Anita logo, despite never having been manufactured.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.一件用高等耀变族桦树生物的大脑制作的装备，佩戴在脑后能让使用者的脑波暂时拟态成虫: Equipment made from advanced varietal Chaos Remains' brain. Worn behind the head, it allows the user's brainwaves to temporarily mimic hive mind thinking. Anita created this equipment primarily to facilitate the coordination of numerous drones.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.学会尝试打入民用市场的一种尝试性产品，摇动以后尖端会发出噼里啪啦的响声和闪。由于: Experimental product from the Citadel's attempt to enter the civilian market. After shaking, the tip emits crackling sounds and flashes. It has caused several terrible accidents leading to its discontinuation.
des.学会一些较为危险的实验室里常用到的防护材料，材质轻便结实。有几率在关键时刻抵挡来: Some protective materials commonly used in dangerous laboratory experiments by the Citadel, lightweight and sturdy. There's a chance it can withstand external damage during critical moments.
des.一些学者用来刺激大脑保持专注的仪器，有一定副作用，需谨慎使用。: Used by scholars to stimulate the brain to maintain focus, but it has some side effects and should be used with caution.
des.御敌枢纽打造的众多武器之一，在不明原理的人眼中宛如魔法般简单有效。只需举起盒子，: One of the many weapons created by the Destroyer, it appears as simple and effective as magic to those unfamiliar with its principles. By simply lifting the box accompanied by a dazzling light, it can effortlessly crush concrete walls and pierce through armor plates. However, the intense light is unnecessary in its principle, designed only to increase deterrence.
des.解剖桦树生物用的工具，能撕碎大部分人造材料或是切开大型桦树生物的皮肤和鳞片。: Used to dissect Chaos Remains, capable of tearing apart most synthetic materials or cutting through the skin and scales of large Chaos Remains.
des.御险学派制造的护甲材料，有着优秀的防护性能，并且能吸收能量加速细胞自愈。: This armor material, created by the Destroyer, has excellent protective properties and can absorb energy to accelerate cellular healing.
des.能提取环境中的信息并高效传输给使用者，在战斗中能帮助使用者加快情报处理速度。: Capable of extracting information from the environment and efficiently transmitting it to the user, it can help the user speed up intelligence processing during combat.
des.一种超因果武器，原理不明，谁也无法预料它将引导使用者走向怎样的结局。: A weapon of unknown principles that transcends causality, no one can predict the outcome it will lead the user to.
des.该材料只是一种超维物体在三维空间的投影，使其能够如同编程一般改变自身的结构，准万: This material is merely a projection of a high-dimensional object into three-dimensional space, allowing it to change its structure like programming, making it an almost universal substance.
des.从更高维度观察目标的工具，能用来分析目标的内部结构，并在短时间内变换功能。: Used to analyze the internal structure of targets from higher dimensions and change functions rapidly.
des.学会在桦树空间里得到的未知文明制造的远古兵器，能够射出引力子，拥有黑洞合并一般破: An ancient weapon of unknown origin acquired by the Citadel from the Chaos Space. It emits gravitons and possesses destructive power akin to the fusion of black holes. Through modifications made by the Citadel, it can be easily wielded by humans. Theoretically, if the Citadel were to create a more potent version, it could potentially even obliterate the Morphic Moon.\n [Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.一种能够干涉时间线的造物，被戏称为“后悔药”，可以从额外的时间线得到多一次选择的: Capable of interfering with timelines, nicknamed the "Regret Potion," it offers the user an extra chance to make a choice from an alternate timeline, but the user must pay a corresponding price.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.在无数的时间线中，永远有一个“你活着”的未来。穿着这种织物制成的护甲，能保证你前: In countless timelines, there is always a future where "you can survive". Wearing an armor made of this fabric, you can ensure you reach that node unscathed.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.便携版的哈依玛之骰，能肆意改变周围现实的规则。\\n【此装备同编队内不可复数装备: The portable version of Haima Zaria, capable of freely changing the rules of reality around.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.帝国士兵常用的武器。: Weapon commonly used by Empire soldiers.
des.帝国士兵常用的护甲。: Armor commonly used by Empire soldiers.
des.有着可爱猫咪图样的纹章，附有奇妙的能力，可以让一些特殊的变形魔法持续效果更长，但: Emblem with a cute cat pattern. Attached with magical abilities, it can extend the duration of some special transformation spells, albeit with weak energy. Perhaps it was created by an Empire mage on a whim.
des.根据曼杜斯帝国祖先对许愿塔所许下的第二个愿望所产生的魔法回音逆向研究出的法杖。据: Wand reverse-engineered from the magical echoes of the second wish made by the ancestors of the Mundus Empire at the Wishing Tower. It is said that the sun emerged from the top of the Wishing Tower by this wish, and this wand can also produce intense flashes capable of blinding and burning.
des.在看不见星空的地下追寻星辰的魔法师们根据帝国祖先对许愿塔许下的第二个愿望研究出来: Dagger crafted by underground mages seeking stars in the absence of the starry sky, based on the second wish made by the Empire's ancestors at the Wishing Tower. This wish brought life to the Mundus Garden. The dagger shines with the gentle light of distant stars and can heal the wounds of the wearer.
des.桦树世界真正的星光——那些闪烁的火花。: True starlight from the chaos world — those twinkling sparks.
des.铭刻了狮子图案的纹章，此纹章是骁勇善战者的证明。: Emblem engraved with a lion pattern, a testament to the bravery of warriors.
des.帝国魔法学院两派相争的结果，其中一派认为奇异火花是最强力的魔法。如果由能释放奇异: Result of the conflict between the two schools of the Empire Magic Academy, where one believes that Strange Sparks are the most powerful magic. If used by a talented individual capable of unleashing Strange Sparks, it can unleash even greater power.
des.帝国魔法学院两派相争的结果，其中一派认为暗艺是魔法的巅峰。如果由能释放暗艺的天赋: Result of the conflict between the two schools of the Empire Magic Academy, where one believes that Shadowcraft is the pinnacle of magic. If used by a talented individual capable of unleashing Shadowcraft, it can unleash even greater power.
des.将许愿塔带来的生机储存在盔甲中。: Harnessing the vitality brought by the Wishing Tower into the armor.
des.许愿塔上人造太阳中取出的物质。: Material extracted from the artificial sun atop the Wishing Tower.
des.如果外界空间无限大，则巨大的东西也可以变得无限小。应用此种概念制造的手杖，将本需: If outer space is infinitly large, then large things can also become infinitely small. This concept is applied to create a staff, which compresses magic that would normally require a large volume of mana. It serves as a much more powerful mana container than the human body. The user can easily unleash extremely powerful magic.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.如果物质能无限小，则有限的空间也能无限大。应用此种概念制造的单手剑，能容纳极其复: If matter can be infinitely small, then limited space can also be infinitely large. This concept is applied to create a one-handed sword, which can contain extremely complex or even dimension-transcending magic constructs. It serves as a much more powerful mana conductor than the human body. The wearer can easily unleash extremely complex magic.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.来历不明的戒指，据说曾是帝国失踪的皇帝曾经拥有的物品，铭文称其为与阿图·金所订立: A ring of unknown origin, said to have belonged to the missing King of the Empire and inscribed with a covenant made with Arthu Jin. It is said to summon powerful servants.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.一种方便隐藏的锋利刀具，难以被常规扫描检测发现，秘密行动的首选。: A conveniently concealable sharp blade that is difficult to detect by conventional scans, the preferred choice for clandestine operations.
des.用来混在平民之中进行特殊任务的装备，别出心裁的线条尽显帅气利落，精挑细选的材质透: Equipment designed for special missions to blend in civilians, featuring unique, stylish lines that exude elegance and carefully selected materials that hint at understated luxury. Oh, and it's bulletproof too.
des.黑月特工常用的烟雾弹，能够帮助使用者如忍者般来去无踪，更重要的是它很帅，采用了与: Smoke grenade commonly used by Night Chains operatives, capable of helping the user move in and out like a ninja, and more importantly, it looks cool, adopting the same design philosophy as the Spring Fashion Show this year, embodying the designer's... For more, see Issue 208 of "Night Chains Fashion Trends."
des.一种结构简单体积小巧并且可以折叠的狙击步枪，方便隐藏威力强大并不是它最大的优势，: A compact and foldable sniper rifle, not only powerful but also impeccably designed. Its exquisite and elegant design makes it versatile without losing its sophistication. The designer's pursuit of stylish aesthetics is evident in every detail.
des.黑月高级特工所使用的一种手杖剑，荣获黑月内部年度爱用好物大赏第四名。帅气内敛的造: A cane sword used by elite Night Chains operatives, it won fourth place in the annual favorite items awards within Night Chains. Its sleek and understated design makes it irresistible, and its lightweight nature allows the user to wield it with ease and style in combat. While its sharpness is unquestionable, that's not what draws most people's attention.
des.黑月执行人所使用的一种特殊装备，可以在身陷险境的危急关头使自己暂时隐形。: A special equipment used by Night Chains executors, capable of temporarily rendering oneself invisible in critical situations.
des.黑月自主研发的无人机，续航时间久，能在战场上空自动狙击敌人。: Autonomous drones developed by Night Chains, featuring long endurance, capable of automatically sniping enemies on the battlefield.
des.一把极其适合隐秘行动的匕首，如果配合黑月常用的烟雾弹，敌人最后看到的景象只有寒光: A dagger perfect for stealthy operations, when combined with the smoke grenades commonly used by Night Chains, the last thing the enemy sees is a flash of cold light. Some may expect to hear more praises about it, but not everyone appreciates that kind of exaggerated rhetoric.
des.由AI辅助战斗的动力甲材料，每一片甲片上的花纹都由匠人手工绘制，一笔一画精心勾勒: Power mecha material assisted in combat by AI, with each pattern on the armor plates handcrafted by artisans, meticulously drawn stroke by stroke, showcasing elegance from the details. It provides all-around protection for the wearer, with AI taking over actions when necessary, ensuring that even in situations of unconsciousness, the wearer can continue to fight and maintain a regal demeanor.
des.黑月超级人工智能的一个子程序，能对事件的结果进行提前预测并提供预备方案，让使用者: A subprogram of the Night Chains super AI, capable of predicting the outcomes of events in advance and providing contingency plans, allowing the user to better cope with upcoming combats.
des.高度自动化让你从此摆脱繁琐操作、解放双手。隐形功能保障行动隐秘，助你在行动中出其: Highly automated, freeing you from tedious operations and allowing you to act stealthily. The Invisible function ensures covert operations, helping you to take enemies by surprise. With a 20-meter effective range, it captures everything you want to seize. Tenryu Rangetsu Chain, a thoughtful chain dart, binds enemies and seizes the moment.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.一把带有传送技术的短剑，能让人的行动宛如一道迅捷的闪电。在这种高速状态中，相对论: A short sword with teleportation technology, allowing the user's movements to be as swift as lightning. In this high-speed state, the time dilation caused by the theory of relativity greatly enhances the user's reaction speed.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.超级AI设计的一种能量护甲。精选仿木质材料打造沉稳雅致风韵，自然风格纹路增加质感: Energy armor designed by a super AI. Selected faux wood materials create a calm and elegant charm, with natural style patterns adding texture. When activated, it emits swirling smoke, creating a serene and distant atmosphere. It can conceal the wearer's form and withstand attacks when traveling, and decorate the space when at home.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.黑月最高授权的象征，离线状态下该装置也能运行超级AI的80%功能，为使用者提供绝: The highest authorized symbol of Night Chains, even in offline mode, this device can run 80% of the functions of the super AI, providing users with absolutely correct advice and greatly enhancing intelligence processing and decision-making capabilities.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.阿妮塔研发的空间转移装备，能够使装备者暂时进入相位空间以此躲避攻击。但是需要在装: Space transfer equipment developed by Anita, capable of temporarily phasing the wearer into the phase space to evade attacks. However, it requires the wearer to use skills to reach the special morphic field values needed for the function.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.一种人员回收装置，也有人将其灵活用于在战场上移动。\\n【此装备同编队内不可复数: A personnel recovery device, also used flexibly by some for movement on the battlefield.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.学会有时会把一些物体的时间加速，不知为何，到了时间的尽头这些物体的质量都会离奇增: Sometimes, the Citadel accelerates the time of certain objects, and inexplicably, at the end of this process, the mass of these objects mysteriously increases. Scholars have found a practical use for these materials: knocking people unconscious.
des.某种梦境中生物的肢体，不知何故被带入现实。: Limbs of a creature from a certain dream realm, somehow brought into reality.
des.拥有七根弓弦的魔法弓，据说其射出的箭能将人的灵魂也一并杀伤。: A magic bow with seven strings, said to shoot arrows that can harm not only the body but also the soul of a person.
des.前北阵剑术高手使用的武器，战斗时会放出丝线缠绕对手。: A weapon used by a swordsmaster of the former Northern Alliance, which releases threads to entangle opponents during combat.
des.持有这件武器的人在战斗时会变得更加好战，对敌人造成更多的伤害。: Holding this weapon makes the wielder more aggressive in combat, inflicting more damage on enemies.
des.持有这件武器的人能加剧雷电对敌人的伤害，宛如故事中可以操纵雷电的神明。: Holding this weapon intensifies the damage of lightning against enemies, akin to a deity in stories who can control lightning.
des.持有这件武器的人能加剧火焰对敌人的伤害，宛如喷发时的火山。: Holding this weapon intensifies the damage of fire against enemies, resembling a volcano erupting.
des.民间科学家发明的便携反重力飞行装置，真的能减轻体重。: A portable anti-gravity flight device invented by a civilian scientist, which can indeed reduce weight.
des.顶在头上，可以接收德拉卡娜鲁传送的力量。: When placed on head, it can receive the power of teleportation from Dracanaru.
des.一种能屏蔽心灵控制相关升构能力的帽子。: A hat that can shield against psychic control-related ascension abilities.
des.监测到佩戴者失去意识以后，会自动激活掐人中功能，使人恢复意识。: Upon detecting the wearer losing consciousness, it automatically activates the acupoint pressure function, restoring consciousness.
des.能发射一种只有相信它存在的人才能看得到的射线，让人丧失战斗意志。使用者越相信其存: It can emit a ray that only those who believe in its existence can see, causing the loss of combat will. The more the user believes in its existence, the stronger its effect.
des.能够拍摄到形态场的照相机，可以帮助持有者提前应对有可能遇到的共振影响。: A camera that can capture images of morphic field, helping the holder anticipate potential resonance effects.
des.在探宝棍上装一把枪，它岂不是既能发现宝贝，还能自动锁定敌人？\\n【此装备同编队: Mounting a gun on a treasure-seeking rod — wouldn't it be able to both discover treasures and automatically lock onto enemies?\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]
des.听了这首歌的人会陷入疯狂的状态，变得无比亢奋、更具攻击性。有时甚至会有更严重的后: People who listen to this song will fall into a state of frenzy, becoming extremely excited and more aggressive. Sometimes, there may even be more severe consequences.
des.一种不属于地球的金属。原本很稀有，但地卫二事件以后各种不属于地球的物质到处都是，: A metal not native to Earth. Originally rare, but after Morphic Moon incident, non-Earth materials are everywhere, and this metal has become commonplace.
des.如果你用摆动怀表的方式没能将人催眠，那就是使用的怀表不对——不妨试试这一只。: If you fail to hypnotize someone using the swing of a pocket watch, perhaps it's because you're using the wrong pocket watch — why not try this one?
des.从中会如泉水一般涌出秘法能量，为佩戴者提供能量补给。: It will spring forth arcane energy like a fountain, providing energy replenishment to the wearer.
des.一件设计用来召唤雷电的武器，本因关键部件磁性的原因无法使用。但强大的升构者能改变: A weapon designed for summoning lightning. It faced operational challenges due to magnetic issues with a crucial component. However, a powerful Ascender can alter its magnetic properties, thereby enabling it to actually summon lightning.\n [Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

DisplayName.“叩响乐园之门”-活动商店: Knocking on Estranger's Door - Event Shop

details.<size=30><b>详情说明：</b></size>\\n\r列车长可在<c: Details: You may use Laplace Protocols to summon the following characters via Regular Recruit – Charlotte Up: SSR 2% Charlotte (Featured) / Nayuta / Caroline / Joshua / Connor / Katas / Ilona / Stella / Suen / Wensheng / Margiela / Verlaine / Tennie / Arina / Nicola / Dorothy SR 10% Livia / Desiree / Yejue / Maruha / Aoba / Yoizuki / Rina Von / Fenia / Cecil / Valentine / Nabi / Lin / Achiwa / Ganya / Yer / Kaleya / Akira / Heinrich R 88% Arcana / Eliot / Fran / Galore / Shizuru / Karen / Reika / Rachel / Yamaarashi / Solum / Tara / Tobinezumi / Julian Guarantee Rules: In the Regular Recruit, Exclusive Recruit, and Targeted Recruit, the cumulative number of draws that you fail to obtain an SSR character will always be accumulated respectively in the Regular Recruit, Exclusive Recruit, and Targeted Recruit. The number of draws to trigger the Guarantee mechanism is calculated independently and not shared by other recruitment modes. In the Regular Recruit, Exclusive Recruit, and Targeted Recruit, if you fail to obtain an SSR character for 70 consecutive draws, the drop rate of obtaining an SSR character will increase by 10% for each subsequent draw until you obtain an SSR character. After that, the drop rate of SSR characters will be reset to 2%. In other words, you will always obtain an SSR character after a maximum of 80 draws. In the Regular Recruit, Exclusive Recruit, and Targeted Recruit, if you obtain tier-R characters 9 times in a row, your 10th attempt will always grant you an SR or SSR character. The number of consecutive tier-R characters obtained in each recruitment mode is not shared by other recruitment modes. Featured Character: When you obtain an SSR character, there is a 50% chance that the SSR character obtained is the featured character Charlotte. If you obtain an SSR character other than the featured SSR character, your next SSR character obtained will always be the featured SSR character. Special Notes: Each recruitment grants you 1 Career Info. Whenever you recruit a character that you already own, that character will be converted into 1 Career Detail for that character. A character's Career Detail can be used for character awakening. Once you have obtained a total of 5 Career Detail for any character, any subsequent Career Detail obtained for that character will be automatically converted into Career Info at the following ratio: Every 1 Career Detail of tier-R characters will be converted into 1 Career Info. Every 1 Career Detail of tier-SR characters will be converted into 3 Career Infos. Every 1 Career Detail of tier-SSR characters will be converted into 10 Career Infos. You can use Career Info to exchange for various items at the Night Chains Shop in the rest area in each city.

In the [Regular Recruit], [Exclusive Recruit], [Story Recruit], [Event Recruit] and [Targeted Recruit], if you fail to obtain an SSR character for 70 consecutive draws, the drop rate of obtaining an SSR character will increase by 10% for each subsequent draw until you obtain an SSR character. After that, the drop rate of SSR characters will be reset to 2%. In other words, you will always obtain an SSR character after a maximum of 80 draws. In the [Regular Recruit], [Exclusive Recruit], [Story Recruit], [Event Recruit] and [Targeted Recruit], if you obtain tier-R characters 9 times in a row, your 10th attempt will always grant you an SR or SSR character. The number of consecutive tier-R characters obtained in each recruitment mode is not shared by other recruitment modes.
