text.喂，列车长，回神了！: Hey, Conductor, snap out of it!
text.总之托那位飞鸟小姐的福，市中心的的主要路线已经基本清晰了。: Well, thanks to Miss Songbird's blessing, the main routes in the downtown area are pretty much mapped out now.
text.下面去哪里就由列车长决定吧！: Let's leave it to you to decide where we go next!
text.话说回来，来修格里城的路上我们不是捡到一些遗失的货物吗？: By the way, didn't we pick up some lost cargo on our way to Shoggolith City?
text.听说列车长看到崭新的<color=#b45e01>无垠号</color>激动得哭: I heard you got teary-eyed when you saw the freshly spruced-up <color=#b45e01>Eternal</color>, Conductor?
text.不过现在不是哭的时候，既然无垠号已经被翻新保养了一遍，列车长也差不多该着手调整<: But now's not the time for tears. Since The Eternal has been refurbished, it's about time you started adjusting the interior decor of the <color=#b45e01>Carriage</color>!
text.配电者波克士将会指导你完成<color=#b45e01>电力引擎</color>: Distributor Box will guide you through the upgrade of the <color=#b45e01>power engine</color>.
text.列车长，让领航者波克士指引你再来复习一遍<color=#b45e01>导航器</: Conductor, let Navigator Box guide you through the <color=#b45e01>navigation system</color> again!
text.列车长，在刚才的战斗中获得了新的<color=#b45e01>装备</color: Conductor, you got some new <color=#b45e01>equipment</color> from that last combat. Better try it on!
text.到啦到啦，这儿就是——海豹奶茶店咯！: Here we are — Seal's Tea Shop!
text.哇！居然有——<color=#b45e01>拉普拉斯协议</color>？！\\: Wow! They actually have the <color=#b45e01>Laplace Protocol</color>?! Conductor, with that, we can recruit new crew members!
text.怎么样，还符合您的口味吗？另外，本店还会出售一些通过黑月特别渠道得到的好东西哦~: How's it, still to your liking? Also, the store sells some goodies acquired through special channels from Night Chains.
text.列车长，这里是<color=#b45e01>车载便当柜</color>！铁盟下发: Conductor, this is the <color=#b45e01>Bento Cabinet</color> on board! The work bentos issued by B.C.R.L. to alleviate fatigue will be stored here, and some crew members will also make bentos for you.
text.如果给他们一些鼓励的话，说不定爱心便当会源源不断地出现！？——开玩笑的。总之列车: If you give them some encouragement, maybe their Love Bentos will keep coming! Just kidding. Anyway, Conductor, feel free to eat when you're hungry.
text.哎，为什么没人给可爱的波克士大人准备爱心便当呢？: Hey, why hasn't anyone prepared a Love Bento for our lovely Box?
text.列车长，来收银台这里排队点餐！: Conductor, come to the cashier's counter and queue up for ordering!
text.哇！又出新品，点这个点这个，牛油果奶昔我还没喝过！: Wow! There's a new item again. Let's try this one. I haven't tried the Avocado Milkshake!
text.选择<color=#b45e01>团队套餐</color>开始点单！: Choose the <color=#b45e01>Team Set</color> to start ordering!
text.列车长，经过长时间的行驶，有必要<color=#b45e01>清洗</color: Conductor, after a long journey, it's necessary to give your vehicle a <color=#b45e01>wash</color>!
text.对<color=#b45e01>推进系统</color>进行改装则能提高<col: Modifying the <color=#b45e01>propulsion system</color> can increase the <color=#b45e01>Rapid Bullet</color> capacity and extend the <color=#b45e01>propulsion time</color>. Before modification, remember to buy materials from the Trading Center.
text.在<color=#b45e01>基础性能</color>相关的改装里，可以提升列: In the <color=#b45e01>basic performance-related</color> modifications, you can enhance the train's <color=#b45e01>acceleration</color> and <color=#b45e01>braking</color> performance.
text.在车站停靠时，可以对列车进行<color=#b45e01>改装</color>，: During station stops, you can <color=#b45e01>modify</color> the train to improve its performance.
text.本机已经帮你开启自动巡航了，\\n只需要选择<color=#b45e01>“修格: This unit has already enabled automatic cruise control. Just select <color=#b45e01>"Shoggolith City"</color> as the destination.
text.目标——曼德矿场！\\n科伦巴商会CBCRR23号列车组，无垠号！启动！: Destination — Mander Mine!\nCOLUMBA's CBCRR23 Crew, The Eternal, set off!
text.大家，该启程出发了吧，乘客还在车里等着我们。: Everyone, it's time to embark. The passengers are waiting for us on board.
text.这件装备——<color=#b45e01>“特浓功能饮料”</color>的效果: This equipment, <color=#b45e01>"EX Energy Drink"</color>, has the effect of <color=#b45e01>gaining 1 Cost after defeating a wave of enemies</color>. Let's equip it and give it a try!
text.及时提升新队员的<color=#b45e01>等级</color>，可以有效提升: Timely <color=#b45e01>upgrading</color> new crew members can effectively enhance combat capabilities!
text.每件装备默认拥有1条<color=#b45e01>固定词缀</color>，每提: Each piece of equipment defaults to having a <color=#b45e01>fixed affix</color>. A <color=#b45e01>random affix</color> is available for every 10 levels of equipment upgrade.
text.点击<color=#b45e01>全部卖出</color>，这样就可以一次性卖出: Tap <color=#b45e01>"Sell All"</color> to sell all the goods at once.
text.列车长，这里就是西大陆的贸易枢纽——7号自由港了。: Conductor, this is the trading hub of the Western Continent — Freeport Ⅶ.
text.列车长，我们要卖出货物，走这边。: Conductor, we need to sell the goods. Let's go this way.
text.在这里可以查看海岛相关<color=#b45e01>任务</color>。: Here you can check out the <color=#b45e01>quests</color> related to the island.
text.列车长，我们到了，<color=#b45e01>进入站点</color>吧。: Conductor, we've arrived. Let's <color=#b45e01>enter the station</color>.
text.完成任务就可以获得商会准备的丰厚奖励，并且提升<color=#b45e01>海岛: Completing quests grants you splendid rewards and <color=#b45e01>levels up your island</color>.
text.共振成功后，我会习得新的<color=#b45e01>共振天赋</color>和: After a successful resonance, I'll acquire new <color=#b45e01>Resonance Talents</color> and <color=#b45e01>Profession Skills</color>.
text.另外，<color=#b45e01>遥</color>偶尔也会来参加模拟战哦。: Oh, and <color=#b45e01>Haruka</color> occasionally joins the simulation battles too.
text.你们就是来接取市政厅订单的吧，这边。: You're here to pick up orders from the City Hall, right? Follow me.
text.如果海岛等级满足条件，你也拥有了足够的资源，就可以进行扩建了！\r扩建后将解锁新: You can expand your island once the requirements on island level and resources are met! Expanding your island will unlock new areas to accommodate more tourists.
text.选择<color=#b45e01>曼德矿场</color>作为本次行程目的地。: Select <color=#b45e01>Mander Mine</color> as the destination for this trip.
text.还有哦，我的商业能力也提升了。总之，今后列车长在交易所<color=#b45e0: Also, my business ability has improved. So, Conductor, I can assist you in <color=#b45e01>Bargain</color> at the Trading Center from now on.
text.我的技能牌【灵鸟夜曲】和【终幕的圆舞曲】将可以共鸣成黄卡，获得<color=#b: My skill cards, [Spirit Nocturne] and [Finale's Waltz], can consonate into Yellow cards and gain the power of <color=#b45e01>[Electrify]</color>.
text.当队员等级达到<color=#b45e01>7级</color>之后就可以进行<: When crew members reach <color=#b45e01>level 7</color>, they can unlock <color=#b45e01>Resonance</color> and learn new skills.
text.通过装修功能就可以改变海岛布局，布置出属于你的、独一无二的蜃息岛。\r如果需要购: The decoration feature allows you to change the layout, thus creating your own Mirage Island. If you need to buy new facilities, come to me in <color=#b45e01>Island Authority</color>!
text.别担心，我已经为你制定好了详细的经营方案，按照方案执行，就一定可以建设出优秀的度: Don't worry, I've made a detailed business plan for you. Just follow the plan, and you'll definitely construct an excellent resort!
text.请列车长立即——马上——即刻——出发！: Conductor, please, right now, let's depart immediately!
text.人类总喜欢在多余的事情上浪费时间！\\n领航者波克士大人已经在此等得不耐烦了。: People always waste time on unnecessary things! Navigator Box is getting impatient.
text.<color=#b45e01>私人仓库</color>开放了，列车长可以把等待行: The <color=#b45e01>Private Warehouse</color> is now open. Conductor, you can temporarily store goods waiting for market conditions in the local private warehouse.
text.<color=#b45e01>仓库容量</color>需要向当地交易所支付铁盟币: The <color=#b45e01>warehouse capacity</color> needs to be purchased from the local Trading Center with BCRL Coins. Having a warehouse allows for more flexible turnover when market conditions are unfavorable.
text.诶，成功了，看起来这里的老板挺好说话的，再抬价一次吧。: Hey, it worked! Looks like the owner here is pretty easy to deal with. Let's raise the price again.
text.将档杆推至<color=#b45e01>前进档</color>，\\n继续前往本: Push the lever to <color=#b45e01>Drive</color>.\nContinue to the destination, Shoggolith City.
text.给，市政厅指定给你们的订单，签好字就拿走吧。: Here, the City Hall has assigned you the order. Sign and take it.
text.首先要<color=#b45e01>添加出战队员</color>。: First, we need to <color=#b45e01>add crew members</color> to the lineup.
text.海岛建设到一定程度后，就可以开始招揽游客了。: Once the construction on your island reaches a certain level, you can start attracting tourists.
text.可以通过多种途径宣传你的海岛，当然每种途径的效果也是不同的，你就尽情地试试看吧！: There are many ways to publicize your island, and of course, each way has its unique effects. Feel free to give them a try!
text.列车长，无垠号马上要开始大修了！\\n你带大家去修格里城转转吧。: Conductor, The Eternal is about to undergo major repairs! Let's head to Shoggolith City for a visit.
text.强化装备需要消耗<color=#b45e01>星云物质</color>或其他装备: Upgrading equipment requires consuming <color=#b45e01>Nebula Matter</color> or other equipments.
text.有价值的装备要及时<color=#b45e01>上锁</color>，列车长可不: Valuable equipment should be <color=#b45e01>locked</color> as soon as possible. Don't mistakenly use them as enhancement materials, Conductor!
text.哇，遥小姐，好可怕的气息。\\n列车长，我们快跑吧！: Wow, Miss Haruka, that's a terrifying aura. Conductor, let's run!
text.接下来让我们去我的老巢……不是，我是说<color=#b45e01>管理中心</: Next, let's check out my hideout... I mean, <color=#b45e01>Island Authority</color>!
text.<color=#b45e01>特产交易品</color>通常会有五角星的特殊标记: <color=#b45e01>Specialty goods</color> usually have a special five-star mark for distinction. Their selling price in other cities is more affected by <color=#b45e01>transportation distance</color>.
text.来~喝下它，<color=#b45e01>银枝气泡水</color>会为您带来特: Here, have a sip of it. <color=#b45e01>Silver Bubble Soda</color> will grant you a special <color=#b45e01>Business Luck</color> buff.
text.位于码头附近的这栋建筑就是<color=#b45e01>管理中心</color>: This building located near the dock is <color=#b45e01>Island Authority</color>, and I work here most of the time.
text.在管理中心可以购买装修所用的设施，以及通过贝币兑换稀有物资。\r嘿嘿，让我们多多: You can buy facilities used for renovation in Island Authority, as well as exchange rare supplies using Shell Tokens. Heehee, let's hang out more!
text.至于你最关心的海岛收益问题……通过<color=#b45e01>营运收益</co: As for your most concerning question about the island's revenue... you can check it through <color=#b45e01>Operation Revenue</color>.
text.无垠号列车组——准备就绪，\\n请列车长在<color=#b45e01>导航器<: The Eternal crew is ready to go.\nConductor, set the destination in the <color=#b45e01>Navigator</color> and start the train!
text.目标——修格里城！\\n科伦巴商会CBCRR23号列车组，无垠号！启动！: Destination — Shoggolith City! \nCOLUMBA's CBCRR23 Crew, The Eternal, set off!
text.嘿嘿，<color=#b45e01>拉普拉斯协议</color>可是有钱都很难买: The <color=#b45e01>Laplace Protocol</color> is something you can't buy with money!
text.之后的运输风险会越来越大，光靠我们可不够呢，就趁这次机会补充一下人手吧！: The transportation risks ahead are increasing, and relying solely on us may not be enough. Let's take this opportunity to bolster our team!
text.将新招募的<color=#b45e01>武装护卫乘员</color>编入队伍中，: Incorporate the newly recruited <color=#b45e01>Armed Guard Crew</color> into our team to strengthen our team.
text.列车长，考核场地一直下雨，让新队员叶珏来当队长吧。: Conductor, since it's raining at the assessment site, let's make Yejue the team leader.
text.在此期间，我们和护卫乘员们一起去这个城市的铁安局拜访一下吧。: During this period, let's visit the BCRL Agency in this city with the guard crew.
text.真是辛苦大家了。: Thank you all for your hard work.
text.我们之前去休息区的时候，好像看到那里卖拉普拉斯协议耶？: When we were at the rest area earlier, didn't we see the Laplace Protocol being sold there?
text.列车长，反正我们现在资金也不紧张，不如去买一张吧！: Conductor, since we're not short on funds right now, why not go buy one?
text.人多好偷懒……咳、好办事嘛！: The more, the merrier... I mean, the more efficient, right?
text.……虽然想说你些什么，但确实该增加些人手了。: ...Even though I want to say something, we really do need to recruit more.
text.这么看来，我们列车组的人手果然还是有些紧张。: It seems that our train is indeed a bit short-handed.
text.海岛收益由客运游客收益、宣传游客收益和散客收益这三个部分组成，当然所有收入都要依: The revenue on your island comes from tourists you transport, tourists attracted by advertisements, and tourists from natural flows. Of course, all revenue must be taxed.
text.目前要说的大概就这些，目前你们的首要任务，还是先去解决自己的住宿问题。: That's all about what needs your attention. As for now, your main focus should be looking for a place to stay.
text.装备升级后会大幅提高<color=#b45e01>基础属性</color>。: Upgrading equipment will significantly improve the <color=#b45e01>base stats</color>.
text.这交易所似乎还挺热闹的。: The Trading Center seems quite lively.
text.对啊！咱们快进去看看吧！: Yeah! Let's go in and take a look!
text.这里又不卖吃的你怎么这么激动啊。: Why are you so excited when they don't sell food here?
text.可是我刚才看到门口海报上明明有烤鸡的嘛！: But I clearly saw roasted chicken on the poster outside!
text.列车长，我们可以从这里购入本地特有的交易品，然后<color=#b45e01>运: Conductor, we can purchase locally unique goods here and then <color=#b45e01>transport them to other cities'</color> Trading Centers to sell. <color=#b45e01>Buy low, sell high</color>.
text.这也是我们这类运输商会的重要收入来源之一，是良好运营列车组的必要手段呢。: This is one of the important sources of income for us chambers, and it's essential for operating our train efficiently.
text.<color=#b45e01>红茶</color>作为修格里城的<color=#: <color=#b45e01>Black tea</color>, as a <color=#b45e01>specialty</color> of Shoggolith City, can fetch higher profits when sold in other cities compared to common goods. It's worth considering prioritizing.
text.现在我可以给你提供3%的基础分成，不过当然，你可以通过<color=#b45e0: I can start you off with a 3% base share, and, of course, you can raise this rate by <color=#b45e01>investing</color> in the island. Good luck to you, Conductor!
text.惊险的逃离！列车长！\\n评判者波克士决定给你打70分！: A thrilling escape! Conductor!\nJudge Box has decided to give you a score of 70!
text.没关系的列车长，遥已经查看过了，都是外部装甲的损伤，她正在临时修补，等到了矿场也: It's okay, Conductor. Haruka has checked it out, and it's just damage to the external armor. She's patching it up temporarily, and we'll be able to do proper repairs once we reach the mine.
text.嗯，也多亏列车长这一撞，咱们才能活着离开，别那么伤心了。: Yeah, thanks to you, we managed to escape alive. Don't be too upset.
text.说的没错！接下来就按照原定计划，前往矿场吧！: That's right! Let's stick to the original plan and head to the mine!
text.……所以差的30分是指啥？: ...So, what's the deal with the missing 30 points?
text.（我们明明都在努力转移话题了！）: (We were trying so hard to change the subject!)
text.问得好艾略特小姐！（情绪高涨的波克士猛地跃到了桌子上，尾巴兴奋地晃动着。）: Good question, Miss Eliot! (Box jumps excitedly onto the table, tail wagging with excitement.)
text.虽然列车长壮士断腕的举动为我们带来了生路！但是！这样莽撞的行为也导致我们的电力引: While your bold move brought us a way out, it also caused some issues with our power engine!
text.而且正是由于列车长平时对于列车部件更新换代的懈怠，才会让这次的行动变得如此惊险！: It's precisely because of your neglect of regular train upgrades that this operation became so perilous! This means an upgrade to the train's power system is urgently needed!
text.因此！请列车长赶紧利用之前获得的材料，对无垠号电力引擎进行提升吧！这必定会在下一: So, Conductor, please make use of the materials obtained earlier to enhance The Eternal's power engine! This will provide greater security for everyone in the future!
text.虽然没太听懂但总之就是小命要紧的意思对吧！支持支持！: Although I didn't quite understand, it seems like safety is the top priority! I'm all for it!
text.那么要怎么提升呢？: So, how do we proceed with the upgrade?
text.技术方面遥小姐足以完成！只需要之前战斗中获得的部分素材就能实现！施工者波克士可以: Miss Haruka is more than capable with the technicals! We just need some of the materials obtained from the previous battles! Construction Overseer Box can guarantee it!
text.大家小心桦树生物，本次作战由莉薇娅担任队长。: Watch out for the Chaos Remains, and this mission will be led by Livia.
text.列车长，我好像领悟到新的战斗技巧了。: Conductor, I seem to have grasped a new combat technique.
text.使用<color=#b45e01>战斗记忆体</color>可以快速提升队员等级: Use <color=#b45e01>Combat Record</color> to quickly level up crew members.
text.放心吧列车长，全员做好战斗准备！: Rest assured, Conductor, everyone is prepared for combat!
text.列车长，买入交易品的价格也是可以商量的，我们可以尝试和幼浅老板<color=#b: Conductor, the price of purchasing goods can be negotiated. We can try to <color=#b45e01>bargain</color> with Owner Cashton to get a better price.
text.随着列车长在当地<color=#b45e01>城市声望</color>的提升，可: As your local <color=#b45e01>Reputation</color> increases, more <color=#b45e01>Bargain attempts</color> become available, and the <color=#b45e01>success rate of Bargain</color> also increases. It seems we still have room to bargain with the owner.
text.2次居然都成功了！砍价并不是每一次都能成功，想不到列车长这么快就掌握了诀窍！: Both attempts were successful! Bargain doesn't always work, but you seem to have mastered the knack quickly!
text.列车长，你的<color=#b45e01>城市声望</color>等级提高了，声: Conductor, your <color=#b45e01>Reputation</color> level has increased. Higher reputation level allows you to earn higher profits from city events. Let's go check the details.
text.所有必要的信息都在说明事项里了，没有别的事了吗？那就请回吧，我要回去看老师送我的: All the necessary information is in the instructions. Anything else? If not, please leave. I want to get back to reading the book my teacher gave me.
text.好的！引擎最大功率提高了，再来！: Alright! The engine's maximum power has been increased. Next!
text.列车长，卖出交易品时我们还可以<color=#b45e01>抬价</color>: When selling goods, you can also <color=#b45e01>raise the price</color> for higher profit. Don't forget! Let's give it a try now.
text.不如趁此，找个合适的地方将那些货物卖出吧。: Let's find a suitable place to sell those goods.
text.如果要交易货物，城内的交易所绝对是不二之选。既然列车长已经有了主意，我们就先去交: If we're trading goods, the Trading Center in the city is the best choice. Since you already have an idea, let's head to the Trading Center first.
text.嗯，就去交易所看看吧。: Well then, let's go to the Trading Center.
text.我会为您调制一杯最——棒的饮品，就请好好期待吧~: I'll prepare the best drink for you. Please look forward to it!
text.列车长，在<color=#b45e01>编队</color>时我们可以进入车厢内: Conductor, when <color=#b45e01>forming a squad</color>, we can enter the carriage's training ground for simulation battles.
text.这里可以切换试练用的<color=#b45e01>靶机</color>。: Here, you can switch the <color=#b45e01>dummy</color> for training.
text.有空的话，就来试试吧。: If you have time, come and give it a try.
text.模拟战挑战成功的话可以获得科伦巴商会准备的<color=#b45e01>特别奖励: If you succeed in the simulation battle challenge, you can receive a <color=#b45e01>special reward</color> prepared by COLUMBA.
text.击败波克士的话甚至可以让<color=#b45e01>波克士</color>加入: Defeating Box can even make <color=#b45e01>Box</color> join our team.
text.列车长——列车长，拿到了资格证又接到了订单是不是应该庆祝一下嘛！: Conductor—Conductor, shouldn't we celebrate receiving the qualification and the order?!
text.……我们还没转亏为盈呢，你就想提前庆祝了。: ...We have yet to turn a profit, and you're already thinking about an early celebration.
text.呜啊，但是确实是有好事发生了嘛。: Uh yeah, but something good did happen after all.
text.艾略特是想喝奶茶吗？: Are you craving for milk tea, Eliot?
text.虽然没有尝试过，但我也可以试着在车上自己做做看……: Although I haven't tried it before, I can also try making it on the train...
text.反正离时刻表预定的发车时间还早，去喝杯奶茶也无妨。: There's still time before the scheduled departure, so there's no harm in grabbing a cup of milk tea.
text.好了好了，就去海豹奶茶店吧，艾略特不是刚才在那排队来着吗？: Alright, alright. Let's go to Seal's Tea Shop. Eliot was queuing there just now, right?
text.列车长你看，修格里城那么大，还有很多有意思的地方咱们没去过呢！: Look, Conductor, Shoggolith City is huge! There are many interesting places we have yet to check out!
text.你怎么就想着玩……: Why are you constantly thinking about having fun...
text.不过，反正交易所已经去过了，也不拦着你。: Well, since we've been to the Trading Center, I won't stop you.
text.去交易所跑了一趟下来我也有点渴了。: I'm feeling thirsty after the trip to the Trading Center.
text.找个地方喝点东西吧。: Let's find some place for a drink.
text.这么说来，我刚才看到有个黑月的休息区好像是卖饮料的。: By the way, I saw a Night Chains rest area earlier that sells drinks.
text.莉薇娅有没有想去的地方？: Is there any place you'd like to go, Livia?
text.我的话其实都可以……: Any place is fine, to be honest...
text.不过，那边好像有一家卖植物和宠物的店铺，有点想去看看。: But there's a shop over there selling plants and pets that I'm a little curious to check out.
text.也许可以为我们的车厢添置一些摆设。: Maybe we can add some decor in our carriage.
text.这听起来不错，还真想去看看。: Sounds good. I'm keen to check it out too.
text.还有还有，我在来的路上闻到炸鸡味儿了！我想吃炸鸡！: And, and, I smelt fried chicken on our way here! I'm craving for it!
text.好了好了，那我们就都去看看吧。: Alright, alright. Let's all go have a look.
text.……为什么我们在不知不觉间就走到了铁安局门口？: ...How did we end up wandering to the entrance of the BCRL Agency?
text.我们已经差不多把刚刚从交易所赚到的活动资金都花完了，接下来几天全车组都会陷入入不: We've almost exhausted all the funds we earned from the events at the Trading Center. The crew will be in financial trouble in the coming days.
text.也就是说，必须要去铁安局看看能不能通过新工作赚取赏金了呢……: This means we must go to the BCRL Agency to see if we can earn some bounties from new gigs...
text.来吧列车长，就算逃避也没用的——跟我们进铁安局看看啦——: Come on, Conductor. It's pointless to avoid it — Come with us for a look in the BCRL Agency—
text.<color=#b45e01>急行弹丸</color>填装完毕，\\n无垠号——: <color=#b45e01>Rapid Bullet</color> locked, loaded.\nEternal — get ready — and advance!
text.看上去卖的东西比想象中更多。: Looks like they sell more things than I expected.
text.除去宠物用品，还有观赏鱼、植物……: Besides pet supplies, there are also ornamental fish, plants...
text.要是有这些装饰车厢，一定会给乘客更好的体验。: If we have these decorations in the carriage, it will surely enhance the overall passenger experience.
text.话说回来，我们出来的时候遥还让我帮忙看看有没有猫粮。: Speaking of which, Haruka asked me to keep an eye out for cat food when we came out.
text.兜兜的猫粮要吃完了吗？这确实很重要啊。: Is Dido's cat food running out? That's very important indeed.
text.这也太拉风了，我们也能整一条放车上就好了！: That's so cool! We should get one for our carriage!
text.当我没说，哈哈、哈哈……: Forget I said anything, heh, heh...
text.不过有观赏鱼缸的话确实能大大提升载客车厢的整体评价呢。: Still, a fish tank would greatly enhance the overall rating of the passenger carriage.
text.也许我们可以先考虑那边那个小一点的。: Perhaps we can consider that smaller one over there first.
text.不过也不错嘛，总比没有好！: But it's not bad, better than nothing!
text.等我们赚大钱了，再来买大鱼吧！: We'll buy a big fish when we're loaded!
text.大家也辛苦了，这一顿就我来请吧。: Everyone has worked hard. This meal is on me.
text.没关系吗？毕竟之前也请大家喝过奶茶了。: Are you sure? You've already treated everyone to milk tea earlier.
text.忙活了这么久，大家都没怎么好好吃过东西，奶茶也不垫肚子。: Everyone hasn't had a good meal after working hard for so long. And milk tea isn't filling.
text.既然你都这么说，那我也不客气了。: Since you put it that way, then I won't stand on ceremony.
text.我要这个！还要那个！哦，都来点吧！: I want this one! And that! Oh, just get one of everything!
text.炸鸡店里还有一个拍大头贴的机器呢。: There's a photo booth in the fried chicken place.
text.机会难得，等一下也去试试看这个机器吧。: What a rare opportunity. Let's try that machine later.
text.不如拍一张莉薇娅的放在驾驶室好了。: How about taking a photo of Livia and putting it in the driver's cabin?
text.邀请队员聚餐可以获得30分钟的<color=#b45e01>随机行车增益效果</: Inviting crew members to meals can give you a 30-minute <color=#b45e01>random train bonus</color> and a <color=#b45e01>Rapport bonus for crew members</color>.
text.列车长，这里是行车时的<color=#b45e01>摄像机位</color>。\: Conductor, this is the <color=#b45e01>camera position</color> while the train is mobile. You can freely switch between <color=#b45e01>12 different</color> perspectives.
text.当处于<color=#b45e01>驾驶舱和乘客车窗视角</color>时，无法: You cannot rotate the camera when in the <color=#b45e01>cockpit or passenger window view</color>.
text.完成驱逐任务可以提升<color=#b45e01>驱逐进度</color>，进度: Completing eviction quests can increase the <color=#b45e01>eviction progress</color>. When the progress reaches <color=#b45e01>100%</color>, you can receive a special reward from B.C.R.L. — <color=#b45e01>Laplace Protocol</color>.
text.列车长，这里是7号自由港的商会站台。\\n我们的列车——“无垠号”，正停靠在这里: Conductor, this is the CoC platform at Freeport Ⅶ. Our train, The Eternal, is currently parked here.
text.列车长真有干劲呢，可是因为连续运输，列车组还在保养维护中。: Conductor, you're really motivated, but due to continuous transportation, the train is still under maintenance.
text.呀，海风和集装箱，是运输的味道。: Ah, the sea breeze and the containers. That's the smell of transportation.
text.现在就去<color=#b45e01>铁安局</color>咨询一下如何获得治安: Let's go to the <color=#b45e01>BCRL Agency</color> now and inquire about how to obtain the Security Cooperation Certificate!
text.我们闲时可以在城市里访问一些特定设施和店铺。: During our free time, we can visit specific facilities and shops in the city.
text.我奶茶还没喝到哎，就要上场了吗？: I haven't even had my milk tea yet, and it's time to go?
text.列车长，让我们继续下一场考核吧。: Conductor, let's move on to the next assessment.
text.列车长，让我们开始铁安局的考核吧。: Conductor, let's start the assessment at the BCRL Agency.
text.拿到了<color=#b45e01>拉普拉斯协议</color>，看来这趟可没白: Got the <color=#b45e01>Laplace Protocol</color>, looks like this trip wasn't in vain!
text.走！列车长，我们去招募新队员吧。: Let's go! Conductor, let's recruit new crew members.
text.擅长使用电磁<color=#b45e01>【引雷】</color>技能的叶珏，更: Yejue, who is proficient in using <color=#b45e01>Electrify</color> skills, is more suitable for combat in rainy weather.
text.让我们利用新队员和天气的力量，通过考核吧。: Let's use the power of the new crew members and the weather to pass the assessment.
text.等咱们赚了钱可一定要搬空这里的好东西！: Once we earn money, we must make sure to empty out the good stuff here!
text.虽然这次来数据中心不是为了参与活动……: Although we didn't come to the data center to participate in the event...
text.但是穿着这样一身衣服，混在人群里顿时就有了气氛！: Blending into the crowd in our costumes immediately amps up the mood!
text.有点不习惯……: It feels a little weird, though...
text.我们扮演的角色应该是需要战斗的吧？: The characters we're cosplaying have to fight, right?
text.可是这个衣服感觉战斗的时候穿并不方便。: But this doesn't feel like a practical outfit to do so.
text.虚拟世界就是要帅，方不方便什么的在现实世界里追求就够了！: Who cares! What matters in the virtual world is looking good! Leave the practicality to the real world.
text.话说列车长和莉薇娅搞明白那个机器要怎么操作了吗？: By the way, Conductor, Livia, you two figured out how to work that machine yet?
text.列车长，基于目前经营情况，有必要建造1节新的<color=#b45e01>货箱<: Conductor, based on the current management situation, it is necessary to build a new <color=#b45e01>freight car</color> to increase the train's <color=#b45e01>cargo capacity</color>.
text.在<color=#b45e01>编组</color>里可以<color=#b45: You can <color=#b45e01>build</color> new carriages in the <color=#b45e01>Lineup</color>.
text.基于商会优惠新政，<color=#b45e01>首次建造</color>车厢时可: In view of new COLUMBA incentives, enjoy <color=#b45e01>80% off</color> all costs for <color=#b45e01>first-time construction</color> of Carriage.
text.这里是列车驾驶档把。<color=#b45e01>D档</color>为<col: This is the train's gear lever. <color=#b45e01>D</color> is for <color=#b45e01>Drive</color>, <color=#b45e01>B</color> is for <color=#b45e01>Brake</color>, and <color=#b45e01>R</color> is for <color=#b45e01>Reverse</color>.
text.列车长，开始战斗前，先提升下新队员的等级！: Conductor, before starting the battle, let's first level up the new crew members!
text.为了监测荒原地区的形态污染情况以及桦树生物动向，全新的荒原站需要你的力量。: The brand-new Wilderness Station needs your help to monitor the morphic field pollution situation and the movement of Chaos Remains in The Wilderness.
text.消灭桦树生物获得<color=#b45e01>素材</color>后，可以在本观: After eliminating Chaos Remains and obtaining <color=#b45e01>materials</color>, you can sell them at this observatory in exchange for <color=#b45e01>BCRL Coins</color>!
text.素材的回收价格……会根据每天研究需求动态调整，当然，重要的素材也需要列车长谨慎考: The price of materials... will be dynamically adjusted based on daily research demand. Of course, you need to consider whether to sell important materials.
text.另外……对本观测站建设作出突出贡献的列车长，我们也准备了丰厚的回报。: In addition... for conductors who make outstanding contributions to the construction of this observatory, we also have prepared generous rewards.
text.哇！这是——<color=#b45e01>阿妮塔萃取装置</color>？！好耶: Wow! Is this <color=#b45e01>Anita Extractor</color>? Great! With it, we can extract <color=#b45e01>Chaos Essence</color> by ourselves!!!
text.列车长！赶快开始行动吧！我已经嗅到了铁盟币的味道~: Conductor! Let's get moving! I can already smell the scent of BCRL Coins!
text.本观测站发布了不同种类的建设任务……: This observatory has issued different types of construction tasks...
text.其实我也没帮上什么忙。: Honestly, I didn't really do anything.
text.没想到铁盟奖励了我们<color=#b45e01>制造工作台</color>！: I didn't expect the B.C.R.L. to reward us with a <color=#b45e01>Workbench</color>!
text.使用<color=#b45e01>制造工作台</color>我们就可以自己加工制: By using the <color=#b45e01>Workbench</color>, we can craft practical items such as <color=#b45e01>Decoy Balloons</color> ourselves.
text.制造物资时需要满足<color=#b45e01>引擎核心等级</color>要求: To manufacture items, you need to meet the <color=#b45e01>Engine Core</color> level requirements, which can be increased by challenging <color=#b45e01>Core Stages</color>.
text.列车长拿着说明书自己在研究，进展还挺顺利的。: Everything has been going pretty smoothly with the Conductor studying the user manual alone.
text.哦哦，可靠的列车长！: Oh wow, reliable as always, Conductor!
text.列车长，如果合理使用<color=#b45e01>【进货采买书】</color>: Conductor, if we make good use of the <color=#b45e01>Purchase Appl.</color> to increase our specialty products for trading, we should be able to beat Simon in no time.
text.在这里，我们可以使用一些商业道具<color=#b45e01>大幅提高贸易效益<: Here, we can use some commercial items to <color=#b45e01>significantly improve trade efficiency</color>.
text.使用<color=#b45e01>【进货采买书】</color>可以增加采购商品: Using <color=#b45e01>[Purchase Appl.]</color> can increase the inventory of goods. If we purchase high-profit specialty items in large quantities, we can gain <color=#b45e01>great profit</color>.
text.哈哈，也还好啦~多亏了说明书写的清晰。: Haha! You flatter me. All credits go to the clearly written user manual.
text.这周边除了热闹，还感觉有点不太平。: This place may be full of life, but it also feels somewhat chaotic.
text.说什么来什么，喏，那边吵起来了。: See, I called it. Those people have started arguing.
text.但愿不会演变成动手吧……: Let's just hope it doesn't escalate into a full-on fight...
text.这里就是第二个需要测量的点了。: This is the second spot that needs to be assessed.
text.考虑到刚才的状况，我和艾略特就负责在边上警戒吧。: Considering what happened earlier, Eliot and I shall stand guard on the sidelines.
text.列车长已经逐渐变得得心应手了。: Conductor has slowly but surely become proficient at this.
text.看上去还真有点研究员的派头呢。: If I didn't know, I'd even guess Conductor is an actual researcher!
text.虽然没有改行的想法，不过就算成为研究员，我也希望我的助手是莉薇娅。: Even though switching careers isn't on my mind, I'll still want Livia as my assistant if I were to be a researcher.
text.去下一个地方吧。: Let's move on to the next place.
text.刚才一路上看到不少寻衅滋事的人，好像都是黑月的。: Those people that we saw stirring trouble so far seems to all be from Night Chains.
text.虽然黑月的行事风格一向奇异，但是刚才那些人看着好像有些恍惚。: It's no surprise that Night Chains does things unpredictably, but those people from earlier looked like they were in a trance.
text.确实是疯疯癫癫的，也不是冲着我们来的样子。: Yeah, it was like they were off their rockers, but I don't think they were after us.
text.感觉就是看到有个人就要过去找一下茬。: More like they were looking to make trouble with anyone they saw.
text.先不说会妨碍我们，也不能让他们对普通人这样任意妄为下去。: Even if it doesn't bother our work, which it does, we can't let them continue acting so out of line toward the civilians.
text.那就先把那边捣乱的打倒！: Let's go take down the troublemakers over there, then!
text.之前都没怎么靠近过这一带，还真是一股浓厚的科研气息。: We've never been around this area before. My, it really does exude the cultivated atmosphere of scientific research.
text.我先去问问访问需要的手续和流程。: I'll go inquire about the necessary procedures for a visit.
text.能顺利就好了。: As long as it works out.
text.诶，那边是不是有个头发超级长的人过来了？: Hey, look. Is that person with extremely long hair coming over?
text.看穿着好像就是阿妮塔的人，要不直接问问她？: She dresses like someone from Anita. How about we ask her?
text.诶，你们这是要去哪儿呀？: Hey, where are you guys heading to?
text.该不会是要去形而上粒子研究所吧？: Don't tell me it's the Metaphysical Particles Institute?
text.讲究和随和的双重特质微妙地凭这一句话纠缠在了一起……: Strangely, amiability and demandingness are both evident in that lone sentence of hers...
text.你们来这里是遇到什么困难了吗？可以直接说给本小姐听哦！: Are you guys here because you're in some kind of trouble? Feel free to share it with me!
text.毕竟这里目前已经没有水平能超过我的人了嘛！: After all, no one else here can rival me in competence anymore!
text.“瞳仁”服装店？好别致的名字。: Pupil's Fashion Wear? What a unique name.
text.光看门面的装潢就觉得透着一种神秘独特的气质。: The exterior decor alone gives off a mystifying, extraordinary vibe.
text.有一种走进去会踏入另一个世界的错觉……: Almost as if we'll be stepping into a whole new world if we enter it...
text.不是有那句话嘛，“来都来了”。: Well, we've come all this way...
text.来都来了，就进去看看吧。: Let's just take a look inside.
text.单局魔方有多个<color=#b45e01>位面</color>，战胜<colo: The Cube has multiple <color=#b45e01>Planes</color>. Defeat the <color=#b45e01>Singularity</color> to enter the next Plane.
text.魔方的格子会随机刷新<color=#b45e01>灵感</color>，<col: The tiles on the Cube randomly generate <color=#b45e01>Inspiration</color>. <color=#b45e01>Inspiration</color> can be converted into <color=#b45e01>Dredge Skills</color>, and you may also receive 1 random Intuition.
text.当前是玩家回合，可以通过<color=#b45e01>移动</color>和<c: This is your turn. You can control your character through <color=#b45e01>Move</color> and <color=#b45e01>Rotate</color>.
text.在玩家完成<color=#b45e01>移动</color>和<color=#b: After you use <color=#b45e01>Move</color> and <color=#b45e01>Rotate</color>, it will be <color=#b45e01>Singularity's turn</color>, during which Singularity will also use <color=#b45e01>Move</color> and <color=#b45e01>Rotate</color> once.
text.对了，你检查过铁安协同终端上的任务信息了吗？这个系统可以让你远程处理铁安局的治安: By the way, have you checked BCRL terminal? It allows you to remotely handle BCRL quests, making it more convenient to upgrade your License Lv.
text.在<color=#b45e01>玩家回合</color>和<color=#b45: After <color=#b45e01>Your Turn</color> and <color=#b45e01>Singularity's Turn</color> end, 1 <color=#b45e01>Action Point</color> will be deducted. Once the <color=#b45e01>Action Point</color> reaches 0, this dive will end.
text.点击<color=#b45e01>移动</color>按钮，会进入移动操作状态。: Tap <color=#b45e01>Move</color> button to enter Move mode.
text.点击<color=#b45e01>旋转</color>按钮，会进入旋转操作状态。: Tap <color=#b45e01>Rotate</color> button to enter Rotate mode.
text.通过<color=#b45e01>宝箱事件</color>和<color=#b4: Gain Intuitions via <color=#b45e01>Trinkets</color> and <color=#b45e01>Shop</color>. Tap to use Intuitions and gain the corresponding effects.
text.可以在当前位面移动，有边框的格子是可以移动的，点击<color=#b45e01>: You can move within the current Plane. You can move to the tiles with borders. Tap the <color=#b45e01>target tile</color>, and confirm to move to it.
text.四个方向按钮，对应四个旋转方向，点击<color=#b45e01>要旋转的箭头按: Four directional buttons correspond to four rotation directions. Tap the <color=#b45e01>arrow button</color>, and the Cube will rotate in the corresponding direction.
text.可以通过<color=#b45e01>位面信息</color>了解格子上的图标对: You can find out about the events corresponding to the icons on the tile by tapping <color=#b45e01>INFO</color>.
text.列车长，敌人看起来不太好对付，先<color=#b45e01>强化下装备</co: Conductor, the enemy seems tough to deal with; let's <color=#b45e01>enhance the gear</color> before continuing the battle!
text.这里是当前火车的<color=#b45e01>耐久</color>，在游戏中耐久: This is your train's <color=#b45e01>durability</color>. Challenge fails if durability reaches 0.
text.可以通过点击<color=#b45e01>修理列车按钮</color>，消耗铁盟: You can tap the <color=#b45e01>Repair Train button</color> to restore the durability with BCRL Coins.
text.在游戏中使用<color=#b45e01>急行弹丸</color>可以在一定时间: Use <color=#b45e01>Rapid Bullet</color> to gain a speed boost for a period of time. Recommended during events such as Ebb Tide.
text.可以通过点击<color=#b45e01>补充急行弹丸按钮</color>，将<: You can tap the <color=#b45e01>Replenish button</color> to replenish <color=#b45e01>Rapid Bullets</color>.
text.游戏中<color=#b45e01>炮台</color>可以攻击特殊怪物，<co: <color=#b45e01>Turret</color> will attack special enemies. You need to equip it <color=#b45e01>in the Train menu</color>.
text.炮台<color=#b45e01>攻击会消耗弹药</color>，弹药在对应交易: Turret <color=#b45e01>requires ammo to attack</color>. You can purchase it in the corresponding Trading Center, <color=#b45e01>or tap here to quick purchase</color>.
text.可以通过<color=#b45e01>列车总览</color>了解当前列车的相关: You can check the stats of your train via <color=#b45e01>Train Info</color>.
text.可以通过<color=#b45e01>整备列车</color>，打开整备列车界面: You can adjust your train equipment via <color=#b45e01>Train</color> menu.

text.【刺须体桦树生物】会召唤小型桦树生物不停骚扰我方后排。请使用带有【引雷】效果的技: [CR: Spine] will summon small Chaos Remains to constantly harass our rearline. Please use [Electrify] skill cards to defeat them.
text.附近的桦树生物似乎活动更加频繁了，在现实稳定装置覆盖范围内居然也出现了桦树生物。: The nearby Chaos Remains seem to be more active. Chaos Remains even appear within the Reality Stabilizer's coverage range.
text.【摄能体桦树生物】以能量为食，<color=#b45e01>我们的【费用】会被吸: [CR: Absorber] feeds on energy, and <color=#b45e01>our [Cost] will be drained</color>. Deal with it first.
text.【动力甲·链锯】会释放护盾保护自己，我的【灵鸟夜曲·红】<color=#b45e: [Chainsaw Mecha] will generate a shield. My [Spirit Nocturne: Red] has the special effect <color=#b45e01>[Break]</color> to counter it. Use it wisely!
text.【深眠者·迷惘】会释放【诅咒】，被诅咒的队员将<color=#b45e01>无法: [DS: Confused] will release [Curse] that prevents crew members from <color=#b45e01>receiving healing effects</color>. Be careful.
text.【动力甲链锯】会释放护盾保护自己，我的【灵鸟夜曲·红】具有【破盾】的特殊效果，择: [Chainsaw Mecha] will generate a shield. My [Spirit Nocturne: Red] has the special effect [Break] to counter it. Use it wisely!
text.【多倍体桦树生物】会制造黑卡【形态污染】污染牌库。抽到【形态污染】时，需要将其丢: [CR: Multicore] will create the Black card [Morphic Field Pollution] in the deck. When you draw a [Morphic Field Pollution], you need to discard it to [Destroy] it; otherwise, it will cause a chain explosion.
text.菲妮娅的队长技【致胜闪耀】是可以通过<color=#b45e01>舍弃所有手牌<: Fenia's leader skill [Victorious Glare] can inflict [Thunder] by <color=#b45e01>discarding all hand cards</color>.\nSeize this opportunity! Let's vanquish the Bone Dragon and claim victory!
text.【钵爪体桦树生物】具有<color=#b45e01>致命的蓄力攻击</color: [CR: Claw] has a <color=#b45e01>deadly charged attack</color> and will create Black card [Morphic Field Pollution] in the deck. When you draw a [Morphic Field Pollution], you need to discard it to [destroy] it; otherwise, it will cause a chain explosion.
text.【深眠者】会释放【禁锢】与【枷锁】，阻碍我方的进攻，是非常难缠的对手。: [Deep Sleeper] will release [Imprison] and [Fetter], hindering our attacks. It's a very tricky opponent.
text.弗兰的【盾牌撞击】，可以对面前范围内敌方造成伤害，同时【打断】目标当前动作。: Fran's [Shield Bash] can deal DMG to enemies in front and [Interrupt] their current action.
text.艾略特的【爆炎弹】，可以在抽1张牌的同时，定点打击并【点燃】范围内的敌方。: Eliot's [Heat Shot] can hit enemies in range and [Ignite] them while drawing a card.
text.尝试使用【盾牌撞击】进攻，<color=#b45e01>【打断】敌方的蓄力攻击<: Try using [Shield Bash] to <color=#b45e01>[Interrupt] the enemy's charged attack</color>.
text.敌方的狙击手正在瞄准弗兰。\\n请使用这张【爆炎弹】，<color=#b45e0: The enemy sniper is aiming at Fran.\nUse this [Heat Shot] to <color=#b45e01>hit the enemy at Rear</color>.
text.弗兰，本列车组的武装护卫乘员之一，她总是持盾陷阵，抵御敌方，是我们可靠的坚盾。: Fran, one of the armed guard crew of our train, always charges into the fray with her shield, fending off enemies. She is our dependable bulwark.
text.弗兰和我受到了伤害，请先使用这张【强愈弹】，治愈弗兰。: Fran and I have been hit. Please use this [Healing Shot] to heal Fran first.
text.弗兰的【能量护盾】，可以指定1名我方目标获得【护盾】。: Fran's [Energy Shield] can designate one of ally units to receive a [Shield].
text.借助我的升构能力【共鸣】，成功转化出具有治疗效果的【灵鸟夜曲·绿】。使用【灵鸟夜: With my ascension ability [Consonance], I generated [Spirit Nocturne: Green], which has a healing effect. Use [Spirit Nocturne: Green] to heal me.
text.艾略特，敏锐的直觉和优秀的射击能力让她总能在合适的时机为队友提供辅助支援，是我们: Eliot's sharp intuition and excellent shooting ability always allow her to provide timely assistance to her teammates, making her our reliable partner.
text.请使用【能量护盾】，保护莉薇娅。: Please use [Energy Shield] to protect Livia.
text.使用我的【冲击剑】，可以在斩击敌方的同时\\n<color=#b45e01>从牌: My [Impact Sword] can <color=#b45e01>draw a [Spirit Nocturne]</color> from the deck while striking the enemy.
text.我的队长技已激活，使用【终末的圆舞曲】结束战斗吧！: My leader skill has been activated. Use [Finale Waltz] to end the combat!
text.艾略特的得意技【飞电弹】，可以在提供火力支援的同时，<color=#b45e01: Eliot's Ultimate card, [Lightning Shot], can provide firepower support and <color=#b45e01>retrieve a card from discard pile</color>.
text.这些是我方队员的【技能牌】。\\n打出技能牌需要消耗对应的费用点数。: These are our crew members' skill cards.\nPlaying them consumes corresponding cost.
text.我方队员会从位于战场左端的位置应敌，列车长请从旁指挥，为大家下达正确的指令。: Our crew member will engage the enemy from the left side of the battlefield. Conductor, please oversee and issue the correct commands to ensure our victory!
text.这里是【弃牌】指令，冷却结束时使用【弃牌】可以丢弃当前所有手牌，同时从牌库中抽1: This is the Discard action, which, when the cooldown ends, allows you to discard all current hand cards and draw a card from the deck. The Discard action has a <color=#b45e01>cooldown of 20 seconds</color>.
text.在【红卡增幅】下，我的得意技【终幕的圆舞曲】<color=#b45e01>将造成: Under [Red Amplify], my Ultimate [Finale's Waltz] will <color=#b45e01>deal even more damage</color>!
text.列车长，这里的形态污染指数越来越高了。\\n我们要尽快解决面前的巨型桦树生物。: Conductor, the morphic field pollution index is escalating.\nWe must quickly deal with the looming Chaos Remain.
text.这里是【费用】槽，技能牌需要消耗费用才可打出。费用会自动增长，<color=#b: Here's the Cost bar, where skill cards require spending cost to play. Cost will increase automatically, with a <color=#b45e01>maximum storage limit of 12</color>.
text.叶珏的【电光石火】可以制造电磁【引雷】环境，<color=#b45e01>增强全: Yejue's Boltrain can create an electromagnetic Electrify environment, <color=#b45e01>enhancing the effect of Electrify</color>.\nUse Boltrain to create a favorable battlefield!
text.敌方为我方乘员施加了【心魔标记】！该状态会导致被标记的我方每秒受到混响伤害，同时: The enemy has applied the [Devil Inside Mark] to our crew! This status will cause the marked ally to take Reverb DMG every second, and generate [Devil Inside] cards.
text.但是不用担心，只需要使用【心魔】手牌，就可以解除这种负面状态。不过使用手牌会消耗: However, don't worry. You just need to play the [Devil Inside] card to remove this debuff. But using the card will incur the corresponding cost, so Conductor, please direct wisely.
text.这里是【牌库】，点击可以查看牌库中剩余的技能牌和进入弃牌区的技能牌。当牌库为空时: Here's the deck. Tap to see remaining skill cards and those in discard pile. When the deck is empty, all discarded skill cards shuffle back into it.
text.骨龙正在汇集巨大的能量，使用冯里奈的【制敌扳机】可以在<color=#b45e0: The Skeleton is amassing immense energy. Use Rina Von's [Ultima Trigger] to <color=#b45e01>draw 3 cards</color> while granting all allies the [Unbreakable Shield] to withstand the impending onslaught!
text.【爆虫桦树生物】会引爆自身的毒液囊袋袭击侵入者，<color=#b45e01>在: [Blastbug Chaos Remain] will explode its poison sacs to attack invaders. <color=#b45e01>Defeat them before they self-destruct</color>.
text.同时，在【暴雨】天气下，【引雷】的触发概率将大幅提升。: Moreover, under [Rainstorm] weather, the chance to inflict [Electrify] will greatly increase.
text.使用【致胜闪耀】，对随机3名敌方触发【轰雷】，同时丢弃所有手牌，<color=#: Use [Victorious Glare] to inflict [Thunder] on three random enemies and discard all cards from your hand, and for <color=#b45e01>each card discarded</color>, inflict [Thunder] once to a random enemy.
text.【电光石火】环境下，全场【引雷】将额外触发1次。同时，【暴雨】天气下，【引雷】的: In [Boltrain] environment, all [Electrify] effects will trigger one more time. Also, in [Rainstorm] weather, the chance to inflict [Electrify] will greatly increase. Cast [Victorious Glare] and dominate the battlefield!
text.在这之前，先使用叶珏的【电光石火】形成【引雷】环境，以触发更多的【引雷】。: Before that, use Yejue's [Boltrain] to create an environment to trigger more [Electrify].
text.叶珏来自阿妮塔全球能源公司，\\n擅长使用电气武器对抗<color=#b45e0: Yejue, from Anita Global Energy, specializes in using electric weapons against <color=#b45e01>[Chaos Remains]</color>, making her a capable "Gardener."
text.叶珏的【滚雷】，可以释放穿越敌阵的球形闪电，对路径内的敌方造成伤害并【引雷】。: Yejue's [Ball Lightning] releases a spherical lightning that passes through enemy lines, dealing DMG and [Electrify] enemies in its path.
text.叶珏的【闪冕】，可以使1名我方乘员获得磁暴线圈。在【击晕】范围内敌方的同时，持续: Yejue's [Thunder Crown] grants a crew member a Tesla Coil. It [Stuns] enemies in range while continuously dealing AOE damage and [Electrify] them.
text.这些桦树生物似乎畏惧雷电！【电光石火】可以在战场中形成【引雷】环境，并在12秒内: These Chaos Remains seem to fear lightning! [Boltrain] can create an [Electrify] environment on the battlefield, continuously dealing DMG and [Electrify] enemies for 12 seconds.
text.【电光石火】环境下，<color=#b45e01>全场【引雷】效果额外触发1次<: In [Boltrain] environment, <color=#b45e01>all [Electrify] effects trigger one more time</color>. Keep playing cards with [Electrify] effects. At this time, [Electrify] cards will have a <color=#b45e01>lightning mark</color>.
text.趁现在！再次使用【滚雷】击溃这些【触须桦树生物】。【滚雷】的存续时间很长，往往可: Now is the time! Use [Ball Lightning] again to crush these [Tentacle Chaos Remains]! [Ball Lightning] lasts long and can often hit the next wave of enemies.
text.菲妮娅的【奔雷】，可以在目标区域引发强大的雷电并【引雷】。请使用【奔雷】击溃敌方: Fenia's [Thunderbolt] can trigger powerful lightning in the target area and inflict [Electrify]. Use [Thunderbolt] to defeat the rearline enemies.
text.【致胜闪耀】，是将【所有手牌】化为雷霆的强大法术。: [Victorious Glare] is a powerful spell that turns [all hand cards] into lightning.
text.菲妮娅是学会的一员，擅长使用雷电重创敌人。: Fenia is a member of the Citadel, skilled in using lightning to devastate enemies.
text.费用不足时，使用【锦囊】，可以获得2点费用。: When lacking Cost, use [Bag of Tricks] to gain 2 Cost.
text.我们的手牌不多了，菲妮娅的【锦囊】具有特殊效果，被【丢弃】时可以抽2张牌。: Our hand is running low, and Fenia's [Bag of Tricks] has a special effect: When [discarded], draw 2 cards.
text.<color=#b45e01>【引雷】</color>的力量对凛川骨龙<colo: <color=#b45e01>[Electrify]</color> is <color=#b45e01>particularly effective</color> against Glacial Skeleton. Let's use [Thunderbolt] to strike it hard.
text.使用【训械】从【御敌之雷】，【摩地之风】和【制衡之钥】中，选择1张加入手牌: Use Tame to choose a card from Enemy Ward Thunder, Mordic's Wind, and Key of Equilibrium to add to your hand.
text.使用【弃牌】指令，丢弃【锦囊】触发特殊抽牌效果。: Discard [Bag of Tricks] to trigger its special draw effect.
text.我的技能牌【灵鸟夜曲】可以在斩击骨龙的同时使<color=#b45e01>下1张: My skill card, Spirit Nocturne, can increase the <color=#b45e01>damage of the next Red by 30%</color> when striking the Bone Dragon!
text.我的技能牌【冲击剑】可以在造成伤害的同时\\n<color=#b45e01>抽取: My skill card, Impact Sword, allows me to deal DMG while also <color=#b45e01>drawing a skill card, Spirit Nocturne,</color> into my hand.
text.趁现在，使用雷比斯的【御敌之雷】重创骨龙吧！: Let's strike now! Utilize Rebis's Enemy Ward Thunder to deal a heavy blow to the Bone Dragon!
text.菲妮娅的得意技能【致胜闪耀】\\n作为队长技的激活条件为：<color=#b45: Fenia's Ultimate, [Victorious Glare] activates as Leader Skill when <color=#b45e01>[9 cards are drawn]</color>.
text.叶珏的得意技【电光石火】\\n作为队长技的激活条件为：<color=#b45e0: Yejue's Ultimate, [Boltrain] activates as Leader Skill when <color=#b45e01>[20 cost has been spent]</color>.
text.<color=#b45e01>丢弃的手牌越多，【轰雷】的伤害越高</color>: Remember, the <color=#b45e01>more cards discarded, the greater the damage [Thunder] deals</color>, with each hit also inflicting [Electrify]!

des.这颗鲜红的果实永远停留在坠落枝头的瞬间。: This bright red fruit stays frozen eternally at the instant it drops from the branch.
des.把好梦打碎，混入蜡滴之中。: Shatter sweet dreams and blend them into dripping wax.
des.拆开糖纸的时候要务必小心。: Handle with extreme care when peeling off the candy wrapper.
des.玻璃瓶里装着不会枯萎的愿望。: The glass bottle holds wishes that never fade away.
des.据说是魔女的同款茶杯。: Said to be the witch's exclusive teacup.
des.配色亮眼，造型可爱，深受喜欢。: Bright-colored and cute in design, widely adored by all.
des.漂亮的羽毛笔，格外轻盈。: A gorgeous feather quill, incredibly light in weight.
des.小狗已经不在了，只留下曾经用过的项圈。: The puppy is gone, leaving only its old collar behind.
des.被祝福的水晶刃能够困住受诅咒的灵魂。: The blessed crystal blade is able to confine cursed souls.
des.妖精交响乐团的栖息之地。: Habitat of the Fairy Symphony Orchestra.
des.月相变化的时候音色也会跟着变化的奇妙唱片机。: A wondrous gramophone whose timbre shifts with the phases of the moon.
des.这个小小的球体里藏着一整个银河的奥秘。: This tiny sphere hides all secrets of the entire galaxy.
des.等一阵来自春天的风，吹醒沉睡的心。: Wait for a vernal breeze to wake the sleeping heart.
des.红木雕刻的守夜者，守护着家庭的美梦。: A redwood-carved night guardian that shelters sweet family dreams.
des.魔女的日记。未经同意就打开看的话会被诅咒。: You will be cursed if you open it without permission.
des.当最后一瓣也枯萎，谁来继承魔女的苦痛？: When the last petal fades away, who shall inherit the witch's sorrows?
des.受到祝福的眼罩，晚安，好梦。: A blessed eye mask. Good night, sweet dreams.
des.生锈的船锚吊坠，浸透了苦咸的泪水。: A rusted anchor pendant soaked with bitter salty tears.
des.混杂着爱与泪的魔药，散发着香味。: A potion blended with love and tears, emitting a gentle fragrance.
des.这副塔罗牌由月光织就。: This tarot deck is woven from moonlight.
des.这是魔女的交通工具……诶，会发光？: A witch's means of transport... Huh, it glows?
des.当风儿吹起，一切不美好的东西都将被过滤。: When the wind blows, all unpleasant things will be filtered away.
des.这柄钥匙上似乎书写着什么密文。: Some secret inscriptions seem to be carved on this key.
des.希望能够照亮回家的路。: Hope it can light the way home.
des.永远停在了最美丽的时分。: Frozen forever at its most beautiful moment.
des.送不出去的信折成的千纸鹤。: Paper cranes folded from undelivered letters.
des.贴着可爱贴纸的相机，应该是谁的遗失物。: A camera covered with cute stickers, presumably someone's lost property.
des.黑猫是魔女最好的伙伴哦。: Black cats are witches' closest companions.
des.戴着锡兵帽的暹罗猫，出击！: A Siamese cat in a tin soldier hat, march forth!
des.它用抗拒的啼哭为你消除所有的痛苦。: It dispels all your sorrows with its reluctant wails.
des.工艺精致的魔杖，老少皆宜。: An exquisitely crafted wand suitable for all ages.
des.嘟嘟嘟，起飞啦~: Doo doo doo, we're taking off~
des.为什么看上去有点美味？: Why does it look somewhat appetizing?
des.这跃动的电光，正是……: The sparking electricity dancing at your fingertips is...

longDes.这颗鲜红的果实永远停留在坠落枝头的瞬间，果皮下流淌着停滞的时间。\r“在手工课上: This bright red fruit stays frozen eternally at the instant it drops from the branch. Stagnant time courses beneath its peel.\n"I submitted this in handcraft class, but the teacher didn't believe I made it on my own."
longDes.把好梦打碎，混入蜡滴之中，被安定的香味萦绕的话，在闭眼之后可以去往另一个快乐的世: Shatter sweet dreams and blend them into dripping wax. Enveloped in peaceful scent, could I wander into another joyful world after closing my eyes?\n"...Mom, can you tell me one more bedtime story?"
longDes.拆开糖纸时候的声响可能会惊扰房间里的不速之客，所以吃的时候一定要小心一些。\r“: The rustling sound of the candy wrapper may alarm uninvited dwellers in the room, so you must eat it cautiously.\n"Eat too many... and you'll have to meet someone dreadful..."
longDes.玻璃瓶里藏着什么？会枯萎的花，或者是无法实现的愿望？\r“又弄碎了……没关系，再: What lies inside? Withered flowers, or unfulfilled aspirations?\n"I broke it again... It's alright, I'll make a new wish bottle!"
longDes.这是魔女的同款蘑菇茶杯哦，在动画电影和周边里经常出现！用这款杯子多喝热水吧！\r: This is the witch's exclusive teacup. It often shows up in animations and merchandise! Drink more hot water from this cup!\n"I cried a long time in the mall till mom agreed to buy it. Yet it tastes no different at all."
longDes.配色亮眼造型可爱的发夹，给一成不变的生活增添一抹亮色。\r“看不惯的人也买了同款: This lovely hair ornament adds radiance to plain daily life.\n"I stopped wearing it once someone I dislike bought the same one. So annoying."
longDes.轻飘飘的漂亮羽毛笔，血红的宝石蕴含着难以想象的巨大力量——包装上是这么写的。\r: A gorgeous feather quill, incredibly light in weight. The crimson gemstone harbors boundless tremendous power — so it says on the package.\n"I was thrilled when I bought it... but it's just an ordinary pen, and I soon lost interest."
longDes.被放在抽屉最里面的项圈，刻着已经离去的小狗的名字。不会再被使用了，连翻出来看到都: Hidden deep in the drawer, carved with the name of the departed pup. It will never be used again, and even a glance at it breaks my heart.\n"But I can no longer remember your appearance clearly."
longDes.受到了祝福的水晶刃，主要用于降灵仪式，沾上血亲之血的话，有机会能够听到故去之人的: A blessed crystal blade mainly used for spirit summoning rituals. If dipped in kinship blood, it might let you hear voices of the deceased.\n"I learned this dark magic from books... I haven't tried it yet. Will it take effect?"
longDes.月光浇筑成了洁白的花瓣，夜幕降临时，栖息在花蕊里的妖精交响乐团就会开始练习。\r: Pale white petals forged by moonlight. When night falls, the fairy orchestra dwelling in flower cores starts their practice.\n"Do fairies also get scolded by their mothers for not winning first place in regional contests?"
longDes.唱片纹路蚀刻着潮汐涨落的节律，在月相变化时，音色也会随之变化。\r“温柔的摇篮曲: The grooves of records are carved with the rhythm of ebb and flow, and its tone alters as the moon changes phases.\n"When did this gentle lullaby turn so harsh..."
longDes.占卜的必要道具，整个宇宙的秘密都凝结在这个美丽的球体当中。\r“魔女能够预知到自: An essential tool for divination, all cosmic secrets gather inside this gorgeous orb.\n"Can a witch foresee her own future? If not, what is the meaning of learning divination?"
longDes.这是妈妈的项链，因为很漂亮所以也经常拿出来偷偷戴着照镜子。\r“这是……银莲花吗: This is mom's necklace. It is so beautiful that I often wear it secretly to look in the mirror.\n"Is this... an anemone? Ah... what an ominous ornament..."
longDes.从有记忆起，家里就一直摆着这个木质的猫头鹰摆件了，还有一股好闻的熏香味，让人很安: I have had this wooden owl ornament at home since I can remember, with soothing incense scent that calms the heart.\n"It feels a little scary seeing it when sneaking snacks in the living room at midnight..."
longDes.烟花表演结束了，离开在城堡广场抢到的最佳观赏位，随着人流漫无目的地走着的时候，妈: After the fireworks show, we left the best viewing spot in the castle square and wandered aimlessly with the crowd, then mom suddenly looked at the shop window and said let's buy this.\n"Fix your hair and go to school."
longDes.魔女的日记。未经同意就打开看的话会被诅咒——虽然怎么看都像是文具店能买到的普通笔: This is a witch's diary. You will be cursed if you open it without permission, though it looks just like an ordinary stationery notebook with cheap decorations.\n"A witch is born between lines and words; this is the origin of all things."
longDes.取一枝雨后的玫瑰，稍加雕琢，未能盛放的遗憾顺着发丝滑落，凝结成一滴血泪。\r“这: Take a rose after rain and carve it gently. Regrets of unbloomed beauty slide down hair and condense into a drop of blood tear.\n"This is too mature for you... I will let you wear it when you grow up, okay?"
longDes.镜子并不是生来就是碎的，它回答不了问题，弥补不了遗憾，于是就这样破碎了——它已经: The mirror was not broken from birth. It could answer no questions and mend no regrets, so it shattered for being useless.\n"This is not what I want... This is never the answer I seek..."
longDes.听说梦貘会在月色正好的夜晚，从森林里探出头来，吸食孩子的噩梦。是从帝国传来的故事: It is said that baku peeks out from forests on bright moonlit nights to devour children's nightmares. Is this a tale from the Empire? Many merchandise are made based on this fairy tale.\n"Please do not take away my nightmares. There are people I long to meet again."
longDes.生锈船锚吊坠，浸透苦咸的水。那是海水还是思念的泪水呢？\r“妈妈，海有多远呢？妈: This rusted anchor pendant is soaked in briny liquid. Is it seawater or tears of longing?\n"Mom, how far is the sea? Mom, when will dad come home?"
longDes.妈妈把这个精致的瓶子放在高高的地方不让人碰。这一定是有魔法的药水吧，不然为什么会: Mom put this delicate bottle high up out of reach. It must be magical potion, otherwise why hide it there?\n"But it smells so nice."
longDes.比起占卜，这幅精致的牌组更像是某种纪念品，换句话说，牌阵的结果已经不再重要，重要: Exquisite as it is, it is more a keepsake than a divination tool. In other words, the reading result matters less than the devoted process itself.\n"I got my palms badly spanked when I was found losing several cards."
longDes.以电影中的魔女的交通工具为原型制造的周边产品……这到底是谁的创意？\r“魔女应该: Merchandise modeled after the witch's broom in movies... Whose idea on earth is this?\n"It must be hard for a witch to run away from home at night."
longDes.恶意会随着清晨的阳光消散，风儿吹起时，这里只会留下美好的东西。这是来自古老帝国的: Malice fades with morning sunlight, leaving only beauty in the wind. It is wisdom passed down from the ancient empire.\n"Where do all the filtered nightmares go?"
longDes.这柄钥匙上似乎书写着什么密文，但却无从解读。亦或者这真的只是一把普通的银质钥匙，: Cryptic words lie on it yet can never be deciphered. Or is it just an ordinary silver key, and all suspicions are mere illusions?\n"All things return to one..."
longDes.在到家之前不会熄灭的烛台，一定要小心地握着，当心被吸引的飞蛾。\r“好冷……好害: This candle never goes out until one gets home. Hold it tight and beware of moths drawn to the flame.\n"It's so cold... I'm scared... Mom..."
longDes.蝴蝶翼膜上流转着日光折射的涟漪，它不再有鳞粉耗尽的苦恼，它的美丽永远地定格在这一: Sunlight shimmers across its butterfly wings. No longer will it worry about fading scales, its beauty preserved eternally.\n"It was meant to be a graduation gift."
longDes.用信纸折成的调皮鹤，也许是因为太调皮了，送信的途中总是开小差，所以信怎么也送不到: Perhaps being too mischevious, these playful cranes made of letter paper always wander off on the way, making it impossible to deliver words to the beloved one.\n"The one hundred and first, the one hundred and second..."
longDes.曾经风靡一时的儿童相机，性能不是最佳，但携带十分方便，非常适合启发孩子的摄影爱好: Once popular among children, it is not high-performance yet easy to carry, perfect for nurturing kids' love for photography.\n"Look here! Smile! Come on, mom... just smile..."
longDes.在魔女系列的动画和电影里，黑猫一直扮演着伙伴的角色。虽然偶尔会调皮捣蛋，偶尔会装: In witch-themed animations and films, black cats are loyal companions. They can be naughty or aloof, yet always show up the moment danger comes.\n"I wish I had a companion like this... It doesn't have to be a cat, anything will do."
longDes.用绸缎精心装饰的奖牌，上面书写着属于第一名的荣誉，很美丽，也很沉重。\r“即使再: A medal finely adorned with silk satin, engraved with the glory of first place, beautiful yet unbearably heavy.\n"Even if I can never win any more medals, will I still be a child worthy of your love?"
longDes.戴着锡兵帽的暹罗猫，扭动发条就会开始唱喵喵咪咪的战歌。\r“很久没玩过了，最近在: Wind up this Siamese cat wearing a tin soldier hat, and it will sing a cute meowing battle song.\n"I haven't played it for ages. I found it deep in the attic recently, and it still works perfectly."
longDes.胡桃木的琴身镶嵌着彩虹键，只是随意地敲打都能演奏出动人的旋律。\r“哪怕是再没有: Its walnut body is inlaid with rainbow keys, and touching it casually can bring forth lovely melodies.\n"Even those with no musical talent can gain confidence from it. What a gentle instrument."
longDes.据说是拥有极强治愈能力的神奇药草，防卫般的动作像是在抗拒离开土壤的怀抱。\r“人: It is said to be a magical herb with powerful healing power, struggling as if refusing to leave the embrace of earth.\n"Both humans and herbs will burst into tears when parting from their mom."
longDes.不织布制作的可爱粉喵爆弹！只是玩具，不会给任何人造成实质伤害哦！\r“其实是解压: A lovely kitty bomb made of felt cloth! It is merely a toy and will never hurt anyone!\n"It's actually a stress reliever. I squeeze it hard when I can't focus on studying, it will never really explode."
longDes.只能在黑月游乐城现场购买的魔杖，和游乐园里的一些装置有联动效果，价格很贵。\r“: This exclusive wand is only sold at Night Chains Land. Extremely expensive, but some facilities in the park can respond to it.\n"How nice it is that other kids all have one... I long for it so much, but I have to hold back, or mom will scold me."
longDes.小巧的飞机模型玩具，经常能看到公园里的家长用这个逗孩子玩。在航空航天彻底停摆的现: A tiny toy plane often used by parents to amuse children in parks. Now that aerospace exploration has long been suspended, space dreams only exist in books.\n"Can humans really fly up into the sky?"
longDes.喜欢在壁炉旁打盹，在被窝里做温暖的梦，喜欢即将到来的春天，和在春天时怀念雪。\r: I love dozing by the fireplace, dreaming warm dreams in bed, looking forward to spring and reminiscing about snow in warm days.\n"Is there any way to keep snowmen from melting away?"
longDes.把火山喷发瞬间定格的摆件，有一种怪异的可爱感。通电以后会散发香味，还有加热功能哦: An ornament freezing the moment of volcanic eruption, carrying a peculiar cuteness. It emits fragrance and generates heat once powered on.\n"What on earth is the amusement park product team thinking every day..."
longDes.当硬币被抛上空中，开始旋转的那一瞬间你会突然明白自己想要的到底是什么。\r“好像: The moment you toss a coin and it spins in the air, you will suddenly know what you truly desire.\n"It sounds like a classic line from some animation, I can't recall clearly. Is the protagonist also a witch?"

des.非常保暖的耳罩，能防止在严寒环境中被冻掉耳朵。: Ultra-warm earmuffs to prevent your ears from freezing off in the extreme cold.
des.曼德矿场经理的牛仔帽。今天你就是摇滚明星！: Mander Mine manager's cowboy hat. You are a rock star today!
des.颜色独特的最新款驾驶目镜，使人想起日落。: The latest driving goggles with unique colors reminiscent of a sunset.
des.配发给铁盟列车长的驾驶辅助面具，工作期间的规范穿着。: Standard-issue driving assistance mask that is part of the B.C.R.L. conductor uniform.
des.配发给铁盟列车长的正式制服，工作期间的规范穿着。: Standard-issue formal attire that is part of the B.C.R.L. conductor uniform.
des.配发给铁盟列车长的正式鞋子，工作期间的规范穿着。: Standard-issue dress shoes that are part of the B.C.R.L. conductor uniform.
des.临界前由阿妮塔航天设计的月面探索服装，如今依旧新潮。: Moon exploration suit designed by Anita Aerospace before Solstice that is still in fashion today.
des.由莉薇娅准备的防寒大衣，以及一个挂有专属坠饰的小斜挎包。: Thermal coat prepared by Livia and a messenger bag with a personal pendant.
des.为实地考察而设计的护目镜，对面部起到多种防护作用。: Goggles designed for field investigations with various facial protections.
des.为实地考察而设计的连体服，对身体起到多种防护作用。: Jumpsuit designed for field investigations with various facial protections.
des.实用的御寒短靴，不惧一切积雪结冰地面。: Cold-resistant short boots that are able to tackle all snowy and icy surfaces.
des.配发给TMT受训生的制服，受训期间的规范穿着。: Standard-issue attire that is part of the TMT trainee uniform.
des.配发给TMT受训生的鞋子，受训期间的规范穿着。: Standard-issue shoes that are part of the TMT trainee uniform.
des.柔软贴肤的遮光眼罩，随时都有好睡眠。: Soft, fitting eye mask for a good sleep anytime.
des.保温材质的连体睡衣，穿上它相当于随身携带一只睡袋。: Thermal jumpsuit that makes wearing it equivalent to having a sleeping bag wherever you go.
des.款式相当前卫的眼镜，戴上以后会让人看起来像是柯尼斯，还会在脑中冒出一些似乎不属于: Avant-garde glasses that make you look like Koenig and produce some otherworldly sounds in your mind.
des.有许多兔子装饰的套装，不过并没有因此显得过分可爱。萌系装饰与帅气的剪裁相得益彰。: A set of bunny decorations that is not overly cute. The adorable decorations complement the handsome cut.
des.亿元户纪念T恤，见证一颗商业新星的冉冉诞生。: Bear witness to the birth of a rising star in business.
des.亿元户纪念牛仔裤，见证一颗商业新星的冉冉诞生。: Bear witness to the birth of a rising star in business.
des.亿元户纪念鞋，见证一颗商业新星的冉冉诞生。: Bear witness to the birth of a rising star in business.
des.按照本季流行风格设计的衣装，上面的破洞装饰引人注目。: Outfits designed in the latest trends, with striking distressed decorations.
des.按照本季流行风格设计的短靴，干练简洁，锃锃闪亮。: Short boots designed in the latest trends, sleek, minimalist, and shiny.
des.百万富翁纪念眼镜，通过外观标志你的独特身份。: Millionaire commemorative glasses to mark your unique identity with your looks.
des.别着巨大回形针的头带，容易把发型压乱。: Headband with a huge paper clip attached that tends to mess up hairstyles.
des.装饰作用胜于保护作用的包扎，彰显酷帅的街头风格。: Bandages that are more as decorative than protective to exude a cool street style.
des.玻璃面异常光亮的护目镜，但透光度太差只能作为装饰。: Goggles with exceptionally shiny lenses but such poor light transmittance that they only serve ornamental purposes.
des.戴上以后会使整个人的气质变得玄之又玄的鼻夹眼睛。: Clip-on glasses that make you mysterious.
des.能起到防止对向车道眩光伤眼的护目镜，是普通护目镜的升级款。: Goggles that block glare from oncoming tracks, an upgraded version of common goggles.
des.看起来会让人觉得非常痛的耳饰，其实只是利用了视觉效果。: Earrings that look very painful but it is just an illusion.
des.装饰了可爱金色星星的帽子，走动时一闪一闪。: Hat adorned with cute golden stars twinkling as you move.
des.扎成兔耳形状的头带，要扎成随性而美观的效果需要多次练习。: Headband tied into the shape of bunny ears that requires practices to tie it in a casual and beautiful style.
des.鞋底非常柔软，便于跑跳，卖点是“让您像兔子一样一蹦三尺高”。: The soles are very soft, ideal for running and jumping. The selling point is "letting you jump as high as a bunny."
des.过去配备给飞行员的夹克，毛领十分温暖。: Jacket with a very warm fur collar issued to pilots in the past.
des.过去配备给飞行员的夹克，采取充分贴合脚部的保温设计。: Boots previously issued to pilots, adopt a fully foot-conforming insulation design.
des.过去配备给飞行员的墨镜，能够有效隔绝高海拔紫外线。: Sunglasses previously issued to pilots, effective in blocking high-altitude ultraviolet rays.
des.据说是流行的“骨风穿搭”，但这可是恐龙头骨啊。: Supposed to be the trendy "old fashion", but isn't it a bit too old?
des.被用于和黑白花色头骨搭配的外套，选择了与头骨相同的花色。: Jacket to go with a black-and-white skull motif, and in the same color palette as the skull.
des.被用于和黑白花色头骨搭配的鞋子，搭配堆堆袜的效果不错。: Shoes to go with a black-and-white skull motif that also go well with stacked socks.
des.看起来不是很仿真的熊猫耳，似乎是黑月游乐城某个店铺的纪念品。: Poor replica of panda ears that seem to be souvenirs from a Night Chains Land store.
des.普通的夹子……直到它出现在列车长的耳朵上。: An ordinary clip... until it appears on Conductor's ear.
des.配色颇为潮流的外套，很适合穿去逛街，回头率很高。: Jacket with striking colors that make it a perfect shopping outfit bound to make heads turn.
des.配色颇为潮流的新款鞋，走在街上会被提问“你怎么已经抢到了？”: A pair of fashionable shoes in the latest design and striking colors that makes people ask "How did you snag them so soon" when walking down the street.
des.此乃封印黑铁之力的头饰。为什么是绷带形状就别问了。: Headwear sealed with the power of Black Iron. Don't ask why it's shaped like a bandage.
des.爆裂吧现实！粉碎吧精神！啊……我的眼睛……: Rupture, reality! Shatter, spirit! Ah... my eyes...
des.此乃增幅魔王之力的战袍……: Robe that amplifies the Demon Lord's power...
des.此乃使得永夜之魂灵复苏的祭品！: Sacrifice that revives the souls of eternal night!
des.经典款的鹅黄色塑料雨衣，相当厚实，质量良好。: The classic pale yellow plastic raincoat that is rather thick and of good quality.
des.跟随着你的小小雨滴，不过并不会沾湿你的头发。: Little Raindrop that follows you around but won't wet your hair.
des.经典款的雨靴。有了它就能随便踩水洼了！: Classic rain boots that allow you to step into puddles as you please!
des.阿妮塔航天动力实验室研发的护目镜。显然不能在太空中穿戴，但可以作为酷炫且功能冗余: Goggles developed by Anita Aerospace Dynamics Lab. While they do not actually work in space, they serve as stylish (and functionally redundant) lab goggles.
des.阿妮塔航天动力实验室研发的连体服，配备了喷射系统，便于在失重环境下移动。一般环境: A jumpsuit developed by Anita Aerospace Dynamics Lab, equipped with a jet system for easy movement in weightless environments. Not intended for use in regular environments.
des.阿妮塔航天动力实验室研发的宇航鞋，与连体服配套使用效果更佳。沃斯托克向你说了很多: Aerospace shoes developed by Anita Aerospace Dynamics Lab, which are more effective when used in conjunction with the jumpsuit. Vostok has provided detailed information on its unique features.
des.轻便透气的登山服套装，附送了一个实用小腰包。: A lightweight and breathable hiking set, coming with a practical fanny pack.
des.轻便透气的登山鞋，无论攀岩还是溯溪均能驾驭。: Lightweight and breathable hiking shoes, suitable for climbing and stream trekking.
des.故事中的雪国信使所佩戴的羽饰，总是代表着好消息。: The feather jewelry worn by the snowland messenger in the story, harbingering good news.
des.故事中的雪国信使所穿的大衣，保证他们不受恶劣天气的侵扰，永远按时赴约。: The coat worn by the snowland messenger in the story, providing protection from harsh weather and ensuring punctuality for appointments.
des.故事中的雪国信使所穿的短靴，能在雪地上留下只有孩子看得见的足迹。: The boots worn by the snowland messenger in the story, leaving footprints visible only to children on the snowy ground.
des.具有神奇作用的符纸，据说贴在脑门上就能招来一笔数额随机的意外之财。: When attached to forehead, this magical charm will attract a random amount of unexpected fortune.
des.吸引眼球的眼球头饰。这种装饰带出去容易吓到人哦。: An eye-catching eyeball headwear, it can freak people out.
des.荒野中离群索居的猎者的头饰，不过这条完全是工业流水线制造的纺织品。羽毛是假的。: A replica of the headwear worn by wasteland hunters, manufactured on an industrial assembly line with fake feathers.
des.仿照亚人的耳朵结构制造的耳朵，戴上以后你也能变得像他们一样毛茸茸。: Ears inspired by the ears of demihumans, giving the wearer a furry appearance.
des.仿照某个电子游戏中的机械亚人女性制造的耳朵，戴上以后仿佛能够化身为游戏角色。: Ears modeled after the mechanical ears of a female character in a specific video game, ideal for cosplay.
des.流行于多年前的淘金者必备装扮。时至今日，还能在资料馆中的旧报纸照片中找到它的踪迹: A costume once favored by gold diggers in past decades, still visible in archived newspaper photos.
des.据称能够降妖伏魔的符纸，比起一般的符纸加装了钉子，看起来就脑袋很痛。: This particular paper is believed to possess the power of exorcising evil spirits. Additional nails attached to the talisman look menacing.
des.表现了疑惑和思考的发夹。戴上以后仿佛脑中充满了呼之欲出的内容……: A hairpin that conveys doubt and contemplation. When worn, it creates the impression that your thoughts are radiating outward...
des.表现了沉默与无可奉告的发夹。戴上以后让人一句话也不想说。: A hairpin that represents refraining from commenting. When worn, it signifies a desire to remain silent.
des.只要戴上就会显得不太聪明的眼罩，如果想建立可信形象的话，就别在其他乘员面前使用了: This eye patch gives the impression of lacking intelligence for the wearer. If you wish to maintain a credible image, please do not wear it in front of others.
des.充满幻想之力的眼罩。现在就发起连携攻击吧！: An eye patch imbued with fantastical power! Unleash a combo attack now!
des.仿照了修格里城某个帮派首领的挚爱款式制作的墨镜，让人不由自主地想来上一段RAP。: Sunglasses modeled after the preferred style of a certain gang leader in Shoggolith City, tempting you to engage in some rap.
des.图案与款式完全相悖的眼罩，或许是想在中二的同时发扬可爱气息？: An eyepatch that features contrasting patterns and styles. Perhaps an attempt to achieve cuteness while maintaining a chuni vibe?
des.一款经典电子游戏中主角的装扮，经过了改良设计，不必以忠于原作的方式加装于眼部。此: A costume inspired by the protagonist of a classic video game, modified so that it's not attached to the eye as per the original design. Such is the Flower of Tears that endures even if the world is destroyed several times.
des.精致迷你的小幽灵耳夹，比起其他的恐怖风格装扮，这个耳夹非常适合日常穿搭。: A delicate and miniature ghost-shaped ear clip, ideal for everyday wear compared to other horror-themed accessories.
des.狰狞的疤痕纹身贴。宣传语声称它是仿真款，不过到底符合与否，就见仁见智啦。: A sticker featuring a grim scar tattoo. Although advertised as perfectly realistic, its actual effect is still a subject of controversy.
des.女仆套装的主体裙子，考虑到顾客可能有迅速穿脱的需求，将背带和蝴蝶结改为了固定款式: This skirt serves as the centerpiece of the maid set, designed with modifications to the back strap and bowtie for convenient and quick changes.
des.女仆套装中包含的头饰，每道褶皱都是预先缝制好的。真正的女仆容不得任何不完美。: A headwear accessory from the maid set, meticulously pleated beforehand to ensure flawlessness, as expected of a true maid.
des.女仆套装中包含的标准小皮靴，耐磨柔软轻便，端茶送水十个来回也不会累。: The soft leather boots belonging to the maid set, durable and lightweight, allowing the wearer to serve tea without tiring even after multiple occasions.
des.戴上就能给人信心的闪亮耳饰，你就是舞台上永不落下的恒星。: These earrings radiate confidence, instantly transforming you into an eternal superstar on stage.
des.柔软贴合而不失美观的束发带，能防止梦中吃到满嘴头发。: A soft and beautiful hair tie that keeps your hair from obstructing your mouth while sleeping.
des.古典风格的洛丽塔头饰，采用简单而不失优雅的色彩搭配。: A classical Lolita-style headwear, featuring a simple yet elegant color scheme.
des.引领时尚风潮的套装。但有人将名字中的“风潮”解读为又漏风又潮湿之意……: A suit that sets the fashion trend. However, some people don't think it quite fits their understanding of trendy...
des.宽松的短款睡衣和颜色相搭配的外套，很适合作为家居服。: A short, loose-fitting nightgown paired with a color-coordinated jacket, perfect for loungewear.
des.古典风格的洛丽塔裙装，自多年前流行至今。即Classic Lolita。纯粹派的: A classical Lolita-style dress, having remained popular for many years, beloved by purists.
des.引领时尚风潮的凉鞋，款式简单而价格不菲，能让不知情者发出“这么贵？！”的感叹声。: Sandals that set the fashion trend, with a minimalist style and an astounding price that may prompt people to exclaim, "Why so darn expensive?!"
des.让人觉得如同踩在云端的室内鞋，脚感舒适，落地无声。: Indoor shoes that provide a sensation akin to walking on clouds, providing a comfortable and noiseless experience.
des.做工精良的小皮鞋，适合搭配古典风格的洛丽塔裙。: Well-crafted leather shoes, suitable for pairing with the classical Lolita-style dress.
des.一点小小的发型变化，也能为整个人的气场带来改变！: A small change in hairstyle can make a difference in one's overall aura!
des.富有活力气息的火焰花纹短衣，仿佛在邀请身边的人一同跃动。: Its flamboyant flame patterns invite everyone around the wearer to join in the excitement.
des.富有活力气息的火焰装饰鞋，有人以为叫这个名字是因为走起路来它的部件碰撞声很吵。: Some believe that these vibrant, flame-embellished boots are named for the loud clashing sound they make when the wearer walks.
des.用于生成虚拟战斗模拟环境的主要设备，外部的灯光活动只是装饰，不代表实际加载进度。: The main device used to generate VR battle simulations. Its external lights are purely for decoration and do not represent the actual loading progress.
des.用于在虚拟战斗环境中监测使用者各项生命体征的服装，在主打高科技实用性的同时兼顾了: A suit used to monitor the user's vital signs in the VR environment, combining aesthetics with high-tech practicality. Launching monitoring program...
des.在进行虚拟环境模拟过程中必须穿戴的脚部装置，能够以电信号使穿戴者认为自己正在进行: A footwear device necessary for VR battle simulations. It emits electrical signals to create the sensation that the wearer is performing various actions. Some crew member said, "These shoes are dragging me around."
des.以传说中飞越银河的蝶为理念设计的头饰。山之顶端，一轮月满。: A headdress designed based on the legendary butterfly that flies across the Milky Way. The full moon gleams atop the mountain.
des.以传说中身披夜幕的蝶为理念设计的耳夹。据说它曾经沉眠群山之间。: An ear clip designed based on the concept of the legendary butterfly shrouded by the night sky. It is said to have remained dormant among the mountains.
des.以传说中曾与月光蝶互相理解的少年为原型所设计的服装。“时代末的风开始吹拂”。: A costume inspired by the legend of a young man who understood the moonlight butterfly. "The winds of the era's end start to stir."
des.以传说中终结战争的蛹为理念设计的鞋具。飞越银河的蝶啊，最终停驻于再无纷争之所，闪: Footwear designed based on the idea of the legendary cocoon that ended the war. The butterfly that flies across the Milky Way finally finds rest in a place free from strife, shining brightly.
