des.黑月旗下潮玩品牌与篝火城中流行的格斗游戏联合推出的可穿戴头盔，辉夜款。戴上它后便: The wearable helmet launched jointly by the trendy toy brand under Night Chains and the popular fighting game in Bonfire City, Kaguya model. Once you put it on, you can pilot a robot to perform dreamlike sword skills - as described in the game.
des.黑月旗下潮玩品牌与篝火城中流行的格斗游戏联合推出的可穿戴头盔，瓦沙克款。戴上它就: The wearable helmet launched jointly by the trendy toy brand under Night Chains and the popular fighting game in Bonfire City, Vassago model. Once you put it on, you can experience unparalleled mecha construct - as described in the game.
des.黑月游乐城推出的魔女主题套装“毒蔷薇”中的头饰。深红蔷薇，红如梦境。: The headpiece from the witch-themed set "Poison Rose" launched by Night Chains Land. Deep red rose, red as a dream.
des.黑月游乐城推出的魔女主题套装“毒蔷薇”中的连衣裙。缠绕的藤蔓、互相掩盖的叶片，是: The dress from the witch-themed set "Poison Rose" launched by Night Chains Land. Entwined vines and overlapping leaves are one of the design inspirations for this outfit.
des.黑月游乐城推出的魔女主题套装“毒蔷薇”中的皮鞋。深灰色的皮面，如同蔷薇丛的影子。: The leather shoes from the witch-themed set "Poison Rose" launched by Night Chains Land. The dark gray leather resembles the shadows of a rose bush.
des.邪恶熊造型的装饰发箍，设计者不明，也许是某个小厂商试图复刻黑月游乐城的成功而做的: A headband with an evil bear design, designer unknown, perhaps made by a small manufacturer attempting to replicate the success of Night Chains Land.
des.邪恶熊造型的耳钉。话虽如此，只能看见一个模糊的形状……这真的是熊吗？: Earrings with an evil bear design. That said, people can't really make out the shape... Is this really a bear?
des.邪恶熊造型的眼镜，不知为何被设计成了这种形状，导致这个款式比别的眼镜要多耗一倍的: Glasses with an evil bear design, designed in this shape for some reason, resulting in taking twice as long to process compared to other glasses.
des.以蜂蜜罐子为灵感进行设计的时尚帽子，出人意料地是材质柔软，但仍然非常沉重。: Fashion hat inspired by a honey jar, unexpectedly soft in material, yet still very heavy.
des.以蜂蜜罐中取出的蜂蜜为灵感进行设计的时尚耳夹，戴上的人会变得非常甜蜜……大概吧。: Fashion earclips inspired by honey extracted from a honey jar, make the wearer very sweet... probably.
des.与黑月游乐城奖券兑换处工作人员相同的礼帽。这样的话就能在拥挤的人群中一眼见到了吧: The same top hat as the staff at the Night Chains Land lottery counter. This way, you'll be able to spot it in the crowd, right?
des.与黑月游乐城奖券兑换处工作人员相同的耳饰。祝你好运喵！: The same earrings as the staff at the Night Chains Land lottery counter. Good luck, meow!
des.清新可爱的茶会侍者头饰。“蝴蝶结需要整理好哦，这是女仆的本分。”: Fresh and cute. "The bow needs to be tidied up, as this is the duty of a maid."
des.清新可爱的茶会侍者连衣裙，衣服上的绶带除去装饰作用以外也有标示身份的作用。: Fresh and cute, with ribbons on the clothes serving not only as decoration but also as a marker of identity.
des.清新可爱的茶会侍者皮鞋。“端茶的时候要小心啦，黑铁之主！”: Fresh and cute. "Be careful when serving tea, Lord of Black Iron!"
des.根据魔女诱拐事件中被找回的孩子们的描述，复原了这顶“魔女的帽子”，和原来有些区别: This "witch's hat" was reconstructed based on the descriptions from the children recovered from the witch abduction incident, with some differences from the original.
des.根据魔女诱拐事件中被找回的孩子们的描述，复原了这对“魔女的耳环”，和原来有些区别: This "witch's earring" was reconstructed based on the descriptions from the children recovered from the witch abduction incident, with some differences from the original.
des.黑月游乐园官方出品的吉祥物帽子，露蕾蒂款。戴上这个帽子，你就是游乐园中最为美丽可: The official mascot hat produced by Night Chains Land, Lunette version. Wearing this hat makes you the most beautiful and adorable person in the park!
des.黑月游乐园官方出品的吉祥物帽子，安布拉款。戴上这个帽子，你就是今夜的大明星安布拉: The official mascot hat produced by Night Chains Land, Umbra version. Wearing this hat makes you tonight's big star, Umbra!
des.有着数张大嘴的魔法帽子，据称戴上它的人可以得到一条“最合适的箴言”。: A magical hat with several big mouths. It is said that the person who wears it can receive the "most suitable proverb."
des.外形奇特的眼镜，据称戴上它的人可以看见真相。: Eyeglasses with a peculiar shape, said to allow the wearer to see the truth.
des.缀有蝴蝶结的鞋子，据称它能带你找到索求的真理！: Shoes adorned with bows, it is said they can lead you to sought-after truth!
des.传说有种名为“夜间飞行”的花，只要找到它的人就能拥有一夜之间学会飞行的能力……这: It is said that there is a flower called "Night Flight," and anyone who finds it can gain the ability to learn to fly overnight... The bow on this cap is dyed with the juice of that flower.
des.“好扫帚……是什么意思？难道世界上还有与它对应的另一把坏扫帚吗，海伦娜老师？”: "Good broom... what does it mean? Is there another bad broom in the world, Miss Helena?"
des.本饰品的穿戴方式是将部件均匀洒在头上并浇水，等待约一至三天不等后，即可获得完整的: The way to wear this ornament is to evenly sprinkle the components on your head and water them. After waiting for about 1 to 3 days, you can gain a complete wearing experience. Note that you should not wash your hair during this period.
des.刀疤菇外形的耳钉。香菇？不，怎么会有香菇长成这样呢！: Earrings in the shape of a scarface mushroom. Shiitake mushroom? No, how could a shiitake mushroom look like this!
des.灵感菇外形的夸张帽子。据说只要戴着这顶帽子并开始哼唱“灵感菇的曲子”，心情就会突: An exaggerated hat in the shape of Inspiration Mushroom. It is said that as long as you wear this hat and start humming the "Inspiration Mushroom's Tune," your mood will suddenly improve.
des.毛毡材质的眼镜猫头鹰玩偶，据说可以增强人的思考能力。而且它毛茸茸的耶……: A plush owl doll made of felt material, said to enhance one's thinking ability. And it's so fluffy...
des.镜片非常厚的眼镜，配合炯炯有神的睫毛，一看就是饱学之人才能穿戴的。: Glasses with very thick lenses, paired with bright and spirited eyelashes, clearly something only a true scholar can wear.
des.以岚心城传说为灵感设计的面具，据说能招来财运。这样的东西真的能比桦石发财树更管用: A mask inspired by the legends of Ranshin City, said to attract fortune. Can such a thing really be more effective than a Chaos Money Tree...
des.模拟猫咪爪子的鞋，贴心地还原了可爱的肉垫，一踩就会响。但是走动起来的声响让人有点: Shoes that mimic cat paws, replicate the adorable paw pads, making a sound with each step. However, the noise when walking can be a bit annoying...
des.黑月匠造推出的“乐园咖啡欧蕾”套装中的蛋糕礼裙，自重相当沉，但喜欢这种风格的顾客: A tiered dress from Night Chains Lesage's "Café Au Lait" set. Quite heavy, but customers who appreciate this style will naturally understand its value.
des.黑月匠造推出的“乐园咖啡欧蕾”套装中的发带。用漂浮在奶油上的小熊作为点缀，每一口: A headband from Night Chains Lesage's "Café Au Lait" set. It is adorned with a small bear floating on cream, making every sip sweet and fragrant.
des.黑月匠造推出的“乐园咖啡欧蕾”套装中的配套皮鞋，底面又轻又软，好像踩在云朵上。: Leather shoes from Night Chains Lesage's "Café Au Lait" set, with soles that are light and soft, as if walking on clouds.
des.献给血与夜的君王的头冠，传说那人就守候在玫瑰色河流的岸边。注：钛钢材质，不含丝毫: The crown dedicated to the king of blood and night, legend has it that he waits by the bank of the rosy river. Note: Made of titanium steel, containing no silver components.
des.献给血与夜的君王的耳饰，戴上以后仿若能够听见簌簌的流淌声。谁有这样尖利的耳朵？: The earrings dedicated to the king of blood and night, wearing them seems to allow one to hear a rustling flow. Who has such sharp ears?
des.献给血与夜的君王的长衣，用那人最为喜爱的玫瑰作为装饰纹样。只因这花与血液是同种颜: The gown dedicated to the king of blood and night, adorned with the roses that person loved most, simply because this flower is red as blood.
des.献给血与夜的君王的长靴，柔软的靴底适合行走于月夜之中。悄悄降临……: The boots dedicated to the king of blood and night, with soft soles suitable for walking under the moonlit night. Silently arriving...
des.钟塔猎人现身于月圆之夜时戴着的帽子。虽然边缘已经破损，但最初的意志没有丝毫动摇。: The hat worn by the Clock Tower Hunter when he appears at the night of full moon. Although the edge is already damaged, his original will has not wavered in the slightest.
des.钟塔猎人现身于月圆之夜时穿着的风衣。唯有安息才是长路的终结，只要猎人仍旧能够行走: The coat worn by the Clock Tower Hunter when he appears at the night of full moon. Only rest is the end of the long road. As long as the hunter can still breathe...
des.钟塔猎人现身于月圆之夜时穿着的长靴。踏过的路上有多少是雨水和泥泞，又有多少污浊和: The boots worn by the Clock Tower Hunter when he appears at the night of full moon. How much of the path treaded is rain and mud, and how much is filth and blood?
des.有着黑色猫耳形状装饰的防风目镜。设计者解释猫耳的部分是为了为工作者的装束增添额外: Goggles with black cat ear-shaped decorations. The designer explained that the cat ear part is meant to add an extra playful touch to the worker's outfit.
des.用特殊材料制作的防风连体衣，很有质感，与此同时也比一般工装沉一些。: Windproof suit made from special materials. It has a great texture and, at the same time, is somewhat heavier than regular workwear.
des.用特殊材料制作的防风工作靴，保暖防水防腐蚀，不过穿脱非常困难。: Windproof work boots made of special material, warm-keeping, waterproof, and anti-erosion, but very difficult to put on and take off.
des.滴答车站站员的高筒礼帽。滴答滴答，您要去什么地方？: The tall ceremonial hat of Tick-tock Station attendant. Tick-tock, where are you going?
des.滴答车站站员的第四季节着装。第三季节是风衣，第二季节是衬衫，第一季节的着装跟着火: The attire of Tick-tock Station attendant for the fourth season. The attire for the third season is a trench coat, the second is a shirt, and the first attire ran away with the train to another part of the world...
des.滴答车站站员的标准皮鞋。穿着这双鞋子，就能走得比指针快得多得多。: The standard leather shoes of Tick-tock Station attendant. Wearing these shoes allows you to walk much faster than the hands of a clock.
des.极度仿真的兔亚人耳，触感非常柔滑。据说有兔亚人投诉这款饰品侵犯了亚人的种种合法权: Extremely realistic bunny ears, with a very smooth texture. It is said that some bunny demihuman have complained that this accessory infringes on the various legal rights of demihuman.
des.在岚心城的寺庙中求得、能够带来好运的红符，不过很可惜这款只是仿制的。: A red amulet obtained in the temple of Ranshin City. Brings good luck. However, this one is just a replica.
des.岚心城多所学校通用的学生裙装，本件在此基础上进行了一定的改良，使其更加便于活动。: Student skirts commonly used in Ranshin City schools. This piece has been modified to be more activity-friendly.
des.岚心城多所学校通用的学生皮鞋，本件在此基础上进行了一定的改良，使其更加适合长途行: Student shoes commonly used in Ranshin City schools. This pair has been modified to be more suitable for long-distance walking.
des.根据亲历魔女诱拐事件的乘员描述复原的魔女帽，另有两位真正的魔女为其赋予了些微魔法: A witch hat recreated based on the description by the crew members who experienced the witch abduction incident, endowed with a slight amount of magic by two real witches. A dream as if thousands of stellar lights were falling.
des.适合独行客的发型挑染。据说某时某地曾有过一位如同赤色闪电般降临又消失之人。: Highlights suitable for solo travelers. It is said that at some time and place, there was a person who appeared and disappeared like a crimson lightning.
des.过去在岚心城周边地区常见的服装。穿上这身往街边茶室里一坐，就绝不会被误认为有事可: Past common clothing seen in the areas around Ranshin City. Wearing this and sitting in a tea house, one would never be mistaken for someone with something to do.
des.过去在岚心城周边地区常见的草履。虽然和传统草履有所区别，但这双实在潮流。: Past common straw sandals seen in the areas around Ranshin City. Although they differ from traditional straw sandals, this pair is truly trendy.
des.环线联合院线大片《故者之环》中主角装束的一部分。掩盖容貌的旅行者啊，你要往何处去: Part of the protagonist's costume in the blockbuster "Fallen Ring" by Loop United Cinemas. Traveler who conceals appearance, where are you going?
des.典籍之馆的管理者常用的发带，简约、经典、优雅。: The headband commonly used by the curator of the House of Classics; simple, classic, and elegant.
des.典籍之馆的管理者常穿的礼裙，有着华丽独特的镂空设计——但别人穿上同款时就会发现，: The ceremonial dress commonly worn by the curator of the House of Classics featuring a luxurious and unique hollow-out design - however, others who put on the same style will find the dress much heavier than expected.
des.典籍之馆的管理者常穿的高跟鞋。真正强大的人无论蹬着多么可怕的高跟都能健步如飞。: The high heels commonly worn by the curator of the House of Classics. Truly powerful people can walk briskly no matter how daunting the heels they wear.
des.第七任枢纽的头冠，专为某个特别的女孩设计，但其实戴在别的人头上也挺可爱的。某位异: The crown of the seventh pope, designed for a specific girl, but it actually looks quite cute on someone else's head too. A certain outlander expressed strong disdain for this.
des.第七任枢纽的华服，每根丝线或者说纤维都受过机械神的祝福。穿上这身华服就接受了机械: The gown of the seventh pope, every thread or fiber has received the blessing of the mechanical god. By wearing this splendid attire, one receives the grace of the mechanical god, but that alone is not enough to become a "pope".
des.第七任枢纽的长袜（配皮鞋），或许是她身上唯一相对符合她年纪的部分。明艳的竖条纹，: The socks (and leather shoes) of the seventh pope, probably be the only part of her attire that relatively suits her age. Bright vertical stripes, like shadows cast by invisible railings.
des.环线联合院线大片《故者之环》中主角装束的一部分。从遥远之地传来消息，故者之环已然: Part of the protagonist's costume in the blockbuster "Fallen Ring" by Loop United Cinemas. The distant land tells a story, the Fallen Ring has already shattered...
des.黑月旗下潮玩品牌最新推出的“异乡来客”设计系列头盔，尼禄款。商品标签上写着“戴上: The latest "Outlander" series helmet from the toy brand under Night Chains, Nero's model. The product tag says "Once worn, it can devour its wearer"… No, no, no, this doesn't seem right at all?!
des.机械之眼的管理者所戴的遮阳帽，装饰作用远大于实用性。毕竟她根本就不在白天醒来嘛。: The sun hat worn by the manager of the Mechanical Eye, more decorative than practical. After all, she doesn't even wake up during the day.
des.机械之眼的管理者所戴的单眼镜，镜片并非用于矫正视力，而是用于窥视机械结构的本质。: The monocle worn by manager of the Mechanical Eye, not used for vision correction but for peering into the essence of mechanical structures.
des.机械之眼的管理者所穿的厚重礼裙，与原主人本就娇小的身形相称。不知道套在别人身上如: The heavy ceremonial dress worn by manager of the Mechanical Eye, suits the petite figure of its original owner. Wonder how it would fit on someone else...
des.机械之眼的管理者所穿的长袜和皮鞋。不知怎么的，看着这双风格奇妙的长袜，你想起了某: The stockings and leather shoes worn by manager of the Mechanical Eye. Somehow, looking at these strangely styled stockings, you are reminded of a certain outlander.
des.环线联合院线大片《故者之环》中主角装束的一部分。将荒芜的道路踏在脚下，重新建立世: Part of the protagonist's costume in the blockbuster "Fallen Ring" by Loop United Cinemas. Tread the desolate paths and become the new lord.

words.嘎、哈、哈、哈！要帮忙的话立刻来找我就好啦！: Ah, ha, ha, ha! If you need a hand, just come to me right away!
words.监视机器人可以帮忙搬东西哦！: My surveillance robots can help carry stuff!
words.你好！这里可以点餐！: Hello! What can I get for you?
words.海豹大头贴机最新型号\\n入驻，不来体验一下吗？: The latest Seals' Photo Booth \njust dropped. Care to give it a try?
words.海豹大头贴机可是现在\\n的流行趋势，没理由不\\n来拍几张吧？: The Seals' Photo Booth is the \nlatest trend. No harm \ntaking a few photos, right?
words.欢迎光临海豹奶茶店！\\n想喝点什么？: Welcome to Seal's Tea Shop! \nWhat do you feel like drinking?
words.请问要不要尝试一下我们的\\n新品呀？评价很不错哦！: Can I interest you in trying our \nnew beverages? The reviews have been great so far!
words.大声说你想找什么？除了最\\n棒的音乐和饮品，这里什么\\n都没有！: Could you repeat more loudly what you're looking for? We have nothing \nbut the best music and drinks here!
words.来杯气泡水如何，想象那些\\n气泡和摇滚乐一同让你灵魂\\n爆裂的感觉！: How about some sparkling water? Imagine the bubbles and rock 'n' roll music making your soul \nburst!
words.你好！这里可以选购衣服！: Hello! You can buy clothes here!
words.本店的拉面全都是当日新鲜\\n食材现做！欢迎品尝！: Our ramen is made with today's freshest ingredients! Feel free to have a taste!
words.旅途疲惫的时候，来一碗热\\n乎乎的拉面就能恢复精力！: When you feel tired from your travels, a bowl of hot ramen can restore your energy!
words.欢迎品尝拉面，配料丰富！\\n但是本店不提供香肠配菜！: Have a taste of our ramen! Ingredients are plentiful, but we don't serve sausage toppings!
words.我们要不要去找点事情做？最近列车组的财务状况好像又变得入不敷出了。: Shouldn't we go find work? The crew's finances have become tight again.
words.那不如打点猎物去卖？: How about hunting some game to sell?
words.这是篝火城，应该也没人会买来路不明的“猎物”吧……: This is a Bonfire City, so no one would buy game of an unknown origin...
words.而且，万一碰见形态污染检查，你的宝贝猎物说不定还会被扣下来送检。: Besides, if we encounter a morphic field pollution check, your precious game might be confiscated for inspection.
words.那怎么办啦——啊，你看那边！站台附近的公告栏上！: What should we do then — Ah, over there! The notice board near the platform!
words.……城防卫队招募海报？和他们一起行动的话，肯定就要混在人堆里。你不是最怕那种场合: ...A recruitment poster for the City Defense Force? If we join up with them, we'll definitely have to mingle in the crowd. Isn't that what you fear the most?
words.你没问题的话，我也没意见。说不定再这样努力下去，我就真的能把你带回去了。: If you're cool with it, I'm fine. Maybe if we keep working like this, I'll really be able to bring you back.
words.不，不行，无论如何都不想和那么多人一起行动……我说，我们还是掉头去看看铁安局有什: N-No. I really don't want to be with so many people... Hey, over there! Let's go see if the BCRL Agency has any missions!
words.好耶！今天是什么味儿的？红茶吗？上次那个好喝！: Oh yeah! What's today's flavor? Black tea? The one I had last time was delicious!
words.……闻起来有种香气，不是很苦……这个也好喝！: ...It's fragrant. Not too bitter...This is yummy too!
words.从前，还在家里住的时候，我老爹偶尔也会把我采回来的草药晒干然后拿去泡水。虽然那个: Back when I was still living at home, my dad would sometimes dry the herbs I gathered and make tea with them. That was slightly bitterer but the fragrance was just as nice.
words.吓死我了……这种事你也早点说啦！: You gave me a scare... You should've told me about this earlier!
words.艾略特，你要喝茶吗？我刚刚泡好的。: Do you want some tea, Eliot? I just brewed some.
words.啊，但今天没问题的，杯子里的不是红茶，是普通的花草茶。有镇静心情的效果哦。: Ah, it's fine today. It's not black tea, just common herbal tea with a calming effect.
words.那，如果什么时候你又找到那种草药的话，我们一起做那种茶吧？: Well, when you find those herbs again, let's make that kind of tea together!
words.但我记得……你喝茶以后容易失眠？上次你就是因为喝了茶后入睡太晚，结果换岗时起不来: But I remember... tea gives you insomnia, right? You stayed up too late the other time after drinking tea and almost missed the shift change. Fran had to search three carriages to find you.
words.虽然我对制茶流程没什么研究，不过简单的草药茶，我还是可以试一试的。: Although I don't know much about brewing tea, I can still try making simple herbal tea.
words.我见过哦。艾略特把小鸟打下来的时候，打得很准！: I've seen it before. Eliot is a marksman in bird shooting!
words.差不多吧，总之是夸黛丝莉厉害的意思。: Well, in any case, my point is, Desiree is very good.
words.下次再也不和你比射击了。你的准头简直好到犯规啊？！: I'm not going to compete with you in shooting again. You're so accurate that it's almost like cheating!
words.唔唔……犯规就是很强？: Uhh... Is being too good considered cheating?
words.不是说你真的犯规，是说你很强的意思啦。毕竟我又没有升构能力……: I'm not accusing you of cheating. It's just that you're really good at it! After all, I lack the ascension ability...
words.黛丝莉没有犯规，都按照之前说好的规则来的！一次只许射一支箭、不要用尖尖的箭头、调: Desiree didn't cheat. She followed the rules we agreed on! Only one arrow allowed at a time, no pointed arrowheads, and the bowstring must be loosened. That's not cheating!
words.怎么会啦，帝国也有很多以打猎为生的人，库克有时候也会自己出去找吃的。: How could that be? Many people in the Empire make a living by hunting. Sometimes Cook even goes out to find food himself.
words.嗯……基本上是风干的肉还有煮熟的肉……然后，库克最喜欢吃的东西是烧鸟串。: Hmm... It's basically dried meat and cooked meat... And Cook's favorite is grilled bird skewers.
words.……原来地上的人出门打猎会直接带回来熟食啊。: ...So people on the ground just bring back cooked food when they go hunting?
words.不不，这是超市买来的。不过刚刚吓死我了，我还以为你要说我猎杀库克的同类然后绝不轻: No, no. I bought this at the supermarket. But I got scared just now thinking you were going to say Cook wouldn't forgive me after I hunted its brethren...
words.……哈哈……这个，是我今天的劳动成果！: ...Haha...This is, uh, the fruit of my labor today!
words.那库克平时吃什么？好像每次都看你单独给他喂些吃的。: So what does Cook usually eat? I see you feeding it something different every time.
words.烧鸟串？！它不是鸟吗？！: Grilled bird skewers?! But isn't it a bird?!
words.嗯，我也不太理解。……哦，刚刚它说，“因为就是好吃”。: Yeah, I don't quite understand either... Oh, it says, 'Because it's delicious.'
words.那，现在我在这里，不会打扰到你吗？: So, am I bothering you by being here now?
words.毕竟是和睦的大家庭，家里的每个人都想寄信来，加上从前的朋友之类，弗兰总是能收到许: We're a harmonious big family, after all. Everyone at home wants to send letters, and then there are old friends and such. So Fran always receives many letters!
words.上面写的是她家里的地址哦，估计又是充满了弟弟妹妹的思念和爱的信？: The address indicates it's from her home. I guess the letter is filled with longing and affection from her younger siblings?
words.我刚刚没找到她，但这里正好有封寄给她的信。: I couldn't find her, but there's a letter addressed to her.
words.……你为什么这么了解啊！: ...Why do you know so much about this?!
words.……啊！我好像看见弗兰了！回头见列车长！: ...Ah! I think I see Fran! See you later, Conductor!
words.那，艾略特呢？会收到别人的信吗？: So, what about you, Eliot? Do you get letters from others?
words.列车长——我回来了！说起来，你看见弗兰在哪了吗？: Conductor — I'm back! Speaking of which, did you see where Fran went?
words.哎嘿……那你看吧！只要把这根弦扣到这里……: Hehe... Watch! Hook this string here...
words.总觉得艾略特在调整武器的时候比较开心呢。: I always get the feeling that you're happier when you're adjusting your weapon, Eliot.
words.是啊，之前差点被打坏了——列车长，这个可以报销吗？: Yeah, it almost got damaged earlier — Conductor, can I reimburse for this?
words.视情况……可以。: Depending on the situation... it's possible.
words.那当然！又可以一个人清净地待着、又是和心爱的武器在一起，怎么想都会很开心啊。\r: Of course! I get to be alone in peace, being with my beloved weapon. It's always a happy thought. Of course! Being alone in peace, and being with my beloved weapon, it's always happy no matter how you think about it.
words.开玩笑的！我还有好几份替换的备用零件。但手弩就是这样啦，需要经常调校，很金贵的。: Just kidding! I have several spare parts. But such a mini crossbow requires frequent calibration. It's very precious.
words.列车长，别凑这么近啊，万一零件崩出来弹到你，报销的就是你的工伤了！: Conductor, don't get too close. If a component flies out and hits you, you'll have to claim it under your work compensation claim!
words.我这是相信艾略特的技术，毕竟你看起来对弩很了解的样子嘛。: It's because I trust your skills, Eliot. After all, you seem to know a lot about crossbows.
words.遥，上次你做的那道菜很好吃！: Haruka, the dish you made last time was delicious!
words.我觉得不是。对自己的烹饪技术有点信心嘛，遥做饭真的很好吃哦，而且能充分利用列车上: I don't think so. Have some confidence in your cooking skills. Haruka, your cooking is really delicious, and you make full use of the equipment on the train.
words.新学到的菜谱？从波克士那里吗？: Did you learn a new recipe? From BOX?
words.……没什么特别的，我就是顺便试了一下新学到的菜谱而已。: ...It's nothing special. I just tried a new recipe I learned.
words.遥很会做饭呢……之前我听大家也说遥的烹饪技术很好，这么看果然。: Your cooking skills are impressive. I've heard everyone praise your cooking, and now that I've witnessed it myself, I completely agree.
words.难道不是大家都没什么可吃的所以不得不吃吗？: Isn't it because there's no alternative available, so they're forced to eat it?
words.嗯，偶尔从广播里听见就记下来了，做出来的效果意外地还不错。很适合当夜宵。: Yeah, I jotted the recipe down when I happened to hear it on the radio. It turned out surprisingly well. Perfect for supper.
words.嗯，下次轮到我做的时候，我也会拿出“外面的”新菜式让遥大开眼界的~: Yeah, when it's my turn to cook next, I'll also prepare some dishes from outside to impress you, Haruka~
words.……不是说那个意思。但，你想的话也行。: ...That's not what I meant. But, go ahead if you feel like doing so.
words.那你很有天赋啊，能把不同的人团结到一起。: Then you're pretty talented, eh? Being able to make different people united.
words.之前发了新版本的《小队行动指导手册》，你有看吗？: Did you see the new Team Mission Guidebook I put out?
words.硬要说的话，不算是天赋，可能只是在家的时候总要把打成一团的弟弟妹妹们分开，所以有: I don't think it's a talent. Perhaps my experience with squabbling younger siblings back home taught me how to mediate between others?
words.哈哈，这么一想，感觉其实很多事情都差不多呢！总想着偷懒和“不要上学”的部分也差不: Haha, come to think of it, they are actually quite similar in many ways indeed! Even the tendency to slack off and dislike going to school~
words.……完全就是很适合带队啊。: ...You're definitely suited to be a leader.
words.那我们这边的情况也差不多。多萝西现在应该还在铁盟的军官办公室写检讨，卡莲呢……刚: We're in similar situations then. Dorothy should still be in the B.C.R.L. officer's room writing appraisals. While Karen... was just led away by Shizuru for special training, after petering her for too long.
words.是啊，刚刚处理完……艾略特和黛丝莉的“射击比赛”的战果。: Oh, yeah. I just finalized... the results of Eliot and Desiree's shooting competition.
words.啊，你来这里休息吗？: Hey, are you here to rest?
words.嗯？之前带队的一直是我哦。: Huh? I've always been the one leading the team.
words.嗯，看了。里面更新了几个行动条款，其余变化不大。对我们在外执勤应该没有影响。: Yeah, I saw it. There're updates on a few mission clauses, but the rest hasn't changed much. It shouldn't affect our duties.
words.没有啦，我也没那种想法。但，要说前线战斗的话，之前一般都是我带队。: Nah, I don't have such an intention. But, when it comes to frontline combat, I'm usually the one leading the team.
words.……据我所知，应该没有，指挥都是列车长直接下达的。: ...As far as I know, there shouldn't be. Conductor issues the orders directly.
words.不，不是要问你那个问题……只是我在想，是不是无垠号上也有类似的手册？: No, that's not what I'm asking... I'm just wondering if there's a similar manual on The Eternal.
words.抱歉，我们没在偷偷谈论你……只是对无垠号的战斗稍微有些好奇。: Sorry, we weren't talking behind your back... We're just kind of curious about combat on The Eternal.
words.记得及时缴纳保证金，保证囚犯正常生活哦~: Remember to pay the deposits in time to ensure the smooth operation of this Reforming Center!
words.我还以为蜜獾小队的人都像朱利安一样可靠呢……: I thought everyone in Team Ratel was as reliable as Julian...
words.……我还以为无垠号上的人都像弗兰一样可靠呢。: ...I thought everyone on The Eternal was as reliable as Fran...
words.她俩把整趟车上的空易拉罐和玻璃瓶子都拿去当标靶了……本来那些都能做回收资源的，现: The two of them used all the empty cans and glass bottles on the whole train as targets... Those could've been recycled, but not anymore. Although it isn't a big loss, still... sigh.
words.我也不知道该干嘛，所以在这休息一会。: I don't know what to do, so I'm just resting here for a while.
words.先不讨论我可不可靠的问题，她俩平时绝对称不上可靠。: Let's not discuss whether I'm reliable or not. Those two definitely cannot be relied on.
words.整顿中心的运转也是需要资金的啦！有闲钱的话，往我这里投点吧？: We need money to keep the Reforming Center running! If you have money to spare, why don't you invest some here?
words.随便挑随便看，试衣间在这边~~~这样说就可以了吧……呼……: Feel free to look around, the dressing room's over here~~~ Guess that'll do... Phew...
words.欢迎光临，请随意落座！\\n要看我捏寿司的话请坐吧台！: Welcome, please feel free to take a seat! If you want to watch me make sushi, please sit at the bar!
words.本店海鲜保证新鲜，\\n当日捕捞随切随吃！: The seafood in our store is guaranteed fresh, catch of the day, cut and eat!
words.本店寿司食材都经过了严格的形态污染检测，\\n无需担心食品安全！: The sushi ingredients in our store have all undergone strict morphic field pollution testing, so there's no need to worry about food safety!

describe.无垠号车组标准64座客车车厢，可提供更高的载客能力。: The Eternal's standard 64-seat car, provides greater passenger capacity.
describe.铁盟拖挂式武器平台车厢，可提供武装搭载能力。: B.C.R.L.'s trailer-mounted armament platform car that provides armament mounting capability.
describe.科伦巴制式重型货厢，可提供更大的载货能力。: COLUMBA standard, provides increased cargo capacity.
describe.科伦巴制式轻型货厢，可提供一定的载货能力。: COLUMBA standard, provides moderate cargo capacity.
describe.无垠号车组标准护卫队车厢，可提供更大的生活空间。: The Eternal's standard guard crew car, provides larger living space.
describe.科伦巴制式标准货厢，可满足列车组日常载货运输需求。: COLUMBA standard, satisfies daily freight transport needs.

skinDetail.无垠号标准列车外观。: The standard exterior of The Eternal.
skinDetail.曼德矿场制造的车厢外观之一。黑色的外观使其在夜间不易被发现，提升了行驶安全性。傍: One of the liveries crafted at Mander Mine. Its black color makes it less noticeable at night, enhancing safety. Passengers often overlook it in the evening.
skinDetail.由100箱金箔和100名贴金机器人手工打造的金色外观。不仅大大提高了列车的豪华程: Hand crafted using 100 boxes of Gold Leaf and 100 gold-plating robots. Not only adds to the train's opulence but also serves as a reflective shield against Chaos Remains' beam attacks.
skinDetail.由100箱金箔和100名贴金机器人手工打造的金色列车外观。不仅大大提高了列车的豪: Hand crafted using 100 boxes of Gold Leaf and 100 gold-plating robots. Not only adds to the train's opulence but also serves as a reflective shield against Chaos Remains' beam attacks.
skinDetail.经典列车外观之一。使用了深受年轻人欢迎的39号涂料，特别的色彩包含着“一切的出发: One of the classic train liveries. It's painted with the popular Paint #39, with a special color symbolizing "the starting point of everything."
skinDetail.稀有车厢外观之一。使用了象征着神秘与永恒的1号涂料，在轨道上飞驰时如同流星在暮色: One of the rare train liveries. Painted with Paint #1 that symbolizes mystery and eternity. When speeding along the tracks, it looks like a shooting star streaking through the twilight.
skinDetail.为亚莉奈量身打造的列车痛车涂装。大胆的配色与那张熟悉的脸庞相得益彰。请不要多想这: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Arina. The bold colors complement her familiar face. Don't dwell on why this option is in the selection list; enjoy the journey together on the railway.
skinDetail.经典车厢外观之一。使用了经典百搭的06号霞光红涂料，带有光泽的红色尽显速度感，用: One of the classic train liveries. It's painted with the timeless and versatile Paint #6. Its glossy red color enhances the perception of speed, while the antennae made from Skeleton Tail contribute to its unique charisma.
skinDetail.经典车厢外观之一。使用了经典百搭的06号霞光红涂料，带有光泽的红色与车身适配度极: One of the classic train liveries. It's painted with the timeless and versatile Paint #6. Its glossy red color matches the carriage perfectly, making it a preferred choice for many conductors.
skinDetail.为妮蔻拉量身打造的列车痛车涂装。先锋的设计风格将那位发明家本人的创造理念展现得淋: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Nicola. The innovative design style showcases the renowned inventor's creativity while instilling a sense of excitement to surpass top speeds.
skinDetail.在不算遥远的过去，地联与阿妮塔曾计划探索木星，并为此投入了巨量的资源。在航天计划: In a collab between the Earth Union and Anita not long ago, significant resources were allocated for a joint exploration of Jupiter. However, with the suspension of the space project, these resources have been repurposed for civilian use, leading to the creation of the "Bustling Business."
skinDetail.为多萝西量身打造的列车痛车涂装。呼呼！正义的使者、孩子们的好伙伴多萝西，伴随着震: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Dorothy. Behold! The messenger of justice and the beloved friend of children, she is making a stunning debut with vibrant fireworks and explosives!
skinDetail.为苔妮量身打造的列车痛车涂装。梦幻柔软的色调与无垠号自身的工业美感达成了奇妙的和: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Tennie. The dreamlike color palette beautifully complements The Eternal's industrial aesthetic, resulting in a captivating design, a true reflection of her artistic preferences.
skinDetail.黑月斥巨资打造的豪华观光列车，从外观到内饰都贯彻典雅奢华，堪称“移动版黑月大酒店: A luxurious sightseeing train created by Night Chains at high expenses. Known as the "Mobile Night Chains Hotel," elegance and luxury are present throughout, from the exterior to the interior. You will surely never forget this extraordinary experience.
skinDetail.为索玛量身打造的列车痛车涂装。低调的配色与那在短暂接触中留下深刻印象的脸庞总是会: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Sommer. Its subdued color scheme and the face that left a deep impression during the brief encounter always remind you of everything that happened in that apartment. You have already created amazing memories with her.
skinDetail.铁盟研发的客运列车型号，泛用性高，载客量大，将性价比贯彻到极致。许多乘客在出行时: A passenger train developed by BCRL, featuring a large passenger capacity and optimized cost efficiency. A preferred choice for many travelers.
skinDetail.铁盟研发的一款列车型号，在灵活性和载重能力上相较于旧系列得到了显著提升，于大量工: A train developed by B.C.R.L. distinguished by its heightened flexibility and load capacity in comparison to the prior series. It is widely used in numerous industrial cities.
skinDetail.为夏尔量身打造的列车痛车涂装。在本人出尽风头的同时，也不会忘了她最好的伙伴朱迪。: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Shire. Let's not overlook her loyal companion Jude while she enjoys the spotlight. Driving a train like this feels more like skipping and dancing along the rails.
skinDetail.地卫二事件让火车事业发生了翻天覆地的变化，余烬号为致敬曾经的老式火车而设计。登上: Morphic Moon event has caused great impact on the train industry, and The Embers was designed to pay homage to the trains of yore. Does boarding it evoke nostalgia in some? The embers remain aglow, with fresh sparks igniting.
skinDetail.为静流·逐夏量身打造的列车痛车涂装。时间会流逝，四季会轮转，但是照耀水面的阳光、: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Shizuru the Summer Chaser. Time will march on, seasons will change, but the sunlight glistening on the water, the faint tang of the sea breeze, and her radiant smile will remain eternal. Carry the cherished memories you have shared with her as you ride the waves.
skinDetail.为蜜獾小队的成员们量身打造的列车痛车涂装。作为新一代铁盟士兵的优秀代表，她们始终: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Team Ratel. As the representatives of the new generation of B.C.R.L. soldiers, they always stick to their posts and reflect the true spirits of B.C.R.L. in every aspect of their work.
skinDetail.为雅莱量身打造的列车痛车涂装。有无数想要亲自踏足的地点，想要亲眼欣赏的风景，这个: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Jalhay. She has countless places that she would like to visit, and it seems that her wish will be realized as the Eternal travels forward. Don't let go of that hand on the way, even if...
skinDetail.浑身上下充满了谜团的列车，据说以一种名为“超合金Z”的梦幻材料打造而成，车身坚不: This train, shrouded in mysteries, is said to be made of a fantastic material called "Chougoukin Z" that makes it indestructible. It is powered by a mysterious energy source known as "Photon Power," which neither Anita Tech nor Source Citadel know anything about. While this is widely believed to be a gimmick, someone has witnessed a certain Conductor transforming the cab into an aircraft...
skinDetail.由各种莫名其妙的零件以莫名其妙的方式组合而成的莫名其妙的列车，只有马力十分强劲。: An inexplicable train made up of inexplicable parts assembled in an inexplicable way, boasting extremely strong power. Upon seeing this train, even erudite scholars of Source Citadel will experience a brief brain downtime due to their inability to comprehend its structure. Unfortunately, the helmet-like armor on top of this train is not removable.
skinDetail.为帕拉笛量身打造的列车痛车涂装。即使离开整顿中心，司令也不会失其风采。扶正帽檐，: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Paladi. The commandant maintains her grace even outside the Reforming Center. Adjust her hat and cloak, she is ready for the next journey.
skinDetail.浑身上下充满了谜团的列车，具有与现今所有列车所不相同的构造，车身坚不可摧。据车内: A mysterious train known for its unique design and indestructible structure. A report found on board identifies the previous owner as "Dr. Aoi," and peculiar wooden sticks were spotted scattered in the trash... Anyway, it will aid you on your journey ahead.
skinDetail.为淘金乐园的人气偶像金子小姐量身打造的列车痛车涂装。不曾因为时光流逝而磨灭，始终: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Miss Gold, a renowned idol in ONEderland. Her enduring dream within the machine will withstand the test of time and shine brightly. Stay true to the original vision and forge a path toward a brighter future.
skinDetail.为佩罗塔量身打造的列车痛车涂装。将目标定为地平线的另一端，相信总有一日能和重要之: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Pelota. This little "fool" will continue her journey, aiming for the distant horizon in hopes of reuniting with someone she holds dear someday.
skinDetail.在对甲铁城的结构以及内外装饰进行考察后复原的列车，对一些部分进行了改进使其符合西: This train has been meticulously restored after a thorough examination of Koutetsujou's structure and interiors, and has been adjusted to meet the standards of the Western Continent Railway Loop. Crew members from Koutetsujou happily comment, "It feels like home."
skinDetail.为身穿“蝶翼”装束的无名量身打造的列车痛车涂装。由于服装本身给人一种轻快活泼的印: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Mumei in her "Wings of Butterfly" attire. This scheme, dominated by pink colors, perfectly complements Mumei's vibrant aura.
skinDetail.为异乡来客·无名量身打造的列车痛车涂装。有她作为保镖，自然不用担心路上遇见的危险: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Outlander Mumei. With her protection, you can remain at ease despite any incoming dangers. "Just remember to pay me, alright?"
skinDetail.为达斯廷量身打造的列车痛车涂装。将遗憾与悔恨埋藏心底，只余熊熊燃烧的赤诚心火不灭: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Dustin. He entombed regrets and remorse deep within his heart, leaving only the fervor burning within. He shall light the way for others, dispel the shadows, and advance unwaveringly toward the future.
skinDetail.改进自一款经典的动力集中型动车组，无论是速度还是乘坐体验都得到了大幅提升，流线型: This train represents an enhanced version of a traditional power-focused train, offering significantly improved speed and riding comfort. Its sleek design takes inspiration from a trout native to the designer's hometown, envisioned to glide effortlessly through various landscapes.
skinDetail.为乌刹娜量身打造的列车痛车涂装。”想要与救世主大人在一起“，这个一直扎根于心间的: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Ushana. "I want to stay with my Master Savior forever!" Her heartfelt wish has finally realized. With her cherished one by her side, she will fearlessly explore every corner of the world.
skinDetail.经过改装的无垠号列车外观，各方面性能均有所提升。: Modified exterior of The Eternal, its performance in all aspects have been enhanced.
skinDetail.在无垠号的基础上，对性能进行了针对性的调整提升，配合未来感的全新外观，似乎更加贴: Built on the Eternal, its performance has been specifically tuned and enhanced, paired with a brand-new, futuristic exterior — it seems to edge closer to what the Eternal was always meant to be. Yet Nicola, the engine designer, believes it's still a long way off from the Eternal's ultimate, perfect form.
skinDetail.为乌刹娜量身打造的列车痛车涂装。”想要与救世主大人在一起“，这个一直扎根于心间的: A customized train livery exclusively designed for Ushana. "I want to stay with my Master Savior forever!" Her heartfelt wish has finally realized. With her cherished one by her side, she will fearlessly explore every corner of the world.
skinDetail.根据CBCRR23列车长本人的改造方案，对无垠号车头的性能进行了更加私人化的改造: The locomotive of the Eternal is further modified for better performance based on the blueprint of the conductor of CBCRR23, perfectly matching the Eternal train. It is said that the design received strong support from Livia.
skinDetail.为马吉拉·星仪量身打造的列车痛车涂装。以星光作为施法媒介，将魔女的故事铭刻心中—: A train livery customized for Margiela the Stargazer. Using starlight as the medium for casting, engrave the witch's story in her heart — live the rest of her life proudly in her own way.
skinDetail.搭载了大功率共振探照灯的列车，能够形成特殊的形态场驱散道路前方的桦树生物，照亮前: This train can create a unique morphic field that disperses Chaos Remains along its path and illuminates the way forward, an ideal option for traveling in low-visibility areas. Its unique style and name are rumored to originate from a legend of the Empire.
skinDetail.为罗洁尔量身打造的列车痛车涂装。与这终于获得平静的灵魂携手，等待再度潜入意识海的: A train livery designed for Raziel. Together with this soul that has finally gained peace, await the moment to dive into Unbewusstes again. One day, please drift further alongside her...
skinDetail.为奥莉薇恩量身打造的列车痛车涂装。相信这趟列车的运行会和绘制其上的专业女仆一样，: A train livery designed for Olivien. The operation of this train will certainly be as smooth, reliable, and reassuring as the professional maid depicted on it.
skinDetail.以物廉价美而著称的列车型号，大大小小的站点都常见到它的身影，是许多乘客出行的不二: Known for its affordable and high-quality features, this train model is frequently seen at stations of all sizes and is a top choice for many passengers. The welcoming and comfortable carriage environment is perfect for experiencing a leisurely journey.
skinDetail.黑月出品电影《魔女奇旅》中短暂作为拍摄场景出现的列车，风格梦幻，受到无数喜爱这部: The train that briefly appeared as a filming scene in the Night Chains' film "Witch's Odyssey." Perhaps many passengers will board the newly decorated Eternal to gain the experience from the film.
skinDetail.为克洛伊量身打造的列车痛车涂装。从地平线另一侧席卷而来的，究竟是暴风雨还是她操控: A train livery tailored for Chloe. Is it a tempest sweeping in from the other side of the horizon, or is it her figure approaching with flashes of lightning?
skinDetail.为真咲量身打造的列车痛车涂装。满怀着对未知的好奇与憧憬，尽情把握充满无限可能性的: A train livery tailored for Masaki. With wonder and longing for the unknown, she seizes a new life of boundless possibility. The witch's wish is granted; her desired future unfurls in the sun.
skinDetail.为涟量身打造的列车痛车涂装。只要和信赖之人并肩，即使是以这双不变的眼睛去看，也一: A train livery designed for Ren. Walk beside the one she holds dear, and even that pair of unchanging eyes will catch sight of new hues.
skinDetail.为伊卡菈量身打造的列车痛车涂装。接受她的赠予，相信她的真心，化作那双绚烂而美丽的: A specially designed train livery tailored for Ikara. Accept her bestowal, trust in her sincerity, and transform into those dazzling and beautiful wings.
skinDetail.风格独特的列车，黑白两色涂装的设计初衷是区分面向山以及面向海的不同侧。在车门打开: A uniquely styled train, with a black-and-white color scheme designed to distinguish the different sides facing the mountains and the sea. When the train doors open, the carriage connections emit mist reminiscent of the "Tamatebako" story.
skinDetail.为海伦娜量身打造的列车痛车涂装。这位魔法师的温柔与智慧是比宝石更加耀眼可贵的事物: A train itasha livery tailored for Helena. The gentleness and wisdom of this sorceress are more dazzling and precious than jewels; her guidance and teachings are sure to guard the smooth road ahead.
skinDetail.为斯洛卡伊量身打造的列车痛车涂装。她的美丽和尊严不容丝毫折损，不信者和叛逆者无法: The train's custom paint job tailored for Slokai. Her beauty and dignity are inviolable, and unbelievers and rebels cannot harm her in the slightest... "Boring prayers. This is only natural, mortals!"
skinDetail.搭载了超热离子引擎的神秘列车，具有难以想象的热吸收转化能力，从设计到结构都有一种: The mysterious train equipped with a super hot ion engine possesses unimaginable heat absorption and conversion capabilities. From its design to its structure, it has a beauty not belonging to this era. According to a certain Outlander, its prototype is a dream mecha known as the "Sword Saint Machine."
skinDetail.为朵拉弥丝量身打造的列车痛车涂装。与另一陌生个体的接触总是充满未知，然而她将毫无: A train itasha paint job customized for Doramisi. Contact with another unknown individual is always full of the unknown; however, she will show you everything without reservation and embrace everything.

des.当刺豚用来保护自己的武器不会扎到我们身上时，这些刺反而让它显得格外可爱。实际上胆: When the spikes that a Puffer uses to defend itself aren't hurting us, they actually make the Puffer look especially adorable. In fact, Puffers are very easily spooked, so kindly avoid scaring them.
des.认真观察你就会发现，刺豚实际并不擅长游泳，大部分时间只是在缓慢地移动。当然，当它: Upon closer observation, you'll discover that Puffers aren't great swimmers and that they move at a slow pace the majority of the time. Of course, when their spikes are out, the surrounding fish will make way for Puffers.
des.分布于较寒冷水域的大型龙虾，颜色十分鲜艳。据说在某种情况下颜色会变得更加鲜艳……: A large lobster found in icier waters, with incredibly vibrant colors. It's said that in certain situations, its color becomes even more brilliant...
des.可爱的刺海马，眼神似乎十分天真。绝对没人想知道它们的繁衍方式。: A cute Spiny Seahorse with a gaze that seems utterly innocent. Absolutely no one wants to know how they reproduce.
des.背壳和四肢花纹都十分具有美感的龟类，花纹很可爱。据说有的地方用这种龟的名字命名了: A type of turtle with lovely, aesthetically pleasing patterns on its shell and limbs. Apparently, some places have named similar patterns after it.
des.蓝色的小鱼，尾巴是亮眼的黄色。攻击性不强，可以小群饲养，很适合新手。: A small blue fish with a bright yellow tail. Non-aggressive and can be kept with a small group. Perfect for beginners.
des.外形像是蛋黄一样的水母。乍一看会让人觉得这种生物是形态污染影响的产物，不过它其实: A jellyfish that resembles an egg yolk. At first glance, you may think its existence is due to the influence of Morphic Field Pollution, but it's in fact 100% natural.
des.蝴蝶鱼的一种。鲜艳协调的色彩使其被广大消费者偏爱。: A type of butterflyfish. Its vivid, complementing colors are adored by most consumers.
des.蝴蝶鱼中的名品，鱼身上的橙色斑点如同海面升起的太阳。: The most well-known butterflyfish. Its orange spots bear semblance to the sun rising above the sea.
des.蝴蝶鱼的一种。鳞片纹路清晰，一张一合之间如同波浪。: A type of butterflyfish with distinct scales that move like waves.
des.蝴蝶鱼的一种，体侧有一黑色圆斑。性情平和，适合与其他鱼类混养。: A type of butterflyfish with a black, round spot on its sides. It is peaceful and thus suitable to be kept with other types of fish.
des.孔雀鱼的一种。外形温柔可亲，性情也大都极为温和。: A type of guppy. Looks lovely and sweet and is mostly genial.
des.孔雀鱼的一种，绿松石相对活泼好动，适应能力很强。如果没有在水族箱里第一时间找到它: A type of guppy that's more active and with excellent adaptability. Do not panic if you don't see it in the aquarium right away. It may have simply blended in with the nearby aquatic plants and is playing Hide-and-Seek with you.
des.鱼身整体是鲜艳的宝蓝色，蓝唐王鱼成年后的颜色会暗淡不少，因此往往是幼鱼的价格更为: With a striking royal blue body, the Blue Tang eventually loses that vibrancy when it matures. Hence, fingerlings tend to cost a lot more in comparison.
des.美丽而优雅的，比其他天使鱼更昂贵的价格也阻挡不了人们饲养它的热情。: Despite its heftier price tag compared to other angelfish, people still can't help but want it for its beauty and elegance.
des.很常见的热带鱼，鱼鳍展开时就像天使张开翅膀。: A very common tropical fish that resembles an angel with spread wings when its fins are fanned out.
des.备受欢迎的热带鱼类，因鲜艳的颜色和身上的白色条纹而得名。小丑鱼已蝉联多年最可爱鱼: A highly popular tropical fish that earned its name from its brilliant color and white stripes. Clownfish has been in the Top 10 of the Cutest Fish Ranking List for several years.
des.形态受到共振影响发生改变的鲀鱼，对环境适应能力大大提高。理论上和桦树生物之间应该: This pufferfish, its morphology altered by resonance, exhibits heightened adaptability to its environment. Theoretically, it has no generic relationship with Chaos Remains...
des.适宜大批养殖的螃蟹，但这个品种被反馈肉太少不好吃。于是今天螃蟹带着朴素的颜色和不: Great for large-scale farming, but its meat has been said to be little and mediocre. As such, crabs, with their plain colors and uninspiring appearance, now live in aquariums.
des.分布于较温暖水域的大型海螺，花纹分布相当美丽。传说中会发出大海声音的海螺，应该就: A large conch found in warmer waters, with relatively stunning patterns. Its shell is likely one of those seashells rumored to give off sounds of the ocean.
des.可爱的冠海马，是刺海马的近亲。攻击力更低，是适合养殖的品种，会睁大圆溜溜的眼睛和: An adorable Crowned Seahorse, closely related to the Spiny Seahorse but less aggressive. It is ideal for farming, and it will even widen its big round eyes to make eye contact with humans.
des.广泛分布于海洋多处的乌贼品种，不过随着形态污染扩散，本来庞大的族群已陷入濒危的境: A type of cuttlefish widely scattered across the ocean, but as Morphic Field Pollution spreads, this originally abundant species has become endangered.
des.分布于较温暖水域的大型龙虾，色彩斑斓。对环境要求苛刻，养殖难度较高。: A large, multi-colored lobster found in warmer waters. Fairly difficult to farm due to its strict habitat requirements.
des.一种腕足较长的海星，除去颜色特殊以外和其他品种的海星差别不大。不过单凭这种特殊的: A type of starfish with long arms that's mostly similar to other starfish, aside from its unique color. However, this unique color alone is reason enough for its steep price.
des.一种腕足较多的海星，除去颜色特殊、腕足很多以外，和其他品种的海星差别不大。它的外: A type of starfish with more arms that's mostly similar to other starfish, aside from its unique color and additional arms. Its appearance reminds people of the sun portrayed in Mundus' storybooks.
des.颜色和外形都十分绚烂的水母，游动时如水中绽放的烟花一样美丽。生活在极为特殊的环境: A jellyfish with amazing colors and appearance that looks as magnificent as fireworks when it swims. Only a few are ever caught and sold due to their highly exclusive living environment.

describe.把海豹咖啡厅开到列车上真是个伟大壮举，是不是？\\n所在车厢乘客收益+10%，同: Isn't it such an achievement to have the Seal's Café on the train? \nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 10%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.内设普通坐便器。: A sitting toilet is installed inside.
describe.花语是“天真和平”与“纯洁之美”，花如其名。光是看它蓬勃盛开的样子心情都会变好。: True to its symbolism of 'peaceful innocence' and 'pure beauty,' the flower is guaranteed to lift your spirits when it blooms.
describe.颜色和咖啡店装修风格匹配的桌椅，给您一天好心情。: Table and chairs with color complementing the café's aesthetics. Certain to make your day.
describe.书架，上面的书好像有点落灰了……: A bookshelf filled with slightly dusty books...
describe.上面展示着今日限定以及特别折扣饮品。: States today's specials and the discounted beverage of the day.
describe.列车电力系统，别乱碰为好，注意让一切液体远离它！: The train's power system. Best not to mess with it, and remember to keep all liquids away!
describe.总会有顾客比起靠椅更喜欢高脚凳呢……: There will always be customers who prefer bar stools to chairs...
describe.叶片富有特殊的金属光泽，银皇后有着与名字同样美好的花语：仰慕。自从某部动作电影大: With leaves covered in an extraordinary metallic sheen, the Silver Queen represents something as pleasant as its name: admiration. Its value has doubled alongside the main lead of a certain action flick that became a box-office hit. But should you intend to profess your love, an indoor plant probably won't be your best option.
describe.一体式厨房，麻雀虽小五脏俱全，使用次数不多，但配料总会被及时补充。偶尔也会有人心: A small but comprehensive integrated kitchen that's hardly used, but cooking ingredients are always replenished in time. Occasionally, people will also conduct experiments here on a whim, thus explaining the few stubborn, charred spots on the counter. BOX reported that recently, someone has been sneakily switching out the ketchup with chili sauce.
describe.简易餐桌，面积有限，可别把东西都堆在这儿。: A minimalistic dining set with limited space. Don't pile all the stuff on here!
describe.不那么注重舒适度的行军床，躺上去时间久了容易腰酸背痛，优点是可以折叠节省空间。: A camping bed that doesn't promise comfort. Backaches are to be expected if you lie on it for long. On the plus side, its foldability makes it space-optimized.
describe.你的车载电脑，列车长社交冲浪必备。: Your onboard computer. A necessity for the Conductor to surf the net.
describe.控制台座椅，可以躺下呢！: The console seat. It is reclinable!
describe.投币式公共电话机，在黑月通讯网络覆盖不好的地方更接近摆设。\\n所在车厢乘客收益: A coin-operated public phone booth, often used more for decorative purposes than as an actual usable public phone in areas with limited Night Chains network coverage.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.自动坐便器，这样你就可以不用手动冲水了。: Automated toilet. This way, you won't have to manually flush it anymore.
describe.只是一个坐便器而已，有必要弄得这么夸张吗……？\\n\r所在车厢舒适度+3%，同: Come on, it's just a toilet. Does it have to be so dramatic...?\nIncreases the carriage's Comfort by 3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.缸中生机勃勃的一方小天地，高低错落有致，令人沉醉其中。: A small, vibrant section within the tank, featuring an enchanting mix of heights.
describe.守口如瓶波克士绝对不会告诉你这是列车长工资回收计划的一部分。\\n所在车厢乘客收: The tight-lipped Box would never tell you the truth this is actually part of the 'Payment Recycling Program' initiated by the Conductor.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.车厢门，进出列车的主要通道，采用最新、最轻便材料制造，保护乘客以及列车组人员的安: The carriage door, crafted with the newest and lightest materials. It is the main accessway in and out of the train and is meant to ensure the passengers and train crew's safety. Do not open it while the train is running unless in an emergency.
describe.方方正正的窗格，把车外的景色切割为一副尺寸标准的画。: Square window panes, providing a standard-sized view of the scenery outside the train.
describe.挤一挤或许能坐更多人的沙发。: A sofa that might accommodate more people if you squeeze in.
describe.电视机，会有信号不稳定导致出现雪花的情况。目前能看的节目很少。: A television that displays static when the signal is unstable. Only a few programs can be watched as of now.
describe.有医疗经验的人才能使用的诊断台，自己使用有很大可能把仪器搞坏或者得到错误的诊断结: A diagnostic table that can only be used by people with medical experience. Be warned that the equipment could be damaged or an incorrect diagnosis could be obtained should you use it by yourself! \nIncreases the carriage's Medical Rating by 5%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.耗费大额资金配备的治疗台，需要定期维护，冗长且无聊的使用手册据说催眠效果不错。\: A medical table acquired with a huge sum of money. Requires regular maintenance. Word has it that its lengthy and boring user manual is pretty good for hypnotism. \nIncreases the carriage's Medical Rating by 1%.
describe.医务室专用床，底部安装了轮子方便移动，可调节高度，同时配备了小桌板方便床上用餐。: A specialized bed for the infirmary equipped with wheels to make it portable. Not only is it height-adjustable, but it also comes with a small tabletop to cater for dining in bed. In consideration of privacy needs, it even has a partition curtain, albeit that hardly ever gets put into use.
describe.存放医疗设备的柜子，定时消毒杀菌，从里面拿取设备需佩戴手套。: A cabinet to store medical equipment. Routinely disinfected. One must be gloved before retrieving anything from it.
describe.药品柜，玻璃柜门能让药品储备一目了然，当然，柜门落灰的情况更被人所期待。: A medicine cabinet with glass doors to make viewing the contents convenient. Of course, it would be best if the doors were covered in dust.
describe.相较学名而言，显然人们更喜欢“发财树”这一名字。大部分消费者都愿意相信，发财树能: People clearly prefer the name 'Money Tree' more than its scientific name. Most consumers are willing to believe that the Money Tree can bring them good luck and unimaginable wealth.
describe.医务室的椅子，配有方便输液的支架。: The infirmary's chair. Comes with a stand for IV drips.
describe.医务室的地板，防滑耐脏，易于清洁。没必要一直盯着看。: The infirmary's floor. Slip and dirt-resistant and easy to clean. No need to keep staring at it.
describe.分类收纳的垃圾箱，容量有限，记得及时处理。制作采用的材质能阻断异味。: A categorized waste bin with limited capacity. Made with materials that block out foul smells. Don't forget to empty it regularly!
describe.为客运车厢配备的餐吧，请注意公共卫生。\\n所在车厢乘客收益+3%，同名家具限1: A dining bar for passenger cars. Please keep it clean for others. \nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.用来贮存新鲜蔬菜的小型冰箱。\\n冰箱容积+24。: A small refrigerator to store fresh vegetables.\nRefrigerator capacity +24.
describe.投币式望远镜，可以清楚地看到沃德山顶的草……要试试看吗？\\n所在车厢乘客收益+: A coin-operated telescope that provides a clear view of distant sights, even capturing the grass atop Ward Mountain... Want to give it a try?\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.车载电视柜，还是想办法把电视固定一下吧……: Onboard TV stand. Probably best to find a way to mount the TV instead...
describe.好的主人都会给宠物来一个这个，一旦你的宠物见到了宠物别墅，它的眼里就再也没有其他: All good owners will get one for their pets. Once your pet sees the pet villa, other run-of-the-mill beds will cease to exist in their eyes.
describe.有可爱外观的猫厕所，聪明的猫猫会自己学会用。\\n所在车厢宠物评分+1%: A cute-looking cat litter box. Smart cats will learn to use it on their own.\nIncreases the carriage's Pet Rating by 1%.
describe.仙人掌猫厕所，别担心，这上面没有真的刺！\\n所在车厢宠物评分+1%: A cactus-shaped cat litter box. Don't worry! It doesn't have real thorns!\nIncreases the carriage's Pet Rating by 1%.
describe.万圣节限定装扮的猫厕所，买到就是赚到。\\n所在车厢宠物评分+2%: A limited-edition Halloween themed cat litter box! Grab it now!\nIncreases the carriage's Pet Rating by 2%.
describe.音乐点唱机，可在车厢内自定义已有音乐，为工作时间增加一点艺术感。: A jukebox that can play whichever existing music you like in the carriages, creating an inspiring ambiance while you're at work.
describe.线索墙，你们经常在它面前一起讨论任务，角落里还贴了一张泛黄的菜单。: The investigation wall where your crew frequently gathers around to discuss your tasks. There's even a yellowed food menu pasted on the corner.
describe.缸中生机勃勃的一方小天地，植被恣意生长，宛如绘本插图。: A vibrant miniature world inside the tank where vegetation grows freely, reminiscent of illustrations from a picture book.
describe.记录了从梦中醒来后见到的第一个微笑。早上好，列车长。睡得还好吗？: The first smile you see whenever you wake up from a dream. Good morning, Conductor. Did you sleep well?
describe.令人感到失落的记录影像。昨日好景不再，人与机器人背道而驰。: A photograph that tugs at people's heartstrings. Yesterday's good times are gone, and the human and robot are going their separate ways.
describe.很好养活的植物，据说光靠定期喷点水就能茁壮成长。经常被摆放在办公室或是接待室中，: A low-maintenance plant that will supposedly grow healthily purely with a bit of regular watering. Often displayed in offices or reception areas, bring a sense of nature to all environments.
describe.花形与铃铛相似，素来深受人们喜爱。作为香料的使用率很高。不建议用力摇晃它纤细的花: With flowers that resemble bells, it has always been a popular pick among people. Used as fragrances in many cases. Shaking its thin stem isn't recommended, for it won't chime like a bell anyway.
describe.一种象征着高贵典雅的花卉，花期长。虽然对生长环境要求苛刻，但正如人们乐于用繁复的: A flower that represents elegance and sophistication. Takes a long time to bloom. It does require a strict living environment, but just like humans who gladly use complex patterns to bring out the splendor of silk, the Phalaenopsis Orchid has always been in high demand in the market for its visual appeal.
describe.圆嘟嘟或光亮亮的各种多肉植物，搭配种植，赏心悦目。不过，每个品种的多肉对土壤、水: Various round and stout or lustrous succulents. A great complement to all kinds of plants, but each succulent has different needs in regards to soil, water, and temperature. It will take a lot of effort to keep an entire succulent garden healthy.
describe.梅花的一种。在寒冬时节热烈开放的红梅无疑会一下子就抓住人们的眼球呢。: A kind of plum blossom. Without a doubt, the Red Plum Blossom is something you can't miss when it blooms in the cold winter season.
describe.又称蜡梅。虽然外观和花期都与梅花相近，事实上却不是同一种植物。蜡梅也有着比梅花更: Despite its similar appearance and flowering time to plum blossoms, it is in fact a wholly different plant that emits a much stronger fragrance.
describe.梅花中的名品，但抗冻性较差些，种植绿梅的人可需要注重防寒了。: The most well-known plum blossom but less cold-resistant. Anyone who has it will have to be extra mindful during winter.
describe.一种栽培起来十分容易的常绿植物。它最大的危险性在于：安置不当的话，可能变成高空坠: An extremely low-maintenance evergreen plant. Its greatest hazard lies in the possibility of falling from height if not placed appropriately.
describe.寄托着使用者的期盼的自动贩售机，增加了更多饮料种类。\\n所在车厢乘客收益+2%: This popular vending machine now offers a wider variety of drinks, making it highly favored among customers.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 2%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.汇集了市面上最受欢迎的饮料的自动贩售机，在列车上往往备受好评。\\n所在车厢乘客: This vending machine features the most popular beverages on the market and is a favorite among passengers.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.座椅表面使用了真皮面料，改良了座椅填充物，使得座椅更加舒适。: The seat's padding is improved and Megafreezed in real leather, making the seat even more comfy.
describe.加装了按摩功能，头等舱的享受。: Massaging function installed. An exceptional first-class experience.
describe.配置了更为柔软的床垫，利于您的放松和入睡。: Comes with a softer mattress for better sleep and relaxation.
describe.加装了氛围灯套件，满足照明需求外，给休息环境增加一点氛围感。: Ambient lights installed for all illumination needs while creating a cozy vibe for your rest area.
describe.为乘客的舒适度着想，升级了床垫。: Mattress upgraded for the sake of passengers' comfort.
describe.加装了氛围灯套件，我们提倡想使用它的旅客跟自己的上下铺事先沟通。: Ambient lights installed. We encourage passengers who would like to use the lights to first communicate with their bunkmates.
describe.加装了黑月天线的投币式公共电话机，信号得到了大幅增强，一分钱一分货。\\n所在车: A coin-operated public phone booth equipped with Night Chains antennas. Its greatly enhanced signal reception is worth every penny.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 2%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.加装了阿妮塔专线的公共电话机，据说再偏远的地区也能接收到信号，当然顺利通话的前提: A public phone booth equipped with Anita's special line, capable of receiving signals even in remote areas. However, please note that communication quality is also dependent on the signal at the other end.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.加装了增倍镜的望远镜，能观赏更远距离的风景。\\n所在车厢乘客收益+2%，同名家: A telescope with a refined magnifying lens for enjoying scenic views from a greater distance.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 2%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.加装了高清镜片的望远镜，角度合适的话，能看清临近城市街道上行人衣物的花纹。（不会: A telescope with high-definition lenses that allow observation of even the patterns on citizens' clothes in the neighboring street. (Nobody would actually do that, right?)\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.阿妮塔能源公司制品，由安菲娅研发的萃取装置，能将取自桦树生物的各种生物质进行提纯: Product of Anita Energy Company. An extraction device developed by Anfiya that can purify or break down all sorts of biomass taken from Chaos Remains.
describe.由伊利亚德研发的尖端仪器，利用特殊技术转化放入其中的道具。为了保证转化过程的安全: Eliade's cutting-edge instrument that utilizes special Tech to transform items placed inside. For safety and stability reasons, only specific items can be transformed.
describe.装了自动坐便器，这样你就可以不用手动冲水了。: Automated toilet installed. This way, you won't have to manually flush it anymore.
describe.黄金自动坐便器，曼德矿场图浩老板大力推荐，顶级享受，至尊之选！\\n\r所在车厢: A top-tier golden automated toilet that guarantees the most decadent experience. Highly recommended by Wealt of Mander Mine!\n\nIncreases the carriage's Comfort by 5%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.由淘金乐园的旧式加工车床改装而来，虽然制造时间距今很久，但运行状态十分良好。该装: Modified from ONEderland's old processing lathe. It may have been a long time since it was made, but it still works excellently. This device can conduct any industrial processing, such as turning Gold Sand into Gold Leaf.
describe.乘员用上下铺，注意不要影响他人休息。: Bunk bed for the crew. Be mindful not to disrupt others' rest.
describe.升级了床垫，保障乘员的睡眠质量。: Mattress upgraded, ensuring better sleep quality for the crew.
describe.应乘员强烈要求，加装了氛围灯套件。: Ambient lights installed, per the strong demand of the crew.
describe.为那些愿意多花一些钱的乘客准备的单人卧铺。: Single bed for passengers who are willing to pay a little more.
describe.更加柔软舒适的单人卧铺，因为旅途疲惫的乘客都可以在此睡个好觉。: A softer and more comfy single bed for passengers who are exhausted from their travels.
describe.加装了氛围灯套件，满足乘客的多样化需求。: Ambient lights installed to satisfy the passengers' various needs.
describe.乘客用双人豪华大床，没有对象的话，就当是给晚上翻身留的空间吧。: Luxurious double bed for passengers. If you happen to be alone, then have fun rolling all over it all night.
describe.可回收材料制造的便当盒，清洗起来很方便，需要的话或许也可以重复使用。: Recyclable bento box. Easy to wash and potentially reusable, if needed.
describe.能让宠物鱼更自在地生活的水草造景，鱼的心理健康也很重要呢。: An aquascape that greatly improves your pet fish's living space. A fish's psychological well-being deserves to be acknowledged too!
describe.颜色和餐吧装修风格匹配的桌椅，给您一天好心情。: Table and chairs with color complementing the dining bar's aesthetics. Certain to make your day.
describe.学会风柜子，哪怕什么也不装，仅仅当作装饰品也很酷！: Even if it holds nothing, the Citadel Cabinet still looks awesome as a decoration!
describe.会开出白花的仙人掌，常规造型。光看花的话容易给人纯洁的印象。虽然有一定的抗形态污: A regular-looking cactus that bears white flowers. Solely looking at the flowers tends to bring 'purity' to mind. Despite it being mildly resistant to Morphic Field Pollution, everyone prefers using it as an embellishment.
describe.乘客用上下铺，常常有人抱怨他们不愿意爬梯子。: Bunk bed for passengers. People frequently complain about not wanting to climb upstairs.
describe.便当专用的便当柜，有前车之鉴的情况下，被禁止存放隔夜的便当和鱼类。: A holding cabinet especially for bentos. Owing to past mistakes, leftover bentos and fish are no longer permitted here.
describe.可堆叠水族箱，结实耐摔！用来饲养小型观赏鱼类。闲置的水族箱也装不了多少杂物，还是: Sturdy and resistant to falls! This Stacked Aquatic Tank is ideal for keeping small ornamental fish. Since unused tanks may not be the best choice for storing chores, perhaps you should put them away?\nThis item can be stacked on top of other <color=#FFB800>[Stacked Aquatic Tanks]</color>.
describe.会开出黄花的仙人掌，扁平造型。光看花的话容易给人活泼的印象。虽然有一定的抗形态污: A flat-looking cactus that bears yellow flowers. Solely looking at the flowers tends to bring 'exuberance' to mind. Despite it being mildly resistant to Morphic Field Pollution, everyone prefers using it as an embellishment.
describe.缸中生机勃勃的一方小天地，氛围静谧雅致，别有一番意趣。: A small, vibrant section within the tank, featuring a serene and delightful sight.
describe.大型智能水族箱，恒温除菌，定时投食，解放双手，实现养鱼自由！\\n饲养在内的水族: This large smart aquarium, equipped with features like constant temperature sterilization and automated feeding, allows for hands-free fish keeping!\nAll the fish housed within provide 10% more Aquatic Rating.
describe.海角城特制的沉浸式水族箱，一旦安装就不可移动，饲养大型鱼类也绰绰有余，豪华程度足: Immerse yourself in the captivating beauty of this aquarium, produced in Cape City. While it may be immobile, it is an excellent option for housing large fish, exuding luxury and captivating visitors. However, it may not be suitable for individuals with deep-sea phobia.\nAll the fish housed within provide 20% more Aquatic Rating.
describe.植物培养舱，有了它你就可以用自己种植的蔬菜烹饪了。\\n种植在内的绿植，绿植评分: Grow your own vegetables with this plant cultivation cabin.\nAll the plants housed within provide 10% more Plants Rating.
describe.金灿灿的向日葵，个子很高，使人想起明媚的阳光。不小心落下的瓜子可能会在第二年长成: A tall, radiant sunflower that reminds you of the blazing sun. Seeds that are unintentionally dropped may just blossom into new sunflowers the following year. Fortunately, there isn't soil on the train, so this is of no concern.
describe.无人自助，即拍即取，因可爱的外观尤其受女性欢迎，有不少消费者喜欢把备份贴在机器自: A cute self-service instant photo machine popular among women. Many consumers enjoy sticking the backup photo on the photo wall near the machine as a souvenir.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 10%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.列车档案柜，内有重要机密，闲人勿碰！: The train's file cabinet. Contains highly confidential information. Authorized personnel only!
describe.行车控制台，你熟悉它的每一个按钮就像熟悉自己的身体部位。: The train console. You know every single button like the back of your hand.
describe.又称“极乐鸟”，花形优雅美丽，但对生长条件的要求非常苛刻，需要温暖湿润、阳光充足: Also known as the 'crane flower.' Has artistic and stunning flowers, but its environmental needs are extremely strict, requiring somewhere warm, moist, and with adequate sunlight. Mostly pollinated by birds in its place of origin. Hopefully, there will be birds capable of shouldering this huge responsibility on the train.
describe.会开出粉花的仙人掌，细长造型。光看花的话容易给人可爱的印象。虽然有一定的抗形态污: A slender-looking cactus that bears pink flowers. Solely looking at the flowers tends to bring 'loveliness' to mind. Despite it being mildly resistant to Morphic Field Pollution, everyone prefers using it as an embellishment.
describe.奔波的旅途中，谁能拒绝泡洗个热水澡呢？现代化的设施配上一点原始复古的装饰，为您驱: Who can resist a relaxing hot bath during a tiring trip? This modern facility, with a touch of retro elements, helps passengers unwind and alleviate fatigue.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 5%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.普普通通的坐便器，不用的话还是离远点吧。: An unremarkable toilet. Best to stay away if you don't need it.
describe.黑月游乐城与大头贴机合作的露蕾蒂玩偶，可通过大头贴机兑换。等身大小，闪闪发亮的微: A Night Chains Land collaboration with Photo Booth, this Lunette doll can be redeemed through the photo booth machine. This human-sized doll features sparkling smiles that bring beautiful dreams.\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.一个模型展示柜，你很乐意把自己的收藏给他人欣赏。: A display case for model kits. You're proud to showcase your collection to others.
describe.透过车窗看到了什么？: What do you see through the window?
describe.经过特殊培育的松树，即使不经常修剪也能基本保持这种独特的飘逸造型。据说能提高列车: A specially cultivated pine tree. Capable of maintaining this unique drifting look even without frequent trimming. Rumor has it that it truly has a "welcoming" effect that boosts train's popularity.
describe.安宁的午后坐在窗边打个盹……: Perfect window to nap next to on a tranquil afternoon...
describe.纤长的观叶植物，喜高温多湿，即使得不到充足日照也能长势良好，但更多的光照能使之保: A skinny potted plant. Favors warmth and humidity. Grows well without adequate sunlight, but more sunlight will keep it lustrous and thriving.
describe.优质布料搭配新型工艺，耐玩的宠物摇摇乐。\\n所在车厢宠物评分+1%: A pet rocking chair featuring high-quality fabric and innovative craftsmanship, adding playful charm to any space.\nIncreases the carriage's Pet Rating by 1%.
describe.天然原料制作，纯手工编织，清新自然的宠物快乐窝。\\n所在车厢宠物评分+1%: Provide your pet with this comfortable and eco-friendly lair, hand-woven and crafted from natural materials.\nIncreases the carriage's Pet Rating by 1%.
describe.新款宠用跑步机，让宠物在封闭空间内得到更多的运动机会，可以有效防止宠物因精力过剩: This new pet treadmill allows pets to get more exercise in an enclosed space, effectively preventing them from causing damage due to their excessive energy.\nIncreases the carriage's Pet Rating by 2%.
describe.一面简约实用的记事板，上面挂着日历以及诸多备忘录，详尽地标出了每月需要注意的节日: A simple yet handy reminder board, pinned with a calendar and plenty of memos. Thoroughly states the special occasions and important dates of each month.
describe.近期大热的列车密室推理小说中就出现了这种尺寸的车窗。: Train windows of this size were featured in a recent popular locked-room mystery fiction set on a train.
describe.由淘金乐园的旧式精炼机改装而来，功能从炼金变为了精炼桦石，有较高的转化效率。: Modified from ONEderland's old refiner. Used to refine gold but now refines Chaos Stones. High conversion efficiency.
describe.采用最新型专利设计的电池包，安装后即可自动连接列车的供电系统，提供额外电力。\\: A battery pack designed with the latest patent. Automatically connects with the train's power supply system to provide additional power once it's installed.\nPower Limit +500
describe.设计风格相当可爱的挂钟，每到整点上面的小格子里都会飞出一只唱歌的弹簧布谷鸟。可惜: A pretty cute wall clock that has a sing cuckoo spring out of the top little box whenever it strikes 12. Sadly, there is no setting to change this, so it never fails to sing at midnight daily.
describe.外形典雅的留声机，看起来颇具格调，但其实内置了电子智能音箱——音乐也该考虑与时俱: A classy and fairly swanky phonograph that actually has electronic smart speakers in it. After all, even music has to keep up with the times.
describe.适合摆在室内的仙人掌盆栽，装饰效果大于防污染效果。不知是谁给它贴上了眼睛贴纸，让: A potted cactus ideal for indoor decor. Way more useful as a decoration than for pollution resistance. Apparently, someone pasted eye stickers on it, making it look like how humans look after a long workday.
describe.TMT培训学校毕业留影，你的忘记放到哪里了，这是莉薇娅的。相框被擦拭得闪闪发亮。: Livia's TMT Training School graduation photo. You've forgotten where you kept yours. The photo frame is polished and clearly well taken care of.
describe.由风格鲜明的涂鸦进行装饰的饮料柜，其中整齐地堆满了罐装饮料。考虑到列车颠簸可能导: A drink cabinet adorned with striking graffiti neatly stocked with canned beverages. Given that the train's jostling may cause excessive pressure inside the cans, please exercise extreme caution when retrieving drinks.\nIncreases the carriage's Delicacy Rating by 2%.
describe.按照铁盟工程标准搭建的工作台，可以制造包括弹药和诱饵气球等消耗品在内的多种实用道: A workbench constructed in accordance with B.C.R.L.'s engineering standards. Many useful items can be crafted, such as consumables like ammunition and Decoy Balloons.
describe.由修格里城市长亲自颁发的纪念品，表彰列车长为维护修格里城及其周边地区安全而作出的: A memento issued by the mayor of Shoggolith City to commend the Conductor's effort in safeguarding Shoggolith City and its surrounding region. Welcome to Shoggolith City, where business opportunities and challenges await you.
describe.由曼德矿场铁安局颁发的纪念品，表彰列车长为维护曼德矿场及其周边地区安全而作出的努: A memento issued by Mander Mine's BCRL Agency to commend the Conductor's effort in safeguarding Mander Mine and its surrounding region. Designed to be industrial style and guaranteed to be unbreakable.
describe.由7号自由港市政厅颁发的纪念品，表彰列车长为维护7号自由港及其周边地区安全的而作: A memento issued by Freeport Ⅶ's City Hall to commend the Conductor's effort in safeguarding Freeport Ⅶ and its surrounding region. The revitalized Freeport Ⅶ looks forward to your visit.
describe.由澄明数据中心管理处颁发的纪念品，表彰列车长为维护澄明数据中心及其周边地区安全而: A memento issued by the CDCA Bureau's Management Center to commend the Conductor's effort in safeguarding the CDCA Bureau and its surrounding region. Documenting the world in data so as to look ahead into the future from the past.
describe.列车长与其他乘员一同准备的画像，作为送给莉薇娅的礼物。不过，鉴于莉薇娅本人要求，: A present for Livia painted by Conductor and the rest of the crew. However, Livia has requested that this painting must never be displayed anywhere outside The Eternal.
describe.与列车上的两位特殊乘客一同分享快乐童梦餐的片刻。童年已经远去，美好却能留存。: A moment shared enjoying Happy Dreams Meal with two special train passengers. We may not be in our childhoods anymore, but the fond memories will always stay with us.
describe.记录了莉薇娅露出笑容的片刻。约好了哦，未来的旅途也一起走吧。: Livia's smile caught on camera. Don't forget that we are to go on future journeys together too.
describe.无垠号列车组人员同神秘生物搏斗的记录影像。为了保护贵客的人身安全，现在得赶紧把蘑: A photograph of the moment The Eternal's crew battled against an unknown creature. To ensure our esteemed guests' safety, we must pluck the mushroom down right this instant!
describe.为表彰列车长为资源回收、环境保护贡献自己的力量而颁发的奖章，由莱斯特与布雷斯用可: A medal awarded to commend the Conductor's effort in material recycling and protecting the environment. Handmade by Lester and Breese using recyclable materials.
describe.雍容华贵的植物，据说有一定的驱邪避灾效果，常用于一些奢华场合的造景。: A plant full of Hyperarmor and grace. Rumored to be somewhat useful in warding off bad luck. Often used to adorn some venues for extravagant events.
describe.通常用于表示奇迹之爱的蓝玫瑰，无法自然长成的珍稀品种。据说是利用了独特形态场扭曲: A rare variant due to it not existing in nature, the Blue Rose is usually used to symbolize the wonders of love. It is reportedly nurtured via special morphic field distortion.
describe.香气迷人的植物，晒干后制成香包能使它的香气保存更久。据说有某个地方的人们会种植大: A plant with a mesmerizing scent. Its fragrance can be preserved longer by drying it out and making it into sachets. Based on hearsay, people from a particular place plant massive fields of Lavender to create a sea of flowers...
describe.经过精心设计的现代风格花架。用特殊材质制造，可以摆放各类植物，也能放一些装饰摆件: An exquisitely and uniquely designed modern-style flower rack made with special materials. Able to display all sorts of plants and also some ornaments.
describe.颜色温暖的花，是著名的观赏花卉，颜色鲜艳。据说在某些地区代表着新生与丰收。: A flower with warm, vibrant colors, the tulip is a popular ornamental plant that's said to symbolize revitalization and gains in certain regions.
describe.经过精心设计的现代风格花架。多层搁板能分开放置不同种类的植物。: An exquisitely designed modern-style flower rack with a few shelves for the arrangement of different plant varieties.
describe.通常用于表示炽烈爱情的红玫瑰，但据说在爱情破裂时用来作为斗殴武器也很不错。: The Red Rose is usually used to symbolize passionate love, but people claim it is also a handy weapon to use when things turn sour.
describe.通常用于表示纯洁仰慕的白玫瑰，洁白如新雪，价格也偏高。: White as fresh snow like its name, the White Rose is usually used to symbolize innocence and admiration, with costs on the pricier end.
describe.经过精心设计的现代风格花架。简约大方的设计提供了充足的平行空间。: An exquisitely designed modern-style flower rack. The minimalistic and sleek design provides an abundance of shelf space.
