describe.描绘了帕拉笛在整顿中心勤恳工作的状态。滴滴警报响起，坏人无处可逃！: This image depicts Paladi working diligently at the Reforming Center. Once she sounds the alarm, no bad guys can ever escape from her!
describe.以莉薇娅的形象为原型设计的充气模型，做成了超大尺寸，戳一下就会摇摇晃晃……不对，: An inflatable model designed based on Livia's image. Due to its overly large size, it wobbles when poked... No, Livia never wobbles!\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 5%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.据说是以纯金打造的雕像，霸气十足地塑造了图浩以雄厚的经济实力“说服”曼德矿场众多: This statue, said to be made of pure gold, depicts Wealt using his financial power to 'convince' the merchants at Mander Mine. According to Wealt, the statue only captures a fraction of his dominance, but it is still considered a fine piece of art.
describe.由无人机拍摄的远星大桥以及附近设施鸟瞰图，由哈里弗克斯公司协助摄制。: An aerial view photo captured by a drone facilitated by HaliFox, showcasing the Apoaster Bridge and nearby facilities.
describe.充满想象力的画作，描绘了被另一个世界的天才少女改装后的无垠号。不过换个思路想，这: An imaginative painting reimagining the Eternal, created by a talented mechanic girl from another world. While it may seem unusual, it brings a unique charm to the train from a fresh perspective.
describe.浑身上下充满了谜团的列车。这幅不知何时出现的挂画背面有个潇洒的签名，“葵博士”…: This painting, which mysteriously appeared one day, features a train shrouded in mystery, with a stylish signature reading "Dr. Aoi" on the back... Could that have been its previous pilot?
describe.浑身上下充满了谜团的列车，以奇异能源“光子力”驱动。就连这幅挂画上的车身似乎也泛: This painting portrays an enigmatic train powered by a mysterious energy source known as 'Photon Power.' The train in the artwork seems to glow with a magical light, as though it could transform at any moment.
describe.以列车长和无垠号的卡通形象组合设计的模型，按照一定比例对列车长和无垠号分别进行了: A model inspired by the chibi version of the Eternal and its conductor. Imagine riding a dragon... No, riding the Eternal!!\nIncreases the carriage's Passenger Revenue by 3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.在淘金大酒店一间客房中找到的镀金天球，结构精巧，看起来价格不菲。最初人们误以为它: A gilded celestial sphere found in a guest room at the ONEderland Hotel, showcasing intricate craftsmanship and appearing highly valuable. Initially mistaken as part of a mysterious ritual, it was later revealed to be a mere decorative piece.
describe.突然闯入镜头前的佩罗塔，偶然按下的快门。“要记得叫我球球啦！”: This photo captures Pelota suddenly appearing in front of the camera and accidentally triggering the shutter. "Call me Ballie!"
describe.“大哥号”于远星大桥附近海上平台拍摄的纪念影像。海两侧的景象完全相异，大海之中的: A commemorative image taken by the Basilisk from a platform near the Apoaster Bridge. The contrasting views on both sides of the sea highlight the unique bridge in the center.
describe.于栖羽站站台上拍摄的影像。洁白的屋檐和墙壁上投下影子，如同鸟儿的羽翼。: A photo taken at Sumihane Station, featuring white eaves and walls casting shadow patterns resembling bird feathers.
describe.名为“甲铁城”的列车，静静地停靠于篝火城的站台边。: The train named Koutetsujou is quietly stationed at the Bonfire City platform.
describe.由无人机拍摄的岚心城鸟瞰图。在学会内部被划为保密资料之一。: An aerial-view photo captured by a drone showcasing Ranshin City, marked as confidential information within the Citadel.
describe.远距离拍摄的岚心城景色，云雾从翠色的屋檐下流动，城市如同一件美丽的工艺品。: A distant view of Ranshin City, with clouds flowing beneath emerald-hued roofs, presenting the city as a picturesque artifact.
describe.无垠号的“保镖”战斗时的飒爽身姿。速战速决！: A captivating scene depicting the valiant bodyguard of the Eternal in battle. Make it quick!
describe.渡过危机后重见阳光的岚心城。当地的故事中，将雨过天晴后的霞光称为“晴岚”。: Ranshin City emerging into sunlight after a crisis. Local legend calls post-rain sunlight "Seiran".
describe.“大哥号”于栖羽站附近拍下的纪念影像。鸟儿划过天空，在此片刻停留。: A commemorative image taken by "the Basilisk" near Sumihane Station, capturing birds in mid-flight against the sky.
describe.铁山城出品的声光电子爆竹挂件，不能像真正的爆竹那样燃放，打开开关后会发出模拟的爆: An electronic firecracker pendant manufactured in Fortress City. When activated, it produces simulated firecracker sounds. While it is popular among conductors who cannot return home for the New Year, some may find it too noisy.
describe.颁发给为海角城的治安与建设作出卓越贡献之人的金属铭牌，经过市长阿莱斯特先生的精心: A metal plaque bestowed upon individuals for remarkable contributions to Cape City's security and development. Crafted by Mayor Aleister, this plaque exudes a stylish and classic design, embodying Cape City's essence.
describe.科伦巴商会设计的“现代餐车”系列家具中配备的餐椅。明亮的颜色能提振就餐者的心情。: Designed by the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, the dining chairs from the "Modern Dining Car" furniture series feature bright colors that can uplift diners' moods.\nDelicacy Rating of the carriage +1%, stackable.
describe.科伦巴商会设计的“现代餐车”系列家具中配备的餐桌。弧形的边缘容许了更大的就餐空间: The dining table equipped in the "Modern Diner Car" series of furniture designed by COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce. The curved edges allow for more dining space, bringing everyone closer together.\nDelicacy rating in the carriage +3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.科伦巴商会设计的“现代餐车”系列家具中配备的电蒸箱与电烤箱套组，温控稳定，外型美: Designed by the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, the "modern dining car" series furniture is equipped with a set of electric steam and electric ovens, featuring stable temperature control and an attractive appearance. Use with caution to avoid burns!\nDelicacy Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.科伦巴商会设计的“现代餐车”系列家具中配备的集成式燃气灶，下方还附送了有消毒功能: Designed by the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, the "Modern Dining Car" series furniture includes an integrated gas stove and a dishwashing cabinet with a disinfection function. \nDelicacy Rating in the carriage +3%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.科伦巴商会设计的“现代餐车”系列家具中配备的水槽和料理台套装。简约经典，易于保持: The sink and cooking station set equipped in the "Modern Dining Car" furniture series designed by COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce. Simple and classic, easy to keep tidy.\nDelicacy rating in the carriage +5%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.科伦巴商会设计的“现代餐车”系列家具中配备的双开门大冰箱。贴在门上的标签上写着“: The double-door refrigerator equipped in the "Modern Dining Car" furniture series designed by the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce. A label on the door reads, "The posture of a train assistant helping the conductor write reports is as reliable as this double-door refrigerator!"... Who wrote that?!\nRefrigerator capacity +36.
describe.紧盯镜头的乌刹娜。救世主大人！我来切碎！: Ushana focusedly staring at the camera. "Master Savior! Leave it to me!"
describe.据说是打倒化物之后出现的箱子。内部容量比较小，不过只要是能放进去的食物，在放置一: A box rumored to be dropped by defeated Metaplasia. Despite its limited capacity, food stored inside will taste better over time.
describe.据说是打倒化物“泥嚎箱”以后，偶尔会出现的箱子。长得非常可爱！: A box that occasionally drops from HelloBox. It looks so adorable!
describe.据说是打倒化物“嚎虎箱”以后，偶尔会出现的箱子。样子非常威风！: A box that occasionally drops from HowlingBox. It looks so mighty!
describe.优雅与高贵兼具的饮料柜，本来是用来放酒的，但考虑到无垠号乘组中有很多年轻人，因此: This elegant beverage cabinet was originally designed for alcohol storage. However, due to the presence of numerous young members in the Eternal crew, it now houses a diverse selection of beverages.
describe.近距离拍摄的塔图站站台。不远处的赤红色建筑是沙漠地带少见的人类社会产物。: A close-up shot of the platform at Tattle Station. The reddish structure nearby stands out as a rare creation of human society in the vast desert.
describe.“大哥号”于塔图站附近拍下的纪念影像。神不掷骰子，人掷骰子。: A commemorative image taken by the Basilisk near Tattle Station. "God does not play dice, but human does."
describe.为表彰在岚心城日常运输以及治安等方面作出重大贡献的列车长而设计的特色牌匾，充满岚: This plaque was crafted to honor conductors who have played a pivotal role in ensuring daily transportation in Ranshin City, showcasing its distinct Ranshin characteristics.
describe.为表彰在发射中心修复工作中作出重大贡献的列车长而颁发的奖杯。但行苦旅，不问前程。: This trophy was crafted to honor conductors who have played a key role in the restoration of the Launch Center. 'Perform good deeds without fretting over the future.'
describe.跨越时间和空间，终于等到了多年前曾在缝隙中见过的约定之人。安心地休息吧，乌刹娜。: Across time and space, finally the person I had a promise with many years ago in the gap has arrived. Rest at ease, Ushana.
describe.一副画像。关于罗洁尔，关于她，关于我。: A portrait. About Raziel, about her, about me.
describe.复古的经典款式斗柜，适合收纳各种零碎物品，缺点是经常会忘记对应的东西放在哪个抽屉: Retro classic style chests of drawers are suitable for storing various miscellaneous items. The downside is that it's often easy to forget which items are in which drawer, and the ornaments placed on top can be easily knocked over.
describe.待命中的奥莉薇恩。您有什么需求吗，主家？: Olivien at your service. What do you need, master?
describe.黑月游乐园提供的纪念花车模型之一。列车长就该亲自驾车，即使是花车！\\n所在车厢: One of the commemorative float models provided by Night Chains Land. A conductor should personally drive, even if it's a float!\nPassenger revenue in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.黑月游乐园提供的纪念花车模型之一。别问嚎虎箱为什么会在这里。\\n所在车厢乘客收: One of the commemorative float models provided by Night Chains Land. Don't ask why there's a HowlingBox here.\nPassenger revenue in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.黑月游乐园提供的纪念花车模型之一。露蕾蒂最、最、最爱大家啦！\\n所在车厢乘客收: One of the commemorative float models provided by Night Chains Land. Lunette loooooooves everyone!\nPassenger revenue in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.黑月游乐园提供的纪念花车模型之一。……别的不说，这气球应该不至于带着花车飞起来吧: One of the commemorative float models provided by Night Chains Land. ...Seriously, this balloon shouldn't be able to make the float fly away, right?\nPassenger revenue in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.黑月游乐园提供的纪念花车模型之一。如果故事里的女孩得到的是货厢，也许比起参加舞会: One of the commemorative float models provided by Night Chains Land. If the girl in the story received a carriage, perhaps traveling across the world's railways would be more appealing than attending a ball?\nPassenger revenue in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的“魔女的高堡”。即使攀爬到离星星最近的地方: "Witch's Castle" scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. Even if she climbs to the place closest to the stars, can she still not grasp her own fate?\nFun Rating in the carriage +5%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的“魔女的围城”。一块又一块的白色砖头，一座: "Witch's Walled Citadel" scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. Brick after brick of white masonry, wall after wall standing tall.\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的花园茶屋。在这里，你大可以放心享用一顿由使: A garden teahouse scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. Here, you can comfortably enjoy a perfect afternoon tea prepared by familiars!\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的园圃，在特殊的设计下会自我生长、自我修剪，: A garden scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. Crafted with a special design, it grows and prunes itself, remaining lush and thriving all year round and never fading.\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的摩天轮。虽然无法亲自坐着它升上高空，不过很: A Ferris wheel scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. Although you can't personally ride it into the sky, it holds great romantic commemorative value.\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的“魔女的居处”。在这座小小的屋子里，住着什: "Witch's Home" scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. What kind of girl lives in this little room?\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的模拟喷泉，不可思议的是，往这里面投入的硬币: A simulated fountain scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. Strangely enough, any coins dropped inside will disappear on their own... "My coin's gone! Aaaaaaah!!!"\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的“扫帚高速路”。如果扫帚竞速也需要场地，这: "Broom Highway" scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. If broom racing also requires a venue, this circular track is undoubtedly an excellent choice, second only to a stadium.\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的“糖果屋”。为了长期保存和卫生考虑，该模型: "Candy House" scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. To ensure long-term preservation and hygiene, the model uses slow-release fragrances to replicate the sweet aroma instead of using actual ingredients.\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的旋转木马模型。叮叮叮，叮叮叮，转个不停……: A carrousel scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. Click click click, click click click, it rotates nonstop...\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.按照黑月游乐园中的建筑微缩数倍制造出的占卜屋。树荫投下的光斑照出道路，顺着它走到: A divination room scaled down multiple times from the one in Night Chains Land. The dappled light from the trees lights up the path. Follow it, and walk to the gate of fate.\nFun Rating in the carriage +1%. Bonus limited once for identical furniture.
describe.“大哥号”于黑月游乐城入口附近拍下的纪念影像。让这辆全地形车进入游乐城可费了无垠: The commemorative image taken by "the Basilisk" near the entrance of Night Chains Land. It took quite some effort from the Eternal crew to get this all-terrain vehicle into the amusement park!
describe.黑月游乐城一角的景色。“花车来了！花车来了！大家快去看呀！”: A view of a corner in Night Chains Land. "The float, the float is coming! Look at that, everyone!"
describe.黑月游乐城一角的景色。在这样的月光下仰望，能和居住在城堡中的神秘存在相遇吗？: A view of a corner of Night Chains Land. Looking up under such moonlight, can one encounter the mysterious presence residing in the castle?
describe.复古的经典款式收藏柜，在保护收藏品的同时也能展现拥有者的良好品味。: A retro classic style display cabinet, not only protects collectibles but also showcases the owner's good taste.
describe.分享苹果的真咲。这个金苹果究竟是天然的还是她用魔法制作的？: Masaki sharing her apple. Is this golden apple natural or created with her magic?
describe.用于测试的家具，绝对不会对外出售。绝对！/n在此家具周围的至多1个家具获得舒适度: Furniture used for testing will absolutely never be sold. Absolutely! \nUp to 1 piece of furniture around this furniture gains a comfort effect of +10%.
describe.造型优雅、设计别出心裁的花架，只要合理分配花盆的悬挂位置就不会有翻倒之忧。何况，: An elegantly styled and ingeniously designed flower stand will not tip over as long as the suspension positions of the flower pots are reasonably allocated. Besides, who could refuse such an artistically inspired home design?
describe.正露出嘲讽微笑的克洛伊。被她抓住话柄的滋味可不好受……: Chloe showing a mocking smile. Once she gets hold of something you say, you will quickly learn to regret it...

describe.“咕噜噜大冒险”推出的地标系列中的主要组件之一。巨大的天然石拱门变成了光滑的形状: One of the main components in the landmark series from "Rumbling Monopolis." The huge natural stone arch turned into a smooth shape...
describe.“咕噜噜大冒险”推出的地标系列中的主要组件之一。保留了澄明数据中心最有标志性的地: One of the main components in the landmark series from "Rumbling Monopolis." It retains the most iconic above-ground platform of CDCA Bureau.
describe.“咕噜噜大冒险”推出的地标系列中的主要组件之一。迷宫般的美妙城市景色一览无余。: One of the main components in the landmark series from "Rumbling Monopolis." The maze-like wonderful cityscape is fully visible.

describe.由某知名家电企业开发的烘干机（经典款）。为了满足列车行车途中快速烘干衣物的需求而: Developed by a well-known home appliance company, the dryer (classic model) was designed to meet the need for quickly drying clothes during train journeys and can also add specific fragrances to clothing during the drying process.
describe.用于测试的家具，绝对不会对外出售。绝对！: The furniture used for testing will absolutely never be sold. Absolutely!
describe.描绘了伊卡菈休憩模样的画像。如今请收起双翼，于那人的身侧休憩吧。: A portrait depicting Icarus at rest. Now, fold your wings and rest beside that person.
describe.装扮精致的小型摊位，适合贩卖面包以及其他各种烘焙制品。让无垠号的车厢摇身一变，化: Delicately decorated small stalls, suitable for selling bread and various other baked goods. Transform the carriage of The Eternal into a gathering place for enticing delicacies!
describe.描绘了涟恬静微笑的挂画。在信赖的人身边，无需不安。: A painting that depicts Ren's serene smile. There is no need for anxiety with someone she trusts.
describe.克洛伊与你共度某段时光的记录，被制成了挂画。当她跃出列车时，你感到了风。: The record of the time spent with Chloe made into a wall hanging. When she leaped off the train, you felt the wind.
describe.克洛伊与你共度某段时光的记录，被制成了挂画。当她回到你身边的时候，就连风也停滞了: The record of the time spent with Chloe made into a wall hanging. When she returned to your side, even the wind came to a halt.
describe.由无人机拍摄的贡露城鸟瞰图，一座象征着联结、由纯洁之白与新生之绿构成的城市。: An aerial view of Gronru City taken by a drone, a city symbolizing connection, composed of the pure white and the green of rebirth.
describe.如果最微小的振翅也能引起一场风暴……: If the smallest flutter of wings can stir up a storm...
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。未记录于任何媒介之中的画面。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." A scene recorded on no medium at all.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。她确实在那里，你遇见了她。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." She was truly there—and you met her.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。眺望着大海的她。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." Her, gazing out at the sea.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。第一次使用筷子这种餐具的她。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." Her, using chopsticks for the very first time.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。品尝着草莓牛奶的她。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." Her, savoring a strawberry milk.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。与可爱的小动物们相伴的她。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." Her, in the company of some adorable little creatures.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。这身衣服也很可爱哦，列车长！: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." This outfit's pretty cute, Conductor!
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。被海水浸染的她。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." Her, soaked through by the sea.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。吃着喜欢的甜甜圈的她。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." Her, enjoying a doughnut she's fond of.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。思考着何为家人的她。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." Her, pondering what it truly means to be family.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。为何他的表情如此真切，他是否仍在回忆着过往？: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." Why does his expression seem so genuine—is he still lost in some memory of the past?
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。她向你伸出手，你与她手紧紧握在一起。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." She reaches out her hand to you, and you clasp it tightly in return.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。只需扣动扳机。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." All it takes is a squeeze of the trigger.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。她心中的些许震颤。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." A faint tremor stirring within her heart.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。这震颤已然化为悸动。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." That tremor has since blossomed into something more like a heartbeat.
describe.于“续写明日”章节中剪切而出的片刻。她仍保留了一些秘密。: A moment from "Pages of Tomorrow." She still keeps a few secrets of her own.
describe.贡露城颁发给曾为城市作出杰出贡献的列车长的纪念品，一只代表着希望的鸟儿，一个如同: The commemorative gift awarded by Gronru City to Conductors who have made outstanding contributions to the city is a bird symbolizing hope, an ornament as beautiful as the vision of the future. You are the hope leading to tomorrow.
describe.陈列了多种来自新南城的水果的摊位。这些种类的果实只在炎热地区生自然长，好在有人尚: The stalls display a variety of fruits from New South City. These kinds of fruits naturally grow only in burning regions, but fortunately, some are still researching how to cultivate them artificially.
describe.KEEP炸鸡推出的移动汉堡推车，保证KEEP死忠粉们随时随地能品尝到自己最爱的美: KEEP has launched a mobile burger cart, ensuring that KEEP's loyal fans can enjoy their favorite delicious meals anytime, anywhere.
describe.售卖铁盟制式快餐的摊位，顾客群体不仅有铁盟士兵，也包括附近地区的普通市民。因快餐: Stalls selling BCRL standard fast food attract not only BCRL soldiers but also ordinary citizens from nearby areas. The fast food is very popular due to its affordable prices.
describe.售卖各种现做杯装饮料的摊位。不少人表示这种成本低廉的冲泡饮料是自己的童年回忆。: Stall selling various freshly made cup beverages. Many people say that these low-cost mixed drinks are a childhood memory for them.
describe.陈列了各种外形精致的甜点的摊位，其中的每种都要花费数小时进行制作。但为了防止蛋糕: The stalls displayed various exquisitely shaped desserts, each of which took hours to make. However, to prevent the cakes from spoiling, all the desserts on the counter were models.
describe.配色淡雅的移动冰柜，装满了市面上能见到的几乎所有雪糕品类。孩子们只要能获得购买其: The mobile freezer with soft colors is filled with almost all the ice cream varieties available on the market. As long as children gain permission to purchase one, they will be happy all day.
describe.按照岚心风格装饰设计的小吃摊，主要售卖寿司。这种美食在岚心城以外的地区亦广受欢迎: A snack stand decorated in Ranshin style mainly selling sushi. This delicacy is also popular in areas outside of Ranshin City.
describe.按照铁山城风格装饰设计的小吃摊，主要售卖包子等铁山城特色面食。在外漂泊的铁山城游: A snack stall decorated in the style of Fortress City, mainly selling buns and other specialty noodles from Fortress City. It's a taste that travelers from Fortress City always miss.
describe.总出现在各种游乐园（除了黑月游乐城）中的零食推车，集中了市面上最受欢迎的速食种类: Snack carts, which always appear in various amusement parks (except Night Chains Land), feature the most popular fast food types on the market, such as instant noodles, potato chips, and chocolate.
describe.无垠号的标准餐车，宽度足以在通道中畅行无阻地推动而不卡在客车车厢的座椅之间。乘客: The standard dining car of The Eternal is wide enough to be pushed freely through the aisle without getting stuck between the seats of the carriage. Passengers all pay attention to it, passengers all wait for it, but not everyone will make it stop.
describe.一位端庄、可爱、美丽的教皇的真容。你说不是这个世界的是什么意思？: The true appearance of a graceful, lovely, and beautiful Pope. What do you mean by saying "not of this world"?
describe.伊利亚德在画室中作画的片刻。得到这样一位大师的关注实为荣幸，如果他没有提出要为你: Eliade painting in the studio for a moment. It is truly an honor to receive attention from such a master, if he didn't ask to paint your portrait.
describe.掩映于装饰物之后。人类无法生出羽翼，伊利亚德早已了解。: Hidden behind the decorations. Humans cannot grow wings, Eliade already understands.
describe.倾倒、调整、混合。冰没有颜色，是寒冷塑造了它；试图把握的人，必然要付出忍耐它的代: Pour, adjust, mix. Ice has no color; it is shaped by the cold. Those who attempt to grasp it must inevitably pay the price of enduring it.
describe.“辉夜号”。一列足以划破任何黑夜的列车。: "Kaguya." A train capable of piercing through any night.
describe.据说是以纯金打造的雕像，充满仰慕地塑造了符渝女士为贡露城的美丽增添一丝风姿的模样: It is said to be a statue made of pure gold, depicting Miss Fu Yu with admiration, adding a touch of elegance to the beauty of Gronru City. She stated, "Not bad," and after a brief pause, added, "At least it's better than my brother's."
describe.擅长近身战的机体“辉夜”的挂画。于朦胧赤红月色之下，斩！: The wall scroll of the unit "Kaguya," which excels in close combat. Under the hazy crimson moonlight, Slash!
describe.擅长近身战的机体“辉夜”的挂画，作者不明。超级迷你形态。: The poster of the mech "Kaguya," known for its prowess in close combat, author unknown. Super mini form.
describe.传说中会吞噬其驾驶者的机体“尼禄”的挂画。吞噬殆尽。: The tapestry of the mech "Nero," which is rumored to devour its pilot. Devoured completely.
describe.传说中会吞噬其驾驶者的机体“尼禄”的挂画，作者不明。超级迷你形态。: The legendary poster of the "Nero" machine, which is said to devour its pilots, author unknown. Super mini form.
describe.于“出地底记”事件中剪切而出的片刻。都怪水压啊啊啊啊啊啊——！: A moment cut from the "Exodus de la Terre" incident. It's all because of the water pressure aaaahhhh——!
describe.于“出地底记”事件中剪切而出的片刻。这是爱丽，绝对没错: A moment cut from the "Exodus de la Terre" event. This is Ellie, absolutely no mistake.
describe.于“出地底记”事件中剪切而出的片刻。眺望着工业的高塔。: In the "Exodus de la Terre" event, a moment cut out. Gazing at the industrial tower.
describe.于“出地底记”事件中剪切而出的片刻。她会就此消逝吗？: A moment cut out from the "Exodus de la Terre" event. Will she disappear because of this?
describe.于“出地底记”事件中剪切而出的片刻。被捏住脸的午夜兔。: A moment clipped from the "Exodus de la Terre" incident. The midnight rabbit with its face pinched.
describe.于“出地底记”事件中剪切而出的片刻。被扯来扯去的午夜兔。: A moment cut from the "Exodus de la Terre" event. The midnight rabbit being pulled back and forth.
describe.于“出地底记”事件中剪切而出的片刻。感受财富的魅力吧！: Moments cut from the "Exodus de la Terre" event. Feel the charm of wealth!
describe.于“出地底记”事件中剪切而出的片刻。别想逃走！: A moment cut from the "Exodus de la Terre" incident. Don't try to escape!
describe.先知讲述之事已经完毕，便就歇了一切的话语，安息了。: The prophet's telling of the matter has come to an end, and he ceased all words and rested.
describe.已经消失在历史长河之中的炼成方法，以及一枚据称可以化虚无为实在的果实。: The method of refinement that has already disappeared into the long river of history, and a fruit that is said to turn nothingness into reality.
describe.祂将重塑器具，使旧物生新，引众人筑路开渠，重整秩序。: He will reshape the tools, bringing new life to old things, leading people to build roads and dig channels, reorganizing order.
describe.描绘了海伦娜微笑模样的挂画。手中宝石绽放光华之时，魔法便会显现。: A portrait depicting Helena's smiling appearance. When the gem in her hand radiates brilliance, magic will appear.
describe.宝石在她的指尖闪烁，而你无法断言这种颜色美过她的眼睛。: The gemstone sparkles at her fingertips, yet you cannot assert that this color is more beautiful than her eyes.
describe.故乡的风、天光的照耀，以及绽放于她手中的魔法。: The wind of the hometown, the illumination of the sky, and the magic blooming in her hands.
describe.据说是以纯金打造的雕像，过犹不及地塑造了包浮先生在海角城待守来客的模样。“过犹不: It is said to be a statue made of pure gold, excessively depicting Mr. Bao Fu's appearance while welcoming guests in Cape City. "Excessively" is a comment he made himself, and he immediately asked, "Does Fu Yu have one too?"
describe.描绘了朵拉弥丝紧盯着你的样子的挂画。感情与身体，哪一个最先开始运作？: A painting depicting Doraemon staring intently at you. Which starts to work first, emotion or body?
describe.伊卡菈的头发被海风吹乱，但她生气的原因好像不止于此……: Ikara's hair was tousled by the sea breeze, but it seemed that her anger was not just because of this...
describe.朵拉弥丝居然像漫画书里的超级英雄一样，被海龙桦树生物驮着，重新出现了。: Dolamiss unexpectedly reappeared like a superhero from a comic book, carried by the CR: Marine.
describe.鬼灯鲨带动的浪声正在越来越近。越来越近的还有……朵拉弥丝的脸。: The sound of waves stirred by the Goblin Shark is getting closer. Also getting closer is... Doremy's face.
describe.不知不觉在竞争中培养出的信任，在这一刻升华为了同伴之情。: Unconsciously developed trust in the competition sublimated at this moment into a sense of camaraderie.
describe.总之，行车途中一定要注意安全，切忌左顾右盼哦。: In short, always pay attention to safety while driving and avoid looking around.
describe.上下颠倒。……她没摔到哪里吧？: Upside down. ...She didn't fall anywhere, did she?
describe.在贡露城的环海道路上开心地骑车，可不是随时都能有的经历！: Riding happily on the Ring Road in Gronru City is not an experience you can have anytime!
describe.在不辨敌我的深邃海洋中，谁是下一个猎物？: In the deep ocean where enemies and allies are indistinguishable, who is the next prey?
describe.星祷节快乐！夏洛蒂换上了星祷风格的装束——不过似乎是地表改良版的？: Merry Astrum Ora! Charlotte changed to a festival costume — an aboveground variant perhaps?

des.以清爽的风味和细腻的泡沫而闻名，淡淡的麦芽香气和轻薄的口感使七号自由港的啤酒适口: Renowned for its refreshing flavor and airy foam, Freeport Ⅶ's Beer is exceptionally palatable. Its subtle malt aroma and light taste make it the perfect choice for most people when getting acquainted with beer.
des.以水果为原料，经过发酵﹑蒸馏﹑贮藏后酿造而成的蒸馏酒。其中用葡萄制成的白兰地最为: A distilled liquor made through fermentation, distillation, and maturing, with fruits as the raw material. The Brandy, made from grapes, is the most classic choice for wealthy collectors.
des.很受欢迎的健康零食，顺应市场需求推出小袋包装后，在年轻的职场女性间变得流行起来。: A highly popular healthy snack. Well-loved by young working ladies after it was repackaged and sold in small packets per the market demand.
des.一种透明的生物化石，因独特的纹路和包裹物吸引了大量狂热的收藏家。荒原地区的琥珀因: A kind of clear fossil resin that attracted hordes of zestful collectors thanks to its unique texture and versatility. The Wilderness's Amber gained fame in the field for its outstanding quality, hence leading to the establishment of the amber carving industry.
des.一种碳酸盐矿物，因美丽的绿色受到人们的喜爱，常常被加工为饰品。一些地区的人们认为: A kind of carbonate mineral adored by people for its gorgeous green color and often turned into accessories. People of certain regions believe that letting kids wear Malachite accessories can keep them safe from Resonance Pollution. Perhaps because of its green color, it tends to bring cacti to mind.
des.随着修格里出台的一系列军工业扶持政策，在仙女木公司长期霸占军火市场大量份额的情况: Following the series of arms trade support policies introduced by Shoggolith, Shoggolith's arms industry turned into a key player in view of its solid product quality and networking, becoming the new go-to of many clients despite DRYAS CORPORATION having monopolized the firearms market for long.
des.受人欢迎的优质玉材，独特的蓝色成为了它的特征，人们甚至以“绿松石色”来命名这种蓝: A well-liked premium gem that is iconic for its distinctive blue-green color, which is named after the gemstone itself. In recent years, plenty of artificially dyed imitation Turquoises have emerged in the market.
des.可以用于提炼金属铅的矿石，在冶金、化工等行业需求量极大。: An ore that can be used to refine lead metal. In great demand among industries like metallurgy, chemical, and so on.
des.碳的一种同素异形体，化学性质稳定，耐腐蚀，同酸、碱等药剂不易发生反应，在多个领域: An allotrope of carbon with stable chemical properties, is erosion-proof, and isn't very reactive to chemical agents like acid and alkali. Widely used in numerous sectors. At present, The Wilderness's Graphite is mainly exported to Freeport Ⅶ.
des.据说七号自由港的海盐与一般的食用盐在口感上有细腻的差别。一些吹毛求疵的厨师认为，: Supposedly, Freeport Ⅶ's Sea Salt tastes subtly different from ordinary table salt. Some fastidious chefs believe that driven food connoisseurs mustn't be remiss in their choice of salt.
des.利用桦石技术将数立方米的垃圾压缩成的垃圾块: A block of trash that was compressed from several cubic meters of trash via Chaos Stone techonology.
des.靛红五月几乎是糖果和应急食品的代名词，他们配合铁盟需求开发的军用食品可以提供人们: Carmine May is virtually synonymous with candy and emergency food. The military rations they developed in fulfillment of B.C.R.L.'s requests can provide all required calories and nutrients to people in difficult times, and most importantly, they taste pretty good.
des.因生长周期短、产量高等优势受人喜爱，成为荒原地区被广泛种植的经济作物。: A favorite of many people for its short growth cycle and high yield, among other things. It has become a widely planted cash crop in The Wilderness.
des.山体中的岩金被河水冲刷、金与石英矿脉分离而成的金。二十多年前，它们在切斯河的河床: Gold formed by separating from quartz veins upon being washed down rock formations by river water. Over two decades ago, it was discovered on the riverbed of the Chess River, which incited a gold rush. Now that the returns of gold mining have become extremely low as a result of depleting resources, Gold Sand has slowly faded out of the public's interest.
des.以精湛切割工艺著称的人造水晶制品，依靠别出心裁的设计以及与时尚品牌的合作变得广受: Known for its cutting technique, this man-made crystal became widely popular after it was used in collaboration with fashion brands in innovative designs. The most classic signature product is one inspired by seagulls.
des.黑月匠造的子品牌GESSO，以“女性正如月亮，阴晴圆缺皆是风采魅力”为核心理念，: GESSO, a sub-brand of Night Chains Lesage, is dedicated to producing a plethora of makeup products to fulfill the needs of different clientele. Its core concept is, "Women are like the moon, enchanting in all its glory."
des.经过精心设计的女装，面向高端客户群体。通过简单的剪裁衬托穿着者的独特品味。: Carefully designed women's clothing, aimed for high-end customers. Its unique aesthetic taste is highlighted by its minimalistic tailoring.
des.囊括清洁、洗护等用途的商品，靠物廉价美的特征走进广大消费者的家中。也有一小部分迎: Cleaning and skincare products, among others, have made their way into the homes of most consumers on the basis of being good and affordable, although there is also a small percentage of high-end products that cater specifically to high-end consumers.
des.将猪腿盐腌风干后制成的美食，因独到的风味广受人们的喜爱。在贡露受欢迎的吃法是生食: Made from salted, air-dried pork leg. Hardly anyone can resist its one-of-a-kind flavor. Generally consumed raw in Gronru, for cutting it could change its taste unless consumed immediately.
des.Latona香水主打古典优雅的风格，有多款经久不衰的香型。创立之初主打花香调女士: Latona Perfume centers around the style of classic elegance, with multiple fragrances that have been sought after since its introduction. Initially a brand that exclusively produces floral-scented perfumes for women, it has now expanded into other product variations after being acquired by Night Chains Lesage, though its original specialty remains unchanged.
des.用鲟鱼子制作的腌制食品，价格高昂，作为一种奢侈的美食受到追捧。: An expensive cured delicacy made from sturgeon roe that's highly coveted because of its prominence as a luxurious gourmet food.
des.黑月匠造旗下高端护肤品品牌Parish Lantern，以始终走在前沿的尖端技术: Parish Lantern, a premium skincare brand under Night Chains Lesage that manufactures the finest skincare products with the most forefront cutting-edge techonology of all time, is a brand for the books for its peerless restoration effect that has shaken the world.
des.海角城出产的海水珍珠因优秀的品相在市面上极受欢迎，与学社合作改良了养殖技术后珍珠: Saltwater Pearl from Cape City that are in high demand on the market, owing to their incredible physical attributes. Their retail price has lowered ever since academic societies worked to improve pearl farming techniques, thus boosting productivity.

des.作为调味品能够赋予食物独一无二的辛辣风味，给人带来别具魅力的味觉体验，相当受欢迎: As a seasoning, it provides a one-of-a-kind spiciness to food that enraptures people's taste experience. Relatively popular but also unbearably hot for many others.

As one of the members of "Gronru City's coastal tourism spots," Cape City has tried and obtained huge success with the introduction of many travel-related products.
des.玉髓类矿物的一种，因为层次丰富的色彩成为受人欢迎的观赏物和饰物。数年前一块颜色如: A type of chalcedony mineral frequently used as an ornament or accessory, thanks to its rich layers of colors. Many years ago, an Agate with magnificent colors like a Chaos Remain's was auctioned off at a sky-high price but was later discovered to indeed be just a Chaos Remain remnant.

des.发动机作为修格里的核心工业产品，其研发技术一直是重要机密。虽然研发企业经历了大换: The development technique of engines, the core industrial product of Shoggolith, has always remained highly confidential. des.兼具口感与性价比，让人们以低廉的价格轻松获得维生素的补给，非常适合列车运输的商品: Its low cost and decent taste have made it the source of many people's affordable vitamin supply. Ideal train transportation product. If you're visiting a patient, there is no better gift than a thoughtful basket of canned fruits!

With that said, it still has its own limitations and can't be used in some environments.

Although the market is still primarily inclined toward natural stones, the production of artificial stones has gradually increased as techonology advances.

des.出产自曼德矿场的未加工铁矿石，在满足自用的前提下，曼德矿场也会向其他地区出口矿石: Unprocessed Iron Ores of Mander Mine that are exported to other regions when there's a surplus. Thanks to their high iron content, these superior Iron Ores are exported on a relatively substantial scale.
des.由新鲜的油橄榄果实直接冷榨而成的食用油，丰富的营养成分与独有的清香让它广受高级餐: An edible oil made via direct extraction of olive fruits. Its rich nutrients and characteristic aroma make it essential in the kitchens of high-end restaurants.

des.年货年年新，佳节家家好。: A new one every year. Happy New Year!

des.可以使灯管切换出不同颜色以此营造氛围的娱乐性用具。在演唱会等活动中出现率极高，还: A novelty item to liven up an atmosphere by making light out of plastic tubes. Especially common in events like concerts, so much so that waving glow sticks has become a sort of dance to express one's fervor.

Now, it's mostly used as media to store music.

As Morphic Moon incident brought about lots of network problems, game developers now prefer to sell their video games in physical copies. Many players also enjoy collecting physical cartridges rather than only owning digital versions.
des.死去的桦树生物有可能形成一种类似桦石的物质。这些物质不具有桦石那样被制造成其它材: Also known as the Chaos Residue, a Chaos Stone-like matter that dead Chaos Remains sometimes create. Unlike a Chaos Stone, it has no potential of being made into other materials but is still usable as a power source. Chaos Residues loosely found in the wild are colloquially referred to as Black Slags.
des.计算机的重要硬件，性能优越，可以为使用者带来更好的体验。不少对计算机有高要求的人: A vital computer part with excellent performance that can enhance user experience. Many people with high requirements for computers would choose to pay an arm and a leg for a tip-top GPU.

des.简约实用的基础款纯棉T恤，大众之选。: A simple and practical basic cotton T-shirt, a popular choice.

des.阿妮塔设计的抗污染防护服，兼具防护一般化学品污染和轻度形态污染的功能。: Anti-Pollution Suit designed by Anita, providing protection against both general chemical substances and mild morphic field pollution.
des.近年制备技术成熟后出现的新型工业纤维，具有耐高温耐腐蚀的特性，广泛应用于航天领域: New industrial fibers that have emerged in recent years, resistant to high temperatures and erosion and widely used in a variety of fields, including the aerospace industry.
des.采用尖端技术研发的瞄准器，能够透过障碍物直接侦测目标的形态场。: A scope developed via cutting-edge techonology that can directly detect the target's Morphic Field even with obstacles in the way.

des.拥有8座现实稳定装置的中型篝火城，该地矿产资源丰富，制造业发达，是典型的综合性工: A medium-sized Bonfire City equipped with eight Reality Stabilizers. This area is renowned for its abundant mineral resources and well-established manufacturing industry, making it a prime example of a comprehensive industrial city.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 5</color>
des.西大陆最大的临海港口城市，虽然海运业务减少，但海产品依然供不应求。另因地理位置特: The largest seaport city in the Western Continent. This city continues to experience high demand for seafood despite a decline in sea transportation business. Additionally, due to its strategic geographical location, the Source Citadel has established a branch here.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 45</color>
des.迷途的船只搁浅在此，静静等待着渺茫的归期。\\n<color=#b45e01>推: Ships lost at sea find their final resting place here, quietly awaiting the unlikely day of their return.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 15</color>
des.二十多年前，一位工厂主在切斯河畔打造了金矿城镇“淘金乐园”，吸引了络绎不绝的淘金: Over twenty years ago, a factory owner built a gold mining town, the ONEderland on the Chess River Bank, attracting a constant stream of gold seekers. Now, the abandoned ONEderland only has robots waiting for visitors day after day...\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended level: 25</color>
des.实力强盛的大型篝火城，有着自己独特的文化与风俗。街道上随时可见传统与潮流的碰撞，: A large, formidable Bonfire City with its own unique culture and customs. Tradition and fashion trends can often be seen clashing on the streets. People from all walks of life are able to find a home here, albeit not as glamorous. \n<color=#b45e01>Recommended level: 50</color>
des.这是一座曾属于阿妮塔的火箭发射基地，由地联出资用于研发探索木星用的混合动力火箭。: This rocket launching base was originally owned by Anita and funded by the Earth Union for the development of hybrid rockets intended for Jupiter exploration. However, for various reasons, the project was suspended, rendering this place completely abandoned.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 35</color>
des.阿妮塔科技下属工厂，以奇思妙想著称。尽管该工厂生产的武器性能惊人，但是有严格的购: This factory, affiliated with Anita Tech and known for its innovative designs, produces weapons of remarkable performance. However, strict purchasing restrictions are in place, and only the Chaos Remains truly comprehend the true dreadfulness of these weapons...\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 40</color>
des.阿妮塔下属的能源研究站点，拥有将桦石和桦树生物能量转化为电力的成熟技术，与七号自: An energy research station affiliated with Anita, known for its proven Tech for converting the energy of Chaos Stones and Chaos Remains into electricity. It maintains close collaboration with Freeport Ⅶ.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 30</color>
des.隶属于铁盟中部基地，进一步扩大了铁盟中部基地影响和管控的辐射范围。对列车长们来说: Serving as a central base for BCRL, this facility expands the organization's influence and provides a secure haven for conductors.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 35</color>
des.岚心城附近的次要站点之一，曾经是候鸟的重要迁徙栖息地，如今发展出了发达的禽类养殖: One of the smaller stations near Ranshin City that used to be a significant migratory habitat for migratory birds. It has since developed a booming poultry farming industry. \n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 45</color>
des.一场意外事故后在原7号自由港遗址附近重建的篝火城。地理位置优越，受形态污染影响，: A Bonfire City near the site of the original Freeport, rebuilt after a certain accident. Strategically located, this city features highly variable climates due to morphic field pollution, creating unique landscapes and topographical features.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 20</color>
des.连接海角城与贡露城的大桥，近期刚刚完成修复建设。此地不仅是连接两座重要篝火城的桥: A recently constructed large bridge that links Cape City and Gronru City. Not only does it function as the bridge between the two major Bonfire Cities, but it is also a stronghold that serves various exhaustive purposes.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 55</color>
des.前身为修格里城建设现实稳定装置时设立的物资转运站，之后因其地理位置发展成了防卫修: A former logistics station for building reality stabilizers in Shoggolith City, it later developed into a military outpost defending Shoggolith.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended level: 20</color>
des.以旅游业和美食著称的大型临海城市，在城市执政的领导下，逐渐成为了吸引高端人群集中: This large seaside city is renowned for its tourism and culinary offerings. Its highly efficient government has played a crucial role in its transformation into a tourist destination that appeals to high-end customers seeking exceptional experiences.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 50</color>
des.保存有未被污染的人类形态场样本，这些样本为测量澄明度提供参照。世界各地的现实稳定: This location preserves numerous uncontaminated human morphic field samples, serving as a reference for clarity measurements. All Reality Stabilizers worldwide operate based on the data provided here. Over time, it has evolved into a thriving underground city through several expansions.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 25</color>
des.索思学会在海角城附近设置的小型站点，外界多认为这是学会的重要补给据点之一。近年长: A small station built by Source Citadel near Cape City, which is widely considered to be one of the Citadel's important supply bases. Remained closed in recent years, open only to those with credentials.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 50</color>
des.修格里城名下的老牌矿场，西大陆规模最大的人工矿场，集开采与粗加工为一体，以出产铁: The most ancient mine under Shoggolith City and the largest mine in the Western Continent, integrating mining and roughing as a whole, famous for producing Special Steel for Tracks.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: 10</color>

desc.百废待兴的淘金乐园将在你的援助下焕发生机，展露全新面貌。: The dilapidated ONEderland awaiting reconstruction will be revitalized with your aid to showcase a new look.
desc.越是美妙的梦境越是需要人们全心全意的维护，为了保证“梦幻之城”长期繁荣，黑月游乐: To ensure the long-term prosperity of "Dream City," Night Chains Land sincerely invites you to the maintenance plan.
desc.为了制造出更有效对抗桦树生物的武器，战备工厂的扩建工程亟待支援。: To create better weapons against Chaos Remains, the expansion of the Weapon Factory needs urgent support.
desc.阿妮塔能源研究所需要你的力量。投身战斗、研发武器，任何贡献都会成为打开未知之门的: Anita Energy Institute needs your strength. Join the combat, research weapons, and any contribution will be a key to unlocking the unknown.
desc.云岫桥基地以羁押违法人员、敦促其改过自新为建设目的。协助整顿中心建设，帮助羁押人: Base Yunxiu Bridge detains lawbreakers and encouraging their rehabilitation. Please support the construction of the Reforming Center.
desc.清除栖羽站周边的潜在危险，维护这条风景秀美、安宁宜居的线路，保证附近行车安全。: Eliminate potential hazards surrounding Sumihane Station to maintain safety and ensure a peaceful travel experience.
desc.维护远星大桥的安全，保证连接贡露城与海角城的主要通道正常通行。: Safeguard the Apoaster Bridge to ensure smooth traffic flow along the primary route connecting Gronru City and Cape City.
desc.为了监测铁盟哨站地区的形态污染情况以及桦树生物动向，全新的铁盟哨站需要你的力量。: The new BCRL Outpost needs your strength to monitor morphic field pollution and Chaos Remains' movements.
desc.作为索思学会的重要据点，汇流塔发展与地区稳定紧密相系。\r协助汇流塔扩建，让大海: A stronghold of Source Citadel, a significant landmark of human civilization in the ocean.

desNew.拥有8座现实稳定装置的中型篝火城，该地矿产资源丰富，制造业发达，是典型的综合性工: A medium-sized Bonfire City equipped with eight Reality Stabilizers. This area is renowned for its abundant mineral resources and well-established manufacturing industry, making it a prime example of a comprehensive industrial city.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.西大陆最大的临海港口城市，虽然海运业务减少，但海产品依然供不应求。另因地理位置特: The largest seaport city in the Western Continent. This city continues to experience high demand for seafood despite a decline in sea transportation business. Additionally, due to its strategic geographical location, the Source Citadel has established a branch here.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.迷途的船只搁浅在此，静静等待着渺茫的归期。\\n<color=#b45e01>推: Ships lost at sea find their final resting place here, quietly awaiting the unlikely day of their return.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.二十多年前，一位工厂主在切斯河畔打造了金矿城镇“淘金乐园”，吸引了络绎不绝的淘金: Over twenty years ago, a factory owner built a gold mining town, the ONEderland on the Chess River Bank, attracting a constant stream of gold seekers. Now, the abandoned ONEderland only has robots waiting for visitors day after day...\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended level: %d</color>
desNew.位置偏僻、环境优美但相对封闭的林场，近年来产量滑落，但仍旧保持着重要木材产地的地: A remote and environmentally beautiful but relatively isolated forest farm, has seen a decline in production in recent years, yet it still maintains its status as an important timber-producing area.
desNew.实力强盛的大型篝火城，有着自己独特的文化与风俗。街道上随时可见传统与潮流的碰撞，: A large, formidable Bonfire City with its own unique culture and customs. Tradition and fashion trends can often be seen clashing on the streets. People from all walks of life are able to find a home here, albeit not as glamorous. \n<color=#b45e01>Recommended level: %d</color>
desNew.娱乐综合篝火城，服务业为主，黑月旗下的游乐城。各个娱乐场所的集大成之处，门票很贵: A Bonfire City with a focus on entertainment and services, Night Chains' amusement park. A culmination of various entertainment venues, the tickets are very expensive.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.这是一座曾属于阿妮塔的火箭发射基地，由地联出资用于研发探索木星用的混合动力火箭。: This rocket launching base was originally owned by Anita and funded by the Earth Union for the development of hybrid rockets intended for Jupiter exploration. However, for various reasons, the project was suspended, rendering this place completely abandoned.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.阿妮塔科技下属工厂，以奇思妙想著称。尽管该工厂生产的武器性能惊人，但是有严格的购: This factory, affiliated with Anita Tech and known for its innovative designs, produces weapons of remarkable performance. However, strict purchasing restrictions are in place, and only the Chaos Remains truly comprehend the true dreadfulness of these weapons...\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.阿妮塔下属的能源研究站点，拥有将桦石和桦树生物能量转化为电力的成熟技术，与七号自: An energy research station affiliated with Anita, known for its proven Tech for converting the energy of Chaos Stones and Chaos Remains into electricity. It maintains close collaboration with Freeport Ⅶ.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.索思学会专为哈依玛之骰以及周边相关设施增设的一处站点，位于沙漠地带的中心。\\n: A station exclusively developed by Source Citadel for Haima Zaria and the relevant facilities nearby. Located in the center of the desert. \n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.隶属于铁盟中部基地，进一步扩大了铁盟中部基地影响和管控的辐射范围。对列车长们来说: Serving as a central base for BCRL, this facility expands the organization's influence and provides a secure haven for conductors.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.岚心城附近的次要站点之一，曾经是候鸟的重要迁徙栖息地，如今发展出了发达的禽类养殖: One of the smaller stations near Ranshin City that used to be a significant migratory habitat for migratory birds. It has since developed a booming poultry farming industry. \n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.一场意外事故后在原7号自由港遗址附近重建的篝火城。地理位置优越，受形态污染影响，: A Bonfire City near the site of the original Freeport Ⅶ, rebuilt after a certain accident. Strategically located, this city features highly variable climates due to morphic field pollution, creating unique landscapes and topographical features.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.连接海角城与贡露城的大桥，近期刚刚完成修复建设。此地不仅是连接两座重要篝火城的桥: A recently constructed large bridge that links Cape City and Gronru City. Not only does it function as the bridge between the two major Bonfire Cities, but it is also a stronghold that serves various exhaustive purposes.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.前身为修格里城建设现实稳定装置时设立的物资转运站，之后因其地理位置发展成了防卫修: A former logistics station for building reality stabilizers in Shoggolith City, it later developed into a military outpost defending Shoggolith.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended level: %d</color>
desNew.以旅游业和美食著称的大型临海城市，在城市执政的领导下，逐渐成为了吸引高端人群集中: This large seaside city is renowned for its tourism and culinary offerings. Its highly efficient government has played a crucial role in its transformation into a tourist destination that appeals to high-end customers seeking exceptional experiences.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.保存有未被污染的人类形态场样本，这些样本为测量澄明度提供参照。世界各地的现实稳定: This location preserves numerous uncontaminated human morphic field samples, serving as a reference for clarity measurements. All Reality Stabilizers worldwide operate based on the data provided here. Over time, it has evolved into a thriving underground city through several expansions.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.索思学会在海角城附近设置的小型站点，外界多认为这是学会的重要补给据点之一。近年长: A small station built by Source Citadel near Cape City, which is widely considered to be one of the Citadel's important supply bases. Remained closed in recent years, open only to those with credentials.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>
desNew.修格里城名下的老牌矿场，西大陆规模最大的人工矿场，集开采与粗加工为一体，以出产铁: The most ancient mine under Shoggolith City and the largest mine in the Western Continent, integrating mining and roughing as a whole, famous for producing Special Steel for Tracks.\n<color=#b45e01>Recommended Level: %d</color>

des.ANITA“质数”系列无人机。用于货运，能把掉落的货物捡回列车。\r\\n该装备: A drone from the ANITA "Prime" series designed for freight transportation, capable of retrieving dropped goods back to the train. \nThis equipment is [train weapon] and can be equipped in the train menu.
des.ANITA“质数”系列无人机。用于货运，能把掉落的货物捡回列车。升级了动力和续航: A drone from the ANITA "Prime" series designed for freight transportation, capable of retrieving dropped goods back to the train. Upgraded power and endurance allow it to transport heavier goods over longer distances.
des.ANITA“质数”系列无人机。园丁款。用于货运，能在各种恶劣环境和形态污染区域稳: A drone from the ANITA "Prime" series, Gardener model, designed for freight transportation and capable of stable operation in various harsh environments and morphic field pollution areas. It has powerful propulsion and long endurance but comes with a high cost. Owners would feel devastated if it crashes.
des.从机身编号可知为ANITA“质数”系列无人机。但系列里并未有此型号。由名为“空间: A drone identified as one of the ANITA "Prime" series, but the model has never existed. It was transported from an unknown location by a fault space positioning anchor named "Space Tangent." Its techonology and performance are far more advanced than other models in the series.\nThis equipment is [train weapon] and can be equipped in the train menu.
des.学会御敌枢纽常用的伺服念珠，加装照明设备以后能够当作车灯使用。 体积虽小，但飞行: A servo rosary utilized by the Destroyer of the Citadel. When fitted with a lighting device, it can serve as a headlight. Despite its small size, it can easily match the train's speed.
des.ANITA“质数”系列无人机。最基础款。\r\\n该装备为【列车武装】，可在列车: The basic model drone from the ANITA "Prime" series.\nThis equipment is [train weapon] and can be equipped in the train menu.
des.用钻头产生能量的实验成功后的产物，原来使用者的叫声越大气势越足产生的能量就越多，: The product of a successful experiment in generating energy with a drill. The louder the user yells, the greater the energy is generated. The previous attempt failed primarily due to the operator's lack of momentum.
des.ANITA“质数”系列无人机。升级了动力，能侦查更远的距离。: An upgraded version of the ANITA "Prime" series drone with increased power, allowing it to scout over longer distances.
des.ANITA“质数”系列无人机。园丁款，能在各种恶劣环境和形态污染区域稳定工作，造: A drone from the ANITA "Prime" series, Gardener model, capable of stable operation in various harsh environments and morphic field pollution areas. It comes with a high cost, and owners would feel devastated if it crashes.
des.最为常见的防撞装置，能撞开大部分杂物。: The most common anti-collision device. Capable of knocking away most debris.
des.由一位路见不平的人士发明。: Invented by someone who was tired of waiting for the uneven roads to be fixed.
des.铁路劫匪都畏惧的大灯。: Headlights that even train robbers fear.
des.使听到的人感到焦虑，能吸引来敌人。: Causes people who hear it to be on edge. Might attract enemies.
des.拾荒者迷信仙人掌能驱散形态污染，用仙人掌汁制作的涂料。也确实能起到一定效果。: A coating made of cactus juice. The Marauders have a superstition that cacti can dispel Morphic Field Pollution, which has been proven effective to some extent.
des.撞击是最原始的攻击手段，但有用。: Ram is considered the most rudimentary method of attack, yet it remains highly effective.
des.让车头进入高维空间，连战舰都能迎头撞碎。: Propel the train into high-dimensional space, transforming it into an enormous battering ram capable of crushing even battleships.
des.小范围人工制造形态污染，利用形态污染侵蚀现实的性质使爆炸物失效，再铲出轨道。: Artificially creates short-range Morphic Field Pollution to corrode reality's constitution and render explosives ineffective, then shovels them away from the railway tracks.
des.铁路上有些东西不能硬碰硬，比如油罐和炸药桶。这项改造可以把这类物体铲出轨道。: While on the railway, some things can't be combatted with force, such as oil tanks and barrel bombs. This modification will be able to shovel these things away from the tracks.
des.一个锯盘没有用，那就上一排锯盘。: If one saw blade doesn't work, how about an entire row?
des.小范围人工制造形态污染，利用形态污染侵蚀现实的性质使物质变得脆弱。再一口气辗过去: Artificially creates short-range Morphic Field Pollution to corrode reality's constitution and weaken physical matters, then rolls over them at once.
des.常用清障装置，连岩石都能锯开。: A commonly used obstacle-clearing device that can even saw open rocks.
des.用桦树生物坚硬的部分做成，去撞桦树生物，字面意思的以眼还眼以牙还牙。: Made from the hard parts of Chaos Remains to ram Chaos Remains. The literal representation of an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.
des.用桦树生物最锋利的爪和最坚硬的骨制成，行驶时会发出尖啸声，光是这声音就能驱散一般: Made from the sharpest claws and hardest bones of Chaos Remains. Screeches when the train is on the move. Just this sound alone is enough to drive away ordinary Chaos Remains.
des.有理论认为钻头旋转时会产生巨大的不明能量，因此制造了巨大的钻头。但这种能源并没有: There was a theory that an immense, unknown energy would be generated when a drill bit spins, which led to the creation of this massive drill bit. However, this energy did not present itself, so the drill bit is now used as a regular obstacle-clearing device.
des.以桦树生物为原料获得巨大的热量，再把热量集中在一点，形成钻开一切的钻头。: Obtains immense heat by using Chaos Remains as the raw material, then directs the heat in one spot to form a drill bit that will drill through anything.
des.原本用于采矿的激光钻头，不知出于什么疯狂的想法被安装在了列车上。对所有拦路的敌人: A Laser Drill originally used for mining but was, for some crazy reason, installed on the train. Intimidates all enemies who attempt to block the train's paths.
des.优化点火性能，从而增加急行弹丸的转化效率。: Optimizes the ignition function, thus boosting the Rapid Bullet's conversion efficiency.
des.优化急行弹丸形态共振的转化效率和装载上限。: Optimizes the conversion efficiency and maximum capacity of the Rapid Bullet's Morphic Resonance.
des.在急行弹丸产生的燃气中掺入一氧化二氮气体，提升其燃烧完成度，增加行驶速度。: Adds nitrous oxide to the gas produced by the Rapid Bullet to boost its burning rate, thus increasing the train speed.
des.妮蔻拉的得意之作，利用列车引擎的超载核心对急行弹丸的形态共振进行增幅，此刻的列车: Nicola's masterpiece. Makes use of the train engine's Overload Core to amplify the Rapid Bullet's Morphic Resonance, which transforms the train into "lightning."
des.列车带武器干嘛？跑得快才是最重要的。这项改造把本该用于武器系统的能源全部分配给了: What's the point of arming the train? Speed is what's of utmost importance. This modification directs all the power to the engine instead of the weapon system.
des.ANITA“质数”系列机器人产品。装备了维修装备和人工智能，可以自动对列车进行维: A robot of Anita's "Prime" series products that can automatically repair the train. Equipped with repair tools and artificial intelligence.
des.采用了更粗的线圈，大大提高了列车的加速性能。: Uses thicker coils to substantially increase the train's acceleration function.
des.额外增加的火箭推进器，增加列车的速度。: An additionally installed rocket thruster that boosts train speed.
des.一种推进火箭的改进装置。直接将重桦石转化为氦3，在重桦石进行质能转换的同时，产生: A type of enhancement device for propulsion rockets. Directly converts Heavy Chaos Stones into Helium-3, and during the mass-energy conversion, the Helium-3 produced will bring about a nuclear fusion reaction under high temperature and pressure. However, as it involves techniques prohibited by the Citadel, it's classified as contraband.
des.与悬针基地沟通的通讯协议。能利用悬针基地的传送装置将你传送一段距离。: A communication protocol to communicate with Suspension Point Base. Can teleport you a certain distance away via Suspension Point Base's teleportation device.
des.将大量桦石直接转化成一个普朗克尺寸的不带电且高速旋转的克尔型黑洞。以此压缩列车前: Directly converts large amounts of Chaos Stones into a Planck-scale electrically neutral Kerr black hole that rotates at high speed. This will compress the space ahead of the train, which propels it forward. It's one of the technologies that Anita believes is viable for intergalactic travel. However, the Morphic Field catalyst will lose its effectiveness upon being polluted by Chaos Stones, so it can only work in a limited range.
des.帝国商业魔法学院制作的秘法道具，持有者身轻如燕。挂在列车上似乎也行。: An arcane item created by Empire Commercial Magic Academy. Whoever possesses it will be light on their feet. Hanging it on trains seems to be an option too.
des.帝国商业魔法学院制作的秘法道具，以前给马用，有奇效。现在挂在列车上居然也行。: An arcane item created by Empire Commercial Magic Academy. Worked wonders when it was used on horses. Surprisingly, it also works when hung on trains.
des.更稳固地固定货物，能增加列车安全运载的货物量。: Secures cargo even better and increases the amount of cargo that the train can safely transport.
des.一种主动产生形态污染的装置，使货仓内产生异常空间以装载更多货物，或躲避铁盟的扫描: A device that produces Morphic Field Pollution on its own, generating an anomalous space in the cargo hold to carry more cargo or to transport prohibited goods under B.C.R.L.'s radar. It's classified as a dangerous techonology by the Citadel and is hence banned from use.
des.帝国商业魔法学院制作的秘法道具，能有效提升牲口的体力。对列车似乎也有用。就是需要: An arcane item created by Empire Commercial Magic Academy. Can effectively increase livestock's physical strength. Seems to work on trains as well, albeit you'd definitely need more than one.
des.带有基底桦树生物阿图-金力量的纹章。阿图-金据传是对人类友好的基底桦树生物，会庇: An emblem with the power of Arthu King, a basal Chaos Remain reportedly friendly to humans. Protects the humans in dangerous zones.
des.带有基底桦树生物瑟普拉索达力量的纹章。其力量能使损坏的物体复原。: An emblem with the power of Seprasoda, a basal Chaos Remain. Capable of restoring damaged objects.
des.针对桦树生物感光器官开发的特殊车灯，对桦树生物有一定的驱散作用。但对没有感光器官: Special headlights invented to specifically affect Chaos Remains' photoreceptors. Able to repel Chaos Remains to some extent but completely useless on Chaos Remains without photoreceptors.
des.针对桦树生物感光器官开发的特殊车灯，对桦树生物有一定的吸引作用。但对没有感光器官: Special headlights invented to specifically affect Chaos Remains' photoreceptors. Able to attract Chaos Remains to some extent but completely useless on Chaos Remains without photoreceptors.
des.桦树生物的器官改造而来，会在列车周围产生浮动的光球，触碰后会造成灼伤。: Adapted from Chaos Remains' organs. Conjures a floating ball of light surrounding the train that causes burns when touched.
des.基底桦树生物德拉卡娜鲁赠与黑月的宝物。能照出桦树世界的通道，黑月能在各地安全往返: A treasure gifted to Night Chains by Dracanaru, a basal Chaos Remain. Illuminates the passage to the Chaos World. It is likely the reason that Night Chains is able to travel everywhere safely. The user can roam in the intermundium to escape the dangers of the two worlds.
des.优美频率，据说能与宇宙共振，让人感到协调。能让一些敌人放你一马。: Its mellifluous frequency is said to be able to resonate with the universe, making people feel harmonized, so much so that some enemies will let you off.
des.能使桦树生物发生声学共振与与携带地球形态场的空气高速撞击，使桦树生物的形态场被地: Makes acoustic resonance occur in Chaos Remains, then have them crash into the atmosphere composed of the planet's Morphic Field at full tilt. This will result in the Chaos Remains' Morphic Field being corroded by the planet's Morphic Field, hence repelling the Chaos Remains. However, it might have an adverse effect if used in places with severe Morphic Field Pollution.
des.黑月制造的世界上最响的音响系统。没别的特点就是声音大。打开之后，所有的劫匪都会奔: The world's loudest sound system manufactured by Night Chains. Nothing else worth mentioning other than its incredibly loud sound. Once it's turned on, all robbers will run toward you, and those fired-up people will be a great help to you in eliminating tons of Chaos Remains.
des.一心毁灭世界的基底桦树生物“拉玛-杜”的低语。由帝国贤者伦道夫在梦中偷取并记录。: The mutter of Rama Doo, a basal Chaos Remain committed to destroying the world. Swiped and recorded in dreamland by the Empire sage, Randalf. The voice itself already embodies destruction. Enhances anything with the concept of "destruction" within its effective range.
des.使车上的形态场稳定器产生的形态共振通过涂层传导，对形态污染有很强的防护效果。: Circulates the Morphic Resonance of Morphic Field Stabilizers on vehicles through a coating. Highly effective in protecting against Morphic Field Pollution.
des.铁路劫匪中代表高速的颜色。涂上以后似乎真的能起到加速效果。: The color that represents high speed among train robbers. Seems to actually increase speed once used.
des.具有极高的硬度和耐腐蚀性，对形态污染也有比较好的防护效果。但最重要的是，它能让你: Has exceedingly high hardness and erosion resistance and is fairly good at protecting against Morphic Field Pollution as well. But most importantly, it can turn your train so shiny as if it were gold-plated.
des.摇滚列车的标志性涂装，拾荒者、游民甚至劫匪都会视你为传奇。他们中的多数不再攻击你: Iconic paint job of Rock 'n' Roll trains. The Marauders, vagrants, and even robbers will be in awe of you, and most of them will no longer attack you. On top of that, it truly does contain rare metal, making it pretty practical.
des.使用桦树生物制作的一种涂料，能使你看起来亦真亦幻，从而化身为不明铁路物体。迷信的: A type of coating made from Chaos Remains that makes your train appear phantom-like, thereby transforming it into an unidentified railway object. Superstitious Marauders and robbers will then regard your train as the ghost train of urban legends and thus dare not approach.
des.作为跑繁忙线路的列车，有些时候不得不卖挂票。: It's inevitable that trains working the busiest routes will have to sell hanging tickets at times.
des.铁盟研发的列车专用装甲板，虽然没有针对能量武器或桦树生物的攻击进行过升级，但胜在: B.C.R.L.-developed armor plate specifically for trains. Even though it hasn't been upgraded to protect against the attack of energy weapons and Chaos Remains, it's still popular due to its ample supply and how easy it is to manufacture.
des.ANITA最初设计是给航天器隔热用，重量轻，具有良好的隔热性能。: Initially designed to be used on spacecraft for heat insulation. Lightweight and great at insulating against heat.
des.烈日级以上的大型桦树生物残骸制作的装甲。普通桦树生物会将你识别为同类或天敌而不敢: An armor made from the carcass of large Chaos Remains above the Blazesun Class. Common Chaos Remains will see you as one of its own or a predator, therefore steering clear of you. At the same time, it's also excellent as protection.
des.学会制造的超级材料，地联科学家对其原理毫无头绪。一旦成型几乎坚不可摧。据说是建造: A supermaterial created by the Citadel that Earth Union scientists can't make sense of. Virtually indestructible once it takes shape. It is supposedly what was used to construct Senanonic.
des.列车的生命就是跑得快。你认同这一说法。于是把用于武器系统照明系统空调系统的电力全: "A train's purpose is to run hell for leather," is something you concur with. So, redirect all the power of the weapon, lighting, and air-conditioning systems to the engine.
des.列车如果没有速度就没有存在的价值，除了速度其它都可以不要。: A train without speed is basically worthless. Anything can be forgone, save for speed.
des.油门到底，十死无归。你唯一的遗憾是铁轨上不能漂移。: Going full throttle to death's door. It's a shame you can't drift on railway tracks, though.
des.利用列车的形态场发生器在形态污染中形成的泡泡加速的装置。原理并不复杂，但必须要在: Makes use of the train's Morphic Field Generator to accelerate the bubbles formed by Morphic Field Pollution. Fairly easy to operate but must be used in severely polluted regions in order to work.
des.新型的悬挂系统，能调节悬架的刚性和阻尼。提高列车行驶的稳定性。: A new-type suspension system that automatically adjusts the stiffness and damping of the train's suspension, thereby enhancing the stability of the ride.
des.一种在轨道上涂肥皂水的设备，能使火车高速滑行。其发明灵感据说来自云岫桥整顿中心的: A device used for applying soapy water to the track to enable trains to glide at high speeds. Its invention is said to have been inspired by the bathrooms in the Yunxiu Bridge Reforming Center, although it can result in a loss of control over the brakes.
des.监狱安装的探照灯，能照射很远的距离。对在云岫桥服刑过的人有威慑效果。: A searchlight installed in prisons that can illuminate a long distance. It has a deterrent effect on those who have served their sentences at Yunxiu Bridge.
des.铁盟授权给部分列车长安装的警灯，本身平平无奇，但由于个别列车长的活跃，导致这种警: The police light authorized by BCRL to certain conductors. While this light itself may not be extraordinary, the actions of certain conductors has made it a significant deterrent.
des.铁盟授权给部分列车长安装的警笛，本身平平无奇，但由于个别列车长的行为，导致这种警: The siren authorized by BCRL to certain conductors. While this siren itself may not be extraordinary, the actions of certain conductors has made it a significant deterrent.
des.铁盟授权给部分列车长的涂装，本身平平无奇，但由于个别列车长的作为，反而导致这种涂: The coating authorized by BCRL to certain conductors. While this paint job itself may not be extraordinary, the actions of certain conductors has inadvertently attracted unwanted attention from robbers.
des.较轻量级的护甲，防护力比不上普通的铁盟列车装甲，但不会拖累列车的速度。: While this lightweight armor lacks the level of protection offered by the standard B.C.R.L. train armor, it does not hinder train speed.
des.试验用车皮车头武装\r\\n该装备不可卸下: A test train weapon.\nThis equipment cannot be removed.
des.俺寻思指定撞不坏。: Me fink dis nevva break duwn. WAAAGH!
des.随便贴爆反只会救了你。\\n\r<color=#FFB800>累计完成30次撞击: Reactive armor always saves the day.\n<color=#FFB800>After 30 rams, this ram will be destroyed.</color>
des.光波干涉技术，在光束的传输过程中创造涟漪效应。这样，光线会在空气中呈现出一种平缓: Created using lightwave interference technology, this device produces a ripple effect in light transmission. Hence light creates a soft, wave-like effect in the air, ensuring that the train's headlights do not disrupt anything potentially hazardous during nighttime travel.
des.借助量子光学的原理，利用光的干涉和衍射效应，创造出多层次的华丽光环效果。: Using quantum optics principles, this device creates a stunning kaleidoscopic effect through light interference and diffraction.
des.这个声纳系统可能不仅仅作为一种侦察工具，还能在极端情况下将敌对目标“变形”，例如: This sonar system serves as both a reconnaissance tool and a device that alters sound waves to weaken targets, making them vulnerable or even causing their destruction.
des.操纵声音的反射和延续，制造出虚假的回声及幻觉，让敌人难以分辨真实的位置，增加攻击: This device uses sound reflection to create false echoes and illusions, confusing enemies and creating tactical opportunities for ambushes or escape.
des.无垠号标配款车载20mm机枪。\r\\n该装备为【列车武装】，可在列车整备处装备: The standard 20mm machine gun for The Eternal.\nThis equipment is [train weapon] and can be equipped in the train menu.

des.<size=25><color=#FFB800>可以从以下SSR乘员名单中自选一:

Due to distrust of Night Chains, Citadel created its own version of the Laplace Protocol. It seems to have some impact on the future. The personnel at Night Chains find this incredible.
des.铁盟发放给列车长们的奖章，小巧精致，用于感谢他们为维护行车沿线安全作出的巨大贡献: A delicate and exquisite medal issued by B.C.R.L., as a token of gratitude for conductors' significant contributions to maintaining safety along the railway lines. These medals can also be exchanged at the B.C.R.L. for practical items to assist conductors in maintaining their active performance.\nDuty Medals are primarily obtained by eliminating Chaos Remains along the railway lines and defeating bosses in bounty quests issued by BCRL Agency.
des.有着奇异光泽的结晶体，一般用桦树生物体内的腺体精炼而成，在桦树世界内可以通过特殊: Crystals with a peculiar sheen, typically refined from glands inside Chaos Remains. Through special methods, Chaos Stones can be directly "generated" within Chaos world. Essentially, Chaos Stones are a type of material not shaped by morphic fields, allowing them to be molded into any material or produce energy using morphic field control tech. Many of the Chaos Stone's unique properties are still being researched. Transporting Chaos Stones requires special isolation boxes to prevent contamination from morphic fields.
des.进行战斗时，由于外界形态场的持续污染，我方护卫队员会不断降低澄明度。澄明度会随时: During combat, allied crew members continually reduce their Clarity due to the sustained contamination from external morphic fields. Clarity gradually restores over time, but can also be quickly cleansed using items like Cactus Candy Roll.
des.<size=25><color=#FFB800>角色招募时所需必要道具。</co: <size=25><color=#FFB800>A necessary item for recruiting characters.</color></size>\nA communication protocol provided by Night Chains to its partners. Connected to the Night Chains' supercomputer located in an unknown location, it is able to precisely predict forthcoming crew members for the train.

des.黑月提供的乘员过往履历情报，能帮助列车长进一步了解该乘员。\\n【履历情报】由招:
Career Info provided by Night Chains, helps conductors further understand crew members.
[Carrer Info] is obtained when recruiting crews. <color=#FFB800>Each recruit grants 1 Career Info</color>.
Once you have obtained a total of <color=#FFB800>5</color> [Career Detail] to any character, any subsequent [Career Detail] obtained for that character will be automatically converted into [Career Info] at the following ratio:
Every <color=#FFB800>1</color> [Career Detail] of <color=#71CEFD>R</color> characters will be converted into <color=#FFB800>1</color> [Career Info].
Every <color=#FFB800>1</color> [Career Detail] of <color=#E4B7FF>SR</color> characters will be converted into <color=#FFB800>3</color> [Career Info].
Every <color=#FFB800>1</color> [Career Detail] of <color=#FFE266>SSR</color> characters will be converted into <color=#FFB800>10</color> [Career Info].
You can use [Career Info] to exchange for various items at the Night Chains Shop in the rest area in each city.

des.以达斯廷的形象为原型，贴合无垠号车身构思的痛车外观设计方案。如此威风凛凛的设计，: A customized train livery designed for the Eternal based on the image of Dustin. Such a majestic design will surely make any ill-intentioned enemies retreat.\n<size=25><color=#FFB800>Unlock the train livery "Flame of Heart".</color></size>
des.获得后会增加栖羽站的阶段进度: This item boosts the Construction Pts of Sumihane Station.
des.由【阿妮塔】出品的装备箱，其中封存着一件该阵营的战斗装备。由于该类装备箱中出现的: An gear box produced by Anita, containing a piece of combat equipment affiliated with that faction. Due to the unpredictable nature of the items within, the outcome is purely dictated by fate, hence named the Fate Box.
des.由【帝国】出品的装备箱，其中封存着一件该阵营的战斗装备。由于该类装备箱中出现的装: An equipment box produced by Mundus, containing a piece of combat equipment affiliated with that faction. Due to the unpredictable nature of the items within, the outcome is purely dictated by fate, hence named the Fate Box.
des.由【黑月】出品的装备箱，其中封存着一件该阵营的战斗装备。由于该类装备箱中出现的装: An equipment box produced by Night Chains, containing a piece of combat equipment affiliated with that faction. Due to the unpredictable nature of the items within, the outcome is purely dictated by fate, hence named the Fate Box.

des.由【学会】出品的装备箱，其中封存着一件该阵营的战斗装备。由于该类装备箱中出现的装: An equipment box produced by the Citadel, containing a piece of combat equipment affiliated with that faction. Due to the unpredictable nature of the items within, the outcome is purely dictated by fate, hence named the Fate Box.
des.黑月游乐城的快速通被爱好者们称为“持有就意味着幸福会立刻到来的神器”，不过这个至: The fastpass for Night Chains Land is called by enthusiasts "the magical item that brings immediate happiness when obtained," but when was this UR edition released...?\nUse it to skip [Combat] or [Special Combat].
des.从某个角落找到的旧物，其中的装备或许并非珍奇却十分可靠，可以帮助列车长应对意料之: An aged item discovered in a dusty corner, containing reliable equipment to aid the Conductor in navigating unforeseen challenges.
des.<size=25><color=#FFB800>可以从以下SSR乘员名单中自选一:
<size=25><color=#FFB800>You can select one crew member from the following SSR crew list to board the train.</color></size>
Joshua, Katas, Suen, Nayuta, Charlotte, Vilan, Connor, Stella, Caroline, Magira, Wensheng, Ilona, Tennie.

Due to distrust of Night Chains, the Citadel created its own version of the Laplace Protocol. It seems to have some impact on the future. The personnel of Night Chains find this incredible.
des.由铁安局签发的铁道清剿许可证，只有持有此证的列车长能够参与铁道行车段内的清剿工作: A license issued by BCRL Agency, granting authorized conductors permission to engage in annihilation operations.
des.老电影里传统派魔女使用的魔法交通工具，话说回来现在新世代的魔女们用的是什么？\\: The traditional magical transportation tool used by witches in old movies. Speaking of which, what do modern witches use now?\nUse it to move further without consuming AP.
des.黑色胡桃木上点缀着星屑，端盖上书写着咒语。透过三棱镜，似乎可以窥视到某处。\\n: Starry specks adorn the black walnut, with spells inscribed on the cap. Through the triangular prism, one seems to catch a glimpse of somewhere.\nUse it to check the gem color of [Candy House].
Starry specks adorn the black walnut, with spells inscribed on the cap. Through the triangular prism, one seems to catch a glimpse of somewhere.\nUse it to check the gem color of [Carousel].

des.未定的命运分支向边缘蔓延，只有知性的魔女能够看穿其中预兆。: The undecided fate branch spreads to the edge, only an intellectual witch can see through its auguries.
des.一块凝固的血珀，倒映着永不服输的魔女精神。: A solidified piece of blood amber, reflecting the indomitable spirit of the witch.
des.湖水涟漪骤止的瞬间，水下乃是牢不可破的魔女之心。: The moment the ripples of the lake abruptly stop. Beneath the water lies the unbreakable heart of the witch.
des.冥火装点着归途，不可直视也不可回避，不要忘却魔女之名。: The nether flame adorns the return journey. Don't look at it directly or avoid it. Don't forget the name of the witch.
des.闻笙赠送的节日巧克力。简约而不失高级的礼盒，糖粉漫洒如芬利城的雪。\\n使用后可: Holiday chocolate gifted by Wensheng. A simple yet sophisticated gift box, with powdered sugar sprinkled like the snow of Frostville City.\nUse to obtain a token and clarity recovery item.
des.达斯廷赠送的节日巧克力。包装的确童趣，但是不是有点太童趣了……\\n使用后可获得: Dustin's holiday chocolates. The packaging is indeed whimsical, but isn't it a bit too whimsical...\nUsing it will allow you to obtain tokens and a Clarity recovery item.
des.铁盟宅家编程达人提供的入侵程序，能控制他人的骰子点数。指定1名其他玩家，使其下1: This hacking program, developed by a BCRL nerd programmer, can set the target's next [Normal Dice] roll points to 1.
des.铁盟宅家编程达人提供的超级入侵程序，能控制他人的遥控骰子点数。指定1名其他玩家，: This super hacking code, developed by a BCRL nerd programmer, can set the target's next [Remote Dice] roll points to 1.
des.感应式的路障，检测到列车通过时会自动弹起阻止其前进。在当前位置(不可为城市)铺设: Place a barricade at the current tile (excluding cities and starting tile), forcing the next player passing by to stop at this tile.
des.出溜滑！在当前位置(不可为城市)涂抹润滑油，下1名经过此处的玩家向前滑行2~4格: (Excluding cities and starting tile) Causing the next player passing by to randomly slide forward 2 to 4 tiles.
des.可怕的地雷。踩到就要重来了哦。在当前位置(不可为城市)铺设地雷，下1名经过此地的: Place a mine at the current tile (excluding cities), sending the next player passing by back to the starting tile.
des.对化物的特制导弹。与其说是造成伤害，不如说是破坏了化物本身形态场的稳定性。发射负: Launch Negative Bomb at the [HowlingBox] on the map, reducing its HP by 5%.
des.可怕的导弹，会制造一阵强风把人吹退一截。小心变成大背头！指定1名其他玩家，使其下: Use this item on a player to make them randomly move back 5 to 8 tiles at the start of their next turn.
des.神秘的锦囊。不过真正的好运还是要靠自己把握。使用后，本回合道具使用次数变为2。: Use this item to enable yourself to use 2 items during this turn.
des.好朋友，帮帮忙~\\n今日可协助他人次数+1。: Let me give you a hand, buddy! Use this item to gain an extra chance to assist others today.
des.投资就是机会，机会就是未来。使用后，本回合投资次数+1。: Investment brings opportunity. Use this item to gain an additional investment chance for this turn.
des.参加“无垠乱斗”游戏获胜后得到的积分，在对应窗口刷卡后可以查看余额或者兑换相应奖: Points earned by winning "The Eternal Scuffle". You can check your points and exchange them for rewards on the game screen.
des.红灯、绿灯、黄灯……这到底该听哪个颜色的话啊！？指定1名其他玩家，使其下1次行动: Use this item on a player to prevent them from selecting a direction in their next turn.
des.大型化物讨伐许可。击败嚎虎箱！使自身今日【嚎虎箱】挑战次数+1。: Use this item to gain an extra challenge chance against HowlingBox.
des.财深发放的护身符。财源滚滚来！使用后，自身下1次局内战斗的奖励加倍。: Use this item to double the rewards from the next battle in this event.
des.测试道具，篝火银行支票: A test item, a check issued by Bonfire Bank.
des.能掌握多个城市经济形势实时走向的监控板。8小时内，使自身所有城市资金产出+10%: Use this item to increase all your cities' Funds yield by 10% for the next 8 hours.
des.批准科伦巴商会承包篝火城建设工程的标书。8小时内，使自身当前所在城市资金产出+2: Use this item to increase your current city's Funds yield by 20% for the next 8 hours.
des.针对性的发展打击方案。指定1名其他玩家，使其8小时内，所有城市的资金产出-10%: Use this item to reduce the target's Funds yield from all cities by 10% for the next 8 hours.
des.流通于娃娃鱼商会负责人之间的仓库钥匙。一人一把，绝不外流。使自身所在城市的资金存: Use this item to increase the current city's Fund storage limit by 10% for the rest of the round.
des.“不许动！手拿出口袋！”\\n指定1名其他玩家，使其下次行动无法使用道具: "Freeze! Hands out of your pockets!" Prevent the target from using any items in their next turn.
des.莉薇娅按照铁山城的春节传统菜肴（的外形）制作的糕点。乍一看是条红烧鱼，闻起来却有: A pastry crafted by Livia, reminiscent of the popular Chinese New Year dish in Fortress City, appears like a braised fish but surprises with a sweet aroma... Could it be a dessert with caramelized toppings?Anyhow, wishing you a New Year filled with fortune, Conductor!

des.执行域外联合行动后获得的奖金点，可用于在活动界面的“兑现办理处”交换道具。黑月锁: Bonus points obtained from Mission: Uncharted operations, can be exchanged for items at the "Redemption". Night Chains and Source Citadel designed it for this operation, which is said to effectively enhance participants' work efficiency.

des.魔女的圣告烙印在绝望与渴求的瞳孔之中，悲恸的命运在紧闭的双眼中轰然洞开。\\n<: The witch's sacred proclamation is branded upon eyes filled with despair and longing. The mournful fate bursts wide open within sealed lids.\nUse it to convert the purple [Gem of Underworld] to the yellow [Gem of Augury].

Holiday chocolate gifted by Livia, carefully handmade and presented in an exquisite box.
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

Dear Conductor,

While I was out shopping this morning, I passed Carmine May and noticed a long line of young people. Upon asking, I learned that today holds special significance for the people of the Western Continent.
The queue was too lengthy, and I feared it would disrupt my schedule, so I didn't join the commotion...
However, after my return to the Eternal, Fran noticed my distracted demeanor. Well, she's always astute... So, I confessed that I hadn't bought the gift intended for you today, then she kindly offered to guide me in making one using the ingredients on the Eternal.

Well, that about sums it up. If you find it delicious, I'll whip up another one for you next year. You are the most special one in my life, Conductor.
des.静流赠送的节日巧克力。\\n……不过，好像没听其他人说过铁盟过节会发这种物资啊？:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Shizuru, labeled as a 'holiday gift' from the BCRL Agency.
...But hey, has anyone else at the BCRL Agency mentioned receiving a gift like this?
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

Conductor,
Once again, the BCRL Agency sent us holiday gifts, and I ended up with an extra batch. Karen is on a diet, Julian prefers bitter treats, and Dorothy got hers from Chief Heinrich. So, I'll just pass this on to you.
The flavor isn't half bad, it seems. Let me know your thoughts after giving it a try.

Shizuru
des.亚莉奈赠送的节日巧克力。爱心手制，味道上流。\\n附上了一封随巧克力寄来的邮件：:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Arina, handcrafted with care and a touch of sophistication.
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

My Love,

Even though we see each other almost every day, special occasions deserve that extra touch of magic, don't they? I put some thought into this, hoping it brings you joy. And the ingredients in this chocolate? They're not your everyday fare, you know?
Being with you, dear conductor, fills me with pure bliss... These moments are the ones I cherish most. I wish they could last forever...

Will you join me at Viburnum tonight too? I'll be waiting for you with bated breath.
des.妮蔻拉赠送的节日巧克力。吃了以后能获得什么天才的启示吗……\\n附上了一封随巧克:

Conductor,

While I was working on a new product recently, the holiday season's arrival inspired me to enhance the chocolates in the current Anita rations. Before wrapping up the patent application, your name crossed my mind, so I decided to share a sample with you. Remember to provide feedback on the taste and, if possible, draft a tasting report.

Once you've finished your report, don't hesitate to bring it to me for review, and if writing isn't your strong suit... present yourself to me instead.

I could really use a special assistant during this holiday.
des.乌刹娜赠送的节日巧克力。不是肥皂是巧克力……充满了孩子的灵机一动！\\n附上了一:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Ushana. No, it's not soap! It's chocolate... packed with that childlike creativity!
