Master Savior!

While I was helping my friends at Bonfire City, I heard that everyone shares chocolates on this special day. I totally remember seeing people sharing chocolates before!
So, I went up to the giant fish at the trading center and asked for some stuff to make this gift! I added mint, strawberries, watermelon, blueberries, apples... and loads and loads more! It turned out super colorful, bright, and oh-so cute!
 Time to dig in and munch away! Yum, yum!

Ushana
des.那由他赠送的节日巧克力。今天是他的生日。\\n附上了一封随巧克力寄来的邮件：\\:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Nayuta. Today is actually his birthday.
Enclosed is a letter sent with the chocolate.

Dear Conductor,

The young scholars from the Citadel came to me with a promotional flyer from the dessert shop, wondering why chocolates were being sold in special bundles with lovely wrappings on my birthday.
It was in that moment that I discovered I share my birthday with such a unique event.
It's quite a rare occurrence when Mr. Dustin and Sommer aren't out on field operations, so we decided to treat ourselves to a chocolate cake.
I made sure to save a slice for you too. Wishing you joy on this special day.

Nayuta
des.卡塔斯赠送的节日巧克力。究极魔法交织而成！真的不是什么漫画的周边产品吗……？\\:
Holiday chocolate gifted by Katas. It's brimming with ultimate magic power! But seriously, are we sure this isn't some popular merchandise...?
O, Lord of Black Iron!

Rejoice! Rejoice! The time has come for the denizens of the earth to exalt and impart their love and gratitude. For this special occasion, I, the Cursed Sword Maiden, have meticulously crafted a keepsake just for you!
To create this keepsake, I journeyed far and wide, seeking counsel from the Erudite Sage of Yore, the Sanctified Wings of the Wind, and the Tailor of the Royal Court! After much deliberation, I imbued this keepsake with six potent blessings with my very own hands! To savor this divine artifact is to be graced with my benedictions...
Anyway... In short... you mustn't share this with others! Keep it all to yourself, got it?

Next time, I'll whip up something even more amazing for you! And don't forget to share your thoughts after tasting it!

Jumakenki

"An eye for an eye is my principle. To repay kindness with kindness as well.
Over the past year, you have taken great care of the colleagues at Night Chains. Mr. Sagi often mentions you and has expressed regret at not having had the chance to meet you, urging me to maintain close contact with you, and I believe he is right.

I also hope you have more opportunities to collaborate with Night Chains in the future. Let's meet more often elsewhere."

Earlier when meeting Nayuta, I heard him mention that you celebrated a birthday together. Thank you for your care for Nayuta and Sommer all this time. Hearing from the two children that you've been doing well recently puts my mind at ease.
The last opportunity I had to spend such a youthful holiday with someone was probably when Melanie was still alive... I was young then. I won't say much about the past, just hope you'll accept this gift.
Spring is coming, and you're welcome to visit the greenhouse to chat whenever you have free time.

The day of reckoning has arrived—the day of the showdown between me and my only rival should, of course, be chosen to coincide with a festival.
How about it? Seeing this high-end chocolate that ordinary people won't have a chance to taste in their lifetime and requires a six-month advance reservation, you must already be convinced of my superiority, unable to hold back tears as you admit your defeat! You absolutely won't find a better chocolate than mine—this time, without a doubt, I win! Use this chocolate to soothe the bitterness of your defeat!

Conductor:

What should I write here? I'm not quite sure.
I've been in Bonfire City for many years, but I generally don't have many people to spend this kind of holiday with... After all, the busier the city gets, the more hectic we members of the BCRL Agency become. But I happened to see these chocolates at the Supply area and kept hearing colleagues say that this is a day suitable for expressing gratitude and acceptance, so I bought them and sent them to you!
Besides, everyone keeps saying it's not good for me to eat chocolate...
Anyway, happy holidays! See you later!

Lycagia

description.我们在澄明数据中心附近发现了几台奇怪的作业机械，正处于失控状态，希望你前去调查一: We found some strange operational machinery near the CDCA Bureau, and they are currently out of control. We hope you can investigate.
description.阿妮塔的成员擅长利用特殊的武器与升构能力作战，甚至有他们能改变气象的夸张传闻。: Anita members are skilled in using special weapons and ascension abilities in combat. There are even exaggerated rumors that they can change the weather.
description.最近公司要求各个研究部门进行紧急情况演练……毕竟事关安全，我也不能说这是浪费时间: Recently, the company required emergency drills in all research departments... After all, it's about safety, so I can't say it's a waste of time. Help me complete it.
description.之前有个谁写了一份关于生物燃料的改进报告书，我觉得还挺有意思，就请你帮我搜集一点: Someone wrote an interesting report on biofuel improvements. Please help me collect some experimental materials.
description.新型生物燃料的研究进展非常理想，但研究需要质量更好的素材——打败那只大型桦树生物: The research on new biofuels is progressing very well, but the research needs better quality materials — defeat that huge CR and bring back the materials.
description.与深眠者对抗前请确认一点：它们已不再是我们的同伴。: Before confronting Deep Sleepers, please accept this fact: they are no longer our companions.
description.我对那些分布广泛的爆虫型桦树生物也很感兴趣，请帮忙随机观测几只的活动轨迹记录下来: I'm also interested in those widespread Blastbugs. Please help randomly observe their activity trajectories. But if they threaten your safety, you can just eliminate them.
description.通过你提交给我的活动轨迹记录，我推算出了那些爆虫桦树生物的领袖所在的位置。请帮忙: Based on the activity logs you submitted, I calculated the location of the leader of those Blastbugs. Please help collect some intel about it, be it records or organ samples.
description.是什么存在吸引了如此多的毒爆虫，它们的目标到底是荒原号，还是“那艘船”？: What attracts so many Burstbugs? Is their target the Wilderness Express or 'that ship'?
description.有些窃取了阿妮塔内部技术和装备的人在能源中心附近游荡。为了不让这些人威胁到研究进: Some people who stole internal tech and equipment from Anita are wandering near the Energy Center. Please deal with them.
description.保存完好的旧地铁，有些线路已被遗忘。成为了篝火城暗面的利益通道。: Well-preserved old subways have become a conduit for interests in the dark side of the Bonfire City.
description.黑月对每一位加入的成员都明确告知过行为的底线是什么，但总有脑子不灵醒的傻子。: Night Chains has clearly informed every new member of the bottom line for their actions, but there're always a few dim-witted fools.
description.通常而言我们不会干涉拾荒者的行动，可如果他们造成财产损失就另当别论了。: Generally, we do not interfere with marauder operations, but if they cause property damage, it's a different matter.
description.除了神出鬼没的流民与拾荒者，这里什么也没有。所幸还有未被风沙掩埋的铁轨，它是这片: Apart from elusive vagrants and marauders, there's nothing here. Fortunately, there're still unburied railway tracks, connecting this desolate land with the Bonfire City. However, no train stops here.
description.鼹鼠帮一直以来盘踞着城市地下，对治安来说是个重大隐患，请驱逐那些暴徒。: The MoleGang has always been entrenched underground in the city, posing a major security threat. Please expel these mobs.
description.乐园附近，桦树生物，很多，这样危险，游客，不来。请你，帮忙清除桦树生物。: Chaos Remains, ONEderland, many. Dangerous, tourists, don't come. Please help, clear them.
description.检测到，桦树生物，威胁级别高。正在活动，距离淘金乐园，越来越近。请帮忙，阻拦。: Detected, high Threat, Chaos Remains. Get close, to ONEderland. Please, stop them.
description.游客，越来越多。可是沙盗，盯上游客，埋伏乐园路段，掠夺。请帮忙，把他们，赶走。: More tourists, but, sand pirates, ambush, ONEderland route. Please, drive them away.
description.这艘搁浅于漫漫黄沙中的船曾经迷失于时空的缝隙中，它经过了漫长的岁月，如今终于回航: This ship stranded in the endless sands was once lost in the space-time rift. After ages had passed, it finally returned.
description.沙盗的领袖，最近，带领他们。沙盗变得，十分难缠。只能拜托你，帮忙赶走他们。: The leader, sand pirates, very troublesome, recently. Only you, drive them away.
description.美味的、让人为之疯狂的红茶，它的秘密就在这里面……也许不要知道还比较幸福。: The secret to the delicious, addictive black tea lies in... maybe it's better not to know.
description.我打算将深眠者躯体上的木质物体投入到新项目的使用——对，你没有听错，不用太惊讶。: I plan to use the wooden objects from Deep Sleepers' bodies for a new project. Yes, you heard right. Don't be too surprised. The collection task is still yours.
description.淘金乐园运营，恢复，机器人稳定运作，是必需。帮忙测试，机器人安保模块运作，拜托了: Stable operation, robots, essential, ONEderland. Please help, test the robot, security module.
description.一成不变、枯燥无味的景象是此处最大的特征，但是今天有引擎的轰鸣声与风声作伴。: An unchanging, dull landscape is the biggest feature here, but today there's the accompaniment of engine roars and wind sounds.
description.行进的列车突破了滚滚沙尘，沙尘散开后显示在眼前的不仅是前方的道路，还有不速之客。: The train breaks through the rolling sand, revealing not just the road ahead but also unexpected guests. Or should I say, they are the true owners here?
description.在战斗中，莉薇娅也是我们最值得信赖的助手。她灵活多变的升构能力能够成为最好的支援: In combat, Livia is our most trusted assistant. Her flexible ascension abilities provide the best support.
description.测定到附近地区所有军阀机械中威胁最大的机械，危险程度极高。请尽快阻止它的肆意破坏: Detected the most threatening mechanical device in the nearby area, extremely dangerous. Please stop its rampant destruction.
description.总有一些对现状心存不满的人开始制造麻烦，好在他们的威胁性并不算太大。: There are always some people dissatisfied with the status quo who start causing trouble, but their threat isn't very significant.
description.潜藏沙中的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: Chaos remains lurking in the sand become more dangerous under pollution influence.
description.具有触手的桦树生物集群，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: The Chaos remains cluster with tentacles becomes more dangerous under pollution influence.
description.我们已经将这些机械的情况与目前阶段的已获得数据作比对，只要剿灭这批敌人，应该就能: We've compared these mechanical conditions with current data. Eliminating this batch of enemies should lead us to their leader.
description.围绕着大型爆虫行动的爆虫集群，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: Blastbugs that cluster around large blastbugs become more dangerous under pollution influence.
description.“游鳞”中的强大个体，危险程度较高。: A powerful individual in the 'swim scale', highly dangerous.
description.成群行动的深眠者团体，在污染的影响下变得更加危险。: Deep Sleepers acting in groups become more dangerous under pollution influence.
description.移动的样子宛如游鱼，却能四处留下火星，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: Moving like a swimming fish but leaving sparks everywhere, this creature is more dangerous under the influence of pollution.
description.强大的深眠者首领，持续在道路附近区域游荡。: The powerful Deep Sleeper leader continues to wander near the roads.
description.游走沙中的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: Roaming Chaos remains in the sand have become more dangerous due to pollution.
description.像是海洋生物的桦树生物，神出鬼没，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: These Chaos remains resembling marine creatures come and go like shadows, becoming more dangerous due to pollution.
description.外形让人联想到幻想物种，总是与寒冷相伴的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: Resembling fantastical creatures, these cold-associated Chaos remains are more dangerous due to pollution.
description.在污染环境下增加了爆炸威力的爆虫，爆炸时分外华丽。: Blastbugs enhanced by pollution have increased explosive power, creating spectacular explosions.
description.美丽的不完整球体，其制造冷气的能力能让周围都下起雪。: A beautiful incomplete sphere, its ability to generate cold can cause snow to fall around it.
description.附近的毒爆虫似乎无穷无尽，它们的目标到底是荒原号，还是“那艘船”？: The Burstbugs nearby seem endless. Is their target the Wilderness Express or 'that ship'?
description.最近又有小部分桦树生物在澄明中心附近游荡，以无垠号乘组的水平能够应付，要去练练手: A small group of Chaos remains has been wandering near the CDCA Bureau recently. You should be able to handle them. Want some training?
description.这种身披铠甲的桦树生物会给周围区域带来隆隆巨响，非常扰民。务必消灭这个危险的噪音: This armored Chaos Remain creates a deafening noise, disturbing the area. Must remove this dangerous noise source.
description.多只桦树生物从附近的山区中现身，对列车运营安全构成了威胁，还是清除为妙。: Several Chaos Remains have emerged from nearby mountains, threatening train operations. It's best to clear them out.
description.这些新北阵成员也算是不合时宜的人吧，不过威胁到正常的物资运输可不行，还是让他们回: These New Northern Alliance members never seem to learn. It's okay to be stubborn, but if they mess with our supply transportation, we'll need to show them who the boss is! Let's put them back to sleep!
description.不知道什么时候起，开始有人相信这种特殊的桦树生物聚集在一起就能引发飓风。为了平息: At some point, people started believing that these special Chaos Remains could cause hurricanes when gathered. To calm their fears, we need to reduce their number and spread the correct information.
description.也许是因为这种桦树生物看起来像缎带，总有人觉得它们会通过下水道入侵自己的家。在那: Because these Chaos Remains resemble ribbons, people fear they will invade their homes through the sewers. Before they cause any plumbing issues, let's make these dangerous creatures vanish.
description.仿佛古怪的花卉，实则为桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: These appear to be Singular Sparks but actually Chaos remains that have become more dangerous due to pollution.
description.桦树生物的活跃一向是不容小觑的威胁，请协助我们将其消灭。: The active presence of Chaos Remains is always a significant threat. Please assist us in eliminating them.
description.既然无法抹消桦树生物的存在，就只能时刻心怀警惕。: Since we can't erase the existence of Chaos Remains, we must always remain vigilant.
description.不管什么环境都能生存，这些桦树生物的适应能力强得惊人。: No matter the environment, these Chaos remains have astonishing adaptability.
description.有大量桦树生物聚集在某个区域，不能继续放任它们影响人们的生活。: A large group of Chaos remains gathering in a specific area cannot be allowed to continue affecting people's lives.
description.我们侦测到了强烈的共振指数波动，需要将这个威胁立刻铲除。: We've detected strong resonance index fluctuations. This threat needs to be eliminated immediately.
description.繁衍了众多子嗣，爆炸的威力非同小可。: It has spawned a mass of offsprings and its explosive power is significant.
description.常常使人神志不清的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: Chaos remain that often cause delirium, has become more dangerous due to pollution.
description.体型巨大的桦树生物。容易暴怒，小心地震。: A massive Chaos remain that is prone to rage and causes earthquakes.
description.我们无法做到彻底消灭桦树生物，只能在它们威胁到市民的生命安全前将其击退。: We're unable to completely eradicate Chaos remains. We can only repel them before they threaten citizens' lives.
description.我们需要针对桦树生物的聚集地进行针对性的打击，作战时请务必小心。: We need to target the Chaos remains' gathering points. Be very careful during operations.
description.随处可见的桦树生物集群，在污染影响下危险程度提升。: Chaos remains clusters that can be seen everywhere have become more dangerous under pollution.
description.具有类似“龙”的外形的桦树生物，非常难以对付。似乎在哪里见过……: A Chaos Remain resembling a "dragon", a tough opponent. It looks rather familiar...
description.桦树生物的活动可能会对矿场作业造成影响，我们需要保证施工环境的安全。: Chaos remains' activity might disrupt mining operations. We need to ensure the safety of the work environment.
description.如同乌鸦般不祥的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: Crow-like ominous Chaos remains have become more dangerous due to pollution.
description.如果桦树爆虫在人类活动区域附近建立了巢穴，我们就需要尽快清除这个隐患。: If Blastbugs establish a nest near human activity areas, we need to eliminate the hazard quickly.
description.对那些学不会适可而止的家伙，就不用再留手了。: For those who don't know when to stop, there's no need to hold back.
description.鼹鼠帮时常能够巧妙地与打击他们的势力周旋，这让彻底剿灭他们成为了难题。: The MoleGang often cleverly evades forces trying to eliminate them, making it difficult to wipe them out.
description.不仅擅长利用地形和情报，他们似乎还拥有秘密武器，战斗时不能掉以轻心。: They not only utilize terrain and intelligence but also seem to possess secret weapons. Stay alert during combat.
description.拾荒者们依靠一些来源不明的装备变得难缠，他们究竟是从哪里得到这些的？: Marauders have become troublesome with some mysterious equipment. Where did they get these?
description.即使失去了领导者，拾荒者们也没有成为一盘散沙，他们会自发地再次凝聚起来。: Even without leaders, Marauders do not scatter but regroup on their own.
description.不要对深眠者有任何的同情，除非你也想成为它们的一员！: Do not sympathize with Deep Sleepers unless you want to become one of them!
description.有人认为深眠者只是坠入了另一个世界，在里面迷失了回家的路。但不要因此有任何的同情: Some believe Deep Sleepers are just lost in another world. But do not sympathize with them unless you want to join them.
description.劫掠者们正在有组织性地作乱，这次的规模已经不能算是小打小闹了，请尽快阻止他们。: Looters are causing trouble in an organized manner. This time, it's not a small nuisance. Stop them quickly.
description.在桦树世界中的探索并不容易，为了能更好地保护自己，园丁们也需要一些额外的训练。: Exploring the Chaos world isn't easy. Gardeners need extra training for better protection of themselves.
description.园丁的对手大部分是桦树生物，所以他们的作战风格也许与其他人不太一样。: Gardeners mostly fight Chaos remains, so their combat style might differ from others.
description.近期桦树生物中实力较强的个体现身与治安部队对抗，请前去协助治安部队剿灭这只敌人。: A strong individual Chaos Remain is resisting security forces. Assist them in eliminating this enemy.
description.劫掠者的首领现身了，这次定要将附近的劫掠者一网打尽！: The leader of the looters has appeared. Round up all the looters in the area this time!
description.劫掠者正成群结队地向澄明数据中心涌来，不能让他们肆意妄为。: Looters are swarming CDCA Bureau. We can't let them run amok.
description.有一只旧型号伐木机械来到了澄明数据中心附近，请将其打倒，排除这一威胁。: An old model logging machine has appeared near the CDCA Bureau. Take it down to eliminate this threat.
description.神出鬼没的沙盗时常掠走他人的财物，是一群让人头痛的家伙。: Elusive sand pirates frequently steal others' belongings. What a troublesome bunch.
description.这些生物十分危险，需要小心谨慎地应对。: These creatures are very dangerous. Handle them with caution.
description.为了提升海角城铁安局的综合应对能力，铁盟和学会的部分成员举办了联合战斗演习。: To enhance the overall combat prowess of the BCRL Agency in Cape City, some BCRL and Citadel members have organized a joint combat exercise.
description.劫掠者们聚集起来在居民区大肆破坏，已经造成了市民受伤和经济损失的情况。请立刻前往: Looters are wreaking havoc in residential areas, causing injuries and economic loss. Stop them immediately.
description.阿妮塔向我们发起合作申请，希望能帮忙测试一下他们最新研发的无人机。由于数据样本的: Anita has requested cooperation to test their latest drones. Given the large data samples needed, we hope to recruit more help for the tests.
description.这些行动迅速的荒古桦树生物总会随着潮水一同在海岸上活动，请前去击退它们。: These swift-moving Primal CR always move along the coast with the tide. Please proceed and repel them.
description.附近地区的深眠者开始了周期性活跃，请协助铁安局击退他们，减轻它们对城市的威胁。: The Deep Sleepers in the vicinity have become active. Please aid the BCRL Agency in repelling them, addressing the threat they pose to the city.
description.荒古桦树生物的头领现身于附近，它的实力强大，甚至拥有重塑附近环境的力量。请协助我: The leader of Primal CR has appeared. This intimidating creature possesses the power to reshape the environment itself. Please assist us in repelling it!
description.为了客人们的笑容，也为了保存与同伴们一同创造的美好回忆。虽然心有不安，但眼下也只: Despite the uneasiness in heart, we must press on for the sake of the tourists and the cherished memories we've built. Will we eventually uncover the secrets of Mirage Island?
description.一位来历不明的强大深眠者出现在了海角城附近，它的战斗方式似乎还保留着生前的特征，: A formidable Deep Sleeper of mysterious origin has emerged near Cape City, maintaining the combat style of its former life. Research into converting this Deep Sleeper is crucial, and your assistance in collecting its combat data is required... Be cautious, as this foe is exceptionally powerful.
description.最近贡露城附近铁路上总是有很多屠戮者出没，接到的投诉很多呢……: Lately there've been so many Slayers showing up along the railways near Gronru City. We've been getting quite a lot of complaints about it...
description.阿妮塔希望我们能帮他们招募到合适的人选帮忙测试他们最新型号的装备，欢迎有意向者积: Anita hopes we can recruit suitable candidates to help test their latest equipment. Interested parties are welcome to participate, but remember not to be overzealous in battle, as our opponents are not enemies during tests.
description.七号自由港周边又出现了一些游荡的深眠者，虽然已经对此习以为常，但它们依然是危险的: Deep Sleepers have appeared near Freeport Ⅶ again. Though we're used to it, they remain dangerous enemies. Investigate their activities and eliminate any threats.
description.桦树生物们在最近十分活跃，它们可能会破坏电缆，而失去电力对一座篝火城来说绝对是个: Chaos Remains have been very active recently and might damage cables. Losing power would be a disaster for a Bonfire City. Please help reduce the number of Chaos Remains.
description.有一些格外强力的桦树生物出现在七号自由港附近，必须尽快排除这些威胁。请小心应对。: Some unusually strong Chaos Remains have appeared near Freeport Ⅶ. Eliminate these threats quickly. Err on the side of caution.
description.寒潮浮囊体十分危险，别看它长得像礼花彩球，真被它攻击到可不是开玩笑的。请尽快消灭: Coldwave Bladders are very dangerous. Don't be fooled by their festive appearance. Their attacks are not to be taken lightly. Eliminate them quickly and beware of weather changes!
description.民众投诉工厂违规排放，结果调查员以后发现是沼泞桦树生物的异常活动导致的。: Residents filed complaints about a factory illegally discharging waste, but it turned out to be caused by unusual activity from Venom CRs.
description.有市民在贡露城附近目击到了北阵的旧型机械队伍。: Some citizens have spotted old models of N.A. machinery near Gronru City.
description.欸？假的吧？为什么屠戮者居然还有首领啊？: Huh?! No way. Why do Slayers even have a leader?
description.城外出现了超级巨大的沼泞桦树生物！列车长，拜托你了！: Massive Venom CRs just showed up outside the city! Conductor, I'm counting on you!
description.以危害篝火城市民安全为目的的疯狂暴力团体成员。: Members of a berserk violent group with the aim of jeopardizing the safety of Bonfire City's citizens.
description.会发出诡异叫声的桦树生物，较为危险。: The CR that emits eerie sounds is quite dangerous.
description.有市民在贡露城附近目击到了北阵的旧型机械队伍，其中出现了战车级别的目标！: Some residents spotted N.A. mechanized unit near Gronru City—including something on the scale of an armored tank!
description.这些桦树生物总是在海滨出现，以至于传出了阿妮塔的实验使海洋生物变异这种无稽之谈，: These Chaos Remains always appear by the shore, leading to rumors about Anita's experiments mutating marine life. These might be baseless objections against space experimentation. Regardless, our goal is to eliminate them.
description.有人坚称在海边看到了吞下阿妮塔的发动机后产生变异的可怕桦树生物，这个可怜的人大概: Someone claims to have seen a Chaos Remain that mutated after swallowing Anita's engine. This person probably watched a silly movie, but these Chaos Remains are indeed powerful. Stay vigilant.
description.一只强力的凛川骨龙引起了周边气候的剧烈变化，一个储存电子配件的大型仓库也受到了影: A powerful Glacial Skeleton has caused severe climate changes, threatening a large warehouse of electronic components. If this continues, the goods within would be damaged. Stay alert and eliminate it.
description.大概是因为这种桦树生物的外形比较特殊，某些人认为它们是桦树生物被病毒感染后演变为: Because of their unique appearance, some believe these Chaos Remains are superior types that mutated from a viral infection, and that they are capable of countless resurrections. Eliminate them and prove these worries baseless.
description.形似海螺的沼泞桦树生物，较为危险。: A shell-like Venom CR, quite dangerous.
description.始终诡异地涌动、翻滚着的桦树生物，较为危险。: The constantly seething and surging CR is relatively dangerous.
description.形态类似灵长类颅骨的桦树生物，较为危险。: Birch-like entities resembling primate skulls are quite dangerous.
description.形态类似灵长类颅骨的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度进一步提升。: The birch-like creatures with skulls resembling primates have increased in danger level due to the effects of pollution.
description.这种桦树生物可以灵活适应多种环境，这让它非常难对付。务必做好万全的准备再展开战斗: This CR can adapt to various environments, making them tough opponents. Be fully prepared before engaging.
description.一个就很麻烦了，没想到现在竟然出现了两只同类型的桦树生物！我们已经紧急疏散了周边: One is enough trouble, but now there are two of the same kind of Chaos Remains! We've evacuated the surrounding area for a siege. We need more capable people to join our action.
description.我们得到情报，鼹鼠帮得知了修格里城的各大运输商会近期有大量订单进出，谋划着聚集大: We've received intel that the MoleGang has learnt of several large transportation CoC having many orders going in and out of Shoggolith City, and plans to gather in numbers for a raid. Assist BCRL Agency in a siege to prevent any property loss.
description.部分鼹鼠帮的成员依靠自制的外置装甲与载具在城内主干道大肆破坏，他们的作战方式灵活: Some MoleGang members are causing havoc in the main streets with custom external armor and vehicles. Their flexible combat methods make them more threatening than the usual MoleGang crew. Stay vigilant and stop them before things worsen.
description.人称“狂飙焚尽”的鼹鼠帮帮主偶尔会带着战车率领他的手下在修格里城兜风，实际上只是: The MoleGang leader known as "Inferno Maelstrom" occasionally drives his war vehicle through Shoggolith City with his underlings supposedly to enjoy the scenery, while in reality they are charging around recklessly causing destruction. Drive them off. Send the moles back underground.
description.近来有一些游荡的深眠者在修格里城的铁路附近徘徊，是有什么值得它们留恋的吗？不过这: Deep Sleepers have been wandering near the railways in Shoggolith City. Is there something they're attached to? Either way, we can't allow this threat to persist.
description.最近有大量桦树生物聚集在修格里城周边。不知什么时候它们就会开始狂躁，很多市民因此: Large numbers of Chaos Remains have gathered around Shoggolith City. They could become violent at any moment, causing panic among citizens. Eliminate them before any disasters occur.
description.进出修格里城的列车频频误点，这一切都是异常兴奋的桦树生物在城市出入口活动造成的。: Trains entering and leaving Shoggolith City have been frequently delayed due to overly excited Chaos Remains near the city gates. These Chaos Remains are tricky, so we need reliable people for the cleanup operation.
description.寒潮浮囊体对于修格里城来说并不陌生，它每次出现都会借助自己特殊的能力给我们造成麻: Coldwave Bladders are familiar troublemakers in Shoggolith City, causing problems with their special abilities. Drive them away.
description.我们不会干涉黑月的商业活动，前提是他们的行为合规。据说他们最近经手的一宗生意涉嫌: We won't interfere with Night Chains' commercial activities as long as they comply with regulations. However, their recent transaction might violate the Bonfire City management ordinances. Investigate the situation and defend yourself when attacked.
description.我们收到检举称黑月的成员涉嫌走私，请前往他们交易的地点帮忙搜集证据。如果遇到黑月: We received reports of Night Chains' smuggling activities. Go to their transaction location and gather evidence. Prioritize your safety if obstructed by Night Chains members.
description.劫掠者的存在一直是一个问题，我们需要时不时进行打击活动避免他们的组织进一步扩大。: Looters have always been a problem. We need to make periodic strikes to prevent them from growing. Looters are mostly well-trained, so don't let your guard down.
description.如果拾荒者只是在荒原上游荡也就罢了，可是他们竟然想破坏矿场的设施，那些设备可不是: If marauders were just wandering in the Wilderness, it's fine. But they plan to damage mining facilities and those equipment aren't trash! Stop the marauders.
description.沙盗最近的活动十分频繁，严重扰乱了这片地区的秩序。需要注意的是，他们的领导者是一: P.U.S have been very active recently, disrupting order in the area. Their leader is an Ascender, so don't underestimate her. Be wary of the evil creature around her!
description.被弃置的掘金机器人暴走了，它们把所有人都错误地识别为敌对目标开始攻击。虽然它们的: The abandoned nugget mechs have gone rogue, mistaking everyone for enemies and attacking. Their attack is limited, but numbers make them troublesome. Take them down.
description.拜那条船所赐，深眠者变得比往常更多了。曼德矿场的防御体系可不如篝火城，在深眠者接: Thanks to that ship, Deep Sleepers are more numerous than ever. Mander Mine's defenses aren't as good as a Bonfire City. Eliminate them before they reach residential areas.
description.桦树爆虫的数量已经多到走路都会踩到的程度了，就没有什么办法能阻止它们繁殖吗？现阶: Blastbugs have become so numerous that they're everywhere. Can't we stop them from breeding? For now, manual removal is our only option. Please help.
description.这些桦树爆虫格外强壮，希望它们别再长大了，毕竟没人想看到和全地形越野车一样大的桦: These Blastbugs are particularly strong. Let's hope they don't grow any bigger. No one wants to see a Blastbug the size of an all-terrain vehicle. Eliminate them before they grow further.
description.曼德矿场出现了一只体型巨大的桦树爆虫，它正在四处引发爆炸破坏矿场的建筑，已经有人: A massive Blastbug has appeared at Mander Mine, causing explosions and damaging buildings. People have been injured. Stop it before the damage worsens.
description.大量桦树爆虫在虫后的带领下开始大迁徙，它们要离开这一带我们自然求之不得，可是一路: Large numbers of Blastbugs are migrating under the queen's lead, causing explosions along the way. Intercept their path to keep them away from railways and residential areas.
description.这种桦树生物不仅外表骇人，而且比普通的种类更难对付。请帮助我们减少它们的数量，防: These Chaos Remains are not only terrifying in appearance but also tougher than normal types. Help reduce their numbers to prevent disrupting people's lives.
description.不知什么时候，有人把它们和矿场偶然会出现在深夜里的凄厉哭嚎联系在一起，研究者们因: At some point, people linked these Chaos Remains to the eerie cries occasionally heard at the mine at night. Researchers are interested in their sound-making abilities. Defeat them and bring back their shards.
description.一只强大的深眠者在附近徘徊，它体表的树枝比一般深眠者更多，也许这意味着它在梦境中: A powerful Deep Sleeper is wandering nearby, with more branches on its body than usual. This might mean it's deeper in dream... Instead of wondering what it can't let go of, we should eliminate it before things get worse.
description.鼹鼠帮成员正开着动力甲出没于铁盟哨站至修格里城之间的路段，严重威胁了列车行车安全: The MoleGang members in power mecha are patrolling the route between the BCRL Outpost and Shoggolith City, severely threatening train safety.
description.鼹鼠帮出动了修复后的大型进攻机械“鼹鼠重机”。为了保证途经列车的安全，请击溃这个: The MoleGang has deployed the repaired Molegang Machinery. To ensure the safety of passing trains, please eliminate this threat!
description.朱利安率领的队伍参与了近期的治安演习，本队擅长突袭战术，请谨慎应对。: Julian's team participated in recent security drills. They excel in ambush tactics, so be cautious.
description.伊洛娜率领的队伍参与了近期的治安演习。……伊洛娜的话，真的能有决心走出房间带领队: Ilona's team participated in recent security drills... Does Ilona have the resolve to leave her room and lead her team in such a large scale event?
description.多萝西率领的队伍参与了近期的治安演习。小心爆炸物，一定要小心！: Dorothy's team participated in the recent security drill. Beware of explosives!
description.附近地区的触须桦树生物被深眠者所吸引，结队在铁盟哨站附近徘徊，希望有人能前往执行: Nearby Tentacle CR have been attracted by Deep Sleepers, gathering near the BCRL Outpost. Someone needs to wipe them out.
description.近期，铁盟哨站周边出现了强大的寒潮浮囊体个体，预定将由列车武装乘员队伍前往消灭。: Recently, powerful Coldwave Bladders have appeared around the BCRL Outpost. The train crew is scheduled to eliminate them. Be cautious during the mission.
description.昏恶巨象这种大型桦树生物在前去消灭时务必注意安全，请千万别被它给压扁了。: Watch out when facing massive chaos remains like Chaos Behemoth! You don't want to get squashed!
description.战备工厂附近的山怪桦树生物进入活跃期，得让它们消停点才行，拜托你啦！: Those rowdy Mountain Chaos Remains near the Weapon Factory are becoming too rowdy and need to chill out! I'm counting on you!
description.从技术角度来说我对这个还挺感兴趣的……能带回来一点样本就好了！: From a technical standpoint, this stuff is pretty interesting... It'd be awesome if you could retrieve some samples!
description.山怪桦树生物中偶尔会诞生一些特别强大的品种，我正在考虑如何应用到生物燃料中，这个: Among the Mountain Chaos Remains, there might be some extraordinarily powerful entities we could use as biofuels. Sounds like a great idea, right?
description.就是这玩意之前破坏了我们的设施啊，再这样下去工程进度要被大大拖延了！拜托你让它消: So, this is the jerk who messed up our facilities. At this rate, our project will be delayed! Please knock some sense into it!
description.当前地区出现重大威胁目标两名，分别为昏恶巨象和混厄石芝，希望接取作战任务者尽快前: Two major threats have surfaced in the region: Chaos Behemoth and Chaos Ganoderma. Swift action is required to avert any unforeseen mishaps.
description.铁路沿线出现了一些危险的桦树生物！为了保证沿线平静，前去消灭它们！: There are some dangerous Chaos Remains appearing near the railway! It's time to step in and get rid of them!
description.鼹鼠帮认为除了他们以外的新世代红茶交易都是来砸场子的……这对吗？: The MoleGang seems to think that any new-generation black tea trades not involving them are just scams... Talk about monopoly, huh?
description.对于新世代红茶的异常火爆，黑月采取了更为直接的商业竞争手段。: In response to the unexpected surge in new-generation black tea, Night Chains has decided to take a more direct approach in their business competition.
description.实力莫测的黑月成员，交手时需要小心。: Unpredictable Night Chains members require caution when engaging in combat.
description.像是海洋生物的桦树生物，神出鬼没，危险程度较低。: These Chaos remains resembling marine creatures come and go like shadows, and are a low-level threat.
description.据《篝火日报》报道，新世代红茶中检出了和混厄石芝的桦树腺体中相同的物质。: Reports from the Bonfire Journal suggest a resemblance between the substance found in the new-gen black tea and that in the Chaos Glands of Chaos Ganoderma.
description.这些穿得像是电影角色的可疑人士人不知道是从哪出现的……请前去调查，如果他们发起攻: Suspicious individuals cosplaying movie characters have appeared out of nowhere... Investigate, and if they attack, retaliate.
description.有人说附近地区经常游荡着一位神秘的刀客，刀上还会着火。但现实毕竟不是武侠小说，请: Someone claims a mysterious swordsman wanders nearby with a flaming sword. But reality isn't a kungfu novel. Help us subdue this swordsman.
description.几乎没人想要靠近的废弃商业区。破败的表象下，火种沉默地等待再一次为人类文明燃烧。: An abandoned business district shunned by most people. Underneath its decaying exterior, the remnants of human civilization lie dormant, awaiting rekindling.
description.昔日的平静被打破，他们究竟为何而来？: The once tranquility has been disrupted. What is the purpose behind their arrival?
description.一只强大的桦树生物总是伴随着扬起的沙尘出没在荒原地区，对该地区的治安与生态造成了: A powerful Chaos Remain causing sandstorms threatens the Wilderness. Eliminate it to protect the area.
description.是什么存在吸引了如此多的深眠者，它们的目标到底是荒原号，还是“那艘船”？: What attracts so many Deep Sleepers? Is their target the Wilderness Express or 'that ship'?
description.围绕着大型爆虫行动的爆虫集群，十分危险。: Blastbugs that cluster around large blastbugs is very dangerous.
description.外形让人联想到幻想物种，总是与寒冷相伴的桦树生物，十分危险。: Resembling fantastical creatures, these cold-associated Chaos remains are very dangerous.
description.游走沙中的桦树生物，危险程度较低。: Roaming Chaos remains in the sand are a low-level threat.
description.移动的样子宛如游鱼，却能四处留下火星，十分危险。: Moving like a swimming fish but leaving sparks everywhere, this creature is very dangerous.
description.如同乌鸦般不祥的桦树生物，危险程度低下。: Crow-like ominous Chaos remains that are a low-level threat.
description.仿佛古怪的花卉，实则为桦树生物，危险程度低下。: These appear to be Singular Sparks but actually Chaos remains that are a low-level threat.
description.阿妮塔那边的研究员说想尝尝海龙桦树生物新种的味道！: Some Anita researchers are itching to get a taste of these new CR: Marines!
description.拦路卡哨能挡住非法车辆却挡不住桦树生物，希望你们能清理一些。: Those roadblock posts might stop illegal vehicles, but not chaos remains. Can you clear out a few of them for us?
description.阿妮塔那边的研究员希望我们能帮忙收集一些海龙桦树生物的行动数据！: Anita researchers need our help in collecting data on the behavior of the CR: Marines!
description.在大桥放行的时候趁机偷渡来的这些劫掠者特别烦人，请你帮忙解决他们！: Those sneaky looters who come in while the bridge is open are so annoying! We need you to kick them out!
description.最近总有劫掠者在附近地区游荡，能帮忙调查一下他们的动向吗？: Lately, there have been reports of looters roaming the neighborhood. Mind helping us investigate their movements?
description.根据你提供的劫掠者动向，我们已经找到了他们的大本营！一网打尽吧！: Based on the information you provided, we've located the looters' base! Let's wipe them out once and for all!
description.这个拿链子的深眠者肯定是危险中的大危险！: This chain-wielding Deep Sleeper must be some serious threat!
description.获得了强大能力的深眠者一直很让我们头疼……打倒它们吧！: Those Deep Sleepers with powerful abilities always give me a headache... Take them down!
description.深眠者比一般的人类敌人危险多啦，你可要小心再小心！: Deep Sleepers are way more dangerous than ordinary human enemies! You can never be too careful!
description.荒原地区的拾荒团体，干的活可不止拾荒。: The Wilderness's scavenger groups do more than just scavenging.
description.那群鬼鬼祟祟的鼹鼠帮成员又开着鼹鼠重机出动了，请帮忙前去探查他们的行踪，必要时可: Once more, the MoleGang is on the move with their Molegang Machinery. Please help us locate their whereabouts and use force in self-defense as needed.
description.具有触手的桦树生物集群，十分危险。: The Chaos remains cluster with tentacles is very dangerous.
description.我们接到内部人士线报，黑月的一位高层人士正带着手下在这附近四处游荡。出发应对时务: We've received insider information that a high-ranking member of Night Chains is moving around the area with their subordinates. Exercise caution during your investigation.
description.铁盟举办的大型实战演习吸引了士兵们争相报名，而分组的同僚似乎有意将与列车长相识的: The extensive training program organized by the B.C.R.L. has drawn numerous soldiers, placing you in the same group with your familiar companions. Let's engage in some training, Conductor!
description.大量劫掠者靠近了发射中心，难道是想把我们当破烂拆走？: A bunch of looters is heading toward the launch center. Are they planning to tear us apart like scrap?
description.不能让这些想把发射中心拆了的劫掠者得逞！: We can't let those looters destroy the launch center!
description.为了保护大桥不被再次破坏……: To protect the bridge from further destruction...
description.活动于铁轨附近的劫掠者，时刻觊觎着路过的列车。: Looters near the railways always eye passing trains.
description.为了……哎呀不记得了。去吧！列车长！迎战超级双头骨龙！: To shield the... Oops, I forgot what exactly! Anyway, Conductor! It's time to face that super-badass two-headed bone dragon!
description.危险的暴徒团伙，成群结队行动时相当棘手。: Dangerous mob gangs are tough when acting in groups.
description.大量深眠者被现实稳定装置阻挡在发射中心外游荡。为了防止意外，请消灭它们！: A cluster of Deep Sleepers got stuck outside the Launch Center, all thanks to the Reality Stabilizer. Let's take them down before any accidents go down!
description.野外最常见的桦树生物之一，当心爆炸时溅出的液体。: One of the most common wild Chaos remains. Beware of explosive liquid splashes.
description.很厉害的链子人从一群深眠者中现身了！战斗就拜托了，列车长！: A super-tough chain man appears among the cluster of Deep Sleepers! I'll leave the battle to you, Conductor!
description.双头骨龙桦树生物，非常难以对付。: That two-headed bone dragon is definitely a challenging opponent.
description.常常使人神志不清的桦树生物，危险程度低下。: Chaos remains that often cause delirium, a low-level threat.
description.修格里城及其周边地区的帮派，喝哈——鼹鼠！: Gangs in Shoggolith City and the surrounding areas — Watch out, moles!
description.成群行动的深眠者团体，已经不再具有人类意识。: Deep Sleepers acting in groups no longer possess human consciousness.
description.掘金机器人的领袖，在场上有其他掘金机器人时无法被伤害。能够驱动所有掘金机器人一同: The leader of the Nugget Mechs, cannot be inflicted with DMG when other Nugget Mechs are on the field. It can drive all Nugget Mechs to release skills together.
description.随处可见的桦树生物集群，危险程度较低。: Chaos remains clusters that can be seen everywhere are a low-level threat.
description.深眠者与桦树生物的组合总是难以对付，好好考虑它们的弱点，分别击破吧。: Handling a mix of Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains is always tricky. Identify their vulnerabilities and take them down individually.
description.潜藏沙中的桦树生物，危险程度较低。: Chaos remains lurking in the sand are a low-level threat.
description.哨站的责任不仅是维护治安，其中也包括了为过路车辆发布合适的怪物预警的职责。我们现: Outposts are responsible not only for upholding law and order but also for issuing warnings about monsters to passing trains. We are currently broadcasting a Chaos Remain alert. Please eliminate the restless Chaos Remains.
description.为应对强敌，请提升队友【共振天赋】、强化武器和防具，并使用【自观测胶卷】为装备获: Please upgrade [RESO] and equipment, and use [Self-Observe Films] for better affixes.
description.信箱的后面是走廊，走廊的尽头是信箱。: Behind the mailbox is a corridor. At the end of the corridor is the mailbox.
description.被精心布置过的婚房，洋溢着幸福的气息。但新人在哪？: This meticulously decorated marital home brims with happiness, but where are the newlyweds?
description.过道的尽头，似乎有某种生物正在窥伺。: A mysterious creature appears to be peering in from the end of the aisle.
description.门窗上密密麻麻贴着“禁止外出”字样的封条。: All doors and windows are sealed with numerous "Stay Indoors" seals.
description.看上去普通的楼梯，但每迈一步都无比费力。还要继续前进吗？: While the staircase appears ordinary, each step is a challenge. Will you continue?
description.干净朴素的房间，只有地上散落着一些由公司配发的药片。: A tidy and simple room, with a few pills from a specific company scattered on the floor.
description.抵达尽头以后，能找到需要寻找的人吗？: Will you find the person you are seeking upon reaching the end?
description.无尽的数据空间，与“她”重逢之地。: A space of infinite data, the place where you reunite with "her."
description.忘记带钥匙的孩子们按响门铃，妈妈会来帮她们开门吗？: When the child who has forgotten their key rings the doorbell, will their mother come to let them in?
description.一对小象玩偶，代表着情侣的爱情、婚约，和永远陪伴彼此的誓言。: A pair of baby elephant dolls symbolizing love, marriage, and a commitment to be together forever.
description.上下楼梯注意事项：在感到寒冷时，不要往下看。: Note: Do NOT look down when you feel a chill ascending or descending stairs.
description.在过道中拖行的带血脚印朝向某个方向，却总会绕回原点。: Bloody footprints shuffling through the aisle lead in a particular direction but always circle back.
description.学如聚沙成塔，死如塔倾沙散。: Learning is constructing a tower from sand, dying is a push on the tower.
description.无论以什么方式挣扎，死亡终会到来。: Struggle as you may, death does not wait.
description.由数据流汇聚成的抽象空间。此即永恒。: An abstract space woven together by streams of data, the eternity.
description.那么我们走吧，向另一个世界；不要问“那是什么？”，让我们快点去作客。总有时间去证: Let's venture to another realm. Time will validate my words.\n<color=#D1BF53>The difficulty of this stage increases with each successful challenge.\nTap </color><color=#9726B6>Lock Difficulty</color><color=#D1BF53> above to fix this stage at the highest difficulty possible.</color>
description.一座颇有年代的公寓楼，似乎潜藏着许多不为人知的过去。: An aged apartment complex that appears to hold a hidden history.
description.在被恐怖分子们“回收”以后被改造成了高效且强力的兵器，原本用于清障的多功能前臂现: After being "retrieved" by terrorists, it was transformed into an efficient and powerful weapon. The multifunctional forearm originally used for obstacle clearing has now deviated from its original function, possessing greater lethality in combat.
description.荒原王汤姆的座驾。使用充能装甲枪械对目标进行射击并击晕，还能在造成我方角色破盾后: Tom the Wilderness King's vehicle. Uses the recharge armored firearms to shoot and stun the target, and after breaking your character's shield, uses a drill attack to inflict an injure effect.
description.莫名令人感到熟悉的深眠者。通过附加”心魔共鸣”并引爆的方式造成伤害，能制造幻影与: An inexplicably familiar Deep Sleeper. Deals DMG by inflicting "Devil Inside Consonance" and detonating it, and can create mirror images to act alongside her.
description.拥有改变周围气候，使环境变得寒冷的能力。并对敌人不断施加冰冻伤害和晕眩效果。随生: Has the ability to change the surrounding climate, making the environment cold. Continuously applies Frost DMG and a stun effect to enemies. Increases DEF as HP decreases.
description.繁衍和统领着毒爆虫们的女王，不仅破坏力和攻击范围远超一般个体，还能召唤大量子嗣进: The queen who breeds and commands the Blastbugs, not only has destructive power and an attack range far exceeding ordinary individuals, but can also summon a large number of offspring for self-destruct attacks.
description.常有拾荒者在整顿中心外游荡，试图回收一些没有被运走的废弃物资，但这种侵占行为是非: Marauders frequently wander around the Reforming Center, scavenging for discarded materials left behind. However, this is illegal. Please help drive them away.
description.为了防止拾荒者对废弃物资进行进一步侵占，请协助我们抓捕并调查拾荒者的头目。: In order to prevent Marauders from continuing to trespass on our discarded materials, we kindly request your help in capturing their leader.
description.鼹鼠帮的成员在监狱里挑起了帮派斗殴！请前去阻止他们！: The MoleGang members are causing a ruckus in the prison! Please stop them as soon as possible!
description.鼹鼠帮的成员在监狱里挑起了帮派斗殴，据报告已发展成了械斗……等等，大型机械互斗？: The MoleGang's prison conflict has escalated into an armed showdown... Wait, heavy war machinery included?!
description.帕拉笛小姐将她的实验性数据模型植入了缴获的军阀机械，现在机械体全部失控……请前去: Paladi imported her experimental data into the captured war robots and sent them haywire... Please subdue them as soon as possible!
description.沙盗团趁动物囚犯放风的时看守不备，将他们的鹅带走了！请把这只大鹅抓回来！: The P.U.S. members took their goose from the prisoners during their break! Please get the goose back!
description.据线人情报，黑月成员试图在云岫桥整顿中心内开展非法地下交易。请协助我们，阻止这种: Intelligence suggests that the Night Chains members are engaging in illicit transactions within the Reforming Center. We need your assistance in halting these activities.
description.整顿中心内部的地下交易似乎已发展至一些被拘留的黑月执行人身上……希望这次行动能调: Reports suggest illicit trading within the Reforming Center now involves detained Night Chains Executors... Let's get to the bottom of this issue.
description.名为夏尔的沙盗团成员，与外表完全不同，是一名十分难对付的升构者。身边形影不离的大: A member of the P.U.S. named Shire, who is completely different from her appearance, a very formidable Ascender. The big goose that never leaves her side is her good partner.
description.能释放庞大能量对敌人造成负能伤害，在沙尘中时能够与环境共振，免疫所有负面效果。: Can release immense energy to inflict reverengy DMG on enemies, and can resonate with the environment when in dust, immune to all negative effects.
description.似乎这些桦树生物的协作能力有所提高，但愿这只是我们的错觉。请继续消灭桦树生物。: Looks like these Chaos remains have improved their cooperation. Let's hope it's just our imagination. Continue eliminating the Chaos Remains.
description.为了测试战备工厂新型武器的普适度，阿妮塔安排了面向不同类型敌人的模拟战斗。我看看: To test the versatility of the new weapons, Anita Weapon Factory has set up simulation battles against a variety of foes. Whoa! The simulated enemies are based on combat data from many of our colleagues... possibly even me!
description.据我们公司的调查，不少乘员在战斗中受到深眠者影响时都会出现“做了个梦”的感觉……: Based on our findings, numerous crew members have described experiencing a sensation akin to dreaming during encounters with Deep Sleepers in battle... I've felt that too! But most of those were more like nightmares...
description.列车长，你吃过海豹奶茶店现在已经下架的那款绵绵冰吗？没错，这次的敌人就给人这种感: Have you ever tried that famous milkshake that's no longer available at Seal's Tea Shop, Conductor? Yeah, that's how the enemies in this quest feel! Pretty cool, right?
description.列车长，你吃过一款贡露城美食吗？一款用特制酱汁拌的沙拉，非常美味，而且不会长胖！: Have you ever tasted a salad made with a special Gronru sauce! Absolutely delicious and doesn't pack on the pounds! Super fun, isn't it?
description.为了测试战备工厂新型武器的普适度，阿妮塔安排了面向不同类型敌人的模拟战斗。我看看: To test the versatility of the new weapons, Anita Weapon Factory has set up simulation battles against a variety of foes. This time, it appears to be Night Chains fighters. Their fighting style is beyond my understanding.
To test the versatility of the new weapons, Anita Weapon Factory has set up simulation battles against a variety of foes. Whoa! It's two N.A. war machines!
description.哇……战备工厂附近居然会出现这种大体型的桦树生物组合，光是想想就很头疼……麻烦你: Geez... Can't believe such massive Chaos Remains are showing up in groups. That's going to be quite a challenge... But I'm confident you can handle them!
description.有一款很火的共斗游戏要推出新作了，你有没有兴趣玩一下？据说里面会添加许多高难度讨: Have you heard about that super popular co-op game? By the way, taking down the Chaos Ganoderma and Glacial Skeleton shouldn't be too different from soloing them, right, Conductor?
description.最近骨龙形态的桦树生物出现得非常频繁，严重影响了沿线行车安全，拜托你去消灭一两只: Lately, Bone Dragon Chaos Remains have been appearing with increased frequency, posing a significant threat to passing trains. Could you please take care of one or two of them?
description.有一群异常聚集的骨龙形态桦树生物出现在了战备工厂附近，想必这会是艰难的一战，请务: A pack of Bone Dragons has been spotted near the weapon factory! Be prepared for a fierce battle! Of course, I'll be cheering you on!
description.冷冽简洁的涂饰、破坏力极强的武装，以及极高的结构稳定性，这些特征揭示了眼前这辆战: The cold, austere markings, formidable armaments, and exceptional structural stability indicate that the armor before you must have served in the ranks of the N.A..
description.能够造成近程物理伤害与范围秘法伤害，并施加诅咒和破盾的效果。随生命值降低提升秘法: Capable of inflicting melee Physical DMG and area Arcane DMG, along with applying Curse and Break effects. Arcane DMG increases as its HP decreases.
description.武技精湛的黑月成员。攻击造成物理与火焰伤害，有独特的见切姿态，见切姿态结束后会对: A Night Chains member with exquisite martial skills. Attacks deal physical and Fire DMG, possessing a unique Migiri stance that, upon ending, delivers a powerful counterattack to enemies.
description.气氛严肃的战备工厂，各种规格的武器装备等待着被启用的时刻。: Within this war factory, a somber atmosphere pervades as weapons and equipment of various specifications await activation.
description.旧式作业用机械，会喷射寒气造成冰冻伤害，并造成冻结效果。防御会随时间逐步降低，但: Old-fashioned operational machinery that emits cold air to inflict Frost DMG and inflict [Chill] effect. DEF gradually decreases over time, but DMG increases.
description.这份战斗数据生成自一位行走地表的帝国剑士。直面她的剑刃，证明你的决心。: This battle data was extracted from a formidable Imperial Swordswoman. Confront her blade directly and demonstrate your resolve.
description.旧时代的军事用机械，仍然会被视为地区威胁。: Old military machines are still a regional threat.
description.驰骋于沙漠与“海”之间的神秘沙盗团。: Enigmatic P.U.S. roaming between deserts and seas.
description.荒原地区的桦树生物是非常理想的研究对象，请帮忙搜集一些不同种类的样本交给我。: Chaos remains in the Wilderness are ideal research subjects. Help me to gather samples of different types.
description.虽说费奇号的主要威胁已经被清除，但依然有不少深眠者在附近活动。请帮忙记录这些深眠: Though the main threat from the Phiggy has been cleared, many Deep Sleepers remain active nearby. Record their resonance data to optimize our research plans for the Phiggy.
description.我们观测到有一名非常强大的深眠者在近期变得活跃，请帮忙制止它靠近人类活动的区域，: We've observed a highly active powerful Deep Sleeper recently. Prevent it from approaching human activity areas and try to record valuable data.
description.桦树生物群中出现了部分实力较强的个体，务必在它们造成实质性危害之前解决它们。: Some strong Chaos Remains have appeared in the groups. Eliminate them before they cause substantial harm.
description.淘金机器人及其手下，及其手下的手下。: Nugget mechs and their underlings, and their underlings' underlings.
description.心怀不轨的人不少，不过像黑月成员那样可怕的还是很少见。希望你们驱赶附近游荡的黑月: There are many ill-intentioned people, but few as terrifying as Night Chains members. We hope you can drive away the Night Chains scouts lurking nearby.
description.有一只蝎型仿生机械被人投放到澄明数据中心附近，请将其打倒，排除这一威胁。: A scorpion-like android has been placed near the CDCA Bureau. Take it down to eliminate this threat.
description.有一群深眠者从附近的异构厄枝中出现，造成了附近地区形态场严重不稳。请消灭他们。: A group of Deep Sleepers emerged from the nearby Heteromorphy, causing severe morphic field instability. Eliminate them.
description.大群聚集、能放出雷电的爆虫类桦树生物，危险程度较低。: These Blastbugs operate in large groups and can discharge lightning. They pose a mild threat.
description.能形成引雷效应的桦树生物，危险程度较低。: These Chaos Remains can induce lightning. They pose a mild threat.
description.我们找到了黑月一名上级成员的藏身处。任务目标是将这些人一网打尽。: We've found a hideout of a high-ranking Night Chains member. Round them up.
description.会在大范围内形成雷暴效果的桦树生物，较为危险。: These Chaos Remains can summon intense thunderstorms over wide areas. They pose a moderate threat.
description.大群聚集、能放出雷电的爆虫类桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: These Blastbugs operate in large groups and can discharge lightning. While previously a mild threat, their danger has escalated due to pollution.
description.能形成引雷效应的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度提升。: These Chaos Remains can induce lightning. While previously a mild threat, their danger has escalated due to pollution.
description.会在大范围内形成雷暴效果的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度进一步提升。: These Chaos Remains can summon intense thunderstorms over wide areas. While previously a moderate threat, their danger has escalated due to pollution.
description.会影响周围地区天气的强大桦树生物，十分危险。: These potent Chaos Remains possess the power to alter the weather in their vicinity. They pose an extreme threat.
description.强大的远古深眠者，手持异常锋利的双刃。即使意志已经消逝，它的斗争仍未结束。: This formidable ancient Deep Sleeper wields twin blades of exceptional sharpness. Despite its loss of self-awareness, its combat prowess remains formidable.
description.我们认为黑月成员正在向他们的一处秘密据点集合，请妨碍他们的汇合进程。: We believe Night Chains members are gathering at a secret base. Disrupt their gathering.
description.这份战斗数据生成自阿妮塔能源研究所的一位重要人士。小心雷电！: This combat data was generated by a key figure at Anita Energy Institute. Beware of lightning!
description.似乎是装扮成正常的客人混进来的，他们想在这座岛上找到什么？: These intruders have disguised themselves as regular guests, seamlessly blending in... What could they be searching for on this island?
description.不知其身份的深眠者，可能会对客人造成威胁，小心应对。: These unidentified Deep Sleepers may pose a threat to tourists. Get rid of them with caution.
description.奇怪装扮的客人，这样的天气还戴着头套的毅力不容小觑，在他们闹事之前先解决吧。: These oddly dressed guests persist in wearing hoods despite the hot weather. While their resilience is commendable, address the situation before it escalates.
description.从未见过的桦树生物类型，散发着令人不安的气息，在大规模入侵之前处理掉吧。: These unidentified Chaos Remains exude an unsettling aura that spells trouble. Eliminate them before they launch a large-scale invasion.
description.哪怕失去知性，也未曾遗忘自己的使命，如果还想前进，就必须通过这位守护者的试炼。: This guardian remains steadfast in duty even after losing consciousness. To advance, we must overcome the guardian's trial.
description.在乌云与闪电中穿梭的暴君，直视着惊扰其沉眠的挑战者。: The tyrant, swathing through dark clouds and lightning, fixes its gaze upon the challenger who has disrupted its slumber.
description.审判者的余兴节目开始了。: The Executor's entertainment show has commenced.
description.不要问她为什么会在这里。“夏尔大人想去哪里去哪里~”: Don't even ask why she is here, for "The mighty Shire goes wherever she pleases!"
description.异想机关的机器人在工作时突然开始“互相打闹”，接着演变成了严重的机器人斗殴，现在: The robots of the Imaginary have initiated a "rough-and-tumble play" at work, which has quickly escalated into a serious situation. Currently, the robotic army is advancing toward a residential area in Cape City.
description.学会那位有名的战斗先导带领一群自愿跟随她行动的昴宿机器人前来，表示想要测试一下受: The renowned combat vanguard of the Citadel is leading a group of Tauri robots, expressing her desire to evaluate the combat skills of the trial subjects.
description.一位总被目击到睡倒在海角城街头的“天使”出现在了训练场地内，恰好被卷入了其他成员: An "Angel," often seen napping on the streets of Cape City, appears at the training site and gets caught in a simulated battle...
description.这个委托是由一名“希望孩子们睡得好的图书管理员”发来的，她希望我们能监测城市附近: This commission comes from "a librarian seeking peaceful nights for kids." She requires us to monitor Deep Sleepers around the city and promptly eliminate them.
description.尽管收到了一些类似“这位深眠者战斗的身姿太美了，已经成为了我们的文艺创作灵感，请: Even though we've been receiving letters like "That Deep Sleeper was so graceful. Please don't drive it away," we still have to deal with powerful Deep Sleepers like this one.
description.海角城附近的荒古桦树生物会随天气周期性活跃，请清剿其中的一部分。: The Primal CR near Cape City may exhibit periodic activity with the weather. Please eliminate some of them.
description.强大的桦树生物出现在海角城附近，为了保证沿线铁路运输的安全，请尽速前去击退！: Intimidating Chaos Remains have emerged near Cape City. Please eliminate them to safeguard the railroad!
description.进行强大冰属性攻击的海龙桦树生物。能造成冻结、枷锁和晕眩等多种负面效果，会不断释: This CR: Marine releases powerful frost attacks. It inflicts a variety of debuffs including Chill, Fetter, and Stun, and it releases "Dragon Might" that reduces DMG taken.
description.“狂飙焚尽”，鼹鼠帮的老大。通过投掷燃烧瓶进行攻击，会使唤喽啰摆放地雷路障，还能: The leader of the MoleGang, known as "Inferno Maelstrom." He attacks by throwing Molotov cocktails, and commands minions to set up landmine barricades. Capable of summoning a fleet of vehicles to cause disturbances.
description.这座海滨篝火城拥有与之相称的美丽街道，只可惜那些桦树生物与这些格格不入。: The bonfire city by the seaside boasts features lovely streets, which unfortunately are being marred by Chaos Remains.
description.步入非人阶段的深眠者。抛弃人类的武器，成为桦树之森的一部分。每一根枝条都是她的力: A Deep Sleeper who has forsaken humanity, abandoning human weapons to become one with the Chaos Forest. Every branch is a part of her strength.
description.劫掠者的头领，以多功能轮锯作为武器。能造成电磁和火焰伤害，伴有多种负面效果。战斗: The leader of the looters armed with a multi-purpose wheel saw. This enemy can deal Electro and Fire DMG, as well as inflict various negative effects. When taking lethal DMG, this unit triggers Eternal Spark.
description.不需要现实稳定装置也能让人安居乐业的奇迹之地，即使危难当头，大家也相信能平安度过: A miraculous haven where people thrive even without the Reality Stabilizer. Everyone is united in facing looming threats.
description.面对镜子，看到的是自己还是别人？你为何诞生，我为何重现？是你在哭，还是我在叹息？: Who do you see in the mirror? Why were you brought to this world, why was I brought back once more? Are those tears on your cheeks, or is it me letting out a sigh? Let's stick together, never to part.
description.被囚禁在自身幻觉中的深眠者，究竟谁能让他们看见现实？: Who will rouse the Deep Sleepers from their illusions and bring them back to reality?
description.通过和不同种类桦树生物的战斗，展现队伍的战术素养。: Show your team's prowess in battles against various species of Chaos Remains.
description.通过与强大的荒古桦树生物以及海龙桦树生物的战斗，证明队伍的战斗能力。: Show your team's prowess in battles against formidable Chaos Remains.
description.据说索思学会内部会不定期展开御敌枢纽成员之间的战斗训练。: Word has it that Source Citadel occasionally hosts combat training sessions among Destroyer members.
description.据说索思学会内部会不定期展开御敌枢纽成员之间的战斗训练……这个强度？开玩笑的吧？: Word has it that Source Citadel occasionally hosts combat training sessions among Destroyer members... Uh seriously? Aren't they really trying to kill each other?
description.面对咒魔剑姬与名誉先导的双层审判。小心重击！: Get ready for a dual trial from Jumakenki and Honorary Vanguard! Beware of smash attacks!
description.面对多名非常规成员的特别测验。当心背后、头顶、脚下，和视野之外。: Take part in a unique training session with unconventional foes. Watch your back, your head, your feet, and beyond your sight.
description.山野桦树生物中极度强大的个体，能够影响人类的精神，施加【灼心】【狂暴】等效果。其: A highly formidable individual among Wilds CR, capable of influencing human minds and inflicting effects such as [Scorch] and [Berserk]. Its armor provides defense and can rebound attacks. Extra caution is required when it enters a defensive stance.
description.唯有超越沉溺幻梦之人，方能通过审判者的试炼。: Only those who surpass the allure of illusory dreams can navigate the trials.
description.按照曼杜斯帝国传统，技艺高超、为维护帝国作出重要贡献者，能获得其专有的骑士封号。: In accordance with Mundus tradition, individuals who have demonstrated exceptional skills and made significant contributions to the Empire may attain knighthood.
description.天使计划的拥护者声称，该实验已经基本成熟的标志是有可称之为真正“天使”的实验体诞: Advocates of the Angel Project claim that the experiment has advanced to the maturity phase of creating a true "Angel."
description.在海角城最近流行的童话故事书里，有一个“黑色触手的怪物被两位红衣魔法师打倒了”的: A prevalent fairy tale in Cape City recounts the defeat of a black-tentacled monster by two red-clad wizards.
description.“如果所有童话故事的结局都是魔法师打倒了怪物、回到了安宁的生活之中，那该多么美好: "How wonderful it would be if all fairy tales end with the hero defeating the monster and everyone living happily ever after..."
description.跨越漫长岁月的回声，所求所愿，皆会实现。: All your desires shall be fulfilled within the resonance that echoes across time.
description.逆转天空之门，无法抵达的出口。: The doorway to sky, inverted and unreachable, an elusive exit.
description.门扉洞开的房间，世界于此颠倒。: A room where the world is reversed.
description.于黑暗中洞彻，前路仍有微光。: Despite the shadowy gloom, a faint light illuminates the path ahead.
description.无论天涯海角我都会寻你而去，直到你再次呼唤我的名字。: I will chase you to the world's edge, in the hope that you will speak my name once more.
description.精密的机械将冰冷的泥土抟塑成一个个小世界。: Precision machines sculpt cold clay, shaping countless miniature worlds.
description.装修精致的步道，通向深处的大厅。: An intricately adorned path leading to a hall of great depth.
description.通向乐园的大门，富丽堂皇。: An ornate door guiding the way to paradise.
description.光啊！光啊！光啊！我苦苦哀求……\\n<color=#6a1c16>深眠者·沉溺:
O, light! O, light! I implore you...
<color=#6a1c16>DS: Immersed is immune to all control effects when its level is above 100.
The difficulty of this stages increases after each successful challenge.
Tap </color><color=#9726B6>[Lock Difficulty]</color><color=#6a1c16> above to fix this stage at the difficulty of the last successful challenge.</color>
description.冷清的主题乐园，里面的装饰似乎下一秒就会活过来。: A desolate amusement park, its decorations seem as if ready to spring to life.
description.环环相扣的围墙将房间划分出无数前途未知的道路。: Interlocking walls divide the space into an intricate maze of pathways.
description.门扉紧闭的房间，曾有人在这里逝去。: A chamber with sealed doors, where lives have faded away.
description.生命凋零，一如花园枯萎的季节。: All life fades, as the season when gardens wither.
description.寄于黑暗，隐于光明，不可见之处，皆为庭院所在。: This hidden hall lies on the border between realms of light and shadow.
description.步入暗廊，万万不可回首而视。: Once you enter this aisle, do not look back.
description.进行强大冰属性攻击的海龙桦树生物，骨龙的亚种。能造成冻结、枷锁和晕眩等多种负面效: This CR: Marine, categorized as a variant of bone dragons, releases powerful ice attacks. It inflicts a variety of negative effects including Chill, Fetter, and Stun, and it releases Dragon Might that reduces incoming DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously. Its frequent and powerful attacks make it a formidable opponent.
description.栖羽站附近出现了一些外形与以往不同的深眠者，请前去解决它们。: Deep Sleepers with a different look have emerged near Sumihane Station. Time to head over and deal with them.
description.栖羽站附近出现了一些外形与以往不同的深眠者，并且实力似乎有所提升……请前去解决它: Deep Sleepers with a different appearance have appeared near Sumihane Station, and they appear to be more dangerous than before... Go over there and deal with them!
description.请协助解决山地区域发现的桦树生物和深眠者。: Please lend a hand in dealing with those Chaos Remains and Deep Sleepers causing trouble in the mountain area.
description.请协助解决山地区域发现的强大桦树生物和深眠者。出击时务必小心！: Please lend a hand in dealing with formidable Chaos Remains and Deep Sleepers causing trouble in the mountain area. Proceed with caution!
description.由于这些强大的敌人可能威胁到附近线路的行车安全，上级发布了立刻消灭它们的命令……: As these formidable creatures could endanger passing trains, the higher-ups have ordered their immediate elimination. Or, to put it in a more dashing way... "Become the Warrior of Rails!"
description.远远望去如同燃烧篝火的桦树生物，较为危险。: A Chaos Remain resembling blazing bonfires from a distance, poses a threat to the area.
description.远远望去如同鬼怪秉烛夜游的桦树生物，较为危险。: A Chaos Remain resembling eerie specters holding candles from a distance, poses a threat to the area.
description.远远望去如同燃烧篝火的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度进一步提升。: A Chaos Remain resembling blazing bonfires from a distance. While previously a moderate threat, its danger has escalated due to pollution.
description.永生者。对我方角色附加多种负面效果，能够以秘法飞弹发起攻击。【唯此永存】状态下，: The Immortal can inflict various debuffs on crew members and launch arcane missiles as attacks. While in the [Immortal Being] state, the Immortal takes less Final DMG. This state can be dispelled by inflicting crowd-control effects on her.
description.强大的深眠者，以锁链和重锤作为武器。会为我方附加标记，通过使用手牌方可解除。: A powerful Deep Sleeper armed with chains and hammers as weapons. This enemy can mark crew members. The mark can be removed by using cards.
description.秘密与情绪交织，在这惊涛骇浪的波澜里，您是否能够发现街道里的危机？: Secrets and emotions intertwine amid this raging turmoil. Can you perceive the peril lurking in the streets?
description.请前往周边地区执行“深眠者清理”分类任务。: Please head to the nearby area and complete the task.
description.为应对强敌，请强化武器和防具，并使用【自观测胶卷】为装备获取更好的词缀。: To defeat powerful enemies, please upgrade your equipment and obtain better affixes.
description.请前往周边地区与黑月执行人及其团伙进行交涉，必要时可使用武力阻止其暴行。: Please negotiate with the Night Chains executor and his minions. Violence is authorized if necessary to halt their offenses.
description.发现严重违反铁盟相关规定的行为。请前往周边地区与黑月执行人及其团伙进行交涉，必要: Severe violation of BCRL laws has been identified. Please negotiate with the Night Chains executor and his minions. Violence is authorized if necessary to halt their offenses.
description.请前往周边地区巡逻，驱逐靠近的劫掠者与屠戮者。: Please patrol the nearby areas and repel encroaching Looters and Slayers.
description.周边地区的劫掠者与屠戮者已经逐渐发展成了实力强盛的暴力团体，在应对时请万分小心。: Looters and Slayers in the vicinity have united into an aggressive gang. Exercise caution when dealing with them.
description.强大的深眠者，外形与帝国故事中一位剑士相似。会根据我方所有红卡与蓝卡的数量决定战: A formidable Deep Sleeper bearing a striking resemblance to a legendary swordsman from the Empire's lore. This entity formulates strategies based on the quantity of Red and Blue hand cards. Its sword waves can deal massive damage and inflict debuffs.
description.以特殊的手段复现了回忆中与聚合体核心的最终战斗。在这黑色的浪潮之中，拯救她。: The final battle with the fused entity in your memory, relived through special means. Rescue her amidst the black tide.
description.此为剿灭深眠卡巴内的系列任务。为了解除岚心城以及周边地区被围困的情况，铁安局需要: This is one of the quests to annihilate Kabanes. BCRL Agency requires reliable assistance from Conductor to lift the siege on Ranshin City and its vicinity.
description.繁华的街道上布满瓦砾，于此往来的繁华人群已无处可寻。唯一要做的事，是贯穿笼罩城市: The once bustling streets now lie in ruins, devoid of their usual crowds. The only option remaining is to navigate through the black smoke engulfing the city.
description.来到无垠号的“保镖小姐”似乎想趁着安全的时期测试一下乘组的战斗实力，以应对接下来: The "Lady Bodyguard" on the Eternal appears keen on testing the crew's combat skills to ensure they are well prepared for upcoming challenges.
description.为了彻底解决周边地区的卡巴内问题，打倒化为“鵺”之人！: To permanently resolve the Kabane issue in the area, defeat the individual who has transformed into Nue!
description.在深眠卡巴内的围困部分解除后，居然又在附近探测到了强大桦树生物的气息！: After partially lifting the siege of Deepsleep Kabane, we have detected powerful Chaos Remains nearby!
description.附近地区的桦树生物似乎受到深眠卡巴内的刺激，变得异常活跃……请协助清理袭来的强大: Chaos Remains in the vicinity seem to have been influenced by the presence of Deepsleep Kabanes, resulting in increased activity.... Please help in eliminating potent Chaos Remains.
description.附近地区的桦树生物似乎受到深眠卡巴内的刺激，变得异常活跃……请协助清理一部分桦树: Chaos Remains in the vicinity appear to have been stimulated by the presence of Deepsleep Kabanes, leading to increased activity... Please help in eliminating some of the Chaos Remains.
description.以特殊的手段复现了回忆中与聚合体的战斗。: The battle with the fused entity in your memory, relived through special means.
description.“就让你们见识一下……呃……咳，身为甲铁城的利刃和盾的力量！……这样可以了吗，无: "I'll demonstrate the might of... uh... the unfailing blade and shield of Koutetsujou!... Um, Mumei? How's it?"
description.远远望去如同鬼怪秉烛夜游的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度进一步提升。: A Chaos Remain resembling eerie specters holding candles from a distance. While previously a moderate threat, its danger has escalated due to pollution.
description.身躯出现钢铁状异化的深眠者，已经不再具有人类意识。: Those Deep Sleepers, characterized by their mutant, metallic bodies, no longer retain human consciousness.
description.身躯出现钢铁状异化的深眠者，在污染的影响下变得更加危险。: Those Deep Sleepers, characterized by their mutant, metallic bodies, have become even more hazardous under the influence of pollution.
description.索思学会的“天使”，优哉游哉地漂浮着……等等，祂身后出现的是什么啊？！: An "Angel" of Source Citadel, emanating grace in their ethereal movements... Wait, what's that stuff behind them?!
description.身处荒原地区广阔的沙漠之中。我们能找到祂吗？: Can we find them in the boundless sands?
description.身处哈依玛之骰的内部，踏足意识海与现实的分界。步步前行，一定能接近所求的答案。: Within Haima Zaria, at the boundary between Unbewusstes and reality. With each step forward, we will surely draw nearer to the answers we seek.
description.躯体外形彻底改变的深眠者。誓言不再重要，守护不再重要，“她”亦不再重要。: A Deep Sleeper whose physical form has been permanently distorted. Her oath no longer holds weight, her guardianship no longer matters, and "herself" is no longer important.
description.“化物”的一种，俗称泥嚎箱。没人知道这个名字是怎么流行起来的，可能是因为读起来很: A type of Metaplasia known as HelloBox. No one knows where this name came from. Maybe because it sounds funny?
description.“化物”的一种，俗称嚎虎箱。没人知道这个名字是怎么流行起来的，可能是因为读起来很: A type of Metaplasia known as HowlingBox. No one knows where this name came from. Maybe because it sounds funny?
description.劫掠者的头领，以多功能轮锯作为武器。能造成电磁和火焰伤害，伴有多种负面效果。: The leader of the Looters armed with a multi-purpose wheel saw. This enemy can deal Electro and Fire DMG as well as inflicting various negative effects.
description.“化物”的一种。会变出各种武器进行攻击，还会发出惊天动地的咆哮。打倒后可获丰富奖: A type of "Metaplasia." It can summon various weapons to attack and emits an earth-shattering roar. Defeating it grants abundant rewards.
description.任务分类-铁路沿线清理。执行目标-沙盗团体，人数若干，威胁等级较低。\\n<co: <color=#0469E3>Whenever you defeat 1 wave of enemies, allies deal 2% less DMG.</color>
description.任务分类-特殊目标抹消。执行目标-特定种类桦树生物，数量若干，威胁等级中等。\\: <color=#0469E3>Whenever you defeat 1 wave of enemies, allies deal 2% less DMG.</color>
description.任务分类-特殊目标抹消。执行目标-特定深眠者，数量若干，威胁等级中等。\\n<c: <color=#0469E3>Whenever you defeat 1 wave of enemies, allies deal 2% less DMG.</color>
description.任务分类-特殊目标抹消。执行目标-泥嚎箱，数量若干，威胁等级中等。注意回收掉落物: <color=#0469E3>Whenever you defeat 1 wave of enemies, allies deal 2% less DMG.</color>
description.任务分类-区域封锁解除。执行目标-嚎虎箱，威胁等级高。备注-化物出现原因不明。\: <color=#0469E3>Whenever you defeat 1 wave of enemies, allies deal 2% less DMG.</color>
description.御险枢纽提供了一种快速清理赛车场地残留物的方法。: The Destroyer provided a quick method for clearing debris.
description.比赛开展前一定时间，观众将被限制进入场地。请待在安全限制线以外。: Audience access will be restricted a certain time before the match begins.
description.为了保证赛事正常开展，举办方需要提前确认比赛当天的天气情况。: To ensure the event proceeds smoothly, the organizer shall confirm the weather conditions in advance.
description.为了保证赛事完满举行，举办方需要保证比赛当天的赛道安全，防止桦树生物闯入。: To ensure the event proceeds smoothly, the organizer shall prevent Chaos Remains from entering the track.
description.武技精湛的黑月成员。攻击造成的引雷效果能够有效地吸引敌方注意力。出色的防御力让他: A skilled member of the Night Chains, whose Electrify effects from his attacks can effectively draw enemy attention. His excellent defense makes him a formidable opponent.
description.索思学会提供了一些“紧急情况演练”机械，但我们可没想到是这个……光凭铁安局的人手: Source Citadel provided some "emergency drills" machinery, but we didn't expect this... BCRL Agency's manpower alone cannot handle it, please lend us a hand.
description.“战斗也是收集实验数据的重要手段。综上所述，戴上这些测量仪器吧。”: "Combat is also an important means of collecting experimental data. In summary, put on these measuring instruments."
description.“大家……总部又发来消息了……哈哈……请大家再坚持下，应、应该会有加班费的！”: "Guys... HQ has sent another message... haha... please hang in there a bit longer, th-there should be overtime pay!"
description.“列车长，欢迎回来。不过今天接到一桩特殊订单，所以麻烦你再出门一趟吧！”: Conductor, welcome back. However, we received a special order today, so could you please head out once more?
description.“……哈？我们黑月的人也要参加什么‘利刃围剿’行动？”: "...Huh? Our people from Night Chains also have to participate in the 'Operation Blade'?"
description.屠戮者的首领，体格巨大，具有升构能力。能造成物理伤害和范围混响伤害，会为我方牌库: Leader of Slayers possessing Ascension Abilities. He deals Physical DMG and area Reverb DMG. In addition, he inflicts [Crack] on your cards, causing the user to suffer damage. This effect can be nullified by using [Crack] cards.
description.饼干做的屋顶，糖果做的窗户，亮闪闪，香喷喷。: Cookie shingles and candy panes glisten softly, breathing a rich sweet aroma.
description.尽情玩闹，把所有的烦恼都丢开。: Laugh and frolic freely, leaving every trouble far behind.
description.甜美的笑容和这里最相配。: Nothing suits this land better than tender, joyful smiles.
description.优美的笛声，听到的人忍不住想跟着一起走。: A graceful flute melody drifts forth, luring all listeners to walk in its wake.
description.沿着这条路，一定能抵达想去的地方。: Stroll down this road, and your destined destination shall await.
description.手拉手，一起跳舞到天明。: Join hands and dance together till the first light of dawn.
description.有魔法的请柬，谁是被魔女招待的客人？: An invitation bearing magic. Who is the guest favored by the Witch?
description.她在绝望的尽头默默编织一场美梦，将自己的双手刺得鲜血淋漓。: On the edge of utter despair, she spins a gentle dream in silence, her hands torn and stained with blood.
description.缴获品被标记为“内详”，谁知道会从装备箱里抽到什么？: Confiscated items are marked as "details inside." Who knows what you might draw from the gear box?
description.只要魔女轻轻在山丘上招招手，就有无数小动物来和她作伴。: A soft wave from the witch upon the hill, and flocks of little beasts gather to stay by her side.
description.亲爱的列车长，我希望通过本次战斗来解析“情感”“回忆”这些抽象部分在战斗中起到的: Dear Conductor, I hope to analyze the role of abstract parts such as "emotions" and "memories" in battle through this fight. Regardless of what you think, I look forward to your response.
description.她们的梦里、魔女的梦里，都有些什么？是美梦吗？还是浸满泪水的梦？: What dwells within their slumbers, and the witch's own? Pure bliss, or visions soaked with tears?
description.毫无疑问是恪尽职守的黑月工作人员们。可能是魔女的同事……就当是这样吧。: They are undoubtedly the dedicated staff of Night Chains. Perhaps they are the witch's colleagues... Let's just think of it that way.
description.为了保持魔女世界的世界观，请称它们为“使魔”。: To uphold the lore of the witch's realm, please refer to them as "familiars."
description.之前出现的变异深眠者问题还没完全解决，拜托你去城外看看。: The previously emerging issue with the mutated Deep Sleepers hasn't been fully resolved. Please go outside the city and take a look.
description.变异深眠者中的强大个体又出现了……不解决的话会造成很大安全隐患。: Powerful individuals among the mutated Deep Sleepers have appeared again... If not resolved, they will pose a significant safety hazard.
description.代号“熄灯行动”——其实就是出去打点桦树生物，要试试吗？: Code name "Operation Lightout" - it's actually about going out to fight some CR, want to give it a try?
description.代号“折剑行动”。这次要对付一只挺强大的桦树生物，你们一定小心。: Code name "Operation Dagger." This time you're dealing with a rather powerful CR, so be careful.
description.黑月的安保部门和我们铁安局组织了一次联合演习。: The security department of Night Chains and BCRL Agency organized a joint exercise.
description.和黑月安保部门组织的联合演习将近尾声，击败敌方武装头目的重任就交给你们啦。: The joint exercise organized with the Night Chains security department is nearing its end. The crucial task of defeating the enemy's armed leader is entrusted to you.
description.又是变异深眠者……看来发生过的事没那么快结束啊。: Mutated Deep Sleepers again... It seems that what happened isn't ending anytime soon.
description.你们对付变异深眠者已经很有经验了吧？那交给你了。: You have a lot of experience dealing with mutant Deep Sleepers, right? I'll leave it to you.
description.接到了一份附近的山怪桦树生物大量增殖的报告。: We've received a report of a massive proliferation of nearby Wild CR.
description.接到了一份附近的山怪桦树生物实力激增的报告。……难道是季节问题？: Received a report of a nearby Wild CR experiencing a surge in strength. ...Could it be a seasonal issue?
description.岚心城民间有个“送行灯”的概念，你说是不是就从这群桦树生物身上来的灵感？: There is a concept of "farewell lantern" among the folks of Ranshin City. Would you say that the inspiration came from these CRs?
description.据说目标桦树生物有能改变天气、遮蔽太阳的力量，真吓人。: It is said that the target CR has the power to change the weather and block out the sun, which is truly frightening.
description.城内自由行动的黑月势力最近有些影响治安了，麻烦你去和他们“交涉”一下？: The wandering Night Chains members in the city have recently started to affect public security. Could you go and "negotiate" with them?
description.铁安局已经找到了那伙黑月执行人的头目，打算展开抓捕行动，希望无垠号乘组也能参与。: BCRL Agency has found the leader of the Night Chains operatives and plans to launch an arrest operation, hoping that the crew of the Eternal will also participate.
description.这份战斗数据生成自索思学会■■收容对象SC-002。你看见了什么？: This battle data was generated from the Source Citadel ■■ containment object SC-002. What do you see?
description.“战斗即为真正的骑士之责！啊、战斗后获得的材料也要带回来……？我明白了。”: "Battle is the true duty of a knight! Ah, do I need to bring back the materials I gained...? I understand."
description.“本次利刃围剿的主要发起方也包括了我们铁盟，请大家务必认真对待。”: "We BCRL is also one of the initiators of this Operation Blade. Please take it seriously."
description.“夏尔！！和朱迪把那门大炮架好了！！！”: "Shire!! Get that cannon set up with Jude!!!"
description.“总而言之，这次利刃围剿行动，没什么不清楚的地方了吧？”: "All in all, there's nothing unclear about this Operation Blade, right?"
description.黑月的装备倾向于在实用之外兼顾美观大气，当然还有一些特殊的强力功能。: Night Chains' gear tends to combine practicality with a stylish and grand appearance, and of course, some special powerful features.
description.铁盟士兵使用的装备以简单、可靠、耐用为主要特征。: The gear used by BCRL soldiers is characterized by simplicity, reliability, and durability.
description.完全无法理解混沌海中的人们出于何种理由制作了许多这样的装备。: I can't understand for what reason people in the Turbulent Sea made such gear.
description.阿妮塔的装备设计风格很有辨识度，同时也具有科技之美。: Anita's gear design style is very distinctive, and it also possesses the beauty of technology.
description.索思学会的装备制造技术曾被评价为“远超现实世界的科技水平”。: The gear manufacturing tech of Source Citadel was once described as "far surpassing the level of the real world."
description.曼杜斯帝国流传而来的珍惜魔法装备，无需多言。: The precious magical gear passed down from Mundus Empire needs no further explanation.
description.雨水送给人们甜蜜的梦境以及酣美的睡眠。: Drizzle brings people sweet dreams and sound sleep.
description.随后，风儿为大地披上青绿的头纱——: Then, the wind drapes a green veil over the earth—
description.咦？曼杜斯也有大鹅？: Huh? Does Mundus also have a big goose?
description.万物复苏，就连昆虫和最为微小的生物也重新出现在风中。: Everything is reviving, and even insects and the tiniest creatures reappear in the wind.
description.春天的梦从第一只土拨鼠露出脑袋开始。: The dream of spring begins when the first groundhog shows its head.
description.在她的奇境中，不再有风沙弥漫、不再有迷途的孩子……: In her wonderland, there is no longer swirling sandstorms, no more lost children...
description.“欸、金子小姐？！难道我刚刚值班时睡着了吗？抱歉，可是我做了一个美梦……”: Ah, Miss Gold?! Did I fall asleep while on duty just now? Sorry, but I had a wonderful dream...
description.“梦里好像回忆起了过去的事情呢。请别担心，是关于家乡的美梦。”: It seems like I recalled past events in my dream. Don't worry, it was a sweet dream about my hometown.
description.为了保持魔女世界的世界观……一般来说魔女不会制造这种充满科技感的造物的吧？！: To uphold the lore of the witch's realm... uh, witches shouldn't be creating this type of high-tech creations, right?!
description.戳！涨价！跌价百分之百！: Poke! Price increased! Price dropped by 100%!
description.现在为您播放“酣战娃娃机 7DAYS”的游玩注意事项！: Now playing the gameplay instructions for "7DAYS VS DOLL MACHINE"!
description.由&*！设计的最新抓娃娃机系统“酣战娃娃机 7DAYS”是一款款款款@！#%！…: The latest claw machine system "7DAYS VS DOLL MACHINE" designed by &*! is a model model model @!#%!... System rebooting, please wait.
description.第三条，请注意，不能在任何条件下摇晃、敲打、破坏娃娃机外壳。: Article 3, please note that under no circumstances should you shake, hit, or damage the shell of the claw machine.
description.第四条，请注意，在对抓娃娃机过程进行拍摄和直播时，不不不不不要拍拍拍拍摄玩偶面面: Article 4, please note that when filming the claw machine, do NOT NOT NOT film the dolls' faces faces faces and eyeballs.
description.第五条已缺失。抓不到怎么办？抓不到怎么办？抓不到怎么办？: Article 5 is missing. What if we can't catch it? What if we can't catch it? What if we can't catch it?
description.第六条以及其后部分已缺失。请尽情游玩“酣战娃娃机 7DAYS”，祝您玩得愉快！: Article 6 and subsequent sections are missing. Please enjoy playing "7DAYS VS DOLL MACHINE"!
description.“……之前听说了这台娃娃机会发出诡异声响的报告，但现在看来其实没问题啊？那么结束: "...I heard this claw machine makes strange noises, but it actually seems fine. Anything wrong? Let's wrap up the work then."
description.骑扫帚也需要训练吗？在这位老师跟前，答案显而易见。: Is training needed for broom riding? The answer is obvious when you stand in front of this teacher.
description.旋转的彩灯和罗盘，旋转的梦……旋转的毛绒会成员……第一圈……: The rotating lights and compass, the rotating dreams... the rotating Fluffy Union member... the first circle...
description.旋转的彩灯和罗盘，旋转的梦……旋转的毛绒会成员……第二圈……: The rotating lights and compass, the rotating dreams... the rotating Fluffy Union member... the second circle...
description.旋转的彩灯和罗盘，旋转的梦……旋转的毛绒会成员……第三圈……: The rotating lights and compass, the rotating dreams... the rotating Fluffy Union member... the third circle...
description.旋转的彩灯和罗盘，旋转的梦……旋转的毛绒会成员……第四圈……: The rotating lights and compass, the rotating dreams... the rotating Fluffy Union member... the fourth circle...
description.旋转的彩灯和罗盘，旋转的梦……旋转的毛绒会成员……还没转完吗？: The rotating lights and compass, the rotating dreams... the rotating Fluffy Union member... Are we not done yet?
description.寂静神秘的房屋，偶尔能听到零落的笑语声，似乎只是过去的回响。她等待着那个人的归来: A silent, mysterious dwelling. Now and then, scattered laughter drifts forth, as if merely echoes of days gone by. She waits for that person's return, even though she has forgotten everything.
description.魔女独自在此编织永恒的黑夜，无人的住所不能被称之为家，只是守住幻梦的最后堡垒。: The witch dwells here alone, spinning an endless night. A vacant place is no true home, only the final stronghold that shelters dreams of phantasm.
description.力量强大的剑形态桦树生物，具有控制火焰和雷电的力量。: A powerful sword-form Chaos Remain, possessing the power to control fire and lightning.
description.拦在轨道上试图进行“毛绒之爱”宣传的毛绒会成员。: Fluffy Union members standing on the track attempting to promote the "fluffy love."
description.波动！停市！沙金价格飙升！: Fluctuation! Market halt! Gold Sand prices soar!
description.“听说要举办新的车赛了，不过是在荒郊野外……”: "I heard there'll be a car race, but out in the wilderness..."
description.来自淘金乐园的神秘投资商亲临比赛现场。: The mysterious patron from ONEderland appears on site.
description.鹅是赛车吗？鹅不是赛车吗？: Whether a goose is a race car is a philosophical question.
description.建设完成后要清理工地！: Remember to clean up the site after construction!
description.赛车比赛原来要从建造赛道这一步开始吗？: Wait, should a car race start with building the track?
description.比赛之间的场地清扫决定了下场比赛的质量！: The cleaniness of the track determines the quality of the next match!
description.能够发动全体攻击的骨龙亚种，极度危险。能够对我方施加多种负面效果，此外，还能丢弃: A variety of Bone Dragon, capable of attacking all crew members, posing a significant threat. In addition, it can inflict various debuffs that discard your cards or modify your Cost.
description.在这个最接近现实与意识海界限的地方，出现一些和人类相似又不同的“同类”也不足为奇: It is only natural that beings both similar to and different from humanity emerge here, at the very threshold between reality and Unbewusstes.
description.在陌生设施内部看见不熟悉的灯光时，千万要与对方对个信号，因为桦树生物可不会和你打: When you see unfamiliar lights inside a strange facility, be sure to exchange signals with whoever is there, for Chaos Remains will never greet you.
description.据说有些桦树生物会互相呼唤……它们使用的声音无法被人类解析，互相交流的方式至今仍: It is said that some Chaos Remains call to each other... The sounds they use cannot be deciphered by humans, and their way of communicating remains a mystery to this day.
description.这里怎么会有沙尘暴？！: How can there be a sandstorm here?!
description.你误以为道路上出现了一片树林，走近后才发现，那是桦树生物的躯体在周围投下的影子。: You think there's a forest ahead. Only when you draw closer do you realize they are shadows cast by the bodies of Chaos Remains all around.
description.哈依玛之骰内部的修复工作大部分由机器人完成，它们有时也会互相检修。这些机器人一发: Most of the repair work inside Haima Zaria is carried out by robots, which sometimes perform maintenance on one another. As soon as these robots detect your approach, they all surround you.
description.探索时视野不清可是冒险的大忌！: Poor visibility during exploration is a fatal mistake in adventures!
description.还未接近不远处的骨龙，你便闻到了随空气逸散的血腥味。: Before you even approach the nearby Bone Dragon, you smell the blood scent drifting through the air.
description.攀登真理天梯之人。如今她已然坠落，向识海的深处……: She who climbs the ladder of truth. Now she falls deep into Unbewusstes...
description.有效的承重计算能保持建筑物的稳定性，但这只昏恶巨象显然来错了地方。: Effective load-bearing calculations maintain structural stability, but this Chaos Behemoth has clearly come to the wrong place.
description.拦在你面前的不是一块石头，而是一只张牙舞爪的混厄石芝……: What blocks your path is not a stone, but a ferocious Chaos Ganoderma...
description.你无论如何也不可能将它叫醒了。那么，要怎么办？: You can never wake it up no matter what. So what will you do?
description.假如存在这么一台超强的防卫机械，那么它当然会被放在最适合发挥作用的地方。: If such a powerful defensive machine exists, it is naturally placed where it can function best.
