description.“哎呀那就是老夫说的一串火花带闪电的东西，哎对对，你看见没？”: "Yeah, that's the thing I was talking about — all sparks and lightning! Yep, right there, you see it?"
description.剑刃依然锋利，持剑的双手仍然坚定；只是被放逐者再也回不到出发之地，再也望不见故乡: The blade remains sharp, and the hands that wield it remain steady. Yet the exiled can never return to where they began, never again glimpse their homeland...
description.是哪个研究者之前说桦树生物无法影响室内天气的？！: Who the hell said Chaos Remains couldn't influence indoor weather?!
description.她的决心已然碎裂，无法捍卫任何事物。没有人能够责备她，但她是否仍然煎熬着自己的心: Her resolve has shattered; she can defend nothing. No one can blame her, yet does she still torment her own soul?
description.以救赎为目的被制作之物。如今它已然失去施行救赎的资格与可能。: Created for the purpose of redemption. Now it has lost both the right and the chance to redeem.
description.索思学会御险枢纽研发的大型对策机械，代号“艾尼”。: A large-sized countermeasure machine devised by the Destroyer of Citadel, codename "Enni."
description.莫名吸引目光的黑月成员。交手时务必小心她的剑法，以防不慎魂飞魄散。: A Night Chains member who attracts attention for unknown reasons. Be careful of her swordsmanship during combat to avoid a fatal blow.
description.形似海螺的沼泞桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度进一步提升。: The Venom CR, which resembles a conch, has become even more dangerous under the influence of pollution.
description.荒古桦树生物中极为强大的个体，能够改变战场环境。在特定条件下，它将不再切换状态、: An extremely powerful entity among Primal CRs, capable of altering the battlefield environment. Under certain conditions, it will no longer switch status and instead accumulate energy during battle, maintaining the [Radiance Ritual] environment almost permanently. This simulation will recreate a battle under such conditions with the Nether Envoy.
description.会发出诡异叫声的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度进一步提升。: The CR, which emits eerie cries, has become even more dangerous under the influence of pollution.
description.“欸？把我的战斗数据录入模拟数据库里吗……可以是可以，但应该只会用来和你的队伍进: "Eh? Uploading my combat data into the simulation database... It's fine, but it should only be used for training with your team, right? Just to let you know, I'm not an easy opponent to deal with!"
description.这场战斗，或者说“捕捉行动”，对困于过去和寻找未来之人来说，都同样是迈向明日的一: This battle, or rather the "capture operation," is equally a step toward tomorrow for those trapped in the past and those seeking the future.
description.“我又不是那种会怕黑、躲起来哭的小孩子，这点儿算什么？”: "I ain't some kid who's scared of the dark an' hides away cryin', what's the big deal 'bout this?"
description.“你考不考虑把这玩意喷的冰块拿回去用？”: "Ya wanna make use of those ice cubes it spits?"
description.“这个的科学原理嘛，我就不解释了。喏，《电磁学理论》，拿去！”: "Ain't gonna explain the science behind it. Here, Theory of Electromagnetism, read it!"
description.“我有点儿困了，能不能速战速决放我回去睡觉啊——”: "I'm kinda sleepy, can we just wrap this up already—"
description.“这么点儿距离，我肯定跑得比无垠号快，你还要启动加速呢。”: "I'll beat your train there for sure. That thing takes forever to get movin'."
description.始终诡异地涌动、翻滚着的桦树生物，在污染的影响下危险程度进一步提升。: The ever-seething, surging CR, under the influence of pollution, has further increased in danger level.
description.“试炼？我？呵呵呵，你就坐那儿好好看着吧！”: "Trial? Me? Heh, just sit back an' watch."
description.“区区战斗力测试……不过你应该也不想输吧？”: "Just a lil' combat test... but ya don't wanna lose either, right?"
description.这里有一则针对屠戮者的调查委托，麻烦你去查看一下~: There's an investigation request here regarding the Slayers—mind taking a look for me?
description.这里又有一则针对屠戮者的委托，只不过这次好像需要拜托你彻底解决他们！: There's another request here about the Slayers—only this time, it looks like they need you to take care of them for good!
description.希望你能帮忙消灭一些最近过度增殖的沼泞桦树生物~: Hoping you could help clear out some of the Venom CRs that have been multiplying like crazy lately~
description.沼泞桦树生物中出现了一个超强的个体，有时间的话去打倒它吧！: There's an exceptionally strong Venom CR that's shown up—got a minute to go take it down?
description.希望有人能帮忙调查贡露城附近出现的旧型北阵机械！: Hoping someone can help investigate those old N.A. machines that showed up near Gronru City!
description.希望有人能帮忙调查贡露城附近出现的旧型北阵战车，但是要注意安全哦~: Hoping someone can help investigate that old N.A. tank that showed up near Gronru City—but do be careful out there~
description.希望有人能帮忙调查贡露城附近出现的旧型北阵机械，能帮忙打倒一些的话就再好不过啦！: Hoping someone can help investigate the old N.A. machines that showed up near Gronru City and take a few of them down.
description.希望有人能帮忙调查贡露城附近出现的旧型北阵战车——看在我们交情的份上，拜托你啦！: Hoping someone can help investigate that old N.A. tank near Gronru City—for old times' sake, I'm counting on you!
description.篝火城里常见的机器人宣传方阵——不是炼金人偶。: Common promotional robots in Bonfire Cities— machines, not alchemy golems.
description.洒水车内部没有源源不断产生水的魔法装置，水罐也只是水罐而已。: There's no magical device inside a water truck endlessly conjuring water; the tank is simply a tank.
description.我很喜欢……和那个人一起度过的时光。: I am... rather fond of the time I spend with that person.
description.人群在街道上活动的声音太过模糊，以至于听起来和“家乡”一模一样。: The murmur of the crowd on the streets is so indistinct that it sounds just like "home."
description.城市里会下雪，只不过是人类促生的雪。: Snow falls upon cities too, though it is snow of humanity's own making.
description.能够污染周围环境的桦树生物，: CR capable of polluting the surrounding environment,
description.地表人会在庆典时放飞气球以示庆贺。: Surface-dwellers release balloons into the sky in celebration of their festivals.
description.在路面上轰隆隆驶过的搬家卡车，看起来和帝国的魔法马车有些相似。: The moving trucks rumble by like the Empire's enchanted carriages.
description.“我不太喜欢吃绿色蔬菜，你帮我吃点吧？”: "I don't really like eating green vegetables, could you help me eat some?"
description.“似乎是老板看在你的面子上送给你的，你先吃第一口吧，喏，张嘴。”: "It seems the owner sent this over out of regard for you. You take the first bite— here, open your mouth."
description.“现在我作好准备了。见识一下我能做到什么程度吧。”: "I'm ready now. See for yourself how far I can go."
description.“……这是什么？地上人选择的肉类还真奇怪。”: "...What is this? The meat surface-dwellers choose really is strange."
description.“这种饮料……冰冰凉凉的，好好喝……”: "This drink... it's so cold and so good..."
description.“服务生的热情是很有用，但她好像太关心我们两个的关系了吧，前辈？”: "A server's enthusiasm has its uses, but she seemed a little too interested in what the two of us are to each other, don't you think, senior?"
description.“我才没有失态呢，只是这里的餐点的确品味不错。”: "I was not being unseemly. The food here simply happens to have good taste behind it."
description.强大深眠生物所创造的幻境，为突破幻境，请提升队友【共振天赋】、强化武器和防具，并: Please upgrade [RESO] and equipment, and use [Self-Observe Films] for better affixes.
description.“正在调取特殊深眠者个体相关数据。战斗中遇见危险分子的时候，一定要小心应对。”: "Accessing data on special DS. Exercise extreme caution when encountering hostile individuals."
description.“这部分内容并没有储存在我的模拟数据内。我想，或许战斗结束后，你们可以去向丽桑德: "This information is not stored in my simulation data. I believe you may consult Lissandra after the battle."
description.“天气预测数据显示，风暴就要来了。虽然这样就一时无法看见海角城……但是，那些温暖: "Weather prediction indicates a storm is approaching. Cape City will be out of sight for a while... but its warm lights will still remain."
description.铁盟哨站近期展开了针对各类深眠者的专项剿灭行动，希望你能助我们一臂之力。: BCRL Outpost launched operations against various Deep Sleepers recently, please help us with it.
description.为了维护铁路环线的正常运行，铁盟巡逻部队需要对特定种类的桦树生物进行清理。此次行: To safeguard the railway loop, BCRL troops need to eliminate certain Chaos Remains. Hope you can join us.
description.在维蒂林场的“归雾节”结束后，铁路环线上出现了更多的沼泞桦树生物，不知是否与事件: After the festival in Viti Plantation, there have been more Venom CRs near the tracks. Please help us investigate.
description.曾经仅在海角城附近有目击报告的冥霆仪者出现在了其他地区，这可能是某种不祥的征兆…: The Nether Envoy sighted around Cape City now appears elsewhere. This is ominous... Defeat it anyway.
description.完美运转，甜蜜微笑，齿轮润滑，最高优先。: Perfect operation, sweet smile, gear lubrication, top priority.
description.过去亦是现在，战斗的终局，你将入身其中，直面强敌。: The past is also the present. At the final stage of battle, you'll step directly into it, facing the strongest of foes head-on.
description.潜藏在海沙里的危机，正窥伺着你。: Dangers lurking in the sea await you.
description.*一段来自海伦娜的录音，主要是低声的轻语。*难道她对波克士也会叫“乖乖”？: *A recording from Helena, mostly whispers.* Could it be that she also calls Box "good boy"?
description.以冰冻类型攻击为主的始源桦树生物，可以生成屏蔽冰冻伤害的护盾，形态场与一般的桦树: Origin CRs that primarily use Frost Type attacks can generate a shield that blocks Frost DMG. Their Morphic Field differs from that of regular CRs.
description.以火焰类型攻击为主的始源桦树生物，能力强大，形态场与一般的桦树生物有所区别。: The Origin CR, which primarily attacks using flame type abilities, is powerful and its Morphic Field differs from that of typical CRs.
description.以电磁类型攻击为主的始源桦树生物，能以多种方式触发电磁伤害，还会生成反伤护盾。形: The Origin CR, which primarily uses the electromagnetic type of attack, can trigger Electro DMG in various ways and also generates a counter-shield. The Morphic Field is different from that of regular CRs.
description.始源桦树生物中极其强大的个体，能造成多种负面效果，另外，还能造成独有的【元素侵蚀: Extremely powerful individuals among the Origin CR can cause various negative effects and additionally inflict a unique "Elemental Erosion" status. The Morphic Field is different from that of regular CR.
description.“正在调取强力破坏型敌人的相关数据。‘弄坏了东西要向人道歉，能修好的要尽量修好’: "Accessing data on high-destruction enemies. If you break something, apologize and repair it if you can. Understood?"
description.“正在调取具有多种负面状态减益敌人的相关数据。接触了危险物品以后要洗手哦。”: "Accessing data on enemies with multiple negative effects. Do wash your hands after handling dangerous materials."
description.“七号自由港的气候相比我的家乡要宜人得多，二十年前，这儿的晴天也要更多些。”: "The climate of Freeport VII is far more congenial than my homeland's. Twenty years ago, there were more clear days here as well."
description.“他在大叫‘别倒！’的时候，大概是想到那种溶液倒进去就会产生爆炸……哈哈。”: "When he shouted 'Don't pour it in!' he must have been thinking of how that solution explodes the moment it goes in... Haha."
description.“就连从前烂熟于心的机械结构，在有人一同研究讨论时，也会变得非常有趣。”: "Even mechanical structures I knew by heart became fascinating once I had someone to study and talk them over with."
description.“虽然从前也不是没离开过家乡，但以研究者的身份参加游学，那还是第一次。”: "I'd been away from home before, of course, but going on field study as a researcher— that was a first."
description.一本涂满了字迹、涂鸦和随想的旧笔记。它的其中一位拥有者不再需要它了。: An old notebook, covered over with handwriting, doodles, and stray thoughts. One of its owners no longer has need of it.
description.一本尚未写下任何内容但按照某人的记忆和要求复原的新笔记。假如将页面倒翻，是否就能: A new notebook with nothing written in it yet, remade from someone's memory and by their request. If the pages were turned backward, would time flow backward as well?
description.“我在芬利城长大。那是一座没有夏天的城市。”: "I grew up in Frostville City. A city with no summer."
description.“结果我们乘坐的列车在途径无人地带时被桦树生物追着跑。”: "As it turned out, the train we rode was chased by Chaos Remains as we crossed the no man's land."
description.「只要打倒这个，无垠号的列车长就会请我们吃世界上最美味的超级大奶酪！」\\n<c: "As long as we defeat this, the Conductor of The Eternal will treat us to the most delicious super cheese in the world!"\n<color=#99130d>After successfully completing this level, the difficulty will increase\nClick on</color><color=#ff0000>【Lock Difficulty】</color><color=#99130d>above, and the level difficulty will be locked to the last successful challenge's difficulty</color>
description.「有时候路上会突然开始下雪，雪里有很漂亮的霓虹灯……」: Sometimes it suddenly starts snowing on the road, and there are very beautiful neon lights in the snow...
description.“这个倒是还挺顺眼的，不过总觉得有些不必要的土豪气……喂，为什么她在放电啊？”: This one is quite pleasing to the eye, but it always feels unnecessarily flashy... Hey, why is she flirting?
description.“终于出现了值得赞赏之物！这美丽的设计、奇妙的结构与熟悉的感觉，值得一战！”: Finally, something worthy of admiration has appeared! This beautiful design, marvelous structure, and familiar feeling are worth a battle!
description.“对已有设计的扭曲。虽然有一定的秩序，不过完全没有体现出机械的魅力。”: Distortion of the existing design. Although there is a certain order, it does not at all reflect the charm of machinery.
description.窟灵族的聚落——黮窨村，在这昏暗的、散发着怪异气味的地下空间里，有什么等待着我们: The settlement of the Kulings, Dark Yin Village, in this dim, oddly scented underground space, what awaits us?
description.「铁安局的人类说，害怕的话，可以先把敌人看作会动的爆米花……什么是爆米花？」: The humans from the BCRL Agency say that if you're scared, you can think of the enemy as moving popcorn... What is popcorn?
description.“……算了。对你们这个世界的品味已经绝望了。不是说要看鹦鹉吗，怎么又是不堪入眼的: ......Forget it. I've already lost hope in the taste of your world. Didn't you say you wanted to see parrots? Why is it another unsightly fellow?
description.“所谓的仿生机械？唔，还不错的构想——但是制造得太过僵硬了……”: The so-called bionic machine? Hmm, it's a pretty good idea—but it's made too rigidly...
description.“波克士啊……这是我在无垠号上比较喜欢的东西呢。假如要回去，我想带上它。”: Box... this is one of the things I quite like on The Eternal. If I were to go back, I'd like to take it with me.
description.“那种拙劣的载具改造方案就不必在我面前丢人现眼了，快点拿走。”: No need to embarrass yourself with such poor vehicle modification plans in front of me, just take them away quickly.
description.「地上的人，都是，这么可怕的吗？」: Are people on the ground all this scary?
description.「还有好多和我们一样大的虫子追着我们跑！」: There are still many bugs as big as us chasing after us!
description.“不过现在，你先在旁边等一下。我要让这家伙见识到，我作为教皇的实力！”: However, for now, wait on the side. I want to show this guy the power I have as the Pope!
description.「守护者不是应该保护我们吗？！为什么他要打我们啊啊啊啊——」: Isn't the Guardian supposed to protect us?! Why is he attacking us ahhhhh——
description.「先、先来到地上的伙伴们说了，一定要做好防虫措施！」: First, the companions who arrived on the ground said to make sure insect prevention measures are in place!
description.「人类居然经常要和这样的生物战斗！好厉害！」: Humans often have to fight against such creatures! Amazing!
description.“本部又接到了关于这台娃娃机的异常投诉，现在看来是化物作乱。尽快解决吧，就当这是: "HQ has received more complaints about this claw machine malfunctioning. It seems it was the Metaplasia's doing. Think of it as a game, and get it over with."
description.大天帝时代的“剑圣机”，只有当代剑圣才可以驾驭它。该机搭载超热离子引擎，可以轻易: The "Sword Saint Machine" from the Great Heavenly Emperor Era can only be piloted by the contemporary Sword Saint. This machine is equipped with a super hot ion engine, allowing it to easily perform various fantastic sword techniques.
description.全称“英明神武毛绒会终极机甲七号机”的钢铁机甲，火力强劲。会在一定时间后陷入无法: Full name: "Herald and Mighty Fluffy Union Ultimate Mecha Unit Mark VII,"  a steel mecha with powerful firepower. It will enter an immobile status after a certain period of time.
description.“索思学会倒是一直来信请我协助他们，不过我对这种大组织实在没什么兴趣……”: Source Citadel has been writing to me for assistance, but I'm really not interested in such large organizations...
description.“装束和剑技……让我想起了一些历史故事。”: The attire and swordsmanship... remind me of certain historical stories.
description.“要是让它乱跑引起了震动可不好，毕竟车辆运行需要安全的行驶环境吧？”: If it's allowed to run around and causes a disturbance, it wouldn't be good. After all, vehicle operation requires a safe driving environment, right?
description.“你怎么会在这里？好久不见，真是吓了我一跳……呵呵，一会要不要去喝杯茶？”: How come you are here? Long time no see, really gave me a fright... Haha, do you want to go have a cup of tea later?
description.“失控的地表动力装置……唔，不知道和帝国的使魔相比如何，就让我领教一下吧。”: The out-of-control surface power device... Hmm, I wonder how it compares to the Empire's Familiar. Let me find out.
description.“这种魔物的外形非常具有美感呢，或许可以成为宝石切割方法的灵感来源。”: The appearance of this magical creature is very aesthetic; it might serve as an inspiration for gemstone cutting methods.
description.*一段第一视角的录像，海伦娜对镜头外的你微笑着。*看来她已经完全掌握地表机械的运: *A first-person perspective video, Helena smiles at you off-camera.* It seems she has completely mastered the operational logic of surface machinery.
description.这份战斗数据来自失败天使个体“■■”的某次失控，她的救世主大人会来拯救她吗？: This battle data comes from a certain out-of-control incident involving the failed Angel "■■". Will her Master Savior come to save her?
description.“老师？老师……你在吗？……我有点害怕……”: Teacher? Teacher... are you there?... I'm a little scared...
description.“虽然见习学者不用通过御敌枢纽的检测……但是，为了变得更有用，我必须努力……”: Although apprentice scholars do not need to pass the test of The Destroyer... however, in order to become more useful, I must work hard...
description.“这里不像家里那么冷。我还是第一次发现，索思学会也是个很温暖的地方……”: It's not as cold here as it is at home. It's the first time I've realized that the Source Citadel is also a very warm place...
description.“不会让你妨碍到罗洁尔老师的！”: I won't let you interfere with Teacher Raziel!
description.“居、居然是您亲自来测试我的能力吗？我明白了。这是对我最大的认可。”: Is it really you personally testing my abilities? I understand. This is the greatest recognition for me.
description.“我很清楚，现在老师已经不在了。接下来的旅途……虽然还不知道怎么走下去，但我会试: I am well aware that the teacher is no longer here. The journey ahead... although I still don't know how to proceed, I will try...
description.“打败这样的敌人，就可以帮上老师的忙了吧？”: Defeating such an enemy would help the teacher, right?
description.“……那是我唯一一次，也是最后一次和老师战斗。现在只能想起，那时候我真的很开心…: ......That was the only time, and also the last time, I fought with my teacher. Now I can only remember that I was really happy then......
description.体型巨大的深海桦树生物，各方面的情况都亟需进一步调查。目前能够确定的信息仅有该个: A large deep-sea CR, all aspects of which urgently require further investigation. The only confirmed information is that the appearance pattern of this individual is attracted by certain human activities.
description.贡露城中一处风景秀美的城市绿地，不知为何潜伏着少量桦树生物。: Gronru City contains a scenic urban green space, where for some reason a few CR are lurking.
description.令人们心向往之的海洋，神秘而美丽，它会带来财富，也能带来毁灭。只有敢于抗争之人，: The ocean, which captivates people's hearts, is mysterious and beautiful. It can bring wealth but also destruction. Only those who dare to fight can preserve themselves amidst the waves.
description.“这个……脆脆的。咬开以后，很甜……列车长？”: This... crunchy. After biting into it, it's very sweet... Conductor?
description.“好硬……咬不动……找遥借个锤子砸开吧。”: So hard... can't bite it... let's borrow a hammer from Haruka to break it open.
description.“列车长，我从冷冷的、发光的盒子里拿了很多吃的，你要吃吗？”: Conductor, I took a lot of food from the cold, glowing box. Do you want some?
description.“……这个吗？吃了会嘴里麻麻的，还有点辣……尝尝？”: ......This one? Eating it makes your mouth tingly, and it's a bit spicy... Want to try?
description.“有一点下雨的味道。和打雷的味道。好吃！”: There's a bit of drizzle in the air. And the taste of thunder. Delicious!
description.“咬不动……但是又咬得动？好像是很久以前就认识的……朋友的感觉……”: Can't bite... but can bite? Feels like someone I've known for a long time... the feeling of a friend...
description.“是芝士吗？芝士，我记得不是朋友……但是很好吃。所以这个朋友应该也很好吃。”: Is it cheese? Cheese, I remember it's not a friend... but it's delicious. So this friend should be delicious too.
description.“……对不起，我知道了，我不小心把大家的盒饭、布丁、牛奶都吃了……要惩罚吗……？: ......I'm sorry, I understand, I accidentally ate everyone's boxed lunch, pudding, and milk... Should I be punished...?
description.“强大个体”，在此研究中通常用于称呼实力以及规模远强于其他同类的个体。: "Powerful individual," in this study, is typically used to refer to individuals whose strength and scale far exceed those of others in the same category.
description.另外，对于变异个体的捕获，尽管此前已有■■■的成功案例，但该类行动仍需最高安全级: Additionally, for the capture of mutant individuals, although there have been successful cases of ■■■ in the past, such actions still require the highest level of security review.
description.最后，说到“出逃”……假如特殊个体离开了我们的监测和控制范围，那么……: Finally, speaking of "escape"... If a special individual leaves our monitoring and control range, then...
description.为了针对不断出现的新亚种……请第五部门尽快……实地捕获。: To address the continually emerging new subspecies... please have the Fifth Department quickly... capture on site.
description.与此同时，对原有的特殊种类的研究……推进不利……: At the same time, the research on the original special varieties...progress is unfavorable...
description.“一般个体”，在此研究中通常用于称呼……是第二部门最常遇到的干扰因素。: "General individual," commonly used in this study to refer to... is the most encountered jammer in the second sector.
description.在强大个体之上，有时会出现成因不明的特殊个体，捕获行动时需格外注意。: Above powerful individuals, sometimes there are special individuals of unknown cause that require extra caution during capture operations.

buffText.每30秒触发1次，受到的最终伤害降低15%，可叠加4层: Reduce enemies' Final DMG taken by 15% every 30 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.
buffText.每30秒触发1次，造成的最终伤害提高15%，可叠加4层: Increase enemies' Final DMG dealt by 15% every 30 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.
buffText.主动技能【轮锯切割】和【弹幕扫射】增强：\\n攻击段数增加，攻击范围扩大: Enhance [Wheel Cutting] and [Barrage Unleash]:\nIncrease the area of effect and hits.
buffText.主动技能【投掷燃烧瓶】和【闪光弹冲击】增强：\\n释放后召唤斧盾暴徒小队进入战场: Enhance [Molotov Cocktail] and [Flashbang Impact]:\nSummon a bunch of mobs equipped with axes and shields.
buffText.【普通攻击】攻击速度提高25%，造成物理伤害和火焰伤害提高25%\\n新增技能【: Increase enemies' [Basic Attack] speed, Physical and Fire DMG dealt by 25%.\nGain a new skill [Ablaze Beam]:\nDeal Fire DMG to your allies in range over 3 hits per second with a 10% chance to trigger [Ignite].
buffText.【普通攻击】增强：\\n对面前范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害\\n同时有30%概率【: Enhance [Basic Attack]:\nDeal Physical DMG to your allies in range once with a 30% chance to inflict [Stun].
buffText.技能冷却时间缩短50%,获得永久【霸体】: Reduce enemies' skill cooldown by 50% and grant them permanent [Hyperarmor].
buffText.每20秒触发1次，每秒回复自身0.5%生命值，持续10秒: Heal the enemy for 0.5% of Max HP per second, lasting 10 seconds. This effect is triggered once every 20 seconds.
buffText.每30秒触发1次，获得【护盾】\\n护盾耐久为自身20%最大生命值: The enemy gains a [Shield] every 30 seconds.\nThe durability is equal to 20% of its Max HP.
buffText.攻击力提高30%，【普通攻击】攻击速度提高50%: Increase the enemy's ATK by 30% and [Basic Attack] speed by 50%.
buffText.阵亡时驱散玩家增益效果\\n技能【三连喷吐】转化为【普通攻击】: When the enemy takes lethal DMG, dispel all buffs on your allies.\nSkill [Triple Spit] is replaced by [Basic Attack].
buffText.技能【虫母呼唤】增强：\\n对敌方全体造成1段混响伤害并【灼心】，同时召唤大量鸣: Enhance [Call of the Matriarch]:\nDeal Reverb DMG once to all your allies and inflict [Scorch]. Summon a large number of Toxic Blastbugs.
buffText.免疫【禁锢】/【枷锁】: The enemy gains immunity to [Imprison] and [Fetter].
buffText.技能【创伤烙印】增强：\\n对随机敌方目标附加【心魔印记】并生成【心魔】\\n同: Enhance [Trauma Branding]:\nInflict [Devil Inside Mark] to your random allies and generate [Devil Inside].\nInflict [Imprison] to the targets.
buffText.技能【创伤激发】增强：\\n对面前范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害并引爆【心魔印记】，: Enhance [Trauma Awakening]:\nDeal Physical DMG to your allies in range once and trigger their [Devil Inside Mark] with the DMG increased by 300%.
buffText.免疫【冻结】/【冰封】\\n攻击力提高15%，受到的最终伤害降低30%: The enemy gain immunity to [Chill] and [Freeze].\nIncrease the enemy's ATK by 15% and reduce its Final DMG taken by 30%.
buffText.阵亡时驱散玩家增益效果\\n技能附加的【冻结】概率提高至100%\\n普通攻击有:
When the enemy takes lethal DMG, dispel all buffs on your allies.
Its skills have a 100% chance to inflict [Chill].
Its [Basic Attack] has a 30% chance to inflict [Chill].
The enemy gains a new skill [Frost Nova]:
Deal Frost DMG to all your allies once and inflict [Freeze].
buffText.技能【绝对零度】增强：\\n对敌方全体造成1段冰冻伤害，同时触发【冻结】\\n随: Enhance [Absolute Zero]:\nDeal Frost DMG to all your allies once and inflict [Chill].\nAfterward, remove [Chill] effect from all your allies. If successful, deal Frost DMG equal to 25% of the target's Max HP and inflict [Curse]. If the target is under [Freeze] effect, remove [Freeze] effect instead, and if successful, deal Frost DMG equal to 50% of the target's Max HP and inflict [Fetter].
buffText.每20秒触发1次，自身【霸体】并使随机目标【混乱】\\n同时每秒回复自身0.5%: Shire gains [Hyperarmor] and inflicts [Confuse] on your random allies, and heals for 0.5% of Max HP per second, lasting 10 seconds. This effect is triggered once every 20 seconds.
buffText.主动技能【精神力瓦解光炮】增强：\\n使敌方全体触发【崩坏】，蓄力后对敌方全体造: Enhance [Psychic Disruption Beam]:\nInflict [Corrupt] on all your allies. Then charge up and launch a powerful beam, dealing Reverb DMG to all your allies once and inflicting [Sleep].
buffText.免疫【诅咒】\\n朱迪的防御力提高50%\\n朱迪濒死时驱散所有负面效果，同时回: Shire gains immunity to [Curse].\nIncrease Jude's DEF by 50%.\nWhen Jude takes lethal DMG, dispel all negative effects from it and fully heal it.
buffText.新增技能【MEGA混沌加农】：\\n对全体敌方造成10段混响伤害: Shire gains a new skill [Chaotic Cannon MEGA]:\nDeal Reverb DMG to all your allies over 10 hits.
buffText.新增技能【横冲直撞】：\\n呼叫沙盗团的兄弟们一起进行冲锋，对范围内敌方造成11: Shire gains a new skill [Barge]:\nCall the P.U.S. members to charge at you, dealing Physical DMG to your allies in range over 11 hits.
buffText.每30秒触发1次，防御力提高25%，可叠加4层: Increase the enemy's DEF by 25% every 30 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.
buffText.开局遇到天气【炙热】，持续180秒: Trigger the weather [Boiling] at the start of battle, lasting 180 seconds.
buffText.受到的最终伤害降低10%，生命值低于50%时效果翻倍\\n技能【沙蜕】增强：\\: Reduce the enemy's Final DMG taken by 10%. This effect is doubled when its HP is below 50%.\nEnhance [Sand Slough]:\nThe enemy leaves a slough and becomes invisible while moving backward. The slough automatically casts skills, dealing Physical DMG once and inflicting [Launch]. Afterward, the slough explodes, dealing Physical DMG once to your allies in range and reducing their DEF by 5%. Afterward, summon a random Bony CR.
buffText.技能【尘壳】增强：\\n自身受到的伤害降低25%，每次受到攻击时回复自身精力值，:
Enhance [Dust Shell]:
The enemy takes 25% less DMG. Whenever attacked, the enemy gains Energy, lasting 6 seconds. Afterward, increase its Final DMG dealt by 20% but the passive skill [Rising Dust] becomes unavailable for 20 seconds.
[Rising Dust]: Sand Phosphor is always accompanied by dust and immune to all negative effects while in the dust.
This effect expires in rainy weather.
buffText.技能【碎灭炮击】增强：\\n每次炮击消耗的精力值降低\\n每3秒对随机敌方进行1: Enhance [Obliterating Barrage]:\nEach barrage consumes less Energy.\nLaunch a barrage against your random allies once every 3 seconds, dealing Fire DMG once and inflicting [Ignite].
buffText.新增技能【底层代码：掩护】：\\n场上存在掘金机器人时金子小姐获得【霸体】: The enemy gains a new skill [Base Code: Cover]:\nMiss Gold gains [Hyperarmor] as long as any Nugget Mech exists on the battlefield.
buffText.每20s触发1次，召唤1只掘金机器人\\n每存在一只掘金机器人，金子小姐攻击力提:
Summon a Nugget Mech every 20 seconds.
For each existing Nugget Mech, increase Miss Gold's ATK by 10%, stacking up to 5 times.
Enhance [Command: Reboot]:
Deal Electro DMG to 2 random Nugget Mechs once and increase their ATK by 20%, lasting 20 seconds. Create an electric field that disables all Explosives entering the field.
buffText.技能【指令：出击】增强：\\n抽取敌方4点费用，召唤1只掘金一号和1只掘金二号，: Enhance [Command: Strike]:\nAbsorb 4 Cost from you and summon a Nugget Mech 1 and a Nugget Mech 2. Miss Gold gains [Hyperarmor] while casting this skill.
buffText.每存在1只掘金机器人，金子小姐与掘金机器人受到的最终伤害降低15%，可叠加5层\: For each existing Nugget Mech, reduce Miss Gold and all Nugget Mechs' Final DMG taken by 15%, stacking up to 5 times.\nEnhance [Command: For Miss Gold]:\n[Knockback] all your allies, then summon a storm of rocket fists that deal Electro DMG to all your allies over 10 hits. All existing Nugget Mechs immediately cast their Ultimate skill.
buffText.“漫漫大雪归乡路”\\n本场战斗天气必定为【暴雪】\\n每60秒触发1次，全体队:
"I tread the path homeward through the snowfall."
The weather is always set to [Blizzard].
Grant a [Shield] to all your allies every 60 seconds. The durability is equal to 20% of their Max HP.
Increase Scorpion's DEF by 25% every 30 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.
buffText.新增技能【例行维护】：\\n每60秒触发1次，停止行动同时每秒回复自身2%生命值: Scorpion gains a new skill [Routine Maintenance]:\nScorpion ceases all actions and heals for 2% of Max HP per second, lasting 10 seconds. This effect is triggered once every 60 seconds.
buffText.蝎型机械体和自走哨戒炮每次造成伤害时触发，自身造成的物理伤害提高0.5%，可叠加: Whenever Scorpion or Sentry Turret deals DMG, increase their Physical DMG dealt by 0.5%, stacking up to 999 times. When reaching 200 stacks, they gain immunity to all crowd-control effects.
buffText.技能【机械制导】增强：\\n对随机敌方发射36枚导弹，每枚导弹对范围内敌方造成1: Enhance [Mechanical Guidance]:\nLaunch 36 missiles at your random allies, each dealing Physical DMG once to targets within range and having a 30% chance to trigger [Ignite].
buffText.自走哨戒炮发射炮弹时驱散蝎型机械体受到的控制和伤害类特殊效果；自走哨戒炮损坏时将: When Sentry Turret fires, remove crowd-control and damage effects from Scorpion. When Sentry Turret is destroyed, transfer its Physical DMG bonus to Scorpion.
buffText.每次最多受到最大生命值3%的伤害: Enemy's Max DMG taken per hit cannot exceed 3% of Max HP.
buffText.受到的最终伤害降低20%\\n新增技能【岩盘崩落】：\\n每12秒触发1次，召唤: Enemy takes 20% less Final DMG and gains a new skill [Rock Crash]:\nSummon a meteorite on your random allies, dealing Reverb DMG once to targets within range and inflicting [Launch]. This effect is triggered once every 12 seconds.
buffText.昏恶巨象在【狂暴】持续时间结束后会获得【护盾】，【护盾】被破坏后会获得【狂暴】，: Chaos Behemoth gains a [Shield] when its [Berserk] effect expires. When its [Shield] is depleted, it gains [Berserk] effect, lasting 12 seconds.\nThe durability is equal to 15% of its Max HP.
buffText.技能【巨象之撼】增强：\\n发射聚能体对敌方全体造成1段秘法伤害并【护盾击碎】，: Enhance [Direphant Crush]:\nLaunch energy orbs that deal Arcane DMG to all your allies once and shatter their [Shield]. The energy orbs explode and create shock waves that deal Reverb DMG to all your allies once and inflict [Sleep]. Afterward, Chaos Behemoth gains [Berserk].\nWhen Chaos Behemoth generates a [Shield], this skill launches an additional orb. This effect stacks.
buffText.免疫【击飞】和【击退】\\n生命值首次低于50%时触发，使敌方无法使用【队长技】: Enemy gains immunity to [Launch] and [Knockback].\nWhen his HP drops below 50% for the first time, prevent you from using [Leader Skill], lasting 12 seconds.
buffText.“纵使无月兮，秉烛照夜”\\n无明火受到部分控制效果时令自身【灼心】并免疫该控制: "In the absence of the moon, I shall illuminate the night with candlelight."\nWhen taking specific crowd-control effects, Mumeika nullifies them, gains [Scorch], and reduces his Final DMG taken by 3%, stacking up to 20 times.\nThe effects include [Freeze], [Stun], [Interrupt], and [Moemoe].
buffText.攻击速度提高50%\\n【普通攻击】触发【点燃】: Increase enemy's attack speed by 50%.\nHis [Basic Attack] triggers [Ignite].
buffText.技能【猎首】增强：\\n进入防御姿态，持续6秒\\n持续期间获得【霸体】同时受到:
Enhance [Headhunter]:
Mumeika enters Defensive Stance, lasting 6 seconds.
During this period, gains [Hyperarmor] and takes 90% less Final DMG.
When the stance expires, Mumeika deals Physical DMG once to your allies in range and heals based on the DMG dealt.
buffText.技能【炽烈】增强：\\n对范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害并【撕裂】\\n短暂蓄力后对:
Enhance [Fervor]:
Deal Physical DMG once to your allies in range and inflict [Rend].
Then charge up and unleash a flurry of cleaves, dealing Physical DMG over 3 hits and inflicting [Slash], and Fire DMG over 3 hits and inflicting [Ignite].
Afterward, trigger an explosion in the front, inflicting [Slash] and [Flare] on your allies in range.
buffText.本场战斗天气必定为【暴雪】\\n每30秒触发1次，伐木重机受到的最终伤害降低15: The weather is always set to [Blizzard].\nReduce Timbersaw's Final DMG taken by 15%, stacking up to 4 times. This effect is triggered once every 30 seconds.
buffText.免疫【冻结】和【冰封】\\n伐木重机和自走哨戒炮每次造成伤害时触发，自身造成的物: Enemy gains immunity to [Chill] and [Freeze].\nWhenever Timbersaw or Sentry Turret deals DMG, increase their Physical DMG dealt by 0.5%, stacking up to 999 times. When reaching 200 stacks, they gain immunity to all crowd-control effects.
buffText.【普通攻击】触发【斩裂】\\n使用技能后降低自身【普通攻击】伤害并【狂暴】: Enemy's [Basic Attack] inflicts [Slash].\nWhen Timbersaw uses a skill, reduces its [Basic Attack] DMG and gains [Berserk].
buffText.自走哨戒炮存活时持续治疗自身，同时伐木重机造成的物理伤害提高50%；自走哨戒炮损: When Sentry Turret is on the field, it keeps healing itself and increases Timbersaw's Physical DMG dealt by 50%. When Sentry Turret is destroyed, transfer its Physical DMG bonus to Timbersaw, and Timebersaw takes 50% less Physical DMG.
buffText.骑士的骁勇：\\n每次【普通攻击】时触发，自身造成的最终伤害提高3%，可叠加10: Knight's Valor:\nCharlotte's [Basic Attack] increases her Final DMG dealt by 3%, stacking up to 10 times.
buffText.剑士的意志：\\n每次自身造成【斩裂】时，自身攻击力提高0.3%，可叠加99层: Sword's Will:\nWhenever Charlotte inflicts [Slash], increase her ATK by 0.3%, stacking up to 99 times.
buffText.持之以恒：\\n生命值低于50%时，每秒回复自身0.3%生命值: Persistence:\nWhen Charlotte's HP is below 50%, heal her for 0.3% of Max HP per second.
buffText.贵族气度：\\n每60秒触发1次，攻击速度提高100%，可叠加3层: Noble Grace:\nIncrease Charlotte's attack speed by 100% every 60 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
buffText.免疫【冻结】 /【冰封】/【打断】/【击晕】\\n【普通攻击】增强：\\n释放1:
Charlotte gains immunity to [Chill], [Freeze], [Interrupt], and [Stun].
Enhance [Basic Attack]:
Release a sword wave, dealing DMG to all your allies once and inflicting [Slash] and [Interrupt].
Sword waves can stack for [Infernal Crescent].
buffText.【心脏起搏器】：\\n每20秒触发1次，对自身造成1段电磁伤害，同时驱散自身受到: [Pacemaker]:\nDeal Electro DMG to Nicola once and remove all crowd-control effects from her every 20 seconds.\nThe trigger interval is halved when her HP is below 50%.
buffText.【高效启动】：\\n每次使用技能后，自身触发【引雷】的概率+5%，可叠加: [Efficient Activation]:\nAfter using any skill, Nicola gains a 5% increased chance to trigger [Electrify]. This effect stacks.
buffText.【所属权论证】：\\n全场不论敌我，触发【引雷】时，回复自身生命值，每秒最多触发: [Ownership Argument]:\nHeal Nicola whenever a unit (ally or enemy alike) triggers [Electrify]. This effect can be triggered once per second.

des.近十年来，修格里城的飞速发展使得它成为了西大陆铁路环线上最有潜力的商业枢纽之一。: In the past decade, Shoggolith City's rapid development has made it become one of the most promising business hubs on the Western Continent Railway Loop. At the same time, shady enterprises and all sorts of underground networks have also been ever-growing. Ensuring the safety of a swiftly evolving Bonfire City isn't a cakewalk, but Heinrich does a pretty good job at it. At the very least, people rarely have to worry about the safety of themselves and their properties while strolling on Shoggolith City's streets. Even if anything does happen, all they have to do is make a trip to the BCRL Agency, and the well-trained, patient BCRL soldiers will put them at ease.\nAs the administrator of Shoggolith City's BCRL Agency, Heinrich plays the role of the leader and protector in such situations where order needs to be maintained. No matter if it's a safety issue caused by hostile gangs or if hordes of Chaos Remains have appeared in nearby areas, Heinrich is constantly able to stay composed and proceed to give out instructions. The mere sight of him at the forefront is a tremendous morale boost for the soldiers when things are critical. Based on this alone, he does indeed seem to save the day like a hero would.
des.海因里希对外公开的履历相当丰厚。少年时接受民兵战斗训练，随后应征入伍，于地联服役: Heinrich's publicly accessible resume addendum is fairly extensive. In his adolescent years, he underwent militia combat training before enlisting in the military, earning plenty of medals for his gallantry while serving in the Earth Union. After Freeport Ⅶ's Reality Stabilizer exploded, he joined in on the rescue mission without hesitation, only to return critically injured, having to disappear from public view for some time for his medical treatment. He eventually recovered with his physical fitness and combat ability better than ever, albeit he lost an eye. Thereafter, as the Earth Union's influence weakened, Heinrich chose to become a BCRL soldier, briefly inspiring a bunch of other Earth Union soldiers to do the same. He then settled down in Shoggolith City in the years to follow and has been a BCRL Agency chief for over ten years.\nAs soon as he joined BCRL, they focused on creating an entire recruitment campaign based on him, with his posters renewed annually even until now. His status as a modern-day hero, dignified yet personable looks, and all-encompassing military experience formed the essence of the imposing, steely-eyed Heinrich pictured in the campaign posters.\nYet, he didn't appear to be interested in these campaigns and even found them dishonoring. A tacit deal then formed among the BCRL Agency staff: Whenever Chief Heinrich showed up, they'd hide all of his posters. After all, they felt bad when they saw him frowning at these posters at work.
des.拜访无垠号的次数多起来以后，海因里希逐渐开始愿意多说一些工作和责任之外的事。谈起:
After repeated visits to the Eternal, Heinrich slowly starts opening up about stuff unrelated to work and responsibilities. Whenever he talks about his family, his expression visibly softens, exhibiting the love he has for them. However, few people on the train have the courage to probe him for more personal details, so everyone can only understand more about him through other ways.
Heinrich often gets in touch with his family at the gangway connection where there's no one around, but surprisingly, all he ever seems to talk about with them is trivial household stuff. For example, check if you've brought your keys before heading to the hospital for work, pay attention to what seasoning you're using when making soup, do not turn up the heat when attempting to cook something new, remember to return the tools you used to wherever they were, or else you won't be able to find them next time... The person on the other side never finds these reminders annoying, seemingly always agreeing with him in delight, and similarly, Heinrich never once sounded mad or anxious. Their conversation tends to end with him saying, "I'll be back soon."
"Hmm? My parents? They're very loving. Mm-hmm, really! You guys heard him, right? He's so mushy on the phone—"
While Dorothy holds up a small megaphone to gossip with everyone with one foot on the train seat, Heinrich approaches from behind her and clears his throat.
"...Don't forget to wipe the seat clean, Dorothy."
des.海因里希正躺在手术台上。\r此前他在7号自由港抢险。在建起现实稳定装置之前，那个:
Heinrich is currently lying on the operating table after partaking in a rescue mission at Freeport Ⅶ.
That coastal port was the hometown he grew up in before it had a Reality Stabilizer built. The moment the explosion occurred, he applied to rush there and help despite the dangers, only to be greeted by a catastrophic scene that regular people would never be able to handle seeing. He and his companions fought to the very last moment until he lost consciousness and could no longer hold his weapon, and the next time he opened his eyes, he was already lying on the operating table.
Needless to say, Heinrich thinks about his death. To people in the military, it is an honor to sacrifice themselves on the frontlines after battling with might and main. Still, there are a few things in his heart he just can't bear to leave behind: the soup made in tin cans in camp, nights where everyone sings and jokes around the table, and the young lady he met in the hospital—Loya.
He realizes that he wants to continue living and save more people with his own power, but gradually, he starts seeing things from the third-person point of view and witnesses what happened when he was taken into a room earlier. Numerous researchers, some of whom he recognized, had been arguing around his unconscious body. Among them, Loya came forward and said, "Since all of you worry that he might become a Deep Sleeper, I'll take care of him by myself." Then, he sees himself being wheeled into a new operating room and attached to unfamiliar equipment...
Before darkness slowly swallows him whole, he sees someone reaching out to him.
...
Twenty years later, as a war hero, Heinrich will casually tell people how his wife Loya had saved his life, but he never once divulges the ins and outs of that circumstance. As for what exactly healed his fatal injury and saved his life while he disappeared from public view, it is likely that the people will never get to find out.
Among his personal belongings lies one such photo: Young Loya beams at the camera in her military hospital uniform, and young Heinrich, who was far less brawny than he is now and who still had both eyes, also flashes a faint smile.
des.苔妮的时髦装扮在列车武装工厂中是难得的一抹亮色。假如向她提问为什么要这么穿，得到:
Tennie's stylish appearance is a rare splash of color within the Train Weapon Factory. Ask her why she dresses that way, and her answer will always be the same: "Because I like it!"

Her oversized earrings are welded together from discarded machine parts. Her cape began life as a standard Anita weatherproof coat (lake blue), later cut apart and embellished with her own accessories. Even her personal ride, which also serves as her weapon in battle, is a custom machine rebuilt from salvaged train components. To put an end to the constant complaints that "long hair gets in the way of work," she carefully braids it before every shift, often experimenting with new and surprisingly inventive styles.

Her coworkers at Anita almost invariably describe her as "exceptionally creative." Perhaps it is precisely because of that unconventional creativity that the Train Weapon Factory occasionally receives customer complaints unlike any others, such as:

"Why in the world did you cover the casing of my awesome engine with a bunch of weird little bear stickers?! That's way too childish!"
— Train Weapon Factory Message Board, Anonymous Conductor

"They're just decorative stickers! They peel right off! Besides, teddy bears are the cutest. They're always the cutest!!!!"
— Train Weapon Factory Message Board, Tennie
des.苔妮的身世被坊间传得神乎其神。有人说她的父母进了混沌海就没出来，也有人说她的家族:
Rumors surrounding Tennie's background have grown increasingly fantastical over the years. Some claim her parents disappeared into the Turbulent Sea and never returned. Others insist that criminal blood runs through her family.

There are, however, a few accounts that can actually be substantiated. One of them is that Tennie was raised by a Chaos Remains researcher. Those familiar with the story usually add another detail: "A researcher who eats Chaos Remains!"

Anyone who has spent enough time reading research records on Chaos Remains specimens will eventually notice the unmistakable trail left by a certain researcher with an extraordinary appetite. Her tasting notes span an astonishing range of places and years, covering no fewer than two decades and well over a thousand different specimens. The reports themselves also make it abundantly clear that she repeatedly placed herself in mortal danger in pursuit of her work. One cannot help but wonder whether someone like that still qualifies as an ordinary human. And if that was the person who raised Tennie... could the child possibly have turned out completely normal?

Tennie herself, however, has never tried to hide where she came from. Ask about her family, and she will casually refer to that researcher as both "my aunt" and "my guardian," usually slipping in a few half-hearted complaints about her along the way.

"...My aunt? Why are you asking so many questions? What, do you want to try her Chaos Remains soup?"

Then look at Tennie's utterly sincere expression. Look at the "adorable" teddy bear in her arms, whose appearance somehow radiates violence. Then look around at the rows of heavy train-mounted artillery nearby...

Are you really sure you want to keep this conversation going?
des.苔妮的真实身世，没有流言蜚语中的那版离奇，但也确实复杂而又苦涩。\r在被收养前，:
The truth behind Tennie's past is nowhere near as fantastical as the rumors suggest. Yet in its own way, it is every bit as complicated... and far more bittersweet.

Before she was adopted, Tennie spent much of her childhood drifting from place to place with her older brother and sister-in-law. The rumble of trains and off-road vehicles became the backdrop of her earliest memories. As she grew older, however, her presence became "less convenient" for the two of them. Their way of raising her changed accordingly, and she was left alone at home for increasingly long stretches of time.

To keep her from getting bored, they would bring back little souvenirs after every "job." A dismantled train engine component from somewhere unknown. Assorted wrenches. Building blocks that never quite made a complete set. Well-thumbed mechanical encyclopedias with worn-out pages...

Even when they were home, the two were usually preoccupied with modifying vehicles or studying increasingly sophisticated machinery, leaving little time to keep Tennie company. It was in this unusually free and solitary environment that she grew up.

On the day her last remaining family members were finally captured by the BCRL, the headline of the "Train Morning Post" read: "Notorious Train Robber Couple Brought to Justice." Tennie herself knew nothing about it. She simply sat at home, quietly assembling her building blocks, waiting for the next "present" her guardians would bring back.

Not long afterward, she was taken in by a child welfare institution and was meant to be sent to an orphanage to await adoption.

Yet the memory that stayed with Tennie was of a certain afternoon, when a young woman with unforgettable crimson hair appeared before her, smiling with unrestrained warmth. Having completed the adoption process ahead of schedule, she officially became Tennie's guardian.

Chen Shuxian, the eccentric Chaos Remains researcher whom nearly everyone at Anita preferred to avoid for one reason or another, found herself feeling a depth of sympathy for the child that she could scarcely explain.

From that day on, under the care of the woman she would come to call her "Aunt," Tennie stepped into an entirely new chapter of her life.
des.苔妮曾经接待过一群来列车武装工厂参观的孩子。尽管她极力避免这样的麻烦差事，但阿妮:
Tennie once found herself hosting a group of children visiting the Train Weapon Factory. Although she had tried her best to avoid such a troublesome assignment, someone from Anita Headquarters eventually persuaded her by pointing out that the visit might inspire the children to discover interests beyond what they already knew. In the end, she gave in.

Her bright, easygoing personality quickly won the children over, and before long she had become the object of their wholehearted admiration. During a break, one little girl suddenly ran up to her, eyes sparkling with excitement.

"You're so cool, miss! Just like those free-spirited outlaw riders from the old movies!"

Tennie understood perfectly why they would think that. Her boldly individual style, together with the enormous custom workshop behind her, did bear a certain resemblance to the glamorous outlaws so often portrayed on the silver screen. Yet she had never imagined herself becoming any sort of criminal. Intrigue and lawlessness had never interested her. She had simply devoted herself to the craft she loved most, refining it day by day until it became the path she walks today.

The child's innocent admiration lingered with her as an unexpected source of unease. From time to time, those words would resurface in her thoughts, prompting her to wonder what kind of person she truly wished to become... and what kind of person she ought to become.

The workshop floor of the Train Weapon Factory is vast and open. It had once been a place that filled her with satisfaction, but whenever uncertainty clouded her mind, the same empty space only seemed to deepen her sense of solitude.

Fortunately, she knows she is no longer someone without a place to belong. She has already found companions she can rely on, people willing to listen patiently to every complaint and frustration she has, never put off by her blunt honesty.

These days, whenever those worries begin to weigh on her, Tennie simply leaves the factory for a while and heads to the Eternal instead. So if you happen to find a mountain of train parts scattered across the freight car, don't worry. It just means Tennie has decided to move her workbench again.

des.凭借自己一人就经营起cos专营店的马吉拉性格活泼奔放，相当擅长与顾客沟通。同时她:
With a buoyant and extroverted personality, Margiela, who manages a cosplay costume store all on her own, is pretty skilled at customer relations and has exceedingly high patience. Not only is her sewing skill and craftsmanship spectacular, but she's also incredibly efficient, constantly striving to deliver costumes that please her customers right on time. According to her, in the past, she could only make costumes by hand because of certain reasons, but now that she has sewing machines, her work has become much easier.

To Margiela, cosplay has long been a part of her life. Just a brief interaction with her and you'll discover that this young lady's demeanor is almost as cheeky and adorable as a little witch in animations. Regardless if it's in her daily life or if she's on a mission for Night Chains, Margiela always dresses however she likes, causing her to often be misunderstood as a delinquent since she had dropped out of school halfway through, not to mention her atypical dressing style.

However, she is far from being young and reckless. Once you get to know her, her intelligence will become apparent, and her numerous outstanding skills also suggest that she has once received an elite education.
des.根据黑月的资料显示，马吉拉是在加入黑月后觉醒的升构能力，毫无疑问的是它绝不容小觑:
Based on Night Chains' records, Margiela's Ascension Ability, which is indisputably not to be underestimated, awakened after she joined Night Chains. Anyone who knows about her ability is always careful not to piss her off for no reason.

As though in response to Margiela, who has always presented herself like a little witch, the act of referring to her as a "witch" somehow began spreading among the people of Night Chains. As you can imagine, this not only doesn't infuriate her, but it will even lift her spirits if you call her that to her face.

Margiela, despite her formidable ability, isn't passionate about combat or adventures. Instead, she prefers spending her time managing her little store and making costumes. Her dressing style has always been bold, and she's never one to shy away from attempting innovative designs. It makes her day whenever someone discovers the "ingenuity" in her clothes. Things like whether or not the clothes she designs for herself are over-revealing are never in her consideration, nor does she care too much about people's opinions of her tastes. But if anyone tries forcing their conservative views on her, they will undoubtedly get on her bad side.
des.马吉拉出生于一个观念保守的家庭。父母要求她将学习放在第一位，而不允许她有任何“不:
Margiela was born into a conservative family, with parents who demanded she put her studies first and who forbade her from having any "unhealthy" hobbies. In such an environment, her only comfort was the one hour she got to spend watching animated shows on the TV every week.

The vivacious, flashily dressed witch in the show looked so free and unrestrained, and Margiela gradually grew a fondness for such a lifestyle, but she was aware that her parents would never approve of such a request. As such, she could only achieve that by herself with discretion.

While no one was home, she would secretly put on witch costumes and stand before the underused mirror to fulfill her tiny wish. At that moment, she'd feel like she had briefly escaped her taxing life and could allow her natural self to be set free. Such a gratifying experience was addictive, and she eventually found it impossible to do without.

Maybe because Margiela got somewhat carried away, she unwittingly loosened up and made a mistake one day. A corner of the eccentric costumes she deeply treasured was inadvertently revealed through the slit of the wardrobe, which led to a discovery by her mother. It went without saying that an intense family fight erupted, but Margiela couldn't understand why her parents had to react so hysterically when she simply wanted a bit of her own joy that didn't affect anyone else. Misery washed over her as she watched them freak out over the witch costumes.

Ultimately, the despondency and loneliness that came from her bottling up her feelings for years and her family's inability to understand her made her decide she was done living in that house, and she stormed out of there, never to return again.

Afterward, Margiela spent a very long time living without a roof over her head until she joined Night Chains. Her ascension ability then awakened, and she slowly established her specialty costume store, finally attaining stability and the dream life she once longed for, which is perhaps also a happy ending.
des.《曼杜斯传说故事集 第六卷：流亡的魔女》\r在遥远的岁月，曼杜斯帝国曾经诞生了一:
The Legendary Tales of Mundus, Volume VI: The Exiled Witch

Long, long ago, a formidable witch once emerged in the Mundus Empire. Nobody knew what her name was; all they knew was that she had overwhelming powers. Predictably, people either envied or feared her.

"She's bound to cause a catastrophe someday!"

Even though this terrible supposition had never been realized, the witch's kinsfolk stubbornly believed that so long as she had such unparalleled powers, a catastrophe would sooner or later befall them all. As a result, they tried suppressing her powers.

Someone begged, "This is all for our family's future. You mustn't be so selfish!"
Someone cried, "Please listen to us. This is also for your own good!"
Someone bellowed, "If you don't agree, don't blame us for what comes next!"
Someone cajoled, "Since you're so powerful, I can stand on your side as long as you do me a favor!"

Unfortunately, all their attempts were futile before the witch's profound powers. That was until one day, multiple strange, unsolved murders occurred within the clan. Rather than mourn their deceased compatriots, the people were beyond thrilled, for they could finally eliminate that fearsome existence!

The witch was forcibly taken into the tribunal. In spite of the lack of evidence, her matchless, formidable powers were the best proof of her guilt, and so she was convicted. The years of restraint and betrayal by the relatives she trusted resulted in her being exiled from her homeland for eternity. Before leaving, she took one last glance at her home and people, then left behind a curse: "This clan will perish after my departure. Someday, I will eventually return."

Following that, the witch's clan indeed withered and crumbled, but the witch never showed up again. At times, people would lament when faced with troubles, wondering where exactly that vile and piteous witch had gone to.
des.阿尔喀娜非常喜欢，或者说习惯于照顾别人。无论是小小冒险队中的其他人受伤生病，还是:
Arcana has a great fondness for, or rather is used to, taking care of others. No matter if someone has gotten injured in her humble adventure team or if she encounters people who need help while traveling on the train, she will always go forward to lend a hand without a second thought. In addition, the knowledge she has is also especially comprehensive, ranging from common healing magic powers of the Empire to making cough syrup from ordinary herbs.

Perhaps just like the idea of "what's good for you may not always be easy to swallow," the medicine Arcana prescribes is usually highly effective, albeit incredibly bitter. Whenever a child complains that the medicine is too nasty, Arcana will find candy or any snack that can take the edge off the bitterness and coax them into finishing the medicine in exchange for a sweet reward.

However, youngsters like the conductor, who's constantly hard at work, would hardly ever fall for that. Arcana generally doesn't stop anyone from working, but she will solemnly remind them not to overtax themselves, for health should always take precedence.

"Be not thou like some valiant champion. Worn out with toil, she slumbereth by the wayside, till a mighty eagle beareth her away unto its nest... What I tell thee is no feigned tale; this did verily come to pass."

As such, when Arcana sees someone who's showing signs of overexhaustion, she'll force them to take a rest, though there, of course, wouldn't be any bird bigger than Cook on the train.
des.曾经被她照顾过的孩子们都很喜欢阿尔喀娜，经常缠着她要求听她讲故事，阿尔喀娜也从不:
The children whom Arcana took care of all love her and frequently pester her to tell them stories, to which she never once refuses. Just like the bedtime stories often told to children, her story always begins with, "Once upon a time..."

However, the stories she narrates are enriched with a tinge of extra realism compared with those written in fairy tales. No other books have ever described how the blood that drips from a slaughtered dragon isn't red, nor do they bring up how the champion has to trek down a particular hill barefoot after accidentally losing one shoe during the journey.

Had she not personally witnessed these scenes, how could she possibly know these details? Could she have lived in the era where dragons and champions existed?

"...If that hero is still alive, she should still be living somewhere now," is typically how her story ends.

Can heroes from hundreds of years ago truly still be freely and blissfully living somewhere? Arcana's stories never fail to fascinate and offer a sense of security. Her listeners are willing to believe that if the people in the stories are immortal, they'll certainly keep living an ordinary life inconspicuously after completing such an awe-inspiring adventure.
des.如果想要了解一些关于帝国的知识，去找阿尔喀娜准没错。如果想要知道帝国人的常识，当:
If you're looking to learn more about the Empire's lore, Arcana is the perfect person to turn to. Of course, if it's merely general knowledge of the Empire that you need, Livia will be able to answer your questions. In fact, there are several appropriate people on the train to inquire about the living conditions of various people in the Empire. Yet, only Arcana can acutely connect the dots between different matters, then trace them back to specific folklore from hundreds of years ago and tell you about its origin.

She also has all sorts of knowledge, a significant part of which is pretty beneficial in real life. There's nothing that can stump her about the Empire, like their traditional agriculture, medical knowledge, and the tons of recipes for different food... If you look at it in another way, a place more suitable for her is probably a hut in a border village of the Empire than on the Eternal, which is continuously on the move.

After some time of adapting and research, Arcana has already mastered the skill of using natural ground materials to make food and medicine. Although she regularly grumbles about how "these substances upon the ground are sorely scant of mana," she still manages to serve exceptionally tasty food each time. Even the dining carriage transforms into a wonderful, magical place whenever she stands on the footstool to work with pots and pans by the stove.
des.很久很久以前，在许愿塔的光辉照耀之下，一位少女向许愿塔朝拜后，生下了一个孩子。\:
Once upon a time, under the brilliant light of the Wishing Tower, a young woman gave birth to a child upon paying homage to the tower.

As the child grew up, people noticed that her skin was marked with an amazing pattern and that she had exceedingly great powers, so much so that monsters adored her. They wouldn't attack her and would instead become her friend.

Despite countless years going by, the girl still looked like a child. She left her hometown and went on a journey, even changing her name, but her physical appearance remained unchanged. It was one thing that was constant in spite of the uncountable adventures she had gone on and the numerous friends she lost to the natural cycle of life. Undoubtedly, she was regarded as abnormal, and that thoroughly devastated her.

Even though she went on to meet a new friend, the forlorn child still cried unceasingly, as she knew that her new friend would eventually die before she did, too. To her shock, this friend held her hand and requested one thing from her: Don't be trapped by the misery of immortality. Please be happy in your future journeys.

The forlorn child agreed. From then on, she vanished from the public eye without anyone ever knowing where she had gone.

"If yon child hath not perished, she ought yet to dwell in some hidden place even now."
des.出生于一个四世同堂大家庭，作为长姐的弗兰非常习惯和许多人共同生活的日子。可以说，: Born into a large, four-generation family, Fran, as the eldest daughter, is especially used to living with plenty of people. As a matter of fact, her family is who she learned the importance of structure and organization from. Growing up this way is what turned her into a strong and dependable person.\nWith her phenomenal physical constitution and noteworthy leadership skills, Fran got promoted to the captain of a small team soon after joining the armed forces of her hometown, Edunn City. To her, who's well-accustomed to military life, she found her teammate Eliot a total freak, for Eliot's unfamiliarity with working in a group had resulted in many troubles in the highly disciplined military troop. Consequently, Fran, the captain, had to shoulder the responsibilities, which led to her paying more attention to Eliot. What she didn't anticipate was that this attention would be the reason her life trajectory "diverged" from how it was originally planned.
des.不适应部队生活的艾略特总是在这样那样的地方出问题，但弗兰并未因此埋怨她。她对待艾: Eliot, unacquainted with military life, often made loads of mistakes, but Fran didn't resent Eliot for it. Rather, she treated Eliot like how she would her younger siblings, trying her best to communicate with Eliot to figure out just what was going on in Eliot's mind.\nIn the eyes of others, Fran had gotten attracted to the "genuinity" of Eliot that had been concealed under her frivolous attitude, but one day, out of the blue, Eliot resigned and left Edunn City. Fran was tempted to go after Eliot and ask about it but had to curb that impulse for her obligations. Yet, in the following days, she sensed that she could no longer work at ease anymore. The realization of her inability to keep a cool head, which rarely occurred, prompted her to make the most risky and 'irresponsible' choice of her life: She submitted her resignation application and went in search of Eliot.
des.“不能放着她不管”，弗兰抱着这样的心情离开了伊敦恩城、追着艾略特的行踪，一路来到:
"I can't just leave her be," was Fran's thought as she left Edunn City to trace Eliot's steps, which led her all the way to a hunter's hut in the wilderness. The only things she looked into were the level of Morphic Field Pollution and the Chaos Remain population nearby. It was when she arrived that she discovered this was such a serene and spacious plot of land. As it turned out, Eliot grew up in an environment wholly different from Fran's, a possibility why she had that 'laidback' aura that kids who grew up in urban cities rarely exuded. 
Now that Fran located Eliot, she started hesitating instead. What if Eliot, who had just lost her father, didn't want to be found? What if Eliot had decided to keep living in the wilderness and wasn't interested in seeing a weirdo who chased after her all this way from the city? But soon after, Fran's urge to see Eliot and get to the bottom of things ultimately chased away her hesitation. She pushed open the hut's door with determination.
"Hmm? Why did I leave with Fran? Well... I mulled it over and realized there wasn't anything fun to do or eat where I lived... Life without milk tea, fried chicken, and gaming consoles is unbelievably boring!" explained Eliot smilingly when asked why she had left the hut with Fran.
Since no one else other than them would be able to know what exactly transpired back then, everyone will just have to take her word for it.
des.“就像没有什么能难倒她一样。只要跟着弗兰姐就行了，她会带着我们前进的！”\r在曾:
"It was like there wasn't anything she couldn't do. All we had to do was follow Fran, and she'd lead us forward!"
From the mouths of the old armed forces members, Fran was an incredibly reliable female leader. Her physique was slightly more muscular than other women her age, making her always the one lifting the shield at the forefront on the battlefield. Similarly, in daily life, she loved looking out for others and frequently solved everyone's problems.
Her background and experiences played a big part in her conduct, allowing her to naturally lead a small team not with commands but with her unique cohesiveness and affability. Nonetheless, only she knew in her heart that for a long time, she herself had no clue what her "dream goal" was. The weight on her shoulders was too heavy. In actuality, she hadn't been proceeding on a path she selected but had been dragged along by "responsibilities" that people hoped for her.
All that changed when Eliot appeared in Fran's life. Fran was both baffled and fascinated by how someone could be this undisciplined, unbridled, and free as a bird. Eliot was like an actual arrow that pierced Fran's monotonous life, spurring Fran to diverge from the "right path" for the first time, impulsively leave everything behind, leave the armed forces, leave the Bonfire City, and leave that future that had been set in stone.
She didn't make any plans for what should happen after locating Eliot, but it didn't matter to her anymore. An unpredictable future is what makes life interesting. Even if there's danger ahead, she has Eliot and everyone on The Eternal by her side now. The thought of this is what motivates her as she moves forward with her shield in hand.
From now on, she will live for herself.
des.某个曼杜斯帝国境内雇佣兵公会中的名册显示，伽罗尔曾是该雇佣兵公会的注册佣兵。他在: In the list of names of a certain Mundus Empire mercenary guild, Galore was noted to be a former registered mercenary of the same guild. It was a position he spent a considerable amount of time in, but there wasn't really anything worth mentioning about his performance, making his resume pale in comparison with those of other Empire mercenaries.\nAccording to intel collected at the Empire's Yeracuse district, Galore had made up his mind to join the mercenary guild without warning one day. Prior to that, he seemed to have had experience being the apprentice of a particular renowned Empire magician, though he ultimately failed to get anywhere in that line of work. His mentor once remarked that Galore was intelligent, quickly mastering many tricks, and even refined the skills he acquired to a praiseworthy level. What was more commendable was the great passion Galore had for magic.\nThe reason why Galore gave up on that career was likely attributable to the awkward situation of his performances being underrated. As he wasn't practiced in social interaction and livening up the mood, his magic performance ultimately felt lackluster, resulting in him not gaining any recognition despite finishing his apprenticeship for years.
des.记录号：M05162 记录员：波克士 \r多萝西：“呀吼~我是特派记者多萝西！:
Transcript No.: M05162
Transcriber: BOX
Dorothy: "Yoohoo! I'm Dorothy, an accredited journalist! Congratulations on winning the 1st Eternal Cup Magic Competition's final prize! Could you please tell us what you're feeling right now?"
Galore: "A journalist?! Nobody told me there would be a post-competition interview..."
Dorothy: "Well, it seems fun, so I've decided to get into journalist mode for today! That's not the point anyway. The other finalist, Nayuta, has already done his interview. Don't even dream of getting out of this!"
Galore: "What did he say?'"
Dorothy: "He said, 'I'm very honored,' and then he left."
Galore: "In that case, I'm also very—"
Dorothy: "Nuh-uh! Come on, tell us how you feel after receiving the chocolate coin personally awarded by the Conductor. Are you happy? Excited?"
Galore: "I-I... Um, I'll have to keep the chocolate coin safe. Some pets, like dogs, might get poisoned if they eat it..."
Dorothy: "Huh?! You're gonna feed the prize that the Conductor personally gave you to dogs?! Unbelievable!"
Galore: "No!!! That's not what I meant!"
Dorothy: "Ah, forget it. Then... Wait, let me check my notes... It was pretty tense between you and Nayuta for a bit in the middle of the competition. What was it that made you two eventually put aside your mutual animosity and shake hands to make peace?"
Galore: "Nayuta's magic is fantastic. We purely approved of each other's skills. There was no mutual animosity."
Dorothy: "Are you sure?! But you two looked soooo terrifying during the competition, as though you wished you could kill each other with your gaze!"
Galore: "I said we don't... (sighs) This is exhausting... Can we just wrap this up already...?"
des.被多次提醒“不适合当魔术师”以后，伽罗尔其实有些沮丧。但那时他对自己的佣兵工作相: After facing numerous comments suggesting he was ill-suited to be a magician, Galore grew somewhat frustrated. However, he found fulfillment in his role as a mercenary and harbored no ambitions of becoming a true magician. As a second-rate magician, he had no aspirations for fame or glory, and his primary goal was to fulfill his duties punctually. The life of a mercenary was clear-cut: follow instructions, complete assignments, and receive compensation. This straightforward approach suited him well. He appreciated the absence of intricate relationships or concerns about popularity — it was the ideal occupation for him.\nNevertheless, when his fellow mercenaries playfully dubbed him "Flamingo" in reference to his hair color, Galore began to question his place in this profession.Amidst his inner turmoil, Galore encountered a pink-feathered owl during a mission. The owl trailed him back to the mercenaries' quarters, seemingly identifying a kindred spirit in Galore due to their matching hair hues. It was then that the owl was named "Flamingo," relieving Galore of his irritating nickname. Subsequently, the owl started bring a variety of stray animals to Galore's abode, seeking refuge as if intuiting a place of safety... This trend persisted until Galore contemplated departing from his mercenary role to establish his own pet emporium.
des.带着一群收留的奇怪动物，伽罗尔来到地上，开了一家宠物店，直接取名为“火烈鸟”。而:
With an array of peculiar creatures under his guardianship, Galore ventured to the surface and opened a pet store, naming it directly after Flamingo. Even on the surface, the owl persisted in venturing out and returning with fresh additions to their eclectic collection. Fortunately, Galore's pet store gained renown in Shoggolith City, attracting customers eager to adopt and nurture these distinctive pets. The owl occasionally absconded from the store, only to return bearing curious discoveries.
However, on one occasion, the owl did not return to the store at his usual time. Fearing for his companion's safety, Galore promptly set out to search for him. He eventually located Flamingo perched on a tree, fixated on a particular direction a few blocks away. Following the owl's gaze, Galore spotted a large eagle resting on a little girl's head nearby.
This encounter led to the meeting of Tara, Cook, Galore, and Flamingo. Over time, Tara and Galore grew acquainted, with Tara occasionally visiting his pet store for supplies. Cook and Flamingo also struck up a bond... though the extent to which Flamingo incessantly pursued Cook around the house raised questions about the nature of their relationship.
When Galore boarded the Eternal, Flamingo was absent — that was exactly the reason for his decision to embark on this journey. One day, Flamingo trailed Tara and Cook out of Shoggolith City and never came back. To reunite with his beloved owl companion, Galore entrusted his pet store to Olivien and set off on the adventure.
des.在战场上，静流是一丝不苟的战地指挥官；在执行任务时，她是严格遵守铁盟规章条例的蜜:
On the battlefield, Shizuru is a conscientious field commander, but she's also the captain of Team Ratel, who strictly abides by the BCRL's rules and regulations when on missions. There are always people who hold themselves to a high standard, and Shizuru is unquestionably one of them. Such self-discipline makes her look difficult to approach, particularly for people who've only heard of her name and never had any in-depth interactions with her.

Be that as it may, her teammates do not really fear her. Julian and Dorothy have always thought of Shizuru as "not that intimidating, just not great at socializing," while Karen, as Shizuru's diehard fan, can't even stand to hear anyone badmouth her idol. Evidently, regardless of her identity as a commander or captain, the responsibilities she shoulders have not changed her intrinsic nature; Shizuru is still Shizuru.

Still, what exactly must she become in order to deem that she has "changed"? Is the current Shizuru really still the same girl from Fortress City who never concedes defeat?
des.静流被叫进长官办公室谈话的那天，她清楚地记得，她在打开门前深呼吸了三次。\r长官:
Shizuru remembers vividly that on the day her presence was demanded in the chief's office, she had sucked in three sharp breaths before opening the door.

She solemnly read the three documents on the desk that the chief slid toward her... Shooting, precision bombing, sprinting, and melee combat... These three people, as soldiers, all had results that stood out in these aspects. In fact, she could tell from the written results what kind of position they would be assigned to and felt like her abilities were nothing to write home about in comparison with theirs.

To her surprise, the chief still expressed his hope for Shizuru to lead this little team. She practically froze in her spot, unable to comprehend why she could receive such an opportunity. Thereafter, bearing the immense pressure from herself and the outside world, she worked hard to become a competent captain.

When she accepted that opportunity, some thoughts about the things she could do with that title came to mind, albeit only for a moment, and they involved a certain person who remains oblivious to this day. The question that she has asked herself umpteen times will perhaps only be answered in a more distant future.
des.蜜獾小队执行任务的效率在相同服役年份的铁盟小队中是领先的，光是这一项就已经值得作:
Team Ratel's efficiency in mission execution is leading among the BCRL teams who have been in service for the same number of years. Just this fact alone is enough to make Shizuru, the captain, proud for ages. It's precisely because of this brilliance that Team Ratel is continuously assigned to all sorts of dangerous missions, making them face numerous life-threatening situations altogether. To Shizuru, there's no one in her team who she wouldn't trust her life with.

Yet, for some reason, opinions of Team Ratel within BCRL were differing. There were other teams who were jealous of Team Ratel's success and also some people with grudges against specific team members. Though mission results couldn't be forged, their reports, evaluations, and colleagues' opinions never failed to cause some kind of problem.

Shizuru never once shirked her responsibilities in these times in spite of being poor at managing these complex interpersonal relations. Time and time again, she stepped forward as the captain to iron things out, gradually earning the understanding and respect of others. Even her teammates couldn't really make sense of this perseverance of hers. They all felt that there was no need for Shizuru to take it upon herself to shoulder these extra responsibilities, saying that they didn't mind not being welcomed.

But Shizuru answered, "It's exactly because you guys think this way that worries me. I genuinely believe all Team Ratel members are exceptionally outstanding and should be given the respect we deserve..."

"In other words, Shizuru, you're also tooting your own horn, huh?"

"...I didn't say that. Anyway, I hope we can all be proud of our team as a whole."
des.高中、铁盟训练营、铁安局，静流一路辗转，终于找到了自己的安身之所。最初离开铁山城:
From high school to the BCRL training camp and then the BCRL Agency... Shizuru finally found where she belonged after all these twists and turns. At first, she had left Fortress City to join the BCRL only to lighten her father's financial burden and gain independence earlier, but now, she has come this far. This thought always leaves her finding everything surreal.

In truth, Shizuru, who was one of the people her friends and classmates trusted most since young, often felt as though she had long lost touch with her past life. The friends she met in the city had all begun their own separate journeys, while the person she cared about most had also become a conductor and started a new life. All this while, what motivated her to work hard was her goal of becoming someone stronger and more remarkable so as to stand alongside, and even protect, the people she cares about. But before accomplishing that goal, she had no idea what to do with herself.

After much contemplation, amid work and continuous self-improvement, Shizuru eventually tried to reach out to Conductor with simple greetings like "I've arrived at a new Bonfire City," or "The route you're driving isn't safe lately." Even though these texts were of little importance, Conductor never failed to reply to each one earnestly, which made Shizuru feel like their relationship hadn't changed, though they had indeed grown apart in distance.

That said, Shizuru still lost her cool upon seeing the numerous speeding and violation tickets issued by the BCRL to The Eternal. She whipped out her communicator angrily and contacted Conductor, exclaiming, "Keep doing anything so reckless for any reason, and I'll go over right away to teach you a lesson!"
des.自小被细心呵护着长大的卡莲，没有养成什么蛮不讲理的作风，对于父亲方方面面过度保护: Reared with tenderness from her earliest years, Karen never learned the ways of unreasoning obstinacy, and had even shown understanding for her father's excessive vigilance in managing her life. Yet neither was she docile by temperament—so when it came to a matter as momentous as her own marriage, decided without a word to her, she made her displeasure plain and left home without hesitation. It was thus that she came to meet Shizuru—an encounter Karen herself would call something "fated," the sort found in films, though Shizuru insisted it was "nothing so dramatic." What passed through Karen's heart in that moment remains uncertain; but plainly, to a girl who had just torn herself, in despair, from the hothouse of her former life, the hand Shizuru extended meant something beyond the ordinary.\n\nAfter leaving home, Karen, possessed of no small savings, could easily have lived at ease regardless. Yet during the very time she was under Shizuru's care, upon learning Shizuru had enrolled in BCRL's recruit training camp, Karen quietly submitted an application of her own. Many doubted it was anything more than a passing whim, or wondered whether she'd truly reckoned with the training's difficulty. And indeed, in those early days, Karen was known to grumble through drills, wail the moment her strength gave out, and mutter despondently at every order given. All of it she now regards as a "dark chapter"—and if raised to her face, she might well deny it outright, for she is, after all, most particular about the impression she leaves in Shizuru's eyes.
des.大概是因为从前想要的东西基本都能得到，又或者天性使然，卡莲从不会把达成什么目标、:
Perhaps because she had, in her earlier years, wanted for nothing that was not given her—or perhaps simply by nature—Karen never regarded the attainment of a goal, the accomplishment of a task, as something beyond her reach, even when, at times, it plainly was. She possessed a tenacity and patience beyond her years, and deep within her lay a quiet pride that would not easily concede defeat. And so, having once walked out of that grand house and away from her father's watchful governance, she never once considered returning to it; and when she came, almost at once, to realize that Shizuru was not the sort of match convention would call suitable, the flame already kindled in her heart refused, all the same, to be extinguished.

This flower, raised so long within a hothouse, proved unexpectedly resilient in the world beyond it. Though every instructor there had marked her as the one most likely to fall first, Karen endured to the very end of the training selection. Even those among her peers who had dismissed her, at first, as nothing more than a spoiled and pampered young lady came, in time, to acknowledge her extraordinary force of will. By her own effort alone, she won the recognition of everyone around her, and became, at last, a proper member of Team Ratel—a companion now standing shoulder to shoulder with Shizuru herself.

Wholehearted in all she did, Karen met with no small number of setbacks along the way, and yet she rose each time without hesitation and pressed onward still—a quality her comrades came to rely upon, one that let her serve, almost improbably, as an active and capable member of the BCRL forces. And yet, for all that, her feelings toward Shizuru have made little progress; Shizuru has never taken her words to heart, and so it remains, entirely and only, a love that Karen carries alone.
des.虽然担任着医疗兵的职责，不过卡莲在受训前几乎没有见过任何关于战场、伤员的景象。在:
Though her duties lay in field medicine, Karen had, before her training, laid eyes on scarcely a single battlefield or wounded soldier in all her life. At home, even the smallest scrape she might earn tripping on a step would bring a small army of servants rushing to her side... and so, the first time she underwent first-aid training at the BCRL camp, the shock of it struck her hard.

The wounds simulated by the training equipment were rendered with unsettling realism, and many recruits unaccustomed to blood and violence found themselves fainting outright, or forced to retch before they could continue at all. The instructors were unforgiving on this point: "If you cannot bear even this much, you have no business calling yourself a medic." No small number gave up then and there, transferring to other divisions instead.

Karen, needless to say, was sick to her stomach and nearly fainted from sheer exhaustion.
