Even once she had grasped the theory of bandaging and emergency care, her trembling hands could scarcely carry out the proper procedure. And yet this girl, whom everyone had marked as the first to fall, cast aside, in that moment, the very pampered nature she had carried since childhood, and forced herself, through sheer clenched will, to endure the nausea and fear and practice again, and again, and again. After an entire afternoon of failure upon failure, she at last completed the bandaging procedure exactly as required. Her instructor came to her side, acknowledged what she had accomplished, and told her to go rest. But the moment Karen finally allowed herself to relax, she sat down on the ground and wept without restraint—until at last the instructor had no choice but to ask Shizuru, who happened to be passing by, to walk her back to the dormitory.

Now, after all manner of trials since, Karen can perform battlefield first aid with practiced skill—and yet she still remembers, quite clearly, what it felt like the first time her own two hands bandaged another's wound. Hands that had once been able to master nothing at all can now save the lives of the people around her... and Karen believes, in complete sincerity, that there is no finer work in all the world than this.
des.在离家之前，卡莲认为爱就是无微不至的保护。父亲不仅在物质上做到完全满足，精神上也:
Before she left home, Karen believed love meant boundless, meticulous protection. Her father saw to it that she wanted for nothing, material or otherwise, forever asking after her comfort and well-being. Though his anxieties ran to excess—fretting over the smallest scratch as though it were some grave misfortune—Karen had believed this to be love in its truest form.

It was only when her father, heedless of her own feelings, arranged her marriage without so much as a word of consultation, that Karen came at last to a sudden understanding, caught between astonishment and fury: that forcing upon another what one believes to be good, without regard for how that person actually feels, is no love at all—not the kind that could bring happiness to someone truly dear to you.

Leaving home. Meeting Shizuru. Enrolling at the BCRL training camp. Becoming a field medic with Team Ratel. Through it all, Karen found herself searching again and again for an answer to a single question: what, in truth, was love, rightly understood? Though she resented her father's high-handedness, she found herself treating Shizuru in the very same manner he had once shown her—fine clothes, delicate ornaments, whatever caught her own fancy pressed upon Shizuru without a second thought. But Shizuru wanted none of it, and found herself only troubled by such gifts.

From gazing at Shizuru's back as she walked ahead, to walking now at her side, Karen came in time to notice something. Whenever Shizuru spoke of her childhood friend, a certain smile would rise unbidden to her face; and seeing it, Karen felt all at once that she understood something at last. Strangely, there was no bitterness in it, no sense of loss—only, at the sight of Shizuru's unguarded joy, a quiet and peaceful happiness that filled her heart entirely. When Shizuru was glad, Karen found that she too could not help but feel glad in turn.

Perhaps, by then, she had already found her answer.
des.还在铁盟训练营的时候，雷火给大家的印象是一个难以接近的、完全没有社交的打算的女孩: While in the B.C.R.L.'s training camp, Reika gave everyone the impression that she was an unapproachable girl with no intentions of making friends, causing her peers who were assigned to work with her as a group to have difficulties communicating with her. She totally refused to work with her partners and exhibited distrust toward them when things were clearly going well, and she even accused others of being 'two-faced' when they did their best to compromise.
des.虽然搞不懂雷火选择那种“刻薄”的说话方式的原因，但狐獴小队的伙伴们早已经习惯自觉:
Although they're clueless as to why Reika chooses to communicate so 'rudely,' Team Meerkat's members have long gotten used to reflexively overlooking her excessively unkind words. No one else can compare to them in recognizing Reika's strength and reliability, considering how long they've spent working with her as a team. She's not only fantastic at managing explosives but also relatively perceptive and cautiously bold. In their various missions, the teammates who put their lives in Reika's hands can all sense that in spite of her cold outward appearance, she's absolutely a dependable partner.
Contrary to how outsiders think of Reika as "malicious," the members of Team Meerkat find her highly sensitive and overly anxious, even somewhat cute. At least, that's what it looks like whenever she constantly suspects someone's following them, is on high alert over any Single noise or movement, and repeatedly inspects their equipment on every mission. Once this impression formed in their minds, they automatically began coming up with logical reasons as to why Reika would never use anybody's stuff and always ate by herself.
Without any overly zealous members on the team, none of them have taken Reika's insistence of "drawing lines with others" to heart. Instead, they always reassure her whenever she plans to take apart her equipment and inspect them, which naturally bewilders Reika, though she does quietly accept their tangible kindness.
Team Meerkat's members may have already established trust with Reika, but evidently, it's still a ways to go before she will truly open up and help them understand why she lives this way and is so distrusting toward others.
des.除了铁盟安排的宿舍，雷火更倾向于独自居住，但显然不是为了追求“年轻人独居的十项超: Excluding the dormitory assigned by the B.C.R.L., Reika is more inclined to living alone, though it clearly isn't to pursue the "ten awesome benefits of youngsters' solitary living" but for the sake of better security. She typically doesn't invite anyone to her home either; if it's absolutely necessary to go near her residence, it should best be done under her company and supervision... After all, all types of devices' shadows can be seen through the gaps in the curtains at the windows.According to Reika, she has designed a couple of escape routes, installed wall-to-wall surveillance cameras and anti-theft devices, and also fitted heavy firearms by the windows, staircase, and balcony in her ordinary home. As for daily necessities, she has set up a designated collection spot near her home with the logistics company, and she would pick them up herself. Her brow was permanently furrowed as she revealed this, albeit it didn't seem to be out of awkwardness. Rather, it made her incredibly uncomfortable to introduce these defense systems one by one. She followed by adding, "It's okay. I'll modify them and swap their spots after you leave."...On the bright side, should The Eternal ever require all sorts of defense systems, you could definitely ask for Reika's help. It's probably for the best not to wonder if her home's defense is an overkill for now.
des.武装到牙齿的雷火，其实也有疲惫的时候。保持多疑和不信任他人的状态固然能保证她的“: Albeit armed to the teeth, Reika does have times when she's exhausted as well. Sure, staying suspicious and not trusting others can ensure her "safety," but the mental toll is equally immense, not to mention that she's a pessimist.Reika had always been popular among children since a young age and was relatively well-liked by her peers despite her slight competitiveness. But with her astuteness, she could always sense the signs of lies and deceptions. As time passed, it dawned on her that the admiration from her so-called "friends" was insincere. The biggest blow dealt to her was when she found out that her best friend only hung out with her out of social pressure and, in fact, detested her to the core.From then on, the once cheerful and admired Reika completely gave up on socializing and began displaying massive distrust toward everybody around her. She gradually spoke ill of the hypocrites she knew, virtually begging to be an outcast in the eyes of others. Years later, she ultimately became the B.C.R.L. soldier you are all familiar with.However, after experiencing plenty of things and meeting lots of people, Reika has also found something she cherishes—a myriad of pets she keeps at home. Unlike humans, these innocent animals deserve her complete devotion, always welcoming her merrily whenever they hear the front door unlocking. The other members of Team Meerkat are the exception whom Reika can rest her eyes at ease with, too. Even though she hasn't lowered her guard against all the potential threats in the world, just let her catch a break at least in these moments of tranquility.
des.能够在战场上拾得的包裹，内含一件珍贵的装备。: A package that can be found on the battlefield. Contains an Epic equipment.
des.能够在战场上拾得的包裹，内含一件常见的装备，偶尔也会有打开后获得了更加优质的装备: A package that can be found on the battlefield. Contains a Common equipment. Occasionally, you may also open it to find better equipment.
des.能够在战场上拾得的包裹，内含一件稀少的装备，偶尔也会有打开后获得了更加优质的装备: A package that can be found on the battlefield. Contains a Rare equipment. Occasionally, you may also open it to find better equipment.
des.能够在战场上拾得的包裹，内含一件常见的黑月制式装备，偶尔也会有打开后获得了更加优: A package found on the battlefield, containing a Common piece of Night Chains equipment. This package might may contain more advanced equipment.
des.能够在战场上拾得的包裹，内含一件稀少的黑月制式装备，偶尔也会有打开后获得了更加优: A package found on the battlefield, containing a Rare piece of Night Chains equipment. This package might may contain more advanced equipment.
des.能够在战场上拾得的包裹，内含一件珍贵的黑月制式装备。: A package found on the battlefield, containing an Epic piece of Night Chains standard equipment.
des.能够在战场上拾得的包裹，内含一件珍贵的学会制式装备。: A package found on the battlefield, containing an Epic piece of Citadel standard equipment.
des.在艾略特加入伊敦恩城的城防体系成为一名士兵后不久，大家就察觉到了她的与众不同之处: Not long after Eliot joined Edunn City's armed forces as a soldier, everybody noticed what stood out about her. She always preferred doing things on her own and appeared unmotivated, not to mention being quite disregarding of rules. Her nonchalant attitude upset some of the members of her troop and naturally caught the attention of her team captain, Fran.\nIt was only after putting in lots of effort to understand Eliot that Fran learned the former had always been in the hunting business prior to this, with superb hunting skills that everyone in her hometown knew, particularly her mind-boggling competency at archery. Putting together these things and Eliot's performance during training, people eventually acknowledged that she wasn't just a lucky, good-for-nothing person who enlisted by chance.
des.作为习惯了山野间自由生活的猎人，加入城防部队这种选择实在很不符合艾略特的作风。实: As a hunter who's acclimatized to living in the wilds, Eliot choosing to join the armed forces was truly out of character for her. In actuality, this decision of hers was majorly influenced by her father. She didn't have any memories of her mother, but her taciturn father had always silently shown her concern through actions and was also the one who introduced her to hunting.\nEliot's innate talent and rapidly establishing interest soon left her obsessed with this sport, and her father supported her hobby despite hoping she could live a much stabler life. However, the wilds weren't her sole focus. A thought formed within her as she observed her father's progressively hunched back view.\nIn the end, Eliot accepted the suggestion he once gave her—join the Bonfire City's armed forces. As she had only made this uncharacteristic decision to appease her father, the moment she received news that he had passed on, she completely lost all motivation to continue staying in the troop.
des.离开伊敦恩城的城防体系以后，艾略特明显过得比之前开心了许多。她回到了自幼生活的小: Following her resignation from Edunn City's armed forces, Eliot lived visibly happier than she did before, returning to her childhood home and getting by by hunting. She no longer had to be woken up by Fran to patrol every morning, endure the dry and hard rations provided by the cafeteria, and be forced to stay in the camp. To her, this was the kind of carefree lifestyle she had always yearned for! Even now, she still misses how free and easy things were back then.\nThough she has joined The Eternal, Eliot has never thought about giving up on her laidbackness and her pursuit of a comfortable lifestyle. There's only a limited number of things worth enjoying in life, so if that's the case, she sees no problem in napping in a cozy spot in the warehouse while no one's paying attention, albeit her shut-eyes are consistently interrupted by Fran's search operations, and she'll have to flee from her hiding spot with her head in her hands to return to work.\nScenes like that virtually occur on the train once every couple of days, so everyone has gotten used to it. In fact, the duo looks as though they kind of have fun with it, but it's most likely not the case... or is it?
des.艾略特的“潇洒生活”的结束与列车生活的开始，似乎都是由于弗兰。在荒野中的小屋里，:
The end of Eliot's "carefree life" and the start of her life on the train seem to both be thanks to Fran. Nobody knows what agreement they came to in the hut in the wilderness, but regardless, as per COLUMBA's registration records, the two of them had joined the crew of The Eternal on the same day.
Eliot has loads of bad habits, such as spending her salary on lottery tickets to try her luck and frequently going missing in action from work, but in critical junctures, her capability and performance make her look like a mature, steadfast hunter. To quote Fran's words, Eliot is like a battery that needs to be charged, but you'll never know when you ever need it.
Meanwhile, the "battery" herself appears to think it will be best if she's never needed so that she can continue lazing comfortably in places only she knows, sneaking out of the train to buy lottery tickets from time to time, and feasting on meat that she barbecued and hunted by herself at any time... There's nothing she wants more than to keep going on this journey this merrily and relaxedly.
From an outsider's point of view, Eliot seems to constantly cause trouble for Fran, and things like "What will happen to Eliot if she doesn't have Fran anymore?" tend to travel to Eliot's ears. But in reality? Eliot herself will not refute such comments. She will simply smile and bob her head, saying, "Yeah, if only Fran thinks so too."
As for what that sentence implies, perhaps it's something only the two of them will ever know.
des.从TMT——也就是列车组乘员资格培训学校毕业时，作为综合成绩出类拔萃的优秀学员，: When graduating from TMT, the train crew training school, Livia, with her stellar overall results, had plenty of career paths more glamorous than being a conductor's assistant. Many CoC more prominent than COLUMBA sent her offers, and everybody believed that this impressive girl would have phenomenal job prospects. Yet, Livia still chose COLUMBA, a much more average CoC in comparison, for in her heart, Signora Medici had saved her life; joining COLUMBA to contribute what she could was the only thing she felt she could do to repay that debt of gratitude.\nTruth be told, there was also a bit of personal motive involved in this decision: Livia looked forward to meeting that most special former classmate of hers in COLUMBA again, as she knew that person would definitely become a conductor. Perhaps this was the real reason why she gave up on the opportunity to train and work in CoC management.
des.莉薇娅没有关于自己的记忆。她记得曼杜斯帝国的风土人情和社会常识，可是唯独不记得和: Livia has no memory concerning herself. She remembers the customs and general knowledge of the Mundus Empire, but anything about herself is a mystery. Who am I? Where did I come from? At the thought of these, her mind doesn't draw a blank, but she still can't grasp any direct answers, and it's truly frustrating. Even consulting professionals hasn't helped with resolving her situation.\nThere isn't any memory of her living in the Empire when she looks back on her vivid recollections. All she's sure of is that she needed to leave the Empire to look for someone on the surface, but who could that person be?\nAfter losing touch with her old friend Connor, Livia, like most Empire citizens, relied on her ascension abilities to work as a freelance mercenary, experiencing tons of ups and downs and fortuitously receiving help from Signora Medici... until obtaining her current job as the conductor's assistant on The Eternal. The starting point of everything seems to be when she first arrived on the surface, as if it was only in that moment that she truly began living.
des.在黑月中，有不少武学世家出身的成员，他们往往自幼就接受了系统的训练，与那些半路出: In Night Chains, there are plenty of members who were born into martial arts families and mostly received methodical training from a young age, which naturally made their abilities strikingly different from those without that background. As a result, it's inevitable that some of them tend to look down on these less experienced martial artists.\nBut Lin had never once been underestimated this way. Although she also got into it late in life at around high school age, her mentor—addressed as 'Miss Toki' by others—was fairly admired in Night Chains. Therefore, no one would disregard Lin's capability based on her unassuming exterior when she was the protégé who had earned Toki' approval. On top of that, Lin often gave it her all during training, not allowing herself to stop despite collapsing from fatigue and being covered in cuts and bruises. Her persistence in pushing herself to catch up with others was pretty much on an unimaginable level.\nAt present, she who has slowly grown stronger and become a stunner no longer bears any semblance to that unremarkable girl she used to be. Perhaps it is precisely because she longs to break away from the bitterness of being dismissed that she treats people's compliments like her saving grace, almost ceaselessly yearning for the attention of others.
des.在网络上，有一位小有名气的一人食便当教程主播。不仅每一期教程里的便当都兼具了合理:
On the Internet exists a pretty popular content creator who teaches others how to make bentos for one. Not only does her weekly tutorials include well-thought-out pairings and aesthetically appealing presentations, but her tone of voice is also always upbeat and adorable, earning her many fans. However, what people don't realize is the multiple other identities this adorable content creator has, such as a blogger who talks about cute accessories and a devoted fan of a particular romance comic...
It's already hard for anyone to connect the dots that these seemingly unrelated accounts are all run by one person, never mind figure out that this girl, who's known to be vibrant and adorable in the online world is, in fact, someone who does covert work for Night Chains in real life. Likewise, people who know Lin in real life will 100% be baffled if they learn that she has such a lively personality online.
To Lin, it will be a disaster if anyone who knows her in real life discovers her online identities, which is why she often becomes flustered whenever someone praises her for her fast typing speed, as she fears she may inadvertently give herself away.
That said... if it's someone she's close to, Lin tends to secretly hope they will find out and admire her charm and yet also worries that such a stark contrast will cause them to view her differently. This dilemma has plagued her, persisting even to this day.
des.霖在学校中是个非常平凡的学生，在家中则是非常平凡的女儿。然而，霖总是由于这份平凡:
Lin was an extremely ordinary student in school and an extremely ordinary daughter at home. Yet, she was constantly reprimanded for this ordinariness. Although her parents' positions in the CoC weren't high, they did cross paths with people of different statuses over work matters, and this expansion of horizons kindled the yearning for a better future. Sadly, the best that the couple could do was probably just as employees of the CoC, which was why they placed all their hopes of moving up the social ladder onto their only daughter.
They kept wishing that their daughter could become more outstanding and distinguished. If Lin did not reach the standards they had for her, it meant that she must not have tried hard enough. Lin truly couldn't please her demanding parents with her limited capabilities and always had to hear them criticize her for being "so insensible despite our hard work." The sense of defeat and guilt over the years made the already introverted girl even more of a recluse. Gloomy, dull, and without any forte, she became someone overlooked by teachers and students in school. These dreary environments both at home and in school eventually led to her hearing things.
One day, after the end of the PE lesson, the health teacher of the school infirmary called out to Lin all of a sudden. This gentle, gorgeous teacher was especially popular among the students, so Lin was rather surprised.
"I noticed that you have some talent in martial arts. Will you be interested to learn from me?" asked the teacher with a smile.
This unexpected recognition, concern, and pat on the back that Lin had always longed for left her at a loss when they finally manifested, so much so that she fled like a coward. Right when she mulled it over while passing by the school's back alley, she chanced upon a scene that changed her life. Her gentle teacher was wielding a sword as a corpse lay by her feet, the corpse's bodily fluids slowly pooling on the ground...
Still, Lin did not tremble one bit, nor did she turn tail and run. The teacher who had long sensed Lin's presence handed the bloodied sword to the girl smilingly. Just like that, Toki took in the student she was most proud of.
des.最初加入黑月时，霖就舍弃了自己原来那个朴素的名字，选择了“翎”作为代号。这样的选: When Lin first joined Night Chains, she immediately gave up her original, ordinary name and chose "Quill" as her code name. This was a choice initially made out of her admiration and envy of Toki, but as her abilities grew, she was no longer content to just be praised by her mentor, and neither did she wish to be forever inferior to Toki. Simply being a subservient feather was far from enough for her. After completing yet another critical mission, she changed her code name to "Lin" to start afresh with her own identity. Toki did not stop her protégé from doing so, nor did she remind Lin that the latter was becoming more and more like her unappeasable parents.\nOutside of missions and filming, Lin is obsessed with all sorts of cute, intricate things, particularly Night Chains Land's mascot's plush toy series. Her collection can be said to be record-breaking, and it—alongside her exquisite appearance—is maintained with extraordinary effort. These adorable, sparkly things pile up to form a magical castle that lets her formerly frumpish, unconfident self hide and heal her wounds. Consequently, if anyone ever ruins her collection, they better prepare themselves to face a virtually hysterical, unhinged Lin.\nIn contrast to her love for plush toys, Lin will pretty much go to any lengths at all costs while on missions. She neither fears blood nor minds tainting herself from head to toe. However, the one thing she's afraid of is anything frail and alive, for that will jog back memories of the old her who would be helpless about everything in her surroundings. No matter how much effort it will take, Lin is willing to do it all so long as she never has to return to the time before she obtained her powers.
des.作为一名研究人员来说，瑞秋无疑是非常出色的，她往往能提出对研究进程有很大帮助的惊: There's no doubt Rachel is a phenomenal researcher, considering the astonishing insights she shares that often have tremendous impact on research processes. This gifted girl always has all sorts of far-fetched ideas and quickly finds ways to actualize them. But from another perspective, with her insatiable thirst for knowledge, she's also prone to causing trouble. Her resolve in practical applications and obtaining firsthand data trumps her concern for her own well-being, making her a known research fanatic in the research department.\nOne of the most amazing traits Rachel possesses is her out-of-the-ordinary concentration. Not even failures or any external factors can affect her. With a never-say-die belief, she isn't afraid of trying and failing again and again until achieving success. \nAs for why she chose the path of scientific research, which is bound to be arduous, she said she was inspired by a satellite launch she witnessed in person as a child. It's hardly possible to verify now how touching of a scene that must have been, but what is guaranteed is that regardless of the difficulties, Rachel will never stop in her explorations of the unknown.
des.没什么干劲的狙击手、独来独往的爆破手加上很少管闲事的队长，就是瑞秋的全部队友了，: An almost lackadaisical sniper, a reclusive demolitionist, and a captain who rarely interferes in one's personal business are the people who make up all of Rachel's team. Even though they all look like there's nothing anyone can do to surprise them, Rachel is often an exception.\nShe's an exceptionally genuine person who doesn't worry about difficulties once her mind is set on accomplishing something. Her heartfelt inquisitiveness is what made her take the initiative to leave the laboratory and enter the battlefield but also what frequently causes her to experiment and gather data without considering the consequences, like directly tasting something picked up from the ground. The first time Rachel did that in the presence of her teammates, Reika—who was initially indifferent to Rachel joining their team—was totally flabbergasted and questioned whether Rachel was an idiot before smacking her back hard to make her spit it out.\nThese occurrences resulted in several stomach aches and even warnings like "nobody will carry you to seek treatment if you're really poisoned," but the notion of kicking the bad habit never crossed Rachel's mind. Moreover, it appears that she can truly acquire some information through "taste" that others can't, and her poison tolerance is also much better than others after her body's long-term conditioning. Of course, under her teammates' supervision, she will still carry gastrointestinal medications and antidotes everywhere with her.
des.瑞秋最开始进入铁盟研究部门时，主要的研究方向是燃料。为了获得第一手资料，她申请与: When Rachel first joined the B.C.R.L.'s research department, her main research focus was on fuel, and to obtain first-hand information, she applied to partake in a B.C.R.L.'s team's mission. Unfortunately, that turned out to be a grave mistake, as they encountered a mighty Chaos Remain midway through that mission, which resulted in severe casualties. It goes without saying that the horrendous scene back then deeply traumatized Rachel. Things like "If only field surgery can be more expedient" and "If only I can better support my teammates in combat" kept popping up in her head and eventually imprinting themselves there.\nAfter returning to the research lab, Rachel flipped through stacks of field surgery-related technical reports as a bold idea slowly took shape in her mind—"If only I could design a type of multi-purpose device that can simultaneously be used for medical treatment and combat support." But then came the question—how could she get people to quickly learn the ropes of a device with so many functions and which holds various reagents, not to mention make it even more handy? She had no inspiration for a long time until that day, when she accepted an odd-tasting beverage from a salesperson.\nAll she needed to do was to make the medicines into such colorful bottles as the beverage! Rachel's inspiration hit her like a ton of bricks, so much so that she hurriedly shoved the beverage back into the salesperson's hand and dashed back to the lab. Following some time of research and development, the prototype of "Rainbow Flask" was born, earning many experts' approval and entering the experimentation phase. As for the fact that the bottle of beverage that Rachel abandoned could've actually been redeemed for the grand prize of a railway loop holiday, it's most likely something she will never get to find out anymore.
des.瑞秋喜欢的东西往往会让他人觉得很奇怪，比如猎奇口味的蛋糕和饮品，比如题材稀少、拍:
People tend to find the things that Rachel likes strange; for example, unusual-flavored cakes and drinks, niche movies with complicated filming methods, and medicines with weird colors and unknown usage. However, this doesn't mean that she doesn't understand 'common sense.' On the contrary, it proves she doesn't really mind people's opinions and the standards of what should be orthodox.
Rachel's colleagues in the research department always found her behavior incomprehensible. When she applied to become part of the B.C.R.L. field personnel in order to finalize the Rainbow Flask, she had to continually swap teams due to the inability to get along with her teammates. Nonetheless, she remained determined and ultimately got to where she is now in spite of constantly being viewed as an oddball.
Rachel's first meeting with Ganya has become a core memory of hers, though. It was during a joint mission, and she had been swapped at the last hour to Ganya's team. As per usual, Rachel did as she pleased, showing no concern for others' thoughts. All she cared about was that her invention could be finalized. Yet, when the mission ended, Ganya asked, "Would you like to join our team?"
It had been a long time since Rachel last felt so taken aback. She couldn't help clarifying, "You're being serious?"
"Although your manner of doing things seems really bizarre, I can see that all the decisions you made during combat were basically correct, and you were prompt when it came to supporting others," said Ganya candidly. "But if you join our team, I won't give you free rein either. You will absolutely be stopped if you attempt to do something weird, like eating something that was picked up from the ground."
Ganya recognized Rachel's disposition but also asked that the latter compromise and cooperate at the bare minimum. "You're only working so hard so that anyone could use the Rainbow Flask, no?" Ganya's words reminded Rachel that her invention was meant to help everyone who needed it; it wasn't something that could be achieved by one person through unceasing research.
Rachel's luck had been abnormally good since she was a child to the extent that she, who never failed to win lucky draws, had long become numb to things like winning prizes and having good fortune. On that day, however, she actually felt the kind of exhilaration and delight one would upon "hitting the jackpot."
"Getting to meet Ganya and befriending everybody in Team Meerkat are the most fortunate events in my life." Whenever Rachel says that, Team Meerkat's members will tell her to stop, but it's probably precisely because they know she means it from the bottom of her heart that makes them bashful.
des.最开始从科伦巴商会处被分派到这辆无垠号时，列车长得到的不仅仅是设备齐全的崭新列车: When first assigned to The Eternal by COLUMBA, what the Conductor got wasn't simply a brand new, all-inclusive train but also a live-in repair technician and her pet cat, who were basically freebies that came with it.\nAs a matter of fact, Haruka boarded The Eternal way before any of its crew members did and has been staying on this train for a very long time, ever since it was sent from the factory to COLUMBA, which is frankly mind-blowing. Even after everyone got acquainted with each other, neither the Conductor nor Livia, who had to deal with all kinds of stuff, nor Fran and Eliot, who took care of security, ever saw Haruka leave the train. Their invitations to her that warrant getting off the train constantly end in rejection as well.\nNonetheless, she lives and works fine despite never leaving the train, and everyone respects her habit, though they do have plenty of questions. Does she plan to live on the train forever? How did she live before this? Alas, no one can answer these but Haruka.
des.偶尔，遥会在收到自己的包裹后表现出特别高兴的模样。虽然和常人的标准相比不能算是“: From time to time, Haruka will look especially happy when she receives a package for her. Although it's not exactly the general standard for "overjoyed," it's already a rare show of excitement when it's her mood in question, and the only thing that can elicit such joy in her has to be related to the present most popular pop singer, Heath David. Sometimes, it's an album of his, and other times, it's his poster... Even BOX's multifunctional media player has played his music umpteen times.\nIn Haruka's heart, David is the king of music who's capable of resonating with her down to her soul. Aside from The Eternal and Dpdo, Heath David is the only other topic that can interest her in a conversation, and yet she, a devoted fan of his, has never once attended his concert and insists that she can appreciate his music without having to leave the train.
des.遥是出生在列车上的孩子。十几年前，技术的不成熟导致列车安全性远不如现在，铁路运输:
Haruka was born on a train over a decade ago when Tech was in its early stages of development, making train safety far from what it is at present. It was a time when railway transportation carried enormous risks, and people working in this field were regarded as those who could travel to another world. By chance, two workers met on the train and fell in love, leading to the birth of one of many "train babies." She was named Haruka.
Haruka almost never spent her life outside of the train. Even if she did, she no longer remembers it. Her memory is filled with her life on the trains, including but not limited to eating, sleeping, playing, and learning, so it isn't hard to see why the train is her home, especially since her parents were too busy working on the train to take her back to the city. It was the place where she spent her childhood and eventually grew up.
One night, a huge Chaos Remain damaged the top of the carriage, and Haruka groggily made eye contact with the ferocious, mouth-agaped Chaos Remain. Her screams pierced the silence of the night and fortunately awoke the adults, who made it in time to fight off the Chaos Remain without any casualty... other than Haruka's fragile heart.
From that moment on, she made up her mind on two things: 1. She would never step foot out of the train again. 2. She would never look up at the ceiling again. Her determination has led to her now being able to change the carriage's linear light bulb without having to look up, her actions so polished as though she's just changing a table lamp bulb in her own home.
des.遥作为列车技师的专业水平是无可置疑的。不少对机械学有所了解的乘员都对她的维修水平:
Haruka, as the train's technician, is indisputably well-versed in what she does. Many train crew members with knowledge of machinery have rated the standard of her repairs with flying colors, and some have even attempted to poach her. Something like "with your capability, you'll surely make a greater difference in advanced repair departments" will sound extremely tempting to any technician, but Haruka has never shown an interest.
"I'm not keen on 'making a greater difference'... My life is only meaningful if I continue living on and moving with a running train," she refused while narrowing her constantly sleep-deprived-looking eyes.
Truth be told, her excuse is flawed. If all she wants is the closed and safe environment of a train, anyone will be willing to pay the simple price of building her own carriage if it means getting someone as talented as her. Still, she turned them down.
A few years ago, the train Haruka was born on retired from service, and her parents decided to permanently settle down somewhere, thinking it was the best opportunity to take their daughter off the train. To their shock, Haruka, who had just acquired her train technician certification, refused to leave no matter what, which led to her boarding the newly operational The Eternal.
The day she stepped foot on it and faced the vacant carriages, she knew this would be where her new life began.
des.朱利安的童年是在七号自由港附近的一个贫民窟中度过的。她自幼失去了母亲，好在父亲并:
Julian's childhood was spent in a slum near Freeport Ⅶ. She lost her mother at a young age, but thankfully, her father didn't give up on taking care and educating her, nor did he sell her for money. Just this alone makes her childhood years much better than the people around her.
Still, Julian almost never brings up about her past life. The things she has occasionally talked about are her father's love for cigarettes, how the slums aren't good places, and the need to protect your head if you're unable to retaliate in a fight... It's truly hard to imagine these somewhat appalling childhood memories were the experiences of the current Julian.
After growing up, she was sent by her father to B.C.R.L.'s training camp, where she began training and learning extra hard. It was a whole new world there with easily accessible things that didn't even exist in the slums, like brand new teaching materials, unfamiliar instruments, and young, dynamic people of the same age. These were things the old Julian never even dreamed of.
Fortunately, in the end, her hard work paid off, and she became Team Ratel's vice-captain, even getting paid a decent salary. Julian's wish is to make as much money as possible so as to move her father, who's still living in the slums, to a better place.
des.朱利安在工作中表现出的基本都是冷静的一面，很有团队意识，虽说职位只是副队长，但基: Julian mostly appears composed at work and is very mindful of team spirit. She may only be a vice-captain in position, but she shares a lot of Shizuru's captain responsibilities without complaints, and even though she loathes socializing as well, she mastered the art of making small talk since Shizuru genuinely isn't able to do so.\nJulian sometimes bears the responsibility of shooting Dorothy's thrown explosives in the air, as her forte lies in archery, and she will also shoot to hold up enemies alongside Karen. This has sparked off some talk about her being a 'doormat' who lets people walk all over her. She never refutes it when she hears it, only saying blandly in response, "I guess that could be it."\nHowever, someone in B.C.R.L. has discreetly shared that anyone who has seen Julian mad will never dream about upsetting her again. The muscle lines on her arms seem to subtly back this up, too.
des.“其实朱利安很会打架哦，据说在训练营的时候有人试图……然后被她砰砰啪啪这样那样就:
"Julian is actually a terrific fighter! I heard through the grapevine that during training camp, someone tried to... and then she smacked that person down with a BAM!" shared a certain blonde demolitionist, who declined to be named, to the Conductor.
Verily, Julian's physical fitness and fighting skills are relatively impressive, but she refuses to put down her gun no matter in what circumstances these days.
This all could be traced back to when she was still tumbling in the mud of the slums. She happened to meet her neighbor, a mysterious middle-aged man, who had appeared out of nowhere and, for some reason, suddenly assisted her as she was getting beaten black and blue. The condition he proposed was, "If you trade me something, I'll teach you how to fight."
Hence, using the cigarettes she secretly stole from her father, Julian did the trade with the mysterious neighbor and began learning a one-of-a-kind fighting technique from him. As she eventually mastered it, the neighbor vanished as abruptly as he first appeared.
Only when she applied this fighting technique in real life against someone did she realize how its power far surpassed her comprehension of it, to the extent that she nearly terminated that person's future in advance. From then on, Julian laid down strict rules for herself and vowed not to use the technique unless in emergency situations.
des.如果有机会拿到朱利安加入铁盟训练营时填写的资料表格，就会发现一件有趣的事：在表情: If you have the opportunity to get your hands on the registration form Julian submitted when she joined B.C.R.L.'s training camp, you'll discover something interesting: The name written beside the photo of the steely-looking girl isn't her current cool-sounding 'Julian' but a run-of-the-mill girl name "Xiya." It has never appeared in any official name lists again ever since she officially joined B.C.R.L. and changed her name.\nTo Julian, Xiya isn't a name she dislikes; her father and people who knew her as a child still address her by it to this day. But the experiences she had as Julian are irreplaceable, although this was initially only a name meant to signify her new life and identity and a part of self-preservation, just like her impassive, overbearing attitude. The intense training she underwent in the training camp and the emotion-laden way her pals called out this name... These are what gave the name meaning and played a part in creating the present Julian.\nNevertheless, even someone who's constantly strong like her has times when she needs to take a trip down memory lane. Julian will entrust the name "Xiya" to her trusted companions and have faith that they will protect it the way they do a treasure.
des.梦玄流忍术的唯一传人，自幼修习忍道的女孩。但是，按照古老的方法独自钻研、学习忍术:
The sole successor of Mugenryu ninjutsu, a girl who practiced the way of a ninja from a young age. But learning it according to the traditional method alone was seriously way too boring, so for the most part, she merely stared at the secret books in a daze. That was until one day, all of a sudden, an enemy emerged out of thin air: Tobinezumi, the successor of Genuryu and nemesis of Mugenryu—who's close in age to Yamaarashi.
However, the discord between Mugenryu and Genuryu was a thing from generations ago. Now that times are different, the two factions have long quit going for each other's throats, and the two current leaders even became friends. Unfortunately, Yamaarashi, who was young and ignorant back then, was clueless about this and simply regarded this girl who came to visit as her enemy, which ignited immense fighting spirit within her as she made defeating Tobinezumi her goal. From then onward, learning ninjutsu and honing her craft no longer stumped her!
Although Tobinezumi left shortly after, Yamaarashi never forgot this enemy of hers. In the following years, despite them only encountering each other a couple of times, Yamaarashi kept a close eye on her enemy's movements and developments and never failed to request a ninjutsu sparring with Tobinezumi. Tobinezumi always agreed.
By the way, Yamaarashi's current record against Tobinezumi is 18 wins and 21 losses.
des.山岚目前的社会职业是私家侦探，虽然她本人好像也没有多大年纪。追踪、拍照以及收集消: Yamaarashi currently works as a private detective in spite of her fairly young age. Trailing, photographing, and collecting information are the most ideal types of work for a Mugenryu ninja, whose fundamental skill depends on concealing one's aura. Although she hasn't reached the superlative phase, these regular tasks are a breeze for her, which is why after completing her detective work, she will diligently hone her ninjutsu craft, hoping to become the most formidable ninja someday.\nIt is basically out of the question to probe Yamaarashi about crucial intel of Night Chains. She may be outgoing and talkative, but she still has the dignity and vigilance of a ninja, even though society has already modernized and there's no longer a master to serve. The same happens when she's asked about the matters of her Mugenryu associates; her answer will always be a proud "no comment," just like those fabulous ninjas in the movies.\nYamaarashi finds it way cooler to wander in the shadows of high-rise buildings every day and night and occasionally emerge smoothly than leaping onto roofs and vaulting over walls like in ancient times. Well, of course, it would be best if she could leap and vault, too!
des.平日是普通的美少女，有需要时则变身为惩恶扬善的忍者！不夸张地说，这基本就是山岚的:
A typically regular pretty young lady who transforms into a vigilante ninja when necessary! Truth be told, this is pretty much the lifestyle of Yamaarashi, but she seems to always wonder if she can become cooler, more impressive, and much closer to an actual superhero. Her favorite form of entertainment is watching anime and special effects films regarding identity transformations.
The revenue of the detective agency is fairly good, allowing Yamaarashi's family, who used to depend on Mugenryu, to live much more comfortably. At first, Yamaarashi was quite ashamed to speak of her "photography career," but now, she's already practiced at explaining her job scope and collecting payments from her clients. In her view, there's nothing to be ashamed of when she's simply earning a living with her own skillset!
However, despite no longer being in financial difficulties, Yamaarashi did not develop her hobby into a stage where she'd splurge on merchandise and costumes. She has long planned out various methods of entry, the specific angle of her finger while pointing at villains, and the final pose after completing her missions; yet, she could never resolve to put on those exaggerated costumes.
That doesn't stop her from lingering outside specialist costume stores every now and then, though. Sometimes, she will even sneak into them alongside other customers and try on the looks of the few series she loves. Who knows, perhaps someday, she may just make up her mind to ring something up at last.
des.山岚其实对忍术有些别样的追求。相比“宿敌”跳鼠做忍者只是为了追寻自己的明星梦，山:
In truth, Yamaarashi has somewhat different goals for ninjutsu, unlike her "nemesis" Tobinezumi, who only became a ninja to pursue her celebrity dream. The thought of straying from her path has never crossed Yamaarashi's mind... for she has learned ninjutsu from a young age, and she does believe she's gifted in this aspect. So what if she can't defeat Tobinezumi once and for all anytime soon? She knows it's only a matter of sooner or later.
Nonetheless, in spite of her hard work, Yamaarashi does encounter some unresolvable problems at times, such as ancestral items suddenly jamming, her massive shuriken causing a gaping hole in the ground, and the failure to recall sealing gestures at critical junctures... These minor troubles do not result in irredeemable consequences, but they never fail to eat away at Yamaarashi. Alas, there isn't anyone her age in her family for her to rant to, and even the people on The Eternal who can understand these frustrations of hers are few and far between.
One time, while discreetly crying over these minor troubles, Yamaarashi—through her blurred vision—accepted a cup of ice cream from someone unknown. She wept and vented her frustrations, having zero courage to even lift her head. By the time she finally looked up sobbingly, that girl her age had already left, leaving behind a cup of melted ice cream on the carriage floor.
It is Yamaarashi's hope that she can befriend that girl one day.
des.无垠号乘员档案系统读取中……\r读取完成。正在播放的记录是：【B.D.S.A.-:
Retrieving The Eternal's crew database...
Successfully retrieved. Currently playing Record No.: [B.D.S.A.-045].

All current The Eternal's crew members' information has been entered and evaluated in the database. My understanding of humans and the way their society operates has progressively improved through conversations with the crew. Prior to this, my primary task was to "observe and detail the work of humans," but since my activation to the time of this ongoing record, I have cognized that what the train crew of CBCRR23 The Eternal requires isn't "assistance." Instead, in keeping with the language habits of humans, the appropriate descriptive term would be: companionship.

The majority of The Eternal's train crew members have treated me cordially and on equal grounds. Therefore, I ought to respond in a comparable manner. The following have been downloaded: Heath David's latest album, 100 top-rated fairy tale books, Tasty Cakes of Bonfire Cities Ranking List (already excluded stores with above average prices), lottery ticket purchasing guide... and more databases.
Additionally, my previous request to retrieve part of the Conductor's information was approved a couple of days ago. The Conductor's resume will be reviewed shortly.
des.为了避免可能会有的误会，与狮鬃结交后不久，“她”，或者说“他们”就会向新朋友说明:
Once Solum befriends someone new, to avoid any potential misunderstanding, "she"—or rather "they"—will inform them about her situation: "Solum" is, in fact, a shared identity between a pair of twin brother and sister.
The "Solum" who's conversing right now is actually the "consciousness" of the older twin brother that's attached to the helmet, while the body belongs to the sister. Most times, the brother is the one who communicates with others.
Unlike the impression that their petite frame gives, Solum possesses immense strength and an utterly swift and violent combat style. Abruptly bursting out a power that their physical constitution typically should not possess and using their appearance to lower their enemy's guard to deal a heavy blow are the tried and tested tactics Solum has used on the battlefield.
Truthfully, to refrain from burdening the sister's body, Solum has already eased up on their combat style. "After all, I used to be an almost two-meter-tall man!" was what she said.
des.狮鬃出生于岚心城外的贫民窟。在他还小的时候，岚心城进行了一次扩建，贫民窟的孩子得:
Solum was born in a slum outside Ranshin City. When he was still a child, Ranshin City underwent an expansion, providing the slum children a chance to live and study in the city, but he was always ostracized by others due to his humble background and for being poor at his studies. The numerous conflicts that eventually developed into physical clashes ultimately made him drop out of school, though thankfully, he didn't just give up on himself.
Not wanting his behavior to affect how others treat his sister, Solum chose to contribute to urban construction after leaving school and was quickly recognized for his naturally advantageous physique and brilliant performance. After work, he'd put in a lot of hard work to improve the neighborhood he resided in, which attracted the attention of people who subconsciously began relying on him. This became a perfect opportunity for him to gather these people to work on improving their living environment altogether.
When Solum left the construction company, he and his small team founded a private security team that maintained peace and stability at the borders. With their hard work, a prominent decrease in all sorts of conflicts was noted, but a bunch of people began seeing the security team as an adversary, for the team had caused them financial losses. One night, these resentful people attacked Solum. In his last moments, all that filled his mind was his worry for his sister, and without warning, his ascension abilities were awakened.
His unique ascension abilities transferred his consciousness and strength to his motorcycle helmet, allowing him to communicate with his sister through telepathy from then on. Even though he would be able to temporarily exert power through his sister's body if she put on the helmet, to avoid drawing their adversaries' attention to her, the siblings came to a decision to join the secretive Night Chains to make a living, and Night Chains also welcomed them with open arms.
des.偶尔，在和狮鬃聊天时，“妹妹”会回忆起过去和哥哥一同生活的时光。她在社团活动结束:
Once in a while, when chatting with Solum, the 'sister' will recall the times when she lived with her brother. She would rush out of school after club activities ended, go to the supermarket at the corner of her home street to get discounted groceries, and then head home with shopping bags in her hands, yelling 'I'm home!' at the doorway. That tiny, worse-for-wear apartment might not be worth mentioning to others, but it was purchased with the money Solum earned with blood, sweat, and tears, a warm refuge for the siblings.
Usually, the brother would come home before sunset and make the only food he was good at making—curry rice. While he busied himself in the kitchen, the sister would tidy up the rest of the apartment or sort out the homework she brought home from school. By the time dusklight shone into the small room, the brother would be done making dinner. All the meat that was already placed on the sister's plate would be discreetly returned to his by her while he was distracted.
Sometimes, when the brother had work and couldn't come home, he never failed to give the sister a call, speaking at the top of his lungs, "I'll be home late tonight! Eat on your own, okay? Don't go hungry!"
That evening was the only time she sat waiting on the dining chair until night fell, and he still didn't come home.
des.这段时间以来，虽然只能以一个头盔的身份在列车上生活，但狮鬃还是很开心的。用他自己:
Even though Solum can only live on the train as a helmet these days, he's still really happy. According to him, he has found solace among a bunch of weirdos. "I know Night Chains has no lack of weirdos either, but it's different on The Eternal! You get it, right?"
Right after he said that, a certain passing Night Chains member knocked the helmet cheekily. "Are you hinting that us Night Chains peeps aren't good enough?"
Of course, that wasn't Solum's intention, but he seemed to genuinely like the vibe on The Eternal. To express that he shared the same sentiment as his sister, he purposely returned control of the body to his sister temporarily, attempting to let the shy and quiet girl speak for herself. Needless to say, it wasn't really a successful evasion. She merely mumbled an "I think so too" before letting him take control again.
Outside of combat and work, Solum has found a new hobby—studying curry recipes from everywhere to try making different but absolutely delicious curry rice. His culinary skills have definitely improved, his testers receiving raving reviews from the other crew members.
Should you visit the dining carriage at dinnertime, you might just be able to bump into the Solum siblings making a new type of curry rice.
des.塔拉在曼杜斯帝国度过了平静的童年。在她的生活中，与遥远外界的联系仅限于父亲时不时: Tara spent her childhood serenely in the Mundus Empire. In her life, the only contact she had with the faraway outside world was from the letters, photos, and strange handicrafts that her father would send from various places periodically. Of course, the most crucial thing that came with these things was her living expenses. These "gifts" might include dried branches, biological specimens, and even well-preserved eggs of certain animals, one of which was where Cook hatched from. Thank the stars what came out wasn't something dangerous!\nJust like that, Tara lived a lonely but considerably decent life in the Empire, raised and cared for by her neighbors, aunt, and friends... at least that was how it was supposed to be. In reality, as the gifts her father sent piled higher and higher on their cabinet, Tara, the daughter left behind at home, felt her resentment and fury grow as the days passed. Until one day, looking at her father smiling brightly as usual in a new photo he sent, she finally lost it and made up her mind to go punch him!\nWith that, Tara left Mundus, arriving on the surface with Cook. Needless to say, her journey here hasn't exactly been smooth sailing, but this is probably still an ongoing adventure for her.
des.塔拉和库克的关系不太像是主人和宠物，反倒更像是关系比较好的上下级。塔拉通常把库克:
The relationship between Tara and Cook isn't really that of an owner and a pet. Rather, it's more like that of a superior and a subordinate on friendly terms. Tara usually bosses Cook around as if it is her most trusted subordinate but is also especially affectionate toward it. The two could be said to be dependent on each other. As long as it's an order from Tara, Cook will obey it, including pecking someone, scouting the surroundings, and bring over whatever snack she asks for.
When Cook was still a chick, it loved standing on Tara's shoulder, but as it grew bigger and bigger, this habit had to be adjusted to fit its circumstances. After all, its wingspan was already taller than her full height. Now, one of Cook's resting spots is on Tara's head. The regular-looking hat that she typically wears isn't just for decorative purposes; despite bearing the weight and sharp claws of a raptor, it not only doesn't get flattened or shredded but even miraculously manages to remain as neat as a new pin.
On top of that, Cook is clearly a raptor yet doesn't really fancy raw meat, even having a preference for grilled bird skewers, which are on some level one of its kind. Tara shared that it was because it believed having raw meat would cause an upset stomach.
Tara does talk to Cook and vice versa, though it seems she's the only one who can understand whatever it is saying.
des.无论独自生活还是旅行都需要在经济上精打细算，因此塔拉在金钱管理方面有着远超同龄人: Whether it is living alone or traveling, they all require wise financial budgeting, which is why when it comes to money management, Tara possesses self-discipline and planning skills that far surpass people of her age, and she's a rational consumer who rarely ever splurges. Aside from when she displays her hardcore proactiveness while stocking up on discounted products, many people tend to give her a wide berth when she haggles, in spite of her looks and thoughtful demeanor.\nGenerally, Tara looks pretty laidback and easy-going, but when it comes to accounting, every single expense must be recorded in detail. Before leaving Mundus, she sold the majority of the gifts sent by her father and acquired travel funds, a huge sum of which she still has to her name with her proper budgeting.\nAs for anything else unrelated to cash flow issues, Tara isn't that hard on herself and, at times, will casually wander supermarkets alone while pushing shopping carts that are pretty much massive for her. Even without purchasing anything, it is still a kind of relaxation. In the meantime, Cook usually waits at the "special depository" outside the supermarket, dozing off with a for-show-only thin rope around its foot.
des.来到地面之前，塔拉对地面世界的了解仅仅来自于父亲寄回的照片和信中的只言片语。没有: Before Tara came to the surface, the only knowledge she had of it came exclusively from the succinct writings that came with her father's photos and letters. No high walls that block humans in, and no Wishing Tower that's the center of everything... Instead, what the surface has are "Bonfire Cities" and the endless dangers outside of them. This type of lifestyle didn't sound too great or bad, but to Tara, it was still hard to concretely visualize a world she had never personally seen herself. She didn't try to understand it better, either. All she could see in the photos were her father's permanent, overly radiant smiles that thoroughly enraged her.\nAfter her arrival on the surface, Tara finally saw the sights that appeared in those photos. Those sceneries that are nothing worth mentioning to surface dwellers turned from photos to reality at last, but she had to continue moving on to other places with Cook, as she couldn't seem to get much information about her father anywhere.\nSomehow, as time flew by, Tara discovered she now had many companions by her side, having formed the "Little Adventure Team" with Arcana and the rest and befriended loads of people on The Eternal and in Bonfire Cities. Since departing from Mundus, she has already experienced multiple adventures on the surface. Her current review of the place is "so-so," but the genuine smile on her face as she says that says it all.
des.与通常表现出来的内敛姿态不同，跳鼠拥有一颗渴望探索新鲜事物的之心。跳鼠非常喜欢光: Unlike the reticence usually exhibited by her, Tobinezumi has an inquisitive heart that yearns to try new things. She absolutely loves visiting those stalls that sell rare products or watching outdoor performances, and she knows the interesting little stores of every Bonfire City she has been to like the back of her hand. Even when she's on a mission, her interest still gets piqued by amusing, novelty stuff from time to time.\nTobinezumi struggles with staying still in one place for long periods of time. On the premise of not affecting the mission, she sometimes even goes elsewhere in the middle of it for a tour or attempts to acquire whatever object has caught her attention. Once her interest is piqued, she'll have to figure out its essence and mysteries no matter what. To date, plenty of items from where she did her missions have become part of her personal collection.
des.在得到“跳鼠”这个代号之前，少女以“诗羽”的名字生活在家族经营的孤儿院中。比起常: Before getting the alias "Tobinezumi," the girl lived as "Shiu" in an orphanage run by her family. Compared with her parents, who were constantly away for work, Shiu spent much more time with her paternal grandfather, who served as the orphanage director, but didn't feel lonely, for she was well taken care of and lived healthily with a ton of similar-aged peers.\nAll the kids who grew up with Shiu knew she had had the dream of becoming a female action star since young and how often she practiced her acting skills. They all looked forward to seeing her agile figure on the big screen in the future, but one day, she suddenly bade everyone farewell and vanished from the orphanage without a trace. That was all because Shiu learned that her family was affiliated with a particular ninjutsu faction, and at her grandfather's desperate plea, she agreed to succeed the legacy that her father once gave up for a bit.
des.工作之余，跳鼠喜欢收集一些让她觉得有意思的物品，谓之“私人收藏”，这点倒是和人们:
Outside of work, Tobinezumi enjoys gathering stuff that interests her and including them in her "personal collection," which is generally what girls her age tend to do as a hobby. After making some friends on The Eternal, she sometimes gives away things from her collection unhesitatingly without asking for anything in return. Of course, it does pain her to lose these things that she once treasured, but she believes maybe they can be put to better use in the hands of their new owners. The one most precious item in her collection that she will never give away, though, is a tiny bamboo basket.
During one of Tobinezumi's chats with her grandfather, the subject of why she was selected as Genuryu's successor came up. He told her earnestly that it was because he happened to pick her name, Shiu, out of six lots, emphasizing, "The carrier I used is the basket dice cup that brought me luck when I was younger!"
Thereafter, as a reward for a successful mission, her grandfather handed this lucky basket, as well as the rewards of other missions, to Tobinezumi with a grin, telling her that it could be used as her lucky charm. It is a gift that she cherishes to this day, especially since it came from her loved one.
Still, occasionally, she wonders if her life would be any different from now had her name not been the one that fell out of that lucky basket back then.
des.儿时的跳鼠经常来孤儿院和大家一起玩，错过了回家的时间就在那里留宿，久而久之在孤儿:
When Tobinezumi was a child, she often visited the orphanage to play with everyone and would stay the night if it was too late to go home, so much so that she eventually got a bed of her own on the second floor as time passed. She hit it off well with all the children and never once felt any different from them.

Due to family principles, she who is meek and quiet only ever reveals her quirky side to people her age once in a while. Numerous nights were spent under the blanket as she told her playmates about her dream of becoming a celebrity, or more specifically, an actress.
"What's the difference between a celebrity and an actress?"
"Well... Even if I can't become bright as a star, I still want to act!"
The lone concept Tobinezumi had of her actress dream was to be able to enter film sets and stand before cameras. It is a goal she has been striving for since then. Her grandfather promised her that so long as she reaches Menkyo Kaiden of Genuryu, he will pave the way for her into the entertainment world and provide her with the best acting opportunities.
The children in the orphanage did not really comprehend the difference, but regardless, they would clap for her dream with twinkling eyes.
"Awesome! That means we'll get to see Shiu on TV next time!" Nothing was more precious than the support of her friends.

Sometime later, the orphanage gradually made a name for itself among philanthropists, and many of the children got adopted, thus emptying out several of the rooms there. Tobinezumi couldn't help feeling slightly crestfallen over her friends' departures amid her heartfelt joy for them. She was well aware that despite the promises they made to each other before leaving, the nights of them discussing their future under the blanket had become a thing of the past.
After a brief period of gloom, however, Tobinezumi felt revitalized and motivated. Even if she could never meet her friends again, they would be able to see her on TV once she became a celebrity, an actress!
With her ninja blade, Katsuobushi Kirimaru‌, clutched in hand, the ninja Tobinezumi continues training for this dream of hers to this very day!
des.阿知波虽然自称问题儿童，但她对各式装备的外部元件和内部构造都十分了解，甚至对它们: Even though Achiwa claims to be a problem child, she's well-versed in the exterior component and inner structure of all sorts of equipment, as well as how they function. Every now and then, she'll blurt out theoretical terms that only exist in textbooks as though it's completely normal. Yet, if you watch her raise her tools at Chaos Stones with what can only be described as a ferocious look, it is really hard to picture that she was once a (self-proclaimed) model student.\nTo quote her words, accidents that occur in life are like gears that have become damaged and slid off in mechanical structures. In order to put this gear back, it may take a ton of energy to take apart the whole structure and start over again. This is where she's currently at in life—the process of taking apart and starting over.\nThat may sound like she has put in huge amounts of resolve and hard work, but it isn't something you can tell based on Achiwa's typical conduct. Only when she's focused on work will she turn into a no-nonsense person, displaying a wholly different attitude as she hammers away at Chaos Stones seriously. Some people can't help but worry if her hammer needs to undergo servicing more often, but as for who's going to foot the bill, it remains unknown.
des.阿知波和人相处的时候总是容易心情不好，而她的解决方式通常就是逛街购物，这点倒是挺:
Achiwa tends to fall into a bad mood whenever she socializes, and her solution is typically to go shopping, a classic pastime of young women. When she's not at work, she's a regular at the clothing stores and boutiques in the malls of the Bonfire City, but the moment she chances upon families who are shopping merrily, she'll immediately get ticked off and turn to leave, seemingly unable to stand such intimate sights.
When she's feeling down in the dumps, Achiwa will sit alone in a family or fast-food restaurant to have a large serving of fries, and she usually eats faster as it goes. Going up to her to ask about it at this time won't give you any answers; it just appears as if she seriously loves fries.
"Why do I love fries? ...Because it's delicious, duh. Why else?"
She seems to enjoy eating in a bustling environment, but footing the bill just because someone's eating with her isn't something she does. To Achiwa, this feels like "paying to have a friend." Sometimes, people on the train or Anita, who know her, will invite her to lunch, and she never fails to accept. Despite never really looking thrilled, she truly hasn't been absent from one of these lunch dates.
des.在加入阿妮塔前，阿知波没太思考过园丁的工作到底是做什么的。她对自己的人生其实也没:
Before joining Anita, Achiwa never really had a concrete plan for her life, nor did she think about what the job of Gardeners really was, much less envision herself as a Gardener who would personally advance into the Chaos Space.
She has an excellent familial background and managed to maintain exemplary conduct and academic results all throughout, even getting to join the student society of countless people's dreams to further her studies. Yet, after getting the approval to join the student society, Achiwa went to Night Chains Land and had the time of her life as though she was an entirely different person. She was no longer the same person she used to be when she returned, becoming temperamental and impatient, so much so that she resorted to using her fists to convince fellow students at an academic debate. The change in her personality was not totally without warning, though. In fact, it would be accurate to say that she had merely given up on herself entirely upon not receiving the love and concern she desired despite her life's worth of hard work and repression.
Regardless, the student society could never tolerate Achiwa's unreasonable behavior. They gave her two options: 1. take responsibility and withdraw from school; 2. contribute to society and regain the student society's approval.
Plagued with remorse and shame upon self-reflection, Achiwa pulled herself together and quickly landed herself an internship in Anita with her abilities. She, alongside her newly modified demolition hammer, then came to a decision to live a more honorable life.
des.阿知波曾经很喜欢去外面的餐厅吃东西。\r小时候，只要获得了好成绩，母亲就会给她很: Achiwa used to love dining in restaurants. When she was younger, her mother would reward her with lots of money whenever she obtained excellent academic results. Though she wasn't that cognizant about the amount of money she had, it was always more than enough to buy her tons of tasty food. Hence, the young Achiwa would take her money to the family restaurant near her home and order a large serving of freshly made fries to munch away merrily. The food in the family restaurant was delicious, perfect for Achiwa's palette, but she never once got to go there with her family. After all, even when she summoned her courage to ask her mother to have a meal with her, the answer she would get was always something like "I'm too busy recently. Let's talk about it next time."\nAfter Achiwa's family moved house, Achiwa never visited that restaurant again. She did go on to taste many more tasty foods as she grew up, but the jealousy she felt seeing those happy families in restaurants also intensified, leading her to loathe all kinds of crowded places. To liven up Achiwa's spirits, the part-time helper that Achiwa's mother hired to look after Achiwa offered to make the girl some food she liked.\n...Alas, no delicacies she tasted all these years ever seemed to measure up to freshly made fries. While having downtime on The Eternal nowadays, Achiwa tends to sit by the window of the dining carriage and munch away on a box of perfectly fried crispy fries. If you're close enough with her, you may perhaps get to try a fry or two if you try your luck.
des.梦玄流是个庞大而古老的家族。族中不仅强调武技和忍术的传承，在逐步获得权力后，自然:
Mugenryu was a massive, long-established family that not only emphasized passing on combat techniques and ninjutsu, but as they gradually attained power, they naturally had to select a successor capable of wielding this power as well. Sometime after Solstice, the world was in a state of unrest, and the same was going on within Mugenryu. At the time, the family head's wife gave birth to a pair of sisters, Aoba and Yoizuki, which was an unexpected surprise for the family head and the entire family, as that meant they now had two people to depend on for their future.
Yoizuki was an undeniable child prodigy who could already read and write fluently when children her age had only just been exposed to it, and she picked things up a mile a minute, thus gaining her the approval and anticipation of their family's elders. In contrast to her baby sister, Aoba might not have been inept, but she simply couldn't measure up to Yoizuki's competency. The pressure young Aoba had to bear was overwhelming, for people couldn't help but compare her with Yoizuki through the years.
Amid her misery, Aoba initially assumed she'd soon be ditched by everyone, but to her shock, Yoizuki appeared before her, clutched her hand, and said, "I'm only able to deal with the stress because you're around. I'm happy as long as you're with me. I hope we'll always stay together..." Aoba was moved to tears.
Just these words from Yoizuki were enough. Aoba was glad simply to be trusted and needed by Yoizuki. There was nothing she wouldn't do for her sister.
des.苍叶没有惯用的、或者最喜欢的武器。她所擅长的是将任何东西都化为武器的技艺，从自己:
Aoba doesn't have a weapon that she habitually uses or likes most. Her strong suit is the art of turning anything into a weapon, from the hairpin on her head to a piece of napkin she offhandedly gets. The numerous skills she picked up from various channels have made things like restraining enemies or rapidly knocking out someone a total walk in the park for her.
Observing the way she does things, you may easily be reminded of an overly devoted ninja in movies. Truth is, she has indeed learned a thing or two from Mugenryu's traditional combat techniques, but Mugenryu's ninjutsu was succeeded by someone else, for she wasn't up to the mark... This didn't matter to her, though. So long as she's capable of utilizing the combat techniques of other factions, Aoba will always earnestly learn them, all so her useless self won't end up burdening Yoizuki. That is in spite of the fact that others already think she's more than impressive.
Yoizuki doesn't mind joining in on the entertainment activities on the train, whereas Aoba generally just observes in silence from afar. There has only been one instance when Aoba passed by Eliot and Fran, who were practicing dart-throwing, and asked softly, "May I give it a try too?"
Afterward, according to Eliot's recountal... "Save for nearly swiping the dartboard off the wall the first time, she hit bullseye consecutively the next few throws!"
des.宵月最喜欢的点心是落雁，最喜欢的场所是能够俯瞰城市又很安静的地方，最喜欢的事情是:
Yoizuki's favorite snack is Rakugan, favorite place is somewhere quiet that overlooks the city, and favorite thing to do is to make people obey her—these are things that Aoba has deeply imprinted in her mind. But when someone asked her what she liked, she was lost for words. That had happened after a hair-raising combat mission concluded, and The Eternal's crew planned to prepare a gift or cake for Aoba according to her preference at the celebration party.
"There's nothing I like," was Aoba's eventual response. To her, "like" and "love" were both needless emotions. Even if she had them, she had long given them all to Yoizuki.
As such, the crew could only do their best to list out cake types and flavors and request Aoba to select one. They even comforted her by saying that Yoizuki couldn't make it to the celebration party this time, so Aoba could feel free to choose something she preferred, even if it were a flavor she "least hated"!
In the end, Aoba picked a pink cake embellished with cream flowers and some decorative leaves. Everyone teased grinningly, "So Aoba likes pink too, huh!"
Only Aoba knew that the cake had reminded her of a time when she shared snacks with Yoizuki as children. The snacks they had at home were always the few that Yoizuki liked, and only Yoizuki would take note of whether Aoba had eaten, as well as hand Aoba a snack with a smile. In Aoba's memory, as long as it was a snack given to her by Yoizuki, it would taste the best in the world.
des.苍叶在城中的独居住处里收养了一只小狗。\r遇见小狗的那天夜晚，宵月少有地给她放了:
The place where Aoba lives alone in the city is also home to a little dog. She had met the dog on one of the rare nights when Yoizuki gave Aoba time off. With a smile, Yoizuki tenderly told Aoba that Aoba could rest for the night, saying "You must also be tired after our long day outside, right...? Leave the rest of the negotiations to me," before gently shutting the door. Aoba had hoped she could help Yoizuki in some way, only to achieve nothing.
As she walked back to her residence, Aoba came across a filthy little dog with a missing patch of fur and scrape wounds on its legs. It was extremely fearful of humans yet cautiously and piteously whimpered at Aoba. For some unknown reason, Aoba squatted down by the roadside and spent some time to earn the dog's trust before taking it to the vet. It goes without saying that it eventually went home with her.
Yoizuki didn't like animals and detested dogs, in particular, for dogs would sniff around and bark randomly, making them a menace if not trained well. If Yoizuki were to find out Aoba had adopted a stray dog in her small apartment, Yoizuki would undoubtedly get mad and might even punish Aoba, so Aoba never told Yoizuki about the dog, feeling simultaneously guilty about having to hide something from her baby sister and reluctant to part with her new pet. With that, she lived every day in fear of ultimately getting found out by Yoizuki.
These days, whenever she returns to her apartment in the time-worn residential building, the now spotless, fluffy, and healthy dog will happily welcome Aoba at the door. "Even I deserve to have this little bit of joy, right...?" she ruminated each time she petted the dog.
des.人们对英雄的定义或许多种多样，但如果把范围限制于某个特定群体之中，收集到的答案就:
People have lots of definitions for a hero, but if you narrow it down to certain specific groups, the answers you collect will eventually be uniform. For example, if you ask Citadel members who the hero in their heart is, a good number of people will give the same answer - Dustin from the Destroyer.

In recent years, Dustin took in Sommer and Nayuta one after another, nurtured both of them into marvelous Citadel members, and formed a relatively close bond among the three of them. Judging from this, he's not only experienced and accomplished in combat but also a considerably impeccable father in daily life... Then, where did the rumors concerning Dustin that occasionally make rounds in the Citadel come from?

"An unfeeling Reaper... Seeks vengeance from Chaos Remains... A beast... You heard about them? Yes, they're all me. I won't run from the things I once did, but explaining and understanding them will both take time. Please give me some time," was Dustin's reply.

One could sense a hint of sincerity radiating through his steel mask as he said that. In that case, let's give him the benefit of the doubt, considering his normally upstanding conduct, and trust him this once.
des.达斯廷在多年前以医疗专家的身份加入学会，与他一同来到塞纳诺尼克的还有他的恋人，植:
Many years ago, Dustin came to Senanonic and joined the Citadel as a medical expert alongside his significant other, Melanie, a botanist. In commemoration of their wedding, the married couple planted a cherry tree in the greenhouse on the Citadel's airship and joked that once their child grew up and met the love of their life, they would gift the fruit of this tree to that child.

Sadly, while on a field trip, Melanie was attacked by Chaos Remains and had already lost consciousness from her injury when she was rescued. Her life was saved with the help of the Citadel's medical technology, but she fell into a deep coma. To heal her, Dustin practically tried anything he could think of, even wanting to participate in an exceedingly dangerous project for a time despite the price of it being losing his reason and past memories.

Right as he was stuck in a dilemma, Melanie miraculously regained consciousness, albeit only for a few short minutes. Her feeble fingers rested on his palm the way they had held hands for umpteen times, and her last words for him were, "Don't forget me."

Following that, all that filled Dustin's heart was hatred for the Chaos Remains that took his wife's life. For the sake of seeking vengeance, he participated in another project and accepted some physical modifications, turning from a doctor to a soldier who made waves in the Citadel for his radical, high-risk combat style. In the beginning, he merely had his four limbs substituted with prosthetics, but as the injuries he got from various missions multiplied, the Citadel had no choice but to successively substitute his skin, muscles, skeleton, and even part of his internal organs.

For a long time afterward, Dustin wallowed in endless hatred and sorrow, becoming a beast whose lone goal was to tear apart all Chaos Remains.
des.对于年纪尚轻的学会成员来说，达斯廷的形象和多年前的记录中那位疯狂的复仇者缺少关联:
To the young Citadel members, Dustin's appearance bears no semblance to that maniacal avenger noted in records years ago, whereas people familiar with Dustin generally believe the change in him only began after the emergence of a little girl. Many years ago, Dustin joined a rescue team and headed to a village destroyed by Chaos Remains, saving part of the survivors. One of them was a child named Sommer.
