Following that, he returned to the lifestyle of fighting his life away on battlefields, while Sommer, with her unstable Ascension Ability, was sent to the Citadel's medical department for long-term observation and treatment.

The two should've never met again... but sometime later, Dustin reached out to the Citadel and applied to adopt Sommer. Everybody was shocked by the maniacal avenger's sudden interest in raising a child, but on account of his past qualifications and character, the Citadel ultimately approved his application.

"Mr. Dustin may be made of metal from head to toe, but he is a very warm-hearted person!" is something plenty of Citadel kids would say these days.

Once in a blue moon, when Dustin does return to the Citadel's airship and gets surrounded by the kids, he will suppress the hostile aura he directs at enemies on the battlefield and willingly answer their every question.

"How did you and Sommer meet, Mr. Dustin?"

"Haha, she helped me take care of the greenhouse left behind by Melanie for a long time... By the time I learned about it, the plants in there had already been revived. Truthfully speaking, for a long, long time, I forgot that I still had places to go. Sommer was the one who snapped me back to reality."
des.在索玛将重伤的那由他带回学会的驻点时，达斯廷为他作了应急处理。在使用学会技术的前:
When Sommer brought the severely injured Nayuta back to the Citadel's base, Dustin was the one who applied emergency first aid to Nayuta. With the Citadel's technologies, Nayuta's injuries weren't considered life-threatening, and the young man's breathing stabilized. Dustin wiped off the blood stains on his mechanical hands and quietly asked Sommer to talk with him outside the hospital ward.

"I won't ask you to be responsible for helping an unknown child. All I want to know is, why did you help him?"

"Because... he's injured... and..."

Sommer found it really hard to answer this question. Seeing his daughter in this state, Dustin suddenly recalled the moment when he met her again.

At the time, he had returned severely injured from a dangerous field mission and had no choice but to lower his core operating power and lie on a hospital bed in the waiting area. Coincidentally, a group of children waiting for their turn for physical checkups passed by, the majority of them steering away in fear and refusing to be near this mechanical man soaked in blood.

Sommer was the only one out of the group who trotted over with fear and slight anticipation, holding Dustin's hand like she was soothing his pain.

...

"Never mind. I trust your judgment, Sommer. Let's wait for him to wake up for now."

Sommer decided to go back and watch over that young man, while Dustin came to the greenhouse left behind by Melanie. In recent years, Sommer had taken great care of this place, and the plants were growing with much more vitality than before. Melanie's unfinished last words replayed in Dustin's mind innumerable times throughout the years, but he never once figured out what she was truly trying to say. He knew she wasn't referring to hatred, but aside from seeking vengeance, he had no idea what else he could do.

Dustin gazed at the sunlight shining through the greenhouse's glass. In the warm light, he recalled Sommer's smile, that deathly pale young man, and the hands he had held umpteen times belonging to the child he saved.

"Don't forget me..." and live on to save many more.
des.黛丝莉的人生可以被分为三个阶段。\r第一个阶段，黛丝莉生活在孤儿院，自记事起，她:
Desiree's life can be divided into three phases.
In the first phase, Desiree lived in an orphanage, a place she had been at since she could remember. Alas, the orphanage director made no effort to make it a loving environment for the children. They were more like the orphanage's money-making tools.
In the second phase, Desiree was adopted, but what awaited her weren't loving, ordinary days, for the mysterious figure who adopted her was a member of a mercenary organization that wanted her for her ascension abilities and unique talent.
In the third phase, the mercenary organization clashed with a particular bigwig whose name escaped Desiree, and nearly everyone was eliminated in the end. Yet, Desiree, by some miracle, survived and encountered COLUMBA's Signora Medici while at the end of her rope, and she then went on to work for COLUMBA to this day.
Despite her appalling past, she's still an innocent child at heart, at least outside of battlefields. This is probably a blessing in itself.
des.掩盖在黛丝莉那稚嫩活泼外表下的是艰辛的过去。黛丝莉曾经待过的孤儿院条件十分恶劣，: Concealed by Desiree's juvenile, perky appearance is a past filled with hardships. The orphanage where she once stayed was a poor excuse for a sanctuary. Before she was adopted by that mercenary organization's member, she barely even got to have meals that tasted normal.\nThe demanding training that awaited her at the mercenary organization didn't really faze her. As her "teachers," the organization members taught her all the qualities and knowledge needed to be a soldier, albeit not exactly with care and concern as the intention, but they did shape a complete "worldview" for Desiree, granting her basic understanding of this world.\nHowever, on the flip side of the coin, although the "teachers" cultivated her into an impressive mercenary, they failed to teach her the skills needed to live independently. As such, till date, Desiree lacks budgeting ability and requires the supervision of a "guardian."
des.黛丝莉刚来到无垠号时，无垠号上的大家对她的第一印象只是“掌握了一些战斗技巧的小女:
When Desiree first boarded The Eternal, the first impression she gave everyone on the train was "a girl who possesses some combat skills" and even "perhaps a relative of someone." After all, no matter if it's her looks or behavior, she exudes the naivety of someone without much life experience, which makes it difficult to imagine what kind of amazing abilities a girl like that could possibly have.
Regardless, this somewhat stereotypical first impression was soon proven wrong.
Desiree is proficient at moving between numerous spots to quickly find a good one to snipe, then accurately taking down the enemy. People skilled at using long-range weapons are generally seen as the team's attacker and weakest member, but no one who has seen Desiree using the advantage of her petite frame to swiftly block and knock down an enemy would think she had gotten her position by pulling strings.
About her astounding abilities that starkly contrast her appearance, she doesn't appear to have much thought about them, never mind comparing herself with others. In her eyes, everyone has their own individuality. For example, Livia makes extremely good Black Tea, Eliot always invites Desiree to play, and Fran cooks for everyone... Desiree has never felt that her existence is "unrealistic." She still spends her days happily on The Eternal, just like the saying, "Ignorance is bliss."
des.有乘员捡到了一个笔记本并且移交给了莉薇娅，希望助理小姐可以通过内容找到失主。\r:

des.菲妮娅的身体柔韧度很高，拜平时的锻炼所赐，足部的抓力也很强，因此只要她想，就能展: Fenia's body is highly flexible thanks to her usual training, and the grip of her feet is also impressive. Hence, so long as she wants to, she'll be able to perform specialized movements akin to that of professional acrobats. For her, doing the split is a piece of cake, and flipping upside down to pick things up with her foot—something that's jaw-dropping to ordinary people—is easy peasy too, which makes jolly, energetic kids enjoy gathering around her. Sometimes, in order to make the kids happy, Fenia will especially perform some high-difficulty stunts. As a form of training, she even enjoyed participating in rock-climbing competitions for a time, once outshining everyone else in an indoor rock-climbing competition held in a Bonfire City and breaking the best record of previous winners. This virtually turned her into a legend in that Bonfire City.\n\nShe who is adroit at using her legs in combat dislikes tight, body-hugging clothing. Shoes that feel constricting around the toes, in particular, are her biggest nemesis. Once she no longer needs them or when no one's watching, she'll send those annoying things flying with a kick without hesitation.
des.率直可爱的菲妮娅在学会中几乎受到了所有人的喜爱。菲妮娅也无比珍惜学会中的朋友，对:
The candid, lovely Fenia is basically adored by everyone in the Citadel, and she, too, cherishes her friends there deeply, treating them and even friendly strangers very affectionately. Of course, the number of people who could reject her enthusiasm can likely be counted on one hand.

Even though their personalities are total opposites and she's always so full of life, Fenia is close friends with Sommer, whose socializing skills could use some work. The patience she exhibits with Sommer, who isn't good at expressing herself, is absolutely above and beyond. Fenia is someone who treats her friends' troubles as her own, and thus, she's exceptionally bothered by Sommer's mutation from the effect of Chaos Remains, and her hatred for those things has also multiplied.

Her tender age and longing to grow up have made her deeply admire charming, mature adults. Whenever she encounters mature women in the Citadel, her gaze will instinctively be drawn to them, and the next thing she knows, she will be following closely behind that person and even mentally make comparisons with their mannerisms. Rina Von from the Citadel's intelligence department is one of the people Fenia admires, but Fenia's curiosity and tailing—owing to her longing—have nearly made her misunderstood as a stalker. Luckily, this misunderstanding was quickly resolved, and Fenia has formed a friendship with the woman she looks up to as an older sister.
des.年纪尚轻的菲妮娅在生活中几乎没遇见过什么阻碍。出生于塞纳诺尼克，拥有既爱她又无条:
The youthful Fenia has almost never encountered any obstacle in life. Born in Senanonic with open-minded parents who not only loved her but also supported her unconditionally, she received a proper education and training and got to grow up just the way she liked. People born in Bonfire Cities will likely find it hard to comprehend why she detests those Chaos Remains that are nowhere near her.

From a young age, Fenia has had to attend one funeral after another. Whenever a Citadel member is confirmed to have perished, whether or not there's a body, personal belonging, or relative present, a small farewell ceremony will be held. Fenia's parents' positive and easy-going personalities have made them many friends at work, which, in turn, resulted in many more losses to experience. Having accompanied her parents to these funerals multiple times, Fenia cognized the obligations of a Citadel member much younger than she should have and consequently began regarding Chaos Remains as the enemies of the Citadel and even the entire human race.

Fortunately, she went on to receive appropriate counseling and guidance, so her memories of death and danger didn't turn into psychological traumas. With a heart full of love for practically all humans, she continues fighting and experiencing this world.
des.可能是出于对桦树生物的熟悉和厌恶，又或者是出于某种直觉，菲妮娅能够感觉到桦树生物:
Perhaps due to her familiarity and disgust of Chaos Remains or some kind of instinct, Fenia is capable of sensing the aura of Chaos Remains. If someone who has just dealt with a Chaos Remain approaches her, she'll immediately detect it and will kindly urge them to go take a shower and get changed as soon as possible. But if the aura is overly intense, it'll be hard for her to control her own actions.

Once, in the Citadel, Fenia chanced upon a young visitor from DRYAS CORPORATION. The two purely walked past each other, and yet Fenia sensed an abnormally strong Chaos Remain aura in that visitor's suitcase, almost as if that visitor had stuffed a whole living Chaos Remain into it. Out of instinct, Fenia, who had just returned from combat, rapidly got into her combat stance. Had her mentors who were nearby not spotted her behavior, an intense fight would've broken out between the two.

Afterward, even Fenia couldn't explain why such an overwhelming antagonism had sprouted within her. The Citadel, left without an alternative, had to restrict her from accessing the area where that visitor stayed and even came up with a series of protective measures lest something like that happened again. After all, Fenia's talent is better utilized on dangerous battlefields.
des.冯·里奈有着一项特殊的才能：从小就喜欢收集和整理信息。通过笔试考入了索思学会的学: Rina Von has a special talent—collecting and organizing information since she was a child. After passing the exam to join Source Citadel's academic society, she was officially an undergraduate, and she quickly formulated a life plan with the goal of becoming a scribe of the Citadel's Fabricate upon getting her hands on internal information about the Citadel. Rina Von's presence in the Citadel indeed marginally increased the organization process of their extensive and complicated data, giving those abstruse information more accurate categorizations.\nBut at the same time, her meekness became problematic, for she who didn't know how to say no to others often felt compelled to work non-stop whenever people eagerly requested her aid. Her days then turned into a cycle of unending overtime work.\nBecause of her sterling image and the fact that she's one of the rare few regular persons in the Citadel, Rina Von is frequently entrusted with tasks concerning external liaisons, which means she's always sent on last-minute business trips. She can't help but cry each time her vacation plans are messed up. Still, with excellent benefits from the Citadel, she has grown to adapt to such a lifestyle and can pretty much take anything in stride.
des.虽然性格温和平静，看起来和瓦伦汀相似，有着文学少女一般的气质，但冯·里奈其实是十: In spite of her mild, serene temperament and cultured vibe that's similar to Valentine's, Rina Von is, in actuality, a total outdoorsy person who loves traveling and has always thought of finding the wonders of foreign places as one of her life goals. In her opinion, having a long bath after a day of sightseeing and admiring sceneries is basically the best way to have a holiday. Sadly, her never-ending workload has caused her to postpone her much-anticipated travel plans over and over again as she comforts herself with all kinds of excuses. On the bright side, her job scope in the Citadel does fit her passion, so at least it isn't all that miserable.\nRina Von, as a mature adult with an extraordinary temperament, is the object of Fenia's fascination. The girl's instinctive tailing behavior had, for a time, made Rina Von think she was being stalked, which sparked off a little chaos in the Citadel at the time. Thankfully, the misunderstanding was quickly resolved, and facing the slightly uneasy Fenia, Rina Von proposed a deal—she would teach Fenia "the self-restraint of adults" in exchange for the right to rub the cheeks of the girl, who was constantly following her around, as a unique destressing method.
des.从刚刚来到学会的第一个月，冯·里奈就畅想着“等到休假出去旅游”的假期计划，但直到:
Since the first month Rina Von joined the Citadel, she had been drawing up vacation plans for "when she took a break from work," but this wish still had yet to fully come true even after she registered and became part of The Eternal's crew. Although she did get to travel a few times during some short breaks, they all either required her to work remotely, be continuously on calls, or the Citadel would summon her back urgently before she even arrived at her destination. She no longer even remembers when was the last time she went on a real holiday.
Her friends had provided Rina Von suggestions, hoping she could learn to say no and speak out when she had too much on her plate... but she remained swamped with work despite putting these suggestions to practice, probably because she just had too strong a sense of responsibility.
"At the end of the day, the Citadel's work is endless, and the operation of a 'Save-the-World' organization is also incredibly complex. To fulfill my dream of becoming a Fabricate scribe and to make use of m-my value as an undergraduate... I have to work even harder!"
"But at the rate you're working overtime, you'll die before your dreams are realized, young lady."
After Rebis bluntly pointed that out, Rina Von began studying all types of health supplements, tonics, and even the recently trending "Urban Beauty Professional Healthcare Set" when she wasn't working. Apparently, one pill of it, and you'll be brimming with energy enough to get back to work.
des.相比其他完全为无垠号工作的乘员来说，冯·里奈的辛苦有相当一部分是她自己的选择。假:
Compared with the other crew members who work full-time for The Eternal, Rina Von is partly responsible for her own stress. To illustrate, if there isn't much difference in salaries, the majority of people will likely choose the more relaxing job with more days off, but Rina Von tenaciously refuses to resign from the Citadel and would rather spend all that effort going back and forth.
Just what is it about the Citadel's work that she can't bear to leave behind? Most people won't understand it, but this is self-evident for the others in the Citadel. The pursuit of knowledge, rescuing others, and keeping the fire of hope alive for the world all sound conceptual but are, in fact, the ultimate goals of a significant number of people in the Citadel; Rina Von is no exception.
Aside from clerical work, she will also leave Senanonic to go on combat missions as a member of the Destroyer from time to time. Combat missions are not only tough but also extra dangerous. However, this helps Rina Von understand what and who exactly her work is for. Whenever she sees the lives of people who got help becoming better and better and the wounded rescued from dangerous regions gradually recovering, it fills her with motivation to keep doing what she does.
If just the effort of one person is sufficient to make such tremendous changes in the world around her, Rina Von reckons she's all right with working this way all her life! But from her friends' perspective, they likely still hope that she can rest awhile before jumping back to work.
des.“这支小队是我自己挑选人员、组建起来的”，甘雅的这句话总会让第一次听说这事的人大:
"This team was established and hand-picked by me," is a line Ganya says that often baffles people. After all, in comparison with the composed, dependable Ganya, the other members of the team can practically be described as three problem children. Why in the world did she choose Rachel, who loves toying with chemical agents, the shut-in Ilona, and Reika, who never has anything nice to say?
The reasons are clear to Ganya herself. They're all outstanding in their specialties and were all kids who, for some reason, were abandoned by most of the world. The moment Ganya stumbled upon the trio's information amid heaps of B.C.R.L. soldiers' files, she noted down their names in her mind. Sometime later, when she became the administrator of Mander Mine's BCRL Agency, she got the approval to establish a special ops team, which was how Team Meerkat came to be.
"From here on out, we will be partners."
No speech about purpose or glory, just a group of young women heading for the future as partners—this, to Ganya, was the most solemn promise she could give.
des.甘雅对研究和修理机械结构有非凡的兴趣。她从小就喜欢把东西拆得七零八落又完整地组装:
Ganya is exceptionally interested in researching and repairing mechanical structures. Taking things apart and then putting them back together are things she has enjoyed doing from a young age, and it's rare that there are ever mistakes like having a bunch of leftover screws after reassembly.
Mander Mine is home to numerous workers who once played a part in constructing Bonfire Cities and railways. These elders were all pleased to see such a diligent, driven child. When Ganya goes back to her residence in Mander Mine now, she still greets them happily as she always did.
As for the person who had the greatest influence on her life trajectory, that would be her paternal grandfather, who joined the Bonfire City engineering team after Solstice and personally participated in the early development of Shoggolith City when he was still a man in his prime. In his humble abode, Ganya listened to him tell one after another story about how he and his companions traveled a long time to construct a city, how the buildings were built from the ground up, and how the tracks were laid miles and miles away, which filled young Ganya with eagerness for the outside world and the future.
However, her grandfather's stories always came to an abrupt end. "Shoggolith City was constructed, and a railway network was built across the land." That marked the end of the journey between him and his companions. Only after he passed on did Ganya comprehend why he looked so forlorn, and thus she decided to venture out into the world outside of the mine.
des.对甘雅来说，结构合理、运转高效的机械结构是相当吸引人的。外行在欣赏这样的机械结构: To Ganya, structurally sound and highly efficient machinery is very attractive. Laymen admiring such machinery may simply give basic compliments like "That's amazing," but Ganya will seriously look into how it works and study the good points in its design. Ever since taking over the power hammer left to her by her grandfather, one of her goals has been to become an outstanding machinery designer; thus, she and the Conductor do have some common topics to chat about.\nAt times, Ganya will put in the work to make some mechanical handicrafts, so it won't be a surprise if you bump into her in all sorts of parts stores every now and then. Lately, she has started giving out her handicrafts to various friends, often surprising them with her out-of-the-box creativity. For instance, she gave Rachel a ribbon bow made out of gears, gave Reika a keychain made out of discarded pull tabs, and gave Ilona a diorama in a tin can... Being Ganya's friend and teammate sure is a pretty delightful thing.\nTools and weapons repaired by her also tend to have more "personality." Her own weapon, for example, was originally a claw hammer that she transformed into a dual-purpose mechanical axe that's still able to function as an everyday tool outside of the battlefield. In a way, Ganya believes this is how she can fulfill her grandfather's dying wish.
des.“甘雅她可是个超级热血的人哦！”瑞秋这句话听上去似乎很荒诞，可是无论是雷火还是伊:
"Ganya is an ultra-zealous person!" said Rachel. This sentence might sound incredibly absurd, but even Reika and Ilona would nod in agreement, as Ganya had a goal that she almost never told anyone else.
Ever since her grandfather passed on, she had been quietly creating the prototype of this goal in her mind, pretty much already determining her direction in life: She intended to build a more equal world that lets people live with more dignity. However, no matter who she could tell this to, they would probably just laugh it off. After all, what could a mere BCRL Agency branch administrator possibly do to make the world a better place?
Ganya was well aware that she was powerless, but she did not give up her goal and instead turned it into her own code of conduct. Before doing anything, she would first consider the consequences in detail. Her aloof nature and much more cautious method of doing things made her appear way more mature than people her age, which was how she won over her teammates with vastly different personalities. Ganya might look like she was set in her ways, but no one other than Team Meerkat's members knew better about her beyond-sincere heart.
It's to be expected that she will be encountering more things and people in the near future. Even though her goal remains a pipe dream as of now, Ganya is still doing everything she can to achieve it.
des.“这双鞋子？哎呀，你很有眼光嘛！没错，这是当季新品，限量发售，我可是蹲点抢到的，:
"These shoes? Well, you've got a good eye! That's right, this season's new release, limited run. I staked out the drop to get a pair. Suits a handsome guy like me, doesn't it~"

"Isn't this the collab milk tea they did with Night Chains Land? Why are you only getting around to trying it now? They're already lining up their next collab!"

"Heh heh, my shots are photogenic by default, and this color grading is nothing short of perfect! This'll rack up plenty of likes once it's online. Makes those hours I spent in line for that restaurant worth it, too."

As someone who keeps a constant eye on what's trending, Akira always has topics like these ready on his lips. Falling behind a trend is, to him, an utterly intolerable thing — fashion to food, travel to film and television. If you want to know what's popular right now, asking Akira is a safe bet. The trouble is, he can never wrap up an enthusiastic rundown without a round of self-congratulation, so not many people are eager to come to him for that knowledge with any humility. It might be less that Akira loves chasing trends than that he simply loves being looked at.

Having failed to become the wildly popular fashion icon with crowds at his heels that he imagined he would be, Akira finds it perpetually baffling — where exactly did it go wrong? Could it be that heaven envies talent, that a stylish, gifted, good-looking guy like him has been singled out by cruel fate itself?!
des.自幼时起，晃就明显地表现出他是一个比大多数同龄人要聪明的孩子。他学什么东西都很快: From early childhood, Akira showed plainly that he was a brighter child than most of his peers. He picked things up quickly, and could often reach, by way of some clever shortcut, goals that would cost an ordinary person a great deal of time and effort. Perhaps because nothing he attempted failed to come easily, his life has been smooth sailing throughout, and that is how he came by the casual, flippant manner he carries today. It isn't that Akira looks down on people who work hard. He simply feels that solving a problem with an air of ease is what makes him look good — after all, making most situations look effortless is what suits the style of a genius!\n\nThat way of doing things has inevitably brought Akira his share of trouble. He gets carried away easily, to the point of committing elementary blunders at the decisive moment and landing himself in some undignified position. Most of the time he does come out of it fine, and perhaps that is precisely why he never learns. Taking a spill while demonstrating his skiing technique. Getting ambushed just as he was about to bring down a Chaos Remain. Holding a pose only to sneeze at the instant someone pressed the shutter. Insisting at his physical that he stood 180cm, then stepping onto the measuring stand and coming out at 179.5cm. Episodes of the sort that leave you unsure whether to laugh are frankly beyond counting. Inside Anita, the impression these embarrassments have left seems to run deeper than the handsome-guy image Akira works so painstakingly to maintain.
des.晃的言行很容易给人留下他很自来熟的错觉，可实际上他与不少人都保持着一定的距离感。:
Akira's manner easily leaves people with the mistaken impression that he warms to anyone instantly, when in fact he keeps a certain distance from a good many of them. Once people stop and think back on it, they find that almost nothing in their exchanges with Akira has let them come to know him any better.

This seems to have to do with his standards for friendship. Akira's fastidiousness is not confined to matters of hygiene in daily life; it extends to the mental sort as well. Often enough he is the one who starts the conversation, yet it amounts to no more than one-sided chatter. He will not readily put himself out to consider another person's circumstances, and he rarely asks anyone for help with anything outside of work, as though deliberately keeping clear of any personal ties he does not need.

It is likely only with people he genuinely regards well that Akira will do something for them of his own accord, and press them to hear out a request of his in turn. His mentor once offered this assessment: "Akira... it might be less that he holds others in contempt than that he is a little spoiled and willful. He is a perceptive person, in fact. Whether he is willing to spend that attention on you, though, comes down to how he happens to feel."
des.列车长在某一天回到自己的车长室时，意外地看到一盆雅致的花艺作品摆在里面，风格怎么:
One day Conductor returns to the conductor's cabin and finds, unexpectedly, an elegant flower arrangement set inside it, in a style that by no measure looks like the work of that Imperial-run shop in Shoggolith.

Asking a few crew members from Ranshin City whether they brought it in gets nothing but denials. Then Conductor runs into Akira in the corridor, and the young man puts on his usual self-satisfied look. "Bet you didn't see that coming. That happens to be the work of yours truly, the genius! I saw flowers in the cabin that nobody had gotten around to putting in a vase yet, so I showed off a little. Quite a nice surprise, isn't it~"

Akira's image as a man of style has long been fixed in everyone's mind, and yet not even the partner he works alongside at Anita knows he has a skill like this.

"Look at how curious you are... I suppose there's no harm in telling you, since it's you, Conductor. But the corridor is a terrible place for this kind of talk. You don't look like you've got anything to do right now, so how about we sit down at a café and take our time? That place's cake has been on my wish list forever!"

This may well be the first time Akira has spoken to anyone about his family. The son of a flower arrangement master in Ranshin City, he has no intention of carrying on the art. He picked up a little of it in childhood simply from being around it, and once he was grown he left home without a backward glance.

"There's nothing strange about that, is there? My brothers and sisters and I all figure there's nothing wrong with keeping a reasonable amount of distance. Family or not, there's no need to stay stuck together all the time... A blood tie isn't the kind of thing that snaps just because of physical distance, is it?"

Akira goes on to say a fair amount more about his life back in Ranshin City. Perhaps because the stories are interesting enough, the painful memories that cake left on the palate — pretty to look at, less rewarding to eat — end up considerably diluted.
des.卡莱雅选择参与研究的项目对于整个园丁部门来说都十分重要，那就是定点传送的技术。定: The research project that Kaleya chose to participate in, which is regarding the technique of fixed-point teleportation, is incredibly important to the entire Gardener division. It is a huge and complicated project, and Kaleya's mentor is also one of the researchers.\nHer mentor had discovered Kaleya's talent for this field while mentoring her and was keen to nurture that for her, which eventually led to Kaleya becoming the only Gardener from her intake who picked this field. To tell the truth, her initial objective was medical-related research, but when faced with her mentor's earnest persuasion, she resolutely gave up on her original plan.\nWith her attentiveness, Kaleya soon managed to utilize this technique stably, and she selected environmental conservation support as her next research subject. When asked about it, she answered with a smile, "This result is more beneficial for everyone, no? Besides, I'm very keen on this issue too."
des.“什么？卡莱雅？好不容易有和我这样的超人气帅哥聊天的机会，你就不能选个更愉快一些: "What? Kaleya? You finally have the chance to chat with a popular heartthrob like me. Can't you pick a nicer topic? Geez... Never mind. On account of your ability to appreciate my charm, I'll be nice and give you one advice. No matter what, just stay away from that woman! All of you have been fooled by her. She's, in fact, a super cheesy person who only knows to say cringey jokes all the time. Hmph! Clearly, you don't get it. If you were as poor thing as me to be assigned to the same Gardener mentor as her, forced to listen to her nonsensical crap every single day, you'd surely avoid her like the plague too! Moreover, sometimes... I have no clue what that woman is thinking, but she just creeps me out! That's all I'm saying. You gotta heed my words!" —Voice recording of a certain 180cm-tall Prince of Skiing.
des.出身于医学世家的卡莱雅自小就对救死扶伤有着强烈的憧憬，这种心情已经强烈到执著的程: Born into a family of physicians, Kaleya had aspired to help the injured since she was a child, a feeling so intense that it became the lone thing she strived for. Her unexpected talents might have stood in the way of her medical research goal after she joined Anita, but she did not give up on this passion of hers; she, who possesses a medical license, would help treat her colleagues in times of need from time to time. \nEven though receiving proper help should be a pleasant thing, a few of the people who had the chance to be looked after by Kaleya have some differing views. She is incredibly meticulous when taking care of the injured, but it's practically over the top. The moment she finds out someone's injured, even if it's purely something minor like a scrape or a bruise, Kaleya will order the injured to rest and not work, and her attention would be fully devoted to the patient. In no time, everyone on The Eternal had such an astonishing experience of their own.\nNaturally, the person who has been "looked after" the most is still the hard-working Conductor. Many times, Kaleya had to half-convince and half-force the Conductor to take a break. An inexplicably excited smile is always on her face as she passes through the carriages looking for people who "need help." For someone who finds so much joy in taking care of others, will she genuinely not regret giving up on pursuing the study of medicine?
des.只要能帮到大家就好。\r只要这能维护大多数人的利益，那么牺牲我也没关系。\r只要:
As long as I can help everyone. 
As long as this can protect most people's interests, I don't mind sacrificing myself.
 All that matters is that the people I want to protect are happy.
These lines belonging to "positive characters" in literary works are also Kaleya's life mottos. The desire to help somebody, protect somebody, and take care of somebody. These actions are what gives her joy, yet for someone who has such a selfless hobby, she once got an extremely dangerous score during a routine psychological assessment in high school.
This result left the teachers open-mouthed, as Kaleya was an excellent student with numerous friends and a happy family, hardly the representation of someone with an unstable state of mind. Their repeated communication with her and her parents also confirmed that she hadn't suffered any kind of stress. Seeing how dumbfounded everybody was, Kaleya had no choice but to reveal, "Sorry. I was a bit absentminded during the assessment, so I didn't really read the questions clearly and just picked an answer at random."
After a redo, Kaleya received a normal score with her answers, much to everyone's relief. From then on, she continued with her education, never once making another mistake when it came to questionnaires handed out by the school, and people eventually forgot about this incident.
However, Kaleya herself was well aware that honesty wasn't required when filling up these questionnaires. Her rational mind knew exactly how to answer these to get a perfect score, and her emotions were cognizant that what she truly wanted to do were fairly radical, such as making a certain someone be eternally reliant on her care, even if it meant she had to do some things that would upset others...
"Will that important person appear in my life someday?" With this expectation in mind, she went on and on to conceal her true thoughts behind those normal scores.
des.在被阿妮塔招募成为正式员工之前，卡洛琳的身份是自由探险者。自幼痴迷探险的她，不断:
Before Caroline was recruited by Anita as an official employee, she was a carefree explorer who had been obsessed with explorations since childhood. Everywhere she went, from barren deserts to hills with stunning sceneries, she planted the flags she always brought into the ground, gradually scattering traces of her all over the world. Leaving marks on brand new things is one of the inclinations of humans; at least, that's how Caroline explains it, and always so emotionally at that.

Finally, when the young explorer planted her umpteenth flag, Anita's liaison officer found her. Anita tapped into the strengths of this young lady who wandered the wilderness alone and gave her the chance to become an official "pathfinder," extending the paths she walked into another dimension.

However, the first time Caroline paired up with Yejue, the two got so close to breaking out into a fight in the Chaos Space. From that moment on, Caroline sensed that her unique, independent working style was being unprecedentedly threatened, and she committed herself to defending her right to freedom no matter what! Needless to say, to date, her protest hasn't proven very effective yet, for she still has no option but to work alongside Yejue.
des.如果将卡洛琳本身作为探路者的素质单独拿出来讨论，她的各项身体指标和实地探索水平都:
Judging solely on Caroline's competency as a pathfinder, all of her physical indicators and field exploration expertise are irreproachable. Maybe her lifestyle of constantly climbing high and low has trained her well, or maybe she was already inherently fit as a fiddle, but Caroline is unbeaten at trekking, consistently walking swiftly and steadily regardless if it's on mountains or flatlands. Her colleagues joked that if the Bonfire City hosted a Walk-the-City Contest, they would without a doubt recommend Caroline to participate right away.

Among the present Anita staff, no one would disregard Caroline's opinion anymore, though everyone agrees as a whole that there was a reason why nobody approved of her working style at first. The way she selects the best path based on her instinct and years of exploration experience tends to come off as "I just feel like we should go this way!" which admittedly doesn't sound very reliable. Precisely because of that, her most trusted partner is actually a robot dog, Shepherd, who never doubts the path she picks under any circumstances.

Caroline and Yejue are currently working for one of Anita Energy Institute's research projects and overseen by the research supervisor, Nicola. This evolved the duo who's already often at odds into a rather inharmonious trio... which naturally makes people wonder, is a staff arrangement like that really okay?
des.卡洛琳曾经为适应城市生活付出过一些努力：首先，利用探路者的薪水，她租下了一间小小:
Caroline once tried to adjust to city life. Initially, she used her earnings as a pathfinder to rent a small living space. Then, she attempted to engage with people around her, much like when she gathered messages in sparsely populated areas. Eventually, she delved into hobbies like fashion, food, and trends, similar to her colleagues.

Yet, she soon realized her efforts were not paying off as expected. Despite having trendy items in her place, they ended up forgotten on the shelves. While she made a few friends and learned about what was in vogue, staying connected was impossible due to limited access to communication devices until she returned to Bonfire City. By then, her friends had made other plans, and the topics that interested her had become outdated.

Caroline is not too disheartened by this, as she is new to conventional social interactions. This realization prompts her to consider the lifestyle that truly suits her. Perhaps the pathfinder's way of life is more fitting, as the well-trodden paths of others may not be her true calling.
des.“龙虾发电？！卡洛琳你到底想干什么啊？！”\r搭档的怒吼声隔着休息室的玻璃门传来:
"Generating power using lobsters? What on earth are you thinking, Caroline?!"

Yejue's voice booms through the glass door of the lounge. Caroline instinctively covers her ears, having grown accustomed to these outbursts. As Yejue strides into the room, Caroline shouts at the same volume, "But I really want to eat them!"
"Fine, but why would such a request even pass the review?! Why not enjoy them at a seafood restaurant in Freeport Ⅶ during your break? Our funds are limited, and the monocrystalline silicon I ordered hasn't arrived yet!"

"I approved it," states the acting director of the institute, seated on the sofa, barely lifting her eyelid.
"Oh, so it was you... wait, you approved it?!"

At Yejue's question, Nicola nods, casually filling in numbers on a Sudoku grid in a magazine. "The system filtered it out, but I kept hearing someone screaming for lobsters, so I put it back. If all goes well, we can enjoy lobsters today."
Yejue, waving her report in frustration, stands stunned in the doorway. Caroline, still covering her ears, braces for another outburst from Yejue. Only Nicola remains composed, engrossed in her Sudoku puzzle.

"...So, what brings you here? It wasn't about lobsters, was it?"
"No, it wasn't... I got sidetracked by the whole lobster situation. Well, I was supposed to inform you..." Yejue clears her throat, irritation evident, "That you've been selected as one of the initial members for the pathfinding operation in the newly discovered Chaos Space. And I'm your partner, of course! We're embarking on a new explor..."

Before Yejue can finish her sentence, Caroline leaps from the sofa, snatching the report and bouncing with excitement.
"I knew they'd approve our requests!"
"It's the result of our teamwork! But remember, you still need to complete your duty days at this station..."
"Yeah! Got it, got it! Let's have lobster tonight to celebrate!"
Caroline cheers and darts outside. Her departing figure in the corridor hints at a new beginning, leading toward uncharted territories.
des.既然奈弥很喜欢画画，那为什么不能趁着行车途中与她偶遇的间隙找她要一张静物画或人像: Since Nabi enjoys art, then why can't others ask her for a still life painting or portrait if they chance upon her while on the road? In fact, why don't they simply chat about art with her to become close to her?\nThe main reasons are as follows, provided by different people: If one abruptly approaches and asks her what she's doing, Nabi will stop drawing, look up, and answer all questions softly and calmly before resuming her work. If one is overly snoopy about her life and hobbies, she may stare at them, but that already intimidating-looking weapon is generally placed near her seat, glinting ominously... It's only understandable that most people will not have the courage to continue bothering her.\nStill, there are people who get to chat normally with her, one of them naturally being Hayabusa. Cecil, who's raised in Night Chains like Nabi, is also pretty friendly with her. It seems she merely lacks the enthusiasm to do things or interact with others.
des.奈弥的唯一的家人死于一桩意外事故。多年前，如今已是修格里城市长的荷塞尚在四处演讲: Nabi's lone kin had died from an accident. Many years ago, while Jose, the current mayor of Shoggolith City, was giving talks everywhere to run for office, Nabi's father worked for the man as a bodyguard until he eventually sacrificed himself to save his boss' life during an attack. It's hard to imagine what Nabi, who had always lived a serene life, must have felt when she got the news in school.\nAt the time, Jose immediately expressed regret for the death of this subordinate of his and promised to provide for Nabi until she came of age. He assured the young Nabi, "You can choose to do whatever you please," but she gave up on the chance to further her education and instead requested bodyguard training so as to become someone like her father.\nAfter her certification, Nabi was assigned to be Hayabusa's guard by Jose. It isn't known what Hayabusa did, but it seems Nabi now prioritizes his orders over Jose's. Is this a choice she made on her own? And what's the reason behind this?
des.奈弥饲养了一只乌鸦，论谁都会觉得这是一只与她的形象非常契合的宠物。\r不过令人意:
Nabi has a pet crow that anyone would think perfectly complements her image. But surprisingly, this crow was actually given to her by Cecil, who's highly sensitive to smell and has always been reluctant to come in contact with animals.
Cecil said that crows are a kind of intelligent bird that looks fully jet black to humans but stunningly colorful to other birds, and she thought they suit Nabi very well.
Nabi has yet to completely figure out why Cecil gave her the crow, but she felt her friend's thoughtfulness and blessing toward her even though at first, Cecil had only taken the initiative to befriend Nabi because of Nabi's exceptionally faint scent. As time passed, they gradually hit it off and became close friends.
Unlike Nabi, Cecil only looks aloof on the outside and is actually passionate about quite a number of things. Nabi's interest in the world was slowly but surely piqued as she hung out with someone like Cecil. At times, when Nabi recalls what Cecil said about crows, she'll subconsciously feel like the crow suits Cecil more than it does her.
des.很小的时候，奈弥就展现出比同龄人懂事、镇定的特质。\r对于靠守护雇主的性命为职业:
Nabi had already displayed astonishing maturity and composure when she was at a really young age. To her Single father whose job was to protect his boss' life, it was truly heartwarming to have such a sensible daughter who had mentioned more than once during his short trips home that she would like to help him out. He thanked her for the thought and stroked her head, telling her that he was contented and didn't need anything.
One day, as Nabi grew older, her father saw his boss' beautiful, pampered daughter and suddenly realized that aside from daily necessities, it was time to buy Nabi some things she liked. But when he asked her what she wanted, she simply shook her head and said she was already contented with what he had given and didn't need anything else. It eventually dawned on him, after several such conversations, that his daughter didn't appear to have any desire. It was as though she couldn't find anything she liked or anything she wanted to do, and... she didn't seem happy.
This realization left him paralyzed with shame and regret. Meanwhile, Nabi was confused, wondering if she had upset her father by not wanting anything. After all, he would be happy in the past, and she genuinely had nothing she wanted. As she mulled over what to do, she abruptly remembered her teacher mentioning last week that the school would be setting up an art contest, and so she told her father she would like to attend art lessons.
Overjoyed by her request, the man wasted no time purchasing a truckload of art supplies, and Nabi quickly mastered her drawing skills, though she was unable to be creative and imaginative, nor was she inspired to use colors at all. All she could do was continuously replicate real-life sights on paper in grayscale. Before she knew it, sketching became part of her daily routine, and she seemed to have finally found a hobby.
After so many years, Nabi's ability to use knives has long become as brilliant as what she could do with pencils. Like any other day, she went to the art store to get supplies she needed when she, for some odd reason, picked up a box of watercolor paint. Although it wasn't the same brand that her father bought her back then, she felt that it could help her paint the skies she saw a few days ago through The Eternal's window. Perhaps before long, The Eternal's conductor will be able to receive an all-new artwork.
des.在积年累月的观测和研究后，塞西尔发现通过气味可以对生物的行为进行一定程度的诱导。: After years of observation and research, Cecil discovered that it was possible to influence the behavior of living things through smell to some extent. Notably, when some of the constituents were artificially amplified, the effect of smell could even penetrate the strongest barrier of reason and directly cause an irresistible influence on the central nervous system. \nDespite the circumstantial limitations, Cecil still used her superior sense of smell and avid exploration desire to collate a fair bit of data and practical experience, then presented her thesis to Night Chains (though "odorology" research hadn't even been recognized by the academic world at the time). Once Night Chains supplied her with the essentials to create an odorology lab, she pretty much dived back eagerly into her research again.\nThe scent sprays studied by Cecil are included but are not limited to sprays that can quickly relax people when used in moderation or sedate when used excessively, sprays that can boost nerve conduction efficiency, sprays that can affect people's stored memory, sprays that can make someone feel naturally dizzy, and et cetera. These sprays, which are more convenient to use than conventional medication, are being developed one by one as of now, and thanks to their practicality, even B.C.R.L. members purchase them through specific channels to use them in some special operations.
des.“嗅觉灵敏”这种天赋无疑是把双刃剑，由于塞西尔实在是过于敏感，她对于一些食材的气: Talents like a "keen sense of smell" is undoubtedly a double-edged sword. As Cecil's sense of smell is seriously overly sensitive, there are some cooking ingredients whose smell she can't tolerate at all, and those imperceptible body scents caused by diet changes will also be intensified for her. One thing she really dislikes is getting people's awful scent on her, so she tends to have several tricks up her sleeve to prevent that.\nIn contrast to most people who judge by sight, Cecil is more used to determining her first impression of people via smell. With this standard, gender or appearance no longer matters that much to her. The effect of this 'primitive sensory stimulation brought by a sensitive sense of smell' has made the sagacious Cecil extremely devoted to her instinct. Whenever she "smells" someone interesting, she'll actively approach and befriend them, which mostly works out in her favor in view of her amiable good looks.\nSo far, her only setback is probably when she heard that a fellow Night Chains employee Mr. Sagi had welcomed a newcomer named Wensheng, who also categorized people by scent, she confidently went to ask him if he'd like to join her project, only to be turned down. Wensheng's response was, "You reek of medicine," but Cecil was positive she didn't smell like that. Regardless, with her dedication toward the research of smell, this tiny setback isn't even worth mentioning.
des.塞西尔的研究已经步入了实验阶段。她尝试着将各种气味喷雾投入实战用途，也开始为黑月: Cecil's research has already entered the experimental phase. She has tried incorporating all sorts of scent sprays into combat situations and has also started consulting on fragrances used in establishments under Night Chains. In one of her reports, she proved a theoretical perspective with loads of arguments: Smell can affect people's impression of a place and mood... This report quickly became a decision-making reference for various major businesses.\nStatistics show that every Bonfire City's residents have different preferences for fragrances. Frostville City's residents like the smell of warm stoves and stews, while Cape City's residents are inclined to the smell of coastal plants. So long as one makes use of these scents, one will be able to rapidly create ambiences that better suit one's target groups, which will naturally increase the time customers linger around and consequently boost one's product sales. As business revenues were the first to substantiate Cecil's theory, her salary has been raised multifold.\nCecil makes sure every type of perfume or spray goes through the experimental process in order to produce satisfactory products. In her opinion, the most perfect tester is none other than her friend Nabi. That Executor who always desires nothing and has a fainter scent than a NC Ninja never fails to comply with Cecil's research criteria and provide ideal feedback. In a sense, Nabi may have had a part to play in Cecil's success.
des.塞西尔的生活非常简单，基本就是来往于实验场所和住处之间，每天都过着两点一线的生活:
Cecil's lifestyle is exceptionally simple. She basically only spends time in the laboratory and her home day in and day out. If there aren't any outdoor missions or a need to purchase anything, she will never complicate her life, for going somewhere new means coming into contact with impure smells, and she is of the belief she has to ensure "her senses remain pure." It is also the reason why she dislikes pungent food and unhygienic people, but it's a double-edged sword; if she doesn't experience enough scent samples, she will lose touch with the world too.
This problem has troubled Cecil for a long time, and it was only recently that she seemed to have found a solution. On The Eternal, she occupied a small area and ensured it was relatively clean and odorless before waiting aside for the crew and passengers to pass by... If a foreign or interesting smell were to waft up her nostrils, she would seek out the source and dive into an interrogation.
Since there were people from all walks of life on the train, such a method did facilitate Cecil's scent sample collection. Still, from time to time, some special people will also pass by, such as those who lack a scent, those who have particularly bizarre scents, and those who smell sweet but are inexplicably unpleasant.
Whenever Cecil expresses obvious aversion toward someone's scent, the Conductor is obliged to step in right away lest an armed conflict erupts on the train.
des.索玛不擅长社交，甚至会让人觉得她散发出一种“生人勿近”的气息。实际上，她只是有轻:
Sommer isn't great at socializing and may even give off an unapproachable vibe to others, but in reality, she simply has a mild communication disorder. Before even forming an answer for the previous question, she would start considering the possible responses for the next, thus leading her to oftentimes speak in incomplete sentences.

Sommer only has a few friends, the most noteworthy one being Fenia of the Destroyer. Nobody really knows how the two's friendship was formed, but not long after Fenia met Sommer, Fenia could already accurately decipher what Sommer was trying to express through her succinct words. Of course, this is mutual; Sommer also constantly becomes Fenia's first supporter whenever Fenia senses "danger." Even if Fenia's instinct isn't immediately proven to be true, Sommer will always choose to believe her friend.

In contrast with her meek and shy physical looks, Sommer holds nothing back when she eats and never says no to food. Competitive eating is a walk in the park for her, too. She has a habit of carrying plenty of snacks on her everywhere she goes, and there never fails to be a fruity hard candy in her mouth when she's outside. Nonetheless, her physique is virtually unaffected in spite of her horrible eating habits.

"But if Sommer keeps eating at this rate, won't the Citadel eventually run out of food?"
des.变异的左腕令索玛有些自卑，她经常有意无意地想将左手藏起来。同时，她也尝试着为自己:
The mutation on Sommer's left hand has made her feel inferior, so much so that she often subconsciously wants to hide it. At the same time, she also tries to defend it, saying that it won't be used to hurt humans. She had gone through a series of physical examinations as a child when her left hand attracted the attention of a certain Citadel department's researchers. With the excuse that they wanted to revert her hand to how it used to be, she was made to undergo numerous procedures, including skin transplant, blood draws, and Ascension Ability interference, but they were all futile. The pain from the examinations and treatments caused Sommer to have a deep-seated aversion toward medical checkups, especially injections. Just the sight of a needle makes her tense up and makes her heart race, and she even blacked out from fear several times when she was younger.

Once, she learned from a makeup influencer's blog that "cosmetics are the magic of girls," and so she began giving makeup a try. Manicure has become her recent obsession, but people have kindly suggested that she try another color of nail polish, for dark red ones truly look quite frightening in dim places. This suggestion really bothered Sommer to the point that she purchased a horde of multicolored nail polishes to compare and experiment.

While in combat, as long as she utilizes her Ascension Ability, she will sense the effect it has on her mutated hand. Yet, when facing the mutated humans—Deep Sleepers—she can't help but glance at her left hand and wonder, "Am I a monster in human's skin or a human who possesses a monster's power?" It is a question that she's still searching for an answer to this day.
des.索玛的养父是学会中人尽皆知的“英雄”达斯廷，而本该成为她养母的女性在索玛被收养之:
Sommer's adoptive father is Dustin, a well-known "hero" in the Citadel, while the woman who would've become her adoptive mother had already died before the adoption. While Sommer was a child, the town she resided in was destroyed by a Chaos Remain invasion, and she who was buried under debris was saved by the Citadel's rescue team. She made up her mind to repay her savior, but at that tender age, all she remembered through her hazy memory was a pair of large, ice-cold hands holding hers, which ultimately didn't help in locating that person.

Sometime later, the immature Sommer and other children chanced upon an out-of-the-ordinary, injured mechanical man on the airship. The mechanical man's utterly maimed body terrified many of the children, but Sommer sensed that this was the hero who saved her when she was younger, so she braced herself and reached out to verify that ice-cold touch. Afterward, she asked the teacher who looked after her about the "huge mechanical hero" and was informed that he was Dustin, a doctor who once saved countless lives and a loving husband whose family was torn apart by a Chaos Remain attack. As a result, he gave up on medicine and turned to combat, attaining remarkable feats on the battlefield as he helped the Citadel eliminate Chaos Remains, thus making him a hero.

Hearing that, the young Sommer resolved to do a little something for Dustin—help him manage the greenhouse garden left behind by his deceased wife. The greenhouse with tightly shut doors seemed to have been abandoned for ages. Starting from things that a child could do, she began recultivating the plants and even found some relevant books on the desk that belonged to the adoptive mother she never got the chance to meet. As time passed, Sommer fell in love with gardening, for being around plants made her feel more at peace than around people, and she started treating this place as her sanctuary.

Her favorite thing to do during noon breaks was to nap under the cherry tree. Having been surrounded by medical equipment and endless treatment plans since her rescue, it had been forever since she last experienced such warmth and serenity. Meanwhile, Dustin, who coincidentally passed by the greenhouse, noticed that the door was ajar and saw the girl who had just woken up from her nap.

"That was... mom... in my dream, right...?"
des.在达斯廷收养索玛后又过了接近十年，索玛在巡逻中偶遇了受伤严重的那由他。对于看上去:
While on patrol approximately ten years after she was adopted by Dustin, Sommer encountered the severely injured Nayuta, who looked a little menacing. Her companions all advised her, "He's clearly not a good guy. Saving him will only bring you trouble." But Sommer didn't believe in judging a book by its cover and ultimately lent him a hand. Trusting his daughter's judgment, Dustin slowly got to know Nayuta and later vouched for the young man to join the Citadel. That was how their unique "family" formed.

After regaining a healthy body and important family members, Sommer started trying to move on with her new life and began nurturing her own cooking skills when she wasn't on a combat mission. Dustin, having already lost his sense of taste, would control the amount of ingredients used down to the grams, while Nayuta's cooking skills were as unpolished as his magic tricks. Both of them were clearly not the most suitable people she could seek help from, and not to mention, Sommer always felt unconfident about her cooking. Hence, she tended to finish her works of failure on her own even when they were far from palatable. Her wish was to make good food for others since she had always been on the receiving end.

However, ever since Sommer boarded the Eternal, she got lots of friendly concern and assistance. When she accidentally messed up while cooking in the train's kitchen, she instinctively shrank back in fear, only to not be reprimanded but kindly teased and guided by the other crew members.

At this rate, perhaps it won't be long before Sommer produces a much more satisfactory dessert and for her to hear the long-anticipated comments from whom she cares about. If possible, please praise her for her effort.
des.瓦伦汀在巨大的书架和台阶间轻盈穿梭的样子会让人觉得“她就是为了成为司书而生的”，:
Seeing Valentine roam lithely between the huge bookshelves and steps tends to give people the impression that she was born to be a scribe, but her original dream had nothing to do with books at all.
Her parents are both members of the Citadel's Destroyer, and owing to their influence, Valentine had hoped to become a soldier like them since she was a child. Unfortunately, when she took part in Destroyer's recruitment test for combatants, she couldn't pass it despite the huge amount of time and effort she had spent to prepare for it. This result wasn't the end of the world for the cool-headed, down-to-earth Valentine, but she still couldn't help feeling disappointed for a while.
At this time, the Citadel examiner contacted her and asked, "We heard that you used to help out in several branch libraries in Senanonic while schooling and that you can instantly find any book on the shelf. Could you demonstrate that for us?"
Little did Valentine know, her workplace would eventually shift from a tiny branch library to the enormous, castle-like Fabricate. Plus, even to this day, she still has no idea how the Citadel examiner knew of her ability. Her best guess is that someone whom she once helped told them about it.
des.撰文迷宫中储备了一切对学会有用的资料，其中几乎全部都是学术著作。对于瓦伦汀来说，: The Fabricate carries all of the useful information for the Citadel, nearly all of which are academic writings. For Valentine, although she can readily memorize the book titles, covers, and locations on the shelves, she's more keen on fiction books, which are sadly in short supply in the Citadel's archive.\nAs a result, after preparing for some time, she submitted a request to the Citadel, wanting to create a small area in the archive to store non-academic publishings, such as recipe books, travel diaries, fairy tale books, romance novels, and other similar "casual books." These are all completely unnecessary content for the Citadel, but to the people there who crave some other form of entertainment, this is the best kind of consolation and trade-off. Everybody who visits the place is incredibly grateful for Valentine's mini library.\nBeing able to share the joy of reading with everyone enraptured Valentine. Whenever it's break time or if the archive is free from visitors, she'll sit at one of the small desks in the mini library and read the new books or even those that she has already read numerous times.
des.为了充实迷你图书馆的藏书，瓦伦汀时常乘坐列车旅行于各地之间，沉重的行李箱内除去简:
To supplement the mini library's book collection, Valentine regularly takes the train to travel to all kinds of places. Her heavy luggage is constantly filled with books, excluding basic travel necessities. Not only does she bring books from everywhere back to the Citadel's headquarters, but she also donates some of the excess to various library facilities, especially the student societies of every Bonfire City.
She has discovered that similar to the people in the Citadel's headquarters, those living in Bonfire Cities enjoy reading entertainment books too, but in hectic cities, these books aren't the people's foremost choice and have even progressively been replaced by other more modernized types of entertainment.
Whichever bookstore Valentine goes to, she will earnestly purchase all the books that have been labeled as "casual books" and ship them back to the Citadel. Her tone always sounds dismal when she talks about these things to the kids in Senanonic, for it has been her belief that the charm and value of books can't be replaced by any other forms of expression. All that she has been doing is also to spread the charm of books to others, particularly young children.
Of course, not everyone will develop a love for reading. Valentine won't pressurize anyone about it, nor will she draw up booklists or stipulate reading time for the kids. Many of them simply enjoy listening to her story-telling, but her overly relaxing voice often becomes their lullaby... Still, at least the kids always end up quieting down. That is why Valentine is someone the parents greatly respect in the Citadel.
des.就像人们对古典美人的刻板印象一样，瓦伦汀喜欢在读书时品茶。她经常在小柜子里准备许: Just like the stereotype people have of traditional beauties, Valentine fancies a cup of tea while reading. She routinely stocks up her small cabinet with plenty of snacks and desserts to go with it, but once she munches away on these snacks, that stereotype will instantaneously vanish, as her favorites are mostly crunchy stuff like potato chips and rice crackers. Naturally, to prevent leaving food remnants on the books, she eats extra cautiously and even bought a pair of tongs specifically meant for snacks while she was away on a trip. \nTo a certain degree, Valentine has changed everyone's impression of the Citadel's scribe and Fabricate. She is not only approachable but also interested in things other than books, and she even patiently responds to questions asked by people who have sent letters seeking help. The Citadel members eventually felt that although scribes who love snacks weren't common, they were pretty intriguing. This recognition truly left Valentine over the moon.\n"So long as you have a beacon of light in your hand, you will not get lost in the Fabricate," is the understanding the majority of people have about scribes. But sometimes, Valentine can't help but wonder how good it will be if she can also be the light in someone's path to enlightenment.
des.宵月所掌管的黑月匠造是相当有名气的奢侈品品牌，旗下有一系列高级服装定制工作室。对:
The Night Chains Lesage managed by Yoizuki is a relatively prominent luxury brand that owns a string of high-end custom clothing studios. For higher-ups and celebrities of Bonfire Cities, the ability to gain access to Night Chains Lesage's stores is in itself the proof of one's identity and standing.
After taking over as Night Chains Lesage's manager, Yoizuki single-handedly directed the locations, launch, and long-term management of multiple new stores, and she regularly made trips to each store as well. It goes without saying how much her presence brightens up the place. At times, she'll also personally try on the designers' new works and offer feedback from a tester's point of view. With her influence and sophistication, even the richest customer is willing to listen to her suggestions.
As for some more out-of-the-ordinary suggestions, they are usually only given on the down-low during hushed discussions of clothing styles. A visitor talking about patterns on a piece of fabric may just cause said fabric to be stained with a terrifying color in a blink of an eye; exquisitely designed accessories for a particular famous person may just shatter in the next "accident."
In a place where beauty is tailored, all it takes is also merely an instant to destroy this beauty—such is the Night Chains Lesage hidden behind a well-crafted facade.
des.当有人问起宵月身后那位护卫到底是谁的时候，宵月会略微惊讶地回答，“您不知道吗？那: Whenever people ask Yoizuki who exactly that guard behind her is, she will answer in slight surprise, "Don't you know? That white-haired lady is my elder sister."Only with this reminder will most people realize the two look identical, except that guard always lets her hair hang loosely with her gaze lowered, her aura poles apart from Yoizuki's. This "sister" even blends herself into the crowd when Yoizuki attends important events, seemingly unwilling to receive any attention, whereas Yoizuki remains unperturbed without trying to conceal their relationship, never once abandoning her sister regardless of the outside world's opinions.\nBit by bit, people's various speculations turned into approvals and admirations of Yoizuki. They praised her for not looking down on her run-of-the-mill sister and not turning on her twin like the successors of other families did for power... These comments have never been able to elicit any response from Yoizuki. Is she oblivious, or does she simply not care about the weight of these words?\nOn occasion, she'll look back while no one's paying attention and lightly hold the hand of the guard behind her with a smile. When it happens, the white-haired lady will be filled with astonishment and bliss.
des.通常来说，庞大的家族背景往往代表着更多的限制。然而，相对于被家族背景所约束，宵月: Generally speaking, an extensive family background tends to mean way more restrictions. Yet, instead of being hampered by it, Yoizuki actually used her own capabilities to turn Mugenryu into her own usable resources... It is a well-intentioned act concealed under her warm, beautiful smile that few people will detect.Yoizuki's father had regarded this gem of the future very highly since she was a child. While imposing strict limits on her, he also pretty much satisfied any of her requests. The first time Yoizuki showed up at a family meeting shortly after she came of age, she completely took everyone aback with her outstanding speech and left a deep impression on the elders. Part of the family's internal affairs were then soon handed over to her to be managed. Afterward, she gradually became Mugenryu's actual person in charge until she was officially appointed as the next family head.\nBut what exactly is Yoizuki after? Is it to slowly make Mugenryu grow even stronger? Or is it to stabilize her standing in Night Chains? No one seems to have a precise answer to that. Maybe there's one person who will have an idea, but she's determined to keep it a secret until Yoizuki's dream is realized, for she cares about nobody's outcome except Yoizuki's.
des.每次出席重要场合时，宵月总是做好了万全准备。从妆容发型到言谈举止，她决不允许自己:
Whenever Yoizuki attends an important event, she makes sure to be 100% prepared, not being careless about her makeup, hairdo, conduct, or giving herself away in any manner. Meanwhile, Aoba never fails to trail behind Yoizuki in protection at all times.
To the people who share the same interests as Yoizuki, her appearance is immaculate; even Mr. Sagi, who's way more influential than her, has never doubted her capabilities. Nonetheless, there are probably still people in Night Chains who can't stand the existence of such a "perfect" person.
The stronger one is, the more resources they own and expend. Yoizuki is free to spend everything that she owns at any cost. The clothing tailored for her and the jewelry and accessories designed for her consistently make her shine like the fullest moon wherever she goes. Things offered to the moon need not be paid back, save for shining a moment of moonlight on the offerer. Yet, that moonlight doesn't only shine on people who yearn for glory but also on those who have collapsed while chasing the moon.
In spite of that, the moon continues radiating its stunning light as though it never knew.
des.根据黑月的相关资料显示，魇擅长使用刀具，而且计划周密、行动谨慎，在一众黑月执行人: According to Night Chains' relevant information, Maruha is skilled at using Katana, does thorough planning, and acts cautiously, thus explaining her stellar mission success rate among the executors of Night Chains. The coldness, decisiveness, and perceptiveness she manifests during combat give her the advantage of unpredictability, which greatly contradicts what she's typically like as an attendant. Her two dearest Katanas are named "Denchuwari" and "Senrokiri" respectively. Though no one has truly seen her cut off utility poles (Denchu) or railway tracks (Senro), the swordsmanship prowess she exhibits in combat makes one wonder whether she could actually do it if she puts her mind to it. It's worth noting that Maruha isn't only adept at concealing herself to catch her enemies off guard on the battlefield; even in daily life, her whereabouts are also mystifying, as if she's actively engaging in some kind of secret activity. As for which side her true self really is, it's doubtful it can be concluded any time soon.
des.黑月旗下的娱乐公司曾向内部成员发送过影视作品喜好的调查问卷，而魇在问卷上“对你产: The entertainment company under Night Chains once surveyed the internal members about their movie and TV show preferences, and Maruha's answer to "a movie or TV show that deeply influenced you" turned out to be an action flick with mediocre box office sales, whose plot was about a lone hero destroying a certain crime syndicate.\nShe noted that her favorite part was when the cold-blooded, insufferably arrogant villain got driven into a corner by the hero bit by bit, and she wrote, "The film perfectly portrayed the patheticness of a once-esteemed person begging for mercy to survive."\nIt's unclear if it was a coincidence, but soon after that movie was no longer screening in theaters, an infamous delinquent was attacked near Maruha's residence and ended up in a seriously miserable state. It's almost as though he was punished by an unknown hero, said the residents who were glad to hear the news.
des.魇的战斗能力十分出色，或许是由于她的升构能力本就本就非常适用于战斗？不过，被她的: Maruha's combat skills are beyond outstanding, likely because her ascension abilities are ideal for combat, to begin with. Nonetheless, hotel guests who have been comforted by her smile probably wouldn't wish to see what she's like on the battlefield. With her two dearest weapons in both hands, she's capable of slashing a colossal Chaos Remain into two in a flash, which hardly makes for a good subject to discuss in the pleasant, luxurious Night Chains Hotel.\nMaruha never compares her two jobs. To her, there is no conflict of interest in whether or not she's an attendant or a righteous executor; instead, the two jobs complement each other. She can gather intel from people's conversations at formal events or high-end restaurants, sieve through them to locate the target, leave the hotel to change into her "work gear," and then execute whatever needs to be done before cleaning up and returning to the hotel. It is a process she has gone through innumerable times.\nOf course, the best part is getting to hear customers talk about "the result of her execution" while she serves food in the restaurant. Punishing criminals gives innocents peace of mind and also discourages other criminals. There's nothing that gives her more motivation to work than this.
des.在某次执行制裁时，被逼到绝境的恶徒抱着魇的大腿求饶，发出了牲畜一般的哀嚎。\r“:
One time, while Maruha executed a punishment, the desperate criminal hugged her thigh and howled like an animal, begging, "Please! ...Anything you want! Money? Chaos Stones? Or the official proof of residence for any Bonfire City? I can give them all to you... Please, just let me go!"
She stayed silent, simply staring at that tear-streaked face that was scrunched up from terror. The criminal knew there was nothing he could do now that his attempted bribing flopped. He could only ask one last question before taking his last breath, "Why?"

"Why?"
Maruha repeated that question in her mind after leaving her secret base in the darkness and stepping back into the sunlight. Lowering her head, she saw dried blood stains between her fingers and quickly washed them off with water once she got back to her hotel dorm. However, the accumulated emotions in her heart over the years—the pleasure of punishing criminals and the slight daze afterward—can never be washed away.
Why? Even her colleagues at Night Chains who are at most acquaintances had asked her the same question. Though they wouldn't stop or interfere, they were curious how one movie managed to change a person's life to such an extent.

Naturally, Maruha could easily give answers like "for justice" or "to be a hero," but when she reapplies dark nail polish on her fingers after washing away the blood stains, she's well aware that she isn't doing this solely for those pretentious reasons. Still, it wouldn't be accurate if she answered "just to satisfy my own desire," at least not entirely.
Maruha didn't answer that already dead criminal or those "concerned" colleagues, not because she didn't want to but because she couldn't.

Her hope is to someday, meet that wise one behind Night Chains whom her teacher told her about and obtain an answer that can convince herself. Before that day comes, she will continue walking the path she selected even with that question endlessly repeating in her heart.
des.出生于修格里城的普通家庭，是家中的长女，负责照顾弟弟妹妹。儿时只能和其他孩子挤在: Born into a regular family in Shoggolith City, Yejue is the eldest daughter and is responsible for looking after her younger siblings. As a child, she had to cramp in one room with the other kids, and her only entertainment was the short while she was allowed to watch television after school. It was through the screen of the old TV that she saw the brilliant, spotless skyscrapers and the impeccable lifestyles of the elite that almost seemed unreal, and from then on, she silently wished to also become this successful in the future!\nMore than a decade has passed. Now, whenever Yejue returns from a mission and flops onto the train seat caked in dust and mud, she will think about her childhood wish while exhausted. Well, her destination is indeed Anita's Researcher's Dormitory, its surroundings are pleasant, and the company has pretty good benefits, not to mention she even got a little pay raise this month... but somehow, she feels like this differs from the success people generally envision.
des.阿妮塔能源第二部门的员工们都身负不同的职责，即使都被笼统地称作“园丁”，各个工种: The employees of Anita Energy's second division all have different responsibilities and do different work despite being known as "Gardeners" as a whole. Caroline and Yejue met when they were both assigned as "pathfinders," and because they're both incredibly competent and have compatible personalities, they're often semi-forced to work together.\nA pathfinder's main responsibility is to go on field explorations in the Chaos Space and draw a map so that future research and pioneer teams can carry out their work more easily. Yejue, who's more cool-headed, favors the mapping process to be no-nonsense, and yet usually, at this moment, Caroline would've already rushed out fearlessly miles away. This is the biggest disagreement between their partnership, which has prompted all sorts of other mild conflicts.\n"I totally wasted time majoring in civil engineering in university... If only I knew I'd eventually have to catch my partner in the Chaos Space for a living!" grumbled Yejue with a sigh. Still, she always finds Caroline, who loves going off on her own, and returns safely from the Chaos Space alongside her partner.
des.受到学生时期必须节约时间投入学习的习惯影响，即使在进入社会后，叶珏对衣物的第一要:
Even after Yejue joined the workforce, her first requirement for clothes was practicality due to the habit of having to save time to study while she was schooling. But after her colleagues gave her some recommendations and reminders, she began slowly trying to make her practical outfits more aesthetically pleasing too, albeit only for a short while.
Once she became a certified Gardener, she was crestfallen at the thought that she'd never get to wear normal clothes anymore, and so she went to dye her hair into a bright pink color that she'd always wanted, which turned out surprisingly good. Hence, her spontaneous hairstyle remains to this day.
Though Yejue may be pleased with her new image, when she finally got a long break from work and went home to visit her family, her mother immediately gave Yejue an earful for her hairstyle. "What in the world did you do to your hair? Look at the mess of colors. How can you be a role model to your siblings this way? And where's your boyfriend? Have you found one?"
Yejue didn't end up dying her hair back into its original color, but her mother's disapproval still dealt quite a heavy blow to her. She had gone through so much to attain some achievements at work, only to end up being criticized by her family. This made her feel like she still wasn't successful enough.
Outside of her career, her family's foremost expectation for her was to find a good man... but she genuinely had no idea where to start looking for one. While ruminating about life and the world, she even went to study old astrology books and learned much relevant knowledge, but up until now, Yejue is still stumped by her relationship problems, or the lack thereof. The one thing she did learn, however, is how to take advantage of the weather during rainstorms to summon another bolt of lightning onto Chaos Remains.
