des.叶珏的各种家务技能都非常熟练，大到全屋大扫除、小到缝纽扣，她都能把一切安排得服服: Yejue is especially proficient at all kinds of household chores. From spring-cleaning the whole house to sewing buttons, nothing fazes her. The Eternal happens to have several crew members who lack general knowledge and don't know how to take care of themselves, so Yejue has become somewhat of a sisterly figure who looks after them all the way she would her younger siblings. Needless to say, nagging is also part of the deal sometimes, though afterward, she always takes it up upon herself to teach them what to do in the same situation the next time.\nIn the past, Yejue didn't give much thought about her life outside of work, and even her job of assisting The Eternal was only done according to the responsibilities specified in the contract. However, here, she came to know lots of different people and saw different sceneries, and this train gradually became a vaster world in her eyes.\nShe met and became the big sister of many new "brothers and sisters," her relationship with her partner has eased up marginally, her work is going fairly smoothly, and her income has also increased... It seems she who has been trained by various utilitarian demands is presently discovering the fine balance of what belongs to herself. Of course, if her wish of finding her significant other can also come true...
des.所有和伊尔有过交流的人都对她留下了“说话耿直”的印象。往好处说就是心直口快，可是: Everyone who has interacted with Yer thinks of her as "straightforward." On the plus side, it means she's as honest as you can get, but that same honesty has also offended people's feelings numerous times. However, she never converses with the mindset of deliberately being mean and insulting others; it is merely all because of her inability to understand and learn complex social cues. Yer has never known how to beat around the bush, nor can she read between the lines of people's words. All she knows is to use the most simple, direct words. Although such a way of speaking may be a problem when socializing, it's a highly efficient method of expression in work environments. She's excellent at operating drones through plain, concise commands and is an indispensable asset to everyone.
des.虽然阿妮塔内部会为员工提供营养均衡的餐食，但是也有许多员工会选择自己烹饪菜肴。偶: Even though Anita does provide nutritional meals for their staff, plenty of them prefer making their own food. The Gardeners from different Bonfire Cities sometimes cook and introduce their hometown's specialty cuisines, but if anyone asks to trade food with Yer, everyone will definitely hastily try to stop that thought in horror. The reason is simple: Anyone who tastes the food Yer makes will never want to try it a second time. Yet, she has yet to realize that she's a horrendous cook and stubbornly insists the issue is just different seasoning methods of different regions. People always stare at her in astoundment as she happily digs into those foods that they can hardly keep down.
des.伊尔的童年以及少年生活，在他人眼中堪称幸福。父母对伊尔的成长展现出了超常的热情和: Yer's childhood and adolescent years are pretty much blissful in people's perspectives. Her parents exhibited tremendous enthusiasm and concern toward her growth, but such excessive concern only served to trouble Yer, who's innately placid. After all, not everyone can accept their parents always being in the honeymoon phase, especially with them constantly spoiling and doting on her like a little kid. Without a doubt, Yer loves her parents with all her heart, but their excessively affectionate and clingy relationship makes her uncomfortable. As a matter of fact, owing to how childish the couple can be at times, Yer actually acts more like the adult in the family instead. Good-looking and independent from a young age, Yer has caught the eye of many other suitors as well, but she honestly prefers being alone and doing whatever she likes. These numerous factors ended up leading her to join Anita after graduating from school.\n\nTo her, being a "Gardener" is the ideal profession. Not only can she distance herself from her original social circle and enter another space, but she can also spend the long hours of researching and data analysis alone. Therefore, this job that would make plenty of people feel lonely actually puts Yer completely at ease and in her own element. At work, Yer is as good as the definition of "efficient." Besides her consistent standards in professional matters, she pretty much reduces pointless social interactions as much as possible, solely communicating when there's useful information to be exchanged. This is one compliment all employees who have worked with her tend to give. With that being said, it doesn't mean Yer abandons basic etiquette. She speaks politely to the majority of the people and is especially serious when it comes to work. Nonetheless, there is also an exception. When it comes to her senior, Akira, she truly doesn't have it in her to be reverential.
des.进入阿妮塔后，伊尔选定了无人机作为自己的专业领域。在她看来，这些结构精巧的飞行机:
After joining Anita, Yer selected drones as her specialization. In her view, these flying machinery with intricate frameworks are marvelous support tools that can make up for the disadvantage of her working alone and thus being short on time. It makes her feel at peace and happy when she gets to dismantle or build drones all on her own without any disturbances.

Even though Yer has experienced numerous changes, she always manages to maintain an unwavering state of mind. No matter if it's when she's assigned a new task, partnered up with different people, or going to various places, she never fails to give the impression of a collected and dependable person. Of course, some have deemed that as her lacking emotions, but anyone with even a slight understanding of her would know that she, in fact, has many adorable moments.

Recently, Yer often spends time in the Eternal's passenger car, either drawing images meant for paper cutouts or relaxing by playing video games. Despite her small gaming console having only a pellet-eating game, the noisy sound effects still tend to attract the attention of several passengers, making them lean in to watch her play. From what she expressed, the passengers do not interrupt her, so it isn't so bad to be observed every now and then after all.
des.不仅在阿妮塔内部，即使放眼整个科学界，妮蔻拉也能算作一位出众的科学新秀。“新秀”:
Nicola is considered an extraordinary, up-and-coming scientist not only in Anita but the entire scientific world. She's only described as an "up-and-comer" in respect of those veteran scientists who have invested in the energy sector for decades; as a matter of fact, her achievements have already become out of most people's leagues, and she's not stopping any time soon.

Those who see her for the first time would likely all be won over by reason of her ultra-modern outfit alone. It was a design custom-made for her to significantly save time on selecting, changing, and washing clothes.

Just like people's stereotypical idea of genius scientists, Nicola is devoted to her research and even somewhat neglects essential daily activities, and the rest of the Anita staff in the energy research institute seem to be rather critical of that. Some say that she does nothing aside from eat, drink, sleep, and research; some say that she has no intention of forming relationships with her colleagues at all... If you've seen Nicola's way of doing things, you'll know about 80% of these criticisms are probably true.

Regardless, they don't bother her one bit. She still devotes her life to research as though that is her whole world.
des.妮蔻拉对研究的执着似乎到了一种不能只用“热爱”来概括的程度。坊间传闻称，这和她初:
Nicola's dedication toward research seems to have reached a degree where "passionate" has become an understatement. Word has it that this has to do with what she experienced when she first joined Anita. Everything she's doing now is actually purely to prove her excellence.

When she first joined Anita, Nicola's talent in invention didn't get any recognition. After she independently created a train engine modification plan that increased Chaos Stone usage efficiency and reduced damage rate, her superior simply skimmed through it before putting it on the back burner. It was only when Eliade came to visit with his students that he stumbled upon it and was full of praise.

However, Nicola's superior took credit for this invention and even hurriedly patented it under his name. Nicola didn't give up, though. She quickly presented a new and improved version of the plan, proving she was the true original creator of this invention and revealing the true colors of her dishonest superior. Blown away by the remarkable capability of this young lady, Eliade, a mentor, then recommended her to the higher-ups of every department.

With that, Nicola earned the chance to showcase her abilities and, using her own hard work and gift, got to where she presently is, where her excellence has frankly long been proven.
des.妮蔻拉记不住人脸。\r并不是她在这方面有什么先天性的障碍，而是单纯觉得没有必要去:
Nicola is unable to remember people's faces not because of a congenital disorder but because she simply finds it unnecessary. After leaving her hometown, from schooling to joining Anita, she has not remembered a single person's face since. In the beginning, owing to her insouciance, some people even felt offended, thinking she was doing it on purpose. It didn't take long before they realized Nicola just purely didn't care about anyone, which in turn made them, who really took it to heart, look ridiculous.

Nicola doesn't see anything wrong about this. She has already made up her mind to use every single one of her brain cells for research, so remembering people's appearance—especially of irrelevant people—is simply a waste of brain capacity and a hindrance to her work. She doesn't even remember the Gardeners whom she works with and regularly mixes up Caroline and Yejue.

It's no surprise that Caroline and Yejue do have opinions about this, but they can only complain about that in private. After all, the only way Nicola remembers someone is by their scientific contribution, such as published theses or major inventions. For Caroline and Yejue, it's still miles away before they reach the level that Nicola can remember them.

If someday, there exists a person whom Nicola can remember not through theses and the like... then that person must be a one-of-a-kind existence.
des.在大陆的最东边，有一座名为米卢廷的幸运小镇。之所以说它幸运，是因为地卫二降临时，:
On the easternmost side of the continent exists a lucky town named Milutin. It's deemed lucky because when Morphic Moon came, it was one of the rare few residential areas that weren't really affected. There are no changes to their geographical environment, nor did Chaos Remains and Deep Sleepers emerge. Even atheists won't be able to help themselves from thinking this must be a place blessed by God.

In fact, the residents of Milutin are believers of God, and they believe it was their unwavering faith and reverence toward God that saved the place from the harm of Morphic Moon. Hence, they've stuck even more to that ancient and traditional way of living in spite of the railway being built right to their entrance.

What no one expected is that Nicola, who drastically transformed the scientific world, was actually born in such an underdeveloped, uninspiring place.

Nicola was welcomed to this world on a stormy night right as a bolt of lightning split the dark skies and engulfed the entire room in its blinding light. This incredible phenomenon made people dub Nicola the "Child of the Light."

Everybody placed high hopes on her, believing she could carry on her father's legacy and become a devout follower of God. Yet, she wasn't interested in the so-called "God" of the Milutin residents, for there wasn't any theory to prove its existence or any evidence that could help her prove it did exist.

"'God' isn't real," was the conclusion Nicola arrived at, but she was aware that such a controversial view couldn't be said aloud to the Milutin residents.

Machinery and physics became her obsession, and her favorite things to do were to continuously disassemble and reconstruct objects around her. As she aged, her talent in math and physics became increasingly pronounced, but this was upsetting to the people who had placed high hopes on her, for they felt that she had "gone astray" and was no longer the "Child of the Light."

Unbeknownst to them, once Nicola left Milutin, she could practically be described as a pegasus who had finally been set free and allowed to fly. Her brilliant abilities quickly made a huge impact on the world, just like a bolt of lightning rending the unknown and impossible. If the outside world were to find out about her former nickname, they would without a doubt praise unanimously, "She is indeed the 'Child of the Light'!"
des.作为自由过头的超级乐天派，多萝西并不是无视规则。只是，当天马行空的奔放思维和惊人: As an ultra carefree super optimist, Dorothy isn't really against rules. It's just that when her bold, unbridled thoughts and astonishing drive merge together, it'll lead to her doing things spontaneously and unthinkingly. Verily, it's all thanks to this always energetic moodsetter that the impression some people have of Team Ratel is "three persons and one very noisy girl." As for how this behavior developed, one will probably have to know her better to understand.\n\nDorothy's outwardly slim body actually contains immense agility and burst power. Rapidly throwing bombs and installing explosives are second nature to her, and she also has a flair for demolishing buildings and scattering enemies. Just one look at her pressing down on the detonator with twinkling eyes and a wide grin, and it's apparent she has tremendous passion for this career, which makes her high standards for researching and developing bombs so much more understandable. To produce a sufficiently stunning, magnificent effect, no matter if it's the dissipation rate or specific color of the smoke of an exploded bomb, Dorothy will repeatedly experiment until perfection. Julian, who's part of Team Ratel, once saw some manuscripts on Dorothy's desk with unsettling titles that went something like "Simple and Easy DIY Explosives" and "Thrilling Explosions You Can Make in the Kitchen!" ...Let's just hope she wasn't being serious.
des.多萝西的性格让她和小队中的其余三人关系都不错，但令人意外的是，她最好的朋友是来自:
With Dorothy's personality, it's not a surprise how easy it is for her to form good relationships with her other three teammates, but what is unexpected is that her best friend is Ilona of Team Meerkat. The duo, with temperaments and conducts that differ like night and day, had met at BCRL's training camp as batchmates. It's only predictable that Dorothy would bug a dog-tired Ilona with her one-sided enthusiasm; what really has jaws dropping is that Ilona could actually bear with Dorothy's "torment."

After graduating from the training camp with outstanding results for her practical assessment, Dorothy officially became a member of BCRL and was assigned to the highly mobile Team Ratel. Although there have been instances of her doing things in advance or disobeying commands in actual combat from time to time, these acts were all done according to her own unique set of guidelines and mostly brought about better outcomes. The rest of Team Ratel have pretty much already given up on controlling Dorothy. Giving her a fixed amount of freedom to make her own decisions can instead let her adequately demonstrate her abilities.
Of course, making highly hazardous explosives in the carriage isn't part of the deal. Should any public facility be accidentally damaged from an explosion, she will still have to compensate out of pocket for it.
des.幼时的多萝西身患严重的呼吸道疾病，经常出入医院，超过一半的童年时光都是在病床上度:
When Dorothy was younger, she was diagnosed with a severe respiratory disease and frequently visited the hospital, spending over half of her childhood on hospital beds. Despite her father constantly keeping her company and encouraging her, young Dorothy was extremely downcast about not being able to travel and engage in many physical activities. She always looked at the skies outside the window, wanting nothing more than to live as freely as a bird. The doctor assured her over and over again, "You'll be cured once you reach the right age for surgery," and thus she kept hoping for time to fly by while enduring the agonizing treatment.

Many years later, Dorothy was truly cured upon being treated with new medical technology. Her physical condition progressively returned to normal like most healthy people her age after the brief recovery period was over. According to her father, when she received that medical report stating that she had a clean bill of health, her eyes lit up as she squealed, "So, I can do whatever I want now, right?!" The next second, she was already out the door.

During Dorothy's "I can do whatever I want" phase, she finally had a thorough experience of school life. Following that, she tried to prepare for the medical licensing exam but failed, and so she changed her plans and entered BCRL's training camp (while concealing the fact that she's the daughter of a particular bigwig), eventually getting her wish of becoming a BCRL soldier. Her energy and zealousness have brought everyone lots of surprises and shocks, and these shocks sum up what people think of her. As previously mentioned, it is a rather polarizing impression.
des.多萝西最爱的座驾是一辆经过改装的摩托。相比能够驾驭大型车辆和各种载具的静流，多萝:
Dorothy's favorite vehicle is a modified motorcycle. Compared to Shizuru, who can handle all types of vehicles, including large ones, Dorothy is better at zooming between cities on motorcycles and will sometimes also ride modified ones into danger zones. She much prefers putting on some speed everywhere she goes than following the convoy. However, a riding style with the sole purpose of chasing speed and thrill truly isn't a popular choice people make, so Dorothy generally has to ride alone. If anyone rides pillion on her motorcycle, make sure to take protective measures before she twists the throttle.

Dorothy's passion for various outdoor activities is out of this world as well. In her opinion, wasting leisure time at home is a total letdown for a holiday! Ilona, as a friend Dorothy made in BCRL's boot camp, can only helplessly say, "There's nothing I can do about her." The others must also have the same sentiment in this regard.

Word has it that recently, Dorothy has been researching a new type of explosive that can produce unprecedentedly amazing effects after exploding, and the blast effect is substantially improved from previous ones too. In order to turn her newest creation into reality as soon as possible, she has pleaded with everyone on the Eternal to help her conduct experiments...

Anyhow, just sit back and brace yourself for her next blasting experiment to get off to an impactful start.
des.吾乃咒魔剑姬卡塔斯，身体中寄宿着不断游走、不断变化的深渊之暗，时而寄宿于双眼、时: In the body of Jumakenki, Katas, lives an incessantly wandering and changing abyssal darkness that at times occupies her eyes and at times the hands that bear her's past karma. To suppress this force, Lord of Black Iron has to routinely offer precious oblations to Jumakenki Katas, or she will have no alternative but to leave the Realm of Black Iron! On top of that, a myriad of entertaining classic literature and an eternally peaceful resting place are also required...\n\n"So basically a salary, work meals, comics, and break time? Just call her off the train when there's work. She has nothing to do most of the time anyway. When she's missing, it means she's seriously too broke to feed herself and has gone to accept some commissions for money," remarked a certain passenger familiar with Katas, with no holds barred, before putting down this "Legend of Jumakenki" back on Conductor's desk.
des.卡塔斯的战斗能力意外地相当强，能把斧……“魔剑暗耀斩钢”挥得虎虎生风，斩击和劈砍:
Katas's combat ability is surprisingly strong. She's capable of swing the ax... the "Spellblade Umbral Fulgor" impressively, and her slashing and chopping techniques are formidable too. That said, she hardly has any combat strategy; her immense physical strength is basically all there is to it. Fortunately, her strength isn't that kind of uncontrollable odd power, so exaggerating accidents like snapping shelves or crushing staircases do not occur outside of the battlefield.

She lives life with an extreme devil-may-care attitude, her motto being living in the present. Anytime she makes money, she will happily go shopping, spending it on stuff that only chuuni girls fancy, like funky clothes (best if it's an all-new design), new cosmetics (not too expensive but must be glittery), and all sorts of personalized stickers and accessories, to name a few. In addition, she's a fan of several classic comics and often visits comic stores in search of new, interesting works.

Her curiosity about novelty things is sky-high, which makes her easily fall prey to advertisements and promotions and buy things she doesn't really need. Such a spending habit has led her to always be penniless and put her in an endless cycle where she has to work once her pockets are empty. Katas herself has no problem with this way of living, though, so it doesn't really matter.
des.卡塔斯经常在停靠站的炸鸡店、小吃店、家庭餐厅……等等物美价廉的吃饭场所出现。如果:
Oftentimes, Katas will patronize the fried chicken stores, snack bars, family restaurants, and other cheap and good food and beverage establishments at stations. If you ever see her eating happily in a restaurant, it means the restaurant's food prices and quality must be pretty good, so you could consider joining her for a meal.

In terms of food preference, her topmost choice is a sumptuous bento with meat, vegetables, and rice. Combinations like this are few and far between in the Empire, but they're widely popular in Bonfire Cities. Katas is friendly with numerous restaurant owners, thanks to her huge appetite and upfront payment method. The owners all delightfully comment that though she behaves somewhat peculiarly, she never fails to dig in with abandon!

When she receives compliments, she will scratch her head bashfully and politely remark to the owners, "Your food is amazing. I'll certainly come again." It is a moment where no one can ever tell she's that fervorous Jumakenki. Perhaps this is what they call her true colors.

Regardless, please do not casually suggest Katas try cooking herself or casually taste the food she makes on a whim once in a while. The "Feast of the Abyss" made by Jumakenki isn't something most people can tolerate, especially since it may very well have been burned by flames created from her Ascension Ability.
des.卡塔斯其实对各类奇怪的书籍相当有兴趣。一部分原因是因为能从奇怪的书籍中汲取扮演“:
Truth be told, Katas is pretty interested in all kinds of strange books. Part of the reason is because she gets to draw inspiration from them to play her role as Jumakenki, and another part is because the knowledge she can acquire from them is indeed intriguing. Sadly, she's not exactly a conscientious learner, so only a minimal amount of this knowledge will be absorbed by her while the rest will be read and then forgotten. She has tried adding the "well-read learner" character to her persona too, but due to her terrible forgetfulness, this idea, alongside the forgettable knowledge, has been wiped clean from her mind.

Sometimes, ignorance is truly bliss. If Katas really commits those fables to memory, she would've long discovered that almost everyone around her is someone with an incredible identity or background.

Thus far, her life remains joyous and practically worry-free, and her reputations in the Citadel and the Eternal crew are steadily improving. In time to come, she might become a member of the Destroyer or even a big shot in the Citadel, or she might continue staying on the Eternal, loudly demanding for "Jumakenki's offerings"... Who knows? Let's just sincerely wish her luck, and may there always be tasty foods by her side.
des.柯娜自小就对帝国盛行的骑士传说充满了憧憬。幸运的是，无论是体魄还是运动能力，她都: Connor has been fascinated by the Empire's popular legend of knights since she was a child. Fortunately, no matter if it was her physique or physical fitness, she was considered the cream of the crop among people her age. These factors altogether were enough to make the young Connor set the ambitious goal of being an Empire knight.\nHowever, in today's Empire, knights seem to have lost their original purpose and have become ornamental existences for the wealthy. Connor chose not to box herself in with the title and instead carried out her knighthood in a more down-to-earth method. With that, she became an Empire soldier who could protect civilians at the frontline, though it came with the price of losing her glamorous identity.\nWith firm goals and impressive capabilities, Connor never forgot to look out for her companions as she marched on with valiance. She was the most trusted and dependable partner of her comrades. One day, a bigwig selected and entrusted Connor with an exceedingly consequential "thing," which turned out to be a task that wholly changed her life.
des.除了那块不离手的盾牌，柯娜身边最亲密的伙伴无疑是她的摩托。\r在帝国没有这样的交: Besides that shield that never leaves her hand, the closest companion of Connor is unequivocally her motorcycle. Such a vehicle doesn't exist in the Empire. When she saw it for the first time after arriving on the surface, she immediately became hooked on the feeling of riding it.\nTo her, her motorcycle isn't merely a great form of transportation but also an important partner that has been by her side throughout her time on the surface. She especially loves the sensation of being able to speed to her heart's content on vacant lands, and it never fails to put a euphoric smile on her face. In fact, the more recklessly she rides, the more fulfilling her experience is.\nNevertheless, Connor is well aware that her riding style often worries and scares others. When someone rides pillion on her motorcycle, she will slow down so as to let her passenger lean on her back with peace of mind.
des.“从今天开始，你的职责就是保护这个孩子。”\r“这、这么重要的使命交给我吗！？我:
"From today onward, your job is to protect this child."
"Y-You're handing such a critical mission to me?! I'm merely an ordinary soldier. I'm not up to it..."
The first time meeting that white-haired girl, Connor panicked, as she knew how important this child was for the entire Mundus Empire. It baffled her how such a major responsibility could've been entrusted to her.
"Are you opting to disregard the words of mine, the great sage, now?" asked an elegant, dignified woman with a smile. As a matter of fact, that was the first time she used her identity as the "Tower Sage" to pressure Connor.
"...All right, I'll do as you ask." Connor knelt to show her absolute allegiance toward this great sage. With her head bowed, she gently pressed her forehead on the back of the Tower Sage's extended hand. "I shall undertake this sacred mission, fight to protect her, and remain eternally loyal and fearless unto death."
Even though that great one is no longer around and Connor had no choice but to leave her homeland, even though this child has already lost her memories, abilities, and name and has found a new life... Connor will never ditch the vows she made back then.
des.不见了。\r意识到这一点的时候，柯娜陷入了深深的绝望之中，被那位大人托付的重要女:
She's gone.
Upon realizing this, Connor fell into deep despair, in disbelief that the important girl whom the great one entrusted to her had disappeared into thin air the instant they stepped on the surface after an arduous trip. She searched with all her might, coming up with all kinds of ideas as a mercenary and even resorting to going back to the Empire a couple of times, but alas, the child remained nowhere to be found.
Just as Connor was at her wits' end, the B.C.R.L. officer who frequently assigned her jobs showed her the way. As all she saw from that middle-aged man's face was sincerity, she opted to trust this surface dweller and hence became one of them. With that, she began wandering around numerous people of the Empire to gather intel, win a suitable candidate over, or blatantly eliminate some pesky people in the name of a commission. Perhaps that wasn't the right thing to do, but failing at that person's last dying wish had already made Connor plunge into a deep well of shame.
At last, Connor ran into the person she had searched all over the planet for, the child having now assumed the name 'Livia' and been employed as an assistant in COLUMBA CBCRR23's train crew. Livia had forgotten everything, save for Connor.
"I have to take her back to the Empire at all costs," thought Connor. However, it dawned on Connor that this child now has things of her own that she wants to do, not to mention she has met the person that she must meet no matter what.
Since that's Livia's choice, Connor will do anything to protect the girl. Despite knowing that The Ascension will never go easy on renegades, she's determined to see this through to the end.
des.丽桑德拉来到无垠号上后，几乎所有曾受过她点拨、帮助、指导的年轻人都过上了神经紧绷:
After Lissandra came aboard the Eternal, practically all the youngsters who had received her help, tips, and guidance began living life on edge. Katas no longer practices Soul-shattering Slash in the aisle, Suen no longer gets rambunctious in the dining carriage, and even Rina Von and Fenia - who are typically more disciplined - have applied to leave the carriage temporarily.

Of course, there are also people who haven't been affected by her, such as Joshua and Dustin. Joshua still carries on with their habit of sleeping as and when they wish, with no concern for anyone else's feelings; not even when Lissandra stands before them do they care to wake up. Dustin, on the other hand, simply had a brief conversation with her before rushing off to somewhere else that needed him more, so that was that.

Some people regard Lissandra as a respectable teacher, some treat her as their trustworthy comrade, and some seem to be nervous and even afraid around her. With such a great discrepancy in people's attitudes and opinions of her, this naturally begs the question: Just what experience was it that shaped this "executor" into who she is now?
des.丽桑德拉的战斗方式能给人留下深刻的印象——身材高挑匀称的她却以一把看起来比她本人:
Lissandra's combat technique truly blows people's minds away. She, who's tall and clean-limbed, actually wields a huge hammer that seems heavier than herself. Her agility and quick-thinking skills on the battlefield are exceptionally strong, her combat strategies equally impressive. Whenever she appears among a wave of Chaos Remains with that hammer in hand, the victory of the battle is virtually already declared.

Lissandra's Ascension Ability isn't clearly registered in any file, and she never brings it up on her own either. That said, several related information and even records from dozens of years ago have indicated that she will "send those people whom she thinks need it to dreamscape." Rather than an objective description of an Ascension Ability, records like that seem more like some sort of glamorized outcome that isn't really credible. But if anyone asks Lissandra about her Ascension Ability, the answer is relatively ambiguous too.

"That is indeed what I do. Apart from passing judgments, I will also give the sinner a gift... Allowing them to welcome their finality in such a dreamscape is the mission given by God, as well as God's mercy."

Despite constantly talking about "God," Lissandra has never once explained who exactly the "God" is.
des.现在，在与丽桑德拉有所接触、或听说过她事迹的人的认知中，丽桑德拉的所作所为仁慈而:
Now, to the people who have interacted with or heard of Lissandra, everything she does is benevolent and humane, another interpretation of the Citadel's "saving humanity" philosophy. But in daily life, she's still a decently rational person; you will even see her playing assistant to other mentors or volunteering in Bonfire Cities' events.

Lissandra also enjoys cooking, albeit the food she makes doesn't look too appealing, and her favorite pastime is to hum a song while creating potions with unknown usage, though she rarely lets anyone use them. Her method of making potions is somewhat similar to what Arcana is used to, and the songs she sings mostly come from the Empire. Based on all the evidence, she's quite possibly a native of Mundus as well.

Yet, the Citadel has no clear records of Lissandra's background. Only in the Fabricate - the place that houses all of the Citadel's books from the beginning of time, where a mere handful of people are able to enter - can bits and pieces of information be found linked to this name and figure in red.

It was only in recent decades that "Lissandra" started appearing in the outside world again. Considering that she can flawlessly recount the things that transpired when the Citadel was first founded, she is commonly regarded as one of the early members of the Citadel, even though the history of the Citadel has dated back long over a hundred years.
des.一旦出现事关重大的、会引发人类强烈情感波动的事件，丽桑德拉就会出现，对事件进行调:
Whenever something consequential that majorly affects humankind occurs, Lissandra will show up, investigate it, and pass judgment on whoever's involved. She will look into their past, family background, life experience, and even little-known details of these people with a fine-tooth comb, then compile these pieces of information into a complete case file.

In the past, countless people opted to be Lissandra's student due to their admiration for her knowledge and character, but upon witnessing her perseverance in gathering and studying these pieces of information, some of them couldn't help questioning her motive.

Lissandra wouldn't answer such questions directly, and owing to that, people kept proclaiming that she was carrying out dangerous activities, causing her to become a fearsome existence over and over again. However, things always get better with time. Once the rumor mills stopped, new students would be drawn to her again.

In this repetitive cycle, only Lissandra's conduct and determination remained steadfast. She tenaciously strived for fair trials to eradicate sinners and rescue innocent people who were framed, but before passing her judgment, she still needed sufficient evidence to prove that what she did was right.

Hence, Lissandra began taking action. A new volume has been added to her case file collection - although the accused currently spends all day with her on the same train, she will still pass her judgment on this person when the time comes.
des.无论是从外观还是言行来看，不熟悉那由他的人都很容易认为他是个沉默乃至冷淡的人。虽:
Anyone who isn't familiar with Nayuta tends to assume he's a reticent, aloof person no matter if he's judged by his looks or conduct. Though the people who battled alongside him had no doubts about his abilities, even the crew whom he worked closely with knew little about his life outside of the battlefield. It didn't help that every now and then, Nayuta helped Citadel members deliver some special "packages," making him an even more enigmatic individual... 

Inevitably, some of the crew members grew curious about him and wondered if there would be an opportunity for them to know him better.

This opportunity ended up emerging rather unusually yet very logically. One day, The Eternal welcomed some especially unique passengers—a bunch of kids who had only just begun schooling. The entire passenger car was filled their excited, noisy chatters, leaving the crew and other passengers at a loss for what to do. All of a sudden, Nayuta appeared out of nowhere and stood among the kids to attract their attention with intriguing magic tricks, even chatting mellowly with them in a soft voice for a while. After thanking Nayuta for restoring peace and quiet to the carriage, the crew came to a conclusion about this enigmatic Citadel member with pre-eminent combat abilities—"Nayuta must have an awfully good temper."
des.在学会的大多数人眼里，那由他与御敌枢纽的另外两名成员，即达斯廷和索玛是一家人。虽:
In the view of most Citadel members, Nayuta and two other members of the Destroyer, Dustin and Sommer, are a family. The trio may not be related by blood, but everyone has tacitly acknowledged the existence of this special family.

However, Nayuta doesn't appear to agree with this saying, not because he has anything against the other two members but rather, it is precisely because he genuinely cherishes them that he finds this conflicting. From his perspective, with such an unconscionable past, there is no way he can wash away the blood on his hands or get rid of his dark side. So, how could he deserve to have such an intimate bond with those two wonderful persons?

But here comes the dilemma. Even though Nayuta truly believes his existence is akin to the weeds growing in this beautiful greenhouse, deep down in his heart, he longs for nothing more than the warmth of this non-biological family. Actions speak louder than words. Regardless if it is when he's able to listen attentively to Dustin's teachings and offer Dustin a helping hand or his thoughtful care of Sommer and constant assistance and consideration of her in life... they all make it obvious that Nayuta has long been treating the two like family.

There's no doubt that his "father" and "sister" will patiently await the day he finally makes peace with himself.
des.“这是你本次的任务目标。”\r黑发的少年淡漠地看了一眼照片，点了点头。\r“和往:
"This is the target."

The black-haired young man glances at the photograph indifferently and nods.
"Per usual, no witnesses. You've been doing great, Ten."

The two words "no witnesses" have long been imprinted in his mind. No compliment or reprimand from the other party can stir any emotion within him. In actuality, he has a name, but everyone is addressed only by code numbers here. Perhaps it won't be long before he eventually forgets his own name, forgets his time spent in the orphanage, and fully turns into a number, a life-taking puppet.

Like all of his previous missions, the young man sneaks into the room where the target is playing a game with his young daughter, so immersed in joy that he's totally oblivious of the murderous intent heading his way.

There is no better opportunity than now. First, deal with the target, then the daughter, and escape via the planned route. It won't even take ten minutes in total.

The gun barrel is now pointed at the typically solemn man, who is currently going all out to make funny faces just to make his daughter laugh. She chuckles and jumps into her father's arms.

At this moment, a thought suddenly strikes the young man. He seems to have had gentle parents, though his memory is already hazy, as well as a cheerful playmate who would laugh with him despite them being in the rundown orphanage. Most importantly, he has his own name. His name is... Nayuta.

The young man pulls the trigger, and practically in the blink of an eye, shrieks, cries, and commotions erupt concurrently. The bodyguards rush into the room, and the familiar pain of being shot radiates through the young man's body.

He missed. Mission failed.
des.那由他仍然记得，自己在逃亡过程中昏迷，再度醒来时，看到的便是一位陌生的少女。他一:
Nayuta still vividly remembers that after he awoke from falling unconscious during the escape, the first person that came to his view was an unknown teenage girl. Her abnormal arm immediately caught his attention, but upon sensing his gaze, she hid her hand behind her a little uncomfortably.

"H-How are you feeling...? I treated your wounds, but I'm not too good at bandaging..."

Nayuta glimpsed at the slanted knot on the gauze and the cautious girl. "Thanks," he blurted out.

Even he himself was stunned when that word escaped his throat, for it seemed like forever since he last said it, and yet it came out so naturally.

Subsequently, he learned that the girl who saved him was called Sommer, and he was temporarily safe since he was lucky enough to be taken in by the Citadel. Still, he was already a traitor in his organization; he knew he couldn't implicate his savior. Just like that, he attempted to leave, had his wounds worsen, and was forced back to treatment multiple times by Sommer's father, Dustin, until he finally recovered.

Then came the day for Nayuta's bandage to be removed. He observed the interaction between Sommer and Dustin. After the time they had spent together, he knew that even though the two of them looked bizarre, they were simply an ordinary, loving pair of father and daughter. Such great people weren't supposed to have entered Nayuta's life.

Dustin could heal Nayuta's wounds but not the young man's old scars. It wasn't hard for Dustin to guess what Nayuta could've experienced thus far, nor did the tinge of humanity deep within the latter's indifferent eyes escape the former.

"If you can't be the light for yourself, then try being the light for someone else," said Dustin to Nayuta. This was the chance Nayuta, member of the Destroyer, got to join Source Citadel.
des.“还在为身边的不明现象烦恼吗？还在担心商旅途中的不明生物袭击吗？恶魔捕手为你解决:
"Still troubled by the strange phenomena around you? Still worried about attacks from unknown creatures during your travels? The Devil Hunter is here to solve your problems and eliminate all your worries about the mysterious and unexplained. Whether the cause is Chaos Remain or magical phenomena, we are dedicated to easing your burdens! For more details, please conta..."

Verlaine was caught on site by Box while loudly reading this advertisement to passengers in the train corridor. Afterward, the crew gave her a serious reprimand. The service promoted in this advertisement, namely "devil hunting," was hardly a term that people living along the railway loop would encounter in their daily lives. After all, what exactly were the "devils" that Reeva referred to?

Reeva herself stood in front of the detained Verlaine, shielding her from the others, and calmly explained the true nature of her work. According to her, the title "Devil Hunter" was merely a name used to make her work easier to promote among people on the surface. In reality, her job was simply to use her knowledge of magic to resolve abnormal phenomena while earning some income along the way.

"In other words, it's all just to make enough money to put food on the table."
des.瑞瓦在烹饪上很有心得。假如要从各种各样的美食中选择一种来做，那瑞瓦总是会选择帝国:
Reeva has a deep understanding of cooking. If she had to choose one dish to make from a wide variety of cuisines, she would always choose an Empire-style stew. She is especially skilled at selecting and preparing meat, and her stews always attract many hungry-eyed and eager-to-eat crew members.

Thanks to her calm personality in the face of emergencies (as well as the help of several tentacles behind her), Reeva can handle any unexpected situation in the kitchen. Sometimes Verlaine suddenly rushes over with a large bag of brand-new ingredients, and sometimes Millie comes running over and sneakily gobbles up half a pot of prepared ingredients... Somehow, all of these situations seem to be within Reeva's expectations. Although she may scold her friends a little when they act unreasonable, she has never once lost her temper over it.

More interestingly, no matter how much of the ingredients are stolen or wasted, whenever it is Reeva's turn to cook, she can always provide everyone with enough delicious stew to fill their stomachs. It must be because she prepared more than enough ingredients in advance!
des.在护卫乘员的工作以及恶魔捕手的委托之余，瑞瓦还很喜欢研究各种各样的编织手法。和由:
Beyond her duties as a guard crew and her Devil Hunter commissions, Reeva also enjoys studying various weaving techniques. Unlike the ropes woven through magic, this is purely her personal hobby. Every weave and knot on her clothes was designed and tied by her own hands. They not only secure parts of her outfit, but also serve to amplify her magical power.

During her free time, Reeva can often be seen leaning by the window or sitting among a pile of soft cushions, weaving various items with her own hands. Problems that other crafters might face, such as having too many materials or keeping everything in a chaotic mess, are easily solved when it comes to Reeva. The devils she commands will obediently fetch materials for her, sort out tangled threads, and hand her whatever she needs without her even having to ask. Of course, this process occasionally leads to some unexpected situations... For example, sometimes people may search for her everywhere, only to later find her wrapped up in yarn and tentacles, smiling awkwardly in embarrassment.

Naturally, Reeva is more than happy to share and discuss her knowledge of this craft with others. She believes that hand weaving and binding devils (or humans) actually have some things in common. Once you understand the techniques, these things are not so different after all... The question is, do we really need to know this kind of knowledge?
des.“为了保护帝国的安宁，制裁强大的魔物，‘恶魔猎人’们出现了。他们旅行各处，尤其是:
"To protect the peace of the Empire and punish powerful monsters, the 'Devil Hunters' appeared. They traveled across the land, especially to the remote regions of the Empire, capturing devils and protecting the safety of villages and roads."

This was the first story Reeva had ever read that was related to "Devil Hunters." It was a simple and straightforward story, yet strangely captivating... Like the protagonists in knight tales or adventure novels, she was drawn in by the image it portrayed. While the children around her dreamed of becoming mages, knights, or adventurers, she began to develop a different dream of her own. Carrying that dream with her, she entered the Magic Academy.

She possessed extraordinary magical talent and was widely praised for it. She spent every day immersed in the library, searching for the knowledge she wanted to learn. She received countless words of approval and admiration. "Reeva will surely become an outstanding mage someday!"

But deep in her heart, Reeva quietly thought that she did not want to become a mage... She wanted to become a Devil Hunter.
...

However, years later, even while fleeing for her life, she still could not understand how everything had turned out this way.

She had only read books that were not made available to the public out of simple curiosity. She had only witnessed the rise, decline, and prohibition of Devil Hunters through those books. She had only learned magic capable of capturing powerful monsters, hoping that she could demonstrate it to her mentor.

It was at that moment that her rope captured the first monster that would become her servant.
...

The "Devil Hunters," once lost to history, have returned to people's sight and begun moving throughout the world on the surface once again...

Not a bad way to start a new story, right?
des.索思学会在临界之后收养了许多孤儿，苏恩就是其中之一。\r也许是为了回报这份恩情，:
Source Citadel had taken in numerous orphans after Solstice, one of them being Suen. Perhaps to repay this debt of gratitude, she volunteered herself as tribute when "The Ascension," a Citadel organization, was recruiting test subjects.
Putting aside the matter of whether she could've known what she was signing up for at that tender age, it was already too late when the Citadel pioneers noticed and put a stop to The Ascension's controversial "Mistletoe Experiment," for Suen's transformation had been done.
It is hard to say if she, the sole successful test subject of that experiment, was lucky or unlucky, but the outcome shown on her body was way more unremarkable than expected. Besides that vivid pattern all over her skin, the only real change she had was probably the physical condition that people her age shouldn't have, and using ascension abilities had also become much easier for her.
Upon closer observation, the pioneers drew a further conclusion: The body patterns implanted into Suen by the Mistletoe Experiment seemingly took away her capability to feel "fear." It couldn't be determined if this had a good or bad effect. Moderate bravery will earn people's admiration, but when it's so excessive that one doesn't even flinch when facing desperate times or death, it will unsettle people instead.
Some have wondered, can Suen still be considered 100% human now that she lost this inherent sense of emotion? After Suen joined the Destroyer, many people refused to team up with her to eliminate Chaos Remains. They didn't want to work with this girl who could laugh like nobody's business amid mass destruction.
des.抛开苏恩面对什么都无所畏惧的反应不谈，她在其他方面表现出的样子差不多就是个普通的: Save for her lack of fear toward any and everything, Suen pretty much behaves like a normal, constantly mischievous imp. She was a slightly timid and quiet child prior to participating in the experiment, but once it ended, she turned into the optimistic, cheerful, and utterly talkative person she is now, likely because her body patterns have given her confidence. Plenty of people have become fond of this almost ridiculously high-spirited girl who always has a smile on her face.\nHowever, Suen has a habit of prattling on and on, able to make any brief topics as long-winded as discussing history. Even when others aren't listening at all, she will ramble non-stop, and if you finally interrupt her after having had enough, she will most likely be oblivious to how troubled you feel. This has caused opinions of her in the Citadel to be poles apart, and some people even go as far as to walk the other way if they see her coming around.\nDespite her grown physique, Suen's mentality is still rather childish, and her knowledge and understanding aren't sufficient to back up the image of an adult she tries to present. Her immaturity is evident in her everyday behavior, but no one has attempted to spend the time to help her recognize this fact since she forever has her own way of rationalization.
des.即使是在人才济济的学会中，能管束住苏恩的人也并不算多。或者说，她并不认为那是“管:
Despite Suen being a part of the Citadel that has innumerable gifted people, few are capable of controlling her—or rather, she doesn't consider that as "controlling"—but thankfully, some have mastered a handful of methods that can temporarily quiet her down.
The pioneers of the Citadel believed they ought to take responsibility for her undergoing the transformation. Even though they weren't directly working on the "Mistletoe" project, they thought that it was their negligence in supervision that prompted this child's unnecessary suffering. Needless to say, some of these people are Dustin, who used to specialize in medical research, and maybe even Lissandra, who's always so full of compassion...
After Suen's physical condition more or less stabilized, Dustin took over the job of monitoring her and, in one way or another, became her "parent." Through a period of trial and error, he eventually managed to persuade her with his uniquely gentle speech to comply on certain things, namely checkup cooperation, timely consumption of medication, and not being fussy with food. In addition, he even made her feel like all those were her own decisions, which was utterly amazing, to say the least.
Meanwhile, aboard The Eternal where she lacks a guardian, Suen has pretty much become 'unruly.' Just like how the crew has become accustomed, her mouth prattles on around the clock, and she often causes a din whenever she pleases... Perhaps it's time to get some tips from the Citadel members to bring her into line.
des.相处一段时间以后就能发现，苏恩不仅自诩成熟女性，而且还误认为自己有“充足的恋爱知:
Once you spend some time with Suen, you'll realize she not only self-proclaims to be a mature woman but also has the mistaken belief that she has "adequate knowledge in romantic relationships." If we use her standards as an example, the kindness the Conductor shows her can practically be explained as unparalleled love. Many people have told her that wasn't the case, but it didn't change her mind either way.
Practically all the knowledge of love in Suen's brain comes from hearsay, and at times, she'll absorb more (useless) knowledge from TV shows and novels as well. Most of the people only become friendly with her because they find her amusing, while some are drawn by the peculiar patterns that cover her from head to toe. Yet, she mistook these to be ironclad proof of her being a heartthrob and even wanted to create a fan club for herself. That said, there might actually be advantages to being mistaken as her romantic partner, as it would make her especially diligent at work.
Suen's fearlessness is basically invincible on the battlefield; anyone who sees her traversing through bloodbaths would most likely be petrified. But at the same time, her impressive combat ability also guarantees that she'll make it back safely. Even if the worst were to happen—she got wounded by enemies—her injuries would heal at terrifying speed, and she'd laugh it off and get back to the battle.
Still, it's almost for certain that anyone who views her as a comrade would hesitate should they see her that way. Is this truly worth it? Must we let this child who doesn't know fear continue fighting like this?
des.隼擅长变装，并且通常不会承认自己曾变装过什么角色，这点相当令人不安。无论怎么盘问:
Hayabusa excels at the art of disguise and generally will not admit what identities he has taken on before, which is quite disconcerting. No matter how you grill him, he will simply grin and say, "All sorts of identities, of course. It's all for completing missions," but he is perhaps the only one who will ever know just the kind of lengths he has gone to for his "missions." Just the thought that any young woman they met could've been Hayabusa in disguise makes people start to doubt their own instincts.

When Conductor told him about this, he was taken aback, claiming he had never once appeared on the Eternal in disguise. Indeed, all of the "recorded crimes" and complaints from passengers are linked with Hayabusa's actual self, and the mysterious occurrences with things and people not matching up usually end up just being misunderstandings among the crew.

Still, at any rate, keep in mind not to accept any food given by Hayabusa in unclear circumstances. What this entails isn't purely minimal odds of food poisoning but a worse situation: it is more often than not purchased by him and instead swiped on a whim. If the food's owner comes storming over before the evidence is destroyed, all hell will break loose.
des.隼的父亲，荷塞·黎，修格里城市长，这是一个不仅限定在其掌权的修格里城，在其他城市:
Hayabusa's father is the mayor of Shoggolith City, Jose Lynch. This is a name not only known in the city where he holds power but also relatively heard in other places. However, this name must never be mentioned in Hayabusa's presence. Even when he simply hears it by chance through news broadcasts, the smile that's always on his face will be instantaneously wiped off. Clearly, he and his father's relationship is far from amicable.

The last time Hayabusa showed up in public as "Jose's son" was during a certain public event several years ago. Jose, campaigning as a populist, had earned tons of election votes with the identity of a widower raising a daughter and son alone and was at a place in life where his career was flourishing. From the photos taken by the media at the time, the adolescent Hayabusa can be vaguely seen facing the camera emotionlessly with his back toward Jose, who was answering questions from the commoners, and a short distance away was a girl waving at Hayabusa for attention. She was Jose's daughter, Hayabusa's little sister.

The significance of this photo lies in the momentous time it was taken. Just a few short minutes after this shot, the venue of the Reality Stabilizer's groundbreaking ceremony was under attack. Jose's daughter was sent to the hospital critically injured, and there were casualties among the security team. Meanwhile, at the media conference later on the same day, Jose vehemently proclaimed that if he were to be mayor in the future, he would never allow such acts of terrorism to happen. The image of him "not giving up on the tough duties of constructing a city despite grieving as a father" once again boosted his election approval ratings.

As for his son, the boy disappeared from the public eye since then and gradually became the current Hayabusa.
des.原本的档案纸被抽走了，留在这里的是一张纸条。\r“你很好奇？但是比起直接坦白一切:
The original document has been replaced by a note.

"You're curious, aren't you? Well, instead of spilling everything, I find it more fun to see you disappointed. The expression on your face right now is quite intriguing. Thanks for the treat."
...

When did he manage to do that? And nobody on the train noticed? Is he lurking around, keeping an eye on me now?
des.纸条还有背面。\r“还真是不死心啊，你的列车上就没有谁抱怨过你挺烦人吗？不过根据: Something is written on the back of the note as well.\n\n"You're quite persistent. Has no one ever told you that you are quite annoying? But fine, I might just be in the mood to share something, though I can't vouch for its accuracy. Now, put down this note and turn around, Conductor."
des.薇尔岚在篝火城外的流民区出生长大。在物资匮乏、生活困苦的环境中，薇尔岚的父母却是:
Verlaine was born and raised in the drifter settlements beyond the walls of a Bonfire City. Amid want and hardship, her parents were an anomaly among the wanderers around them—for even living so far from comfort, they never lost their faith in beautiful stories and wondrous legends, and never once hesitated to share them with their young daughter. In time, the other children of the settlement, those near enough to Verlaine in age, began to gather together, playing and trading tales, some heard from elsewhere and some spun fresh from their own imaginations; and among them, the one closest to her heart was a neighbor's child named Polaris.

Having made so many new friends, Verlaine often ventured out with them on little expeditions of discovery. The adults, worn thin by long hours of labor and the hunt for their daily bread, paid little mind to the children's games and wanderings; and in any case, the places the children could reach never strayed far from the settlement—the ruins left over from before the Solstice, mostly, or the woods just beyond the edge of camp.

Besides, Verlaine had a secret weapon of her own. It was a pendant brought from her parents' homeland, glittering like some treasure out of a fairy tale; and by her parents' telling, it had been formed from the scales of a dragon, said to shine with a protective light for the brave whenever danger drew near. Verlaine believed this without a shred of doubt, and it seemed, more than once, to have led her and her companions safely out of harm's way—though of course, they never once breathed a word of it to the grown-ups. It was a secret shared only between Verlaine and her friends.
des.而故事的背后其实包含着无比简单的真相：那件“宝贝”，只是在曼杜斯帝国再常见不过的:
And behind that story lay a truth of the simplest, plainest kind: the "treasure" was nothing more than a mineral, common enough throughout the Mundus Empire, used to help young Ascenders newly awakened to their powers learn to master them—it possessed no ability, in truth, to ward off evil or turn aside misfortune.

One day, the children who had ventured out from camp on their little expedition met with disaster. As Verlaine and her friends stood facing the Chaos Remains that came pouring out from within the cave, the only thing she could remember afterward was that Polaris had been standing right there beside her. She had not felt afraid.

When she woke again, it was in the camp, with her parents keeping watch at her bedside; and at the sight of her waking, they were overcome with joy beyond measure. It was then that they resolved to tell her the whole of the truth—of how they had fled all the way from the Mundus Empire to this place, of the true nature of that treasured trinket, and of the dangers that lay beyond the safety of camp.

But Verlaine cared for only one thing: where was Polaris now? Though the grown-ups would not answer her, still, every night before sleep, she listened to her stories and held in her heart the hope that Polaris would someday suddenly return, so that the two of them might set out on some new adventure together, just as before.

Not long after, Verlaine awoke from a dream to find, curled up beside her bed and sleeping soundly, a great hound—one that seemed almost to wear armor, its head covered in shaggy black fur. She remembered, then, the story her parents used to tell her before sleep: that after the knight died, he became a great hound, and then a towering tree, and at the last, a gentle breeze—forever remaining at his friend's side.

As for why the hound now bears the name "Monday," well—that is another story altogether.
des.在又长大一些以后，薇尔岚决定出门旅行。父母没有反对她的决定，只是叮嘱她一定要保护:
As she grew a little older still, Verlaine made up her mind to set out and travel the world. Her parents raised no objection to her decision, only cautioning her, again and again, to keep herself safe. Verlaine, brimming with confidence, promised them she would return home safe and sound—and with that, she set off on her journey, her hound at her side.

By the standards of the Mundus Empire, Verlaine was already a rather formidable mage, though her command over certain forms of magic remained somewhat unrefined; but by the standards of the surface, she was, for now, only an Ascender of unstable performance—her Ascension Ability's output fluctuated wildly, and its effects could hardly be called consistent. None of this troubled Verlaine in the least. To her mind, pressing ever forward with her Ascension Ability, gathering new stories along the way—that, and nothing else, was the true meaning of travel.

"But when Miss Verlaine first boarded the train, the registered crew count was three..."
"Ah! That's right! Me, Millie, and Reeva, wasn't it?"
"Indeed. So then, where might Miss Millie and Miss Reeva be? It seems the Conductor's office has never once found any boarding record for either of them."
"That... I'm not sure either! But once they show up, you'll find out soon enough! We'll all help you with your work, so don't worry!"

With a radiant smile, this was how Verlaine explained the whereabouts of her two missing traveling companions. And indeed, from the odd turn of phrase she let slip now and then in daily conversation, one could occasionally catch a glimpse of a ravenous companion here, a fellow mage there—it seemed her travels were, after all, never quite so lonely. And besides, aboard the Eternal, she still had Monday to keep her company.
des.薇尔岚从未有一刻踏足帝国的土地。\r在父母的坦诚解释后，她知道了自己的身世。薇尔:
Verlaine had never once, in all her life, set foot upon the soil of the Empire.

When her parents at last spoke to her plainly, she learned the truth of her own lineage. Her ancestors had once served among the Empire's ancient Tribunal, a family whose members carried a rare and singular gift—born with the power to shape and command the dreams of others. Decades ago, amid some great upheaval, a young couple, descended from a collateral branch of that line, had fled the Empire together with so many others; and it was thus that Verlaine came to be born upon the surface.

Her parents' stories were always steeped in a tender longing for their homeland, and this, in turn, could not help but stir in Verlaine her own yearning for the landscapes of the Empire. In her dreams, again and again, she found herself gazing upon sights she seemed almost to have lived through herself: a lake as clear and still as a mirror, great trees rising to pierce the clouds, hillsides washed in the colors of spring... And yet, what could possibly have befallen so beautiful a place, that her young parents were forced to flee it?

Among the people of the Empire around her, this was a matter treated as forbidden. It seemed that all Verlaine's ears were ever permitted to hear were those gentle, wistful recollections, while the truth beneath them remained forever sealed in silence.

After meeting Millie and Reeva, both natives of the Empire, Verlaine one day fell to speaking with them of her childhood and her parents' stories, hoping to learn at last what great calamity had truly befallen the Empire—only to find both of them thoroughly bewildered by the question. Millie declared she had never once heard of any such thing; Reeva said that any book recording such an event would count, even in the Academy's own archives, among the forbidden texts. It was a remarkably peaceful night, the three of them seated together around the campfire, Monday resting close against Verlaine's leg—by all rights, a scene that should have brought comfort. And yet Verlaine felt, instead, an unusual and heavy sense of loss.

That night, Verlaine dreamed a dream she would never forget.

She stood once more beside that lake so familiar to her, and looking up toward the great tree upon the hillside, she saw Polaris—grown now into an adult—waving to her from far beneath its boughs. When she woke, only Polaris's words remained, lingering still in her ears.

"Look for me beneath your feet, Verlaine. Look for me along your travels."
des.在多年前的某一天，一次再寻常不过的出差结束后，黑月酒店总负责人“鹭”先生将一名青:
Years ago, after the end of a standard business trip, "Sagi"—general manager of Night Chains Hotel—brought a young man back to the headquarters.
Night Chains has always had the tradition of looking for "their kind." As long as it's someone deemed to be disturbed by "noise," Night Chains will take them in without condition. Still, that was the first time Sagi, as the assumed head of Night Chains, personally took someone in.
Unavoidably, loads of rumors about that young man began circulating within Night Chains Hotel, the most absurd one claiming that "the guy named Wensheng is actually Mr. Sagi's illegitimate son" despite the ages not matching up.
The rumors and gossip didn't go on for long, for people soon realized it was unnecessary to discuss it behind his back. Though Wensheng looks standoffish, he is surprisingly approachable and will pretty much answer any question.
"Mr. Sagi is my benefactor," he shared. "He got me out of the juvenile detention center and brought me here."
Meh, just juvenile detention center? In the morally gray Night Chains, where there is no shortage of oddballs, this truly isn't that sensational of a scoop.
des.闻笙出身于芬利地区的普通家庭。在他曾经是航空公司工人的父亲由于航天业的停摆而丢了:
Wensheng was born into a regular family in Frostville. When the aviation industry shut down, his father, who worked for an airline, became unemployed and started drinking excessively at home and abusing Wensheng and Wensheng's mother. As a child, Wensheng would sometimes suffer from tinnitus and headaches, which he initially assumed were the results of his father's abuse or because Frostville City was seriously too cold.
The constantly wounded Wensheng frequently slept in class at school, and somehow, the delinquents believed that he was someone they couldn't afford to mess with. One time, a bunch of troublemakers wanted to ask Wensheng's deskmate out for a "talk," only to unwittingly rouse Wensheng from his nap. Irritated, Wensheng yelled at those boys and thus began their rivalry.
At first, Wensheng could still hold them in check with his attitude, but he and his deskmate ended up getting ambushed in an alley near their school and were beaten into a pulp. Wensheng didn't really get injured since that wasn't his first rodeo, but at the sight of his friend, whose face had gotten busted up, he asked perplexedly, "Why?"
"An eye for an eye, a favor for a favor. This is a given!" replied the friend with a grin. He was clearly weaker than Wensheng, and yet he still positioned himself in front of Wensheng earlier. Perhaps that was him "returning the favor."
That night, Wensheng searched for the hammer and wrench his father had used at home and went to seek vengeance from those delinquents' leader while the skies were dark. That was how he eventually landed himself in the juvenile detention center.
des.身为黑月酒店的安全总监，闻笙的出身和经历显得有些平凡。既没有在人才辈出的环境里长: Wensheng's background and experience seem fairly mundane, considering he is Night Chains Hotel's safety director. Not only did he not grow up in an environment with a history of eminences, but he has also never received any education concerning "how to lead a group of morally gray organization members." It's hard to fathom how he manages his job. But when you consider that Wensheng has always been a simple person, his leadership style instantly becomes clear-cut: let competent people do what they're good at, and show up when things are critical.\nSince joining Night Chains, Wensheng hasn't avoided those difficult tasks and could be said to possess a fairly proactive (and calm) work attitude. A few Night Chains members who worked with him remarked that he was someone who totally didn't avoid trouble, as he lacked both the skill and willingness. Rather than avoiding, he preferred facing everything head-on, even if it was an extremely problematic trouble. Some of his colleagues took advantage of this and repeatedly dumped their important tasks onto him, and he completed them all as usual.\nMeanwhile, Mr. Sagi, who had been discreetly observing Wensheng, grew certain that this young man was a promising talent whom he would like to nurture. With Mr. Sagi's arrangement and guidance, Wensheng's capability was utilized to its full potential, leading him to where he is now. This is a debt of gratitude he would never forget.
des.闻笙在离开芬利城、乃至在黑月安身以后才意识到，世界上还有“爱好”和“业余生活”这:
It wasn't until Wensheng left Frostville City and settled down in Night Chains that he came to the realization that "hobbies" and "leisure activities" still exist in this world. Life in Frostville City was chilling and agonizing for him. After breaking free from that environment, he spent a long time learning about the outside world and developing his own interests.
Wensheng followed Mr. Sagi to learn about the fundamentals of calligraphy and tea during this process, making solid improvements each day. To get on Mr. Sagi's good side, some people would also suck up to Wensheng, claiming he looked like a prominent family's cultivated son to a tee. In response, he would generally say "I'm simply someone Mr. Sagi took in from the streets" in a flat tone, totally unbothered about their embarrassment.
However, Mr. Sagi apparently cared more about Wensheng's mental state than Wensheng did, continuously encouraging the young man to try and explore new things. As such, Wensheng slowly attempted to change his dressing style, picked up hip-hop dancing lessons, and then entered a claw machine arcade in a mall by mistake one day.
Even though he kept snapping the machine's joystick in the beginning, his technique progressively reached the expert level under Mr. Sagi's guidance. Now, he is regularly spotted standing alone by these claw machines to seek out his new catch, and when he's in a good mood, The Eternal's crew members will be blessed with the stuffed toys he won.
des.作为一家四姐妹中的老幺，夏洛蒂一直在父母与三位姐姐的悉心呵护下长大。虽为贵族，但:
As the youngest of four children, Charlotte was raised under the loving care of her parents and three older sisters. Despite being of noble birth, she has been enthusiastic about experiencing commoners' culture since she was a child and would often take her maid to visit the town. Her undue interest in the people did upset her parents on many occasions, but as she didn't forget her noble upbring and on account of the freedom she would lose upon getting married, they did not reproach her more than necessary.

It was during those visits of hers that Charlotte witnessed the hardships of the commoners, and the sights she saw became imprinted on her mind. She who had received an aristocratic education and who felt drawn to the commoners got an even deeper understanding of the responsibility nobles had to protect the people. Hence, when she grew up, she chose a path for herself that astounded everyone—she decided to become a soldier.

Regrettably, Charlotte didn't get to rush to the frontlines as she hoped after graduating from military school. Just as she thought she was marching toward her dream, her extraordinary looks got her the designation of an honor guard, which was nothing close to what she originally joined the military for.

With that, the girl made yet another brave decision and left the military, then established "Knight's Hall" to protect the civilians in her own way.
des.追溯到很久以前，夏洛蒂的家族就是靠着在战场上取得的荣誉才有了如今的地位。所以夏洛:
The current standing of Charlotte's family is thanks to the accolades their ancestors earned on the battlefield in the distant past, which is why her father is unable to disagree with her viewpoint about how "nobles are nobles because we have noble obligations." If he were to disagree, that would equate to discrediting their ancestors' hard work and the glory of his own background.

Charlotte's decision to leave home was not strongly objected against, for her father held the belief that his pampered daughter could never be able to survive military life and was even anticipating her to make her own way home after learning a lesson out there and becoming truly "sensible."

To his shock, under Charlotte's adorable appearance was an exceptionally tenacious spirit, and with the support of her Ascension Ability, she obtained phenomenal results in military school. While this father fretted over it, what he refused to admit was that in reality, a tinge of pride had also sprouted deep within him. He vaguely sensed that although she had diverged from the path her family expected of her, this daughter of his would excel everywhere she went.

And that certainly is true. Charlotte was already greatly admired and fascinated by the juniors while in the military. When she left, Tistar, who had been close with Charlotte, even chose to leave alongside her.
des.“骑士屋”开业后一段时间，夏洛蒂迅速适应了这种非正式的骑士生活。没有受勋也没有光:
After the "Knight's Hall" was established, Charlotte swiftly adapted to the life of an unauthorized knight—lacking the formal knighthood or gleaming armor—and relied solely on her skills and weapons. Despite this, Charlotte found her new life much more fulfilling than her previous role as an honor guard. Even simple acts like rescuing a kitten stuck in a tree brought her satisfaction, knowing she could help those around her.

Charlotte had built strong relationships with the townspeople, who held her in high regard, leading to the prosperity of the Knight's Hall. Balancing self-sufficiency with aiding others, both Charlotte and Tistar found joy in this way of life.

As the Knight's Hall gained renown, they decided to expand their business to neighboring towns, becoming popular across a wider area. When Charlotte contemplated expanding her business further to the world on the surface, the townspeople threw a farewell party for her and Tistar, worried they might not return.

Charlotte reassured them, affirming her unwavering dedication: "No matter how tempting other places may be, I shall never abandon my noble duty or my people."
des.完全按照贵族礼仪行事的夏洛蒂，恐怕是列车上最为正统的一位曼杜斯贵族。无论是她高贵:
Charlotte, renowned for her noble etiquette, stands as the epitome of Mundus nobility among the crew. Her refined demeanor and steadfast adherence to etiquette are a rarity on the surface, often leading to misunderstandings and occasional trouble. Undeterred, Charlotte refuses to compromise her codes of conduct while adapting to the surface world in her own unique manner.

Currently, the Knight's Hall operates without a fixed base, with Charlotte and Tistar serving as beacons for those in need of assistance from this noble-hearted knight. While Charlotte's fees are generally reasonable, her exceptional skills often attract clients willing to pay a hefty sum for her services. Consequently, she now leads a comfortable life, occasionally indulging in purchases that match her refined tastes.

Outside of work, Charlotte frequents second-hand markets, uncovering items whose true value has yet to be realized. Despite Tistar's scolding for what she considers wasteful spending, Charlotte is drawn to these overlooked treasures, even if they occasionally lead to financial struggles at the Knight's Hall. She simply cannot resist rescuing items with hidden worth, unnoticed by many.

Charlotte's most recent acquisition is an old medal from the Imperial Order. Its once-gilded layer has been worn away by previous owners, and its intricate design bears scratches and marks. Despite the damage, its historical significance remains intact. As Charlotte gazes pensively at the medal, she begins to contemplate her true path as a knight...
des.一般来说，人们对研究员的认知都是“穿着白大褂埋头研究的人”；他们或许偶尔会出现在:
Generally speaking, people's impression of researchers is "someone who studies things in a white coat." They may appear in places other than laboratories from time to time, but they will definitely not be active in the outside world, never mind walking into danger all by themselves. However, Stella's existence has totally broken this stereotype.

She frequently enters the Chaos Space to explore, investigate, and also conduct preliminary minings of veins. Regarding why she insists on doing everything herself to this degree, her explanation is that for one, she wants to obtain research materials and data from the Chaos Space, and for another, it allows her to apply for a huge sum of funding for the research institute.

Her reason for not obtaining research investment through her family is supposedly that "she had made a deal with her father to make a name for herself." Still, if the situation calls for it, Stella will not hesitate to use her family background as a viable resource for her own benefit.
des.把漂亮的头发看得像生命一样重要，每天都会花不少时间对自己的长发进行护理。有时会带:
To Stella, her gorgeous long hair is as important as her life, so much so that haircare is an essential part of her daily routine, and there isn't a single popular haircare product on the market she doesn't know. On occasion, she will bring a large bag of heavy bottles and jars onto the train and very naturally tell others they are all for maintaining her lustrous hair.

During her haircare process, she will turn the music on to kill time, and if her spirits are high, she even sings a line or two of the songs she likes. As quoted by some passengers who have heard her periodically, she has a pretty remarkable voice that's basically akin to a professional singer's standard.

Every time Stella is done taking care of her hair is when she's most relaxed and happy. Here's a little fun fact about her: She loves the sensation of her hair swing airily as she turns her head, though that is not something many people understand unless they have such long hair too...

"Your hair is so long! Doesn't it put a strain on your neck?"
"Nope. Now that you mention it, I have indeed been feeling a bit tired lately, but I think that's because the new acceleration component installed on the multifunctional crusher is too heavy... Um, it's probably best to switch it back to the old lighter version next time... or should I just remove it for good?"
des.“现在是——偶像时间！尽情享受STELLA带来的闪耀时刻吧！”\r研究员星花的另:
"It's... Idol time! Sit back and enjoy the brilliant performance brought to you by STELLA!"

The other side to Stella the Researcher is her identity as an idol who shines on stage and makes people happy. Although it's more like her own hobby, she does it to the best of her ability, as that is Stella's motto. Every single performance of hers is done with utmost effort to exude her charisma to the world.

She has never readily told the people around her about her idol side of life, but if anyone discovers that she's the star of an advertising billboard, she won't try to deny it either. Plenty of her fans have said things like "Stella is especially breathtaking." That may have something to do with her genuine confidence, a radiance from within that made her into a rising star on stage.

Stella is always able to hold her head up and proudly display any side of her to others. Be it as an idol or a researcher, she is sufficiently assured by her talent and hard work and believes she will excel in both areas.
des.自幼被父亲寄予厚望的星花，从识字起就被多位严格的私人教师围绕，做错任何事都会招致:
Faced with her father's high expectations from a young age, Stella was surrounded by multiple stern personal teachers since she could read and would be lectured and punished for any little mistake she made.
