Like hopscotch, she became accustomed to advancing the squares of her strict daily schedule as a child, learning the skills that a competent successor should know, such as basic etiquette and art appreciation. Thankfully, Stella absolutely loved learning new knowledge, so books and information weren't taxing and were instead an enjoyment to her. She was like a seed that had been meticulously selected and planted in the soil that suited her most.

Stella's father was well pleased with her performance and improvement and planned to make her his successor. However, as she climbed up the steps piled with trophies, certificates, and excellent results, she beat her father to his plan and entered Anita Energy Company as a researcher, rendering him shocked and astounded. A deal was made between the father-daughter duo that she would eventually return to fulfill his wishes, but before that...

Only Stella herself knows what kind of career she really wants to achieve. For this dream, she is still working hard to this day, but a flower as beautiful as hope is bound to blossom most stunningly someday.
des.关于亚莉奈的魅力，有这样一则趣闻可以佐证：《列车晨报》的记者曾经在因选题压力而痛:
Arina's charm can be attested to by one tidbit. Once, while breaking down from the stress of picking a subject, a reporter of "Railway Morning Post" happened upon one of the bars that Arina worked at, and she served the poor reporter a soothing beverage and lent a listening ear with a smile.

Shortly after, an article titled "Finding Solace Along the Journey" was published in the entertainment section of the newspaper, which described Arina as an incredibly gentle, thoughtful, and kind bartender, with eyes like rubies and the vibe of a fairy emerging from the fog... et cetera.

A paragraph of it was familiar to the regulars of the rest area. It read: "A phantom of Miss Bartender approached my table with a drink in hand. I fixed my eyes on that glass of drink, fearing that the liquid would spill or that the phantom would unexpectedly lose strength and shatter it, but my worries were unneeded. After placing the drink on the table before me, she vanished into thin air, leaving me wide-eyed as I looked toward the bartender herself behind the counter. An exceptionally adorable, charming smile flashed on her face when our eyes met."

Perhaps just to witness a phantom serving drinks with their own eyes, for a period of time, there were way more tourists coming in hopes of seeing that bartender in real life, but alas, the gorgeous "Miss Bartender" had long quit working there by then.
des.身为黑月一员的亚莉奈，并没有在列车长面前刻意掩饰或逃避自己的身份。据她本人声称，:
Arina didn't deliberately conceal or avoid her identity as a member of Night Chains from Conductor. According to her, circumstances led her to join the organization after her mother's passing, and then she began traveling to various cities, living life on the go without a permanent residence. Night Chains allowed its members to have personal freedom outside of work, so this could somewhat explain the phenomenon of her "showing up everywhere."

When combat is necessary, Arina can cooperate with her phantoms and unleash astonishing combat power. The phantoms' state seems to be influenced by her mood. In a tranquil bar, they are merely regular servers, whereas on the battlefield, when Arina goes all out for the sake of earning Conductor's praise, the phantoms' power will multiply as well.

As for what her goal outside of work and combat is, Arina's conduct has already made the answer clear as day. She will do anything to make Conductor's gaze linger longer on her, all in the hope of being loved by the destined person.
des.在深入接触后让人感觉略有些可怕的亚莉奈，在大部分未与她深入交流的人眼中却是一名楚:
Close interactions with Arina tend to make her seem mildly intimidating to others, but to the majority of those who do not know her on a personal level, she is a piteous woman in their view. Her faintly scarred body, lovely makeup, and meticulously coordinated outfit never fail to attract concern and offers of assistance from all sorts of people, but she always politely declines their kindness with the excuse that she's waiting for her lover to show up.

With her level of popularity, Arina was totally capable of getting a decently paid receptionist job in the bars and restaurants she used to work at or even working full-time for Night Chains to make higher bounties. Yet, despite receiving numerous recognitions and invitations from everywhere, she didn't do so and instead continued living life on the move. Once again, her excuse was that she was waiting for her lover to show up.

Fortunately, even a never-ending wait would conclude someday. The instant that person walked into the rest area, almost in a flash, Arina sensed something change within her and believed that was when she fell in love. Thereafter, to pursue this destined one, she used her own abilities to appear wherever Conductor would be like a shadow and patiently made Conductor drinks, hoping for her feelings to be accepted. If Conductor didn't notice anything, she would intensify her ardor the next time until she deemed that her feelings had been made known.
des.对亚莉奈来说，越想和某人成为恋人、越是爱恋着对方，心中的灼烧就越剧烈。即使恋人就:
For Arina, the more she loves and pines for someone, the more intense the burning becomes in her heart. Even if her lover is physically within reach, she will have to incessantly verify if their love or existence is actually real. It is a dealbreaker if her lover acts affectionately with anyone other than her, and she will demand them to spend multifold the time they spent with others to accompany her. Regardless of what she does, she wants her lover's opinion. Even when it comes to food or drink preferences, she has to repeatedly make sure it suits their palate.

Such excessively possessive concern is more likely than not unbearable for most people and might even frustrate them to the point of flaring up at her. Yet, Arina treats verbal and physical abuse as a reward, so violence is a completely futile option for resolving a conflict with her. The only solution she has to offer is, "If you don't love me and need me anymore, just kill me."

Needless to say, all her lover can do is refuse such a request. This will make Arina feel guilty for making an unreasonable demand, and rather than resent them for not killing her, she will yearn for more of their love.

"The above is the detailed analysis of Arina's relationship perspective! I suggest you think twice if you're considering to date her, Conductor!"
des.俗话说，家里蹲不是一日炼成的……但伊洛娜的确从很小的时候就喜欢室内，喜欢一个人待: People say one doesn't become a recluse overnight... but Ilona has indeed liked staying indoors and alone from a very young age. Worried that she wouldn't be able to socialize with people her age, her parents encouraged her to play outside, only to usually find her sitting in the space under the slide. Otherwise, they would come home from work and find her curled into a ball under her quilt. As lenient parents, they were at a loss for what to do about their young homebody daughter.\nIlona completed her studies rather normally, with decent results and one or two friends in school. However, other than when it was necessary to leave home, she basically stopped going out. Coupled with the high-calorie food she stuffed herself with while not programming or watching shows, her fitness test result deteriorated to rock bottom, and she was also putting on weight.\nAt last, her parents intervened before things became beyond remedy, and Ilona joined B.C.R.L.'s training camp. After experiencing long-term communal living, training, and various hardships, she not only got to know and befriended lots of people but also amazingly became Team Meerkat's sniper. From the looks of it, she is, in fact, stronger than imagined.
des.不执行任务的时候，伊洛娜基本都在宿舍房间里吃零食、看影片、研究电脑程序。她喜欢各:
When not on missions, Ilona basically spends her time snacking, watching shows, and studying computer programming in her dorm room. Old documentaries are her favorite, and she will watch even those with bizarre subjects and strange techniques. They have taught her tons of uncommon and shady knowledge, which occasionally helps her answer some questions that no one knows.
The type of snack she enjoys varies greatly, and so she tends to come home with a huge bag of snacks from the supermarket whenever she isn't ordering groceries online. Still, she is very mindful about not dirtying her keyboard, desk, and bedsheet while snacking in her room; after all, if she does, she will have no choice but to go outside and change or clean them.
Team Meerkat's other members are all understanding of Ilona's lifestyle and will discreetly help her out in any way. But when it comes time that she really needs to be dragged outside, they will also use a myriad of methods to prod her. For instance, Ganya will reason things out with her outside her door, Rachel will use her newly formulated mysterious reagent as bait, and Reika will impatiently bang the door and threaten to blow it up if she still refuses to come out! All three methods are highly effective; Ilona always ends up coming out of her room, albeit with extreme reluctance.
If worse comes to worst, they can also get the loudmouthed Dorothy from another dorm as reinforcement. Team Meerkat's members can never convince Ilona to attend barbecue parties or large gatherings, but sometimes, Dorothy can.
des.伊洛娜和支援机器人雷吉的关系很好。虽说待在房间里就能安心了，但毕竟房间里也不是什:
Ilona has a really good relationship with the support robot Regi. Although she can be at ease so long as she's in her room, her bedroom doesn't have everything after all. Worried about her health and hygiene, her teammates placed all the food, drinks, computer, reading materials, and so on beyond her room so that she would be forced to exit her safe space multiple times a day.
When Ilona's parents learned about this, they, too, implemented this at home, rendering her weak objection futile. However, having to leave her room to get any and everything consumed too much of Ilona's energy. Determined not to live life this way, she delegated most of this task to the support robot, making it her personal attendant.
Sadly, support robots weren't almighty and tended to have limitations in mobility, such as failing to dodge small obstacles and thus knocking things down at home or in the B.C.R.L. dorm. Ilona spent a long time studying indoor features and then upgraded Regi's obstacle-avoidance function herself, slowly turning the robot into a great helper at home.
By the time her teammates planned to knock on Ilona's door upon noticing that it had been ages since she left her room, Regi had already turned from a clumsy robot dog to an awesome in-house helper that could block the door with a paper with a large "Busy!" written on it in its mouth.
des.如果硬要把伊洛娜拉出房间，大概也是可以的。在长期的社交脱敏训练以后，伊洛娜已经不: It's not exactly impossible to drag Ilona out of her room. After long-term social desensitization practice, she no longer looks like she might burst into tears the moment she's exposed to sunlight, and she can now go on outdoor missions... Regardless, on account of how she'll enter the 'power overload' mode as soon as she's outside, it's ultimately better to leave her alone for the most part. Her teammates are well aware of this attribute of hers, so they won't purposely ask that she travel with another teammate and will instead assign her a more suitable task.\nProbably due to her hermitic nature, Ilona is always able to rapidly find an apt bunker or even a proper venue for the whole team to gather and rest, even if they're in the middle of Solstice ruins or the chaotic wilderness. After she upgraded Regi, Regi is now also equipped with functions like terrain scanning and ballistic trajectory computation. From this perspective, maybe Ilona could have a fantastic career in robot design too.\nHowever, exceptions are bound to exist. Team Ratel's Dorothy never fails to come up with a way to "dig out" Ilona from all sorts of nooks and crannies. Seeing how the two extreme opposites get together and form an amazingly neutral bond, the captains of both teams can't help but think about the same thing—it feels like a weight off the shoulders all of a sudden.
des.超出常理的机动能力、比人类时期更加优秀的综合战斗能力，以及深不可测的学识。学会十:
With unbelievable maneuverability, comprehensive combat abilities better than when Joshua was human, and profound knowledge, Joshua is a special entity that the Citadel seriously wishes to analyze and enter into their massive, thorough database system as precious reference material. However, when asked to fill up the "Self-Awareness Form," Joshua crossed out the "education level" section and left the "area of expertise" completely blank.

On some level, this seems to prove that the human who once studied, fought, and participated in research in the Citadel's facilities has already disappeared from this world entirely, and it is meaningless to look too deep into an Angel's self-awareness. Facing such a Joshua, the Citadel members dedicated to research and discovering the unknown are on cloud nine, whereas people who used to know them find it really hard to accept that "the old Joshua no longer exists."

Oftentimes, people who need to seek help from Joshua will resort to more indirect methods like looking for a messenger or via communication device... but alas, no device can ever rouse them when they're asleep. When an interaction with them is unavoidable, make sure to be mentally prepared in advance lest your self-esteem gets wounded by their words.
des.该个体对犬类生物的厌恶和恐惧超乎常规，原理及深层原因暂未解明，推测可能与“天使”:
This entity's abhorrence and fear toward canine creatures are out of this world, and it's still not known why that is so, though it's speculated to be linked to a part of the "Angel" transformation process. Joshua refuses to admit fear of dogs; simply put, they just will not own up to disliking dogs no matter what. In contrast, they appears to be favored by feline creatures, particularly those general pet and stray cats, but they doesn't get many opportunities to interact with cats within the Citadel.

Some of the Citadel members (e.g. Fenia from the Destroyer) have an unfathomable animosity, or perhaps fear, toward Joshua, hence making it vital to prevent them from crossing paths in unmonitored situations in everyday life. Their combat attire and weapon are specifically designated by themselves and are not required to conform to the Citadel's relevant combat regulations.

Maybe Joshua's way of doing things will cause some misunderstandings, but they has never failed to live up to the name of an Angel. As it happens, the meaning of "Angel" has even been redefined by them. Saviors of others may not necessarily care about others' hardships, and enemy conquerors may not truly want to obliterate enemies. Imparting knowledge is simply an integral deed; Joshua does not harbor any added good or ill will toward other humans. What is left after the needless parts are discarded may not be pure, but it is ultimately indispensable.

So, this begs the question—how much of what is left still belongs to this body, the real Joshua?
des.近期对该个体的数值分析再次突破了我们的预期。与其接受天使改造前的数据相比，个体的:
The recent analysis of the target entity has once again exceeded our expectations. Following the Angelic Transformation, the entity's overall capabilities have significantly improved across all aspects. Despite this progress, the entity has not yet reached the perceived boundaries of what defines an "Angel." It prompts us to question: Do Angels truly have limits? Given their mission of world salvation, it is crucial to continue exploring their potential until a definitive threshold is established.

Different from other Angels, this entity demonstrates a willingness to engage in experimentation without resistance, fear, or emotional instability. They proves to be an exceptional subject for this project. If we halt our investigations out of so-called humanitarian concerns, we risk closing off avenues to uncovering further uncharted territories.

Hence, this conference proposes to the entire Source Citadel to resume the ■■■■■■ Plan of the Angel Project.

— Excerpt from an confidential document

"Why are you sharing this with me? Is it an attempt to reassure me? Or an indication that the Citadel has stopped their research on me? How preposterous. I stand firm in my belief that they lack the capability to cause me harm, just as I doubt they will easily abandon their study of an Angel. Moreover, before I consented to the experiments, I had already steeled myself to confront any horrors, regardless of what they may entail... or what I may be transformed into."

Even when faced with evidence depicting them as an experimental subject, Joshua remains resolute.
des.“上次战斗完成得非常完美。约书亚，下次也都靠你了。”\r“前辈、约书亚前辈！你好:
"You performed exceptionally in the previous operation. We'll be relying on you for the next operation, Joshua."
"You're amazing, Senior! If only I could be such a distinguished member just like you! When we come back, could you provide me with some training sessions?"
"I have full confidence in our upcoming operation, especially with Joshua at the helm."
"Captain Joshua! We've detected abnormal morphic field fluctuations. Please proceed with caution. We've got your back!"

In Joshua's dream, they revisited memories filled with laughter and joy. Just hearing these familiar voices from the past filled their mind with warmth.

Ah, flowers. Joshua noticed small, white blooms adorning their limbs and the surroundings. They found themselves surrounded by flowers. Despite unable to recall the name of the flower, Joshua remembered their significance: they were flowers for the deceased.

A shadow swiftly blanketed the wilderness, casting a grayish pallor.

"Run..."
"Please! Help us!"
"Captain Joshua... you'll achieve... our..."
"Don't you die!"

Joshua tightly held the flower in their hand. A vibrant crimson hue seeped from the petals and roots of each flower beneath their feet, turning the field into a sea of blood. Amidst this sanguine expanse, Joshua looked up at the sky. A question emerged from an unknown source, and they awoke.

The dream faded, along with the ocean of blood, petals, and echoes of the past. Lingering in Joshua's mind, alongside a sharp headache, was a persistent question—or perhaps a curse, a label they refused to accept—the genesis of all things.

"So, you're volunteering for the Angel Project?"
des.波克士搭载有多媒体播放接口，可以接入车内的多媒体系统，播放包括音频和视频在内的各: BOX is equipped with a multimedia playback port that can connect with the train's multimedia system to play an assortment of media, such as audio and video files.\nIn the interest of communicating better with users and relieving the loneliness and fatigue of long-distance travel, BOX is also fitted with a database-reliant bionic dialogue system that allows it to engage in real-time conversation like a real person based on feedback from the database. However, some conductors have recently reported that talking to these robots inexplicably ticks them off. The database provider is currently working hard on getting to the bottom of this.\n"But logically speaking, the algorithm of the Bionic Operator X is designed to keep learning from 'whatever pleases the Conductor'... So, is there a possibility that maybe BOX determined this is exactly how the Conductor likes to be treated?"
des.搭载在无垠号上的波克士，为了能够更高效地辅助列车长驾驶列车管控各项指标，以及应对:
To more effectively assist the Conductor in driving, controlling various indicators, and handling some emergency situations, the BOX on Train No. CBCRR23, The Eternal, has undergone customized modifications experimentally.
For example, it invoked a more rational bionic dialogue database and computational logic in order to aid the Conductor—or at least that is what it believes—but when put to practical use, the unexpected still happened.
After the Conductor and Livia's information was logged into the database and analyzed for some time, The Eternal's BOX indeed accurately identified the Conductor, but it labeled Livia as "the person with the highest standing on this train." Despite numerous other people becoming permanent staff of the train afterward, BOX's beyond-deferential attitude toward Livia remained unchanged.
Even Livia herself is pretty baffled as to why this is so.
des.仔细一想，“世界上的波克士不止有一个”这个事实还是挺吓人的。一个波克士的存在已经:
If you think about it, the fact that "there is more than one BOX in this world" is pretty scary. The existence of one BOX alone is already capable of causing chaos on the train. Should numerous BOXes converge on The Eternal and launch into BOX-style sarcasm at the Conductor in tandem... just the thought of it is enough to give you nightmares.
Out of curiosity for what exactly happened to BOX's mindset, Haruka once requested a robot repair technician who came by to inspect BOX's program logic, and the conclusion obtained was obviously "everything is fine." The technician even specially wrote a maintenance report to prove that not only were there no abnormalities in BOX's operation, but it fared much better than other same-model machines running for the same duration.
With this report, BOX became fairly smug about its state of health and started fulfilling its duty of supervising the Conductor's improvement with more resolve. There is no doubt it can work on The Eternal until the Conductor retires, judging by its excellent operating condition.
In other words, the days of living with BOX aren't going to end anytime soon.
des.据说仿生技工系列还在不断研制新的型号，不过大多是试作机，由于价格昂贵、技术缺乏泛:
It's said that new models of the Android Mechanic series are still continuously being developed, but most of them are prototypes that have yet to gain widespread popularity due to high price tags, lack of versatility in function, and so on. BOX is very keen on information like this, often looking unusually enthusiastic when receiving news on "new Android Mechanics," and it will even hop onto the small tables on both sides of the carriage to play the news on a loop.
The majority of the crew have already gotten used to this. Livia's comment is, "It's just like how pet hounds of the Empire's people get excited and wag their tail whenever they hear other pets nearby..."
BOX is oblivious about itself being analogized to dogs, but Livia is very worried about BOX getting too lonely and has been seriously considering whether or not to spend a fortune to bring in a new robot that can keep BOX company. Sadly, this idea has remained stagnated at the conceptualization stage, as getting a new robot truly costs a bomb.
"We'll have to depend on you to work hard and diligently supervise the Conductor's work, BOX! If our earnings are good, you just might get yourself a new friend!"
Nobody realized that while thinking that BOX "needs company from its kind," BOX's existence is already no longer just a pure android but more like... Hmm, more like what?

des.咳咳！咳嗯！好！我要说话了！有好好端着摄像机吧朱迪？\r这次夏尔大人侵入车厢，可:
Ahem! Ahem! Okay, I'm gonna speak now! Are you holding the camera properly, Jude?

This time, I made sure to be thoroughly prepared before inflitrating the carriage! But today... after closer observation... I realized it was much more boring than when I was locked up before... The cabinet was filled with robot dog bentos, and the rest area was even messier than my room... There was even someone in the passenger car screaming "How can you bring a goose onboard"! It was simply outrageous! Anyway, the Eternal isn't all that fun!

...Still, I ate one of your bentos, and, um, slept on the bed. It was unoccupied, after all! It was a chaos in the carriage today! Jude and I also yelled at that passenger who scolded me. Jude was loud. Good Jude. Bad passenger.

Anyway, I'll still coming to the train next time! Keep making improvements be prepared to welcome me!

All right, Jude, turn it off. It's the button on the side. Gah, let me do it...

"This is the 'secret videotape' Miss Shire left behind when she infiltrated our carriage last time. It was taped down in your drawer. Shall we keep it and play it for her when she boards the Eternal again, Conductor?"
des.自从无垠号上来了这位沙盗团的成员，本就称不上整齐的车厢秩序更是变得一团乱。有洁癖:
Ever since this P.U.S. member boarded the Eternal, the already rather disordered carriage has become even more in disarray. Clean freaks ran out of their bedrooms screaming about goose feathers on their beds, while the light sleepers claimed to hear odd noises in the carriage in the middle of the night... Even those members who cared least about orderliness also screamed their lungs out upon finding their midnight snack half-eaten. When all clues pointed in the same direction, the human-goose duo hiding merrily in the corner with their loot was quickly dragged out in the open.

"That's not fair!!! I've never been caught like this back in Turbulent Sea!!!"

Shire appeared to be in disbelief about everything happening, likely because her various violations in P.U.S. were really never found out or because she was simply an expert in making a run for it. Regardless, she still had to face the music for her actions.

The next day, a huge "Reformation Order" was pasted on the head of Shire's bed.

This child is hereby ordered to keep early hours daily. Taking Jude to the carriage after lights out is prohibited. If violated, the child must compensate each affected crew member with a packet of premium Carmine May snacks with no upper limit!
des.对于外界的人来说，混沌海是神秘又可怖的未知之地；但对在其中成长的夏尔来说，那里是:
To outsiders, Turbulent Sea is a mysterious, terrifying unknown place, but to Shire, who grew up there, that is simply her home. That being said, children tend to have an excessively lovely impression and memory of their home. It's actually usually futile to get any meaningful information about Turbulent Sea from Shire.

"Turbulent Sea? Well, it's a sea. I mean, it may not really be a sea, but it's more or less the same! Everyone drives a car or boat and comes and goes there. When they wanna leave, they can simply get to the shore! But motorcycles aren't common there. Even the one Papaga modified for me can't really be ridden. It's scary, as if trash could hit you in the face at any time!"

While Shire describes this, Jude stands aside and flaps its wings in an exaggerated show of support. But if Turbulent Sea is truly that dangerous, how exactly did those astonishing groups founded there thrive?

Perhaps we'll have to wait to get closer to Shire before she's willing to let us in on the secret of navigating through it.
des.“哈哈哈哈哈！！终于找到了！功夫不负有心人，乌露露你看！这绝对是小妞她爸妈！你看:
"Hahahahaha! At last, I found them! My hard work paid off! Look, Ululu! These are 100% that girl's parents! Look at their eyes 'n' hair!"

"All right, I got it. Keep it down, will you? Let me see... You did the DNA test? And what about their background?"

"Of course! What, you think I'll just assume things without evidence?!"

"Guess it's time to arrange for a meetup. Hasn't Shire always been bothered about her parentage?"

"Yeah, yeah, I know. I'll throw a bunch of her photos into that piteous couple's home... Teehee!"

"But that will make this look like an abduction."

"Nah! Besides, we don't know if Shire's willing to meet them. She's always been indecisive when it comes to important matters."

"Oh? Aren't you going to accompany her?"

"Nope. You?"

"No."

"That's it, then."

"...Well, didn't she say she met some interesting friends out there. Maybe she'll find someone to go with her. Papaga, it's been many, many years since we first met that doll-like child who was brought back from the railway platform, huh?"

des.只要曾经造访荒原站的人，大多会对驻守阿妮塔观测站的安菲娅印象深刻。以她的年纪，单:
Most people, as long as they've visited the Wilderness Station, tend to have a deep impression of Anfiya, who's stationed at the Anita Observatory. At her age, it seems almost too soon for her to be posted alone at a deserted station, but her professionalism as she buries herself in research is enough to prove her competence.

Anfiya's Ascension Ability is "Mind Palace." She can rapidly take apart and analyze the composition of objects, then improve on their performance. Meanwhile, her other Ascension Ability registered is the ability to converse with Chaos Remains, albeit this hasn't been proven yet.

It is exceedingly rare for Ascenders to have multiple Ascension Abilities, so why is the fortunate Anfiya still so unheard of? It appears either she or the unknown force behind her doesn't want her identity to be publicized... Maybe that has something to do with it? Her employee ID simply states her first name and no last name, and the position is merely an "intern" as well, but to Anfiya, who she is in the public eye doesn't matter at all.

The first thing she did upon boarding the train was to solemnly reintroduce her Chaos Remain friend who lives in the box to Conductor.
des.自从安菲娅成为护卫乘员并常驻无垠号后，车上的非人类成员们就变得格外警惕。宠物店长:
Ever since Anfiya became a guard crew member and a permanent fixture on the Eternal, all the non-human members onboard became especially vigilant. The animals taken in by the pet shop owner would consistently bark frenziedly at the box Anfiya held, and the two with an eagle and a goose also feedbacked that their animal pals would lose sleep at night. Everyone in the know always subconsciously had their guard up against the box even when there weren't tentacles coming out from within.

Meanwhile, the cause of this—Anfiya and her box—expressed nothing in regard to this series of events. She avoided eye contact with the other members and wasn't willing to explain to everyone that the "creature" in the box was frankly harmless, simply refusing any form of interaction with people... 

This lasted until Conductor and Livia found an opportunity to have a long chat with her. Anfiya revealed that she didn't want everyone to dislike White Birch, but she couldn't find the right way to explain that either. A lightbulb moment hit Conductor as a splendid idea came to mind.

The next day, a paper was added to Anfiya's box that read: "Anti-Midnight-Snacking Deputy: White Birch."
des.安菲娅小时候在一本书上读到，人诞生在这个世上就会与其他人产生联系，那些“联系”会:
As a child, Anfiya learned from a book that humans would form connections with others once they were born in this world, and these "connections" would multiply, leading to heavier footsteps due to the constant dilemma between connections.

She subconsciously touched her shoulder, attempting to visualize what it would feel like to have a thread-like "connection" attached to her.

Alas, there was nothing.
No mother, no friends, and her "father" wasn't a like a "father" either, merely someone who saw her occasionally to check if she was still alive. The only person in her world was an elderly nanny, but the woman was purely doing her job and wasn't obligated to give Anfiya the feelings she longed for.

As if being placed in an empty sterile room with not a single decor, Anfiya was all alone and had no connection with anybody, virtually like an alien that didn't belong in this world.

Only when her father saw the weapon designs that she learned to draw on her own did she finally have the chance to stand before the man. Nonetheless, Anfiya understood that her father didn't view her as a daughter but as a talent that had half of his genes - something he had yearned for all his life.

Under his arrangement, she went eagerly to DRYAS CORPORATION's ninth factory, Ironworks IX, wondering if she could start addressing that man as "Father" instead of "Mr. Dryas" if she did well there and if there would be people similar to her in the factory whom she could talk to and perhaps... befriend.

"Friend" was a word she had only seen in books, an exceptionally significant "connection" in the lives of humankind.

With a heart full of hope, Anfiya stepped into Ironworks IX.
des.“一直闷不做声，语言功能可是会退化的。”\r以这句搭话为开端，安菲娅和妮基塔结识:
"Your ability to speak will deteriorate if you keep staying silent."
This was the line that set the acquaintance between Anfiya and Nikita in motion. Nikita was the ideal type of friend Anfiya had always dreamed of - close in age, friendly, and on the same wavelength. With Nikita's guidance, Anfiya gradually became one of the members of a small group who idolized Nikita, leaving her awestruck as she carefully tried to maintain this hard-won friendship.

Slowly but surely, Anfiya got used to life in Ironworks IX, and her talent, which had been repressed for years, finally had the chance to shine as she managed to continuously produce more outstanding results faster than others. The joy brought by the sense of achievement filled her heart bit by bit, but when she tried to share her elation with her "friend," she was met with Nikita's frosty gaze instead.

Did she... do something wrong?
Please don't hate me. Please don't abandon me. I would do anything. She practically tossed her dignity aside and begged Nikita. Yet, facing Anfiya's vulnerability, Nikita seemed to only become even more distant.

"How could you have done anything wrong? You're too impressive."
...Aren't we friends?
Mocking smiles spread onto everybody's faces like a disease. "Aren't you amazing? Who are we to be your friends?"

No insult or violence. Anfiya was simply, once again, thrown back into that sterile room, losing all connections. It was a long time later when she finally learned that had been a plan Nikita conceived all along. The woman had never been sincere from the beginning; her only goal was to make things hot for Anfiya so as to root out this misfit.

"Your ability to speak will deteriorate if you keep staying silent."
It still hurts a lot to recall these words, but in order to keep at it, Anfiya chose to converse with the Chaos Remains in the incubators instead, though needless to say, she couldn't get any response.

However, one day, a Chaos Remain lightly tapped the glass with its tentacle after Anfiya was done talking. She took it to be a coincidence at first, but as time passed, she noticed that it would indeed react differently to the things she said.
For the second time, an invisible thread linked her with the world, and right when she bordered on a mental breakdown, she finally heard their "voices."

The night before leaving Ironworks IX, Anfiya smashed the incubator open, asking, "Are you willing to leave with me? If not, you can leave by yourself too."
Its tentacle gently touched her, and then it wormed its way into the box beside her, lying contentedly in it as if it knew this was its future home.
"May I call you White Birch?"
White Birch's tentacle wiggled up and down, mimicking a human's nod.
Anfiya hugged White Birch's box tightly, having found a friend at last.
des.“啊？！刚刚过去的那是静流吗？！”\r换了身新装备的静流，在蜃息岛的风波告一段落:
"Huh?! Was that Shizuru passing by?!"

Shizuru, having changed into a new getup, returned to the Eternal soon after the issues on Mirage Island were settled, and she updated her record in the crew database with her present appearance. However, as not everybody was aware of this, gasps of astonishment erupted continually wherever her hasty footsteps led her. This reaction caused her to blush in embarrassment at first until she gradually got used to it in a few short days. Now, she's already able to wave leisurely in greeting at the colleagues who let out such exclamations.

According to Shizuru herself, this getup was put together by her teammates. Dorothy made this combat-ready "Summer Blast Water Gun" based on Shizuru's typical practices; Julian altered the exterior of Shizuru's combat backpack; Karen made the call to get Shizuru a simple, airy, yet fashionable vacation outfit.

Anyway, when she appeared before Conductor, this casual yet combat-ready new getup definitely lit up the eyes. There was no doubt Shizuru must've been a sight to behold as she wandered the beach of Mirage Island in this look.
des.静流自发奋勇地担任了清理岛屿沙滩上垃圾和残骸的工作。这项工作不算轻松，但静流却做:
Of her own volition, Shizuru took on the job of cleaning up the trash and remains on Mirage Island's beach. It was by no means easy, but she did it all in apple-pie order, working like a well-oiled team with the rest of the crew and adequately acknowledging others' work. Doing everything alone has become a thing of the past for her.

This day, Shizuru and her companions came across a large flotsam on the beach that was washed ashore. As they couldn't move it with their bare hands, they decided to drive the tow truck over. Before leaving, everyone reminded Shizuru with a laugh, "You better not overextend yourself and attempt to move it on your own!"

She answered laughingly, "Don't worry. I won't!"

Yet, while waiting alone on the beach for her companions to return, Shizuru recalled something minor that occurred while she was a student. During the school's spring cleaning, she had been assigned to tidy up the long-neglected storage room, which was not only covered in dust but also packed with loads of heavy stuff. As she didn't want to seek help from anyone, she had no choice but to shield her mouth and nose while struggling to move those heavy things. When it was finally decently clean, she remained the only person in the storage room.

Upon learning about that, all of her teachers and classmates were amazed and praised her for being hardworking and responsible. Only a close friend reprimanded her angrily, "Do not try to overextend yourself again! It's really dangerous to move heavy objects!"

From then on, Shizuru, unsurprisingly, went through many, many periods of overextending herself, but whenever she was at her limits, she would recall this incident... Now, she has at least managed not to overextend herself all on her own.

The sound of everyone's voice drifted into her ears from afar. With that, Shizuru saw that friend of hers wave at her while running over.
des.“我不需要新衣服啦……铁盟配发的夏季作战服也可以穿啊，还配套了制式泳衣……”\r:
"I don't actually need new clothes... I can wear the BCRL summer combat uniform. There's even a standard swimsuit that goes with it..."

"No can do, Shizuru! This is a vacation. You ought to get in the mood, switch up your style, and put on new pretty clothes! How boring would it be to wear a uniform on vacation!"

Ignoring the captain's faint protest, the three members of Team Ratel dragged the unenthusiastic Shizuru into Cape City's largest shopping mall just like that. At first, a few of the salespeople in the mall assumed they were on the job, but it eventually dawned on them that these were simply young ladies enjoying a shopping spree after work, albeit they did create quite a racket.

Not many brands could meet the fashion expert Karen's standards, so Team Ratel had no option but to browse in every single shop in the mall. Julian, at the rear of the group, quietly helped the leading Karen carry more and more shopping bags, whereas Dorothy seized the opportunity to get some ice cream from a kiosk to reward everyone. Meanwhile, Shizuru, walking in the front as the woman of the hour, felt somewhat uneasy, unaccustomed to being surrounded and taken care of this way. But whenever she looked back and saw the trio's sort of silly grins, she just couldn't find it in herself to turn down their kindness.

In the end, taking into account everyone's varying opinions, Shizuru selected an outfit perfect for a vacation. Right as she let out a sigh of relief and pulled out her wallet to foot the bill, her friend stilled her arm and said, "Let us take care of it."
"...What do you mean? It's fine. I can afford it..."
"I know, but this is something we want to do. Just take it that we're wishing you a happy holiday in advance?"
"But—"
"Captain Shizuruuuu! There's no need to be shy!"
"Please, Shizuru! Let us pay for it, okay? Please!"

Despite accepting this gift, Shizuru still felt slightly embarrassed about it. Using the excuse of trying it on again, she hid in the changing room, planning to recompose herself, only to spot the genuine smile on her face through the mirror upon putting on the new outfit. It then hit her that she was no longer alone; she now had what she deserved...

I'll wear this the next time I see you.
des.作为一名经常在篝火城之外活动的铁盟士兵，静流近几次的体检数值和各种形态场检测数值:
As a BCRL soldier who frequently travels outside Bonfire Cities, Shizuru has logged relatively normal vital signs and all types of morphic field examination data these days. Every year, numerous soldiers would lose their lives due to excessive morphic field pollution outside Bonfire Cities, so to Shizuru, these figures not only symbolize good luck but also the effectiveness of her pragmatic yet prudent command strategy.

Shizuru doesn't have an Ascension Ability, but she has met plenty of powerful Ascenders and seen how powerful Ascension Abilities could instantly resolve what would take her ages to complete. Once in a while, she'd also imagine what it would be like if she had an Ascension Ability, and what she could do with it. Would she become a wholly different person? Could she... use this power to help the people she wanted to protect even more?

These thoughts usually don't last, for Shizuru is simply too busy; it never takes long before her packed daily schedule brings her to the next task. At the same time, she isn't in a hurry for answers either, not to mention that she sometimes feels like she won't have the willpower to face these answers.

However, when she bade farewell to her companions on Mirage Island's beach and clutched her weapon as she faced the incoming swarm of Chaos Remains, she suddenly realized she had already found the answers to those questions.

Even without extraordinary powers, she can live as herself. There are still things she can do as a normal person.

My childhood playmate, my closest friend, the most important person in my life... I will help you with the capability of a normal person. Hopefully, you'll get further in life until you find your answers.
des.来自海角城的遗失货物，里面可能装有一种或几种海角城对外贸易的交易品。: Lost cargo from Cape City, potentially containing one or more traded products produced in Cape City.
des.该收容对象于约██前获得收容。当时，疑似导致该状况的索思学会学者██位于其研究室:
The entity was contained approximately ████ ago. During the incident, the Citadel scholar ███, who was suspected of triggering the situation, was located in her laboratory. She was seated in a kneeling position, holding SC-002 tightly, and insisted to the present Citadel members that SC-002 was her blood kin, her only family. Since scholar ███ refused to cooperate with the enforcement and release SC-002, the team resorted to forceful measures to subdue her before taking SC-002 into custody.

Upon awakening and regaining consciousness, SC-002 showed a willingness to communicate with other humans but insisted on meeting Scholar ███. After a discussion within Source Citadel, it was decided to inform SC-002 that she was the younger sister of Scholar ███, and that ███ had taken special measures to save her life. As long as she adhered to the Citadel's instructions, she would eventually be reunited with ███.

SC-002's condition necessitates ongoing monitoring. However, I have a request. Please address her as "Jalhay" in the future.

In case she comes across this document in the future, I want her to understand that we all aspire to embrace her and care for her as a fellow human being.

— Guarantor ███
des.SC-002，在以下档案中将以代号“雅莱”作为其代称。\r在铁盟建立的市民数据库:
SC-002 will now be addressed as "Jalhay" in following records.

Scholar ███'s personal details can be accessed in BCRL's citizen database. During her younger years, ███ was a member of a family of four, consisting of her father, mother, herself, and her younger sister Jalhay. Jalhay underwent prolonged hospitalization due to a chronic illness and its complications at a young age, and eventually passed away from organ failure.

Upon reaching adulthood, ███ delved into neurology and human cloning research. Her remarkable contributions in academia drew the attention of Source Citadel, leading her to join the █████ to address research challenges. While her projects made significant progress and influenced scholars across various disciplines, she consistently expressed that she had yet to achieve her targets.

In the year ████, the Citadel detected abnormal energy fluctuations in ███'s research area and dispatched a specialized enforcement team. In the same year, subject "Jalhay" was contained. Throughout her containment, numerous researchers and guards reported hearing ██████. Eventually, researchers confirmed the existence of Symbiont SC-002-A through monitoring techniques.

SC-002-A typically lacks a physical form and cannot be visually observed. Its voice can only be "heard" through ███████. SC-002-A does not possess a consistent human persona, with its vocal tone ranging from █████ to ████████. It can exert a certain influence on reality, the extent of this influence remaining unclear.

Caution is required during interactions. Avoid provoking SC-002... Avoid provoking Jalhay, as it could lead to the Symbiont losing control of its temper and power, resulting in catastrophic incidents.
des.请求与SC-002会见。\r——拘禁人员██\r\r请求与SC-002会见。接受:
Request a meeting with SC-002.

Request a meeting with SC-002. I accept unilateral meeting, she doesn't need to know of my presence.

Request a meeting with SC-002. If Lissandra or Raziel sees this message, please talk to me. I want to know how Jalhay is doing outside. As you see, I won't do a thing... I just want to know if she's doing alright outside.

des.以下文字记录转写自一卷于CBCRR023███列车上发现的录像带。该录像带由雅莱:
The following transcript is from a videotape discovered on train CBCRR23 ███. Jalhay found this tape and handed it over to the █████ of the train.

Upon examination, this tape is created by "WOKTO" and spans 60 minutes of footage. However, only the 12th to 15th minutes contain blurred visuals and sounds, with some content being unidentifiable, likely due to tape damage.

[Transcript: SC-002-A-013]
You must wonder why Jalhay's hair length is noted in the archive, right?
It's simply because they have seen me before. I look exactly like Jalhay, and Jalhay looks exactly like a younger version of Harle. We are duplicates of one another, so minor details hold significance.
Picture this: How would you react upon waking to find two identical [Unidentifiable] before you? I have long hair, which I personally prefer. That's a common preference among human girls, right?
As for what I am, well, I don't think it matters to you.
What really matters... and what you should remember is: "I am always there". I was there when Harle cradled the newborn "us" in the lab; I was there when you talked with Jalhay and took her picture; I was there when you discussed your envisioned future...
[Unidentifiable]
...But I guess you can't make sense of my words yet. One day, you will comprehend what we are, what we are composed of, and what we will turn into.
Then, we shall meet again in [Unidentifiable].
des.伊索斯在无垠号上的工作区域大多在医疗台附近。凭借他的专业知识，他能在日常救护、用:
Ithos's working area on the Eternal is primarily near the medical workstation. With his expertise, he's able to provide relatively professional guidance in regular first aid, medication usage, and even various surgeries, which has greatly helped the crew members and passengers who needed emergency medical attention. For the same reason, he has earned the respect of a good number of people on the train, though he has never exhibited obvious delight about that.

When he's not working, Ithos will normally go to the exclusive lab prepared for him to continue the experiments he has yet to finish at the Citadel's HQ. These experiments are typically conducted in silence, which is why the majority of people tend to assume that he's resting in the room when, in reality, what he's experimenting with is far more cruel than they can imagine.

Ithos will use tools and drugs to carry out all sorts of tests on himself, then record these test results as is and analyze them. His body is covered in extensive, horrifying scars, all of which come from him using himself as a lab rat.

Even now, when elaborating on fundamental biological knowledge to the juniors, Ithos would always begin with "The technical requirements for dissection and surgery are basically the same."
des.伊索斯完全不懂得享受生活，除了研究，世界上好像就没有什么值得伊索斯提起兴趣的事情:
Ithos has not a single clue about the pleasures of life. It seems as though nothing is worth his interest, save for research. To him, even eating and sleeping are a nuisance. If it weren't because he had to maintain his vitals, he would've gladly given up these two things as well.

What's shocking, however, is that someone like him actually has pets. Sometimes, people would chance upon him with a cockatiel on his shoulder or head. His pets are highly talented, a stark contrast to their owner. They're extremely enthused about the beauty of music and have already mastered plenty of tunes, be it a children's song or a trendy pop song.

Some curious people have asked Ithos where the cockatiels came from, to which he'd simply say they were his family's pets but were now in his care exclusively. Nevertheless, what's certain is, although he hasn't expressed adoration to them, he has never acted irked either. Judging by the cockatiels' smooth and slick feathers and pudgy shape, they are clearly well taken care of.

Perhaps unlike his typically unkind manner of speaking, Ithos is honestly a tender person...? This remains to be determined.
des.“当我们接到周边居民的投诉赶到现场后，很快找到了臭味的来源是0316室。队长前去:
"When we received the neighbors' complaints and rushed to the scene, we quickly discovered that room 0316 was the source of the stench. Captain went to knock on the door, but there wasn't any sound in there, so we forced our way in upon determining that nobody was home. What greeted us caused many rookies to throw up at once. Of the family of six, the grandfather, father, mother, and two daughters were killed. It was simply horrific. The only survivor was the son, the eldest of the siblings. He was in the room and browsing through reading materials at the time, seemingly oblivious to everything that transpired. The medical examiner told us that owing to the degree of decomposition and deliberate contamination of the scene, it would be tough to find any useful evidence, and even their cause of death remains undetermined.

According to witnesses, the son had come home over two weeks ago, which is to say that he did not report this for the entire duration and continued living in the room. In addition, he was the one behind those deliberate contaminations; he claimed he was 'doing experiments.'

Needless to say, he didn't admit to being the murderer, but when we asked him why he contaminated the scene, he alleged that he was purely searching for a way to save them. Such a reason naturally didn't convince the detectives. When asked why he did not respond when we knocked, he said he had hit a roadblock in his contemplation and didn't want to face any disruptions... All of us were of the sentiment that he must be a lunatic. However, in spite of him topping the list of suspects, we indeed did not have proof. There wasn't any clue at the scene, and he had an alibi, so we couldn't convict him.

Thereafter, we engaged several mental health experts in hopes of getting his statement once again, but it was then that he went missing. Even the higher-ups prohibited us from continuing the investigation for the reason that he had gotten a trustworthy guarantor and that he would never commit a crime. With that, the Gronru Familicide turned into a cold case. Some people theorized that he had obtained protection from Source Citadel in view of his academic contributions, while others speculated that he had already changed his identity entirely to work for Night Chains. I guess we'll never know. Maybe he's not even in this world anymore..."

—Excerpted from Page 56 of "The Mysteries of the Gronru Familicide Case"
des.又失败了。\r看着手术台上开始向深眠者转化的病人，伊索斯在对方失去“人”的身份之:
Yet another failure.

Seeing that the patient on the operating table was beginning to turn into a Deep Sleeper, Ithos ended this life before the patient would lose their identity as a "human." This was something they had agreed upon beforehand - should the surgery fail, the patient wished to die a human.

Few people were willing to go under Ithos's knife for this gamble, most of whom were terminally ill and were already counting down their days. Instead of spending their last handful of days in dread, they might as well go for it; if they were lucky, they could gain a brand-new life as an Ascender. Alas, to date, the success rates remain minimal.

Ithos left the operating room and bumped into a scholar from the Ascension faction. The scholar eyed the young Ithos, who had only recently joined the Citadel, and advised, "Don't be discouraged. There have always been plenty of people researching how to turn regular people into Ascenders, but to no avail. I've seen your paper on genetic medicine. It was an interesting read."

Ithos nodded, then suddenly halted in his tracks and walked back in haste. The scholar went on, "Woah, you're a real hardworking one. Don't you need to eat?"

Ithos behaved as though he didn't hear that at all. Afterward, people found him unconscious in the operating room, thoroughly wounded and running a high fever. He had used himself as the test subject in an attempt to execute his idea, and it was a success. He became an Ascender. Reportedly, the first thing he said upon waking up was, "I get it now. Human bodies are inherently deceiving; this is a sort of self-protection. All we need to do is to get rid of the body's ability to deceive."

It was said that he had done a fairly reckless surgery on himself, suppressing some of his senses. When that scholar who spoke with Ithos came for a visit, Ithos was writing a report in the hospital bed. The scholar skimmed through it and queried, "You plan on turning all humans into Ascenders?"
"This is the only way to protect everyone in the current world," replied Ithos without even looking up. "No one should be left behind."
"I reckon quite a number of people are not willing to become Ascenders."
"I don't care about their willingness."
"I must say, your ambition is truly arrogant, but it doesn't sound bad." The scholar smiled. "The Ascension will be perfect for you, Ithos."
At last, Ithos raised his head, his eyes visibly flickering with a hint of joy. "In that case, I'm looking forward to it."
des.“准备好了吗，监视机器人们？！”\r定时输出内容:【准备好了——】\r“预备——:

[End of A-S2O's Log]
Just like the surveillance log accessed by BOX, Paladi appears to be having a contented time on the train. The change in her work setting does not seem to affect her usual lively and carefree demeanor. The girl darting through the Reforming Center's corridors and the rowdy one who sings loudly with her surveillance robots on the Eternal, are indeed the same Paladi.
However, what's the point of her game? Is it intended to train her robots?
des.作为AOS系统，也就是“神盾”系统的开发者，帕拉笛显然对她的作品相当自豪。这套系:
As the developer of the AOS system, the "Aegis" System, Paladi takes immense pride in her work. The system not only encompasses a wide array of basic functions but also excels in user-friendliness, responsiveness, and interface optimization. In Paladi's words, it's not a system that "takes human's place as a commandant" but "helps people become a commandant." Given her expertise as the most knowledgeable and skilled user of this system, Paladi has been appointed by BCRL as the head of the Reforming Center, entrusted with its operations.

Management is no easy feat, particularly for someone like Paladi who started as a system developer. Nonetheless, with her dynamic and resilient nature, she successfully brought order to the once chaotic Reforming Center and consistently improved the "Aegis" System to meet evolving management needs. Her commitment and accomplishments have garnered respect from all.

However, the strain of prolonged and intense work hours is evident. Despite her passion for her work, she seeks ways to alleviate work-related stress by sneaking off. If you happen to catch Paladi discreetly pretending to be a regular passenger on the Eternal, it is simply her way of briefly escaping the demanding tasks at the Reforming Center for a bit of respite.
des.帕拉笛的披风上有一枚异常巨大的吊牌，是按部分索思学会专属设施的通行证明制作的。这:
Paladi's cloak features an unusually large tag which has the design of Source Citadel facility access permit. The tag's style has an antique look, with some Citadel members suggesting it could be at least a decade old. As a BCRL member, Paladi treasures this Citadel tag with uncommon passion, adamantly refusing anyone to touch it.

Her attachment to Citadel-related items and members is apparent to all. Even amidst her early days at the Reforming Center, buried in her demanding managerial duties, she consistently prompted the Eternal crew to keep an eye for the latest Citadel merchandise during their explorations. Whenever she found something she fancied, she would eagerly declare, "I want this!" and promptly place an order for it.

In fact, Paladi is not obsessed with Source Citadel. She does not purchase Citadel items like a fanatic, but is more like "feeling delighted whenever she sees them". While she enjoys collecting such items, missing out does not lead to overwhelming disappointment. This could be attributed to her inherently carefree and easygoing nature. Occasionally, someone might ask her, "Why are you so fascinated with the Citadel's items?" To which she would respond with a wide grin, "Because I want to join the Citadel!"

This inevitably leads to another unspoken question: Why hasn't she joined the Citadel? Well, such an awkward question is best left unsaid.
des.“我才不要帮你们做监视别人的工作呢！”\r在这场足以改变帕拉笛人生的技术比赛上，:
"No, I won't spy on people for you!"
In a pivotal moment during the Tech Contest that could have altered Paladi's life, she successfully advanced to the final challenge. However, as the demands of the investors grew more unbearable, the young Paladi found their expectations unacceptable. In her opinion, technology should exist to benefit humanity, to improve lives, and not be exploited solely for commercial gain.

Unable to endure this any longer, Paladi erupted in anger at the investors and abruptly left, thereby forfeiting the opportunity to continue in the competition. Her sudden departure left many of her peers astonished. Later, she learned that one of these peers had secured the investment.

Since her youth, Paladi had been exposed to the ideals of the Source Citadel through a distant relative: the salvation of all humanity. Since then, she had aspired to join the Citadel, facing repeated setbacks and rejections. After unsuccessful attempts to join the Citadel, she turned to seeking investment from Anita... only to face failure once more due to conflicting ideologies.

Unperturbed by the curious stares of bystanders, Paladi made her way back home, tears rolling down her cheeks as she recalled the harsh criticisms from the investors. Although she rejected the commercialization notions presented by the investors, one statement lingered in her mind, "What society truly needs is a newer and better system."

When she reached home, only A-SO, previously dormant, turned its flat head toward her. Paladi, with tears still fresh, broke into a smile and rushed to embrace her barrel-shaped robot.

"Even if no one else understands me, I'll never abandon you... I'll improve you for the better, and I'll upgrade my Aegis System... One day, it will truly protect many, many people!"

As if in response to her vow, the robot's eyes blinked twice and a mail bearing the BCRL logo emerged from the printer.

Even now, Paladi, the head of the Reforming Center, vividly recalls that moment. The current Aegis robots not only ensure the security of the Reforming Center but also excel in various off-duty tasks like printing, baking muffins, singing, and other "small things." Such is the AOS Gen 2 System developed by Paladi. Rooted in these everyday aspects of life, she leads as the chief commandant of the Aegis robots.
des.身为“异界来客”中的一员，在对生驹的能力和个人意愿进行综合考量后，无垠号乘组决定:
Following thorough considerations of the abilities and willingness of Ikoma, one of the "outlanders," the Eternal crew decided to let him continue playing the role of a mechanic, though he is currently unable to complete complex maintenance works since he has been living in a world different from modern Bonfire City society. Still, he has proved to be a good fit thus far.
"The Eternal is surely different from Koutetsujou... but many things are common. I reckon this will never change!"
Holding on to this belief, Ikoma tried his hand at numerous jobs on the Eternal with passion, ranging from observing engine checks to performing daily maintenance of power hinges. On top of that, he also enjoyed getting together with the creative inventors among the crew to study weapons and equipment.
During the events near Ranshin City, Ikoma was one of the first people to adapt to the situation and pull himself together to liaise with the administrators of BCRL and other organizations. "The way to kill Kabanes is to pierce their hearts." His words became the resistance guideline of the helpless Bonfire City. At the same time, the steam-powered weapon he carried, "Tsuranuki Zutsu," also became one of the crucial weapons that defeated the Kabane horde later.
After learning that Ikoma was from another world and how he managed to create the Tsuranuki Zutsu through studying the anatomy of Kabanes and continuously tweaking hand cannons, the researchers of various organizations in the Bonfire City were deeply amazed by his intelligence and gift in invention. Compared to modern science, which is essentially built upon our predecessors' wit, Ikoma is unquestionably a genius for being able to create an all-new weapon under terrible conditions.
Yet, Ikoma himself never displays pride for his abilities. Judging solely on how he typically behaves, he seems to simply be an ordinary youth, often hitting it off with other young technicians. Only when witnessing him stepping forward in times of crisis can anyone tell from his unwavering gaze that he has once experienced things unimaginable to others.
des.“所以，甲铁城上的生活是什么样的？”\r每当被问到这个话题，无论正在做什么，生驹:
"So, how's life on Koutetsujou?"
Whenever this question is asked, regardless of what he's doing, Ikoma will immediately look up and talk passionately about the train of that other world. Where he grew up, trains are called "Hayajiro," meaning "forts that run like horses," whereas the stations situated along the railroad are called "Eki," referring to "places where horses rested in ancient times." According to Ikoma's enthusiastic descriptions, Koutetsujou is a pure black armored train with metal exterior. Although it merely belongs to a local daimyo, it is not any inferior to the shogunate's Hayajiro.
Ikoma wasn't born on Koutetsujou, but ever since boarding it to leave his Eki, he spent most of his time on the locomotive, developing a strong bond with the others aboard amid various crisis. His animated narration gives life to multiple people, such as the chubby Takumi who's also a mechanic, Miss Ayame who's in charge of the train, Kurusu the guard, Yukina the driver, and Kajika, who takes care of the women and children. Of course, among them who feels most dear is Mumei, who's also presently aboard the Eternal. Even though she was the last passenger to board the Hayajiro, she still played a part in the stories of everyone else.
If you were to ask Ikoma about interesting stories of these people, one day would hardly be adequate to hear them all. As for details of Koutetsujou itself, they come naturally to Ikoma, a Hayajiro enthusiast; even tough times like wetting his shirt with cooled stove water to wipe his face can be told entertainingly. Evidently, he truly regards Koutetsujou as his home.
"...But Koutetsujou still can't be compared to the Eternal. After all, all of us frequently go hungry, and our weapons and equipment aren't as advanced as yours... If we had what you have, I'm sure we'd be able to live a better life."
Ikoma always sounds a little sad when discussing the differences between the two trains. He even told us crew about his family who died in an accident, the numerous destroyed Ekis, and the many companions he lost after boarding Koutetsujou... Carrying such remorse, he devoted himself to studying all sorts of knowledge and working hard, hoping to be able to turn things around with his own power if there were a chance to return to Koutetsujou.
"I have to be strong. My life is deeply enriched now, and Mumei looks happy to be on the Eternal too... This is all thanks to your help. I will do my best to share what I know about Kabanes and steam engines with you all. Hopefully, that will be of use!
"...Someday, we will return to Koutetsujou together. We will get our lands back from the Kabanes and plant tons and tons of food to feed everyone!"
des.佩罗塔最初来到列车上的那天做的第一件事，是询问“这里的电子设备是不是都投了保险”:
Upon her arrival on the train, the first thing Pelota asked was, "Oh, are all the electronic devices on your train insured?" The second thing she did was present a substantial stack of documents, bearing Anita's departmental insignias and seals, with a cheerful smile, saying, "Please sign all these documents!"
Even Livia, who is experienced in onboarding new crew members and managing paperwork, found this task challenging. After spending the entire day collaborating with reliable crew members familiar with contracts, they agreed to have Conductor sign the documents. It was one of the rare times Conductor had to sign so many papers outside of the trading center, leading to a sore hand.
Box's analysis of the contracts revealed that they were not designed to hold the Conductor liable for breaches or to demand excessive compensation from the Eternal. Instead, they seemed more like agreements outlining procedures for managing situations where Pelota might cause a power outage on the train or significant environmental damage. The contracts also detailed insurance claim processes and reimbursements. Paired with Pelota's words, these documents led to some contemplation...
"It feels more like a universal manual for taking care of a kid who's away from home!"
Box confidently summarized the essence of the documents. As for Pelota, she wore a gentle smile, seemingly believing that none of the situations outlined in the contracts would ever come to pass.
des.虽然挂着特别派遣专员的名头，但日常生活中的佩罗塔显然更像是个充满热情的探险家。她:
Despite holding the title of Special Commissioner, Pelota often comes across more like an enthusiastic adventurer in her everyday life. She forms a close bond with Caroline, another member of Gardener, and establishes a strong connection with Verlaine, who is of imperial lineage. Pelota's enthusiasm shines during happy moments, as she animatedly walks through the carriages, sharing her travel stories with the crew and asking about unexplored destinations—appearing much like an ordinary girl.
Additionally, she has a helpful nature. Her ascension ability, "Attractive Field", enables her to control the electromagnetic environment around her, thus allowing her to manipulate metal objects within a certain range. While her ability can come in handy, she struggles to control it precisely. For example, she may try to retrieve a pen nearby but often ends up attracting various unintended items, leading to potentially hazardous situations. Fortunately, Pelota is quick to deactivate her ability in such emergencies, preventing harm to others, although the collateral damage is often...
"I didn't do that on purpose! I... I'll help clean up this mess!"
"In my opinion, this is the perfect time for the claims clause to kick in!"
Box remarks, reflecting on the aftermath of Pelota's ability.
des.佩罗塔身上还聚集着许多谜团。比如说，根据档案和合同上的年份推算，佩罗塔的确已经是:
Pelota remains shrouded in mystery. According to her documents and contract, she is an adult, even a few years older than Livia and Conductor. However, her behavior is notably more childish than one might expect for her age, and her petite physique resembles that of a young adolescent.
Notably, her ascension ability is exceptionally powerful. During the first encounter at the ONEderland Hotel, she eliminated all the Chaos Remains in the Endless Path unscratched, aside from a few scares from the eerie environment. Furthermore, the contents of her contract and her own statements suggest that she once caused a complete blackout in a large neighborhood, indicating her abilities far surpass those of an ordinary ascender.
Furthermore, her cane-shaped weapon and the luminous device on her head add to the intrigue. According to analyses from other members of Anita, the cane is a specialized prototype weapon designed to complement her powers. While the device on her head may resemble a fluorescent tube, it is actually a sophisticated electrical discharge mechanism to help manage the voltage load on her brain.

"What will happen if you remove this device? Well, I'm not a biotech expert, so I can't give you a definite answer, but I believe it might cause her ascension ability to overwhelm her brain... Such strain could destroy a person's sanity in no time. What's your take on this? What do you think she'll become?"
– An Anonymous Genuis Inventor
des.“小女孩儿叫球球，球球球球快快跑；踏上靴子穿上裙，咕噜咕噜往前去。”\r妈妈？\:
"Little Ballie, full of glee. Skirt a-twirlin', boots so free. Running fast, ahead she shoots. Cheeks ablaze, in her cute boots!"
Mom?
"Through oceans wide and mountains tall. She never falters, never shall fall..."
Mom!
"Until..."
Until what, Mom?
"Until you've traveled to all corners of the world... Until then..."
...
In Pelota's dreams, a nursery rhyme hummed by her mother always echoes. From her earliest memories, her mother held her close, singing softly to lull her to sleep.
Pelota's development has been slower compared to her peers. She recalls her mother's ruby-hued eyes, telling her stories about their hometown—the gardens blooming beneath the Wishing Tower, and tales of magical races and spells, like something out of a fairy tale. Her father, a dedicated Anita researcher, always found a way to balance his work and family life. Despite his demanding job, he would come home to play with her, often crafting whimsical inventions for her amusement. Pelota enjoyed a happy childhood in their cozy home in a bonfire city.
However, tragedy struck when her father disappeared during an uprising caused by demi-humans. Stricken with grief, her mother fell into despair and eventually left, never to return. Fortunately, Anita personnel intervened in time, taking Pelota in and accepting her as a unique member of their ranks. Perhaps due to her hybrid heritage, she matured more slowly, both mentally and physically.
Throughout the years, Pelota never lost faith in her absent parents. She held on to the belief that "Mom and Dad would never abandon their Ballie!" She believed the nursery rhyme was a promise of their eventual return. As she learned more about geography, she became convinced that the world's roundness would eventually bring her loved ones back to her. She believed that if she traveled far enough, she would one day reunite with them. Viewing her mother's lullaby as a beacon of hope, Pelota set out on her journey with determination.
In the midst of her endless travels, Pelota has chosen to become a companion to the Eternal. So, please remain by her side as she continues her journey around the world.
des.“这位是来自淘金乐园的‘前’淘金乐园管理者，金子小姐！来，大家和她打个招呼吧！”:
"This is ONEderland's Miss Gold, 'former' manager of ONEderland! Let's all say hi to her!"
"That robot lady that's indestructible even if struck by lightning?"
"I saw with my own two eyes how she threw money on the battlefield during combat exercise previously..."
"Why did she come aboard The Eternal? Working at Mander Mine would suit her better, no?"
"Come to think of it, since she has left ONEderland, who's in charge of managing it now? And does Mr. Peter Hwang know of this...?"
"Ah! Big Gold Potato!"
—"Gold is not Big Gold Potato, beep."
Among the several crew members' responses, Gold only replied to this comment that she couldn't comprehend. Following the brief introduction and welcoming ceremony, she was officially considered a member of The Eternal.
All in all, The Eternal's crew members were pretty welcoming of this extraordinary newbie and even overcame all kinds of obstacles for her. For example, when she had to be photographed for crew registration, they specially brought her a small stool for her to step on; searched through past articles to find her date of manufacture; and included the length of the antenna on her head as part of her height as she requested...
Miss Gold really likes The Eternal, at least that's what she said.
des.与负责管理一整个澄明数据中心的人工智能摩尔不同，金子显然没有AI那般先进的思考计:
Unlike the AI Moore who's in charge of managing the entire CDCA Bureau, Gold evidently does not possess such advanced analytical computational skills. Not to mention, she was designed and created over two decades ago. Even when compared to BOX—who's part of the 'Android Mechanic' series as well, albeit a newer model—she also appears slow and outdated.
It is seriously fascinating that such an almost-archaic robot could continuously remain in operation for decades. Part of the report noted that there was a possibility morphic field pollution had caused her framework or logical circuit to change.
After ONEderland's situation basically stabilized, a researcher expressed a desire to conduct a comprehensive inspection for Gold, and she agreed to it. However, the result was out of anybody's expectation—prolonged morphic field pollution did not change any of her internal components nor affect her program much.
This model of nugget mech was created with the intent of accompanying human gold diggers, and she accomplished it impeccably. It seems the best explanation for this would be a coincidence, or perhaps, a miracle.
des.“金子觉得，波克士的机能存在问题。为什么，不接受检查？”\r“本机认为本机的机能:
"Gold thinks, BOX have functionality issues. Why not, accept inspection?"
"There isn't any functionality issue with me! I will not accept these dubious inspections! I will not!"
It's unknown when it began, but somehow, Miss Gold became insistent that BOX's hostile, teasing attitude toward the Conductor must be due to a virus in BOX's program. As such, she kept persuading BOX to return to its manufacturer to undergo a program inspection.
In contrast to that, BOX does not believe that anything is wrong with its program at all and thus constantly turns down Gold's suggestions. This sparked off an intense, unending chase aboard between the two robots of different sizes and styles.
From a maneuverability standpoint, the Bionic Operator X, which is BOX's model, is much smaller, making it ideal to play the role of humans' assistant. Meanwhile, the Android Mechanic Nugget Mech—Miss Gold's model—has various Outdoor Gear integrated, hence making it much larger and heavier. In such a chase, Gold doesn't have the advantage, which makes it understandable that she would lose.
However, what BOX doesn't know is that Miss Gold had already been serviced and upgraded by COLUMBA when boarding The Eternal. COLUMBA not only replaced her exterior with a much lighter and sturdier material but also added a special weapon module, "Rocket Punch," for her.
Hanging upside down on the ceiling of the front carriage, BOX only made it in time to see the armor on Gold's arm glow when activated...
des.在淘金大酒店事件告一段落后，淘金乐园突然接受到了一笔来历不明的拨款，汇款备注只有:
After the ONEderland Hotel incident came to a close, ONEderland received a grant from out of nowhere, with a transaction remark of only two words—"Remember her."
As it was a truly vague remark, Miss Gold eventually decided to use this money on the construction of ONEderland's historical archive. For robots, to "record" is to "remember."
However, a problem arose during an unexpected juncture of the construction. The downtime Miss Gold experienced prior had caused her memory module to be significantly damaged, resulting in her having only a small portion of the documents and reports left saved in her memory. Meanwhile, owing to the lack of upkeeping throughout the years, ONEderland did not have much relevant memory retained either.
Miss Gold was extremely troubled by that, and when The Eternal crew noticed it, everyone offered various advice. One of them ultimately stood out and attracted her attention: "How about seeking help from Mr. Peter Hwang and Baxter? With their influence, they should be able to locate those past gold diggers and gather some stuff that can suffice as historical materials, right?"
Needless to say, Peter agreed to Gold's request with a bitter smile, getting to it right away while mumbling how he would have to owe people favors again. Conversely, Baxter nearly spat out his cactus drink upon hearing that request. His eyes widened in shock as he exclaimed at her outlandish idea, though he still made great contributions later.
Of course, not everyone who was contacted was willing to help. Some of them weren't keen on recalling anything concerning ONEderland, and some hung up after going on a tirade, but at the same time, a good number of them did send back some items and even materials too. 
In these materials, The Eternal crew discovered a special photograph of young Peter and Baxter standing before ONEderland's entrance with arms around each other's shoulders. Gold stared at the photo for a long, long time until she finally asked for a special commission from The Eternal.
"Please, bring Peter and Baxter, back to ONEderland. Gold, want, take photo. ...With everyone."
des.作为“异乡来客”，无名显然一直都生活在一个和各个篝火城都截然不同的世界；也是因此:
As an "Outlander," Mumei has evidently been living in a world completely different from all Bonfire Cities. Because of that, she caused quite a few misunderstandings after coming aboard the Eternal. She knew nothing about electronic devices; her understanding of firearms remained at the flintlock from centuries ago; and when seeing new Bonfire Cities, she would look in utter disbelief and astonishment. To quote the words of some of the crew members familiar with her, she was "virtually from ancient times."
Aside from her interest in things like food and accommodation, the most memorable incident occurred was when she exclaimed while passing by the dining carriage: "You get as much rice as you want?!" It seemed that where she was born, even having one proper meal a day was tough.
From the outside, Mumei looks like one of the youngest crew members aboard. Everyone wanted to know her better, so they frequently probed her about what she liked to eat or do. But when it came to food, Mumei acted sort of indifferent.
"Food that I like? Rice, I guess... But it's not what I need to fill my belly anyway. As long as— Don't pull me, Ikoma!"
...In any case, no matter the situation, she still gets along well with the people on the Eternal. Everyone has already regarded her as a comrade ever since the events around Ranshin City. Despite having witnessed her unforgettable and pretty much unflinching combat style, many people still see her as a regular child. Meanwhile, Mumei's attitude toward the Eternal's crew is certainly unusual. She won't reject their concern, but she doesn't express any signs of joy about it either. Instead, she behaves as though she's doing some kind of duty.
"I'm a bodyguard of the Eternal now. Since I've accepted payment, I should work, shouldn't I?"
des.“呜哇~啊！吓人的大~卡巴内来了~！”\r在工作间隙，无名经常逗乘车的孩子们玩儿:
"Waaaah~ A biiig scary Kabane is here!"
Mumei often plays with the children on the train while working. Unlike how she usually behaves, she cares a lot for children younger than her, particularly crying infants, and when coming across passengers who brings children, she tends to go forward and entertain the kids for a bit. Thanks to that, the Eternal has received compliments and gifts of appreciation from the passengers several times.
