After putting a crying child to sleep, Mumei would typically bid their parent farewell with a grin, then skip back to the area where she's usually on standby - the corner of the crew carriage - and curl up to rest. Every time, she would look even lonelier than before.
On one such ordinary afternoon, Mumei disclosed to Conductor, who happened to be passing by, about what happened when she was still a child.
...
Like most children in her world, Mumei also had a normal life. Even though Kabanes were wreaking havoc in the outside world, life in the Eki was safe and sound, and she could still live in peace with her family, albeit having to go hungry sometimes.
However, the Ekis where humans lived were invaded by Kabanes one after another. The people who managed to survive on Hayajiros swarmed toward the Ekis still standing, and the survivors started clashing among themselves as they fought for the chance to live. Apart from strict Kabane inspections, people doubted, accused, and attacked each other, making them the foremost threat within Ekis.
It was during one such conflict that others doubted Mumei and her mother. Mumei's mother was stabbed to death at home when protecting the young Mumei from a soldier's blade. Afterward, the person who would change Mumei's life came. To repay that person for saving her and to obtain stronger powers, Mumei voluntarily became a Kabaneri and kept fighting to date.
...
"Meeting Ikoma on Koutetsujou... that isn't considered the past. That's the present. Being with everyone on Koutetsujou is the 'present' too.
"...How should I put it? Lots of things did happen thereafter. I made mistakes, then got hurt and healed, caused bad consequences... Many people died. But there were good things too. I don't know what the future will be like...
"Nonetheless, I know I have to keep going forward, as I still have dreams to fulfill! Whenever I see children on the Hayajiro, it's as if I can see myself through them. They're adorable, aren't they?
"It is also because of these children here that I'm positive no matter where it is, people are the same. There are good ones and bad ones; there are those who are welcomed and those who are despised... This will remain the same all around.
"Regardless, I've had a great time on the Eternal. Please continue taking care of me, Conductor."
des.罗洁尔的早年生活与许多进入索思学会的学者相同。她在雪金城出生、长大，很早便找到了:
Raziel's early life is similar to plenty of the scholars in Source Citadel. Born and raised in Platinum City, she discovered the field of study she was passionate about very early on in life and resolved to devote the rest of her life to it.

After completing foundational studies, Raziel enrolled in the Climber with outstanding results, yet the majors she chose were something that were no longer popular in Bonfire Cities —linguistics and psychology. Certainly, it was a feat to be able to major in two subjects concurrently, but many people still couldn't understand her decision. They wondered, "Why don't you choose more 'meaningful' subjects?"

"Because I like these subjects... How should I word this? Although they can't be used to change the world immediately, they are what support the human mind without you realizing it. Have you ever read the fairy tale, 'Children Who Chase the Stars'? It's precisely about..."

That was Raziel's answer, but those who questioned her often didn't have the patience to listen to her lengthy explanation. Still, that didn't demotivate or weigh down on her. She persisted with her studies until eventually entering Source Citadel and becoming a scholar.
des.初到索思学会的罗洁尔本打算继续她的本业研究。然而，学会的名誉先导丽桑德拉却提出对:
When Raziel first joined Source Citadel, she had planned to continue her research in her majors. However, the Citadel's Honorary Vanguard, Lissandra, expressed strong interest in Raziel's abilities and wished to have a chat with her. That was a controversial conversation at the time. Although the Citadel wasn't exactly lacking in manpower, researchers like Raziel were rare. Every department head wanted someone like Raziel under their wing. Furthermore, Lissandra's whereabouts had been uncertain in recent years, and the public opinion of her within the Citadel was mixed. Not everyone wanted the new scholar to be overly close to Lissandra.

Nobody had a clue how Lissandra managed to convince Raziel or why Raziel decided to join Lissandra. In any case, before long, people in the Citadel noticed that Raziel was gradually changing her research direction and becoming Lissandra's student. When news of it broke, some were for it and some against. Yet, Raziel's voice was the only one drowned out by the varied discussions.

After years of focusing on research, Raziel became a mentor who could call the shots as well. Her students both loved and respected her as a teacher and also hung out with her just like friends and equals. In no time, people seemed to forget her identity as Lissandra's student and began addressing her as "Mentor Raziel."
des.罗洁尔离开塞纳诺尼克的契机，在旁人看来，或许并不值得。赫尔，一名疯狂的研究者，为:
To third parties, Raziel's opportunity to leave Senanonic might not have been worthy. Harle, a fanatical researcher, created an artificial human body in order to resurrect her little sister and injected it with the personality she retrieved from Unbewusstes. That was the true existence of SC-002, "Jalhay." Harle's plan was quickly discovered, and she, as a high-risk threat, was also detained. Meanwhile, Raziel started traveling around upon hearing of this, using her reputation and research as guarantee to protect the artificially born Jalhay and accompanied Jalhay to the Confluence Tower.

Prior to that, Raziel and Harle were merely regular colleagues, and she had never even met Jalhay. She gave up her life in the HQ over a child, over an artificial person. Why in the world would she make such a choice?

When Raziel left the airship, her students and friends were all really reluctant to see her leave. She ended up being the one to console them smilingly instead. After getting to the Confluence Tower, she never told Jalhay about her past life and simply devoted herself to her new research. As time passed, Jalhay's condition stabilized, and the Confluence Tower became a cozy base, so much so that Citadel members would regularly come visit the two.

That was all until an old friend's arrival broke the peace, and the words "Angel Project" pierced through Raziel's life once again.
des.“这样应该就开始录了吧。‘是否确认将内容转换为人格模拟数据’……‘是’……好，我:
"Okay, start recording. 'Do you wish to convert the content into personality simulation data?' ...'Confirm.' ...All right, let me see. Where should I begin...? Firstly..."

"To Jalhay. Let me think... Make sure to eat your meals and take your medications on time, and don't forget to routinely adjust the device according to the readings I gave you... This way, you can definitely remain healthy. A good child must maintain a balanced nutrition, got it? You might even grow taller!"
...

"To Miss Valentine. About the book I borrowed from you previously, I've already asked Miss Rina Von to store it in the Imaginary. It's a truly lovely novel. Sorry that it took me so long to finish it, and thank you so much for the snacks you gave me alongside the book! I didn't dirty it thanks to that pair of tongs. Oh right! I've passed down the bookmark to Miss Rina Von. Hopefully, she can make good use of it."

"To Chelsea. I'm really sorry. I haven't contacted you ever since you transferred to the Apoaster Bridge... But I'm sure you must be doing well. Hopefully, you can also meet people who love and care for you in the new environment... Yes, I'm certain you will. After all, you're a child deserving of all the love in the world. Like before, remember not to overexert yourself during strength training. Make sure to do warm-ups!"
...

"...To Lissandra. I'm not mad at you. It's just, since the beginning, we've been simply walking alongside each other. There will always come a day when we go our separate ways. I didn't want it to happen this way, but things have ultimately come to this. Nevertheless, you are still my mentor, my friend. Please don't forget that, even though our lifespans aren't the same."

"To Ushana. There's a new ball catcher game I bought in the cabinet that typically stores your favorite things. You seemed to like it when we saw it on the catalogue previously, so I had Conductor bring it to the Confluence Tower. I just haven't had the chance to give it to you. Remember to use it to practice your exoskeleton coordination. That will prevent your hands from fighting!"
...

"Lastly, to Conductor. Hmm, what should I say to you...? I've always felt you're an impressive child. You probably don't need good wishes from me or anything, do you? But I've already told you to feel free to come to the Confluence Tower anytime. It would be pretty bad of me if I don't leave any last words to you... Haha. Let me think... Ah, I got it! Ahem...!"
"...Thank you for everything you've done. You've been fantastic, Conductor. Keep up the good work."
"May you have a safe journey. Hope we can meet again in the future."
des.岚心城是一座在多种意义上都异常错综复杂的城市。不仅是由于它的特殊地理位置和城市铁:
Ranshin City is a city of tangled complexity, in more senses than one. It is not merely the peculiarity of its geography and the labyrinth of its rail-lines that give it this character; within this Bonfire City itself lie chasms carved by disparities of station and wealth, so that a single street may divide the antiquated from the modern, the fashionable from the forgotten, as starkly as two different eras. The delivery trade, too, took early root here; long before any unified platform arose to knit the city's commerce together, the most prosperous establishments had already fashioned their own means of carrying food to those who could not come to them.

Amid such a city stood a modest family izakaya, kept by a pair of canine demihumans, renowned for the richness of its rice bowls and the depth of its ramen broth—a haven, in the small hours, for the weary and the overworked. Yet there were many more who longed for a taste of that warmth but could not cross its threshold, and the two proprietors, bound fast to the demands of their kitchen, found themselves with no hands to spare for such deliveries...

To this couple was born a daughter, her fur a bright and golden hue, so lovely a child that they named her Komugi—Wheat. From the moment she was old enough to shoulder a delivery satchel, Komugi took to the streets, weaving in and out to carry her parents' cooking to every corner of the neighborhood. As she grew, she made a name entirely her own; there was not a customer she had once served who could forget the warmth of her smile.

"Thank you so much for supporting our shop—I'm Komugi, your delivery girl today! I hope you enjoy your meal!"
des.小麦虽然保持着纯真快乐的天性，但由于很早便与父母一同承担起了家里生活的重担，她受:
Though Komugi has kept, through it all, the innocent and cheerful nature that is hers by birth, she took up the burdens of the household alongside her parents from a tender age, and thus the chances afforded her for learning were few; it was by mere happenstance, in the end, that she came to join the BCRL.

Some years past, acceptance of demihumans within Bonfire Cities had not yet reached the measure it enjoys today, and even in a place as varied in its populace as Ranshin City, a demihuman seeking to make a life for herself faced hardships far beyond those of an ordinary human. For all the years her parents labored over their little tavern, they succeeded only in securing the barest subsistence for their family. In time, their circumstances eased somewhat from what they had known in Komugi's infancy, yet still allowed no room for carelessness.

As a delivery girl, Komugi harbored no lofty ambitions of her own. Then, one day, she chanced to notice that the billboard above an intersection she often passed on her rounds had been replaced by a BCRL recruitment poster, calling for trainee soldiers. Perhaps in consideration of the great number of demihumans who called Ranshin City home, the poster even bore an image of a demihuman clad proudly in the BCRL uniform—the first time Komugi had ever beheld such a sight.

And on the day she raced home at full speed, breathless, to declare to her family that she meant to become a BCRL soldier, it was then, perhaps, that her life began quietly to change.
des.得知家里的宝贝女儿居然想独自离家加入铁盟，小麦的父母起初非常反对。无论小麦怎么用:
When they learned that their treasured daughter meant to leave home alone and join the BCRL, Komugi's parents were, at first, resolutely opposed to the notion. No matter how Komugi pleaded her case, citing the terms set out in the recruitment pamphlet or the results of her preliminary physical examination, nothing could set to rest the misgivings of this demihuman couple—and though in the end they chose to honor their daughter's decision, their faces, in the moment of parting, remained clouded with unease. Her mother pressed into her hands a bracelet of blue beads, telling her it was a charm to keep her safe wherever she might wander.

After joining the BCRL, Komugi came to understand that her parents' worry and objections had not, perhaps, been without cause. The standards of training and testing, designed as they were around the physical constitution of human soldiers, did not always suit a demihuman's needs, and even the standard-issue equipment proved ill-fitted to a demihuman's frame. Armor she could not fit into, triggers too stiff for her hands to pull, caps that slid down to cover her whole face the moment she put them on—amid the already grueling training, such small indignities were often enough to leave Komugi in tears.

And yet, life in the BCRL was not without its brighter moments. Little by little, Komugi grew accustomed to the rhythms of BCRL life, and made a few friends along the way; chief among them, of course, was Karen, whom she first came to know while sobbing her heart out in a warehouse near the training grounds.
des.-离开训练营的小麦并没有直接被派去某个前线行动小队或者站点驻守。在一段令人心焦的:
Upon leaving the training camp, Komugi was not sent directly to any front-line action squad, nor stationed to hold some outpost. After a stretch of anxious waiting, she was informed that she had been assigned as a towing car driver—news that took her entirely by surprise. Though Komugi had indeed, of her own initiative, obtained her towing car license during training, never once had she imagined she would truly be chosen for the role!

To Komugi, this appointment meant recognition, meant approval, and with it, an entirely new realm of responsibility and possibility. Others might well have looked upon the work of a towing car driver as a lesser thing—lacking the glamour of an action squad, or the security of a fixed post—but Komugi found herself overjoyed at the thought that her work would, from that day forward, offer real and tangible help, day after day, to the conductors making their way along the rails. Long before she ever set foot aboard the Eternal, Komugi had already won the goodwill of many among its crew—for a girl so golden-furred, so brimming with spirit, forever appearing like a savior at just the right moment, could hardly fail to endear herself to others.

Even after registering as a proper crew member of the Eternal, Komugi did not set aside her work as a towing car driver. To this day, she remains active in that role... though, every now and then, she finds herself wondering whether it has simply been too long, far too long, since she last went home—long enough that she can still recall the method by which her mother made pickles, yet has quite forgotten the very taste of it.

And so Komugi has begun making plans to return home on her next leave. She has already worked out, in her mind, the local delicacies she means to bring back, the gifts, and all the many things she wishes to tell her family about her friends...

And among those things, of course, is the story of the Eternal.
des.与相当一部分好像登上无垠号就是为了来添乱的乘员不同，奥莉薇恩显然是前来帮忙的那部:
Unlike quite a few crew members who seem to have boarded the Eternal just to cause trouble, Olivien is clearly part of the group here to help. Within twenty-four hours of officially signing the contract, she fully demonstrated the qualities and conscientiousness of a professional maid — first by cleaning the carriage where she resides until it was spotless, and after consulting with other crew members, meticulously categorizing and organizing their haphazardly placed items.

Some crew members specifically inquired about the contract Olivien signed and found that its terms only included ensuring the cleanliness of the conductor's living and working environment and protecting the conductor's personal safety under specific circumstances. However, after flawlessly completing these tasks, she continuously looks for new things to do herself. Her choice to do so doesn't seem to stem from any special sentiment but rather as part of what she considers her job to effortlessly complete. By the time those being cared for realize it, they often find themselves in the comfortable environment she has arranged.

"It cannot be ruled out that some people do not need or want to be served. Confirming the will of such individuals is also a maid's responsibility; I will take care to avoid offending others, so please rest assured, master. Also, I have organized the file cabinet — do you have any other needs, master?"
des.一名合格的女仆，必须要对主家生活与工作的各方面知识都有充分的了解。奥莉薇恩熟知市:
A qualified maid must have a thorough understanding of every aspect of the master's life and work. Olivien is well-versed in the flavors, aromas, types, and brewing methods of every tea that might appear on the market. Whether it's the most common box-packaged cheap tea in Bonfire City or the expensive and hard-to-find original black tea from Mundus Garden, she can find the most suitable place for each.

Taking tea leaves is just like choosing a proper way to handle affairs. Waiting for the water on the stove to come to a boil is just like waiting for the perfect moment to act. Selecting tea set with delicate patterns, elegant shape and just the right capacity is just like taking up a fitting identity to step into an incident. Pouring the tea and sharing it with every guest at the tea party is just like maneuvering among all parties while witnessing the matter come to an end. Clearing away the aftermath of an afternoon tea, then bowing and taking leave, is just like withdrawing quietly after accomplishing her task. Such is the demeanor a proper mediator ought to possess — and also the very quality a maid should have.

In Olivien's view, being a qualified maid and being a qualified mediator are in truth one and the same.
des.登上无垠号许久之后，在某次女仆与主家的“深夜谈心会”时，奥莉薇恩提到了她的“恩师:
Long after boarding the Eternal, during one late-night heart-to-heart between maid and master, Olivien spoke of her revered "mentor." She said this lady had forever changed her perspective on the world and life, gently melting her old obsession with hatred like spring rain nurturing all living things. Tranquil and elegant with a soft smile always playing on her lips now, Olivien bears no trace of the girl she once was — no one could imagine her youth was once entirely consumed by a thirst for revenge.

According to Olivien's own account, she lost her family at a young age in a cruel tragedy. Her mother did everything in her power to hide Olivien's existence, entrusting her to her closest friend from school days — the arch mage Helena. Learned and warm-natured, the mage taught her countless precious lessons: not only how to wield magic, but also how to conduct herself and interact with others.

One timeless magical philosophy left the deepest mark on Olivien. It teaches that to bind all things together is far more noble than to keep them apart, and that to give is worth more than to take. Olivien had once sworn she would never let go of her vengeance. Yet she found herself weeping for the little familiars she had summoned, who made their homes inside teapots and clocks. In them, she discovered something far more precious than chasing revenge.

Back then, the girl hiding behind the guise of a maid had no idea that one day, devoting herself to helping others and bridging two worlds would become her lifelong purpose.
des.“卡塔斯小姐，这样懒散可不行哦？”\r“哇啊嘎？！奥、奥莉薇恩你什么时候来的？！:
"Miss Katas, slacking off like this isn't proper, you know?"
"W-Wah?! O-Olivien! When did you get here?!"
"Please call me Head Maid while we are on duty, Miss Katas."
"H-Head Maid..."

Grumbling in annoyance, the chestnut-haired Jumakenki sits up straight at the round table. Just like usual, she is sure the Head Maid has come to fix her posture and tidy up her appearance.

"...Still, since we're on break now, we can talk about private things. I was entrusted by my master aboard the Eternal to ask you if have you have anything troubling you lately."
"Huh?"
"The way you're fretting now reminds me of a few years ago, when you were stuck at home and could only occasionally read the comic books I brought over. You may no longer be my master, but I still keep those days in mind. Besides, as the Head Maid here, it's only right I look after the maids' physical and mental state."
"Y-You still remember that... I guess it hasn't been all that long. Ahem! It's nothing really! My family sent another letter. But I don't want to open it. It's definitely just another hassle urging me to go back. Even though they promised long ago they wouldn't send anyone to fetch me again... Come to think of it, does the Lord of Black Iron worry about me? What did the Lord of Black Iron say..."
"Are you scared?"

The Jumakenki falls quiet. The Head Maid also lapses into a short silence, then brews her a cup of tea from Mundus Garden.

"Please try to ease your mind a little. Whether as your Head Maid or your friend, I believe you are fully able to deal with your family affairs now. If you're worried about lacking help... Then allow me — Olivien, a professional maid and one of the Empire's mediators on the surface — to serve you with all my dedication."
des.“救世主~大人~”\r“救世主大人？哈哈哈哈谁这么叫你的啊！”\r“听说你从列车:
"Master~ Savior~"
"Master Savior? Hahahaha! Who's calling you that?"
"I heard you've been promoted! You're now the... Master Savior, right?"

As Ushana boarded the Eternal, teasings from the rest of the guard crew, passengers, and even work partners started filling the carriages, for the way she addressed Conductor was seriously too unique and memorable. In no time, the title "Master Savior" spread wide and far among the people familiar with Conductor. Most people typically stopped teasing after doing so a couple of times, but a small minority kept asking about how the title came to be. Alas, none ever really got a definite answer.

Apart from that, Ushana managed to adapt to the Eternal relatively well. There isn't a lack of young and immature children here, and it's also home to some oddballs who used to fret over their own abilities. Although "Angels" like her are fairly rare, she does share some similarities with plenty of the rest and has found some friends she could talk to, despite her generally not being on the same wavelength with others in conversation. That's probably as good as it can get.
des.《雷比斯给乌刹娜监护人的综合小贴士手册》条目摘录：\r……\rSOAP系统：\r:
Excerpt from "Rebis's Tips for Ushana's Guardian":

...
SOAP System:
The full name is a pain to write, and I don't remember it anymore, so I won't go into it here. Anyway, it's a consonance system that can keep Ushana calm. It works similarly to noise reduction devices, playing a kind of noise to drown out another. Gah, it's a hassle to put in plain words. Just figure it out yourself.
By the way, make sure to play soap-cutting audios when she's in a bad mood~

...
"Myriarms":
Basically those extra arms of hers. Do not remove them, or her two hands will fight each other. No one else knows how to use them anyway. Unless she breaks them herself, do not remove them! Just like buggy code, if it works fine, don't touch it. Got it?

...
"Realmbreaker":
I won't tell you about this. You'll find out about it when you have the chance. Once you learn its story, you will then truly be responsible for her destiny... When that time comes, I wonder what kind of choices you'll make and how you'll view this girl.
des.“迦梨”。以战斗和杀戮为滋养，传说中诞生于纯然愤怒的存在。她的每一只手都持有一把:
"Kali" - An existence rumored to have been born from pure rage and who feeds on battling and massacres. Every hand of hers wields a sword and clutches her enemies' heads. When she sees red, everything will be destroyed and devoured. Her dance tramples the earth and rattles all that lives; even other gods will be squashed under her feet.

Even after Ushana's transformation process ended and caused casualties nearby Haima Zaria, the Ascension still believes that the experiment was not a failure. After all, the test subject has obtained immense power as we anticipated, making her deserving of the name "Kali." In fact, that will be her new name from now on; Ushana has already ceased to exist. It'll be okay for her to work alongside Destroyer members. After all, it'll be a waste not to use such an excellent weapon in saving humanity.

Her own consciousness should've already been overwritten by "Kali's." Even if her old memory returns, it most likely won't stand a chance against "Kali." After all, there's no way a little girl's consciousness can possibly be stronger than the forces extracted from Unbewusstes.

Variables still exist, but she can never continue living as anything else besides a sharpened blade.

—Notes of an Ascension researcher from years ago, unsealed
des.乌刹娜做了一个梦。一个很长、很长的梦！\r梦里什么都有。有乌刹娜照顾的小小小小的:
Ushana had a dream. A very, very long one.

There were all sorts of things in it, like the tiny flowers she cared for, extremely tall mountains, clouds that shroud the mountaintops like a giant blanket... and also Master Savior!

Ushana and Master Savior travelled everywhere hand in hand, climbed to the peak of the mountain to watch the sky on a huge leaf. They went to the boundless lake that was so, so blue, just like... like Cape City's sea in the past! The fish in it carried Ushana and Master Savior to the clouds. With the big, snow white blanket covering them, they fell asleep on this soft, fluffy bed...

However, when Ushana was about to fall asleep, she suddenly recalled someone's words. Who was it... She no longer remembered. Perhaps it was said by a lot of people. Those voices said her dream was wrong, she was broken... Those voices said she had done bad things, she was evil, so she didn't deserve to be this happy. Ushana was sad, so she wanted to chop them up, but no matter how she tried, she couldn't put a stop to all the voices!

When she was exhausted, a click sounded! Master Savior appeared from a slit that Ushana had slashed open and smiled at her, just like when she was little, like lots and lots of times when she wanted to cry and couldn't win!

...
"Oh~ And then?"
"And then, Ushana woke up! When she woke up, Master Savior was right next to her and even holding her hand... She knew she'd never have to be afraid again, because she's already found Master Savior~"
des.虽然已经被判定为失败天使个体，但罗洁尔的情况在大部分时候算得上相当稳定。和情绪波:
Even though she has already been determined to be a failed Angel entity, Raziel's situation is considered relatively stable for the most part. Unlike Ushana, who has greater mood swings and who acts much more energetically and dangerous, Raziel doesn't usually carry a weapon, nor is she aggressive toward regular people.

If you were to overlook her appearance, there would probably only be something marginally off as you converse with her. The way she acts is virtually identical to the "original Raziel" sometimes. All in all, although this body's "memory" has disappeared, its "habits" and "feelings" have been retained somehow.

This disparity made many people who knew the old Raziel feel utterly unaccustomed. Among them, some began regarding Raziel as an entirely new individual, while some opted to temporarily avoid meeting this thoroughly different Raziel.

After all those things that transpired in Haima Zaria, the conflict between Ushana and Raziel was pretty much concluded. However, this has left people wondering, how exactly should these so-called failed Angel entities be treated? Should the lives they used to have be returned to their new self?
des.罗洁尔的升构能力在本质上没有发生太大变化，但它的表现形式却几乎完全逆转了。过去身:
Raziel's Ascension Ability didn't change too much in nature, but the way it manifested has practically reversed entirely. In the past, she, as a Citadel mentor, maintained a conservative and cautious attitude toward Ascension Abilities. "Mind Walk," which was used to analyze one's thoughts and feelings, was hardly ever utilized by her even though it could make a simple conversation smoother. Now, however, as an Angel, Raziel would unhesitatingly turn endless thoughts and feelings into torrents and use them on the battlefield. Due to that, she would appear especially frenetic during combat as all sorts of thoughts and feelings engulf her.

After Raziel processed and obtained sufficient data and embodied thoughts — commonly known as "crystallization" — from Unbewusstes, her mental state stabilized, and part of her appearance was also returning to its former humanly state. But as of now, the odds of her body completely returning to normal are exceedingly low, much less her psyche and memory.

In any case, she has changed, but she's also growing and recovering bit by bit, slowly learning the knowledge of this world and becoming a new "person." Who could possibly criticize a child like her?
des.丽桑德拉、达斯廷以及她的其他旧识，为罗洁尔的恢复和再适应过程提供了不少帮助。这些:
Lissandra, Dustin, and other old acquaintances of Raziel have provided substantial assistance in her recovery and readaptation. They all behave with extreme caution toward Raziel, particularly Lissandra, who keeps avoiding meeting this former friend of hers in person. Lissandra might not have ever verbalized it, but her behavior makes it adequately clear: She believes the current Raziel is an entirely different entity and therefore has no need to inherit Raziel's previous life and relationships.

However, Raziel herself has a different perspective. As her understanding of the surrounding world deepened, she started having a myriad of questions and also began wondering about her past. "What was life like for Raziel?" "What kind of person was she?" These questions aren't easy for others to answer. Hence, she has chosen to seek them herself in daily life and in every matter that's relevant to the past.

Her search will never end. Just like any child that is born in the world, she is presently walking her own path that nobody can do in her stead. That said, as friends and companions, the Eternal crew can provide her with appropriate guidance and company. I implore you all to do so, and I believe you will.
— One of Lissandra's letters, archived
des.“我过来送一些书就走。虽然只是依据我个人的喜好挑选的，但她应该……你们也可以阅览:
"I am simply here to deliver some books. Although I picked them based on my preferences, she should probably... You all can read them too. For Raziel, these books should be perfect for her need to relearn the world."
"Got it. But won't you say something to her?"
"No need."
"All right. We will pass them to her. Please rest assured, Miss Lissandra."

Right as Livia accepts the few books Lissandra hands over, the carriage door behind them opens. The executor in red turns around and happens to come face to face with Raziel, who's entering the carriage.

In her quest to relearn herself and the world, Raziel finally made it here. She has chosen to personally meet this person who has given her lots of gifts, this friend of the old Raziel, albeit to her, they have never met until now.

"Hello. ...Are you Lissandra?"
"Yes."
"Were we friends?"
"...Yes."
"Then can we be friends again?"
"Of course. But that is entirely up to you. Should you not want to—"
"I want to get to know you and many, many others." Raziel flashes a genuine smile. "It's a pleasure to meet you, Lissandra."

Once again, the new Raziel extends her hand toward "her" old friend and her brand new life.
des.澄明数据中心铁安局的新负责人究竟是何许人物？为什么能在经历急剧变化的铁路环线上占:
Who exactly is the new head of the BCRL Agency at the CDCA Bureau? How did he secure such an important standing amid the drastic changes sweeping the Railway Loop?
The frequent demi-human conflicts of recent years seem to be easing, and each Bonfire Cities has begun accepting an increasing number of demi-human residents. Meanwhile, the total number of demi-human tribes wandering the wilderness has dropped sharply. Yet does this truly mean the cities are fully prepared to embrace these special outsiders? To look into this matter, our reporter interviewed Moore, the administrator of the CDCA Bureau. In the interview, this enigmatic figure revealed plenty of information about Lycagia, the new chief of the BCRL Agency. We now bring you the exclusive details...

— Excerpted from "Bonfire Dwellers," Issue XX

"...What's this? I've never seen it before! Gossiping about me? ...I did hear my colleagues mention something about it. But I'd just taken over as the chief back then, swamped with work and no time to care at all... It's fine, all water under the bridge anyway. Wanna go for a ride today?"
des.莱卡吉亚是较早在铁安局获得一定地位的亚人之一。虽然澄明数据中心在铁路环线上的地位:
Lycagia is among the earliest demi-humans to gain a solid standing within the BCRL Agency. Though the CDCA Bureau holds a special position across the Railway Loop, taking charge of the BCRL Agency here still bears immense responsibility. In the years since taking office, Lycagia has lived up to expectations as a dedicated chief, earning the trust of both citizens and the administrative authority of the Bonfire City.

Yet when he first assumed the post, the cities were far less accepting of demi-humans than they are today. Lycagia's straightforward career background was dug up by interested parties and the press, laid bare for all to see: he completed the BCRL soldier training with outstanding results, then took part in countless perilous missions. Each time he returned unscathed alongside his comrades, earning numerous merits and even official commendations from the BCRL HQ. Judging solely by this record, his appointment as the chief seemed perfectly reasonable... But what about his past before all that?

Records of his birthplace and early life have been sealed by official approval of the BCRL. Though insiders claim his identity and integrity are vouched for by Chief Heinrich, Lycagia still faced far more doubts than ordinary people would.

Beneath such immense pressure, however, his way of conduct remained largely unchanged. During his tenure as chief, his optimistic and forthright nature won him the trust of colleagues and townsfolk alike. He even jokingly became the prototype for several urban legends — though that is a story for another time.
des.莱卡吉亚的身份和来历在铁盟内部已有定论，但也充斥着解不开的谜团。多年前，篝火城近:
Lycagia's identity and background have reached an official verdict within the BCRL, yet they are still riddled with unsolved mysteries. Years ago, when security conditions in the outskirts of the Bonfire City were poor, countless demi-human gangs of varying sizes were active along the Railway Loop. Among them was a powerful wolf demi-human tribe. Judging by bloodline origins, tribal structure and migration trails, Lycagia is undoubtedly a member of this tribe.

This wolf demi-human tribe once had several minor skirmishes with a BCRL Agency squad. According to BCRL archives, the conflict was stopped by a wolf demi-human affiliated with the tribe. Records show the squad formed a cooperative bond with this wolf demi-human named Lycaon, and later signed a peace agreement with the demi-human tribe as a whole. The name Lycaon appeared many times in subsequent mission reports: he helped the BCRL squad familiarize themselves with the surrounding wilderness, and even took direct part in riot control operations.

Everything changed with a severe accidental outbreak of Morphic Pollution. The squad was ordered to leave the city and intercept a massive Chaos Remain, only to be completely annihilated in the end — not a single member made it back. Shortly after the Morphic Pollution in the region subsided, a search team found only one wolf demi-human wandering in the middle of the wilderness, having lost most of his memories. He called himself Lycagia, and bore a special BCRL medal — the cherished honor medal of the fallen captain of the squad.

Researchers of the BCRL determined that Lycagia was also a victim entangled in the catastrophe, and that his former identity was none other than Lycaon recorded in the reports. Yet the core puzzle remains: what really happened during that disaster? Why would a wolf demi-human from a wild tribe carry the medal of a heroic soldier who perished on duty?

Hence, even though he has joined and served the BCRL Agency for many years, a central debate still lingers around Lycagia: can humans truly trust and embrace demi-humans?
des.“恭喜你通过了铁安局的入局考核。但介于你的特殊身份，我代表铁盟，最后来向你确认一:
"Congratulations on passing the BCRL Agency entry assessment. Given your special status, I'm here on behalf of the BCRL to confirm a few final matters with you. Relax, and answer me honestly."
"Yes, Sir!"
"The BCRL has finished its on-site investigation. We haven't found the squad you care about. In other words, with no bodies recovered, suspicion that you killed them cannot be ruled out — yet neither can you be formally charged. Still, under the regulations of the Bonfire City, you could obtain citizenship here even without joining the agency."
"But I want to join you."
"Why?"
"My memories are indeed incomplete... but I still remember every member of that squad I once traveled with. They all believed their work was meant to build a better world... and I believe in that ideal too. I also refuse to let down this medal they left with me."
"This means you must abandon your old life entirely. From this day onward, you can never return to the demi-human tribe that stands opposed to the Bonfire City."
"All memories tied to them are nothing but sorrowful ones. I made up my mind long ago when I abandoned my original name."
"I understand. I shall relay your resolve to my superiors exactly as you've spoken it. ...I also have a word of personal advice."
"Yes, Sir. Please go ahead."
"I knew the members of that squad. I watched them lay down their lives chasing what they believed in. One day, you will face a question — what is it that you truly wish to pursue? No need to answer right away. I hope you find the answer along the path ahead of you."
"Good luck, Private Lycagia."
des.来自岚心城的遗失货物，里面可能装有一种或几种岚心城对外贸易的交易品。: Lost cargo from Ranshin City, which may contain one or more of the goods traded by Ranshin City.
des.涟的升构能力“恶意视界”，是能够看见他人负面情绪、并将其化为实体进行攻击的能力。:
Ren's Ascension Ability, "Malice Vision," allows her to see others' negative emotions and materialize them for attack. This means that the denser the crowd and the more mixed the emotions, the stronger Ren's ability becomes. However, before boarding the Eternal, Ren first sent a request "hoping for a small area where she could be alone," indicating that she does not wish for her ability to manifest everywhere at all times.

This concern is understandable, as Ren's Ascension Ability awakened when she was very young, accompanied by changes in the appearance of her eyes. Throughout her upbringing, her family sought medical help in vain, trying to resolve the various issues she faced. Ultimately, she chose to leave her family and join the Night Chains on her own.

This background shaped the personality she exhibits today — excessively cautious, seemingly always fearful of losing control and being disliked by others. During her adolescence, unable to cope with the emotional pressures from the outside world, Ren opted to take a break from school and stay home, facing it all alone.
des.休学期间的涟几乎终日闭门不出，独自靠听音乐和发呆打发时间。这样的日子过了很久，她:
During her leave of absence, Ren almost never left her room, spending time alone by listening to music and daydreaming. This went on for a long time, during which she was tormented by her inability to live normally like her peers; most frighteningly, her Ascension Ability made her aware that in the hearts of her parents, who seemed to care for her deeply, impatience and struggle were also growing like thorns.

The day she realized this, Ren painfully fled from home. Without a clear destination, just thinking anywhere would be fine, Ren somehow got caught up in an opening performance at a shopping mall in the bustling district of Shoggolith City. A magician was putting on a magnificent and grand show on stage, while the audience below cheered and laughed; but even in this lively scene, Ren could not ignore the thorns piercing her view—

When she regained consciousness, the crowd had already screamed and scattered, and the surrounding BCRL Agency troops were shining flashlights this way. The atrium of the mall was in complete disarray, with only Ren, who had caused all this destruction, at its center. She didn't know when her emotions had gotten out of control, nor did she understand why she had done such a terrible thing.

The magician on stage a moment ago appeared in front of Ren and extended an invitation to her.
"It's unfortunate. You do know there's no place for you here, right? If you come with us, at least you will find people who truly understand you..."
des.应那位魔术师，也就是歌德的邀请加入黑月后，涟从前感到疑惑和困扰的很多事得到了解答:
After joining Night Chains at the invitation of that magician, Goethe, many things that once confused and troubled Ren found answers. For instance, the sound similar to tinnitus that had disturbed her since childhood turned out to be a kind of "noise" that most members of Night Chains could hear. It was not frightening; it was just that no one had ever explained it to Ren before. Similarly, her Ascension Ability and the various incidents it caused could actually find corresponding solutions under reasonable conditions, rather than repeatedly destroying her life as in the past.

More importantly, Ren found new friends. Lin, who is also an executor, has a personality similar to hers, and they would often discuss new clothes and accessories they saw in magazines and occasionally go shopping together. Maruha, on the other hand, seemed more like an experienced senior in the role of executor, jokingly nicknaming Ren's Weapon "Highway Destroyer" and often scaring her with some half-true jokes.

Life seems impeccable at present, but there remains a question in Ren's heart that has yet to be answered: Even after encountering so many wonderful things, does she still have to endure the pain of seeing thorns?

This question was eventually answered on a sunny day.
des.“黑月执行人这个名号听起来或许稍显可怖，但‘公路毁灭者’这个名字有没有让您倍感好:
"The title 'Night Chains Executor' may sound a bit intimidating, but doesn't the name 'Highway Destroyer' pique your curiosity? Next up is 'Into the Tales'! Today, in the bustling area of Shoggolith City, we suspect we have found traces of him!"

"Cameras, zoom in on the road below—now it's blocked off. Earlier, an out-of-control mob appeared on this road, but now the mob has been taken down! Judging by the surrounding destruction and impact marks, there's no doubt that the 'Highway Destroyer' stepped in to subdue him. We will now look around for possible eyewitnesses for interviews! This young lady—"

The camera turns to a girl in a black dress with purple hair, who seems startled in front of the lens.

"Miss, did you see the scene where the Highway Destroyer punished the villain?"
"Uh, ah? No, I didn't... I was just passing by, going to buy something... can I..."
"But you're right here, judging from the direction you came from, you even passed by the scene!"
"No..."
"Please tell us a bit about what happened!"
"...Well, then... the Highway Destroyer did well... resolved it quickly...I guess?"
"Exactly! Thank you for your testimony!"
As the host excitedly turns back to the camera to start explaining, the girl quietly sneaks away.

"I saw you on TV today, Ren. Were you compromised?"
"I don't think so... probably..."
"But I thought you were not the kind to meddle in others' business. Ah, unless that person was too annoying at the time!"
"...It's not like I lost control... After spending a lot of time with the Conductor, I've become... much calmer. Not likely to lose control anymore."
"Eh, so this time... was it intentional?"

Under Maruha's surprised yet teasing gaze, Ren seems embarrassed as she takes out two boxes of tapes.
"Because I wanted to go to the store to buy this. They're for the Conductor... but that person was blocking the door... so I just, kind of... um..."
des.在看到《魔女奇旅》宣传图的第一眼，马吉拉就开始做缝制cos服的准备。出于对“魔女:
At the first glance of the poster of "Witch's Odyssey," Margiela began preparing to sew a cosplay costume. Due to her fondness for the image of a "witch," she believed she would definitely love this movie.

After watching the movie in the cinema several times, she studied the protagonist's costume design carefully. As an experienced cosplayer, crafting a highly accurate replica was never a hard task for her. Still, Margiela often fell into deep thought mid-sewing, slowing down her progress greatly.

She poured her whole heart into making the clothes and felt a strong bond with the character. What touched her most was the plot where the protagonist gave up all her achievements at the magic academy after going through countless hardships, and walked her own unique path as a witch alongside her friends. This scene kept echoing in her mind.

She realized simple imitation was far from enough. She yearned to become a genuine witch, brave enough to face her true feelings and embrace every side of herself. After wandering far from home for years, this once fading aspiration became clear and firm again.

Though she had no idea where to begin, she decided to start with the costume in her hands, the thing she loved the most. With this resolve, she revised her drafts repeatedly and picked out fabrics carefully. Finally, an exclusive outfit that belonged solely to Margiela the Witch was finished. Everyone who saw it praised her: "It fits you so well, as if you were born to wear it."
des.在黑月游乐城的占卜屋内扮演为大家指点迷津的占卜魔女时，马吉拉不需要用到任何升构能:
While working as a fortune-telling witch offering guidance in the divination house of Night Chains Land, Margiela never needs to wield her Ascension Ability. That power serves no purpose within this little dreamlike haven. She merely listens to people's troubles and perplexities, and offers uplifting replies based on her own observation and judgment.

"Isn't it wonderful? Everyone leaves feeling lighter, smiles returning to their eyes... No Ascension Abilities could ever do this!" Magira's voice brims with uncontained delight as she speaks. "I cannot truly solve all their troubles, yet in this fleeting moment, I've sown seeds of magic in their hearts. Someday, they will surely take root and bloom."

Magira waves her magic wand. Under her deft control, her immense power condenses into a dazzling star at the wand's tip, brightening her glowing face and the person before her.

"This is incredibly powerful magic, isn't it? But..."
The witch tilts her head and flashes a mischievous grin.
"You're far better at casting this spell, Dear Conductor! I've already fallen under its charm, and there's no way to break free... You will take full responsibility for me, won't you?"
des.“这里就是马吉拉的店吗？好厉害啊！”\r马吉拉招待真咲来到自己的cosplay服:
"So this is Margiela's shop? It's amazing!"
After Margiela invited Masaki over to her cosplay costume store, Masaki couldn't help but exclaim in awe.

"I can handle my abilities much more freely now, and I'm able to make custom adjustments for others too." Margiela said as she showed Masaki what she could do. "This way, when people put on the outfits, they truly feel like they've become the character, instead of just wearing clothes that look the same."

"You're truly outstanding, Margiela."
No longer do they share that profound sense of merging into one being, yet the intimate rapport between these two kindred souls still remains. Margiela knew Masaki meant every word, not just empty courtesy.
She broke into a gentle smile.
"And you're truly adorable, Masaki."
"Huh? B-but... I mean... I'm indeed younger than you, but we're not talking about the same thing..."

Seeing her flustered look, Margiela laughed heartily, and the embarrassed Masaki soon smiled along with her. Their reflections in the shop window looked just like real sisters. Perhaps this was exactly the warm sight that lonely witch had always yearned for.
des.了解了一切的来龙去脉后，马吉拉曾经想过要不要回家看望自己的父母。\r她想要告诉他:
After learning the whole story, Margiela once thought about going home to visit her parents.
She wanted to tell them that she was living a happy life now. Most of all, she hoped to let her mother know that witches were nothing to be feared.

Thinking back to how her mother could only secretly use Ascension Ability to ease her burdens when no one was around, Margiela believed her youthful mother must have longed for someone to tell her that life need not be lived in constant dread, and that no vicious witch would lay curses upon others.

Yet she knew full well that the fear of witches had long taken deep root in her family's minds. If she, now a witch, showed up out of the blue, things would surely end badly.

Thus Margiela chose to bring joy to everyone in her identity as a witch, by working as a fortune-teller at Night Chains Land, crafting dream-weaving costumes at Pupil's Fashion, and eliminating hidden dangers within Bonfire Cities as a Night Chains executor.

She held a firm hope. Someday, just as the surface world was influenced by Imperial witch culture, the beloved image of witches from the surface would spread back to the Empire, gradually fading away all prejudices against them.

People would no longer regard all witches as evil beings, and her family would no longer live in fear of illusory terrors.

By then, the ideal world once longed for by the ordinary girl named Betty would surely come true.
des.多方组织联合出品的装备箱，其中封存着一件SSR品级的战斗装备。由于是多方联合，最: The equipment box, jointly produced by multiple organizations, contains an SSR-grade piece of combat gear. Since it is a collaboration between multiple parties, the specific faction's gear obtained can only be known upon opening, hence it is called Fate Box.
des.黑月游乐城的儿童诱拐事件结束后不久，真咲便与黑月签订了兼职生工作的合约。很快，她:
Shortly after the abduction incident at the Night Chains Land came to a close, Masaki signed a part-time employment contract with Night Chains. Not long afterward, she arrived aboard the Eternal alongside Margiela, where she introduced herself to everyone as a newly joined crew member.

"My name is Masaki. Whether you knew me before or not, I hope you'll all... address me by this name. What's more, I am a 'witch', and also a part-timer for Night Chains..."

Her cheeks flushed pink after finishing such a lengthy self-introduction, Masaki smiled bashfully to herself. Margiela, who had been listening at her side with her chin resting on one hand, patted her shoulder and smiled as she led everyone in a round of applause — a small welcome ceremony for the "Witch."

For Masaki herself, nothing could have brought her greater joy. Everyone was willing to accept her for all that she was: Masaki the girl, the part-time working student, and the Witch. Though the mystery of her identity that had troubled her for years had already been unraveled, the warm welcome she received aboard the Eternal undoubtedly gently brushed away the faint remaining shadows that had lingered over it.
des.真咲是个家庭幸福、生活圆满的孩子，在这样的成长环境中，她也理所应当地成为了一个既:
Masaki grew up in a warm, happy family and lived a fulfilling life, and it was only natural that such an upbringing shaped her into a brave and courteous young person. At the same time, her past as the "Witch" has granted her far richer knowledge and life experience than her peers. Yet sometimes, these fine qualities can also become a source of awkwardness —

"Miss Margiela..."
"There you go again with that weird formal way of addressing me?"
"Ah— no, I mean, M-Margiela!"

On top of that, Masaki is an extremely well-liked girl aboard the Eternal. Her sensible, thoughtful nature leads many crew members to treat her as a younger sister and a junior. When they learned she was the fearsome "Witch" they had heard of, most could scarcely believe it. Having a witch under their care felt like a rather novel and precious experience.

"So, which age are you really right now? Your student age, or the age of that centuries-old witch?"
"W-well... let's just say both apply..."
des.早在年纪尚幼时，真咲便通过各种美食类的电视节目对烹饪产生了兴趣。不过，真咲的父母:
From a very young age, Masaki developed an interest in cooking through various food-themed TV programs. At first, her parents worried it was unsafe for a child so young to handle kitchen utensils, so they strictly restricted her from accessing open flames, kitchen knives and other dangerous items in the kitchen. Undiscouraged by this limitation, Masaki explored all kinds of play cooking sets with great enthusiasm, and found plenty of joy chopping plastic toy carrots.

The real problem arose on the very first day her parents permitted her to enter the kitchen. Her mom and dad accompanied her to the supermarket to buy her favorite vegetables and meat, then taught her how to use a kitchen knife. But the moment her mother stood by her side and turned on the stove flame, an inexplicable surge of resistance completely took hold of Masaki. She screamed and jumped back from the stove, and even her parents' reassurance failed to calm her down... It was a long time before she gradually regained her composure. After this incident, her parents were no longer willing to let Masaki near open flames casually. And for a long time afterward, Masaki's nightmares recurred frequently: she would dream of the Witch's cottage burning down, and the villages she passed through reduced to scorched earth...

Fortunately, modern society always offers multiple solutions to any given problem. After a while, her parents introduced Masaki to a cooking appliance that works without any open flame — the induction cooker!

Now, as Masaki prepares lunch bentos for herself and the Conductor aboard the Eternal, she has grown into a remarkably capable little chef. Sometimes, she even shares her cooking tips and thoughts with other crew members.
des.出生在普通又幸福的家庭中的真咲，是一个值得旁人艳羡的孩子。\r出生在■■而■■的:
Born into an ordinary yet happy family, Masaki was an enviable child.
Born into a ███ yet ███ world, Betty was a ███████ child.

From the very first day she discovered her Ascension Ability, Masaki pondered endlessly: Why had any of this come to pass? Could she use this power to help more people? And why was she bestowed with such an ability in the first place?
From the very first day she was reviled for her immense magic power, Betty lived in constant terror: Why had any of this come to pass? Why must she suffer harm for the magic within her? And why was she cursed with this power?

— Centuries slipped by after that.

Betty woke from her dreams to find she had become Masaki. Unlike her past self, Masaki grew up in a peaceful city, had a loving family to rely on, and never had to scrape by or fight for survival. A soft little bed sat in her room, hot soup cooked by her father waited on the dining table, her mother would iron her new dresses, and photo booth stickers from shopping trips with friends were stuck to the corner of her desk.

It hardly seemed like a bad thing, to live a happy life in this world forever... Yet nightmares still came for her every night. The memories of being "Betty" hounded her ceaselessly, like ghosts of hatred from a bygone past. As Masaki grew older, every year that passed drew her nearer to that desperate, fated end...

Before that end could befall her, one witch crossed paths with another. And then, they reached out to each other.

This is the story of how Betty the Witch gained her liberation. It is also the story of how Masaki came to accept her very first friend — and the final, truest version of herself.
des.“各位旅客请注意： 如您听到突发的剧烈空爆声或类似雷鸣的巨响，请保持冷静。 此现:
"Attention, passengers: If you hear a sudden sonic boom or thunder-like blast, please remain calm. The noise is caused by Chloe, Vanguard of the Citadel, accelerating during mission operations. For the safety of both the train and its passengers, please close all windows immediately and secure your personal belongings. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation."

This newly added announcement is the Eternal's latest solution for dealing with its rather unconventional guest.

Chloe commands a wide range of ultra-high-speed flight techniques, yet regardless of the method she employs, the shockwaves produced during acceleration are simply unavoidable. For that reason, the Citadel strictly forbids her from flying at such speeds outside of active missions.

As one of the Citadel's primary long-term observation posts, the Eternal is tasked with continuously monitoring the Conductor, the Angels, and various contained anomalies, while submitting detailed reports on a regular basis. Chloe, however, quickly realized there was a loophole she could exploit. Soon, she began making frequent trips between Senanonic and the Eternal under the convenient excuse of "collecting reports." Before long, the crew even cleared out an entire cabin and hung up a sign reading Report Collection Office just for her.

"Don't forget to have tomorrow's report ready."
That was the only thing Chloe ever asked of the Eternal.
des.克洛伊的右眼始终佩戴着学会为她特制的眼罩“叶”，这是隔绝意识海的屏障，以防他人窥:
Chloe always wears a custom-made eyepatch over her right eye, a device crafted by the Citadel known as "Leaf." It serves as a barrier that seals off the Unbewusstes, preventing others from glimpsing its depths and descending into madness. Though she often delights in terrifying anyone curious enough to ask about it, she has never once removed it before another person.

That hidden eye is both her gateway to the Unbewusstes and the source of her power as an Angel. Katas once remarked that the eyepatch made her seem mysterious and overwhelming, dubbing it the "Unseeable Evil Eye." The name caught on, and before long, everyone was calling it the same.

The phrase unseeable carries another meaning as well. It is not only that no one should look into the eye—it is that Chloe herself can no longer truly look upon humanity. Bound to the Unbewusstes, the eye has left her with severe perceptual impairment. To her, most people appear as indistinguishable masses of chaos, their individual forms dissolved beyond recognition. Only a rare few can still be perceived as they truly are.

After an agonizingly long period of adaptation, Chloe eventually learned to identify people through fragments of incomplete information. Yet the process is itself an act of reduction: lives stripped down into symbols, transformed into data that can be classified and processed. In adapting to the eye, she gradually lost any genuine sense of human individuality.
des.在多次往返无垠号和塞纳诺尼克后，克洛伊觉得是时候在列车上占据一个属于自己的角落了:
After making countless trips between the Eternal and Senanonic, Chloe decides it's about time she claims a corner of the train for herself. She sets her sights on a forgotten storage compartment at the very rear of the train, empties it without so much as asking, and stuffs it with her own belongings.

A cushion. A projector. A shelf crammed with cheap, low-budget film reels. That is the entirety of Chloe's room. The flickering light cast across the wall by the projector is the only illumination the compartment ever knows.

Chloe neither eats nor sleeps. Between assignments, she can spend entire days inside this tiny room—sometimes sitting cross-legged on the cushion, sometimes simply drifting in midair—expressionless as one film gives way to the next. She can remain like this for days at a time. Curiously, these are also the rare moments when she is at her quietest.

Grand productions and critically acclaimed masterpieces hold little appeal for her. Instead, Chloe has a particular fondness for cheap B movies. Her own life is, after all, a cruel black comedy. Art films striving for profound beauty, or prestige dramas celebrating lofty ideals, strike her as unbearably dull. The shameless absurdity of low-budget cinema, by contrast, reflects the world with far greater honesty. Rather than watching someone labor to present a carefully crafted "deeper meaning," she'd much rather enjoy the glorious chaos of a truly terrible film.

"Seriously, what's with all the yappin'? It's just a B movie. Ya gonna turn this into a thesis or what? Never seen ya work this hard on your reports."
— Chloe (Recorded at her own insistence. The original wording has been suitably sanitized.)
des.通道洞开的刹那，骰数空间陷入了死寂。她的意识被精确的从血肉中剥离，世界在她的感官:
The moment the passage opened, Haima Zaria fell into absolute silence. Her consciousness was cleanly severed from flesh and bone. The world bled of all color, dissolving into nothingness as dim beacons pierced her awareness, pulling her downward... deeper... ever deeper.

At first, there was only silence. Then came a resonance beyond sound itself, an indescribable hum that echoed directly within the depths of consciousness. Vast. Ancient. Indifferent. It did not observe, because it was observation itself. It did not think, because it was thought itself.

The darkness began to writhe.

The first fragments of information flooded her mind.

This is "humanity"—not individuals, nor civilization, but the ultimate convergence of every consciousness, past, present, and future, woven together beyond time itself.

It held neither malice nor mercy. Only an irresistible instinct, as inevitable as the pull of a black hole: assimilation.

It reached for her, seeking to dissolve the boundaries of her consciousness, to free her from the very notion of self, so that she, too, might become part of this chaotic sea. She would inherit every fragment of knowledge, every emotion, every memory, every history. And in return, she would lose herself.

At the deepest reaches of her soul, all her hatred and rejection of humanity erupted into a bolt of pure negation, tearing open a single crack within the chaos—a place that belonged only to "I."

"No!"

The word cut through the abyss with absolute conviction. For an instant, she was back upon that perilous wilderness once more, running as she always had, a tiny spark of lightning dancing in the palm of her hand.

Faster. Farther. At last, she escaped.

She was no longer a part of the sea, but a solitary observer standing forever at the edge of the abyss, gazing into its depths. She had witnessed the whole of reality, and in doing so, had forever lost the way home.
—Adapted from the fantasy novel "***** in Wonderland".

"Holy s***! I f****** wrote this! You goddamn plagiarizin' bastard, pay me my f****** royalties!"
—The remarks of a certain unnamed Angel.
des.大多帝国人在初次来到地表时，都会对地表的文化、社会以及日常生活方式感到极大的惊奇:
Most people from the Empire, when they first set foot on the surface, feel a great deal of astonishment and discomfort at its culture, society, and everyday way of life — and Ikara is no exception.

She arrived at your side as though descended from the heavens, appearing out of nowhere and slipping away again just as gracefully. She spent an unforgettable stretch of time with you at Freeport VII, and fought alongside you through the crisis at the Apoaster Bridge — going only by these memories, she seems like a girl wrapped in miracle. Yet back in the everyday routine of life aboard the Eternal, she still lacks no small amount of common sense.

She'll toss priceless clothes into the washing machine without sorting light from dark, or, unable to work out how to light the stove in the dining car, simply heat her food with her own flame — beautiful, but far too hot. Once caught doing this, she usually just tilts her chin up with pride and insists this was never something she was supposed to know. "If you're so willing, you could always come teach me yourself, senior?"

You don't mind teaching her how to manage daily life yourself. The trouble is, every time you find yourself indulging her cute, pampered, perfectly harmless little demands, you can't help but wonder — was she once some kind of princess, used to giving out instructions just like this?
des.“……所以特意来找我就是为了谈我们第一次见面时的事啊……有点意外呢，前辈。”\r:
"...So you came looking for me specifically to talk about the time we first met... That's a bit surprising, senior."

Contrary to your expectations, when you go to Ikara and tell her you intend to rewrite a report on your first encounter for the archives, she doesn't put up much resistance — she simply accepts it, quite calmly.

Your "first meeting" took place some time before you two crossed paths again at Freeport VII. Ikara — a child of dragon, addressed as "Draconis" — descended from the sky together with her sister, and showed you the power hidden within them. A mere touch of her fingertip was enough to grant even a mortal a brief taste of magic-like strength — and it was at that same meeting that she revealed her draconic side, even calling you "My Demon Lord." The meaning behind that title, the true extent of Ikara's power, and the reason for their appearance there all remain unclear, and looking into any of it is bound to be difficult. But judging by how Ikara carries herself and speaks now, she clearly sees nothing wrong with her current life.

"And I recall you're not exactly good at writing reports, senior. If you need help from your junior here... go ahead and say so — I suppose I could consider lending a hand."

At the end of the conversation, the girl with the power of dragons says this to you with a smile. Surprisingly mischievous, isn't she.
des.在七号自由港的一系列事件结束后，伊卡菈暂时进入了无事可做的状态。理论上她应该进入:
After the string of events at Freeport VII come to a close, Ikara finds herself with nothing much to do for the time being. In theory she should be starting classes at the academy the Verdant Realm Project has arranged for her, but with so many aspects of the project yet to move forward, this "holiday" of hers stretches on indefinitely — until she actually enrolls, she may well end up staying aboard the Eternal, by your side.

As she grows more familiar with you, she begins sharing pieces of her past. These are different from what's recorded in "Journey with the Demon Lord" — that book documenting you and the Draconis — these are more personal, and far more fragmented memories. She has no intention of telling you everything at once, but neither does she mean to hide anything from you. If you had to put it into words, her story is like a book of poetry meant to be leafed through gently, read aloud in murmurs — the lines still carry traces of dragon's blood and pain, and yet remain beautiful all the same.

The memory of once being treated as the "Draconis" in a small village, she tells you in the laundry room, amid the scent of coconut-fragranced detergent. The memory of once being an experimental prototype in the Royal Court, she tells you in the dining car, to the pleasant sizzle of frying eggs. The memory of fleeing alongside Lukavi, with Theo chasing close behind yet never quite managing to talk things through with her, she tells you in the passenger car, under the warm sunlight.

She tells you so much. Before you know it, she's said almost everything there is to say about her past.
des.FROM：红色草莓龙翼\rTO：科伦巴商会会长\r——\r亲爱的梅迪奇女士：\r:
FROM: Strawberry Dragonwing
TO: President of COLUMBA
——

Dear Madam Medici:
I hope this finds you well.
I've settled into life aboard the Eternal. The crew hasn't pried too much into my privacy — they treat me like a friend. The one you thought so highly of, the conductor, I'm getting along with quite well too... Conductor is a good person, your judgment was spot on. Though a little unreliable at times as a senior.
Also, I hope to introduce my two sisters to you before long... though I'm not sure how well that will go.
Looking forward to your reply. This is my first time using the mail system, and I hope it won't intercept letters the way the Royal Court's couriers used to.

FROM: President of COLUMBA
TO: Strawberry Dragonwing
——

Dear little Ikara:
I'm glad to hear you've settled in well aboard the Eternal. When you find the time, do come back and visit me more — and if you'd like, you're welcome to bring the conductor along. I do miss the two of you.
"Strawberry Dragonwing" is such a cute name, haha! [smile] Though I do hope you'll change your username to your own name — it took me a good while to figure out it was you.
Little Ikara, I hope you keep on living happily.

"Senior! Y-you knew she'd see this username, didn't you?! Why didn't you warn me to change it?!"

Clutching her communicator, Ikara comes bursting into Conductor's cabin, face flushed red from reading the mail.
des.来自贡露城的遗失货物，里面可能装有一种或几种贡露城对外贸易的交易品。: Lost cargo from Gronru City, which may contain one or several types of goods for external trade from Gronru City.
des.伊利亚德的日常生活习惯非常健康。他维持着早睡早起、定时锻炼的生活节律，即使被同僚:
Eliade's daily habits are exceptionally healthy. He keeps to a rhythm of early nights, early mornings, and exercise on a fixed schedule, and has never once adjusted it, even after colleagues took to calling it an old man's routine. Barring the unexpected, any morning after five thirty there is a fair chance of finding him at the exercise equipment in the crew activity car.

Where food is concerned, he insists on a "diet" of his own devising. One of his prized students, who prefers not to be named, maintains that what he likes to eat "may be no closer to the divine, but it has certainly left humanity behind" — for no other reason than that he prepares his daily health drink with his own hands and downs it in one go.

"So Mr. Eliade really drinks shakes made with chicken breast and protein powder?"

Asked this, Eliade nods, puzzled but unfailingly polite. Perhaps in his mind this truly is just part of daily life, and not some unorthodox regimen of enforced wellness.
des.伊利亚德的私人爱好很丰富。他很喜欢画画，由他绘制的一些桦树生物图鉴至今还被当范例:
Eliade has a wide range of private interests. He is very fond of painting, and several of the Chaos Remain field guides he illustrated are still used as models today. Puzzlingly, though, once scientific rigor is set aside and he creates purely for his own pleasure, the results are an ordeal to look at. Calling them merely ugly would be generous; they are the sort of thing that gives people nightmares.

He once held an exhibition of his paintings. Afterward the organizers went so far as to pull every string they had, petitioning Anita's senior leadership for one thing only: that Eliade never again entertain the notion of holding another. Facing the man himself, their representative worked through one handkerchief after another mopping his brow while explaining that his art was simply too far ahead of its time and might, at this stage, be better shared within a small circle... Eliade, for his part, was equally puzzled. To his eye the paintings are nothing more than a personal style; he sees nothing ugly in them, and nothing frightening. That no one understands his artistic sensibility is something he finds mildly regrettable.

His students have gently raised the matter in private: might he consider retiring the "fine tradition" of painting a portrait of every new student? Eliade gave it long thought and concluded that it cannot be retired. As a mentor he must be fair; he will not favor one over another. Take Conductor, that outstanding recruit of his from not long ago — not a true student, perhaps, but there has been some guidance along the way, so if the chance arises he will paint that young newcomer a portrait as a keepsake!
des.伊利亚德从小就展现出了惊人的天赋，每个人都笃定，这孩子未来一定会成为一个大人物。:
Eliade showed astonishing gifts from an early age, and everyone was certain the boy would one day become someone of consequence. His parents hoped he would grow into a person who contributed to society, and under their guidance he developed a deep interest in science.

Naturally enough, the day came when he received an invitation from Anita and became a Gardener intern. He was proud in those days: as the child his parents had late in life, he had been doted on from the start, and as a prodigy, he had never once met a peer as clever as himself. So apart from the hours he spent seeking guidance from his mentor and more experienced colleagues, Eliade spent nearly all his time reading. Rather than waste it on people who had not reached his level, better to take in more knowledge.

"You're reading this work too? If you have the time, would you care to compare notes on it?"

This happened more than twenty years ago. Hearing the voice, Eliade did not put his book down; he only raised his eyes to the red-haired youth standing there with a genial smile.

"My name is Chu Yuheng. I'm interning as a Gardener under Mentor Elvas as well. And you?"

Something stirred in Eliade. The look in this youth's eyes gave him a powerful presentiment: here, perhaps, was someone standing at the same height as himself, someone capable of understanding him.

So Eliade closed the book in his hands and answered, "Name's Eliade. Tomorrow, after lunch, I'm free."
des.刚刚登上无垠号时，车上的人们，尤其是来自阿妮塔的乘员多少对伊利亚德的到来有些紧张:
When Eliade first came aboard the Eternal, the crew — the Anita personnel especially — were somewhat on edge about his arrival. This was a mentor of considerable renown, after all, and everyone regarded him with a degree of awe.

After some time in his company, however, they found that he put on no airs whatsoever. He was approachable, and more than happy to explain scientific matters to anyone in plain, easily understood terms. No one had ever seen him angry, or caught him at a loss. He always seemed patient and gentle, a presence that put people at ease and could be counted on.

He did let the fatigue show once, though. It was in Conductor's Room, where he closed his eyes and — astonishingly — simply fell asleep.

"...I actually fell asleep. How embarrassing, and in your own room, of all places." Perhaps because there was no one else present, he pinched the bridge of his nose to wake himself but made no immediate effort to smooth the tiredness off his face. He wiped his lenses and looked up again. "Does that surprise you?" Eliade smiled. "After all, I do maintain that image deliberately. As a mentor, I can't simply be a source of guidance. I need to be something people can hold on to in a deeper sense — a symbol, an anchor. Mm... which is rather like what you do as conductor, isn't it?"

Eliade rose, straightened his clothes and his hair, and then gave a smile so knowing it made you feel found out.

"Stop staring at me. I'm a little tired, yes, but I will not let you see me yawn."

Then his expression shifted, and he was once again the great mentor nothing seemed able to knock down, walking out of Conductor's Room at an easy, unhurried pace.
des.虽然无垠号已接待过不少要人贵客，但有一位堪称“宗教首领”的人到来并登记成为乘员，: Although The Eternal has hosted many distinguished guests, having someone who could be called a "religious leader" arrive and register as a crew member is still an unprecedented event for The Eternal. Nonetheless, even Slokai, who serves as the hub or "Pope," cannot escape the trivial tasks of basic inspections, identity registration, and confirming file information. Despite appearing countless times during this tedious process as if she wanted to manually lift The Eternal and the Conductor into the air, she cooperated with all the processes—ultimately becoming an official member of The Eternal.Long before this, Slokai had already completed her—whatever it may be called—inspection, review, examination, or critique of The Eternal. She offered various suggestions and opinions on the structure, appearance, and interior of The Eternal, but her final conclusion was surprisingly, "Actually not bad, barely meets my standards."Those who were already familiar with Slokai's style chose not to protest, but only Anfiya, who gradually became acquainted with her during the incident, asked somewhat puzzledly, "Does Slokai really like The Eternal?""What makes you think a creation of mere mortals could earn the favor of the agent of the Mechanical God? You simply don't understand... I only said it's sufficient as my temporary resting place!""But Miss Slokai has never expressed such an opinion about any other... places... after arriving here?""...I don't want to waste more words with you."Slokai turned around displeased, seemingly intending to leave Anfiya behind and continue inspecting the surroundings alone; however, it wasn't long before she turned back and waved proudly at the stunned Anfiya."Aren't you going to catch up? Since you say I like this train, take responsibility to prove it!"..."It seems that Miss Slo... Ellie does indeed like The Eternal."Livia, who watched the entire small wave unfold, softly mentioned this to you.
des.对于斯洛卡伊来说，停留此地的主要理由是“为了帮窟灵族们建造一间看得过去的温泉浴场: For Slokai, the main reason for staying here is "to help the Grotto Spirits build a decent hot spring bathhouse." Judging by current progress, everything is going as she wished: the Grotto Spirits quickly mastered part of the human language, some have even begun integrating into human society, and the construction of the hot spring bathhouse is proceeding smoothly. Although Slokai maintains an attitude of making full use of these little guys' labor, it's clear that she has a good impression of the hardworking Grotto Spirits.However, life on the surface is far from smooth for the Grotto Spirits—even though they have tried hard to show their goodwill and abilities, many people and even some organizations oppose their existence. The reason is simple, these small labor forces of unknown origin are still an unconfirmed presence; who knows if they might cause any serious trouble?Breese and Lester, who arrived early on the surface, feel very helpless about these voices of doubt. Seeing the dejected look of these two little guys, one red and one blue, Slokai becomes somewhat irritated. Rarely using a commanding tone, she orders them to stand up and demands they accompany her to the relevant institutions."Pioneers themselves should pave the way for those who come later, being dejected won't help. Stand up, and let me show you the courage of a Mechanical God's agent!"...A few days later, the opposing voices had mostly subsided, and the hot spring bathhouse was preliminarily completed as expected. To express admiration for Slokai and gratitude to The Eternal crew and other assisting individuals, the Grotto Spirits decided to invite these humans to be the first guests at the bathhouse. Of course, entrance is free. The Grotto Spirits even happily offer you their collected scrap iron, beer bottle caps, and similar items as "Dwarf Coins," indicating that you can exchange the Dwarf Coins for drinks after bathing in the bathhouse!"Whew..."Finally experiencing the hot spring she directed the construction of, Slokai leans comfortably by the edge of the bath, taking a deep breath. Not far away, amidst the mist, her "followers" in this world are frolicking or enjoying moments of peace. Looking at such scenes, Slokai, or rather "Elly," suddenly feels a bit sentimental."This world, although unreasonable, is sometimes quite nice because of this bunch of fools... Hmm, and some places have pretty scenery, some people are quite interesting...""It would be even better if you could be by my side at this moment... lousy brother."
