des.虽然切茜娅正式成为无垠号乘员的契机十分特殊，但她在那个编织出的梦境中经历的一切、: Although Chelsea's official induction as a crew member of The Eternal was under very special circumstances, what she experienced in that woven dream and the opportunity to escape from it are unknown to most. The members of The Eternal who were not involved in the incident are very sympathetic toward this new companion, though some were quite taken aback by Chelsea's low-key demeanor from the start. Even with small matters in real life, Chelsea always approaches them with an attitude of giving her all and dedicating everything."Report! Miss Chelsea attempted to compete with Miss Olivien for four days last week over the speed of tidying up the carriage, and for five days tried to reassign cooking and cleaning duties with the kitchen duty crew of the day. However, near the dining car area, she successfully prevented two minor safety incidents caused respectively by Mr. Pelota and Miss Desiree. Additionally, during a full week of medical station duty, Miss Chelsea...""Box's report is very detailed, but for me, these aren't what's truly important. Conductor, tell me, what do you think about the information revealed in these records?"
des.由于拥有充分的相关知识，同时在索思学会的工作中也积累了一些医疗方面的相关经验，切: Due to her extensive knowledge in the field and some medical experience accumulated while working at the Source Citadel, Chelsea took on part of the medical duties aboard The Eternal. Since being assigned to this role, she diligently fulfilled her responsibilities, sometimes even a bit too diligently as she has always tended to do. Despite there being other crew members on The Eternal who could prepare delicious meals and provide bento boxes for the crew, Chelsea still chose to only eat portable rations at the duty station during her shifts.After noticing Chelsea's habit, the rest of the crew decided, after some discussion, to schedule her to take turns working in the dining car every so often. Initially, Chelsea declined, citing her lack of cooking skills, but when the Conductor personally expressed his hope for this arrangement, she agreed to the scheduling.From then on, on the days Chelsea was on duty, the dining car would always serve sweet and sour tomato beef soup. No one asked whether this was Chelsea's preference or a decision made due to objective conditions, but Chelsea, stirring the soup by the pot, seemed to be slightly happier.
des.切茜娅的童年在父母的严格要求下度过。身为北阵军官的父母面对没落的时代，反而将人生: Chelsea's childhood was spent under the strict demands of her parents. As officers in the Northern Regiment, her parents, facing a declining era, excessively placed their hopes for life and future on a little girl. However, before Chelsea could show her academic talents, the couple both passed away. Young Chelsea found it difficult to cope with everything, mistakenly thinking it was her own incompetence that caused her parents to abandon her—at this time, Raziel appeared in front of Chelsea, gently holding her hand.After that, Raziel adopted the underage Chelsea as a mentor of the Citadel, providing her with an environment to learn and grow. During her growth, Chelsea officially became a member of the Source Citadel through her own abilities.However, she was not willing to stop there, or rather, to gain more love and care from Raziel, she could not stop there. She hoped to achieve more outstanding achievements, but her talents were not as great as those geniuses in the Source Citadel, and even her Ascension Ability could only manage limited self-healing, being quite weak.Just as she was troubled by how to "be of greater use," the Mistletoe Project and a "father" from the Ascension faction appeared before her, marking her first major mistake in seeking her own value. Years later, in the pain and despair of losing Raziel, the "Steward" extended a hand to her again—this was another major mistake she made.Amidst the accumulation of these mistakes, Chelsea continuously struggled in agony. Even so, she still believes she must constantly give and continually sacrifice to finally gain the right to be loved.
des.“切茜娅。”\r“是，老师。”\r“自从你去到远星大桥驻守后，我一直没有和你联络: Chelsea.  Yes, teacher.  I haven't contacted you since you went to the Apoaster Bridge to stand guard, I'm really sorry...  ...No, it's okay, teacher.  But I hope you're doing well. I hope in the new environment you can meet people who care for and love you... No, I'm sure you will.  I suppose I have. And... it was someone you chose. That person cares about me a lot.  ...  After all, you are a child very deserving of love.  ...  Just like before, remember not to push yourself too hard during strength training and always do a proper warm-up!  —The room was filled only with Chelsea's sobbing.  In front of her was an ordinary recording device. This device was given to Raziel by someone in the past; it could record audio and video like a regular camera and also convert the recorded content into data for simulated personality images. Before Raziel set off to go to Haima Zaria to participate in the Angel Experiment, she spent several days recording such footage for most of her students and friends she could think of. The original purpose of this footage was to provide computational data for future simulated personality images, but from another perspective, it was Raziel's final message to those around her.  For a long time, Chelsea firmly believed she was not worthy of Raziel's care and love unless she contributed enough to prove her worth. It was this misunderstanding that ultimately led her astray. Lissandra used dreams to make her accept judgment, but even after waking from the dream, Chelsea insisted she was nothing special to Raziel.  One day after everything ended, the conductor of The Eternal gave her the tape with the recorded message.  Now Chelsea can no longer see the original Raziel, nor does she acknowledge the rebirth of Raziel or the simulated personality image modeled after her. She simply talks and cries continuously to the recording like a child.  It was a love that illuminated more than just her. Yet sometimes love doesn't need to be sought, seized, or compared. After losing and then regaining that love, Chelsea finally began to understand.
des.“朵拉”曾经是个很好、很可靠、很有奉献精神的人。尽管在阿妮塔内部的决策和保密协议: ‘Dora' used to be a very good, reliable, and dedicated person. Despite the internal decisions and confidentiality agreements within Anita that constrained most people who once knew Dora from speaking about her past, and even though most of the basic information about her has been sealed, it is still easy to reach this conclusion. The search for her during her disappearance was not entirely due to safety concerns but also out of worry for her personal well-being. After she was found, her former colleagues made new outfits for her and a special cloak suitable for her activities. Even knowing that she is no longer 'Dora' but 'Doramis,' many people still come to visit her and get to know her new self.As for Doramis's own thoughts on these phenomena? She doesn't seem to care. Although her reactions to these matters often surprise, sadden, or concern visitors, she is probably just being herself.Moreover, as long as there are labeled items in the refrigerator of The Eternal for her to eat, and as long as she can stay by the Conductor's side, it is enough for her at present.
des.“……是娃娃鱼！”\r很难解释或理解朵拉弥丝对“娃娃鱼”这个物种的极大热情是怎么:
……it's a salamander!" 

It's hard to explain or understand how Dolores's great enthusiasm for the species "salamander" originated and developed, but in any case, every time she went out with Dolores, she would show the same excitement as a child seeing a doll whenever they happened to pass by a Trading Center, encounter salamanders, or even see a billboard painted with salamanders. One might have thought this special interest was somehow connected to Dolores's nature, but after inquiring with all the salamander family members available, they also found themselves puzzled about this.

However, this search was not entirely fruitless. After passing through Cape City, Mrs. Fu Yu had a friendly suggestion: "Since this child likes our family so much, why not make some toys for her?"

A few days later, a large package of salamander-shaped pillows and cushions was sent to The Eternal. To avoid some dreadful possibilities, Mrs. Fu Yu didn't choose any actual salamander portraits as prototypes... In short, these pillows and cushions are cute and handy shapes, just right for a young girl to hold in her arms.

Dolores liked them very much. However, she would always look at these pillows with a thoughtful expression. Since she already knows that pillows are not suitable as food... then she should know that salamanders can't be used as food either, right?

It would be best not to let Mrs. Fu Yu and her family know about this.
des.对于吃什么以及不吃什么，朵拉弥丝有自己的一套选择心得。虽然理论上她可以吃掉——按: When it comes to what to eat and what not to eat, Doraemis has her own set of preferences. In theory, she can consume—according to Anita's report, "devour"—most things in the world, but she doesn't eat just anything. At least Chen Shuxian's creative birch soup is not on her menu. As for the general items widely available on The Eternal, she is quite enthusiastic about trying them.She tried Eliot's game cartridge and concluded that it tasted very strange, so she didn't eat it (everyone told her this taste was called "bitter"). She went through everything in the refrigerator, and after enduring many interrogations like "Where's my meal?!" "I was saving that pudding—ahhhh!" "Where's my unfinished milk?" Doraemis discovered that not everything labeled as "edible" in the world is actually edible.However, as an individual known as "Doraemis," why does she have such a great enthusiasm and need for the process of eating or devouring? If this is her way of perceiving the world, how was it formed?
des.“人类认知方式的方式往往需要依赖自己的感官。目前阶段的研究已经证明了桦树生物亦有: Human cognition often relies on our own senses. Current research has proven that CR also have senses and perceptions similar to humans, and they can make some simple judgments... but whether they possess the ability to think, or have "intelligence" like us, remains an unsolved mystery.As a leading company in the research of CR, Anita Energy is closely studying all aspects of them by continuously narrowing the distance between CR and ourselves. Take my research project as an example, the special mimic CR individuals I captured...Someone's voice. A lecture. A lecture from a few months ago, a script she wrote by hand. Since the audience was not made up of professionals, it was important to explain the content about CR as plainly and interestingly as possible.Say goodbye to the test subject before leaving the laboratory. It just stayed motionless against the glass of the protective room.The lecture went smoothly. Proudly educating people who lacked understanding of CR, mentioning the name of the test subject... People were very surprised.Why name it? people asked.A few months later, a serious accident occurred. She found herself in a life-threatening situation, with only the mute, special test subject as her sole companion.Ah, in that case, if one could gain rebirth... what kind of name should be given to such a life? What should it be considered? Human? CR?... "Friend"?Gently cradling the other, swallowing it at that moment, she understood. So this is "me." The protective room no longer existed, language lost its necessity, and the barrier of the Morphic Field was meaningless. "I" am me.From that moment on, Doraemis, who merged with the "friend," was born.
des.尽管财力雄厚，但海伦娜仍旧拥有亲和而高贵的气质，这种气质足以让任何与她对话、甚至: Although financially well off, Helena still possesses an affable yet noble demeanor, a demeanor that is enough for anyone conversing with her, or even just passing by her, to respectfully address her as "madam." Complementing this demeanor is her virtue of being willing to help others at any time; even if passengers on the train who have never interacted with her before and are complete strangers seek her assistance after hearing about her extensive knowledge, she is usually patient in providing advice. However, the help Madam Helena offers is not without conditions. Before providing help and advice, she usually requires the seeker to pay a "price"—this price is often not paid directly in money or tangible goods. More often, what she asks for is a task, a promise, an agreement, or possibly even a request left temporarily open-ended."Whether as a magician or a gem researcher... oh, and just like what you refer to as 'science,' nothing in the world comes from nothing. There must be a loss to gain something, which is one of the basic principles of Imperial Alchemy."
des.海伦娜在魔法与炼金等方面非常博学，这一点在无垠号乘组试图帮助某位异乡来客克服发生: Helena is very knowledgeable in magic and alchemy, which was fully demonstrated when the crew of The Eternal attempted to help a certain Outlander overcome the "Dissociation" happening to her. Faced with a problem that most people in the Empire could neither understand nor tackle, she not only provided a mature solution but also discreetly guided and assisted everyone through the lengthy search and preparation process. In the end, the process of completing the "Primordial Fruit" was personally completed by her. Would such a learned person really be, as she claims, "just a modestly wealthy traveling mage"?If one has even a slight understanding of the social system of the Mundus Empire, it would be known that powerful magic users are usually eventually concentrated in a few limited institutions like the royal court or the magic academy. Judging from the surprised expressions of those on the train who had some connection with the magic academy upon seeing Helena, it's clear that she had met them before; and given Helena's always guiding and instructive manner of speaking, it's easy to guess that she is one of the teachers at the magic academy, albeit temporarily on the surface for some reason.However, considering her own attitude... It's best to pretend to know nothing about her identity and quietly accompany her on vacation.
des.如前所述，海伦娜的财力异常雄厚，而且她的财产大多是“帝国式”的。与地表流行投资、: As previously mentioned, Helena is extraordinarily wealthy, and most of her assets are "imperial." Unlike the popular trend of investing and starting industries on the surface, the elite of the Mundus Empire seem more inclined to preserve their wealth. Some conservatives consider this a "dignified approach." While Helena also does not advocate extravagant wastefulness, she doesn't quite agree with this conservative approach either. So, several years ago, she began using her personal funds to help some children in unfortunate circumstances within the empire. In Helena's view, these children are not lacking in talent and effort; they just need the right assistance and guidance to succeed—like selecting raw gems, Helena seemingly casually yet carefully chose some candidates she believed had potential. These children all grew up safely; some returned to ordinary lives, some became renowned magicians, and some even went to the surface, contributing to the development of another world.Among them was a special child who, after losing family members at a young age, remained obsessed with revenge. It was Helena who found her, kept her by her side for education and nurturing, allowing her to put down the sword of vengeance and instead become a person with dreams.This child is now known to others as "Olivien."
des.在为某位异乡来客提供帮助、以及为那些“小矮人”解明真相时，海伦娜又见到了“那幅壁: While assisting an Outlander and uncovering the truth for those "little dwarves," Helena once again saw "that mural." When she was still a spirited young mage, she had seen that painting on her way to meet a person of importance, who was also her friend. As she grew older, she encountered it over and over while explaining the history of the empire and the origins of gemstone magic to some of her students. When she was invited by the alchemist of the royal court to assist them but politely declined after seeing those children, she saw the painting again…Just like Helena's appearance, the scene in the painting had not changed much. A tower with its brilliance extinguished, a dragon opening the path for the world, and people crossing through, with some round little creatures added to this painting compared to the common ones in the empire.In this world, they are called the Kulings. Long before they were ever referred to as Kulings, Helena had already seen these created, adorable little beings."How long has it been since then?"There was no echo in the cave. The people who could answer her had long passed away in the river of history; yet she continued to confide in the gradually dimming piece of sealing light."I have lived well over these years. The children I met on the surface have already completed your wish.""And also, the little ones you created have very adeptly learned the human 'heart'… The world hasn't turned bad like we feared, and the newborn lives have begun to shine brightly. By the way, the dragon children who were coerced back then are also on that train, and they are safe and sound.""Now, I will deliver a gift to these children on your behalf.""I hope one day, these children will find answers that belong solely to them—"

skillText.开局检测手牌、牌库、弃牌区所有卡牌，根据红卡数和蓝卡数进行形态转换：\\n\\n:
At the start of battle, examine the number of Red and Blue cards in your hand, the deck and the discard pile and adjust stance accordingly.

If there are more Red cards, enter [Defensive Stance]:
Gain immunity to all crowd-control effects.
Whenever taking damage, heal and reduce Final DMG taken by 10%. DMG reduction stacks up to 10 times, and resets when reaching the maximum stacks.
All Red cards have their Cost reduced by 1 when drawn.

If there are more Blue cards, enter [Offensive Stance]:
Increase ATK by 10% and reduce DEF by 10%.
Attacks deal additional True DMG equal to 5% of the target's Max HP.
All Blue cards have their Cost reduced by 1 when drawn.

If the numbers of Red and Blue cards are equal or at 0, enter [Balanced Stance]:
DMG taken per hit won't exceed 3% of Max HP.
Attacks deal additional True DMG equal to 3% of the target's Max HP.
All cards have their Cost randomly increased or reduced by 1 when drawn.

skillText.敌方每使用13张卡牌，自身触发【霸体】，持续9秒: Whenever you use 13 cards, the enemy gains [Hyperarmor], lasting 9 seconds.
skillText.每降低20%生命值触发1次，召唤1颗陨石，对范围内敌方造成1段混响伤害并【击飞】: Summon a meteorite that deals Reverb DMG to your nearby allies once and inflicts [Launch]. Reduce the targets' Final DMG dealt by 10%. This effect stacks. This effect is triggered whenever the enemy loses 20% of Max HP.
skillText.血影骨龙释放技能后，若有角色死亡或生命值低于50%，则立即释放1次【尸山血河】: After Sanguine Skeleton casts a skill, if an ally is killed or their HP drops below 50%, Sanguine Skeleton immediately casts [Holocaust].
skillText.引爆能量，对敌方全体造成1段混响伤害并【打断】，同时随机丢弃敌方1张手牌: Trigger an explosion, dealing Reverb DMG to all your allies once, inflicting [Interrupt], and discarding a random card from your hand.
skillText.生成1张【形态污染】进入敌方手牌，随后销毁敌方手牌中的所有【形态污染】，每销毁1: Generate a [Morphic Field Pollution] in your hand, then destroy all [Morphic Field Pollution] in your hand. For each card destroyed, deal Reverb DMG to all your allies once.
skillText.在战场中穿梭，对范围内敌方造成2段物理伤害: Dash through the battlefield, dealing Physical DMG twice.
skillText.随机召唤1个【爪桦树生物】或【蜇桦树生物】进入战场: Randomly summon a [Clawed Chaos Remain] or [Stinger Chaos Remain] on the battlefield.
skillText.命令所有【爪桦树生物】和【蜇桦树生物】立即释放得意技: All [Clawed Chaos Remains] and [Stinger Chaos Remains] immediately unleash Ultimate skill.
skillText.引爆能量，对敌方全体造成1段混响伤害，同时生成1张【形态污染】进入牌库: Deal Reverb DMG to all your allies once and generate a [Morphic Field Pollution] in your deck.
skillText.对敌方目标造成1段混响伤害，同时生成1张【形态污染】进入牌库: Deals Reverb DMG once and generates a [Morphic Field Pollution] in enemy's deck.
skillText.销毁敌方手牌区1张黑卡，同时将自身【普攻攻击】替换为【暗焰球】: Destroy a Black hand card and replace the enemy's [Basic Attack] with [Darkflame Sphere].
skillText.发射1颗火球，对范围内敌方造成1段混响伤害，同时触发【点燃】: Launch a fireball, dealing Reverb DMG once and inflicting [Ignite].
skillText.汲取单个敌人的精力，使其费用回复速度降低，同时自身持续获得精力值: Drain energy from the target, reducing your Cost regen speed while gaining Energy over time.
skillText.汲取敌方全体的精力，使敌方费用回复速度降低，同时自身持续获得精力值: Drain energy from all your allies, reducing your Cost regen speed while gaining Energy over time.
skillText.释放全部能量，对敌方全体造成1段负能伤害: Unleash all stored energy, dealing Reverengy DMG to all your allies once.
skillText.濒死时触发，对范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害: Deal Physical DMG once when taking lethal DMG.
skillText.短暂延迟后开始行动，同时自身【狂暴】: Attack after a short delay and gain [Berserk].
skillText.持续消耗精力值，每秒对敌方目标造成1段混响伤害: Consume Energy over time, dealing Reverb DMG once per second.
skillText.低头进行贯通性的激光射击，对敌方全体造成1段负能伤害: Fires a penetrating laser beam, dealing Reverengy DMG to all enemies once.
skillText.甲片扩张，释放一道能量波，为范围内生命值最低的友方单位回复生命值: Release an energy wave, healing the enemy with the lowest HP within range.
skillText.原地弹跳并闪避即将受到的伤害: Bounces in place and dodges upcoming attacks.
skillText.回复友方全体少量生命值: Heals all allies for a small amount of HP.
skillText.对范围内敌方造成1段混响伤害，同时概率触发【混乱】: Deal Reverb DMG once with a chance to inflict [Confuse].
skillText.对敌方目标造成1段混响伤害，同时触发【禁锢】: Deals Reverb DMG once and Imprisons the target.
skillText.对敌方目标造成3段物理伤害并【斩裂】，同时根据造成的伤害回复自身生命值: Deal Physical DMG over 3 hits and inflict [Slash]. Heal based on the DMG dealt.
skillText.生成幻影闪现至随机敌方身后，对范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害，同时触发【灼心】或【诅: Summon a mirage that teleports behind your random ally and deal Physical DMG to targets in range once and inflict [Scorch] or [Curse].
skillText.仰头长啸，自身触发【狂暴】: Let out a furious roar and gain [Berserk].
skillText.快速刨动四肢钻入地面，回复自身生命值: Burrow into the ground and heal.
skillText.生成成群的飞虫向对方发冲击，对范围内敌方造成1段混响伤害，同时触发【灼心】: Generate swarms of flying insects to deal Reverb DMG once and inflict [Scorch].
skillText.全身能量汇聚到头部核心，发射出一道能量光束对敌方目标造成1段混响伤害: Unleash a concentrated energy beam from the head, dealing Reverb DMG once.
skillText.头部核心短暂高亮后向四周发出一道环状的念动力波纹，对敌方全体造成1段混响伤害，同: Release a ring of psychic energy, dealing Reverb DMG to all your allies once and inflicting [Scorch].
skillText.向前喷出一个火环，对范围内敌方造成1段混响伤害，同时触发【枷锁】: Ejects a ring of fire forward, dealing Reverb DMG once and inflicting Fetter.
skillText.从头部向前喷出一个巨大的暗能火球，对范围内敌方造成1段混响伤害，同时自身获得【护: Generates a Shield and unleashes a massive dark-energy fireball forward, dealing Reverb DMG once.
skillText.濒死时【无敌】并回复自身全部生命值，每次触发时对全场造成永久持续的【火海】，自身: When taking lethal DMG, gain [Invincible], fully heal, and trigger [Inferno] on the entire battlefield that lasts the rest of the battle. Reduce Final DMG taken by 30%. This effect stacks. While in this state, dispel and gain immunity to all negative effects but cannot take any actions and lose HP every second.\nThis effect can be triggered up to 3 times.
skillText.受到的物理伤害提高50%\\n战场被火焰覆盖，每6秒对双方全体造成1段火焰伤害，: Take 50% more Physical DMG.\nEngulf the battlefield in flames. Deal Fire DMG once every 6 seconds to all units on the battlefield and trigger [Ignite].
skillText.每10秒触发，消耗自身所有精力值触发1道火环，基于消耗的精力值对敌方全体造成1段: Consume all Energy to unleash a ring of fire, dealing Fire DMG to all enemies once based on the Energy consumed and trigger [Ignite]. This effect is triggered once every 10 seconds.
skillText.开局释放1次【崩山击】: Cast [Mountain Shatter] at the start of battle.
skillText.受到的混响伤害提高50%\\n战场被火焰覆盖，每6秒对双方全体造成1段火焰伤害，: Take 50% more Reverb DMG.\nEngulf the battlefield in flames. Deal Fire DMG once every 6 seconds to all units on the battlefield and trigger [Ignite].
skillText.每30秒触发，将敌方全体攻击力重置为1500点: Reset all enemies' ATK to 1,500. This effect is triggered once every 30 seconds.
skillText.开局生成5张【负能】进入敌方牌库: Generate 5 [Reverengy] in your deck at the start of battle.
skillText.敌方全体最大生命值降低20%: Reduce all enemies' Max HP by 20%.
skillText.将右臂的轮锯甩出，对敌方全体造成1段物理伤害，同时触发【撕裂】: Hurl the wheel saw on the right arm, dealing Physical DMG to all your allies once and inflicting [Rend].
skillText.对敌方全体造成5段物理伤害，同时丢弃敌方2张手牌: Deal Physical DMG to all your allies over 5 hits and make you discard 2 hand cards.
skillText.释放锯刃向前滚动，对接触到的敌方造成1段物理伤害并使其遭受【深度创伤】持续3秒，: Roll the wheel saw forward, dealing Physical DMG once to the target contacted and inflicting [Deep Wound], lasting 3 seconds. During this period, if the target uses a skill, rend the [Deep Wound] and deal DMG once based on the HP lost.
skillText.每次洗牌时，攻击速度提升 20%，可叠加: Whenever you shuffle the deck, increase the enemy's attack speed by 20%. This effect stacks.
skillText.当生命值低于 30%时，普攻会触发【弹射】: When the enemy's HP falls below 30%, its [Basic Attack] triggers [Ricochet].
skillText.对随机敌方造成1段物理伤害并【斩裂】，同时驱散场上的【力场】/【结界】: Deal Physical DMG once and inflict [Slash], then remove all [Force Fields] and [Barriers] on the field.
skillText.生成环境【归墟】，持续20秒\\n【归墟】：全场触发的【斩裂】伤害提高100%，: Generate environment [Guixu], lasting 20 seconds.\n[Guixu]: All [Slash] effects on the field deal 100% more DMG, and reduce the Cost of Red cards by 1 when they enter your hand.
skillText.令敌方抽取1张卡，随后对随机敌方斩出一道剑气，每道剑气造成1段物理伤害并【斩裂】: Force you to draw 1 card, then release a sword wave to a random target, each dealing Physical DMG once and inflicting [Slash], up to 20 waves. Stop releasing when you draw a 5+ Cost card.
skillText.战斗开始时在敌方手牌生成1张【桎梏】\\n【桎梏】：此卡禁止使用，红卡入手时费用: At the start of battle, generate 1 [Shackle] in your hand.\n[Shackle]: This card cannot be used. Reduce its Cost by 1 when a Red card enters your hand. This card is destroyed when the effect is triggered 20 times, and all allies gain [Prisoner] effect, while removing the enemy's [Caged Beast] effect.\n[Prisoner]: Increase Max HP by 100% and reduce healing received by 50%. This effect cannot be dispelled.
skillText.开局获得【困兽】状态，【困兽】状态被驱散时，同时销毁敌方红卡和黑卡外全部卡牌\\: At the start of battle, gain [Caged Beast] effect. When it is dispelled, destroy all your cards except Red and Black cards.\n[Caged Beast]: Reduce Final DMG dealt and taken by 99%.
skillText.每次洗牌时生成10张【厮杀】进入敌方牌库\\n【厮杀】：对随机敌方造成3段物理伤: When you shuffle your deck, generate 10 [Deathmatch] in your deck.\n[Deathmatch]: Deal Physical DMG over 3 hits and inflict [Slash], then draw a card.\nThis card is [Destroyed] when used.
skillText.使友方全体获得【护盾】，同时自身获得【霸体】，持续6秒: Grants Shield to all allies and gains Hyperarmor for 6 seconds.
skillText.对敌方目标造成1段物理伤害并【击晕】，同时自身攻击力+2%: Deals Physical DMG once and Stuns the target. In addition, gains a 2% Attack bonus.
skillText.重击地面产生冲击波，引爆场上所有【护盾】，每个【护盾】对敌方全体造成1段混响伤害: Smashes the ground and creates a shockwave that detonates all Shields on the battlefield. For each Shield detonated, deals Reverb DMG to all enemies once.
skillText.牵引大盾重击地面，对范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害，同时触发【诅咒】\\n施放该技能: Smashes the ground with the massive shield, dealing Physical DMG to enemies once and Cursing them.\nIn addition, gains a 3% Attack bonus.
skillText.使友方全体获得【护盾】，同时自身获得【无敌】，持续3秒: Grants Shield to all allies and gains Invincible for 3 seconds.
skillText.牵引大盾砸向敌方，对敌方全体造成1段负能伤害，同时触发【护盾击碎】: Smashes enemies with the massive shield, dealing Reverengy DMG to all enemies once and shattering their Shield.
skillText.使用舌头刺击敌方全体，造成1段物理伤害，同时在3秒后令目标【昏睡】: Stabs all enemies with the tongue, dealing Physical DMG once and putting them to Sleep after 3 seconds.
skillText.牺牲自身当前20%生命值治疗友方全部【泥嚎箱】，回复值与自身牺牲的生命值相等: Consumes 20% of current HP to heal all allied HelloBoxes for the same amount of HP that was consumed.
skillText.每次进行治疗时，都有概率为自身回复5%生命值: Whenever this unit heals another unit, it has a 5% chance to restore its own HP.
skillText.从宝箱中伸出一挺机枪向敌方半场进行无规则扫射，对随机敌方造成20段物理伤害: Fetch a machine gun from the box and strafe, dealing Physical DMG to random targets over 20 hits.
skillText.从宝箱中吐出三个惊爆盒随机落在敌方阵营中，惊爆盒落地3s后发生爆炸对范围内敌方造: Spit out three scare boxes on your field. The boxes will explode in 3 seconds after landing, dealing Physical DMG to nearby targets once and inflicting [Ignite].
skillText.对范围内敌方单位造成2段物理伤害，同时触发【撕裂】: Deal Physical DMG twice and inflict [Rend].
skillText.对范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害并【打断】，随后对范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害并【击飞: Deal Physical DMG once and inflict [Interrupt]. Then deal Physical DMG once and inflict [Launch].
skillText.每秒回复自身少量生命值: Restores a small amount of HP per second.
skillText.随机释放以下3种暗器的1种：\\n木扉流·暗器【梨花】，对敌方造成12段物理伤害:
Randomly releases one of the following throwing weapons.
Woodwind - Pear Blossom: Deals Physical DMG over 12 hits. Inflicts Scorch and Rend.
Dream Profound - Instant Wind: Deals Physical DMG to 3 random enemies once. Inflicts Scorch and Slash.
Phantom Wings - Black Plume: Deals Physical DMG over 6 hits. Inflicts Scorch and Ignition.
skillText.自身下1次释放的技能造成的最终伤害提高50%: This character's next skill deals 50% more Final DMG.
skillText.施展奥义【无相·转轮】，对敌方全体造成10段物理伤害: Unleashes the ultimate move Formless: Turning Wheel, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies over 10 hits.
skillText.每次使用【无常】后，使自身【隐形】，持续3秒: Upon using Anitya, gains Invisible for 3 seconds.
skillText.自身触发【隐形】时，持续时间增加2秒: Invisible triggered by this character lasts 2 seconds longer.
skillText.自身处于【隐形】状态时，【无常】造成的最终伤害提高30%: While this character is Invisible, Anitya deals 30% more Final DMG.
skillText.使用【开眼】后，使自身【隐形】，持续3秒\\n自身下1次【无常】额外触发【崩坏】: Upon using Awareness, gains Invisible for 3 seconds.\nThe next Anitya additionally inflicts Corrupt.
skillText.自身处于【隐形】状态时，【无相·转轮】 造成的最终伤害提高10%: While this character is Invisible, Formless: Turning Wheel deals 10% more Final DMG.
skillText.释放【无常】后，有50%的概率再次释放【无常】: Casting Anitya has a 50% chance to recast this skill.
skillText.每累积使用3次相同暗器，下次释放【无常】后额外释放1次该种类暗器: For every 3 uses of a specific type of throwing weapon, the next Anitya will release an additional throwing weapon of that type.
skillText.挥扇，使我方前排攻击力+2%，可叠加: Waves the fan, increasing all frontline allies' Attack by 2%. This effect stacks.
skillText.施展【奥义·流风】，对敌方全体造成6段物理伤害\\n基于【舒卷】的释放次数，每释: Casts Ogi: Ryufu, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies over 6 hits.\nFor each time Tayutau has been cast, increases this character's Attack by 1%. This effect stacks.
skillText.【舒卷】增强为：\\n挥扇，使我方前排攻击力+2%，可叠加\\n同时驱散我方前排: Enhances Tayutau:\nWaves the fan, increasing all frontline allies' Attack by 2%. This effect stacks.\nRemoves all Ignition effects from all frontline allies.
skillText.释放【舒卷】后，有30%概率再释放1次: Casting Tayutau has a 30% chance to recast this skill.
skillText.【奥义·流风】增强为：\\n施展【奥义·流风】，对敌方全体造成6段物理伤害，同时: Enhances Ogi: Ryufu:\nCasts Ogi: Ryufu, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies over 6 hits and Chilling them.\nFor each time Tayutau has been cast, increases this character's Attack by 2%. This effect stacks.
skillText.释放【捭阖】时，自身攻击力+1%，可叠加: Casting Improvision increases this character's Attack by 1%. This effect stacks.
skillText.开局释放1次【捭阖】: Casts Improvision at the beginning of the battle.
skillText.自身释放【奥义·流风】时，友方宵月一同释放【奥义·流虹】: When this character's casts Ogi: Ryufu, the allied Yoizuki immediately casts Ogi: Nagaruniji.
skillText.使自身造成的【引雷】触发概率+5%，可叠加\\n释放1个分身，对范围内敌方造成1: This character has a 5% increased chance to Electrify the target. This effect stacks.\nSummons a mirror image that strikes nearby enemies, dealing Electro DMG once and Electrifying them.
skillText.释放1个分身，对敌方目标造成3段电磁伤害，同时触发【引雷】: Summons a mirror image that strikes enemies over 3 hits, dealing Electro DMG and Electrifying the target.
skillText.释放3个分身，每个分身对敌方目标造成3段电磁伤害，同时触发【引雷】: Summons 3 mirror images, each striking enemies over 3 hits, dealing Electro DMG and Electrifying the target.
skillText.每隔30秒，使自身【隐形】，持续5秒: Every 30 seconds, gains Invisible for 5 seconds.
skillText.分身消失时，回复自身2%生命值: Upon the disappearance of a mirror image, restores 2% of Max HP.
skillText.【雷走】增强为：\\n使自身造成的【引雷】触发概率+8%，可叠加\\n释放1个分: Swift Bolt enhanced to:\nIncreases the probability of triggering "Electrify" by 8%, can be stacked\nReleases 1 m, dealing 1 hit of Electro DMG to enemies within range, while triggering "Electrify"
skillText.分身消失时，自身发射暗器，对敌方目标造成1段电磁伤害，同时触发【引雷】: When the mirror image expires, immediately hurls a throwing weapon, dealing Electro DMG once and Electrifying the target.
skillText.每次释放技能后，自身攻击力+5%，上限45%: Whenever using a skill, this character gains +5% ATK, up to 45%.
skillText.有15%概率触发幻影回避受到的攻击，免疫这次伤害: When attacked, this character has a 15% chance to trigger Phantom Evasion, avoiding the incoming attack and nullifying the incoming damage.
skillText.当任意我方处于【隐形】状态时，直接释放1次【雷走】: When any ally is Invisible, directly casts Swift Bolt once.
skillText.挥舞【双极雁翎】横斩，对敌方目标造成2段物理伤害并【斩裂】\\n自身获得25点精: Wields [Goose Wing Twinblade], cleaves the target over two hits and inflicts [Slash].\nNabi gain 25 Energy.
skillText.挥舞【双极雁翎】袈裟斩，对敌方目标造成1段物理伤害并【斩裂】\\n自身获得25点: Wields [Goose Wing Twinblade], cleaves the target over 1 hit and inflicts [Slash].\nNabi gain 25 Energy.
skillText.使用【双极雁翎】招架，使自身进入【格挡】状态，持续6秒\\n自身获得25点精力值: Parries with [Goose Wing Twinblade], enters [Block] stance for 6 seconds.\nNabi gain 25 Energy.
skillText.释放暗器【鸦翎】，对敌方目标造成3段物理伤害并【弹射】，同时触发【撕裂】\\n自: Releases the throwing weapon Raven Feather. The weapon Ricochets among enemies, dealing Physical DMG over 3 hits and inflicting Rend.\nRestores 25 Energy.
skillText.挥舞【双极雁翎】旋转斩击，对范围内敌方造成8段物理伤害: Wield [Goose Wing Twinblade] to perform a spinning slash, dealing 8 hits of DMG to enemies within range
skillText.释放技能后使自身【隐形】，持续2秒: Upon casting any skill, gains Invisible for 2 seconds.
skillText.【双极雁翎】的一端喷上塞西尔特供【迷乱喷雾】，每次命中有5%概率触发【混乱】: One end of [Goose Wing Twinblade] is sprayed with Cecil's exclusive [Confusing Spray]. Each hit has a 5% chance to inflict [Confuse].
skillText.解除【格挡】状态后，回复自身生命值: When this character's Block expires, restores HP.
skillText.自身处于【隐形】状态时，【无相·鸾回麟返】追加4段物理伤害: While this character is Invisible, Muso: Hokai Rinhen deals Physical DMG over 4 more hits.
skillText.【双极雁翎】的一端喷上塞西尔特供【灼心喷雾】，每次命中有5%概率触发【灼心】: One end of [Goose Wing Twinblade] is sprayed with Cecil's special [Scorch Spray], with a 5% chance per hit to trigger [Scorch].
skillText.解除【格挡】状态后，使自身【狂暴】: Upon exiting the Block stance, enters Berserk.
skillText.所有自身攻击技能触发【引雷】: This character's offensive skills always Electrify the target.

Has [Hyperarmor] while channeling this skill.\nLeaps into the air and summons three fiery meteorites upon enemies, dealing 1 hit of Fire DMG, disabling a random non-Red, and inflicting [Wildfire].
skillText.使用【通明】后，尾部的火焰开始燃烧，同时将【通明】转变为【灼天】: After using [Illumination], the flames at the end begin to burn, and [Illumination] becomes [Incineration].
skillText.施放【灼天】后自身死亡，同时令随机1只不知火丛立即施放【通明】/【灼天】: Upon casting [Incineration], immediately dies and causes a random Shiranui Bush to cast [Illumination] / [Incineration].
skillText.释放全部烛光并灭烛，对敌方全体造成1段火焰伤害，同时封印敌方队长技，持续5秒，: Thoroughly glows and extinguishes the candle, dealing Fire DMG to all enemies once and disabling their leader skill for 5 seconds. This effect stacks.
skillText.扬起大量灰烬，在敌方区域生成【炽地】: Stirs up a hefty amount of ash, inflicting [Blaze] on the enemy's field.
skillText.烛火燃烧时，不知火烛受到的最终伤害降低，友方死亡时吸取其精魄恢复自身生命值并获得: While the candle is burning, Shiranui Lamp takes less Final DMG. Whenever Shiranui Lamp's ally is killed, Shiranui Lamp restores HP and Energy and gains an Attack bonus.\nThis effect no longer works once the candle is extinguished.
skillText.使随机友方【隐形】，持续5秒，同时使其攻击力+3%，可叠加: Make a random ally [Invisible] for 5s, while increasing their ATK by +3%, can be stacked.
skillText.消耗全部精力值，每1点精力值使自身攻击力+0.1%\\n同时有概率立即释放【破构: Expend all Energy, each 1 point of Energy increases your ATK by 0.1%\nThere is also a chance to immediately release "Bolt: Disintegrate", with the trigger probability equal to the Energy consumed this time.
skillText.回复自身20点精力值，同时有概率对生命值最高的敌方目标触发【轰雷】\\n若触发失: Restore 20 points of your own Energy, with a chance to trigger Thunder on the enemy unit with the highest HP.\nIf it fails, restore another 20 points of your own Energy.\nAfter activation, replace with Power: Reconstruct.
skillText.激活大型【力场】，使我方全体受到伤害降低80%，持续10秒\\n释放后替换为 【: Activate a large Force Field, reducing DMG received by all allies by 80% for 10 s.\nAfter casting, replace with Flame: Integrate.
skillText.对范围内敌方目标造成1段火焰伤害并触发【枷锁】和【禁锢】\\n同时每秒有10%概: Deal 1 hit of Fire DMG to enemy units within range and trigger Fetter and Imprison.\nAdditionally, there is a 10% chance per second to trigger Ignite x1 on the target for 6s.\nAfter casting, replace with Light: Purify.
skillText.对随机友方目标射出净化之光，回复目标50%生命值\\n同时驱散目标受到的控制和伤: Shoot Light: Purify at a random friendly target to restore 50% of the target's HP\nwhile dispelling Control and DMG special effects on the target.\nAfter casting, replace with Bolt: Disintegrate.
skillText.使用【消失】后，回复自身10点精力值: After using Vanish, recover 10 points of Energy.
skillText.施放【洗牌】时，有30%概率不会清空自身精力值: When casting [Shuffle], there is a 30% chance that your Energy will not be depleted.
skillText.战斗开始时立即获得30点精力值: Gain 30 Energy at the start of the battle
skillText.释放【破构之雷】/【再构之力】/【立构之炎】/【净化之光】后，根据自身由 【消失: Release Bolt: Disintegrate/Power: Reconstruct/Flame: Integrate/Light: Purify, then based on your own Attack increase gained from Vanish/Shuffle, for every 1% Attack increase, deal DMG equal to 1% of the current HP to all enemies, while resetting your own Attack increase effect gained from Vanish/Shuffle.
skillText.自身精力值清空时，回复自身5%最大生命值: When own Energy is depleted, restore 5% of own Max HP.
skillText.使处于【隐形】状态下的我方每秒回复1%生命值: Make our side in an Invisible Status recover 1% HP per s
skillText.释放【破构之雷】/【再构之力】/【立构之炎】/【净化之光】时，使我方全体【隐形】: When releasing [Bolt: Disintegrate] / [Power: Reconstruct] / [Flame: Integrate] / [Light: Purify], all allies become [Invisible], and ATK +1%, up to 100%.
skillText.自身造成的【引雷】概率+10%: This character has a 10% increased chance to Electrify the target.
skillText.【普通攻击】增强为：同时使用2把高斯手枪射击: [Basic Attack]Enhanced to: Simultaneously use 2 Gauss pistols to shoot
skillText.当场上只有妮蔻拉存活时，攻击力和防御力+150，同时立即释放一次【火力全开】: When Nicola is the only ally that survives, increases her Attack and DEF by 150 and immediately casts Fullpower.
skillText.以娴熟的双枪射击，对敌方目标造成6段伤害: Unleashes a barrage of bullets using dual pistols, dealing DMG over 6 hits.
skillText.对敌方目标造成3段伤害\\n随后，对目标踢出强有力的一击造成1段伤害并使敌方目标:
Deals DMG over 3 hits.
Then launches a powerful kick, dealing DMG once and reducing the target's DEF by 3%. This effect stacks.
In addition, inflicts Stun, Rend, and Slash.
While channeling this skill, this character has a 50% chance to dodge incoming attacks.
skillText.枪刃乱舞，对敌方全体造成12段伤害并【撕裂】: Unleashes a flurry of lance attacks, dealing DMG to all enemies over 12 hits and Rending them.
skillText.将【贯筒】抵住敌方射击\\n对敌方目标造成1段伤害并【崩坏】: Points the Tsuranuki Zutsu at the target and launches a point-blank shot.\nDeals DMG once and inflicts Corrupt.
skillText.蓄力增压，使【贯筒射击】和【爆裂射击】伤害提高10%，可叠加: Builds up the pressure in the Tsuranuki Zutsu's COLUMBA, enabling Tsuranuki Shot and Burst Shot to deal 10% more damage. This effect stacks.
skillText.注射【黑色药剂】，对敌方全体造成1段伤害，无视防御\\n每秒献祭自身3%生命值，:
Injects the Black Potion and strikes all enemies once. This attack ignores the target's DEF.
This character loses 3% of Max HP per second for 30 seconds.
This character deals 40% more Final DMG.
This character takes 40% less Final DMG.
Cooldown: 60 seconds.
skillText.将【贯筒】刺入敌方体内爆裂射击，对敌方目标造成5段伤害并【斩裂】: Thrusts the Tsuranuki Zutsu into the enemy and fires a Burst Shot. Deals DMG over 5 hits and inflicts Slash.
skillText.战斗开始后，敌方卡牌入手时若是0费则将其销毁，同时生成1张【负能】加入手牌: When a card has 0 Cost when it enters your hand, destroy it and generate 1 [Reverengy] in your hand.
skillText.自身精力值首次到达50%时，驱散自身受到的控制和伤害类特殊效果，同时将自身当前攻: When the enemy's Energy reaches 50% for the first time, dispel all crowd-control and damage effects, and reset ATK to initial value and heal for 20% of Max HP.
skillText.受到的物理伤害提高50%\\n战斗开始时将敌方所有红卡置于牌库顶端: Enemies take 50% more Physical DMG.\nAt the start of battle, place all your Red cards at the top of the deck.
skillText.当头一棒，对敌方目标造成1段伤害并【击晕】，同时触发【点燃】: Launches brutal smite that deals DMG once, and Stuns and Ignites the target.
skillText.全力挥击本垒打，对敌方目标造成1段伤害并【击退】，同时有20%概率将目标【击飞】: A full swing for a home run, dealing DMG once and Knocking Back the target. In addition, this attack has a 20% chance to Launch the target.
skillText.重击地面，对范围内敌方造成1段伤害\\n释放可燃气体，使范围内敌我双方触发【点燃: Smites the ground, dealing DMG to enemies once.\nReleases a flammable gas that Ignites both allies and enemies alike, and Ignited allies have their Attack increased by 3%. This effect stacks.
skillText.使用【棒喝】后，自身获得少量精力值: Casting Clobber restores a small amount of Energy.
skillText.自身被燃烧时，每秒回复2%生命值: When this character is Ignited, restores 2% of Max HP per second.
skillText.使用【一发入魂】时，自身触发【霸体】，持续5秒: Casting Homerun grants this character Hyperarmor for 5 seconds.
skillText.自身被燃烧时，造成的最终伤害提高20%: When this character is Ignited, deals 20% more Final DMG.
skillText.自身被燃烧时，【普通攻击】触发【点燃】: When this character is Ignited, Basic Attacks Ignite the target.
skillText.【无明】增强为：\\n重击地面，对范围内敌方造成1段伤害\\n释放大量可燃气体，:
Enhances Ignorance:
Smites the ground, dealing DMG to enemies once.
Releases a large amount of flammable gas that Ignites both allies and enemies alike, and Ignited allies have their Attack increased by 3%. This effect stacks.
After that, this character becomes Berserk.
skillText.自身生命值低于30%时，回复自身30%生命值，仅1次: When this character's HP drops below 30%, restores 30% of Max HP. This effect can be triggered only once.
skillText.在面前制造雪球抵御伤害，同时自身【霸体】，持续5秒\\n持续期间，雪球每秒获得1:
Summons a giant snowball that absorbs incoming damage. Gains Hyperarmor for 5 seconds.
During this period, the snowball gains durability equal to 10% of this character's HP per second.
After Hyperarmor expires, pushes the snowball against enemies, dealing DMG once and Chilling them.
The size of the snowball and the damage it deals are determined by the snowball's remaining durability.
skillText.腾空翻滚，对范围内敌方造成5段伤害并【击退】\\n同时触发【冻结】: Launches an aerial spinning attack, dealing DMG to enemies over 5 hits and knocking them back.\nChills the targets.
skillText.展开液氮喷射装置，形成环境【开尔文笑话】\\n使全场【冻结】状态下的目标【崩坏】: Deploys the liquid nitrogen sprayer generates the environment Kelvin Joke.\nWhenever a unit (allies and enemies alike) is Chilled, additionally inflicts Corrupt on them. This effect lasts 12 seconds.\nDuring this period, Chills a random enemy every second.
skillText.受到的物理伤害提高50%\\n免疫【冻结】/【冰封】/【打断】/【击晕】/【击退: Timbersaw takes 50% more Physical DMG and gains immunity to [Chill], [Freeze], [Interrupt], [Stun], [Knockback], [Launch], [Sleep], and [Moemoe].
skillText.每20秒触发，将自身攻击力和防御力重置为初始值，同时自身最大生命值提高10%，可: Every 20 seconds, reset the enemy's ATK and DEF to their initial value, and increase its Max HP by 10%. This effect stacks.
skillText.敌方使用手牌或队长技时，生成1张【负能】进入敌方牌库: Whenever you use a card or a [Leader Skill], generate 1 [Reverengy] in your deck.
skillText.战斗开始时，敌我方全体精力值/怒气值提高至上限: At the start of battle, fill the Energy and Fury gauge of all allies and enemies.
skillText.战斗开始时获得99层【誓言】，全场触发【撕裂】/【斩裂】/【蚀灭】时失去1层【誓: Demised Oath gains 99 stacks of [Oath] at the start of battle. Whenever a unit (allies and enemies alike) inflicts [Rend], [Slash], or [Erode], Demised Oath loses 1 stack of [Oath] and gains 1 stack of [Oathbreaker].\n[Oath]: Take 0.5% less Final DMG. This effect stacks.\n[Oathbreaker]: Deal 0.5% less Final DMG. This effect stacks.
skillText.受到的混响伤害提高50%\\n免疫【冻结】/【冰封】/【打断】/【击晕】/【击退: Demised Oath takes 50% more Reverb DMG and gains immunity to [Chill], [Freeze], [Interrupt], [Stun], [Knockback], [Launch], [Sleep], and [Moemoe].
skillText.对范围内敌方造成4段负能伤害，同时将造成伤害的250%治疗自身: Deal Reverengy DMG to your nearby allies over 4 hits and heal the enemy for 250% of the DMG dealt.
skillText.对敌方全体造成1段负能伤害，并使其造成的最终伤害降低20%，持续20秒: Deal Reverengy DMG to all your allies once and reduce their Final DMG dealt by 20%, lasting 20 seconds.
skillText.重置自身攻击力，随后对敌方全体造成3段负能伤害并【蚀灭】，同时触发【破盾】\\n: Reset the enemy's ATK, then deal Reverengy DMG to all your allies over 3 hits and inflict [Erode] and [Break].\nEach of your allies have one of their random cards' Cost increased by 3, then generate 1 [Elemental Core] in your hand.\nThe enemy gains immunity to crowd-control effects when channeling this skill.
skillText.每10秒生成1张随机【元素核】加入敌方手牌\\n首次触发为战斗开始后5秒: Generate 1 random [Elemental Core] in your hand every 10 seconds.\nThis effect is first triggered 5 seconds after the battle begins.
skillText.每60秒触发，双方全体的生命值上限降低20%，同时回复50%生命值: Reduce all units' Max HP by 20% and heal them for 50% of Max HP every 60 seconds.
skillText.全场触发【波】/【斩裂】时自身防御力降低2点，上限500\\n嚎虎箱能够免疫部分: Whenever a [Wave] or [Slash] is triggered on the battlefield, reduce the enemy's DEF by 2, up to 500.\nHowlingBox gains immunity to [Freeze], [Stun] and [Interrupt]. Whenever HowlingBox nullifies these effects, increase its Max HP by 2%, up to 200%.
skillText.敌方使用【队长技】时，生成1~2张费用为9的【元素核】进入敌方手牌: When using a [Leader Skill], generate 1 or 2 9 Cost [Elemental Core] in your hand.
skillText.受到的物理伤害提高50%\\n免疫【禁锢】/【枷锁】/【诅咒】: The enemy takes 50% more Physical DMG and gains immunity to [Fetter], [Imprison] and [Curse].
skillText.敌方使用红卡时，双方全体攻击力提高3点，上限150\\n敌方使用蓝卡时，自身失去: Whenever you use a Red card, increase the ATK of all units on the field by 3, up to 150.\nWhenever you use a Blue card, the enemy loses 1 stack of [Oathbreaker].
skillText.全场触发【波】/【斩裂】时敌方获得0.2费用\\n自身受到的冰冻/电磁/火焰伤害: The enemy takes 35% less Frost, Electro and Fire DMG.\nWhenever a unit (allies and enemies alike) triggers [Wave] or [Slash], you gain 0.2 Cost.
skillText.每10秒触发，对敌方全体造成2025点真实伤害: Deal 2025 True DMG to all your allies once every 10 seconds.
skillText.每当敌方黑卡入手时，生成1张【负能】进入敌方牌库: Whenever you gain a Black hand card, generate a [Reverengy] in your deck.
skillText.受到的物理伤害提高50%\\n受到的火焰伤害降低50%: The enemy takes 50% more Physical DMG and 50% less Fire DMG.
skillText.体型减小50%，攻击速度提高50%: Reduce Mole's body size by 50% and increase his attack speed by 50%.
skillText.生命值低于50%时触发，使双方全体回复100%生命值，同时生命值上限降低50%，: When the enemy's HP falls below 50%, fully heal all units on the battlefield, and reduce Max HP by 50%. This effect can be triggered only once.
skillText.免疫【点燃】，同时受到的最终伤害降低60%，持续120秒\\n受到100次物理伤: The enemy gains immunity to [Ignite] and takes 60% less Final DMG, lasting 120 seconds.\nRemove this effect immediately when the enemy takes Physical DMG over 100 hits.
skillText.受到的物理伤害提高50%\\n受到的冰冻伤害降低50%: The enemy takes 50% more Physical DMG and 50% less Frost DMG.
skillText.体型增大50%，精力恢复速度提高25%: Increase the enemy's body size by 50% and Energy regen speed by 25%.
skillText.免疫【冻结】，同时受到的最终伤害降低60%，持续120秒\\n受到100次物理伤: The enemy gains immunity to [Chill] and takes 60% less Final DMG, lasting 120 seconds.\nRemove this effect immediately when the enemy takes Physical DMG over 100 hits.
skillText.受到的混响伤害提高50%，同时自身生命值上限翻倍: The enemy takes 50% more Reverb DMG and has Max HP increased by 100%.
skillText.开局自身造成的最终伤害降低50%，随后每15秒自身造成的最终伤害提高10%，可叠: The enemy deals 50% less Final DMG at the start of battle. Its Final DMG dealt increases by 10% every 15 seconds. This effect stacks.
skillText.敌方使用【队长技】时，生成1张【负能】进入敌方牌库\\n敌方黑卡入手时，抽1张卡: When you cast a [Leader Skill], generate a [Reverengy] in your deck.\nWhen you gain a Black hand card, draw a card.
skillText.每次释放【尸山血河】后获得50点精力值: Whenever casting [Holocaust], the enemy gains 50 Energy.
skillText.投射催泪瓦斯弹，对敌方全体造成10段物理伤害并触发【目盲】\\n【目盲】：8秒内: Launch a tear gas grenade, dealing Physical DMG to all your allies over 10 hits and inflicting [Blind].\n[Blind]: During the next 8 seconds, whenever using a [Basic Attack], there's a 25%, 25%, 25% and 25% chance for them to gain [Imprison], [Fetter], [Confuse] or no effect. When a negative effect is triggered this way, dispel [Blind].
skillText.受到火焰伤害后，在随后的10秒内普通攻击的【击退】概率提高至100%: When taking Fire DMG, this unit's [Basic Attacks] have a 100% chance to inflict [Knockback] within the next 10 seconds.
skillText.每次受到物理伤害时，使自身受到伤害降低5%，最高降低100%\\n当自身受到伤害: Whenever taking Physical DMG, reduce this unit's DMG taken by 5%, up to 100%.\nWhen this effect reaches 100%, discard all your Red hand cards and reset the effect.
skillText.每25秒一次，清除敌方全体所有增益效果: Dispel all your allies' buffs every 25 seconds.
skillText.受到的火焰/冰冻/电磁伤害降低35%\\n全场触发【点燃】/【炽地】/【燎原】/: The enemy takes 35% less Fire, Frost, and Electro DMG.\nWhenever a unit on the field inflicts [Ignite], [Blaze], [Wildfire], or [Inferno], the enemy gains 2, 4, 6, or 8 Energy respectively.
skillText.引动九天之雷对范围内敌方造成1段电磁伤害，同时触发【引雷】\\n每存在1名敌方，: Invoke lighting bolts from heavens, dealing Electro DMG to nearby targets once and inflicting [Electrify].\nFor each target hit, inflict it one more time.
skillText.每20秒触发1次，回复自身5%生命值，同时自身生命值上限提高5%: Every 20 seconds, heal self for 5% of Max HP and increase Max HP by 5%.
skillText.对敌方随机三个单位造成1段电磁伤害并【击飞】，同时生成一张【元素核·电】进入敌方: Deal Electro DMG once to three random targets and inflict [Launch], then generate 1 [Element Core: Electro] in your hand.
skillText.对敌方随机三个单位造成1段火焰伤害并【击飞】，同时生成一张【元素核·火】进入敌方: Deal Fire DMG once to three random targets and inflict [Launch], then generate 1 [Element Core: Fire] in your hand.
skillText.从牌库中抽取7张卡牌，每抽出1张卡牌对卡牌所有者造成1段电磁伤害\\n若抽出的卡: Draw 7 cards from the deck. For each card drawn, deal Electro DMG once to the card holder.\nIf the card is not Yellow, discard it and generate 1 [Element Core: Electro] in your hand.
skillText.从牌库中抽取7张卡牌，每抽出1张卡牌对卡牌所有者造成1段火焰伤害\\n若抽出的卡: Draw 7 cards from the deck. For each card drawn, deal Fire DMG once to the card holder.\nIf the card is not Red, discard it and generate 1 [Element Core: Fire] in your hand.
skillText.吸收手牌区所有【元素核】，对敌方全体造成1段电磁伤害，同时触发【雷域】，持续6秒: Absorb all [Element Cores] from your hand, dealing Electro DMG once to all your allies and triggering [Thunder Zone], lasting 6 seconds. Each absorbed [Element Core: Electro] extends its duration by 2 seconds.\n[Thunder Zone]: Inflict [Thunder] to all your allies every 2 seconds. If the target is under [Paralysis] effect, inflict [Bolt] instead.
skillText.吸收手牌区所有【元素核】，对敌方全体造成1段火焰伤害，同时触发【火域】，持续6秒: Absorb all [Element Cores] from your hand, dealing Fire DMG once to all your allies and triggering [Flame Zone], lasting 6 seconds. Each absorbed [Element Core: Fire] extends its duration by 2 seconds.\n[Flame Zone]: Deal Fire DMG once to all your allies every 2 seconds. If the target is under [Ignite] effect, deal 3 hits instead, and reduce their DEF by 10. This effect stacks.
skillText.开局生成环境【白日耀】，自身造成的伤害属性转变为电磁伤害\\n施放得意技后转换环: Generate the environment [Blazing Sun] at the start of battle change the attack attribute to Electro.\nWhen using an Ultimate, change the environment to [Solar Flame] and the attack attribute to Fire.
skillText.【元素核·火】/【元素核·电】入手时变为9费: Increase the Cost of [Element Core: Fire] and [Element Core: Electro] to 9 when they enter your hand.
skillText.电磁伤害提高30%，使用黄卡时自身触发【麻痹】: Increase Electro DMG by 30%. When using a Yellow card, inflict [Paralysis] on the card holder.
skillText.火焰伤害提高30%，使用红卡时自身触发1次【点燃】: Increase Fire DMG by 30%. When using a Red card, inflict [Ignite] on the card holder.
skillText.攻击力降低20%\\n受到的混响伤害降低50%: The enemy's ATK is reduced by 20%.\nThe enemy takes 50% less Reverb DMG.
skillText.开局使敌方前排单位攻击力提高200点，同时使敌方后排单位攻击力降低200点: At the start of battle, increase the ATK of your frontline units by 200, and reduce the ATK of your rearline units by 200.
skillText.受到的火焰伤害提高50%\\n开局回复自身50%精力值: The enemy takes 50% more Fire DMG and gain 50% Energy at the start of battle.
skillText.开局标记敌方前排单位，令其受到的伤害提高50%: At the start of battle, mark your frontline units and increase their DMG taken by 50%.
skillText.受到的最终伤害降低70%，持续120秒\\n每次受到冰冻/火焰伤害时，持续时间减: The enemy takes 70% less Final DMG, lasting 120 seconds. Whenever it takes Frost or Fire DMG, reduce the duration by 0.5 seconds.
skillText.生命值低于50%时触发，投影出自身的【复制体】进入战场，持续30秒\\n【复制体: When the enemy's HP falls below 50%, generate a [Replica] of it, lasting 30 seconds. [Replica] inherits 150% of the enemy's ATK and 50% of DEF.
skillText.受到的冰冻伤害提高50%\\n开局回复自身50%精力值: The enemy takes 50% more Frost DMG and gain 50% Energy at the start of battle.
skillText.受到的最终伤害降低50%，防御力提高50%: The enemy takes 50% less Final DMG and has DEF increased by 50%.
skillText.每10秒触发，回复自身10%生命值: Heal for 10% of Max HP every 10 seconds.
skillText.开局触发【不可陷之盾】，持续40秒: Trigger [Unbreakable Shield] at the start of battle, lasting 40 seconds.
skillText.攻击力提高300点，可叠加5层: Increase ATK by 300, stacking up to 5 times.
skillText.每损失10%的生命值则会为敌方全体附加1个【锚点】，尽可能获得【锚点】以接收遗失: For every 10% HP lost, inflict 1 [Anchor Point] to all your allies. Gain as many [Anchor Points] as possible to retrieve signals lost in the Unbewusstes.
skillText.防御力降低20%\\n受到的混响伤害降低50%: The enemy's DEF is reduced by 20%.\nThe enemy takes 50% less Reverb DMG.
skillText.每10秒自身体型增大10%，同时生命值上限提高10%，仅触发5次: The enemy's body size and its Max HP increase by 10% every 10 seconds. This effect can be triggered only 5 times.
skillText.自身免疫受到控制类特殊效果，触发免疫时令敌方攻击力最高的单位触发【狂暴】: The enemy gains immunity to crowd-control effects. When nullifying such effects, inflict [Berserk] on your ally with the highest ATK.
skillText.标记3个敌方目标，随后分别对第1个目标造成1段火焰伤害，对第2个目标造成3段火焰: Mark 3 targets, and deal Fire DMG to them over 1, 3 and 9 hits respectively.\nWhen the marks are active, for each of their skill card used, increase their Fire DMG taken by 10%.
skillText.生成3张【镜中的幸福】进入敌方牌库\\n【镜中的幸福】：对随机友方造成1段电磁伤: Generate 3 [Phantom Happiness] in your deck.\n[Phantom Happiness]: Deal Electro DMG to a random ally once and grant Serena 10 Energy. This card is [Destroyed] when used.
skillText.对随机敌方造成1段冰冻伤害，同时触发【星缚】\\n【星缚】：攻击力降低30%，友: Deal Frost DMG once and inflict [Starbind].\n[Starbind]: Reduce ATK by 30%. When an ally uses a skill card, move this effect to them, deal Frost DMG once and inflict [Chill] to them. This effect expires after moving 6 times.
skillText.消耗全部【光华】，召唤星辰坠落，对范围内敌方造成1段混响伤害并附加等同层数的【瑕: Summon the falling stars. Consume all [Radiance] stacks and apply equal [Flaw] stacks to allies in range. Deal Reverb DMG to them once and randomly inflict [Imprison], [Fetter], [Curse] or [Confuse] once.\nFor each [Perpetual Reincarnation] cast, inflict the above negative effects once more.
skillText.战斗开始后，每10秒获得1层【光华】\\n敌方卡牌入手时费用-1，同时令持有者获:
Gain 1 stack of [Radiance] every 10 seconds.
When a card enters your hand, reduce its Cost by 1, and apply 1 stack of [Flaw] to the card holder. If the Cost becomes 0, apply 1 stack of [Radiance] to Serena.
When you use a card, remove 1 stack of [Flaw] from the card holder.
[Radiance]: Increase Max HP by 1%. This effect stacks.
[Flaw]: Reduce Max HP by 1%. This effect stacks.
skillText.每次释放【终幕·星辰陨落】后，按照顺序将自身技能切换为【永恒的别离】/【镜中的幸: After casting [Finale·Starfall], draw your cards to a full hand, and Serena will cast [Eternal Farewell], [Phantom Happiness] and [Restrained Dote] sequentially.
skillText.每15秒触发，召唤1颗陨石，对范围内敌方造成1段真实伤害，同时使目标造成的最终伤: Triggers every 15 s, summoning a meteor to deal one hit of true DMG to enemies within range, simultaneously reducing the target's Final DMG by 5%, up to 50%.
skillText.每10秒触发，驱散自身所有负面效果，同时自身攻击力提高5%，可叠加: Dispel all negative effects from the enemy every 10 seconds and increase her ATK by 5%. This effect stacks.
skillText.每30秒触发1次，敌方全体每秒受到5%生命值的真实伤害，持续10秒: All your allies take True DMG that equals 5% of Max HP once per second, lasting 10 seconds. This effect is triggered every 30 seconds.
skillText.敌方单位生命值低于50%时触发，血影骨龙立即释放1次【尸山血河】，触发后冷却10: When the enemy unit's HP is below 50%, Sanguine Skeleton immediately unleashes [Corpse Mountain Blood River] x1, with a cooldown of 10s after triggering.
skillText.持续发射火焰灼烧范围内敌方，每秒造成1段火焰伤害，持续7秒\\n持续时间结束后发: Continuously emit flames in the front, dealing Fire DMG once per second, lasting 7 seconds.\nAfterward, launch a fire bomb that deals Fire DMG once and inflicts [Stun] and [Blaze].
skillText.使用机枪进行3轮弹药倾泻，每秒对随机敌方造成7段物理伤害，持续7秒\\n每轮弹药: Use a machine gun to unleash 3 rounds of strafe, dealing Physical DMG over 7 hits per second, lasting 7 seconds.\nThe strafes have a 3-second cooldown.
skillText.释放大量烟雾，持续期间自身无法被命中，同时敌方全体触发【狂暴】和【混乱】，持续7: Release a large amount of smoke, making itself untargetable during this period. Inflict [Berserk] and [Confuse] to all your allies, lasting 7 seconds.
skillText.同时启动喷火器和机枪，每秒造成1段火焰伤害，同时每秒对随机敌方造成7段物理伤害，: Activate the flamethrower and machine gun simultaneously, dealing Fire DMG once and Physical DMG over 7 hits per second, lasting 7 seconds.\nDuring this period, inflict [Suppressing Fire] on targets hit by both types of DMG.\n[Suppressing Fire]: Reduce ATK by 99%, lasting 1 second.
skillText.自身技能造成的火焰伤害令目标受到的治疗量降低1%，上限25%\\n自身技能造成的: Fire DMG dealt by this unit reduces the target's healing received by 1%, up to 25%.\nPhysical DMG dealt by this unit reduces the target's DEF by 1, up to 250.
skillText.英武机甲周期性获得【护盾】，护盾耐久等同自身50%已损失生命值。\\n【护盾】持: Herald Mecha VII periodically gains a [Shield]. The durability equals 50% of its HP lost.\nIf the [Shield] is not broken during its duration, heal the mecha for 50% of the remaining durability.
skillText.英武机甲能够战斗3分钟，持续期间免疫全部控制效果，3分钟后无法行动: Herald Mecha VII can fight for 3 minutes. During this period, it is immune to all crowd-control effects. It is disabled after 3 minutes.
skillText.开局自身受到的最终伤害降低30%，自身生命值首次低于50%时效果转变为造成的最终: The enemy takes 30% less Final DMG at the start of battle. When HP falls below 50% for the first time, change the effect to take 30% more Final DMG.
skillText.开局使敌方全体攻击力降低15%或防御力降低15%: Reduce all your allies' ATK or DEF by 15% at the start of battle.
skillText.每10秒触发，自身【普通攻击】速度提高10%，同时自身攻击力提高30点，可叠加1: Increase the enemy's [Basic Attack] speed by 10% and ATK by 30 every 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.
skillText.自身受到的治疗效果提高100%\\n战斗开始60秒后移除上述效果，同时禁用【弃牌: The enemy takes 100% more healing.\nThis effect is removed 60 seconds after the start of battle. At the same time, disable your [Discard] action and [Leader Skill], lasting 20 seconds.
skillText.对前方范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害并【击晕】: Deal 1 hit of physical DMG to enemies within range and [Stun].
skillText.任意敌方单位对自身造成伤害时均有5%的概率使其获得1层【毒蚀】\\n【毒蚀】：攻: When any enemy unit deals DMG, there is a 5% chance for it to gain 1 stack of [Toxic]\n[Toxic]: Attack  is reduced by 25 points, can stack up to 8 times, and when [Purge] is triggered, layers -2
When both sides trigger [Slash], they gain 0.5 Energy \nWhen both sides trigger [Electrify], the enemy gains 0.1 Cost
skillText.敌方每使用1张卡牌，自身攻击力+2，上限750: When the opponent uses 1 card, own ATK +2, limit 750
skillText.免疫【冻结】/【冰封】，同时受到的冰冻伤害降低50%: The enemy gains immunity to [Chill] and [Freeze], and takes 50% less Frost DMG.
skillText.每秒使双方全体造成的最终伤害降低0.5%，上限50%: Reduce the Final DMG dealt by all units by 0.5% per second, up to 50%.
skillText.每秒概率生成1张【元素核·冰】进入敌方手牌，同时敌方红卡入手时费用变为3: There's a chance to generate 1 [Element Core: Frost] in your hand every second. Change the Red cards' Cost to 3 when they enter your hand.
skillText.开局使自身受到的物理伤害降低100%，该效果在50秒内持续降低至0%\\n开局使: The enemy takes 100% less Physical DMG at the start of battle. This effect gradually decreases to 0% within 50 seconds.\nThe enemy takes 0% more Reverb DMG at the start of battle. This effect gradually increases to 100% within 50 seconds.
skillText.黑卡销毁时，双方全体生命值上限降低3%，同时攻击力提高3%: When a Black card is destroyed, all units on the battlefield have their Max HP reduced by 3% and ATK increased by 3%.
skillText.开局生成6张【负能】进入敌方牌库: At the start of battle, generate 6 [Reverengy] in your deck.
skillText.每30秒触发1次，敌方每秒受到10%生命值的真实伤害，持续10秒: Triggers x1 every 30s, causing the enemy to take true DMG equal to 10% of their HP per second for 10s.
skillText.战场被火焰覆盖，每6秒对双方全体造成1段火焰伤害，同时触发【点燃】: The battlefield is engulfed in flames. Deal Fire DMG and inflict [Ignite] to all units on the field once every 6 seconds.
skillText.开局禁用【弃牌】，持续20秒: Disable [Discard] action at the start of battle, lasting 20 seconds.
skillText.开局使敌方全体造成的最终伤害降低20%，同时防御力提高20%: Reduce all your allies' Final DMG dealt by 20% and increase their DEF by 20% at the start of battle.
skillText.敌方角色的卡牌入手时无法使用，持续3秒\\n开局自身获得【护盾】，持续期间自身受: Cards cannot be used within 3 seconds after being obtained.\nThe enemy gains a [Shield] at the start of battle. It reduces the enemy's Fire, Electro, Frost and Physical DMG taken by 30%. Its durability equals 50% of the enemy's Max HP.
skillText.弃牌区每有1张卡牌，敌方全体造成的最终伤害提高1%，上限50%: For each card in the discard pile, all enemies deal 1% more Final DMG, up to 50%.
skillText.双方所有概率触发机制概率+5%: All units on the field get a 5% increased chance to trigger effects.
skillText.受到的火焰/冰冻伤害降低80%: The enemy takes 80% less Fire and Frost DMG.
skillText.每30秒触发，自身生命值上限/防御力提高15%，仅触发4次\\n触发4次后自身【: Increase the enemy's Max HP and DEF by 15% every 30 seconds, up to 4 times. When the effect is triggered the fourth time, the enemy gains [Hyperarmor], lasting 30 seconds.
skillText.随机施放1次【御敌之雷】、【摩地之风】或【制衡之钥】: Randomly cast x1 [Thunder of Repulsion], [Wind of the Earth], or [Key of Balance].
skillText.自身连续触发5次特殊效果，每次触发使自身攻击力+5%或对生命值最高的敌方触发1次: Trigger a special effect 5 times consecutively, each trigger increases your ATK by 5% or triggers Thunder x1 on the enemy with the highest HP, and there is a 5% chance to trigger Bolt.
skillText.对敌方全体造成3段伤害，同时触发【点燃】和【燎原】: Deal 3 hits of DMG to all enemies while triggering Ignite and Wildfire.
skillText.使范围内敌方触发【冰封】，同时回复自身10点精力值: Cause enemies within range to trigger Freeze, while restoring 10 Energy to yourself.
skillText.对敌方全体造成1段的负能伤害或使敌方全体攻击力降低50%，持续10秒: Inflict 1 stack of Reverengy DMG to all enemies or reduce all enemies' ATK by 50% for 10s.
skillText.12秒内自身每秒触发1次特殊效果，每次触发对敌方全体造成1段无视防御的负能伤害或: Within 12s, trigger a special effect on itself every second: each time it triggers, it deals x1 hit of Reverengy DMG to all enemies ignoring DEF or recovers 5% of its lost HP.
skillText.自身技能触发的特殊效果造成伤害时，使自身受到治疗效果+5%，上限+100%: When the special effects triggered by one's skills deal DMG, increase self-received Healing effect by 5%, up to 100%.
skillText.每秒回复自身0.5%生命值: Regenerate 0.5% of own HP per second
skillText.【无弦之振】的持续时间延长3秒: The duration of [无弦之振] is extended by 3 s.
skillText.施放【训器】 、【 母球】或【无弦之振】 后，生成1张【负能】进入敌方手牌: After casting [Training Device], [Cue Ball], or [Stringless Vibration], generate 1 card of [Reverengy] into the opponent's hand.
skillText.对范围内敌方造成2段火焰伤害，同时触发【点燃】: Deal 2 hits of Fire DMG to enemies within range and simultaneously trigger Ignite.
skillText.对范围内敌方造成1段火焰伤害\\n将敌方目标的【点燃】持续时间延长3秒\\n将范: Cause 1 hit of Fire DMG to enemies within range\nExtend the duration of Ignite on the enemy unit by 3s\nExtend the duration of Blaze and Wildfire within range by 3s
skillText.对范围内敌方造成1段伤害并【击晕】，同时触发【急燃】\\n释放技能期间自身【霸体: Cause 1 hit of DMG to enemies within range and Stun, while triggering Flare.\nDuring skill release, gain Hyperarmor, and after releasing the skill, gain Berserk.
skillText.释放2次【点火】后，触发1次【炽地】\r释放3次【煽风】后，触发1次【燎原】: After releasing [Kindling] 2 times, trigger [Blaze] x1.\nAfter releasing [Fanning] 3 times, trigger [Wildfire] x1.
skillText.释放【煽风】后，使自身下1次【普通攻击】触发【点燃】: After using [Fanning], the next [Basic Attack] triggers [Ignite].
skillText.【断火】释放后，【急燃】成功结算燃烧伤害时，每结算1个【点燃】回复自身5%生命值: After releasing [Cut Off], when [Flare] successfully calculates burn DMG, restore 5% HP for each [Ignite] calculated and restore 10% HP for each [Blaze] calculated.
skillText.自身受到的生命值回复效果提高20%: The HP recovery effect received is increased by 20%
skillText.【煽风】的攻击距离提高: The attack range of [Fan the Flames] is increased.
skillText.战斗开始时，立即释放1次【点火】、【煽风】或【断火】: At the start of the battle, immediately release one [Kindling], [Fanning], or [Extinguishing].
skillText.本场战斗【普通攻击】射出的弹药数+1，限10次\\n同时水枪进入连点模式，持续6: [Basic Attack] launch an additional projectile, lasting 10 attacks.\nIn addition, water gun enters Burst Mode for 6 seconds. During this period, [Basic Attack] launch doubled projectiles.
skillText.基于自身当前生命值回复我方全体生命值，使我方全体生命值和自身相等: Based on her current HP, restores all allies' HP so that all allies' HP equals her own.
skillText.将【普通攻击】转化为：\\n发射【普通攻击】弹药数等量的【流影】，持续10秒\\: Enhance [Basic Attack]:\nFor the next 10 seconds, release [Watershade] equal to the number of [Basic Attack] projectiles.\nEach [Watershade] deals DMG once to random 3 times of [Basic Attack] projectiles.
skillText.每10秒使我方全体攻击力、防御力+2%，可叠加。同时恢复自身最大生命值2%的血量: Every 10s, increase ATK and DEF of all allies by 2%, stackable. Also restores 2% of own Max HP.
skillText.【连涌】增强为：\\n本场战斗【普通攻击】射出的弹药数+1，限10次\\n使我方:
Enhance [Burst Surge]:
In this battle, [Basic Attack] launch an additional projectile, lasting 10 attacks.
Increase the DMG of all allies' [Basic Attack] by 40%.
In addition, water gun enters Burst Mode for 6 seconds. During this period, [Basic Attack] launch doubled projectiles.
skillText.使用【盛夏泡影】后，使我方全体回复5%生命值\\n驱散场上的【炎热】/【酷热】/: When using [Summer Mirage], heal all enemies for 5% of Max HP.\nDispel [Burning], [Melting] and [Boiling] weather.\nDispel [Blaze], [Wildfire] and [Inferno] from the enemy field.
skillText.【连涌】增强为：\\n本场战斗【普通攻击】射出的弹药数+1，限10次\\n使我方:
Enhance [Burst Surge]:
In this battle, [Basic Attack] launch an additional projectile, lasting 10 attacks.
Increase the DMG of all allies' [Basic Attack] by 40%.
In addition, water gun enters Burst Mode for 6 seconds. During this period, [Basic Attack] launch doubled projectiles. When targeting allies, each projectile from [Basic Attack] heals the target for 0.5%  HP and dispels [Ignite].
skillText.开局额外获得20点精力值，使我方全体攻击力和防御力+3%，可叠加: Gain an additional 20 Energy at the start of battle, increasing all allies' ATK and DEF by 3%, can be stacked.
skillText.【海滨之花】增强为：\\n每8秒使我方全体攻击力、防御力+2%，可叠加。同时恢复: Enhance [Seaside Blossom]:\nIncrease allies' ATK and DEF by 2% every 8 seconds. This effect stacks. In addition, restore 2% of own Max HP.
skillText.每次使用【连涌】和【盛夏泡影】后，使我方全体【狂暴】: When using [Burst Surge] or [Summer Mirage], grant [Berserk] to all enemies.
skillText.静流的水弹对目标造成【湿润】状态\\n使目标受到的电磁伤害增加20%\\n使目标:
Shizuru's water projectile inflicts [Moisture] status on the target.
Increases Electro DMG taken by the target by 20%.
Reduces Fire DMG dealt by the target by 20%.
Increases the target's probability of gaining [Freeze] by 10%.
skillText.本场战斗【普通攻击】射出的弹药数+1\\n同时每发弹药有3%的概率触发【冰封】: In the battle, the number of projectile fired by [Basic Attack] +1.\nEach projectile has a 3% chance to trigger [Freeze].
skillText.自身回复精力值的过程无法被阻止，精力值满时释放【精神风暴】，同时不再释放【感知】: Jalhay's Energy restoration cannot be stopped in any way. When gaining full Energy, release [Psychic Storm] and stop casting [Perception].\n[Basic Attack] randomly casts [Emotion: Calmness], [Emotion: Joy] or [Emotion: Fury]. When they're cast in this way, reduce the DMG and healing dealt by 85%.
skillText.敌方手牌补充冷却时间增加2秒，持续10秒: The enemy's Card Regen CD is increased by 2s, lasting 10s.
skillText.展开【极化雷域】，持续10秒\\n持续期间，敌方弃牌区每增加1张卡牌，对生命值最: Activate [Polar Thunder Zone], lasting 10 s\nDuring this period, each card added to the enemy's discard pile will trigger [Lightning] on the enemy with the highest HP
skillText.每5秒【销毁】敌方手牌中的所有黑卡。每【销毁】1张，对生命值最高的敌方触发【落雷: Every 5 s, destroy all Black cards in the opponent's hand. For each card destroyed, trigger Lightning on the opponent with the highest HP.
skillText.敌方黄卡进入弃牌区时，基于该卡费用对生命值最高的敌方触发等量【落雷】: When an opposing Yellow card enters the discarded pile, trigger an equivalent amount of Lightning on the opponent with the highest HP based on the card's cost.
skillText.我方造成【落雷】/【轰雷】时，有50%概率触发【炽地】: When we cause [Lightning] / [Thunder], there is a 50% chance to trigger [Blaze].
skillText.全场造成【落雷】/【轰雷】时，自身攻击力+0.5%，上限99%: When causing [Lightning] / [Thunder] across the field, ATK +0.5%, up to 99%
skillText.全场造成【落雷】/【轰雷】时，回复生命值最低的我方单位0.1%/0.3%生命值: When the whole field causes [Lightning] / [Thunder], restore 0.1%/0.3% HP to the ally unit with the lowest HP.
skillText.自身每拥有1点精力值，我方全体造成的电磁伤害提高0.5%，上限50%: For every 1 point of Energy possessed, Electro DMG dealt by all allies is increased by 0.5%, up to 50%.
skillText.对敌方全体造成1段负能伤害，同时有30%的概率触发【昏睡】: Cause 1 hit of Reverengy DMG to all enemies, with a 30% chance to trigger [Sleep].
skillText.对敌方任意单位造成伤害时均有25%的概率使其获得1层【毒蚀】\\n【毒蚀】：攻击: When dealing DMG to any enemy unit, there is a 25% chance to make it gain 1 stack of [Toxic]\n[Toxic]: Attack is reduced by 25 points, can stack up to 8 times, when [Purge] is triggered, stacks -2
skillText.全场造成的【点燃】/【融心】/【烬灭】的伤害提高30%: Increase the DMG of "Ignite"/"Rongxin"/"Jinmie" caused throughout the match by 30%
skillText.对范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害并【击飞】: Deal 1 hit of physical DMG to enemies within range and [Launch] them.
skillText.在地面生成毒液黏潭，在黏潭范围内的全体单位攻击速度-30%，造成的最终伤害降低3: Generate a venomous sticky pool on the ground, reducing the attack speed of all units within the pool by 30% and their Final DMG by 30% for 6s.
skillText.每次【普通攻击】时触发，自身造成的最终伤害提高3%，可叠加10层: Charlotte's [Basic Attack] increases her Final DMG dealt by 3%, stacking up to 10 times.
skillText.生命值低于50%时，每秒回复自身0.3%生命值: When Charlotte's HP is below 50%, heal her for 0.3% of Max HP per second.
skillText.自身生命值首次低于50%时，自身触发【霸体】，持续20秒: When HP drops below 50% for the first time, gain [Hyperarmor], lasting 20 seconds.
skillText.全场造成的【冻结】/【冰封】/【冻伤】持续时间缩短50%\\n全场造成的【点燃】: [Chill], [Freeze] and [Frostbite] on the battlefield last 50% shorter.\n[Ignite], [Blaze], [Wildfire] and [Inferno] on the battlefield last 50% longer.
skillText.战斗开始后，敌方卡牌进入弃牌区时，双方受到的最终伤害提高0.5%，上限30%: When a card enters the discard pile, all units on the battlefield take 0.5% more Final DMG, up to 30%.
skillText.战斗开始时，吸取敌方全体5%防御力转化为自身防御力: The enemy absorbs 5% of all your allies' DEF.
skillText.战斗开始后，敌方卡牌进入弃牌区时，双方受到的治疗效果降低1%，上限60%: When a card enters the discard pile, all units on the battlefield receive 1% less healing, up to 60%.
skillText.战斗开始时，吸取敌方全体5%攻击力转化为自身攻击力: The enemy absorbs 5% of all your allies' ATK.
skillText.连续喷吐四个黏胞随机命中场上单位：\\n· 对命中的敌方单位造成1段负能伤害，同: Continuously unleash four mucocyte to randomly hit units on the field:\n· Deal one hit of Reverengy DMG to enemy units hit and trigger [Toxic]\n Heal allied units hit, restoring 5% of their Max HP
skillText.抛掷聚合黏胞对范围内敌方造成1段负能伤害并引爆【毒蚀】：每层【毒蚀】额外造成1段: Throwing the aggregated mucocyte causes 1 hit of Reverengy DMG to enemies within range and detonates [Toxic]: each stack of [Toxic] deals an additional hit of Reverengy DMG and reduces their max HP by 1%.\nAt the same time, a [Miasma] that lasts 10s is generated at the point of mucocyte explosion. Enemies within the range of [Miasma] suffer Reverengy DMG equal to 2% of their current HP per second.
skillText.开局检测手牌、牌库、弃牌区所有卡牌，根据红卡数和蓝卡数进行形态转换：\\n\\n:
At the start of battle, examine the number of Red and Blue cards in your hand, the deck and the discard pile and adjust stance accordingly.

If there are more Red cards, enter [Defensive Stance]:
Gain immunity to all crowd-control effects.
Whenever taking damage, heal and reduce Final DMG taken by 10%. DMG reduction stacks up to 10 times, and resets when reaching the maximum stacks.
All Red cards have their Cost reduced by 2 when drawn, and other cards increased by 1.

If there are more Blue cards, enter [Offensive Stance]:
Increase ATK by 10% and reduce DEF by 10%.
Attacks deal additional True DMG equal to 5% of the target's Max HP.
All Blue cards have their Cost reduced by 2 when drawn, and other cards increased by 1.

If the numbers of Red and Blue cards are equal or at 0, enter [Balanced Stance]:
DMG taken per hit won't exceed 3% of Max HP.
Attacks deal additional True DMG equal to 3% of the target's Max HP.
All cards have their Cost randomly increased or reduced by 2 when drawn.
skillText.每秒使自身受到的治疗量降低0.5%，受到的最终伤害提高0.5%，上限60%: Reduce the enemy's healing received by 0.5% and increase their Final DMG taken by 0.5% every second, up to 60%.
skillText.每秒使自身受到的治疗量降低0.5%，造成的最终伤害降低0.5%，上限30%: Reduce the enemy's healing received by 0.5% and increase their Final DMG dealt by 0.5% every second, up to 30%.
skillText.场上存在敌方单位处于【点燃】状态时，对其造成1段火焰伤害: When there is an enemy unit on the field in an [Ignite] status, deal 1 hit of Fire DMG to it.
skillText.对范围内敌方造成1段物理伤害，同时触发【麻痹】和【毒蚀】: Deals 1 hit of physical DMG to enemies within range, triggering [Paralysis] and [Toxic].
skillText.使随机敌方单位陷入持续6秒的痛觉幻境，每层【毒蚀】会使幻境延长2秒，幻境持续期间: Cause a random enemy unit to fall into a pain illusion that lasts 6s. Each layer of [Toxic] extends the illusion by 2s. During the illusion, inflict 1 hit of Reverengy DMG per second on the target and [Stun] them.
skillText.短暂延迟后将毒素汇聚至目标区域并引爆，对范围内敌方造成1段负能伤害，同时触发【打: After a brief delay, gather the venom to the target area and detonate it, causing 1 hit of Reverengy DMG to enemies within range, while triggering [Interrupt] and [Toxic].
skillText.使敌方全体【毒蚀】层数+1，随后引爆敌方全体的【毒蚀】，每层【毒蚀】引爆时降低目: Increase the number of [Toxic] stacks on all enemies by 1, then detonate the [Toxic] on all enemies. Each stack of [Toxic] reduces the target's Max HP by 5% upon detonation and deals 1 hit of Reverengy DMG, lasting 6s.
skillText.自身在场时，带有【毒蚀】的单位使用卡牌时有30%概率使其【毒蚀】层数+1\\n【: When present, there is a 30% chance for units with [Toxic] to have their [Toxic] stacks increased by 1 when they use a card.\n[Toxic]: ATK is reduced by 25 points, can stack up to 8 times, and decreases by 2 stacks when [Purge] is triggered.
skillText.受到【裂蚀】、【撕裂】伤害时使自身的生命值上限提高0.1%，上限100%。受到【: When taking [Corrode] or [Rend] DMG, increase maximum HP by 0.1%, up to a limit of 100%. When taking DMG from [Slash] or [Erode], increase ATK by 1, up to a limit of 1000.
skillText.敌方单位的【毒蚀】层数达到8层时消耗4层【毒蚀】并使其获得【濒死感】，重复获得【: When the enemy unit's stacks of [Toxic] reach 8, consume 4 stacks of [Toxic] and make it gain [Death Impending]. Repeatedly gaining [Death Impending] resets the duration.\n[Death Impending]: Max HP is reduced by 30%, and received healing effects are reduced by 30%, lasting 8s.
skillText.每10秒触发，自身受到的火焰伤害提高3%，同时自身所有概率触发机制概率+1%: Every 10 s, increases the Fire DMG received by 3%, while all self probability-trigger mechanisms probability +1%.
skillText.敌方每使用1张卡牌，自身防御力+2，上限750: For each card the opponent uses, increase own DEF by 2, up to 750.
skillText.对生命值最高的目标造成1点负能伤害，同时触发【熔心】，持续6秒: Deal 1 point of Reverengy DMG to the target with the highest HP and trigger "Heartblaze" for 6 seconds.
skillText.对生命值最低的敌方目标造成1段负能伤害，同时触发【诅咒】，持续6秒: Deal 1 segment of Reverengy DMG to the enemy unit with the lowest HP, while triggering [Curse], lasting 6 seconds.
skillText.解除自身防御力降低效果，同时对随机敌方造成3段负能伤害: Remove the effect of reduced defense on self, and simultaneously inflict 3 segments of Reverengy DMG on a random enemy.
skillText.召唤虚无之潮席卷全场，对敌方全体造成1段真实伤害，同时触发【浸湿】\\n【浸湿】: Summon a tide of void to sweep the field, dealing 1 segment of true DMG to all enemies while triggering [Soggy]\n[Soggy]: Each stack increases Card Regen cooldown by 1 second, can be stacked up to 9 layers.
skillText.释放技能后会溢散部分元素能，使敌方全体触发【元素侵蚀】，同时自身下1次受到控制类: After releasing the skill, a portion of elemental energy will dissipate, causing all enemies to trigger [Elemental Erosion]. The next time it suffers a control-type special effect, triggers [Purge] and increases its DEF by 3%\n[Elemental Erosion]: Increases dealt Fire/Frost/Electro DMG by 3%, while reducing triggered Healing/Shield effects by 6%, up to 60%
skillText.战斗开始时，立即释放1次【时溯潮涌】\\n自身濒死时，触发【净化】并反转自身的防: At the start of the battle, immediately release x1 [Temporal Surge].\nWhen taking fatal damage, trigger [Purge] and reverse the decrease in your defense, while immediately releasing x1 [Temporal Surge]. After being triggered, your maximum HP becomes 0 and you die instantly.
skillText.战斗开始时，将自身的全部攻击力以30%的比例转化为自身防御力\\n自身进行攻击时: At the start of the battle, convert 30% of all its ATK into DEF\nWhen attacking, calculate DMG based on its DEF.
skillText.解除自身的防御力降低效果，同时对随机敌方造成3段负能伤害: Remove its own DEF Reduc, while inflicting 3 hits of Reverengy DMG to random enemies.
skillText.自身防御力+60%，开局60秒后增益减半: Own DEF +60%, gain halved after 60 s from the start of battle.
skillText.每秒触发，双方造成的最终伤害提高0.5%，造成的治疗/护盾效果降低0.5%，上限: Triggers every second, increasing both parties' Final DMG by 0.5% and reducing Healing/shield effects by 0.5%, up to 30%.
skillText.生命值首次低于50%时触发，自身体型缩小50%，同时触发【火海】，持续20秒: When HP first drops below 50%, body size is reduced by 50% and triggers Inferno for 20s.
skillText.对敌方全体造成1段火焰伤害，同时触发【点燃】。之后对敌方全体造成1段火焰伤害，同: Deal 1 segment of Fire DMG to all enemies and trigger Ignite. Then deal 1 segment of Fire DMG to all enemies and trigger Detonate.
skillText.辉夜进行翻滚斩击，规避翻滚过程中受到的伤害，同时对敌方全体造成1段物理伤害并【撕: Kaguya performs a rolling slash, avoiding DMG during the roll, while dealing 1 instance of physical DMG and inflicting Rend on all enemies. Then, she deals 2 instances of physical DMG and 1 instance of Fire DMG to all enemies.
skillText.对敌方全体造成5段物理伤害，之后处决当前生命值低于10%的敌方单位，使目标立即死: Deal 5 segments of physical DMG to all enemies, then execute enemy units with current HP below 10%, causing the target to die immediately. For each stack of Ignite on the target unit, increase the execution threshold by 1%.
skillText.辉夜对敌方单位造成伤害时有10%概率触发【点燃】: When Kaguya deals DMG to enemy units, there is a 10% chance to trigger [Ignite].
skillText.辉夜受到的电磁伤害提高100%。每受到50次电磁伤害，会生成等同于自身最大生命值: Kaguya's Electro DMG taken is increased by 100%. For every 50 instances of Electro DMG received, a shield equal to 10% of her max HP is generated, lasting 30 seconds. While the shield is active, it absorbs 50% of the Electro DMG taken and converts it into HP.
skillText.辉夜濒死时获得等同于自身最大生命值20%的【护盾】，并立即施放一次【星天辉夜】。: When Kaguya takes fatal damage, gain a shield equal to 20% of her maximum HP and immediately cast "Starry Sky Kaguya." In each battle, "Crescent Moon" can be triggered only once.
skillText.敌方造成【冻结】/【冰封】/【封冻】延长2秒: The enemy causes Chill/Freeze/Megafreeze extended by 2 seconds.
skillText.开局触发，自身防御力提高30%: At the start of battle, increase own defense by 30%
skillText.开局使所有黄卡费用永久+1: At the start of battle, increase the cost of all Yellow cards permanently by 1
skillText.召唤一股黑暗激流，对范围内敌方造成1段负能伤害并【打断】: Summon a surge of darkness, dealing 1 segment of Reverengy DMG to enemies within range and [Interrupt].
skillText.召唤巨浪对敌方全体造成1段负能伤害并【击退】距离较近的敌方单位: Summon a giant wave to deal 1 segment of Reverengy DMG to all enemies and [Knockback] nearby enemy units.
skillText.召唤【发光诱饵】，诱饵会持续【嘲讽】敌方单位，持续10秒\\n若持续期间诱饵被击: Summon a [Luminous Decoy], which will continuously [Taunt] enemy units for 10 seconds.\nIf the decoy is destroyed during this period, you lose 2 stacks of [Deep Sea Darkness].\nIf the decoy is not destroyed during this period, the Cost of all enemy cards will be randomly increased.
skillText.释放过程中自身【霸体】，同时获得可再生1次的【护盾】\\n进行持续12秒的蓄力，: During the release process, activate your own [Hyperarmor], and simultaneously gain a renewable x1 [Shield].\nCharge for a continuous 12 seconds; if the above-mentioned [Shield] is broken during this period, the charge fails.\nUpon successful charging, deal one instance of physical DMG to enemies within range. If the target has [Deep Wounds], it converts to true DMG.
skillText.每15秒触发，获得1层【深海黑暗】，可叠加4层\\n每层使自身有12%的概率闪避: Triggers every 15 seconds, gain 1 stack of [Abyssal Darkness], can stack up to 4 layers\nEach layer grants a 12% chance to evade incoming attacks
skillText.每次释放【深渊吞噬】时吸取敌方全体5%攻击力，持续20秒\\n每次造成技能伤害时: Each time [Abyssal Devour] is released, absorb 5% attack power from all enemies for 20 seconds.\nEach time skill DMG is dealt, there is a 10% probability to cause the target to gain 1 stack of [Deep Wound].\n[Deep Wound]: Upon triggering, take 1 instance of true DMG and defense is reduced by 5%, stackable. Stacks are cleared when [Purge] is triggered.
skillText.自身受到的负能伤害提高50%: DMG taken from Reverengy increased by 50%
skillText.全场造成的【引雷】伤害提高50%: The Electrify DMG dealt by the whole team is increased by 50%
skillText.全场不论敌我，触发【引雷】时，回复我方全体1%生命值，每秒最多触发1次: Regardless of friend or foe, when Electrify is triggered, restore 1% HP to all allies, up to x1 per second.
skillText.每有1名【掘金1号】或【掘金2号】进入【瘫痪】状态，回复自身50%已损失生命值，: For each Nugget Mech 1 or Nugget Mech 2 entering Breakdown status, restore 50% of own lost HP, while increasing/reducing DMG dealt/received by 20%, limited to 3 times.
skillText.濒死时回复自身50%生命值，同时额外触发【独狼】，限3次: Recover 50% HP when taking fatal damage and additionally trigger [Lone Wolf], up to 3 times.
skillText.战斗开始时在敌方手牌生成1张【桎梏】\\n【桎梏】：此卡禁止使用，红卡入手时费用: At the start of the battle, generate 1 "Shackle" in the enemy's hand.\n[Shackle]: This card cannot be used. Cost is reduced by 1 when a Red card is drawn. After triggering 5 times, it will automatically Destroy, and all allies gain "Prisoner" Status while removing the enemy's "Caged" Status.\n[Prisoner]: HP limit is increased by 100%, Healing received is reduced by 50%, cannot be dispelled.
