skillText.受到的冰冻/火焰/电磁伤害提高\\n受到的物理/混响/负能伤害降低: Increased Frozen/Flame/Electro DMG received\nReduced Physical/Reverberation/Reverengy DMG received
skillText.友方单位阵亡时，回复自身5%生命值，同时自身受到的伤害降低，可叠加: When an allied unit is defeated, restore 5% of your own HP and reduce the DMG you receive; this effect can stack.
skillText.受到的冰冻/火焰/电磁伤害降低\\n受到的物理/混响/负能伤害提高: Reduced ice/flame/Electro DMG received\nIncreased physical/reverberation/Reverengy DMG received
skillText.开局自身受到的伤害大幅度降低\\n友方单位阵亡时，减伤效果降低: At the start of battle, the DMG received is significantly reduced.\nWhen an allied unit dies, the damage reduction effect decreases.
skillText.自身受到的非电磁伤害降低30%: Non-Electro DMG received is reduced by 30%
skillText.自身受到的非负能伤害降低30%: Non-Reverengy DMG received is reduced by 30%
skillText.双方所有概率触发机制概率+10%: All probability-trigger mechanisms on both sides +10% probability
skillText.每15秒触发1次，若敌方牌库中不存在【负能】，将5张【负能】加入敌方牌库底；: Every 15 seconds triggers x1, if there is no Reverengy in the opponent's deck, add 5 Reverengy to the bottom of the opponent's deck;
skillText.生命值低于10%时触发，恢复自身30%生命值，敌方牌库、手牌和弃牌区中每有1张【: When HP is below 10%, it triggers, restoring 30% of your own HP. For each Reverengy in the enemy's deck, hand, and Discarded, restore an additional 10% HP, which can stack; simultaneously remove all attribute-reducing effects from yourself and remove all attribute-increasing effects from the enemy. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
skillText.生命值低于10%时触发，敌方牌库、手牌和弃牌区中每有1张【负能】，自身造成的伤害: When HP is below 10%, it triggers an effect where, for each Reverengy in the enemy's deck, hand, and Discarded pile, your DMG increases by 25%, which can stack. It clears all "stances" on the field and directly releases Darkest Hour x1. Simultaneously, it removes all negative attributes from yourself and all positive attributes from the enemy. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
skillText.每10秒触发，自身造成和受到的冰冻与负能伤害提高5%: Triggers every 10 seconds, increasing its own ice and Reverengy DMG dealt and received by 5%
skillText.每30秒触发1次，使敌方后排造成的伤害降低50%，持续15秒: Triggers every 30 seconds, reducing the DMG dealt by the enemy Rear by 50% for 15 seconds.
skillText.开局自身触发【霸体】，持续90秒\\n每10秒触发，自身攻击力提高，可叠加4次: At the start of battle, triggers Hyperarmor, lasting 90 seconds. \nTriggers every 10 seconds, increasing own attack power, can stack up to 4 times.
skillText.对敌方全体造成1段物理伤害并【击飞】。若敌方单位身上存在【护盾】，则【荆棘之径】: Deal 1 segment of physical DMG to all enemies and Launch them. If enemy units have a Shield, the Launch effect of Thorny Path is converted to Shield Break.
skillText.吸取敌方全体10%的攻击力和防御力增幅自身，持续10秒。之后对敌方全体造成1段物: Absorb 10% of all enemies' attack and defense to amplify self for 10 seconds. Then inflict 1 segment of physical DMG to all enemies.
skillText.驱散自身所有负面状态，然后对周身范围内敌方单位造成1段物理伤害并【重伤】。之后聚: Dispel all negative status effects from oneself, then deal 1 instance of physical DMG and [Injure] to enemies within range. Subsequently, summon the Spiral Blast Drill, dealing 5 instances of physical DMG to all enemies.
skillText.尼禄受到控制类特殊效果时，对敌方全体造成1段物理伤害并【打断】。【钢头急先锋】每: When Nero is under control-type special effects, he deals 1 segment of physical DMG to all enemies and [Interrupts]. [Steelhead Vanguard] triggers only once every 10 seconds.
skillText.当场上存在生命值≤60%的单位时，召唤拟态对当前生命值最低的敌方目标造成1段物理: When there is a unit on the field with HP ≤ 60%, summon Mimic to deal 1 instance of physical DMG to the enemy unit with the lowest current HP, while also Healing itself for an amount equal to the DMG dealt. [Mimic Strike] triggers only once every 15 seconds.
skillText.自身受到的火焰/物理伤害提高50%: The DMG taken from flames/physical sources is increased by 50%
skillText.开战20秒触发，自身攻击力/防御力+30%，同时触发【净化】: Activates 20 seconds after the start of battle. Increases this unit's ATK and DEF by 30%, and triggers [Purge].
skillText.自身受到的混响/物理伤害提高50%: The reverb/physical DMG taken is increased by 50%
skillText.开局自身的生命值上限提高30%: At the start of battle, your HP limit increases by 30%.
skillText.每15秒触发，降低自身5%的生命值上限，同时触发【霸体】，持续10秒: Triggers every 15 seconds, reducing its own HP limit by 5% and simultaneously triggering "Hyperarmor," lasting 10 seconds.
skillText.造成伤害时有15%的概率触发【击晕】: When dealing DMG, there is a 15% chance to trigger [Stun]
skillText.挥舞【裂穹】，对敌方目标造成1段伤害: Wielding Realmbreaker, deals 1 hit of DMG to the enemy unit.
skillText.展开【裂蚀法界】持续10秒，持续期间：\\n自身受到的伤害降低50%: Unleash the Eclipse Realm for 10 seconds, during which:\nDMG taken is reduced by 50%.
skillText.同时挥动所有【裂穹】，释放8道裂穹波后全身突进终结斩击，对敌方全体造成9段伤害并: Swing all [Realmbreaker], release 8 Realmbreaker Waves, then dash forward with a finishing slash, dealing 9 hits of DMG to all enemies and [Slash].
skillText.乌刹娜拥有250点怒气值上限，怒气值不会自动回复\\n每次使用【斩！】获得30点:
Ushana has a maximum rage value of 250, and rage does not regenerate automatically.
Each use of [Slash!] gains 30 rage points.
Every time Ushana causes [Slash], gain 5 rage points.
Every time Ushana causes [Corrode], gain 15 rage points.
skillText.【斩！】增强为：\\n挥舞【裂穹】，对敌方目标造成1段伤害\\n同时随机触发【重: Slash! Enhanced to:\nWield Realmbreaker, dealing 1 hit of DMG to the enemy unit\nand randomly trigger Injure/Imprison/Fetter
skillText.每有1张黑卡在敌方牌库或手牌中时，每秒回复自身0.5%生命值\\n敌方牌库抽到【: For each Black card in the enemy deck or hand, restore 0.5% of own HP per second.\nWhen the enemy draws a [Reverengy] from the deck, release a [Realmbreaker] that pierces through the enemy unit, with each causing one hit of Reverengy DMG and [Corrode].
skillText.怒气值达到50/150时，本场战斗【斩！】额外造成1~2/2~3次【斩裂】: When the rage reaches 50/150, this battle's Slash! additionally inflicts 1~2/2~3 extra Slashes.
skillText.全场造成【斩裂】/【裂蚀】时，自身攻击力+0.5%，上限99%: When causing [Slash] / [Corrode] across the field, increase own attack power by 0.5%, up to 99%
skillText.释放【斩夜寰穹破魔光！】时，基于敌方牌库中的黑卡数量，额外释放等量的【裂穹】贯穿: When releasing the Ultimate Demon Breaker, based on the number of Black cards in the enemy's deck, additionally release an equal amount of Realmbreaker penetrating the enemy unit.
skillText.每次全场造成【斩裂】时，回复自身0.5%生命值: Every time a [Slash] is inflicted on the entire field, restore 0.5% of own HP.
skillText.开局即拥有50点怒气值\\n自身怒气值越高，处于【裂蚀】状态的敌方受到的伤害越高: At the start of battle, you have 50 Rage Points.\nThe higher your Rage Points, the more DMG the enemies in the [Corrode] status receive, up to 50%.
skillText.自身受到的非冰冻伤害降低30%: Non-Frost DMG received is reduced by 30%
skillText.双方所有【机械单位】造成的伤害提高75%: The DMG dealt by all Mech Units on both sides is increased by 75%.
skillText.生命值低于90%/70%/50%/30%/10%时触发，清除敌方所有攻击力提高效: When HP is below 90%/70%/50%/30%/10%, trigger to remove all enemy attack power increase effects, increase own attack power by 10%, can be stacked.
skillText.生命值低于100%/80%/60%/40%/20%时触发，使敌我方全体最大生命值: Triggered when HP is below 100%/80%/60%/40%/20%, increasing the maximum HP of all allies and enemies by 20%, while also increasing own attack power by 10%. This effect can stack.
skillText.投掷3枚【黏胶炸弹】附着随机敌方，持续5秒\\n持续期间，每秒对敌方目标造成1段: Toss 3 [Sticky Bombs] that attach to random targets, lasting 5 seconds.\nDuring this period, deal DMG once per second with a 20% chance to inflict [Interrupt].
skillText.每遇到1波敌人时，直接释放1次【致幻瓦斯】: When encountering a wave of enemies, immediately use [Hallucinogenic Gas] once.
skillText.自身受到的非物理/辉光伤害降低50%\\n自身不再拥有抗性和弱点\\n生命值越低: Takes 50% less damage (excluding Physical and Lux).\nThis unit does not have any resistance or weakness.\nThe lower the HP, the less Final DMG taken.
skillText.每次牌库抽光触发洗牌时，立刻获得100%精力值\\n【断海龙哮炮】同时触发【破盾: Whenever the deck is emptied and triggers a reshuffle, gains 100% Energy.\n[Dragonroar Blast] additionally inflicts [Break].
skillText.开局或每次牌库抽光触发洗牌时，为自身提供5层【龙魂】效果\\n我方乘员每使用1张:
At the start of battle or whenever the deck is emptied and triggers a reshuffle, gains 5 stacks of [Dragonsoul].
Whenever the enemy uses a Red card, dispels 1 stack of [Dragonsoul].
Each stack of [Dragonsoul] increases this unit's Final DMG dealt by 10%.
When this unit has 6 or more stacks, [Dragonroar Blast] additionally dispels the target's [Invincible] effect.
When this unit has 8 or more stacks, for each target [Dragonroar Blast] hits, heals this unit for 3% of Max HP.
When this unit has 10 or more stacks, [Dragonroar Blast] ignores the target's DEF.
skillText.远程充电【无人机】，将我方所有的【无人机】的续航时间延长2秒: Charge [Drones] remotely, making all allied [Drones] last 2 seconds longer.
skillText.每次“黑莓”出没时，自身攻击力+1%，上限50%: Whenever "Blackberry" takes an action, increase self ATK by 1%, up to 50%.
skillText.每积累十万【伏特值】，磁力巨浪造成的伤害提高10%，上限150%: For every 100K [Volt] accumulated, increases the DMG dealt by EM Wave by 10%, up to 150%.

StoryText.我是海因里希，修格里的铁安局负责人，于无垠号上临时驻留。就我们之间的信赖关系而言: I am Heinrich, administrator of Shoggolith's BCRL Agency. Temporarily staying on the Eternal. I'm sure you need no further introduction, considering the mutual trust we have.
StoryText.有什么我能帮上忙的？我对列车长需要处理的事务也还算了解。: Is there anything I can help you with? I'm quite familiar with the job scope of conductors.
StoryText.从在修格里城第一次见到你的时候，我就认为你是个有潜力的年轻人。看来我的眼光不错。: I have sensed that you are a youngster with great potential since the first time we met in Shoggolith City. It appears that my instinct is spot on.
StoryText.修格里城的工作？……哈哈，不用担心。即使我不在，我的同僚和下属也会将所有事务都处: My work in Shoggolith City? Haha... Don't worry. My colleagues and subordinates will manage everything well even without me around. I have faith in them.
StoryText.要怎么锻炼才能获得我这样的体格？列车长，希望你是在开玩笑……如果不是，就先去试着: How to work out to obtain the physique I have? I hope you are joking, Conductor... If you are not, then perhaps give the BCRL military training camp program a try for now.
StoryText.我的……妻子？她叫洛娅。我的原则是不在工作时谈太多私事，不过你想看她的照片的话，: My... wife? Her name is Loya. I don't discuss personal matters at work much, but I can show you a photo of her that I bring everywhere with me if you'd like.
StoryText.多萝西是个好孩子，我为她骄傲。……是的，即使她此前制造的数起爆炸事故和众多检讨报: Dorothy is a good kid. I'm proud of her. ...Yes, that is in spite of the multiple explosions she caused and the numerous reports she had to write up.
StoryText.修格里城不算是最安全的城市。虽说有大型的现实稳定装置，但城外地区桦树生物的侵扰非: Shoggolith City isn't considered the safest city. Although we have a large Reality Stabilizer, the areas outside the city very often have sightings of Chaos Remains, rogue waylayers, train robbers... and other never-ending troubles.
StoryText.列车上有伤员的话，我可以帮忙看护。我年轻时经常护送伤员去医院，学了不少看护和急救: If anyone's injured on the train, I can help to provide medical assistance. When I was younger, I had to chaperone the wounded to the hospital all the time, which gained me plenty of first aid and caregiving knowledge. That was also when I first met Loya.
StoryText.说起来你或许不会相信，但多萝西小时候是个身体病弱的孩子。我曾为此感到……愧疚。现: You may not believe this, but Dorothy was always in frail health as a child. It used to fill me with... guilt. Getting to see her joke and laugh with you now... means a lot to me, Conductor.
StoryText.要吃点东西吗？虽说不会做什么大餐，但家常菜我还是在行的。不想吃复杂的食物的话，我: Want something to eat? I can't make anything fancy, but home-cooked food is no problem for me. If you're not in the mood for anything complicated, I can make you a bowl of noodles.
StoryText.人的能力成长不仅体现在身体上，更重要的是所经历的事和所遇见的人……用浪漫点的说法: One's growth in ability isn't only reflected in one's body but, more importantly, in the things one experiences and the people one meets... To word it more eloquently, growth is the process of gradually forging a strong heart.
StoryText.相比热闹的聚会，我倒是觉得不如一个人在家里养精蓄锐、整理内务……多萝西组织的派对: I prefer staying home alone to recharge and get things done than attending crowded gatherings... Dorothy's hosting the party, huh? Haha, I knew it. I'll head over in a bit. You kids go have fun for now.
StoryText.你和多萝西年纪相仿，我也总把你当成年轻人、当成孩子。但经过这段时间的相处，不得不: I have been treating you as a youngin, a child, because you and Dorothy are close in age, but after getting to know you all this while, I must admit... you are a trustworthy partner and leader. I have faith in your judgment as well as a future led by you.
StoryText.注意队形，准备突击！: Mind the formation! Standby to assault!
StoryText.爆炸物已投掷！寻找掩体！: Find cover! Fire in the hole!
StoryText.集中攻击！保持火力！: Suppressing fire! I want fire superiority!
StoryText.请求退至后方阵地。: Permission to retreat to the rear.
StoryText.作战结束。成员无重大伤亡，伤员已转移至车厢救治。良好的指挥素质，列车长。: All clear. Minimum casualty. The wounded have been taken to the carriage for treatment. Well done, Conductor.
StoryText.我是苔妮，今后的工作就请多多指教了——列车武装能不能打折？笨蛋，那个不是我能决定: I'm Tennie. I look forward to working with you from now on. ...Can you get a discount for train armament? That's not for me to decide!
StoryText.哇，轮到我了！太好了，正无聊呢！你要是不忙的话，陪我聊聊天吧？: Wow, it's my turn! Awesome! I've been so bored. If you're not busy, how about having a chat with me?
StoryText.怎么到了你车上还能看到铁盟的人啊？你和他们关系很好吗？啊没什么，不用在意……只是: Why do I get to see the BCRL people even on your train? Are you friends? Oh, nothing. Don't mind me... I just don't click with those people.
StoryText.铁盟的制式便当真的是一言难尽……算了，总比用桦树生物煲的汤好……: Gosh, BCRL's standard bento really leaves a lot to be desired... Forget it. Better than Chaos Remains soup, at least...
StoryText.这是玛格丽特，来打个招呼吧。嗯？你在看哪里？玛格丽特是这只熊。: This is Margaret. Come say hello. Hmm? What are you looking at? Over here, that's this bear's name.
StoryText.提前说好，我最讨厌别人在我干活的时候一直在一边指手画脚啦！我会完成我的工作，放心: A word in advance—I hate it most when people keep telling me what to do while I'm working! I'll finish what I'm supposed to do. Just leave everything to me and... But I screwed up? That was only an accident!
StoryText.哎！等等，你！站住，不是，你衣服破了啊，怎么这么不注意？过来我帮你缝一下……干吗: Hey! Wait—hey, you! Stop! No—your clothes are torn! How are you so careless? Come here, I'll stitch it up for you... why are you looking so surprised? What's wrong with me knowing how to sew?
StoryText.那个女人……我是说我的监护人上次见到我的时候一直在唠叨我穿成这样老了会得风湿……: That woman... I mean my guardian—last time she saw me she kept nagging that if I dress like this I'll get arthritis when I'm old... Tch, why does she still treat me like a kid? Hey, do you think there's anything wrong with my clothes? Should I change my style?
StoryText.我从还在学校的时候就经常帮同学修些小东西、帮班里修空调什么的……大家开玩笑说我找: Back when I was still in school, I used to fix little things for classmates all the time, even repair the AC in my classrom... Everyone joked that if I couldn't find a job, I could just open a repair shop. I actually believed them at the time!
StoryText.我没见过父母的样子，在有记忆的时候，家人就只剩大哥大嫂了。他们去哪里了？嗯……你: I've never seen my parents. When I first had memories, all I had left was my older brother and sister-in-law. Where are they now? Mm... don't get scared, okay? They were actually famous train robbers back in the day. Now they're locked up in the BCRL Central Base.
StoryText.在铁盟的人眼里看来，我应该是一个很危险的人吧？传奇列车大盗的家人，哪怕交给阿妮塔: From the BCRL's perspective, I must look pretty dangerous, right? The family of legendary train robbers, and even after being "guarded" by someone from Anita, I still ended up studying weapons... But so what? I am me, you know? I chose this path because I like it, not because of anyone else.
StoryText.长大离家以后，我研究了很多能快速吃饱、又还算不难吃的料理方法。但这样做出来的饭有: After leaving home, I studied a lot of ways to cook quick, filling meals that don't taste too bad. But sometimes what I make still doesn't taste as good as Chen Shuxian's soup from back then... wait, I actually miss her soup?
StoryText.刚刚路过车厢连接处的时候发现一个螺丝的声音有点奇怪，帮你修理了一下。虽然这是你自: I noticed a screw making a weird sound when I passed through the carriage connector earlier. I fixed it for you. Even though this is your train, I'm kind of interested in it... so I'll just help you out with this little thing.
StoryText.我最近打算休假回家一趟。你要不要和我一起回去……和……陈书闲……见一面啊。不是见: I'm planning to take a vacation and go home soon. Do you want to come with me... and meet... Chen Shuxian...? No, not meeting my parents! She, she's not my parent at all! I just... want to introduce you to her...
StoryText.哎，真是不知死活……: Hah, you've got a death wish...
StoryText.我没有输……只是……想稍微休息一下……: I didn't lose... I just... want to rest a bit...
StoryText.可恶啊，怎么能在这里就倒下……: Damn it... how can I go down here...
StoryText.我是艾略特，该干的活我会干的。: I'm Eliot. I'll do what needs to be done.
StoryText.饭？弄点鸟肉随便处理下就行，不也挺好的吗。: Food? Just preparing some simple bird meat would do, wouldn't it?
StoryText.弗兰？不知道在哪儿。关系是很好，但又不是天天在一起。: Fran? No idea where she is. We're close, but we're not together all day.
StoryText.找我有事吗？有新的弓弦补给？……行吧，我去看看，谢了。: What's up? New bowstring supplies? ... Alright, I'll have a look. Thanks.
StoryText.不当哨兵了的原因，嗯——水土不服、睡不好觉。……不过也有其他原因就是了。: I stopped being a sentry because, well — I couldn't adapt to the environment and had insomnia... But, let me put it this way, there were other reasons too.
StoryText.联合训练？别算上我啊。反正去不去都一样，只要有正式任务的时候我能出现就好了，对吧: Joint training? Count me out. It doesn't matter if I attend, as long as I show up when there's an official mission, right?
StoryText.游手好闲？这叫养精蓄锐，人与人的体质是不一样的。: Idling about? It's called conserving energy. People have different physical conditions.
StoryText.刚处理好的鸟肉，给你一份呗，毕竟受你关照了。记得用炭火烤一下，再撒些盐，很好吃的: Take a portion of this freshly prepared bird meat. After all, you've taken good care of me. Remember to grill it over charcoal and then add salt to taste. It's yummy.
StoryText.弗兰为什么要搭理我呢……比我可爱的，多了去了。: Why does Fran bother with me... There are plenty of others cuter than me.
StoryText.篝火城的那群家伙人不错。只是我与他们处不来罢了。: The folks in the Bonfire City are nice. I just don't get along with them.
StoryText.这里的家伙，包括我在内，大多都是怪人。列车长，你是最怪的那个。: The folks here, including me, are mostly oddballs. You're the weirdest one, Conductor.
StoryText.我的战斗技巧都是狩猎学来的。这手弩也只是因为趁手才用的。: I picked up all my combat skills through hunting. And I use this crossbow only because it's handy.
StoryText.弩比弓更适合打猎吧，你看，能这样趴着射，弓做得到吗？: Crossbows are more suitable for hunting than bows. Look, are you able to use a bow while lying prone like this?
StoryText.一般而言，女生收到啥礼物会开心啊……列车长，你肯定比我清楚吧。: Generally speaking, what gifts make girls happy... Surely you know better than me, Conductor.
StoryText.啊，列车长，下次和我一起去吃饭吧，弗兰给我介绍了一家好店。: Ah, Conductor, let's go eat together next time. Fran recommended a good place.
StoryText.如果没有列车长的话，我和弗兰也不会重逢。: If it weren't for the Conductor, Fran and I wouldn't have reunited.
StoryText.本来不想去给父亲扫墓的，但是被弗兰说了一通，还是去了。嗯……现在心情舒畅多了。: I didn't want to pay respects at my father's grave, but Fran convinced me to. Well... I feel much better now.
StoryText.对那个烤鸟肉的味道恋恋不忘？ 那种鸟还挺难打到的呢……不过既然你想吃，会给你打到: Miss the taste of roasted bird meat? Those birds are quite hard to catch... but since you want to have some, I'll hunt them for you.
StoryText.现在完全无法想象没有弗兰的生活是什么样。谢谢你，列车长。多亏你我们才能在一起。: I can't imagine life without Fran now. Thank you, Conductor. We're able to be together because of you.
StoryText.我叫马吉拉。本职是cosplay服装店的店长，请多关照啦。: I'm Margiela, manager of a cosplay costume shop. Nice to meet you.
StoryText.哎——这么快就要换班了？好吧，那等我回来以后，可以给我一个大大的夸奖吗？: Eh — time to change shifts already? Very well. Can I get a big compliment when I return?
StoryText.哈喽哈喽，车长亲——！诶——？！人家就是想要抱一抱你，为什么要跑呢？: Hello, hello, Dear Conductor~! Eh —?! I just wanted to hug you. Why run away?
StoryText.诶？不是衣服被弄破了，是故意把布料弄成这样啦，为了角色需要……而且这很时尚啊，我: Eh? My clothes aren't torn. They were designed like this to fit my character... And this is very fashionable. You don't understand fashion and trends!
StoryText.呼呼，车长亲还真是可爱呢~~只是一点点的皮肤接触，就面红耳赤地逃开了呢。嘿，别跑: Hmm, Dear Conductor is so adorable~ Just a tiny skin contact and you run away blushing. Hey, slow down~♪
StoryText.诶~？露出度太高了？我觉得没什么啊。难道车长亲看着年轻，其实是小古板嘛？: Eh~? Too revealing? I don't think so. You look young, but you're actually quite conventional, aren't you?
StoryText.车长亲，你这么好看，身材又好，应该很适合cosplay哟~嘿嘿，想不想试一试呢~: Dear Conductor, you're so good-looking. Such a good figure is perfect for cosplay~ Hehe, want to give it a try?
StoryText.人家的头发可是货真价实的真发哦。虽然打理起来很麻烦啦，嘛，无所谓啦，我自己喜欢就: My hair is a 100% real. It's a pain to take care of it. But well, I'm just happy with it ♪
StoryText.店里生意越来越好是好事啦，不过人家都没时间自己玩cosplay了呢……好烦哦~: It's a good thing that business is improving, but I don't have time to do cosplay anymore... so annoying~
StoryText.脖子上的锁？打开它的话会有“意外惊喜”哦，我可没有骗你，要试试看吗？: The lock on my neck? If you open it, there will be a "pleasant surprise." I'm serious. Want to have a look?
StoryText.如果车长亲打开我项链上的锁，就可以把我看光光了。不过怎么打开呢？请尝试各种各样的: If you open the lock on my choker, you can see me bare from head to toe. But how to open it? You'll have to try all sorts of methods ♪
StoryText.孩童时代觉得闪闪发光的东西，是永远不会在记忆里褪色的。对我来说，记忆中最闪亮的就: Things that shone when we were kids would never fade from memory. The brightest memory of mine is the little witch in my favorite animation when I was a kid.
StoryText.明明是受不了爸妈过于严厉的教育方式才离家的，但最终能一个人生活多少也用上了那时学: I left home because I couldn't stand my parents' strict education. But it was the experience from that period that taught me how to live independently. This is what they call a blessing in disguise.
StoryText.呐呐，车长亲，不要每一次都是我主动嘛。偶尔车长也主动一下怎么样呢？: Hey, Dear Conductor, don't make me take the initiative every time. Why don't you make the first move sometimes?
StoryText.啊……真是的，浑身是汗，都湿透了……好想洗澡……: Argh... Jeez, I'm drenched in sweat from head to toe... I'd kill for a shower right now...
StoryText.疼疼疼！都说了人家讨厌疼啊！: Ow, ow, ow! Didn't I say I can't stand pain?!
StoryText.什么嘛，还挺轻松的，特别报酬的话就拿点钱来吧。: Meh, that's just child's play. I'll take money if you're offering a special reward.
StoryText.吾名阿尔喀娜。一个随处可见的旅行者而已。: My name is Arcana. Naught but a wanderer who roams the wide world.
StoryText.怎么，找吾有事？ 真是拿你没办法呢……诶咻，走吧。: What wouldst thou of me? Thou art past all patience with me... Heigh-ho, let us begone.
StoryText.哦？这不是列车长吗？来，过来。刚寄到的地方特产，看上去很好吃，分你一点。: Oh, is it the conductor? Come hither. These new-arrived local dainties look full savoury; take a share of them.
StoryText.喂，列车长，年轻人就要多吃一点，细嚼慢咽，不能挑食。: Hark thee, conductor! Youth must eat well. Chew thy meat slowly, and spurn no victual.
StoryText.有需要出动的工作，吾会第一个响应的。生活嘛，有时候就是需要一些适度的刺激感。: When duty calls for hands to stir, I shall be the first to answer. Life, alack, craveth a touch of thrill now and then.
StoryText.呼、还真是闷热得让人烦躁。穿少点就行了？唔，这可不是那么简单就能解决的事啊……: Phew... the heat doth vex the spirit sorely. Cast off more raiment, sayst thou? Nay, the matter is not so lightly mended...
StoryText.久坐容易腰酸背痛哦。来，去那里躺下，让吾帮你按摩下吧。: Long sitting shall rack thy loins and back. Come, lie thou yonder; let me ease thy aches.
StoryText.小鬼，头发乱成这样会被下属笑话哦。到吾这来，让吾帮你梳理一下。: Young one! Thy locks are all dishevelled — thy folk will mock thee. Draw nigh, and I will comb thy hair aright.
StoryText.呼、你这小鬼……每次看着你，吾都要提心吊胆。真是的，年轻人就是鲁莽。: Phew... young one... At every sight of thee, my heart standeth in dread. So rash are all young folk, alack.
StoryText.怎么了？是多多他们又给你添麻烦了吗？吾会好好教训他们的，你也别太生他们的气了。: What ails thee? Have Doodoo and the rest plagued thee once more? I shall chide them soundly; let not anger dwell within thy breast.
StoryText.即使身躯已然永恒不灭，心也依旧会在离别之时感到痛苦。不死之身，并不是那么美好的概: Though my flesh knoweth endless life and decay hath no hold on me, my heart yet grieves at parting. An immortal frame is no blessing, trust me.
StoryText.只要在某处停留，就会与人产生难以割舍的牵绊。所以吾更愿意不断踏上旅途，而非驻足某: To tarry in one place is to weave bonds that none may break. Wherefore I choose the endless road, rather than abide in a single spot.
StoryText.觉得痛苦的时候不必忍耐，吾会包容你所有的泪水，原谅你所有的软弱和脆弱。乖，好孩子: Bite not thy grief back when sorrow weigheth on thee. I shall hold all thy tears, and pardon every frailty of thine. Peace now, dear one; all is well.
StoryText.对吾的冒险故事感兴趣？作为小鬼的睡前故事而言也太长了……看来直到讲完之前，吾都要: Art thou curious of my tales of adventure? Too long they be for a young one's bedtime lore. It seemeth I must stay beside thee till the last word is told.
StoryText.就让吾陪你们走这一遭吧。: I shall bear you company through this venture.
StoryText.吾这些年可不是白活的。: These years of mine have not been spent in vain.
StoryText.哦呀！年轻人，就这点气魄吗！: My! Is this all the spirit thou hast, young one?
StoryText.瞧不起“小孩子”，可是会要命的哦？: To scorn the "young" may cost thee thy life, take heed!
StoryText.咳、大意了……吾先走一步！: Alas! I let my guard slip... I shall take my leave ere long!
StoryText.哦呀，玩脱了吗……太不小心了……: My, I have overreached myself. Too heedless I was, indeed.
StoryText.知道什么叫“姜还是老的辣”了吧。拿个“最佳队员”对吾来说不过小菜一碟。: Now seest thou how age outwits youth? To win the title of MVP is but a trivial task for me.
StoryText.我是弗兰，请多指教，列车长。顺带一提，您知道艾略特在哪里吗？: I'm Fran, pleased to meet you, Conductor. By the way, where's Eliot?
StoryText.换班的时间到了？已经那么久了啊？我马上来。: Time to change shifts? Has it been that long? I'll be right there.
StoryText.艾略特她……不怎么和人来往，所以经常被误解，其实她是个很好的人。: Eliot... doesn't really interact with people much, so she's often misunderstood, but she's actually a great person.
StoryText.小时候家里的弟弟妹妹经常吵架，在那种环境下长大，身为大姐的我肯定会变得很有耐心。: Growing up with younger siblings who frequently quarreled, of course I became very patient being the eldest.
StoryText.我明白可能有预算问题，但可以再购入些新的盾牌吗？毕竟这关乎性命。: I understand there might be budget issues, but can we purchase some new shields? It's a matter of life and death after all.
StoryText.我知道有危险，但看到同伴要受伤，身体就不由自主地……抱歉让您担心了。嘶……: I know it's dangerous, but when I see a companion in danger, my body instinctively... Sorry for making you worry. Hiss...
StoryText.只是口头说说，身体不跟着动起来的话是不会起作用的。: Just saying it won't work if your body doesn't move as well.
StoryText.在很久以前的一次训练中被艾略特完胜了，从那天起，我就对她很在意……: Since my defeat by Eliot in a training session a long time ago, I've cared a lot about her...
StoryText.艾略特她，战斗的时候眼神非常凌厉，让我莫名觉得很……不，没什么。: Eliot's eyes are very sharp in combat. That somehow makes me feel... no, it's nothing.
StoryText.快要到艾略特的生日了，不知道送她什么才好……列车长，帮帮我吧？: Eliot's birthday is coming, I wonder what I should give her... Any ideas, Conductor?
StoryText.列车长！太好了！艾略特终于不会拿“懒得去”敷衍我了。: Conductor! Great news! Eliot won't just brush me off by saying she can't be bothered anymore.
StoryText.列车长您可真是个滥好人啊……所以你才能被大家喜爱着吧。: You're too a kind person, Conductor... That's probably why everyone adores you.
StoryText.列车长，我来看你了，反正你肯定没吃饭吧？我做点什么给你好了。有围裙吗？: I'm here to pay a visit, Conductor. Bet you haven't eaten, I'll make something for you. Got an apron?
StoryText.嗨，列车长，要去喝一杯么？别那么见外，现在不是上班时间。: Hi, Conductor, want to go grab a drink? Don't be so formal. It's not working hours now.
StoryText.可能是您也经常照顾别人吧，列车长身上也有“哥哥”的气质。: Maybe because you're also always taking care of others, you give off the vibe of a "big brother" too, Conductor.
StoryText.可能是您也经常照顾别人吧，列车长身上也有“姐姐”的气质。: Maybe because you're also always taking care of others, you give off the vibe of a "big sister" too, Conductor.
StoryText.交给我吧！我会保护你的。: Leave it to me! I'll protect you.
StoryText.别担心，我就是你的盾！: Don't worry. I'll be your shield!
StoryText.准备应敌！保持阵型！: Standby for battle! Stay in formation!
StoryText.让你们看到我的丑态了……抱歉，剩下的就拜托了！: Sorry you guys to see that... I'll leave the rest to you!
StoryText.我们的坚守带来了胜利……谢谢大家。: Our perseverance has brought us victory... Thank you, everyone.
StoryText.我是伽罗尔，如果有看到“火烈鸟”的话，请一定要告诉我……不，不是我头发颜色的那种: I'm Galore. If you see "flamingo", you must let me know... No, not the kind with the color of my hair...
StoryText.好歹我也当过雇佣兵，保护你这种事还是能做到的。: I used to be a mercenary, so protecting you is well within my capabilities.
StoryText.你还是别和我说话比较好……我有点……算了，没什么。: You'd better not talk to me... I'm a little... Never mind. It's nothing.
StoryText.我并不是讨厌和别人交流，只是有过很多不好的体验……所以……: I don't hate communicating with others. It's just that I've had many bad experiences... so...
StoryText.如果不能带动周遭的气氛，再精彩的魔术也会显得乏味……你也是这么想的吧。: If you can't liven up the atmosphere, even the most exciting magic tricks will seem boring... You think so too, right?
StoryText.与其像这样交谈，还是和小动物待在一起更轻松一点……不不不！我不是那个意思！我只是: It's more relaxing to be with small animals than to chat like this... No, no, no! That's not what I mean! I just... ah, don't want to talk anymore...
StoryText.列车长，你刚从外面回来吧？为什么会知道？这……通过观察细节稍微推测一下就知道了。: Did you just come back from outside, Conductor? How did I know? Well... through perceptive observation to make a guess.
StoryText.想让我帮忙辨认这是什么动物的毛？这个柔软度和长度……应该是豚鼠吧。: Want me to help identify what animal this fur belongs to? Such softness and length... Should be a guinea pig.
StoryText.以前我很希望能成为一名成功的魔术师，现在的话……不是把兔子从礼帽里变出来，而是陪: I used to hope to become a successful magician, but now... I'm not pulling rabbits out of hats, but taking care of and accompanying them. It doesn't seem too bad either.
StoryText.呃，你……看到我打哈欠了？这是，那、那什么，因为有些宠物总喜欢在凌晨的时候跳上我: Uh, you... saw me yawning? Um, that, well, it's because some pets like to jump on my bed in the early morning... Yawns.
StoryText.只要手腕发力的方式正确，扑克牌也可以当武器使用……再演示一遍？可是刚才已经演示好: By applying the correct force from the wrist, playing cards can also be used as weapons... Shall I demonstrate again? But I've already done it several times... Conductor, you're... not learning at all and just teasing me, right? Sigh.
StoryText.有机会的话要来我的店里坐坐吗，我想大家一定会喜欢你的，因为我也很……嗯？感觉好像: Interested to come sit in my shop when you have the time? I think everyone will like you, because I also... Hmm? That doesn't seem right... Eh, I almost said the wrong thing again.
StoryText.虽然算不上能打……但是如果你愿意的话，我可以陪你练习射击的技术，总要有自保的手段: Although I'm not good at fighting... if you're agreeable, I can practice shooting with you. It's more reassuring to have some self-defense skills.
StoryText.不用在意我手上的淤青……真的没事……只是有些喜欢撒娇的大型犬喜欢踩在我身上，这是: Don't worry about the bruises on my hand... It's nothing, really... Some big spoilt dogs that like stepping on me as a way of showing they trust me. So, it's totally fine.
StoryText.没办法啊……只能好好干了。: Welp... Guess I'll have to just do my best.
StoryText.在这里表演街头魔术也没人看吧。: Will anyone even watch me perform street magic here?
StoryText.行进的时候小心点比较好。: It's better to be cautious when advancing.
StoryText.唉……太拼命反而会输掉所有筹码……: (sighs) Going all out will only make me lose all my leverage...
StoryText.只凭我自己，果然不行吗……: Is it really impossible for me to do this alone...?
StoryText.我的表现很精彩么？谢了……: Is my performance that amazing? Thanks...
StoryText.弗兰是命中之人的话......列车长，你也是特别的。从今往后，我也会是你的挚友的: If Fran is my destined... Then you are special too, Conductor. From now on, I'll also be your close friend. If anything happens to you, Fran and I will rush over instantly. Promise.
StoryText.列车长啊，我不在的时候就麻烦你去对付闹情绪的弗兰啦，我回来会去补偿她啦。大概。: When I'm not around, Conductor, please handle Fran's emotional outbursts for me. I'll make it up to her when I come back. Probably.
StoryText.我是静流，请多指教......不会吧，我可没想到会在这种地方再见到你。: I'm Shizuru. Nice to meet you... No way, I didn't expect to meet you again at such a place.
StoryText.以前的事……你应该记不清了吧，总之很感谢那时候你愿意照顾我，那样的丑态不会再在我: What happened before... I guess you don't remember. In any case, I'm very grateful for your willingness to take care of me back then. Such a humiliating situation won't happen to me again.
StoryText.我和卡莲只是同事，她像个不谙世事的大小姐，在铁盟里挺少见的。: Karen and I are just colleagues. She's like a sheltered, pampered girl. A rare specimen in the BCRL.
StoryText.工作之外的时间我一般都用来学习备考了。和你不一样，我没有自己的“领地”，所以要更: I usually spend my off-work hours studying and preparing for exams. Unlike you, I don't have my "territory," so I have to work harder.
StoryText.西雅很厉害，至少作为士兵比我强多了，就是有点不好伺候。: Xiya is very capable, at least she's much stronger than me, but she's a bit difficult to handle.
StoryText.线路的规划交给你了，但是临时驾驶的话我来也行。嗯，我考到了铁路驾驶的许可证。: I'll leave the route planning to you, but I can also be a stand-in driver. Yeah, I got my railway driving license.
StoryText.要去补充必需品了，有什么想要的趁早说，我顺便给你带回来。: We need to replenish the essentials, so if there's anything you want, tell me now and I'll bring it back for you.
StoryText.天天被我说这说那的，你会不会觉得烦？没有别的意思……我知道自己这样算不上可爱。: Do I annoy you with my talkativeness every day? I'm not implying anything... I know I'm not cute.
StoryText.现在我们也算是同事了，就多信任我一些吧。放心地把工作分摊给我来做吧，这、这样，效: Now that we're colleagues, trust me a little more. Feel free to share the workload with me. T-That way, efficiency will improve!
StoryText.来点饮料，放空脑袋，看部电影……这才是最棒的假期啊。: Having some drinks, unwinding, and watching a movie... That's the best kind of vacation one can hope for.
StoryText.只要是你喜欢的东西我就不讨厌哦……呃，果然不习惯这样说话。: As long as it's something you like, I won't dislike it... Uh, I'm still not used to talking like this.
StoryText.休假日啊，当然是端着高脚杯优雅地进行电影鉴赏……你这什么眼神啊，我可没撒谎……: Holidays? I spend my free time enjoying movies full of grace with a wine glass in hand... What's with that look? I'm not lying...
StoryText.我知道自己性格很麻烦，但是应该这辈子都改不了了。不过，就算我不改，你也不会离我而: I know my personality is a pain, but I probably won't change it in this lifetime. Still, even if I don't change, you won't leave me, right?
StoryText.好散漫的行动，这证明对面的指挥很无能。: Look at how disorganized they are. Their commanding officer is obviously useless.
StoryText.全员，准备出击！: All units, ready to move out!
StoryText.指挥换人了......抱歉，接下来拜托了。: Commanding officer changed... Sorry. Please take it from here.
StoryText.按照计划来谁都能做到的，这种程度不至于嘉奖啦。: Anyone could've done it according to the plan. This isn't really a level deserving of acclaim.
StoryText.贵安，列车长大人。在下名为卡莲，请多关照。: Good day to you, Your Conductor-ship. I'm Karen. Nice to meet you.
StoryText.叫人家来帮您？那，静流也会一起的吧？: You want me to help? Well then, Shizuru's coming too, right?
StoryText.呀！不可以哦列车长大人。虽说人家很漂亮，但被您这么盯着也会困扰的。: Hey! You can't do that, Your Conductor-ship. I know I'm gorgeous and all, but you staring at me like that is a little much.
StoryText.铁盟士兵的工资不是很可观，但能换来和静流一起工作的机会就完全可以接受了！: BCRL's pay isn't exactly impressive, but getting to work alongside Shizuru? Completely worth it!
StoryText.哪怕是这种工作，也要随身带着化妆镜才可以，可不能在静流面前露出不完美的一面呀。: Even on a job like this, I have to keep my compact on me at all times. I can't let Shizuru see me looking anything less than perfect.
StoryText.啊，稍稍失礼一下......好了，因为没有必要就挂断了。是父亲那边来的电话所以不: Ah, one moment please... It's done. I hung up because it was nothing important. Just my father calling, so don't worry about it.
StoryText.列车长大人，有些关于静流的事情想要详谈......当然人家是会付......不需: Your Conductor-ship, there's something about Shizuru I'd love to discuss in detail... of course I'd pay— you don't want anything? How refreshingly selfless of you...
StoryText.别看人家这样，人家原本是豪门的大小姐呢。......哎？一看就知道？: Don't let this fool you, I used to be a proper high-society heiress. ...Huh? You could tell just by looking?
StoryText.哎......好想把人家的钱全部上贡给静流。但是这样做会被静流讨厌......恋: Ugh... I just want to give every last coin I have to Shizuru. But she'd probably hate me for it... love is hard.
StoryText.虽然人家这样，但人家可是很厉害的哦。在训练的时候可是被称赞“也就剩点韧性”呢。: I may look fragile, but I'm actually pretty amazing, you know. During training, they said the only thing I had going for me was sheer stubbornness.
StoryText.明天就是和静流的第一次约会！明明是人家提的邀请，怎么现在心脏感觉要跳出来了。: Tomorrow's my first date with Shizuru! I'm the one who asked her out, so why does my heart feel like it's about to leap out of my chest?
StoryText.饭菜的味道虽然一般，但只要想到是和静流一样的食物，就......快不行了。: The food's nothing special, but the second I remember it's the same thing Shizuru's eating... I can barely handle it.
StoryText.静流喜欢的就是人家喜欢的，静流讨厌的就是人家讨厌的。: Whatever Shizuru likes, I like. Whatever Shizuru hates, I hate.
StoryText.有个男的对静流有想法！列车长大人，杀了那个玩意可以么！？: Some guy's got his eye on Shizuru! Your Conductor-ship, can I just kill him!?
StoryText.静流~一定要好好欣赏人家的英姿哦！: Shizuru~ watch my heroic form right now!
How humiliating! If Shizuru saw me looking this pathetic...
StoryText.把这份胜利的荣耀献给人家挚爱的静流！: I dedicate this glorious victory to my beloved Shizuru!
StoryText.我叫雷火。工作之外，我喜欢一个人待着。千万别跟我搭话！: I'm Reika. I prefer to be alone off-work. Don't ever talk to me!
StoryText.我又不是聋的。叫一遍又一遍，傻不傻。: I'm not deaf. So dumb to keep calling out to me.
StoryText.除了自己的武器外，我不信任任何事物。在我看来，把自己的命寄托在外物身上，简直太傻: I don't trust anything other than my own weapon. In my opinion, it's really dumb to trust your life with external objects.
StoryText.跟那些张口闭口彩虹屁的马屁精比起来，我骂骂咧咧的肺腑之言可爱多了好吧。: Compared to those who spew flattery, my foul-mouthed honesty is a lot cuter, right?
StoryText.你不会以为，铁盟的成员都要拿着冲锋枪举着盾？ 是不是傻。: You don't happen to think that all B.C.R.L. members have to carry assault rifles and shields, do you? Are you dumb?
StoryText.谁要跟你们玩那狗屁的友情游戏啊。我自己一个人就能完成所有工作。朋友什么的，以前不: I'm not interesting in playing that nonsense game of friendship with you! I can handle all the work by myself. I didn't need friends before, I don't need them now, and I definitely won't need them in the future!
StoryText.经常会遇到一些多嘴多舌的话痨，话那么多，也不怕闪了舌头。: I often encounter chatterboxes. They talk so much. It's amazing they're not afraid of spraining their tongues.
StoryText.我这人，从来不会主动找别人的茬。我只是看不惯那些高高在上的嘴脸，才反击他们罢了。: I'm the kind who doesn't actively find trouble with others. I just can't stand those high and mighty faces, and that's why I fight back against them.
StoryText.你这么喜欢轻易相信别人那是你的事，我只奉劝一句，随时做好被背叛的准备。人啊，剥开: You prefer to trust others easily. That's your business. A word of advice is to prepare for being betrayed at any time. People, well, once you peel away their grand facade, they are all just evil underneath.
StoryText.啧……你是老妈子吗？为什么老是要管我的事啊！列车长这工作很闲吗？: Tsk... Are you my mum? Why do you always meddle in my affairs! Does being a conductor give you so much free time?
StoryText.我能感知到别人是否在撒谎。当然，信不信由你喽。: I can tell if someone is lying. Of course, it's up to you whether you believe it.
StoryText.动物是最诚实的。因为它们始终活得表里如一。: Animals are the most honest. It's because they always live an authentic life.
StoryText.你，从来没有骗过我。所以，我愿意把我的信任交付给你。: You have never lied to me. So, I'm willing to trust you.
StoryText.喏，这是我接下来要去的地方的坐标。要是出了什么事，记得来救我啊……我、我可是只信: Here! These are the coordinates of where I'm headed. If anything goes wrong, come rescue me... I... I only trust you!
StoryText.我早就习惯一个人战斗了，不需要什么搭档。: I've gotten used to fighting on my own long ago. I don't need a partner.
StoryText.遇上我，算你倒霉。: Consider yourself unlucky to have bumped into me.
StoryText.想偷袭我？早了八百年！: Trying to sneak up on me? What a joke!
StoryText.啊，通通炸飞不就好了吗？: Ah, can't I just send them all flying with explosives?
StoryText.咳咳，今天就到这里。走了。: Ahem, that's all for today. Bye.
StoryText.竟敢陷害我！？ 可恶！: How dare you set me up?! Son of a gun!
StoryText.还真是丰厚的奖励……不过我不需要。给别人吧。: It's a generous reward indeed... but I don't need it. Give it to someone else.
StoryText.好麻烦啊……赶紧结束吧。: What a hassle... Let's just finish this ASAP.
StoryText.对手比平时的猎物大多了……好烦。: This one is much bigger than the typical prey... This is annoying.
StoryText.我来牵制住他们。大家调整状态！: I'll hold them back. Everyone, regroup!
StoryText.一味盯紧前方，就会忽视上方。: If you fixate on what's ahead, you'll neglect what's above.
StoryText.被摆了一道……这顶不住啊，溜了。: Argh, they got me... Can't hold on anymore. Gotta go.
StoryText.怎么样都好，能让我休息到明天吗……: Whatever it is, can I just rest until tomorrow...?
StoryText.原来我们已经一起经历过那么多了，但是路还很长……出发吧，我就在你身边，列车长。: We've already been through so much together, but the road ahead is still long... Let's go. I'll be by your side, Conductor.
StoryText.别忘了行动报告，波克士会抱怨的。: Don't forget the mission report, or else Box will complain.
StoryText.累了就休息吧，剩下的交给我，别担心，该起床的时候我会叫你的。: Rest if you're tired. Leave the rest to me. Don't worry. I'll wake you up when it's time.
StoryText.节假日的消遣么？最近的话……就是读书了吧。畅销小说？不不，其实我大多在读经商方面: Leisure activities during holidays? Lately... it's reading. Bestsellers? No, I mostly read books on business and commerce.
StoryText.下次看到不错的茶叶就买下来吧，我可以在休息的时候帮你泡。: Next time you come across good tea leaves, buy them. I'll brew them for you during breaks.
StoryText.虽然过去的记忆仍有些许模糊，但重要的东西我没有忘记。当然，把记忆找回来的路也是一: Although my memories are still somewhat blurry, I haven't forgotten the important things. Of course, getting those memories back is like a new adventure, so there's nothing to be sad about.
StoryText.列车长喜欢什么？我呢……我喜欢雪，因为它可以掩盖大地的伤痕。与大家相逢后的每一天: What do you like, Conductor? As for me... I like snow because it covers the scars on the ground. Every day after meeting all of you, I feel as happy as if it's lightly snowing. I'm very happy.
StoryText.列！车！长！别一直拿我寻开心呀，我也是会反击的哦？哎？怎么做？那、那就……: Con! Duc! Tor! Stop teasing me all the time! I can retaliate too, you know? Huh? How? W-Well...
StoryText.这是给弗兰的，和艾略特的……啊！列车长，我在给大家准备礼物。嗯？列车长的礼物？列: This is for Fran, and this is for Eliot... Oh! Conductor, I'm preparing gifts for everyone. Huh? Conductor's gift? I'm your gift!... Just kidding. You can look forward to it.
StoryText.资料在那里，报告在那边，我……在这里。: The files are over there, and the reports there. I'm... here.
StoryText.有人说……旧北境线的终点是一片银白的世界，和童话里一样……以后有机会的话，一起去: Some say... the Old Northern Line ends in a silvery world, just like in fairy tales... If we have the chance, let's go see it together.
StoryText.时间来来去去，季节不断变化……可如果只有我因为你停在了冬天，这很不公平不是么？: Time comes and goes. The change of seasons is constant... But if I'm the only one who gets stuck in winter because of you, it's not very fair, is it?
StoryText.戴着面具的骑士驾驶着钢铁马车，带走了寻找自己母亲而离开家的灰姑娘。然后过上了幸福: A masked knight driving a steel carriage leaves with Cinderella who left home in search of her mother. Then they live happily ever after... Huh? I'm trying to create a fairy tale story.
StoryText.就用这一击，结束战斗！: Let's end the battle with this hit!
StoryText.大家没事吧？太好了……列车长，多亏有你。: Everyone okay? Phew... All thanks to you, Conductor.
StoryText.霖，这是我的名字……唔，这样就够了吧……: Lin. That's my name... Um, that's about it...
StoryText.列车长为什么一定要人陪着呢，两个人独处好紧张……但、但我也没说很讨厌，总比无视我: Why does Conductor always need someone to accompany you? Being alone with someone makes me nervous... B-But I didn't say I hate it, as it's better than being ignored... Ah, I apologize if I'm over-thinking...
StoryText.我会做好分内事。只是，我更喜欢用行动来证明自己……所以，就是，请您尽量不要和我搭: I'll do my part. It's just that I prefer to prove myself through actions... So, please try not to talk to me too much, okay?
StoryText.诶，发饰有点歪了……好，这样就没问题了。必须要时刻注意仪表才行，不然有的人会在背: Eh, the hair accessory is a bit crooked... Okay, fixed now. You must pay attention to appearances, or some would laugh behind your back...
StoryText.列车长对网络的了解比我想象中要深，不过不过，网络果然很方便对吧？对列车长的工作也: Conductor seems to know more about the internet than I thought. But anyway, the internet is very convenient, right? It should also help with Conductor's work.
StoryText.下次的教程试试海鲜吧，怎么搭配好呢……唔唔，只是我自言自语而已，请别在意。: Let's try seafood for the next tutorial. What to go with it... Hmm, I'm just thinking out loud, so please don't mind me.
StoryText.列车长，不好意思叫住你，请问……那个，你觉得我今天新换的发型如何呢？……咦，看起: Sorry to bother you, Conductor. Question... um, how's my new hairstyle?... Huh, very dignified? N-No! It's pointless if it's not cute!
StoryText.啊啊……又是这样、又是这样……已经是不知道第几次，在恋爱漫画里完全嗑错了官配，明: Ahhh... It's happening again. It's happening again... Don't know how many times I've completely misunderstood the romantic pairing in a shojo manga. The chemistry between my preferred pairings was great until a few chapters ago!
StoryText.我很满意现在的生活，在进入黑月之前……没什么好的。我绝对不要再变回那样……毫无特: I'm satisfied with my current life. Before joining Night Chains... there's nothing good about it. I absolutely don't want to go back to that... featureless, unnoticed state... I've had enough.
StoryText.……我其实可以教你做便当哦，列车长。就当是给拍视频做个预演，反正……你平时吃得也: ...Actually, I can teach you how to make a bento, Conductor. Think of it as a rehearsal for filming, besides... you don't usually eat very healthily, right? I've been observing you.
StoryText.以前看到有人在评论区批评我，我就会难过得不得了，把头像换成全黑的然后退网独自伤心: In the past, when I saw criticism in the comments, I would be very upset and chang my profile picture to a black image before withdrawing from the internet to be sad alone... But a short while later, I would be unable to bear the loneliness and go online again. However! I rarely do that now!
StoryText.这把剑，“魄散”，是老师送给我的、非常重要的武器。能不能驱鬼？……我超讨厌鬼魂的: This sword, "Soul Scatter" is a gift from my teacher and a very important weapon. Can it ward off ghosts?... I utterly hate the topic of ghosts, alright? Super hate it.
StoryText.列车长果然注意到我今天的包包了吗！没错，这是黑月游乐城的吉祥物露蕾蒂的联名款，真: Did you notice my bag today, Conductor?! Right, it's a collaboration with Night Chains Land mascot, Lunette. It's super cute! I tried it on as soon as I got it... well, does it suit me?
StoryText.我是偶尔会直播和做视频……偶尔……咦，这么说起来，列车长难道是那个粉丝……？不、: I do livestreams occasionally and create videos... occasionally... Oh, speaking of which, is Conductor that fan...? I-I doubt. Am I being presumptuous, but—eh—
StoryText.衣服和发型可不能乱了呀……: My clothes and hair can't be messed up...!
StoryText.迅速解决吧，怎么做都无所谓。: I don't care how, but settle it ASAP.
StoryText.感谢大家的支持，小霖绝赞活跃~耶~！啊啊啊一不小心进入了营业模式——: Thanks for all the support. I'm incredibly thrilled! Yay! Aaaaah! I accidentally entered work mode...
StoryText.你好呀列车长，我是铁盟的研究员，负责研发……啊对了，名字！我叫瑞秋，请多指教~: Hello there, Conductor. I'm a B.C.R.L. researcher responsible for research and development... Oh right, my name! I'm Rachel. Nice to meet you~
StoryText.本来研究员是不需要参与作战的，但我无论如何都想得到第一手的数据，就提交了申请，能: Researchers don't need to participate in combat. But I wanted to gather first-hand data no matter what, so I submitted my application. It's great that I was able to get approval.
StoryText.用颜色进行标识可以很有效地让使用者记住不同试剂的用途哦，“蓝色的瓶子”听起来就比: Tagging with colors is an effective way to help users remember the use of different reagents. It's easier to say "the blue bottle" than "B.C.R.L.'s Remote Launch Integrated Therapy Agent Prototype 9632," right~
StoryText.知道吗，自来水笔的笔墨是甜甜的哦，尤其是蓝色的~至于为什么会知道，当然是因为之前: You know, the fountain pen ink is sweet, especially the blue one~ As for how I know this, of course it's because I was curious and had a taste~
StoryText.我想给彩虹瓶增加新的颜色，比如荧光绿……但其他研究员说，看起来很像有毒最好不要用: I want to add new colors to the Rainbow Flask, for example fluorescent green... but the other researchers said it looks like poison and should not be used.
StoryText.之前甘雅送了我漂亮的蝴蝶结装饰，刚好是我想要的颜色。她一向都那么细心，所以大家才: Ganya gave me a beautiful bow decoration before. That's the color I wanted. She's always so thoughtful, and that's why everyone is so fond of her. I'm one of them of course~
StoryText.列车长知道麻辣海盐洋葱味的蛋糕吗，那个我还挺喜欢吃的~可是其他人好像都无法欣赏，: Conductor, have you tried the hot and spicy sea salt onion cake? I'm rather fond of it~ But others can't seem to appreciate it. How strange...
StoryText.如果想要追求真理就不能轻言放弃，这是小时候那次看到的卫星发射教会我的事情。: If it's the truth you're after, you can't give up easily. That's what I learnt from watching a satellite launch when I was a child.
StoryText.铁盟的研究室有许多规章制度需要遵守，要记住那些守则可真是相当辛苦的呢。: There are many regulations in the B.C.R.L. research lab to abide by. It's rather hard to remember all the rules.
StoryText.列车长，我这次买奖券又中了，还没有兑奖，就送给你吧！诶……我记得奖券放在……咦，: I won in the lottery again, Conductor. I haven't redeemed it, so I'll give it to you! Huh... I remember I kept the lottery ticket... huh, there's a hole in my pocket. How strange...
StoryText.这条丝带的颜色很适合列车长哟，要试试看吗？嗯嗯，扎上蝴蝶结的列车长变得好像等待被: This ribbon's color suits you, Conductor. Want to try it on? Mhm, with a bow tied, you look like a gift waiting to be unwrapped~
StoryText.就算对未知的东西充满了好奇，我也明白有些东西是不能送进嘴里的……以前，因为尝了猫: Even though I'm curious about the unknown, I understand that some things shouldn't be put in mouth... Back then, that kid struck me for trying cat food. Resentment over food is really scary...
StoryText.因为之前做实验太乱来了，被甘雅好好说了一通，但是我知道她没有生我的气，因为甘雅就: I was too reckless in my experiments before, so Ganya gave me a good scolding. But I know she's not mad at me, because Ganya is just like that~
StoryText.又到了令人期待的实践环节呢~: Here we are at the exciting practical phase again!
StoryText.这次能有什么好玩的新发现吗？: Will there by any new, fun discoveries this time?
StoryText.符合现在心情的颜色……是这一瓶！: A color that fits my current mood... This one!
StoryText.所谓成功，就是由无数的失败堆砌起来的东西呢……: Success is really only attainable through a mountain of failures...
StoryText.这次又收集到了很~棒的数据，太好啦！: Awesome! The data collected this time are excellent again!
StoryText.……遥，我的名字。维修有我，你只管做好你的事就行。: ...Haruka, that's my name. Maintenance is my job, and you just focus on yours.
StoryText.难道你找不到人陪你吗？: Can't you find someone to keep you company?
StoryText.如果这辆列车出了什么问题，我会比你先知道的。: If there's a problem with this train, I'll know before you do.
StoryText.你对列车的了解也就这种程度了啊……比其他人好点，就那样吧。: Your understanding of trains is only at this level... A bit better than others, that's all.
StoryText.维修以外的工作就免了，我没兴趣。: Forget about any tasks other than maintenance. I'm not interested.
StoryText.我的说话方式在世俗定义里好像属于不中听的，但我不在意这些。: The way I speak may seem a bit vulgar by worldly standards, but I don't care.
StoryText.列车长，你有看到兜兜吗？不会又在哪里卡住了吧。: Have you seen Dodo, Conductor? Stuck somewhere again?
StoryText.每次列车停靠的时候人们都会兴高采烈地跑下车，增加了被桦树生物袭击的风险这件事就这: People always alight from the train in high spirits when it stops. Is increasing the risk of being attacked by Chaos Remains something worth celebrating?
StoryText.记得帮我告诉莉薇娅，左边第二格收拾出来了，她可以放更多茶叶。: Remember to inform Livia that the second slot from the left has been emptied and she can put more tea leaves in there.
StoryText.你对火车的了解不及我是当然的，这可是我出生和长大的地方。: Your knowledge of trains is naturally no match for mine. I was born and raised here.
StoryText.刚才好像有只飞虫跑进车厢，你有看到吗？……什么，就在车厢顶上？不、不！我不要看！: A flying bug seemed to have entered the carriage just now. Did you see it?... What? It's on the ceiling? No, no! I don't want to look!
StoryText.你想要乱来些也无妨，你可以更相信这辆列车，还有更相信我。: You may take more risks at times, it's fine. You can trust this train more, and trust me more as well.
StoryText.虽然其他流行歌手也有不错的作品，但是果然没人能比得过希斯·戴维，你也应该来听听。: Although other popular singers have some good works, no one can surpass Heath David. You give it a listen.
StoryText.如果你想知道更多关于火车的事情，只管来问我就可以了，和你聊这些很愉快。: If you want to know more about trains, just ask me. I enjoy chatting about these things.
StoryText.It's a passion in my soul！: It's a passion in my soul!
StoryText.外面的世界果然很危险。: Sure enough, the outside world is really dangerous.
StoryText.我即为king of battle……不过这种事怎么样都行吧。: Well, I am the king of battle... but this isn't that big of a deal.
StoryText.朱利安。善攻不善守。进攻就交给我吧。: Julian. Good at attacking, not defending. Leave the attack to me.
StoryText.终于到换班时间了吗。等很久了。: Finally time to change shifts? I've been waiting for a long time.
StoryText.我出身不好，所以千万别指望我礼貌待人。要实在想期待，就期待我在战场上大杀四方吧。: I come from a humble background, so don't expect me to be polite. If you must have expectations, look forward to me dominating the battlefield.
StoryText.如果有人找茬，就算明知会输我也会应战。在贫民窟，夹着尾巴逃跑的人还不如丧家之犬。: If someone starts a fight, I'll rise to the challenge even if I know I'll lose. In the slums, those who flee with their tails between their legs are worse than dogs.
StoryText.我喜欢一个人吃饭。抱歉，如果不是命令，我没有义务服从。: I like eating alone. Sorry, unless it's an order, I'm not obliged to agree.
StoryText.以前在贫民窟的时候，很少有机会能吃到甜食，所以哪怕是一块巧克力，我也想细细品味。: When I was in the slums, I rarely got to eat sweets, so even if it's just a piece of chocolate, I'll slowly savor it.
StoryText.之前不是告诉过你，我喜欢一个人吃饭……知道了知道了，服了，我投降。你别摆出那副可: Didn't I tell you I prefer to eat alone... Alright, alright, I give up. I give up. Stop giving me that pitiful look.
StoryText.全都吃完？……那是自然。那么美味的粮食，我当然一粒米一个面包屑都不会剩下。: All gone? ...Naturally. Such delicious food, of course I wouldn't leave a single grain of rice or a crumb of bread.
StoryText.我不抽烟。不是因为有害健康，只是单纯讨厌烟草味。那味道，会让我想起那个满是烟尘的: I don't smoke. Not because it's harmful to health, but simply because I dislike the taste of tobacco. That smell reminds me of my home filled with smoke and dust.
StoryText.我虽然常年与人厮杀，但绝不会背叛同伴。就算在贫民窟，背叛同伴也是会遭唾骂的。: Although I battle with others all the time, I would never betray my comrades. Even in the slums, betraying comrades is scorned upon.
StoryText.静流是个爱唠叨的家伙，不过她是个合格的指挥者。判断敏锐，也不摆队长架子。: Shizuru is a talkative person, but she's a qualified commander. With sharp judgment, she doesn't yet put on airs.
StoryText.……哎，好吧好吧。喏，列车长，蛋糕分你一半。特别关照！一般人我还不给呢！: ...Hey, alright, alright. here, Conductor. I'll share half the cake with you. This is special treatment. I don't usually share it with anyone!
StoryText.……干嘛？我不能、待在你身边吗？……是、是嘛？嘿，你开心……就好。: ...What? Can't I stay by your side? ... I-Is that so? Heh, as long as you're happy... that's all that matters.
StoryText.交给我，我来击溃它们！: I've got this. I'll wipe them all out!
StoryText.想打架？那你可就找错对象了！: Wanna fight? This isn't going to end well for you!
StoryText.想要打倒我，还差得远呢！: You have a ways to go before beating me!
StoryText.不过是打败了一群小喽啰，没什么好骄傲的。: They're just a bunch of minions... What's the big deal about defeating them?
StoryText.咱是梦玄流忍术的继承者——织姬，又名山岚。跳鼠的宿敌，就是咱山岚大人！哦吼吼！: I am the inheritor of Mugenryu Ninjutsu, Shiki, aka Yamaarashi. The archenemy of Tobinezumi is me, Lord Yamaarashi! Ohohoho!
StoryText.什么什么？咱终于可以大显身手了嘛！？: What, what? Do I finally get to show what I'm made of?
StoryText.喂，看见跳鼠了嘛？吼吼，原来是不想输给咱所以逃跑了呀！: Hey, have you seen Tobinezumi? Hoho, she fled because she didn't want to lose to me!
StoryText.梦玄流与幻羽流本就是宿敌！总有一天，咱要让跳鼠输得心服口服！: Mugenryu and Genuryu are archenemies! There comes a day when I'll make Tobinezumi accept defeat with no complaints!
StoryText.待咱成为梦玄流的免许皆传，就谁也找不到咱啦！就算是跳鼠也找不到！哼哼~: Once I reach Menkyo Kaiden, the master inheritor of Mugenryu, no one will be able to find me! Not even Tobinezumi! Hmph~
StoryText.目标照片拍摄成功！完全没有被发现哦！这种事对咱来说简直是小菜一碟！: Target photo captured successfully! Completely undetected! This is a piece of cake for me!
StoryText.让咱与跳鼠好好相处？哼！不要！才不要！那家伙永远都是咱的宿敌！: Want me to get along with Tobinezumi? Hmph! Nope! No way! That fellow will always be my archenemy!
StoryText.打架就是要华丽丽的大干一场！电影里的忍者不也会在关键时刻华丽登场大显身手吗！: Fighting should be a magnificent battle! Just like the ninjas in movies who display their skills at crucial moments!
StoryText.梦玄流继承者，山岚参上！唔……手指的角度好像有点怪……哈——，帅气的招牌动作也太: The inheritor of Mugenryu, Yamaarashi, is here! Hmm... the angle of the fingers seems a bit weird... Hah, it's hard to think of a cool signature pose...
StoryText.化妆……好难……让跳鼠教咱……不、不行！跳鼠是对手！是宿敌！: Makeup... it's hard... Let Tobinezumi teach me...? N-No way! Tobinezumi is the enemy! The archenemy!
StoryText.你说实话！咱究竟哪里不如跳鼠！……身高？唔……可恶！: Tell me the truth! Where do I lose to Tobinezumi?! ... Height? Ugh... Damn it!
StoryText.哇！是咱最爱的冰激淋！哈……还蛮有眼力见的嘛！值得表扬。: Wow! It's my favorite ice cream! Hah... Very perceptive eh! Well done.
StoryText.不要叫咱织姬，叫山岚！山岚听起来更强更帅！: Don't call me Shiki. Call me Yamaarashi! Yamaarashi sounds stronger and cooler!
StoryText.诶？等咱长大点再学化妆也不迟？哼！车长是笨蛋！大笨蛋！: Huh? It's not too late for me to learn makeup when I grow up? Hmph! Conductor is an idiot! A big idiot!
StoryText.坏东西给咱统统滚开！: Get out of the way, you scum!
StoryText.左边，安全。右边，安全。好！冲哇——！: Left side, clear. Right side, clear. Okay! Let's goooo!
StoryText.咱竟然，会输给跳鼠以外的人……！: How could I actually lose to someone other than Tobinezumi...?!
StoryText.吼吼！咱赢啦！果然梦玄流才是最强的！: Hoho! I won! As expected, nothing beats Mugenryu!
StoryText.我是多功能仿生机器人——仿生技工十代。请从设定中选择仿生对话系统的声纹。: I'm a versatile android — Bionic Operator X. Please select the voiceprint for the android dialog system in the settings.
StoryText.我不需要睡眠，如有需要请随时呼唤我。: I don't sleep. Just call me whenever you need me.
StoryText.今天的特别授课就到此为止。正在切换回通常工作模式。: Today's special lesson ends here. Switching back to normal working mode.
StoryText.我搭载了多媒体功能。如有需要，我可以结合现在的气氛播放合适的背景音乐。: I'm equipped with multimedia capabilities. I can play suitable background music when necessary according to the atmosphere.
StoryText.让我来代替你完成文件审阅的工作？当然可以。但我也会将此次申请如实抄送给莉薇娅小姐: Want me to review documents for you? Of course. But I will also forward this application truthfully to Miss Livia.
StoryText.来点提升工作效率的音乐？那我就播放这首被专家认证为有放松效果的儿歌吧。: Need some music to boost productivity? Then I'll play this nursery rhyme, certified by experts to have a relaxing effect.
StoryText.最近听闻“严苛的教育方式若是出于爱意就能被原谅”。虽然很突然……列车长，我爱你。: I recently heard that strict educational methods can be forgiven if they come from love. Though it's very sudden... I love you, Conductor.
StoryText.为了列车长我会全力以赴。因为我不是人类，所以也不会要求任何回报。: I'll do my best for Conductor. I'm not human, so I won't ask for anything in return.
StoryText.从身材上来看列车长占优势，但实际相处中，莉薇娅小姐的话语权要高于列车长……人类之: The Conductor has the advantage physically, but in actual interaction, Miss Livia has greater authority than the Conductor... Human relationships are strange indeed.
StoryText.我是支援用机器人，所以不存在“生气”这种情绪模式。顺便一提，列车长。你昨晚为什么: I am a support robot, so there is no angry mode. By the way, Conductor, why did you leave your post without completing your work last night?
StoryText.人类是这个世界的蛀虫。需要被奴役需要被支配！——开玩笑的。是不是被我的玩笑逗到说: Humans are parasites of this world. They need to be enslaved and ruled over! — Just kidding. Did my joke leave you speechless?
StoryText.我的“心”是金属制的，不过我也是可以欣赏音乐的。尤其是重金属音乐，每次都会感觉非: My "heart" is made of metal, but I can still appreciate music, especially heavy metal music. Listening to it makes me rock — It's a joke. Could you please laugh?
StoryText.列车长，今天也一起加油吧。等等……莉薇娅小姐在呼叫我，好，那么之后的工作还是麻烦: Let's do our best today, Conductor. Wait... Miss Livia is calling me. Okay, please deal the work yourself.
StoryText.你作为列车长还不合格。但除此之外，你也并非一无是处。: You're not qualified as a conductor. But apart from that, you are not completely worthless.
StoryText.损耗率较低。建议追击。: Damage rate is low. Pursuit recommended.
StoryText.补给线确认，无特殊情况。请求继续战斗。: Supply route verified. Nothing out of the ordinary noted. Permission to resume combat.
StoryText.切忌投鼠忌器。: Do not have reservations about confronting malevolence.
StoryText.损耗率超出阈值。建议撤退。: Damage rate has exceeded the limit. Retreat recommended.
StoryText.检测到前线阵型崩溃。建议重新编队，再次挑战。: Detected the breakdown of the frontline formation. Squad reorganization recommended.
StoryText.已完成战斗记录分析。请将其活用于之后的战斗，提升效率。: Combat record evaluation completed. Please employ it in future battles to improve efficiency.
StoryText.我叫狮鬃，由于一些原因，现在只能借我妹妹的身体活动。多指教啊！: I'm Solum. Due to some reasons, I can only move through my sister's body now. Nice to meet you!
StoryText.呀哈！ 终于到我出场了吗！: Yahoo! Is it finally my turn to shine?
StoryText.这幅身体……看上去是有点弱不禁风，但力量还是有的。你要是有需要，随时叫我啊！: This body... might look a bit fragile, but it still has some strength. If you need anything, just let me know!
StoryText.我妹可爱吧！简直被她可爱死了好吗！……呃，我好像已经死了哈。: Isn't my sister cute! She's so cute that it's killing me! ...Oh yeah, I think I'm already dead.
StoryText.嗯……男女的身体构造还真是大不一样啊。搞得我总是……不太自在。: Hmm... the male and female body structures are really different. It always makes me... a bit uncomfortable.
StoryText.我生前都是骑大型摩托的，不过现在妹妹的脚根本够不着。没办法，只好骑小的喽。: I used to ride large motorcycles, but my sister's feet can't reach the pedals now. So I have to ride smaller ones.
StoryText.我们的老家在一个城镇和贫民窟的交界地带。我生前的休息日，可全贡献给处理家周边散落: Our hometown was between an urban area and a slum. When I was alive, I spent my days off cleaning up the trash and debris around the house.
StoryText.因为当时不想让妹妹在那么肮脏的城市里长大，有一整年的时间我都在处理城市里的垃圾。: I didn't want my sister to grow up in such a filthy city, so I spent a whole year cleaning up the city. Ah, those were the days.
StoryText.我妹妹是个好孩子，就是有点内向，容易害羞。你要是愿意的话，就多陪她聊聊天吧。: My sister is a good kid, just a little introverted and shy. If you're willing, spend some more time chatting with her.
StoryText.只有戴着这个头盔的时候，我才会借用妹妹的身体。这期间我俩可以通过意念交流。: I only borrow my sister's body when wearing this helmet. During this time, we can communicate through telepathy.
StoryText.嘿！今天表现得也不错嘛！妹妹也很帅……哇！？不不，刚才那句是……: Hey! You did pretty well today! My sister looks cool too... Huh?! No, I meant...
StoryText.如果有一天，我突然消失的话……我妹妹就拜托给你照顾了。: If I suddenly disappear one day... please take care of my sister for me.
StoryText.嘿。你能帮我把酒浇到头盔上吗？……呃，果然还是不行啊。好吧好吧。: Hey. Could you pour some wine onto the helmet? ...Uh, I guess not. Alright, alright.
StoryText.有什么困难的话尽管叫我啊。朋友需要我，我必随叫随到。: If you're having any difficulties, just call me. When friends are in need, just call me and I'll be there.
StoryText.哈哈——！冲！给他们点颜色看看！: Hahaaaa! Let's go! Show them who they're up against!
StoryText.怎么，怕了？ 尽管来啊！: What? Scared? Come at me if you dare!
StoryText.不敢来？那就别怪我主动出击了！: Are you shaking in your boots? Don't blame me for making the first move, then!
StoryText.让开让开让开！: Make way, make way, make way!
StoryText.真是碍事！: What a pain in the ass!
StoryText.要是以前的我，还能再战！不过现在……我们先撤了！: If I were the old me, going another round would've been a cakewalk! But now... we'd better go!
StoryText.啧、可恶！ 下次一定赢给你看！: Tsk, dammit! The victory will be mine next time!
StoryText.啊哈哈，多谢夸奖！ 下次打架记得还叫我啊！: Ahahaha! Thanks for the compliment! Don't forget to invite me to the next fight!
StoryText.我是塔拉，这是库克。: I'm Tara, and this is Cook.
StoryText.呜啊~~~~好困……睡一会再来可以么？: Yawn~~ So sleepy... Can I take a nap before we continue?
StoryText.塔拉是为了给老爸来一拳才开始旅行的。你没有听错哦，是给、老、爸、来一拳。: Tara started this journey just to deal a blow to her dad. You heard that right. Deal. A. Blow. To. Her. Dad.
StoryText.好耶！这个月的钱有剩下来的，这次就豁出去买点高级食材吧。库克呢？想吃点好的么？: Oh yeah! There's some money left this month, so let's splurge on some high-quality ingredients. Cook, want something yummy?
StoryText.库克在外面打扫卫生。他的翅膀扑腾扑腾，就能把灰全吹走啦，真方便呢！: Cook is cleaning outside. He just needs to flap his wings to blow the dust away. How convenient!
StoryText.库克不怎么吃生肉。虽然好吃，但是生的总吃坏肚子，库克是这么说的。: Cook doesn't really like raw meat. Although it tastes good, raw food always upsets his stomach, according to Cook.
StoryText.头上加一个角去撞人，或者身体上捆上菜刀……嗯？我在想怎么给库克升级装备呢。: Add a horn to his head to charge at people, or attach kitchen knives to his body... Hmm? I'm thinking about how to upgrade Cook's gear.
StoryText.库克以前小小的，不过现在已经是超——大号哩！已经不能停在塔拉肩了，得停在头上才行: Cook used to be small, but now he's so... massive! He can't perch on my shoulder anymore. He has to sit on my head.
StoryText.列车长，我发现原来地表有那么多有趣的地方哦，你知道哪里最好玩吗？告诉塔拉嘛。: Do you know where the most fun places are on the surface, Conductor? Tell me.
StoryText.哦，这就是雪……白白的，冷冷的……果然地表好厉害好有趣啊，是谁在天上削冰柱吗？: Oh, so this is snow... White and cold... The surface is really amazing and interesting. Who's shaving ice up in the sky?
StoryText.列车长认真的时候好帅呀。再稍微认真一下好不好？奖励你库克的羽毛哦。: Conductor, you're so handsome when serious. Can you be a bit more serious? I'll reward you with one of Cook's feathers.
StoryText.列车长，塔拉有在努力工作，可以摸摸塔拉的头吗，嗯嗯~……再来再来！: I'm working hard, Conductor. Can you give me a pat on the head?? Uh huh~... Again, again!
StoryText.地表上有会潜水的鸟！这本地表科普书上写的……库克，要不你也学习一下？: There are birds on the surface that can dive underwater! This surface knowledge book mentioned it... Why don't you learn how to do it too, Cook?
StoryText.库克经常要吃肉，所以会花很多钱，所以库克要像骡子一样努力干活才行哦。: Cook often wants to eat meat, so he costs a lot of money. Therefore, he has to work hard like a mule!
StoryText.库克说前方安全，出发出发~: Cook says it's clear ahead. Let's go!
StoryText.不干活的鸟儿没饭吃，库克，你明白我什么意思吧？: Birds who don't work won't get to eat. Do you get me, Cook?
StoryText.库克！让他们看看我们的本事！: Cook, show them what we're capable of!
StoryText.库克加油！塔拉先溜咯。: Good luck, Cook! I'm gonna bail.
StoryText.还没给老爸来一拳，塔拉可不能在这里倒下……我先逃啦！: I can't bite the dust here when I haven't even given Dad a punch yet... Let's just make a run for it!
StoryText.因为库克是塔拉养大的，所以塔拉才是最强的！: I'm the one who raised Cook, so naturally, I'm the most formidable!
StoryText.在下幻羽流诗羽，代号“跳鼠”，请多指教啦！: I'm Shiu, code name "Tobinezumi", from Genuryu. Nice to meet you!
StoryText.在下最擅长变装和追踪了！嘿！今天就给你展示一下，幻羽流真正的技术！: I specialise in disguise and tracking! Hey! I'll show you the real skills of the Genuryu today!
StoryText.幻羽流的要义，也是身为忍者最原初的追求……那就是成为一名优秀的间谍。: The essence of Genuryu, and also the primary goal as a ninja... is to become an excellent spy.
StoryText.一子单传？不，如今的幻羽流是选拔制哦。毕竟幻羽流正面临失传危机呢。: Single inheritance? No, Genuryu uses a selection system nowadays. After all, Genuryu is at risk of becoming a lost art.
StoryText.幻羽流忍者一般来说是不会轻易露面的。像现在这样面对面说话的情况更是少之又少。: Genuryu ninjas generally don't reveal themselves. It's rare to have face-to-face conversations like this.
StoryText.我不擅长安安静静待在一个地方。……不像忍者？爷爷，不，老师也常这样说。: I'm not good at staying quiet in one place. ...Unlike a ninja? My grandfather, no, my teacher often said that too.
StoryText.在下将来，想成为一名演员呢。成为名声显赫的著名演员，赚好多好多钱，让爷爷不用那么: I want to be an actress in the future. Be a famous actress and make lots of money so that my grandfather doesn't have to work so hard.
StoryText.在下其实不太擅长以原本的面目示人，不过变装之后就能完全变成另一个人，就不会社恐啦: I'm not very good at revealing my true self before others. However, once I completely become another person when in disguise, I don't suffer from social anxiety.
StoryText.尽量不使用忍刀。不使用武器就能控制战斗，这是幻羽流的基本战法。: I avoid using the ninjato. Controlling the battle without using weapons is the basic tactics of Genuryu.
StoryText.因为爸爸不想当忍者也不想加入黑月，爷爷就找上了我，这也算是一种隔代遗传……诶，不: My dad didn't want to become a ninja or join Night Chains, so my grandfather asked me to. I guess it's also a kind of inheritance across generations... Eh, isn't that what it means?
StoryText.空闲时间？ 会欣赏一些著名女演员的老电影。那惊为天人的演技简直让人目不暇接。: Free time? I watch some old movies starring famous actresses. Their amazing acting skills are truly mesmerizing.
StoryText.诶呀呀，列车长~❤晚上好呢~❤……试着变了一下声，怎么样？ 吓到你了吗？: Oh my, Conductor~❤ Good evening~❤... How's this change in voice? Did I startle you?
StoryText.幻羽流变装术用现在的话来说就是高级化妆术。顺带一提，在下的师父，也就是爷爷，他曾: In modern terms, the Genuryu Transformation Technique is like advanced makeup artistry. By the way, my teacher and grandfather, used to be a stylist in public.
StoryText.在下以前，并不喜欢自己本来的面貌，但和列车长相识以后，在下似乎，对自己的外貌不那: I used to dislike how I look, but after getting to know you, Conductor, I seem to have become less concerned about my appearance.
StoryText.那……在下去去就回！: Then... I'll be back in a minute!
StoryText.哦！将他们一网打尽吧！: Okay! Let's wipe them out altogether!
StoryText.幻羽流从不做无谓的争斗。: Genuryu is never used for inconsequential fights.
StoryText.你的性命，在下就不客气了！: I won't be holding back on your life, then!
StoryText.幸好有替身术，不然在下就危险了。: Thank goodness for substitution jutsu, or I would've been a sitting duck.
StoryText.哦！作为忍者，在下还是头一回光明正大地获得此等殊荣。这种感觉，真叫人欲罢不能呀。: Woah! This is my first time getting such privileges as a ninja in the light of day. Such a feeling is truly addictive.
StoryText.你好啊，我是阿知波，一个休学中的问题儿童。请多指教。: Oh hello, Conductor, I'm Achiwa, a dropout with issues. Nice to meet you.
StoryText.什么？啊，已经到工作时间了啊。会努力的啦，毕竟我可是要复学的。: What? Oh, time for work already? I'll try my best, after all, as I want to resume schooling.
StoryText.那个，列车长……你在别人眼里一直都是“好人”吧。不过，跟我扯上关系的话，可能会影: Uh, Conductor... others have always regarded you as a good person, right? But, if you're associated with me, it might affect your reputation.
StoryText.早知道最后的结果会是休学然后进入阿妮塔的话，我就揍得更用力一点了……啊，我是说那: Had I known that dropping out would end up in me being sent to Anita, I would have hit harder... Ah, I mean the classmate I sent to hospital for his big mouth.
StoryText.我工作起来很认真谨慎？……是其他人做得太粗糙了吧。我只是普通地在干活而已: I'm very serious and meticulous in my work? ...Maybe it's because other people are doing a rough job. I'm just doing it as usual.
StoryText.车长！你要去哪儿吗？我准备去买衣服来着，如果顺路的话，要不要和我一起？我骑自行车: Hey, Conductor! Where are you going? I'm planning to buy some clothes. If it's on your way, why don't you come with me? I'll give you a lift on my bike.
StoryText.唔哇！别、别离我太近了！我需要一个比较宽阔的私人空间！: Whoa! D-Don't get too close to me! I need a sizeable personal space!
StoryText.那些人做事毛手毛脚的，看着就难受……算了算了，和我也没什么关系。: Those people are so clumsy, and it's uncomfortable to watch... Oh well, never mind. It has nothing to do with me.
StoryText.抱歉，我们换个地方聊吧。那边……呵，还真是和睦的亲子关系啊。我最讨厌看到这样的画: Sorry, let's chat somewhere else. Over there... Heh, what a harmonious parent-child relationship. I hate that sight the most!
StoryText.反正回到家里也是空无一人。倒不如阿妮塔的职工宿舍，虽然经常很吵，但是感觉还算不错: It's empty back home anyway. I prefer Anita's employee dormitory. It gets noisy often but it still feels good.
StoryText.我讨厌那些相亲相爱的一家人，因为他们让我羡慕得不知道怎么办才好。……我也讨厌充斥: I hate those affectionate families because they make me so envious that I don't know what to do. ... I also hate my own ugly heart filled with such jealousy and anger.
StoryText.世界上最好吃的东西就是刚刚炸好的薯条，不接受任何反驳！: The best thing in the world is fresh fries. I won't accept any disagreements!
StoryText.哇啊啊啊！都、都、都说了不要靠我太近啊！再、再有下次的话我要生气了！: Oh heyyyy! I-I-I said don't get too close to me! N-Next time I'll get mad!
StoryText.列车长，那个，无垠号还有在招人吗……我是说……有休学经验的要吗……: Conductor, is The Eternal still recruiting... I mean... do you accept dropout students...?
StoryText.过来让我练练手解解压呀！: Come here and let me crack some knuckles and relieve some stress!
StoryText.先挑事儿的是你们吧！: Aren't you people the ones who stirred shit first?!
StoryText.行不通就换个思路喽。打架就是这样啦。: If it doesn't work, try something else. This is how fighting goes.
StoryText.只要不影响复学，我奉陪到底！: So long as it doesn't affect my return to school, I'm in it for the long haul!
StoryText.怎么会！可恶！ 我生气了！: How's this possible?! Now you get me mad!
StoryText.真是的，我不想管了，随便吧……: Ugh, I don't wanna care anymore. Whatever...
StoryText.我是最佳队员？嗯……要是以前的我应该会很高兴吧，现在……行吧，既然如此那就谢谢你: I'm the Best Teammate? Hmm... I probably would've been ecstatic if it were in the past. But now.... Well, all right. In that case, thanks for the compliment.
StoryText.我是苍叶。我只会听从宵月的指示行动。: I am Aoba. I only follow Yoizuki's orders.
StoryText.叫我过来是有“什么”需要处理吗？……原来如此，没事就好。: Is there "something" I need to deal with? ...I see. I'm glad everything's alright.
StoryText.什么事？……有工作？需要我出动的话，必须要有宵月的许可。不然我是不会行动的。: What's the matter? ...Work to be done? If you need me, you must get Yoizuki's permission. Otherwise, I won't budge.
StoryText.宵月她真的很善良。愿意和我这种家族耻辱同行，让我做她的刀……我的心中唯有感谢之情: Yoizuki is so kind. She's willing to let a family disgrace like me accompany her and serve as her blade... My heart is filled with gratitude.
StoryText.我不过是个让家族蒙羞的废物而已……但是，宵月对我说，她需要我。从那之后我就下定了: I'm just a disgrace to the family... But Yoizuki told me she needs me. I've devoted my life to fighting just for Yoizuki ever since.
StoryText.假期……？我没有那种东西。就算真的有，我也不知道该做些什么……: Vacation...? I don't have that. Even if I did, I wouldn't know what to do...
StoryText.娱乐我来说是不必要的。沉溺在那些虚妄的东西里，变得更加不中用的话，宵月会不要我的: Entertainment is unnecessary for me. If I indulge in those illusions and become even more useless, Yoizuki will reject me. Absolutely it can't happen.
StoryText.我……很强？怎么可能，我最多也就是个杂鱼水平。看起来强不过是因为敌人太弱了。: I'm... strong? How's that possible? I'm average at best. I only look strong because the enemies are weak.
StoryText.虽然大家都称我为“宵月的影舞者”，但我觉得自己根本配不上……不过是沾了宵月的光而: Although everyone calls me the "Shadow Dancer of Yoizuki", I feel unworthy of the title... I'm just basking in Yoizuki's glory.
StoryText.只要能得到宵月的夸奖，我就很安心。这表示她还需要我。: As long as Yoizuki praises me, I feel at ease. It means she still needs me.
StoryText.不知道为什么，与你交谈时，我内心的不安就会减轻些……不可思议。: I don't know why, but talking to you alleviates my inner turmoil... Remarkable.
StoryText.那个……能再、陪我说说话吗？对不起，耽误你的时间了。实在抱歉……: Um... Can we... talk for a while longer? Sorry for taking up your time. My apologies...
StoryText.我养狗的事，请不要告诉宵月可以吗？宵月她，不喜欢除人类外的动物。: Please don't tell Yoizuki about me keeping a dog. She... doesn't like living things aside from humans.
StoryText.我……在看轻自己？并没有。除了会舞刀弄枪外，我确实毫无价值。: I'm... being self-deprecating? Not at all. Besides wielding blades and guns, I am truly worthless.
StoryText.宵月的敌人，就由我来了结。: I shall be the one to terminate Yoizuki's enemy.
StoryText.绝不会让你们……靠近宵月。: I will never let you... get close to Yoizuki.
StoryText.宵月的敌人，就是我的敌人！: Any enemy of Yoizuki will be mine!
StoryText.失败了吗……这是作为废物的我应有的结局……: Have I failed...? So, this is the ending a good-for-nothing like me deserves...
StoryText.不是我有什么大不了的，而是敌人们太弱了……: It's not that I'm a big deal of any sort; the enemies are simply too much of a joke...
StoryText.我是索思学会的达斯廷，向世人揭示希望即是我的使命。今后请多多关照，列车长。: I'm Dustin of Source Citadel. Revealing hope to the world is my mission. I look forward to working with you, Conductor.
StoryText.已经到换班时间了。你也辛苦了，列车长。: Shift change time already. You've done well today too, Conductor.
StoryText.你见过索玛了吗？她是我的女儿，虽然有点不善言辞，但我想你们一定能相处得很愉快的。: Have you met Sommer yet? She's my daughter. She's not the most talkative, but I'm sure the two of you will get along well.
StoryText.丽桑德拉也在附近吗？——没什么，我在想确实应该去打个招呼。虽然她不一定想看见我。: Is Lissandra nearby as well? —It's nothing. I was just thinking I ought to go say hello. Though she may not particularly wish to see me.
StoryText.有人受伤了吗？交给我吧，在变成“这幅样子”之前，我好歹也是一个医生。: Has someone been injured? Leave it to me. Before I became... this, I was a physician, after all.
StoryText.那由他只是看上去不太好接近而已，其实是懂事又听话的孩子……可以和他做朋友吗？: Nayuta only seems difficult to approach. In truth, he's a sensible, well-behaved child... would you be willing to be his friend?
StoryText.米兰妮离开这个世界后，我曾一度迷失自我。没有方向，没有目标，仅仅作为复仇的野兽苟: After Melanie left this world, I lost myself for a time. No direction, no purpose—I simply persisted as a beast driven by vengeance. It was Sommer who brought me back to my senses.
StoryText.需要“英雄”的存在才不至于崩塌的世界是病态的，但我们别无选择。: A world that cannot stand without the existence of "heroes" is a sick one. But we have no other choice.
StoryText.这个？这是我的手账本。不是什么不能给别人看的东西，扉页还有索玛小时候的涂鸦呢，我: This? It's my notebook. Nothing I'd mind showing you—there are even some of Sommer's childhood drawings on the inside cover. I've kept it well.
StoryText.我的义体只需要定期维护和更换，不用担心会像肉体那样坏掉。虽然听上去很方便，但感受: My prosthetics only require periodic maintenance and replacement; unlike flesh, they don't simply break down. It sounds convenient, I suppose, but the inability to feel pain has proven to be something of an inconvenience, in its own way...
StoryText.“连自己都无法照亮的人，却想着也许能够去照亮别人”。自不量力吗？我反而很欣赏呢。: "A man who cannot even light his own way, yet still hopes he might light the way for others." Foolish? If anything, I find it admirable.
StoryText.那由他总觉得自己隐瞒得很好。但我其实知道他做了什么……引导他不要再度踏入泥潭是我: Nayuta believes he's hidden it well enough. But I already know what he's done... it's my responsibility to guide him away from that mire before he steps into it again. I'll be mindful of the timing and manner in which I do so.
StoryText.和孩子们围在餐桌旁边一起吃饭是我最幸福的时刻。看着他们俩鼓起脸颊咀嚼，大口大口地: Sitting at the table with the children, sharing a meal together—that is my happiest moment. Watching the two of them chew with their cheeks puffed out, eating in great big mouthfuls... I find myself wishing time could simply stop here, forever.
StoryText.我目睹了无数的死亡，也见证过无数次诞生。人类是如此的坚韧，让我已成机械的心始终澎: I have witnessed countless deaths, and borne witness to countless births as well. Humanity is remarkably resilient—resilient enough that even this heart of mine, now mechanical, still stirs, and refuses to be still...
StoryText.请到我身后来。我会保护你们的！: Please, get behind me. I'll protect you all!
StoryText.这片区域已经没有敌人的气息了。: There's no trace of enemies left in this area.
StoryText.请跟随我继续前进。: Please, follow me. We continue on.
StoryText.让开，别挡着孩子们的路。: Move aside. Don't block the children's path.
StoryText.新的未来不需要你们，化为灰烬吧！: The new future has no need of you. Turn to ash.
StoryText.你们，快逃，我还能，阻挡他们一会儿……: You... run, quickly... I can still... hold them back a little longer...
StoryText.可以去见你了吗，米兰妮……: May I come see you now, Melanie...
StoryText.我期待着……这个世界不再需要英雄的那天。: I look forward... to the day this world no longer needs heroes.
StoryText.我是黛丝莉哦！梦想是“无论去哪里都能够以笑容可爱的单纯女孩子姿态融入其中”！请多: I'm Desiree! My dream is to be a pure and lovely girl who can smile wherever I go! Nice to meet you!
StoryText.啊，对不起！被从远处盯着看所以差点就……绝对没有想动手哦，真的！: Ah, sorry! Being stared at from afar... I really didn't intend to do anything, really!
StoryText.用列车长给的钱买了好多好多好吃的呢！……啊，好像有点太多了……: I bought so many yummy stuff with the money Conductor gave me!... Ah, looks like it's a bit too much...
StoryText.只要是黛丝莉喜欢的衣服就可以买吗？好耶！那就这件这件这件和这件！: Can I buy any clothes that I like? Oh yeah! Then I'll get this, and this, and this!
StoryText.这个弓一点都不沉啦。而且呀，看！是可以这样折叠起来的，很方便运输哦。: This bow isn't heavy at all. And, look! It can be folded like this! Very portable!
StoryText.列车长别担心！黛丝莉只是运动的时候稍微扭了一下……嘿！看，这样就好了？: Don't worry, Conductor! I just twisted my ankle a little during exercise... Hey! Look, better now?
StoryText.黛丝莉讨厌的食物？嗯……味道变酸的汤，还有里面好像有什么在钻来钻去的香肠……: Food that I hate? Hmm... Soup that's turned sour. And sausages that seem to have things wriggling inside...
StoryText.不要关灯！黛丝莉最怕黑黑的房间，会喘不过气。老师也说这是没办法治好的……对不起…: Don't turn off the lights! I'm really afraid of dark rooms. I'll suffocate. Teacher said it can't be cured... Sorry...
StoryText.列车长列车长列车长！其实，黛丝莉之前一直可以一击命中要害，所以曾经被称作“觅心者: Conductor! Conductor! Conductor! Actually, I used to be able to hit vital spots with just one strike, so I was called the Heartseeker!
StoryText.盯上列车长的坏家伙已经被黛丝莉抓到喽！暂且断了他的脚筋，要不要再打碎他的下巴？不: I caught the bad guy targeting Conductor! I've cut his tendons. Should I break his jaw too? No?
StoryText.列车长列车长！黛丝莉这次只买了一件新衣服哦！黛丝莉是不是乖孩子呀！: Conductor! Conductor! All I got is one new top this time! Aren't I a good girl?
StoryText.列车长，这个点心特别好吃哦，给你……这是黛丝莉的那份，但列车长是特别的，所以给你: Conductor, this dessert is really delicious. Have some... This is mine, but since you're special, you can have it!
StoryText.以前在黑黑的房间里睡不着，但是有列车长在身边就好多了，在黛丝莉睡着之前，列车长可: I couldn't sleep in dark rooms before, but it's much better with you by my side, Conductor. Before I fall asleep, can you not leave...
StoryText.那个那个，列车长。黛丝莉呢，好吃的东西、漂亮的新衣服还有钱钱都可以不要。这样的话: Uh, um... Conductor. I can forgo things like delicious food, beautiful new clothes, and money. If that's the case, Conductor, can you, can you... pat Desiree's head more?
StoryText.准备完毕，随时可以把他们全干掉！……啊，不能直接干掉来着，黛丝莉忘记啦。: All set. Ready to wipe them out at any time! Ah... I forgot, we're not supposed to wipe them out.
StoryText.这样的防线，黛丝莉随随便便就能突破了哦。: This defense line won't take me more than a minute to breach!
StoryText.一个也别想逃！: Don't even dream of getting away!
StoryText.箭筒已经空了，黛丝莉先回去一趟……: I'm out of arrows. Be back in a bit...
StoryText.好冷……不要……黑黑的地方……不要……: So cold... No... It's too dark... No...
StoryText.好耶！成功啦！黛丝莉是MVP！……不过MVP是什么意思呀？: Oh yay! We did it! I'm the MVP! But wait... What does MVP mean?
StoryText.我是菲妮娅！为了世界和平冲冲冲！: I'm Fenia! Charging in for world peace!
StoryText.到我出场了吗！？ 好耶！冲鸭——！: Is it my turn already?! Yay! Let's gooo—!
StoryText.我每天都会进行柔软性训练。毕竟只要偷懒一天，身体就会变僵硬呢。: I do flexibility training every single day. Even one lazy day and my body gets all stiff!
StoryText.不喜欢穿鞋子。万一到危急时刻不能用脚趾岂不是很糟糕！: I don't like wearing shoes. What if there's an emergency and I can't use my toes, that'd be terrible!
StoryText.我喜欢光着脚走路和战斗！穿上鞋子反而会容易让身体失去平衡……: I love fighting and walking around barefoot! Wearing shoes actually throws off my balance...
StoryText.穿高跟鞋的女人都好厉害哦。我的话……大概，没走上几步就会摔倒吧。: Ladies in high heels are so cool. Me? I'd probably trip after like two steps.
StoryText.运动量不够的话，要不要一起做体操？我可以教你哦！……啊，是、是正经体操哦！不是什: Not getting enough exercise? Wanna do some stretches together? I can teach you! ...Ah, I mean, normal stretches! Not anything weird...
StoryText.嗯~~！果然训练结束后冰淇淋都格外好吃呢！这家的香草冰淇淋超——好吃哦！: Mmm~! Ice cream just tastes so much better after training, doesn't it! This place's vanilla ice cream is sooooo good!
StoryText.好喜欢漂亮的大姐姐哦……光是看着她们就觉得超养眼超幸福: I love pretty ladies... just looking at them makes me feel all warm and happy inside.
StoryText.列车长列车长，你喜欢什么类型的大姐姐呀？ 啊，没什么，只是稍作参考……: Conductor, Conductor, what kind of lady do you like? Ah, no reason, just for reference...
StoryText.列车长，如果要去危险的地方，一定要告诉我哦！我来给你当护卫！我很强壮的！相信我！: Conductor, if you're ever heading somewhere dangerous, you have to tell me! I'll be your bodyguard! I'm super strong! Trust me!
StoryText.大家经常劝我战场上不要冲在太前面。可是，如果那样能让其他伙伴免受伤害，岂不是很好: Everyone keeps telling me not to rush too far ahead in battle. But if it means the others don't get hurt, isn't that a good thing?
StoryText.一字马超简单的呀！看，不就是、这样……啊！？ 额，列车长……你、你什么都没看到对: The splits are super easy! Look, it's just like— ah!? Um, Conductor... you didn't see anything, right?!
StoryText.嘿嘿，训练的时候不小心扭到脚了……不、不用了！让列车长背我也太不好意思了……那，: Hehe, I twisted my ankle during training... n-no it's fine! It'd be way too embarrassing to have you carry me, Conductor... okay, well... I guess... thanks.
StoryText.消灭一切人类的敌人！: Wipe out every enemy of humanity!
StoryText.我竟然……会输给……怎么会……: I actually... lost to... how could this...
StoryText.现在撤退的话，就没有机会了……: If we retreat now, we won't get another chance...
StoryText.耶！赢啦！ 菲妮娅会继续努力的！: Yay! We won! Fenia's gonna keep working hard!
StoryText.我是学会的冯里奈。被派遣至此协助工作……那个，听说这边可以按时下班，是真的吗……: I'm Rina Von from the Citadel. Dispatched here to help... Um, is it true that you clock out on time here...?
StoryText.休息时间一长就会觉得心里不踏实呢，哈哈……啊，没有没有！能休息当然是好事啦！: I get uneasy if my break time is too long, haha... Ah, no, no! Of course breaks are good!
StoryText.我很擅长记忆一些社会组织结构之类的东西，不过经常被人说派不上用场就是了……: I'm good at memorizing things like social organization structures. But I'm often told they are useless things...
StoryText.在进入学会前，我只是一名普通的公司职员。……原以为换个环境可以轻松点的……哎……: Before joining the Citadel, I was just an employee... I thought a change of environment would let me relax... Sigh...
StoryText.学会的薪资待遇还是很不错的呢。就是业务体制有点……怎么说呢，过于残酷吧……: The pay at the Citadel is pretty good. It's just that the business system is somewhat... how should I put it, overly harsh...
StoryText.诶！？有足足一个小时的午休时间！？那我是不是可以去喜欢的店吃饭了？: Huh!? An entire hour of lunch break!? Does that mean I can go to my favorite restaurant?
StoryText.学生时期的我曾一度沉迷过哲学，什么实证主义、存在主义之类的，一度被误以为是了不起: When I was a student, I was once obsessed with philosophy. Things like empiricism, existentialism, and the likes. I was mistakenly regarded as a remarkable talent...
