StoryText.上班时间竟然还能喝到这么好喝的茶……要是还在以前的公司，最多只能喝喝营养剂。: To think I can actually enjoy such marvelous tea during office hours... Back at my previous company, the most I got was nutritional supplements.
StoryText.嗯……以前有一次放长假，本计划好了去旅行的，结果被公司紧急召回去加班……真的是…: Yeah... There was once a time when I planned to travel during a long vacation, but was recalled by the company urgently to work overtime... Gosh...
StoryText.我给自己安排了一次“云旅行”，就在明天哦~——就是一边看旅游宣传片一边享受美食啦: I've planned a "virtual trip" for myself. It happens tomorrow~ — It's just watching travel videos while indulging in good food~ Haha~
StoryText.……最近明明没有在喝保健品和功能饮料了，但身体状态反而格外不错呢。这是为什么？: ...Even though I haven't been taking health supplements or energy drinks lately, my physical condition is unusually good. Why is that?
StoryText.那个，列车长……下次假期你有安排了吗？前段时间很火的那个景点，想去吗……？: Um, Conductor... Do you have any plans during the next holidays? Want to check out that scenic spot that was very popular recently...?
StoryText.啊——在无垠号上工作实在是太舒服了，被召回学会后还有点不适应呢。: Ah — Working on The Eternal is so comfortable that I had trouble adjusting to being recalled to the Citadel.
StoryText.来这边以后每天都能按时下班休息，甚至让我觉得有一些负罪感……不，果然还是应该庆幸: Since coming here, I've been able to clock out on time every day. I even feel guilty about it... No, of course I should feel fortunate!
StoryText.诶？！我、我也要战斗吗？！: Huh?! I-I have to join the combat too?!
StoryText.还、还有战败津贴？！福利居然这么好吗！？: T-There's even defeat compensation?! Are the benefits that great here?!
StoryText.这工作真的要干不下去了……: God, this job is killing me...
StoryText.那、那个，我负责防守可以吗？: U-Um... Can I be on the defense?
StoryText.都说了我肯定打不过……: See, told you I'd definitely lose...
StoryText.啊……住院的话，就能休假了呢……: Ah...! Being hospitalized means a break from work...
StoryText.真的吗，我是MVP吗？嘿嘿……什、还有下次？！！啊———: Really? I'm the MVP? Teehee.... W-What? I have to do this again?! Aaaaaaah!
StoryText.铁盟所属狐獴小队队长，甘雅。我没准备什么见面礼，你也不需要搞什么欢迎仪式，让我们: Captain of B.C.R.L Team Meerkat, Ganya. I haven't prepared any gifts, so don't plan some welcome ceremony. Let's just get down to work.
StoryText.我来协助你？不，我没有意见，我也对你怎么工作的有些好奇。: Need me to assist you? No, I've no opinion about that. I'm also a little curious about how you work.
StoryText.看到波克士的时候会觉得有些微妙，作为机械来说，它太像人了。不知道在雷火看来，这属: I find it a bit strange when I see BOX. As a machine, it's too human-like. I don't know if Reika considers this trustworthy.
StoryText.你想看看我的机械斧？可以，记得小心点，这斧子内部结构还挺复杂的，外行人摆弄不好可: You want to see my mechanical axe? Sure, just be careful. The internal structure of this axe is quite complex, and mishandling it could cause injury to someone unfamiliar with it.
StoryText.虽说现在是协助你的关系，但不代表你接下的铁安局任务我就会放松审核，请努力完成并且: Though I'm assisting you now, it doesn't mean I'll relax my scrutiny of the tasks you undertake for the BCRL Agency. Please strive to complete them and submit good reports. It'll make things easier between us.
StoryText.啊！有一只很少见的甲虫停在车窗边……已经飞走了。有点可惜，我还没来得及看清楚。: Ah! There was a rare beetle on the window... It's flown away now. It's a bit of a shame I didn't get a good look at it.
StoryText.列车长有事找我吗？抱歉，稍等一下……好了，完成。这是爷爷留给我的表，因为很老了，: Is there something you need, Conductor? Sorry, just wait a moment... There, done. This is the watch my grandfather left me. It's quite old, so I have to manually adjust the time from time to time.
StoryText.不擅长应付的东西？啊，那肯定是所有酸味的食物了……以前，瑞秋为了捉弄我专门搞了一: What I'm not good at? Ah, that would definitely be anything sour... Rachel once made a super sour drink just to tease me, and after taking a sip... I don't remember anything...
StoryText.我是在曼德矿场长大的，小时候喜欢和朋友溜到工地里看那些大型机械工作，我原本想着长: I grew up in Mander Mine. I spent my childhood sneaking into the construction site with friends to watch those large machines work. I wanted to be a skilled worker like my grandfather when I grew up... but since learning about his past, I've never thought about it again.
StoryText.伊洛娜虽然总是懒洋洋的，但我们都很信任她的能力。比起那些唯命是从的“省心”士兵…: Ilona always appears lazy, but we all trust her abilities. Compared to those obedient 'worry-free" soldiers... I prefer teammates like mine.
StoryText.关于维护机械这方面的技术，爷爷教了我不少知识，他是一名出色的工人。正因为他曾经如: Grandfather taught me a lot about maintaining machines. He was an excellent worker. It's precisely because he was once so proud of his work that I feel sad and angry to see him so disheartened now...
StoryText.唔，虽然我很感谢你的好意，可是作为铁盟的成员，擅自接受你的馈赠会引起不必要的麻烦: Hmm, while I appreciate your kindness, accepting gifts from you without permission as a member of B.C.R.L. would cause unnecessary trouble... Oh, alright, I'll accept it. I'll think about what to give in return.
StoryText.列车长每次碰面都很准时，我很喜欢。怎么了？我只是在夸赞你啊，干嘛露出那么奇怪的表: Conductor is always punctual when we meet. I like that. What? I'm just complimenting you. Why the odd expression?
StoryText.我发现了，列车长你其实不是什么很老实的人吧？别那么紧张，我又没说这样不好。如果你: I've noticed, Conductor, that you're not a very honest person, are you? Don't be so nervous. I'm not saying it's a bad thing. If you're the obedient type, I wouldn't be chatting with you like this.
StoryText.就这样循序渐进吧。: We'll take it one step at a time.
StoryText.不会再容许你们胡作非为！: I won't allow you all to continue running rampant!
StoryText.我还差得远吗……: Am I still not good enough...?
StoryText.怎么可以在这里就倒下……: How could I be defeated here...?
StoryText.只是尽力做好了分内之事而已。: I was just doing what I should do.
StoryText.噔噔噔~阿妮塔的人气大帅哥——晃，闪耀登场！: Ta-daaa~ Anita's most popular heartthrob, Akira, making his dazzling entrance!
StoryText.虽然我是不介意——但你要是因为沉醉于我的魅力，疏忽了工作那该怎么办？: Not that I mind—but what if you get so caught up in my charm that you start slacking off at work?
StoryText.放眼整个阿妮塔，我的人气也一定是数一数二的，毕竟我是善解人意的帅哥嘛。: Across all of Anita, my popularity has got to rank in the top two, easy. I'm the handsome guy who actually gets people, after all.
StoryText.列车长，你知道这个吗？最近超流行的饮料！到处都是同款，我？我早就去喝过了，落后潮: Conductor, do you know about this? The drink everyone's obsessed with lately! It's everywhere. Me? I tried it ages ago. Falling behind a trend? Never gonna happen to me!
StoryText.列车长，你是那种每天只顾着埋头开火车完全不关注流行的人吧……也没什么不好的，嗯！: Conductor, you're the type who keeps your head down driving the train all day and pays zero attention to what's popular, aren't you... Nothing wrong with that. Mm!
StoryText.怎么样，白色很适合我吧？回答的话在“是的”和“没错”里面选一个！: Well? White suits me, doesn't it? For your answer, pick between "yes" and "absolutely"!
StoryText.唉，我这样风趣的人居然会摊上那个“认真小姐”做搭档……哦，就是伊尔啦。虽然和她一: Ugh, a fun guy like me, stuck with "Miss Serious" for a partner... oh, I mean Yer. Working with her is low-maintenance, sure, but she doesn't get humor at all. Such a drag!
StoryText.铁盟的制服真是一言难尽，直白点说就是超——老土，不过……跟你倒还算搭。: There's a lot I could say about the BCRL uniform, and to put it bluntly, it's so— dated. Though... it does kind of work on you.
StoryText.要来合影吗，我会把你拍得很上镜的哦~嗯嗯……反正不管怎么样都不用担心会被你抢风头: Want to take a photo together? I'll make you look great in it~ Mm-hmm... anyway, no danger of you stealing the spotlight, so go ahead and show off all the charm you've got!
StoryText.停停停——不，不是嫌弃你……只是我对肢体接触，嗯……需要一些心理建设。: Stop, stop, stop— no, it's not that I mind you... it's just, physical contact, I need to, um... brace myself for it a bit.
StoryText.之前我特地去学了一个超帅的回转动作，大概就是像这……哇啊！嘶，好痛！别笑了，快扶: I learned this seriously cool spin move a while back. It goes something like—whoa! Ss—that hurt! Stop laughing and help me up! ...And don't tell anyone!
StoryText.列车长对滑雪有兴趣吗？可以先从挑一副适合你的滑雪镜开始哦，我有推荐的牌子和款式，: Are you interested in skiing, Conductor? You could start by picking out a pair of goggles that suit you. I've got a brand and a style to recommend, so keep your time off free—hm? I'm coming with you, obviously.
StoryText.我一直很想去芬利城旅游来着，最好是长期的。列车长，要是你哪天要去的话一定记得叫上: I've always wanted to travel to Frostville City. Long-term, ideally. Conductor, if you ever go, remember to bring me along. Promise? And if you go back on it... Huh? I would not cry!
StoryText.列车长，你身边各种各样的人真的好多啊——这不就证明了你比我还有人气吗！啊，我可没: Conductor, you've got so many different kinds of people around you—doesn't that prove you're more popular than me?! Ah, I'm not saying I feel lonely or anything. It just doesn't add up!
StoryText.在这里拍一张纪念照吧~: Let's get a photo here to remember it by~
StoryText.这种事对我来说洒洒水啦！: Something like this is nothing to me!
StoryText.这个动作，应该会超上镜的吧！？: This pose is going to look amazing on camera, isn't it?!
StoryText.看漏了我帅气的身姿的话可是你的损失！: Missing me looking this good is your loss!
StoryText.脏兮兮的……糊在身上……真恶心。: Filthy... all over me... this is disgusting.
StoryText.这不是理所当然的吗？要把我的英姿好好烙印在你的脑海里哦！: Well, obviously! Make sure you burn my glorious form into that memory of yours!
StoryText.您好，我是来自阿妮塔的卡莱雅，要是有什么需要我帮忙的，请不要客气直接开口吧。: Hello, I'm Kaleya from Anita. If there's anything I can help you with, feel free to ask.
StoryText.守护的工作我很擅长哦，请尽管，不，应该说是务必依靠我。: I'm very good at guard work. Please feel free, or rather, definitely rely on me.
StoryText.咦，以为我不是园丁而是阿妮塔的实习护士？不，不用道歉，不如说我很高兴听到你这么说: Hey, did you think I was Anita's intern nurse instead of a Gardener? No need to apologize. I appreciate that you did. Thank you.
StoryText.我所使用的工具拥有传送功能，就像船锚一样能够标记特定的“位置”。不要小看它哦，曾: The tool I use can teleport, just like ship anchors are able to mark specific "locations". Don't underestimate it. Accidents due to getting lost and being unable to return to the surface are not uncommon.
StoryText.关于如何保管桦石，我的建议是在它们旁边播放摇滚乐，毕竟桦石也算石头嘛，呵呵呵。: As for how the storage of Chaos Stones, my suggestion is to play rock & roll music nearby. After all, Chaos Stones are rocks, hehehe.
StoryText.园丁们每一次探险都需要大家各司其职、互相配合，我很喜欢能在其中一环发挥作用支持同: Gardeners need everyone to do their part and cooperate in every adventure. I enjoy being able to contribute and support my companions in any way I can.
StoryText.晃和我曾经是跟随同一位导师的同期生，但是他似乎不太愿意和我一起共事。嗯……可能还: Akira and I were once classmates under the same mentor, but he seems reluctant to work with me. Hmm... maybe he's still feeling awkward about not being popular.
StoryText.虽然我在工作时也会使用无人机，不过这方面的技术还是伊尔小姐懂得更多些，她是一位很: While I use drones at work, Miss Yer is more knowledgeable in this field. She's a really nice person.
StoryText.我的父母都是很优秀的医生，所以我也希望能成为和他们一样的人……虽然现在的本职并不: My parents are excellent doctors, so I hope to be like them... even though my current job isn't in healthcare, I can still protect everyone.
StoryText.我喜欢搜集餐具，但是不喜欢惨剧，也不太擅长应付残局……噗！啊哈哈哈，我不行了，哈: I like cutlery, but not cut atery, get what I mean... Pfft, ahahaha, I can't handle this, hahahahaha!
StoryText.我有许多藏品都是陶瓷的，美丽却易碎。如果想要保证它们不会破碎，最好是将其束之高阁: Many of my collections are ceramic, beautiful yet fragile. It's best to keep them locked away high up in cabinets forever to prevent them from being broken...
StoryText.总觉得面对你时能够越发敞开心扉了，这究竟是好事，还是坏事呢？: I feel that I'm starting to open up more when I'm with you. Is this a good thing or a bad thing?
StoryText.必要的时候我也会重拾医者的技能为受伤的同伴治疗，每当这时我总会心潮澎湃，要是……: I also rediscover my medical skills when necessary to treat injured companions. Whenever that happens, I always feel excited, but... ah, no, how could I wish for others to get hurt?
StoryText.医生还是园丁，列车长认为我更接近哪边呢？医生的话那就是一生一世，园丁的话就是缘定: Conductor, do you think I'm more of a doctor or a gardener? Doctor means "death omen cannot tear our relationship", and gardener means "gentle affection, radiant days, endless nights, eternal raves". Either way is good, isn't it? Hehehe, do you find this interesting, Conductor?
StoryText.我会尽己所能支援各位的。: I'll do my best to assist all of you.
StoryText.这里就请交给我！: Allow me to take care of this!
StoryText.无论战斗还是治疗都需要热情呢。: Passion is needed no matter in combat or healing.
StoryText.啊啊……怎么能自己先倒下……: Aaah...! How could I be defeated first...?!
StoryText.有劳各位了！以防万一，战斗结束后请好好检查自己的身体状况。: Thank you for the help, all! As a precaution, please do a thorough physical examination after the battle.
StoryText.你好啊列车长，我是阿妮塔的探路者卡洛琳。这段时间就麻烦你多多关照啦！: Hello, Conductor, I'm Caroline, Anita's Pathfinder. Nice to meet you!
StoryText.我准备好后就来！一会儿见！: I'll be ready soon! See you in a bit!
StoryText.探路者的职责，就是提供最优行程路线——关于这方面，我还是很有经验的，放心交给我吧: A Pathfinder's job is to provide the best route possible — I have a lot of experience in that, so leave it to me!
StoryText.别看我瘦，其实我耐力还挺好的哦。你看长跑运动员里一般没有肌肉特别发达的，对吧？就: Don't be fooled by my skinny appearance. My endurance is actually pretty good. Most long-distance runners don't have very developed muscles, right? The same logic applies.
StoryText.比起饮料和点心，结束工作以后要是能喝到一瓶冰镇的纯净水，就是我最开心的事啦！: Instead of drinks and snacks, I'm delighted when I get a bottle of chilled purified water after work!
StoryText.我的眼神看起来有点凶？对啊，因为这个，大家都有点怕我。不过也因此给人留下了深刻的: My gaze looks somewhat fierce? Well, that's why everyone is a little afraid of me. But it also leaves a lasting impression, so... I guess it's a blessing in disguise, hahaha.
StoryText.“当地人”提供的各种信息，对于探路者来说是不可或缺的。所以我这份工作也需要出色的: Information provided by locals is indispensable for Pathfinders. So, my job also requires excellent conversational skills. I mustn't let the conversation die after just a few sentences.
StoryText.我从小就一直喜欢去各种陌生的地方冒险，但我从没想过，长大之后还能有如此适合自己兴: I've always loved adventuring in all kinds of new places since I was a child, but I never thought I could land a job that suits my interests. Accepting Anita's offer to become a Pathfinder was one of the best decisions I've ever made.
StoryText.列车长，我最近的几次任务都没有和叶珏吵架哦。和她比起来，总觉得能源研究所的那些个: Conductor, I haven't argued with Yejue in my recent missions. Compared to her, I feel that the researchers at Anita Energy Institute are the real problem, especially the acting director... No, it's not like I'll listen to Yejue just because of that.
StoryText.以上就是这次的工作报告……哦，对了。这个，路上发现的纪念品，送你啦。是一种稀有植: And that wraps up this report... Oh, right. Here, I found this souvenir on the way. It's for you. It's the fruit of a rare plant. You can dry it and make it a decoration.
StoryText.列车长——我回来了!……啊，好险好险，差点就……工作汇报结束后才能击掌和拥抱，对: Conductor — I'm back!... Ah, that was close, I almost... No hand shakes or hugs before giving the report, right? I remember!
StoryText.我住的地方基本上什么家具和摆件都没有，空荡荡的，叶珏上次去了以后说“一点生活气息: I've got no furniture or decorations at home. It's completely empty. Yejue said there's no trace of life there when she visited last time. But I don't stay home anyway! My true home is the road of exploration!
StoryText.……发现了新的未探索区域？！我要去，我当然要去，务必派我去！和谁搭档还是一个人都: ...Discovered a new unexplored area?! I want to go. Of course I want to go! You must send me! Alone or with a partner, I'll go — Conductor — let me go —!
StoryText.一直以来，探路者的工作都是一个人的冒险，我也习惯了独自享受和经历这个过程。但现在: I've always adventured alone in my job as a Pathfinder and I've gotten used to enjoying it alone. But now I feel that it's not bad having a place to come back to either.
StoryText.出发，开拓安全地带！: Let's go pioneer a safe zone!
StoryText.不好意思，这局我就拿下啦！: Sorry, victory's gonna be mine this time!
StoryText.你们要不要考虑主动撤退？这对我们彼此都好！: How about you guys consider a voluntary retreat? This will be better for us all!
StoryText.别想阻挡我们开拓新路线的脚步！: Don't even think about stopping us from pioneering a new route!
StoryText.这就是……过于相信直觉的结果吗？: Is this... the result of overly trusting my instinct?
StoryText.还想要去……更多地方冒险啊……: I still wanna go... on more adventures...
StoryText.突然这么多伙伴祝贺我，我……不太习惯，有点怯场，哈哈哈哈哈。但是很高兴，谢谢。: Gosh, I'm... not that used to so many of you congratulating me all of a sudden. Makes me a bit nervous. Hahahahaha! But I'm really happy. Thank you.
StoryText.我是奈弥，受命来此协助你的工作。请下令吧。: I'm Nabi, tasked to assist you with your work. Orders, please.
StoryText.我不太擅长当助理……不过，保镖工作我还是能胜任的。: I'm not a very good assistant... but I can handle being a bodyguard.
StoryText.你说你不会命令我？……那，给我派发任务就好。你很独特，但希望你不要变成隼先生那样: You won't give me orders?... Then, just assign me tasks. You're unique, but I hope you won't become like Mr. Hayabusa, constantly leaving me to make decisions on my own.
StoryText.这把武器还算趁手，更重要的是轻巧好用。很适合我。: This weapon feels good in my hands, and more importantly, it's light and easy to use. Suits me well.
StoryText.塞西尔？是的，我和她算是……朋友。她是我来到黑月后认识的第一个朋友。……她人很好: Cecil? Yes, we're... friends. She's the first friend I made after arriving at Night Chains... She's a good person.
StoryText.我偶尔会画些素描，绘画总需要一些安静的个人空间。不过请放心，不会耽误工作的，命令: I draw sketches sometimes. Drawing requires some quiet personal space. But don't worry. It won't interfere with my work. My orders take precedence over my personal needs.
StoryText.那是我和塞西尔刚成为朋友的时候，她送了我一只乌鸦作为礼物。它是个很聪明的孩子，还: That's when Cecil and I first became friends. She gave me a crow as a gift. It's a clever little thing and even helps me fetch my slippers. If I get the chance, I'll bring it to show you.
StoryText.父亲是我唯一的家人，他为了保护荷塞先生而牺牲。荷塞先生从来没有亏待过我，也许他是: My father was my only family. He sacrificed himself to protect Mr. Jose. Mr. Jose has never mistreated me. Maybe he hopes I can protect Mr. Hayabusa like my father did, but Mr. Hayabusa seems to dislike me doing that.
StoryText.我没什么远大的梦想，也没有野心。现在的生活还不错……但也仅此而已。: I don't have grand dreams or ambitions. Life is good as it is now... but that's about it.
StoryText.我的战斗术融合了许多流派，都是通过不断的比试和切磋精进的。我希望变得更强，但要论: My combat skills incorporate many styles, honed through constant practice and sparring. I want to become stronger, but I don't know what for. I just feel like having a goal to achieve would make it easier and not have to think too much about it.
StoryText.塞西尔特别喜欢让我试用她研发的各种香水，说是因为我的气味最淡，能够很好地展现那些: Cecil loves getting me to test the perfumes she makes, saying my scent is the lightest and can showcase the effects of the products well. I can't smell the differences in everyone's scent, but I'm glad to see her happy.
StoryText.至今为止，我好像都只是在摹画现实存在的事物……不过，我好像逐渐诞生出“想要创作什: I've only been sketching things that exist so far... but I'm getting close to the idea of creating something beautiful. Though, I can't draw anything specific yet. It's just a sudden impulse.
StoryText.想要我教你跳舞……？抱歉，不行。不，并非我不愿意教你，但我认为舞是一种发自内心的: Want me to teach you how to dance...? Sorry, I can't. No, it's not that I don't want to teach you, but I believe dance is an expression from the heart. It's hard to convey through structured tutorials. Next time, I can invite you to the club to watch me dance.
StoryText.最初来到这里时，我认为你会把我当做武器使用。不过，现在我知道了，你以及其他人，都: When I first came here, I thought you would use me as a weapon. But I get it now that you and the others treat me as a companion. It's an unfamiliar feeling... but I'll get used to it.
StoryText.在彻底结束之前，不要松懈。: Do not be complacent before it's absolutely over.
StoryText.我能应付。上了。: On it. I can handle it.
StoryText.你们先撤退。: Retreat for now, all of you.
StoryText.完成了，不用给我额外的表彰。我只是执行命令而已。: Done. Save the extra praise. I was only following orders.
StoryText.我是气味学研究员，塞西尔。……你的味道，我不讨厌。请多指教。: I'm Cecil, a Scent Researcher... I don't dislike your scent. Nice to meet you.
StoryText.列车长？不用看也知道是你来了。你的味道，很特别……: Conductor? I can tell it's you without looking. Your scent is rather unique...
StoryText.我的专业是生理气味学。简单来说，我研究的是那些可以影响到生物行为反应的气味。: I specialize in physiognomy. Simply put, I study scents that can affect biological behavioral responses.
StoryText.虽然大多数人不会意识到，但气味实际上是可以对人的状态产生影响的。想试试看么？: Although most people don't realize it, scents can actually influence a person's status. Want to try it?
StoryText.请原谅我在握手时会带着手套这件事。我无法忍受手上沾染别人的味道。: Please forgive me for wearing gloves when shaking hands. I can't stand the smell of others on my hands.
StoryText.对外貌的赞美之词有那么多种，而对气味称赞的词语却只有寥寥数个。人们对气味可真是迟: There are so many words to compliment looks, but only a few for scent. People are really dull when it comes to scents.
StoryText.我会根据气味来判断对人的第一印象。比如说列车长，其实我很喜欢你身上的味道呢……怎: I'll judge a person's first impression based on their scent. For example, Conductor, I actually quite like the scent on you... What's with that look? Did I surprise you?
StoryText.休息的时候我也会去玩玩，交点新朋友……说是搭讪也可以，因为我需要更多的样本来帮助: I also go out to make friends and socialize during my free time... Or even call it flirting. It's because I need more samples to aid my research.
StoryText.亚莉奈……我和那个女人合不来。她身上的气味很危险……我劝你也离她远一点。: Arina... I don't get along with that woman. Her scent is very dangerous... I advise you to stay away from her.
StoryText.调香只是兴趣使然。你要不要也试试看呢？……不想？别担心，我没有往里面加什么奇怪的: Perfuming is just a hobby. Want to give it a try?... No? Don't worry. I haven't added anything strange.
StoryText.无法理解手抓饭这种东西，怎么会有人能容忍那气味留在自己的皮肤上……: I can never wrap my head around the concept of eating with hands. How can anyone tolerate having that smell on their skin...
StoryText.有气味的清洁用品是真是让人讨厌，工业合成的气味怎么都说不上好闻吧。: Scented cleaning products are really annoying, as industrial synthetic scents just smell bad.
StoryText.听说我研制出的气味喷雾的销量很好，这只不过是刚刚开始而已。气味学一定会应用到更多: I heard the sales of the scent sprays I developed are doing well. This is just the beginning. Aromatherapy will be applied to more areas in the future.
StoryText.列车长——？你在哪里呢？不出来也没关系，只需要靠气味就能很快找到你了。: Conductor—? Where are you? It's okay if you don't come out. I can find you quickly just by your scent.
StoryText.我会不择手段，想必你不会有异议。: I'll do whatever it takes, and I doubt you'd disagree with that.
StoryText.就当做是一场实验吧。: Just take it as an experiment.
StoryText.别担心，最多是阵痛而已。: Don't worry. Just cramps at most.
StoryText.……我受够了，全部抹去吧。: ...I've had enough. Wipe them all out.
StoryText.没想到，我也有今天……: To think this would happen to me too...
StoryText.抱歉……善后的工作就拜托了。: Sorry... Please take care of the rest.
StoryText.既然我是大功臣，那么要求些许报酬也在情理之中的事吧。: Since this is mostly thanks to me, it's just reasonable for me to ask for some rewards, right?
StoryText.我是……索玛……我，我会……努力的……: I'm... Sommer... I'll... try my best...
StoryText.唔……拜、拜托你……不、不要……看我的、手……: Um... please... don't... look at my... hand...
StoryText.对、对不起……我、没有、讨……讨厌列车长。我只是不、不太擅长……和人讲话……: S-sorry... I don't... hate you, Conductor. I'm just... not very good... at talking to people...
StoryText.左、左手有些、奇怪……但是、没、没关系的……！我、我是人类！不、不会袭击、任何人: My... left hand is a little... strange... but it's... fine... I'm human! I won't... hurt anyone...!
StoryText.与、陌生、人……不擅长……讲话。要、要考虑、很久……我、我说不、好……: I'm not good... at talking to... strangers. I need... a long time to think... I can't... find the words...
StoryText.我很容易饿的……所以为了不让自己饿肚子，我会……随身携带很多很多……糖果！: I get hungry really easily... so to make sure I don't go hungry, I... carry a lot, a lot of... candy with me!
StoryText.想让自己的手稍微、好看一点……就、尝试了美甲……列车长……好、好看吗？: I wanted my hands to look a little... nicer... so I tried... nail art... Conductor... does it... look okay?
StoryText.我会尝试、再释放一些自己的力量的……但是，很害怕……我会不会变得、不再是我……: I'll try to... release a little more of my power... but... I'm scared... what if I stop being... me...
StoryText.我、讨厌体检……以前他们为了研究我的左臂，总是抽我的血，很痛的……！再也不要了…: I... hate check-ups... they used to take my blood all the time, to study my left arm... it hurt... I don't want that... ever again...
StoryText.那个、车长……！我发现了一家好吃的自助餐厅……想和你、一起去……可以吗？: Um, Conductor...! I found a really good buffet... do you want to... go with me?
StoryText.我的左手虽然变异了……但它依旧能感受到车长的温度……是非常温柔的、温度。: My left hand may have changed... but it can still feel your warmth, Conductor... it's a very... gentle warmth.
StoryText.唔……如果车长想听的话，我可以、唱歌给你听的！因为、你是、特别的……: Um... if you want to hear it, I could... sing for you! Because... you're... special...
StoryText.车长，这个、给你……是我最喜欢的糖果、超大的糖果！有点酸酸的，能吃很久呢！: Conductor, this is... for you... it's my favorite candy... the extra big one! It's a little sour, but it lasts a long time!
StoryText.嗯……没、没事的……继续……前进。: Mm... it's... fine... let's keep... moving forward.
StoryText.你好，我叫瓦伦汀，在学会中担任“司书”一职。: Hello, I'm Valentine. I serve as a Scribe at the Citadel.
StoryText.有什么吩咐吗？ 请稍后，我夹个书签。: Orders? Please hold one while I place a bookmark.
StoryText.你在找什么书吗？如果有困难的话可以随时问我。: Are you looking for a particular book? If you're having trouble, feel free to ask me.
StoryText.虽然列车摇晃得很厉害，但我完全不会觉得难受。嗯……没有晕车的症状呢。: Although the train is shaking quite a bit, I don't feel uncomfortable at all. Hmm... no symptoms of motion sickness.
StoryText.我只是能记住书的封面和书名，并不能记住书里的全部内容……: I only remember the covers and titles of books, not their contents...
StoryText.这个湿度……书容易受潮。我得带一个除湿机来。: The humidity... makes the books prone to dampness. I need to bring a dehumidifier.
StoryText.你要找的书……不能轻易外借呢。请稍等，我和学会的上级申请一下。: The book you're looking for... can't be easily lent out. Please wait while I get approval from the Citadel superiors.
StoryText.别看我这样，以前还申请过加入御敌枢纽呢。不过因为实在不具备相应素质，很快就被淘汰: Don't judge me by my appearance. I applied to join the Destroyer. However, I lacked the necessary qualifications and I was quickly eliminated.
StoryText.列车长，要一起去喝茶吗？是的，这是我搭配的茶点。嗯？有什么奇怪的吗？: Care for some tea, Conductor? Yes, I prepared these snacks to go with the tea. Hmm? Is there something strange?
StoryText.我讨厌虫子……蚊子大小的还可以忍受，再大一些的就……呃——！: I hate bugs... I can tolerate ones the size of mosquitoes, but any bigger ones... ugh—!
StoryText.边看书边吃点心的时候，一定要注意别把油渍弄到书上。所以我准备了小夹子。: When eating snacks while reading, we must be careful not to get oil stains on the books. That's why I prepared clips.
StoryText.撰文迷宫中有许多不够“平和”的藏书，我用管理员权限建了个迷你休闲图书馆。那么……: The Fabricate contains many books that aren't "peaceful" enough. So, I created a mini leisure library with administrator privileges. So... Conductor, what book would you like to borrow?
StoryText.每天需要搬运那些沉重的书籍资料，所以肩膀很容易酸痛。列车长，你……能不能帮我按摩: Every day, I need to move those heavy books and documents, so my shoulders easily get sore. Conductor, could you... give me a massage?
StoryText.啊，列车长，之前给你推荐的书，好看嘛？ 是、是嘛……你喜欢就好！: Oh, Conductor, did you enjoy the book I recommended to you before? Y-You did... I'm glad you liked it!
StoryText.希望不拖大家后腿……我会努力的。: I'll do my best and hopefully not drag you guys down...
StoryText.从书上得来的知识，就让我来实践一下吧。: Let's see how well book knowledge applies in practice.
StoryText.火焰……不会饶恕你！: The flames... will not pardon you!
StoryText.果然，我的力量还是太弱了……: My power is still too weak...
StoryText.我还是乖乖待在后方吧……: I'd best stay out of the way at the back...
StoryText.没有大家的帮助，我什么也做不到。谢谢大家！: I couldn't have done anything without your help. Thank you, all!
StoryText.我是黑月的宵月。往后还请您多多指教。: I am Yoizuki of Night Chains. I look forward to working with you in the future.
StoryText.需要小女出面，想必事态已经十分严峻呢。呵呵……我很期待。: If I need to intervene personally, I'm sure the situation is very serious. Hehe... I'm looking forward to it.
StoryText.哦呀，这是给我的伴手礼吗？真是多谢您了，列车长。我对这“落雁”可是十分钟情呢。: Oh my, is this a souvenir for me? Thank you very much, Conductor. I'm quite fond of this "Rakugan".
StoryText.黑月吗？嗯哼……我们黑月确实是很优秀的组织。每一位成员都很能干。: Night Chains? Hmm... we are an excellent organization indeed. Every member is very capable.
StoryText.不管您信不信，这世上啊，无论什么事都逃不过黑月的“眼睛”……: Believe it or not, nothing in this world can escape the "eyes" of Night Chains...
StoryText.我个人非常看好您的前景呢，列车长。希望今后，我们能建立全方位的合作关系，那么，首: I sincerely believe in your potential, Conductor. I hope that in the future, we can establish a comprehensive cooperative relationship. So, let's start by getting to know each other better...
StoryText.身而为人，皆有弱点。无情之辈的血肉也是父母赋予。有牵绊，便有破绽……。: As humans, we all have weaknesses. Even the blood and flesh of ruthless people are from their parents. Where there are bonds, there are vulnerabilities...
StoryText.“他们”希望我接任家主之位，但是我并无此打算。不过如果拒绝得过于明显，我的行动便: "They" want me to take over as the head of the family, but I have no intention of doing so. However, if I refuse too blatantly, my actions will be restricted. Therefore, I still need to cooperate with them and put on an act.
StoryText.我真心地爱着我的姐姐。……越是笨拙的孩子，越是可爱，正是这个道理，不是吗？: I truly love my sister. ...The clumsier the child, the more adorable. Isn't that right?
StoryText.我与姐姐是不同的。我最爱的是我自己。这世上有一个我便足够了，能与我并驾齐驱之人无: I am different from my sister. I love myself the most. The world only needs one of me, and there's no need for anyone to be equal to me.
StoryText.我最讨厌动物了。因为那些畜生不仅没用，还总对我流露敌意。: I hate animals the most. Because those beasts are not only useless, but they're also always hostile toward me.
StoryText.黑月、是个优秀的组织。所以我必须提防他们会成为我的敌人。: Night Chains is an excellent organization. So I must be wary of them becoming my enemies.
StoryText.落雁的话，我能一下子吃一百枚哦。呵呵，没关系的。大脑的高速运转需要这些能量。: When it comes to Rakugan, I can eat a hundred of them in one go. Hehe, it's okay. The high-speed operation of my brain requires all the calories.
StoryText.列车长，你可千万不要背叛我哦。我可不想，忍痛手刃心爱之人呢。: Conductor, please don't ever betray me. I don't want the pain of having to end the life of someone I love.
StoryText.战斗并非我的强项，请不要对我抱有期待。: Combat isn't my strong suit. Please don't expect much from me.
StoryText.今日就到此为止吧，祝您万事顺遂。: That's it for today, then. All the best to you.
StoryText.真是扫兴。我要回去了。: What a buzzkill. I'm heading back.
StoryText.不胜荣幸，就让小女收下这份殊荣吧。: It'd be my privilege to accept this glory.
StoryText.我是魇。我会把坏人统统打跑哦。: I'm Maruha. I'll chase away all the bad guys.
StoryText.什么！对手是个令人作呕的大坏蛋？！我要去我要去！！: What?! The opponent is a disgusting villain?! I'm in! Count me in!!
StoryText.不会抵抗的对手就没有击溃的价值。你能理解吗？ 喔？看样子你也是同道中人嘛~！: There's no point defeating an opponent who doesn't fight back. Do you understand? Oh? Looks like we're one of a kind~!
StoryText.他们老说我是抖S，可我也不是谁都欺负的哦。我很挑的！: They always call me a sadist, but I'm not someone who bullies just anyone. I'm very picky!
StoryText.黑月的情报一直很准确呢。但它可不是什么好地方哦。相信我。: Night Chains has always provided accurate intelligence indeed, but it's not a good place. Trust me.
StoryText.竟然有人说我是无差别下手！真是失礼。明明每一个目标都是我精挑细选的，哼……: Someone actually accused me of attacking indiscriminately! How rude. I select each target carefully, hmph...
StoryText.欢迎光临~！今日的推荐菜单是——刺身套餐~是真的刺身哦，不是什么奇怪的材料☆: Welcome~! Today's recommendation is — the sashimi set~ It's real sashimi, not some strange ingredients☆
StoryText.当服务员的时候，我的人设是个“迟钝的懵懂少女”啦。这种人设最受男人欢迎了呢。: When I was a waitress, my character was a clueless innocent girl. Such a character is the most popular with men, you know.
StoryText.若是遇上实力悬殊的对手，就蛰伏起来，直到找到制胜之法为止。要花上几天也好，几个月: When facing opponents with vastly different strengths, I'll lay low until I find a way to win. It can take days or months. Whatever the case, I'm very patient.
StoryText.亲眼看着那些自以为是的东西不堪折磨跪地求饶，真是，最极致的欢愉了呢，嗯哼。: To see those who think they're superior begging for mercy in agony... it's the ultimate pleasure, mhmm.
StoryText.这副眼镜只是个装饰品啦~不过是因为以前拷问俘虏时失手伤了他的动脉……总之影响了我: These glasses are just decorative~ I just accidentally injured someone's artery during an interrogation... That affected my vision, so I got these glasses made just in case~
StoryText.我这个人呀，虽然喜欢杀戮，但是却讨厌那些鲜红的液体呢~沾到衣服上可就不好了呢。: Although I enjoy killing, I dislike the sight of that crimson liquid~ It's bad if it gets on my clothes.
StoryText.竟然能如此坦然的与我说话，哼哼~列车长，你其实本质上，是和我一样的人吧？: To speak to me so openly, hmm~ Conductor, you're actually quite similar to me deep down, aren't you?
StoryText.怎么会，我可不是什么享乐主义！ 我可是会为了追求我的欢愉而不惜一切拼命努力的勤勉: Why, I'm not a hedonist! I'm a diligent woman who would do anything for my pleasure~~
StoryText.可别逃走哦，尽情抵抗吧。: You'd better not run. Enjoy resisting me.
StoryText.我会让你品尝这世间最大的痛苦。: I'll let you taste the greatest agony of this world.
StoryText.还不够，还完全不够，再痛苦一些，再多取悦我一些。: Not enough. Far from it. The more agonized you are, the more pleased I will be.
StoryText.哈哈哈哈哈哈，这正是我想看到的表情！: Hahahahaha! This is just the expression I was anticipating!
StoryText.哼，我记住你了。下次一定打败你。: Hmph, I'll remember you. Next time, you will be begging me for mercy.
StoryText.唔，竟然输了……调查有些失误。: Oof, can't believe I lost... The intel wasn't accurate.
StoryText.要给我奖励吗？那……送我一个俘虏，怎么样？干什么用？保~密~: A reward for me? Then... how about a captive? What for? Well, it's a secret.
StoryText.我是来自阿妮塔全球能源公司的派遣员工叶珏。你就是列车长、对吧？多指教啊！: I'm Yejue, dispatched by Anita Global Energy. Conductor, right? Nice to meet you!
StoryText.嗯？是特意叫我去吗？哈哈，你这家伙有眼光！: Hm? Did you call me here on purpose? Haha, you have good taste!
StoryText.在“园丁”的探路者中我也是数一数二的哦。任何需求，包君满意。: I'm also one of the best among the Gardener's Pathfinders. I'll satisfy all your requests.
StoryText.卡洛琳？啊，对，是我同事……不过！我绘制的线路图比她的精确多了！: Caroline? Oh, right, she's my colleague... But! The route maps I draw are more accurate than hers!
StoryText.放心，我会利用一切知识和经验，为你指引一条去往目的地的最佳线路。嘿嘿嘿，你就瞧好: Don't worry. I'll use all my knowledge and experience to guide you to your destination via the best route. Hehehe, you just watch!
StoryText.这份工作的确存在一定的危险性。不过，当下这个时代，很少有绝对安全的工作吧？: This job has some risks. But in this era, there are very few jobs that are absolutely safe, right?
StoryText.探路者的工作，其实就是反复的调查和计算啦。但是卡洛琳……啊，算了，别在意。: A Pathfinder's work is actually about repeated investigations and calculations. But Caroline... ah, forget it. Don't mind.
StoryText.家里还有弟弟妹妹……哎？你怎么一点也不吃惊？我平时难道表现得很像个姐姐吗……: I have younger siblings back home... Huh? Why aren't you surprised at all? Do I behave like an older sister...?
StoryText.呼……累趴了。嗯？帮我预留了淋浴室吗？……谢谢。那我就不客气啦。: Phew... Exhausted. Hm? Did you reserve the shower for me?... Thanks. I won't stand on ceremony then.
StoryText.看起来很受欢迎？我吗？！ 不不不，我还没谈过恋爱……你、你什么表情啊……没谈过怎: Looks popular? Who me?! No no no, I've never been in a relationship... What's with that look... So what if I've never been in one!? Got a problem with that!?
StoryText.我家的条件不是特别好啦，所以当初接到阿妮塔的录用通知书时，全家都高兴坏了。: I don't come from a good family background, so when I received Anita's offer, my entire family was ecstatic.
StoryText.弟弟妹妹小时候都是皮孩子，没少挨我的拳头。不过现在都老实多了呢，嘿嘿。: My younger siblings were rather mischievous when they were young, and often got beatings from me. But they're much more well-behaved now, hehe.
StoryText.因为我父母工作都很忙，所以以前在家都是我做饭。要尝尝吗？味道其实还不错哦。: Both of my parents were busy working, so I was the one who cooked at home. Want a taste? It's actually not bad.
StoryText.刚到这里来时，我特别想早点结束派遣，回到阿妮塔。不过现在……我觉得能来这里实在是: When I first came here, I really wanted to end my assignment early and return to Anita. But now... I'm so grateful to be here. Really, it's great.
StoryText.战斗不是我的本职，不过，也只能上了！: I'm not trained in combat, but there's no choice now except to try!
StoryText.好吧，那我就勉为其难帮你开道吧！: All right, I'll be nice this time and open up a path for you!
StoryText.就这也想拦住我！: Think you could stop me with this?
StoryText.通通成为我升职加薪的踏板吧！: You shall all be the proof of why I deserve a raise and promotion!
StoryText.我来为你探索新的线路。: I'll seek a new route for you.
StoryText.哼，回去要“好好问问”人事，给我分配的什么破工作……: Hmph! I gotta "properly question" HR later for the shitty job they assigned me...
StoryText.喂喂，这要是影响了我的业绩评估……可不是开玩笑的……: Hey! If this affects my performance evaluation... this is no laughing matter...
StoryText.一骑绝尘！照这势头，升职加薪不是梦哇哈哈哈！: I'm unstoppable! At this rate, my raise and promotion will no longer be a dream. Hahaha!
StoryText.你好，列车长，我是来自阿妮塔的伊尔，请给我一间单独的工作间，并且工作时间内请叮嘱: Hello, Conductor. I'm Yer from Anita. I'd like a workroom to myself, and during working hours, please remind the other crew not to wander in.
StoryText.这是列车工作必要的一环，我会尽力做好辅助的。: This is a necessary part of running the train. I'll do my best to support it.
StoryText.列车长对我的无人机好奇？总之这里有一份647页的说明手册，要是看完还有不明白的可: You're curious about my drones, Conductor? There's a 647-page manual here to start with. Feel free to ask me if anything is still unclear once you've finished it.
StoryText.稍等一下，我正在抄写仪器里的数据。不管怎么说，纸质的备份都是很必要的。: One moment. I'm copying down the data from the instruments. A paper backup is always necessary.
StoryText.在我看来，无人机和列车虽然外表上没有共同点，在功能上却都是能够帮助人类深入险境的: The way I see it, drones and trains have nothing in common on the outside, but as tools they both carry people deep into danger. The ones who built them must have been working toward the same thing.
StoryText.文书方面的工作我可以帮忙，单纯以书写速度来论，我算是写得快的，毕竟每天要抄写很多: I can help with the paperwork. Purely in terms of writing speed, I'm on the fast side. I copy out a great deal of experimental data every day.
StoryText.晃虽然喜欢说多余的话，而且关键时刻不太靠得住，但他很喜欢赞美别人，比如他经常夸我: Akira says a lot of unnecessary things, and he isn't very dependable when it counts, but he does like to praise people. He often calls me "Miss Serious." Hm? What are you laughing at?
StoryText.剪纸的时候希望能别打扰我，毕竟对我来说剪纸不只是放松，也是我调整思维状态的手段。: I'd appreciate not being disturbed while I'm cutting paper. It isn't only relaxation for me. It's how I settle my thinking. If you'd like to learn, though, come find me anytime.
StoryText.仿生技工十代的功能非常强大，列车长也因此轻松了不少吧？什么，波克士会和列车长吵架: The Bionic Operator X is remarkably capable. It must have made things much easier for you, Conductor. What? Box argues with you? Perhaps support machines are better off not being too intelligent after all...
StoryText.了解和学会应对桦树生物是园丁的必修课，但是有的时候我也会想，我们的做法是否正确…: Understanding Chaos Remains and learning to handle them is required study for a Gardener. Though there are times I wonder whether what we do is right... Then again, if we never try, we'll never find out.
StoryText.在听到我的真心话以后，很多人都一副被刺伤的模样。但说谎也是不好的吧，更何况我从来: A lot of people look wounded after they hear what I actually think. But lying isn't good either, and I've never once meant to attack anyone with words. I only say what I honestly feel.
StoryText.我的父母为人都挺好，我并不讨厌他们。只是我实在不擅长和他们相处，列车长的话——抱: My parents are good people. I don't hate them. I'm simply not good at being around them. What about you, Conductor— sorry, is this too personal a topic?
StoryText.啊！……列车长，是你啊，抱歉。我似乎玩得有点投入了，虽然是很简单的吃豆人游戏，却: Ah! ...Conductor, it's you. Sorry. I seem to have gotten absorbed in it. It's a simple pellet-eating game, but it's easy to sink into. I'm working on beating my last record.
StoryText.……请不要对我递过来的食物露出那么警惕的神色，就算是我也会觉得有点失落的，这只是: ...Please don't look at food I hand you with that much suspicion. Even I find it a little disheartening. It's only juice from the vending machine.
StoryText.后方援护的工作由我来。: I'll cover support from the rear.
StoryText.已调整好无人机状态，可以前进。: Drones are adjusted. We can advance.
StoryText.报告内容拟定好了，你要过目吗？: The report is drafted. Would you like to look it over?
StoryText.我是妮蔻拉。别害怕，这些装备都已经被我调整到了非杀伤模式。: I'm Nicola. Fear not, these weapons are in non-lethal mode.
StoryText.无聊的工作，不过正合适我。: Boring work, but it suits me.
StoryText.哦？你画的这个机械结构还挺不错的嘛，有兴趣来能源研究所给我打下手吗？啊？不能兼职: Oh? Your drawing of this mechanical structure is pretty good. Interested to work under me at Anita Energy Institute? Oh? Can't do part-time? Oh yeah, you're already a conductor... Tsk.
StoryText.新专利的说明和审核用报告书都准备好了。到下一个落脚点就能提交给篝火城审核了，交给: The new patent documentation and audit report are ready. Submit them to the Bonfire City for review at the next stop. I'll leave it to you. I'm gonna take a nap...
StoryText.换衣服？不需要，我没有对于潮流的追求。我身上这件是材料部门最新研发的自清洁连体衣: Change? No need to. I'm not into fashion. This outfit is the latest self-cleaning bodysuit developed by the Materials Department. It's designed to reduce the frequency of washing and changing. I have ten of these in my closet, each numbered.
StoryText.在我出生的那个小镇上，不论是如何亮眼的能力与想法都不会被重视……非常无趣的地方。: In the small town where I was born, even the most outstanding abilities and ideas were not valued... It was a very boring place. Compared to that, you've created a place on this train where people can live in peace. It's really nice.
StoryText.列车长？——果然是你啊，远远地就看到了。说起来，好像莫名其妙就记得你的脸了，搞不: Conductor? Yeah, it's you, I spotted you from afar. Come to think of it, I seem to remember your face somehow. Strange.
StoryText.这两架武器内置的桦石能源转换器是我自己设计制作的，算是大型装置的试作型。你要试试: I designed and made the Chaos Stone energy converters built into these two weapons. They are prototypes for mass devices. Want to give them a go? Send me a feedback and research report after you test them. If it's well-written, I'll reward you with anything you want... What do you fancy?
StoryText.数独杂志……又写完了。再给我弄几本来，啊，还有魔方和限定版的露蕾蒂……想要的东西: Finished... another Sudoku magazine. Get me a few more. Oh, and some Rubik's Cubes and a limited edition Lunette plushie... There're too many things I want. I'll list them down for you. Be sure to bring them yourself, got it?
StoryText.因为出生的时候天有异象，我被米卢廷的人称为“光之子”——直到我长成了他们无法接受: There was an omen when I was born, so the people of Milutin called me the Child of the Light — until I grew up into something they couldn't accept. My nickname became the Forsaken by Light thereafter. How creative.
StoryText.米卢廷是一个无聊的地方，那个镇子的唯一优点只剩土豆好吃了，不过，感觉印象里的土豆: Milutin is a boring place. The delicious potatoes are the only good thing about that town. But, those potatoes aren't as delicious as the ones you make from what I remember of them. I really wish you cook them daily... Nutritional imbalance? No way at all? What a pity.
StoryText.抓住你了~暂时就这么待一会吧。接下来还有工作？那就辞职吧，专心待在我身边就好。多: Got you~ Stay here for a while. More work coming up? Then resign and stay by my side. How long? Hmm... forever.
StoryText.你的研究报告呢？……写得不怎么样？没关系，快交上来，给我。我已经准备好奖励了……: Where's your research report?... It's not great? Never mind. Hand it over. I've prepared a reward... Don't refuse. Come sit over here.
StoryText.终有一天世界上所有人都会用上我的发明。在达成这个目标之前，你可不许从我身边逃走，: One day, everyone in the world will use my inventions. Until I achieve this goal, you're not allowed to escape from my side. With you around, I can achieve it faster.
StoryText.感觉好麻烦……赶紧解决掉回去吧。: This is such a pain... Let's just take care of it and get out of here.
StoryText.能源装填，最大输出功率——期待测试结果。: Energy loading, maximum output power... Looking forward to the test result.
StoryText.……实验失败……到此为止吧。: The experiment failed... Let's just wrap it up.
StoryText.……需要修正作战中出现的问题。: ...Need to fix the problems occurred in battle.
StoryText.这种结果是理所应当的。回去吧，该进行下一次实验了。: An expected outcome. Let's go. Time for the next experiment.
StoryText.呀吼~~！我是多萝西！今后就麻烦你啦！: Yahoo~~! I'm Dorothy! I'll be counting on you from now on!
StoryText.轮到我了？行嘞，就交给我吧！: Is it my turn? Alright, leave it to me!
StoryText.果然战场的精华还是爆炸呀！巨大的声响，喷出的火光，感觉会非常“爽到”！对吧？: The essence of the battlefield is always explosions! The loud noises, and the bursts of flames! So exhilarating! Right?
StoryText.呀吼车长！准备去吃饭吗？和大家一起来吧，一起吃更香不是吗？: Yahoo, Conductor! Ready to eat? Come along with everyone! Eating together makes it more delicious, right?
StoryText.车长来开趴吧！嗯？什么趴？真是的，开趴就是开趴啦！: Conductor, let's party! Huh? What kind of party? Geez, a party is a party!
StoryText.我战斗是为了自由地爆破——才怪！开玩笑的开玩笑的啦！哎？听起来像认真的？不会吧！: I fight for the right to blow things up — Just kidding! Huh? That sounded serious? No way!?
StoryText.啊啊啊，又搞砸了……哎？车长！？啊，后面那节车厢为什么会那么黑我完全不知道哦！真: Oh, oh oh, I messed up again... Eh? Conductor!? Ah, I really have no idea why the carriage behind us turned pitch-black! Serious!
StoryText.邀请伊洛娜来参加烤肉大会的事又没成……下一次一定要成功！噢——！！: Failed to invite Ilona to barbeque party once again... Must succeed next time! Oh—!!
StoryText.我总是被说每天看起来都挺开心的，其实不太对哦~~我是，每！天！都一定要！开开心心: People always say I look happy every day, but actually, that's not quite right~~ I! Must! Be! Happy! Every! Day! That's the way!
StoryText.哼哼~成了。啊，车长，要不要一起去看焰火！Made by多萝西哦！: Uh huh~ Success! Hey, Conductor, want to watch fireworks together? Made by Dorothy~!
StoryText.Fighting！！啊，车长车长，来一起做吧！给新的一天打个气呗！噢！噢！噢！: Fighting!! Oh, Conductor, let's do it together! Hurray for the new day! Oh! Oh! Oh!
StoryText.车长车长！随便找个地方一起疯一把呗？走吧走吧！咱们两个就行，不想等啦等不及啦！: Conductor! Conductor! Let's go crazy somewhere! Let's go, let's go! Just the two of us will do. I can't wait! I can't wait!
StoryText.我有时候会想啦，要不要索性来个——“我们是铁盟部队成员，现在要征用你的列车！”—: Sometimes I want to just say something like — "This is BCRL troop, and we're requisitioning your train!" — and then we'll go somewhere nice together on vacation.
StoryText.嗯——不行不行，只有我看到车长就忍不住开心可不行，车长也要一见到我就开心起来呀！: Hmm — No, no, I can't help but feel happy every time I see you. You should be happy the moment you see me too!
StoryText.被发现了！？不过船到桥头自然直——！: I've been spotted?! Guess I'll just improvise—!
StoryText.呀吼~我要狠狠地给他们点颜色看看！: Yahoo! I'll show them who they're really up against!
StoryText.送你份大礼！: Get ready for a huge gift!
StoryText.停停停！这可真的顶不住啦！: Stop, stop, stop! This isn't going to cut it!
StoryText.完蛋！战略撤退啦！！溜了溜了！: Crap! Strategic retreat! Time to bail!
StoryText.谢啦谢啦~多亏大家了~~: Thanks, thanks! All of you have been a great help!
StoryText.吾即咒魔剑姬卡塔斯！！被深渊侵蚀带来万世终焉的使者！......好，发挥不错。: I am Jumakenki Katas!! Harbinger of eternal doom brought by the abyssal corruption! ...Good, that was good.
Ah... Why do I have to do such boring lookout work...
StoryText.哼~想知道吾之灾厄暗耀斩钢与吾的孽缘是么。斧子？不对！是剑啊，这是剑！: Hmph~ Curious about how my Umbral Fulgor and my fates are entwined? Axe? No! Sword! This is a sword!
StoryText.呜呼！传说中的《终末奇想谭第一卷》的再版终于到手了！: Oh yeah! The reissue of the legendary "Tales of Finality Volume 1" is finally mine!
StoryText.哼！啊哈！......哎，看不懂吗？吾在构思登场时符合吾身份的方案。: Hmm! Aha! ...Eh, don't you get it? I'm just brainstorming ideas fitting of my status when I make my entrance.
StoryText.黑铁之主啊，潜入深邃之土的幽暗之......不对，重来。喂我说，你知道哪里可以买: Lord of Black Iron, diving into the depths of darkness... No, that's not it. Um... Hey, do you know where I can buy the latest issue of Azot the Master Dragoon?
StoryText.哼~哼~哼~竟然在这种地方兵戎相见——顺便一提吾推荐特供套餐的C套餐。: Hmm~ Hmm~ Hmm~ To think we clash our blades in such a place — by the way, I recommend the special set meal C.
StoryText.有什么事吗，黑铁之主，吾很忙。之后还要去钻研漫......禁书。: Need anything, Lord of Black Iron? I'm very busy. I still need to go study comi... forbidden books.
StoryText.咳咳！如、如果你想要，可以给你讲讲魔想少女的故事哟。: Ahem! If you want it, I can tell you the story of the Magic Girl.
StoryText.啊，黑铁之主，在汝的宫殿中，刚才好像看到了熟悉的身影？......没，没什么，没: Ah, Lord of Black Iron, I noticed a familiar figure in your palace just now... No, nothing, nothing.
StoryText.......伤口？哼，这种程度的小伤......你，你干嘛！？停停停，这点小伤不: ...Wound? Hmph, such a minor wound... W-What are you doing!? Stop, stop, stop! You don't have to patch it!
StoryText.下一份工作前把面包切开再来点水......不行，现在停下来的话全通特典就没戏了！: Slice some bread and get some water before the next job begins... No, stopping now means no special bonus! Hang in there!
StoryText.总觉得苏恩身上的那些纹路在哪里看到过，好像是在哪本书上，嗯……搞不懂啊，不过她是: I feel like I've seen the patterns on Suen somewhere, perhaps in a book. Hmm... Can't figure it out, but she's a good companion worthy of Jumakenki!
StoryText.哼，哼哼~汝若是闲得发慌，吾就勉为其难地陪陪汝吧。要，要感谢吾啊！: Hmm, hmm hmm~ If you're bored stiff, I'll reluctantly accompany you. Y-You should thank me!
StoryText.邪魔也会畏惧的狂气，就在此展现吧！: Let the madness that even evil spirits fear be unleashed here!
StoryText.唔！！魔剑暗耀斩钢已经快要暴走了！喂，冷静，要冷静下来！: Shoot! The spellblade Umbral Fulgor is about to go berserk! Hey, calm down! You need to calm down!
StoryText.乌合之众！让你们都变成魔剑暗耀斩钢的......呃......饲料！！: Bunch of dregs! I'll turn all of you into Umbral Fulgor's... um... meal!
StoryText.呜！竟，竟然是破晓圣光的使用者......这屈辱，吾可不会忘！: Ugh! I-It's the user of Divine Dawnlight... I will not forget this humiliation!
StoryText.与深渊之暗缔结了契约的我不需要所谓的荣光！哼哼哼......哼哈哈哈哈！啊哈↑哈: The one in pact with abyssal darkness need not such glory! Hhhhng... Hhhahahahaha! Mwaha! Ha! Ha! ...Argh, my ears hurt...
StoryText.原曼杜斯帝国士兵，柯娜。现在因为一些缘故在当保镖，请多指教。: Former Mundus Empire's soldier, Connor. Working as a bodyguard now for some reason. Pleased to meet you.
StoryText.需要了叫我，我就在这里。: Holler if you need me. I'll be here.
StoryText.我？我没什么好隐藏的，以前是为了国家为了家人而战的士兵。现在，现在是为了不让那份: Me? I've nothing to hide. I used to be a soldier fighting for my country and family. Now, I'm just a mercenary trying to keep that belief from fading.
StoryText.防守的最强利器是盾。一旦知道攻击无法穿透盾牌，攻击方也就会放弃了。: The shield is the best defensive gear. Once the attacker knows their attacks can't penetrate the shield, they'll give up.
StoryText.虽然不太了解许多地表的机械造物，但是摩托车的驾驶我可以说得上略有心得。居然能制造: Although I don't understand many mechanical devices on the surface, I do have some experience in riding motorcycles. To be able to craft such a convenient and neat riding tool is very impressive.
StoryText.来来来美味的食物来咯~~嗯~~~今天你也好漂亮呀喵~~: Come, come come, delicious food~~ Mmm~~ You look pretty today too, nyaa~~
StoryText.莉薇娅泡的红茶很好喝，可惜我对这方面一窍不通……如果是我那位精通品茶知识的友人，: Livia's black tea is very good, but unfortunately, I don't know anything about tea... If it were my friend who's a tea expert, they would definitely give more valuable feedback.
StoryText.来~~今天也是个乖孩子喵~~~嗯？......你，你，你是从什么时候开始看的！？: Come on~~ You're a good kid today, nyaa~~~ Hmm?... W-When did you start watching?
StoryText.刚才，打盹了吧？别逞强了，去休息会吧，一小时后我会叫你的。: Doze off earlier, eh? Don't be stubborn. Take a break, and I'll wake you in an hour.
StoryText.在我意志最为消沉的时候，几乎与行尸走肉无异……但如今，我发誓不会再自甘堕落。: When I was at my lowest, I was practically a walking dead... But I swear I won't succumb to despair anymore.
StoryText.列车长，给我点水。喝过的？哈哈哈！都这关系了还在意什么啊。: Get me some water, Conductor. That's the cup you used? Hahaha! If it's your cup, I don't mind at all.
StoryText.事到如今，我可不是完全出于愧疚的心情才决定守护你的……这与纯粹的责任感还是不一样: At this point, I'm not protecting you solely out of a sense of guilt... It's different from mere responsibility.
StoryText.为、为什么我喜欢猫咪的流言最近传得到处都是！？列车长，不会是你去乱说了吧！: W-Why are rumors about me liking cats spreading everywhere lately!? Did you go around gossiping, Conductor!?
StoryText.我不曾忘记过去的那些悔恨与悲哀，也正因如此，与你们相遇后的时光让我想要好好珍惜。: I haven't forgotten the regrets and sorrows of the past, and that's precisely why, I want to cherish the time spent with all of you.
StoryText.好像轮到我了。出发！: I think it's my turn. Let's go!
StoryText.跟上！一鼓作气击溃他们！: Keep up! We'll take them down all at once!
StoryText.有赢就有输……撤退！: You win some, you lose some... Retreat!
StoryText.这次是我输了……下次可不会……！: I lost this time... But there won't be a next...!
StoryText.入伍期间的经验都发挥出来了，下次也一定要大家一起回去。: I've used everything I experienced during enlistment. Next time, we'll be safe and sound as well.
StoryText.我是丽桑德拉。光辉也好，黝黯也罢，只要您的信念坚定，我终将会抵达您的身畔。: I am Lissandra. Be it light or darkness, as long as your belief is firm, I shall eventually reach your side.
StoryText.需要帮助吗？我立刻就来。: Do you need help? I'll come right away.
StoryText.众生皆平等。维持社会的公正是我的愿望，也是我的使命。: All beings are equal. It is my wish and duty to maintain social justice.
StoryText.为迷途的羔羊指明方向正是我的职责。: It is my duty to guide the stray lambs back to the right path.
StoryText.虽然我是御敌枢纽的先导，但并不是一直待在那里等待指示。我会出现在任何需要我的地方: Though I am a Vanguard of the Destroyer, I don't always stay there waiting for orders. I'll appear wherever I'm needed.
StoryText.不知您是否发现了，这个世界正在走向崩坏……我必须根除这份扭曲，阻止悲剧进一步发生: Perhaps you've noticed, this world is heading toward doom... I must eradicate this distortion and prevent further tragedies.
StoryText.我曾为应如何公正地审判不公之事而苦恼。在无尽的苦恼过后……我得到了这份能力、这个: I used to agonize over how to fairly judge injustice. After infinite agony... I gained this ability... this miracle.
StoryText.当人类意识不到自己身处梦境时，便会长睡不醒。因为梦境本就是另一个“理”所维系的世: When humans are unaware that they're dreaming, it's impossible for them to wake up, as dreamscape is essentially another world sustained by another "logos."
StoryText.我多数时候身无分文。钱对我而言只是身外之物。: I'm penniless most of the time. Money is just an extraneous thing to me.
StoryText.对我来说，成为“人类多数意志”的代行者就是在践行“正义”。: To me, being the executor of "the will of mankind's majority" is practicing "justice."
StoryText.为了标榜绝对的正义，我让很多错途的英雄前往了更美好的世界。为了守护人性的美好，我: In the name of absolute justice, I've sent many misguided heroes to a better world. To safeguard the beauty of mankind, I've also transformed countless villains into the "image" people long for.
StoryText.不论是穷奢极欲还是穷困潦倒，最终死亡都会平等地降临到每个人身上。死亡，也是一种慈: In opulence or poverty, death will eventually befall upon everyone equally. Death, too, is a form of mercy.
StoryText.若有一日，学会犯下滔天大罪，我亦会毫不犹豫降下审判。即使要摧毁整个学会也在所不辞: Should the Citadel commit heinous crimes one day, I won't hesitate to pass judgment, even if it means destroying the entire Citadel.
StoryText.我与太多人有过相遇相知，但因为这一生太过漫长，他们中的大多数都成了模糊的回忆。只: I've met too many people, yet most of them have become my vague memories throughout my everlasting life. Only that child still makes me sigh. I won't forget her.
StoryText.罪孽深重之人，亦需要拯救。: Atone for thy sins, redemption awaits.
StoryText.带着汝之罪孽，长眠于此吧。: Bear thy sins, and yield to eternal slumber.
StoryText.予那罪孽之人，至高的慈悲。: Grant the sinner thy utmost benevolence.
StoryText.赐予汝，神之祝福。: I shall grant thee God's blessing.
StoryText.迷途之人，奉劝归返。: Thou lost one, return to the path.
StoryText.一切皆为神谕，非吾之功。: All is God's decree. I am but a servant.
StoryText.我叫米莉！只要负责把接近你的人统统打跑就行了，是吧？！: I'm Millie! I just have to be responsible for scaring off anyone who comes near you, right?!
StoryText.终于到我出场了？等得我都不耐烦了！ 啊，我的对手是哪一个啊？: Finally my turn to shine? I'm getting impatient! Ah, who's my opponent?
StoryText.哟！车长，早啊！……什么啊，你竟然还没起床？已经六点了。快！起！来！: Yo! Good morning, Conductor!... What? You're still in bed? It's already six. Hurry! Get! Up!
StoryText.做你的护卫也太清闲了吧，都没有敌人来袭击吗？ 哈？还是闲着比较好？: Being your guard is too easy? No enemy attacks at all? Huh? It's better to be idle?
StoryText.为什么来地表？ 哎反正就是，因为种种原因！好了好了，进下一话题！: Why come to the surface? Oh well, the bottom line is, it's due to lots and lots of reasons! Alright, alright. On to the next topic!
StoryText.不爱吃的东西？没有，我不挑食的。 给我多盛点儿饭就行！一定要，多！: Food I dislike? None. I'm not picky. Just give me more food! Plenty of it!
StoryText.酒店只订到了单人房？ 那你睡床好了。我站着也能睡！: Only booked a single hotel room? Then you sleep in the bed. I can sleep standing up!
StoryText.我只渴求强者。战胜弱者有什么意思？什么都得不到嘛。: I only thirst for the strong. What's the point of defeating the weak? You gain nothing.
StoryText.我不喜欢与桦树生物战斗。那群家伙只知道机械地杀戮，根本不明白胜负的魅力。还不如野: I don't like fighting the Chaos remains. They only know mechanical slaughter and can't grasp the charm of victory and defeat. They're worse than beasts.
StoryText.刚到地下竞技场的时候我玩得很开心，但后来就渐渐没有对手了。觉得无聊，就溜喽。: I had fun when I first arrived at the underground arena, but there weren't many opponents left gradually. It became boring, so I left.
StoryText.喂，车长！你能帮我包扎下背后的伤口吗？呼……幸好有你在，方便多了。: Hey, Conductor! Can you patch the wound on my back? Phew... Good thing you're here. Makes things easier.
StoryText.车长，想要什么，说。我买给你！ 我除了吃饭基本不花钱，所以存款充裕啦。好歹给我个: What do you want, Conductor? Name it and I'll buy it for you! I hardly spend money other than on food, so I have a lot of my savings. At least give me a chance to splurge, alright?
StoryText.哦——车长给人吹头发的样子很熟练啊。脑袋这么被热风包围着，感觉……要睡着……了呢: Oh — The way you blow your hair dry is so skillful! Being surrounded by hot air like this, makes me... feel... so sleepy...
StoryText.什么？已经做300个俯卧撑了吗？和你说着话，感觉训练眨眼就结束了诶！: What? Finished 300 push-ups already? Talking to you makes training feels like it's over in the blink of an eye!
StoryText.喂喂，可别一击就倒哦！: Hey, you better not get knocked out with one hit!
StoryText.别想逃跑！: Don't you dare try to make a run for it!
StoryText.来吧！看看我们谁的拳头更硬！: Come on then! Let's see whose fist is harder!
StoryText.就算你再强！我也！不会！认输的！: No matter how good you are, I. Won't. Surrender!
StoryText.该死！ ……下次我绝对不会输！: Dammit! ...I won't lose the next time!
StoryText.不赖嘛！ 胜利的感觉就是爽啊哈哈哈！虽然没观众有点可惜……: Not bad! Nothing's more satisfying than winning. Hahaha! A pity there isn't an audience, though...
StoryText.我是那由他，作为索思学会的一员，将为您带来希望与光……嗯，这种事情我其实是做不到: I'm Nayuta. As a member of the Source Citadel, I'm here to bring you hope and light... hm, that's not really something I can actually do. In any case, I look forward to working with you.
StoryText.我已经在这里了，所以请放心吧。: I'm already here, so you don't need to worry.
StoryText.保护你和这趟列车是我的工作，我会认真执行，仅此而已。: Protecting you and this train is my job. I'll carry it out properly. That's all there is to it.
StoryText.工作之外的时间去哪里了……你不会想知道的。就当是我的秘密吧。: Where I go outside of work hours... you don't want to know. Just consider it my secret.
StoryText.想看魔术？虽然不知道你是从哪里听说的……好吧。请靠近一点。: You want to see a trick? Not sure where you heard about that... fine. Come a little closer.
StoryText.索玛救了我，达斯廷先生给了我第二次生命，所以……为了他们，我什么都能做。: Sommer saved me. Mr. Dustin gave me a second chance at life. So... for the two of them, there's nothing I won't do.
StoryText.先生希望我多交朋友，但我不知道要怎么做。你可以教我吗，列车长？: He wants me to make more friends, but I don't really know how. Could you teach me, Conductor?
StoryText.手指灵活啊……如果我说这是为了更好地变魔术锻炼出来的，你会相信吗？: Nimble fingers, huh... if I told you it's from practicing tricks, would you believe me?
StoryText.……为什么盯着我的脸看，是上面沾了什么吗？饭粒……？抱歉，我的吃相不太好，从小就: ...Why are you staring at my face? Something on it? Rice grains...? Sorry, I've never had great table manners. Been like that since I was a kid. I'll be more careful next time.
StoryText.“家人”、“朋友”，在与你们相遇之前，我从来没有和人建立起这样的关系。所以，如果: Family. "Friends." Before meeting all of you, I never once built that kind of connection with anyone. So if there's something I'm doing wrong, please tell me.
StoryText.即使没有血缘关系，也是可以成为家人的——先生也好，索玛也好，他们都对我说过类似的: Family doesn't require blood ties—both Mr. Dustin and Sommer have told me something like that, more than once. It's not that I doubt it. I just wonder... can someone like me really have that?
StoryText.如果你有下不了手的情况，就交给我好了。嘘，别去看，也别去想了。我会处理好的。: If there's ever something you can't bring yourself to do, leave it to me. Don't look. Don't think about it either. I'll take care of it.
StoryText.在别人面前彻底放松警惕这件事，曾经是不被允许的，可是我现在很困了，列车长，我可以: Letting your guard down completely in front of someone else... that used to be something I wasn't allowed to do. But I'm tired right now, Conductor. Mind if I close my eyes for a bit...?
StoryText.有光的地方就一定会有影子相随——就将我当作你的影子吧，列车长。: Wherever there's light, a shadow follows close behind—so think of me as your shadow, Conductor.
StoryText.……真是与我十分相称的……结局。: ...A fitting end for someone like me, I suppose.
StoryText.对不起，没能遵守约定，先生……: I'm sorry, Sir. I couldn't keep my promise...
StoryText.“我做得很棒”？是吗……谢谢。: "You did well"? ...Is that so. Thank you.
StoryText.我是“恶魔捕手”，看见无垠号有一个预约订单……您说列车上没有需要抓的恶魔？那么就: I'm a "Devil Hunter." I saw an order from the Eternal... There aren't any devils on the train that need catching? Then just think of me as an ordinary passenger.
StoryText.是我提出要当乘员来抵车票的，因为我们真的没有钱。抱歉给你添了麻烦，但是我们会好好: It was my idea to work as passengers in exchange for the ticket. We really don't have any money right now. Sorry for the trouble, but we'll do our best.
StoryText.我手上的绳子能够轻易地控制人类或者魔物的行动，这是我亲手编织、用于施展魔法的。它: The rope I carry can easily control the movements of humans or monsters. I wove it myself, and it's a tool for casting magic. It'll never turn against me. A trustworthy weapon.
StoryText.啊——啊——啊，列车长。我想试试能不能学着一个人唱多声部，但好像还是有点困难。要: Ah—ah—ah, Conductor. I want to try singing different parts by myself, but it's a little difficult. It would be amazing if Talon and Claw could have sung along with me.
StoryText.地表的商店……叫做“超市”的那个，可真方便啊……想要什么食材都可以轻松买到，即使: The shops on the surface... the ones called "supermarkets", they're really convenient... You can buy almost any ingredients you want, and even things you've never seen before... Ah, no... I bought too much.
StoryText.帝国的历史……我觉得很没意思，如果仔细读过的话，会发现那其中充斥着阴谋、仇恨和互: The Empire's history... I don't find it interesting at all. All you can find in it are schemes, hatred, and people plotting against each other. The traces of Devil Hunters are hidden between those sinful words... but I don't want to become like them.
StoryText.战斗的时候稍微受了点伤……不过没关系，现在已经完全恢复了，一点痕迹也没有。: I got hurt a little during the fight... but it's fine. I'm completely healed now. Not even a scar left.
StoryText.还是比较喜欢休息。薇尔岚总是拽着我到处跑，米莉总想着要找人打一架……她们都很有活: I'd rather rest. Verlaine is always dragging me around, and Millie is always looking for someone to fight... They're both full of energy. That's not a bad thing, I guess. But I'll sit this one out.
StoryText.给你准备了一点炖菜，就放在餐车的桌子上。要快点去吃，不然米莉可能会连着锅全吃完，: I made some stew for you. It's on the table in the dining car. You should go eat it soon, or Millie might finish the whole pot, literally... and then you'll lose a pot for nothing.
StoryText.有的时候，科劳和塔隆它们就像是小孩子一样，各自有自己想要的东西，又要去找，又想和: Sometimes, Claw and Talon are just like little kids. They both have things they want, they want to go search for them, but they also want to stay with me... Taking care of them is really troublesome.
StoryText.列车长，我可以帮忙给你的业务对手们施加一点小小的魔法恶作剧，比如让他们近三天吃饭: Conductor, I can help you play a little magic prank on your business rivals. Like making chili skins get stuck between their teeth whenever they eat for the next three days. Hmm? You don't want that?
StoryText.如果是难以交流的敌人，还是要把手脚全部限制住然后切断吧。毕竟有的时候不得不这么做: For enemies that can't be reasoned with, I guess I still have to cut down their hands and feet. Sometimes, that's just how it has to be.
StoryText.虽然地表应该没有魔法学院的追兵，但我还是有点害怕。如果被他们找到，现在的生活会不: There shouldn't be any pursuers from the magic academy on the surface... but I'm still a little scared. If they find me, then it will be the end of my current life... I won't let that happen.
StoryText.嗯，这是恶魔捕手的工作。: Yeah. This is the job of a Devil Hunter.
StoryText.这些敌人能喂饱大家的肚子吗……: Can these enemies fill our stomachs...
StoryText.用什么手段都可以吗？: Can I use any method I want?
StoryText.恶魔的绳索啊，为我捕获它们。: O the ropes of the devil... capture them for me.
StoryText.与我合奏吧，我的力量！: O my power, play a duet with me!
StoryText.不要把我做成熏肉……: Don't turn me into smoked meat...
StoryText.好了，所有工作都完成了。没有其他事的话，我来做一顿庆功宴给大家吃吧。: Alright, everything's done. If there's nothing else, I'll make a feast to celebrate for everyone.
StoryText.人家是学会美少女苏恩！迷恋我也好崇拜我也好都OK啦！但是！跟踪什么的可不行哦！: I'm Suen, a cute girl from the Citadel! You can be infatuated with me or idolize me! But! No stalking allowed!
StoryText.什么嘛，原来列车长你，这么想让人家时刻都待在你身边嘛？ 嗯……这可怎么办呢~: What, Conductor, turns out you want me to be with you all the time? Hmm... What should I do~
StoryText.伤口？啊哈！不用在意不用在意~我不会这么轻易就死掉的啦！: Wounds? Ahaha! Don't worry~ I won't die so easily!
StoryText.人家身上的纹路是不是很帅？虽然是“实验”的产物啦，但我超满意的！: The patterns on me are pretty cool, aren't they? Although they are the result of "experiments", I'm extremely satisfied!
StoryText.喂喂，列车长你为什么会做这份工作呀？喜欢的食物是什么呢？喜欢什么类型呢？: Hey hey, Conductor, why do you take up this job? What's your favorite food? What's your type?
StoryText.列车长，你最近经常来学会嘛。难不成……是特意来见人家……诶，别走那么快嘛！: Conductor, you've been visiting the Citadel often lately. Is it... done on purpose to see me... Hey, don't walk so fast!
StoryText.要是列车长想去约会的话，人家也可以陪你啦~……诶？不想？ 等等，你去哪里嘛~！: If you want to go on a date, I can accompany you~... Huh? You don't want to? Wait, where are you going~!
StoryText.列车长，要不要加入人家的后援会？福利多多童叟无欺哦！: Conductor, want to join my fan club? Lots of benefits, really!
StoryText.有人问我为什么每天都有那么多话要说，可是可是，没有才很奇怪吧？只要活着一天，就总: Someone asked me why I always have so much to say every day. But, but, isn't it weird not to? Every day you live, there's always something to say, right?
StoryText.大人才能吃的零食？嗯……呕！这什么呀这么难……好、好吃……哦？: Snacks for adults only? Hmm... Ugh! What's this, so terr... d-delicious... oh?
StoryText.最喜欢的料理？一切带鸡蛋的人家都喜欢！特别是煎蛋卷！……与年龄相符？才没有那回事: Favorite dish? Anything with eggs! Especially omelets!... Matches my age? No way!
StoryText.嗯哼，车长，你是不是、还没有接过吻呀？跟你讲，接吻是巧克力味的哦！: Hmm, Conductor, have you... never kissed before? Tell you what, kissing tastes like chocolate!
StoryText.车长，想让人家陪你嘛？如果车长实在想的话……到晚饭我都会陪着你哦！: Want me to accompany you, Conductor? If you really want to... I'll be with you all the way till dinner!
StoryText.车长，要邀请人家吃晚餐的话一定要选一家豪华餐厅哦。这样才能配得上学会最可爱美少女: If you want to ask me out for dinner, Conductor, you should choose a posh restaurant. That way, it'll be suitable for the cutest girl from the Citadel!
StoryText.能和我这样的美少女战斗，还真是你们的荣幸呢~！: You should be honored to fight against a pretty girl like me!
StoryText.精神百倍！冲呀！: Woohoo, I'm fresh as a daisy! Let's go!
StoryText.啊~就这样结束了啊……: Ah? It's over just like that...?
StoryText.人家还想继续玩来着……: But I haven't had enough fun...
StoryText.诶~我是最佳队员嘛~唔呵呵，他们还真弱呢~！: Eh~ I'm the best teammate~ Heheh! They're just too weak~!
StoryText.哟，我是隼。不欢迎一下我吗？: Hey, I'm Hayabusa. No welcome for me?
StoryText.不管离得多远我都能准确掌握你的行踪哦……嗯？我在开玩笑啦。: No matter how far you are, I can accurately track your whereabouts... Hmm? I'm just kidding.
StoryText.没发现我的接近是理所当然的，在这方面我可是专业的啊。: Of course you can't notice it when I'm sneaking up on you. I'm a professional.
StoryText.黑月的工作我当然有在好好完成，怎么突然问这个？难道我长得像无业游民吗？: Of course I've been working hard for Night Chains. What? Do I look like a jobless drifter?
StoryText.别松懈呀，列车长，我可是一直看着你呢。: Don't slack off, Conductor. I've been watching you.
StoryText.聚集在你列车上的战斗狂热分子意外地多，我和那些家伙实在是没什么共同语言。: I didn't expect to see so many battle fanatics on your train. I seriously don't have anything to say to them.
StoryText.列车长，这块蛋糕送给你，不用谢我……后面的车厢有点吵？大概是因为他们在找你手里的: Conductor, I've got a piece of cake for you. You're welcome... It's a bit noisy back there? Oh, perhaps they're looking for the cake in your hand.
StoryText.诶，你也开始习惯了啊，明明之前我在旁边盯着的话，你会觉得很介意来着。: You're getting used to it, huh? You used to get all flustered when I stared at you like this.
StoryText.黑月里面的怪人和麻烦人物也太多了吧。嗯？为什么要这样看着我，什么意思呢？真是失礼: There are too many weirdos and troublemakers in Night Chains. Huh? Why do you look at me like that? How rude.
StoryText.你该不会觉得把番茄酱换成辣椒酱我会分不出来吧，我讨厌这种辛辣刺激的调味，完全遮盖: Do you think I can't tell that you switched the ketchup with chili sauce? I hate such spicy seasoning. That's an awful taste. It masks the original flavor of the ingredients.
StoryText.黑月游乐城的雪山芭菲非常有名，是我吃过的七十五种不同城市的芭菲里味道最棒的，顺便: The snow mountain parfait in Night Chains Land is very famous. It's the best out of the 75 types of parfait I've tried. I recommend strawberry flavor.
StoryText.砰！什么嘛，真是平淡的反应。你说早就发现我了？哈哈哈，怎么可能，我可是隼哦？: Bang! Nah, such a bland reaction. You've already noticed me? Hahaha, no way, I'm Hayabusa!
StoryText.说实话没想到能像这样和你相处，一般人在经历了那么多事以后只会把我撵下车吧，列车长: To be honest, I didn't expect to get along with you like this. It's only normal to kick me out of the train after going through so much. Or perhaps you're... Nevermind. Hey, don't glare at me.
StoryText.列车长，你不会把我当成“朋友”了吧。这个想法很危险，最好快点忘掉哦？别忘了，我可: Conductor, you're not considering me a friend, are you? That's a dangerous thought. You'd better forget it. Remember, I'm a nasty villain.
StoryText.我是不会看漏目标的动向的。: Their movements won't escape my eyes.
StoryText.希望对手能有趣一点啊……: Please give me some interesting foes...
StoryText.跟你说了我不擅长这种事，看吧。: See, told you I'm not good at this.
StoryText.能让我出这么多力，你们这群人还真派不上用场啊。: I'm doing all the real work here, and you lot are completely useless.
StoryText.你好，我是薇尔岚，目前正在旅行的途中，这趟算是搭个便车！……说起来，我的朋友在这: Hi, I'm Verlaine, I'm actually traveling right now, this is just a bit of hitchhiking along the way! ...Speaking of which, is my friend around here somewhere?
StoryText.我来帮忙啦！啊，在房间里行动要小心别碰坏东西啊，星期一！: I'm here to help! Ah, be careful moving around the room, don't knock anything over, Monday!
StoryText.旅行很好玩的，不过偶尔搭车也不赖，可惜要花旅费。啊，我是听说登记成护卫乘员以后就: Traveling is a lot of fun, but hitching a ride every now and then isn't bad either, though it does eat into the travel budget. Ah, I heard that once you're registered as a guard crew you don't need to buy tickets anymore, that's why I came!
StoryText.魔法……啊，还是叫升构能力吧！一开始是和爸爸妈妈学的，不过出来旅行以后都是自己研: Magic... ah, I should call it Ascension Ability instead! I learned the basics from my mom and dad at first, but once I started traveling on my own, I just kept figuring things out myself. I miss the mark pretty often, but there's something nice about all that randomness too!
StoryText.大家的升构能力不都是很强的火花啦闪电啦什么的吗？……我的话……让人睡着，有时候还: Doesn't everyone else's Ascension Abilities look like sparks or lightning or something powerful like that? ...Mine just... makes people fall asleep, and sometimes not even all the way asleep. I'm not even sure that counts as an ability, does it?
StoryText.我在列车上遇到了来自黑月的人，他们知道很多有意思的事情，原来黑月游乐城是建在一只: I met someone from Night Chains on the train, they knew all sorts of interesting things. Apparently Night Chains Land is built on the back of a giant sea turtle! But everyone else who was there at the time said I got fooled... is that actually true?
StoryText.对旅行者来说最重要的素质就是保持好心情！只要还能露出笑容，就能恢复力气重新出发啦: The most important thing for a traveler is to keep a good mood! As long as you can still smile, you'll find the strength to set out again. Come on, smile a little, Conductor~
StoryText.阿尔喀娜小姐知道很多帝国的冒险故事呢……甚至还知道那个，“我的朋友化为了巨树，随: Miss Arcana knows so many adventure stories from the Empire... she even knows that one, "my friend became a great tree, and then a hound, staying by my side forever"... it's really lovely, isn't it.
StoryText.不知撤退的战斗是很危险的！要我说呀，很多人在战斗的时候都不会想着逃跑……但是没关: Fighting without knowing how to retreat is really dangerous! You know, a lot of people never even think about running away when they're in a fight... but it's okay, Monday and I will make sure everyone's got a way out! Everyone should learn how to run when it's time!
StoryText.星期一叫这个名字是因为我喜欢开始，不喜欢结束……不过，地表的大家好像更喜欢星期六: Monday got its name because I like beginnings, not endings... though it seems like everyone here on the surface likes Saturday and Sunday a lot better.
StoryText.其实我从小时候就一直跟着营地到处搬迁……我觉得这样的生活很有趣！虽然和城市内的生: Actually, I've been moving from place to place with the camp ever since I was little... I think that kind of life is pretty fun! It's different from living in a city, sure, but you get to see so many different sights, and feel the wind blowing free wherever you go...
StoryText.帝国啊……因为我是在地表出生的嘛，总感觉帝国对我来说很遥远，大概是“祖籍”的感觉: The Empire, huh... since I was born here on the surface, it always feels really far away to me, like more of an "ancestral homeland" kind of thing? But I've seen it in my dreams! Huge trees, a beautiful lake, sparkling light, things like that!
StoryText.星期一，你能变成摩托车吗？不能？嗯……为什么不能呢……虽然没有轮子，但你明明长得: Monday, can you turn into a motorcycle? You can't? Hmm... why not... I mean, you don't have wheels, but you sure do look a lot like one...
StoryText.下次什么时候出发我已经决定了！但是我肯定还会回无垠号上来的，毕竟这里也算是我的家: I've already decided when I'm setting off next! But I'll definitely come back to the Eternal again, after all, this is kind of my home too!
StoryText.好嘞！星期一，给它们点颜色瞧瞧！: Alright! Monday, let's show them what we're made of!
StoryText.我会保护大家的！我们一起！: I'll protect everyone! We're in this together!
StoryText.三、二、一，躺！: Three, two, one, down you go!
StoryText.呜呜……不行了啦……: Ugh... I can't take this anymore...
StoryText.星期一，快跑！等等等等——带上我一起——: Monday, run! Wait, wait, wait—take me with you—
StoryText.我做得还不错吧？接下来的旅途，不知道还会遇见什么呢~: I did pretty well, didn't I? Wonder what we'll run into on the rest of the journey~
StoryText.闻笙，奉鹭先生之命与你同行。唔，你的气味……不，别在意。: Wensheng, accompanying you at the behest of Mr. Sagi. Hmm. Your scent... No, don't mind me.
StoryText.需要我做什么？直接说吧。: What do you need? Just say it.
StoryText.有空闲时间的话，我会练习书法。兴趣爱好？不，说是“功课”或者“修行”应该更准确。: I practice calligraphy in my free time. It that my hobby? No, "study" or "training" would be more accurate.
StoryText.我并不关心你的目标、理想之类的东西。但鹭先生希望我能协助你，所以我会尽我所能地让: I don't care about your goals or ideals. But Mr. Sagi hopes I can assist you, so I'll do my best to make everything go smoothly for you.
StoryText.“以牙还牙”是我的行事准则，“以恩报恩”也是。虽然因此吃过苦头，但我并不后悔。: "An eye for an eye" is my code of conduct, as is "a kindness for a kindness". Although I've suffered as a result, I have no regrets.
StoryText.这个吗？这个是可可含量75%的黑巧克力，还不错。你想吃？那等我一会儿，我把店的地: This? It's 75% cocoa dark chocolate. It's not bad. Want some? Wait a moment. I'll write down the address of the shop for you.
StoryText.檀香味……很好闻吧？只要闻到这个味道，我就能安心下来。: Sandalwood... smells good, right? I just need to smell this to calm down.
StoryText.鹭先生说我应该多一些年轻人的爱好，所以我去学习了街舞。不过，我的水平，目前还只能: Mr. Sagi said I should have more interests typical of young people, so I learned street dance. However, I'm only at amateur level currently.
StoryText.我的力气很大，但是，在接受鹭先生的指导之前，控制不好，经常弄坏东西……你不害怕吗: I'm very strong, but before receiving Mr. Sagi's guidance, I couldn't control it well and often broke things... Aren't you afraid? Really? I see... Hmm, nothing.
StoryText.对我而言，黑月是不以血缘关系为纽带的另一个家。只是，这个家族太大了，难免会有相处: To me, Night Chains is another family not bound by blood ties. It's just that this family is too big, so it's inevitable that there are people I can't get along with.
StoryText.我的过去被沉重的、肮脏的雪掩埋了。但是鹭先生说，等春天来了，脏雪会融化，上面也会: My past has been buried under heavy, dirty snow. But Mr. Sagi said that when spring comes, the dirty snow will melt, and new buds will grow on top.
StoryText.总会有需要暴力解决问题的时候，如果遇到的话，只管使唤我就好。信任你？也许吧，你的: There will always be times when violence is needed to solve problems. If you encounter such situations, just give the order. Trust you? Perhaps. Your scent is warm, different from those immersed in violence.
StoryText.你也对书法有兴趣吗？虽然我的水平不足以指导你，但是，我们可以一起练字。这样吧，明: Are you interested in calligraphy too? Although I'm not at a level where I can guide you, we can practice together. Tell you what, I'll be waiting in the Conductor's Room tomorrow morning at five... Eh, you don't want to?
StoryText.我回来了，这些是娃娃机的“战利品”，喜欢的话就全送给你好了。为什么？因为你平时对: I'm back. These are my "loot" from the claw machine. If you like them, they're all yours. Why? Because you've always been nice to me. What's wrong?
StoryText.该一网打尽了。: Time to take them all out.
StoryText.抱歉……鹭先生……: I've let you down... Mr. Sagi...
StoryText.我还没能……报答恩情……: I have yet to... repay your kindness...
StoryText.以牙还牙，以恩报恩，还有事吗？: An eye for an eye, a favor for a favor. Isn't that how it should be?
StoryText.你好，我是夏洛蒂，现在在地表经营“骑士万事屋”。请多指教。: Hello, I'm Charlotte, currently managing the "Knight's Hall" on the surface. Nice to meet you.
StoryText.该我出场了呢。感谢给予我休息的时间。: It's my turn to take the stage. Thanks for giving me time to rest.
StoryText.我的“骑士万事屋”也包含上门的剑术教练服务。列车长有兴趣学习剑术吗？: My "Knight's Hall" also includes home service swordsmanship training. Are you interested in swordsmanship, Conductor?
StoryText.别看我这样，曾经也是帝国的仪仗兵。虽然不是什么上得了台面的兵种。: Don't be fooled by my looks. I was an imperial honor guard, though it's not a prestigious military role.
StoryText.“贵族义务”，这才是我辞掉仪仗兵，转而拿起剑的理由。: "Noble's obligations." That's why I quit being a honor guard and took up the sword.
StoryText.这把大剑的确不方便日常携带。每当走在木制地板上，地板就会吱吱作响……: It's inconvenient to carry this great sword around daily. Every time I walk on wooden floors, they would creak...
StoryText.我如今虽是这幅样子，曾经也是一介贵族。多少还是有一些对名品的鉴定能力的。: Even though I look like this now, I was once a noble. I still have some ability to appraise fine things.
StoryText.蒂斯在我离开兵团时就跟着我了，就像我的妹妹一样。: Tiss followed when I left the army, just like a little sister.
StoryText.蒂斯做的饭很好吃。相比之下，我做的就……有些、上不了台面……: Tiss's cooking is delicious. What I whip up... can't quite measure up...
StoryText.在二手市场发现了非常值钱的宝贝，没忍住就、买了……千万别告诉蒂斯哦！: I found some valuable treasures in a second-hand market and couldn't resist buying them... You mustn't tell Tiss!
StoryText.列车长没有因为我的贵族身份而对我区别对待，这让我很高兴。: Conductor doesn't treat me differently because of my nobility. This makes me happy.
StoryText.虽然我的厨艺、有些上不了台面……但如果列车长强烈要求的话，我也可以……: Although my culinary skills are somewhat lacking... if you really insist, Conductor, I can also...
StoryText.如果是“商业需求”的话，我可是要收费的哦。但如果是列车长的个人请求，可以免费。请: If it's a "business request," I charge a fee. But if it's your personal request, it's free. So, which is it, dear "customer"?
StoryText.我最近，在跟蒂斯学习厨艺……不知列车长，是否愿意帮我品尝一下？: I've been learning cooking from Tiss lately... I wonder if you would be willing to taste it for me, Conductor?
StoryText.面对拦路之人，我绝不手软。: I do not show compassion to those in my way.
StoryText.我会将碍事者，统统清除。: I will get rid of every single nuisance.
StoryText.此乃曼杜斯的骑士技艺！: Such is the finesse of a Mundus knight!
StoryText.失策……暂时撤退。: My mistake... Fall back for now.
StoryText.今后亦会不骄不躁、继续精进。: I will continue pressing forward with humility and composure.
StoryText.你就是列车长？看起来不太靠谱的样子呢……算了。我叫星花，请多指教喽。: You're the conductor? You don't look very reliable... Oh well. My name is Stella. Pleased to meet you.
StoryText.已经到换班时间了吗？稍等一下，我清洗完器具就去。: Is it time to change shifts already? Just wait a moment. I'll finish cleaning the utensils first.
StoryText.先说好哦，我是研究员，不是战斗员。麻烦牢记这一点。: Let's make things clear. I'm a researcher, not a combatant. Please remember that.
StoryText.我去阿妮塔能源，当然是为了钱啦！听说过一句话吗？“预算是研究人员最大的敌人”。: I joined Anita Energy Institute for money, of course! Have you heard the saying, "Budget is the researcher's greatest enemy?"
StoryText.如果发现高纯度的桦石，能让给我吗？我想用来做研究。当然，不会让你白给啦。: If you find Chaos Stones with high purity, could you give them to me? I want to use them for research. Of course, I'm not asking for them for free.
StoryText.虽然都说研究员头脑灵活思路清晰，但其实我们在专业领域之外和普通人没差啦。比如列车: Although researchers are said to have agile minds, we're no different from ordinary people outside our fields of expertise. Like you, Conductor, if someone assumed you could operate a ship just because you drive a train, you'd be perplexed, right?
StoryText.诶嘿，是不是为我的秀发着迷啊？毕竟可是费了我好多时间打理，自然是十分美丽让人移不: Hehe, are you fascinated by my hair? I invest a lot of time to maintain it, after all, so it's natural that it's beautiful and captivating.
StoryText.经常有人说，我是靠父母的光环才走到今天这步。我不否认。毕竟身为人子，永远无法摆脱: Many people say I'm where I am today solely because of my parents' influence. I don't deny it. After all, as a child, it's normal to be influenced by one's parents forever.
StoryText.我认为，每个人一开始都是一颗未经加工的钻石原石，要不断打磨才能崭露锋芒。所以，我: I believe everyone starts out as an unpolished diamond, and we need constant polishing to shine. So, I'll do whatever it takes to refine myself.
StoryText.咳咳、咳……好严重的粉尘……啊、我的头发……哎，看来今晚泡澡的时候得好好洗一洗了: Cough, cough... So much dust... Ah, my hair... I guess I'll have to give it a good wash when I bathe tonight...
StoryText.我的头发，可以允许你稍微、“稍微”摸一下哦。因为是你，才特别允许的！可不是什么人: You can touch my hair a little, just a little. I'm giving special permission only to you! Not everyone gets to touch it, you know!
StoryText.这个？是我一个月的洗发水和护发素啊。因为发量比较多，用量就比较大喽。: This? It's my month's worth of shampoo and conditioner. I have a lot of hair, so I need a large quantity.
StoryText.喂，帮我吹下头发。啊……有你在，我打理头发也能变得更轻松呢。: Hey, could you help dry my hair? Ah... it's so much easier with you here.
StoryText.客观来说，我也算是个大家闺秀、高岭之花呢。劝你在我被别人拿下之前尽早行动哦？: Objectively speaking, I'm quite the belle, the cream of the crop. I advise you to act fast before someone else wins me over, okay?
StoryText.妨碍我研究的家伙，绝不放过！: I won't let go of anyone who gets in the way of my research!
StoryText.不想挂彩的话现在跑还来得及哦！: You still have time to run before bad things happen!
StoryText.真碍事，本小姐可是很忙的！: Ugh, so annoying. Don't you know I'm a busy lady?
StoryText.看好喽！能支配天的才叫做天才！: Keep your eyes peeled! I'll show you what it means to be a real genuis!
StoryText.啊——！我、我心爱的头发！！你、你怎么敢啊！！！: Aaaaah! M-My precious hair!!! H-How dare you?!
StoryText.哼，我赶着回去做研究，没空陪你们这群愚蠢之徒！: Hmph! My research is waiting for me. You bunch of morons don't deserve my time!
StoryText.虽然更想拿到项目研究的奖项……但既、既然你非要给，那我就收下好了。: I'd much rather receive an award for my research project, but... s-since you insist, I'll take it, then.
StoryText.又见面了，列车长，我是侍应生亚莉奈呀。: We meet again, Conductor. I'm Arina, the bartender.
StoryText.有什么需要我去做的请立刻告诉我哦，无论是睡觉的时候还是洗澡的时候都可以……: If there's anything you need me to do, just tell me right away, even if I'm sleeping or bathing...
StoryText.第一次见到列车长的瞬间，我就明白了呢，眼前的这个人无疑是我的命运之人。: The moment I first saw you, I knew that you're undoubtedly my destined one.
StoryText.哼哼~没事~只是想看着你而已。仅此而已，我的内心就感觉要被填满了呢。: Hehe~ It's nothing~ I just wanted to watch you. This is enough to make my heart feel like it's being filled up.
StoryText.我今天稍微换了一下唇妆，怎么样，列车长，好看吗，你喜欢这个颜色吗？: I've changed my lip color today. How does it look, Conductor? Do you like this color?
StoryText.有更过分的要求也可以提出来，只要是列车长喜欢的，我都会尽全力满足的。: You can make even more demanding requests, as long as it's something you like. I'll do my best to fulfill it.
StoryText.列车长……你收到我的邮件了吧，为什么没有回复呢？是因为工作太忙了吗？: Conductor... You received my email, didn't you? Why haven't you replied? Is it because you're too busy?
StoryText.列车长，你可以稍微调整一点工作时间吗。最近和我待在一起的时间越来越少了，难道列车: Could you adjust your work schedule, Conductor? We're spending less and less time together lately. Are you starting to dislike me now?
StoryText.你和那个孩子看上去关系很好呢，是怎么回事呢？只是工作伙伴？真的吗，没有在骗我吧？: You and that girl seem to have a good relationship. What's going on? Just colleagues? Really? You're not lying to me, are you?
StoryText.列车长，和朋友在一起的时间确实很重要，但是也不能占用和恋人相处的时间呀。: Spending time with friends is important indeed, Conductor, but it shouldn't take away from time with your lover.
StoryText.我知道的……如果被打了的话就说明我有错是吧……那，列车长可以打我吗？直到我变成一: I know... if I get spanked, it means I did something wrong... Uh, Conductor, can you spank me? Don't stop until I become a good girl.
StoryText.那个女人……刚才是不是对着列车长抛媚眼了？不可原谅……想要偷走我的列车长的人，全: That woman... Did she just wink to my Conductor? Unforgivable... I won't allow anyone to steal away my Conductor!
StoryText.你总是对我这么温柔，我会感到不安的……所以，如果你有什么不满，请动手打我吧……求: You're always so gentle with me, and it makes me uneasy... so, if you're dissatisfied in any way, please, spank me... I'm begging you.
StoryText.我愿意为列车长做任何事，所以……请你永远爱着我吧，可以吗，可以吗？: I'm willing to do anything for you, so... please, keep loving me forever. Please? Pretty please?
StoryText.列车长，我会努力的，好好看着我吧~: I'll do my best, Conductor. Just watch me~
StoryText.我不是说了吗……离列车长远一点！: Didn't I tell you... to stay away from Conductor?!
StoryText.无论有多危险，我都会好好保护列车长的~: No matter how dangerous it is, I'll protect Conductor!
StoryText.为什么，为什么要打扰我和列车长……: Why? Why must you bother Conductor and me...?
StoryText.为了能让列车长露出满意的表情努力了！之后也会以此为目标继续战斗……所以，所以，列: I worked hard to make Conductor look satisfied! This will continue to be my goal in combat... S-So, Conductor, don't ever dislike me, okay?
StoryText.我比较喜欢，窝在被子里就能完成的任务……: I prefer tasks that I can complete from within the comfort of my blanket...
