StoryText.人类创造了屋子来遮风挡雨。屋子的价值体现在有人待在里面的时候，所以喜欢待在屋子里: Humans create houses to shelter from wind and rain. The value of a house is realized when someone is inside it, so it's normal to enjoy staying inside...
StoryText.工作，会认真做的……早点成为教官，然后隐退，继续窝家里躺平了……: I'll work diligently... the sooner I become an instructor, the sooner I can retire and continue lazing around at home...
StoryText.宽敞的地方，让我冷静不下来……在窝里小被子一盖才能放松……是我的天堂。: Spacious places make it hard for me to stay calm... I can only truly relax when I'm wrapped in my blanket... It's my paradise.
StoryText.多萝西，总想着抓我去参加烤肉派对……要是去了那种地方，我可就燃尽了。: Dorothy always wants to drag me to barbecue parties... If I go to such places, I'll burn out.
StoryText.车长，来一起摸鱼吧……已经把小可爱的系统黑掉了，所以，不用怕啦，呼啊——: Conductor, let's slack off together... I've already hacked into the cutie's system, so there's nothing to worry about, hehe—
StoryText.小时候，因为说想当家里蹲，把爸妈给气哭了。所以，我要挣很多的钱，然后再去当家里蹲: When I was a child, I made my parents cry by saying I wanted to be a homebody. So, I need to earn lots of money, then I can become a homebody.
StoryText.多萝西，总想抓我去聚餐或者出去玩……多萝西是个好人，所以很不好拒绝。: Dorothy always wants to drag me to gatherings or outings... Dorothy is a nice person, so it's hard to refuse.
StoryText.狙击手可以找个地方躲起来，所以很轻松……偶尔会有虫子壁虎之类的爬来爬去，但比待在: Snipers can find a place to hide, so it's quite relaxing... There are bugs or geckos crawling around sometimes, but it's better than being in spacious places.
StoryText.再休息5分钟……不可以么？我在车长身边就会感觉很放松，很想……想……: Five more minutes of rest... I can't? I feel so relaxed when I'm with you, Conductor, I just want to... want to...
StoryText.我是很不想出去吃饭的，但是车长邀请的话……行，行吧。但是要尽量选有包厢的餐厅哦！: I really don't want to go out to eat, but if it's you inviting me... Fine, fine. But try to pick a restaurant with private rooms!
StoryText.我好几年前就已经停止生长了……但是不许叫我矮子哦？: I stopped growing years ago... but don't call me short, okay?
StoryText.多萝西的聚会……果然我还是不要去了。没办法，我已经把一辈子的社交份额都用完了……: Dorothy's gatherings... I'd better not go. I've already used up my lifetime quota of socializing... sigh...
StoryText.呜……不想动啦。: Mmh... I don't wanna move anymore.
StoryText.已经把一整年的外出份额都用掉了……想回窝……: A whole year's travel quota has been used... I wanna go home...
StoryText.这样就能早点回去了吧……永别啦。: This will wrap things up sooner, right...? Farewell, then.
StoryText.好耶……可以回去……了。: Awesome... I can finally... go home.
StoryText.看不见我看不见我……: You can't see me. You can't see me...
StoryText.这，这样就可以从前线脱身了！哎？不行！？又，又骗我……: T-This means I can be relieved from the frontlines! Huh? No?! Y-You lied to me again...
StoryText.我是约书亚。作为学会的天使，我可以给你讲授凡人无法理解的深奥学识。“老师~这是什: I'm Joshua. As an Angel of the Citadel, I can teach you profound knowledge that ordinary people can't understand. Please refrain from asking, "Teacher, what does this mean~" or other similarly silly questions.
StoryText.什么事？如果是浪费我时间的事就不必开口了。: What's up? Bite your tongue if it'll be a waste of my time.
StoryText.以前的“我”是御敌枢纽的战斗人员，但是现在的“我”已经不同以往。希望你不要忘记这: "I" was a combatant of the Destroyer before, but now "I" am different from back then. Hope you don't forget that.
StoryText.希望你能够理解身为“天使”的辛苦。毕竟要配合那些愚钝者的步调，简直就像驯养家畜一: I hope you understand the hardships of being an "Angel." After all, having to cope with those dullards is like raising livestock...
StoryText.你虽然算不上聪明，但总比那些自作聪明之人有救一些。那么，你想问“天使”什么问题呢: You may not be very bright, but you're still better than those who think they're clever. So, what questions do you have for the "Angel"?
StoryText.无数的“知识”，组成了掌管万事万物的“理”。请你仔细衡量其中价值，然后再向我发问: Countless "knowledge" forms the "principles" governing all things. Please evaluate their value carefully before asking me.
StoryText.以前的“我”好像特别顽强，在哪里都能睡得着。不过这个体质对现在的“我”来说也算方: "I" seemed to be particularly tenacious before, being able to sleep anywhere. But this physique is also convenient for the current "me"...
StoryText.你……对，就是你。赶快把这只躺在我膝盖上的厚颜无耻的野兽挪开。……我是说，这只猫: You... yes, you. Hurry up and remove this shameless beast lying on my lap. ...I mean, this cat.
StoryText.有人托你传话？真是的，不敢直接与我说吗？学会的人何时也变得这么窝囊了呢。: Someone asked you to pass on a message? Really, couldn't they just tell me directly? When did the Citadel members become so spineless?
StoryText.以前的“我”的朋友，说现在的“我”变成了完全不同的另外一个人……这是肯定的呀。在: "My" friends from before said the current "I" has become a completely different person... That's for sure. The moment "I" became an "Angel", the current "I" was born.
StoryText.我不需要穿鞋子。因为我现在只有要睡觉的时候才会接触地面……平时都是飘着的呢。: I don't need to wear shoes. Because I only touch the ground when I need to sleep... I float most of the time.
StoryText.遗憾的是，哪怕成为了“天使”，这具身体也仍旧残留着潜意识里的恐惧……所以你、你可: Unfortunately, even though I've become an "Angel", this body still retains the subconscious fear... so, can you, uh, chase that dog away?
StoryText.那些猫总是随时随地地想蹭我。嗯……天冷的时候让它们给我做天然暖炉倒也可以接受。: Those cats always want to snuggle against me. Hmm... maybe I can accept them as natural heaters when it's cold.
StoryText.能一直厚着脸皮来找“天使”闲聊的也只有你了，真的是……带点心来了？好，再给我泡杯: You're the only one who has the nerve to come and chat with the "Angel" like this. Gosh... Did you bring some snacks? Fine, make me another cup of tea.
StoryText.到了需要我出场的地步吗？请你反省一下人手为什么会不足到这份上吧。: Am I needed to step in already? You should reflect on why your manpower is this insufficient.
StoryText.可以快点解决吗？我已经开始觉得麻烦了。: Can we keep this brief? I'm starting to get tired of this.
StoryText.我与愚人无话可说。: I have nothing to say to fools.
StoryText.能拦住我，确实是一件值得骄傲的事。: Indeed, you should be proud that you managed to block my way.
StoryText.义务履行完毕。该回去了。: My obligations are fulfilled. Time to get going.
StoryText.啊，不小心就包揽了大部分工作呢，真是不胜惭愧，下一次给你们留点事干吧，一定一定。: Ah, I deeply apologize. I can't believe I accidentally took care of most of the job. I'll leave some work for you next time, I promise.
StoryText.啊！那个很吓人的列车长？！你怎么在这里？！……哦，我知道了！你正打算转行，要来当: Ah! That terrifying Conductor! Why are you here?! ...Oh, I got it! You're submitting to the mighty Lord Shire, right?
StoryText.嗯嗯好好一会儿就来——知道啦知道啦——: Mm-mm, all right, I'm coming... I know, I know...
StoryText.你这里还不错嘛！虽然比不上我们沙盗团的基地。好了，我的卧室呢？朱迪的床呢？: You've got a nice place! Though, it can't beat our P.U.S. base. All right, where's my bedroom? And Jude's bed?
StoryText.再说一遍，朱迪不是鸭子，我不是鸭子妹！夏——尔，就那么难记吗？！……你说这不像人: Once again, Jude isn't a duck, and I'm not Miss Duck! S, H, I, R, E! Is it that hard to memorize?! ...What do you mean it doesn't sound like a human name?!
StoryText.什么？想知道更多关于沙盗团的事？我不会和你说的！我可是沙盗团的三把手，地位很高，: Huh? You wanna know more about P.U.S.? Well, you won't be hearing it from me! I'm the third-in-command in P.U.S. My standing is significant!
StoryText.朱迪和我可不是一般的关系，哼哼……如果我遇到危险，朱迪绝对、肯定、一定会第一时间: The relationship between Jude and me is way more special than you can imagine... If I'm in trouble, Jude will definitely, absolutely, without a doubt come to my rescue at once!
StoryText.既然列车上没有捕梦网，那平时你都怎么对付超级大的桦树生物啊？……你上车顶用大炮轰: Since there isn't any dreamcatcher on the train, how do you usually deal with massive Chaos Remains? ...You bomb them with the cannon on the roof? N-No way!
StoryText.我不喜欢那种复杂的衣服！嗯，不过好像之前大家给我买的这件毛衣是有点破了……回去让: I'm not a fan of complicated clothing! Hmm, but this sweater they bought me is indeed torn... I'll have sis fix it.
StoryText.我还被铁安局追过咧。不过每次我都成功逃脱了！那些蓝衣服的人本事也不怎么样嘛，还是: I've even been chased by the BCRL Agency! But I managed to get away every time. Those blue shirts aren't anything special. I'm just the best.
StoryText.要是看见了大鹅主题的挂件、玩偶什么的，就买下来吧！我会付钱的。是朱迪喜欢哦！不是: If you see any accessories, stuffed toys, or something else related to goose, buy them all! I'll pay for them. Jude is the one who likes them, not me.
StoryText.尾巴？这不是尾巴，我是普通人类耶！这是二姐帮忙做的秘密装置！作用是……呃，因为是: Tail? This isn't a tail. I'm an ordinary human! This is a secret device Papaga made. It's for... uh, it's a secret device, so I can't tell you.
StoryText.虽然小时候的事情基本上都不记得了，大家也说我就是站台上捡来的，不过好像我还记得我: Although I've pretty much forgotten about everything from my childhood, and everybody says that I was found on a railway platform, I think I still remember my birthday. But, it's not like it makes any difference...
StoryText.列车长，你知不知道去7号自由港的路上有一家很好吃的车厢拉面店？很好吃的，真的很好: Conductor, do you know about the amazing carriage ramen shop on the way to Freeport Ⅶ? I swear, their food is amazing! Let's go together next time, okay? It'll be your treat!
StoryText.……综上所述！我决定再在无垠号上待一段时间。假如、假如你再让我开心一点，说不定我: ...To sum up, I have decided to stay a bit longer on the Eternal! If, if you make me happier, I might just invite my two sisters here too! Do not be mean to me, understood?
StoryText.这是为了以后带领沙盗团积累经验……: This is to gain experience in leading P.U.S. in the future...
StoryText.这些敌人根本不堪一击嘛~: They don't even stand a chance~
StoryText.想跑也太迟啦！: It's too late to run away now!
StoryText.我们真是太厉害了！好，朱迪，去把列车长的钱包抢过来，我们一会儿吃顿好的。: We're just awesome! All right, Jude, go snatch Conductor's wallet, we'll have a nice meal later.
StoryText.果然还是不能没有我吧！不过为什么来了游乐园还要坚持工作？: Guess you can't do without me after all! But why do you still insist on working when you're at a theme park?
StoryText.哎，好无聊啊，你什么时候陪我去玩？欸……一个小熊……两个小熊，三个……: *sigh* I'm so bored. When can we hang out? One teddy bear... Two teddy bears... Three...
StoryText.神秘特制饮料？监护人？桦树生物研究？……你在说什么，该不会是吃了人类的食物出现幻: Mysterious special beverage? "Guardian?" "Chaos Remains research?"... What are you even talking about? Don't tell me human food made you hallucinate! Snap out of it!
StoryText.以前，玛格丽特是不受欢迎的小熊。不过自从我们成了朋友以后……啊！你快看那边，那是: Back then, Margaret was an unpopular bear. But ever since we became friends... Ah! Look over there! That's the Margaret-themed haunted house!
StoryText.在熊熊乐园，犯错的人不会被关起来，只会被送去体验三十次过山车。我认识的一对熊熊夫: In Teddy Wonderland, people who do something wrong don't get locked up. They just have to ride the roller coaster thirty times. A bear couple I know was thrilled about it... they even gave me a huge hug!
StoryText.这里就是世界上最好的地方啊，又有小熊，又有无穷无尽的游乐项目——超开心的，你不觉: This is the best place in the whole world! It's got bears, and endless rides... it's amazing, don't you think?! Let's just stay here forever!
StoryText.不许打扰我们熊熊乐园的安宁！: Don't you dare disturb the peace of Teddy Wonderland!
StoryText.欸？！要去玩小熊过山车吗！: Huh? We're riding the Teddy Coaster?!
StoryText.好烦！要重新排队了！: Ugh! Now we have to wait in line all over again!
StoryText.啊，我为什么在轨道上站着？！: Huh?! Why am I standing on the tracks?!
StoryText.嘿嘿——你看！熊熊乐园超级贵宾卡！有了以后就可以无限畅玩所有游乐项目啦！当然是送: Hehe... Look! A Teddy Wonderland VIP Pass! With this, you get unlimited access to every ride! Of course it's for you. You've earned it!
StoryText.我是安菲娅，正在游学中……箱子？箱子里是安菲娅的朋友，所以别在意。: I'm Anfiya, and am currently on a study tour... The box? It's my friend in it. Please don't mind.
StoryText.好。……我会带着白桦一起。: Okay... I'll bring White Birch along.
StoryText.“桦树生物”的由来是因为其发现者的姓氏，但大众因误会一直认为其本源和桦树有关。不: Chaos Remain is named by the one who discovered it. Due to its behavior, it's only natural for people to relate it with chaos. But my friend is different, so I named it "White Birch" — a symbol of fortitude and vigor. My last name? I... don't have such a thing.
StoryText.设计武器的天赋吗？档案上写的？……其实我并没有想过这种天赋是好是坏，也没有想过制: Talent for weapon design? It's stated in my file...? Truthfully, I've never considered if a talent like that is good or not, nor have I wondered if the weapons I made... are good or not.
StoryText.我喜欢收集各种各样的素材。但是，桦树生物调查报告上的“口味”之类的，并不是我写的: I like collecting all kinds of materials, but the "flavors" in the Chaos Remain research reports aren't written by me... I wonder who it is.
StoryText.要吃黑巧克力吗？纯度很高，好像有人会觉得又酸又苦。……但是，我很喜欢。: Want some dark chocolate? It's almost wholly pure. Some people find it both bitter and sour... but I love it.
StoryText.有什么问题想问我吗？缴获的武器……请让我看看。……对武器的改装能够增加输出功率，: Do you have a question for me? Confiscated weapons... Let me see... Modifying weapons can boost output power, but similarly, it will also increase the risk of circuit fusing.
StoryText.我之前工作和学习的地方不是学校，而是工厂。某个被称为“工厂”的地方……列车长应该: I used to work and study in a "factory," not a school. I don't think you've heard of this place, Conductor... It's a factory under "DRYAS CORPORATION."
StoryText.我的父亲……那位先生拥有很高的地位，备受尊敬。有了他的同意，我才能离开工厂、出来: My father... That gentleman holds a really high position and is esteemed. It was only with his approval that I could leave the factory and come on a study tour... It's been a long time since I last saw him. Regardless, I have friends with me now...
StoryText.“闻起来很开心”……？怎么会。我只是待在列车上而已，没有做什么特别开心的事情……: "I smell happy"...? How's that possible? I merely stayed on the train and didn't do anything particularly happy... Am I actually happy...?
StoryText.愿望吗？嗯……暂时没有了呢。我曾经很想要别人……叫我“德拉亚斯小姐”，那是我父亲: A wish? Hmm... None for now. I once really wished people would... call me "Miss Dryas." That's my father's last name, which means "fairywood." But I wasn't allowed to... It's okay. I don't care about it anymore. I am Anfiya. This is enough for me.
StoryText.白桦本来是在工厂里待着的。……但是，它同意陪我一起四处游历，所以我制造了这个箱子: White Birch was supposed to stay in the factory... but it agreed to travel the world with me, so I made this box that's spacious enough for White Birch to live in. In fact, humans can fit in it too...
StoryText.……啊，列车长。白桦刚刚在说，这里虽然有很多人类，但它还是能在这里生活，很不可思: ...Ah, Conductor. White Birch was saying that even though there are tons of humans here, it's surprised that it's still able to live here. There are few things that can really surprise a Chaos Remain.
StoryText.不需要付出代价的“爱”……真的存在吗？远行的机会、现在的生活……白桦的声音、朋友: Is there really a kind of "love" that demands nothing in return? The chance to travel, my current lifestyle... White Birch's voice, the company of friends... Just which was it that I gained by fighting for it, and which was obtained through a trade...?
StoryText.白桦，我们去战场上看看吧。: White Birch, let's go to the battlefield.
StoryText.为了保存采集到的素材，先退回后方吧。: Let's retreat to store the acquired materials.
StoryText.这次胜利也有白桦的功劳。不过它现在已经休息了。……我会转达给它的。: Part of the credit goes to White Birch. But it's resting now... I'll tell it later.
StoryText.前辈，我来参加社团活动了。白桦已经先去活动室了吗？: Senior, I'm here for club activities. Is White Birch already in the room?
StoryText.和您待在一起的时间很开心。但是这样的时间或许在您毕业后就会结束……啊，还是……先: Spending time with you makes me really happy, but this will probably stop once you graduate... Ah, I'd better not... think about that for now...
StoryText.学生证，带了……寄存柜钥匙，带了……零食，带了。啊，这是我在校外便利店买的，黑巧: Student ID, check... Locker key, check... Snacks, check. Ah, I bought this in the convenience store outside the school. It's dark chocolate flavored. Wanna try some?
StoryText.上次考试的成绩非常好，所以爸爸妈妈给我买了新的书包。前辈，你看……咦，您说这是…: I scored exceptionally well in the last exam, so mom and dad bought me a new backpack. See... Huh? This is a surveillance device? No, this is my backpack...
StoryText.同学们都对我很和善，但有人却因为外貌就欺负白桦……太过分了。但我会保护白桦的，无: My classmates are all nice to me, but some people have bullied White Birch just because of its looks... It's unbelievable. Still, I will protect White Birch no matter what.
StoryText.如果我能像前辈一样就好了。……前辈是我崇拜的人，以很厉害的方式生活着……嗯，我真: If only I can be like you... I really look up to you for your impressive lifestyle... Mm, I mean every word from the bottom of my heart.
StoryText.没关系，我不会让任何人遭遇不幸。: Don't worry. I won't let anything bad happen.
StoryText.我会保护大家的，请放心吧。: Please rest assured. I will protect everyone.
StoryText.我在的地方必须是安全的……: Wherever I am, I must ensure its safety...
StoryText.破坏教室的人会被惩戒，这是理所应当的。: Anyone messing around in the classroom will be punished.
StoryText.窗户，开始溶化了……外面下雨了吗？: The windows are melting... Is it raining out there?
StoryText.风扇……掉下来了吗……？: Did the fan... just fall down...?
StoryText.太好了，我保护了大家……也保护了前辈和白桦。可惜教室似乎变得乱七八糟的……我们把: Glad to know I've protected everyone... including you and White Birch. It's a shame the classroom is messed up... Let's tidy it up, shall we?
StoryText.我看起来不太一样了吗？但无论如何我都还是静流……总之，即使是这副样子也请多指教了: I don't look the same anymore? But I'm always going to be Shizuru regardless... Anyhow, I'm pleased to see you, even while in this state.
StoryText.这就来，稍等一下。: I'm coming. Hold on a second.
StoryText.穿、穿着这身服装拍乘员档案照的时候，感觉稍微有点害羞……你可要做好档案库的保密措: I-It was a bit embarrassing to take crew database photos wearing this... You gotta make sure the archives are kept hidden! If my colleagues were to see them...!
StoryText.射击不是我的长项，但为了弥补这一点，我特地加练了很久……要来测试一下我的训练成果: Shooting isn't my strong suit, but I deliberately trained extra hard to make up for it... Want to give my hard work a test? We'll use this water gun to avoid accidental injuries.
StoryText.我的包里有基本的制式武器和急救用品，能够应对大多数突发情况，放心吧……嗯，还装了: There are basic standard weapons and first-aid items in my bag, so don't worry... Mm, there are also my UV jacket and sunscreen... If you need it, you can have some. Here...
StoryText.……列、车、长，请你看看这个。然后请你把这行标题读出来……哦？你说你看不见？那我: ...Con-duc-tor, please take a look at this, then kindly read this heading aloud... Oh? You can't see a thing? I'll read it to you, then. "Train Speeding Ticket"! Unbelievable! Hey, Get back here!
StoryText.无法独立解决的工作我一般会拜托同僚，你也可以试着和其他乘员多商量商量。……嗯，我: If there's work that I can't deal with independently, I'll generally get the help of my colleagues. You can try discussing more with your crew, too... Mm, I get that now as well. Not everything has to be done by yourself to turn out well.
StoryText.新衣服适合我吗？这身是从铁盟出发前……其他人硬拉着我去逛街时挑的。不是什么很贵的: Do my new clothes suit me? This outfit was bought... when the others forced me to go shopping before setting out. It wasn't really expensive, but Karen insisted on buying it with "their salary." They said it was a gift... It's one precious gift, indeed.
StoryText.你还记得小时候的事吗？那时候的你对我说的话……我到现在都还记得。所以现在，每次需: Do you still remember what happened when we were young? I haven't forgotten... anything you told me at that time. So every time I need to throw myself into danger now, I will instinctively think of you and the reason why I chose to become an honorable BCRL soldier.
StoryText.工作也需要劳逸结合，一味想着快点成长说不定会适得其反……我说，不要一边点头一边找: A good work-rest balance is essential in any career. Solely striving for swift development might just backfire instead... Will you stop nodding while searching for new orders? Goodness, why haven't you changed a bit...
StoryText.只要是你喜欢的东西，我都会尽力尊重……不许说你喜欢恐怖电影！就算你拉着我看，我、: As long as it's something you like, I will do my best to respect it... Don't say you like horror movies! Even if you drag me there, I-I won't watch them!
StoryText.最初担任队长时，我其实很担心自己做不好。那时候我就想着，如果是你的话会怎么做、怎: When I first became Captain, I was seriously afraid that I couldn't do a good job. I only pulled through because... I kept wondering what you would do if you were in my shoes, and how you'd get along with everyone. In a way, I really ought to thank you for being my role model.
StoryText.同僚和朋友们一直都很支持我，也经常鼓励我、说我做得很好……听了这些话以后，我稍微: My friends and colleagues have always given me lots of support and encouragement, telling me that I've done well... These words have helped put me at ease a little. I didn't slack off, it's just these recognitions told me that I've indeed improved. ...Of course, I read every single message that you sent me.
StoryText.休息日你有安排吗？要去逛街，还是就打算待在列车上鼓捣各种东西？……算啦，不管怎么: Got any plans on your day off? Want to go shopping? Or are you simply going to stay aboard to tinker with stuff? ...It's okay. Whatever it is, I'm happy just getting to spend time with you.
StoryText.按作战计划有序行动就行，别紧张。: Relax. Just keep to the plan.
StoryText.我将退回后方……前线不要放弃！: I'm retreating to the rear... Don't give up, frontline!
StoryText.作战完成。……感谢你的配合，接下来，也一起努力吧。: Battle concluded. ...Thanks for the cooperation. Let's keep the momentum.
StoryText.如果你愿意服软的话，我也不是不能帮你一些小小的忙……首先，就从叫我一声“船长”开: It's not exactly impossible for me to help you out a little, provided that you're willing to submit... First, how about you start calling me "Captain"? Go on. Let's hear it.
StoryText.嗯，安心睡吧。我会抱着你的，就算你有什么装睡潜逃的计划也绝对不会让你得手……只需: Mm, just go to sleep. I'll embrace you. Even if you have some kind of nighttime escape plan, I'll make sure you don't succeed... All you need to do is be my treasure forever.
StoryText.越过前面的海角就是我们的驻地了。别急，我知道你很想回家，但回去以后我们还有许多时: We'll reach our compound once we pass the headland ahead. Relax. I know you're really homesick, but we'll still have a lot of time to do whatever we wish to do after we get back.
StoryText.偶尔换身衣服玩玩也还挺有意思的。不过你的同伴怎么对我那副态度？他们应该知道这是角: It's certainly interesting to put on something new every now and then, but what's with your friends' attitude toward me? They should know this is part of role-playing, right...? Never mind. I've always wanted to steal you away from the Eternal, anyway. This makes for a golden opportunity.
StoryText.酒？船上确实还有一些，想喝的话自己去拿来。要我也喝？我可不能保证会出现什么样的后: Alcohol? There are indeed some on the ship. You can take it if you want one to drink. You want me to join you? I can't guarantee what will happen, though... Are you going to try to get me drunk?
StoryText.之前确实也构想过一些船舶引擎的设计，不过大多搁置了……没什么特别的原因，单纯是缺: I did conceptualize some ship engine designs before, but they've mostly been shelved... No special reason, really. I just lacked the interest to carry on. That said, if you're keen, I can make time to design one for you. Take it as a reward for your excellent performance. What do you say?
StoryText.舰队的下一步计划是远征……远征到哪里？这重要吗？那就暂且将目标定为打败遇见的每个: What's next on the fleet's agenda is to go on an expedition... To where? Does that matter? Well, let's make "defeating all enemies we encounter" the temporary goal then. Of course, with you around, failure is impossible. No matter where we go, I will never let anyone get their hands on my treasure...
StoryText.舰队全员听令，准备出击！: On my command! Get ready to strike!
StoryText.跟我上，把敌方舰船掠夺一空！: Follow me lead! Let's raid those ships!
StoryText.哼，一群庸才……: Tsk, a bunch of average Joes...
StoryText.火力不敌，暂时撤退吧。: We're overpowered. Let's pull back for now.
StoryText.赢了。尽管高兴吧，跟随着我的舰队就该取得这样的结果——好了，我们回去吧，还有许多: Victory is ours. Celebrate as you please, because this is what we deserve. Alright, let's get back, there's still work to be done.
StoryText.我是雅莱，是学会的……嗯，收容对象。<color=#8e8e8e>赫尔的……妹妹: I'm Jalhay, a... a subject of the Citadel. <color=#8e8e8e>Harle's sister...</color>
StoryText.要帮忙吗？虽然之前没试过，但我会努力的。<color=#8e8e8e>就交给我吧: Need a hand? I'm new to this, but I'll do my best. <color=#8e8e8e>Just count on me!</color>
StoryText.请不要伤害我。我会很听话的，也会尽力配合你的要求……<color=#8e8e8e: Please don't hurt me. I'll behave, and I'll do as you say... <color=#8e8e8e>Just leave...</color>
StoryText.我喜欢看风景。过去……一直待在家里，从来没见过外面世界的样子。<color=#8: I love taking in the sights. I used to be... staying at home, and I've never seen the outside world before. <color=#8e8e8e>Only me...</color>
StoryText.列车长……如果有的人只是活着就会给别人添麻烦的话，放弃她会不会比较好？<colo: Conductor, do you think... it's better to give up on someone if her mere existence is a nuisance to others? <color=#8e8e8e>Help me...</color>
StoryText.如果能去探望姐姐就好了，我很想她，也有很多问题想问。不过……<color=#8e: It would be great to see my sister. I miss her, and I have so many questions for her. But... <color=#8e8e8e>Where is sister~?</color>
StoryText.列车长，我们下一站要去哪？我已经准备好了，随时都可以出发……不会在旅途中拖累您的: Where are we going next, Conductor? I'm ready when you are... and I won't drag you down. <color=#8e8e8e>Unknown location recorded...</color>
StoryText.今天吃什么？速冻汉堡……？太好了……无垠号上的食物，比营养液好多了。<color: What's on the menu? Instant burgers...? Great... The food on the Eternal is much better than nutrient solution. <color=#8e8e8e>You serious?</color>
StoryText.我的愿望吗？……已经不记得了。列车长呢？旅行……也许曾经……我也很想旅行…<co: My wish? ...I can hardly recall. What about you, Conductor? Travel... maybe I loved to travel in the past... <color=#8e8e8e>Maybe...</color>
StoryText.虽然我没去过学校，但是姐姐教授了我很多常识，包括一些医疗方面的知识，她说是为了让: Although I've never been to school, my sister taught me a lot, even some medical knowledge to help me blend in... What's wrong? <color=#8e8e8e>Gonna eat you alive... Just kidding.</color>
StoryText.这个是修格里城……这个是淘金乐园……这个是在学会拍的……找到了！列车组的……嗯…: Shoggolith... ONEderland... Citadel... Oh, found it! This is for the crew... but my album is almost full. I should get a new one. <color=#8e8e8e>Why not prepare a separate album for someone special?</color>
StoryText.另一个声音？我听不到哦……她应该能听到我说话吧。列车长，她也是个好孩子吗？<co: The other voice? No, I can't hear her... But I think she can hear me. Is she nice too, Conductor? <color=#8e8e8e>You silly...</color>
StoryText.这些装置？我也不知道有什么用……罗洁尔老师说一定要随身携带。可能是学会的治疗装置: These devices? I'm not sure what they're used for... but Mentor Raziel told me to carry them all the time, so I guess they're healing devices from the Citadel? They float on their own, so they don't weigh me down. <color=#8e8e8e>Well... some things are better kept unknown~</color>
StoryText.关于我自己的过去……很多都记不得了…但我记得和列车长走过的每一个地方、共度的每一: I can't remember clearly about my past... but I remember every journey, every day with you, Conductor. I'm scared of forgetting it all, so let's take another photo. <color=#8e8e8e>I remember everything. I won't forget. And I can't appear in the photo.</color>
StoryText.真是不可思议，我居然也能战斗……<color=#ff0000>真……好……</c: How incredible... I can actually fight...<color=#ff0000>That's... good...</color>
StoryText.没关系，我不怕……我不怕……<color=#ff0000>前……进……</col: It's fine. I'm not scared... I'm not scared... <color=#ff0000>Move... forward...</color>
StoryText.坏人吗……没办法逃走的话……只能打败他们……<color=#ff0000>伤……: Bad guys... If I can't run away... I'll have to take them down... <color=#ff0000>Harm... them...</color>
StoryText.不要挡住我的去路……<color=#ff0000>我一定要活下去！</color: Don't stand in my way... <color=#ff0000>I must live on!</color>
StoryText.又变成这样了……<color=#ff0000>好痛……好痛啊……！</color: Not like this again... <color=#ff0000>It hurts... It hurts...!</color>
StoryText.诶，我……吗？我也能做到这一步吗，谢、谢谢……<color=#ff0000>下一: Huh? Me... Can... can I do that, too? T-thank you... <color=#ff0000>What's... the next station?</color>
StoryText.我是伊索斯，你车上有很多值得采集的样本。不可以？无所谓，我总会争取到你的同意。: I'm Ithos. You have a lot of specimens on your train worth collecting. Not allowed? It's all right. I'll earn your approval eventually.
StoryText.觉得我在会比较好吗？看来你缺乏判断能力。: You think it's better if I'm around? Seems like you don't have any good sense.
StoryText.我并不介意你和我交谈，倾听是我的长处，但不要指望我能给出符合期待的回应。: I don't mind you talking to me; listening is my strong suit. Just don't expect me to provide the response you're looking for.
StoryText.说谎是人的本能，我不觉得这有什么不好，但是这会造成误差，误差对我来说就是一种妨碍: Lying is a human instinct. I don't find anything wrong with that, but it will result in inaccuracies. And that annoys me.
StoryText.我在吃饭，这很难理解吗？不，虽然外观相似，但这是学会研发的便携营养补充包，不是你: I'm eating. Is it so hard to understand? No, it looks similar, but this is a convenient nutritional supplement sachet developed by the Citadel, not the cat paste you normally feed your pet.
StoryText.很多人对我研究的基因医学存在误解，我对制造那些既不美观也不实用，纯粹是为了污染生: Many people have misconceptions about the genetic medicine I study. I have no interest in creating those ugly and impractical stitched creatures that have no purpose other than polluting the environment.
StoryText.我在旁边观察了有一会，是不是别人给你片面包就能把你哄走？: I've been observing you for a while. I really think you can be coaxed away with a mere slice of bread.
StoryText.我的升构能力可以帮助我暂时隔绝一部分感知，从而减少人体自外界接收到的信息，起到提: My Ascension Ability can help me block off parts of my senses temporarily so as to minimize the information received from the outside world and in turn boost concentration... It appears you've already grasped the secret to my listening talent.
StoryText.你在看贡露城的资料，想去？那是一个寸土寸金的地方，住房昂贵得不可思议。不过自我的: You're looking at information about Gronru City. You going there? That's a place worth its weight in gold, it's impossible to afford a room there. But ever since my family died at home, that neighborhood had become much cheaper.
StoryText.我的理想是治愈全人类，让所有人拥有适应共振污染的能力，当然你也在这之列，我不会丢: My dream is to cure all of humanity, letting everyone have the ability to adapt to resonance pollution. You're included too. I won't leave anyone behind.
StoryText.我是升构学派的学者，不过我与你接触过的“升构塔”成员无关……看来你还是没学会怀疑: I'm a scholar of the Ascension faction, but I'm not related to "The Ascension" you encountered... I guess you still haven't learned to be suspicious. Can't believe you took my word for it so easily.
StoryText.我可以在你需要的时候帮你隔绝疼痛，或者是视觉、听觉、触觉等，想必会让你有一个很难: I can help you block off pain or even sight, hearing, touch when you need. I'm sure it'll be an unforgettable experience for you. If you like it, feel free to ask me for it anytime. I'm always glad to help.
StoryText.这些玄凤鹦鹉原本是我家人的宠物，这是一种胆小且脆弱的鸟类……别让它们站在你头顶，: These cockatiels were originally my family's pets. A species that's rather timid and weak... Don't let them stand on your head, or you'll have a hard time getting rid of their feather dust.
StoryText.你尽管可以尝试对我说谎，这不是警告。只是我认为，凭我现在对你的了解，要分辨你真实: Go ahead and try lying to me. This isn't a warning. I just feel that with my understanding of you, it won't be difficult to discern if you're telling the truth or not.
StoryText.必要时我会自己另行判断。: If necessary, I'll be the judge of it myself.
StoryText.希望不会花太长的时间。: Hope it won't take too long.
StoryText.不疼，一瞬间就能结束。: It won't hurt. It'll be over in the blink of an eye.
StoryText.这样做会更有效率。: It'll be more efficient this way.
StoryText.我会吸取这次的教训。: I will learn from this lesson.
StoryText.这点程度的疼痛不算什么。: This pain is merely child's play.
StoryText.……怎么，你要给我奖励吗？: ...What? Are you giving me a reward?
StoryText.帕拉笛报道！从今天开始，我就是无垠号的乘员——咦？整顿中心？没关系没关系，监视机: Paladi reporting for duty! I will be part of the Eternal crew from now on... Huh? Reforming Center? No worries, my surveillance robots will keep everything in check!
StoryText.来咯！但你要不要先试着让监视机器人给你帮帮忙？我还想再休息会儿嘛！: I'm here! But how about we get the surveillance robots to pitch in first? I'd like to rest a bit more!
StoryText.列车长！别走！让我测试一下这个从别人手里抢东西的新功能运行得如何！: Hold up, Conductor! Let me test out this new feature of snatching stuff from people!
StoryText.着装要求？那个无所谓啦，只要和当地的负责人搞好关系，就不用穿得太整齐。何况我有好: Dress codes? Don't stress about that. As long as you're cool with the authorities, there's no need to dress to impress. Plus, I've got my uniform on, just spiced it up with a few accessories~
StoryText.是不是还没有跟你正式介绍过我设计的监视机器人系统？咳咳！听好了哦，等着大吃一惊吧: Have I introduced you to the surveillance robot system I developed? Ahem! You'll be surprised! "Aegis" Observation System, or AOS for short... Hey, what's with that look? Isn't that name cool?
StoryText.还是无垠号好，可以随便给我当测试场地。余淞那家伙一直念叨着什么安全啊保险啊的原因: I love the Eternal. I can put my creations to test. That Yusong guy keeps blabbering about security and whatever, stopping me from my experiments! And he won't even let me trade my Citadel merch with others!
StoryText.工作~好累呀~受不了了~明天我就要~带着~监视机器人~远航~啦~~~: Work is~ tiring~ Can't take it~ I'll take~ my robots~ on a voyage~~~
StoryText.你说发现系统的逻辑里有BUG？哈哈，我知道啊。……但是这不是好好在运行吗！你你你: Found a bug in the system, you say? Hah, I know... but the system's running fine!  D-D-D-Don't you touch it! Don't touch it if it's running fine!
StoryText.嗯——说是当上了整顿中心负责人，但我没什么感觉呢。也不是什么特别大的官职？就只是: Hmm... Though I'm now the manager of the Reforming Center, it doesn't feel like an important role, I guess? I mean, all I need to do is to prevent all the prisoners breaking out at once,.
StoryText.松饼好好吃……好幸福……吃一口感觉活过来了又能继续上班了……好好吃好好吃哦……啊: Muffins so delicious... so happy... One bite and I'm revived... Awwww... it's so yummy... *Munch*
StoryText.新功能？早就做好了，需要的话可以随时投入实战哦！各种测试也早就完成啦~: New features? They're all set and ready to go at any moment! All the testing are already finished~
StoryText.你看！学会的限量纪念款行李箱！容量超大，可以装下两个拆分以后的监视机器人！好喜欢: Check this out! Limited edition Citadel luggage! It's super roomy, fits parts for two surveillance robots! Love it love it... I'll ride it around the halls of the Reforming Center!
StoryText.之前开发的第一代神盾系统……唔，怎么说呢，反正算是被迭代了。都怪对面的投资人一直: My first Aegis System... Well, it's kinda outdated. Our negotiation fell apart in the end, all thanks to that picky investor!
StoryText.列车长！请吃！这是我和机器人一起做的十层松饼塔，还配了一小瓶蜂蜜和冰凉凉的奶油—: Enjoy it, Conductor! It's a muffin tower whipped up by me and my robots, paired with a jar of honey and chilled cream! You're welcome! But don't collapse it when you dig in.
StoryText.神盾系统，紧急应对模式开启！: Aegis System, Emergency Response Mode activated!
StoryText.我就勉为其难地帮帮忙吧！: Alright, I'll help you a bit!
StoryText.还好没被打到……我先撤啦！: That was close... Falling back for now!
StoryText.紧急应对模式关闭！我的指挥水平还不错吧！: Emergency Response Mode off! How's my commanding?
StoryText.需要我的帮助吗？……啊，忘了，我还是魔法师呢……嗯。那么，需要吾等大魔法师的帮助: Need my help?... Oh, right, I'm a wizard now. Ahem, so... Hast thou need of my help?
StoryText.出发之前，我和白桦商量好了哦。今夜我是魔女，然后白桦是我的使魔……嗯，白桦同意了: Before we left, White Birch and I agreed that I'll be the witch tonight, and it'll be the familiar... Yeah, White Birch agreed. It said "happy to be your familiar."
StoryText.之前用新研发的材料为白桦定制过各种各样的住所，但一直没有机会拿出来用。趁着这次节: I crafted various homes for White Birch with new materials, but never got to use them until the festival... White Birch is thrilled, and me too.
StoryText.我玩得很开心。嗯，之前不太知道……原来这就是，开心的感觉啊。感觉自己也变成了轻飘: I've had so much fun. I never quite understood before... so this is what having fun feels like. It's like I'm turning into a balloon drifting in the air, just like these little ghosts...
StoryText.最近，我试着吃了一些其他的零食。饼干，糖果，还有黑巧克力味的甜甜圈……这个是我最: I've been trying out various snacks lately. Cookies, candies, and chocolate donuts... Oh, this one's my favorite. You should have some too, Conductor... It's a gift for you.
StoryText.我是魔法师。我是魔法师……: I'm a wizard. I'm a wizard...
StoryText.带回去放进坩埚……: Take it back and put it in the crucible...
StoryText.敌人也在排着队行动呢。: The enemy's getting ready for action too.
StoryText.全部变成魔药的素材……！: Turn into ingredients for my magic potions...!
StoryText.回去要整理一下袍子……: Need to tidy my robe when I get back...
StoryText.啊！甜甜圈掉地上了……！: Ah! My donut fell on the ground...!
StoryText.挡住道路的敌人全部消灭了，让游行继续吧……列车长，要一起来吗？: All troublemakers have been taken care of. Let the parade continue... Want to join us, Conductor?
StoryText.我是生驹。……什么？还要其他介绍？那就不用了吧……！我会努力工作，也会努力战斗的: My name is Ikoma. ...What? Share more about me? I'd rather not...! I will work hard and fight to the best of my ability. After all, I still have dreams to fulfill!
StoryText.我就在你旁边继续研究武器了。有什么事的话记得叫我啊！: I'll carry on studying weapons next to you. Call me if you need anything!
StoryText.不管看多少遍还是觉得很新奇……无垠号内部真宽敞啊，和骏城相比。假如骏城上的大家也: No matter how many times I see it, it still amazes me... Compared to Hayajiros, the Eternal is so spacious on the inside. If only everyone on Hayajiros could enjoy such space.
StoryText.是我研发了贯筒，不过，成功的契机有点危险……现在想想，我还真是运气好。也多亏了我: I created the Tsuranuki Zutsu, but its success was somewhat dangerous... Now that I think about it, I was truly lucky. I owe part of that to my dependable friends.
StoryText.列车长你看！只要把卡巴内的心脏皮膜覆在普通的武器上，就能让武器拥有足以刺穿他们的: Look, Conductor! As long as we cover regular weapons with Kabanes' heart membrane, the weapons will become strong enough to pierce through them...! I-It's a little scary? Sorry, I didn't realize that...
StoryText.列车长。上次擅自在车厢里进行武器实验是我不对，请不要让我驻留驿站……欸？您说不会: Conductor, I apologize for conducting unauthorized weapon testing in the carriage last time. Please don't drop me at a station... Huh? You won't ditch me over such a reason? R-Really?!
StoryText.无名很强。我当然达不到她那样……不过，在战场上，我可以掩护她。毕竟她说我是她的盾: Mumei is formidable. I can't measure up to her... That said, I can cover her on the battlefield. She said I'm her shield, after all.
StoryText.吃饭时间到了。我正好也肚子饿……不，你别摆出那么戒备的表情啊。我会自己用不伤害同: Ah, it's mealtime. I'm starving too... Hold on, don't look so guarded. I will take care of it without harming anyone.
StoryText.你是从专门培训列车长的学校毕业的？！好厉害啊，没想到还有这样的学校……有空的话，: You graduated from a specialized conductor school?! That's amazing! To think there would be such a school... When there's time, you have to tell me what it's like studying there!
StoryText.即使变成了现在这副样子，在面对强大的敌人时还是会很害怕……但是，我不能退缩。我知: Even after becoming like this, I'm afraid when facing powerful enemies... But I can't back down. I know what I should do.
StoryText.我的梦想，当然是希望卡巴内都消失，然后无名能够变回人类……我和她保证过会让她变回: My dream is for Kabanes to vanish and for Mumei to return to human... I promised her that I'd turn her back. What about myself? I... never really thought about it.
StoryText.我手里的石头？啊，这是……我妹妹的遗物。不，和你说说也没事。我把它绑在手心里，就: The stone I'm holding? Ah, this... was my late sister's. No, it's fine. I can talk about it. I wrap it around my hand to remind myself of my incompetence. I will never let what happened that day repeat itself.
StoryText.铁路沿线的城市还真气派啊……里面的每栋建筑简直都和天守阁一样高！我想去里面逛逛！: The cities along the railway are impressive... Every single building is practically as tall as Tenshukaku! I wanna take a look around in there! ...Of course, I'll put my clothes on properly.
StoryText.列车长，我们的战斗一定会获得胜利。因为我们拥有人类的心和灵魂……这是我们的敌人没: Conductor, we will definitely prevail, as we have the heart and soul of humans, which our enemies lack.
StoryText.暂时解除限制了，我们走吧。: Restriction lifted for now. Let's move.
StoryText.呼……还好，一切都还来得及。列车长，这次也多亏你了。: Phew... thankfully, it's not too late. Thank you again, Conductor.
StoryText.我的伤口？哦，这是强行将“它”填入胸膛所付出的代价……不用在意。比起这个，外面的: My wound? Oh, that's the price I paid for shoving "it" into my chest... Don't worry about it. There's still a lively party going on out there, isn't there? You've got your own things to take care of, right? Just leave me be.
StoryText.……真安静啊，你的身边。简直让人想起梦中所见的过去……: ...It's so peaceful staying by your side. It almost feels like the past I experienced in my dreams...
StoryText.“人类的基本欲望包括了食物、安全、爱”？给我看这个干什么。……哦，假如你认为我现: "Basic human desires include food, security, and love." Hmm? Why are you showing me this...? Oh, if you think my eating and sleeping habits prove that I'm still human, you can't be more wrong.
StoryText.能教授给你的知识多了一项，那就是在我进食和睡觉时不要张嘴提问。对，说的就是现在。: Another heads-up for you: don't disturb me while I'm eating or taking a break. Yeah, that's what I'm doing now. Save your questions for later.
StoryText.能一直来找我聊天，也算你勇气可嘉……特许你参加魂灵的宴会吧。不要品尝这些食物的躯: You're quite insistent on coming over for a chat... Alright, I'll grant you access to the feast of souls. Taste not the form of these foods, but their essence.
StoryText.口渴了吗？我让它给你端酒来。不要喝酒？那你要喝什么？: Feeling thirsty? I can have it bring you some wine. Not a fan of wine? What else do you want?
StoryText.战斗之前连场宴会都没有……: Not even a banquet before the battle...
StoryText.给我端酒来……啊，忘了这是战场。: Bring me some wine... Oh, right., we're in a fight.
StoryText.那就释放一部分力量吧。: Then I'll unleash some of my power.
StoryText.在天使面前不值一提。: It's nothing compared to an Angel.
StoryText.哈……要不是没吃饱……: Hah... If only I had filled my stomach...
StoryText.结束了。在我休息好之前不要再问我任何问题，我需要更多的灵魂来补充消耗……什么？这: It's settled. No more questions until I've had a decent rest. I need more souls to replenish my energy... Huh? Is this bouquet... for me?
StoryText.我是佩罗塔！但是你愿意的话，也可以叫我球球。我很厉害的，一定能派上用场！……对了: I'm Pelota, but you can call me Ballie if you'd like to! I'm pretty awesome and definitely useful!... Oh, by the way, are all the electronic devices on your train insured?
StoryText.来啦来啦~咦，这是什么呀？我玩一下！: I'm on my way! What's this? Let me tinker with it for a bit!
StoryText.我的手杖——嗯，我不太擅长记住数字和字母，所以搞不太懂型号什么的。但是可不许小看: My cane... Well, I'm not great with numbers and letters, so I don't know its model or anything. But trust me, I know how to use it best. You can totally rely on me, Conductor!
StoryText.列车长在发糖吗？佩罗塔也会有的，对吧，对吧？太好啦！果然列车长最棒了！下次第一个: Are you handing out candy, Conductor? You'll share some with me too, right? Right? Yeah! I knew you're the best! Can I be the first next time?
StoryText.“球球力场”就是把周围的金属物品都吸过来然后变成球的能力啦。平时也可以用来隔空取: My "Ballie Force Field" can attract metal objects and transform them into balls. It's super handy for grabbing things from a distance, though it might accidentally pick up other stuff too!
StoryText.响立逃？我没带耶，因为我小时候开始就很容易弄坏电子仪器……不过我还是有自卫能力的: Flee Alarm? No, I don't have one because I've been breaking electronic devices since I was a kid... but no worries, Conductor! I know how to protect myself! If we encounter Chaos Remains, I'll just shoo them away!
StoryText.这里好像有很多活得很长的人呢。阿尔喀娜小姐和丽桑德拉小姐，都……啊，对了，别人的: Many crew members seem to have lived long lives, like Miss Arcana and Miss Lissandra... Oops! It's impolite to discuss people's ages! Huh? Me? Why not take a guess, Conductor? And no peeking at my profile!
StoryText.我好像没怎么长高耶。上次量身高还是春季体检的时候。哪年？嗯……去年吧……记得去年: It seems like I haven't grown much. The last time I was measured was during my spring check-up... What year? Hmm... maybe last year... The birds returned early last year...
StoryText.我旅行的原因啊……嗯，就讲给列车长听好了。你看这个球！这是我们目前所在的位置——: The reason I'm traveling, hmm... Alright, I'll spill the beans to you, Conductor. Look at this ball! We're here right now, and we'll circle around the ball like this and come back, right? So Mom says, as long as we keep moving forward, we're bound to meet the one we've been searching for!
StoryText.列车长，车上有好多帝国来的和去过帝国的人耶。而且听他们说，帝国人基本都会魔法……: There are so many members who have been to the Empire, Conductor. They say the Imperial people are skilled in magic... If I get the chance, I'd love to visit the Empire and witness their way of life with my own eyes!
StoryText.阿妮塔的哥哥姐姐们把我从家里带走的时候，我不小心用了太多升构能力，导致周围一大片: When Anita's people took me from my home, I accidentally went a bit overboard with my powers and caused a blackout in the block around me... But I didn't hurt anyone, you know? I just threw everyone to the sky, and once I saw they were good people, I gently brought them back down!
StoryText.“理论上你可以用大量金属将敌人砸扁，但是佩罗塔，如果不是紧急情况，千万不要那么做: "Theoretically, you could crush the enemy with a large amount of metal, but Pelota, don't ever do that unless it's an emergency."… someone told me before departure. I know what to do when necessary, don't worry, Conductor.
StoryText.嘿！喏，签字笔。怎么样，我就说我的能力很方便吧……啊，餐车的炒锅也一起飞来了！列: Hey! There goes the signing pen! See? My powers do come in handy... Oh, wait! A frying pan is flying too! Get down, Conductor!
StoryText.……要到什么时候才能再见呢……我已经走了很多地方了……啊！列车长！我、我就是有一: ......When will we meet again......I've been to many places......Ah! Conductor! I, I'm just a little bit......missing my mom......
StoryText.呜哇啊啊玩过头了……！: Whoaaaahh! I got a bit carried away...!
StoryText.我觉得这次发挥得很不错，基本没有砸到人！就说了我很厉害嘛，相信我相信我啦！: I think I did pretty well this time, and I didn't smack anyone, mostly! See? I told you I've got skills! Just have faith in me!
StoryText.我是STELLA！制作人，等你很久啦……哈哈开玩笑的，就算是这副模样也愿意为你效: I'm STELLA! Producer, I've been waiting a long time... Haha, just kidding! I'm still at your service even in this get-up, Conductor~
StoryText.稍微休息一下吧……嗯，毕竟这里也没别人。不过，如果需要的话，我可是随时能打起精神: Let's take a short break... Mm, there isn't anyone here anyway. But if needed, I'm ready to bring smiles to everybody at any time!
StoryText.为了适应不同演出还有广告的造型需要，最近经常要烫染头发……我的头发……！呜……这: I've had to perm and dye my hair again and again lately for various performances and commercials... My hair...! Hic... I gotta get hair treatment once work is done! You will also be helping, right?
StoryText.嗯？我在读粉丝来信哦。能读到他们想要传达的心情是一件非常幸福的事，这意味着“为大: Hmm? I'm reading fan letters. It's incredibly delightful to read the emotions they try to convey. This means that "to bring everyone hope" is no longer just a catchphrase but something that's currently happening. My effort isn't in vain!
StoryText.只要站在舞台上，心想着“现在STELLA要开始表演了”——一切就都水到渠成啦。虽: All I have to do is to stand on stage and tell myself that STELLA is about to perform, and everything comes naturally. Prior preparations and practice are of course necessary too... but allow me to say this: The stage is the magic that turns regular people into idols.
StoryText.之前有和你说过吧？付出努力的过程就是把原石打磨为宝石的过程，但这对我来说还不够。: I've told you before, haven't I? The process of putting in effort is the process of polishing raw stones into gems, but this isn't enough for me. Right now, my goal is to become the star in everyone's eyes. Don't look away! Watch as I shine!
StoryText.灯光、音响就位！应援就拜托你啦！: Lights, audio, set! I'll leave the cheering to you!
StoryText.STELLA的特别舞台，要开始了哦！: Get ready for STELLA's special stage!
StoryText.那么，下一首是！大家最期待的——: And now, for the next song! The one you've all been waiting for...!
StoryText.稍等一下哦，我马上就回来……！: Hang tight! I'll be back in a jiffy...!
StoryText.非常感谢大家来到本次的STELLA特别演唱会！为大家准备了特别的安可曲，请陪伴我: Huge thanks for coming to STELLA's concert! I've got a special encore ready, so make sure to hang around till the very end~
StoryText.我是金子。什么？你认识我？可是我们，这是，第一次见面。……开玩笑哒！没错，我，学: I am Gold. What? Know me? But this, first meet. ...Just joking! Yes. I learn, jokes, Conductor. Happy, be your friend.
StoryText.已启动辅助模式。今天要探寻哪一座矿山？: Support mode activated. Which mine to explore today?
StoryText.现在，我的登记身份是，科伦巴商会访客。所以，可以，乘坐无垠号。也可以，帮忙打架。: Now, I registered, visitor of COLUMBA. So, I'm permitted, board The Eternal, and combat. Please, make use of me. I won't, charge you high.
StoryText.波克士。希望他也能，去商会的工厂，维修一次。金子认为，他有的时候，有点不聪明。而: Hopefully, BOX go to, COLUMBA's factory, for servicing. Gold thinks, he is foolish, sometimes, and hostile to you. Might be virus.
StoryText.我们这个型号的机器人，可以很好地，防御外来电流。因为有绝缘涂层。金子，很结实。但: Robots of my model, can defend, external currents, we have insulation coating. Gold, sturdy, but internal short-circuit, out of options...
StoryText.彼得·黄，在这里吗？不在啊。……他之前说，要给我的投资款，还没到账呢。他是不是，: Is Peter Hwang here? Oh, not. ...The investment money, he said, give me, not received yet. Is he hiding?
StoryText.我和，摄像头脑袋的摩尔，聊天了。他说，对我的遭遇，感到，同情。为什么，要同情我？: I talked, to camera head, Moore. He said, sympathize, what I've been through. Why sympathize me? He has no human important to him.
StoryText.摇滚！！正在播放，最新摇滚单曲排行榜TOP10……耶~。金子很开心。来外面以后，: Rock 'n' Roll!!! Now playing, the Top 10 songs on the newest Rock 'n' Roll singles chart... Yay~ Gold happy. After coming out, listen to new Rock 'n' Roll songs, endlessly. ...So happy.
StoryText.金子的名字？是很多年前，大家一起取的。因为人类希望金子可以带大家找到金子，所以，: Gold's name? It was given, by everyone, many years ago. Humans wanted Gold, to lead them to gold, so they called me "Miss Gold."
StoryText.那个混沌海的小孩，叫我，金色圆滚滚大土豆。这是，什么意思？是爱称吗？: That Turbulent Sea child, called me Big Gold Potato. What that mean? An endearment?
StoryText.波克士，同意去维修了！金子，很高兴。什么？火箭拳？……金子不知道哔。完全不知道哔: BOX, agreed to servicing! Gold, happy. What? Rocket Punch? ...I don't know, beep. Not at all, beep.
StoryText.之前和列车长说过。金子，是淘金机器人，没有父母，也没有兄弟姐妹。但是现在金子有朋: Once told Conductor, Gold is a gold-digging robot, no parents, no siblings. But now, have friends. ...Gold, really happy.
StoryText.机器人通常不会记得宕机期间发生的事。我已经不记得，那时候在淘金乐园发生了什么……: Robots generally will not remember what happens during downtime. I have already forgotten what happened in ONEderland at the time... but it must have been something horrible. I will not let such a thing ever happen again!
StoryText.淘金乐园现在已经热闹起来了。金子的愿望，已经达成了。接下来，金子想找到，新的愿望: ONEderland has become lively now. Gold's wish has been realized. Next, Gold would like to find a new wish.
StoryText.金子，出发！掘金机器人，跟上。: Gold, move out! Nugget Mech, follow.
StoryText.金子，是最好的机器人，人类的朋友，大家的帮助者！列车长，你说，对吗？: Gold, the best robot, human's friend, helper of all! What do you think, Conductor?
StoryText.我是无名，暂且在这里担任保镖——啊，酬金就不用了，你给我提供充足的食物还有睡觉的: I'm Mumei, temporarily serving as a bodyguard here. Ah, payment won't be necessary. Just provide me with adequate food and a place to sleep.
StoryText.了解，敌人在哪里？哦，不是要战斗啊……来了。: Gotcha. Where's the enemy? Oh, not a fight... coming.
StoryText.我看起来和人类不太一样？但我可不是卡巴内哦，虽然也不是人类。我们这种存在叫做“卡: I look different from human? But I am not a Kabane, though neither a human. Those like us are called "Kabaneri."
StoryText.原来你们这里流行小队作战啊……嗯，和甲铁城上不一样呢！甲铁城上的话，一开始都是大: So it's a norm to fight in groups here... Mm, that's different from Koutetsujou! There, everybody used to hide aboard, while I get off and take care of things. And later I would take Ikoma along as my shield.
StoryText.（嗅嗅）车厢里的味道很清新，没有卡巴内的气息……嗯，目前是安全的！！: (sniffs) The carriage smells refreshing. No Kabane scent detected... Mm, it's safe for now!
StoryText.这个是用来锻炼身体和指尖协调度的道具，好像在这边也叫“剑玉”的样子。这样——抛到: This is an item used for working out and fingertip coordination. It's also called "kendama" here. See... Toss it upward, then it drops... Just like Kabanes' heads. ...Huh? Don't say such things? Why?
StoryText.我和列车上的其他人聊过天了哦。原来变成升构者也要经历很痛苦的过程……听起来和我的: I've chatted with others on the train. Turns out, there's a painful process to go through when becoming an Ascender... Just like my curse, but I can endure it.
StoryText.我看到了哦，你和生驹蹲在那堆白色的树枝面前一起研究了吧？像是兄长大人手下的那些仵: I saw that. You and Ikoma were crouching there studying those white tree branches. Just like those coroners under brother's command... Then, would you also lock the "Kills Ramens" in the carriage and inject all kinds of things in them?
StoryText.生驹虽然很多时候都不太机灵，不过他可是很勇敢的哦。经常“哇~”地大叫着就冲出去了: Ikoma might be dumb most of the time, but he's really brave. He often dashes out while yelling at the top of his lungs. I guess you can describe him as all brawn and no brains!
StoryText.在篝火城的“博物馆”里，看见了蝴蝶。……小时候，母亲告诉我，蝴蝶是死去之人的亡灵: I saw butterflies in the Bonfire City's "museum." ...When I was a child, mother told me that butterflies were formed by the souls of deceased people. Once a butterfly leaves, it means that person's soul has left too...
StoryText.“无名”这个称呼，是兄长大人送给我的，意思是让我抛弃本来的生活……但我倒还记得很: The name "Mumei" was given to me by brother, with the intention of making me leave my former life behind... But I still remember everything vividly. Would you like to know? My name, the original one.
StoryText.列车长，我肚子饿了~。能拜托你把手伸过来吗？剩下的我自己来就好。: Conductor, I'm hungry~ Could you stretch out your hand please? I'll handle the rest.
StoryText.……车长，最近我在想啊。难道我不用一直依赖着兄长大人也可以活下去吗……难道就算不: ...Conductor, I've been thinking, is it possible that I could survive without relying on brother? ...Could I survive without fighting endlessly? H-Huh?! You said "of course"? Why is that?!
StoryText.假如还能在这里过上七夕节的话……还想许别的愿望呢，和之前不一样的愿望。毕竟七夕节: If I could stay long enough to spend Tanabata Festival here... I'll wish for something different from before. After all, isn't Tanabata just for making wishes!
StoryText.刀刃一点都没有钝呢。: My blade is as sharp as ever.
StoryText.……没有人被咬吧？那回去吧？哈啊——（哈欠）我要睡觉了——: ...No one got bitten? So let's head back? *Yawn* I'm off to dreamland...
StoryText.我是罗洁尔。虽然不确定我在无垠号上究竟能帮上什么忙……但我希望至少能稍稍为你减轻: I am Raziel. Though I'm not sure what exactly I can do on the Eternal... I hope I can at least lessen the burden on your shoulders a little.
StoryText.到换班时间了吗？好快啊……: It's time for a shift change? That's fast...
StoryText.如果有什么需要处理的文书工作，就尽管交给我吧。或许在其他方面比不上其他乘员，但在: If you have any clerical work to do, feel free to leave it to me. I may not be as competent as other crew members in other aspects, but I have confidence when it comes to filtering information and sorting documents.
StoryText.我和丽桑德拉是朋友，很久以前就是了，她在这些年间一点也没有变。从我的角度来看，没: Lissandra and I have been friends since a long time ago. She has never changed a bit throughout these years. From my perspective, no one is more suitable for that job than her... Hmm, in fact, she's practically the definition of "judgment" itself.
StoryText.头发乱了？不用在意……我过会儿会稍微整理下的。我需要先记录一下刚刚的想法……: My hair's messy? It's fine... I'll tidy it up later. Right now, I have to note down what just came to mind...
StoryText.嗯，列车长，我在。我、我的名字？罗洁尔……当然是罗洁尔啊。怎么突然问这个……就算: Mm, I'm here, Conductor. M-My name? Raziel... Of course it's Raziel. Why are you suddenly asking this...? No matter how engrossed I am in my research, there's no way I'll forget my own name. What are you worrying about? *sigh*
StoryText.从汇流塔所在的位置，能看见远处的海角城。工作告一段落的深夜里，我都会登上塔顶，看: Cape City can be seen in the distance from the Confluence Tower. When work is finished at night, I'll always climb up the roof and look at the lights in the city. Just the thought of many people out there are still working hard to live makes me feel at ease.
StoryText.……我和学会中的一部分同僚，在立场上有些分歧。我不支持天使计划，是因为不希望有更: ...I have differing views with some of the Citadel members. I do not support the Angel Project, because I do not wish for there to be more... unintended "sacrifices."
StoryText.语言会被曲解，它传达的意义有时也十分有限。理论认为，无论是说出口的话语还是写下的: Words can be twisted, and the meaning they convey can also be limited at times. The theory holds that words, be it spoken or written, are unreliable vessels... Yet, for the most part, humans can only rely on words to communicate. What do you think about that? ...Eh? Are you asleep? Conductor?
StoryText.经常会有人带着问题来到汇流塔，为他们解答疑问就是我的工作。不过，最近经常有人和我: People often come to the Confluence Tower with questions, and answering them is my job. But recently, people often told me there are things like "Mentor Raziel Fanclubs" out there... Of course, they were joking. ...They WERE joking, right...?
StoryText.丽桑德拉……好久不见了。你是不是很久没有去篝火城啦？我想去那家店里坐一坐……还有: Lissandra... It's been a while. You haven't been in the city for ages, yes? I'd love to check out that store... and to read some new books with you. Ah, and the super spicy fried chicken! Let's go together, Lissandra...!
StoryText.雅莱是个非常善良的孩子，但她其实心事很重。希望你能够和她好好相处。……顺利的话，: Jalhay is an exceptionally kind child, but she actually has a lot on her mind. I hope you can get along with her. ...If things go well, perhaps she would be able to reunite with her sister in the future...
StoryText.在学会里和孩子们相处的时间很让人安心。即使只是帮他们检查装备、整理衣服，我都会感: Spending time with the kids in the Citadel is really soothing. It makes me really happy, even if it's simply to help them inspect their equipment or tidy their clothes. ...But the other day, Lissandra told me that I often forget to flip back the edge of my skirt hem... Mm...
StoryText.怎么了吗？你看起来有些不开心……不用为了短暂的分别而难过。即使不在无垠号上，我也: What's wrong? You look a little upset... There's no need to be sad over brief separations. Even if I'm not onboard, I'll always be waiting for you in the Confluence Tower. Should you need help or are at a loss, feel free to come look for me anytime. I'll be pleased to assist you, no matter if it's today, tomorrow, or long in the future.
StoryText.我会全力协助你。: I'll do my best to assist you.
StoryText.好像需要处理一下呢……: It seems I need to do something about it...
StoryText.我还是能保护自己的哦。: Don't worry, I can protect myself.
StoryText.嘶……先、先撤退吧？: Hiss... u-um, shall we retreat for now...?
StoryText.战斗结束啦。我们回去吧，还有许多该做的事情呢，列车长。: The battle is over. Let's head back, Conductor. There's so much more to do.
StoryText.列车长，我是小麦——不不不，今天我不是来开拖车的！咳咳！——从今天开始，我是无垠: Conductor, it's me, Komugi—no wait, I'm not here to drive the towing car today! Ahem! Starting today, I'm officially crew on the Eternal! Nice to meet you!
StoryText.来啦！今天要干点儿什么呀？: Coming! So what are we doing today?
StoryText.列车长，有什么活儿就叫我吧！我跑得很快！虽然我个子还是太小了……没关系，我会努力: Conductor, got any work for me? Just say the word! I run real fast! ...Okay, I'm still kinda small, but don't worry, I'm gonna grow taller!
StoryText.吃饭吃饭~按时吃饭~列车长，你有好好吃东西吗？我觉得一日三餐是生活中最重要的事了: Eat, eat~ you gotta eat on time~ Conductor, have you been eating properly? Three meals a day, that's the most important thing ever, if you don't eat right you won't have the energy to work!
StoryText.这个头巾？啊，我自己绣的，是岚心城一带的传统纹样！之前在家里的居酒屋帮忙跑腿，为: Oh, this headscarf? I embroidered it myself, it's a traditional pattern from around Ranshin City! I used to wear it running errands at my family's izakaya, just to show "hey, I'm working here"—and somehow I just never took it off since.
StoryText.列车长，你吃咸菜吗？我之前在家里的时候跟着妈妈学了一点……你吃的话，我可以教你怎: Conductor, do you like pickles? I learned to make some from my mom back home. If you're into it, I can teach you, I know how to make all kinds!
StoryText.我没有上过人类的学校，所以太复杂的内容我都看不懂……拖车的驾驶资格，也是考了好多: I never went to a real school, so anything too complicated just goes right over my head... even my towing car license, I failed the test a bunch of times before I finally passed. But you know me, Conductor, I'm actually really good at driving!
StoryText.教我开拖车实习的那位红彤彤的长官……夏……？哦，修伊长官！他对我们这些新兵很和蔼: Oh, the officer who trained me on the towing car—that red one—Hoo...? Right, Chief Huey! He was so nice to us new recruits, taught us so much. We all just call him "Boss"!
StoryText.就算是亚人，族群之间也会有所不同……比如我们犬亚人就和人类关系比较好，当然，也有: Even among demihumans, different groups aren't all the same, you know? Like us dogs, we actually get along great with humans. Though there are other groups that just can't get along with humans, no matter what.
StoryText.水！列车长，水水水……谢谢，我好多了！啊，没有吃什么危险的东西，好像就是刚刚吃咸: Water! Conductor, water, water... thanks, I feel so much better now! No, I didn't eat anything dangerous, I just went a little too hard on the salty stuff earlier...
StoryText.啊！！卡莲！！是卡莲！太好了，又见面啦！欸，你还有事啊……那下次再见！没关系的，: Ah!! Karen!! It's Karen! We get to see each other again, yay! Oh, you're busy right now? Okay, see you next time then! It's fine, we're good friends anyway~
StoryText.之前还是新兵的时候，我总是握不住枪、也不会抛手榴弹……大家都为我发愁，也有人劝我: Back when I was a new recruit, I couldn't even hold a gun right, couldn't throw grenades to save my life... everyone was worried about me, some people even told me to just go home and quit being a soldier. But I stuck with it!
StoryText.有时候我说不出心里的感觉……就像是，明明知道有的事不对，可我不知道到底是哪里不对: Sometimes I can't really put how I feel into words, you know? Like I just know something's wrong, but I can't tell exactly what. But there's one thing I know for sure—I'm never gonna do something I don't want to do!
StoryText.好耶！列车长是我的好朋友！我们会一直是好朋友，对吧？: Yay! Conductor's my good friend! We're gonna stay friends forever, right?
StoryText.冷静、冷静，工作工作……: Okay, calm down, calm down... focus, focus...
StoryText.小心小心，不要走火……: Careful, careful, don't fire by accident...
StoryText.我不要回去……当……跑腿……: I don't wanna go back... to being... an errand girl...
StoryText.下次我会……小心的……: Next time I'll be... more careful...
StoryText.作战完成，没有伤亡！列车长的指挥好厉害！: Mission complete, no casualties! Conductor's got amazing command skills!
StoryText.好的，我这就来。今天要找什么书呢？我可以帮忙哦。: All right, coming. What book are you looking for today? I can help you with it.
StoryText.哈啊……稍微有点困了……我小睡一会儿……: *yawn* ...I'm a bit tired... Let me catch a wink...
StoryText.这副眼镜是新换的。之前和丽桑德拉老师一同去到城内购物，她坚持说我戴着很好看，所以: This is a new pair of glasses. When I went shopping in the city with Mentor Lissandra the other day, she insisted that I look good in it and bought it as a gift for me. What do you think? Does it suit me?
StoryText.晚饭……就吃特辣炸鸡怎么样？啊，你这为难的表情……看来我们还是吃点别的吧……: How about having... super spicy fried chicken for dinner? Ah, that troubled look... I guess we'll have something else...
StoryText.我的梦想啊……嗯，还是有的。在学位啊、成就啊这些常规的理想之外，我还希望能像今天: My dream...? Mm, I do have one. Aside from typical aspirations like degrees or achievements, I also hope to be able to manage the Confluence Tower just like how I manage this library today. Sounds a little far-fetched, huh? ...It'll surely come true? Hehe, thanks for the well wishes!
StoryText.我正在看的这本童话，讲述了一个爱上月亮而每个夜晚都追逐它的孩子的故事……写的很好: This fairy tale I'm reading is about a child who fell in love with the moon and would chase it every night... Quite a lovely story, but every time I finish it, I always wonder if anyone chose to chase after something else, like the twinkling stars that will ultimately vanish. Don't you think that could be a beautiful story too?
StoryText.我会试着帮上忙的。: I'll do my best to help you.
StoryText.大家一起行动会比较安心呢。: It's such a relief when we stick together.
StoryText.我会保护好大家的。: I'll make sure everyone stays safe.
StoryText.书掉到地上了……: My book... just fell on the ground...
StoryText.呼……没想到图书管理员的职务还包括了这种工作……但能保护书籍平安无事就好。: Phew... I never imagined the librarian's work would involve such kind of task... but all is good as long as I can keep the books safe.
StoryText.我是奥莉薇恩，从现在开始会在无垠号上工作。我应该怎么称呼您呢——“主家”？: I am Olivien, and I will be working on the Eternal from now on. How should I address you — "master"?
StoryText.是，我马上到。: Yes, I'll be there right away.
StoryText.引导主家走上正确的道路也是女仆的应尽之责。虽然不会使用过于严厉的手段，但……之后: Guiding master onto the right path is also a maid's duty. Although I won't use overly harsh methods, please... bear with it in the future.
StoryText.每个人都有自己不擅长的事，这很正常。但作为完美的女仆，我必须每样都懂一些。: It's normal that everyone has things they're not good at. But as a perfect maid, I must know a little about everything.
StoryText.今天的工作只有这些吗？我知道了，我会在晚餐之前帮您处理好的。: Is that all the work for today? Understood, I'll have it done for you before dinner.
StoryText.“想尝尝帝国的美食”？没问题，我以前在公爵家中担任过厨师长，对帝国的各种烹饪方法: You wish to taste imperial cuisine? No problem. I once served as head chef in a duke's manor, so I know a thing or two about all kinds of imperial cooking methods.
StoryText.“和所有帝国人都认识”？呵呵，主家也太看得起我了，这显然是过于夸张的说法——不过: I know every imperial citizen? Heh, you flatter me far too much, master. That's quite an overstatement — still, I do know the name of every imperial active on the surface.
StoryText.随时随地拿出主家需要的各种东西是女仆的必备技能。至于东西放在了哪里，还请不要在意: Being able to pull out anything you need anytime, anywhere is an essential skill for a maid. As for where I keep them... please don't mind the details.
StoryText.操纵杆……推进器……火控装置……无人机控制台……如您所见，我正在学习如何操作无垠: Control lever... thrusters... fire control systems... drone console... As you can see, I'm learning to drive the Eternal. I believe operating a train is also a must-have skill for a maid.
StoryText.您想要学习怎么做饭？当然没问题，我会尽心尽力教导您的。首先，我们来认识一下二十六: You wish to learn how to cook? Of course I'll teach you wholeheartedly. First, let's go over the proper use of twenty-six types of kitchen knives. Each has its own purpose, so please remember them well.
StoryText.在当女仆之前，我是个什么样的人？……您为什么会这么问呢，是知道了些什么，还是单纯: What was I like before I became a maid? ...Why do you ask? Have you found out something, or are you simply curious about my past? Either way, when the time is right, I'll tell you myself.
StoryText.许多人因为短视放弃了沟通转而付诸暴力，这才导致了仇恨的蔓延。但我相信，沟通可以改: Many act short-sightedly, abandoning communication for violence, and that is how hatred spreads. But I believe communication can change everything — and I'm striving for that very goal.
StoryText.我是正统的女仆，不会为主家提供商业目的的服务。但是……好吧，如果您坚持的话。……: I am a proper maid, and I do not offer services for trivial amusement. But... very well, if you insist. ...Moe Moe Q. Is that satisfactory, master?
StoryText.无论主家想做什么事，我都会为您做好一切准备、提供一切必要帮助。这不仅是女仆应尽之: Whatever you wish to do, I shall make all preparations and lend every necessary aid. It is not only my duty as a maid, but also my personal wish.
StoryText.女仆的服务不止局限于家政，为主家扫清障碍亦是我的职责。: A maid's service is not limited to housekeeping. Clearing all obstacles in your path is also my responsibility.
StoryText.马上打扫干净。: I shall clean this up at once.
StoryText.希望这次能清理干净。: I hope this can be cleaned thoroughly.
StoryText.在您面前丢人了，我这就退下。: I've embarrassed myself before you. I shall take my leave at once.
StoryText.当然了，这是作为完美而潇洒的女仆应当做到的。: Naturally. It is only what a perfect, elegant maid ought to do.
StoryText.属于我和救世主大人的冒险故事，要开始啦！: The adventure story of me and my Master Savior is about to begin!
StoryText.救世主大人，有空的时候一定要来找乌刹娜玩哦。: Master Savior, come hang out with Ushana when you're free~
StoryText.火车开过，哐当哐当~按下喇叭，嘟嘟嘟嘟~救世主大人，要发车了吗？好耶，又可以坐火: Drive the train, clank clank~ Sound the horn, toot toot~ Master Savior, are we setting off? Yay! Another train ride!
StoryText.我能用八只手同时表演抛接球哦，诶，还可以打多份工？不要，乌刹娜才不要上班，上班…: I can perform ball catching with eight hands simultaneously. Eh? I can also do more work? No! Ushana doesn't wanna work. Working... gives me wrinkles.
StoryText.海角城外、桦树生物、学会的人……啊啊……救世主大人，我的头好疼啊………每次想到爸: Beyond Cape City, Chaos Remains, the Citadel people... Aaaah... Master Savior, my head hurts... This always happens when I think about mom and dad...
StoryText.学会的人为了让失去理智的我冷静下来，会在头盔里播放舒缓的共振频率来着。对了，启动: When the Citadel people want to calm me down when I lose control, they will play soothing resonance frequency in my helmet. Oh, when it's turned on, I can't help but think about cutting soaps. Is that a soap-cutting frequency they're playing?
StoryText.乌刹娜将以机甲形态出击，举起手来，放在我能看到的位置，向我跪下吧，大坏蛋！救世主: Ushana will strike in mecha form! Raise your hands, place them where I can see, and kneel, baddies! Master Savior, can I say that on my next mission? It took me a long time to come up with it!
StoryText.这是送给乌刹娜的礼物吗，乌刹娜会好好珍惜的，哇！是无垠号的模型，乌刹娜好喜欢！: Is this a present for Ushana? Ushana will cherish it! Wow! It's a model of the Eternal! Ushana loves it!
StoryText.救世主大人，我们昨天遇到了一个超级大的桦树生物，有这~么大，发现我们后马上朝我们: Master Savior, we came across a super big Chaos Remain yesterday. It was thiiiiiiiis big, and it immediately pounced at us when it saw us... Did I get hurt? I'm already used to injuries like that. The Citadel people will help with healing too.
StoryText.今天的任务是躺在床上好好养伤？好呀，只要是救世主大人的命令的话……可是躺在床上好: Today's mission is to rest and recuperate in bed? Sure, as long as it's Master Savior's order... But it's so boring to lie in bed. The Citadel people never read me bedtime stories. Eh? You'll read me bedtime stories? Awesome! Ushana wants to hear fairy tales.
StoryText.以前呢，乌刹娜身边的人就算不怕我，也总是一副在忌惮着什么的表情。只有列车长会接纳: In the past, even if the people around me didn't fear me, they would still look vigilant. Only conductor accepted and embraced me and never looked at me differently. Ah, I want the whole world to know how gentle conductor is.
StoryText.世界上只有三种人，“邪恶坏蛋”“救世主大人”还有可以随时撕碎的普通人。“请放心，: There are only three types of people in the world: "evil baddies," "Master Savior," and commonfolk who can be torn apart at any time. "Please rest assured. I will protect Master Savior until my last breath." Does it sound cool?
StoryText.这是献给列车长的礼物，乌刹娜亲手做的哦，当当当，香皂上雕的是列车长大人和乌刹娜。: This is a gift for you. I made it myself. Tadaaaah~ That's Master Savior and me carved on the soap. There's also a version where we're holding hands, but that's my precious collection.
StoryText.列车上的大家对乌刹娜很好，乌刹娜非常喜欢呆在列车上哦，要是能一辈子呆在上面就好啦: Everyone on the train treats me well. I love being aboard. I wish I can stay here my whole life. That way, I can be with you forever.
StoryText.消灭大坏蛋去咯！: Time to take down some baddies!
StoryText.哒哒哒，直达坏蛋大本营，都别想逃！: Ta-da-da! Right to the baddie's lair! You won't run away!
StoryText.砍砍砍，哈哈哈哈哈，都砍成碎片吧！: Chop chop chop! Hahahaha! Turn into ashes!
StoryText.救世主大人……乌刹娜……能获得救赎吗。: Master Savior... will Ushana... be saved?
StoryText.不甘心……才没有输，再来一次，一次就好……: No way... I haven't lost... Just one... one more time...
StoryText.我是罗洁尔，他们是这样告诉我的。好像之前给你添过麻烦，虽然我已经记不清了……: I'm Raziel. That's what they told me. It seems I have caused you trouble before, though I no longer remember it...
StoryText.到换班时间了吗？这么快。: It's time for a shift change? That's fast.
StoryText.你刚才是在叫我吗？不，就是有点没反应过来。罗洁尔，罗洁尔，我得记住。: Were you calling me? No, I just wasn't paying attention. Raziel, Raziel, I have to remember that name.
StoryText.我好像做了个梦。是什么内容已经想不起来了，只觉得很温暖，很安定……: I think I had a dream. I've forgotten what happened in it, but it felt really warm and safe...
StoryText.我完全记不得以前的我是什么样的了，但是其他人提到她的时候总是带着微笑，她是不是一: I've totally forgotten what I was like before, but everyone always talks about her with a smile. Was she a really nice... Ah, I shouldn't say that. Sorry.
StoryText.整理文件，归档书籍，不知道为什么，这些事情做起来很得心应手。: Sorting documents and organizing books. For some reason, these things are a cakewalk for me.
StoryText.无论以前的我是什么样的人，她都已经迎来了新生。但是，你很像她之类的话，我姑且当成: Regardless of what I was like in the past, she has already found a new life. But I'll take it as a compliment that I'm a lot like her.
StoryText.列车长，你看我的眼神…也许，你有关于她的故事想要告诉我？: Conductor, the way you look at me... Do you have a story about her to tell me?
StoryText.按理来说我应该不会对学会有什么归属感才对，毕竟醒来以后没有在那里待太久。但是看到: Logically speaking, I shouldn't feel any sense of belonging in the Citadel since I didn't stay there long after waking up. But it gives me such a sense of familiarity seeing those children in that uniform. Is this also a feeling she left for me...?
StoryText.列车长，你认识一位名叫丽桑德拉的女士吗？学会的先导？原来如此，她托人给我带了一些: Conductor, do you know a lady named Lissandra? A mentor of the Citadel? I see. She had someone bring me some books but didn't leave any note. I guess she was her old friend...
StoryText.战斗的时候像是变了一个人，被人这么评价了。我知道这是夸奖，但，究竟哪一个样子才是: Someone said I'm like a wholly different person in combat. I know that's a compliment, but which exactly is the real me? Conductor, I long to hear your answer.
StoryText.我喜欢从高处眺望夜晚的篝火城，那很美。那些彻夜闪耀的光，会让我很安心……: I like looking out at the Bonfire City at night from a high vantage point. It's beautiful. Those lights that shine all night make me feel really at ease...
StoryText.好多个晚上，当我睁开眼睛，会茫然于自己是否还在梦中。列车长，这个世界会不会也只是: On many nights, when I open my eyes, I'd feel in a trance, wondering if I was still dreaming. Conductor, could this world also just be somebody's dream?
StoryText.我喜欢人类，喜欢那些耀眼的人们，那些让我感到震撼的灵魂光芒。这也是她留给我的吗。: I love humans, love those brilliant people and those radiant souls that take my breath away. Is this what she left me too? That's nice. She left me the best gift. How I wish I could witness this radiance with her.
StoryText.对不起，又一次……在你面前……: I'm sorry... This happens again... in front of you...
StoryText.我不想……让你们失望……: I never want... to let you down...
StoryText.这是我应该做的，毕竟我是罗洁尔。我会继续加油的。: It's only natural. After all, I'm Raziel. I'll keep it up.
StoryText.莱卡吉亚报道！从今天开始，我就是无垠号的一员了。至于理由……哈哈，以后再和你说明: Lycagia reporting in! Starting today, I'm officially one of the Eternal crew. As for the reason... Heh, I'll tell you another day. Looking forward to the work here, Conductor!
StoryText.来了！刚刚是你叫我吧，列车长？: Coming! Did you call me just now, Conductor?
StoryText.这个？是高强度护甲，可以整体拆卸，不是很硌。后勤部的同事说“毛茸茸的肚皮需要保护: This? It's a heavy-duty body armor, detachable and not that uncomfortable. My logistics colleagues made it for me, saying "my fluffy tummy needs proper protection"... Sigh.
StoryText.我跑得很快的，不信可以给你演示一下，明天在训练场上……不不，你放心吧，绝对不会伤: I can run really fast! Let me show you at the training ground tomorrow... No, don't worry, I won't hurt you! You don't want me to? But why?!
StoryText.“狼脑袋朋友”是大家给我取的绰号，我还挺喜欢的。感觉从很久之前就被这么叫了，所以: Everyone calls me "wolf buddy" as a nickname, and I actually like it. It seems people have called me that for ages, so feel free to use it. I don't mind at all!
StoryText.其实亚人之间的礼仪是见面时互相碰碰鼻子。但我知道这对人类来说有点吓人……所以，如: Demi-humans have a custom of touching noses as a greeting. I know it might seem a little intimidating to humans though... So if you ever feel okay with doing the nose greeting... uh, never mind!
StoryText.我刚刚出去透气了，车顶上好大的风……！虽然我喜欢吹风，但没想到这么强……感觉嘴都: I just went out to get some fresh air. The wind on the roof was so strong... I love the breeze, but I didn't expect it to be this wild... My face feels all blown out of shape... Brrr.
StoryText.海因里希先生一直是我尊敬的前辈，他帮了我很多忙，也是在他的担保下，我才能获得正式: Mr. Heinrich is a senior I deeply respect. He's helped me so much, and it was with his guarantee that I got official identity and joined the BCRL Agency. Still, there seem to be things he's always keeping from me...
StoryText.列车上吃的真是丰富啊。我那天路过餐车想去冰箱里拿我的柠檬慕斯蛋糕，结果看见便当柜: There's such a rich variety of food onboard! One day, I passed the dining car to get my lemon mousse from the fridge, then I saw some pitch-black stuff in the bento cabinet... Is that some new dish?
StoryText.我被同事推荐了一部电影，讲的是狼反抗人类、自由地追求理想中的乐园的故事。结局居然: A colleague recommended a movie to me. It's about wolves rebelling against humans, chasing freedom and an ideal paradise. The ending even has wolves ruling the world... Pretty bold story, huh? They said there are also movies where apes, sharks or dinosaurs take over the world. For real?
StoryText.我曾经在篝火城里遇见过一位声称认识我的亚人同族。他叫着什么叛徒啊人类的狗啊就冲过: I once met a fellow demi-human in the city who claimed to know me. He charged at me immediately, yelling words like traitor and human's lapdog... I had no clue what was going on, and it really annoyed me!
StoryText.铁安局偶尔也会接待一些帝国来的亚人同胞、给他们办办临时身份之类的。听他们说，帝国: The BCRL Agency occasionally receives demi-human compatriots from the Empire and helps them apply for temporary ID cards. From what they told me, most demi-humans in the Empire live alongside humans with little discrimination... That sounds wonderful, almost like a utopia.
StoryText.我战斗的时候眼睛会变色，这算是一种……特殊能力？好像也不是别的亚人都会这样，希望: My eyes change color when I fight. I guess it's some sort of special ability? Not every demi-human can do this though... I hope it doesn't startle you.
StoryText.我不是人类，也不可能变成人类。但我觉得，不管人类还是亚人，都有追寻自由的权利……: I am not human, and I can never become one. But I believe both humans and demi-humans have the right to pursue freedom... I'll keep walking down my own path, no matter what awaits me in the future.
StoryText.执行结束，莱卡吉亚归队。敌人的气息已经全部消失了，我们回去吧！: Mission accomplished. Lycagia falling in. I can't sense the presence of enemies anymore. Let's head back!
StoryText.你好，我是涟。……麻烦把我安排到人最少的区域。: Hello, I'm Ren. ...Please assign me to the area with the least people.
StoryText.你看起来很平静，太好了。……谢谢。: Ah great, you look very calm. ...Thank you.
StoryText.之前，魇说我的武器是“公路毁灭者”，我还以为是说我本人。……她人很好，只是我有点: Maruha said my weapon was the "Highway Destroyer," and I thought she was talking about me personally. ...She's really nice, it's just me, I'm a bit...
StoryText.这些乌鸦，和我的升构能力没有关系……就只是会停在我身边而已。它们有时会给我……亮: These crows have nothing to do with my Ascension Ability... They just perch around me. Sometimes they bring me... shiny little stones, which makes me a bit... happy.
StoryText.需要战斗的时候，希望你别被我的样子吓到。……等一切安静下来，我就会恢复正常的。: I hope you won't be startled by my appearance in battle. I'll return to normal when everything calms down...
StoryText.喜欢闪闪发光的东西很常见吧？我可是普通的……嗯，普通的年轻女孩子哦。: Isn't it common to like all kinds of shiny things? I'm just an ordinary... hmm, an ordinary girl.
StoryText.什么？你说什么？……什么？哦，把音响调小一点，好的。对不起，对不起……: Sorry, come again? ...Yes? Oh, turn the volume down a bit. Sorry, I'm so sorry...
StoryText.歌德先生把我带出来、给了我容身之处，我很感谢他……假如没有他，我现在应该已经伤害: Mr. Goethe brought me out and gave me a place to stay. For that I am very grateful... If it weren't for him, I might have harmed someone I held dear. That's the last thing I want...
StoryText.损失、损失赔偿单？！我不记得我做过这种事情！我……我做过吗？: Damage compensation?! I don't remember doing anything like that! Uh... I didn't do it... right?
StoryText.对外的恶意是尖刺形状的，但对自身的恶意却是一团阴影……嗯，在我的眼里，所有人都黑: Malice directed outward is shaped like thorns, but malice toward oneself is a mass of shadows... Hmm, everyone looks dark in my eyes. Myself? ...I can't see... my own feelings.
StoryText.我想回家……但是回去了应该也不会开心的吧。只会让他们为我担心……而且他们也不理解: I want to go home... but I probably won't be happy even if I do. It will only make them worry about me... and they don't understand me either... But I still really want to go home, Conductor...
StoryText.不要抢啦……！啊，又把我的挂坠叼走了。真是的……就当是和你们交换了，下次要记得带: Don't snatch it...! Ah, you took my pendant again. Really... let's consider it a trade, next time make sure to bring me other shiny things, okay? Hmm, hmm... you guys are so nice.
StoryText.那个、周末有空的话，我们一起去购物中心吧？！……啊，不，不行，还是不行……别管我: I-If you have time this weekend, shall we go to the shopping mall together?! ...Ah, no, not yet... don't mind me, Conductor...
StoryText.我今天的造型怎么样？……还，还不错……吗？你没有在伪装呢，没有敷衍或者讨厌的情绪: How do I look today? ...N-Not bad... really? You're not pretending. You're not perfunctory nor annoyed... So you really think that way, right? Right?
StoryText.看见尖刺了……没关系，没关系……: I see thorns... Calm down, it's okay...
StoryText.别再伤害我了……别再让我看那些……: Don't harm me... Stop showing me those things...
StoryText.呵呵，把你也摧毁吧……！: Hehe, might as well destroy you...!
StoryText.把造成痛苦的东西毁灭就解决了！: Just destroy everything that brings me pain!
StoryText.尖刺，扎进身体了……好痛啊……: The thorns are piercing into my body... It hurts so much...
StoryText.我是不是应该逃走的呢……是不是又做错了……: Should I have run away... Have I done something wrong again...
StoryText.……真安静啊……作为奖励，留我在这里独自待一会儿，可以吗？: ...It's so quiet... As a reward, may I stay here alone for a while?
StoryText.车长亲车长亲！嗯~？我没有在cosplay啦，这就是魔女马吉拉真正的样子！: Dear Dear Conductor! Hmm~? I'm not cosplaying, this is the true form of Margiela the Witch!
StoryText.放心地交给魔女马吉拉吧。: Rest assured and leave everything to Margiela the Witch.
StoryText.锁到哪里去了？——哎呀，车长亲在明知故问吗？: Where did the lock go? — Oh, is dear Conductor pretending not to know?
StoryText.真咲那家伙，明明比我小那么多，讲话却一点都不客气呢，呵呵……是在说她可爱啦，你也: Masaki, that little rascal, is so much younger than me, yet speaks so bluntly, hehe... I'm saying she's cute, don't you think so, Dear Conductor?
StoryText.cosplay？没有放弃呀，人家怎么可能放弃自己的爱好和追求！而且现在可以用更加: Cosplay? I haven't given it up at all. How could I give up my hobbies and pursuits! Moreover, now I can modify the details of my costume with even more meticulous magic... It's very convenient.
StoryText.想体会一下电影里那种占卜师的感觉？好呀，当然可以……这位顾客，请把你的手放在我的: You want to feel the vibe of those fortune tellers in the movies? Sure... Dear customer, please place your hand on my crystal ball — hey, gotcha! I won't let go for the rest of the day~
StoryText.车长亲，从某种意义上来说，人家已经被你从里到外从上到下都看个精光了，所以说，你得: Dear Conductor, in a way, you've already seen me bare from head to toe and inside out, so you must — hey, don't just run off...
StoryText.衣服上的蛛网装饰一开始只是为了增加神秘感，再加上看着好看而已……不过在魔女的知识: The cobweb decoration on my costume was initially just to add a sense of mystery, and it looked really nice... But in the world of witches, cobweb is a material that represents "connection."
StoryText.虽说魔女总是会和谎言之类的关键词挂钩，但是我相信车长亲能听出我的真心话的吧？因为: Though witches are always associated with lies, I believe Dear Conductor can hear my true feelings, can't you? Since you are really perceptive, I never worry about being misunderstood by you.
StoryText.小魔女动画要出新作啦！下个月就会播出……到时候车长亲肯定会抽空会陪我一起看的，对: The Little Witch animation is getting a new release! It will be broadcast next month... You'll definitely make time to watch it with me, right, Dear Conductor?
StoryText.呐车长亲，如果我和真咲同时掉进水里……哦等一下，我先去问一下她会不会游泳……: Dear Conductor, if Masaki and I fall into water at the same time... Oh wait, let me ask if she can swim...
StoryText.车长亲，你相信“命运”吗？最近我经常在想这个问题呢，我和真咲的重逢，我和车长亲的: Dear Conductor, do you believe in "Fate"? I've been thinking about it lately. The reunion with Masaki, the acquaintance with you — were these things preordained? Hah, don't worry, I don't mind being dominated like this.
StoryText.我希望所有的孩子都能不要惧怕“变得幸福”。如果为了负罪感，为了逃避而歌颂不幸，就: I wish all children would never fear to embrace happiness. If one praises misfortune out of guilt and escapism, they shall never find the way to joy... I truly, truly hope so. Hehe, it hardly sounds like words a witch would speak, does it?
StoryText.如果没有和车长亲相遇的话，或许我永远都没有勇气去面对过去和未来。所以，真的真的很: If I hadn't met Dear Conductor, perhaps I would never have had the courage to face the past and the future. Therefore, I'm truly, truly grateful to you... Alright, enough of my confession! Let's do something more enjoyable!
StoryText.嗯嗯，轮到魔女上场啦。: Mm-hm, it's time for the witch to shine.
StoryText.哈啊……有点犯困了……: Haah... I'm feeling a bit sleepy...
StoryText.车长亲，暂时别看这边哦~: Dear Conductor, please look away for now~
StoryText.明明已经下定决心了……为什么……: I've already made my choice... but why...
StoryText.魔女……怎么能这样……倒下……: How can a witch... fall like this...
StoryText.再多说一点夸奖人家的话吧——称赞会让魔女变得更加强大哦？: Praise me more~ Praises can make a witch even stronger!
StoryText.嗯哼~要牵着乌刹娜的手去逛街吗？: Hmph~ Wanna hold my hand and go for a walk?
StoryText.乌刹娜准备了一份超——级大礼物送给救世主大人，请您好好期待哟。救世主大人？救世主: Ushana has prepared a super—big gift for Master Savior. Please look forward to it. Master Savior? Master Savior... are you asleep...
StoryText.救世主大人说要乌刹娜多接触各种各样的人，唔……不太明白。但是广告上说，流行文化受: Master Savior said that Ushana should interact with various kinds of people, hmm... I don't quite understand. But the advertisement says pop culture is popular among young people... So Ushana bought this, Catopus. It's quite like Ushana, right? Do you like it? Ushana likes it a lot.
StoryText.乌刹娜买了好多好多手手喵，嘿嘿。送救世主大人一只吧，捏着软绵绵的，很安心。——手: Ushana bought a lot of Catopus, hehe. You can have this one. It's so soft and comforting to hold. — Catopus, listen carefully, when Ushana is not around, you must protect Master Savior.
StoryText.呦，要来一杯吗，喝完我们去一个好地方逛逛吧。……呜……真的要这样念台词才能交到好: Yo, wanna grab a drink? Let's find a nice place after. ... Uh... Do I really have to say this to make good friends? Will Master Savior like it? Ushana's face is burning. This feels so awkward...
StoryText.啊！救世主大人，在这里！听我说，乌刹娜超厉害的哦，我给列车长做了个特别版的“手手: Ah! Master Savior, over here! Listen to me, Ushana was amazing. I sewed a special version of "Catopus" for you, and it's almost complete. Eh, you don't want to see my fingers get hurt again, so want to join in? Yes, yes!
StoryText.我们去那边看看好不好？: Shall we take a look over there?
StoryText.没有抢到限量周边……唔，抱歉。: I didn't get the limited edition merch... Mm, sorry.
StoryText.如果乌刹娜能更厉害的话……: If Ushana could be more powerful...
StoryText.您好。之前还没有自我介绍过，我的名字是神代真咲。“魔女”？也一同在这里哦。但是，: Hello. I haven't properly introduced myself yet. My name is Kamishiro Masaki. The "Witch"? She's here with me too. But I'd prefer you call me by my current name. Mm... just call me Masaki.
StoryText.我明白啦。可以把作业拿过来写吗？: Got it. Can I do my homework here?
