StoryText.作业写完以后，就能干点别的事啦。需要我帮您做点简餐吗，列车长？: I can do other things once I finish my homework. Would you like me to make you a simple meal, Conductor?
StoryText.我正在看的这本书是《未确认生物年鉴》，记录了一定时期内各地出现的未知或无法解明生: I'm reading the Almanac of Unidentified Mysterious Animals. It documents traces left by unknown or unexplained creatures spotted across different regions over a period of time. Would you like to take a look? Nyx? It's not a UMA, you know...
StoryText.书包里装着各种各样的东西，所以拎起来稍微有点沉……不过，这是为了更好地应对各种突: My school bag is stuffed with all sorts of things, so it feels a little heavy to carry... but it's all to be better prepared for any unexpected situations.
StoryText.喂？……嗯，我吃过饭了！嗯……但我还在工作，一会儿给你们回电话，好吗？嗯！好……: Hello? ...Mm-hmm, I've already eaten! Yeah... but I'm still working right now. I'll call you back later, okay? Mm! Alright... bye~ — Ah, Conductor! That was my parents on the phone just now!
StoryText.虽然同时做着两份兼职，不过因为黑月和无垠号的大家都很照顾我，所以其实不怎么累……: I have two jobs at the moment, but everyone in Night Chains and the Eternal crew takes such good care of me that I don't really feel tired... If there's anything you need me to do, just tell me directly.
StoryText.我小时候经常做梦……那些梦境，其实都是魔女的记忆。虽然有很多可怕的事，但是其中也: I used to have so many dreams when I was little... Those dreams were actually the Witch's memories. There were a lot of frightening things in them, but there were also beautiful, happy moments. I'm grateful that she used to preserved all of it so completely.
StoryText.要我为您介绍一下未确认生物吗？当然可以。在雪怪、水怪、大脚怪之外，所有的未解明生: Would you like me to tell you about UMAs? Of course. Out of all the unexplained beings besides yetis, lake monsters and bigfoot — the most famous one, and the only one ever recorded in the Mundus Empire, is without a doubt the "dragon"!
StoryText.列车长饿了吗？我带了小零食……请吃吧。如果不喜欢原味海苔的话，我这里还有辣味的。: Hungry, Conductor? I brought some snacks... help yourself. If you don't like plain seaweed, I have spicy flavored ones too. Ah... Nyx, that's not for you, don't bite it...
StoryText.作为魔女所经历的一切，我都还记得。虽然有时让人痛苦，但这绝不是惩罚。每想到这点，: I still remember everything the Witch went through. It can be painful at times, but it was never a punishment. Whenever I think about that, I feel like she, from long ago, has passed her courage on to the me of today.
StoryText.我想要在未来成为未确认生物的研究者。为了这个目标，必须不断努力才行……这是作为新: I want to become a UMA researcher in the future. I have to keep working hard toward that goal... This is the dream of the new me, the person I am right now.
StoryText.每个人都会有想要逃避、不愿面对的事吧？我有时候能够克服，有时候却没办法……比如偶: Everyone has things they want to run from, things they don't want to face, right? Sometimes I can push through them, and sometimes I can't... Like how I occasionally get so absorbed in reading that I forget to do my homework...
StoryText.过去我很害怕长大，因为每长一岁，就是离梦中那个可怕的结局更近了一些……但是现在，: I used to be so afraid of growing up, because every year older felt like getting closer to that terrible ending in my dreams... But now, I'm not afraid anymore. Thank you for staying by my side and facing all of this with me, Conductor.
StoryText.没关系，还跑得动……: It's okay, I can still run...
StoryText.呼，呼……请、等我一下……: Huff, huff... P-please, wait for me...
StoryText.见证魔女之力吧！: Behold the power of the Witch!
StoryText.感谢您的夸奖。奖状？不……不用了，列车长，我已经不是需要举着奖状回家的小孩子了哦: Thank you for the praise. A certificate? No... Conductor. I'm not a kid who needs awards to show off anymore. But... I'll accept it, as long as it makes you happy.
StoryText.克洛伊，学会的天使，这是我的档案，拿去自己看。: I'm Chloe, Angel of the Citadel. Here's my file. Read it yourself.
StoryText.让我帮忙？好呀，我会帮你把一切都搞砸的。: Want my help? Sure! I'll help ya mess everything up.
StoryText.唔……我出来的时候好像接了个什么任务来着……但是不太记得具体内容了。哈哈没关系，: Hmm... think they gave me some kinda mission 'fore I left... can't remember what it was though. Ah, whatever. If it was actually important, Lissandra would've done it herself!
StoryText.天使计划？啊，那个玩意就是……有一帮人想要在这个不起眼的星球上，制造一个全知全能: The Angel Project? Uh, basically a buncha people wanted to build an all-knowin', all-powerful... uh, local god? On this tiny lil' planet. Me? I'm just one of the failed products outta that ridiculous mess.
StoryText.我的天使代号啊，没有那种东西。他们想取来着，但我自己不愿意，他们也没办法……我真: My Angel codename? Don't got one. They wanted to give me one, but I said no, so that was that. I seriously wish they'd trust science 'stead of all that "names are the shortest spells" mumbo jumbo.
StoryText.幸好我的父母在我9岁的时候就把我卖掉啦……为什么？因为10岁的时候他们就打不过我: Good thing my parents sold me off when I was nine. Why? 'Cause once I turned ten, they couldn't beat me no more.
StoryText.我的工作是预防和处理形态污染引发的灾害，但最近一直都跟在你们无垠号后面给你们收拾: My job's dealin' with disasters caused by Morphic Field Pollution. Lately though? I've basically just been followin' the Eternal 'round cleanin' up your messes. Wherever the Eternal goes, the Unbewusstes starts actin' up. Honestly, easier to just move onto your train.
StoryText.天使的性格都很恶劣？你是怎么得出的结论呀？事先声明哈，我没素质是因为我没上过学，: All Angels got terrible personalities? Where'd ya get that idea? Just so we're clear, I got no manners 'cause I never went to school. As for the other Angels... well, you can draw your own conclusions.
StoryText.学会的人会向天使寻求真理，虽然我一般不会搭理他们，不过，列车长想要寻求什么呢？赚: Citadel folks come to Angels lookin' for truth. I usually can't be bothered. But what 'bout you, Conductor? Lookin' for the secret to gettin' rich? Hang on, lemme connect to the Unbewusstes... While I'm searchin', here. Three economics problem sets. Knock yourself out.
StoryText.把人类的过去和未来炖成一锅糊糊然后把你的嘴掰开灌下去，等你消化完了，你也能讲出那: Take humanity's whole past an' future, throw it into one giant stew, then pry your mouth open an' force-feed it to ya. Once you've digested all that, you'll be able to say profound stuff too.
StoryText.故事里的英雄往往都是天生的勇者，承担着拯救世界的命运。但其实都是写小说的为了赚钱: Stories always make heroes sound like they were born to save the world. That's just authors tryin' to sell books. Most of them "heroes" start out deliverin' packages for spare change, or just tryin' not to starve. Me? I save the world, then I still gotta go home an' clean the place.
StoryText.道德？我觉得天使实际上不被那玩意约束哦。所谓的道德呢，其实是人类设定的一套行为准: Morality? Don't think Angels are really bound by that. It's just a buncha rules humans made up that only work in certain situations. Whole point's probably to keep humanity's collective unconscious—the Unbewusstes—goin'. Once you're far enough away from people, morality kinda stops applyin'. How far's "far enough"? 'Bout as far away as where I grew up.
StoryText.说起来，列车长是不是有什么特别的升构能力呀？感觉每个来无垠号的人，最后都会悄悄把: Hey, Conductor... you got some weird Ascension Ability or somethin', don't ya? Feels like everyone who boards the Eternal ends up tellin' you their deepest, darkest secrets. Bet you've heard some pretty interestin' stuff. C'mon, tell me one!... No? Aww.
StoryText.朋友？我没什么朋友，就算偶尔有说得来话的人也不一定是什么好人，都是随手就劈死了…: Friends? Not really. Even when I do find someone I get along with, they're usually not great people... an' they get chopped in half by my lightnin'. But you, Conductor... you're alright. I like ya. So I won't do nothin' to ya... for now.
StoryText.代表人类的意志，来毁灭你们咯！: I'm here to wipe y'all out in the name of humanity!
StoryText.让我们在新世界再会！: See ya in the new world!
StoryText.哎呀，玩过头了……跑路咯！: Oops. Might've gone a lil' overboard. I'm outta here!
StoryText.此身既是人类的荣光！下一句是什么来着？: This body is humanity's pride! ...Uh... what was the next line again?
StoryText.伊卡菈，作为萃境联盟的代表，以及将来的实习列车长前来。……旅行的时候有人告诉我，: Ikara, here as the representative of the Verdant Realm Alliance and a future conductor in training. ...Someone told me that at school you call those who graduated before you "senior"... Am I to call you that as well?
StoryText.有什么要教我的吗？……前辈。: Is there something you wish to teach me? ...Senior.
StoryText.前辈，你昨晚因为看机器人电影熬了夜吧？……什么？真是失礼，我可不是那种偷偷摸摸的: Senior, you stayed up late last night watching robot movies, didn't you? ...What? How rude. I'm not the sort who sneaks around— Dodo told me! Here, drink this coffee while it's hot. I only made it while I was at it, so don't read anything into it.
StoryText.来到无垠号以后，我第一次试着用地表人的机械去洗涤衣物。结果这才知道，深色衣物与浅: After coming to the Eternal, I tried using surface machinery to wash clothes for the first time. And that was how I learned that dark clothes and light clothes must not be washed together... rather a nuisance. May I put my clothes in your laundry basket next time? Then you could do it for me.
StoryText.尾巴……稍微有点不整齐了，一会要花点时间整理下……前辈，得体的仪表也是很必要的啊: My tail... it's gotten a little untidy. I'll need to spend some time on it later... Senior, a presentable appearance does matter. How about putting some time into yours? If you have no experience, I could offer you a few pointers.
StoryText.前辈是TMT的“风云人物”吧。之前遇到了一个和你同届的列车长，一直说你是劲敌、劲: You were something of a "figure" at TMT, weren't you. I ran into a conductor from your year not long ago, and he kept calling you his rival, over and over. There's no use being embarrassed— that's a "title" you won for yourself.
StoryText.最近有点无聊呢……虽然各方面的事都算是走上正轨了，可是这样也没有我们一起待在学校: Things have been rather dull lately... Everything's more or less on track, but it isn't as interesting as when we were at school together. ...Given the chance, I think I'd still rather be with you— no. I said nothing. Nothing at all!
StoryText.你的手……怎么了？修理东西的时候擦伤了一点？为什么不告诉我！快点把手给我——你看: Your hand... what happened? You scraped it while repairing something? Why didn't you tell me! Give me your hand— there, all better. ...Honestly, you don't look after yourself in the slightest. In that respect you're nothing like a senior!
StoryText.战斗的时候是把“龙”的那一边分出来了，所以那也是我，也是伊卡菈。……不用害怕啦，: In battle I set the "dragon" side of me apart, so that is me as well. ...There's no need to be afraid, since at heart— you say you "like" it...? From the standpoint of beauty, it is beyond compare, naturally. I'll allow you to like that side of me, but you're not to overlook this side either.
StoryText.……我还挺喜欢晒太阳的。地表的太阳……哈啊……（哈欠）很暖和，和火炉的光芒、灯的: ...I'm rather fond of sitting in the sun. The sun on the surface... haah... (yawn) it's warm, and it isn't like firelight or lamplight at all. It's very good for... sleeping...
StoryText.前辈辛苦了，这些是我刚刚剥好的石榴，请用。……为什么要一副这么意外的样子？我只是: Good work today, senior. I shelled these pomegranates just now. Please have them. ...Why do you look so surprised? I simply wanted to do something for you. I'm not going to seize the chance to ask for anything in return. ...You and President Medici are the ones who taught me that, after all.
StoryText.我会做一点吃的，如果前辈需要，我可以帮忙做饭。上次路过便当柜的时候，看见了好像不: I can cook a little, so if you need it, senior, I can help with the meals. When I passed the bento cabinet last time, I saw something that looked inedible... surely it wasn't roasted with flame the way I do it? Or was it roasted too long?
StoryText.一、二、三……前辈？呃，没有看什么……只是舞蹈教学视频而已。……毕竟听说从学校毕: One, two, three... Senior? Ah, I wasn't watching anything... only a dance instruction video. ...I heard there's a ball when you graduate, so I wanted to prepare in advance. And as for who my partner will be... I already have someone in mind. I'll invite "that person" myself when the time comes.
StoryText.那个相机，最后还是被阿妮塔的人收走了呢……我理解，反正就是研究用途吧。不过，我前: That camera was taken away by Anita's people in the end... I understand. It's for research, after all. But I saw an advertisement for a new camera model the other day! If you have time, shall we go pick one out together? ...How about I take the photographs this time, senior?
StoryText.战斗……这么简单的事还要我来？: Combat... you need me for something this simple?
StoryText.居然还有吗……？: There are still more of them...?
StoryText.我当然没事了，你在担心什么呢？前辈不受伤已经拼尽全力了吧，这我知道。哼，那就快点: Of course I'm all right. What are you worried about? You gave everything you had just to keep from getting hurt yourself— I know that much. Hmph, now hurry up and follow me back!
StoryText.我是来自阿妮塔的伊利亚德，任何能力范围内的问题，我都很乐意为你答疑解惑。: I am Eliade, of Anita. Any question within my competence, I'll gladly answer.
StoryText.是有什么感到棘手的难题吗？不用着急，我们可以一起解决。: Something proving difficult? There's no need to rush. We can work through it together.
StoryText.闲暇时间我很喜欢去活动身体，其中最喜欢的项目是拳击……很惊讶吗？: In my free time I like to keep active. Boxing, most of all... Surprised?
StoryText.想看看我手里这个容器？里面是我从桦树空间带回来的样本，不过还有些危险，所以等我处: Curious about the container I'm holding? There's a sample inside that I brought back from the Chaos Space. It's still a little dangerous, so come have a look once I've finished processing it— would that be all right?
StoryText.早在遇见你之前，我就不止一次听到我的学生们提起过你，如今终于见面，倒是感觉……哈: Long before I met you, my students had mentioned you to me more than once. Now that we've finally met, I find... haha, don't look so nervous. What I was about to say is a compliment.
StoryText.即使我的学生们已经可以独当一面，我还是忍不住觉得他们仍很稚嫩，也许这就是为人师者: Even now that my students can stand on their own, I can't help feeling they're still green. Perhaps that's the common failing of those of us who teach.
StoryText.之前将绘制完毕的画作挂在办公室里，等我意识到的时候，它已经作为众多园丁口中的“诅: I hung one of my finished paintings in the office once. By the time I realized what was happening, a good many Gardeners were calling it the "cursed design," and it had taken its place among Anita's uncanny legends.
StoryText.列车长要是也对拳击有兴趣的话，我可以做你的陪练。放心，我会把力道控制好，不会做出: If you have an interest in boxing as well, Conductor, I can be your sparring partner. Don't worry, I'll keep the force under control. Nothing so crude as flooring you with one punch.
StoryText.如果站在引领他人的位置上，就要更加严格地锤炼自己的内心，自身的存在就是大家的希望: If you stand in a position of leading others, you must temper your own spirit all the more rigorously. Your very presence becomes everyone's hope. But you are already doing this well, so there is no need for me to say any of it.
StoryText.你的神情看上去有点恍惚，是太累了吗？劳逸结合也是很重要的，接下来请好好休息，有什: Your expression looks a little dazed. Are you too tired? Rest matters as much as the work does. Get some proper rest now— I'll stand in for you for the time being.
StoryText.原来是你……没事，我只是有点累，稍微休息一会罢了。啊，没关系，不用回避。可以的话: Oh, it's you... It's nothing, I'm only a little tired. Just taking a moment. Ah, it's all right, there's no need to slip away. Sit with me a while, if you don't mind. You needn't do anything. Just being here is enough.
StoryText.二十年前的事情，如果说我已经不在意了那只是自欺欺人而已。我无论如何都不希望同样的: As for what happened twenty years ago— to say I no longer care about it would only be a lie I tell myself. I will not have the same thing happen again. Whenever I teach my students the means to survive, I find myself wondering whether I could be doing it better.
StoryText.虽然我很关心我的学生们，但不代表我会无底线的纵容，过分溺爱只有坏处。对于列车长也: I care a great deal for my students, but that doesn't mean I'll indulge them without limit. Coddling does nothing but harm. The same holds for you, Conductor. If it proves necessary, I'll take whatever measures are appropriate to help you.
StoryText.能够对某一事物始终保持纯粹的热爱是相当难能可贵的，我希望能守护你眼中的光芒永不熄: To hold a pure love for one thing and hold it all the way through is a rare and precious thing. I hope to guard the light in your eyes, so that it never goes out.
StoryText.很荣幸能助你一臂之力。: It's an honor to lend you my strength.
StoryText.我也久违地有些热血沸腾了。: It's been a long while since my blood ran this hot.
StoryText.不能继续这样纵容你们下去了。: I can't go on indulging you.
StoryText.奋力一搏的感觉还真是酣畅淋漓。: Throwing everything into it— there's nothing quite so exhilarating.
StoryText.抱歉，我没能履行导师的职责。: Forgive me. I failed in a mentor's duty.
StoryText.那个时候的错误又要重演了吗……: Is the mistake back then to be repeated...
StoryText.只是尽到了分内之事而已，大家的表现都很出色。: I only did what fell to me. Everyone performed admirably.
StoryText.偶尔像这样各自做些喜欢的事情，共度放松时间也不错。: It's nice, once in a while, to spend some relaxed time like this, each of us doing what we enjoy.
StoryText.我刚才速写了你打瞌睡的样子，想看看吗？: I did a quick sketch of you dozing off just now. Care to have a look?
StoryText.有人说画作能够反映作者的内心，但是自从我的作品被评论为“拥有恐怖的混沌感，大概率: They say a painting reflects the painter's inner world. But ever since one of my pieces was described as having "a horrifying sense of chaos, most likely from the hand of someone with a severe organic mental disorder," I've begun to doubt how accurate that saying is.
StoryText.不用担心我的衣服，穿着最舒适的衣物进入创作状态是我的习惯。况且我很喜欢作画过程中: Don't worry about my clothes. It's a habit of mine to settle into the work in whatever's most comfortable. Besides, I'm rather fond of the marks the painting leaves on them without my meaning to — they bear witness to the whole enjoyable process.
StoryText.我的手上沾满了颜料……不好意思，能麻烦你帮我重新系一下头发吗？: My hands are covered in paint... Sorry to trouble you, but would you mind retying my hair for me?
StoryText.这块颜料很特别对吗？它是从一种桦树生物的器官里提取出来的，在市场上的价格也十分昂: This pigment is something special, isn't it? It's extracted from the organ of a certain Chaos Remain, and it fetches a considerable price on the market. At Anita, though, getting hold of the raw material is no great difficulty.
StoryText.有一种外出采风的感觉呢。: This rather feels like heading out to sketch from life.
StoryText.我很期待接下来的景色。: I'm looking forward to the scenery ahead.
StoryText.穿拖鞋作战好像有点危险啊……: Fighting in slippers might be a bit risky...
StoryText.我随身携带的可不只是画具。: My art supplies aren't the only thing I keep on me.
StoryText.这会成为很棒的参考素材。: This will make excellent reference material.
StoryText.看来我还学艺不精，下次会做好万全的准备。: It seems my craft still needs work. Next time I'll come thoroughly prepared.
StoryText.抱歉，今天的写生只能到此为止了。: My apologies — today's sketching will have to end here.
StoryText.回去就把这场战斗复现在画布上吧。: I'll put this battle on canvas once we're back.
StoryText.我就是在人间行走的机械神！拜倒在我的力量之下吧！: I am the mechanical god walking among humans! Bow down before my power!
StoryText.有什么事向我报告吗？说的尽量简短些。: Is there anything to report to me? Try to keep it brief.
StoryText.机械可以修复你的一切缺陷。让我来看看……我会帮你塑造一具完美的机械躯体，怎么样？: Machines can fix all your defects. Let me see... I will help you create a perfect mechanical body, how about that?
StoryText.你的就是我的，我的还是我的。有什么不满吗？: What's yours is mine, and what's mine is still mine. Any complaints?
StoryText.呵呵~我才不会为你担心呢，凡人。: Hehe~ I won't worry about you, mortal.
StoryText.凡人的祭祀仪式可真是闹腾，该说是他们的神太没有威严了吗？: The rituals of mortals are really noisy; could it be that their god lacks majesty?
StoryText.哼~夸你两句竟然还跳起来了。果然是只猴子~: Hmph~ Just a couple of compliments and you're already jumping around. Truly a monkey~
StoryText.你问我想要什么东西？呵呵，我乃机械教廷之主，机械神行走于凡间的代理，有什么是我得: You ask me what I want? Hehe, I am the leader of the Mechanicus Church, the agent of the Machine God walking among mortals. What is it that I cannot obtain? Yes... I have everything... I can get anything...
StoryText.凡人受凡躯之左右，反复无常，难以信赖。相比起来，机械更值得信赖，只要诚挚地维护，: Mortals are swayed by their mortal bodies, fickle and hard to trust. In comparison, machines are more trustworthy; as long as they are sincerely maintained, there is no doubt that they will meet your expectations.
StoryText.一切机械都属于机械之神所有，换言之，都是属于我的，想到我的东西在黑市上被贩卖，实: All machines belong to the God of Machines, in other words, they all belong to me. The thought of my things being sold on the black market is truly displeasing.
StoryText.唔……坐近一点，不要误会，钢铁的冰冷才是我的最爱，我只是偶尔，偶尔想要试试人的温: Uh... Sit a little closer, don't get me wrong, the coldness of steel is my true love, I just occasionally, occasionally want to try what human warmth feels like.
StoryText.哈？未成年？身为机械神的代理，我早已不受凡间的律法束缚。去酒馆当然也是没有关系的: Huh? Underage? As the agent of the Machine God, I am no longer bound by mortal laws. Of course, it's perfectly fine to go to the tavern.
StoryText.你以后只要看着我一个人就够了。: Just keep your eyes on me in the future, and that will be enough.
StoryText.凡人就像地上蝼蚁一样。当然，你除外。你……是我的蝼蚁。: Ordinary people are like ants on the ground. Of course, you are an exception. You... are my ant.
StoryText.有趣，就让我来尝尝你的命运是什么味道。: Interesting, let me taste what your fate is like.
StoryText.不堪一击。: No match for glossary terms was found. The translation is: Vulnerable.
StoryText.不过是打发时间而已。: It's just to pass the time.
StoryText.摧毁世间一切之恶吧，神之裁决！: Destroy all evil in the world, Divine Judgment!
StoryText.你们这些凡夫俗子，做得还算不错，看在你们那么努力的份上，我就稍微认真点吧。: You ordinary folks have done quite well. Considering how hard you've worked, I'll take it a bit more seriously.
StoryText.是的，我终于获得了和无垠号乘组并肩作战的许可。……接下来的旅途中，如果有什么需要: Yes, I have finally gained permission to fight alongside the crew of The Eternal. ...In the upcoming journey, if there is anything that needs to be done, please feel free to order me directly without hesitation.
StoryText.……我没有办法自己思考。只有听了别人的话我才能行动。“自己找出想做的事”，这话根: …I can't think for myself. I can only act after listening to others. "Finding out what I want to do on my own" is simply a fantasy…
StoryText.休息？不，不用了。我还有可以做的事……请让我再多为您做些什么。: Rest? No, no need. I still have things to do... Please allow me to do a little more for you.
StoryText.虽然战斗能力无法与御敌枢纽的杰出成员相比，但我应该能处理途中遇到的大部分情况。如: Although my combat abilities cannot compare to the outstanding members of The Destroyer, I should be able to handle most situations encountered along the way. If there is an opportunity for battle, please consider taking me along.
StoryText.车上时不时会有非常混乱的情况发生，看来无垠号的状况和塞纳诺尼克内部不相上下。……: There are frequently very confusing situations occurring on the vehicle, and it seems that the condition of The Eternal is comparable to that of inside Sainanonic. … Have you even gotten used to this?
StoryText.我参与过“天使计划”的选拔。结果当然是没有被选上……否则现在也无法在这里和您说话: I participated in the selection process for the "Angel Project." Of course, I wasn't selected... otherwise, I wouldn't be here talking to you now, Conductor.
StoryText.我不太想回学会。不仅是塞纳诺尼克，就连其他设施也……我无法面对同僚们异样的目光。: I don't really want to return to the Citadel. It's not just Seinonique, but even other facilities as well... I can't face the strange looks from my colleagues.
StoryText.从前生活在北阵辖区的人，应该都很喜欢番茄牛肉汤吧……算是一种家常菜。小时候，只要: People who used to live in the North District probably all liked tomato beef soup... It's considered a kind of homemade dish. When I was a child, as long as I met the requirements set by my parents, they would make this soup for me to drink.
StoryText.我曾经将投身一件伟大的事业定为我的毕生目标，然而它却一次又一次地将我抛弃了。是我: I once set dedicating myself to a great cause as my lifelong goal, yet it abandoned me time and again. Is it because I'm not qualified? Or is it that the number of people it chooses is just so limited...
StoryText.……这是什么？铁盟配发的速溶汤吗……谢谢，下次请让我为您准备食物吧。您问什么？汤: ......What is this? Instant soup issued by the BCRL?......Thank you, next time please let me prepare the food for you. What did you ask? The taste of the soup? Very, very good......Thank you.
StoryText.这是今天您布置给我的工作，已经全部完成了，请您过目。……还请您不要那么……高兴地: This is the work you assigned to me today. It is all complete, please take a look. ……And please don't praise me so enthusiastically, I'm not quite used to it.
StoryText.寄托吗……的确。就连身在战场上，我也必须紧握盾牌……否则就像失去了所有依靠一样。: A source of support... indeed. Even on the battlefield, I must hold the shield tightly... otherwise it feels like losing all my reliance. I think I still can't act on my own strength.
StoryText.您之前说过，我可以向您提一些要求。那么，我只有一个请求……请一直作为我的力量、我: You previously mentioned that I could make some requests of you. In that case, I have only one request... Please always be my strength, my support... Give me orders. Only in this way can I continue to persist. Is that okay, Conductor?
StoryText.……结束了。感谢您能够这样命令我。能被信赖的感觉真好……啊，被使用的感觉也是。: ...it's over. Thank you for being able to command me like this. It feels really good to be trusted... Ah, the feeling of being used as well.
StoryText.啊，又见面了……好高兴。: Ah, we meet again... I'm so happy.
StoryText.在你身边很舒服，想要多待一会儿。: Being around you is very comfortable, I want to stay a little longer.
StoryText.……这个不可以吃吗？啊……不好吃……: ……Can't I eat this? Ah... not tasty...
StoryText.亲一亲，痛痛飞走了~……这是波克士教我的，不适合吗？: Give it a kiss, and the pain will fly away~... This is what Box taught me, doesn't it fit?
StoryText.艾略特找不到她新买的游戏卡带了……她问是不是我吃掉了……可是那个味道很奇怪，我舔: Eliot couldn't find her newly bought game cartridge... She asked if I had eaten it... But it tasted strange, I just licked it and put it aside... It wasn't me...
StoryText.亮亮的、冷冷的箱子里有很多吃的。但吃了以后……好像就会有别的朋友哭……为什么？伤: In the bright, cold box, there is a lot of food. But after eating... it seems like other friends will cry... Why? Sad? Sorry... I won't eat directly in the future...
StoryText.衣服……少穿一些，比较舒服。穿太多的话……手全都被绑住了，就没有办法抱着你了。: Clothes... wear a little less, it's more comfortable. If you wear too much... your hands are all tied up, and there's no way to hold you.
StoryText.龙的尾巴去掉鳞片的话看上去会很美味。啊，列车长，不要难过，你去掉面具应该也会很好: If you remove the scales from a dragon's tail, it looks delicious. Ah, Conductor, don't be upset, you would probably taste good without your mask too... Eh, why that expression...
StoryText.实验器材……会用。但是为什么要用？现在已经可以全部理解朋友了。不会像那时候一样伤: Laboratory equipment... I know how to use it. But why use it? Now I can understand all my friends. I won't be sad like back then, so it's not needed anymore.
StoryText.餐桌礼仪……嗯……吃饭之前要说“我开动了”，吃完以后要说“谢谢款待”……还有……: Table manners... Hmm... Before eating, you should say "I will begin," and after finishing, you should say "Thank you for the meal"... Also... you must not eat off the plate. I remember.
StoryText.……有一次，睡觉的时候看见了桌子上面摆着一个小小的我。所以走过去，把她吃掉了……: ...One time, while sleeping, I saw a tiny version of myself on the table. So I went over and ate her... Now I am with myself forever.
StoryText.要吃我吗？可以。不管吃多少我都会马上变回来……不要吃？……哦……那，抱抱，可以？: Are you going to eat me? Sure. No matter how much you eat, I'll come back right away... Don't want to eat? ... Oh... then, can I have a hug?
StoryText.因为喜欢所以都想吃掉……但是不能吃掉列车长。因为只有一个列车长，吃掉就没了……在: Because I like it, I want to eat everything... But I can't eat the Conductor. There's only one Conductor, and if I eat him, he'll be gone... inside my stomach... he won't be able to talk, won't be able to hug, and will feel lonely.
StoryText.我还有很多很多要学的……比方说……想要一直一直在一起的心情是什么呢……？: I still have a lot to learn... For example, what is the feeling of wanting to be together forever...?
StoryText.没关系，不痛的，很快就好……: It's okay, it doesn't hurt, it'll be over soon...
StoryText.这时候应该说什么……晚安？: What should I say at this moment... Good night?
StoryText.我知道……你教过我的，要说“多谢款待”。: I know... you taught me to say "thank you for the hospitality."
StoryText.贵安，我是海伦娜，一位来自曼杜斯帝国的宝石魔法师——这是推荐信，这是见面礼，请收: Greetings, I am Helena, a gem magician from the Mundus Empire—here is my letter of recommendation, and this is a meeting gift. Please accept it, no need to be formal.
StoryText.我在这看会儿风景，需要什么的话就叫我。放心吧，我哪儿也不去。: I'll watch the scenery here for a while. If you need anything, just call me. Don't worry, I'm not going anywhere.
StoryText.哦，这是……宝石鉴定书啊。和帝国的鉴定证明有些类似……可惜我在这里只算一名籍籍无: Oh, this is... a gemstone appraisal certificate. It's somewhat similar to the certification from the Empire... Unfortunately, here I am just an obscure mage and cannot provide you with such an authoritative proof—however, I am confident I can do better than them, as long as you're willing to trust me.
StoryText.无论是打扫、泡茶、接待来客、照顾宠物——不好意思，这些我全部都不会做。不过我可以: Whether it's cleaning, making tea, entertaining guests, or taking care of a pet—sorry, I can't do any of these. However, I can use magic to handle all these chores, how about that?
StoryText.……嗯？为什么看着你笑？只是在观察你而已，顺便一提，我发现你努力工作时的侧脸很可: ...Hmm? Why am I smiling at you? I'm just observing you. By the way, I noticed that your profile looks very cute when you work hard.
StoryText.虽然善于发现美的眼睛很重要，但表达和阐述的口才也很重要哦。发现身边的美丽之物就应: While having an eye for discovering beauty is important, the ability to express and articulate it is also crucial. When you discover beautiful things around you, you should express your appreciation to others—this is my principle.
StoryText.我和奥莉薇恩认识很久了……在她还是个小丫头的时候，我就认识她啦。以前她练习剑术比: I have known Olivien for a long time... I knew her when she was just a little girl. She used to practice swordsmanship more diligently than tidying up her room, have I ever told you that?
StoryText.这是我在交易所的鉴定处买下的，拜托那位娃娃鱼商人现场开出来，果然是块漂亮的好料子: This is what I bought at the appraisal section of the Trading Center, and I asked that Salamander merchant to open it on the spot. It indeed turned out to be a beautiful piece of good material, and I'm giving it to you. Why? Well, there's no need for any special reason... Let's just say it's a "Good Kid Award" because I like you?
StoryText.地上和帝国的学校似乎没什么区别……无非是校规里的名词有些变化而已。呵呵，我上学的: The schools on the surface and in the Empire don't seem to be much different... It's just that some terms in the school rules have changed. Hehe, I did quite a few interesting things during my school days too.
StoryText.莉薇娅……从这段时间的相处来看，是个好孩子呢。要打比方的话，她就像是纯净无瑕、又: Livia... from the time we've spent together, she's a good child. If I were to make a comparison, she's like the pure and flawless, most precious high-grade diamond. You must not easily let go of that beautiful brilliance.
StoryText.怎么了？害怕一个人睡觉的话，我可以用宝石为你做一盏小夜灯……不是那个问题？要我陪: What's wrong? If you're afraid to sleep alone, I can make a small nightlight for you using a gem... That's not the issue? Do you want me to stay with you? Alright, I can't say no to you... but only for a little while.
StoryText.要尝一口吗，列车长？啊，我忘记了……行车期间不可以饮酒。等你有空休息了再来和我一: Would you like to have a taste, Conductor? Ah, I forgot... You can't drink alcohol while on duty. Come and taste it with me when you have some time to rest.
StoryText.宝石并不是永恒之物，就像我也不会是永恒之物一样……哎呀，看来你舍不得我。不用担心: Gems are not eternal, just like I won't be eternal either... Oh, it seems you can't bear to part with me. Don't worry, at least I'm still here for now.
StoryText.列车长……是啊，把你比作什么才好呢？之前我还不能确定，但现在我知道了。应该是陨铁: Conductor... Yes, what should I compare you to? Before, I couldn't be sure, but now I know. It should be meteoric iron, the special metal formed in a meteorite crater. Haha, of course, it's very beautiful and precious, no need to worry... You are a treasure that exists only in this world.
StoryText.这次要上一堂什么样的课呢……: What kind of lesson is going to be taught this time...?
StoryText.我已经掌握破解之法了。: I have already mastered the method to crack it.
StoryText.……战前准备不足，就当积累经验了。: ……Insufficient preparation before the battle, just treat it as gaining experience.
StoryText.我先退下了，你们别逞强。: I'll step back first. Don't push yourselves too hard.
StoryText.指挥得很好呀，对你刮目相看了！……好了，回去休息之前，陪我去篝火城里逛逛吧？: You commanded very well, I'm seeing you in a new light! …Alright, before going back to rest, how about accompanying me for a walk around Bonfire City?

But listen up, if you want to stay on top of the game, it's not just about working your butt off. You'll need some help from others too! Well, consider this your chance to shine! And you're welcome! As your nemesis, I can't let you leave the stage too soon, you know? Oh, by the way, it's just a coincidence that my train suddenly needs repairs! Don't ask unnecessary questions.

Our aim is to optimize your gaming experience and ensure smoother and more enjoyable in-game explorations in the future! We sincerely thank you for your understanding and patience!
content.亲爱的列车长：\\n经历了兵荒马乱的一天，不是吗？我也刚处理完许多工作。来信是因:
Dear Conductor,
It's been a rough day, right? I've been dealing with my fair share of issues too. I wanted to reach out because I heard about the serious gum supply accident on the Western Continent. Different conductors have reacted differently to this sudden mishap. But here's the thing: the cause of the incident was faulty work by the COLUMBA and its partners. So, it's crucial that appropriate actions are taken. The B.C.R.L. is on it now. We'll make sure those who took advantage of the accident face the consequences they deserve. And don't worry, the conductors who played by the rules will receive their well-deserved rewards. On behalf of COLUMBA, I want to express my utmost respect and appreciation for you. Please find the chewing gum for you attached.

After carefully considering the lessons learned from this accident, the COLUMBA has decided to mark March 12 as the annual COLUMBA Gum Day. Starting from next year, you'll receive gum on March 12 as a special token of remembrance.

Please keep in mind that this message is more of a personal treat from me. We'll be making a more formal announcement later on.

In the meantime, I wish you nothing but a safe and smooth journey through The Eternal.
Sincerely Yours, Columba.
content.亲爱的列车长：\\n今天一天真的辛苦了，日常生活被打乱的滋味不好受吧？而且一切的:
Dear Conductor,
Today must have been a tough day. It's never pleasant to have your daily routine disrupted, right? And it was all because of someone else's mistakes... Well, it's been a whirlwind, but finally, it's coming to an end, and things are slowly getting back to normal.
But here's what I really want to say! You, dear Conductor, have been an absolute hero in handling all these emergencies. You stayed true to your principles without wavering, and it's truly inspiring! It's like a realization, feels like... 'Ah, I knew our Conductor would never let us down!' Although I've confirmed this a thousand times during our journey, today that feeling hit me like never before.
You've been tirelessly working for The Eternal and the crew since day one, so I've been thinking... maybe it's time for you to take a break? Even if it's just a short vacation, it will be amazing. How about taking a stroll together in a place with a breathtaking view and fresh air?
I'll be dressed in my new clothes, Conductor, so please wait for me at the platform :)
content.列车长：\\n我听说了最近发生的一系列事件，也读过了铁盟内部关于事件的报告。报告:
Dear Conductor,
I've heard about the recent series of events and read the B.C.R.L. internal report regarding the incident. The report mentioned that you insisted on following the rules during this incident and did not engage in any illegal behavior for personal gain. The B.C.R.L. has decided to award a prize to conductors who followed the rules, and I happened to be present at the time. Therefore, I applied for a trophy on your behalf, as you truly deserve it.
It seems you haven't changed much over the years, and you're still the same good person I know so well.
Catch you later.

content.亲爱的列车长：\\n我准备了一点小小的心意，希望能成为列车长旅途顺利的一点助力。: Dear Conductor,\nI've prepared a little gift as a gesture of gratitude, and I hope it will come in handy on your journey. Let's keep being there for each other as we navigate the path ahead.
content.列车长，您的冰箱储存空间已满，下列多余道具暂无法存放，请查收。\\n请前往商会家: Dear Conductor, your refrigerator is full. The following items cannot be stored.\nPlease visit the COLUMBA and purchase additional storage slots for your refrigerator.
content.新专利的流程推进非常顺利，给你准备的一些试作武器也完成了。最近每次看到你给我带来:
The new patent process is going swimmingly, and the prototype weapons made for you are also completed. Lately, my mood has always lifted whenever I see the stuffed toy you brought me... Could it be that you've brought me good luck?

But staying too long in the laboratory gives me a headache, so I'll be heading back to my place now that work has concluded.

Since you belong to me, it's only right you come and see me today, yeah?
content.列车长，今天的“荚蒾”夜场本来有许多人预定……不过，想到要接待一位特殊的客人，我:
Conductor, 'Viburnum' was initially fully reserved tonight... but at the thought of receiving a special guest, I canceled them all! ❤

I'm emailing you now because you should be more or less done with work already, right? Are you free to come over? I've prepared lots of big surprises for you, and I can get you whatever it is you wish for!

So, I'll be waiting for you at Viburnum today... No matter if you show up or not, Arina will always be here.
content.又有段时间没能联系了，我最近在整顿中心执勤中，但你似乎没有来这里的必要……这也是: It's been a while since we last got in touch. Recently, I've been on duty at the Reforming Center, but it doesn't seem like you have a need to come here... That's a good thing too, I guess.\nI was planning to catch up with you on my day off, but you somehow crossed my mind today... Do you still remember that cake shop we always passed by during our schooling days? I found its branch in the city. Thankfully, we can finally afford a cake now.\n...Let's go try it the next time we meet, okay? That's all for now. I have to get back to work.
content.列车长！刚刚结束采购的时候，我看到街上有许多互赠鲜花和礼物的人。在路过商会时，墨: Conductor! I saw many people gifting each other flowers and presents on the street after I did my shopping earlier. When I passed by the COLUMBA, Miss Moirai told me today is one of the days that people aboveground express affection and gratitude to each other... She said she didn't know how this trend started, but everyone looked so happy. Any occasion that makes people feel blissful has got to be a good occasion!\n\nAnywho, I got you a little present. Please accept it! You ought to be showered with bliss too!
content.新的一周开始了呢，列车长此时一定在辛勤工作吧？但工作间隙务必抽空来酒吧多和亚莉奈: A new week has started, Conductor. You must be hard at work now, yeah? Still, it's a must to make some time and come to the bar more often to see me... There's not a day that goes by that I don't wish to see you.\n\nHere's a gift I prepared especially for you. Please accept it!

content.親愛的列車長：\\n隨著形態污染的深入，我們深知諸位列車長在行駛的路上，時常面臨: Dear Conductor,\nAs the morphic field pollution intensifies, it has come to our attention that you often encounter a scarcity of supplies during your explorations. In light of this, the headquarters of COLUMBA has prepared emergency provisions for you. We wish you the best in your endeavors!
content.親愛なる車掌様：\\nモーフィックフィールド汚染が進む中、各車掌様が運行中に物資: Dear Conductor:  As morphic field contamination progresses, we understand that many conductors frequently face shortages of supplies during operations. Therefore, the Columba Trading Company headquarters has prepared emergency supply support. Have a safe journey!
content.列車長：\\n我聽說了最近發生的一系列事件，也讀過了鐵盟內部關於事件的報告。報告:
Train Manager: 
I have heard about the series of events that occurred recently and have read the internal report by the Rail Alliance regarding the incidents. The report mentioned that you adhered to the rules during this incident and did not engage in cheating for personal gain. The Rail Alliance has decided to reward train managers who abide by the rules. I happened to be present at the time, so I applied for a trophy on your behalf as a squad leader; it is well-deserved. 
It seems you haven't changed much over the years, still the kind-hearted person I know. 
See you later.
content.おいおいおい：\\n最近君が相当活躍していると聞いたぞ。きっと僕が君に挑戦を仕掛: Hey, hey, hey:\nI've heard that you've been quite active lately. Surely, it's because I challenged you that you're so motivated, right? Let me give you a piece of advice: To keep standing on stage, you need not only your own efforts but also external help. I'll give you this spotlight opportunity. You don't have to thank me too much! As my opponent, you can't just exit early. By the way, it's purely coincidental that my train needed repairs, so don't overthink it.
content.エターナル号の車掌さんへのお知らせです。アニタとハンザキ同盟が最新の協力協定を結: Notification to the conductor of the Eternal. Due to the latest cooperation agreement between Anita and the Hanzaki Alliance, a new trading post has been established at Wasteland Station. Please feel free to stop by when you have time.
content.車掌さん：\\nこれから、よろしくお願いしますね～: Conductor: \nFrom now on, let's work well together～
content.親愛的列車長：\\n恭喜您作為科倫巴商會的一員正式上任。商會為您提供了一筆啟動資: Dear Conductor,\nCongratulations, you are now an official member of COLUMBA! The Chamber of Commerce has provided you with start-up funds to assist you in your future operations. Wish you the best of luck on your journey ahead!
content.親愛なる車掌様：\\nこの度、貴方がコロンバ商会の一員として正式に就任されました: Dear Conductor:\nWe would like to extend our congratulations on your official appointment as a member of the Columba Trading Company. The company will provide startup support funds to assist with future train operations. May your journey be smooth and successful.
content.無垠號列車長：\\n根據阿妮塔能源公司與娃娃魚商會最新簽署的合作協定，荒原站增設: Train Conductor of Infinity:\nAccording to the latest cooperation agreement signed between Anita Energy Company and the Salamander Chamber of Commerce, a new Trading Center has been added at Wilderness Station. Please come by and have a look when you have time.
content.意外だったか？こんなに早く再会できるとは！我は今、シュグリシティにいるぞ。時間が: Was it unexpected? To be able to meet again so soon! I am currently in Shuguri City. If you have time, let's meet again at the address below, my dear friend!
content.親愛なる車掌さん：\\nささやかな気持ちを用意しました。これが車掌さんの旅の順調: Dear Conductor:\nI have prepared a small token of my appreciation. I hope this contributes to the smoothness of your journey. Let's continue to support each other and walk together on this path.
content.沒想到吧？重逢來的那麼快！吾現在就在修格里城內，有空的話就來下面這個地址與吾再會: Didn't expect it, did you? Our reunion has come so quickly! I am now in Shoggolith City. If you have time, come to the address below and meet me again, dear friend!
content.呀呼列车长～短暂的假期结束，有没有感觉完全不想返工？不过我相信列车长一定会打起精: Hey there! Conductor! Your short break is up! Not quite ready to head back to work, right? But I bet you'll feel pumped to get back on track, because you're the rockstar Conductor around here!\nWe've got a little surprise waiting for you from everyone! Swing by Yunxiu Bridge whenever you can and let's hang out for a bit!
content.亲爱的列车长，请查收确认您的购买商品如下：: Dear Conductor, please find the details of your purchase below:
content.親愛なる車掌様、商品の内容にお間違いなどないかご確認くださいませ：: Dear Conductor, please confirm there are no discrepancies in the product details:
content.喂喂喂：\\n聽說你最近相當活躍，想必全靠我向你提出了挑戰，才讓你這樣幹勁十足吧: Hey, hey!\nYou've been hustling hard lately, right? I've got to say, it's all thanks to my challenge that got you all fired up, huh? But listen up, if you want to stay on top of the game, it's not just about working your butt off. You'll need some help from others too! Well, consider this your chance to shine! And you're welcome! As your nemesis, I can't let you leave the stage too soon, you know? Oh, by the way, it's just a coincidence that my train suddenly needs repairs! Don't ask unnecessary questions.
content.列車長：\\n我這邊就拜託你啦。今後請多關照。: Conductor:\nHey there, glad to meet you! I'll be counting on you!
content.祝い無料ゲームランキング1位達成！\\nこの度『レゾナンス：無限号列車』がApp:
Celebration for Achieving First Place in Free Game Rankings!
We are pleased to announce that "Resonance: Infinity Express" has achieved first place in the App Store's free download rankings!

Thank you very much for the support from all our conductors!

As a token of our gratitude, we present "Laplace Agreement*2", "Mixed Crystal*200", and "Iron Alliance Coin*200,000"!!
content.車掌様、%sに報告された案件が%sによって無事に完了しました、どうぞお早めに受け: Conductor, the case reported to %s has been successfully completed by %s. Please come and receive it as soon as possible.
content.車掌様、冷蔵庫の容量が足りません。下記の余分なものはしばらく保存できません、ご査: Conductor, the refrigerator's capacity is insufficient. The following extra items cannot be stored for a while, please check.\nYou can expand the refrigerator's capacity by purchasing a refrigerator from the furniture store of the chamber of commerce.
content.車掌様、倉庫の容量が足りません、こちらはあなたの落し物です。: Conductor, there is not enough warehouse capacity, this is your lost item.
content.親愛なる車掌様、新しいトラベラー手帳が発行されました。こちらは前期手帳の残りの進: Dear Conductor, a new Traveler's Handbook has been issued. Here are the remaining progress rewards from the previous handbook. Please be sure to collect them promptly.
content.親愛なる車掌様、これまでのご支援とご協力、誠にありがとうございます。さあ、出発し: Dear Conductor, thank you very much for your support and cooperation so far. Now, let's depart!
content.「エターナル号」の運行過程において様々な不具合が発生し、車掌様のゲーム体験の快適:
Various malfunctions occurred during the operation of the Eternal, compromising the comfort of your gaming experience as the conductor. We sincerely apologize for this.

As compensation, we will send you 10 Laplace Agreements via email.

If you have any questions or need further assistance, please feel free to contact us at resonance_jp@gameduchy.com at any time.

We hope you continue to enjoy Resonance: Infinity Train.
We sincerely apology for various issues occurred during the operation of the Eternal and affected your gaming experience.
content.鉄盟とアニタが共同で立ち上げた西大陸建設プロジェクトが正式に開始されました。フリ: The Western Continent Construction Project jointly launched by Tetsumou and Anita has officially commenced. The Iron Security Bureau of Freeport VII is looking forward to the participation of conductors with a security cooperation qualification certificate in the construction project support plan. Let's work together to build a wonderful future for the Western Continent.
content.尊敬的列车长，您共享的订单【%s】，已被您的好友【%s】完成。这是您的奖励，请及: Dear Conductor, the order you shared [%s] has been completed by your friend [%s]. Here are your rewards, please check them in time!
content.共享订单限时1小时，超时的订单已被系统回收。如果连续多次未完成共享订单，将会限制: Shared orders must be completed within 1 hour. Overdue orders have been automatically canceled. Failure to complete shared orders repeatedly will result in restrictions on accepting new shared orders.
content.親愛的列車長，請查收確認您的購買商品:: Dear Conductor, please check and confirm your purchased items:
content.恭喜你列车长！铁盟通知我你已经获得了铁盟哨站的访问许可，现在你可以随时拜访铁盟哨: Congratulations, Conductor! The BCRL Outpost just gave the green light for you to swing by its outpost whenever you like!\nAnd here's a little something for you! So, drop by more often, will you? ☆
content.亲爱的列车长，为你准备的【虚演刻录】功能现已调试完毕，随时可以运行。我特意为你准: Dear Conductor, the Calculation Recording feature is all set up for you now. I've prepared enough simulation materials so that you can thoroughly enjoy the fun.\nPlease swing by when you are idle. I'll always be excited for your visits.
content.尊敬的列车长，由于您一直以来的辛勤工作和出色表现，现特向无垠号CBCRR23列车: Dear Conductor, your diligence and top-notch performance have earned the entire crew of the Eternal CBCRR23 access to the [Advertising] feature in the Passenger Transport system.\nPlease maintain your spirit and keep pushing forward, making a great contribution to the railroad and passenger transportation.
content.无垠号的列车长，特大好消息！云岫桥基地的整顿中心现在开放对外承包啦，到站即可咨询: Wonderful news, Conductor! The Reforming Center in the Base Yunxiu Bridge is now open for contracting! Visit my station to learn more about the details!\nTo sweeten the deal, I'm is now giving you ten super-helpful Support Tickets verified by Paladi herself, the awesome administrator here (it's me, by the way)! Swing by at any time!
content.阿妮塔能源公司现已向列车长执照等级达到40级的列车长开放站点【阿妮塔战备工厂】。: Anita Energy Company has granted all conductors above level 40 access to Anita Weapon Factory.\nPlease step into Anita Weapon Factory for top-notch armament.
content.シャショー、おめでと！アタシ、鉄盟からのメッセージはもう読んだよ！すでに鉄路同盟: Conductor, congratulations! I've already read the message from the Iron Union! You've obtained permission to visit the Iron Alliance Forward Base, as expected, you're amazing! This means you can invite me out anytime!\nAlright, alright! To the Conductor who worked hard on various things, I'll give a special gift! From now on, please come and visit often~☆!
content.親愛なる車掌様、あなたのために用意した【虚演刻録】機能は既にデバッグが完了しまし: Dear Conductor, the "Imaginary Performance Recording" feature prepared for you has already been debugged. You can experience it at any time. We have also prepared enough blank videotapes, so we believe you will be able to enjoy its essence even more. \nPlease feel free to come and experience it yourself. We are always waiting here for you.
content.親愛なる車掌様、これまでの勤勉さと際立った活躍ぶりにより、現在エターナル号CBC: Dear Conductor, due to your diligence and outstanding performance, we are now granting the CBCRR23 Transport Team of the Eternal Train the authority for free guest transport between Bonfire City. \nAs the conductor of the Eternal Train, we hope you will remain mindful of your initial intentions, continue to improve and advance, safeguard the harmony along the West Continent Railway, and make even greater contributions to promoting the development of the guest transport business.
content.エターナル号の車掌、大変素晴らしいお知らせだ！云岫橋基地の整備センターは最近外部: The conductor of the Eternal, I have great news! The maintenance center at Yunxiu Bridge Base has recently opened up to external contracts! You can inquire about the commissions when you arrive~!\nTo show how serious the maintenance center is about gathering contractors, I'm giving away ten special Super Help Tickets issued by me, Paradis! Make sure you come!
content.アニタ・テクノロジーは車掌レベル40に達した車掌様に対し、傘下の【アニタ武器研究: Anita Technology will open its subsidiary [Anita Weapons Research Institute] to conductors who have reached Conductor Level 40. \nAt Anita Energy, we are always engaged in the research and development of train armaments. Conductors are always welcome to visit the Anita Weapons Research Institute.
content.恭喜你列車長！鐵盟通知我你已經獲得了鐵盟哨站的訪問許可，現在你可以隨時拜訪鐵盟哨: Congratulations, Train Captain! The Iron League informed me that you have been granted access to the Iron League Outpost. Now you can visit the Iron League Outpost anytime! \nI've included a little gift with this message. Make sure to come and visit me often~☆!
content.親愛的列車長，為你準備的【虛演刻錄】功能現已調試完畢，隨時可以運行。我特意為你準: Dear Train Conductor, the [Virtual Performance Recording] feature prepared for you has been fully debugged and is ready to operate at any time. I have specially prepared a sufficient amount of blank recording material for you in the hope that you can better enjoy the fun within.\nPlease be sure to come and experience it yourself; I am always looking forward to your arrival.
content.親愛的列車長，由於您一直以來的辛勤工作和出色表現，現特向無垠號CBCRR23列車: Dear Train Conductor, due to your hard work and outstanding performance, we are now granting access to the Passenger System's [Advertisement Placement] function for the CBCRR23 Infinity Train set as an encouragement.\nWe hope that the conductor of the Infinity Train remains true to the original aspiration, continues to forge ahead, and makes greater contributions to maintaining a harmonious railway environment and promoting the development of the railway passenger transport industry.
content.無垠號的列車長，特大好消息！雲岫橋基地的整頓中心現在開放對外承包啦，到站即可諮詢: Conductor of the Boundless, great news! The reorganization center at the Yunxiu Bridge base is now open for external contracting. You can inquire about contract matters upon arrival~\nTo show the sincerity of the reorganization center in recruiting contractors, I'm giving you ten Super Helper Coupons signed by the person in charge, Paladi (me)! Be sure to come and get them!
content.阿妮塔能源公司現已向列車長執照等級達到40級的列車長開放站點【阿妮塔戰備工廠】。: Anita Energy Corporation has now opened the site [Anita Armament Factory] to conductors with a license level of 40 or above. \nCommitted to developing more elite weaponry, Anita Armament Factory welcomes your visit.
content.열차장님, 새로운 여행 수첩이 발행되었습니다. 지난 시즌 수첩 임무 완료: Trainmaster, a new travel journal has been issued. We have sent the unclaimed rewards from last season's journal mission completion, so please make sure to receive them.
content.사랑하는 열차장님, 구매하신 상품이 도착하였습니다.\\n공명 코인의 경우: Dear Train Manager, the product you purchased has arrived.\nIn the case of Resonance Coins, you can check your held Resonance Coins on the product payment screen rather than in the bag.
content.무한호 열차장님:\\n아니타 에너지 사와 피쉬 상회가 최근에 체결한 협력: Head Conductor of the Infinity Train:\nDue to the recent cooperation agreement between Anitta Energy Corporation and Fish Trading Company, a new exchange has been added at Hwangwon Station. Please visit when you have time.
content.축하해, 열차장! 열차장이 철도연맹 초소의 방문 허가를 받았다고 통지가: Congratulations, Trainmaster! A notification has arrived that you have received permission to visit the Railway Federation Outpost. Now you can visit the Railway Federation Outpost anytime!\nI've also sent a small gift along with the letter. Come visit often~☆!
content.親愛的列車長，感謝您一直以來的支持與陪伴。現在，讓我們出發吧。: Dear Conductor, thank you for your continued support and companionship. Now, it's time to get going.
content.아니타 에너지 사에서 열차장님들을 향해 [아니타 군수공장] 역을 개방합니: Anita Energy Corporation opens the [Anita Munitions Factory] station to conductors.\nAnita, dedicated to more precise weapon development, awaits your visit.
content.이렇게 빨리 다시 만나게 될 줄은 생각도 못했지? 나 지금 슈그리스시 안: Didn't expect to meet again so soon, did you? I'm inside Seugrisisi right now, so if you have time, come find me at the address below!
content.열차장님:\\n심각한 형태 오염으로 인해 물자 부족 상황이 이어지고 있습: Train Manager:\nDue to severe contamination, there is an ongoing shortage of supplies. Therefore, the Columba Trading Company's headquarters is providing emergency supplies, so please receive them.
content.열차장님:\\n앞으로 잘 부탁드립니다~: Train conductor:\nI look forward to working with you~
content.열차장님, 창고가 가득 차서 초과된 아이템을 아래에 보관해 드렸으니 수령: Train conductor, the storage is full, so we have stored the excess items below. Please collect them.
content.열차장님:\\n앞으로의 여정을 응원하는 마음을 담아 작은 선물을 준비해: Train Manager:\nI have prepared a small gift for you with encouragement for your future journey, and I hope you will receive it.
content.존경하는 열차장님, 지금까지 성실한 노력과 뛰어난 활약을 보여주셨기에 무: Dear Train Manager, because you have shown sincere effort and outstanding performance so far, we are opening the [Advertising Distribution] feature under the passenger transportation system to the CBCRR23 Infinite Train Team. \nWe ask that you continue moving forward without losing your initial resolve, maintain a harmonious railway environment, and contribute to the development of the passenger transportation business.
content.친애하는 열차장님, 당신을 위해 준비한 [버추얼 레코드]가 기능 테스트를: Dear Trainmaster, the [Virtual Records] prepared for you have completed their functionality test. I have provided plenty of blank record materials, so feel free to come and enjoy them at any time.\nI sincerely hope you will personally come and experience it. I will be waiting until you arrive.
content.열차장님, %s에서 신고한 사건이 %s에 의해 접수되었습니다. 해당 화면: Train manager, the incident reported at %s has been received by %s. Please move to the relevant screen to verify it.
content.열차장님, 그동안 레조넌스에 대한 성원과 관심에 감사드립니다. 지금 바로: Train Conductor, thank you for your support and interest in Resonance. Let's begin the train journey right away.
content.열차장님, 냉장고가 가득 차서 초과된 아이템을 우편으로 발송해 드렸으니: Conductor, the refrigerator is full, so we have sent the excess items to you by mail. Please receive them.\nRefrigerator storage space can be purchased at the furniture shop in the mall.
content.親愛的列車長：\\n我準備了一點小小的心意，希望能成為列車長旅途順利的一點助力。: Dear Conductor,\nI've prepared a little gift as a gesture of gratitude, and I hope it will come in handy on your journey. Let's keep being there for each other as we navigate the path ahead.
content.열차장:\\n듣자니 요즘 상당히 활약하고 있다던데, 아마도 내가 도전장을: Train Conductor:\nI hear you've been quite active lately. Maybe it's thanks to my challenge that you're so motivated? Let me give you a piece of advice: to survive long, you need not just your own efforts but also external support. As my only rival, you must neither give up easily nor back down. By the way, it was just a coincidence that my train broke down, so don't ask anything.
content.무한호 열차장, 좋은 소식이야! 운수교 기지의 교정센터에서 외부의 도급을: Infiniteho Train Manager, good news! The Correction Center at the Transport Bridge Base has started taking external contracts. When you arrive at the station, you can inquire about contract agreements~\nTo show appreciation for contractors at the Correction Center, we'll gift you a Super Help Coupon issued by the representative, Paradi! You must come!
content.恭喜你，无垠号的列车长！不对，该说是恭喜我才对……总之蜃息岛的经营权限已经移交给: Congratulations, Conductor of The Eternal! No, it should be congratulations to me instead... Anyway, the management rights of Mirage Island have been transferred to you. Come and take a look at the island! Recently, a series of strange events have occurred, and it seems like the CRs have increased in number. It would be great if you could find a way to solve this!\nSee you later! This is a Material Voucher from COLUMBA, I've brought it for you!
content.열차장님:\\n콜룸바 상회의 일원으로 정식 임명되신 것을 축하드립니다!: Train Manager:\nCongratulations on being officially appointed as a member of the Columba Trading Company! We have provided you with startup funds to support your future journey, so please make sure to receive them.
content.刚刚接到铁盟上级来信，通知我说你已经获得了铁盟的委派巡逻许可。发这封邮件是为了把: Just got word from my higher-up in the B.C.R.L. that you've scored a commissioned patrol permit. I'm sending this mail to deliver the grants as well as my congratulations.\nKeep up the great work going forward.
content.[本邮件为学会公务账号群发请勿回复]\\n已向特定对象发放访问许可，允许列车及随: [This is an automated email from the Citadel's official account. Please do not reply.]\nSpecial access has been granted for the train and crew to enter the Confluence Tower.\nIn addition, please find Cactus Lollipops attached.
content.海角城现已向无垠号CBCRR23列车组发放篝火城通行权限\\n预祝贵列车组在海角: Cape City has granted the Eternal CBCRR23 crew access to bonfire cities!\nWish you a fantastic journey in Cape City! Meow!
content.おめでとう、エターナル号の車掌！いや、喜ぶべき奴は俺じゃねえか……とにかく、蜃息: Congratulations, conductor of the Eternal! No, shouldn't I be the one celebrating... Anyway, I've already transferred the management rights of Shinsokujima to you, so come over quickly! Recently, a series of mysterious events have been occurring, and it seems the Hybrid presence has increased quite a bit, but if you could manage it somehow, it would be a great help! \nWell then, I'll wait for a while! By the way, I've also sent you some material vouchers from the Colomba Trading Company!
Congratulations, Infinity Train Conductor! Oh no, actually, I'm the one who should be congratulated... Anyway, I've handed over the management rights of Clam Island to you, so hurry and check out the island! There seem to be strange happenings lately, and it looks like there are more Betula life forms. I hope you can resolve it!\nSee you next time! This is a materials voucher from the Columba Trading Company. Accept it well!
content.剛剛接到鐵盟上級來信，通知我說你已經獲得了鐵盟的委派巡邏許可。發這封郵件是為了把: I just received a letter from the Iron Alliance superior, informing me that you have been granted a patrol permit by the Iron Alliance. I am sending this email to send you the subsidy and to extend my congratulations.\nWell done, keep up the good work in the future.
content.たった今、鉄盟の上層部から、あなたが鉄盟の委託任務資格を得たとの連絡を受けたわ。: Just now, I received a message from the upper management of Tetsumē that you've obtained the qualification for commissioned missions. This email is partly to send you a subsidy and also to congratulate you... Anyway, well done. I believe you'll continue to do your best.
content.방금 철도연맹 상부에서 당신이 철도연맹의 순찰 파견 허가를 받았다는 통지: A notification just came down from the upper management of the Railroad Union that you have been granted permission for a patrol dispatch by the Railroad Union. This letter is sent to provide you with a subsidy. And congratulations.\nYou did very well. Please continue to work hard in the future.
content.エターナル号CBCRR23列車全員に、既にケープシティの訪問許可を与えたぞ。 \: To all passengers of the Eternal CBC RR23 train, you have already been granted permission to visit Cape City. \nI hope you will enjoy a wonderful journey of knowledge in Cape City, nya!
content.케이프시에서 CBCRR23 열차팀에게 본파이어 시티 통행권을 발급해 드립: In Cape City, the CBCRR23 train team will be issued a Bonfire City transit pass.\nWe hope your train team enjoys a journey full of book scents in Cape City. Meow!
content.[当該メールはソース学会の事務用メールアドレスによる一括送信なので、ご返信は不要: [This email is a mass transmission from the office email address of the Citadel, so no reply is necessary] \nAccess permission has been granted to specific individuals, allowing all train personnel and crew members to visit the Confluence Tower.\nPlease check the cactus lollipop in the attached file.
content.[시타델의 공식 계정에서 발송한 우편입니다. 회신하지 마세요.]\\n이: [This is a mail sent from the official Citadel account. Do not reply.]\nThe train and accompanying personnel with this visit permit can visit [Flow Tower] station.\nWe have attached cactus energy candy, please check it.
content.为了表彰你们之前没有对本夏尔大人做出太过分的举动，给你发点大姐二姐送给我的物资！: Hey, you! Remember when you weren't too rude to the mighty Shire the last time? Well, I'm sending you some supplies from my sisters!\nBUT! Next time we meet, don't expect me to be as friendly!!!
content.欢迎来到淘金乐园，开拓者的梦想之所！\\n请收下这份访客礼物！\\n发掘金子，发: Welcome to ONEderland, where all pioneers' dreams come alive!\nHere's a little gift for you!\n Embark on a journey to uncover treasures and chase your dreams!
content.别以为这就算我认输了……我们之间的胜负才刚刚开始！\\n这是此前比试中输给你的代: Hey, don't take this as me admitting defeat... Our battle is only just beginning!\nConsider this a little token for losing to you last time. Just hold on to it!\nRemember, this is not over yet! When I'm geared up for another round, I'll definitely return to challenge you again!
content.これで俺が負けを認めたと思わないでよ！俺たちの勝負はまだ始まったばかりだ！\\n: Don't think I've admitted defeat with this! Our battle has just begun!\nThis is the spoils of victory you earned from our last match, go ahead and take it!\nI won't forget about this. Once I'm ready for a new match, I'll definitely call on you again!
content.別以為這就算我認輸了……我們之間的勝負才剛剛開始！\\n這是此前比試中輸給你的代: Don't think that this means I've admitted defeat... The contest between us has only just begun!\nThis is the price for losing to you in the previous competition, take it!\nI won't forget this experience. Once I have a new competition project ready, I'll definitely come find you again!
content.내가 이대로 패배를 인정할 거라 생각하지 마… 진정한 승부는 이제 시작이: Don't think I'll admit defeat just like this… The real battle starts now!\nThis is what you get for winning, take it well!\nI will never forget this. When a new challenge is ready, I'll definitely come back, so wait for me!
content.あんたたちがこの前、このシャール様に対して過度な行動を取らなかったことを讃えて、: I commend you for not taking excessive action against Lord Sharl the last time, so I'll send you supplies from my sister!\nNext time we meet, I won't be this kind!
content.为了表彰你们之前没有对本夏尔大人做出太过分的举动，给你发点大姐二姐送给我的物资！: To commend you for not having taken excessive actions against Lord Shire before, I'm giving you some supplies that my eldest and second eldest sisters sent me! \n Next time we meet, don't think I'll be this courteous again!!!
content.너희들이 이 샤이어님한테 과분하게 행동하지 않은 것에 대한 보답으로 큰: As a reward for not behaving excessively toward Shire-nim, I will send you the supplies that Big Sister and Little Sister gave!\nDon't expect to receive such treatment the next time we meet!
content.開拓者の夢の楽園ーーワンダーランドへようこそ\\nこれは来訪者へのプレゼントです:
Welcome to the pioneers' dream paradise—Wonderland

This is a gift for visitors, please accept it.

Dig for gold, dig for dreams.
content.欢迎来到淘金乐园，开拓者的梦想之所！/n请收下这份访客礼物！/n发掘金子，发掘梦: Welcome to ONEderland, the dream place of pioneers!\nPlease accept this Visitor gift!\nDiscover gold, discover dreams.
content.개척자들이 꿈꾸는 곳, 골드 원더랜드에 오신 것을 환영합니다!\\n방문객: Welcome to Gold Wonderland, the place pioneers dream of!\nPlease accept the gift we have for visitors!\nIn search of gold, in search of dreams!
content.『レゾナンス：無限号列車』公式LINEスタンプ第一弾「フラン＆エリオット篇」が発: The official release for 'Resonance Solstice' LINE Stamps – Vol.1 'Fran & Elliot Edition', is now open!\nPlease purchase the item from the sales page linked below, or by searching 'Resonance: Box's Observation Diary' in the search box in the stamp shop.\n▶ To Sales Pages
content.『レゾナンス：無限号列車』公式LINEスタンプ第1弾「フラン＆エリオット篇」が発: The first official LINE stickers for "Resonance: Infinity Train" featuring "Fran & Elliot Edition" have been released!\nSearch for "Resonance 'Box Observation Diary'" on the sales page below or in the sticker shop, and be sure to get them and try them out.\n▶Here's the sales page
content.亲爱的列车长，您在【虚演刻录】中表现卓越，为您补发以下奖励：夏洛蒂专属头像【高洁: Dear Conductor, thank you for your exceptional performance in the Calculation Recording. Attached is the unclaimed reward for you: Charlotte's exclusive avatar – Dignified Knight's Portrait.
content.亲爱的列车长，您在【虚演刻录】中表现卓越，为您补发以下奖励：妮蔻拉专属头像【代理: Dear Conductor, thank you for your exceptional performance in the Calculation Recording. Attached is the unclaimed reward for you: Nicola's exclusive avatar – Acting Director's Portrait.
content.亲爱的列车长，您在【虚演刻录】中卓越表现，为您补发以下奖励：妮蔻拉专属头像【代理: Dear Conductor, due to your excellent performance in [Calculation Recording], we're granting you the following reward: Nicola's exclusive avatar [Image of the Deputy Director]. Please check it promptly.
content.親愛なる車掌様、「虚演刻録」での素晴らしい活躍に感謝し、以下の限定報酬を追加させ: Dear Conductor, we appreciate your amazing performance in "Virtual Performance Chronicle" and are pleased to add the following limited-time reward: a Charlotte-exclusive icon. Please accept it.
content.[本邮件为学会公务账号群发请勿回复\\n已向特定对象发放访问许可，允许列车及随车: [This is an automated email from the Citadel's official account. Please do not reply.]\nSpecial access has been granted for the train and crew to enter the Apoaster Bridge.\nIn addition, please find Cactus Lollipops attached.
content.列車長，您的冰箱儲存空間已滿，下列多餘道具暫無法存放，請查收。\\n請前往商會傢: Train conductor, your refrigerator storage space is full, and the following extra items cannot be stored for now. Please check.\nPlease go to the Chamber of Commerce Furniture Store to purchase a refrigerator to increase the storage space for refrigerated items.
content.列车长：\\n列车长！花了一番功夫，总算把这挺机枪修好啦！虽然是商会委托的工作，: Hey there, conductor!\nIt was a bit of a hassle, but I finally got this machine gun all fixed up! The COLUMBA asked me to fix this and deliver it straight to you. Feel free to use it whenever you need it!\nWishing you a safe journey ahead!
content.車掌！最近、嵐心城の近くで予想外の混乱があったって聞いたけど、列車用の大型武器が: Conductor! I heard there was some unexpected confusion near Arashin City recently, and you needed heavy weapons for the train. Responding to the requests from the company and the Iron League, I've repaired this autocannon. It can be installed anytime if needed!\nTake care on your journey!
content.親愛的列車長：\\n感謝您積極參與蜃息島的開拓與建設。為了讓您可以更順利的執行發:
Dear Train Conductor:
Thank you for actively participating in the development and construction of Mirage Island. To help you execute the development plan more smoothly, we will be providing you with supply materials over the next 7 days.

Once again, thank you for your support. We wish Infinite a brave journey ahead!

Sincerely yours, Mission Accomplished
Columba Chamber of Commerce
content.親愛なる車掌様：\\nゲーム中に発生した一部の異常エラーにより、車掌様の運転体験: Dear Conductor,\nWe sincerely apologize for the impact on your driving experience caused by certain abnormal errors that occurred during the game. As part of our compensation, we are releasing an update patch. We hope this will provide a better gaming experience and make future operations smoother and more enjoyable. We are truly grateful for your understanding and patience.
content.列車長：\\n列車長！花了一番功夫，總算把這挺機槍修好啦！雖然是商會委託的工作，: Conductor:\nConductor! After some effort, I finally managed to fix this machine gun! Although it was a job commissioned by the Chamber of Commerce, they said it could be delivered directly to you. If you need it, you can install it anytime!\nWish you a safe journey!
content.열차장: \\n열차장! 내가 큰 힘을 들여서 드디어 이 기관총을 수리했어: Train Manager: \nTrain Manager! I finally managed to repair this machine gun with great effort! They said I should send it directly to you from the shop. Feel free to mount it on the train whenever you need!\nTravel safely!
content.親愛なる車掌様：\\nこれまでのご理解とご支援、誠にありがとうございます。旧暦新: Dear Conductor:\nThank you very much for your understanding and support so far. As we welcome the Lunar New Year, I would like to extend my heartfelt greetings to you! We are sending you a bonus code, so please enjoy your gaming time!\n25CHUNJIEKL
content.亲爱的列车长：\\n佳节将至，祝愿列车长们新春快乐~蛇年大吉！感谢列车长一直以来: Dear Conductor:\nWith the festive season around the corner, we're sending warm greetings to all conductors out there! Wishing you a fantastic new year in the Year of the Snake! Here's a special Chinese New Year Eve's redemption code for you! Have a joyful journey ahead!\n25CHUNJIEKL
content.咳咳，10RoundsGame开发的街机新模式无垠乱斗发布了，你已经试玩过了吗？: Ahem, the new arcade game The Eternal Scuffle developed by 10RoundsGame has been released. Have you tried it yet? I hear many people say tokens are not enough... As an opening bonus, I'll give you a few more. Remember to tell me your feedback, Conductor!
content.亲爱的无垠号CBCRR23号列车长，由本商会和10RoundsGames联合发行: Dear Conductor of the Eternal CBCRR23, the board game "Rumbling Monopolis" co-created by COLUMBA and 10 Rounds Games is now available for play. On this holiday season, we hope you can relive your adventures in the Western Continent from last year and the moments shared with your crew.\nJoin us in Rumbling Monopolis now!
content.亲爱的列车长，\\n\\n上午出门采购的时候路过了靛红五月的门店，注意到有许多年:
Dear Conductor,

While I was out shopping this morning, I passed Carmine May and noticed a long line of young people. Upon asking, I learned that today holds special significance for the people of the Western Continent.
The queue was too lengthy, and I feared it would disrupt my schedule, so I didn't join the commotion...
However, after my return to the Eternal, Fran noticed my distracted demeanor. Well, she's always astute... So, I confessed that I hadn't bought the gift intended for you today, then she kindly offered to guide me in making one using the ingredients on the Eternal.

Well, that about sums it up. If you find it delicious, I'll whip up another one for you next year. You are the most special one in my life, Conductor.
content.列车长，\\n\\n铁安局又发节日礼了，我这边多了一份，卡莲说要减肥，朱利安喜欢:
Conductor,

Once again, the BCRL Agency sent us holiday gifts, and I ended up with an extra batch. Karen is on a diet, Julian prefers bitter treats, and Dorothy got hers from Chief Heinrich. So, I'll just pass this on to you.
The flavor isn't half bad, it seems. Let me know your thoughts after giving it a try.

Shizuru
content.我的爱人：\\n\\n虽然几乎每天都能见面，但节日还是需要一些特别的仪式感呀。提:
My Love,

Even though we see each other almost every day, special occasions deserve that extra touch of magic, don't they? I put some thought into this, hoping it brings you joy. And the ingredients in this chocolate? They're not your everyday fare, you know?
Being with you, dear conductor, fills me with pure bliss... These moments are the ones I cherish most. I wish they could last forever...

Will you join me at Viburnum tonight too? I'll be waiting for you with bated breath.
content.救世主大人~\\n\\n乌刹娜在篝火城里帮忙的时候听说大家都会在这一天都会互相送:
Master Savior!

While I was helping my friends at Bonfire City, I heard that everyone shares chocolates on this special day. I totally remember seeing people sharing chocolates before!
So, I went up to the giant fish at the trading center and asked for some stuff to make this gift! I added mint, strawberries, watermelon, blueberries, apples... and loads and loads more! It turned out super colorful, bright, and oh-so cute!
 Time to dig in and munch away! Yum, yum!

Ushana
content.列车长，\\n之前学会的孩子们拿着海角城的甜品店发的套餐促销传单，问为什么在我的:
Dear Conductor,
The young scholars from the Citadel came to me with a promotional flyer from the dessert shop, wondering why chocolates were being sold in special bundles with lovely wrappings on my birthday.
It was in that moment that I discovered I share my birthday with such a unique event.
It's quite a rare occurrence when Mr. Dustin and Sommer aren't out on field operations, so we decided to treat ourselves to a chocolate cake.
I made sure to save a slice for you too. Wishing you joy on this special day.

Nayuta
content.黑铁之主啊！\\n\\n欢庆吧！喜悦吧！此即为地上的人们散播爱恋与感谢之情的节日:
O, Lord of Black Iron!

Rejoice! Rejoice! The time has come for the denizens of the earth to exalt and impart their love and gratitude. For this special occasion, I, Jumakenki, have meticulously crafted a keepsake just for you!
To create this keepsake, I journeyed far and wide, seeking counsel from the Erudite Sage of Yore, the Sanctified Wings of the Wind, and the Tailor of the Royal Court! After much deliberation, I imbued this keepsake with six potent blessings with my very own hands! To savor this divine artifact is to be graced with my benedictions...
Anyway... In short... you mustn't share this with others! Keep it all to yourself, got it?

Next time, I'll whip up something even more amazing for you! And don't forget to share your thoughts after tasting it!

Jumakenki
content.列车长，\\n\\n最近研发新品的时候偶然被谁提醒节日就要到了，所以顺手给现有的:
Conductor,

While I was working on a new product recently, the holiday season's arrival inspired me to enhance the chocolates in the current Anita rations. Before wrapping up the patent application, your name crossed my mind, so I decided to share a sample with you. Remember to provide feedback on the taste and, if possible, draft a tasting report.

Once you've finished your report, don't hesitate to bring it to me for review, and if writing isn't your strong suit... present yourself to me instead.

I could really use a special assistant during this holiday.
content.車掌、\\n鉄安局からまた祝日のギフトが届いて、ちょうど余った分を一つもらったわ:
Conductor,
Another holiday gift has arrived from the Railway Safety Bureau, and I happened to get an extra one. Another holiday gift has arrived from the Railway Safety Bureau, and I got one too. Karen is on a diet, Julian likes bitter things, and Dorothy said she doesn't need one since there's already one for Chief Heinrich. So, I've decided to give it to you.
I think the taste is okay, so let me know your thoughts once you've tried it.

Shizuru
content.黒鉄の主よ！\\n\\n祝いなさい！喜びなさい！これこそが地上の者たちが愛と感謝:
O Lord of Black Steel!

Rejoice! Be glad! This is a festival for those on Earth to express love and gratitude! And as the Cursed Demon Sword Princess, I have prepared a memento for you—
To create this memento, I visited the Eternal Grand Sage, the Guardian of the Twin Wings of Wind, and the Artisan of Courtly Garments, incorporating numerous opinions, and personally completed it with six protections! To the hero who consumes this memento, blessings will surely be bestowed! Hahaha—
Anyway... anyway, absolutely do not give it to anyone else! Eat it all yourself!

I'll make something different for you next time! Don't forget to tell me how it was~

Cursed Demon Sword Princess
content.親愛なる車掌さんへ\\n\\n午前中に買い物に出かけた時、カーマイン・メイの店の: Dear Conductor,This morning, when I went out shopping, I passed by Carmine May's store. There were a lot of young people lined up, so I asked what was happening, and apparently today is a special day for the people of the Western Continent. However, the line was too long and it seemed like it would interfere with my work, so I ended up not participating in the event.When I returned to the Eternal, Fran noticed my mood... as expected, she's quite perceptive. When I told her that I couldn't buy the present I was supposed to give you today, Fran offered to teach me how to make one using the materials on the Eternal.If you find it delicious, I'll make it again next year and give it to you because you are the most important person to me.
content.車掌、\\n\\n以前、学会の子どもたちがケープシティの菓子屋のチラシを持ってき: Conductor,Previously, the children from the Citadel brought a flyer from a confectionery shop in Cape City and asked me why chocolate was beautifully wrapped and sold on my birthday. They realized that I was born on a special day. Since Lord Dustin and Soma don't have any work outside today, I ordered a chocolate cake. I left a slice for you too, so happy holiday.Nayuta
content.車掌、\\n\\n最近、新しい製品の開発中に偶然、もうすぐ祝日だってことを誰かに: Conductor, Recently, while developing a new product, I was casually reminded by someone that the holidays are approaching. So, I've made a few modifications to the chocolate I was making for Anita's rations. Before applying for a patent, I thought you might like it, so I'm sending you a little. I'm looking forward to your feedback after you eat it. Please make sure to write a proper food report. Once you're done writing, submit it... if that's not possible... bring yourself here~I need a special assistant during the holiday period.
content.救世主様~\\n\\nウチャナが篝火城で手伝ってたとき、みんながこの日にチョコレ:
Dear Savior~

When Uchana was helping out at Bonfire City, I heard that everyone exchanges chocolate on this day! I also once saw someone giving chocolate to another person.
So, Uchana asked the big fish at the exchange to get the materials and made it! The materials used were mint, strawberries, watermelon, blueberries, apples... and much, much more! The result is colorful, shiny, and extremely cute!

Savior, please eat it!

Uchana
content.アタシの愛する人へ\\n\\n毎日顔を合わせるけど、やっぱり特別な日にだけはちょ: To the person I loveWe see each other every day, but I think a little ritual is necessary on special days, so I took some time to prepare this. I'll be really happy if you like it. Plus, I've added a special ingredient to this chocolate that only I know about... You can't buy something like this just anywhere, you know?The days I spend with the conductor are truly enjoyable... They are the happiest times for me. How wonderful would it be if such times could last forever...Come to "Gamazumi" tonight as well, okay? I'll be waiting.
