content.黑鐵之主啊！\\n\\n歡慶吧！喜悅吧！此即為地上的人們散播愛戀與感謝之情的節日:
O Master of Black Iron!

Celebrate! Rejoice! This is the day when people on earth spread love and gratitude. On this occasion, I, the Curse Sword Maiden, have specially prepared a token for you—
To create this token, I visited the ancient wise sage, the protector of the Wings of Wind, and the court's attire tailor. After listening to numerous opinions, I personally added six kinds of blessings to the token! The brave soul who consumes this item will surely receive its blessings...
In short... in short, don't share it with others; you must eat it all yourself, understand?

I'll make something else for you next time! Remember to tell me your thoughts after eating it~

Curse Sword Maiden留下
content.親愛的列車長，\\n\\n上午出門採購的時候路過了靛紅五月的門店，注意到有許多年: Dear Conductor,This morning, when I went out for shopping, I passed by the Indigo May store and noticed many young people lining up. After asking around, I found out that today is a special day for people from the Western Continent. Because the line was too long and it felt like it would delay my work, I didn't join in on the excitement...However, after returning to the Astral Express, Fran noticed that I seemed a bit preoccupied. Fran is always so perceptive. I told her that I didn't manage to buy the gift I should have given you today, and she said she could teach me how to make one using the materials available on the Astral Express.—Well, that's about it. If you find it delicious, I'll continue making it for you next year, Conductor. My most important person.
content.列車長，\\n\\n之前學會的孩子們拿著海角城的甜品店發的套餐促銷傳單，問為什麼: Conductor,The children who learned previously brought flyers for a set menu promotion from the dessert shop in Cape City and asked why, on my birthday, chocolate is sold with beautiful packaging. That's when I realized I was born on such a special day. It's rare that Mr. Dustin and Soma have no external duties today, so we ordered a chocolate cake. We saved a piece for you too, happy holidays.Nayuta.
content.列車長，\\n\\n最近研發新品的時候偶然被誰提醒節日就要到了，所以順手給現有的: Conductor,While recently developing a new product, I was reminded by someone that the holiday is approaching, so I casually made some modifications to the chocolates included with the current Anita rations. Before submitting a patent application, I thought you might like them, so I'm sending you some. Remember to tell me how they taste afterward, and it would be best if you could write a special tasting report.Once it's done, come find me to submit it yourself. Or, if you really can't write one... just bring yourself over.I really need a special assistant during the holiday period.
content.我的愛人：\\n\\n雖然幾乎每天都能見面，但節日還是需要一些特別的儀式感呀。提: My love:Although we see each other almost every day, holidays still need a special sense of ceremony. I took some time to prepare in advance, and it would be wonderful if you liked it. Moreover, this chocolate includes my secret ingredient... something you can't just buy anywhere, you know?The days spent with the train conductor have been truly joyful... they are Alina's happiest times. I hope such moments can continue forever and ever...Come to "Viburnum" tonight as well? I'll be waiting for you.
content.크흠, 10RoundsGame에서 개발한 아케이드 게임 무한난투가 출시됐: Ahem, the arcade game Infinite Brawl developed by 10RoundsGame has been released. Have you tried playing it? Everyone says they're short on coins... To celebrate the launch, I'll gift you a few. Try playing it and let me know what you think!
content.亲爱的列车长：\\n一年的时间转瞬即逝。还记得去年这个时候，西大陆铁路环线上出现:
Dear Conductor:
A year has passed in the blink of an eye. Do you remember the chewing gum supply incident that occurred around this time last year on the Western Loop Line? As colleagues and peers, we went through that wave together. Your admirable honesty displayed during that incident remains vivid in my memory.

As promised, I sent you this year's chewing gum on March 12th.

As the president of the COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, I sincerely believe in and look forward to your continued active performance. Wishing you all the best.
content.列车长，您好。贸然来信，还望海涵。\\n近日云岫桥整顿中心正在开展“整顿树新风”: Conductor, hello. I apologize for contacting you out of the blue and ask for your understanding.\nRecently, the Reforming Center at Yunsui Bridge is conducting an activity called "Reforming to Foster New Practices," aimed at improving the efficiency of the Reforming Center and further maintaining the safety and stability of the railway loop. The BCRL has arranged a batch of special supply materials for conductors with access permits, which have been sent along with this letter. Please check and accept them.\nAll personnel at the Reforming Center and Yunsui Bridge Station thank you for your continuous dedication and assistance.
content.以牙还牙是我的准则。以恩报恩亦是。\\n过去一年你对黑月的同僚们很是照顾，鹭先生:
An eye for an eye is my principle. Repaying kindness with kindness is too.
Over the past year, you have been very considerate to your colleagues at Night Chains. Mr. Sagi often mentions you and has expressed regret over not having the chance to meet you, advising me to maintain close contact with you, and I believe he is right.
Therefore, on this day of expressing gratitude, I am sending you a gift.

I also hope you have more opportunities to collaborate with Night Chains in the future, and let's meet more often elsewhere.
content.稍早些与那由他见面时，听他提到你们一起过了个生日。谢谢你一直以来对那由他和索玛的: Earlier, when I met Nayuta, he mentioned that you celebrated a birthday together. Thank you for always taking care of Nayuta and Sommer. Hearing from the two kids that you're doing well recently puts my mind at ease.\nThe last time I had the chance to spend such a youthful holiday with someone was probably when Melanie was still alive... I was young then. I won't dwell too much on the past, but I just hope you'll accept this gift.\nSpring is coming, and you're welcome to visit me in the greenhouse for a chat when you have time.
content.一决胜负的日子到了——作为本少爷和唯一宿敌的对决之日，当然要选一个节日才像话。\: The day to settle the score has arrived—naturally, the duel between me, this young master, and my sole rival must take place on a special occasion for it to make sense.\nHow about it? Seeing this exquisite chocolate that ordinary civilians have no chance of tasting in their lifetime and needs to be booked six months in advance, you must already be completely convinced, moved to tears admitting your defeat, right? You ab-so-lute-ly can't buy better chocolate than mine. This duel is undoubtedly my victory! Use this chocolate to properly wash away the bitterness of failure!
content.看见这个寄信人署名有没有感到心潮澎湃？无论你把这份礼物想成是爱意的证明也好、随心:
Seeing the signature of this sender, do you feel thrilled? Whether you think of this gift as a token of love or a spontaneous prank, I hope you can accept it.
You must be thinking "then let it be love," right? But it's too early to be pleased; at least try the taste of the chocolate first.
Additionally, a sorrowful little bird in the wind asked me to pass on this message—
(The note below is written in a graceful handwriting)
This is a gift of gratitude. My brother enjoys pranks a bit too much and has caused you trouble, sorry.
Happy White Day... Can I say that? If there's a chance in the future, I'd like to convey it to you in person :)

Hayabusa & Songbird
content.列车长：\\n\\n这时候该写什么啊？我不太清楚。\\n在篝火城里也待了很多年了: Conductor:What should I write at this time? I'm not quite sure. I've spent many years in Bonfire City, but I usually don't have anyone to spend such holidays with... After all, the busier the city gets, the busier we members of the BCRL Agency become. But when I happened to see this chocolate at the supply station and always heard my colleagues say that this is a day suitable for expressing gratitude and acceptance, I bought it and sent it to you!And everyone says chocolate isn't good for me...Anyway, happy holidays! See you!Lycagia
content.先日ナユタと会った時に、君と一緒に誕生日を過ごしたと聞いた。いつもナユタとソーマ: The other day when I met Nayuta, I heard that you spent your birthday together. Thank you for always caring about Nayuta and Soma. According to them, it seems you have been living peacefully recently—I was a bit relieved to hear that.\nThe last time I had the opportunity to share in such youthful celebrations with someone was probably back when Miranee was still around... I was quite young then. Let's leave the old stories at that. I would be happy if you could accept this.\nSpring is coming soon. When you have time, please stop by the flower room. I'm looking forward to talking with you.
content.車掌：\\n\\nこういう時って、何を書けばいいんだろうな……正直、よくわからな:
Conductor:

At times like this, I wonder what I should write... Honestly, I'm not really sure.
I've been in Bonfire City for a long time, but I've hardly ever spent this kind of festival with anyone. After all, the busier the city becomes, the busier our work at the Iron Safety Bureau gets. But then I saw this chocolate at the supply station. I just remembered a colleague saying, "Today is a day to express gratitude and acceptance," so I sort of wanted to send it to you.
Besides, everyone keeps telling me that "chocolate isn't good for me"...
Well, anyway—enjoy the festival! See you!

Laikajia
content.この差出人の名前を見て、ドキッとしたりした？この贈り物を「愛の証」だと思ってもい:
Did your heart skip a beat when you saw the name of this sender? You can think of this gift as a "token of love" or simply as a "whimsical prank." Either way, I'd be happy if you accepted it.
By now, you're probably thinking, "Well then, maybe I'll consider it as love." But it's still too early to feel that way. Let's first confirm the taste of this chocolate.
And, you know, a little bird whispering sadly in the wind insisted on delivering this message—
(The handwriting below changes to a slightly more refined script)
This is a token of gratitude. My brother is a bit mischievous and may have caused you some trouble. I apologize.
Happy White Day... Is this how I'm supposed to say it? If there's ever an opportunity, I'd like to convey it directly :)

Hayabusa & Asuka
content.「暴力には暴力を、恩には恩を返す」――それが俺の信条だ。\\nこの一年、あんたが:
"Violence for violence, kindness for kindness" - that's my creed.
Over the past year, I've heard that you've been looking out for the members of Black Moon. Sagi-san often talked about you as well. He regretted not having the chance to meet face-to-face yet… He told me to cherish my relationship with you. I think he's right about that.
So today, I prepared a gift to express my gratitude.
I hope there will be more opportunities to collaborate with Black Moon in the future. – Let's meet again elsewhere.
content.決戦の日がついにやってきた――この俺と唯一無二のライバルとの対決にふさわしいのは: The day of the decisive battle has finally arrived—it's only fitting that the showdown between me and my one and only rival should take place on a holiday, right?\nHow about it? Seeing this ultra-luxurious chocolate, which commoners could never dream of tasting in their lifetime and requires booking six months in advance to acquire, doesn't it make you want to completely bow down before me? Don't you feel like shedding tears and acknowledging your defeat? You absolutely won't get your hands on a better chocolate than this. In this contest, without a doubt, the winner is me! Use that chocolate to at least neutralize the bitterness of defeat!

content.親愛的列車長：\\n感謝您一直以來的支持與陪伴。「域外聯合」活動原定由6月12日:
Dear Conductor:
Thank you for your continuous support and companionship. The "Outland Union" event, originally scheduled from June 12 to June 26, is now extended to July 3, and the exchange shop will also close simultaneously.
To ensure smoother mission execution for the conductor, we will provide supply resources for the next 7 days.

Thank you once again for your support, and may the Boundless continue to forge ahead!

Dear Conductor: 
Thank you for your continued support and companionship. The "Joint Extraterritorial" event originally scheduled from June 12 to June 26 has now been extended to July 3, with the exchange store closing simultaneously.
To facilitate smoother task execution for the Conductor, we will be providing supply materials over the next 6 days.

Thank you once again for your support, and best wishes for the Boundless to forge ahead!

Dear Conductor:
Thank you for your continuous support and companionship. The "Outside Alliance" event was originally scheduled from June 12 to June 26, but it is now extended to July 3, and the exchange store will close at the same time.
To assist the conductor in executing tasks more smoothly, we will provide you with supply materials over the next 5 days.

Thank you once again for your support, and may Infinite Express forge ahead!

Dear Train Captain,
Thank you for your continuous support and companionship. The "Extraterrestrial Union" event, originally scheduled from June 12 to June 26, has been extended to July 3, with the exchange store closing simultaneously.
To ensure that the Train Captain executes missions more smoothly, we will be providing you with supply materials over the next four days.

Once again, thank you for your support, and may the Boundless continue to forge ahead!

Dear Conductor: 
Thank you for your continued support and companionship. The "Intergalactic Union" event was originally scheduled from June 12 to June 26, and is now extended until July 3, with the exchange store closing simultaneously. 
To ensure smoother mission execution for the conductor, we will provide you with supply materials over the next three days. 

Once again, thank you for your support, and may the Boundless move forward bravely!

Dear Conductor:
Thank you for your continuous support and companionship. The "Extraterritorial Union" event, originally scheduled from June 12 to June 26, is now extended to July 3, with the exchange store closing at the same time.
To ensure the Conductor executes tasks more smoothly, we will be supplying you with resources over the next 2 days.

Once again, thank you for your support, and may the Boundless Express forge ahead!

Dear Train Captain:
Thank you for your continued support and companionship. The "Outer Union" event, originally scheduled from June 12 to June 26, is now extended to July 3, and the exchange shop will also close at the same time.
To help the Train Captain carry out tasks more smoothly, we will provide you with supply materials over the next day.

Once again, thank you for your support. Wishing the Infinite a brave journey ahead!
content.亲爱的列车长：\\n非常抱歉游戏期间存在部分异常问题，影响了列车长的开车体验。为: Dear Conductor:\nWe sincerely apologize for any issues experienced during the game that may have affected your driving experience. To compensate for any inconvenience caused, we have completed the necessary fixes and included appropriate compensation. These compensations are intended to enhance your gaming experience, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable driving time ahead. Thank you again for your understanding and patience!
content.亲爱的列车长，您已退出或被队长请离拼单队列，订单已被删除。这些是您提交的保证金及: Dear Conductor, you have exited or been asked by the team leader to leave the group order queue, and the order has been deleted. These are the deposit and materials you submitted. When the volume of goods is too large, they will be distributed in batches, please check and receive them promptly.
content.親愛的列車長\\n感謝您一直以來的支持與陪伴。關於本次「魔女記憶留影組合1」禮包: Dear Train Conductor,\nThank you for your support and companionship all along. Regarding the issue with the "Witch's Memory Snapshot Set 1" bundle this time, we will compensate the train conductors who have purchased the bundle via email.
content.親愛的列車長\\n感謝您一直以來的支持與陪伴。關於本次「魔女記憶留影組合2」禮包: Dear Train Conductor\nThank you for your continued support and companionship. Regarding the issue with the "Witch's Memory Snapshot Combo 2" package, we will compensate the train conductors who purchased the package via email.
content.親愛的列車長\\n感謝您一直以來的支持與陪伴。關於本次「魔女記憶留影組合3」禮包: Dear Train Conductor, \nThank you for your continuous support and companionship. Regarding the issue with the "Witch Memory Souvenir Set 3" package this time, we will compensate the train conductors who have purchased the package via email.
content.轰雷排行名次奖励已发放，请注意查收。: The Thunder ranking rewards have been distributed, please check and receive them.
content.列车长，这是对您在【繁星的轨迹-马吉拉·星仪】卡池抽卡的补偿。对于给您带来的不便: Conductor, this is compensation for your draws in the [Magical Trail of Stars - Margiela The Stargazer] banner. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to you.
content.亲爱的列车长：\\n我们已确认以下异常现象:\\n部分玩家在连接服务器时可能出现:
Dear Conductor:
We have confirmed the following anomalies:
Some players may experience lag or delays when connecting to the server
We are working hard to identify and fix this issue. We apologize for the inconvenience caused, and thank you for your understanding and support. We will fix the problem as soon as possible to ensure your gaming experience.
content.燎原排行名次奖励已发放，请注意查收。: The Wildfire ranking rewards have been distributed. Please check and verify.
content.感谢列车长们热情参与「联动作品前瞻竞猜」活动！\\n本次「联动作品前瞻竞猜视频」:
Thank you to the Conductors for enthusiastically participating in the "Cross-Project Preview Guessing" event!
The "Cross-Project Preview Guessing Video" has reached the target number of likes, and we have sent the corresponding Cheer rewards to all Conductors on the server.
Reward details:

Laplace Protocol x5

—— The Resonance Operations Team
content.冻伤排行名次奖励已发放，请注意查收。: The rewards for the frostbite ranking have been issued. Please check and receive them.
content.亲爱的列车长：\\n感谢列车长们热情参与本次《雷索纳斯》联动作品前瞻竞猜活动！\:
Dear Conductor:
Thank you to the Conductors for enthusiastically participating in the preview guessing event of the "Resonance" collaboration!
Due to the enthusiastic participation and strong response from Conductors in the comments section, we have decided to issue additional rewards to all Conductors as a token of our gratitude for your support and enthusiasm!

Additional reward content:
Laplace Protocol ×5

There will be more collaboration content revealed in the future, so stay tuned!
content.亲爱的列车长，黑月游乐城中的危机还没有完全解决。为了请你协助，也为了减轻一部分你: Dear Conductor, the crisis in Night Chains Land has not been completely resolved. To request your assistance and to alleviate some of your burden, we have applied for some Supreme Passes for you as witches, hoping this can help you out~\n\nWhen you have time, remember to visit us in the divination room or the candy house!
content.親愛的列車長，\\n無垠亂鬥進行中錯誤問題已修復完成，\\n損失之亂鬥街機幣，將: Dear Train Manager,\nThe issue during the Infinite Brawl has been completely fixed.\nThe lost Brawl Arcade Coins will be compensated via mail.
content.親愛的列車長，黑月遊樂城中的危機還沒有完全解決。為了請你協助，也為了減輕一部分你: Dear Conductor, the crisis in Night Chains Land has not been completely resolved. To request your assistance and to alleviate some of your burden, we have applied for some Supreme Passes for you as witches, hoping this can help you out~\n\nWhen you have time, remember to visit us in the divination room or the candy house!
content.撕裂排行名次奖励已发放，请注意查收。: The rewards for the ranking in the Rend leaderboard have been distributed, please check them.
content.燎原ランキングの順位報酬が配布されましたので、ご確認ください。: The ranking rewards for Wildfire have been distributed, so please check.
content.凍傷ランキングの順位報酬が配布されましたので、ご確認ください。: The ranking rewards for frostbite have been distributed, so please check them.
content.引き裂きランキングの順位報酬が配布されましたので、ご確認ください。: The ranking rewards for the Tear Ranking have been distributed, so please check.
content.轟雷ランキングの順位報酬が配布されましたので、ご確認ください。: The rewards for the Thunderstorm Ranking have been distributed, so please check them.
content.친애하는 열차장님, 가입하신 공동 주문 파티에서 탈퇴 혹은 강퇴되어 주문: Dear Trainmaster, you have been removed or expelled from the group order party you joined, and your order has been deleted. We are returning the deposit and supplies you submitted below. If there are a large number of supplies, they will be delivered in several installments, so please ensure you receive them all.
content.친애하는 열차장님, 가입하신 공동 주문을 기한 내에 완료하지 못하셨기에: Dear Conductor, as you have not completed the collective order you joined within the deadline, the order has been canceled. The deposit is non-refundable, and we will return the materials you submitted, so please make sure to collect them.
content.本机检索到，按照列车长家乡铁山城的习俗，这几天该吃月饼赏月了！恰巧无垠号上收到了: Detected by this unit, according to the customs of the Conductor's hometown, Fortress City, it's time to eat mooncakes and appreciate the moon in these days! Coincidentally, The Eternal has received a box of mooncakes brought from outside and a box of homemade mooncakes by Miss Livia, both entrusted to me to pass on to you. This unit will dutifully fulfill this task... \nPlease enjoy this wonderful mixture of sugar and oil to your heart's content!
content.亲爱的列车长：\\n为庆祝与《机动战队》的盛大联动，感谢您一直以来的等候与支持，: Dear Conductor:\nTo celebrate the grand collaboration with "Jidong Squadron," we sincerely thank you for your patience and support. Here are some collaboration benefits for you, wishing that the brilliance of the hub guides your railway route.
content.Conductor:\\nAfter some effort, I finall: Conductor:\nAfter some effort, I finally fixed this machine gun! Although it was a commission from the Chamber, they said it can be delivered directly to you. If you need it, you can install it anytime!\nMay you have a smooth journey!
content.亲爱的列车长：\\n在8月26日更新后游戏出现了部分异常，给您带来了不好的游戏体: Dear Conductor:\nAfter the update on August 26, some anomalies appeared in the game, which have affected your gaming experience. Upon receiving feedback, the technical team immediately conducted an investigation and released a new version update tonight to fix the known issues. You can view the detailed content of this update in the in-game announcement.\nTo make up for the impact caused by these anomalies, we have prepared 300 CS as compensation, please check your email to receive it.
content.Conductor of The Eternal, great news! Th: Conductor of The Eternal, great news! The Reforming Center at Base Yunxiu Bridge is now open for external contracting. Just arrive at the station to inquire about contract matters~\nTo show the Reforming Center's sincerity in recruiting contractors, I'm specially giving you ten Support Tickets issued by commander Paladi (me)! Come soon!
content.Conductor of The Eternal:\\nAccording to: Conductor of The Eternal:\nAccording to the latest cooperation agreement between Anita Energy Institute and the Salamander Chamber of Commerce, a new trading center has been added to Wilderness Station. Please visit when you have time.
content.Dear Conductor:\\nCongratulations on you: Dear Conductor:\nCongratulations on your official appointment as a member of COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce. The Chamber has provided you with a startup fund to support your future operations of the train crew. May your journey ahead be smooth and successful.
content.Dear Conductor:\\nI've prepared a small: Dear Conductor:\nI've prepared a small token of my heartfelt intention, hoping it can be of some help in ensuring your journey goes smoothly. Let's continue supporting each other and moving forward together from now on.
content.Hey hey hey:\\nI heard you've been quite: Hey hey hey:\nI heard you've been quite active lately. I bet it's all because I challenged you that you're so motivated, right? I don't mind reminding you that to stay on stage, you need not only your own efforts but also external support. I'll give you this chance to be in the spotlight—no need to thank me too much! As my rival, you can't bow out early. By the way, my train needing repairs is just a coincidence; don't ask too many questions.
content.Congratulations, Conductor! BCRL has inf: Congratulations, Conductor! BCRL has informed me that you've obtained access permission to BCRL Outpost. Now you can visit BCRL Outpost anytime!\nAttached is a small gift; come play with me often~☆!
content.Respected Conductor, due to your continu: Respected Conductor, due to your continuous hard work and outstanding performance, the passenger transport system's [Advertising] function is now open to the The Eternal CBCRR23 train crew as an encouragement.\nWe hope you remain true to the original aspiration, forge ahead, and contribute more to maintaining railway harmony and promoting railway passenger transport development.
content.Dear Conductor:\\nAs Morphic Field Pollu: Dear Conductor:\nAs Morphic Field Pollution deepens, we understand that Conductors often face material shortages on their journeys. Therefore, COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce HQ has prepared emergency supplies for you. May your journey be smooth!
content.Conductor, your refrigerator storage is: Conductor, your refrigerator storage is full. The following excess items cannot be stored temporarily; please check.
content.Don't think this means I've admitted def: Don't think this means I've admitted defeat… The competition between us has just begun!\nThis is the cost of losing to you in the previous match; take it!\nI won't forget this experience. When I prepare a new challenge, I'll definitely come for you again!
content.Welcome to ONEderland, the dreamland for: Welcome to ONEderland, the dreamland for pioneers!\nPlease accept this visitor gift!\nDig for gold, dig for dreams.
content.I just received a letter from BCRL highe: I just received a letter from BCRL higher-ups, notifying me that you've obtained BCRL's dispatch patrol permission. I'm sending this email to forward the subsidy to you and to congratulate you.\nWell done; keep up the good work in the future.
content.Cape City has now granted Bonfire City a: Cape City has now granted Bonfire City access permissions to the The Eternal CBCRR23 train crew.\nWishing your train crew a wonderful journey in Cape City. Meow!
content.Conductor, the case you reported at %s h: The content to be translated is: Conductor, the case you reported at %s has been successfully completed by %s. Please proceed to claim it as soon as possible.
content.Dear Conductor, thank you for your conti: Dear Conductor, thank you for your continuous support and companionship. Now, let's set off.
content.To commend you for not acting too excess: To commend you for not acting too excessively towards me, Lord Shire, I'm sending you some supplies from my elder sisters!\nNext time we meet, don't expect me to be this polite!!!
content.Respected Conductor, the shared order [%: Respected Conductor, the shared order [%s] you posted has been completed by player [%s]. This is your reward; please claim it promptly.
content.Conductor, here is today's produced Chao: Conductor, here is today's produced Chaos Stone; please remember to check~
content.Dear Conductor, the [Calculation Recordi: Dear Conductor, the [Calculation Recording] function prepared for you is now debugged and ready to run. I've specially prepared ample blank recording materials for you, hoping you can better enjoy the fun.\nPlease be sure to come and experience it personally; I look forward to your arrival.
content.Didn't expect it? Reunion comes so quick: Didn't expect it? Reunion comes so quickly! This one is now in Shoggolith City. If you have time, come to the address below to meet me again, my beloved friend!
content.[This email is sent from a Citadel offic: [This email is sent from a Citadel official account; please do not reply]\nAccess permissions have been granted to specific individuals, allowing the train and crew to enter the site [Confluence Tower].\nAttached is a Cactus Lollipop; please check the attachment.
content.Anita Global Energy has now opened the s: Anita Global Energy has now opened the station [Anita Weapon Factory] to Conductor.\nDedicated to developing more elite armaments, Anita Weapon Factory awaits your visit.
content.Dear Conductor, we regret that you faile: Dear Conductor, we regret that you failed to complete the joint transport order on time; the order has been deleted. The deposit cannot be refunded to you. These are the materials you submitted; please claim them promptly.
Conductor:\nI'll leave the rest to you. Wish you a pleasant journey.
content.Congratulations, Conductor of The Eterna: Congratulations, Conductor of The Eternal! No, I should say congratulations to me… Anyway, the management rights of Mirage Island have been transferred to you. Come to the island quickly and take a look! Recently, a series of strange events have occurred, and Chaos Remains seem to have increased. It would be great if you could solve this!\nSee you then! This is a Material Voucher from COLUMBA; here you go!
content.Dear Conductor, please confirm your purc: Dear Conductor, please confirm your purchased goods as follows:
content.Dear Conductor, you have left or were re: Dear Conductor, you have left or were removed by the leader from the group order queue; the order has been deleted. These are the deposit and materials you submitted; if the quantity is large, they will be distributed in batches. Please claim them promptly.
content.Conductor, your warehouse is full. These: Conductor, your warehouse is full. These are items you lost.
content.親愛的列車長：\\n\\n停機維護已完成，附件為維護補償，請注意查收，感謝您的支: Dear Train Conductor:The maintenance shutdown is complete, and the attachment is the maintenance compensation. Please check it carefully. Thank you for your support and understanding.
content.Dear Conductor, a new issue of Brochure: Dear Conductor, a new issue of Brochure has been released. These are rewards from the previous Brochure tasks that have not been claimed yet; please claim them promptly.
content.Ahem, the new arcade game The Eternal Sc: Ahem, the new arcade game The Eternal Scuffle developed by 10RoundsGame has been released. Have you tried it yet? I hear many people say tokens are not enough... As an opening bonus, I'll give you a few more. Remember to tell me your feedback, Conductor!
content.伤害排行名次奖励已发放，请注意查收。: The DMG ranking rewards have been distributed, please check them.
content.【同调】排行名次奖励已发放，请注意查收。: [Homology] Ranking rewards have been distributed, please check.
content.本機のデータベースによれば、車掌の故郷・フォートレスシティでは、この時期、月を眺: According to this machine's database, in the conductor's hometown of Fortress City, there is a custom during this season of eating mooncakes while gazing at the moon. Two boxes of mooncakes have just arrived on the Eternal. One box is a gift from outside, and the other is handmade by Mr. Livere. I will personally take responsibility for safeguarding both and delivering them to the conductor. It is only natural that I undertake this task.\nNow, please fully enjoy this wondrous mixture of glucose and oil.
content.親愛的列車長，您在【虛演刻錄】中表現卓越，為您補發以下獎勵：約書亞專屬頭像【完美: Dear Train Conductor, your outstanding performance in the [Imaginary Staging] has earned you the following reward: Joshua's exclusive avatar [Statue of the Perfect Angel]. Please check it promptly.
content.燎原排行名次獎勵已發放，請注意查收: Wildfire ranking rewards have been distributed, please check and receive them.
content.ねぇねぇ、車掌っち～、黒月有楽町のピンチ、まだ完全には片付いてないんだよね。だか: Dear Conductor, the crisis in Night Chains Land has not been completely resolved. To request your assistance and to alleviate some of your burden, we have applied for some Supreme Passes for you as witches, hoping this can help you out~\n\nWhen you have time, remember to visit us in the divination room or the candy house!
content.親愛的列車長：\\n\\n不停機更新已完成，附件為更新補償，請注意查收，感謝您的: Dear Train Conductor:\n\nThe non-stop update is complete, and the attachment is the compensation for the update. Please check it carefully. Thank you for your support and understanding.
content.親愛的列車長：\\n\\n閃斷更新已完成，附件為更新補償，請注意查收，感謝您的支: Dear Conductor:\n\nThe flash disconnection update is complete. The attachment contains the update compensation. Please check it, and thank you for your support and understanding.
content.Dear Conductor:\\nThank you for joining: Dear Conductor: Thank you for joining Resonance Solstice CBT. As the current version is still under development, if you encounter any localization issues or bugs during your experience, please report them to our Discord to help us further optimize the game. ▶Click to open
content.親愛的列車長：\\n近期集中出現遊戲報錯以及人物素材丟失等異常，非常抱歉給各位列: Dear Train Conductor:\nRecently, there have been frequent occurrences of game errors and missing character assets. We apologize for the inconvenience caused to all conductors! Attached is compensation for these issues. Please check it carefully, and thank you for your support and understanding.
content.好久没见，我是书闲！\\n今天按日历来算是我老家那边过“星期节”的日子……这个星:
Long time no see, I'm Shu Xian!
Today, according to the calendar, is the "Starry Festival" day in my hometown… This "week" doesn't refer to the weekly one, but means "the stars' meeting." It happens only once a year. Family, friends, and loved ones choose to gather on this day and make wishes to the stars; the lights will stay on until dawn. How about it? Isn't it a nice day?

To celebrate this day, Tennie and I made some soup in advance for Box to bring over to you.
Have a hot drink first, we'll be there soon, just in time to cook a big meal together for the festival!
content.親愛なる車掌様、ご自身でチームから退出されたか、もしくは隊長によって退出処理が行: Dear Conductor, the order has been deleted because you either left the team on your own or were removed by the captain. Here are the deposit and supplies you submitted. If there is a large amount of cargo, it will be distributed in several installments, so please check.
content.親愛なる車掌様、誠に残念ながら、協力注文を期限内に完了できなかったため、注文は削: Dear Conductor, we regret to inform you that as the cooperative order was not completed within the deadline, it has been deleted. The deposit cannot be refunded, so here are the materials you submitted. Please confirm.
content.蚀灭排行名次奖励已发放，请注意查收。: The ranking rewards for Erode have been distributed, please check and receive them.
content.由于本期转盘活动已结束，未使用的万象秘钥已转化为等量桦石发放，请注意查收。: Current roulette event is over. Unused Aether Keys are converted to Chaos Stones of equal value. Please accept.
content.列车长，帝国的传统节日星祷节就要到了。难得有这个机会，我想和无垠号的大家一起去市:
Conductor, it's almost time for the traditional imperial festival Astrum Ora. I'd love to buy some carriage decoration and food with our crew! If you have time, let's meet up in [Freeport VII].
We'll be waiting for you. Merry Astrum Ora!

>>Please head to Freeport VII for the event.
content.Conductor, it's almost time for the trad:

We'll be waiting for you. Merry Astrum Ora!

dialogContent.修格里的街道上，大多数过路人都行色匆匆；不得不说，这座近十几年才繁荣起来的城市内: On the streets of Shoggolith, most passersby are in a hurry; this city, which has only flourished in the last decade or so, is like a maze. Fortunately, we now have a certain impression of the streets and will no longer get lost in the city center as we did when we first arrived. But if it weren't for that previous adventure, we probably wouldn't have met Miss Songbird, who kindly guided us.\n"Eh? What a coincidence, we meet again, Conductor."\nA strange yet familiar voice sounded from behind, and she quickly catches up and walks beside us.
dialogContent.“嗯，我就知道我们还会再见的——只是没想到这么快。上次没给你像样的谢礼，恰好这次: "Mm, I knew we would meet again—just didn't expect it to be so soon. Last time, I didn't give you a proper thank-you gift, and this time I happen to have something to offer. No refusing, okay, Conductor?"\nIn shock, we accept Songbird's gift, and she smiles and waves at us before disappearing into the crowd. I guess it can only be explained as fate...
dialogContent.随着业务稳步发展，我们出入修格里城交易所的次数也变多了，偶尔还能趁着行情上涨谈到: As our business steadily develops, our visits to the Shoggolith City Trading Center have increased, and occasionally we can discuss some big deals when the trends are rising. On this day, we come to the Trading Center again, only to find Miss Songbird not far away, surrounded by a group of apprentices, looking troubled.\n"Ah... it's you, what a coincidence. But it seems there's a problem with the system here, thinking that the intermediary who previously guaranteed my orders has become invalid... I'm having trouble finding someone familiar to act as a new guarantor."
dialogContent.飞鸟的订单合同上，除了担保人失效这一项没有其他问题。仔细商量后，我们决定帮她一把: There are no other issues with Songbird's order contract except for the invalid guarantor. After careful discussion, we decide to help her and become the new guarantor for this order. Songbird seems very happy and says she wants to take us out for a big meal.
dialogContent.来到了西大陆重要的工业站点之一，曼德矿场！由于靠近修格里城，同时在西大陆环线上坐: Arrived at one of the important industrial sites on the Western Continent, Mander Mine! Due to its proximity to Shoggolith City and its advantageous geographical location on the Western Continent loop, Mander Mine has seen rapid development in recent years. However, because of the mixed crowd of people coming and going, the security here is unstable, and the local BCRL Agency issues some clearance commissions every day.\nGanya is the organizer of these commissions. As the captain of Team Meerkat, she handled all this paperwork by herself. Today she looks a bit tired, but she still hands us the completed portion.
dialogContent.“谢谢你们愿意帮忙。如果以后能多来曼德矿场看看，就帮大忙了。我的确是新上任不久的: "Thank you for being willing to help. It would be a great help if you could visit Mander Mine more often in the future. I am indeed the recently appointed person in charge and may not have enough experience yet... but I believe that efforts made to maintain peace are certainly not in vain."
dialogContent.再次来到了曼德矿场。在通往工业区域的路上，发现了一伙嚣张的劫掠者！正当我们要与对: Back at Mander Mine. On the way to the industrial area, we encounter a group of arrogant Looters! Just as we are about to clash with them, a familiar figure appears behind the Looters.\nA flying axe makes a beautiful arc in the air, returning to Ganya's hand. The mechanical devices stop operating, and the Looters fall to the ground in response.\nGanya flexes her wrist, nods at us, and then steps forward to hand us several commendation letters and bonus documents from BCRL.
dialogContent.“刚刚恰好在找你们呢。这是之前没来得及给你们的表彰书以及奖励。曼德矿场的治安状况: "I was just looking for you. Here is the certificate of commendation and reward that I didn't have a chance to give you earlier. The security situation at Mander Mine has also improved, thanks to you."\n"I told you, our efforts would be rewarded. Let's continue moving forward together as partners."
dialogContent.决定去澄明数据中心的商业街逛逛！遇见了一家橱窗风格独特的服装店，招牌上的店名是“: Decided to take a stroll around the commercial street of CDCA Bureau! We come across a clothing store with a uniquely styled display window. Even the name on the sign "Pupil's Fashion" is quite unique, so we decide to have a look.\nThe moment we enter, we're immediately drawn in by the extravagant clothing all around. The shop owner's greeting came from behind the shelves, along with her flamboyant pink long ponytail, "Hello, I'm Margiela, the manager and designer of 'Pupil's Fashion'. Do you like these clothes?"
dialogContent.“咦？……没想到人家准备好的促销话术都没来得及用上……今天正好店里在举办活动，您: "Huh? ...That was quick. I didn't even get to use the promotional speech I prepared... We're holding an event today, and you are the first customer to arrive! Please accept this free clothing voucher, then pick your favorite set~"\nMiss Margiela's proposal is unexpected, but it's hard to refuse such kindness, so just go along with it!
dialogContent.听说最近在数据中心会开办大规模同人展，艾略特很感兴趣，硬拉着我们要一起参加。为了: I heard that a large-scale fan fes will be held at CDCA recently. Eliot is very interested and insists on us attending together. To order suitable cosplay costumes, we return to Pupil's Fashion. But this time, there was only a sign on the door saying "Visitors please ring the bell."\nAfter ringing the bell, we wait cautiously outside for a while, but no one come to open the door, so we decide to go inside. Margiela is busy in the store. She seems very happy to see us.\n"Sorry, been working. Didn't hear the doorbell—welcome! Do you need more clothing?"
dialogContent.“原来是想去参加同人展啊！人家明白了，但能不能等我先完成手上的工作？最近各个篝火: "Oh, you mean that fan fes! I understand, but can you wait until I complete my work at hand? All these Bonfire Cities are holding comic conventions recently, and I have too many orders... Even a witch can get tired."\nDespite expressing her fatigue, Margiela's hands don't stop working at all, and she has a genuine smile on her face. Let's wait until the witch completes her work!\n"By the way, this time I can also give you a little discount and some gifts, how about that?"
dialogContent.“……我小时候在港区的贫民窟长大，靠一位老师教授我的格斗术保护自己，当时也得罪了: "...When I was young, I grew up in a slum in the port and someone taught me martial arts to protect myself, which offended quite a few people. Even today, there must still be people who know me wandering in the slums. However, joining BCRL was my own choice, and I am very proud of that decision... As for their other slanders, I have a clear conscience and have never done anything bad. I hope you don't misunderstand."
dialogContent.“朱利安小姐是土生土长的7号自由港人？”\r“没错。怎么了吗？”\r“啊，没什么: "Miss Julian's a native of Freeport VII?""That's right. Why do you ask?""Oh, it's nothing... I just heard some rumors about you when I was helping deal with that street fight."Julian's hands don't stop organizing the documents. She hands the papers to us with a poker face and points to the blank space in the lower right corner, "If you have no objections, please sign for this payment."
dialogContent.“请问痴迷黑巧克力的拳皇是哪位？”\r由于送货机器人一直无法识别包裹上的收件人名: "May I ask which one is 'Master brawler chocolate lover'?"\nBecause the delivery robot couldn't identify the recipient's name on the package, it made a round in the city and was sent back to the Eternal. We decide to visit BCRL Agency ourselves. When everyone at the agency hears the recipient's name, they show a suppressed smile, as if they want to say something but can't... It seems the recipient is indeed here, but who could it be?\nAs someone lightly taps my shoulder, the weight in my hand disappears. Julian walks in from behind us, takes the package, and casually stuffs a stack of documents into our hands.
dialogContent.“这是近期的委托酬劳结算单。一直看我干什么？……是我的包裹没错。但这收件人名，多: "These are for your recent payment. Why are you staring at me? ...Yes, this package is mine. But the name is likely a prank from Dorothy on a whim... Seriously, why did she use this name? Doesn't she have any work to do?"
dialogContent.在被卡莱雅按照完整的下午茶规格热情招待、和她畅谈一下午后，我们告别卡莱雅，离开了: After being warmly hosted by Kaleya with a full afternoon tea and chatting with her for an entire afternoon, we bid farewell to Kaleya and leave the Launch Tech Center.\n...Wait, weren't we originally here for a tour?!
dialogContent.发射中心是形态污染出现前就存在的站点，这里的许多建筑看起来都相当“具有历史”。在: The launch center is a site that existed before the appearance of Morphic Field Pollution, so many buildings here appear quite "historical." Among the many facilities weathered by time, the Launch Tech Center stands out as particularly modern.\nResponsible for stationing here is Anita employee Kaleya. Dressed in a long white coat, she looks more like a young doctor, and upon seeing our arrival, she gives a surprised yet gentle smile.\n"It's not completely organized here yet, but we have a visitor—how wonderful! Please sit down, I'll prepare some snacks!"
dialogContent.说完刚刚的冷笑话后，卡莱雅就自顾自地笑开了，过了好一会儿才开始带我们参观。\r这: After finishing the cold joke, Kaleya starts laughing to herself and only after a while does she begin to show us around. This time she gives us a lot of help. However, why is her sense of humor so strange?
dialogContent.为了完成上次未能完成的参观行程，我们再次拜访了发射科技中心。相比之前所看见的景象: To complete the visit we were unable to finish last time, we visit the Launch Tech Center again. Compared to what we saw before, the internal facilities here have become more complete... It seems that Anita Launch Center is gradually recovering its proper status.\nSeeing us return, Kaleya rejoices.\n"Conductor! I've heard that you're actually here for a tour, right? I'll do my best as your guide, explaining everything to a T... Oh, I'm not talking about afternoon tea! T... hahaha!"
dialogContent.拿着它晃一晃，还能听见圆球状物体内发出沉闷的碰撞声。虽然对它的结构很感兴趣，但这: Giving it a shake, I can hear a dull collision sound from within the spherical object. Although I'm very interested in its structure, what exactly is it? Surely it's not a dangerous explosive, right?
dialogContent.和菲妮娅在街道上偶遇！不过菲妮娅行色匆匆，似乎正要去做什么事……见到我们，她立刻: Encountered Fenia on the street! However, Fenia seems to be in a hurry, as if she is about to do something... When she sees us, she immediately runs over excitedly and hands us a palm-sized camera-like object.\n"Conductor! This is some random thing Mentor Rebis gave me, but I don't know how to use it—I was just about to show it to someone else, and then you came! Would you like to have it?"\nAlthough it's another mysterious device with unknown usage, since it's a product of Rebis, it should worth quite a few coins...
dialogContent.和菲妮娅在街道上偶遇！见到我们，她立刻开心地过来和我们聊天。\r“……对了！雷比: Encountered Fenia on the street! Upon seeing us, she immediately comes over happily to chat with us.\n"…Oh right! Mentor Rebis said she wants that thing from last time to conduct an experiment! Conductor, do you still have it?"\nAfter we give her a positive response, Fenia expresses her desire to buy back the device. Seeing the anticipation in her eyes, it is really hard to refuse...
dialogContent.“太好了，我可以和雷比斯老师交差啦~欸？这个的真实用途？雷比斯老师好像提过哦，是: "Great, now I can report back to Mentor~ Eh? The real purpose of this? I think she said it's the core component of the next-gen Tauri robots!"
dialogContent.贡露城的街景和其他城市差别不大，但或许是受了商业广告的影响，总觉得处处弥漫着一种: The street view of Gronru City is not much different from other cities, but perhaps due to the influence of advertisements, there's a sense of decadence in the air... Every year, a carnival lasting several days is held here.\nI wonder what this city is like for local residents? With this thought in mind, I take over a large stack of vouchers and coupons from Karen...\n"Welcome to Gronru City! I didn't expect you to be here for sightseeing as well. Here, take these supply coupons for this period."
dialogContent.听见我们的问题，卡莲有些惊讶。\r“人家觉得这座城市除了很好玩以外没什么特别的呢: Upon hearing our question, Karen is somewhat surprised.\n"I think this city is just fun and nothing special... If I really have to say, some parts might require personal experience to understand? For example, the arena and the carnival are quite interesting."
dialogContent.“那我先走啦列车长~拜托这段时间你替我看着点哦！人家很快就回来，大概会在晚班换班: "I'll be off now, Conductor~ Please keep an eye on things for me! I'll be back soon, probably before the evening shift change~!"
dialogContent.卡莲面带怒色地冲了过来！很少见她这么生气，除非是发生了对她来说的大事。\r“列车:
Karen rushes over with an angry face! It's rare to see her so upset unless something big has happened to her.
"Conductor! I want to take the crew leave in advance!"
Huh?
"Because Shizuru absolutely refuses to go shopping with me... saying there's work or something, but I haven't left my duty post for two weeks and I'm really tired! —Oh, right, this is hush money for you. Do keep it a secret for me, Conductor!"
dialogContent.多萝西向我们挥挥手，蹦蹦跳跳地离开了。仔细看看这几枚奖章……这怎么看都是她自己做: Dorothy waves to us and skips away. Taking a closer look at these medals... she definitely made them by herself!\n"Bye-bye! Be a good kid when I inspect again!"
dialogContent.“紧急停车！接受铁盟检查！！！！”\r除了多萝西之外，很少有人能用嗓门把高音喇叭:
"Emergency brake! BCRL inspection!!!!"
Aside from Dorothy, few people can shout loudly enough to distort a megaphone. Although knowing this is a routine BCRL inspection, the scene somehow feels familiar...
Fortunately, the process goes smoothly, and there is no illegal cargo on the Eternal—of course not! How could there be!
Dorothy cheerfully pins medals on us one by one, saying they are proof of passing multiple inspections without any violations.
dialogContent.“紧~急~停车！接受铁盟检查！”\r这次的声音没有从后方跟随的越野车里传来……而: "Emergency~ brake! BCRL inspection!"\nThis time, the voice does not come from the vehicle following behind... but from right behind us! Dorothy has somehow sneaked into our carriage and is waving at us with a playful smile! Is this the skill of a BCRL soldier?!\n"Alright, alright, just kidding! This time I hid in the passenger car to sneak onboard. Got you a gift!"
dialogContent.“可以拆吗？当然可以啊！这就是送给你的呀，列车长！说起来总是拦住你们突击检查真对: "Can you unwrap it? Of course! It's now yours! I'm really sorry for always stopping you for emergency inspections, and also very sorry for accidentally blowing up the carriage while on the Eternal—this is a token of my apology, hmm!"
dialogContent.“别动。陪我一会儿……报酬会给你的。”\r如她所述，在她休息到满意以后，她的确在: "Don't move. Stay with me for a while... You'll be rewarded."\nAs she says, after she has rested to her satisfaction, she indeed leaves a substantial check on the table. But such an experience is still a bit too frightening; hopefully, it will happen less often in the future...
dialogContent.今天，无垠号上来了一位特殊的乘客。\r作为能源研究所的代理所长，对妮蔻拉的接待自: Today, a special passenger boarded the Eternal.\nAs the acting director of the Energy Institute, Nicola was naturally received with the highest standards... To welcome this special passenger, we specifically cleared out the passenger car. With her being the only passenger, the carriage is now eerily quiet.\nWhen bringing her lunch, she suddenly reaches out and pulls me into her embrace!
dialogContent.借着胡椒和装作偶然路过的艾略特塞来的一袋便携装调味肉汁，你吃完了一整盘土豆泥。妮: With the help of pepper and a bag of gravy that Eliot casually brought by, I finished off an entire plate of mashed potatoes. Nicola is very pleased with my love for potatoes and gifts me some precious inventions.
dialogContent.对于妮蔻拉的不定时拜访，无垠号的各位乘员已经逐渐习惯了。何况她不算是非常高要求的: The crew has gradually become accustomed to Nicola's irregular visits. Moreover, she is not a particularly demanding guest; she doesn't nitpick about the train's simple environment nor does she feel at a loss with new facilities after improvements. However, her high demands on me still gives me a bit of a headache.\nThis afternoon, she seems troubled by a problem that arose during an invention process and requests me to join her for lunch.\nNicola candidly hands me a whole plate of unseasoned mashed potatoes. In front of her is the same whole plate of unseasoned mashed potatoes.
dialogContent.费劲九牛二虎之力，我们将漂浮状态的约书亚带回了车上，重新启动了列车。事后，由于“: After great effort, we bring the floating Joshua back to the car and restart the train. Afterward, due to the "reasonable disposal of railway obstacles," we receive an additional bonus.
dialogContent.列车行驶途中，探测雷达显示铁轨前方突然出现障碍物，不得不减速停车！全车人都惊魂未: During the train's journey, radar shows that an obstacle suddenly appears on the tracks, forcing us to stop! Everyone on the train is still startled, and we decide to get off and take a look.\n...We find Joshua hovering unscathed in front of the train. They are even sleeping soundly; it seems that even an approaching train couldn't disturb their sleep.
dialogContent.一天之中，约书亚醒着的时间相当之短。有时祂醒来的时间恰好是深夜，也不会和列车上的: During the day, Joshua's waking hours are quite short. Sometimes they wake up in the middle of the night and don't meet most of the crew on the train... Therefore, encountering Joshua eating in the crew area is quite rare. However, it seems like they rarely have any favorite foods? Why not take this opportunity to ask?
dialogContent.约书亚看了我们一眼，摆出了祂平时的“不和愚人说话”的态度。很快，祂用餐完毕离开了: Joshua glances at us, displaying their usual "not speaking with fools" attitude. Shortly after, they finish the meal and leave the dining car, but before leaving, they take out a small package from nowhere and toss it to us, drifting away without a word.\nPerhaps they feel quite happy for being taken care of. We should communicate with them more in the future!
dialogContent.意外地非常好吃！口味上简直超越99%家常菜，不知道原主人喜欢什么口味……有机会相: Unexpectedly delicious! The taste surpasses 99% of homemade dishes. I wonder what flavors the original owner likes... If we get to meet, I must treat her to a meal.
dialogContent.在铁路附近的废弃站台上发现了几个摆放整齐的保温箱，标签上写着“阿妮塔即热食品”。: Several neatly arranged insulated boxes are found on an abandoned platform near the railway, with labels reading "Anita Instant Food." It says, "Not to my taste, for those in need," signed "Chen Shuxian"... The name seems a bit familiar?
dialogContent.列车驶入失稳区域时，一面墙突然出现在铁路前方，拦住了去路。\r你下车查看，发现墙: When the train entered a destabilized area, a wall suddenly appears in front, blocking the way.\nI get off to check and find that there is a door on the wall big enough for the train to pass through, but no matter what method I use, it can't be opened.\nEliot suddenly shouts a string of gaming terms, "I got it! This is from &!@*￥E!&! Let me try! Just press this key—"
dialogContent.门开了，露出了门后面的货物箱！无暇多想，你拿走了箱子中的宝物，驶离了这里。: The door opens, revealing the cargo box behind it! Without thinking further, I take the treasure from the box and drive away.
dialogContent.突如其来的风暴将列车困在了失稳区中。\r在风暴的中心，一位身穿黑衣的拾荒者正坐在: A sudden storm trapped the train in a destabilized area.\nIn the center of the storm, a Marauder dressed in black is sitting on a white plastic chair, seemingly waiting for my arrival.\nWhen I walk up behind him, a powerful, very old song begins to play, and the mysterious power in the song compels me to say those words...
dialogContent.一番激烈的交锋之后，拾荒者把仙人掌交给了你，然后随着风暴一起消失。\r你看着手中: After the most intense confrontation, the Marauder hands the cactus to me and then disappears with the storm.\nI look at the cactus in my hand and feel filled with POWER!
dialogContent.你在附近发现了几个贫困的拾荒者聚落，聚落中用破碎的木板和数值搭建起了几个棚屋，有: I discover several impoverished marauder settlements nearby, where a few shanties are constructed using broken wooden planks and numbers. A group of marauders is sitting around the bonfire to keep warm.\nI take some food from the train to help them.\nThey warmly welcome me and offer some of their meager supplies in return. An inexplicable impulse arises in my mind, prompting me to cheer with them—
dialogContent.拾荒者向你分享了以太相引擎技术……这是什么？\r“虽然以地球现有的技术无法制造，: The marauders share with me the Aetherophasic Engine technology... What is that?\n"Although it's impossible to manufacture with Earth's current technology, maybe there will be hope by the year 2400," the marauders explain.\nEven though I don't understand their explanation, it's valuable stuff, right?
dialogContent.你发现铁路旁的信号灯因为过于老旧而损坏，会影响到来往列车的运行。经过检查，发现这: I discover that the signal light beside the railway is weathered by time, which will affect the operation of passing trains. Upon inspection, it is found that this signal light is an old model manufactured by the Citadel decades ago, and the spare parts currently available on the train are not compatible with it.
dialogContent.大成功！你们从遥那里得知，根据学会的施工标准，在放置器械周边三米范围内可以找到存: Natural 20! Haruka says that according to the Citadel's construction standards, within a three-meter radius around the placed device, there is a small warehouse for storing spare parts. Inside, we find spare parts wrapped in oiled paper and perfectly repair the signal light.
dialogContent.篝火城的面貌日新月异，各地市政厅和城市管理处也开始逐步解除对外来投资的限制。无论: The appearance of Bonfire City is changing rapidly, and City Halls and management offices are also gradually lifting restrictions on foreign investment. Whether you are a merchant or a traveler, as long as you have funds in hand, you can engage in investment at the City Hall. Helping Bonfire City develop may one day result in corresponding returns.
dialogContent.市政厅的负责人对你的慷慨投资表示了感谢。\r这座城市不会遗忘人们的付出，它将从中: The head of City Hall expresses gratitude for my generous investment. The city will not forget the contributions of its people; it will draw nourishment from them and flourish.
dialogContent.随着篝火城的商业发展、铁路环线沿线各地的交流增多，市政厅获得了越来越多的投资。\: With the commercial development of Bonfire City and increased exchanges along the railway loop, the City Hall has gained more and more investment.\nWhen I return to City Hall to inquire about investment matters, the receptionist greets me with a big smile.\n"Thanks to your previous help, the city has already overcome its financial difficulties! We are no longer open for public investment. Wishing you prosperous business fortunes!"
dialogContent.从工作人员口中得知，这座城市已经得到了充分发展，不再接受大众投资了。\r或许省下: From the staff, it is learned that this city has been fully developed and no longer accepts public investment. Perhaps the saved funds can be used elsewhere. In any case, the feeling of helping the city's development is not bad at all!
dialogContent.前方的轨道上发现了高高堆起的障碍物……为了乘车人员的安全，只好暂时停车了。\r一: Barricades piled high have been discovered on the track ahead... For the safety of the passengers, we have to stop temporarily.\nA group of bandits in a heavily armored vehicle blocks the way, arrogantly shouting things like "Pay the toll."
dialogContent.为了保证列车上乘客和货物的安全，我们只好付钱走人。\r希望未来的某天我们能“回敬: To ensure the safety of passengers and cargos on the train, we have no choice but to pay. Hopefully we can "retaliate" against these lawbreakers one day in the future.
dialogContent.在行驶途中发现了一些遗失货物！\r根据铁盟运输有关条例，因外力遗失在运输途中的货: Found some lost cargo during the journey!\nAccording to the relevant regulations of BCRL, the right to dispose of cargo lost in transit due to external forces belongs to the conductor who finds them.
dialogContent.箱子里装着一些有用的素材和常见的货物。\r我们一定能好好运用这些意外收获！: The box contains some useful materials and common goods.\nWe will surely make good use of these unexpected gains!
dialogContent.在铁路沿途的一处流民营地，我们遇见了一位商人。\r他正在营地中主持“淘金热”游戏: At a refugee camp along the railway, we meet a merchant.\nHe is hosting the "Gold Rush" game in the camp, a tabletop game featuring guessing the dice numbers, which used to be quite popular. The people sitting around the table make room for us, as if welcoming us to join... However, what can this luck-based game really bring us?
dialogContent.见我们好奇凑近，他立刻开始热情地介绍游戏规则，邀请我们加入。\r“骰子摇出1、2: Seeing us curiously approach, he immediately begins enthusiastically explaining the game rules and invites us to join. "A roll of 1, 2, or 3 is considered 'small', while a roll of 4, 5, or 6 is 'big'. To participate, you just need to guess whether it will be big or small. If you win, you take the money and leave, but if you lose, you must voluntarily pay me a bit! Want to play, young people?"
dialogContent.对这种只靠运气的游戏没什么信心，或许等以后有闲情逸致了再来玩玩吧。: I have no confidence in luck-based games, maybe I'll play it later when I have more leisure time.
dialogContent.骰子在桌面上停下，结果正如先前所猜测的那样。商人认输地耸耸肩，把我们应得的奖励推: The dice stops on the table, and the result is just as predicted. The merchant shrugs in defeat and pushes the reward to us.\n"You guys are really lucky! Come back again!"
dialogContent.骰子在桌面上停下，结果却与先前所猜测的相反。商人开怀大笑，伸手拿走了我们预先放在: The dice stops on the table, but the result is contrary to our prediction. The merchant laughs heartily and reaches out to take the money we have placed on the table in advance.\n"Bad luck this time, but maybe better next time! Do come again!"
dialogContent.为了保证列车上乘客和货物的安全，我们挺身而出！\r劫匪们开着装甲车落荒而逃，移开: To ensure the safety of passengers and cargo on the train, we step forward!\nThe bandits flee in their armored vehicle, and after clearing the barricades, we set off again.
dialogContent.哦？路边有一个神秘的箱子，也许打开后会有意想不到的好事发生……打开看看吗？: Oh? There is a mysterious box by the roadside. Maybe something unexpectedly good will happen after opening it... Would you like to open it?
dialogContent.虽然努力与劫匪战斗，却还是被他们钻空子了……没能打赢。: Although we tried to fight the bandits, they still prevailed.
dialogContent.“很久很久以前，在梦幻之城里……有一个白色的、毛茸茸耳朵、亮晶晶眼睛的王子殿下。: "Once upon a time, in the City of Dreams... there lived a prince with white fluffy ears and bright, glittering eyes. His name was Staris — a name that means the sky strewn with stars."\n"Staris's eyes shine so brilliantly, just like shooting stars. If I make a wish upon those eyes, could every desire come true?"\n"Then I have a wish... I no longer want to be bound by strict rules, nor scolded by teachers during etiquette lessons. I never want to spend my whole life trapped inside a cage."
dialogContent.“很久很久以前，在梦幻之城里……有一位粉色耳朵、粉色礼裙、浑身蝴蝶结的公主。公主: "Once upon a time, in the City of Dreams... there lived a princess with pink ears, a pink gown, and bows adorning her from head to toe. Her name was Lunette, which means the maiden like the moon."\n"Lunette is the most perfect and adorable girl. Everyone will sing her praises the moment they first lay eyes on her. Countless people across the world hold her dear..."\n"If only I could be just like her. I want to be loved!"
dialogContent.来三选一吧: Please choose one of the three options.
dialogContent.“当然了。能找到这座小屋的人，除了我自己，便只有最熟知我行动、信赖我的主家。身为: "Of course. Aside from myself, only my master who trusts me and knows my every move could ever find this place. As your maid, I know this better than anyone... In any case, your affairs come first. Please take your things and continue on your journey."\nOlivien's manner toward you is utterly deferent now, a far cry from how she acted as acting shopkeeper back at the Flamingo Petshop. Before you can gather your thoughts, you take the items she hands over, and the brooms surround you as you set off once again.
dialogContent.“哦呀哦呀……这可真是，没想到第一个遇到的客人居然是您呢？”\\n\r循着声音望:
"Oh my! I never expected you to be my very first guest."
You turn toward the voice. At first sight lies a fantastical creature with adorable rabbit-like features — yet it looks nothing like any ordinary rabbit in the real world. Raising your gaze, you recognize the speaker: Goethe, the master of Night Chains Land, whom you met briefly once before.
"Since we are bound by such pleasant fate, you may choose any wares I have here."
He snaps his fingers, and a countless stream of dazzling objects materializes before your eyes...
dialogContent.不知何时，你发现自己走到了一排扫帚组成的队列之中……奇妙的是，这些扫帚似乎有了自: Before you realize it, you find yourself walking into a line of brooms. Strangely enough, these brooms seem to have gained a will of their own. The moment they sense your approach, they stand perfectly straight, waiting silently by the roadside. At the end of the broom line stands a simple, rustic cottage, where familiars shaped like teapots and clocks bustle about busily.\nOutside the cottage door, Olivien offers you a gentle smile.\n"What's the matter, master? You've returned all of a sudden... Did you come back to retrieve something?"
dialogContent.“看见您安全无恙真是太好了。我刚刚将我的使魔们派去各地，为其他的魔女们帮忙……当: "I'm truly relieved to see you safe and sound. I just sent my familiars to various places to assist the other witches... and my apprentice, of course. I took a short rest after finishing my duties, yet you found me nonetheless. I hope you will not mind."\nShe rises to her feet and bows respectfully, then holds open the cottage door for you. The interior is warm and cozy, resembling a second home woven from dreams...\nYou take a peaceful rest for a while, accompanied by Olivien.
dialogContent.眼前再次出现扫帚的队列时，你知道，距离奥莉薇恩所在的场所不远了。但与此前不同，使: When the line of brooms appears once again, you know Olivien's dwelling is close by. Yet something is different from before — the familiars have grown far fewer in number. Has some change taken place?\nYou walk up to the cottage and see Olivien resting in a wicker rocking chair. You hesitate to wake her, but she slowly opens her eyes of her own accord. She stands and gives you a gentle, slight bow.\n"As you see, master, I was just having a short nap. If you need anything at all, please do speak your mind."
dialogContent.在“肚子饿了”这个念头出现的瞬间，面前就出现了一家植物主题的餐厅。与一般的餐厅不: The moment the thought of "I'm hungry" crosses your mind, a plant-themed restaurant appears before you. Unlike ordinary eateries, this venue is built entirely within a giant tree. All dishes rest on flat leaves floating around the trunk, drifting through the air and pausing at intervals, giving guests time to pick up their meals...\nAs you step into the peculiar restaurant, a doll-sized figure perched on one of the leaves makes you halt in your tracks. It is no living doll — but Katas, dressed in a maid outfit!
dialogContent.玩偶大小的卡塔斯震惊地转过身来，接着就开始对你大喊大叫。由于她的大嗓门也一同随着: The miniature Katas spins around in shock and immediately starts shouting at you. Her loud voice has shrunk along with her body, forcing you to lean close to the leaf just to make out her frantic cries. "Lord of Black Iron!!!! Help!!!!"\nWhy is Katas working here in a maid outfit? And why has she shrunk to such a tiny size? Before you can voice any of these questions, the leaf she stands on stirs to motion, carrying her away until she vanishes from your sight. The next second, a box of crispy, piping-hot potato fries falls straight into your arms.\nYou decide to ask her about it the next time you meet.
dialogContent.再次来到这家餐厅时，“树干”周围的叶片仍然像原来一样不断漂浮移动，区别在于这里提: Upon your return to the restaurant, the leaves drifting and swirling around the giant tree trunk still move just as they did before—yet the selection of food has grown far richer. Besides ordinary fast food, several leaves now hold full afternoon tea platters... along with black tea exuding a luxurious, refined aroma. Unlike your last encounter, the miniature Katas now leaps and nimbly drifts between the floating leaves with effortless ease, like a sprite hailing from the land of fairies.\nNoticing your approach, she directs a leaf to glide toward you. It comes to a steady halt right in front of you, and she plants her hands proudly on her hips.\n"Well?! How's my leaf restaurant?!"
dialogContent.“当然不需要！在你消失的期间，我已经掌握了控制这些……这些春日精灵分身的方法！现: "No help needed at all! While you were gone, I've completely mastered how to control these... these spring sprite proxies! They're all under the command of the Jumakenki now — no more getting swept away and flown all over the place!"\nLooking at triumphant, self-assured Katas, you figure there is no need to ask why she is here anymore. Just as you turn to leave, she calls out to stop you.\n"Wait! Take this to Miss Olivien for me. Tell her Katas is capable now!"A cup of black tea floats over to you. Strangely enough, no matter how you move or tilt it, the tea inside never spills or overturns. With this magical cup of tea in hand, you take your leave of the peculiar restaurant.
dialogContent.不知何时，你发现自己走到了一排扫帚组成的队列之中……奇妙的是，这些扫帚似乎有了自: Before you realize it, you find yourself walking into a line of brooms. Strangely enough, these brooms seem to have gained a will of their own. The moment they sense your approach, they stand perfectly straight, waiting silently by the roadside. At the end of the broom line stands a simple, rustic cottage, where familiars shaped like teapots and clocks bustle about busily.\nOutside the cottage door, Olivien offers you a gentle smile.\n"What's the matter, master? You've returned all of a sudden... Did you come back to retrieve something?"
dialogContent.察觉到你的到来，乐园的主人再次露出了笑脸。\\n\r“多亏了您的活跃，我见识到了: Sensing your presence, the master of the amusement park greets you with another warm smile.\n"Thanks to all your lively endeavors, I've gotten to behold such lovely sights. In return, you may pick any wares here as you wish."
dialogContent.走着走着又碰到那个充满童趣的摊位了，你也终于想起来这位商人的真实身份——火烈鸟宠: As you continue on your way, you run into that playful stall once more. At last, you remember who this merchant truly is — Galore, owner of the Flamingo Petshop and a magician from the Empire. Why has he ended up here? You decide not to dwell on it. In this strange realm, you have met far too many people who seem out of place.
dialogContent.道路的前方出现了一个摊位——马卡龙色的桌椅上装饰着漂亮的气球，应该是很受孩子们喜: Up ahead stands a stall. Its macaron-colored tables and chairs are decorated with pretty balloons, clearly a little shop beloved by children. Beside it stands a pink-haired young man with a vacant look on his face. He seems unfamiliar, yet there lingers a strangely familiar aura about him. Where have you felt this presence before?\nWhile you are lost in thought, the young man speaks.\n"Would you like to purchase anything?"
dialogContent.已经不会再启动的列车安然停歇此处，开启的车门中倾泻出暖色的灯光。魔女于此等待——: The train, never to depart again, rests peacefully here. Warm light streams out from its open doors. A witch lingers in this place — and fortunately, she is the one you know well. She holds cards and a crystal ball that govern the course of others' fates.\nSeeing you approach, the witch turns to you and smiles.\n"You're here at last, Dear Conductor. I've been waiting for you for ages."
dialogContent.雾气温柔地将你环绕，其中传来了模糊的对话声。仔细聆听后，依稀能分辨出是一对母女正:
Soft mist gently wraps around you, and faint voices drift from within it. Listening closely, you can just make out a mother talking with her daughter...
"Mommy, what are these stickers?"
"This is magic to protect my little one..."
"Mommy can do magic? You're so awesome! You're the best mommy in the whole world!"
dialogContent.淡紫色的菌盖在月光下缓慢地旋转，就像是哼着歌在小径上轻快转圈的魔女的裙摆，孢子洒: The pale purple mushroom caps rotate slowly under the moonlight, resembling the skirt of a witch who hums and twirls lightly along the path. Spores drift down, dotting the surroundings with glimmering star-shaped rings. Fireflies creep carefully out from the gills of the mushrooms and flutter toward a strange woman sitting beneath a giant mushroom, absorbed in a book.\nJust as you step forward to strike up a conversation, the gentle and tranquil blonde woman raises a finger.\n"Do not disturb them."
dialogContent.“一些还在此处徘徊的灵魂……看不见他们对你来说反而是好事。”女人充满慈爱地看着你: "Spirits still lingering here... It is actually a blessing that you cannot see them." She looks at you with warm kindness. Then she stretches out her hand and catches a firefly at an incredible speed. Before you can react, she opens her palm. The firefly has vanished, leaving only a round, gorgeous gem that holds the reflection of moonlight in its surface.\n"Take this. May it keep you safe on your way out."\nMoved by her reassuring aura, you take the gem without hesitation.
dialogContent.与上一次迷路到此处时相比，菌盖已经不再旋转，连色彩都黯淡了许多。巨型蘑菇下的女人:
Compared with the last time you got lost here, the mushroom caps no longer rotate, and their hues have faded considerably. The woman still sits beneath the giant mushroom, and her book seems nearly finished.
Noticing your presence, she lifts her head and offers a soft smile.
"You have come back after all." She lets out a gentle sigh. She no longer bids you stay quiet, but sets down the book and stands to her feet.
"The fireflies have led them away."
It is true. You glance around, and the mushroom gills lie completely empty. Only the long shadows cast by the mushroom stretch forth like ancient boundary markers, separating this secluded place from the world beyond.
dialogContent.“回到该回的地方去了，你应该为他们感到高兴。”她走到你的面前，冰凉的指尖划过空气: "They have returned to where they belong. You ought to feel happy for them." She walks over to you. Her cold fingertips trail through the air, before coming to rest with a light tap between your brows. "I hope our next meeting will be on a bright, lovely day."\nHer eyes appear dim and unfathomable beneath the night sky. Meanwhile, a faint humming drifts from afar, like the flutter of countless wings. Yet when you turn to look, there is nothing to be seen.
dialogContent.空中落下了乌鸦的羽毛。随着第一片乌鸦的羽翼从视野中划过，黑色的鸟儿就越来越多地向: Raven feathers drift down from the sky. As the first feather flits across your view, more and more of the black birds swoop toward you, until they blot out everything in sight. The moment you are about to be swallowed by this chaotic darkness, the flutter of wings suddenly ceases.\n"...Come back... That's not a bad person. No thorns linger on that soul."\nThe ravens all return to the purple-haired girl at the center of the swirling flock, their bright yellow eyes fixed steadily on you. Her eyes resemble those of these ill-omened birds, yet there is something distinctly different about them.
dialogContent.“……我们认识吗？抱歉，我不记得了……‘乌鸦的魔女’应该减少和人的接触，因为我是:
"...Do we know each other? I'm sorry, but I cannot recall. The Witch of Ravens ought to keep her distance from others, for I am a source of misfortune."
A troubled look crosses Ren's face as she gazes at you. Could that brief encounter from before have faded deep into her memories? Or might this not even be the her that dwells in the real world? There is no way to tell.
"Staying here will bring you bad luck. If my Raven's Eye loses control, terrible things will surely happen... Please leave quickly. I'm... truly sorry."
After apologizing, she takes a soft, sleek raven feather and tucks it into your palm. Then she gestures for one of the ravens to lead you away from this place.
dialogContent.再次被乌鸦的羽毛所指引——这次，它们没有疯狂地将你视为侵入者。这些鸟儿仍然凝视着:
You are guided onward by raven feathers once again. This time, the birds no longer treat you as a hostile intruder. They still keep a close watch on you, yet their gazes now carry a tone of scrutiny and observation.
At your reappearance, the Witch of Ravens looks torn between joy and unease.
"Why have you come back? I thought once you knew I bring misfortune, you would be scared out of your wits just like everyone else... and flee away."
She keeps fidgeting, brushing her loose hair repeatedly, and a faint blush even tints her cheeks.
dialogContent.仅仅是被叫住这个名字，她就愣住了。\\n\r“……虽然不知道你为什么会知道我的名:
The instant you call her by her name, she freezes on the spot.
"...I have no idea how you know my name, but... we must have crossed paths somewhere, right? You remember my real name, instead of that terrifying, hateful title — the Witch of Ravens... Thank you. In another place, I am not a symbol of bad luck, am I? Did I... did I make you happy?"
Before you can reply with either yes or no, she shakes her head firmly and starts weaving a spell with feathers held in her hands.
"No, I don't need to know. I ought to give you this... I want to be of some help to you."
"...Thank you for coming to see me. Even if you were just passing by, thank you."
dialogContent.疑惑为何这里会出现月台已经是浪费时间的事了，比起那个，只在TMT的历史教材看到过: There is no point wondering how a platform came to be here. What surprises you far more is the vintage locomotive — a model you have only seen mentioned in TMT history textbooks — puffing steam that carries the faint scent of ink. Looking closely, you find the pillars along the platform are actually built from stacked book pages, covered in dense lines of writing in an unknown script.\n"Welcome to the Story Platform."\nThe tall masked man tips a hat that does not exist and bows deeply.
dialogContent.“是我，没想到我们会在这里重逢。”他的语气平和，略带遗憾，“可惜，我现在正在赶时:
"It's me. I never thought we would meet again in this place." His voice is calm, with a touch of regret. "Sadly, I am pressed for time."
He pulls out a pocket watch to check the time, then leaps aboard the old train.
"I am off to witness a trial. I wait for the ending of a tale: the story of a queen, a witch, and a mother. I will tell you all about it when we cross paths next."
"Oh, and one more thing —"
He conjures a handful of candies out of thin air from his top hat and tosses them your way.
"Have some sweets to recharge. See you later."
dialogContent.嗯，又来到了那个月台，不过原本停靠在这里的蒸汽火车已经不见了。故事先生拎着一个箱:
You arrive at the platform once more, yet the steam locomotive that once stopped here is gone. Mr. Storyteller paces between the pillars, a box in his hand. Every now and then he pauses, as if reading the tales inscribed upon them.
He looks quite pleased when he notices you.
"Fortune smiles on me. I thought I would have to wait a while longer."
With these words, he holds out the box for you to take.
"I promised I would share the ending with you," he says gently. "But I can tell you are in a hurry too. I did not wish to keep you lingering here, so I have sorted everything out."
Your gaze drifts to the box — crammed so full that its shape is visibly warped.
"All forty-two endings are inside. I hope they will satisfy you."
dialogContent.“因为这里是故事月台，连接开头和结局的地方，一切的惊喜、反转、拐点都从此衍生……:
"This is the Story Platform, a place that links every beginning to its end. All surprises, plot twists and turning points originate right here..."
He raps his knuckles against the lid. Streaks of rainbow-colored ink suddenly seep out from the cracks.
"When a reader turns to the final page, all the untaken paths of a story travel along the rail tracks back into the writer's dreams. That is where they become sealed inside this box. I merely collected them along my way — it would be such a pity to let them fade away."
"In the world beyond, one single ending has been set in stone. But these unclaimed finales long for new masters. I believe you are the right person to take them."
You do not fully understand his words, but it seems you only need to accept the box for now.
dialogContent.在一个遍布魔法的世界中突然遇见一位持枪的女性……很不寻常。\\n\r路边这位女性:
To come across a woman armed with firearms in this world brimming with magic is truly out of the ordinary.
She stands by the roadside, looking laid-back and bored, yet seemingly searching for something all the while. Noticing you draw near, she steps aside and lifts a hand to greet you.
"Hi~"
She is undeniably a beautiful and approachable lady. Even so, what is with those striking, oversized horns on her head?
"Hey there. Are you here to hitch a ride too?"
dialogContent.“嗯嗯，地表不是会有这种文化嘛——在路边伸出大拇指，请求路过的车带自己一程。我觉:
"Yep! This is a custom on the surface world, right? Stick out your thumb by the road to ask passing vehicles for a lift. I think it looks really cool and fun — it feels so free and unrestrained, just like me. That's why I'm trying to hitchhike here... but no cars have come at all, no matter how long I wait. By the way, I'm Lukavi. What's your name?"
"Huh? You mean there are no cars here because this is the realm of witches? ...Really?"
"Well, nothing I can do about it then. I'll just find another way to get around~"
The long-haired woman turns slowly to leave. Then a thought crosses her mind, and she flicks a coin over to you.
"This was my travel coin. You can have it. Good luck to you, fellow hitchhiker!"
dialogContent.又与这位自称“露卡薇”的奇怪女性在路上相遇了。一见到你的身影，她就像是见到了相识: You run into the peculiar woman who calls herself Lukavi once more on the road. The second she catches sight of you, she strides over quickly, just like greeting an old friend.\n"We meet again! What a nice surprise. I didn't think you'd still be here. I figured we wouldn't cross paths again until much later..."\n"By the way, I just came across some really strange people a little while ago. They gave me supplies, and even some magical items. Want me to share them with you? Do you need any?"
dialogContent.穿过花园小径，眼前出现了一个氛围静谧的人造湖。湖水泛着珍珠母般的冷调光泽，湖面的: Walking down the garden path, you come upon a tranquil artificial lake. Its surface glows with the cool luster of mother-of-pearl. The ripples spread out in all directions, smooth as fine silk woven and tended by a witch's loom. Images drift across the pebbles half-submerged in the shallows — figures of children with varied faces, some playing, others lost in thought...\nA woman with golden hair and scarlet robes, wearing a crown of thorns, stands gazing out over the water, her thoughts hidden from view.
dialogContent.“受人之托。替一位老朋友看管此地。她去指挥萤火虫们了，此处又不能无人监视。”先导:
"I keep watch here for an old companion. She has departed to guide the fireflies, and this realm must never be left unguarded." The Vanguard glances at you, then turns her eyes back to the water. "You look as if you have questions."
Your thoughts have been seen through once more. You nod awkwardly.
"This is the lake of memories. Beneath its waves lie the recollections of childhood — fragments and scenes many believe they have cast away, be they filled with joy or grief."
"To forget is not to erase. Long after they have stepped into adulthood, a single moment may reawaken the past: a bite of the chocolate they once yearned for, or the fulfillment of a dream held since youth. Then these unassuming pebbles shall be drawn up from the depths once more."
"Hence a guardian must remain, lest the waters be defiled and precious memories plundered."
You do not fully grasp her words, yet you follow her lead and stare at the lake. The water is clear and calm, and silence hangs all around. Gradually, your body and mind are soothed and healed.
dialogContent.湖面映照着深沉的夜空，微风拂过，水波轻轻荡漾，倒映出的星光被揉碎，仿佛是每一个被: The lake reflects the deep night sky. A soft breeze sweeps across the water, stirring gentle ripples.
