The reflected starlight scatters into glimmers, just like fragments of sunken memories glowing beneath the surface.\nLisandra's scarlet robes merge with the night, like faint embers left after silence has swallowed everything around.\n"You wander back here again... It may signify that my appointed task in this dream is drawing to its close."
dialogContent.她摇摇头，继续解释道：“如果单纯说是某人的梦那并不准确，这里更像是链接着无数梦境:
She shakes her head and carries on explaining. "To define this as a single person's dream would be wrong. This peculiar domain arises from the slender gaps between endless intertwined dreams. I fear I am making this too convoluted. Yet once you comprehend the true nature of this realm, the path to leave will reveal itself sooner."
"Here, take this."
The Vanguard presses a pebble into your hand. It is a vessel for memories, yet no images appear upon its surface.
"This stone belongs to you, yet it stands hollow inside. A most curious sight. Do you hold every precious memory fast in your heart, letting nothing fade into oblivion? Or might you have never... No, let us speak no more of it. Carry this stone, and press forward."
dialogContent.长途跋涉让你又累又饿。正在你想找个地方坐下来稍事休息时，却看见了远处的火光和炊烟: The long journey has left you tired and hungry. Just as you search for a place to sit and rest, you spot firelight and curling smoke in the distance. A faint scent of cooked food drifts over with the wind. Could someone be camping out here?!\nYou walk toward the flames and find three travelers gathered around the fire, laughing and chatting as they share their meal. One of them notices you approaching and turns to look your way right away.\n"Are you a traveler too?"
dialogContent.“那我们就是应该互相照应的同伴啦。要吃点东西吗？”\\n\r她用空余的餐具分了一: "Then we are companions who should look out for each other. Care for some food?"\nShe uses an extra utensil to serve you a portion. You tuck into the meal heartily. The meat has a unique aroma and a firm, chewy texture, yet you cannot tell what kind of meat it is. Even so, you eat with great enjoyment. You can't help thinking that if restaurants in the real world could recreate this flavor, it would definitely be a massive hit.\nOnce you have regained your strength, you chat happily with the travelers for a while before heading off again.
dialogContent.远处的火光、隐约的香气、熟悉的笑闹声……\\n\r不会错！就是那三个欢快脱线的旅:
The campfire in the distance, the faint aromas and familiar laughter and chatter...
There is no mistaking them — those three lively, easygoing travelers!
You walk over to the campfire with delight. This time, it is the traveler accompanied by a silver hound(?) who greets you. The one who once served you soup seems to be studying magic, while the blonde traveler lies sprawled out fast asleep.
"We meet again! How has your journey been? Everything going well? Come and chat with us."
dialogContent.在用餐时与她们分享了这一路上的所见所闻。带着银色猎犬的旅行者一边抚摸着自己的伙伴:
Over the meal, you share all the sights and experiences you have encountered along the way. While stroking her canine companion, the traveler with the silver hound speaks her thoughts thoughtfully.
"I came here with Millie and Reeva, yet something just feels off about this journey. It is like wandering through an adventure inside a dream... but it does not belong to any single person. If it were the dream of one individual, that person must be extraordinarily powerful — and deeply sorrowful too."
"Stay careful as you continue your exploration. I hope we can meet again."
After finishing your meal, you set off once more, bearing the travelers' earnest warnings in mind.
dialogContent.出现了！是经典电影里魔女们一定会使用的魔法交通工具——扫帚！魔女们骑着扫帚在天空: There it is! A broom — the classic magical vehicle that witches are always seen using in old films. The sight of witches flying freely through the sky on brooms has always filled you with longing... This broom looks brand-new. You have no clue why it was left here, but it must still be usable. Should you get on it?

There it is! A broom — the classic magical vehicle that witches are always seen using in old films. The sight of witches flying freely through the sky on brooms has always filled you with longing... This broom looks worn out and bears obvious signs of frequent use. Yet on second thought, those marks prove it is a trustworthy tool that has served its purpose well. It would definitely be better than walking all the way on foot. Will you ride it?
dialogContent.你骑上了扫帚，扫帚带着你向远处飞去……: You get on the broom, and it carries you off into the distance...
dialogContent.虽然嘎吱作响，但好歹扫帚还是驮着你飞起来了……: Although it creaks, the broom still manages to carry you into the air...
dialogContent.“……是、是谁在说话？”\\n\r“是王子殿下回应我了吗……如果是的话，能不能实: "W-Who's talking?"\n"Could it be the Prince answering me? If so... would you grant my wish?"\n"My name is Anna. I beg you, Your Highness..."
dialogContent.走近这孤单但又浪漫的摩天轮下时，你的目光不由地被远处的一个身影吸引。\\n\r白: As you walk beneath the lonely yet romantic Ferris wheel, a figure in the distance catches your eye.\nIt is the white-haired young man — Wensheng, Safety Director of Night Chains. Dressed in casual wear that stands in sharp contrast to his usual appearance, he is completely absorbed in... playing the claw machine!?\nHe moves swiftly. Every press of the button is steady and precise. Oddly enough, the dolls inside the machine seem endless, as if they will never run out.
dialogContent.不知为何，路边的草丛对你产生了神秘的吸引力。\\n\r直觉告诉你，其中一定能找到: Somehow, the grass by the roadside holds a mysterious appeal for you.\nYour intuition says there must be something useful hidden within. Still, would it be appropriate to rummage through the grass all of a sudden?
dialogContent.顶着满身草屑和大自然的气息，你真的寻得了一些有用之物。: Covered in grass clippings and the scent of nature, you indeed found some useful items.
dialogContent.喷泉像是一颗沉寂的星辰，镶嵌在广场中央，池水映照着月光与街灯，微微荡漾。斑驳的浮: The fountain stands at the square's center like a slumbering star. Its water ripples softly, mirroring the glow of moonlight and street lamps. Weathered relief carvings appear and fade amid the gentle light and shadow. Water streams down with a soft gurgle, splitting into countless silvery threads. They glimmer for a moment in the air before falling back into the pool.\nA voice echoes inside your mind. "Toss in a coin. I will teach you how to chase the stars."
dialogContent.青年回头看你，他有一瞬间的迷惑，但很快递来了一个玩偶，是送给你的意思吧……？\\: The young man turns to glance at you. Confusion flits across his face for a moment, then he holds out a doll. He must be giving it to you... right?\nYou hear him murmur, "Seven more rounds to clear the game." You cannot quite tell what he is caught up in, yet it is plain he is working to finish some sort of challenge.\nMaybe you will drop by again next time you pass through here.
dialogContent.伴随着乐队的演奏和漫天飘洒的彩花，花车巡游开始了！\\n\r接近的花车上，魔女装: To the accompaniment of the band's performance and swirling confetti everywhere, the float parade begins!\nOn the approaching float, the performer dressed as a witch reaches out to you, as if inviting you to climb aboard. The parade undoubtedly heads for the castle far in the distance.\nYet the witch's face and hands slowly grow blurry in your vision. To gain a witch's power, one must always pay a corresponding price...
dialogContent.只消一瞬间，你便站在了魔女的身边。然而，魔女的面容仍然模糊不清，你甚至无法听清那: In the blink of an eye, you find yourself standing right beside her. Her features remain indistinct. You cannot even make out what words spill from her constantly moving lips. A curse? Or a blessing?\nThe next moment, you have arrived at your destination. The float and the witch are gone without a trace. Only a soft whisper drifts from afar and lingers in your ears.\n"I will wait for you here. I will keep waiting..."
dialogContent.“很久很久以前，在梦幻之城里……有一位神秘、总是身着黑色礼服的演员。演员的名字叫: "Long long ago, in the City of Dreams, there was a mysterious performer who always dressed in a black formal gown. The name was Umbra, a name that stands for the profound darkness and mystery of the night sky."\n"I long to be just like Umbra. To move freely between stages and theaters, and capture the heart of the entire City of Dreams."\n"To speak my thoughts and share what I see with ease... and make my presence known to the world... Every soul, be it a princess or a prince, will turn their eyes to him."
dialogContent.“魔女小姐，能听见我的声音吗？”\\n\r“我是安娜。是那个寻找星星般的王子殿下: "Miss Witch, can you hear me?"\n"I'm Anna, the one who seeks the prince like a shining star. I want to tell you why I made this wish. In return, I will give you something I hold dear."
dialogContent.“魔女！你是魔女对吧！我想要解释我的愿望，请你仔细听！”\\n\r“……对了，名: "Witch! You are a witch, aren't you? I need to explain my wish, so please listen closely!"\n"Oh right, my name is Belle. Don't get it wrong! Will you hear me now? I want to become just like Lunette."
dialogContent.“魔女大人……能听见我的声音吧？”\\n\r“大家都说向魔女献上祭品的话就可以实: "Lady Witch... I know you can hear me."\n"Everyone says that if you present an offering to a witch, your wish will come true. And I need to tell you my name too — I think I mentioned it when I wished before... I'm Carol, the one who wishes to be like Umbra..."
dialogContent.“魔女小姐？魔女小姐……你的声音消失了……”\\n\r“我好像迷路了……难道这里: "Miss Witch? Miss Witch... Your voice is gone..."\n"I seem to have gotten lost. Could this place be a trap? I kept following the silvery-white star of Lord Staris, but no matter what I do, I can never reach it."\n"Will I never get out of here? It's so cold... Is anyone there?"
dialogContent.“魔女、魔女……你真的在那里吗？你答应我会实现我的愿望的，可是现在为什么消失不见: "Witch, witch... Are you really there? You promised you would grant my wish, so why have you vanished now?!"\n"I've looked everywhere for you... Do you not want to see me? Will you abandon me too, just because I'm not cute or pretty enough? But you promised to make me a girl like Lunette!"
dialogContent.“魔女大人……肯定已经抛弃我了吧。”\\n\r“反正也不会有人来找我……即使我在: "Lady Witch... You must have left me for good."\n"No one will come looking for me anyway. Even if I disappear or get eaten by monsters here, nobody will come to save me. And I'm so weak... I could never be like Umbra..."
dialogContent.在一片模糊的雾气中，所有声音都消失了。\\n\r但你似乎能听见不远处有着急匆匆的: All voices fade away amid the thick, blurred mist.\nYet you hear hurried footsteps not far off, sounding like children running. Soon the footsteps die out, and an object wrapped in a faint soft glow emerges from the mist nearby...
dialogContent.“是我。我的名字叫做贝莉。”\\n\r“你是魔女吗？还是说，是幽灵呢？”\\n\: "It's me. My name is Belle."\n"Are you a witch? Or... a ghost?"\n"Either way, I want to be just like Lunette, loved by countless people!"
dialogContent.“咦……是魔女听见我的声音了吗？”\\n\r“我是……卡洛儿。我会去找你的……”: "Huh... Has the witch heard me?"\n"I'm Carol. I'll come find you..."\n"Please make me as mysterious, aloof and charming as Umbra. I beg you..."
dialogContent.“我想要更自由的生活。只要能像是魔女一样，通过魔法，应该就能实现了吧……”\\n: "I long for a freer life. If I could wield magic like a witch, I'm sure my wish would come true..."\n"To reach for the stars... or shine as brightly as the prince. I wish to have a heart, courage and confidence worthy of a formal gown."\n"This is something I carry with me. It may not be valuable, but please take it."
dialogContent.“我一直都想变得受大家欢迎……可是无论我怎么努力，好像也还是不如别人。肯定是还缺: "I've always wanted to be popular among everyone... Yet no matter how hard I try, I still fall short of others. There must be something I'm missing... Something that no amount of money can buy, perhaps?"\n"This is a gift I brought... It may be useless to a witch, but if you take it, you have to grant my wish!"\n"I'm coming for you. Don't go away!"
dialogContent.“是不是应该解释一下……愿望？这样魔女才能更好地施展魔法……”\\n\r“……我: "Maybe I should explain my wish first... So you can cast your magic better..."\n"I'm so afraid it won't come true. What will I do if my wish fails? This dream is all I have. I want to accomplish things with my own strength..."\n"Please accept this. Is it enough as an offering, Lady Witch?"
dialogContent.“……你是谁？还有人能听见我的声音吗？”\\n\r“我知道了……那我就把这个留在: "...Who are you? Can anyone hear my voice?"\n"I see... I'll leave it here then. If you walk the same path as me, you will find it. I will keep moving toward the silvery-white star... I hope to find you, Miss Witch."
dialogContent.“你是谁？就算你说不要放弃，我也不知道该怎么坚持了……”\\n\r“……我、我知: "Who are you? Even if you tell me not to give up, I don't know how to keep going..."\n"I... I understand. I'll find a safe place to rest and figure things out. If you wield magic or any other power, please come for me quickly. I'll leave a mark here, so be sure to follow it!"
dialogContent.“你是谁？！不，不是安布拉……”\\n\r“你说得对……我其实不想待在这里的。我: "Who are you?! No... You're not Umbra..."\n"You're right... I never wanted to stay here. What should I do? Can I go look for you near the castle? Once I reach the parade route, I'll be able to see you, won't I?"\n"Thank you. If you have magic, take this... and come find me..."
dialogContent.随着你握住那个物品，周围的雾气在瞬间全部消散了。是雾中的孩子留下的吗？还是说这只: The moment you grasp the object, all the surrounding mist disperses in an instant. Was it left behind by the child hidden in the fog? Or is it just another unsolved mystery within the witch's realm?\nRegardless, the item is now yours.
dialogContent.“当然是我啦，除此之外还有谁呢？我花了很长时间准备各种各样的魔法……不过见到车长: "Of course it's me! Who else could it be? I've spent ages preparing all sorts of magic. Now that you've arrived safe and sound, Dear Conductor, all my efforts have not gone to waste!"\n"You have the things you picked up along the road with you, right? Hand them over. I'll imbue them with magic, just like the little witches in animations~"
dialogContent.“看见我很高兴吧，车长亲！那么先来拥抱一下——”\\n\r“不过，你现在还是在魔: "You're happy to see me, aren't you, Dear Conductor? Come on, gimme a biiiiiig hug~"\n"Bear in mind, you are still trapped within the witch's realm. Only by pressing forward and finding the exit can you save those children. Give me what you hold in your hands... I'll turn them into talismans strong enough to keep you protected!"
dialogContent.再次来到列车中支起的小小占卜屋中，你的心中充满了庆幸。在这个变幻莫测的领域之中，: You return to the tiny divination room set up inside the train, and a great sense of relief comes over you. In this erratic and unpredictable realm, having such a reassuring refuge is nothing short of a miracle.\nAs she always does, Margiela stirs the magic in her hands the moment she sees you.\n"You've made it here safely, Dear Conductor!"
dialogContent.在你确定这是谁的声音之前，雾气便逐渐凝聚在你伸出的手心中，化为了一枚薄薄的、亮晶: Before you could tell who the voice came from, the mist swirled and gathered in your outstretched palm, turning into a thin, glistening slip of paper.\nKeep moving forward.
dialogContent.墙壁散发着甜蜜的香气，屋顶泛着诱人的光泽，出现在你面前的是一座真正的“糖果屋”。: The walls exude a sweet fragrance, and the roof shines with an inviting glow. Standing before you is a genuine candy house, just like the ones told in fairy tales. It is enough to entrance any lost child who stumbles upon this place.\nA girl in a black dress waits on the steps outside the house. You recognize her as Masaki. Spotting you, she takes quick little steps over and bows slightly.\n"Welcome to the candy house. Ah, do not be afraid. It is still me, Masaki. Please follow me, Conductor."
dialogContent.“当然是为了引导所有迷途的孩子离开这里啦。其实，马吉拉也在这里的某个地方，我能够: "I am here to lead all the lost children out of this realm. I can feel it — Margiela is somewhere nearby too..."\nMasaki bustles about among the shelves and containers inside the candy house. At last, she picks up a jar filled with colorful candies and holds it out to you.\n"These candies bring sweetness and good luck. If you come across any lost children along the way, they will help keep you safe. Please stay careful, Conductor..."
dialogContent.在踏遍众多魔女的领域和设施以后，你再次来到了无数孩子向往的糖果屋面前。真咲正在门: After traversing countless realms and facilities of the witch, you arrive once more before the candy house that countless children long for. Outside the gate, Masaki stands troubled by a broken cookie fence. Yet the moment she hears your footsteps, she turns toward you with a bright smile.\n"Conductor, you're finally back! What did you come across along the way?"
dialogContent.“看您没事就太好啦……但，毕竟这里还是魔女的领域，为了消除她在领域中制造的各种影: "I'm so glad you're safe. Still, this is the witch's realm after all. We need to keep working to dispel all the effects she has created here. I'll do my best to help too!"\nWhile preparing more magical candies, Masaki cheers you on sincerely. You take the supplies she hands over, then set off for the castle again, determined to face the witch.
dialogContent.“哦！我知道啦，等我找找！”\\n\r说着“等我找找”，露卡薇就轻松地从随身外套: "Oh! Got it, let me look for them!"\nWith that, Lukavi casually pulls out one glowing trinket after another from her coat pocket. Each item seems to hold a special power. She grins and presses all of them into your hands.\n"Here you go! Keep up the good work. I'm looking forward to seeing you again!"
dialogContent.雾气温柔地将你环绕，其中传来了模糊的对话声。仔细聆听后，依稀能分辨出是一对母女正:
Soft mist gently wraps around you, and faint voices drift from within it. Listening closely, you can just make out a mother talking with her daughter...
"Mommy, what are these stickers?"
"This is magic to protect my little one..."
"Mommy can do magic? You're so awesome! You're the best mommy in the whole world!"
dialogContent.硬币落入水中，发出轻微的声响，接着在池水中化作银色的泡沫……泡沫漂浮在空中，其中: The coin drops into the water with a soft plink, then dissolves into silvery bubbles within the pool. The bubbles drift through the air, gradually taking the shape of what you wish for.
dialogContent.伴随着乐队的演奏和漫天飘洒的彩花，花车巡游开始了！\r接近的花车上，魔女装束的演: To the accompaniment of the band's performance and swirling confetti everywhere, the float parade begins!\nOn the approaching float, the performer dressed as a witch reaches out to you, as if inviting you to climb aboard. The parade undoubtedly heads for the castle far in the distance.\nYet the witch's face and hands slowly grow blurry in your vision. To gain a witch's power, one must always pay a corresponding price...
dialogContent.游乐城的主人再度出现在你的面前，他看上去并不惊讶你能走到这里，甚至还有一丝……兴:
The master of the amusement park appears before you once again. He shows no surprise at your arrival — there is even a hint of... excitement in his expression.
"You must have realized it by now. Though familiar sights stretch all around, this place is merely a realm reshaped from the concept and memories of my park. It is not the real Night Chains Land. What a pity. If I were the ruler of this illusory dream, I would pay the highest tribute to all your efforts along the way."
You wonder what he means. His words sound like praise... Before you can gather your thoughts, he snaps his fingers once more.
"Naturally, I can still lend my aid for the brilliant finale that awaits you."
dialogContent.脚步还未停下，就听到了那已经称得上熟悉的声音了。\\n\r“为了向赝作之主残留的: You have barely stopped walking when a familiar voice reaches your ears.\n"I shall lay all I have before you to challenge the lingering sorrowful resentment of the lord of counterfeits! Flowers or thorns? Illusion or truth? Let me witness your choice!"\nGoethe spreads his arms wide.

failTip.持有资金不足，劫匪同情而嫌弃地把我们放走了。: Insufficient funds, the robber lets us go with sympathy and disdain.
failTip.持有资金不足，无法参与商人发起的“淘金热”游戏。: Insufficient funds to participate in the "Gold Rush" game.

name.这是NPC对话事件: This is an NPC dialogue event

selection1.嘿，拾荒者，把仙人掌给我！: Hey, Marauder, give me the cactus!
selection1.其实我需要一点帮助！: Actually, I need a little help!
selection1.那，还能再帮帮我吗？: Then, can you help me a bit more?
selection1.呃，你是服务员的话……: Uh, if you are the waitress...
selection1.……这里除了我们还有其他人吗……？: ...Is there anyone else here besides us?
selection1.所以这里其实是某人的梦？: So this is actually someone's dream?
selection1.管他呢，反正没人看见！: Who cares, no one's watching anyway!
selection1.好吧，挑选一下商品吧。: Fine, let me take a look.

outline.波克士带你来到了训练场，拿出了名为\"挨揍宝\"的训练机器人，为你提供专业的陪练: Box leads you to the training ground and introduces you to "Punch Me", a robot that offers expert training services.
outline.铁安局的警察们正神色匆匆地四处救火，而刚好在修格里城城中的你们，也被人手不足的铁: The BCRL Agency's police officers are desperately putting out fires across the city. Since you happen to be in Shoggolith City, they have forcibly recruited you to help, given their manpower shortage.
outline.被击垮的挨揍宝恢复了原样，训练再一次开始。: The defeated Punch Me returns to its original state, and the training regimen continues.
outline.在波克士的催促下，你开始了第三次训练。: Prompted by Box, you embark on the third training session.
outline.睁开眼，迎接即将到来的同伴……以及敌人。: Stay aware and prepare to face upcoming allies... and enemies.
outline.展示了挨揍宝的神奇特性后，波克士为你转达了铁盟的广告词。: Having shown you all the incredible qualities of Punch Me, Box now presents you with the BCRL advertisement.
outline.在波克士的教导下，你开始了第五次训练。: You begin the fifth training lesson with Box's guidance.
outline.为了能获得更多的收益，扩建一下货箱来增加列车的载货量吧！: Consider enlarging the freight car to raise the train's cargo capacity!
outline.这是最后一次训练，完成它将获得波克士的认可。: Finishing this last training session will get you recognized by Box.
outline.静流和两姐妹前来与列车长告别，学会会将她们带到最近的海角城学社，静流与我们约定未: Shizuru and the two sisters bid farewell to Conductor. The Citadel agrees to take them to the nearest Climber in Cape City. As we say goodbye, Shizuru assures us that we will visit the two sisters together someday.
outline.你们来到商会接取新的委托订单，莉薇娅发现了一个前往淘金场的订单报酬十分丰厚，想要: You arrive at COLUMBA to pick up new commission orders. Livia finds a profitable order to visit the gold mine, but it has already been "reserved" by a familiar face (the "adversary"). Regardless of the disappointment, Conductor may only look for other work. Just then, the supervisor informs you about the ONEderland and leads you to locate the mine owner.
outline.彼得想委托你们把他送到“淘金乐园”，他的豪爽让你隐隐不安，但经过权衡，你还是决定: Peter wishes to be guided to the ONEderland, and despite your reservations about his generosity, you decide to take the train on this adventure.
outline.拿着响立逃扫描着行李的你被雷比斯注意到，对你手中“落后的小玩意儿”嘲讽了一番后，: Everyone gets ready to board the train after Rebis catches you using the Flee Alarm to scan luggage and makes fun of your "outdated trinket".
outline.你带着雷比斯来到列车上，此时，波克士“隆重”欢迎了你们。: As you and Rebis board the train, Box "grandly" greets you.
outline.列车发动，根据情报，你们需要警惕活跃在途径区域的犯罪组织——沙盗团。: The train sets off. Based on the intel received, you've got to stay alert for the criminal group P.U.S. operating in the area.
outline.你在交易所门口意外遇到了老同学西蒙，一向自诩为你命中宿敌的西蒙向你发起了挑战。面: At the door of the Trading Center, you accidentally run into Simon, an old classmate who views himself as your adversary and challenges you. Following his persistent pursuit, you have decided to take on this advantageous but challenging endeavour.
outline.在修格里城商会，你们再次遇到了飞鸟小姐，她提醒你们要小心市长。: Again, you run across Miss Songbird at the Shoggolith CoC. This time, she cautions you about the mayor.
outline.彼得为你讲述了修格里城的历史，你也从他口中得知沙盗劫车案的谋划者另有其人，而这个: Peter tells you about the history of Shoggolith City, revealing that someone else is responsible for the train robbery case, and this person seems to be Peter's reason for undertaking this journey...
outline.一轮比赛刚刚告一段落，不肯服输的西蒙又立刻向你发起了第二次挑战。为了不让他幻想的: As one round of competition is about to end, Simon, who refuses to admit defeat, promptly challenges you to a second round. It seems like you'll have to be more aggressive if you don't want him to fantasize about winning.
outline.荒原之上，以带着一只鹅的少女夏尔为首的沙盗车队正飞驰而来，这群人的目标似乎正是你: In the Wilderness, a group of P.U.S. carriages, led by a girl named Shire and accompanied by a goose, is speeding toward you, and it appears they are after you...
outline.你从工厂获得了更多的车厢改造思路，不过，考虑到列车组目前的状况，这些恐怕都要以后: You received more ideas for carriage modifications from the manufacturer. However, given the current state of the train crew, these will have to wait...
outline.许多掘金机器人挡在了淘金乐园门口，显然它们已经把你们当做了入侵者。: A large number of Nugget Mechs block the entrance to the ONEderland, apparently thinking you're an invader.
outline.解决掉了机器人们，你们终于顺利进入淘金乐园，这里的管理者是名为“金子”的机器人，: After dealing with the robots, you finally manage to enter the ONEderland smoothly. The manager here is a robot named "Gold", which is precisely the purpose of Peter's journey, and he hopes you can help locate it together.
outline.从商会的墨伊拉小姐那里了解到了修格里为推广最新款红茶而举办的活动详情之后，你们决: Miss Moirai from COLUMBA informed you of an event showcasing the latest Black Tea in Shoggolith, and you decided to go.
outline.曾经的淘金地，可说是淘金乐园开始的地方。: This was once a gold mining site and might be regarded as the origin of the ONEderland.
outline.简单封闭的矿洞，黝黑而布满苔藓的洞口相当的阴森。: The moss-covered, plain, sealed-off entrance to the mine gives off an eerie atmosphere.
outline.早已失去往昔热闹的破旧酒馆，曾在中央的舞台上高歌的年轻人皆已不在。: The rundown bistro has long since lost its once-vibrant atmosphere, and the youthful singers who formerly graced the main stage are now nonexistent.
outline.淘金乐园的中心，伫立着此地唯一的形态场稳定器。: The sole morphic field stabilizer in the ONEderland is located in the center of the land.
outline.只剩下淘金乐园的管理中心还没去过，在进入之前，列车长问了彼得一个令他沉默许久的问: No one has yet set foot in the ONEderland's Management Center. Before visiting, Conductor asks Peter a question that silences him for a long time. Meawhile, Shire and the P.U.S. are talking with Miss Gold, the manager here and their employer, in the Management Center.
outline.形态场稳定器成功运转起来，金子也恢复了正常，尘埃落定之后，你们和沙盗们决定在这里: As the morphic field stabilizer successfully operates, Gold returns to normal. When everything settles down, you and the P.U.S. decide to spend the night here.
outline.清晨，无垠号车长室，伏案睡着的你逐渐醒来，看到了身旁仍在书写什么的少女，新的一天: Slumped over the desk in Conductor's room on The Eternal, you slowly awaken in the early morning. Next to you, a girl is still writing. A new day begins, but it doesn't seem particularly pleasant...
outline.好几年都无人光顾的旅馆，虽然破旧，但却被打扫得很干净。: The hotel, which has been uninhabited for years, is old yet tidy.
outline.在货舱静候的遥本打算对雷比斯的货物进行例行检查，但雷比斯拒绝了，出于高报酬的压力: While waiting in the cargo carriage, Rebis declined Haruka's request to inspect her cargo. Under pressure from the high reward, you didn't insist on her.
outline.列车组一起品鉴了新世代红茶，奇怪的是，你和莉薇娅并没有体会到其特别之处，而其他人: The train crew taste the new gen Black Tea together. While the rest of the train crew rave about it, you and Livia are the only ones who don't seem to enjoy it.
outline.出身帝国的旅行者们，在他乡的奶茶店里闻到了莫名熟悉的香气。: The Empire travellers find a familiar aroma in a foreign milk tea shop.
outline.你们来到了修格里城交易所寻找线索，墨伊拉答应帮你们寻找红茶的来源。: In your quest to uncover the origin of Black Tea, you visit the Shoggolith City Trading Center, where Moirai has offered to assist you.
outline.你意外地与如今身为铁盟执行小队队长的青梅竹马静流重逢，少女和她的队员因为一则匿名: You unexpectedly reunite with your childhood friend Shizuru, who is now the captain of a BCRL execution team. Shizuru and her crew members board your train due to an anonymous tip-off. While the train crew find the tip-off suspicious, you still agree to cooperate with the team's investigation.
outline.修格里城近在眼前，一路平静的旅程却在此时突生变故……: Shoggolith City is within sight, but a sudden, unexpected event disrupts the peaceful journey...
outline.醒来的女孩们几乎什么都不记得，你们只能根据她们仅有的记忆片段推测着发生了什么。你: The awakened girls hardly remember anything, so you can only speculate on what happened based on their memory fragments. While you're determined to help the two girls, Shizuru is concerned that you might put yourself in even more danger if you do, so you promise to protect yourself first. Under the flowing lights, you have all grown up to become the people you aspired to be.
outline.在波克士扫描出的影像里，数不清的桦树生物正朝着列车涌来，你紧急制动了列车，准备和: As Box scans the surroundings, countless Chaos Remains are closing in on the train. You quickly hit the brakes, ready to disembark with your comrades and face them head-on.
outline.你从睡梦中醒来，此时的你们已经安全回到了曼德矿场，新的一天已经到来。: Upon awakening, you discover that you and your companions have returned to Mander Mine, where a fresh day has started.
outline.为了赚钱，你们打算在七号自由港的铁安局中接取一些治安任务赚点佣金，为了获得资格，: In order to earn some money, you intend to complete security quests offered by the BCRL Agency in Freeport Ⅶ. However, before you can qualify, you will have to overcome a number of difficult tests.
outline.关于如何更好地利用交易所赚取资金，不妨听一听莉薇娅的想法。: You should probably listen to Livia's advice if you want to know how to make more money via the Trading Center.
outline.在摩尔的引导下，你见到了意想不到的人，她的态度一如往常不算配合，但是从她嘴里，你: Guided by Moore, you meet someone unexpected. Her attitude, as usual, is hardly cooperative, but from her words, you may find clues to that puzzle...
outline.因为“网友”临时有事，安菲娅多出了四张澄明嘉年华的门票，大方地赠送给了列车组。: As her "online friends" had a change of plan, Anfiya generously gives four extra CDCA Carnival tickets to my crew.
outline.出现在眼前的就是整顿中心的负责人帕拉笛，来不及思考更多，你在这里的工作即将展开—: The person before your eyes is none other than the manager of the Reforming Center, Paladi. There's no time to consider anything else, as your work here is about to begin...
outline.通讯终端里突然收到了一则来自夏尔的不明信息，附件里还写着修格里城黑月大酒店的房间: The comms terminal suddenly receives a message from Shire that includes a room number of Shoggolith's Night Chains Hotel. I meet Shire at the Wilderness Station.
outline.夏尔下定决心前往修格里。: Shire makes up her mind to head to Shoggolith.
outline.得知夏尔在混沌海众人的帮助下找到了亲生父母，要去修格里城见他们。为了让夏尔漂漂亮: Shire has found her parents with the help of Turbulent Sea and is about to meet them. In order for her to show up looking her best, I decide to get her new clothes.
outline.买完新衣服后的夏尔却在酒店门口意欲反悔跑路。拉扯之中，几位神秘人突然加入了“战局: Arriving at the hotel entrance, Shire abruptly tries to turn tail and run. As I struggle to hold her back, a few mysterious people join the "battle"...
outline.酒店门前，夏尔又开始犹豫，两个神秘人再次出现，要抢走夏尔。: Shire starts hesitating at the hotel entrance again. The two mysterious people appear once more and attempt to take her away.
outline.你从再次露面的西蒙口中得知，之前修格里城商会的那个订单果然是被他抢先预定。对于在: You learned from Simon's return that he had reserved that order from the Shoggolith CoC in advance. Simon, who is falling behind in the competition and is getting frustrated, decides on the goal amount for the next round.
outline.西蒙貌似受到了很大打击，在交流一番以后，你多少也能体会到他一直以来夸张的言行下的: Simon seems deeply affected. After a few conversations with him, you begin to see the sincerity behind his exaggerated words and actions. Nevertheless, you and Simon are still engaged in a fierce rivalry...
outline.袭来的神秘人原来是放心不下夏尔的沙盗。向她承诺无论如何她都不会失去她的家人后，夏: Turns out, the mysterious people are Sand Pirates who are concerned about Shire. With their help, she finally gains the courage to meet her parents.
outline.夏尔决定不和父母一起回去生活。作出这样决定的她，已经是个有担当的孩子啦！对于夏尔: Shire decides not to go with her parents. The fact that she makes such a choice proves she has already learned what responsibilities are! To her, today is another lovely sunny day.
outline.亚莉奈今天非常兴奋，跟你们打了个赌，要你猜猜看今天是什么特别的日子，并且请你品尝: Arina was brimming with excitement today. She made a bet with you, challenging you to guess what made the day special, and even let you try her newly crafted drink.
outline.你和莉薇娅艰难地抵御着敌人，不远处，冯·里奈对带上没有升构能力的你同行表示不解，: You and Livia fight hard against the enemies. Nearby, Rina Von is puzzled about why bring someone like you without ascension abilities, but Rebis calls you the "star of the show".
outline.第一场考核顺利通过。: The first assessment has been completed successfully.
outline.考核结束，你们拿到了许可证书，可以接取所有篝火城铁安局的任务了。: Upon completing the test, you will be issued a licence certificate granting access to all missions offered by BCRL Agency.
outline.灰发少女的身份似乎并不普通，就在你们试图弄明情况时，小混混们去而复返。: The grey-haired girl's identity seems uncommon. While you attempt to unravel the mystery, the juveniles reappeared.
outline.列车受到沙盗团的攻击，你很快想到了应对之策……: The train is attacked by the P.U.S., and you quickly devise a strategy to counter it.
outline.攻击效果甚微的沙盗团只好选择撤退。车长室里，格外疲惫的你决定去休息一会儿。: The weakened P.U.S. forces retreat as their attacks prove ineffective. Feeling exhausted, you decided to take a short break in Conductor's room.
outline.与此同时，阿尔喀娜和夏洛蒂正在城中调查着令人不安的香气的源头。: Meanwhile, Arcana and Charlotte are attempting to identify the source of the strange scented source throughout the city.
outline.潜入列车的夏尔误入了休息室，踩中了正在此休息的你。将夏尔擒获的你们听她讲述了袭击: Shire sneaks into the train and accidentally stumbles upon you while you're resting. After capturing Shire, you've learned why she launched the attack. After a series of events, you find yourself alone with Livia and decide to share your dream about her earlier. As you both ponder its significance, an alarm suddenly interrupts your thoughts.
outline.你们陷入了苦战，而此时的隔离舱中，彼得向想要逃走的夏尔提出做个交易。: You engage in a fierce battle. Just as Shire attempts to flee from the isolation chamber, Peter proposes a deal to her.
outline.危急之时，从车厢中逃出的夏尔带领沙盗赶到，帮你们一起迎击敌人。: Shire, who escaped the carriage, rallies the P.U.S. to fight beside you during the crisis.
outline.桦树生物们退去，重新朝着某个方向聚集。等你们回过神来，沙盗团也已经跑得无影无踪。: The Chaos Remains scatter, regrouping in another direction. When you come to your senses, the P.U.S. is nowhere to be found. Back on the train, you prepare to approach Peter Hwang to inquire if Shire's appearance is connected to him.
outline.彼得终于说出了他来这里的目的——把金子从这里带走，然而因此地的形态场稳定器损坏，: Peter eventually reveals his true purpose: to take Gold from here. However, with the morphic field stabilizer damaged, Gold spirals out of control. As everyone is at a loss, Akira and Yer, whom you once met on the Phiggy, appear and offer their assistance. At first glance, it seems like everything is working fine, but then Gold starts acting extremely strangely...
outline.为了让金子的形态场恢复稳定，晃和伊尔需要一个助手协助修理形态场稳定器，恰好的是，: To restore Gold's morphic field stability, Akira and Yer need an assistant to help repair the morphic field stabilizer. Luckily, you're capable of fulfilling that role.
outline.曾经年轻的彼得与巴克斯特来到了淘金乐园，借由金子的帮助赚到了足够入城的钱，然而面: Young Peter and Baxter once travelled to ONEderland, where they could enter the city with the help of Gold after earning enough money. Nevertheless, Gold turned down Peter's invitation. However, at this very moment, Gold is raving insane, vehemently fighting for the survival of ONEderland. Peter changes his mind about taking Gold away. Just then, communicator rings, and you bring good news.
outline.名为卡塔斯的学会成员现身篝火城追查着什么……: A member of the Citadel, known as Katas, has arrived in the Bonfire City to conduct an investigation...
outline.早早起床的你和莉薇娅见到了正等候你们的夏尔，相互贫嘴了一番后，夏尔与你们道别，并: As early risers, you and Livia meet with Shire, who has been waiting for you. After some friendly banter, Shire bids you farewell and informs you that Peter is handling things in the hall while waiting for you.
outline.彼得与你们谈到了淘金乐园的未来，他想将这里打造为旅游度假地，并希望与你们在淘金乐: Peter speaks to you about the future of the ONEderland. He is keen on turning it into a tourist hotspot and hopes to collaborate with you on its development. However, he needs you to escort him and ten Nugget Mechs needing repair back to Mander Mine right now.
outline.回忆起过去，亚莉奈的人生充满了波折与扭曲，曾经的小混混同学“意外”的来到她工作的: Looking back on the memories of the past, Arina's life was full of twists and turns. An "accident" brought her old juvenile classmate to her workplace, reopening old wounds, and she couldn't resist giving them a lesson.
outline.巴克斯特先生表示他对过去的矿场美食了解不多，建议我们去问问在这里生活了很久的交易: Baxter confesses he is unfamiliar with the historical local mining delicacies. He suggests consulting Wealt, the longtime boss of the Trading Center, who has been living here for ages.
outline.深居简出的遥突然出现，请求你陪她练习战斗技巧，想要获得一些自保能力。: All of a sudden, the reclusive Haruka shows up and asks you to practice combat techniques with her, as she hopes to acquire some self-defense skills.
outline.遥的战斗表现意外的不错，于是你决定提高一些难度。: Haruka's unexpected combat prowess impresses you, prompting you to increase the challenge.
outline.现在的训练对遥来说已经有些勉强了，但遥还想再练习一下。: The current training is pushing Haruka's limits, but she is eager to practice.
outline.已经筋疲力尽的遥抱着猫猫，虽然你觉得遥的水平应该足以应对一些危险，但遥觉得仍然不: Exhausted, Haruka cradles a cat. While you believe she could handle some danger with her current skills, she feels unprepared for danger.
outline.在不断地训练中，遥找到了属于自己的战斗方式，立刻来实践一下。: Through rigorous training, Haruka uncovers her unique combat style and promptly puts it into practice.
outline.遥已经找到了战斗的诀窍，最后再来测试一下吧。: Haruka has already mastered the essence of combat. Let's proceed with the final test.
outline.你和久别重逢的静流叙旧，流动的灯光下，已经长大的你们都成为了自己想要成为的人。: Reminiscing the moving lights, you and Shizuru had a reunion after a long time. Both of you have grown to become the people you wanted to be.
outline.你们再次遇到了雷比斯，得知她送你的台球是一种神秘的武器，同时她愿意为你提供一些其: You reencounter Rebis and learn that the billiard ball she gave you is a mysterious weapon. She also offers you some other weapons as compensation.
outline.来到铁安局，通过甘雅你们得知，最近你们在协作铁盟工作方面的活跃和贡献，为列车组赢: While at the BCRL Agency, you learn that your recent contributions to the B.C.R.L have earned the train crew a special crafting workbench via Ganya.
outline.你在休息区与匆匆离去的黑月酒店负责人闻笙打了个照面——在你尚未察觉的时候，城内似: In the rest area, you briefly encounter Wensheng, the manager of Night Chains Hotel. Something is occurring in the city without your knowledge...
outline.深夜，莫伊拉将装有波克士的箱子交给了交给了带着口罩的神秘人，你们将跟着波克士的信: Late at night, Moirai hands a package containing BOX to a mysterious figure wearing a mask. You will follow the signal from BOX to find your target.
outline.除了你和莉薇娅，喝了新世代红茶的列车组乘员们的行为举止都极为反常。: Besides you and Livia, the behavior of the train crew members who drank the New Gen Black Tea is extremely unusual.
outline.铁安局门口居然围着一大群人在闹事，你们连忙上前帮忙。: A large crowd is causing trouble in front of the BCRL Agency, and you rush to help.
outline.基于最近的种种异常，铁安局的朱利安拜托你们帮忙调查有关新时代红茶的诸多怪异事件的: Due to recent anomalies, Julian from the BCRL Agency asks you to investigate the source of the bizarre incidents related to the Black Tea.
outline.刚刚走出铁安局，你们突然遭到从天而降的怪人的攻击……: As soon as you step out of the BCRL Agency, you are suddenly attacked by oddballs descending from the sky...
outline.同为调查新世代红茶，你们和卡塔斯达成一致决定合作。: While investigating the New Gen Black Tea, you decided to cooperate with Katas.
outline.你们来到了一个神秘的工厂，追寻找脚印发现了工厂中的敌人。: You arrive at a mysterious factory. Following the footprints, you find the enemies within.
outline.通过着装你们发现，那些被你们击败的敌人都是鼹鼠帮的人。你们继续向工厂深处前进，发: Based on their attire, you realize the enemies you defeated are from the MoleGang. As you venture deeper into the factory, you find that the materials for making the Black Tea are actually the limbs of the Chaos Remains.
outline.一只会说话的鼹鼠突然冲了出来，你们从他的口中套出了许多信息。: A talking mole suddenly emerges, and you managed to extract a wealth of information from it.
outline.你们击败了鼹鼠，但被豢养的桦树生物突然冲了出来。: After defeating Mole, a domesticated Chaos Remain suddenly charges at you.
outline.击败了桦树生物后，铁安局也赶到了现场。朱利安逮捕了鼹鼠，并给你们提供了奖励。和卡: After defeating the Chaos Remains, the BCRL Agency arrives at the scene. Julian arrests Mole and rewards you. It's also time to part ways with Katas.
outline.你们回到了七号自由港，弗兰和艾略特决定趁着假期出去逛逛。你和莉薇娅在朱利安的邀请: You return to Freeport Ⅶ, where Fran and Eliot decide to take advantage of the holiday to go out and explore. At Julian's invitation, you visit the destruction site of the Black Tea with Livia. At the port, you meet Arcana from Mundus, who explains how to handle the Black Tea.
outline.墨伊拉来到七号自由港的奶茶店，要露珀特请她喝奶茶。: Moirai arrives at the milk tea shop in Freeport Ⅶ, asking Ruperto to buy her a milk tea.
outline.你来到了荚蒾，亚莉奈为你讲述了事件的另一面与黑月内部的明争暗斗。: You arrive at Viburnum, and Arina updates you about the other side of the events and the internal strife within the Night Chains.
outline.薇尔岚一行三人来到了KEEP炸鸡店，却发现找错了地方。: Verlaine and her group arrive at KEEP Fried Chicken but realize they've come to the wrong place.
outline.你们应卡塔斯的邀请来到了一间咖啡厅，在这里你们见到了完全不一样的卡塔斯。: You guys accept Katas' invitation and arrive at a café. The Katas that greets you is totally unlike the one you know.
outline.收到西蒙邮件的你应邀与他见面，并从他那里得知了修格里城即将推出新品牌红茶的珍贵情: After receiving a mail from Simon, you met with him and received valuable information about the upcoming launch of a new brand of black tea in Shoggolith City.
outline.发射基地的沃斯托克小姐为你介绍了这次工程的主要内容。: Miss Vostok of the launch base has introduced the primary objective of this project to you.
outline.你在奶茶店再次偶遇苔妮，聊起了她在这里的原因。她似乎是出于对发射中心工作人员的敬: You chance upon Tennie in the milk tea store again and find out her reason for being here. She seems to have participated in the reconstruction work out of respect for the staff of the launch center.
outline.从淘金乐园回来休息完毕的列车组正准备重新出发，你却突然收到了静流的联络，得知费尔: The train crew is preparing to set out again now that everyone is well-rested after returning from ONEderland. All of a sudden, you receive Shizuru's message and learn that someone has leaked out the matter concerning Phildridge, and you might be charged with baseless charges for using the billiard ball.
outline.你与列车组的乘员们分析了一番状况，决定找安菲娅咨询关于台球的谜团，安菲娅建议你前: You and your crew members analyze the situation, then decide to inquire about the billiard ball's mystery from Anfiya. Anfiya suggests you head to Freeport Ⅶ to seek help from her teacher.
outline.在前往七号自由港的路上，有些意志消沉的你和莉薇娅重振精神，开始分析散布消息的幕后: On the way to Freeport Ⅶ, you pull yourself together and start chewing over who could be behind the leaked news with Livia. The mysterious intruder you previously saw at Mander Mine abruptly comes to mind...
outline.你们在形而上粒子研究所门口遇到了名为星花的园丁，她竟然就是当初在修格里城外引开鲸: Your crew encounters a Gardener named Stella at the entrance of the Metaphysical Particles Institute. She turns out to be the person who lured the whale away from outside Shoggolith City back then, and she appears to have some ideas about your plight.
outline.星花的实验结束后，她表示条件有限，很难进一步研究。这个时候，一名神秘女子经过，而: After Stella's experiment is done, she says the limited circumstances make it hard to continue examining it. At this moment, an unknown woman passes by, and Stella seems to know her...
outline.神秘女子名为妮蔻拉，据星花介绍是一名出色的学者，她也表示愿意协助你们。只是她给人: The unknown woman is an exceptional researcher named Nicola, according to Stella. Nicola also agrees to help you out, but she seems peculiar and standoffish, which doesn't make her feel trustworthy.
outline.你们根据妮蔻拉的要求送她前往澄明数据中心，面对不愿交流的她，你们束手无策。这时，: Per Nicola's request, your crew gives her a ride to the CDCA Bureau. Her unwillingness to make conversation leaves you guys feeling at a loss. Out of the blue, hostile enemies emerge right ahead.
outline.艾略特发现妮蔻拉居然在打游戏，让你们吃惊不已。而列车前方出现了一群意想不到的敌人: Eliot discovers Nicola is actually playing video games, which is bewildering, to say the least. Meanwhile, the unexpected enemies ahead of the train are revealed to be remnants of Northern Alliance.
outline.眼看就要到目的地，你决定通知一下妮蔻拉即将到站，没想到你居然被她拽倒，而妮蔻拉表: Seeing as the train is nearing the destination, you elect to inform Nicola about it, but without warning, she yanks you down, claiming it's merely her rumination habit.
outline.对于新北阵的残党为什么会出现在这里，你们不免有些疑惑。: The abrupt appearance of Northern Alliance's remnants here naturally fills your crew with plenty of questions.
outline.妮蔻拉交给你一个仪器，吩咐你们去她规定的地点搜集数据。你们也发现，妮蔻拉似乎并不: Nicola hands you an instrument and instructs all of you to collect data at the location she specified. You all realize that she isn't that hard to get along with, after all.
outline.为了防止铁盟行动起来抓捕你们，艾略特建议去服装店买一身新衣服来掩人耳目。: In case B.C.R.L. sets out to arrest your crew, Eliot suggests going to a clothing store to get new clothes as a disguise.
outline.你们在服装店结识了店长马吉拉，马吉拉热情地向你们推荐了几件用于cosplay的服: You guys become acquainted with Margiela, the clothing store owner, who enthusiastically recommends several cosplay costumes to you all. In the meantime, Team Ratel has also arrived at the CDCA Bureau...
outline.完成妮蔻拉交代的任务后，你们正准备打道回府，却被几个黑月成员纠缠。这时，飞鸟突然: After completing the task given by Nicola, all of you are about to head back for the night, only to be harassed by a couple of Night Chains members. At this time, Songbird shows up out of nowhere and helps you out of the situation, and you learn about a scary rumor involving Nicola from her.
outline.飞鸟的话让你们对妮蔻拉更加防备，不料妮蔻拉轻易看穿了你的心思，而且一点也不在意你: Songbird's words have made you guys even more wary of Nicola. To your shock, Nicola sees through your thoughts right away and doesn't mind your attitude at all. She tells you the considerations behind her actions and wants you to collect data a second time.
outline.正在车站里为了生计长吁短叹的你遇上了一个奇特的、来自学会的怪人，她需要你帮她送点: While at the station, sighing over your livelihood, you come across an oddball from the Citadel. She needs you to deliver some goods and presents an offer you can't refuse.
outline.最后一名乘员也回到了列车上，你们商量好了运输方案，窘迫的经济现状让你只能在人手有: The final crew member has also returned to the train. You discuss the transportation plan, but you must set off with a short-handed crew due to the difficult financial situation. Late at night, you find Livia still pondering something in the carriage.
outline.逼近而来的巨大威胁并未解决，致命的危险仍紧追不放。: The looming threat has not been resolved, and the deadly danger continues to pursue you.
outline.被激怒的鲸鱼凶悍地撞向了列车。面对艰难抵御着狂风的大家，你选择了断开车厢，并再次: The enraged whale violently collides with the train. Confronting the strong winds, you decided to detach the carriage and point the turret at the Chaos Remain. Inside the cargo carriage, Rebis notices something...
outline.危机解除，无垠号终于能有惊无险地继续旅程。距离列车几公里外的某处，名为星花的少女: The crisis has been averted, and The Eternal can safely continue its journey. A girl named Stella, a few kilometers away from the train, quietly departs.
outline.终于抵达修格里城城外，原本在车厢内的雷比斯却消失得无影无踪，面对她留下的金属台球: Upon finally arriving outside Shoggolith City, Rebis, who was in the carriage, vanished without a trace. Faced with the Metal Billiard Ball she left behind, everyone is clueless. Furthermore, you still have not obtained any information about the Dream Station. At this moment, the forces from Shoggolith City contact you.
outline.被视为英雄护卫入城的你受到了修格里城执政官——荷塞市长的接见与道谢。夜里，疲惫的: You are welcomed into the city as a hero. You are received and thanked by Mayor Jose of Shoggolith City. At night, the exhausted Fran and Eliot have already fallen asleep. In the moonlit carriage, you and Livia renew your long-standing promise.
outline.无垠号被送去维修后，在修格里城漫无目的闲逛的你们碰到一群小混混正在为难一个少女，: After The Eternal is sent for repairs, you wander aimlessly in Shoggolith City and encounter a group of juveniles harassing a girl. Without hesitation, you rush forward to intervene.
outline.原来飞鸟本就是为了和暴徒们的交易而来，而你们一行人只是误入了这场乌龙事件。告别之: It turns out that Songbird was here to strike a deal with the mobs, and you had accidentally got involved in this misunderstanding. Before parting ways, the friendly Miss Songbird drew a simple map of downtown Shoggolith.
outline.正为资金奔波忙碌的大家和四处鉴定金属台球的你，在两天后迎来了列车的回归。崭新的无: While everyone was trying to raise funds, you were busy with identifying the Metal Billiard Ball. The train returned after two days, and everyone was delighted with the brand-new Eternal. Additionally, you received a mail from Mayor Jose...
outline.荷塞市长在黑月大酒店举行了宴会对你们进行表彰，在单独的闲谈中，他对那个金属台球表: Mayor Jose hosted a banquet at Night Chains Hotel to honor you. He expressed a strong interest in the Metal Billiard Ball during a private chat.
outline.拒绝了市长提议的你在返回的路上和莉薇娅讨论起此事，而此时，市长办公室里，已经确定: After declining the mayor's proposal, you discussed it with Livia on the way back. Meanwhile, in the mayor's office, Mayor Jose, who had confirmed that the billiard ball was related to the Citadel's Weapons, issued an order to seize it.
outline.正在执行市长亲自下发的订单的你们来到了作为运输路线的地铁入口，而另一边，接到市长: Carrying out the mayor's personal order, you arrive at the subway entrance used for transportation. Meanwhile, Walter, the leader of the MoleGang, received information from the mayor's secretary and was lying in ambush with his men...
outline.大家正准备休息时，警报突然响起。在这条隐秘路线上突然出现了众多障碍物和武装人员拦: Just as everyone was about to rest, an alarm suddenly went off. Numerous obstacles and armed personnel appeared on this secret route, and they are clearly targeting you...
outline.你们击败了第一波伏兵，却始终联系不上救援，后退的道路也被炸断，只能继续前进。: You have defeated the first wave of ambushers but cannot contact any rescue teams. The retreat path has also been destroyed, leaving you with no choice but to move forward.
outline.你们不断击败沿路的敌人，清理路障并开辟道路，但你明显感觉到，这些敌人只是在拖延时: You continued to defeat enemies along the way, clearing barricades and opening the path. However, you couldn't shake the feeling that these enemies were stalling for time. What exactly were they planning?
outline.随着路障的逐渐清除，铁路终于畅通，但此时瓦尔特驾驶着一台庞大的改造重机挡在了莉薇: As the barricades were gradually cleared, the railway finally became clear. At that moment, Walter appeared, driving a massive modified mech and blocking Livia and the others.
outline.莉薇娅等人的攻击几乎没有效果，正当瓦尔特准备彻底解决她们时，震动的隧道中，无垠号: Livia and the others' attacks had almost no effect. Just as Walter was about to finish them, The Eternal roared through the vibrating tunnel...
outline.无垠号成功离开了修格里城，而同时，因为一封神秘的举报信，铁安局的一支小队紧随无垠: The Eternal successfully left Shoggolith City. However, a squad from the BCRL Agency, who was acting on a mysterious tip-off, followed The Eternal, prompting the mayor to abandon his actions against them. The mayor seemed to know the identity of this mysterious helper...
outline.为庆祝刚刚的死里逃生，你们在列车上举行了一个简单的派对，然而麻烦似乎并没有结束，: To celebrate the close shave you guys just had, your crew has a simple party on the train, but it doesn't seem like you're out of the woods yet. While you're planning the itinerary for after arriving at Mander Mine, you hear an explosion vaguely sounding from afar...
outline.搜查过后，列车的驾驶权限制得到解除。根据静流透露的情报，你们推断鼹鼠帮的袭击和奇: The train's driving restriction is lifted after the search. According to the intel shared by Shizuru, you all surmise that there may be a connection between the MoleGang's surprise attack and the weird anonymous tip-off.
outline.列车刚刚抵达曼德矿场，这里的负责人彼得·黄就恰时出现。这位经理的话意味深长，你察: The train has only just arrived at Mander Mine when Peter Hwang, the person in charge here, shows up right in time. From the implicative way he speaks, you sense that Mayor Jose must have a hand in all your recent troubles.
outline.你们在铁安局了解到最近矿场附近有不少游荡的“拾荒者”，桦树生物的数量也莫名增多，: At the BCRL Agency, upon learning that there have been multiple wandering "Marauders" around the mine, and the number of Chaos Remains has also somehow increased, your crew offers to lend a hand by taking the commission.
outline.无垠号突然接收到一则紧急求援信号，怪异的是信号来自一艘多年前就在海港失踪的轮船。: Suddenly, The Eternal receives an emergency SOS call. What's strange is that the call is coming from a ship that disappeared from the seaport many years ago. At once, Team Ratel decides to head over to check it out. You suggest taking them there on the train for safety's sake.
outline.透过雨幕，能望见“拾荒者”们竟然正操纵着经过改造的地联军用机械，显然，必须有人来: The "Marauders" are spotted in the rain, shockingly fiddling with the modified Earth Union military equipment. Evidently, someone will have to go forward and stop them...
outline.原本活跃在修格里附近的拾荒者们却突然出现在此，其背后似乎另有隐情……: It goes without saying that something must be going on for these Marauders, who usually hang around Shoggolith, to appear here out of the blue...
outline.避开了拾荒者大部队，你们三人顺利进入荒原帝王号。: After slipping past the horde of Marauders, the three of you successfully board the Wilderness King.
outline.终于潜入到工程平台最深处，你们与荒原王正面对上……: It is when you all finally get to the deepest part of the engineering platform, where you run into Wilderness King himself...
outline.被击败的荒原王匆忙逃窜，你们紧追不舍。: The defeated Wilderness King flees for his life with you guys hot on his heels.
outline.追到总控室的你们制服了荒原王，成功收缴了荒原帝王号，并救走了两个昏迷不醒的小女孩: At the main control room, your group manages to restrain Wilderness King, take control of the ship, and successfully rescue two unconscious girls.
outline.似乎忌惮着什么的荒原王不肯配合，你们的审讯一无所获。: However, Wilderness King, seemingly fearful of something, refuses to cooperate with your interrogation, leaving you with no answers.
outline.在某种升构能力的作用下，列车上的人都陷入了沉睡，而意外不受影响的你听到了名为隼的: While everyone on the train falls into a deep sleep under the effects of certain ascension abilities, you, who's surprisingly immune, overhear the conversation between Wilderness King and an uninvited guest named Hayabusa. After Hayabusa disappears into thin air, Livia comes to let you know that the two girls have awakened.
outline.静流带走两个女孩和荒原王后，暂时没有安排的你们决定去寻找让女孩们念念不忘的那种美: Once Shizuru takes Wilderness King and the two girls away, your crew, with nothing on the agenda for the time being, decides to head out and look for the food that the girls crave for.
outline.炸鸡店店长告知你们“快乐童梦餐”在七八年前就已经取消贩售，而这位老人在了解到你们: The fried chicken shop's manager tells you that "Happy Dreams Meal" was already discontinued about eight years ago, but upon hearing about your intent, he generously gives you the recipe for it.
outline.将所得线索串联，你们得到了一个难以置信的结论：两个孩子是当年费尔德里奇号的随船人: All of you come to an incredulous conclusion after connecting the dots: The two girls were passengers of the Phildridge who inexplicably survived and traveled to the present.
outline.品尝着炸鸡的两个女孩的记忆逐渐苏醒。车厢外，静流向你转达了总指挥官的指令：将两个: The girls gradually recover their memories as they dig into the fried chicken. Outside the carriage, Shizuru informs you of the commander-in-chief's order: Send the two girls to be isolated in Anita Tech' office under the B.C.R.L.'s supervision. However, Shizuru doesn't seem to be on board with this plan.
outline.你和莉薇娅探讨着铁盟为何会忌惮升构者的异变，此时静流传来讯息：荒原王和双子一同消: As you and Livia chew over why the B.C.R.L. is afraid of Ascenders mutating, Shizuru sends over a piece of news: Wilderness King and the twins have gone missing...
outline.面对路上激增的桦树生物，你们集中注意力一路突围。: Facing the surge of Chaos Remains on the road, your group directs all attention to breaking through them.
outline.苦战过后，你们登上了费奇号。尽管船上的共振污染给身体造成了极大的负荷，你仍选择和: You all board the Phiggy after the tough battle. Although the ship's resonance pollution causes you tremendous physical pressure, you still insist on going forward with the others.
outline.荒原王竟是被双子用升构能力挟持才来到这里，两个女孩执念般地寻找船上的幸存者……: Turns out, the twins have used their ascension abilities to take Wilderness King hostage all the way here. Feverishly, they keep searching the ship for survivors...
outline.双子最终在舰长室见到了记忆中的“大副”和同样已经变成深眠者的妈妈，在怪物的嘶吼声: In the end, in the captain's cabin, the twins see the "chief mate" and their mother, who has also become a Deep Sleeper. Amid the screeches of monsters comes a gunshot that wrecks their last sweet dream...
outline.多年前，费奇号即将被共振吞没之时，双子因被送到形态场的中心而得以幸存。你们艰难抵: Many years ago, when the Phiggy was about to be engulfed by resonance, the twins managed to survive, as they were sent to the core of the Morphic Field. While all of you struggle to fight against the Deep Sleepers, two Anita members arrive at the most critical juncture for assistance...
outline.不过刚刚喘了口气，名为“门徒”的巨型桦树生物就出现在你们面前，趁它尚未发动攻击，: Yet, just as you finally catch a breath, a massive Chaos Remain named "Disciple" materializes right in front of your group. You guys need to break through from an area with fewer Chaos Remains before it attacks.
outline.疯狂的桦树生物在前，你们寸步难移，而此时原本了无生机的“妈妈”竟牺牲自己保护了双: However, with a berserk Chaos Remain ahead of you, you all are trapped. At this moment, "Mom", who is supposed to be dead, unexpectedly sacrifices herself to protect the twins, fulfilling a mother's final duty. Rebis, who you haven't seen in a long time, then emerges out of nowhere, and under her guidance, you take out that billiard ball, hoping it can bring miracles.
outline.两位神秘人在某处观察着一切，他们似乎与雷比斯有关联？: Elsewhere, two mysterious figures are observing the scene. They seem to have ties with Rebis.
outline.关于两姐妹念念不忘的美食，大家结合自身的生活经验给出了不同的见解，也许询问一下曼: About what food precisely the sisters are missing, everyone gives different answers based on their own living experiences. Perhaps asking the locals of Mander Mine may give you some clues.
outline.曼德矿场出身的甘雅结合当地的情况帮助我们进行了分析，认为两姐妹惦念的美食来自其他: Born in Mander Mine, Ganya, after helping you analyze the situation, believes the food the sisters are missing is from another city. She suggests you check with Mr. Baxter from COLUMBA, who has handled orders from various cities.
outline.图浩爽快地告诉了我们他掌握的情报，他认为我们一定能在修格里的keep炸鸡店找到答: Wealt readily tells you the information he knows. He thinks you'll surely find the answer in Shoggolith's KEEP Fried Chicken.
outline.妮蔻拉的分析让你怀疑当初雷比斯委托你运送的货物与现实稳定装置故障有关，而你们走在: Nicola's analysis makes you suspect that the cargo Rebis previously commissioned you to deliver may be connected with the Reality Stabilizer's malfunctioning. As your crew walks on the street, a familiar young woman suddenly sneaks up on you.
outline.袭击你们的人居然是卡塔斯，就在战斗无法收场的时候，一名陌生女性出手制止了你们。莉: The person sneaking up on you guys turns out to be Katas. Just as the fight is about to take a turn for the worse, an unknown woman comes forward and stops it. Shockingly, she is someone whom Livia knows...
outline.收到铁安局的邮件后，你们应邀前往荒原站洽谈工作事宜。: After receiving mail from BCRL Agency, your crew heads to Wilderness Station at their invitation to discuss business.
outline.你们来到了阿妮塔的临时本，并给你们提供了丰富的报酬。: You arrive at Anita's temporary outpost and obtain generous rewards.
outline.你们在搜集数据时察觉到街上有些骚乱。: While collecting data, your crew notices some commotion on the streets.
outline.你们顺利在第二个坐标点搜集了数据。: The data is successfully collected by you all at the second coordinate point.
outline.对于行事古怪的黑月成员，你们决定出手制止。: Your group decides to step in and stop those Night Chains members who are acting erratically.
outline.来到整顿中心，静流为你介绍了这里的情况和相关的工作内容。: At the Reforming Center, Shizuru tells you about the situation and work responsibilities here.
outline.另一边，莉薇娅等人也顺利完成了任务，而柯娜竟然希望莉薇娅和她一起回到帝国，莉薇娅: Meanwhile, Livia and the others have also successfully completed their task, and Connor expresses her wish that Livia returns to the Empire with her. Though utterly shocked, Livia turns Connor down without any hesitation.
outline.从长远来看，列车运行需要更高的能源转化效率，尽快升级一下电力系统吧！: The train will require higher energy conversion efficiency to work in the long run. It's time to upgrade the power system!
outline.你们如约在瞳仁服装店汇合，马吉拉告诉了你黑月行动背后的真相。而你也答应了大家的请: As promised, your crew convenes at Pupil's Fashion Wear, and Margiela tells you the truth behind Night Chains' actions. You agree to everyone's request and decide to get them out of the CDCA Bureau on The Eternal.
outline.你告诉妮蔻拉关于雷比斯订单的详情，给了她一些帮助。这时候，列车前方出现了敌人。: You tell Nicola about the details of Rebis' order, giving Nicola more insight. Suddenly, enemies pop up ahead of the train's path.
outline.面对数量众多的敌人，马吉拉使用了强大的力量，这一幕令在场的帝国人都感到吃惊。: Margiela exerts immense power against the horde of enemies, astounding all the Empire people present.
outline.没想到桦树生物也在这个时候涌来，妮蔻拉打算独身面对，让你们继续前进。: Without warning, Chaos Remains also swarm forward at this juncture. Nicola plans to let you guys continue going forward while she deals with them alone.
outline.就在你们好不容易突破包围圈时，新北阵居然派出了威力强大的机甲应战。: Right as you all finally break through the encirclement, Northern Alliance deploys formidable mechas to join the battle.
outline.被打倒的机甲竟然还有最后一丝余力，危急时刻，柯娜挺身而出……: The mechas still have one last ounce of power left after being knocked down, to your consternation. At the nick of time, Connor puts her life on the line and steps forward...
outline.柯娜生命濒危，偏偏桦树生物紧接着出现，你感觉到桦树生物对你的仇恨，惊慌失措之际，: Connor's life is threatened, and yet the Chaos Remains keep coming unceasingly. You panic upon sensing their hatred toward you, but Nicola saves you.
outline.名为隼的神秘青年在暗处将你的行动尽收眼底，而他与飞鸟、与这一系列事件之间的关系到: In an inconspicuous spot, an enigmatic young man named Hayabusa is observing every move of yours. How exactly is he related to Songbird and this series of events?
outline.原来柯娜曾经是莉薇娅的同伴，你们也与卡塔斯等人解除了误会。: As it turns out, Connor and Livia used to be companions, and your crew's misunderstanding with Katas' group is also resolved.
outline.你突然收到来自妮蔻拉的联络，她要求你立刻回到无垠号，柯娜提出可以用摩托车载你们过: All of a sudden, you receive Nicola's message. She wants you to return to The Eternal at once. Connor offers to give you all a ride back on her motorcycle.
outline.多亏了柯娜近乎离谱的高速行驶，你们顺利在妮蔻拉要求的时限内赶到。: Thanks to Connor riding at virtually insane speeds, you guys successfully make it back in the time requested by Nicola.
outline.你回到车厢与妮蔻拉会面，遥表达了她的担忧。: You return to the carriage to meet Nicola, and Haruka expresses her concern.
outline.你通知了伙伴们和妮蔻拉合作的决定，在妮蔻拉的要求下你们兵分两路，分头处理地下数据: You inform your crew about the decision to work together with Nicola. Following Nicola's instruction, all of you split up into two teams to separately deal with the issues of the underground database being hacked and the Chaos Remains that have congregated.
outline.你与两位护卫乘员跟随妮蔻拉来到地下数据库，得知入侵者竟然是黑月的成员。: You and two of your guard crew members tag along with Nicola to the underground database. The hacker is revealed to be a member of Night Chains.
outline.在你们行动进展顺利的同时，另一边，卡塔斯怀疑妮蔻拉忌惮自己的学会成员身份才故意将: While your operation is going swimmingly, Katas suspects Nicola only sent her group away out of fear of Katas' identity as a Citadel member.
outline.你们遇到了黑月的执行小队，没想到此前有一面之缘的服装店老板娘也是黑月的一员。: You guys bump into Night Chains' execution team. Surprisingly, the clothing store owner you briefly met earlier is also a member of Night Chains.
outline.黑月执行小队内部似乎存在分歧，他们没有过多纠缠就离开了。而马吉拉似乎对你们没有敌: There seems to be discord within Night Chains' execution team, but your group leaves without getting involved. Margiela, who doesn't seem to have any ill will toward you, says she has something to tell you.
outline.马吉拉的话语令你感到非常不可思议，思前想后，你决定把这件事告诉妮蔻拉。: Margiela's words leave you in total disbelief. After much contemplation, you opt to let Nicola in on what you just heard.
outline.了解你们的困境后，柯娜一行人决定帮助你们。: Connor and friends make up their minds to help your crew upon learning about your predicament.
outline.没想到妮蔻拉竟然是无垠号引擎的设计者，你们相谈甚欢。: In a surprise twist of events, Nicola is found to be the designer of The Eternal's engine. The things you two chat about almost seem endless.
outline.你应邀与摩尔进行单独会面，他为你展示了虚演空间的成果，权衡之下，你同意参与到该项: You accept Moore's invitation to meet in private, and he shows you the results of the calculation space. After weighing the pros and cons, you agree to participate in this project's testing.
outline.你在铁安局遇到了曼德矿场的苔妮小姐，原来本次工程她也参与其中。: At the BCRL Agency, you encounter Miss Tennie from Mander Mine and find out she is also participating in this project.
outline.发射中心大桥的重建即将完成。沃斯托克承诺，无垠号已经获得了拜访发射中心的资格。: The reconstruction of the launch center's bridge is about to be completed. Vostok promises that The Eternal has already earned the right to visit the launch center.
outline.发射中心大桥正式建成！和沃斯托克用梨味汽水碰杯，分享联结新站点的喜悦吧！: The launch center's bridge is officially reconstructed! Celebrate the joy of connecting new stations with Vostok through a toast of Pear Soda!
outline.你从朱利安小姐那里得知，援助计划的详细内容你可以在七号自由港找到阿妮塔方面的项目: You learn from Miss Julian that the details of the assistance project can be obtained from Miss Vostok, Anita's project manager, in Freeport Ⅶ.
outline.你们接到前往铁盟哨站的委托，朱利安拜托你们顺便去看看在那里的多萝西。: We received a commission to head to BCRL Outpost. Julian asks that we check up on Dorothy, who is there as well.
outline.完成货物交接，拉妲与你们闲聊了几句，这时大家突然听到不远处传来的爆炸声。: After the handover of cargo is done, Rada is casually chatting with us when, out of nowhere, an explosion sounds a short distance away.
outline.原来多萝西注意到了有不法分子尾随着你们的列车。虽然打倒了不法分子，但由于擅自行动: Turns out, it's because Dorothy noticed outlaws tailing our train. Although the outlaws have been taken down, she is punished with confinement for acting without orders and causing an explosion.
outline.你申请了去禁闭室探望多萝西，通过和她聊天，你知道了她小的时候曾有段因为生病只能被: I apply to visit Dorothy in the confinement room. Through conversing with her, I learn about how she spent part of her childhood confined in hospital wards because of her illness.
outline.你们在铁盟哨站遇到了带着多萝西母亲做的爱心便当来探望的海因里希，这才知道原来他就: I chance upon Heinrich, who has come to visit Dorothy. Turns out he is Dorothy's father. Dorothy, whose confinement has ended, rushes over to thank me and reminds me not to forget about my promise to her.
outline.亚莉奈从小家庭问题导致她出现了一些认知偏差，加入黑月的时候，塞西尔也对她极其的不: Arina's early family issues led to some cognitive distortions. When she joined Night Chains, Cecil was highly distrustful of her. Now, she must confront her former juvenile classmate, who has returned seeking revenge...
outline.你及时出现吓走了小混混，亚莉奈对你的做法很是不解。但她发现只要呆在你的身边，困扰: You arrived just in time, scaring off the juvenile, which left Arina puzzled by your actions. However, she soon realized that when she was near you, the Noise that troubled her would vanish. This sparked a deep interest in you.
outline.你曾经拯救过亚莉奈的那天，作为秘密藏在她的心底，她认为每年的今天就是最特别的日子: The day in the past when you saved Arina is a secret she holds deep in her heart, and she believes today is the most special day of the year. Before you left, you gave her drink a new name: White Lady.
outline.在妮蔻拉的陪同下，你得以在铁安局自证清白，然而海因里希告诉了你一些意料之外的情报: With Nicola by your side, you manage to clear your name at BCRL Agency, but Heinrich reveals some above and beyond unexpected information.
outline.在初步调查后，你与大家暂时分开行动，带领你的列车组前往荒原站调查特殊状况。: After the initial investigation, you and the others temporarily go separate ways. You lead your train crew to the Wilderness Station to look into a special situation.
outline.刚到荒原站，你们就发现这里的桦树生物数量出奇的多。: When you arrive at Wilderness Station, you encounter an unusually large amount of Chaos Remains.
outline.来到澄明数据中心，列车组被嘉年华热闹的氛围感染。数据中心的负责人摩尔竟然亲自前来: We are quickly influenced by the carnival's lively atmosphere upon reaching CDCA Bureau. Moore even personally comes to greet us...
outline.与莉薇娅一同在知识集市闲逛散心，听摊主介绍了远见公寓的怪谈，在推销下购买了都市传: In the Knowledge Bazaar, Livia and I overhear a stall owner talking about Vision Apartment's story. At the owner's pitching, we purchase an urban legend book titled "Haunted CDCA."
outline.在远见公寓外围举办的《不眠之城》发布会现场，突发集体昏迷事件，连莉薇娅都昏倒了，: During the launch event of "Dreamless City" hosted outside Vision Apartment, a mass fainting suddenly occurs, affecting even Livia. Just what in the world...
outline.莉薇娅陷入未知原因的昏迷，必须要调查清楚发生了什么。: Livia has fallen into an unexplainable coma. I have to figure out what exactly is going on.
outline.重回远见公寓外围，为遭遇非议的学会成员索玛解围。在与铁安局负责人莱卡吉亚的交涉下: I return to Vision Apartment and come to the aid of Citadel member Sommer. After negotiating with Lycagia, we receive approval to investigate the apartment.
outline.无论怎么往前走，都一直是同一片走廊……: No matter how we keep walking straight ahead, we find ourselves stuck in the same corridor...
outline.怪谈中的婚房就这样出现在了我们的眼前。: The marital home mentioned in the supernatural story appears right in front of us.
outline.解决深眠者之后，在搜查和讨论中，我们好像拼凑出了这对新婚夫妻遭遇的惨剧……: After dealing with the Deep Sleeper, we conduct a search and figure out the tragedy that befell this newlywed couple...
outline.从索玛口中听到了她的身世，她准备跟随“天火”的指引前去与达斯廷汇合，嘱咐我在原地: I hear about Sommer's background from herself. She plans to follow the "Celestial Fire" and rendezvous with Dustin, but I see a familiar figure...
outline.被达斯廷解救了，从他口中了解到了这个空间运行的原理，阴谋的乌云笼罩着我们……: Dustin rescues me and enlightens me about how this space works. It appears all of us have fallen victim to a conspiracy...
outline.“莉薇娅”再次出现，并要求不要信任索思学会的人，然而被一眼识破身份，“莉薇娅”恼: "Livia" reappears and asks me not to trust Source Citadel, only to be immediately exposed as an impostor. Enraged, she summons more enemies.
outline.这个空间正在崩塌，迷茫之际，熟悉又陌生的歌声指引着去路。: This space is collapsing. While we're at a loss, a familiar yet foreign singing voice guides us to the way out.
outline.再度醒来，但我们似乎仍被困于虚拟空间之中。达斯廷似乎对这一切的幕后黑手有了推测…: I regain consciousness and find that we seem to still be trapped in the virtual space. Dustin has an inkling about who is behind this...
outline.在永生者的口中，我们知道了她做这一切的目的。: The Immortal reveals her motive behind all of this.
outline.无论打倒多少次，永生者好像都会站起来……但是，我们绝不会认输。: No matter how many times we knock her down, it seems the Immortal can always get back on her feet... Nonetheless, there's no way we will give up.
outline.这次醒来终于见到了熟悉的天花板，昏迷多日以后，听听那由他是怎么说的吧。: This time, I finally see the familiar ceiling. Let's hear from Nayuta about what has happened while I was unconscious for days.
outline.你们与安菲娅相遇，为了调查这些异状是否与柯娜失踪有关，主动请求与她一起调查。: You meet Anfiya and ask for her help to investigate whether these anomalies are connected to Connor's disappearance.
outline.康复训练只要偷懒就会被卡洛琳的机械狗盯上，导致最后累的不行被卡洛琳背回列车上。路: By the end of rehab training, you are worn out and need Caroline's help to get back. On the way, Caroline spots an ad that sparks her interest in climbing the mountain to catch a stunning sunrise.
outline.卡洛琳喜欢大自然，在康复训练的时候带你逗狍子玩。你注意到卡洛琳很在意那座高山，再: Caroline loves of nature. You notice her fascination with the distant mountains. After some persuasion, she agrees to join you in climbing to the peak for the sunrise.
outline.你们向山顶出发，但是中途遇到了泥石流，卡洛琳受了伤，你们搀扶着继续前进。你靠着天: As you ascend toward the summit, a mudslide halfway up causes Caroline to get injured. You follow Polaris' lead as you strive toward the final leg of the climb.
outline.你们终于登上了山顶，看到了最美的日出，卡洛琳也表明了自己想要探索这片未知大陆的愿: Reaching the top, you witness a stunning sunrise. Caroline expresses her eagerness to explore this uncharted land. To symbolize trust, she invites you to join her on a journey of exploration.
outline.你们发现行进的方向与前往淘金乐园的方向一致。: You realize that the direction you are heading aligns with the path to ONEderland.
outline.听说了你们在澄明数据中心的经历后，安菲娅提议你们可以前往阿妮塔发射中心与战备工厂: After hearing about your experiences at the CDCA Bureau, Anfiya suggests that you seek help from the Anita Launch Center and the Weapon Factory.
outline.你没能在发射中心得到想要的答案，但是安菲娅向你讲述了有关费尔德里奇号的过去。: You can't find the answers you were looking for at the launch center, but Anfiya does share with you the history of the Phildridge.
outline.你们抵达了阿妮塔战备工厂。: You arrive at the Anita Weapon Factory.
outline.你们顺利参观战备工厂的内部，同时，你们也注意到了安菲娅在待人接物上的困难之处。: You successfully tour the Weapon Factory and observe the challenges Anfiya faces during social interactions.
outline.安菲娅临时收到了来自铁盟的联络，要求你们一起前往工厂入口处会面。: Anfiya receives an unexpected message from BCRL, requesting a meeting at the factory entrance.
outline.你们并未见到铁盟的人，你意识到这是一个陷阱。: When no one from BCRL shows up, you realize it's a trap.
outline.在你们陷入绝境之际，园丁的导师伊利亚德现身救下了你们。: In a moment of desperation, Eliade, the Gardener mentor appears and rescues you.
outline.休整后，前来无垠号拜访的伊利亚德解释了他为何会出现在此处。: After a brief rest, Eliade visits the Eternal and explains the reason for his appearance.
outline.从伊利亚德口中，你们得知了当年旧七号自由港事故的真相。: Eliade reveals the truth about the Old Freeport Ⅶ incident to you.
outline.得知事情的真相后，安菲娅面色难看，伊利亚德拜托你帮忙照看她。: Upon learning the truth, Anfiya's face turns pale, and Eliade asks you to look after her.
outline.你在战备工厂的房间外找到了安菲娅形影不离的朋友白桦。: Outside a room, you find Anfiya's inseparable friend, White Birch.
outline.在你的努力下，安菲娅鼓起勇气，第一次向他人诉说自己的经历。: With your support, Anfiya musters the courage to share her experiences for the first time.
outline.通过安菲娅的叙述，你好像掌握到一系列事件元凶的线索。: From her account, you seem to uncover clues about the mastermind behind the events.
outline.你与莉薇娅想要循着现有的线索进一步调查，并为此请求伊利亚德的帮助。: You and Livia decide to follow up on the clues and seek out Eliade's help.
outline.在列车即将发车时，安菲娅主动来到了车站。: As the train is about to depart, Anfiya arrives at the station.
outline.你们在铁轨的前方见到了一个意想不到的人。: Up ahead on the railway track, you come across an unexpected person.
outline.苏醒的柯娜做出了匪夷所思的举动，她袭击了安菲娅。: The awakened Connor behaves erratically and attackes Anfiya.
outline.柯娜成为了深眠者，你们只能打倒她。: Connor has transformed into a Deep Sleeper, leaving you no choice but to defeat her.
outline.在你们手足无措之际，雷比斯突然现身，并抓住了始作俑者妮基塔。: In the midst of the chaos, Rebis suddenly appears and captures the culprit, Nikita.
outline.你向雷比斯索要一个解释，你感觉到她似乎仍有隐瞒，而妮基塔的动机也让你在意。: You demand an explanation from Rebis, suspecting she is still hiding something, while Nikita's motives continue to intrigue you.
outline.阴险的妮基塔想要逃跑，但是安菲娅阻止了她，这令妮基塔恼羞成怒。: The cunning Nikita tries to flee, but Anfiya blocks her off, only enraging her further.
outline.眼看情况危急，雷比斯的两位学生终于及时赶到。: As the situation reaches a critical point, Rebis' two students arrive just in time.
outline.妮基塔得到不明人士的帮助逃脱，但是在临走前，她还留下了什么……: Nikita receives assistance from unknown allies and manages to escape, but she leaves something behind...
outline.妮基塔居然强行引发柯娜深眠者化的二次进程……: Before fleeing, Nikita forcibly triggers Connor's second transformation into a Deep Sleeper...
outline.面对旧友和她发誓要守护的人，莉薇娅下定了决心。: Confronted by an old friend and the one she has sworn to protect, Livia makes her choice.
outline.莉薇娅亲手重创柯娜，而雷比斯见此情景，似乎想起了莉薇娅的母亲。: Livia personally delivers a fatal blow to Connor, and witnessing this, Rebis appears to recall memories of Livia's mother.
outline.终于将一切的事件告一段落，你知晓了过去之人的理想，并祝福重获新生之人走上旅途。: As everything finally comes to a close, you understand the ideals of those from the past and wish the rebirth a safe journey.
outline.与安菲娅告别后，你与伙伴们再度回归到列车长忙碌的日常生活中。: After bidding farewell to Anfiya, you and your companions return to the bustling life of a train conductor.
outline.连日的送货让你的肩膀酸疼不已，检查后医生建议多运动，这时正好遇到了卡洛琳，她自告: After days of strenuous deliveries that leave your shoulders sore, the doctor advises more exercise. Exiting the infirmary, you run into Caroline, who volunteers to be your coach. And so, your rehabilitation training begins.
outline.重回无垠号，来到了熟悉的车长室……一切都是那么亲切。欢迎回来，列车长！: Returning to the Eternal, you arrive at the familiar conductor's room... Everything is so familiar to you. Welcome back, Conductor!
outline.无垠号乘员被召集到一起，准备接受由梅迪奇会长亲自下发的任务。: The crew of the Eternal gather to receive a quest personally assigned by President Medici.
outline.抵达海角城，这里的氛围和其他篝火城都不一样……: Upon arriving at Cape City, the atmosphere is unlike any other Bonfire Cities...
outline.海角城商会接待员告诉我们，此行的目标是传说中的蜃息岛。: The COLUMBA receptionist in Cape City informs us that the destination of this journey is the legendary Mirage Island.
outline.到了海角城铁安局，却见到意想不到的人。: Upon arriving at the BCRL Agency in Cape City, we encounter someone unexpected.
outline.海角城的市长亲自接待我们——这里怎么会有猫？: The mayor of Cape City personally greets us—why is there a cat here?
outline.准备完成，换上新装，出发登岛吧！: Preparations are complete, and with new outfits on, it's time to set off for the island!
outline.自说自话的宿敌西蒙再次登场，这次比拼的内容是度假村的建设！: Simon, my self-proclaimed rival, makes another appearance, and this time the competition is about building a resort!
outline.终于登上蜃息岛了！在这里见到的第一个人竟然是……静流？: Finally arrived at Mirage Island, and the first person I meet is... Shizuru?
outline.和商会派来的负责人鲨伯特见面，开始着手于度假村的建设工作。: We're met by Sharkbert, the administrator sent by COLUMBA, and start working on building the resort.
outline.虽然现在只能住在帐篷里，但只要和无垠号的大家在一起就会觉得快乐。: Although we're staying in tents for now, just being with the crew of the Eternal brings me happiness.
outline.面对突如其来的桦树生物的威胁，有一个意外之外的人物登场……: As the sudden threat of Chaos Remains looms, an unexpected person appears...
outline.客人当中似乎混入了一些奇怪的人。: It seems some strange people have mingled in among the guests.
outline.我们的住所再次升级，该犒劳一下辛苦的莉薇娅了。: Our residence has been upgraded again—it's time to reward Livia for all her hard work.
outline.与莉薇娅一起创造更多美好的回忆吧。: Let's create even more wonderful memories with Livia.
outline.该丰富一下度假村的各类设施增加竞争力了。: It's also time to upgrade the resort's facilities to boost its competitiveness.
outline.亚莉奈非常难得地吐露了心声，似乎和她更近了一些……: Arina, who rarely opens up, has finally done so, and it feels like I'm getting closer to her...
outline.劫掠者来袭，他们究竟为何而来……: Looters have attacked, but what are they really after...?
outline.升级后的小屋让大家都十分满意！: Everyone is thrilled with the upgraded hut!
outline.新增的炒面摊位满足了客户的需求，同时唤醒了大家对家的回忆……: The newly added noodle stand not only meets the customers' needs but also stirs up memories of home.
outline.在讨论西蒙动向时，发现他也在关注劫掠者。: While discussing Simon's movements, we realize he's also keeping an eye on the Looters.
outline.与西蒙面对面对话，两人到底算什么关系呢？: A face-to-face conversation with Simon—what exactly is our relationship?
outline.从西蒙那里得到了更多线索，但是谜题越来越多。: We gather more clues from Simon, but the puzzle only deepens.
outline.经过我们的不懈努力，海岛上有了我们“第二个家”。: After all our hard work, we've finally created our "second home" on the island.
outline.在与静流关于过去的对谈终，了解了她的心意，然而就在此时，异状显现……: During a conversation with Shizuru about the past, I uncover her true feelings but just then, something strange happens...
outline.亚莉奈和莉薇娅也赶来了，到底发生什么事了？: Arina and Livia arrive—what exactly has happened?
outline.事到如今，只能继续前进了。: At this point, the only option is to keep moving forward.
outline.莉薇娅告诉我们这一切可能与帝国有关。: Livia tells us that all of this might be connected to the Empire.
outline.静流向前一步，走向了她认为“适合自己的位置”。: Shizuru steps forward, moving toward "the position she believes is right for her."
outline.打败神秘的深眠者后，我们发现了数张壁画……: After defeating the mysterious Deep Sleeper, we discover several murals...
outline.眼前的这个就是被封印在蜃息岛的怪物吗？我们真的能够打败它吗？: Is this the monster sealed on Mirage Island? Can we really defeat it?
outline.不管怎么样，我们最终还是得回归到日常生活中去。: Regardless of everything, we eventually have to return to our daily lives.
outline.苔妮邀请光顾列车武装工厂的列车长一起休息，喝一瓶“家族特制饮料”，聊了一些工作上: Tennie invites me to take a break at the Train Weapon Factory with a bottle of her family's "special drink," and we chat about work. Somehow, the drink leaves us both dizzy... and seeing strange things.
outline.在游乐园内占地最大的熊熊过山车上，发现了疑似苔妮家人的小熊。逐渐意识到这里并非自: On the largest roller coaster in Teddy Wonderland, we find a teddy that resembles one of Tennie's family members. As Tennie realizes this isn't the world she belongs in, she loses herself in the illusion and summons a swarm of plush phantoms to protect herself...
outline.打败毛绒玩偶的幻影，抓住苔妮的手，将苔妮带出了梦境。她似乎对于梦境中所做的一切感: After defeating the plush phantoms, I take Tennie's hand and pull her out of the dream. She seems a little embarrassed by what happened... Still, as the owner of Teddy Wonderland, she promises that I'm welcome back anytime.
outline.再次睁开眼睛，列车长发现自己身处一处梦幻的乐园之中，而苔妮看起来是乐园的主人。在: When I open my eyes, I find myself in a dreamlike amusement park, where Tennie seems to be its owner. At her invitation, we begin exploring together.
outline.苔妮向列车长介绍了鬼屋——玛格丽特屋。列车长认出这里的熊熊以玛格丽特为原型，但苔: Tennie takes me to the haunted attraction, Margaret House. I recognize the teddy bears as being modeled after Margaret, but one of my jokes inspires Tennie to remodel it into the Invincible Margaret Workshop.
outline.你正与列车组的同伴们在车上放松，结果在电台里听到曼德金库遭到入侵的新闻，下一刻，: While unwinding on the train with your crew mates, you learn of intruders breaking into Mander Vault over the radio. Shortly after, the mayor of Cape City personally tasks you with delivering his collections.
outline.你与莉薇娅前往曼德金库，顺利取走了阿莱斯特市长存放在这里的宝石。: Accompanied by Livia, you set off to Mander Vault, retrieving the gems belonging to Mayor Aleister.
outline.将存有宝石的箱子送到后，你们却发现箱子里的物品被金库的工作人员搞错了。: Upon handing over the suitcase with the gems, you realize the staff has mistaken it for another suitcase.
outline.为了找到宝石，你们前往海角城铁安局寻求静流的帮助。: Eager to reclaim the gems, you make your way to the BCRL Agency in Cape City, seeking assistance from Shizuru.
outline.为了尽快找到宝石，你打算请亚莉奈提供情报。你在荚蒾意外邂逅了一名神秘女子塞西尔，: In your quest to recover the gems, you decide to ask Arina for information. Later, a mysterious woman named Cecil crosses your path in Viburnum, and Arina eventually provides you with clues.
outline.你们在荚蒾附近遭到了毛绒会成员的袭击，就在箱子被对方抢走时，一名在金库有过一面之: Near Viburnum, you are ambushed by members of Fluffy Union. Just as they are about to grab the suitcase, a Citadel member you met at the vault steps in to help.
outline.名为伊索斯的学会成员误以为你擅自启动了他的物品，双方僵持之际，丽桑德拉出面为你解: The Citadel member Ithos mistakes you for meddling with his belongings. In the midst of the tension, Lissandra steps in to aid you.
outline.丽桑德拉解答了你们的疑惑，你从她口中得知学社将要举行一场选拔“天使”的仪式。: Lissandra answers your questions and discloses Citadel's upcoming ritual to select an "Angel."
outline.暗中操纵毛绒会的人竟然就是塞西尔，黑月的人似乎也想得到万象眼眸。: It turns out that Cecil is the mastermind behind the Fluffy Union. It appears that the Night Chains members are also eyeing the Omniscopic Gaze.
outline.来到学社后，丽桑德拉惊讶地发现万象眼眸已经选择了莉薇娅作为新的天使资格者。而莉薇: In the Climber, Lissandra is surprised to find out that the Omniscopic Gaze has chosen Livia as the new candidate, with Livia herself seemingly interested...
outline.察觉到莉薇娅的犹豫，你陷入了矛盾的心情，察觉到这一点的弗兰和艾略特打算开解你们。: You are overwhelmed by conflicting emotions when you sense Livia's hesitation. Noticing this, Fran and Eliot step in to soothe your worries.
outline.在弗兰的劝说下，你暂时放下心中的纠结，准备先找伊索斯了解更多成为天使的细节，: Encouraged by Fran, you temporarily set aside your emotional turmoil, committed to gathering more information about Angels from Ithos.
outline.在答应了伊索斯提出的条件后，你得知可以在汇流塔找到天使的真相。: After agreeing to Ithos's terms, you learn that the secrets about angels are hidden within the Confluence Tower.
outline.你在学社打听前往汇流塔的方式无门，苦恼时遇到了名为罗洁尔的学社成员。在帮助她时，: Your efforts to find a way into the tower prove futile. Just when you are feeling stuck, you come across Raziel, a Citadel member. While helping her, you and Livia manage to ease the tension between you.
outline.你们向罗洁尔打听汇流塔管理者，但是她拒绝了你们。: You ask Raziel about the Confluence Tower's administrator, but she refuses to help.
