outline.原来罗洁尔就是汇流塔的管理者，她在听完你们的话后改变主意，决定带你们前往汇流塔。: Raziel turns out to be the administrator of the Confluence Tower. After hearing you out, she has a change of heart and offers to guide you to the tower.
outline.准备离开学社时，你们收到了来自铁盟的强制征召，然而到现场后，你们发现状况有些蹊跷: As you are about to leave the Climber, you are summoned by BCRL. However, you sense that something is off about the situation.
outline.你得到了伊索斯的帮助，并从他口中了解了始作俑者和他个人的坚持。伊索斯告诉你，罗洁: You receive help from Ithos and delve deeper into the culprit's intentions and Ithos's personal motives. Ithos mentions that Raziel has something crucial to share with you.
outline.罗洁尔想委托你去修格里城取一件送给雅莱的礼物，你感受到了她对雅莱的关爱。: Raziel tasks you with retrieving a gift for Jalhay from Shoggolith City. Her words reveal her deep care for Jalhay's well-being.
outline.你从修格里交易所拿到了货物，同时发现罗洁尔给你的信封里有一些奇怪的宝石碎片。: Upon obtaining the gift from the Shoggolith Trading Center, you notice peculiar gem shards hidden within the envelope.
outline.在罗洁尔的帮助下，你们顺利进入汇流塔，从她口中得知了“天使”计划的残酷真相。: With Raziel's guidance, you gain access to the Confluence Tower, where she unveils the harsh truth behind the Angel Project.
outline.你们在汇流塔内见到了名为雅莱的少女，原来她就是天使技术的牺牲品。与她交谈后，你们: Inside the tower, you meet Jalhay, a young girl who has fallen victim to the Angelic tech. Your conversation with her deepens your understanding of the Angels.
outline.罗洁尔向你们回忆起她曾经与丽桑德拉深厚的情谊。: Raziel shares with you the deep bond she once had with Lissandra.
outline.你们拒绝了丽桑德拉，她表示尊重你们的决定。此时，学社内突然出现机器人失控的事故。: You turn down Lissandra's request, and she respects your choice. Meanwhile, a robot riot occurs in the Climber.
outline.在那由他的陪同下，你们再次见到雅莱，雅莱请求你帮忙修复罗洁尔留在汇流塔的投影仪器: Accompanied by Nayuta, we meet Jalhay again. She seeks my help to fix the projector Raziel left in the Confluence Tower.
outline.与余淞交流后我们得知从岚心城撤退至此的铁安局小队长伏见正在休养。: After conversing with Yusong, we learn that the BCRL Agency's Captain Fushimi, who withdrew from Ranshin City to here, is currently resting.
outline.你们打算将仪器带去远星大桥维修，从那由他口中，你们得知了远星大桥的状况。: We plan to take the device to the Apoaster Bridge for repair. Nayuta tells us about the Apoaster Bridge's situation.
outline.你们在抵达远星大桥后，见到了这里的负责人切茜娅和投资人“管家”，他们身上有着诸多: At the Apoaster Bridge, we meet Chelsea, the administrator of this place, and "Butler" the investor. They're both shrouded in mysteries.
outline.你将礼物交到雅莱手上，雅莱却追问你关于她姐姐赫尔的事情，而雅莱似乎意识到了什么，: You hand the gift to Jalhay, but she presses you about her sister Harle, and it seems Jalhay realizes something, becoming increasingly unstable...
outline.你们根本无法招架发狂的雅莱，一名言行奇怪的天使在这时候出现，坚定地保护你。: When you are overwhelmed by the frenzied Jalhay, a strange Angel appears, standing firm to shield you with unwavering resolve.
outline.眼看着乌刹娜与雅莱不相上下，伊索斯及时出手稳住了局面。: Just as the clash between Ushana and Jalhay reaches a stalemate, Ithos intervenes to restore order.
outline.你们从伊索斯口中得知，罗洁尔操纵了选拔的结果，让自己成为天使。想到成为天使的后果: Through Ithos, you discover that Raziel manipulated the ritual's outcome and decided to become an Angel herself. You hasten to Cape City, intent on meeting Raziel for one last time.
outline.你们没能见到罗洁尔的最后一面，从丽桑德拉的话语中，你们对整件事的来龙去脉，以及她: Your attempt to bid farewell to Raziel ends in failure. From Lissandra's account, you uncover the full story, delving into the inner struggles of Raziel and Lissandra.
outline.丽桑德拉无法挽留她，无法阻止她，公正而高尚的裁决者，只能目送她走向与自己相反的道: Lissandra, the fair and honorable judge, is powerless to prevent Raziel's descent down a starkly different path, watching helplessly as she strays.
outline.淘金大酒店修缮完毕，彼得·黄邀请你前去参加试营业活动。在莉薇娅的鼓励下，你迎来了: The ONEderland Hotel has been fully renovated, and Peter Hwang has invited you for a trial experience. Encouraged by Livia, you decide to enjoy a personal vacation.
outline.作为黑月合作代表的阿尔塞恩邀请你们参与一个推理游戏，大家在享受游戏后，瓦伦汀作为: Alcyon, the representative of Night Chains, has invited you to a detective game, and Valentine emerges victorious.
outline.你无意间听到飞鸟与阿尔塞恩的对话，在追问后得知飞鸟想在酒店内找到卡尔文老爷的遗产: You overhear a conversation between Songbird and Alcyon. Further inquiry reveals that Songbird intends to find Mr. Calvin's legacy within the hotel.
outline.你遭到了飞鸟的恶作剧，打算向她兴师问罪时，发现飞鸟看上去有点奇怪……: Pranked by Songbird, you decide to confront her, but you notice her unusual demeanor...
outline.刚刚抵达淘金大酒店，你就在门口发现了一群可疑的人，所幸有人替你解围。: Upon arriving at the ONEderland Hotel, you notice a suspicious group at the entrance. Thankfully, another person steps in to resolve the situation.
outline.你见到了同样是客人的佩罗塔与瓦伦汀，在彼得·黄带你们参观酒店时，你意外与神秘的飞: You run into Pelota and Valentine, who are also guests at the hotel. During a tour led by Peter Hwang, you encounter the mysterious Songbird once more.
outline.第二轮游戏是一场寻宝游戏，但是你们得到的暗语有些古怪，而飞鸟似乎知道些什么，破解: The second round is a treasure hunt, but the cryptic message seems too strange to decipher. However, Songbird appears to have insider knowledge and easily decodes it.
outline.瓦伦汀对第二轮游戏的暗语仍有些在意，而在第三轮游戏进行时，你通过莉薇娅得知了一些: Valentine remains unsettled by the cryptic message from the second round. During the third round, you have the chance to learn something new from Livia...
outline.瓦伦汀似乎有话要对大家说，而在打开房间门后，你们遭遇了一种诡异的共振……: Valentine seems to have something on her mind. When you open the door, you are met with a disquieting resonance...
outline.故事先生提示你们可以破解现场的暗语寻找出路。一番争论后，你们决定去探索酒店内部。: Mr. Storyteller suggests that deciphering the cryptic message may lead to a way out. After some discussion, you decide to explore the hotel's interior.
outline.来到酒店房间时，飞鸟与你们分开行动，之后失去了踪迹。: Upon reaching the hotel room, Songbird parts ways with you, and you lose track of her.
outline.在迷宫内，迷失的佩罗塔不见了踪影，你们只得继续探索。: Pelota has disappeared within the maze, leaving you to continue exploring alone.
outline.你与瓦伦汀在主题乐园遭遇大量桦树生物，瓦伦汀选择独自对敌，将你护在身后。: In the amusement park, you come across a swarm of Chaos Remains. Valentine steps forward to confront them, shielding you behind her.
outline.你们在各自突破困境后终于汇合，并且从故事先生口中得知了阿尔塞恩策划这一切就是为了: After overcoming various challenges, you reunite and learn from Mr. Storyteller about Alcyon's plan to reconstruct the Wishing Tower.
outline.你们回到了仪式发生的房间，在这里迎接你们的竟然是复活的阿尔塞恩，而他道出了当年一: When you return to the ritual room, you encounter the resurrected Alcyon, who reveals the hotel's hidden past.
outline.你们发现无法真正打败阿尔塞恩，而你们的体力也在不断被耗尽……: You find yourself unable to truly defeat Alcyon, and your stamina is wasted in vain...
outline.在你们精疲力尽的时候，莉薇娅的通讯奇迹般地传达，与她汇合的雷比斯给了你解决的思路: Just as you're exhausted, a message from Livia arrives in time, and Rebis, having reunited with her, suggests a solution.
outline.在所有人的一同努力下，你们最终化解了眼前的危机。: Through your combined efforts, you successfully resolve the ongoing crisis.
outline.你需要找他谈谈，而他也正在等你，揭开他的假面吧。: You need to speak with him, and he is waiting for you. It is time to unmask him.
outline.索思学会告知你们，他们将派遣一名成员陪同完成你们与雅莱的会面。: Source Citadel tells us that they will be sending one of their members to accompany us to our meeting with Jalhay.
outline.除了维修技术人员，你们还意外见到了随行的黑月执行人苏利耶，他向你们解释了投影背后: Besides the technician, we also happen to meet Night Chains executor Surya who came along. He tells us about how the projection works.
outline.切茜娅从桦树生物手中保护了你，但是她对罗洁尔的事情仍然耿耿于怀……: Chelsea protects me from Chaos Remains, but she's still brooding over Raziel's matter...
outline.切茜娅没能从罗洁尔的投影那里得到想要的答案，而苏利耶告诉你们，投影并没有损坏。: Chelsea fails to get the answer she wants from Raziel's projection, and Surya tells me the projection isn't malfunctioning.
outline.那由他能够理解切茜娅的心情，他向你道出自己的过去，原来他曾经和切茜娅一样迷茫……: Nayuta can relate to Chelsea's feelings. He tells me about his past. As it turns out, he used to be as lost as Chelsea...
outline.你将真相告诉了雅莱，意识到无法再见到罗洁尔，她第一次落下了泪水……: I tell Jalhay the truth. Realizing that she will never get to see Raziel again, she sheds tears for the first time...
outline.那由他将雅莱的监护权移交给你，在告别之时，他发现“管家”竟然与升构塔有所牵扯。: Nayuta makes me the custodian of Jalhay. Before leaving, he discovers that "Butler" is actually associated with the Ascension.
outline.前所未见的巨大怪物出现在岚心城的附近，铁盟与黑月联手抵抗。岚心城与外界的通讯因为: An enormous monster appears near Ranshin City. BCRL and Night Chains work together to fight against it. Ranshin's communication with the outside world is cut off. The whole city is a forsaken island now...
outline.在列车上神不知鬼不觉出现的少女，苏醒之后的第一反应竟然是发起攻击？: Unknown to anyone, a young lady appears on the train out of thin air, and the first thing she does upon waking up is to attack?
outline.无名在听完伏见对于岚心城的描述后，几乎已经可以肯定那怪物正是与她来自同一个世界的: After hearing Fushimi describe Ranshin City's situation, Mumei is certain that the monster is from her world. To ensure the safety of the route to Ranshin City, Mumei, my crew, and BCRL decide to work together...
outline.在岚心城的华美宅邸中，阴谋正在酝酿。: Within a magnificent abode in Ranshin City, a conspiracy is brewing.
outline.在海因里希处我们得知岚心城被怪物袭击并且失联的现状，我们触发前往离岚心城最近的云: Heinrich tells us that Ranshin City has been invaded by a monster and has since been uncontactable. We head toward Yunxiu Bridge which is nearest to Ranshin City to find out more.
outline.按照星花发来的通讯和她在咖啡馆见面；到达时，她正在出神地看游戏《雪色胶卷》的广告: I meet Stella in a café. She is watching the commercial for the game "White Film" distractedly. She tells me about a friend of hers who's an idol.
outline.星花表示她的这位朋友最近正苦恼于偶像事业的未来发展，也苦恼于一位奇怪的“跟踪狂”: Stella says this friend of hers has been fretting over her idol career and an odd "stalker." There seems to be some secrets behind this... I promise to help the idol.
outline.见到了偶像STELLA。从她的样子判断，似乎她对于怎么继续做偶像这件事感到迷茫—: I meet the idol STELLA. She seems at a complete loss for how to continue being an idol. As such, I decide to take her to the seaside to clear her head!
outline.在海边大道的冷风中交流了二人的想法。STELLA坦陈了对她而言的“事实”，我则表: In the cold breeze on the esplanade, we have a heart-to-heart chat. STELLA opens up about her "truth", while I let her know that I'll support her no matter who she chooses to be.
outline.打败了袭击者，对方的身份出乎我们的意料，星花却似乎对此早有心理准备。: We defeat the attacker, who surprises me with her true identity. Yet, Stella seems to have seen this coming.
outline.经历一番波折后有惊无险地来到了片场。在拍摄开始前的短暂休息时间里，星花表示她已经: We arrive at the film set in one piece. Stella tells me she has figured out how to deal with her idol job. This star will continue to shine on her path.
outline.和波克士一同去往黑月大酒店，在路上遇见了一位装扮有些新潮的少女……参与模拟战斗训: On my way to the Night Chains Hotel with Box, I meet a girl with somewhat trendy attire... On my way to the combat training, I hear about a terrifying "Highway Destroyer" in Night Chains.
outline.终于来到岚心城的我们带着无名见到了她的同伴生驹，还没来得及寒暄，就听说了深眠卡巴: We arrive at Ranshin City, and Mumei finally encounters her companion Ikoma. But before they can catch up with each other, the news of Deepsleep Kabanes coming hits...
outline.与生驹并肩作战之后，我们察觉所面对的敌人与之前遭遇的有很大差异。: After fighting alongside Ikoma in battle, we notice that there's a huge difference in the enemies than those encountered before.
outline.无名与生驹交流了各自的经历后，我们从生驹口中得知了宵月对甲铁城众的所谓“庇护”，: Mumei and Ikoma share their experiences with each other. I hear from Ikoma about Yoizuki's so-called "sheltering" for those aboard Koutetsujou, but discover the discrepancies.
outline.宵月的护卫带来了菖蒲的来信，信中透露的信息让人十分不安，岚心城中或许正酝酿着一个: Yoizuki's guard comes to deliver a letter from Ayame that reveals unsettling information. It appears there might be a huge conspiracy brewing within Ranshin City.
outline.收到生驹和无名的邀请一起在岚心城逛逛，吃完杯面后，他们坦白了自己的“秘密”。: Ikoma and Mumei invite me to stroll along Ranshin City. After having cup noodles, they come clean about their "secret."
outline.苍叶带来了令人震惊的情报，虽然追求的目标不同，但此刻似乎唯有联手才能阻止宵月继续: Aoba brings astounding news. Although we have different objectives, it seems that working together is the only way to stop Yoizuki.
outline.在我们为如何破局焦头烂额之际，融合体再度出现在了岚心城，这究竟是……: As we frets over how to turn things around, the fused entity reemerges in Ranshin City. But this time...
outline.看着成为了融合体核心的苍叶，无名似乎下定了某种决心。: At the sight of Aoba who has now become the core of the fused entity, Mumei appears to make up her mind about something.
outline.在众人的齐心协力下，危机终于解除，宵月也将面对来自岚心城城主朱鹮的惩罚。: With everyone working as a team, the crisis is finally resolved. Yoizuki will have to face punishment from Ranshin City's governor, Toki.
outline.事情告一段落，我们为依然暂时留在岚心城的甲铁城众人带来了好消息……: Things come to a close. We bring good news to the Koutetsujou crew who are still temporarily living in Ranshin City...
outline.在协助御敌枢纽成员离开的海角城完成治安协力任务后，你接到了亚莉奈的联络，原来她在: After completing the security cooperation quest in Cape City, I receive a call from Arina. It turns out her colleague in Night Chains, Cecil, encountered trouble.
outline.拜访澄明数据中心铁安局时，莱卡吉亚请求你帮他一个忙：成为“一日局长”。: When visiting the BCRL Agency in the CDCA Bureau, Lycagia asks you for a favor: to become "One-Day Chief."
outline.你作为黑月的代表前往交涉地点，与学会的行政人员冯·里奈见面。塞西尔似乎和乌刹娜起: As the representative of Night Chains, I meet with the administrative officer of Citadel, Rina Von. It seems Cecil had a conflict with Ushana.
outline.在你的建议下，你们决定先前往汇流塔，寻找方法治疗塞西尔的伤口。: Under my suggestion, we decide to first go to the Confluence Tower to find a method to heal Cecil's wound.
outline.你从乌刹娜口中得知了事情经过，打算信任她。罗洁尔的投影告诉了你有关乌刹娜的事情，: I learn about the event from Ushana's perpective. Raziel's hologram tells me about Ushana's story, and I learn that Joshua has the potion to heal Cecil.
outline.你告知冯·里奈了解到的内容，但是约书亚作为“天使”来去自由，想要找到祂并非易事。: I inform Rina Von about what I have learned, but since Joshua comes and goes freely, finding them is not easy.
outline.罗洁尔的投影向你展示了乌刹娜的过去，而你似乎也知道了乌刹娜把你称为“救世主”的原: Raziel's hologram shows me Ushana's past, and it seems I now understand why Ushana calls me "Master Savior."
outline.你们来到淘金乐园，却没有看到约书亚的踪影。据掘金机器人所说，祂不久前才离开，也许: We arrive at ONEderland, but there is no trace of Joshua. According to Nugget Mechs, they left not long ago, so maybe we can still catch up with them.
outline.你和莉薇娅驾驶大哥号出发，终于在沙漠中发现了约书亚。祂似乎昏迷了，而大量的桦树生: Livia and I set off in the Basilisk and finally discover Joshua in the desert. They seem to be unconscious, and a large number of Chaos Remains have surrounded us...
outline.你们成功救助了倒在沙漠里的约书亚，但桦树生物的危机也包围了你们。: We successfully rescued Joshua, who had collapsed in the desert, but the Chaos Remains surround us again.
outline.莉薇娅独自应对威胁，约书亚尚在昏迷之中。危急时刻，乌刹娜展现出超凡的力量救下你们: Livia faces the threat alone while Joshua is still unconscious. In a critical moment, Ushana reveals extraordinary power to save us.
outline.约书亚告诉你，滴溜溜转转瓶不在他手中。经过一番掰扯，这名性情古怪的天使答应带你们: Joshua tells me that the Twirly Whirly is not in their hands. After some back-and-forth, this quirky Angel agrees to help us find the item.
outline.约书亚指引你们来到一处神秘的站点塔图站，你们在那里见到了天使诞生的场所哈依玛之骰: Joshua guides us to a mysterious station, Tattle Station, where we see the birthplace of Angels, Haima Zaria, and hear the story behind it.
outline.你在塔图站遇到了曾有过缘分的达斯廷，根据他的态度，你意识到事情有些复杂……: We meet Dustin, with whom we had a past connection. Based on his attitude, I realize things are somewhat complicated...
outline.乌刹那情绪激动，她似乎受到了某种感应，与此同时，你察觉到了不知从何时起就窥探着你: Ushana is emotional, as if she has sensed things. At the same time, I notice the gaze that has been watching me for who knows how long...
outline.在昏迷中似乎看到了不属于自己的记忆，再度醒来，一行人竟然已经在哈依玛之骰内部了…: While unconscious, I seem to see memories that don't belong to me. When I wake up again, all of us are somehow already within Haima Zaria...
outline.终于找到了骰子的核心——思维浮标所在的房间，但是，接下来会有在等待呢……: We finally find the core of Haima Zaria — the Mind Buoy. However, what will be waiting next...?
outline.她醒来了，但醒来的也不再是你们所熟知的那个她。: She wakes up, but is no longer the one we knew.
outline.从意识海中归来的你，从约书亚口中听到了乌刹娜的牺牲，你也下定了决心。: Having returned from Unbewusstes, I hear about Ushana's sacrifice from Joshua and also come to a decision.
outline.在赶赴决战之前，你向那位天使确认了祂的目的。: Before heading to battle, I learn from the Angel about their motive.
outline.同伴已经全数败下阵来，约书亚已经没有不战斗的理由了。: My companions have all been defeated. Joshua no longer has an excuse to step aside.
outline.乌刹娜做了一个长远的梦，梦里，救世主大人找到了她。: Ushana had a long dream. In the dream, Master Savior found her.
outline.达斯廷和约书亚向一个神秘人提起了种种提案，从今往后，学会会变得不一样吗？: Dustin and Joshua put forward various proposals to a mysterious person. Will the Citadel change from now on?
outline.第一站是市政厅。在市政厅里，“一日局长”和莱卡吉亚受到了摩尔充满机器人之爱的关心: The first stop is the City Hall. In the City Hall, the "One-Day Chief" and Lycagia receive Moore's care and help filled with robotic love, as well as reminders.
outline.第二站是商会。雷齐娅一如既往地态度不太客气，不过，她似乎想要提醒你今天这份工作背: The second stop is COLUMBA. Reizia, as usual, isn't very polite; however, she seems to want to remind me about the hidden story behind today's work.
outline.勉强答应了替雷齐娅去附近巡逻的邀请。莱卡吉亚向你坦诚，其实今天的工作主要是向各个: I reluctantly accept Reizia's invitation to patrol the vicinity. Lycagia confides in me that today's main task is to deliver a special document to the heads of various facilities, and the issuance and implementation of this document have encountered a lot of obstacles.
outline.在交易所，莱卡吉亚提出要提富子解决附近的治安隐患问题，富子却认为他的这种责任感有: At the Trading Center, Lycagia offers to address the nearby security issues for Plutessa, but Plutessa feels that his sense of responsibility is somewhat excessive. Lycagia gains Plutessa's understanding, and we set out on patrol together.
outline.最后一站是无垠号——结束工作以后，莱卡吉亚和你一同回到了无垠号上，享受难得的休息: The final stop is the Eternal. After finishing work, Lycagia and I return to the Eternal together to enjoy a rest. I experienced many things with him in just one day and got to know him better. Hopefully, he can find freedom for himself and others.
outline.黑月大酒店中出现意外事件。前往查看情况时，偶然在人群中再次与那名少女擦肩而过。: An unexpected incident occurs in the Night Chains Hotel. When checking the situation, I accidentally brush past that girl again in the crowd.
outline.在走廊中遇见前往天台的少女，担心其安危而追了上去，误打误撞将她从天台边缘拉回。她: I meet the girl in the corridor who is going to the rooftop. Worried about her safety, I chase after her, accidentally pulling her back from the edge. She introduces herself as "Ren."
outline.在天台上与涟一同休息谈心。不一会儿，附近的乌鸦从四处聚集而来，围绕着我们二人。与: I rest and chat with Ren on the rooftop. Before long, nearby ravens gather, surrounding the two of us. After a pleasant farewell with Ren, we agree to meet again when we have the chance.
outline.与涟告别后，回到训练室继续训练，但对手换成了魇。从魇的口中得知，原来传说中的“公: After saying goodbye to Ren, I return to the training room to continue practicing, but my opponent is now Maruha. I learn that the "Highway Destroyer" is actually Ren's weapon. Where will I meet Ren again?
outline.真咲来到无垠号，请求以列车长的名义来调查铁盟封锁区的神秘生物UMA。: Masaki boards the Eternal and requests to investigate the unknown mysterious animal in the BCRL restricted area with your help.
outline.UMA看起来只是一种桦树生物，二人准备调查一下再回去汇报情况。: The UMA appears to be just a Chaos Remain, and you two decide to investigate further before reporting back.
outline.真咲的情绪似乎有些低落，她向你倾诉了心事，二人做出了分享秘密的约定。: Masaki seems a bit downcast. She confides her feelings to you, and the two of you promise to share secrets.
outline.真咲发现了你身上的一些怪异，受限于某些规则无法直接告诉你，但仍为你献上祝福。: Masaki notices something strange about you. Limited by certain rules, she cannot tell you directly, but she still offers you her blessing.
outline.打捞公司从七号自由港打捞上一个神秘的盒子，随后，多方势力齐聚一堂开始会议，大家心: A salvage company recovers a mysterious box from Freeport VII. Multiple factions gather for a meeting, each harboring their own agendas as they maneuver around the Verdant Realm Project.
outline.在完成了报酬丰厚的订单之后，你招待自己的乘员以及商会派来的帮手黛丝莉前往黑月游乐: After completing a lucrative order, you entertain your crew and Desiree, the helper sent by COLUMBA, to go to Night Chains Land.
outline.与你们约好碰面的黛丝莉失去了音信，而你从巧遇的黑月成员马吉拉口中得知游乐城内发生: Desiree, whom you arranged to meet, lost contact, and you learn from the Night Chains member Margiela, whom you encounter by chance, that several incidents of teenage disappearances have happened in the amusement park.
outline.与此同时，黛丝莉在游乐城内偶遇了正被一可疑人士纠缠的塔拉，面对这个漏洞百出的骗子: Meanwhile, Desiree has a chance encounter with Tara, who is being harassed by a suspicious person in the amusement park. Facing this blatantly flawed scammer, the two quickly team up.
outline.通过你的努力，原本不愿配合的失踪者同伴们提供了一些有价值的情报。: Through your efforts, the missing person's uncooperative companions provide some valuable information.
outline.从与你有过一面之缘的游乐城员工涟口中，你们得知失踪人群的负面情绪十分强烈。: From Ren, an employee at the amusement park whom you have met once, you learn that the negative emotions of the missing people are very intense.
outline.马吉拉从青少年游客处打听到一个令人在意的传闻，霖的态度似乎有些不对劲……而在这时: Margiela heard an intriguing rumor from some teenage tourists. Lin's attitude seems a bit off... and at that moment, Desiree calls.
outline.黛丝莉和塔拉顺利抓住了诱拐犯，然而那个被诱拐犯关起来的少女却不见踪影。: Desiree and Tara successfully catch the kidnapper, yet the girl imprisoned by the kidnapper is nowhere to be found.
outline.诱拐犯被带来后经受了审讯，然而他并非你们要追查的真凶。: The kidnapper undergoes interrogation; however, he is not the real culprit you are pursuing.
outline.你们愁眉不展时，游乐城的管理者歌德现身，并且带来了一个重要情报。一名幸存者称犯人: When you are feeling stuck, the manager of the amusement park, Goethe, appears and brings important information. A survivor claimed that the culprit is the Witch.
outline.你们从塔拉处听说了流传于帝国的魔女传说，得知魔女是这样邪恶的存在，马吉拉的信仰产: You hear from Tara about the witch legend from the Empire and learn that the Witch is such an evil being, causing Margiela's faith to collapse. On the other hand, Masaki seems to have seen the true culprit...
outline.又有新的失踪者出现了，而马吉拉的状况也很古怪，好像受到某种控制一般向某个方向而去: There are new missing persons, and Margiela's condition is also very strange, as if under some kind of control, heading in a certain direction.
outline.你与马吉拉得到了阿尔喀娜的帮助，在得知自己与帝国魔女的渊源后，马吉拉依然下定决心: You and Margiela receive help from Arcana. After learning about her connection with the Witch of the Empire, Margiela still decides to face it all.
outline.你们进入了占卜小屋内的空间，马吉拉终于与真咲相遇。: You all entered the divination room, and Margiela finally meets Masaki.
outline.从塞蕾娜癫狂的话语中，你们依稀明白了她为何会走上这样的道路。: From Serena's mad words, you vaguely understand why she took such a path.
outline.见识到马吉拉的决心后，真咲也向马吉拉袒露了过去的一切。: After witnessing Margiela's determination, Masaki also reveals everything about her past to Margiela.
outline.事情告一段落后，你们了解到并非作为魔女，只是她们自己的过去。: After things settle down, you learn their past not as the Witch.
outline.在马吉拉的努力下，占卜小屋重新开放，这一次，就由魔女为大家带来幸福与奇迹吧。: With Margiela's efforts, the divination room has reopened. This time, let the witch bring happiness and miracles to everyone.
outline.由于乌刹娜在无垠号的状况很稳定，学会允许她可以自由外出一天。大家费尽心思为乌刹娜: Since Ushana's been in a good condition on the Eternal, the Citadel allowed her to go out freely for one day. We wish she can spend a happy day at the amusement park.
outline.来到游乐城的乌刹娜却非常紧张，完全看不到开心的样子，也许是出了什么问题……: Ushana becomes very nervous and doesn't look happy at all. Maybe something went wrong...
outline.逐渐找到了游玩的节奏，乌刹娜开始能全心全意投入这次游乐城之旅。: Gradually finding the pace, Ushana begins to fully immerse herself in this amusement park adventure.
outline.休息时间，独自等待的乌刹娜意外与几名游客起了争执，她的情绪一时间陷入了波动之中，: During the break, while waiting alone, Ushana unexpectedly gets into a dispute with several tourists. She's at the risk of losing control...
outline.成功控制住了局面，乌刹娜的情绪也重新恢复，你们约定好下次还要一起出来玩。: The situation is under control, and Ushana's mood also recovered. We agree to have fun together again.
outline.在无垠号上发现了一张写着时间地点的神秘纸条……到澄明数据中心赴约后，发现是需要同: A mysterious note is found on The Eternal... After going to the appointment at the CDCA Bureau, it turns out to be Reeva who needs a companion. What kind of adventure awaits when traveling with this Devil Hunter?
outline.听取委托人的证词后，瑞瓦似乎对恶魔的真身有了些想法。深受“恶魔”困扰的小女孩卡洛: After listening to the client's testimony, Reeva seems to have some ideas about the truth of the devil. The girl Carol, who is deeply troubled by the "devil," asks us to help her.
outline.在远见公寓内部四处调查，瑞瓦认为这里出现的桦树生物和深眠者是“扭曲”后的产物。: Investigating around the Vision Apartment, Reeva believes that the Chaos Remains and Deep Sleepers appearing here are results of "distortion."
outline.和瑞瓦在调查途中聊起了她的身份和过往。身为魔法学院逃亡者的她，如今在地表以“狩猎: Reeva talks about her past during the investigation. As a fugitive from the Magic Academy, she now makes a living on the surface by "hunting devils"... Additionally, the true identity of the target turns out to be a Deep Sleeper, not a devil.
outline.采取巧妙的方式让委托人相信了我们的说法，为小女孩解围。结束了今天的工作，与瑞瓦道: Using a clever approach, we convince the client of our explanation to help the little girl out of trouble. I conclude today's work and say goodbye to Reeva, hoping to meet her on The Eternal in the future!
outline.在塔图站伫立着的神秘建筑物——哈依玛之骰，学会迟迟没有对其进行回收，似乎是有其他: The Citadel has been delaying the retrieval of Haima Zaria at Tattle Station, seemingly with other plans in mind. On this day, an Angel never seen before breaks into the Eternal, bringing new trouble...
outline.打败骰数空间中的幻影罗洁尔之后，克洛伊对你完成了深潜表达了惊讶，并且告诉你一个更: After defeating the Phantom Raziel in Haima Zaria, Chloe expresses surprise at your completion of the deep dive and informs you of an even more shocking fact: you now seem to be the key to the transformation of the Angel Project...
outline.自称是你血亲的奇怪男人出现在你面前，他的话语，他所讲述的所谓“真实”让你觉得无比: A strange man claiming to be your blood kin appears before you. His words and the so-called "truth" he speaks make you feel incredibly uneasy. What does he really mean?
outline.列车长一行人因梅迪奇的要求来到七号自由港，在正式与她见面前还有些时间，大家不由得: You arrive at Freeport VII at Medici's request. With time before your formal meeting with her, everyone chats about anecdotes concerning the President.
outline.列车长和莉薇娅见到梅迪奇会长，得知了纪念活动的来龙去脉。梅迪奇想要引荐伊卡菈没成: You and Livia meet with President Medici and learn the full story behind the commemoration. Medici's attempt to introduce Ikara doesn't go as planned; everyone discusses the speech then splits up to prepare.
outline.列车长在海边偶遇了伊卡菈，两人寒暄一番，随后打算一起行动。: You run into Ikara by the seaside. The two of you exchange pleasantries, then decide to go around together.
outline.两人为了俯瞰城市先去了观景台，遇到了缅怀过去的人，搜集了一些资料，之后伊卡菈请列: To get a view of the city, you head to an observation deck, where you meet someone reminiscing about the past and gather information. Ikara asks you to take a photo of her, saying she wants to show it to her guardian.
outline.搜集一圈情报后两人暂时休息，伊卡菈对列车长说出了自己对梅迪奇的态度感到烦恼这件事: After gathering intel, you and Ikara take a break, during which she confides that she's troubled by her feelings toward Medici.
outline.与伊卡菈在城里逛得时候，发现了一家服装店，进去选购了一番。: While wandering the city with Ikara, you discover a clothing store and go in to browse and shop.
outline.两人来到海岸边上，结果发现一个女人状态古怪，好像要跳海，他们急忙上前施救，却不小: You and Ikara arrive at the coast, where you find a woman acting strangely, as though about to walk into the sea. You rush to help her, but end up accidentally falling into the water together.
outline.上岸后发现原来事情是一场误会，这位叫陈书闲的人似乎和旧七号自由港有渊源。而伊卡菈: Once ashore, you discover it was all a misunderstanding — the woman, named Chen Shuxian, seems to have a connection to Old Freeport VII. Ikara is upset that her belongings got soaked.
outline.谈话时，伊利亚德也来了，列车长从他口中了解到了自由港的过去和萃境计划。: While you talk, Eliade arrives, and you learn from him about the Freeport's past and the Verdant Realm Project.
outline.伊利亚德向你们介绍起一度被搁置的，计划将铁路铺设到帝国的“萃境计划”。你兴奋不已: Eliade tells you about the once-shelved "Verdant Realm Project," which aimed to extend the railway into the Empire. Thrilled, you readily agree when Eliade invites you to join, while also realizing Ikara might be connected to it somehow.
outline.几人分别，列车长邀请伊卡菈去无垠号，帮她修手机，在无垠号上碰到莉薇娅后，大家交流: The group parts ways, and you invite Ikara to the Eternal to help fix her phone. Running into Livia aboard, everyone discusses preparations for the speech.
outline.列车长说起萃境计划，众人讨论一番，之后接到了伊利亚德的电话，约好第二天发车过去。: You bring up the Verdant Realm Project, then receive a call from Eliade, arranging to depart the next day.
outline.纪念活动开始，各种大人物讲话，打捞公司老板说了远星大桥通车这件事，随后就宣布选中: The commemoration begins, with dignitaries giving speeches. The salvage company's head mentions the opening of the Apoaster Bridge, then announces Livia's speech has been chosen.
outline.莉薇娅上台演讲得到掌声，然而下台后她就变得非常疲惫。回到无垠号后莉薇娅直接倒下发: Livia takes the stage and delivers her speech to applause, but afterward becomes utterly exhausted. Back on the Eternal, she collapses with a high fever.
outline.梅迪奇、伊卡菈还有打捞公司老板闻讯都来看望，列车长打算推掉伊利亚德的委托被莉薇娅: Medici, Ikara, and the salvage company's head come to visit upon hearing the news. You intend to turn down Eliade's request, but Livia stops you.
outline.伊利亚德前来和列车长碰面，列车长与伊卡菈一起前往远星大桥。: Eliade comes to meet with you, and you and Ikara set off together for the Apoaster Bridge.
outline.路上闲聊，列车长注意到了梅迪奇手中的照片，这才知道伊卡菈与梅迪奇之间的渊源: Chatting along the way, you notice the photograph in Medici's hand, and learn of the connection between Ikara and Medici.
outline.抵达远星大桥后，众人立刻做准备，开始抓捕计划。: Upon arriving at the Apoaster Bridge, everyone begins preparations and launches the capture operation.
outline.面对领航员，列车长与伊卡菈想到了一个对策。: Facing the Navigator, you and Ikara come up with a plan.
outline.列车长借用伊卡菈的力量，准备对怪物发动致命一击。: You draw on Ikara's power, preparing to deliver a fatal blow to the monster.
outline.准备开车进入桦树空间战斗。: You prepare to drive the train into the Chaos Space to fight.
outline.伊卡菈能力显露冰山一角，帮助大家追击桦树生物，双方展开了激烈的战斗。: Ikara reveals just a glimpse of her true power, helping everyone pursue the Chaos Remain, and a fierce battle breaks out between the two sides.
outline.来到桦树空间后，你们看到了裂隙的另一端，那是一片星海一样的地方。: Upon entering the Chaos Space, you see what lies beyond the rift — a place like a sea of stars.
outline.伊卡菈最后力挽狂澜，击败了怪物，她想要成为像你一样的列车长。: Ikara turns the tide and defeats the monster. She says she wants to become a conductor just like you.
outline.一切尘埃落定，伊卡菈与你道别，踏上了她的道路。: With everything settled, Ikara bids farewell to you and sets off on her own path.
outline.大人物开会，在提到萃境学园的选址时，鹭提出可以由他们黑月来提供场地，这个新学校的: The dignitaries hold a meeting, and when the location for the Verdant Realm Academy comes up, Sagi proposes that Night Chains could provide the venue — there seems to be something special about the origins of this new school...
outline.在我参观宝石展会时，海伦娜忽然现身，以黑卡买下我心仪的宝石，并要求我作为她的助手: While I was visiting the gem exhibition, Helena suddenly appeared, bought the gem I desired with a Black card, and asked me to be her assistant, beginning to learn the mysteries of gemology and trading.
outline.克洛伊来到淘金乐园执行任务，在她的身后，菲妮娅和冯·里奈正悄悄跟随着她。: Chloe arrives in ONEderland on a mission, unaware that Fenia and Rina Von are secretly tailing her.
outline.跟随的二人被克洛伊发现，菲妮亚在解释的时候，突然中暑晕倒。: The two are quickly discovered, and while Fenia tries to explain herself, she suddenly collapses from heatstroke.
outline.菲妮娅被送到无垠号上接受治疗。克洛伊霸占了休息室。突然一阵电光闪过，列车陷入了黑: Fenia is taken aboard the Eternal for treatment, while Chloe shamelessly takes over the Conductor's lounge. Moments later, a burst of electricity plunges the entire train into darkness.
outline.为了保证菲妮亚的治疗，克洛伊不得不以自身的能力强行重启列车的引擎。: To keep Fenia alive, Chloe has no choice but to force the Eternal's engines back to life with her own power.
outline.忙碌之后，克洛伊回到列车上休息。我坐在克洛伊的身边对她倾诉着，感到肉麻的克洛伊羞: After everything is finally over, I quietly tell her what I truly think. Embarrassed by the heartfelt words, Chloe takes off into the sky in a huff.
outline.伊利亚德表示两人在考核中拿到第一名，就可以把手册给他们看，两人为了达成这个目标开: Eliade tells the two of them that if they place first in the assessments, he will let them read the handbook. They set to work on making that happen.
outline.得知设计图原件在伊利亚德的画室，这触发了晃和伊尔不堪的回忆，原来伊利亚德的绘画作: Learning that the original schematic is in Eliade's art studio triggers memories Akira and Yer would rather not revisit — as it turns out, Eliade's paintings have quite an impact, and not one anybody is prepared for...
outline.两人达成了目标，伊利亚德遵照约定将手册给他们看，本子上有两个人的笔迹，就这样意外: The two of them meet the goal, and Eliade keeps his word and lets them read the handbook. There are two hands in the notebook, and that is how they brush up against a past from over twenty years ago.
outline.在伊利亚德的引导下，两人参与了褚玉衡留下的，最后的挑战谜题，看着自己的学生，一代: Guided by Eliade, the two of them take part in the last of the challenge puzzles Chu Yuheng left behind. Watching his own students, and one generation of new Gardeners after another, come into their own stirs a great deal in Eliade...
outline.伊利亚德打算在园丁考核中采用新模式，请晃和伊尔配合测试，两人对伊利亚德那本不离身: Eliade plans to use a new mode in the Gardener assessments and asks Akira and Yer to help test it. The handbook he never lets out of his hands catches their curiosity.
outline.斯洛卡伊在陌生的地底醒来，她勉强驱动机神力，操纵一台钻掘单元试图脱困，却意外撞上: Slokai woke up in an unfamiliar underground. She struggled to drive her machine's power, operating a drilling unit in an attempt to escape, but accidentally crashed into an underground village.
outline.斯洛卡伊控制的钻头意外冲入地下村落的浴室，导致村庄设施与物品被冲得七零八落，引来: The drill controlled by Slokai accidentally crashed into the bathroom of an underground village, causing the village's facilities and items to be scattered everywhere. This attracted the angry Cave Spirits who surrounded them, and since she couldn't communicate with them, she could only be taken away to wait for the so-called "Breese" to communicate.
outline.在垃圾回收站的布雷斯与安菲娅交谈时，得知有一名来自异世界的个体出现在其故乡黮窨村: While Breese was talking with Anfiya at the recycling station, he learned that an individual from another world had appeared near his hometown of Anxun Village, suspected of bringing danger. Subsequently, a flustered Tarei, wrapped in a towel, burst in to report an emergency. Breese immediately set out with Anfiya to investigate the situation.
outline.荒原站外，列车长与莉薇娅按安菲娅的坐标抵达，却意外发现安菲娅正与一群外貌与布雷斯: Outside Wilderness Station, Conductor and Livia arrived at Anfiya's coordinates, only to unexpectedly find Anfiya surrounded by a group of dwarves resembling Breese. They were surrounding two young girls, one of whom was a stranger named Slokai, accused by the dwarves of damaging village facilities... Was this person the "Miss Ellie" you had once met?
outline.斯卡洛伊与窟灵族的矛盾还没调解结束，在交谈中，她突然高烧昏倒，手臂开始逐渐透明，: The conflict between Skaroy and the Kulings hasn't been resolved yet. During the conversation, she suddenly fainted with a high fever, and her arm began to gradually turn transparent, as if she were disappearing from this world.
outline.安菲娅告知斯洛卡伊因被形态场排斥引发的解离现象，将于七天后消失，她请求我们寻找传: Anfiya informed us that the dissociation phenomenon Slokai is experiencing, caused by the repulsion of the morphic field, will disappear in seven days. She requested that we find the legendary "Primordial Fruit" to help extend Slokai's life.
outline.列车组在讨论向哪位帝国人寻求帮助，另外一边，斯洛卡伊已经醒来，并且告知安菲娅她已: The train crew is discussing which Imperial person to seek help from, meanwhile, Slokai has already woken up and informed Anfiya that she understands her physical condition but is not ready to rest.
outline.冯里奈告知我们卡塔斯有事不在，我们决定去修格里城询问咖啡馆的奥莉薇恩更多情报。: Rina Von informed us that Katas was not present due to some matters, so we decided to go to Shoggolith City to ask Olivien at the café for more information.
outline.在修格里城咖啡馆，我与莉薇娅遇见奥莉薇恩的监护人海伦娜，得知她熟知曼杜斯的情报；: At the Shoggolith City café, Livia and I met Olivien's guardian Helena, who informed us that she was well-acquainted with intelligence on Mundus; meanwhile, Slokai spoke with Breese outside Wilderness Station and promised to assist him.
outline.海伦娜答应提供原质之果的炼成配方，但拒收金钱，改要求我与莉薇娅将来履行一次承诺作: Helena agreed to provide the formula for the Primal Fruit but refused to accept money, instead requiring me and Livia to fulfill a promise in the future as compensation, and she is willing to personally assist in the synthesis.
outline.海伦娜向我和莉薇娅详细讲解了炼制原质之果所需的五种材料，并揭示了原质之果的历史。: Helena explained in detail to Livia and me the five types of materials needed to refine the Primal Essence Fruit and revealed the history of the Primal Essence Fruit.
outline.斯洛卡伊通过指挥窟灵族重建工地，成功赢得他们中部分人的尊敬与支持。: Slokai, by directing the reconstruction site of the Kuling tribe, successfully earned the respect and support of some among them.
outline.我们与斯洛卡伊一同推理神秘材料线索，窟灵族人则因先知“布罗斐忒”身份引发争议。: We are reasoning about the mysterious material clues together with Slokai, while the identity of the prophet "Brofit" has sparked controversy among the Kulings.
outline.安菲娅提供了关于最后一样材料的情报，我们决定前往矿场和淘金乐园寻找材料，斯洛卡伊: Anfiya provided information about the last piece of Material, and we decided to go to the mine and ONEderland to search for Material. Slokai insisted on participating in the operation personally.
outline.斯洛卡伊再次登上了无垠号，与此同时，布雷斯在垃圾站向安菲娅吐露了内心的迷茫。: Slokai boarded The Eternal once more, while at the same time, Breese expressed his inner confusion to Anfiya at the junkyard.
outline.抵达曼德矿场，斯洛卡伊默默感受着熟悉而又陌生的工业氛围，内心复杂；随后我们在矿场: Arriving at Mander Mine, Slokai silently felt the familiar yet unfamiliar industrial atmosphere, his heart complex. We then searched for the key material "Star Silver" in the mine and received assistance from Uncle Baxter, preparing to continue to go to ONEderland to collect the remaining materials.
outline.我们准备迎击尘鸣游磷，嘱咐斯洛卡伊在车上待着。: We are preparing to confront the Sand Phosphor and instruct Slokai to stay in the car.
outline.我和莉薇娅在淘金乐园完成了仙人掌采集任务，斯洛卡伊对金子小姐产生了兴趣……？: Livia and I completed the cactus gathering Quests at ONEderland, and Slokai became interested in Miss Gold...?
outline.窟灵族内部因圣炉争议爆发冲突，族长拒绝外人接近神殿，但随着多名族人突然失去意识，: Conflict erupted within the Kuling tribe over the sacred furnace controversy. The chieftain refused outsiders from approaching the temple, but as several tribespeople suddenly lost consciousness, Slokai decided to accept the trial, vowing to uncover the truth and respond to her people's trust in her.
outline.布雷斯报告窟灵族同伴不断昏迷，众人决定前往神殿使用圣炉唤醒族人并炼制原质之果；海: Breese reported that the Kulings were continuously falling unconscious, and everyone decided to go to the temple to use the sacred furnace to awaken their people and refine the Primal Fruit; Helena mysteriously left the camp, and Slokai decided to return underground to investigate the truth.
outline.我们发现通往神殿的道路已经损坏，利用滑索和隐藏机关准备进入神殿探查秘密。: We found that the road leading to the temple was damaged, so we prepared to use zip lines and hidden mechanisms to enter the temple and explore its secrets.
outline.布雷斯和波克士利用滑索进入对岸启动伸缩桥，却遭遇“长耳窟灵族”伏击，险象环生。: Breese and Box used a zipline to reach the opposite shore and activate the drawbridge, but they were ambushed by the "Long-Eared Goblins," facing great danger.
outline.我们发现了穿着帝国服饰的深眠者和神殿守卫者，神殿的存在与曼杜斯帝国有关……我们决: We discovered Deep Sleepers and temple guardians wearing imperial attire, and the existence of the temple is related to the Mundus Empire... We are determined to uncover the truth about the temple and the sacred furnace.
outline.我们在神殿通过解读炼金术师留下的封语光片，成功破解了宝石机关，打开了通往圣炉的神: We successfully deciphered the gemstone mechanism by interpreting the alchemical lens left behind in the temple, opening the temple gate leading to the Sacred Furnace.
outline.我们在神殿内部调查熄灭的圣炉和轨道系统，发现了圣炉无法启动的关键，随后在午夜兔的: We investigated the extinguished sacred furnace and track system inside the temple, discovering the key to why the sacred furnace couldn't be activated. Then, under the guidance of the Midnight Rabbit, we prepared to explore the hidden secrets deep within the temple.
outline.在神殿深处发现了被隐藏的窟灵族造物“本体”和震撼壁画，揭露了他们是炼金术师为帝国: Deep within the temple, the hidden creation "main body" of the Kuling tribe and a stunning mural were discovered, revealing that they were creations made by alchemists for the empire's migration plan. Breese fell into agony because of the truth, while everyone else began repairing the sacred furnace, preparing to rekindle hope.
outline.我们神殿内重新点燃圣炉后，轨道阵法启动，却意外触发了潜伏的强大桦树生物，迫使他们: After reigniting the sacred furnace within our temple, the track formation activated but unexpectedly triggered a dormant powerful CR, forcing them to evacuate urgently.
outline.布雷斯带领苏醒的窟灵族人群抵挡强敌桦树生物，斯洛卡伊以机神力反制敌人却陷入意识崩: Breese led the awakened Cave Spirits to resist the formidable enemy, CR. Slokai used mechanical power to counter the enemy but fell into a state of mental collapse. The group took the opportunity to retreat, and the crisis was temporarily resolved.
outline.斯洛卡伊在濒死与梦境边缘挣扎后，在海伦娜炼制的“原质之果”作用下苏醒了。: After struggling on the edge of death and dreams, Slokai awoke under the effect of the "Primordial Fruit" crafted by Helena.
outline.斯洛卡伊在荒原站帮助窟灵族建设地上村落，恢复了元气并规划温泉浴场，同时决定继续守: Slokai helped the Kurin tribe build a surface village at Wilderness Station, restored their vitality and planned a hot spring bath, while also deciding to continue guarding them and waiting for the right time to start engine and leave.
outline.我跟随海伦娜在展会上购入大批原石，在搬运与见学的过程中，她借一块普通石头向我阐述: I followed Helena to purchase a large number of rough stones at the exhibition. During the transportation and learning process, she used an ordinary stone to explain to me the philosophy of "polishing flaws, giving meaning," and ultimately entrusted that Mumei rough stone to me.
outline.在咖啡厅，奥莉薇恩婉拒了萃境代表乌菲兹的请求后，与现身的海伦娜讨论情报；随后海伦: In the café, after Olivien politely declined the request from Uffizi, representing Crystal Realm, she discussed intelligence with the newly arrived Helena. Subsequently, Helena performed her unique gem divination for me, revealing that my destiny had been rewritten by some force, displaying countless unpredictable possibilities.
outline.我和海伦娜、奥莉薇恩一同前往汇流塔寻找卡塔斯，却与丽桑德拉不期而遇。海伦娜与丽桑: I, along with Helena and Olivien, went to Confluence Tower to look for Katas, but unexpectedly encountered Lissandra. Helena and Lissandra had a fierce magical confrontation due to a clash of ideologies.
outline.海伦娜借宝石卜术向丽桑德拉证明自己的立场，同时向我讲述了她关于守望命运与放手挚友: Helena used gem divination to prove her position to Lissandra, while telling me about her choice between safeguarding destiny and letting go of a close friend. Afterward, we reunited with Katas and Olivien, sharing a moment of tranquility.
outline.无垠号停靠在贡露城的一个夜晚，刚结束一天的我意外迎来乌刹娜与那由他的突访，我被带: The Eternal docked in Gronru City one night. Just after finishing my day, I unexpectedly received a visit from Ushana and Nayuta, and I was taken to a secret location of the Source Citadel.
outline.在索思学会秘密据点，我以“证人”身份见证切茜娅的审讯，目睹她在爱维珊娜的药物质询: At the Source Citadel's secret outpost, I witnessed Chelsea's interrogation as a "witness," observing her gradually unravel under Avicenna's pharmaceutical inquiry.
outline.在审讯中，切茜娅逐步暴露出材料申请背后的矛盾，最终在药物质询下崩溃，喊出“父亲”: During the interrogation, Chelsea gradually exposed the contradictions behind the material application. Ultimately, under the influence of drug questioning, she broke down and shouted out the name "father," unraveling the mystery of the mistletoe experiment and the professor who might still be alive.
outline.丽桑德拉判定切茜娅“主观无罪、结果有责”，并宣布解除其一切职务给予自由，但切茜娅: Lissandra determined Chelsea to be "subjectively innocent but accountable for the outcome" and announced the removal of all her duties, granting her freedom. However, Chelsea, unable to bear the "freedom of innocence," broke down emotionally, crying out and begging for punishment, ultimately rushing madly toward me.
outline.在梦境审判中，丽桑德拉借助我的存在诱出寄生于切茜娅潜意识的执念，使其得以清除并获: In the Dream Judgment, Lissandra used my presence to lure out the obsession parasitizing Chelsea's subconscious, allowing it to be cleared and for her to gain true freedom; however, upon waking, Chelsea was still confused by "why not herself." In the end, with my encouragement, she accepted the journey to find herself, albeit with mixed feelings.
outline.梅迪奇做了一个与女儿有关的梦，而这个梦境似乎预示着什么……: Medici had a dream about his daughter, and this dream seemed to be an omen of something...
outline.梅迪奇前往海伦娜的珠宝店拜访，她想要见一个人，这个人似乎和莉薇娅有关。: Medici went to Helena's jewelry store to visit; she wanted to see someone who seemed to be related to Livia.
outline.阿妮塔的园丁们在研究爆炸事故，他们想要找到一位失踪研究员的下落。: Anita's gardeners are investigating the explosion incident, and they want to find the whereabouts of a missing researcher.
outline.与此同时，学会检测到了某种危险的存在……: At the same time, the Citadel detected the presence of some danger...
outline.你从一个噩梦中惊醒，随后，伊卡菈告知你她今天即将离开，希望能和你利用剩下的时间在: You wake up from a nightmare, and then Ikara informs you that she will be leaving today, hoping to spend the remaining time with you exploring Gronru City.
outline.你与伊卡菈一起体验了自行车后，将她送到车站，前来接应的护卫蒂斯塔尔早已等候多时。: After experiencing cycling with Ikara, you took her to the station where the guard Tistar, who came to meet you, had been waiting for a long time.
outline.终于和康复的莉薇娅汇合，你们的车组再次完整集结，等待你们的是新的任务。: Finally reunited with the recovered Livia, your crew is once again fully assembled, awaiting new quests.
outline.另一边，正在四处搜寻的阿妮塔园丁们发现了要找的研究员，然而对方的情况出乎所有人的: On the other side, the Gardeners who were searching around found the researcher they were looking for; however, the situation of the latter was beyond everyone's expectations.
outline.任务中的意外遭遇让你结识了名为朵拉弥丝的神秘少女，在阿妮塔的帮助下你们避免了最大: An unexpected encounter during the quests introduces you to a mysterious girl named Doramis. With Anita's help, you avoided the biggest crisis. However, the entire crew still needs to halt for repairs for a while. You plan to take the opportunity to try out a famous restaurant in Gronru City.
outline.根据伊利亚德的吩咐，你准时来到贡露城的机构参与阿妮塔的新人培训，在那里你与朵拉弥: According to Eliade's instructions, you arrive on time at the institute in Gronru City to participate in Anita's new employee training. There, you reunite with Doraemis and meet your mentor, Shilo.
outline.时萝的讲课过于枯燥，你和朵拉弥丝无法抵挡睡意，这让时萝很不高兴。: Shiluo's lectures are too dull, and you and Dolores cannot resist the drowsiness, which makes Shiluo very unhappy.
outline.贡露城的人们都在为即将到来的捕鱼大赛做准备，而你和朵拉弥丝肩负时萝布置的任务，开: The people of Gronru City are all preparing for the upcoming fishing competition, while you and Doraemis have taken on quests assigned by Shiluo and have begun the practical segment.
outline.休息时你发现了朵拉弥丝的特殊体质，桦树生物似乎把她认作同类，十分亲近。: During the break, you discovered Dolores' special constitution. The CR seems to recognize her as one of their own and is very close to her.
outline.你们被捕鱼大赛的宣传消息吸引，这时，你的宿敌西蒙再次出现，向你发起了挑战邀约。: You are attracted by the promotional message of the fishing competition, and at this moment, your nemesis Simon appears once again, issuing a challenge to you.
outline.你们原本打算买票观看比赛，朵拉弥丝却在工作人员的劝诱下不小心报名成为了比赛选手，: You originally planned to buy tickets to watch the competition, but under the persuasion of the staff, Dolores accidentally signed up to be a contestant, and the conditions for withdrawal are extremely strict, so you can only accept reality.
outline.得知你要参加比赛，西蒙感到非常不可思议，于是决定他也要参加。在西蒙母亲和姐姐的支: Upon learning that you were going to participate in the competition, Simon was very incredulous and decided he would also participate. With the support of Simon's mother and sister, Simon's father finally relented and agreed.
outline.莉薇娅非常反对你参加比赛，不过在你向她分析了比赛规则后表示可以中途弃权时，她总算: Livia was very opposed to you participating in the competition. However, after you explained the competition rules to her and mentioned that you could withdraw halfway, she finally reluctantly agreed.
outline.你和朵拉弥丝等待着比赛开场，贡露城的所有人都无比关注这场盛大的赛事。: You and Dolamis are waiting for the competition to start, and everyone in Gronru City is paying close attention to this grand event.
outline.虽然最开始不熟练，但你很快掌握驾船要领，并在朵拉弥丝的帮助下捕到大量海鱼，亮眼的: Although initially lacking proficiency, you quickly grasp the essentials of sailing and, with Dolores' help, catch a large number of sea fish. Your impressive performance wins you considerable popularity.
outline.比赛进入第二阶段，突然出现了一条神秘的怪鱼开始袭击选手，被袭击的选手变成了桦树生: The competition entered the second stage, and suddenly a mysterious monster fish appeared and began attacking the competitors. The attacked competitors turned into CR, while the audience thought it was just part of the program...
outline.好不容易让参赛选手们愿意听你说话，你们却从时萝那里得知了新的坏消息，幕后黑手竟然: It was not easy to get the contestants to listen to you, but then you received new bad news from Shi Luo: the mastermind had actually planted bombs on your ship and in the audience seating area.
outline.随着第二轮投票结束，主持人又宣布了新的规则，被淘汰的选手只要牺牲自己的同伴就能获: As the second round of voting ended, the host announced a new rule: eliminated contestants could be saved if they sacrificed their companions, which immediately caused new confusion.
outline.莉薇娅等人正在想办法支援你，而你也没有坐以待毙，联合其他选手打算杀死鬼灯鲨，可就: Livia and others are trying to find a way to support you, and you are not sitting idly by either. You join forces with other contestants intending to kill the Demon Lantern Shark, but just as you are about to succeed, the forward ship is blown up, revealing the mastermind behind the scenes...
outline.在妮基塔的撺掇下，你被淘汰出局，面对鬼灯鲨的追杀，你突然想到一个找到妮基塔藏身处: Under the instigation of Nikita, you were eliminated. Facing the pursuit of the Ghost Lantern Shark, you suddenly thought of a good idea to find Nikita's hiding place.
outline.你被逼入绝境，朵拉弥丝义无反顾地打算牺牲自己，换取你的生路。: You are driven into desperation, and Doraemis resolutely plans to sacrifice herself to secure your way out.
outline.西蒙唤醒了意志消沉的你，而他也被淘汰出局，你想到了一个风险很大的方法，在你的鼓励: Simon awakened your discouraged will, and he was also eliminated. You thought of a very risky method, and with your encouragement, Simon decided to do as you said.
outline.西蒙和婕丝成功配合了你的计划，你们将鬼灯鲨击杀。与此同时，静流等人也找到了妮基塔: Simon and Jess successfully cooperated with your plan to kill the Ghost Lantern Shark. Meanwhile, Shizuru and others also found Nikita's hiding place.
outline.朵拉弥丝平安无事回到你们身边，然而，妮基塔却成功逃走，并且准备好了一场全新的危机: Doramis returned to you safe and sound, however, Nikita managed to escape and is ready for a brand new crisis...
outline.和莉薇娅一同来到篝火城中采购星祷节风格的车厢装饰，却偶遇了陷入抽选困境的卡塔斯。: I go to buy carriage decoration with Livia, but run into the confused Katas. In order to attract her attention, I ask Livia to walk her around.
outline.在超市独自继续采购时与同样前来采购的伊尔和陈书闲碰面。采购完毕后，陈书闲想去某个: While I am shopping alone, I run into Yer and Chen Shuxian. Afterward, Chen Shuxian wants to go somewhere...
outline.和陈书闲一起缝制了星祷节风格的可爱玩偶，收到了完成品作为礼物……似乎更能理解节日: I make a cute doll with Chen Shuxian, and receive a gift... Now the festival is more heartwarming. Merry Astrum Ora!

des.童话故事中才会出现的梦幻糖果屋，一位年纪尚幼的魔女等待着你的到来。\\n此处可以: A dreamy candy house that only appears in fairy tales, where a young witch awaits your arrival.\nYou can polish Dream Emblems here.
des.在废弃车厢中支起的占卜帐篷，一位明晓命运的魔女等待着你的到来。\\n此处可以擦亮: A divination tent set up in an abandoned carriage. A witch who sees fate awaits your arrival.\nYou can polish Dream Emblems here.
des.喷泉中似乎传来呼唤声——向喷泉里抛入一枚硬币，就能实现一个小小的愿望。\\n可通: A calling seems to come from the fountain — toss a coin into the fountain, and a little wish can be fulfilled.\nMake a wish to obtain [Tracker of Lost Traces] that reveals the route of the Float.
des.缓缓旋转的摩天轮下，有一位特殊的游客正在攻克连续抓娃娃关卡。: Under the slowly rotating Ferris wheel, a special tourist is tackling consecutive claw machine challenges.
des.骑扫帚也需要训练吗？在这位老师跟前，答案显而易见。: Is training needed for broom riding? The answer is obvious when you stand in front of this teacher.
des.旋转的彩灯和罗盘，旋转的梦……旋转的毛绒会成员……: The rotating lights and compass, the rotating dreams... the rotating Fluffy Union member...
des.亮着篝火、有着欢快谈笑声的场所，在此可以稍作休息、恢复体力。: A place with a bonfire and cheerful laughter. You can rest and recuperate here.
des.提供点心、茶水和休憩之地的场所，在此可以稍作休息、恢复体力。: A place with a bonfire and cheerful laughter. You can rest and recuperate here.
des.寂静神秘的房屋，偶尔能听到零落的笑语声，似乎只是过去的回响。她等待着那个人的归来: A silent, mysterious dwelling. Now and then, scattered laughter drifts forth, as if merely echoes of days gone by. She waits for that person's return, even though she has forgotten everything.
des.魔女独自在此编织永恒的黑夜，无人的住所不能被称之为家，只是守住幻梦的最后堡垒。: The witch dwells here alone, spinning an endless night. A vacant place is no true home, only the final stronghold that shelters dreams of phantasm.

des.一只黑猫，似乎是某位资历尚浅的魔女的伙伴，它将指引你走向一条艰难但也充满收获的道: A black cat, seemingly a partner of an inexperienced witch, will guide you on a path that is difficult but also full of rewards.
des.一把钥匙，来自某位拥抱自我的新生魔女，她已允许你打开她身上的枷锁，暂时借用她的力: A key from a rebirth witch. She has allowed you to unlock the shackles on her and temporarily borrow her power.
des.一枚戒指，来自某位行事低调，学生满天下的曼杜斯魔法导师。翠绿通透的宝石中蕴含着强: A ring from a low-key imperial magic mentor. The emerald gem seems to protect travelers passing through this place.

des.要是不做好保暖措施，冬天的时候可能会变得非常黑……: If it isn't kept warm, it may become extremely black in winter...
des.大家都特别喜欢它面包一般可爱的身姿！: Everybody loves its adorable, bread-like figure!
des.据说它的爸爸被选作靛红五月的优秀员工以后再也没有回家……: Word has it that its father hasn't come home since being selected as Carmine May's most outstanding employee...
des.某位漫画家一到截稿日就会发出和它一样的声音。: A certain comic artist makes the same noise as it whenever the deadline is close.
des.仿佛拥有着一股浓郁的芒果气息……: It seems to carry the strong fragrance of mangoes...
des.虽然长满了尖刺，但只要获得它的信任，它就愿意把布丁般软软弹弹的一面让你抚摸。: Although it's full of thorns, it'll be willing to let you caress its soft-as-pudding belly so long as you earn its trust.
des.非常有责任心的猫，总是会抓各种各样的东西送给你，尽管那些东西你并不想要。: An incredibly responsible cat that constantly catches all kinds of stuff for you, even those that you don't want.
des.听了狐狸化作人形的故事以后，它希望自己也能化形成为万众瞩目的明星，正在在努力学习: After hearing the story of foxes transforming into humans, it's currently working hard to fulfill its dream of becoming a prominent celebrity.
des.遥小姐的爱猫，时常像巡视自己的领地一般在列车上神出鬼没。: Miss Haruka's beloved cat. Often shows up in the train out of the blue as if it's patrolling its territory.
des.一杯芋泥啵啵奶茶，不要芋泥，不要奶不要茶。: So cute and fluffy that you may need to take a number to apply to be its servant.
des.当有人问它的名字时，有个人在旁边打了个喷嚏，于是打喷嚏的声音被当成了它的名字: When someone asked about its name, another person sneezed nearby. Hence, it only responds to the sound of a sneeze now.
des.性格随和的小猫，一顿饭吃掉的量是其他猫咪的三倍。: An amiable little cat that has thrice the appetite of its kind.
des.它好像一直觉得自己比其他的猫都有品味。: It seems to have always thought itself more cultured than other cats.
des.嘿！这可不是用来擦地的！就算长得像也不行！: Hey! It isn't a cleaning rag, even though it looks like one!
des.这个漂亮的孩子曾经有一百只猫追求它，然后那一百只追求者全都失恋了。: This gorgeous child once had 100 suitors, but they all got their hearts broken.
des.总是有些发愁的样子，但其实是因为它本来就长这样。: Seems perpetually glum but it's really just how it looks.
des.对卫生环境有着极高的要求，偷懒的主人可不行！: Has especially high hygiene standards. Lazy owners won't be tolerated!
des.就是爬不上去，只能化为贴地行动的一团黑洞。: A black hole that may open up anywhere on the floor, as jumping isn't its forte.
des.据说天使看到它会被吓到浑身无力？: Rumor has it that angels get scared out of their minds at the sight of it.
des.谁能拒绝摸摸它呢？: Who can ever resist patting it?
des.看起来好像一直在笑，有什么值得高兴的事情吗？: It always appears to be smiling. Is there something to be so happy about?
des.好像从岩浆里蹦出来的一样！: Looks like it popped up out of a volcano!
des.不是鸡肉的罐头我才不吃呢！: Only eats canned food if it's chicken!
des.性格活泼的小猫，一顿饭吃掉的量是其他猫咪的四倍。: An energetic little cat that has four times the appetite of its kind.
des.只有在开罐头的时候才会跑出来，难不成以为罐头才是它的名字……？: Only appears when cans are opened. Could it actually think its name is Can...?
des.总是待在水温正好的浅水里思考蛙生……: Always pondering life in shallow water that's at just the right temperature...
des.让人想到撒了冻干草莓的白巧克力。: Reminds people of white chocolate with freeze-dried strawberries.
des.据说着装灵感取自世界名画《撑洋伞的小鸭》。: Its outfit is said to be inspired by the famous painting "La Canette à l'ombrelle".
des.穿上生灵节装扮的红守宫。呜哇~超可怕~~！: Orange Gecko in Fantasma Eve's costume. Whoa~ That's scary~~
des.被套上礼服礼帽仍旧保持淡定的青蛙。一个蛙只有一个命运。: Composed Frogfather exhibiting composure. He will give you an offer you cannot refuse.
des.奶牛加牛仔，列车上只喝牛奶~: A cowboy is just perfect for a train that serves milk!
des.穿着童话故事主人公裙装的卷耳布偶猫。攀上猫爬架，踏入奇境！: A folded-ear ragdoll cat wearing a princess dress from fairy tales. Climb up the scratching post and enter fairyland!
des.穿着星祷节特色服装的卷耳布偶猫。替你带来礼物了喵！: A folded-ear ragdoll cat wearing a special Astrum Ora costume. Here's a gift for you, meow!
des.招财进宝，财源广进~: Wishing you abundant wealth and prosperity!
des.穿着学士服的卷耳布偶猫。两耳不闻帽外事，一心只当学士喵。: A ragdoll cat with folded ears wearing a bachelor's gown. Paying no mind to matters beyond the cap, focused solely on being a scholar cat.
des.穿着睡衣的卷耳布偶猫。沉入甜蜜的喵乡……: A folded ear ragdoll in pajamas. Drifting into a sweet meow dream...
des.珍岛犬的名称取自韩国珍岛郡的地名。珍岛狗有划分排名的倾向,但一般不会认为比自己低: The name of the Jindo Dog is derived from the place name of Jindo County in Korea. Jindo Dogs have a tendency to distinguish rankings, but they generally do not consider others lower than themselves, so you can rest assured.
des.狮子狗是代表韩国的传统犬。虽然有驱赶牛鬼蛇神的说法，但似乎无法驱赶'桦树生物': Lion dogs represent the traditional Korean dog. Although there is a saying that they can drive away evil spirits, it seems they cannot drive away "Chaos Remains."
des.据说能为年龄小于14岁的孩子叼来黑月游乐城的邀请函。: It is said to be able to fetch invitations to Night Chains Land for children under the age of 14.
des.穿上这身装扮，歌声也比平时更加宏伟嘹亮了。: Putting on this outfit, the singing becomes even more magnificent and resonant than usual.
des.误入魔法森林的时候，就要戴上红帽子！: When you accidentally enter the magical forest, make sure to wear a red hood!
des.前往海洋，掠夺属于我们的宝物！: To the ocean, to plunder the treasures that belong to us!
des.学生文静的扮相很适合它，想必在音乐课上能有十分亮眼的表现。: A studious, gentle student's look—suits it well. Bet it would really shine in music class.
des.什么可怕的面具？什么小刀？什么追杀？大家为什么要跑？: What terrifying mask? What small knife? What pursuit? Why is everyone running?
des.已经完全准备好去郊游了。: Already fully prepared for the outing.
des.去往温暖的岛屿度假的装束，那边应该不会有让猫变黑的魔法……: Outfits for vacationing to warm islands, where there shouldn't be any magic that turns cats black...
des.感觉下一秒会变成一股烟雾消失……: Feels like it will turn into smoke and vanish the next second...
des.喜欢一边唱歌一边飞，把雪花般的羽粉洒满房间的每一个角落。: Loves to sing as it flies, scattering snowflake‑like down over every corner of the room.
des.最喜欢说的一句话是“本大爷是天才”！: Its favorite line is: "I'm a genius!"
des.放松的时候会在掌心融化为一滩蓬松的小鸟。: When relaxed, it melts into a fluffy little puddle of bird in the palm.
des.穿上多萝西亲手制作的可爱小洋装的蜜柑。危险性很低，但头上的蝴蝶结会边走边掉。: Mikan in a cute Dorothy-made dress. Barely dangerous — save for the bow atop its head, which slips off with every step it takes.

content.什么？？这章鱼跑这么快！: What?? This octopus is so fast!
content.拼了，干它！！: Give it our all! Finish it!!
content.哔哔！能源不足，无法启动！: Beep beep! Insufficient energy. Unable to start!
content.它来得好快！这样下去会撞上的！: It's approaching too fast! At this rate, we'll crash!
content.啧！看来必须得先打上一架了！: Tsk! Looks like we have to fight it first!
content.（摇头）是我们辜负了大家的好意，还连累大家被卷进了那样危险的情况。: (Shaking head) We let everyone down and got everyone into such a dangerous situation.
content.诶！？还在疼吗？那、那是不是要跟我们一起去接受检查……: Huh!? Are you still in pain? Sh-Should we go for a check-up together...
content.哈哈，开个玩笑，我身体好着呢，不用担心~: Haha, just kidding. I'm fine. No need to worry~

Desc.在这些失败的例子里，旧七号自由港也排得上最惨重的前几名了。: Among them, the old Freeport Ⅶ pretty much tops the worst list.
Desc.哔哔，当前行驶路线：发射中心大桥。: Beep beep! Current route: The launch center's bridge.
Desc.这么一看还真是壮观啊！太了不起了我们！: Wow, it's truly spectacular! We're simply way too amazing!
Desc.列车真正行驶在桥上时，感受到了格外强烈的成就感呢！: Don't you just feel an extra strong sense of achievement when the train really drives over the bridge?
Desc.好，亲爱的无垠号，就将从这里开始，和我们一起踏上西大陆征服之旅！终有一日，我们将: All right. Our dear The Eternal shall begin conquering the Western Continent with us starting from here! Someday, we will reach the ends of the world!
Desc.不知道为什么，这种情景感觉卡塔斯小姐应该也在……: For some reason, it feels like Miss Katas should be here for such a sight...
Desc.我已经深刻地认识到了我的错误……: I've truly reflected on my mistake...
Desc.从今以后我一定会认真履行职责，勤勤恳恳，在自己的岗位上发光发热！: From now on, I will carry out my duties in earnest, be conscientious, and thrive in my position!
Desc.等等不要用那种眼神看着我啊，我随口乱说的——: Hang on, don't look at me that way. I wasn't being serious—
Desc.听到你这句话才是真正的寒心。: Now that is what's really disheartening.
Desc.嘿嘿，毕竟马上要去的是那个地方嘛，只是开个玩笑活跃下气氛啦！: We're going to that place now. I thought I'd crack a joke to lighten up the atmosphere!
Desc.（吓唬）下次没有人会再配合你！: No one will play along with you again!
Desc.很快就要到海角城了。: We'll be reaching Cape City very soon.
Desc.感觉空气里都充满了学会的书卷气息……: Feels like even the air is thick with the Citadel's highbrow vibes...
Desc.这可是著名的书香之都……: This is a renowned city of literature...
Desc.既然是和学会密切相关的篝火城，那街道上应该也有很多学会成员吧？: Since it's a Bonfire City with close connections to the Citadel, the streets should be packed with Citadel members, right?
Desc.难道都是像卡塔斯小姐那样……: Would they all be like Miss Katas...?
Desc.不过，之前也有和其他人约定过“海角城见”呢。: But we did promise to meet a few others in Cape City.
Desc.嗯！说得对，如果能在街道上遇见熟悉的人就好了！: Mm, that's right. It'll be nice if we can bump into some familiar faces in the street!
Desc.啊……又到这里了，曾经的七号自由港……: Ah, we're here again. The old Freeport Ⅶ...
Desc.也不是所有的篝火城最后都成功建立起来了，建造失败的例子数都数不过来。: Not all Bonfire Cities managed to be successfully established. In fact, there are countless such failed examples.
Desc.我记得是因为现实稳定装置没有成功运行吧？: If I recall correctly, it was because the Reality Stabilizer failed to work, right?
Desc.如果只是没有成功运行那还算好的，关键是之后还引发了一连串故障，结果整个城市都被毁: If so, that wouldn't be so bad. Problem is, it prompted a series of malfunctions afterward, causing the entire city to be ultimately destroyed.
Desc.西大陆地区脱离地联、成立铁盟和这起事故之间脱不了干系。: This incident definitely had something to do with the Western Continent withdrawing from the Earth Union and establishing B.C.R.L.
Desc.不过也有阴谋论的人觉得……: But some conspiracy theorists also believe...
Desc.嗯？这荒郊野外的还有人点篝火？: Eh? This is the middle of nowhere, and yet someone lit a bonfire here?
Desc.多半又是哪里的流民团伙吧。: It's most likely some kind of refugee group again.
Desc.不对，篝火边只有一个人在哎！: That's not it. There's only one person by the bonfire!
Desc.……不会是什么隐士高人吧？: ...Don't tell me it's a seclusive maven of sorts?
Desc.哪儿有你说的这么夸张，而且咱们还急着送货呢。: Obviously not that exaggerating. Besides, we have no time to lose with this delivery on hand.
Desc.唔唔……下次路过的时候一定要去搭个话！说不定有什么意外收获呢！: Aww... We have to go strike up a conversation the next time we pass by! Who knows, we might get an unexpected reward!
Desc.会这么想证明你游戏打太多了……: Clearly, you've played too much video games to have such a line of thought...
Desc.按照铁盟和商会的规定，铁轨两旁的遗失物超过一定时限未被回收的话，就归下一位发现者: According to the COLUMBA and B.C.R.L.'s rules, any lost property that's left uncollected on both sides of the tracks shall belong to whomever finds it after a certain amount of time has passed.
Desc.如果在铁轨边发现遗失货物的话，记得提醒列车长拾取一下。: If you see any lost cargo by the tracks, please remind the Conductor to pick it up.
Desc.每次经过都要被硫磺味呛一鼻子……: The smell of sulfur always chokes me every time we pass by...
Desc.谁让你老开着窗透气。: Aren't you the one who always insists on opening the window for fresh air?
Desc.好歹快到这里前提醒我一下嘛。: You could've at least reminded me when we're almost here!
Desc.才不咧，还要往来很多次的，早点习惯吧。: No chance. We'll be coming a lot in the future. Get used to it.
Desc.好多的棚屋，怎么会有这么多难民在这儿？: Wow, so many huts! Why are there so many refugees here?
Desc.毕竟距离城市的稳定装置辐射范围比较接近。: Well, it's much closer to the radiation range of the city's Reality Stabilizer.
Desc.遇到危险也来得及逃，对难民来说算是不错的居住地了。: They'll have enough time to flee in times of peril. It's already considered a relatively good place to stay for refugees.
Desc.城里就那么多地，那些老爷们哪儿舍得让难民进来。: There's only so much land in the city. No way those residents will let the refugees in.
Desc.咱们路上遇到过那么多暴民不就是这么来的。: This is exactly why we've run into so many mobs.
Desc.说起来，为什么修格里一出门就是铁盟的哨站基地？: By the way, why is B.C.R.L.'s outpost base right outside Shoggolith's border?
Desc.不是好事吗，更有安全感了。: Isn't that good? Feels more secured.
Desc.修格里城毕竟是西大陆核心篝火城之一，铁盟在这里驻扎一定武装力量也很合理。: Shoggolith City is one of the core Bonfire Cities in the Western Continent, so it makes sense that B.C.R.L. would station some armed forces here.
Desc.道理是这样啦，但是总觉得……: That does sound plausible, but I still think...
Desc.有点互相提防的感觉？: It's as if they're both guarding against each other?
Desc.也可能真的只是为了治安呢。: Or it may just really be for public safety.
Desc.毕竟咱们刚刚才经历了一场恶战。: We did go through a tough battle not long ago, after all.
Desc.只要经过这条隧道，就到曼德矿场了。: We'll reach Mander Mine once we pass this tunnel.
Desc.说起来，这条隧道好像年头不短呢。: Interestingly enough, this tunnel seems relatively old.
Desc.从一开始，曼德矿场就为修格里城源源不断地输送工业原料。: Mander Mine has been continuously supplying industrial materials to Shoggolith City since the beginning.
Desc.因此早早修建了铁路专线……不过每次经过这里时，还是想感叹直达的便捷呢。: So, a dedicated railway line was built long ago... But whenever we pass by here, the convenience of direct access still amazes me.
Desc.好事哎，赶紧交完货，咱们就能休息啦！: Cool! Well, let's quickly finish this job so that we can get some rest!
Desc.就算离得老远都看得清清楚楚啊，那栋大楼。: Even if we're miles away, that building still can't be missed.
Desc.啊啊，真想知道是用怎样的工程技术造出来的~: Aaah! I'm seriously dying to know what engineering Tech was used to construct it...
Desc.列车长又开始了……话说你不是痴迷机械吗？: Here we go with the Conductor again... Speaking of which, aren't you a gearhead?
Desc.工学的美都是相通的！: The art of engineering is interlinked!
Desc.是啊，听说经常因为赶进度而废寝忘食，加班也是日常了。: Yeah. I heard they often skip meals and sleep just to make deadlines. Overtime work is a norm.
Desc.唉，要耗费不知多少的人力物力才能建造出一个这样的现实稳定装置。: Creating a Reality Stabilizer like this would require a huge amount of manpower and resources.
Desc.然而面对地卫二的污染，这类装置却是纯粹的消耗品。: However, these facilities are considered disposable in the face of Morphic Moon threat.
Desc.天呐，这能算是鱼吗？: Gosh, can this even be considered a fish?
Desc.之前列车长你说他们是做什么来的？哦对，游戏公司。做游戏的要这么辛苦啊！: Conductor, what did you say they worked for again? Oh, right. A game company. Is making video games that demanding?
Desc.大概又是在加班吧。: Probably because they were working overtime as usual.
Desc.上次到达这里的时候，已经是凌晨了却还灯火通明的。: It was already midnight when we arrived here the other time, but the lights were still on.
Desc.哦~说起来，这个观测站的选址还挺得天独厚的呢？: Oh. Come to think of it, the location of this observatory is pretty naturally advantageous, huh?
Desc.毕竟是地卫二观测站嘛，建造时一定考虑到了各种条件的，也算是阿妮塔的得意之作了。: It's Morphic Moon observatory, after all. They must've taken everything into account when they constructed it. It can be said to be one of Anita's proudest works.
Desc.嗯~一到曼德矿场，熟悉的工业气息就扑面而来啊。: Hmm... We've only just neared Mander Mine, and the industrial atmosphere is hitting us.
Desc.地卫二啊……不知道以后我们能不能亲眼观测一下。: Morphic Moon... I wonder if we'll ever get to see it with our own eyes.
Desc.这些建筑好像比之前见过的被破坏得更严重呢。: These buildings seem to be even more damaged than the ones we saw.
Desc.你说的“工业气息”指什么？: What do you mean by "industrial atmosphere"?
Desc.就，比如那些大型机械不停运作的声音什么的啦！: For example, the noises of those working heavy machinery!
Desc.这里不对外开放的情况下，感觉没什么机会呢。: Doubt so. Not when this place isn't open to the public.
Desc.这大概就是最近很流行的那个“氛围感”吧？: This must be what the recently trending term "vibe" means, huh?
Desc.哈哈，这么说的话，这种“氛围感”加持下，每次运送曼德矿场的货物，我也会有种无垠号: Haha! If you put it like that, with such a "vibe," I too will feel like The Eternal is heavier than usual each time we deliver cargo to Mander Mine.
Desc.哈哈，那我们努力一下，说不定以后结识了阿妮塔的大客户，就有机会借光参观了。: Haha! Let's all work harder, then. Maybe if we get acquainted with Anita's biggest client in the future, we will have a chance to tour the place on their account.
Desc.最多只算鱼型的桦树生物吧……虽然像模像样地和鱼群一起活动了。: Just a fish-shaped Chaos Remain, at most... albeit it's living rather normally with fishes.
Desc.你别胡来哦，我不觉得桦树生物换种形态就可以作为食材了。: Hey, don't mess around. I don't believe Chaos Remains can become food just because they've taken another form.
Desc.欸——我可没那么说！只是好奇嘛！: Wha—? I didn't say that! I was just curious!
Desc.虽然不能作为食材，不过也有把小型的桦树鱼型生物作为宠物饲养的吧？: Even though it can't be eaten, people do keep small fish-typed Chaos Remains as pets, right?
Desc.啊……这也可以养的？！不会有一天变异成巨型怪兽把房子撑破吧！: Huh... Can this really be domesticated?! What if it mutates, turns into a giant monster, and blows up the house someday?!
Desc.依稀能见到一些曾经“山崩地裂”的痕迹……: Some traces of a landslide can be spotted here and there...
Desc.嗯，不知道是经历了什么灾难的摧残。: Mm-hmm. I wonder what kind of disaster could've caused this degree of devastation.
Desc.也不知道当时的住户怎么样，有没有全部安全撤离……: Oh boy... What do you think happened to the residents back then? Hopefully, they all managed to evacuate safely...
Desc.也不一定是荒无人烟啦，这片区域不是还有沙盗出没嘛。: It may not really be unpopulated, though. Isn't this the region where Sand Pirates are active?
Desc.当然会啦，况且就算是再怎样的工作狂，对着一成不变的沙漠景色恐怕也要倦怠了。: That's for sure. Moreover, no matter how much of a workaholic one is, the never-changing sight of a desert will put anyone to sleep.
Desc.列车长你也会在路程中觉得无聊吗？: Conductor, do you also get bored during the journey?
Desc.这一路上真的半个人影也没有啊。: There really isn't a single living soul around here.
Desc.那还是无聊点，什么也别遇见吧，爱惹麻烦的家伙已经够多了。: Then it's better to be bored than encounter anything. There are already enough troublemakers as it is.

MainTitle.间章二：渡过荆棘的河: Interlude Two: Crossing the Thorny River

SecTitle.不要沉溺在那个梦: Do not get lost in that dream
SecTitle.恍若隔世: As if it were a lifetime ago
SecTitle.大梦初醒: Waking up from a big dream
SecTitle.功亏一篑: The final step falls short of success
SecTitle.绝处逢生: A ray of hope in a desperate situation

SecTitleDesc.清晨，无垠号车长室，伏案睡着的你逐渐醒来，看到了身旁仍在书写什么的少女，新的一天: Slumped over the desk in Conductor's room on The Eternal, you slowly awaken in the early morning. Next to you, a girl is still writing. A new day begins, but it doesn't seem particularly pleasant...
SecTitleDesc.你为了申请治安协力许可证来到七号自由港的铁安局，那里的负责人为你准备了一系列考核: To apply for the Security Cooperation Certificate, you came to Freeport Ⅶ's BCRL Agency, where the administrator had prepared a series of assessments for you.
SecTitleDesc.你们完成了铁安局的第一次考核。之后你拿着艾略特抽奖得来到拉普拉斯协议去招募新的人: Your crew completed the BCRL Agency's first assessment. Afterward, using the Laplace Protocol that Eliot won in a lucky draw, you recruited new members in preparation for the next assessment.
SecTitleDesc.你们通过了考核，拿到了治安协力许可证。: You guys passed the assessment and obtained the Security Cooperation Certificate.
SecTitleDesc.你在车站里遇上了一个奇特的、来自学会的怪人，她需要你帮她送点货物，并开出了一个此: At the train station, you bumped into a peculiar Citadel oddball who needed your help in delivering some cargo. She even offered you something you couldn't refuse at the time.
SecTitleDesc.修格里城近在眼前，一路平静的旅程却在此时突生变故……: Shoggolith City is within sight, but a sudden, unexpected event disrupts the peaceful journey...
SecTitleDesc.炮击取得了效果，但逼近而来的巨大威胁并未解决，致命的危险仍紧追不放。: The artillery strike was effective, but the enormous incoming threat still hadn't been resolved. Everybody's life was on the line.
SecTitleDesc.被激怒的鲸鱼凶悍地撞向了列车。面对艰难抵御着狂风的大家，你选择了断开车厢，并再次: Confronting the strong winds, you decided to detach the carriage and point the turret at the Chaos Remain. Inside the cargo carriage, Rebis notices something...
SecTitleDesc.危机解除，无垠号终于能有惊无险地继续旅程。: The crisis was resolved. At last, The Eternal could continue the rest of its journey.
SecTitleDesc.终于抵达修格里城城外，原本在车厢内的雷比斯却消失得无影无踪，面对她留下的金属台球: The train finally reached Shoggolith City, and yet Rebis, who was supposed to be in the carriage, had vanished into thin air. The metal billiard ball she left behind left everyone feeling at a loss.
SecTitleDesc.你在入城后，因为先前的英勇表现受到了修格里城执政官荷塞市长的接见与道谢。: After entering the city, you were greeted and thanked by Shoggolith City's mayor, Jose, in view of your earlier show of bravery.
SecTitleDesc.来到修格里城的你们还没来得及好好逛逛，就遇见了一位被混混纠缠的女子。: Before your crew could even have a proper tour of Shoggolith City, you came across a woman being harassed by thugs.
SecTitleDesc.神秘女子对你们的出手相救表达了谢意，但她的态度有些古怪。这时，不死心的混混搬了救: The mysterious woman thanked your group for coming to her aid, albeit with a somewhat odd attitude. At this juncture, the indignant thugs returned with reinforcements.
SecTitleDesc.原来飞鸟是前来交易的，而你们的帮助反而加重了混混们对她的误会。但飞鸟没有表现出不: <size=20>As it turned out, Songbird had come for a transaction, but your crew's assistance had instead deepened the misunderstanding the thugs had of her. Yet, she didn't express any dissatisfaction and even provided you with some guidance.</size>
SecTitleDesc.你们来到了黑月的休息区——荚蒾酒吧，酒保亚莉奈“热情”的邀请你们喝上一杯。: Your group came to Night Chains' rest area—Viburnum Bar. The bartender, Arina, "passionately" offered all of you a drink on the house.
SecTitleDesc.正为资金奔波忙碌的大家和四处鉴定金属台球的你，在两天后迎来了列车的回归。崭新的无: <size=20>While everyone was trying to raise funds, you were busy with identifying the Metal Billiard Ball. The train returned after two days, and everyone was delighted with the brand-new Eternal. Additionally, you received a mail from Mayor Jose...</size>
SecTitleDesc.荷塞市长在黑月大酒店举行了宴会对你们进行表彰，在单独的闲谈中，他对那个金属台球表: Mayor Jose hosted a banquet at Night Chains Hotel to honor you. He expressed a strong interest in the Metal Billiard Ball during a private chat.
SecTitleDesc.你拒绝了将台球转让的请求，而市长办公室里，已经确定台球与学会武器有关的市长下达了: You rejected the proposal to let go of the billiard ball. Meanwhile, in the mayor's office, the mayor laid down the order to seize it.
SecTitleDesc.你前往修格里的商会分部接取荷塞市长委托给你的订单，不料在路上再次偶遇飞鸟，她提醒: <size=25>You headed to Shoggolith's COLUMBA branch to receive the order Mayor Jose commissioned you to complete. Unexpectedly, you bumped into Songbird again, and she cautioned you guys to beware of Mayor Jose.</size>
SecTitleDesc.正在执行市长亲自下发的订单的你们来到了作为运输路线的地铁入口，而另一边，接到市长: <size=20>Carrying out the mayor's personal order, you arrive at the subway entrance used for transportation. Meanwhile, Walter, the leader of the MoleGang, received information from the mayor's secretary and was lying in ambush with his men...</size>
SecTitleDesc.大家正准备休息时，警报突然响起。在这条隐秘路线上突然出现了众多障碍物和武装人员拦: Just as everyone was about to rest, an alarm suddenly went off. Numerous obstacles and armed personnel appeared on this secret route, and they are clearly targeting you...
SecTitleDesc.你们击败了第一波伏兵，却始终联系不上救援，后退的道路也被炸断，只能继续前进。: You have defeated the first wave of ambushers but cannot contact any rescue teams. The retreat path has also been destroyed, leaving you with no choice but to move forward.
SecTitleDesc.你们不断击败沿路的敌人，清理路障并开辟道路，但你明显感觉到，这些敌人只是在拖延时: You continued to defeat enemies along the way, clearing barricades and opening the path. However, you couldn't shake the feeling that these enemies were stalling for time.
SecTitleDesc.瓦尔特驾驶着他的秘密武器——名为“鼹鼠”的重机阻挡在你们面前。: Walter drove his secret weapon—a construction vehicle named "Mole"—to block your path.
SecTitleDesc.莉薇娅、弗兰、艾略特无力再战，正当瓦尔特准备彻底解决她们时，震动的隧道中，无垠号: Livia, Fran, and Eliot were on their last legs. Right as Walter was about to take them out for good, The Eternal's whistle reverberated through the vibrating tunnel...
SecTitleDesc.无垠号成功离开了修格里城，而同时，因为一封神秘的举报信，铁安局的一支小队紧随无垠: <size=20>The Eternal successfully left Shoggolith City. Meanwhile, an anonymous tip-off prompted one of the BCRL Agency's teams to give chase to The Eternal, leaving the mayor with no alternative but to scrap his scheme against The Eternal. At the same time, the mayor seemed to know who this mystery helper was...</size>
SecTitleDesc.为庆祝刚刚的死里逃生，你们在列车上举行了一个简单的派对，然而麻烦似乎并没有结束，: <size=20>To celebrate the close shave you guys just had, your crew has a simple party on the train, but it doesn't seem like you're out of the woods yet. While you're planning the itinerary for after arriving at Mander Mine, you hear an explosion vaguely sounding from afar...</size>
SecTitleDesc.你意外地与如今身为铁盟执行小队队长的青梅竹马静流重逢，少女和她的队员因为一则匿名: <size=20>You unexpectedly reunite with your childhood friend Shizuru, who is now the captain of a BCRL execution team. Shizuru and her crew members board your train due to an anonymous tip-off. While the train crew find the tip-off suspicious, you still agree to cooperate with the team's investigation.</size>
SecTitleDesc.从意义不明的白日梦中惊醒，你与静流回忆起两人曾经共度的时光。流动的灯光下，已经长: You and Shizuru reminisced about the times you two had shared together. Under the dancing light, both of you had already grown to be the people you wanted to become.
SecTitleDesc.列车刚刚抵达曼德矿场，这里的负责人彼得·黄就恰时出现。这位经理的话意味深长，你察: <size=20>The train has only just arrived at Mander Mine when Peter Hwang, the person in charge here, shows up right in time. From the implicative way he speaks, you sense that Mayor Jose must have a hand in all your recent troubles.</size>
SecTitleDesc.你们在铁安局了解到最近矿场附近有不少游荡的“拾荒者”，桦树生物的数量也莫名增多，: At the BCRL Agency, upon learning that there have been multiple wandering "Marauders", and Chaos Remains has also increased, your crew offers to lend a hand by taking the commission.
SecTitleDesc.无垠号突然接收到一则紧急求援信号，怪异的是信号来自一艘多年前就在海港失踪的轮船。: <size=20>Suddenly, The Eternal receives an emergency SOS call. What's strange is that the call is coming from a ship that disappeared from the seaport many years ago. At once, Team Ratel decides to head over to check it out. You suggest taking them there on the train for safety's sake.</size>
SecTitleDesc.透过雨幕，能望见“拾荒者”们竟然正操纵着经过改造的地联军用机械，显然，必须有人来: The "Marauders" are spotted in the rain, shockingly fiddling with the modified Earth Union military equipment. Evidently, someone will have to go forward and stop them...
SecTitleDesc.在荒原地区再次遇到了雷比斯，从她那得知台球是一种神秘的武器，同时她愿意为你提供一: You met Rebis again and learned that the billiard ball was a mystery weapon. She was willing to provide you with some weapons that you could exchange as compensation.
SecTitleDesc.原本活跃在修格里附近的拾荒者们却突然出现在此，其背后似乎另有隐情。多萝西按照计划: <size=20>The Marauders who should've been hanging around Shoggolith suddenly appeared here, and there seemed to be more than meets the eye about the reason behind it. According to the plan, Dorothy yelled at them head-on to attract their firepower while you guys took the opportunity to slip in.</size>
SecTitleDesc.避开了拾荒者大部队，你们三人顺利进入荒原帝王号。: After slipping past the horde of Marauders, the three of you successfully board the Wilderness King.
SecTitleDesc.走廊里，你们与荒原王正面对上……: In the walkway, your group ran right into Wilderness King...
SecTitleDesc.被击败的荒原王匆忙逃窜，你们紧追不舍。: The defeated Wilderness King flees for his life with you guys hot on his heels.
SecTitleDesc.追到总控室的你们制服了荒原王，成功收缴了荒原帝王号，并救走了两个昏迷不醒的小女孩: At the main control room, your group manages to restrain Wilderness King, take control of the ship, and successfully rescue two unconscious girls.
SecTitleDesc.似乎忌惮着什么的荒原王不肯配合，你们的审讯一无所获。离开房间后，通过艾略特的汇报: Wilderness King refused to cooperate, leaving you guys with no answers. And through Eliot's report, you guys discovered that the two kids you rescued by chance were both Ascenders.
SecTitleDesc.在某种升构能力的作用下，列车上的人都陷入了沉睡，而意外不受影响的你听到了名为隼的: <size=20>While everyone on the train falls into a deep sleep under the effects of certain ascension abilities, you, who's surprisingly immune, overhear the conversation between Wilderness King and an uninvited guest named Hayabusa. After Hayabusa disappears into thin air, Livia comes to let you know that the two girls have awakened.</size>
SecTitleDesc.醒来的女孩们几乎什么都不记得，你们只能根据她们仅有的记忆片段推测着发生了什么。你: <size=20>The girls had practically forgotten everything after they regained consciousness, so all of you could only hypothesize what had happened based on their fragmented memories. You were determined to help the girls, but Shizuru was worried that you'd get into bigger trouble because of it. As such, you promised her you would first ensure your own safety.</size>
SecTitleDesc.静流带走两个女孩和荒原王后，暂时没有安排的你们决定去寻找让女孩们念念不忘的那种美: Once Shizuru takes Wilderness King and the two girls away, your crew, with nothing on the agenda for the time being, decides to head out and look for the food that the girls crave for.
SecTitleDesc.你们在曼德矿场中寻找美食的线索，最终交易所的老板图浩告诉你们修格里有一家keep: Your crew searched high and low for the food until Wealt told you about a KEEP Fried Chicken in Shoggolith. They used to sell the "Happy Dreams Meal," which was extremely liked by children.
SecTitleDesc.炸鸡店店长告知你们“快乐童梦餐”在七八年前就已经取消贩售，而这位老人在了解到你们: The fried chicken shop's manager tells you that "Happy Dreams Meal" was already discontinued about eight years ago, but upon hearing about your intent, he generously gives you the recipe.
SecTitleDesc.将所得线索串联，你们得到了一个难以置信的结论：两个孩子竟然是当年费尔德里奇号的随: You guys connected all the dots and came to a mind-blowing conclusion: The two kids were actually passengers of Phildridge from back then...
SecTitleDesc.准备回程的你们突然收到了来自修格里铁安局的强制征召。: As your group started heading back, you unexpectedly received a mandatory deployment notice from Shoggolith's BCRL Agency.
SecTitleDesc.完成铁安局的委托后，你感觉到列车组需要更多人手，为此你来到黑月商店，向亚莉奈说明: After completing the BCRL Agency's commission, you felt that the train crew was lacking in manpower. Hence, you came to the Night Chains Shop and informed Arina about your intention.
SecTitleDesc.品尝着炸鸡的两个女孩的记忆逐渐苏醒。车厢外，静流向你转达了总指挥官的指令：将两个: <size=20>The girls gradually recover their memories as they dig into the fried chicken. Outside the carriage, Shizuru informs you of the commander-in-chief's order: Send the two girls to be isolated in Anita Tech' office under the B.C.R.L.'s supervision. However, Shizuru doesn't seem to be on board with this plan.</size>
SecTitleDesc.你和莉薇娅探讨着铁盟为何会忌惮升构者的异变，此时静流传来讯息：荒原王和双子一同消: As you and Livia chew over why the B.C.R.L. is afraid of Ascenders mutating, Shizuru sends over a piece of news: Wilderness King and the twins have gone missing...
SecTitleDesc.面对路上激增的桦树生物，你们集中注意力一路突围。: Facing the surge of Chaos Remains on the road, your group directs all attention to breaking through them.
SecTitleDesc.在登上费德里奇号前，你们遇到了一个神秘的少女。: You guys encountered a mystifying young lady before boarding Phildridge.
