SecTitleDesc.苦战过后，你们登上了费奇号。尽管船上的共振污染给身体造成了极大的负荷，你仍选择和: You all board the Phiggy after the tough battle. Although the ship's resonance pollution causes you tremendous physical pressure, you still insist on going forward with the others.
SecTitleDesc.双子凭着记忆来到了费奇号的舰长室，与此同时，你们也探明了她们的去向。然而，莉薇娅: Relying on their memories, the twins arrived at the captain's cabin. Meanwhile, your group had also ascertained their whereabouts, but Livia had a sinking feeling in her chest...
SecTitleDesc.双子最终在舰长室见到了记忆中的“大副”和同样已经变成深眠者的妈妈，在怪物的嘶吼声: In the end, in the captain's cabin, the twins see the "chief mate" and their mother. Amid the screeches of monsters comes a gunshot that wrecks their last sweet dream...
SecTitleDesc.多年前，费奇号即将被共振吞没之时，双子因被送到形态场的中心而得以幸存。你们艰难抵: <size=20>Many years ago, when the Phiggy was about to be engulfed by resonance, the twins managed to survive, as they were sent to the core of the Morphic Field. While all of you struggle to fight against the Deep Sleepers, two Anita members arrive at the most critical juncture for assistance...</size>
SecTitleDesc.不过刚刚喘了口气，名为“门徒”的巨型桦树生物就出现在你们面前，趁它尚未发动攻击，: Yet, just as you finally catch a breath, a massive Chaos Remain named "Disciple" materializes right in front of your group. You guys need to break through before it attacks.
SecTitleDesc.疯狂的桦树生物在前，你们寸步难移，而此时原本了无生机的“妈妈”竟牺牲自己保护了双: <size=20>With a berserk Chaos Remain ahead, your crew was trapped. Out of the blue, "Mom," who should've been dead, sacrificed herself to protect the twins, fulfilling the final duty of a mother. The billiard ball that Rebis gave you suddenly came to your mind at the most critical juncture.</size>
SecTitleDesc.两位神秘人在某处观察着一切，他们似乎与雷比斯有关联？: Elsewhere, two mysterious figures are observing the scene. They seem to have ties with Rebis.
SecTitleDesc.从淘金乐园回来休息完毕的列车组正准备重新出发，你却突然收到了静流的联络，得知费尔: <size=20>The train crew is preparing to set out again now that everyone is well-rested after returning from ONEderland. All of a sudden, you receive Shizuru's message and learn that someone has leaked out the matter concerning Phildridge, and you might be charged with baseless charges for using the billiard ball.</size>
SecTitleDesc.你与列车组的乘员们分析了一番状况，决定找安菲娅咨询关于台球的谜团，安菲娅建议你前: You and your crew members analyze the situation, then decide to inquire about the billiard ball's mystery from Anfiya. Anfiya suggests you head to Freeport Ⅶ to seek help from her teacher.
SecTitleDesc.在前往七号自由港的路上，有些意志消沉的你和莉薇娅重振精神，开始分析散布消息的幕后: You pull yourself together and start chewing over who could be behind the leaked news with Livia. The mysterious intruder you previously saw at Mander Mine abruptly comes to mind...
SecTitleDesc.你们在形而上粒子研究所门口遇到了名为星花的园丁，她竟然就是当初在修格里城外引开鲸: <size=20>Your crew encounters a Gardener named Stella at the entrance of the Metaphysical Particles Institute. She turns out to be the person who lured the whale away from outside Shoggolith City back then, and she appears to have some ideas about your plight.</size>
SecTitleDesc.星花的实验结束后，她表示条件有限，很难进一步研究。这个时候，一名神秘女子经过，而: After Stella's experiment is done, she says the limited circumstances make it hard to continue examining it. At this moment, an unknown woman passes by, and Stella seems to know her...
SecTitleDesc.神秘女子名为妮蔻拉，据星花介绍是一名出色的学者，她也表示愿意协助你们。只是她给人: The unknown woman is an exceptional researcher named Nicola, according to Stella. Nicola also agrees to help you out, but she seems peculiar and standoffish.
SecTitleDesc.你们根据妮蔻拉的要求送她前往澄明数据中心，面对不愿交流的她，你们束手无策。这时，: Per Nicola's request, your crew gives her a ride to the CDCA Bureau. Her unwillingness to make conversation leaves you guys feeling at a loss.
SecTitleDesc.艾略特发现妮蔻拉居然在打游戏，让你们吃惊不已。而列车前方出现了一群意想不到的敌人: Eliot discovers Nicola is actually playing video games. Meanwhile, the unexpected enemies ahead of the train are revealed to be remnants of Northern Alliance.
SecTitleDesc.眼看就要到目的地，你决定通知一下妮蔻拉即将到站，没想到你居然被她拽倒，而妮蔻拉表: Seeing as the train is nearing the destination, you elect to inform Nicola about it, but without warning, she yanks you down, claiming it's merely her rumination habit.
SecTitleDesc.对于新北阵的残党为什么会出现在这里，你们不免有些疑惑。: The abrupt appearance of Northern Alliance's remnants here naturally fills your crew with plenty of questions.
SecTitleDesc.妮蔻拉交给你一个仪器，吩咐你们去她规定的地点搜集数据。你们也发现，妮蔻拉似乎并不: Nicola hands you an instrument and instructs all of you to collect data at the location she specified. You all realize that she isn't that hard to get along with, after all.
SecTitleDesc.为了防止铁盟行动起来抓捕你们，艾略特建议去服装店买一身新衣服来掩人耳目。: In case B.C.R.L. sets out to arrest your crew, Eliot suggests going to a clothing store to get new clothes as a disguise.
SecTitleDesc.你们在服装店结识了店长马吉拉，马吉拉热情地向你们推荐了几件用于cosplay的服: You become acquainted with Margiela, the clothing store owner, who enthusiastically recommends several costumes to you all. In the meantime, Team Ratel has also arrived...
SecTitleDesc.完成妮蔻拉交代的任务后，你们正准备打道回府，却被几个黑月成员纠缠。这时，飞鸟突然: <size=20>After completing the task given by Nicola, all of you are about to head back for the night, only to be harassed by a couple of Night Chains members. At this time, Songbird shows up out of nowhere and helps you out of the situation, and you learn about a scary rumor involving Nicola from her.</size>
SecTitleDesc.飞鸟的话让你们对妮蔻拉更加防备，不料妮蔻拉轻易看穿了你的心思，而且一点也不在意你: <size=20>Songbird's words have made you guys even more wary of Nicola. To your shock, Nicola sees through your thoughts right away and doesn't mind your attitude at all. She tells you the considerations behind her actions and wants you to collect data a second time.</size>
SecTitleDesc.妮蔻拉的分析让你怀疑当初雷比斯委托你运送的货物与现实稳定装置故障有关，而你们走在: <size=20>Nicola's analysis makes you suspect that the cargo Rebis previously commissioned you to deliver may be connected with the Reality Stabilizer's malfunctioning. As your crew walks on the street, a familiar young woman suddenly sneaks up on you.</size>
SecTitleDesc.袭击你们的人居然是卡塔斯，就在战斗无法收场的时候，一名陌生女性出手制止了你们。莉: The person sneaking up on you guys turns out to be Katas. Just as the fight is about to take a turn for the worse, an unknown woman comes. Shockingly, she is someone whom Livia knows...
SecTitleDesc.原来柯娜曾经是莉薇娅的同伴，你们也与卡塔斯等人解除了误会。了解你们的困境后，柯娜: It turned out that Connor used to be Livia's companion, and your group's misunderstanding with Katas was also resolved. Connor and friends decide to help you.
SecTitleDesc.你突然收到来自妮蔻拉的联络，她要求你立刻回到无垠号，柯娜提出可以用摩托车载你们过: All of a sudden, you receive Nicola's message. She wants you to return to The Eternal at once. Connor offers to give you all a ride back on her motorcycle.
SecTitleDesc.多亏了柯娜近乎离谱的高速行驶，你们顺利在妮蔻拉要求的时限内赶到。: Thanks to Connor riding at virtually insane speeds, you guys successfully make it back in the time requested by Nicola.
SecTitleDesc.你回到车厢与妮蔻拉会面，遥表达了她的担忧。没想到妮蔻拉竟然是无垠号引擎的设计者，: You returned to the carriage to meet Nicola. Nicola was found to be the designer of The Eternal's engine. The things you two could chat about almost seemed endless.
SecTitleDesc.你通知了伙伴们和妮蔻拉合作的决定，在妮蔻拉的要求下你们兵分两路，分头处理地下数据: <size=20>You inform your crew about the decision to work together with Nicola. Following Nicola's instruction, all of you split up into two teams to separately deal with the issues of the underground database being hacked and the Chaos Remains that have congregated.</size>
SecTitleDesc.你与两位护卫乘员跟随妮蔻拉来到地下数据库，得知入侵者竟然是黑月的成员。: You and two of your guard crew members tag along with Nicola to the underground database. The hacker is revealed to be a member of Night Chains.
SecTitleDesc.在你们行动进展顺利的同时，另一边，卡塔斯怀疑妮蔻拉忌惮自己的学会成员身份才故意将: While your operation is going swimmingly, Katas suspects Nicola only sent her group away out of fear of Katas' identity as a Citadel member.
SecTitleDesc.你们遇到了黑月的执行小队，没想到此前有一面之缘的服装店老板娘也是黑月的一员。: You guys bump into Night Chains' execution team. Surprisingly, the clothing store owner you briefly met earlier is also a member of Night Chains.
SecTitleDesc.黑月执行小队内部似乎存在分歧，他们没有过多纠缠就离开了。而马吉拉似乎对你们没有敌: There seems to be discord within Night Chains' execution team, but Margiela, who doesn't seem to have any ill will toward you, says she has something to tell you.
SecTitleDesc.马吉拉的话语令你感到非常不可思议，思前想后，你决定把这件事告诉妮蔻拉。: Margiela's words leave you in total disbelief. After much contemplation, you opt to let Nicola in on what you just heard.
SecTitleDesc.另一边，莉薇娅等人也顺利完成了任务，而柯娜竟然希望莉薇娅和她一起回到帝国，莉薇娅: Meanwhile, Livia and the others have also successfully completed their task, and Connor expresses her wish that Livia returns to the Empire with her. Livia turns Connor down without any hesitation.
SecTitleDesc.你们如约在瞳仁服装店汇合，马吉拉告诉了你黑月行动背后的真相。而你也答应了大家的请: As promised, your crew convenes at Pupil's Fashion Wear, and Margiela tells you the truth behind Night Chains' actions. You decide to get everyone out of the CDCA Bureau on The Eternal.
SecTitleDesc.你告诉妮蔻拉关于雷比斯订单的详情，给了她一些帮助。这时候，列车前方出现了敌人。: You tell Nicola about the details of Rebis' order, giving Nicola more insight. Suddenly, enemies pop up ahead of the train's path.
SecTitleDesc.面对数量众多的敌人，马吉拉使用了强大的力量，这一幕令在场的帝国人都感到吃惊。: Margiela exerts immense power against the horde of enemies, astounding all the Empire people present.
SecTitleDesc.没想到桦树生物也在这个时候涌来，妮蔻拉打算独身面对，让你们继续前进。: Without warning, Chaos Remains also swarm forward at this juncture. Nicola plans to let you guys continue going forward while she deals with them alone.
SecTitleDesc.就在你们好不容易突破包围圈时，新北阵居然派出了威力强大的机甲应战。: Right as you all finally break through the encirclement, Northern Alliance deploys formidable mechas to join the battle.
SecTitleDesc.被打倒的机甲竟然还有最后一丝余力，危急时刻，柯娜挺身而出……: The mechas still have one last ounce of power left after being knocked down, to your consternation. At the nick of time, Connor puts her life on the line and steps forward...
SecTitleDesc.柯娜生命濒危，偏偏桦树生物紧接着出现，你感觉到桦树生物对你的仇恨，惊慌失措之际，: Connor's life is threatened, and yet the Chaos Remains keep coming unceasingly. You panic upon sensing their hatred toward you, but Nicola saves you.
SecTitleDesc.名为隼的神秘青年在暗处将你的行动尽收眼底，而他与飞鸟、与这一系列事件之间的关系到: In an inconspicuous spot, an enigmatic young man named Hayabusa is observing every move of yours. How exactly is he related to Songbird and this series of events?
SecTitleDesc.从商会的墨伊拉小姐那里了解到了修格里为推广最新款红茶而举办的活动详情之后，你们决: Miss Moirai from COLUMBA informed you of an event showcasing the latest Black Tea in Shoggolith, and you decided to go.
SecTitleDesc.列车组一起品鉴了新世代红茶，奇怪的是，你和莉薇娅并没有体会到其特别之处，而其他人: The train crew taste the new gen Black Tea together. While the rest of the train crew rave about it, you and Livia are the only ones who don't seem to enjoy it.
SecTitleDesc.出身帝国的旅行者们，在他乡的奶茶店里闻到了莫名熟悉的香气。: The Empire travellers find a familiar aroma in a foreign milk tea shop.
SecTitleDesc.与此同时，阿尔喀娜和夏洛蒂正在城中调查着令人不安的香气的源头。: Meanwhile, Arcana and Charlotte are attempting to identify the source of the strange scented source throughout the city.
SecTitleDesc.名为卡塔斯的学会成员现身篝火城追查着什么……: A member of the Citadel, known as Katas, has arrived in the Bonfire City to conduct an investigation...
SecTitleDesc.你在休息区与匆匆离去的黑月酒店负责人闻笙打了个照面——在你尚未察觉的时候，城内似: In the rest area, you briefly encounter Wensheng, the manager of Night Chains Hotel. Something is occurring in the city without your knowledge...
SecTitleDesc.除了你和莉薇娅，喝了新世代红茶的列车组乘员们的行为举止都极为反常。: Besides you and Livia, the behavior of the train crew members who drank the New Gen Black Tea is extremely unusual.
SecTitleDesc.铁安局门口居然围着一大群人在闹事，你们连忙上前帮忙。: A large crowd is causing trouble in front of the BCRL Agency, and you rush to help.
SecTitleDesc.基于最近的种种异常，铁安局的朱利安拜托你们帮忙调查有关新时代红茶的诸多怪异事件的: Due to recent anomalies, Julian from the BCRL Agency asks you to investigate the source of the bizarre incidents related to the Black Tea.
SecTitleDesc.刚刚走出铁安局，你们突然遭到从天而降的怪人的攻击……: As soon as you step out of the BCRL Agency, you are suddenly attacked by oddballs descending from the sky...
SecTitleDesc.同为调查新世代红茶，你们和卡塔斯达成一致决定合作。: While investigating the New Gen Black Tea, you decided to cooperate with Katas.
SecTitleDesc.你们来到了修格里城交易所寻找线索，墨伊拉答应帮你们寻找红茶的来源。: In your quest to uncover the origin of Black Tea, you visit the Shoggolith City Trading Center, where Moirai has offered to assist you.
SecTitleDesc.深夜，莫伊拉将装有波克士的箱子交给了交给了带着口罩的神秘人，你们将跟着波克士的信: Late at night, Moirai hands a package containing BOX to a mysterious figure wearing a mask. You will follow the signal from BOX to find your target.
SecTitleDesc.你们来到了一个神秘的工厂，追寻找脚印发现了工厂中的敌人。: You arrive at a mysterious factory. Following the footprints, you find the enemies within.
SecTitleDesc.通过着装你们发现，那些被你们击败的敌人都是鼹鼠帮的人。你们继续向工厂深处前进，发: Based on their attire, you realize the enemies you defeated are from the MoleGang. As you venture deeper, you find that the materials for Black Tea are actually the limbs of CRs.
SecTitleDesc.一只会说话的鼹鼠突然冲了出来，你们从他的口中套出了许多信息。: A talking mole suddenly emerges, and you managed to extract a wealth of information from it.
SecTitleDesc.你们击败了鼹鼠，但被豢养的桦树生物突然冲了出来。: After defeating Mole, a domesticated Chaos Remain suddenly charges at you.
SecTitleDesc.击败了桦树生物后，铁安局也赶到了现场。朱利安逮捕了鼹鼠，并给你们提供了奖励。和卡: After defeating the Chaos Remains, the BCRL Agency arrives at the scene. Julian arrests Mole and rewards you. It's also time to part ways with Katas.
SecTitleDesc.你们回到了七号自由港，弗兰和艾略特决定趁着假期出去逛逛。你和莉薇娅在朱利安的邀请: <size=20>You return to Freeport Ⅶ, where Fran and Eliot decide to take advantage of the holiday to go out and explore. At Julian's invitation, you visit the destruction site of the Black Tea with Livia. At the port, you meet Arcana from Mundus, who explains how to handle the Black Tea.</size>
SecTitleDesc.墨伊拉来到七号自由港的奶茶店，要露珀特请她喝奶茶。: Moirai arrives at the milk tea shop in Freeport Ⅶ, asking Ruperto to buy her a milk tea.
SecTitleDesc.你来到了荚蒾，亚莉奈为你讲述了事件的另一面与黑月内部的明争暗斗。: You arrive at Viburnum, and Arina updates you about the other side of the events and the internal strife within the Night Chains.
SecTitleDesc.薇尔岚一行三人来到了KEEP炸鸡店，却发现找错了地方。: Verlaine and her group arrive at KEEP Fried Chicken but realize they've come to the wrong place.
SecTitleDesc.你们应卡塔斯的邀请来到了一间咖啡厅，在这里你们见到了完全不一样的卡塔斯。: You guys accept Katas' invitation and arrive at a café. The Katas that greets you is totally unlike the one you know.
SecTitleDesc.你从朱利安小姐那里得知，援助计划的详细内容你可以在七号自由港找到阿妮塔方面的项目: You learn from Miss Julian that the details of the assistance project can be obtained from Miss Vostok, Anita's project manager, in Freeport Ⅶ.
SecTitleDesc.发射基地的沃斯托克小姐为你介绍了这次工程的主要内容。: Miss Vostok of the launch base has introduced the primary objective of this project to you.
SecTitleDesc.你在铁安局遇到了曼德矿场的苔妮小姐，原来本次工程她也参与其中。: At the BCRL Agency, you encounter Miss Tennie from Mander Mine and find out she is also participating in this project.
SecTitleDesc.你在奶茶店再次偶遇苔妮，聊起了她在这里的原因。她似乎是出于对发射中心工作人员的敬: You chance upon Tennie again and find out her reason for being here. She seems to have participated in the reconstruction work out of respect for the staff of the launch center.
SecTitleDesc.发射中心大桥的重建即将完成。沃斯托克承诺，无垠号已经获得了拜访发射中心的资格。: The reconstruction of the launch center's bridge is about to be completed. Vostok promises that The Eternal has already earned the right to visit the launch center.
SecTitleDesc.发射中心大桥正式建成！和沃斯托克用梨味汽水碰杯，分享联结新站点的喜悦吧！: The launch center's bridge is officially reconstructed! Celebrate the joy of connecting new stations with Vostok through a toast of Pear Soda!
SecTitleDesc.因为“网友”临时有事，安菲娅多出了四张澄明嘉年华的门票，大方地赠送给了列车组。: As her "online friends" had a change of plan, Anfiya generously gives four extra CDCA Carnival tickets to my crew.
SecTitleDesc.来到澄明数据中心，列车组被嘉年华热闹的氛围感染。数据中心的负责人摩尔竟然亲自前来: We are quickly influenced by the carnival's lively atmosphere upon reaching CDCA Bureau. Moore even personally comes to greet us...
SecTitleDesc.与莉薇娅一同在知识集市闲逛散心，听摊主介绍了远见公寓的怪谈，在推销下购买了都市传: In the Knowledge Bazaar, Livia and I overhear a stall owner talking about Vision Apartment's story. At the owner's pitching, we purchase an urban legend book titled "Haunted CDCA."
SecTitleDesc.在远见公寓外围举办的《不眠之城》发布会现场，突发集体昏迷事件，连莉薇娅都昏倒了，: During the launch event of "Dreamless City" hosted outside Vision Apartment, a mass fainting suddenly occurs, affecting even Livia. Just what in the world...
SecTitleDesc.莉薇娅陷入未知原因的昏迷，必须要调查清楚发生了什么。: Livia has fallen into an unexplainable coma. I have to figure out what exactly is going on.
SecTitleDesc.重回远见公寓外围，为遭遇非议的学会成员索玛解围。在与铁安局负责人莱卡吉亚的交涉下: I return to Vision Apartment and come to the aid of Citadel member Sommer. After negotiating with Lycagia, we receive approval to investigate the apartment.
SecTitleDesc.无论怎么往前走，都一直是同一片走廊……: No matter how we keep walking straight ahead, we find ourselves stuck in the same corridor...
SecTitleDesc.怪谈中的婚房就这样出现在了我们的眼前。: The marital home mentioned in the supernatural story appears right in front of us.
SecTitleDesc.解决深眠者之后，在搜查和讨论中，我们好像拼凑出了这对新婚夫妻遭遇的惨剧……: After dealing with the Deep Sleeper, we conduct a search and figure out the tragedy that befell this newlywed couple...
SecTitleDesc.从索玛口中听到了她的身世，她准备跟随“天火”的指引前去与达斯廷汇合，嘱咐我在原地: I hear about Sommer's background from herself. She plans to follow the "Celestial Fire" and rendezvous with Dustin, but I see a familiar figure...
SecTitleDesc.被达斯廷解救了，从他口中了解到了这个空间运行的原理，阴谋的乌云笼罩着我们……: Dustin rescues me and enlightens me about how this space works. It appears all of us have fallen victim to a conspiracy...
SecTitleDesc.“莉薇娅”再次出现，并要求不要信任索思学会的人，然而被一眼识破身份，“莉薇娅”恼: "Livia" reappears and asks me not to trust Source Citadel, only to be immediately exposed as an impostor. Enraged, she summons more enemies.
SecTitleDesc.这个空间正在崩塌，迷茫之际，熟悉又陌生的歌声指引着去路。: This space is collapsing. While we're at a loss, a familiar yet foreign singing voice guides us to the way out.
SecTitleDesc.再度醒来，但我们似乎仍被困于虚拟空间之中。达斯廷似乎对这一切的幕后黑手有了推测…: I regain consciousness and find that we seem to still be trapped in the virtual space. Dustin has an inkling about who is behind this...
SecTitleDesc.在永生者的口中，我们知道了她做这一切的目的。: The Immortal reveals her motive behind all of this.
SecTitleDesc.无论打倒多少次，永生者好像都会站起来……但是，我们绝不会认输。: No matter how many times we knock her down, it seems the Immortal can always get back on her feet... Nonetheless, there's no way we will give up.
SecTitleDesc.这次醒来终于见到了熟悉的天花板，昏迷多日以后，听听那由他是怎么说的吧。: This time, I finally see the familiar ceiling. Let's hear from Nayuta about what has happened while I was unconscious for days.
SecTitleDesc.你们接到前往铁盟哨站的委托，朱利安拜托你们顺便去看看在那里的多萝西。: We received a commission to head to BCRL Outpost. Julian asks that we check up on Dorothy, who is there as well.
SecTitleDesc.完成货物交接，拉妲与你们闲聊了几句，这时大家突然听到不远处传来的爆炸声。: After the handover of cargo is done, Rada is casually chatting with us when, out of nowhere, an explosion sounds a short distance away.
SecTitleDesc.原来多萝西注意到了有不法分子尾随着你们的列车。虽然打倒了不法分子，但由于擅自行动: Turns out, it's because Dorothy noticed outlaws tailing our train. Although the outlaws have been taken down, she is punished with confinement for acting without orders and causing an explosion.
SecTitleDesc.你申请了去禁闭室探望多萝西，通过和她聊天，你知道了她小的时候曾有段因为生病只能被: I apply to visit Dorothy in the confinement room. Through conversing with her, I learn about how she spent part of her childhood confined in hospital wards because of her illness.
SecTitleDesc.你们在铁盟哨站遇到了带着多萝西母亲做的爱心便当来探望的海因里希，这才知道原来他就: I chance upon Heinrich, who has come to visit Dorothy. Turns out he is Dorothy's father. Dorothy, whose confinement has ended, rushes over to thank me and reminds me not to forget about my promise to her.
SecTitleDesc.通讯终端里突然收到了一则来自夏尔的不明信息，附件里还写着修格里城黑月大酒店的房间: The comms terminal suddenly receives a message from Shire that includes a room number of Shoggolith's Night Chains Hotel. I meet Shire at the Wilderness Station.
SecTitleDesc.得知夏尔在混沌海众人的帮助下找到了亲生父母，要去修格里城见他们。为了让夏尔漂漂亮: Shire has found her parents with the help of Turbulent Sea and is about to meet them. In order for her to show up looking her best, I decide to get her new clothes.
SecTitleDesc.袭来的神秘人原来是放心不下夏尔的沙盗。向她承诺无论如何她都不会失去她的家人后，夏: Turns out, the mysterious people are Sand Pirates who are concerned about Shire. With their help, she finally gains the courage to meet her parents.
SecTitleDesc.夏尔决定不和父母一起回去生活。作出这样决定的她，已经是个有担当的孩子啦！对于夏尔: Shire decides not to go with her parents. The fact that she makes such a choice proves she has already learned what responsibilities are! To her, today is another lovely sunny day.
SecTitleDesc.亚莉奈今天非常兴奋，跟你们打了个赌，要你猜猜看今天是什么特别的日子，并且请你品尝: Arina was brimming with excitement today. She made a bet with you, challenging you to guess what made the day special, and even let you try her newly crafted drink.
SecTitleDesc.回忆起过去，亚莉奈的人生充满了波折与扭曲，曾经的小混混同学“意外”的来到她工作的: Arina's life was full of twists and turns. An "accident" brought her old juvenile classmate to her workplace, reopening old wounds, and she couldn't resist giving them a lesson.
SecTitleDesc.亚莉奈从小家庭问题导致她出现了一些认知偏差，加入黑月的时候，塞西尔也对她极其的不: Arina's early family issues led to some cognitive distortions. When she joined Night Chains, Cecil was highly distrustful of her. Now, she must confront her former juvenile classmate...
SecTitleDesc.你及时出现吓走了小混混，亚莉奈对你的做法很是不解。但她发现只要呆在你的身边，困扰: You arrived just in time, scaring off the juvenile. She soon realized that when she was near you, the Noise that troubled her would vanish. This sparked a deep interest in you.
SecTitleDesc.你曾经拯救过亚莉奈的那天，作为秘密藏在她的心底，她认为每年的今天就是最特别的日子: The day when you saved Arina is a secret she holds deep in her heart, and she believes today is the most special day of the year. You gave her drink a new name: White Lady.
SecTitleDesc.你应邀与摩尔进行单独会面，他为你展示了虚演空间的成果，权衡之下，你同意参与到该项: You accept Moore's invitation to meet in private, and he shows you the results of the calculation space. After weighing the pros and cons, you agree to participate in this project's testing.
SecTitleDesc.在摩尔的引导下，你见到了意想不到的人，她的态度一如往常不算配合，但是从她嘴里，你: Guided by Moore, you meet someone unexpected. Her attitude, as usual, is hardly cooperative, but from her words, you may find clues to that puzzle...
SecTitleDesc.在妮蔻拉的陪同下，你得以在铁安局自证清白，然而海因里希告诉了你一些意料之外的情报: With Nicola by your side, you manage to clear your name at BCRL Agency, but Heinrich reveals some above and beyond unexpected information.
SecTitleDesc.在初步调查后，你与大家暂时分开行动，带领你的列车组前往荒原站调查特殊状况。: After the initial investigation, you and the others temporarily go separate ways. You lead your train crew to the Wilderness Station to look into a special situation.
SecTitleDesc.刚到荒原站，你们就发现这里的桦树生物数量出奇的多。: When you arrive at Wilderness Station, you encounter an unusually large amount of Chaos Remains.
SecTitleDesc.你们与安菲娅相遇，为了调查这些异状是否与柯娜失踪有关，主动请求与她一起调查。: You meet Anfiya and ask for her help to investigate whether these anomalies are connected to Connor's disappearance.
SecTitleDesc.你们发现行进的方向与前往淘金乐园的方向一致。: You realize that the direction you are heading aligns with the path to ONEderland.
SecTitleDesc.听说了你们在澄明数据中心的经历后，安菲娅提议你们可以前往阿妮塔发射中心与战备工厂: After hearing about your experiences at the CDCA Bureau, Anfiya suggests that you seek help from the Anita Launch Center and the Weapon Factory.
SecTitleDesc.你没能在发射中心得到想要的答案，但是安菲娅向你讲述了有关费尔德里奇号的过去。: You can't find the answers you were looking for at the launch center, but Anfiya does share with you the history of the Phildridge.
SecTitleDesc.你们抵达了阿妮塔战备工厂。: You arrive at the Anita Weapon Factory.
SecTitleDesc.你们顺利参观战备工厂的内部，同时，你们也注意到了安菲娅在待人接物上的困难之处。: You successfully tour the Weapon Factory and observe the challenges Anfiya faces during social interactions.
SecTitleDesc.安菲娅临时收到了来自铁盟的联络，要求你们一起前往工厂入口处会面。: Anfiya receives an unexpected message from BCRL, requesting a meeting at the factory entrance.
SecTitleDesc.你们并未见到铁盟的人，你意识到这是一个陷阱。: When no one from BCRL shows up, you realize it's a trap.
SecTitleDesc.在你们陷入绝境之际，园丁的导师伊利亚德现身救下了你们。: In a moment of desperation, Eliade, the Gardener mentor appears and rescues you.
SecTitleDesc.休整后，前来无垠号拜访的伊利亚德解释了他为何会出现在此处。: After a brief rest, Eliade visits the Eternal and explains the reason for his appearance.
SecTitleDesc.从伊利亚德口中，你们得知了当年旧七号自由港事故的真相。: Eliade reveals the truth about the Old Freeport Ⅶ incident to you.
SecTitleDesc.得知事情的真相后，安菲娅面色难看，伊利亚德拜托你帮忙照看她。: Upon learning the truth, Anfiya's face turns pale, and Eliade asks you to look after her.
SecTitleDesc.你在战备工厂的房间外找到了安菲娅形影不离的朋友白桦。: Outside a room, you find Anfiya's inseparable friend, White Birch.
SecTitleDesc.在你的努力下，安菲娅鼓起勇气，第一次向他人诉说自己的经历。: With your support, Anfiya musters the courage to share her experiences for the first time.
SecTitleDesc.通过安菲娅的叙述，你好像掌握到一系列事件元凶的线索。: From her account, you seem to uncover clues about the mastermind behind the events.
SecTitleDesc.你与莉薇娅想要循着现有的线索进一步调查，并为此请求伊利亚德的帮助。: You and Livia decide to follow up on the clues and seek out Eliade's help.
SecTitleDesc.在列车即将发车时，安菲娅主动来到了车站。: As the train is about to depart, Anfiya arrives at the station.
SecTitleDesc.你们在铁轨的前方见到了一个意想不到的人。: Up ahead on the railway track, you come across an unexpected person.
SecTitleDesc.苏醒的柯娜做出了匪夷所思的举动，她袭击了安菲娅。: The awakened Connor behaves erratically and attackes Anfiya.
SecTitleDesc.柯娜成为了深眠者，你们只能打倒她。: Connor has transformed into a Deep Sleeper, leaving you no choice but to defeat her.
SecTitleDesc.在你们手足无措之际，雷比斯突然现身，并抓住了始作俑者妮基塔。: In the midst of the chaos, Rebis suddenly appears and captures the culprit, Nikita.
SecTitleDesc.你向雷比斯索要一个解释，你感觉到她似乎仍有隐瞒，而妮基塔的动机也让你在意。: You demand an explanation from Rebis, suspecting she is still hiding something, while Nikita's motives continue to intrigue you.
SecTitleDesc.阴险的妮基塔想要逃跑，但是安菲娅阻止了她，这令妮基塔恼羞成怒。: The cunning Nikita tries to flee, but Anfiya blocks her off, only enraging her further.
SecTitleDesc.眼看情况危急，雷比斯的两位学生终于及时赶到。: As the situation reaches a critical point, Rebis' two students arrive just in time.
SecTitleDesc.妮基塔得到不明人士的帮助逃脱，但是在临走前，她还留下了什么……: Nikita receives assistance from unknown allies and manages to escape, but she leaves something behind...
SecTitleDesc.妮基塔居然强行引发柯娜深眠者化的二次进程……: Before fleeing, Nikita forcibly triggers Connor's second transformation into a Deep Sleeper...
SecTitleDesc.面对旧友和她发誓要守护的人，莉薇娅下定了决心。: Confronted by an old friend and the one she has sworn to protect, Livia makes her choice.
SecTitleDesc.莉薇娅亲手重创柯娜，而雷比斯见此情景，似乎想起了莉薇娅的母亲。: Livia personally delivers a fatal blow to Connor, and witnessing this, Rebis appears to recall memories of Livia's mother.
SecTitleDesc.终于将一切的事件告一段落，你知晓了过去之人的理想，并祝福重获新生之人走上旅途。: As everything finally comes to a close, you understand the ideals of those from the past and wish the rebirth a safe journey.
SecTitleDesc.与安菲娅告别后，你与伙伴们再度回归到列车长忙碌的日常生活中。: After bidding farewell to Anfiya, you and your companions return to the bustling life of a train conductor.
SecTitleDesc.无垠号乘员被召集到一起，准备接受由梅迪奇会长亲自下发的任务。: The crew of the Eternal gather to receive a quest personally assigned by President Medici.
SecTitleDesc.抵达海角城，这里的氛围和其他篝火城都不一样……: Upon arriving at Cape City, the atmosphere is unlike any other Bonfire Cities...
SecTitleDesc.海角城商会接待员告诉我们，此行的目标是传说中的蜃息岛。: The COLUMBA receptionist in Cape City informs us that the destination of this journey is the legendary Mirage Island.
SecTitleDesc.到了海角城铁安局，却见到意想不到的人。: Upon arriving at the BCRL Agency in Cape City, we encounter someone unexpected.
SecTitleDesc.海角城的市长亲自接待我们——这里怎么会有猫？: The mayor of Cape City personally greets us—why is there a cat here?
SecTitleDesc.准备完成，换上新装，出发登岛吧！: Preparations are complete, and with new outfits on, it's time to set off for the island!
SecTitleDesc.终于登上蜃息岛了！在这里见到的第一个人竟然是……静流？: Finally arrived at Mirage Island, and the first person I meet is... Shizuru?
SecTitleDesc.自说自话的宿敌西蒙再次登场，这次比拼的内容是度假村的建设！: Simon, my self-proclaimed rival, makes another appearance, and this time the competition is about building a resort!
SecTitleDesc.虽然现在只能住在帐篷里，但只要和无垠号的大家在一起就会觉得快乐。: Although we're staying in tents for now, just being with the crew of the Eternal brings me happiness.
SecTitleDesc.面对突如其来的桦树生物的威胁，有一个意外之外的人物登场……: As the sudden threat of Chaos Remains looms, an unexpected person appears...
SecTitleDesc.客人当中似乎混入了一些奇怪的人。: It seems some strange people have mingled in among the guests.
SecTitleDesc.我们的住所再次升级，该犒劳一下辛苦的莉薇娅了。: Our residence has been upgraded again—it's time to reward Livia for all her hard work.
SecTitleDesc.与莉薇娅一起创造更多美好的回忆吧。: Let's create even more wonderful memories with Livia.
SecTitleDesc.该丰富一下度假村的各类设施增加竞争力了。: It's also time to upgrade the resort's facilities to boost its competitiveness.
SecTitleDesc.亚莉奈非常难得地吐露了心声，似乎和她更近了一些……: Arina, who rarely opens up, has finally done so, and it feels like I'm getting closer to her...
SecTitleDesc.劫掠者来袭，他们究竟为何而来……: Looters have attacked, but what are they really after...?
SecTitleDesc.升级后的小屋让大家都十分满意！: Everyone is thrilled with the upgraded hut!
SecTitleDesc.新增的炒面摊位满足了客户的需求，同时唤醒了大家对家的回忆……: The newly added noodle stand not only meets the customers' needs but also stirs up memories of home.
SecTitleDesc.在讨论西蒙动向时，发现他也在关注劫掠者。: While discussing Simon's movements, we realize he's also keeping an eye on the Looters.
SecTitleDesc.与西蒙面对面对话，两人到底算什么关系呢？: A face-to-face conversation with Simon—what exactly is our relationship?
SecTitleDesc.从西蒙那里得到了更多线索，但是谜题越来越多。: We gather more clues from Simon, but the puzzle only deepens.
SecTitleDesc.经过我们的不懈努力，海岛上有了我们“第二个家”。: After all our hard work, we've finally created our "second home" on the island.
SecTitleDesc.在与静流关于过去的对谈终，了解了她的心意，然而就在此时，异状显现……: During a conversation with Shizuru about the past, I uncover her true feelings but just then, something strange happens...
SecTitleDesc.亚莉奈和莉薇娅也赶来了，到底发生什么事了？: Arina and Livia arrive—what exactly has happened?
SecTitleDesc.事到如今，只能继续前进了。: At this point, the only option is to keep moving forward.
SecTitleDesc.莉薇娅告诉我们这一切可能与帝国有关。: Livia tells us that all of this might be connected to the Empire.
SecTitleDesc.静流向前一步，走向了她认为“适合自己的位置”。: Shizuru steps forward, moving toward "the position she believes is right for her."
SecTitleDesc.打败神秘的深眠者后，我们发现了数张壁画……: After defeating the mysterious Deep Sleeper, we discover several murals...
SecTitleDesc.眼前的这个就是被封印在蜃息岛的怪物吗？我们真的能够打败它吗？: Is this the monster sealed on Mirage Island? Can we really defeat it?
SecTitleDesc.不管怎么样，我们最终还是得回归到日常生活中去。: Regardless of everything, we eventually have to return to our daily lives.
SecTitleDesc.你从奇怪的梦中惊醒，此时的你们已经安全回到了曼德矿场，新的一天已经到来。: Awakening from your eerie dream, you find yourself back in the Mander Mine. The dawn of a new day has arrived.
SecTitleDesc.静流和两姐妹前来与你告别，学会会将她们带到最近的海角城学社，静流与我们约定未来有: Shizuru and the sisters bid you farewell as the Citadel prepares to transport them to Cape City. Shizuru assures you of a future visit with the sisters before saying goodbye.
SecTitleDesc.来到铁安局，通过甘雅你们得知，最近你们在协作铁盟工作方面的活跃和贡献，为列车组赢: While at the BCRL Agency, you learn that your recent contributions to the B.C.R.L have earned the train crew a special crafting workbench via Ganya.
SecTitleDesc.你在交易所门口意外遇到了老同学西蒙，一向自诩为你命中宿敌的西蒙向你发起了挑战。面: <size=20>At the door of the Trading Center, you accidentally run into Simon, an old classmate who views himself as your adversary and challenges you. Following his persistent pursuit, you have decided to take on this advantageous but challenging endeavour.</size>
SecTitleDesc.升级电力，保障列车的运行。: Upgrade the power to maintain train operation.
SecTitleDesc.电力系统升级完毕，该决定扩建列车了。: With the power system upgraded, it is time to expand the train.
SecTitleDesc.车厢建造完成，可以投入使用了。: The new carriage is complete and ready for service.
SecTitleDesc.一轮比赛刚刚告一段落，不肯服输的西蒙又立刻向你发起了第二次挑战。为了不让他幻想的: As one round of competition is about to end, Simon promptly challenges you to a second round. It seems like you'll have to be more aggressive this time.
SecTitleDesc.你们来到了阿妮塔的临时研究基地，在那里你们再次见到了安菲娅，她希望你们能够搜集一: When you arrive at Anita's temporary research base, you meet Anfiya once again. She hopes all of you can gather some samples in exchange for a generous rewards.
SecTitleDesc.你们来到商会接取新的委托订单，却遗憾得知那个目的地为淘金乐园并且报酬格外丰厚的订: <size=20>Upon reaching CoC to accept new commissions, you are disappointed to learn that a highly lucrative assignment bound for ONEderland has already been claimed. Baxter shares insights about ONEderland's history and recommends a visit to the Mander Mine for potentially unexpected discoveries.</size>
SecTitleDesc.彼得想委托你们把他送到“淘金乐园”，他的豪爽让你隐隐不安，但经过权衡，你还是决定: Peter wishes to be guided to the ONEderland, and despite your reservations about his generosity, you decide to take the train on this adventure.
SecTitleDesc.列车发动，根据情报，你们需要警惕活跃在途径区域的犯罪组织——沙盗团。: The train sets off. Based on the intel received, you've got to stay alert for the criminal group P.U.S. operating in the area.
SecTitleDesc.荒原之上，以带着一只鹅的少女夏尔为首的沙盗车队正飞驰而来，这群人的目标似乎正是你: In the Wilderness, a group of P.U.S. carriages, led by a girl named Shire and accompanied by a goose, is speeding toward you, and it appears they are after you...
SecTitleDesc.列车受到沙盗团的攻击，你很快想到了应对之策……: The train is attacked by the P.U.S., and you quickly devise a strategy to counter it.
SecTitleDesc.攻击效果甚微的沙盗团只好选择撤退。车长室里，格外疲惫的你决定去休息一会儿。: The weakened P.U.S. forces retreat as their attacks prove ineffective. Feeling exhausted, you decided to take a short break in Conductor's room.
SecTitleDesc.潜入列车的夏尔误入了休息室，踩中了正在此休息的你。将夏尔擒获的你们听她讲述了袭击: <size=20>Shire sneaks into the train and accidentally stumbles upon you while you're resting. After capturing Shire, you've learned why she launched the attack. After a series of events, you find yourself alone with Livia and decide to share your dream about her earlier. As you both ponder its significance, an alarm suddenly interrupts your thoughts.</size>
SecTitleDesc.在波克士扫描出的影像里，数不清的桦树生物正朝着列车涌来，你紧急制动了列车，准备和: As Box scans the surroundings, countless Chaos Remains are closing in on the train. You quickly hit the brakes, ready to disembark with your comrades and face them head-on.
SecTitleDesc.你们陷入了苦战，而此时的隔离舱中，彼得向想要逃走的夏尔提出做个交易。: You engage in a fierce battle. Just as Shire attempts to flee from the isolation chamber, Peter proposes a deal to her.
SecTitleDesc.危急之时，从车厢中逃出的夏尔带领沙盗赶到，帮你们一起迎击敌人。: Shire, who escaped the carriage, rallies the P.U.S. to fight beside you during the crisis.
SecTitleDesc.桦树生物们退去，重新朝着某个方向聚集。等你们回过神来，沙盗团也已经跑得无影无踪。: The Chaos Remains scatter, and the P.U.S. is nowhere to be found. Back on the train, you prepare to approach Peter Hwang to inquire if Shire's appearance is connected to him.
SecTitleDesc.彼得为你讲述了修格里城的历史，你也从他口中得知沙盗劫车案的谋划者另有其人，而这个: Peter tells you about the history of Shoggolith, revealing that someone else is responsible for the train robbery, and this person seems to be Peter's reason for undertaking this journey...
SecTitleDesc.许多掘金机器人挡在了淘金乐园门口，显然它们已经把你们当做了入侵者。: A large number of Nugget Mechs block the entrance to the ONEderland, apparently thinking you're an invader.
SecTitleDesc.解决掉了机器人们，你们终于顺利进入淘金乐园，这里的管理者是名为“金子”的机器人，: You finally manage to enter the ONEderland. The manager here is a robot named "Gold", which is precisely the purpose of Peter's journey, and he hopes you can help locate it together.
SecTitleDesc.好几年都无人光顾的旅馆，虽然破旧，但却被打扫得很干净。: The hotel, which has been uninhabited for years, is old yet tidy.
SecTitleDesc.曾经的淘金地，可说是淘金乐园开始的地方。: This was once a gold mining site and might be regarded as the origin of the ONEderland.
SecTitleDesc.简单封闭的矿洞，黝黑而布满苔藓的洞口相当的阴森。: The moss-covered, plain, sealed-off entrance to the mine gives off an eerie atmosphere.
SecTitleDesc.早已失去往昔热闹的破旧酒馆，曾在中央的舞台上高歌的年轻人皆已不在。: The rundown bistro has long since lost its once-vibrant atmosphere, and the youthful singers who formerly graced the main stage are now nonexistent.
SecTitleDesc.淘金乐园的中心，伫立着此地唯一的形态场稳定器。: The sole morphic field stabilizer in the ONEderland is located in the center of the land.
SecTitleDesc.只剩下淘金乐园的管理中心还没去过，在进入之前，你问了彼得一个令他沉默许久的问题；: <size=20>No one has yet set foot in the ONEderland's Management Center. Before visiting, Conductor asks Peter a question that silences him for a long time. Meawhile, Shire and the P.U.S. are talking with Miss Gold, the manager here and their employer, in the Management Center.</size>
SecTitleDesc.彼得终于说出了他来这里的目的——把金子从这里带走，然而因此地的形态场稳定器损坏，: <size=20>Peter eventually reveals his true purpose: to take Gold from here. However, with the morphic field stabilizer damaged, Gold spirals out of control. As everyone is at a loss, Akira and Yer, whom you once met on the Phiggy, appear and offer their assistance. At first glance, it seems like everything is working fine, but then Gold starts acting extremely strangely...</size>
SecTitleDesc.为了让金子的形态场恢复稳定，晃和伊尔需要一个助手协助修理形态场稳定器，恰好的是，: To restore Gold's morphic field stability, Akira and Yer need an assistant to help repair the morphic field stabilizer. Luckily, you're capable of fulfilling that role.
SecTitleDesc.曾经年轻的彼得与巴克斯特来到了淘金乐园，借由金子的帮助赚到了足够入城的钱，然而面: <size=20>Young Peter and Baxter once travelled to ONEderland, where they could enter the city with the help of Gold after earning enough money. Nevertheless, Gold turned down Peter's invitation. However, at this very moment, Gold is raving insane, vehemently fighting for the survival of ONEderland. Peter changes his mind about taking Gold away. Just then, communicator rings, and you bring good news.</size>
SecTitleDesc.形态场稳定器成功运转起来，金子也恢复了正常，尘埃落定之后，你们和沙盗们决定在这里: As the morphic field stabilizer successfully operates, Gold returns to normal. When everything settles down, you and the P.U.S. decide to spend the night here.
SecTitleDesc.你在萨特酒馆遇到了一个神秘人，他有些委托要给你。: You meet a mysterious person at Sartre's Tavern who has some commissions for you.
SecTitleDesc.早早起床的你和莉薇娅见到了正等候你们的夏尔，相互贫嘴了一番后，夏尔与你们道别，并: As early risers, you and Livia meet with Shire, who has been waiting for you. After some friendly banter, Shire bids you farewell and informs you that Peter is waiting for you.
SecTitleDesc.彼得与你们谈到了淘金乐园的未来，他想将这里打造为旅游度假地，并希望与你们在淘金乐: Peter spoke to you guys about the future of ONEderland. He wanted to turn it into a tourism hotspot and hoped to collaborate with you on its development.
SecTitleDesc.连日的送货让你的肩膀酸疼不已，检查后医生建议多运动，这时正好遇到了卡洛琳，她自告: <size=22>After days of strenuous deliveries that leave your shoulders sore, the doctor advises more exercise. Exiting the infirmary, you run into Caroline, who volunteers to be your coach. And so, your rehabilitation training begins.</size>
SecTitleDesc.康复训练只要偷懒就会被卡洛琳的机械狗盯上，导致最后累的不行被卡洛琳背回列车上。路: By the end of rehab training, you are worn out and need Caroline's help to get back. On the way, Caroline spots an ad that sparks her interest in climbing the mountain to catch a stunning sunrise.
SecTitleDesc.卡洛琳喜欢大自然，在康复训练的时候带你逗狍子玩。你注意到卡洛琳很在意那座高山，再: Caroline loves of nature. You notice her fascination with the distant mountains. After some persuasion, she agrees to join you in climbing to the peak for the sunrise.
SecTitleDesc.你们向山顶出发，但是中途遇到了泥石流，卡洛琳受了伤，你们搀扶着继续前进。你靠着天: As you ascend toward the summit, a mudslide halfway up causes Caroline to get injured. You follow Polaris' lead as you strive toward the final leg of the climb.
SecTitleDesc.你们终于登上了山顶，看到了最美的日出，卡洛琳也表明了自己想要探索这片未知大陆的愿: Reaching the top, you witness a stunning sunrise. Caroline expresses her eagerness to explore this uncharted land. To symbolize trust, she invites you to join her on a journey of exploration.
SecTitleDesc.苔妮邀请光顾列车武装工厂的列车长一起休息，喝一瓶“家族特制饮料”，聊了一些工作上: Tennie invites me to take a break at the Train Weapon Factory with a bottle of her family's "special drink," and we chat about work. Somehow, the drink leaves us both dizzy... and seeing strange things.
SecTitleDesc.再次睁开眼睛，列车长发现自己身处一处梦幻的乐园之中，而苔妮看起来是乐园的主人。在: When I open my eyes, I find myself in a dreamlike amusement park, where Tennie seems to be its owner. At her invitation, we begin exploring together.
SecTitleDesc.苔妮向列车长介绍了鬼屋——玛格丽特屋。列车长认出这里的熊熊以玛格丽特为原型，但苔: Tennie takes me to the haunted attraction, Margaret House. I recognize the teddy bears as being modeled after Margaret, but one of my jokes inspires Tennie to remodel it into the Invincible Margaret Workshop.
SecTitleDesc.在游乐园内占地最大的熊熊过山车上，发现了疑似苔妮家人的小熊。逐渐意识到这里并非自: On the largest roller coaster in Teddy Wonderland, we find a teddy that resembles one of Tennie's family members. As Tennie realizes this isn't the world she belongs in, she loses herself in the illusion and summons a swarm of plush phantoms to protect herself...
SecTitleDesc.打败毛绒玩偶的幻影，抓住苔妮的手，将苔妮带出了梦境。她似乎对于梦境中所做的一切感: After defeating the plush phantoms, I take Tennie's hand and pull her out of the dream. She seems a little embarrassed by what happened... Still, as the owner of Teddy Wonderland, she promises that I'm welcome back anytime.
SecTitleDesc.你正与列车组的同伴们在车上放松，结果在电台里听到曼德金库遭到入侵的新闻，下一刻，: While unwinding on the train with your crew mates, you learn of intruders breaking into Mander Vault over the radio. Shortly after, the mayor of Cape City personally tasks you with delivering his collections.
SecTitleDesc.你与莉薇娅前往曼德金库，顺利取走了阿莱斯特市长存放在这里的宝石。: Accompanied by Livia, you set off to Mander Vault, retrieving the gems belonging to Mayor Aleister.
SecTitleDesc.将存有宝石的箱子送到后，你们却发现箱子里的物品被金库的工作人员搞错了。: Upon handing over the suitcase with the gems, you realize the staff has mistaken it for another suitcase.
SecTitleDesc.为了找到宝石，你们前往海角城铁安局寻求静流的帮助。: Eager to reclaim the gems, you make your way to the BCRL Agency in Cape City, seeking assistance from Shizuru.
SecTitleDesc.为了尽快找到宝石，你打算请亚莉奈提供情报。你在荚蒾意外邂逅了一名神秘女子塞西尔，: In your quest to recover the gems, you decide to ask Arina for information. Later, a mysterious woman named Cecil crosses your path in Viburnum, and Arina eventually provides you with clues.
SecTitleDesc.你们在荚蒾附近遭到了毛绒会成员的袭击，就在箱子被对方抢走时，一名在金库有过一面之: Near Viburnum, you are ambushed by members of Fluffy Union. Just as they are about to grab the suitcase, a Citadel member you met at the vault steps in to help.
SecTitleDesc.名为伊索斯的学会成员误以为你擅自启动了他的物品，双方僵持之际，丽桑德拉出面为你解: The Citadel member Ithos mistakes you for meddling with his belongings. In the midst of the tension, Lissandra steps in to aid you.
SecTitleDesc.丽桑德拉解答了你们的疑惑，你从她口中得知学社将要举行一场选拔“天使”的仪式。: Lissandra answers your questions and discloses Citadel's upcoming ritual to select an "Angel."
SecTitleDesc.暗中操纵毛绒会的人竟然就是塞西尔，黑月的人似乎也想得到万象眼眸。: It turns out that Cecil is the mastermind behind the Fluffy Union. It appears that the Night Chains members are also eyeing the Omniscopic Gaze.
SecTitleDesc.来到学社后，丽桑德拉惊讶地发现万象眼眸已经选择了莉薇娅作为新的天使资格者。而莉薇: In the Climber, Lissandra is surprised to find out that the Omniscopic Gaze has chosen Livia as the new candidate, with Livia herself seemingly interested...
SecTitleDesc.察觉到莉薇娅的犹豫，你陷入了矛盾的心情，察觉到这一点的弗兰和艾略特打算开解你们。: You are overwhelmed by conflicting emotions when you sense Livia's hesitation. Noticing this, Fran and Eliot step in to soothe your worries.
SecTitleDesc.在弗兰的劝说下，你暂时放下心中的纠结，准备先找伊索斯了解更多成为天使的细节，: Encouraged by Fran, you temporarily set aside your emotional turmoil, committed to gathering more information about Angels from Ithos.
SecTitleDesc.在答应了伊索斯提出的条件后，你得知可以在汇流塔找到天使的真相。: After agreeing to Ithos's terms, you learn that the secrets about angels are hidden within the Confluence Tower.
SecTitleDesc.你在学社打听前往汇流塔的方式无门，苦恼时遇到了名为罗洁尔的学社成员。在帮助她时，: Your efforts to find a way into the tower prove futile. Just when you are feeling stuck, you come across Raziel, a Citadel member. While helping her, you and Livia manage to ease the tension between you.
SecTitleDesc.你们向罗洁尔打听汇流塔管理者，但是她拒绝了你们。: You ask Raziel about the Confluence Tower's administrator, but she refuses to help.
SecTitleDesc.原来罗洁尔就是汇流塔的管理者，她在听完你们的话后改变主意，决定带你们前往汇流塔。: Raziel turns out to be the administrator of the Confluence Tower. After hearing you out, she has a change of heart and offers to guide you to the tower.
SecTitleDesc.在罗洁尔的帮助下，你们顺利进入汇流塔，从她口中得知了“天使”计划的残酷真相。: With Raziel's guidance, you gain access to the Confluence Tower, where she unveils the harsh truth behind the Angel Project.
SecTitleDesc.你们在汇流塔内见到了名为雅莱的少女，原来她就是天使技术的牺牲品。与她交谈后，你们: Inside the tower, you meet Jalhay, a young girl who has fallen victim to the Angelic tech. Your conversation with her deepens your understanding of the Angels.
SecTitleDesc.罗洁尔向你们回忆起她曾经与丽桑德拉深厚的情谊。: Raziel shares with you the deep bond she once had with Lissandra.
SecTitleDesc.你们拒绝了丽桑德拉，她表示尊重你们的决定。此时，学社内突然出现机器人失控的事故。: You turn down Lissandra's request, and she respects your choice. Meanwhile, a robot riot occurs in the Climber.
SecTitleDesc.准备离开学社时，你们收到了来自铁盟的强制征召，然而到现场后，你们发现状况有些蹊跷: As you are about to leave the Climber, you are summoned by BCRL. However, you sense that something is off about the situation.
SecTitleDesc.你得到了伊索斯的帮助，并从他口中了解了始作俑者和他个人的坚持。伊索斯告诉你，罗洁: You receive help from Ithos and delve deeper into the culprit's intentions and Ithos's personal motives. Ithos mentions that Raziel has something crucial to share with you.
SecTitleDesc.罗洁尔想委托你去修格里城取一件送给雅莱的礼物，你感受到了她对雅莱的关爱。: Raziel tasks you with retrieving a gift for Jalhay from Shoggolith City. Her words reveal her deep care for Jalhay's well-being.
SecTitleDesc.你从修格里交易所拿到了货物，同时发现罗洁尔给你的信封里有一些奇怪的宝石碎片。: Upon obtaining the gift from the Shoggolith Trading Center, you notice peculiar gem shards hidden within the envelope.
SecTitleDesc.你将礼物交到雅莱手上，雅莱却追问你关于她姐姐赫尔的事情，而雅莱似乎意识到了什么，: You hand the gift to Jalhay, but she presses you about her sister Harle, and it seems Jalhay realizes something, becoming increasingly unstable...
SecTitleDesc.你们根本无法招架发狂的雅莱，一名言行奇怪的天使在这时候出现，坚定地保护你。: When you are overwhelmed by the frenzied Jalhay, a strange Angel appears, standing firm to shield you with unwavering resolve.
SecTitleDesc.眼看着乌刹娜与雅莱不相上下，伊索斯及时出手稳住了局面。: Just as the clash between Ushana and Jalhay reaches a stalemate, Ithos intervenes to restore order.
SecTitleDesc.你们从伊索斯口中得知，罗洁尔操纵了选拔的结果，让自己成为天使。想到成为天使的后果: Through Ithos, you discover that Raziel manipulated the ritual's outcome and decided to become an Angel herself. You hasten to Cape City, intent on meeting Raziel for one last time.
SecTitleDesc.你们没能见到罗洁尔的最后一面，从丽桑德拉的话语中，你们对整件事的来龙去脉，以及她: Your attempt to bid farewell to Raziel ends in failure. From Lissandra's account, you uncover the full story, delving into the inner struggles of Raziel and Lissandra.
SecTitleDesc.丽桑德拉无法挽留她，无法阻止她，公正而高尚的裁决者，只能目送她走向与自己相反的道: Lissandra, the fair and honorable judge, is powerless to prevent Raziel's descent down a starkly different path, watching helplessly as she strays.
SecTitleDesc.淘金大酒店修缮完毕，彼得·黄邀请你前去参加试营业活动。在莉薇娅的鼓励下，你迎来了: The ONEderland Hotel has been fully renovated, and Peter Hwang has invited you for a trial experience. Encouraged by Livia, you decide to enjoy a personal vacation.
SecTitleDesc.刚刚抵达淘金大酒店，你就在门口发现了一群可疑的人，所幸有人替你解围。: Upon arriving at the ONEderland Hotel, you notice a suspicious group at the entrance. Thankfully, another person steps in to resolve the situation.
SecTitleDesc.你见到了同样是客人的佩罗塔与瓦伦汀，在彼得·黄带你们参观酒店时，你意外与神秘的飞: You run into Pelota and Valentine, who are also guests at the hotel. During a tour led by Peter Hwang, you encounter the mysterious Songbird once more.
SecTitleDesc.作为黑月合作代表的阿尔塞恩邀请你们参与一个推理游戏，大家在享受游戏后，瓦伦汀作为: Alcyon, the representative of Night Chains, has invited you to a detective game, and Valentine emerges victorious.
SecTitleDesc.你无意间听到飞鸟与阿尔塞恩的对话，在追问后得知飞鸟想在酒店内找到卡尔文老爷的遗产: You overhear a conversation between Songbird and Alcyon. Further inquiry reveals that Songbird intends to find Mr. Calvin's legacy within the hotel.
SecTitleDesc.你遭到了飞鸟的恶作剧，打算向她兴师问罪时，发现飞鸟看上去有点奇怪……: Pranked by Songbird, you decide to confront her, but you notice her unusual demeanor...
SecTitleDesc.第二轮游戏是一场寻宝游戏，但是你们得到的暗语有些古怪，而飞鸟似乎知道些什么，破解: The second round is a treasure hunt, but the cryptic message seems too strange to decipher. However, Songbird appears to have insider knowledge and easily decodes it.
SecTitleDesc.瓦伦汀对第二轮游戏的暗语仍有些在意，而在第三轮游戏进行时，你通过莉薇娅得知了一些: Valentine remains unsettled by the cryptic message from the second round. During the third round, you have the chance to learn something new from Livia...
SecTitleDesc.瓦伦汀似乎有话要对大家说，而在打开房间门后，你们遭遇了一种诡异的共振……: Valentine seems to have something on her mind. When you open the door, you are met with a disquieting resonance...
SecTitleDesc.故事先生提示你们可以破解现场的暗语寻找出路。一番争论后，你们决定去探索酒店内部。: Mr. Storyteller suggests that deciphering the cryptic message may lead to a way out. After some discussion, you decide to explore the hotel's interior.
SecTitleDesc.来到酒店房间时，飞鸟与你们分开行动，之后失去了踪迹。: Upon reaching the hotel room, Songbird parts ways with you, and you lose track of her.
SecTitleDesc.在迷宫内，迷失的佩罗塔不见了踪影，你们只得继续探索。: Pelota has disappeared within the maze, leaving you to continue exploring alone.
SecTitleDesc.你与瓦伦汀在主题乐园遭遇大量桦树生物，瓦伦汀选择独自对敌，将你护在身后。: In the amusement park, you come across a swarm of Chaos Remains. Valentine steps forward to confront them, shielding you behind her.
SecTitleDesc.你们在各自突破困境后终于汇合，并且从故事先生口中得知了阿尔塞恩策划这一切就是为了: After overcoming various challenges, you reunite and learn from Mr. Storyteller about Alcyon's plan to reconstruct the Wishing Tower.
SecTitleDesc.你们回到了仪式发生的房间，在这里迎接你们的竟然是复活的阿尔塞恩，而他道出了当年一: When you return to the ritual room, you encounter the resurrected Alcyon, who reveals the hotel's hidden past.
SecTitleDesc.你们发现无法真正打败阿尔塞恩，而你们的体力也在不断被耗尽……: You find yourself unable to truly defeat Alcyon, and your stamina is wasted in vain...
SecTitleDesc.在你们精疲力尽的时候，莉薇娅的通讯奇迹般地传达，与她汇合的雷比斯给了你解决的思路: Just as you're exhausted, a message from Livia arrives in time, and Rebis, having reunited with her, suggests a solution.
SecTitleDesc.在所有人的一同努力下，你们最终化解了眼前的危机。: Through your combined efforts, you successfully resolve the ongoing crisis.
SecTitleDesc.你需要找他谈谈，而他也正在等你，揭开他的假面吧。: You need to speak with him, and he is waiting for you. It is time to unmask him.
SecTitleDesc.索思学会告知你们，他们将派遣一名成员陪同完成你们与雅莱的会面。: Source Citadel tells us that they will be sending one of their members to accompany us to our meeting with Jalhay.
SecTitleDesc.在那由他的陪同下，你们再次见到雅莱，雅莱请求你帮忙修复罗洁尔留在汇流塔的投影仪器: Accompanied by Nayuta, we meet Jalhay again. She seeks my help to fix the projector Raziel left in the Confluence Tower.
SecTitleDesc.你们打算将仪器带去远星大桥维修，从那由他口中，你们得知了远星大桥的状况。: We plan to take the device to the Apoaster Bridge for repair. Nayuta tells us about the Apoaster Bridge's situation.
SecTitleDesc.你们在抵达远星大桥后，见到了这里的负责人切茜娅和投资人“管家”，他们身上有着诸多: At the Apoaster Bridge, we meet Chelsea, the administrator of this place, and "Butler" the investor. They're both shrouded in mysteries.
SecTitleDesc.除了维修技术人员，你们还意外见到了随行的黑月执行人苏利耶，他向你们解释了投影背后: Besides the technician, we also happen to meet Night Chains executor Surya who came along. He tells us about how the projection works.
SecTitleDesc.切茜娅从桦树生物手中保护了你，但是她对罗洁尔的事情仍然耿耿于怀……: Chelsea protects me from Chaos Remains, but she's still brooding over Raziel's matter...
SecTitleDesc.切茜娅没能从罗洁尔的投影那里得到想要的答案，而苏利耶告诉你们，投影并没有损坏。: Chelsea fails to get the answer she wants from Raziel's projection, and Surya tells me the projection isn't malfunctioning.
SecTitleDesc.那由他能够理解切茜娅的心情，他向你道出自己的过去，原来他曾经和切茜娅一样迷茫……: Nayuta can relate to Chelsea's feelings. He tells me about his past. As it turns out, he used to be as lost as Chelsea...
SecTitleDesc.你将真相告诉了雅莱，意识到无法再见到罗洁尔，她第一次落下了泪水……: I tell Jalhay the truth. Realizing that she will never get to see Raziel again, she sheds tears for the first time...
SecTitleDesc.那由他将雅莱的监护权移交给你，在告别之时，他发现“管家”竟然与升构塔有所牵扯。: Nayuta makes me the custodian of Jalhay. Before leaving, he discovers that "Butler" is actually associated with the Ascension.
SecTitleDesc.按照星花发来的通讯和她在咖啡馆见面；到达时，她正在出神地看游戏《雪色胶卷》的广告: I meet Stella in a café. She is watching the commercial for the game "White Film" distractedly. She tells me about a friend of hers who's an idol.
SecTitleDesc.星花表示她的这位朋友最近正苦恼于偶像事业的未来发展，也苦恼于一位奇怪的“跟踪狂”: Stella says this friend of hers has been fretting over her idol career and an odd "stalker." There seems to be some secrets behind this... I promise to help the idol.
SecTitleDesc.见到了偶像STELLA。从她的样子判断，似乎她对于怎么继续做偶像这件事感到迷茫—: I meet the idol STELLA. She seems at a complete loss for how to continue being an idol. As such, I decide to take her to the seaside to clear her head!
SecTitleDesc.在海边大道的冷风中交流了二人的想法。STELLA坦陈了对她而言的“事实”，我则表: In the cold breeze on the esplanade, we have a heart-to-heart chat. STELLA opens up about her "truth", while I let her know that I'll support her no matter who she chooses to be.
SecTitleDesc.打败了袭击者，对方的身份出乎我们的意料，星花却似乎对此早有心理准备。: We defeat the attacker, who surprises me with her true identity. Yet, Stella seems to have seen this coming.
SecTitleDesc.经历一番波折后有惊无险地来到了片场。在拍摄开始前的短暂休息时间里，星花表示她已经: We arrive at the film set in one piece. Stella tells me she has figured out how to deal with her idol job. This star will continue to shine on her path.
SecTitleDesc.前所未见的巨大怪物出现在岚心城的附近，铁盟与黑月联手抵抗。岚心城与外界的通讯因为: An enormous monster appears near Ranshin City. BCRL and Night Chains work together to fight against it. Ranshin's communication with the outside world is cut off. The whole city is a forsaken island now...
SecTitleDesc.在列车上神不知鬼不觉出现的少女，苏醒之后的第一反应竟然是发起攻击？: Unknown to anyone, a young lady appears on the train out of thin air, and the first thing she does upon waking up is to attack?
SecTitleDesc.在与无名交换完情报后，我们基本了解了她的来历，为了寻找更多情报，无名将在无垠号上: We catch up on Mumei's story after trading intel with her. To acquire more information, she will serve as a provisional crew member on the Eternal until her companions are located.
SecTitleDesc.在海因里希处我们得知岚心城被怪物袭击并且失联的现状，我们触发前往离岚心城最近的云: Heinrich tells us that Ranshin City has been invaded by a monster and has since been uncontactable. We head toward Yunxiu Bridge which is nearest to Ranshin City to find out more.
SecTitleDesc.与余淞交流后我们得知从岚心城撤退至此的铁安局小队长伏见正在休养。: After conversing with Yusong, we learn that the BCRL Agency's Captain Fushimi, who withdrew from Ranshin City to here, is currently resting.
SecTitleDesc.无名在听完伏见对于岚心城的描述后，几乎已经可以肯定那怪物正是与她来自同一个世界的: After hearing Fushimi describe Ranshin City's situation, Mumei is certain that the monster is from her world. To ensure the safety of the route to Ranshin City, Mumei, my crew, and BCRL decide to work together...
SecTitleDesc.在岚心城的华美宅邸中，阴谋正在酝酿。: Within a magnificent abode in Ranshin City, a conspiracy is brewing.
SecTitleDesc.终于来到岚心城的我们带着无名见到了她的同伴生驹，还没来得及寒暄，就听说了深眠卡巴: We arrive at Ranshin City, and Mumei finally encounters her companion Ikoma. But before they can catch up with each other, the news of Deepsleep Kabanes coming hits...
SecTitleDesc.与生驹并肩作战之后，我们察觉所面对的敌人与之前遭遇的有很大差异。: After fighting alongside Ikoma in battle, we notice that there's a huge difference in the enemies than those encountered before.
SecTitleDesc.无名与生驹交流了各自的经历后，我们从生驹口中得知了宵月对甲铁城众的所谓“庇护”，: Mumei and Ikoma share their experiences with each other. I hear from Ikoma about Yoizuki's so-called "sheltering" for those aboard Koutetsujou, but discover the discrepancies.
SecTitleDesc.宵月的护卫带来了菖蒲的来信，信中透露的信息让人十分不安，岚心城中或许正酝酿着一个: Yoizuki's guard comes to deliver a letter from Ayame that reveals unsettling information. It appears there might be a huge conspiracy brewing within Ranshin City.
SecTitleDesc.收到生驹和无名的邀请一起在岚心城逛逛，吃完杯面后，他们坦白了自己的“秘密”。: Ikoma and Mumei invite me to stroll along Ranshin City. After having cup noodles, they come clean about their "secret."
SecTitleDesc.苍叶带来了令人震惊的情报，虽然追求的目标不同，但此刻似乎唯有联手才能阻止宵月继续: Aoba brings astounding news. Although we have different objectives, it seems that working together is the only way to stop Yoizuki.
SecTitleDesc.在我们为如何破局焦头烂额之际，融合体再度出现在了岚心城，这究竟是……: As we frets over how to turn things around, the fused entity reemerges in Ranshin City. But this time...
SecTitleDesc.看着成为了融合体核心的苍叶，无名似乎下定了某种决心。: At the sight of Aoba who has now become the core of the fused entity, Mumei appears to make up her mind about something.
SecTitleDesc.我们终于见到了作为“幕后黑手”的宵月，面对不惜以自己的生命阻止计划的姐姐，宵月的: At last, we meet the "mastermind," Yoizuki. What would her answer be, facing her elder sister who was stopping at nothing to halt the plan, even at the cost of her own life...?
SecTitleDesc.在众人的齐心协力下，危机终于解除，宵月也将面对来自岚心城城主朱鹮的惩罚。: With everyone working as a team, the crisis is finally resolved. Yoizuki will have to face punishment from Ranshin City's governor, Toki.
SecTitleDesc.事情告一段落，我们为依然暂时留在岚心城的甲铁城众人带来了好消息……: Things come to a close. We bring good news to the Koutetsujou crew who are still temporarily living in Ranshin City...
SecTitleDesc.在协助御敌枢纽成员离开的海角城完成治安协力任务后，你接到了亚莉奈的联络，原来她在: After completing the security cooperation quest in Cape City, I receive a call from Arina. It turns out her colleague in Night Chains, Cecil, encountered trouble.
SecTitleDesc.你作为黑月的代表前往交涉地点，与学会的行政人员冯·里奈见面。塞西尔似乎和乌刹娜起: As the representative of Night Chains, I meet with the administrative officer of Citadel, Rina Von. It seems Cecil had a conflict with Ushana.
SecTitleDesc.在你的建议下，你们决定先前往汇流塔，寻找方法治疗塞西尔的伤口。: Under my suggestion, we decide to first go to the Confluence Tower to find a method to heal Cecil's wound.
SecTitleDesc.你从乌刹娜口中得知了事情经过，打算信任她。罗洁尔的投影告诉了你有关乌刹娜的事情，: I learn about the event from Ushana's perpective. Raziel's hologram tells me about Ushana's story, and I learn that Joshua has the potion to heal Cecil.
SecTitleDesc.你告知冯·里奈了解到的内容，但是约书亚作为“天使”来去自由，想要找到祂并非易事。: I inform Rina Von about what I have learned, but since Joshua comes and goes freely, finding them is not easy.
SecTitleDesc.罗洁尔的投影向你展示了乌刹娜的过去，而你似乎也知道了乌刹娜把你称为“救世主”的原: Raziel's hologram shows me Ushana's past, and it seems I now understand why Ushana calls me "Master Savior."
SecTitleDesc.你们来到淘金乐园，却没有看到约书亚的踪影。据掘金机器人所说，祂不久前才离开，也许: We arrive at ONEderland, but there is no trace of Joshua. According to Nugget Mechs, they left not long ago, so maybe we can still catch up with them.
SecTitleDesc.你和莉薇娅驾驶大哥号出发，终于在沙漠中发现了约书亚。祂似乎昏迷了，而大量的桦树生: Livia and I set off in the Basilisk and finally discover Joshua in the desert. They seem to be unconscious, and a large number of Chaos Remains have surrounded us...
SecTitleDesc.你们成功救助了倒在沙漠里的约书亚，但桦树生物的危机也包围了你们。: We successfully rescued Joshua, who had collapsed in the desert, but the Chaos Remains surround us again.
SecTitleDesc.莉薇娅独自应对威胁，约书亚尚在昏迷之中。危急时刻，乌刹娜展现出超凡的力量救下你们: Livia faces the threat alone while Joshua is still unconscious. In a critical moment, Ushana reveals extraordinary power to save us.
SecTitleDesc.约书亚告诉你，滴溜溜转转瓶不在他手中。经过一番掰扯，这名性情古怪的天使答应带你们: Joshua tells me that the Twirly Whirly is not in their hands. After some back-and-forth, this quirky Angel agrees to help us find the item.
SecTitleDesc.约书亚指引你们来到一处神秘的站点塔图站，你们在那里见到了天使诞生的场所哈依玛之骰: Joshua guides us to a mysterious station, Tattle Station, where we see the birthplace of Angels, Haima Zaria, and hear the story behind it.
SecTitleDesc.你在塔图站遇到了曾有过缘分的达斯廷，根据他的态度，你意识到事情有些复杂……: We meet Dustin, with whom we had a past connection. Based on his attitude, I realize things are somewhat complicated...
SecTitleDesc.乌刹那情绪激动，她似乎受到了某种感应，与此同时，你察觉到了不知从何时起就窥探着你: Ushana is emotional, as if she has sensed things. At the same time, I notice the gaze that has been watching me for who knows how long...
SecTitleDesc.在昏迷中似乎看到了不属于自己的记忆，再度醒来，一行人竟然已经在哈依玛之骰内部了…: While unconscious, I seem to see memories that don't belong to me. When I wake up again, all of us are somehow already within Haima Zaria...
SecTitleDesc.终于找到了骰子的核心——思维浮标所在的房间，但是，接下来会有在等待呢……: We finally find the core of Haima Zaria — the Mind Buoy. However, what will be waiting next...?
SecTitleDesc.她醒来了，但醒来的也不再是你们所熟知的那个她。: She wakes up, but is no longer the one we knew.
SecTitleDesc.从意识海中归来的你，从约书亚口中听到了乌刹娜的牺牲，你也下定了决心。: Having returned from Unbewusstes, I hear about Ushana's sacrifice from Joshua and also come to a decision.
SecTitleDesc.在赶赴决战之前，你向那位天使确认了祂的目的。: Before heading to battle, I learn from the Angel about their motive.
SecTitleDesc.同伴已经全数败下阵来，约书亚已经没有不战斗的理由了。: My companions have all been defeated. Joshua no longer has an excuse to step aside.
SecTitleDesc.乌刹娜做了一个长远的梦，梦里，救世主大人找到了她。: Ushana had a long dream. In the dream, Master Savior found her.
SecTitleDesc.达斯廷和约书亚向一个神秘人提起了种种提案，从今往后，学会会变得不一样吗？: Dustin and Joshua put forward various proposals to a mysterious person. Will the Citadel change from now on?
SecTitleDesc.拜访澄明数据中心铁安局时，莱卡吉亚请求你帮他一个忙：成为“一日局长”。: When visiting the BCRL Agency in the CDCA Bureau, Lycagia asks you for a favor: to become "One-Day Chief."
SecTitleDesc.第一站是市政厅。在市政厅里，“一日局长”和莱卡吉亚受到了摩尔充满机器人之爱的关心: The first stop is the City Hall. In the City Hall, the "One-Day Chief" and Lycagia receive Moore's care and help filled with robotic love, as well as reminders.
SecTitleDesc.第二站是商会。雷齐娅一如既往地态度不太客气，不过，她似乎想要提醒你今天这份工作背: The second stop is COLUMBA. Reizia, as usual, isn't very polite; however, she seems to want to remind me about the hidden story behind today's work.
SecTitleDesc.勉强答应了替雷齐娅去附近巡逻的邀请。莱卡吉亚向你坦诚，其实今天的工作主要是向各个: I reluctantly accept Reizia's invitation to patrol the vicinity. Lycagia confides in me that today's main task is to deliver a special document to the heads of various facilities, and the issuance and implementation of this document have encountered a lot of obstacles.
SecTitleDesc.在交易所，莱卡吉亚提出要提富子解决附近的治安隐患问题，富子却认为他的这种责任感有: At the Trading Center, Lycagia offers to address the nearby security issues for Plutessa, but Plutessa feels that his sense of responsibility is somewhat excessive. Lycagia gains Plutessa's understanding, and we set out on patrol together.
SecTitleDesc.最后一站是无垠号——结束工作以后，莱卡吉亚和你一同回到了无垠号上，享受难得的休息: The final stop is the Eternal. After finishing work, Lycagia and I return to the Eternal together to enjoy a rest. I experienced many things with him in just one day and got to know him better. Hopefully, he can find freedom for himself and others.
SecTitleDesc.和波克士一同去往黑月大酒店，在路上遇见了一位装扮有些新潮的少女……参与模拟战斗训: On my way to the Night Chains Hotel with Box, I meet a girl with somewhat trendy attire... On my way to the combat training, I hear about a terrifying "Highway Destroyer" in Night Chains.
SecTitleDesc.黑月大酒店中出现意外事件。前往查看情况时，偶然在人群中再次与那名少女擦肩而过。: An unexpected incident occurs in the Night Chains Hotel. When checking the situation, I accidentally brush past that girl again in the crowd.
SecTitleDesc.在走廊中遇见前往天台的少女，担心其安危而追了上去，误打误撞将她从天台边缘拉回。她: I meet the girl in the corridor who is going to the rooftop. Worried about her safety, I chase after her, accidentally pulling her back from the edge. She introduces herself as "Ren."
SecTitleDesc.在天台上与涟一同休息谈心。不一会儿，附近的乌鸦从四处聚集而来，围绕着我们二人。与: I rest and chat with Ren on the rooftop. Before long, nearby ravens gather, surrounding the two of us. After a pleasant farewell with Ren, we agree to meet again when we have the chance.
SecTitleDesc.与涟告别后，回到训练室继续训练，但对手换成了魇。从魇的口中得知，原来传说中的“公: After saying goodbye to Ren, I return to the training room to continue practicing, but my opponent is now Maruha. I learn that the "Highway Destroyer" is actually Ren's weapon. Where will I meet Ren again?
SecTitleDesc.在完成了报酬丰厚的订单之后，你招待自己的乘员以及商会派来的帮手黛丝莉前往黑月游乐: After completing a lucrative order, you entertain your crew and Desiree, the helper sent by COLUMBA, to go to Night Chains Land.
SecTitleDesc.与你们约好碰面的黛丝莉失去了音信，而你从巧遇的黑月成员马吉拉口中得知游乐城内发生: Desiree, whom you arranged to meet, lost contact, and you learn from the Night Chains member Margiela, whom you encounter by chance, that several incidents of teenage disappearances have happened in the amusement park.
SecTitleDesc.与此同时，黛丝莉在游乐城内偶遇了正被一可疑人士纠缠的塔拉，面对这个漏洞百出的骗子: Meanwhile, Desiree has a chance encounter with Tara, who is being harassed by a suspicious person in the amusement park. Facing this blatantly flawed scammer, the two quickly team up.
SecTitleDesc.通过你的努力，原本不愿配合的失踪者同伴们提供了一些有价值的情报。: Through your efforts, the missing person's uncooperative companions provide some valuable information.
SecTitleDesc.从与你有过一面之缘的游乐城员工涟口中，你们得知失踪人群的负面情绪十分强烈。: From Ren, an employee at the amusement park whom you have met once, you learn that the negative emotions of the missing people are very intense.
SecTitleDesc.马吉拉从青少年游客处打听到一个令人在意的传闻，霖的态度似乎有些不对劲……而在这时: Margiela heard an intriguing rumor from some teenage tourists. Lin's attitude seems a bit off... and at that moment, Desiree calls.
SecTitleDesc.黛丝莉和塔拉顺利抓住了诱拐犯，然而那个被诱拐犯关起来的少女却不见踪影。: Desiree and Tara successfully catch the kidnapper, yet the girl imprisoned by the kidnapper is nowhere to be found.
SecTitleDesc.诱拐犯被带来后经受了审讯，然而他并非你们要追查的真凶。: The kidnapper undergoes interrogation; however, he is not the real culprit you are pursuing.
SecTitleDesc.你们愁眉不展时，游乐城的管理者歌德现身，并且带来了一个重要情报。一名幸存者称犯人: When you are feeling stuck, the manager of the amusement park, Goethe, appears and brings important information. A survivor claimed that the culprit is the Witch.
SecTitleDesc.你们从塔拉处听说了流传于帝国的魔女传说，得知魔女是这样邪恶的存在，马吉拉的信仰产: You hear from Tara about the witch legend from the Empire and learn that the Witch is such an evil being, causing Margiela's faith to collapse. On the other hand, Masaki seems to have seen the true culprit...
SecTitleDesc.又有新的失踪者出现了，而马吉拉的状况也很古怪，好像受到某种控制一般向某个方向而去: There are new missing persons, and Margiela's condition is also very strange, as if under some kind of control, heading in a certain direction.
SecTitleDesc.你与马吉拉得到了阿尔喀娜的帮助，在得知自己与帝国魔女的渊源后，马吉拉依然下定决心: You and Margiela receive help from Arcana. After learning about her connection with the Witch of the Empire, Margiela still decides to face it all.
SecTitleDesc.你们进入了占卜小屋内的空间，马吉拉终于与真咲相遇。: You all entered the divination room, and Margiela finally meets Masaki.
SecTitleDesc.从塞蕾娜癫狂的话语中，你们依稀明白了她为何会走上这样的道路。: From Serena's mad words, you vaguely understand why she took such a path.
SecTitleDesc.见识到马吉拉的决心后，真咲也向马吉拉袒露了过去的一切。: After witnessing Margiela's determination, Masaki also reveals everything about her past to Margiela.
SecTitleDesc.事情告一段落后，你们了解到并非作为魔女，只是她们自己的过去。: After things settle down, you learn their past not as the Witch.
SecTitleDesc.在马吉拉的努力下，占卜小屋重新开放，这一次，就由魔女为大家带来幸福与奇迹吧。: With Margiela's efforts, the divination room has reopened. This time, let the witch bring happiness and miracles to everyone.
SecTitleDesc.由于乌刹娜在无垠号的状况很稳定，学会允许她可以自由外出一天。大家费尽心思为乌刹娜: Since Ushana's been in a good condition on the Eternal, the Citadel allowed her to go out freely for one day. We wish she can spend a happy day at the amusement park.
SecTitleDesc.来到游乐城的乌刹娜却非常紧张，完全看不到开心的样子，也许是出了什么问题……: Ushana becomes very nervous and doesn't look happy at all. Maybe something went wrong...
SecTitleDesc.逐渐找到了游玩的节奏，乌刹娜开始能全心全意投入这次游乐城之旅。: Gradually finding the pace, Ushana begins to fully immerse herself in this amusement park adventure.
SecTitleDesc.休息时间，独自等待的乌刹娜意外与几名游客起了争执，她的情绪一时间陷入了波动之中，: During the break, while waiting alone, Ushana unexpectedly gets into a dispute with several tourists. She's at the risk of losing control...
SecTitleDesc.成功控制住了局面，乌刹娜的情绪也重新恢复，你们约定好下次还要一起出来玩。: The situation is under control, and Ushana's mood also recovered. We agree to have fun together again.
SecTitleDesc.在无垠号上发现了一张写着时间地点的神秘纸条……到澄明数据中心赴约后，发现是需要同: A mysterious note is found on The Eternal... After going to the appointment at the CDCA Bureau, it turns out to be Reeva who needs a companion. What kind of adventure awaits when traveling with this Devil Hunter?
SecTitleDesc.听取委托人的证词后，瑞瓦似乎对恶魔的真身有了些想法。深受“恶魔”困扰的小女孩卡洛: After listening to the client's testimony, Reeva seems to have some ideas about the truth of the devil. The girl Carol, who is deeply troubled by the "devil," asks us to help her.
SecTitleDesc.在远见公寓内部四处调查，瑞瓦认为这里出现的桦树生物和深眠者是“扭曲”后的产物。: Investigating around the Vision Apartment, Reeva believes that the Chaos Remains and Deep Sleepers appearing here are results of "distortion."
SecTitleDesc.采取巧妙的方式让委托人相信了我们的说法，为小女孩解围。结束了今天的工作，与瑞瓦道: Using a clever approach, we convince the client of our explanation to help the little girl out of trouble. I conclude today's work and say goodbye to Reeva, hoping to meet her on The Eternal in the future!
SecTitleDesc.真咲来到无垠号，请求以列车长的名义来调查铁盟封锁区的神秘生物UMA。: Masaki boards the Eternal and requests to investigate the unknown mysterious animal in the BCRL restricted area with your help.
SecTitleDesc.UMA看起来只是一种桦树生物，二人准备调查一下再回去汇报情况。: The UMA appears to be just a Chaos Remain, and you two decide to investigate further before reporting back.
SecTitleDesc.真咲的情绪苏沪有些低落，她向你倾诉了心事，二人做出了分享秘密的约定。: Masaki seems a bit downcast. She confides her feelings to you, and the two of you promise to share secrets.
SecTitleDesc.真咲发现了你身上的一些怪异，受限于某些规则无法直接告诉你，但仍为你献上祝福。: Masaki notices something strange about you. Limited by certain rules, she cannot tell you directly, but she still offers you her blessing.
SecTitleDesc.发生在某个节点的战斗以及素不相识的同行者，这一切到底是……: A fight that occurred at some point and a fellow compatriot you don't recognize. Just what exactly is...
SecTitleDesc.面对强敌，你不由得想起这一连串事件的起点……: Facing the formidable enemy, you couldn't help but think about what started this chain of events...
SecTitleDesc.克洛伊正在执行清楚形态污染引发灾害的任务，而在她身后，菲妮娅和冯·丽奈正悄悄跟随: Chloe arrives in ONEderland on a mission, unaware that Fenia and Rina Von are secretly tailing her.
SecTitleDesc.跟随的二人被克洛伊发现，菲妮亚在解释的时候，突然中暑晕倒。: The two are quickly discovered, and while Fenia tries to explain herself, she suddenly collapses from heatstroke.
SecTitleDesc.菲妮娅被送到无垠号上接受治疗。克洛伊霸占了休息室。突然一阵电光闪过，列车陷入了黑: Fenia is taken aboard the Eternal for treatment, while Chloe shamelessly takes over the Conductor's lounge. Moments later, a burst of electricity plunges the entire train into darkness.
SecTitleDesc.为了保证菲妮亚的治疗，克洛伊不得不以自身的能力强行重启列车的引擎。: To keep Fenia alive, Chloe has no choice but to force the Eternal's engines back to life with her own power.
SecTitleDesc.忙碌之后，克洛伊回到列车上休息。我坐在克洛伊的身边对她倾诉着，感到肉麻的克洛伊羞: After everything is finally over, I quietly tell her what I truly think. Embarrassed by the heartfelt words, Chloe takes off into the sky in a huff.
SecTitleDesc.旧七号自由港遗址，一个神秘的盒子被打捞上来，随后，一场关于“萃境计划”的会议在七: A mysterious case is salvaged from the ruins of Old Freeport VII, and a meeting on the "Verdant Realm Project" convenes in Freeport VII.
SecTitleDesc.在索思学会的事情告一段落后，你收到了来自科伦巴商会会长梅迪奇女士本人的联络，希望: With matters at the Citadel settled, you hear from President Medici herself, asking you to meet her in Freeport VII.
SecTitleDesc.梅迪奇向你们布置了这一次的任务：原来七号自由港即将迎来遇难事故20周年纪念，主办: Medici lays out the assignment: Freeport VII is approaching the 20th anniversary of the disaster, and the organizers have decided each CoC involved in the reconstruction will send one representative to speak. Medici has chosen you and Livia.
SecTitleDesc.你与莉薇娅分头为演讲做准备，在海边，你遇见了一名有过奇妙际遇的女孩伊卡菈。: You and Livia part ways to prepare. At the shore you meet Ikara, a girl with a curious history behind her.
SecTitleDesc.在搜集了一些情报后，伊卡菈拿出一个造型奇特，形似波克士的相机，请你帮忙拍照，结果: After gathering some information, Ikara takes out an oddly shaped camera resembling Box and asks you to take photos. It does not go well.
SecTitleDesc.你们随后来到七号自由港市政厅，一路的见闻也让伊卡菈产生了一些思考和疑问，在尝试一: At Freeport VII City Hall, what Ikara has seen along the way leaves her with questions. Over a Ranshin-style meal, she tells you what has been troubling her.
SecTitleDesc.你们来到一家服装店，在完成了情报搜集后，伊卡菈突然起了一些坏心思，打算“捉弄”你: At a clothing shop, having finished the interviews, Ikara gets a mischievous idea and decides to have some fun at your expense.
SecTitleDesc.你们走在海滨步道上，伊卡菈哼唱起一首据说是科伦巴商会主题曲的歌，令你一头雾水。这: On the seaside promenade, Ikara hums a song said to be COLUMBA's theme, which leaves you baffled. Then you spot someone by the water who seems about to end their life, and you rush over.
SecTitleDesc.原来一切只是个误会，对方只是打算站起来活动一下筋骨，而那个人是阿妮塔的园丁导师陈: It was all a misunderstanding— she only meant to stand up and stretch. She is Chen Shuxian, a Gardener mentor from Anita, and your paths have kind of crossed before.
SecTitleDesc.你们交谈时，陈书闲的同伴，阿妮塔的大导师伊利亚德也出现了。他们回忆起二十年前旧七: As you talk, Chen Shuxian's companion appears: Eliade, Anita's great mentor. They recall the outbreak of the Old Freeport VII disaster twenty years ago, and one man who mattered— Chu Yuheng.
SecTitleDesc.伊利亚德向你们介绍起一度被搁置的，计划将铁路铺设到帝国的“萃境计划”。你兴奋不已: Eliade explains the long-shelved "Verdant Realm Project" and its plan to lay rail into the Empire. Thrilled, you accept his invitation to join— and realize Ikara may be connected to it.
SecTitleDesc.结束了资料搜集，你带着伊卡菈暂回无垠号修整，顺便帮她修手机。伊卡菈的手机铃声正是: With the interview done, you bring Ikara back to the Eternal to rest and fix her phone. Her ringtone is the very song she was humming, and more surprising still, Livia knows it too.
SecTitleDesc.你和莉薇娅完成了各自的稿件，大家一起各自读了一遍，各有特色，难评优劣。伊利亚德也: You and Livia finish your drafts and read them aloud. Each has its merits, and neither is easy to rank. Eliade sends word: the Navigator capture begins once tomorrow's commemoration ends.
SecTitleDesc.纪念活动正式开始，你们见到了哈里弗克斯打捞公司的创始人之一哈里先生，并了解到了公: The commemoration opens, and you meet Mr. Hali, a founder of HaliFox Salvage, and learn something of how the company began.
SecTitleDesc.主办方选中了莉薇娅的稿子，她的演讲引发了许多市民的共情。然而下台后，莉薇娅很快发: The organizers choose Livia's draft, and her speech moves many in the crowd. But soon after leaving the stage, she comes down with a high fever.
SecTitleDesc.仅凭无垠号的医疗条件无法治愈莉薇娅，而莉薇娅坚决不同意你为了她放弃伊利亚德的委托: The Eternal's medical facilities cannot cure Livia, and she refuses outright to let you give up Eliade's commission for her sake. President Medici, Ikara, and Mr. Hali all come to see her, and through Hali's intercession she is admitted to the finest hospital.
SecTitleDesc.莉薇娅和艾略特前往医院，在梅迪奇会长的推荐下，伊卡菈作为代理行车助理协助你完成这: Livia and Eliot head for the hospital, and on President Medici's recommendation, Ikara joins you as acting train assistant for the mission.
SecTitleDesc.路上，梅迪奇看着一张旧照片，回忆起她女儿的往事，另一边，伊卡菈也因为梅迪奇的照顾: On the way, Medici looks at an old photograph and recalls her daughter. Elsewhere, Medici's care has stirred something in Ikara— for the first time in her life, she longs for a mother's love.
SecTitleDesc.一切准备完毕，领航员抓捕计划正式开始。: With everything ready, the Navigator capture operation begins.
SecTitleDesc.在大家感到头疼时，你展现出可靠而惊艳的行车技术，解决了一个大难题，陈书闲毫不掩饰: With everyone at a loss, your driving proves both dependable and astonishing, and it clears a major obstacle. Chen Shuxian makes no secret of how impressed she is.
SecTitleDesc.始源桦树生物想要阻止你使用抓捕装置，眼看你陷入危机，伊卡菈不顾一切赶来，将她的力: The Origin CR moves to stop you from reaching the capture device. Seeing you in danger, Ikara comes for you regardless of the cost and places her power in your hands.
SecTitleDesc.虽然你和伊卡菈合作解决了危机，但是对你这样不顾自身安全的行为，伊利亚德很不赞同。: You and Ikara resolve the crisis together, but Eliade takes strong exception to your disregard for your own safety.
SecTitleDesc.为了追捕领航员，你们让行车轨道和桦树空间重叠，但是目标利用自身形态场阻碍你们，眼: To pursue the Navigator, you overlap the track with Chaos Space— but the target uses its own Morphic Field to block you. Just as it seems you will return empty-handed, Ikara resonates with your conviction...
SecTitleDesc.你们和领航员开展了最后的搏斗，但是还是让它逃跑了。但是伊利亚德似乎利用伊卡菈的相: You fight the Navigator one last time, and still it escapes. Yet Eliade seems to have done something with Ikara's camera, and to good effect.
SecTitleDesc.回到远星大桥后，伊卡菈已经不再踌躇不前，她已经下定决心，要真正出于自己的意愿成为: Back at the Apoaster Bridge, Ikara no longer hesitates. She has made up her mind: she will become a conductor out of her own will, and see the Verdant Realm Project through.
SecTitleDesc.原来那部相机并非单纯的相机，而是一种极其特殊的装置，它成功搜集到了阿妮塔需要的数: That camera was no ordinary camera but a highly specialized device, and it captured the data Anita needed. Eliade formally engages you as Anita's external agent— though questions still linger in your mind...
SecTitleDesc.为了培养萃境计划的人才，众人开始筹备萃境学园，可是迟迟找不到符合要求的校舍。这时: To train the people the Verdant Realm Project needs, preparations for Verdant Realm Academy begin— but no suitable premises can be found. Then Sagi of Night Chains offers to provide them...
SecTitleDesc.伊利亚德打算在园丁考核中采用新模式，请晃和伊尔配合测试，两人对伊利亚德那本不离身: Eliade plans to use a new mode in the Gardener assessments and asks Akira and Yer to help test it. The handbook he never lets out of his hands catches their curiosity.
SecTitleDesc.伊利亚德表示两人在考核中拿到第一名，就可以把手册给他们看，两人为了达成这个目标开: Eliade tells the two of them that if they place first in the assessments, he will let them read the handbook. They set to work on making that happen.
SecTitleDesc.得知设计图原件在伊利亚德的画室，这触发了晃和伊尔不堪的回忆，原来伊利亚德的绘画作: Learning that the original schematic is in Eliade's art studio triggers memories Akira and Yer would rather not revisit — as it turns out, Eliade's paintings have quite an impact, and not one anybody is prepared for...
SecTitleDesc.两人达成了目标，伊利亚德遵照约定将手册给他们看，本子上有两个人的笔迹，就这样意外: The two of them meet the goal, and Eliade keeps his word and lets them read the handbook. There are two hands in the notebook, and that is how they brush up against a past from over twenty years ago.
SecTitleDesc.在伊利亚德的引导下，两人参与了褚玉衡留下的，最后的挑战谜题，看着自己的学生，一代: Guided by Eliade, the two of them take part in the last of the challenge puzzles Chu Yuheng left behind. Watching his own students, and one generation of new Gardeners after another, come into their own stirs a great deal in Eliade...
SecTitleDesc.斯洛卡伊在陌生的地底醒来，她勉强驱动机神力，操纵一台钻掘单元试图脱困，却意外撞上: Slokai woke up in an unfamiliar underground. She struggled to drive her machine's power, operating a drilling unit in an attempt to escape, but accidentally crashed into an underground village.
SecTitleDesc.斯洛卡伊控制的钻头意外冲入地下村落的浴室，导致村庄设施与物品被冲得七零八落，引来: The drill controlled by Slokai accidentally crashed into the bathroom of an underground village, causing the village's facilities and items to be scattered everywhere. This attracted the angry Cave Spirits who surrounded them, and since she couldn't communicate with them, she could only be taken away to wait for the so-called "Breese" to communicate.
SecTitleDesc.在垃圾回收站的布雷斯与安菲娅交谈时，得知有一名来自异世界的个体出现在其故乡黮窨村: While Breese was talking with Anfiya at the recycling station, he learned that an individual from another world had appeared near his hometown of Anxun Village, suspected of bringing danger. Subsequently, a flustered Tarei, wrapped in a towel, burst in to report an emergency. Breese immediately set out with Anfiya to investigate the situation.
SecTitleDesc.荒原站外，列车长与莉薇娅按安菲娅的坐标抵达，却意外发现安菲娅正与一群外貌与布雷斯: Outside Wilderness Station, Conductor and Livia arrived at Anfiya's coordinates, only to unexpectedly find Anfiya surrounded by a group of dwarves resembling Breese. They were surrounding two young girls, one of whom was a stranger named Slokai, accused by the dwarves of damaging village facilities... Was this person the "Miss Ellie" you had once met?
SecTitleDesc.斯卡洛伊与窟灵族的矛盾还没调解结束，在交谈中，她突然高烧昏倒，手臂开始逐渐透明，: The conflict between Skaroy and the Kulings hasn't been resolved yet. During the conversation, she suddenly fainted with a high fever, and her arm began to gradually turn transparent, as if she were disappearing from this world.
SecTitleDesc.安菲娅告知斯洛卡伊因被形态场排斥引发的解离现象，将于七天后消失，她请求我们寻找传: Anfiya informed us that the dissociation phenomenon Slokai is experiencing, caused by the repulsion of the morphic field, will disappear in seven days. She requested that we find the legendary "Primordial Fruit" to help extend Slokai's life.
SecTitleDesc.列车组在讨论向哪位帝国人寻求帮助，另外一边，斯洛卡伊已经醒来，并且告知安菲娅她已: The train crew is discussing which Imperial person to seek help from, meanwhile, Slokai has already woken up and informed Anfiya that she understands her physical condition but is not ready to rest.
SecTitleDesc.冯里奈告知我们卡塔斯有事不在，我们决定去修格里城询问咖啡馆的奥莉薇恩更多情报。: Rina Von informed us that Katas was not present due to some matters, so we decided to go to Shoggolith City to ask Olivien at the café for more information.
SecTitleDesc.在修格里城咖啡馆，我与莉薇娅遇见奥莉薇恩的监护人海伦娜，得知她熟知曼杜斯的情报；: At the Shoggolith City café, Livia and I met Olivien's guardian Helena, who informed us that she was well-acquainted with intelligence on Mundus; meanwhile, Slokai spoke with Breese outside Wilderness Station and promised to assist him.
SecTitleDesc.海伦娜答应提供原质之果的炼成配方，但拒收金钱，改要求我与莉薇娅将来履行一次承诺作: Helena agreed to provide the formula for the Primal Fruit but refused to accept money, instead requiring me and Livia to fulfill a promise in the future as compensation, and she is willing to personally assist in the synthesis.
SecTitleDesc.海伦娜向我和莉薇娅详细讲解了炼制原质之果所需的五种材料，并揭示了原质之果的历史。: Helena explained in detail to Livia and me the five types of materials needed to refine the Primal Essence Fruit and revealed the history of the Primal Essence Fruit.
SecTitleDesc.斯洛卡伊通过指挥窟灵族重建工地，成功赢得他们中部分人的尊敬与支持。: Slokai, by directing the reconstruction site of the Kuling tribe, successfully earned the respect and support of some among them.
SecTitleDesc.我们与斯洛卡伊一同推理神秘材料线索，窟灵族人则因先知“布罗斐忒”身份引发争议。: We are reasoning about the mysterious material clues together with Slokai, while the identity of the prophet "Brofit" has sparked controversy among the Kulings.
SecTitleDesc.安菲娅提供了关于最后一样材料的情报，我们决定前往矿场和淘金乐园寻找材料，斯洛卡伊: Anfiya provided information about the last piece of Material, and we decided to go to the mine and ONEderland to search for Material. Slokai insisted on participating in the operation personally.
SecTitleDesc.斯洛卡伊再次登上了无垠号，与此同时，布雷斯在垃圾站向安菲娅吐露了内心的迷茫。: Slokai boarded The Eternal once more, while at the same time, Breese expressed his inner confusion to Anfiya at the junkyard.
