SecTitleDesc.抵达曼德矿场，斯洛卡伊默默感受着熟悉而又陌生的工业氛围，内心复杂；随后我们在矿场: Arriving at Mander Mine, Slokai silently felt the familiar yet unfamiliar industrial atmosphere, his heart complex. We then searched for the key material "Star Silver" in the mine and received assistance from Uncle Baxter, preparing to continue to go to ONEderland to collect the remaining materials.
SecTitleDesc.我们准备迎击尘鸣游磷，嘱咐斯洛卡伊在车上待着。: We are preparing to confront the Sand Phosphor and instruct Slokai to stay in the car.
SecTitleDesc.我和莉薇娅在淘金乐园完成了仙人掌采集任务，斯洛卡伊对金子小姐产生了兴趣……？: Livia and I completed the cactus gathering Quests at ONEderland, and Slokai became interested in Miss Gold...?
SecTitleDesc.窟灵族内部因圣炉争议爆发冲突，族长拒绝外人接近神殿，但随着多名族人突然失去意识，: Conflict erupted within the Kuling tribe over the sacred furnace controversy. The chieftain refused outsiders from approaching the temple, but as several tribespeople suddenly lost consciousness, Slokai decided to accept the trial, vowing to uncover the truth and respond to her people's trust in her.
SecTitleDesc.布雷斯报告窟灵族同伴不断昏迷，众人决定前往神殿使用圣炉唤醒族人并炼制原质之果；海: Breese reported that the Kulings were continuously falling unconscious, and everyone decided to go to the temple to use the sacred furnace to awaken their people and refine the Primal Fruit; Helena mysteriously left the camp, and Slokai decided to return underground to investigate the truth.
SecTitleDesc.我们发现通往神殿的道路已经损坏，利用滑索和隐藏机关准备进入神殿探查秘密。: We found that the road leading to the temple was damaged, so we prepared to use zip lines and hidden mechanisms to enter the temple and explore its secrets.
SecTitleDesc.布雷斯和波克士利用滑索进入对岸启动伸缩桥，却遭遇“长耳窟灵族”伏击，险象环生。: Breese and Box used a zipline to reach the opposite shore and activate the drawbridge, but they were ambushed by the "Long-Eared Goblins," facing great danger.
SecTitleDesc.我们发现了穿着帝国服饰的深眠者和神殿守卫者，神殿的存在与曼杜斯帝国有关……我们决: We discovered Deep Sleepers and temple guardians wearing imperial attire, and the existence of the temple is related to the Mundus Empire... We are determined to uncover the truth about the temple and the sacred furnace.
SecTitleDesc.我们在神殿通过解读炼金术师留下的封语光片，成功破解了宝石机关，打开了通往圣炉的神: We successfully deciphered the gemstone mechanism by interpreting the alchemical lens left behind in the temple, opening the temple gate leading to the Sacred Furnace.
SecTitleDesc.我们在神殿内部调查熄灭的圣炉和轨道系统，发现了圣炉无法启动的关键，随后在午夜兔的: We investigated the extinguished sacred furnace and track system inside the temple, discovering the key to why the sacred furnace couldn't be activated. Then, under the guidance of the Midnight Rabbit, we prepared to explore the hidden secrets deep within the temple.
SecTitleDesc.在神殿深处发现了被隐藏的窟灵族造物“本体”和震撼壁画，揭露了他们是炼金术师为帝国: Deep within the temple, the hidden creation "main body" of the Kuling tribe and a stunning mural were discovered, revealing that they were creations made by alchemists for the empire's migration plan. Breese fell into agony because of the truth, while everyone else began repairing the sacred furnace, preparing to rekindle hope.
SecTitleDesc.我们神殿内重新点燃圣炉后，轨道阵法启动，却意外触发了潜伏的强大桦树生物，迫使他们: After reigniting the sacred furnace within our temple, the track formation activated but unexpectedly triggered a dormant powerful CR, forcing them to evacuate urgently.
SecTitleDesc.布雷斯带领苏醒的窟灵族人群抵挡强敌桦树生物，斯洛卡伊以机神力反制敌人却陷入意识崩: Breese led the awakened Cave Spirits to resist the formidable enemy, CR. Slokai used mechanical power to counter the enemy but fell into a state of mental collapse. The group took the opportunity to retreat, and the crisis was temporarily resolved.
SecTitleDesc.斯洛卡伊在濒死与梦境边缘挣扎后，在海伦娜炼制的“原质之果”作用下苏醒了。: After struggling on the edge of death and dreams, Slokai awoke under the effect of the "Primordial Fruit" crafted by Helena.
SecTitleDesc.斯洛卡伊在荒原站帮助窟灵族建设地上村落，恢复了元气并规划温泉浴场，同时决定继续守: Slokai helped the Kurin tribe build a surface village at Wilderness Station, restored their vitality and planned a hot spring bath, while also deciding to continue guarding them and waiting for the right time to start engine and leave.
SecTitleDesc.在我参观宝石展会时，海伦娜忽然现身，以黑卡买下我心仪的宝石，并要求我作为她的助手: While I was visiting the gem exhibition, Helena suddenly appeared, bought the gem I desired with a Black card, and asked me to be her assistant, beginning to learn the mysteries of gemology and trading.
SecTitleDesc.我跟随海伦娜在展会上购入大批原石，在搬运与见学的过程中，她借一块普通石头向我阐述: I followed Helena to purchase a large number of rough stones at the exhibition. During the transportation and learning process, she used an ordinary stone to explain to me the philosophy of "polishing flaws, giving meaning," and ultimately entrusted that Mumei rough stone to me.
SecTitleDesc.在咖啡厅，奥莉薇恩婉拒了萃境代表乌菲兹的请求后，与现身的海伦娜讨论情报；随后海伦: In the café, after Olivien politely declined the request from Uffizi, representing Crystal Realm, she discussed intelligence with the newly arrived Helena. Subsequently, Helena performed her unique gem divination for me, revealing that my destiny had been rewritten by some force, displaying countless unpredictable possibilities.
SecTitleDesc.我和海伦娜、奥莉薇恩一同前往汇流塔寻找卡塔斯，却与丽桑德拉不期而遇。海伦娜与丽桑: I, along with Helena and Olivien, went to Confluence Tower to look for Katas, but unexpectedly encountered Lissandra. Helena and Lissandra had a fierce magical confrontation due to a clash of ideologies.
SecTitleDesc.海伦娜借宝石卜术向丽桑德拉证明自己的立场，同时向我讲述了她关于守望命运与放手挚友: Helena used gem divination to prove her position to Lissandra, while telling me about her choice between safeguarding destiny and letting go of a close friend. Afterward, we reunited with Katas and Olivien, sharing a moment of tranquility.
SecTitleDesc.无垠号停靠在贡露城的一个夜晚，刚结束一天的我意外迎来乌刹娜与那由他的突访，我被带: The Eternal docked in Gronru City one night. Just after finishing my day, I unexpectedly received a visit from Ushana and Nayuta, and I was taken to a secret location of the Source Citadel.
SecTitleDesc.在索思学会秘密据点，我以“证人”身份见证切茜娅的审讯，目睹她在爱维珊娜的药物质询: At the Source Citadel's secret outpost, I witnessed Chelsea's interrogation as a "witness," observing her gradually unravel under Avicenna's pharmaceutical inquiry.
SecTitleDesc.在审讯中，切茜娅逐步暴露出材料申请背后的矛盾，最终在药物质询下崩溃，喊出“父亲”: During the interrogation, Chelsea gradually exposed the contradictions behind the material application. Ultimately, under the influence of drug questioning, she broke down and shouted out the name "father," unraveling the mystery of the mistletoe experiment and the professor who might still be alive.
SecTitleDesc.丽桑德拉判定切茜娅“主观无罪、结果有责”，并宣布解除其一切职务给予自由，但切茜娅: Lissandra determined Chelsea to be "subjectively innocent but accountable for the outcome" and announced the removal of all her duties, granting her freedom. However, Chelsea, unable to bear the "freedom of innocence," broke down emotionally, crying out and begging for punishment, ultimately rushing madly toward me.
SecTitleDesc.在梦境审判中，丽桑德拉借助我的存在诱出寄生于切茜娅潜意识的执念，使其得以清除并获: In the Dream Judgment, Lissandra used my presence to lure out the obsession parasitizing Chelsea's subconscious, allowing it to be cleared and for her to gain true freedom; however, upon waking, Chelsea was still confused by "why not herself." In the end, with my encouragement, she accepted the journey to find herself, albeit with mixed feelings.
SecTitleDesc.梅迪奇前往海伦娜的珠宝店拜访，她想要见一个人，这个人似乎和莉薇娅有关。: Medici went to Helena's jewelry store to visit; she wanted to see someone who seemed to be related to Livia.
SecTitleDesc.阿妮塔的园丁们在研究爆炸事故，他们想要找到一位失踪研究员的下落。: Anita's gardeners are investigating the explosion incident, and they want to find the whereabouts of a missing researcher.
SecTitleDesc.与此同时，学会检测到了某种危险的存在……: At the same time, the Citadel detected the presence of some kind of danger...
SecTitleDesc.你从一个噩梦中惊醒，随后，伊卡菈告知你她今天即将离开，希望能和你利用剩下的时间在: You wake up from a nightmare, and then Ikara informs you that she will be leaving today. She hopes to spend the remaining time with you exploring Gronru City.
SecTitleDesc.你与伊卡菈一起体验了自行车后，将她送到车站，前来接应的护卫蒂斯塔尔早已等候多时。: After experiencing cycling with Ikara, you take her to the station where the escort Tistar has been waiting for a long time.
SecTitleDesc.终于和康复的莉薇娅汇合，你们的车组再次完整集结，等待你们的是新的任务。: Finally reunited with the recovered Livia, your crew is once again fully assembled, and new quests await you.
SecTitleDesc.另一边，正在四处搜寻的阿妮塔园丁们发现了要找的研究员，然而对方的情况出乎所有人的: On the other side, the Gardeners, who were searching everywhere, found the researcher they were looking for; however, the situation of the person was beyond everyone's expectations.
SecTitleDesc.任务中的意外遭遇让你结识了名为朵拉弥丝的神秘少女，在阿妮塔的帮助下你们避免了最大: An unexpected encounter during the quests introduced you to a mysterious girl named Dolly Mis. With Anita's help, you avoided the greatest crisis; however, the entire crew still needs to pause for a while to recuperate. You plan to take this opportunity to try one of the famous restaurants in Gronru City.
SecTitleDesc.休息时你发现了朵拉弥丝的特殊体质，桦树生物似乎把她认作同类，十分亲近。: During the break, you discovered Dolores' special constitution; the CR seems to regard her as one of their own and is very close to her.
SecTitleDesc.你们被捕鱼大赛的宣传消息吸引，这时，你的宿敌西蒙再次出现，向你发起了挑战邀约。: You are attracted by the promotional news of the fishing competition, and at this moment, your rival Simon appears again, issuing you a challenge invitation.
SecTitleDesc.你们原本打算买票观看比赛，朵拉弥丝却在工作人员的劝诱下不小心报名成为了比赛选手，: You originally planned to buy tickets to watch the match, but Doraemys was inadvertently signed up as a contestant under the persuasion of the staff, and the conditions for withdrawal are extremely strict, so you can only accept reality.
SecTitleDesc.得知你要参加比赛，西蒙感到非常不可思议，于是决定他也要参加。在西蒙母亲和姐姐的支: Upon learning that you were going to participate in the competition, Simon was very amazed and decided he would join as well. With the support of Simon's mother and sister, his father finally relented and agreed.
SecTitleDesc.莉薇娅非常反对你参加比赛，不过在你向她分析了比赛规则后表示可以中途弃权时，她总算: Livia was strongly opposed to you participating in the competition, but after you explained the rules to her and indicated that you could withdraw halfway, she finally reluctantly agreed.
SecTitleDesc.你和朵拉弥丝等待着比赛开场，贡露城的所有人都无比关注这场盛大的赛事。: You and Dolamys are waiting for the game to start, and everyone in Gronru City is paying close attention to this grand event.
SecTitleDesc.虽然最开始不熟练，但你很快掌握驾船要领，并在朵拉弥丝的帮助下捕到大量海鱼，亮眼的: Although you were not proficient at first, you quickly mastered the essentials of sailing and, with Doris's help, caught a large number of sea fish. Your impressive performance earned you considerable popularity.
SecTitleDesc.比赛进入第二阶段，突然出现了一条神秘的怪鱼开始袭击选手，被袭击的选手变成了桦树生: The competition entered the second stage, and suddenly a mysterious monster fish appeared and started attacking the contestants. The attacked contestants turned into CR, while the audience thought it was just part of the show...
SecTitleDesc.随着第二轮投票结束，主持人又宣布了新的规则，被淘汰的选手只要牺牲自己的同伴就能获: As the second round of voting ended, the host announced a new rule: eliminated contestants could be saved by sacrificing their companions, which immediately triggered new confuse.
SecTitleDesc.莉薇娅等人正在想办法支援你，而你也没有坐以待毙，联合其他选手打算杀死鬼灯鲨，可就: Livia and others are trying to find a way to support you, and you are not sitting idly by. You plan to team up with other contestants to kill the Ghost Lantern Shark, but just as you are about to succeed, the forward ship is blown up, and the mastermind behind the scenes emerges...
SecTitleDesc.在妮基塔的撺掇下，你被淘汰出局，面对鬼灯鲨的追杀，你突然想到一个找到妮基塔藏身处: Under Nikita's instigation, you were eliminated. Facing the pursuit of the demon lantern shark, you suddenly thought of a good idea to find Nikita's hiding place.
SecTitleDesc.你被逼入绝境，朵拉弥丝义无反顾地打算牺牲自己，换取你的生路。: You were forced into desperation, and Dolores was determined to sacrifice herself to secure a way out for you.
SecTitleDesc.西蒙唤醒了意志消沉的你，而他也被淘汰出局，你想到了一个风险很大的方法，在你的鼓励: Simon awakened the dispirited you, and he was also eliminated. You thought of a very risky method, and with your encouragement, Simon decided to do as you said.
SecTitleDesc.西蒙和婕丝成功配合了你的计划，你们将鬼灯鲨击杀。与此同时，静流等人也找到了妮基塔: Simon and Jess successfully coordinated with your plan, and you killed the Demon Lantern Shark. Meanwhile, Shizuru and others also found Nikita's hiding place.
SecTitleDesc.朵拉弥丝平安无事回到你们身边，然而，妮基塔却成功逃走，并且准备好了一场全新的危机: Dolamis returned to you safely, however, Nikita managed to escape and is preparing a brand new crisis...
SecTitleDesc.和莉薇娅一同来到篝火城中采购星祷节风格的车厢装饰，却偶遇了陷入抽选困境的卡塔斯。: I go to buy carriage decoration with Livia, but run into the confused Katas. In order to attract her attention, I ask Livia to walk her around.
SecTitleDesc.在超市独自继续采购时与同样前来采购的伊尔和陈书闲碰面。采购完毕后，陈书闲想去某个: While I am shopping alone, I run into Yer and Chen Shuxian. Afterward, Chen Shuxian wants to go somewhere...
SecTitleDesc.和陈书闲一起缝制了星祷节风格的可爱玩偶，收到了完成品作为礼物……似乎更能理解节日: I make a cute doll with Chen Shuxian, and receive a gift... Now the festival is more heartwarming. Merry Astrum Ora!

text_1.之前在费奇号附近见过的……叫什么来着？: Saw her near the Phiggy... What's her name again?
text_1.我倒是想靠近看看……: I want to get a closer look...
text_1.那就去看看吧，反正是见过的人。: Let's go, then. It's and aquaintance anyway.
text_1.原来你早有计划啊？！: So you already have a plan?!
text_1.静流她和我从小就认识，算是青梅竹马吧。: I've known Shizuru since we were kids, we're childhood playmates.
text_1.也许这只是一个母亲无法忘却的本能。: Maybe it's just an unforgettable maternal instinct.
text_1.哈哈，没事，这顿猪排饭让静流请我吃就行。: Haha, it's fine. Shizuru treating me to this Pork Chop Rice is enough.
text_1.对不起，好像让你们担心了。: Sorry, seems like I made you worried.
text_1.我的第六感也有这么准的时候啊。: My sixth sense is actually so accurate sometimes, eh.
text_1.继续调查吧，不能半途而废。: Keep investigating. We can't give up halfway.
text_1.为了篝火城能够尽快恢复平静。: To restore peace to Bonfire City as soon as possible.
text_1.我一句都没听懂。: I didn't understand a single word.
text_1.现在不是聊这些的时候。: Now is not the time to talk about this.
text_1.好像是要推出新的红茶品牌？: Looks like they're launching a new black tea brand?
text_1.她说话的方式有为我们考虑吧。: She sounds considerate of us, no?
text_1.也许恰恰是因为这颗台球是学会产物吧。: Maybe it's precisely because this billiard ball is a property of the Citadel.
text_1.我竟然有点感动……: I'm actually feeling a little touched...
text_1.虽然很感谢您的好意……: Thank you for your kindness, but...
text_1.为什么又变成这样了！？: How did things come to this again?!
text_1.我的后背也还算可靠！: I've got a pretty nice back to lean on!
text_1.这个引擎还不是完全体？: This engine is still a work in progress?
text_1.因为妮蔻拉小姐相信我。: Because you trust me, Miss Nicola.
text_1.苔妮小姐怎么在这？: What is Miss Tennie doing here?
text_1.其他都不错但是小熊感觉好没必要啊！: Everything else is fine, but teddy bears? Really???
text_1.不能网开一面吗？: Is there no way to make an exception?
text_1.我懂，我有时候也会这样。: I get it. I'm like that every once in a while, too.
text_1.这也太夸张了吧……: This is way too over the top...
text_1.好难得能接到你主动发起的通讯。: It's rare to receive a call from you.
text_1.我们去知识集市吧。: Let's head to the Knowledge Bazaar.
text_1.抱歉，记忆有点模糊……（需要前情提要）: Sorry, my memory's a little hazy... (I need a recap)
text_1.我知道了，是荚蒾开业纪念日？: I got it. Is it Viburnum's anniversary?
text_1.等等，我们先不去酒店。: Hold on. Let's not go to the hotel yet.
text_1.那我去付钱了！: I'll go pay for it, then!
text_1.你先别想这些……: Don't think about these for now...
text_1.全靠在交易所的历练。: Thanks to my experience at the Trading Center.
text_1.你认为吉索普夫妇是清白的？: Do you think the Gesops were innocent?
text_1.因为阿妮塔担心自身的形象？: Is it because Anita is worried about its image?
text_1.但是也有铁盟干涉的因素吧？: But BCRL is also interfering, right?
text_1.因为他们想要除掉所有碍事的人。: They were determined to eliminate anyone who got in their way.
text_1.不擅长交际但很真诚。: She's not great at socializing but sincere.
text_1.你在介意判断失误牵连大家的事情吗？: Are you guilty about the mistake that dragged everyone else into this mess?
text_1.友好只是那些人的伪装。: They were pretending to be friendly.
text_1.不会是我们又惹祸了吧……: Have we caused some sort of trouble again...?
text_1.你怎么穿成这样！？: Why are you dressed like that?!
text_1.你对我来说一直很重要。: You've always been important to me.
text_1.你要放弃自己拥有的一切吗？: Do you want to give up everything you have?
text_1.你还没把我的列车武装修好呢！: You haven't finished repairing my train weapon yet!
text_1.还用问？当然是跑啊！: Do you even need to ask? Run, of course!
text_1.我：还用问？当然是跑啊！: Me: Do you even need to ask? Run, of course!
text_1.没关系，好歹我们活着回来了。: No problem. At least we came back alive.
text_1.好啊，过去打个招呼吧。: Sure, let's go and say hello.
text_1.那走吧，正好我也想去看看。: Let's go then. I want to take a look too.
text_1.没事，我心里有数，来得及的。: It's fine. I know what I'm doing, and there's still time.
text_1.我想这里不会有什么危险。: I don't think there's any danger here.
text_1.事到如今，只能试一试了。反正试一试也不亏。: At this point, we can only try. It doesn't hurt to give it a shot anyway.
text_1.因为之前的乌龙吗？: Is it because of the earlier blunder?
text_1.很抱歉让你想起了伤心事……: I'm sorry for bringing up sad memories...
text_1.战力充足，就这样继续吧！: The combat strength is sufficient. Let's continue like this!
text_1.那怎么少得了我。: You can't leave me out of this.
text_1.我能看看是什么吗？: Can I see what it is?
text_1.赚钱的机会可不能放过啊！: Can't miss the opportunity to make money!
text_1.修格里的城市生活还挺刺激的。: Life in Shoggolith City is quite thrilling.
text_1.救人，把他们赶跑！: Protect her! Drive the looters away!
text_1.我会去铁安局了解的。: I'll learn more from BCRL Agency.
text_1.雅莱小姐也是汇流塔的工作人员吗？: Miss Jalhay, are you also an employee here?
text_1.你和丽桑德拉小姐很熟悉吗？: Are you and Miss Lissandra close?
text_1.我们以后还会再见面吗？: Will we meet again in the future?
text_1.你果然别有目的。: As I thought, you have a hidden agenda.
text_1.既然关乎黑月和学会两个组织，我会去的。: Fine, if it concerns both the Citadel and Night Chains.
text_1.这有什么好看的？: Why would I? It's not like it's any fun.
text_1.因为马吉拉小姐喜欢魔女？: Because Miss Margiela likes the witch?
text_1.能和黑月成员合作当然让人放心。: Sure, if it's cooperating with Night Chains members.
text_1.（蹲下看着她的眼睛）: (Squat down and look into her eyes)
text_1.有何贵干，天使大人？: What can I do for you, Master Angel?
text_1.听起来让人跃跃欲试。: Sounds like something worth diving into.
text_1.我想去看看海。: I want to go see the sea.
text_1.夹一块蟹柳寿司: Pick up a crab stick sushi.
text_1.因为客如丝投了赞助，为了让你看到然后来买。: Kerisse paid for the placement. To get you buying.
text_1.等等！这、这不太合适吧？: Wait! It doesn't fit me at all!
text_1.找到我梦中的车站！: To find the station from my dreams!
text_1.需要我调整车速吗？: Do you need me to adjust our speed?
text_1.大概是我们心有灵犀吧！: Maybe our hearts are just in sync!
text_1.卡塔斯真是始终贯彻自己的人设……: Katas really is true to her character setting...
text_1.好像有点眼熟……: She does look a little familiar...
text_1.现在只能答应了吧？: Guess we can only agree now.
text_1.确实有这么个地方……: There is such a place indeed...
text_1.不吃会死的那种。: You'll die if you don't eat it.
text_1.和打捞公司哈里弗克斯有关？: Involved with the salvage company Halifax?
text_1.要不去泡一杯红茶吧……: How about making a cup of black tea...
text_1.我们可以在贡露城玩。: We can play in Gronru City.
text_1.麻烦时萝老师再讲解一下可以吗？: Could you please explain it again, Teacher Luo?
text_1.回忆时萝给的学习资料: Study materials from Luoge when reminiscing
text_1.好啊好啊！: Sure thing! Here is the translation:"Great, great!"
text_1.他们不想失去这个改变人生的机会。: They do not want to lose this life-changing opportunity.
text_1.我的同伴是阿妮塔的研究员: My partner is a researcher of Anita.
text_1.往左前方发射鱼叉炮: Fire the harpoon cannon to the front left
text_1.我当然不想死……: Of course I don't want to die...

text_2.诶？之前去过的地方？: Huh? The place we went to before?

text_2.当然，我可是时刻关注行情的。: Of course, I always keep an eye on the market.

text_2.怎么说呢，超出想象的风格……: Hmm, how do I put it? It's quirky...

text_2.感激不尽！: I'll forever be indebted to you!

text_2.难道这是从宝琳娜·百奇那里回收的……: Was this perhaps collected from Paulina Birch...?

text_2.见到了不就知道了嘛。: Well, you'll know once you meet them.
text_2.需要我们另外做什么吗？: Is there anything else we should do?
text_2.只要付出真心就一定可以得到回报。: So long as you're genuine, your efforts will pay off.
text_2.你对此感同身受？: Do you feel any sympathy for them?

text_2.听起来这些也只是次要的原因。: Sounds like these are not the main factor.

text_2.你就打算永远躲在这里吗？: So, you plan on hiding here forever?

text_2.……就算想帮她们，也不知道能做什么。: ...Even if I want to help them, I don't know what to do.
text_2.……你确定不是什么危险的东西吗？: ...Are you sure it's not something dangerous?

text_2.唔……也是，下次来再说吧。: Hmm... that's true. Maybe next time.

des.登记在无垠号乘员档案中的照片，统一裁切为标准尺寸。: Photo submitted to the Eternal's crew archives, cropped to standard size.
des.登记在铁盟列车长档案中的照片，统一裁切为标准尺寸。: Photo submitted to the B.C.R.L. Conductors' archives, cropped to standard size.
des.由KEEP炸鸡店内设置的大头贴相机拍下的照片，捕捉了乘员面对相机的瞬间。: Photo taken in the KEEP Fried Chicken's photo booth, capturing the moment the crew looking at the camera.
des.由KEEP炸鸡店内设置的大头贴相机拍下的照片，看见自己出现在大头贴上是种奇妙的体: Photo taken in the KEEP Fried Chicken's photo booth, a peculiar experience to see oneself in a snap shot.
des.休憩时分露出可爱笑容的莉薇娅，由列车长随手记录下的一瞬间。: Livia with a cute smile during a break, candid snap by the Conductor.
des.“列车长，要不要来联机？三局两胜！输了请吃炸鸡！”: "Want to play a co-op game, Conductor? Best of three! Loser buys fried chicken!'
des.经过一处形态场扭曲地区后，莫名出现在信息终端中的图像。……难道这是某种形态的约书: After passing through a morphic field distortion area, an image mysteriously appeared on the terminal. Is this Joshua?
des.“列车长，要来这里拍张照吗？”: "Shall we take a photo here, Conductor?"
des.列车长，要来这里拍张照吗？: "Shall we take a photo here, Conductor?"
des.“三、二、一……哎？食梦貘不是这样让人睡着的？”: "On 3, 2...1! Does Yumekui knock people unconscious like this?"
des.“我今天的装扮如何呢？您……喜欢吗？”: "How do you like today's Arina? Do you... like it?"
des.“请您照着我头顶来一下吧！放心，我脑袋可结实啦！……如果如果Q版有点下不去手，就: "Please hit the top of my head! Don't worry. I'm hard-headed! ...If you can't bear striking the chibi version, try this form instead!!"
des.“哦~黑铁之主！今天要喝点什么呢？就让我咒魔……侍从的魔剑使来为您效劳吧！”: "Oh~ Lord of Black Iron! What would you like to drink today? Let me, the Juma... the Magus squire, serve you!"
des.“等您很久了，列车长。特殊委托就由骑士屋接下了。”: "I've been waiting for you, Conductor. The Knight's Hall will handle special commissions."
des.“没有其他工作了，要聊点什么？或者，你想听点什么……”: "I'm free for now. What do you want to talk about? Or is there something you want to hear...?"
des.“必须要找到重启塔的方法。众多消逝之物……”: "I must find a way to reboot the tower. Too many things are disappearing..."
des.“可是在吾故乡的夜晚呐，既看不见月亮，也看不见星星……”: "Yet in the nights of mine own native land, neither moon nor star may we behold..."
des.“车长，要不要一起去看焰火？Made by多萝西哦！”: "Conductor, wanna see some fireworks? All made by Dorothy!"
des.“要当我的乘客吗？放心在后座尖叫也没关系。”: "Do you want to be my passenger? You are free to scream your lungs out behind me as you wish."
des.“倾注耐心与爱意，精心照料，总有一天，珍藏品也会明白我的心意的吧？”: "So long as I keep pouring in patience and love and take meticulous care of it, the treasure will understand my intent someday, right?"
des.“我有时也会想穿些别的衣服。好了，过来。”: "Sometimes I may feel like trying something new. Come over here."
des.列车经停澄明数据中心时，终端中出现的影像。看起来是正在探险的索玛……: An image flashes on the terminal when the train stops at CDCA Bureau. It appears to be Sommer on an adventure...
des.“车长亲、车长亲！怎么样——嗯，从你的表情上已经得到答案啦！”: "Hey, Dear Conductor! How do you like my... Oh, never mind, I can tell by your expression!"
des.“世上没有偶然。我会来到你的身边，这是既定的未来。”: "There's no such thing as chance. I will find my way to you - it's destined."
des.“多抓了几个，送你了。”: "I've picked up a few extras. You can have them."
des.“我的名字也和玉有关。每次家具聚餐，家里的大群亲戚就会拍着我说，‘真是人如其名啊: "My name actually means something similar to jade. How do you like it, Conductor? Oh, I'm talking about my new outfit!"
des.“迷信？不对哦，这是帮你把命运掌握在自己手里，难道不好吗？”: "Superstition? That's completely wrong. It's a good thing to take your destiny into your own hands, isn't it?"
des.夏尔猛吃蛋糕的影像，摄于黛丝莉的生日餐会上。不管了，总之先吃点蛋糕吧。: An image of Shire digging in a cake, taken at Desiree's birthday party. Anyway, let's have some cake first.
des.“大姐二姐你们看这边！还有那边！还有那边！！”: "Look, sisters, over there, and there! And there, too, there!"
des.“哈哈哈哈！！无垠号上的仙人掌全部归我啦！列车长，体会被一盆植物支配的恐惧吧！”: "Hahahaha!! All the cacti on the Eternal are mine now! Experience the fear of being dominated by potted plants, Conductor!"
des.“嘎，嘎嘎，嘎嘎嘎。嘎嘎嘎嘎？嘎嘎嘎嘎嘎？”: "Quack! Quack quack, quack quack quack! Quack quack quack quack? Quack quack quack?"
des.“呃，那女人送我们的‘小熊乐园体验特饮’……应该不是什么危险的东西吧？”: "Uh, the 'Limited Edition Teddy Wonderland Drink' that woman gave us... it should be safe to consume, right?"
des.“难得的假期呢，列车长……呼，要陪我在这里一起看看海吗？”: "A well-earned holiday, isn't it, Conductor? Pfff... How about being part of the picture with me?"
des.金子，是机器人。当然，要加装，防雷模块。否则，万一被劈坏了，怎么办？: Gold, robot. Naturally, lightning protection module, need. If not, if struck, what to do?
des.安菲娅和她的伙伴和睦相处的影像。拍完之后，要加入她们吗？: A happy photograph of Anfiya and her companion. Want to join them after?
des.“前辈，要吃零食吗？黑巧克力味的。”: "Conductor, want a snack? It's dark chocolate flavored."
des.“像姐姐们一样浮上海面，对我来说还太早啦。现在，先和我一起开开心心地待在海底吧！: "It's too soon for me to float up to the surface like my sisters. Just stay with me in enjoyment at the bottom of the sea for now!"
des.“哦？这就是你们的列车长？我拿走了，想要回去的话就来找找看吧。”: "Oh? So this is your conductor? I'm taking them. If you want them back, come look for them yourself."
des.“要喝吗？来，更近一点……”: "Want a sip? Here, come even closer..."
des.“哇、哇！漂起来了！真的漂起来了啊列车长！这就是大海啊——！”: "Look! I'm actually floating, Conductor! This is -THE OCEAN!"
des.“这附近的空间稍微有点不稳定呢……不过没关系，列车长，请快过来吧！”: "The surrounding space isn't stable... But rest assured, come over to me, Conductor!"
des.“眼下的美好最终会化为回忆……希望它能够在你我二人的脑海中存留得更久一些。”: "Happiness in the present may fade away as memories... But I hope it could linger a bit longer in our minds..."
des.“我、我是伊洛娜。接下来我要弹的曲子叫做——”: "M-My name is Ilona. The song I'm going to play is called—"
des.“吾已掌握破晓圣光之力！现在即是灿阳盛放之刻！沙滩上的甘甜欲望之果实啊，接受咒魔: "I have acquired the power of Divine Dawnlight! O sweet fruits of desire on the beach, time to take Jumakenki's judgment!"
des.通过【雷索纳斯 x 三月兽mini】联动获得的特别款列车长头像（女列车长款）。是: A special Conductor avatar (female) obtained through the collaborative event between Resonance and March Monster Mini. Always a pleasure！
des.通过【雷索纳斯 x 三月兽mini】联动获得的特别款列车长头像（男列车长款）。是: A special Conductor avatar (male) obtained through the collaborative event between Resonance and March Monster Mini. Always a pleasure!
des.通过线下联动渠道获取的特别款卡塔斯头像。无论身穿女仆裙还是战袍，只需一声呼唤，咒: A special Katas avatar obtained through offline collaboration events. Whether adorned in a maid's attire or armor, Jumakenki will descend upon a mere call!
des.在沙滩上拍下的一张静流照片。为了留下美好的回忆，对镜头笑一笑吧！: A photo of Shizuru taken on the beach. Smile at the camera for great memories!
des.“嘎、哈、哈、哈！我就是整顿中心的司令，神盾系统的设计者，大名鼎鼎的帕拉笛！……: "Gah-hahaha! I'm the renowned Paladi!... Ahem, could you bring me some Citadel merchs as a gift for our first meeting?"
des.“列车长，您准备好了吗？我们要向下一站出发了。”: "Are you ready, Conductor? We're leaving for the next stop."
des.借雅莱的相机拍下的照片。由此处去，自彼方来。: A photo taken with a borrowed camera from Jalhay. Depart from here, arrive from beyond.
des.在整顿中心勤恳工作的帕拉笛，总会弄出一些常人难以理解的动静……: The diligently working Paladi always makes incomprehensible noises...
des.“魔怪糖果炸弹！！！别紧张别紧张，开玩笑的啦~不过车长要不要咬一口看看？说不定里: "Monster Candy Bomb!!! Hehe, did they hold you back? Don't worry, it's all fake - but how about taking a bite of it? Surprise inside!"
des.“要加入我们的游行吗？……可以，因为你是安菲娅的朋友。”: "Want to join our parade?... Come then, because you're Anfiya's friend."
des.“曾经有过这样一个庄园，里面居住着幸福的人们……”: "A mansion from the past, a loving place where happiness once existed."
des.“世界上真的有鬼魂吗？有的话，我还真想抓来一个。”: "Do ghosts exist in this world? If they do, I'd sure like to capture one."
des.“我的伤口？哦，这是强行将“它”填入胸膛所付出的代价……不用在意。”: "My wound? Oh, that's the price I paid for shoving "it" into my chest... Don't worry about it."
des.描绘了夏洛蒂的端庄姿态的画像。……虽然更多是可爱，不过当事人被这么说了的话似乎会: This portrait shows Charlotte in a composed... or rather, adorable pose. If she hears this, she will likely correct you with a blush.
des.“咕噜噜大冒险”修格里城投资排行前100名纪念头像。路上竟然还会遇见这样的事情啊: A commemorative avatar for the top 100 players on Shoggolith Investment in Rumbling Monopolis.
des.“咕噜噜大冒险”扭蛋中获得的头像。钱包空空，打劫不成功。: An avatar obtained from Rumbling Monopolis. An empty wallet, a disappointing sight. A failed robbery took flight.
des.“咕噜噜大冒险”扭蛋中获得的头像。列车长——您没事吧——！: An avatar obtained from Rumbling Monopolis. Are you alright, Conductor?!
des.“咕噜噜大冒险”扭蛋中获得的头像。前方的情况好像没见过呢……: An avatar obtained from Rumbling Monopolis. I don't think we've ever dealt with such a situation before...
des.描绘了妮蔻拉倨傲姿态的画像，但下角的标题却明晃晃地写着“代理所长”。无妨，对于天: Nicola with her title "Acting Director" noted. A genius does not care for mundane titles... Wait, why is she raising her weapon?!
des.于淘金大酒店试营业期间的宴会上偶然拍下的一张金子小姐照片。圆圆脑袋里盘旋着什么样: A photograph of Miss Gold, taken during the trial run of the ONEderland Hotel. What might be going through her mind in this moment?
des.“不是说要一起逛街的吗？怎么……呆在这里？那个，稍微换了身衣服……我们走吧。”: "Aren't we planning to go shopping together? Why are you... just standing here? Oh, I just wanted to try a different style... Let's go."
des.“人家最新学到了这个哦！那、那，列车长是要先吃饭、先读书，还是先——”: "I just learned this! A-hem, Conductor, what would you like to do first? Eat, read, or..."
des.佩罗塔意外闯入镜头内而拍下的一张照片。噼里啪啦球！: A photo taken when Pelota accidentally walked into the camera's view. Ballie is here!
des.“我的时间有限——那么，速战速决！”: "I don't have much time, so let's make it quick!"
des.“大家准备好了吗？现在是——STELLA时间！”: "Are you ready now? It's — STELLA TIME!"
des.描绘了达斯廷涉足险地时的英勇身姿。若前路无光，便以此身照彻黑暗。: Dustin ventures into hazardous territories. A shining beacon in the darkness when the path ahead is shrouded in darkness.
des.“每场战斗将要结束的时候，战场上唯一还活着的东西……就是蝴蝶。”: "As a battle draws to a close, the sole survivor on the battlefield... is the butterfly."
des.“好的，我这就来。今天要找什么书呢？我可以帮忙哦。”: "All right, coming. What book are you looking for today? I can help you with it."
des.异乡来客·生驹的联应卡牌影像。为了追求更遥远的未来，还要变得更加坚强。: An artwork created for Outlander Ikoma. He will strive to hone his skills for a better future.
des.异乡来客·无名的联应卡牌影像。总有一天，能够从这诅咒之中解放。: An artwork created for Outlander Mumei. One day, she will be liberated from her lingering curse.
des.“咕噜噜大冒险”扭蛋中获得的头像。对手？解决就是了。: An avatar obtained from Rumbling Monopolis. Opponents? Just get rid of them.
des.“放心吧，这间屋子里不会有其他能阻止我的人。呼——”: "Just give up. Nobody in this room can stop me... Phew..."
des.描绘了“天使”约书亚高傲表情的影像。不过是战斗这种小事，下次还是不要麻烦祂了……: Joshua the "Angel". Well, let's not bother Joshua if it's just fighting... Huh? Joshua is actually the enemy?
des.“咕噜噜大冒险”扭蛋中获得的头像。要把其他人都炸飞对吧！: An avatar obtained from Rumbling Monopolis. So, I just need to blow up everyone else, right?
des.莉薇娅在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。总觉得表情似乎有点无奈……: Livia's customized image in The Eternal Scuffle. Somehow, she looks a bit reluctant...
des.星花在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。护目镜是精髓啦！: Stella's customized image in The Eternal Scuffle. The goggles are the essence!
des.乌刹娜紧盯镜头时拍下的一张照片。要一起去玩吗，救世主大人？: A photo of Ushana staring intently at the camera. "How about playing together, Master Savior?"
des.“我吗？第一名哦。谢谢你来看我的比赛。‘很美’……是吗……”: "Me? I was the first to cross the finish line. Thanks for coming. 'Angelic'?... Thanks for the compliment."
des.“列车长——球球下次真的不会再干坏事了，让我休息一下啦——！”: "Conductor—pleaseee, Ballie won't cause any more trouble next time! Just let me rest for a bit—!"
des.阿知波在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。全力挥打！: Achiwa's customized image in The Eternal Scuffle. Full swing!
des.于域外联合活动中可获得的头像奖励。此为新生。: Avatar obtained in Mission: Uncharted. This is Rebirth.
des.罗洁尔·定格在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。在思考什么的样子……: Raziel The Reminisce's customized image in The Eternal Scuffle. She seems to be contemplating about something...
des.乌刹娜在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。像素斩！: Ushana's customized image in the Eternal Scuffle. 8-bit Chop!
des.描绘了嚎虎箱外形的画像。谁也不知道它为什么会以画像形式出现在这里，难道是从某个嚎: A picture of HowlingBox. No one knows why it appears here. Perhaps robbed from some random HowlingBox?
des.于域外联合活动中可获得的头像奖励。此为决断。: Avatar obtained in Mission: Uncharted. This is determination.
des.于域外联合活动中可获得的头像奖励。此为超越。: Avatar obtained in Mission: Uncharted. This is transcendence.
des.无需多言！超级！绚烂！霓虹！斩！: No need to say more! Brilliant! Neon! Slash!
des.此即为天使的黄金剑！将一切变为黄金……咦？乌刹娜也变成黄金了？！: This is the Angel's Golden Sword! Turning everything into gold... huh? Ushana has turned into gold too?!

des.伊洛娜在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。完全用她本人编写的程序生成并优化。: Ilona's custom character image in The Eternal Scuffle. It is entirely generated by a program she wrote herself.
des.艾略特带回来的KEEP特辣炸鸡套餐。好吃。: Eliot brought back the KEEP extra spicy fried chicken combo. Delicious.
des.静流教的潜水憋气术。噗噜噗噜噗噜……有泡泡……: Shizuru's underwater breath-holding technique. Blub blub blub... there are bubbles...
des.星花推荐的健康饮料。味道不如之前的……可乐？: Stella's recommended health drink. The taste is not as good as before... cola?
des.卡塔斯给的超级弹力泡泡糖，结果还是被吹破了。啪！: Katas gave me a super bouncy bubble gum, but it still popped. Pop!
des.“对钱的反应还真是诚实呢……不过这样我也并不讨厌！”: The reaction to money is really honest... However, I don't dislike it!
des.“来让我看看这次都捡了什么好东……欸？”: Let me see what good stuff we've collected this time... huh?
des.“往右边……相信我。”: Go to the right... trust me.
des.“好久不见！我那愚弟也是受你关照了！”: Long time no see! My foolish younger brother has also been under your care!
des.“刚刚闪了一下的是、是无垠号！！”: Just now, what flashed by was The Eternal!!
des.“你好好回答的话，这块曲奇就给你吃！”: If you answer well, you can have this cookie!
des.“哪呢哪呢？没看到啊？”: Where is it, where is it? I don't see it!
des.描绘了一位手手喵粉丝超幸福模样的画像。谢谢你，列车长大人，乌刹娜最喜欢手手喵啦！: It depicted an image of a Catopus fan looking extremely happy. Thank you, Conductor, Ushana loves Catopus the most!
des.“今天的天气很好啊，切茜娅。你要不要出去散步呢？”: Today's weather is great, Chelsea. Do you want to go for a walk?
des.“就让我一个人留在这里吧。”: Just let me stay here alone.
des.跳鼠在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。在下义不容辞！: Tobinezumi's custom image in The Eternal Scuffle. I am duty-bound!
des.约书亚在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。嘁……凡人的儿戏。: Joshua's customized image in the Eternal Scuffle. Tch... the games of mortals.
des.不知为何非常执迷于你的融合体。她的爱全然纯粹，无论来自哪个部分。: I'm not sure why she's so obsessed with your fusion. Her love is entirely pure, regardless of which part it comes from.
des.“嗯？不会出去……就待在这里。和你一起。”: Hmm? Not going out... just staying here. With you.
des.为什么这个衣服奇怪的人会在这里啊？！: Why is this strangely dressed person here?!
des.还有这个光线枪是什么回事？: And what is the deal with this light gun?
des.……虽然还是很不可思议，不过她睡着的样子也挺可爱的嘛。: Although it's still quite unbelievable, she does look pretty cute when she's asleep.
des.朵拉弥丝的荣誉称号，仅授予无垠号上（目前）吃了最多饼干之人。: The honorary title of Dolamis is only awarded to the person who has currently eaten the most cookies on The Eternal.
des.“不要动。我先把列车长的伤治好。很快的，一点也不痛……”: Don't move. I'll treat the Conductor's injury first. It will be quick and won't hurt at all...
des.嚼嚼嚼……什么？略车涨？木有看见。嚼嚼嚼……: Chew chew chew... What? Some car is increasing in price? Didn't see it. Chew chew chew...
des.我是谁？我在哪？宇宙是什么？万物又是什么？: Who am I? Where am I? What is the universe? And what are all things?
des.“你一定要跳到我身上吗！”“情况紧急谁还管那么多啊！”: Do you really have to jump on me?" "It's an emergency, who cares about all that!
des.瑞瓦在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。塔隆和科劳被迫做的。: Reeva's customized image in the Eternal Scuffle. Actually it was made by Talon and Claw forcefully.
des.“星祷节快乐！我为什么会穿成这样？这个嘛……”: "Merry Astrum Ora! Why I dress like this? Well..."
des.克洛伊在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。为了证明她的游戏技术，她摧毁了一座机台。: Chloe's customized image in the Eternal Scuffle. She destroyed a game console to prove her skills.
des.“列车长，您怎么会在这里呢？我、我吗？我正在上学的路上呀……”: "Hey, Conductor, what brings you here? M-me? I'm on my way to school..."
des.奥莉薇恩在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。即使成为像素风格，依旧专业。: Olivien's customized image in the Eternal Scuffle. Always professional, even in a 8-bit form.
des.马吉拉在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。既然是魔女，来点特别的也未尝不可吧？: Margiela's custom image in the Eternal Scuffle. For a witch, it is only fitting to have her own peculiar ways, is it not?
des.马吉拉·星仪在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。魔女的创想永无止境。: Margiela the Stargazer's customized image in the Eternal Scuffle. A witch's imagination knows no boundary.
des.真咲在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。倪克斯，要做个好孩子哦！: Masaki's cutomized image in the Eternal Scuffle. Be a good kid, Nyx!
des.斯洛卡伊在《无垠乱斗》中的自制角色形象。无需冠冕。: Slokai's customized image in the Eternal Scuffle. She has no need for a crown.

story.应这位奇妙雇主的需求，将她和那些神秘的货物运送到修格里城。: Meet the peculiar employer's request to transport her and those mysterious goods to Shoggolith City.
story.依据飞鸟小姐给予的引导地图，前往修格里城交易所卖出沿途拾取的货物。: Following Miss Songbird's map, head to Shoggolith City Trading Center to sell the goods picked up along the way.
story.既然到了新城市的铁安局，带着新乘员试着赚取赏金吧。: Since you're at a new city's BCRL Agency, try earning a bounty with the new crew.
story.收到了来自荷塞市长的邀请，前往宴会的举办地赴约。: Received Mayor Jose's invitation. Head to the banquet venue.
story.继续朝目的地出发，完成手中的订单。: Continue to the destination to complete the order.
story.帮助铁安局解决荒原上的威胁。: Help the BCRL Agency resolve the threat of the Wilderness.
story.运送蜜獾小队的成员们前往可疑信号的来源地。: Transport Team Ratel members to the source of a suspicious signal.
story.潜入名为“荒原号”的巨型移动平台寻找线索。: Infiltrate the giant mobile platform "Wilderness King" to find clues.
story.关于如何安置那两名神秘的少女，需要回程后再议。: Discuss the arrangements for the two mysterious girls after returning.
story.失去记忆的两姐妹却对一种美食念念不忘，要是能找到这个食物，也许能唤醒她们的记忆。: The two sisters who lost their memories remember a certain food. If you find it, it might trigger their memories.
story.将得到的食谱再现，告诉静流我们的发现。: Recreate the recipe you received and tell Shizuru our discovery.
story.两姐妹竟然和荒原王一起失踪了，他们能去的地方只有一个……: The two sisters disappeared with the Wilderness King. There's only one place they could have gone...
story.找到她们，将他们安全地带回来。: Find them and bring them back safely.
story.突然出现的神秘女性似乎是可以为我们解决问题的人，不妨和她谈谈。: The mysterious woman who appeared out of nowhere seems to be able to solve our problems. It might be a good idea to talk to her.
story.在曼德矿场与大家道别。: Bid farewell to everyone at Mander Mine.
story.在曼德矿场转转，寻找新的工作机会。: Walk around Mander Mine to find new job opportunities.
story.根据巴克斯特的建议，与彼得·黄谈谈。: Follow Baxter's suggestion and talk to Peter Hwang.
story.接下了彼得·黄的任务，向“淘金乐园”方向出发吧。: Accepted Peter Hwang's task. Now head toward the ONEderland.
story.大量出现的桦树生物令人十分不安……必须要突破这重重包围！: The large appearance of Chaos Remains is concerning... Must escape the encirclement!
story.短暂的合作结束后，旅程仍需继续。: After a brief cooperation, the journey continues.
story.想要解决发生在这破败乐园的异常，必须先找到她。: To resolve the anomalies at the ruined land, she must first be found.
story.既然对方主动冲过来，也只能上前应战了。: Since the opponent charged, there's no choice but to fight.
story.夏尔说黄彼得在乐园管理中心等待，去见他吧。: Shire says Peter Hwang is waiting at the land's Management center. Go meet him.
story.星花对我们面临的困境似乎有些头绪，配合她的行动也许能解决问题。: Stella seems to have some clues about the problem we are facing. Working with her may help solve the problem.
story.【红茶战争】期间，成功交易30箱【红茶】: Trade 30 crates of [Black Tea] during [Black Tea War].
story.【红茶战争】期间，成功交易60箱【红茶】: Trade 60 crates of [Black Tea] during [Black Tea War].
story.【红茶战争】期间，成功交易150箱【红茶】: Trade 150 crates of [Black Tea] during [Black Tea War].
story.公司生产了最新型号的家电，合作方等不及就想收到了。请运送37箱家电至%s。: The company has produced the latest model of home appliances, and the partner can't wait to receive it. Please transport 37 crates of Home Appliances to %s.
story.在大桥放行的时候趁机偷渡来的这些劫掠者特别烦人，请你帮忙解决他们！: Those sneaky looters who come in while the bridge is open are so annoying! We need you to kick them out!
story.公司又签下了一笔订单，大批产品需要交到买家手上。请运送40箱家电至%s。: The company has closed another order and a large batch of products needs to be delivered to the buyer. Please transport 40 crates of Home Appliances to %s.
story.请将这件重要的物品交给曼德矿场的负责人彼得·黄。考虑到潜在的运输风险以及时间紧迫: Please deliver this important item to Peter Hwang, the person in charge of Mander Mine. Considering potential transport risks and time constraints, please use the underground tunnel from the Seventh District to reach the destination. We have obtained a temporary pass for your train. Transport one package entrusted by Jose to Mander Mine.
story.拦路卡哨能挡住非法车辆却挡不住桦树生物，希望你们能清理一些。: Those roadblock posts might stop illegal vehicles, but not chaos remains. Can you clear out a few of them for us?
story.喜欢钱的人类喜欢的桦石发财树。请运送69箱桦石发财树至%s。: Chaos Money Trees popular among money-loving humans Please transport 69 crates of Chaos Money Trees to %s.
story.看不出实用性的桦石发财树。请运送29箱桦石发财树至%s。: Chaos Money Trees lacking practicality. Please transport 29 crates of Chaos Money Trees to %s.
story.看到桦石发财树摆在家里，心情都会变得更好。请运送61箱桦石发财树至%s。: Chaos Money Trees at home soothes the mood. Please transport 61 crates of Chaos Money Trees to %s.
story.利用了石墨烯制造技术生产出的电器大受好评，公司决定投入更大的成本来制造新系列产品: Graphene crafting techonology based appliances are well-received, and the company decides to invest in a new product series. Please transport 70 crates of Graphene to %s.
story.如果想要一座城市的发展能够更进一步，就不能拘泥于现有的资源，而是抓住新的机遇。请: For a city to develop further, it can't rely on existing resources alone but must seize new opportunities. Please transport 67 crates of Graphene to %s.
story.考虑到未来的发展需要，我们决定增加对石墨烯的引进量。请运送74箱石墨烯至%s。: Considering future development needs, we decide to increase the import of graphene. Please transport 74 crates of Graphene to %s.
story.获得了强大能力的深眠者一直很让我们头疼……打倒它们吧！: Those Deep Sleepers with powerful abilities always give me a headache... Take them down!
story.【红茶战争】期间，成功交易300箱【红茶】: Trade 300 crates of [Black Tea] during [Black Tea War].
story.【红茶战争】期间，成功交易600箱【红茶】: Trade 600 crates of [Black Tea] during [Black Tea War].
story.海龙桦树生物中的强大亚种出现在阿妮塔发射中心附近路段。为了保护发射中心的安全，前: A powerful CR: Marine has appeared in the Anita Launch Center area. Destroy it to protect the launch center.
story.漂亮的人工晶花是不错的礼品，虽然我个人更喜欢实用性比较强的东西……请运送69箱人: Beautiful Artificial Crystal make nice gifts, though I personally prefer more practical things... Please transport 69 crates of Artificial Crystal to %s.
story.也许会有人质疑，这里的人是否真的有闲情消费这种东西，但正因为渴望不同的事物，他们: Some may question whether people here really have the leisure to spend on such things, but precisely because they desire different things, they place unrealistic hopes on boring crafts. Please transport 55 crates of Artificial Crystal to %s.
story.在修格里城停靠，接听来自朱利安的联络。: Stop by Shoggolith City and answer the call from Julian.
story.完成朱利安委托的工作，前往铁盟哨站。: Head to BCRL Outpost and finish the task Julian entrusted to you.
story.在旅游的快乐气氛下，很多人容易冲动消费，在所谓的景点买了纪念品回去才发现是到处都: Tourists often make impulsive purchases. People buy souvenirs at attractions only to realize they are common crafts available everywhere. Please transport 23 crates of Artificial Crystal to %s.
story.电子配件到处都用得到！请运送69箱电子配件至%s。: Electronic components are used everywhere! Please transport 69 crates of Electronic Components to %s.
story.总有源源不断的工程以及采矿团队在前往淘金乐园。请运送10名乘客至曼德矿场。: There's a constant stream of engineering and mining teams heading to the ONEderland. Please transport 10 passengers to Mander Mine.
story.工程团队所配备的协助型机械工人需要前往工作场所，请运送10名乘客至曼德矿场。: Assistance robots assigned to the engineering team need to reach the work site. Please transport 10 passengers to Mander Mine.
story.现在是我升职的关键时期，要是订单出了岔子就要给客户和上司鞠躬道歉到腰酸背痛为止了: It's a critical time for my promotion. If the order goes wrong, I'll have to bow and apologize to the customers and my boss until my back hurts! Please transport 61 crates of Home Appliances to %s.
story.这可是一笔非常重要的订单，在茶水间的时候听说对方和老板还有点不可告人的秘密……请: This is a very important order. I heard in the break room that there are some secrets between the other party and the boss... Please transport 22 crates of Home Appliances to %s.
story.修格里城的红茶一直颇受好评，每天都会收到源源不断的订单。请运送55箱红茶至%s。: Black tea from Shoggolith City is always well-received, with a constant stream of orders every day. Please transport 55 crates of Black Teas to %s.
story.显然，怀塔尔德牌的红茶可找不到替代品，是不是？请运送78箱红茶至%s。: Obviously, there's no substitute for black tea, right? Please transport 78 crates of Black Teas to %s.
story.修格里城的红茶可是任何一个爱茶人士都不容错过的！请运送57箱红茶至%s。: Shoggolith City's black tea is a must-try for any tea lover! Please transport 57 crates of Black Teas to %s.
story.每产出一批新茶的时候，我们都会像这样忙个不停呢，辛苦了，请运送28箱红茶至%s。: Whenever a new batch of tea is produced, we are always busy like this. Thank you for your hard work. Please transport 28 crates of Black Teas to %s.
story.修格里城的红茶在那里向来畅销，当然，我相信我们的红茶在哪都是一样受欢迎！请运送4: Shoggolith City's black tea has always been a bestseller there. Of course, I believe our tea will be popular everywhere! Please transport 40 crates of Black Teas to %s.
story.我们收到了新的罐头食品订单，请运送60箱罐头至%s。: We received a new order for Canned Fruits. Please transport 60 crates of Canned Fruits to %s.
story.我们的罐头的密封性向来经得起考验。请运送80箱罐头至%s。: The sealing quality of our Canned Fruits is tested and proven. Please transport 80 crates of Canned Fruits to %s.
story.听说即使在大陆那头，生病的孩子也会跟他们的母亲说想吃我们的水果罐头。请运送27箱: Even on the other side of the continent, sick children ask their mothers for our canned fruits. Please transport 27 crates of Canned Fruits to %s.
story.我们用了很复杂的工艺来保证罐头的口感，哦！我不该说这个的……请运送67箱罐头至%: We use a complex process to ensure the taste of our Canned Fruits — Oops, I'm not supposed to say that... Please transport 67 crates of Canned Fruits to %s.
story.和一些脆弱的食材不同，我们的罐头非常适合列车运输，沿着铁轨所能抵达的任何地方都能: Unlike some delicate ingredients, our Canned Fruits are perfect for train transport and are available anywhere the tracks can reach! Please transport 78 crates of Canned Fruits to %s.
story.作为以工业为傲的城市，我们制造的发动机能通过铁路抵达其他城市发光发热。请运送64: As a city proud of its industry, the engines we craft can travel via rail to other cities and shine. Please transport 64 crates of Engines to %s.
story.最普通的工人也清楚我们发动机的优秀之处，当然，其研发技术一直是重要机密。请运送5: Even the most common workers know the excellence of our engines, and of course, the Tech behind their development is a closely guarded secret. Please transport 59 crates of Engines to %s.
story.让竞争对手失望是我们所擅长的，修格里城的发动机在市场中始终有着不可取代的地位。请: Disappointing competitors is what we do best. Shoggolith City's engines always have an irreplaceable position in the market. Please transport 25 crates of Engines to %s.
story.不论出于什么理由，当下的环境只有把武力握在自己手中才能安心。请运送72箱枪械至%: Whatever the reason, having military power in the current environment is the only way to feel secure. Please transport 72 crates of Firearms to %s.
story.公司与修格里城达成了合作，决定更新所属员工使用的武器。请运送73箱枪械至%s。: The company has reached a cooperation agreement with Shoggolith City and decided to upgrade the weapons used by our employees. Please transport 73 crates of Firearms to %s.
story.我的团队决定尝试一下新的装备，请运送55箱枪械至%s。: My team decided to try some new equipment. Please transport 55 crates of Firearms to %s.
story.如果不是沃德山泉煮的泡面，我的家人根本吃不下去。请运送27箱沃德山泉至%s。: If it's not noodles cooked with Ward Spring Water, my family won't eat them. Please transport 27 crates of Ward Spring Water to %s.
story.我工作的餐厅打算更换提供给客人的饮用水品牌。请运送33箱沃德山泉至%s。: The restaurant where I work plans to change the brand of drinking water provided to guests. Please transport 33 crates of Ward Spring Water to %s.
story.我工作的餐厅装修全面升级，需要新的餐具配合现在的装潢。请运送53箱高档餐具至%s: The restaurant where I work is undergoing a complete renovation and needs new tableware to match the decor. Please transport 53 crates of High-End Tablewares to %s.
story.新鲜蔬果涨价得厉害，老板打算暂且使用罐头蔬果来做沙拉。请运送64箱罐头至%s。: The price of fresh fruits and vegetables has risen sharply. The boss plans to temporarily use canned fruits and vegetables for salads. Please transport 64 crates of Canned Fruits to %s.
story.我工作的餐厅决定在免费茶水里增加红茶的选项，请运送73箱红茶至%s。: The restaurant decided to add black tea to the free tea options. Please transport 73 crates of Black Teas to %s.
story.老板终于谈下了与沃德烤鸡的合作事宜，准备在餐厅推出沃德烤鸡联动套餐。请运送66箱: The boss finally secured a collaboration with Ward Roast Chicken and plans to launch a combo meal featuring it. Please transport 66 crates of Ward Roast Chickens to %s.
story.这个罐头品牌请来了我的偶像代言，每买一箱就可以参与抽签名生写，好想要！这个罐头品: This Canned Fruits brand hired my idol as an ambassador. Every box bought enters you into a draw for signed photos. I really want one!

What a demanding guy. Let's clear this batch of inventory first! Please transport 45 crates of Aerospace Mementos to %s.
story.说到底，真的会有人喜欢带着可爱美少女偶像涂装的宇宙飞船吗……？不能细想，卖库存，: Would anyone really like a spaceship decorated with cute anime idols...? Don't overthink, clear the inventory, clear the inventory... Please transport 24 crates of Aerospace Mementos to %s.
story.为了表示对合作商的感谢，店长打算送一些对方喜欢的斑节虾作为礼物。请运送22箱斑节: As a show of gratitude for the business partner, the store manager plans to send some Penaeus as a gift. Please transport 22 crates of Penaeus to %s.

story.想不到这些坚果能在市场上取得如此亮眼的成绩，感觉只要是铁路能到达的地方，都会有它: I never thought these nuts could achieve such impressive sales. It seems they sell well anywhere the railway reaches! Please transport 61 crates of Nuts to %s.

story.本店推出的全新系列产品广受好评，取得了十分优秀的营业额，因此我们需要更多这个配方: The new series of products our store launched has been well received and achieved excellent sales, so we need more sea salt used in this formula. Please transport 30 crates of Sea Salts to %s.

story.与莉薇娅一起逛逛知识集市。: Visit the Knowledge Bazaar together with Livia.
story.与无垠号上的伙伴们一同参加游戏发布会吧。: Participate in the launch event with your crew.
story.调查莉薇娅昏迷的原因。: Investigate the cause of Livia's coma.
story.问问看学会的人知道什么，并且得想个办法进入公寓。: Ask the Citadel member for information and find a way to get into the apartment.

story.前往摆渡船诞生的荒原站，与沃斯托克一同了解核心的锚定技术。: Go to Wilderness Station where Ferryboat was born, and learn about Anchoring technology with Vostok.
story.参观工厂内部，参与内部的实验测试。: Take a tour of the factory and participate in weapon tests.
story.打倒桦树生物，找到突破包围的方法。: Defeat the incoming Chaos Remains and find a way to break out of the siege.
story.与伊利亚德交谈，挖掘一系列事件背后的真相。: Talk to Eliade to unveil the truth behind a series of events.
story.在战备工厂内找到安菲娅，寻找合适的时机与她谈话。: Find Anfiya inside the weapon factory and find the right moment to talk to her.
story.继续与安菲娅交谈，挖掘更多的线索。: Continue talking to Anfiya to gather more clues.
story.我的雇主很重视这一笔订单，所以必需得是可靠的列车长来负责这些货物。请运送41箱珍: My customer takes this order seriously. We need a reliable conductor to be in charge of these shipments. Please deliver 41 crates of Pearl to %s.
story.希望你的护卫乘员足够优秀，上次有个列车组连劫匪都打不过，我们丢了好几箱珍珠。请运: Let's hope your escort crew is good enough. Last time, the men we hired couldn't even fend off those robbers, and we lost several crates of Pearl. Please deliver 20 crates of Pearl to %s.
story.只要是有利可图的商品就值得我投入成本！请运送59箱珍珠至%s。: Any profitable products are worth the cost to me! Please deliver 59 crates of Pearl to %s.
story.我打算尽可能将珍珠的货源渠道进行垄断，请运送40箱珍珠至%s。: I'm intending to monopolize the pearl supply channel. Please deliver 40 crates of Pearl to %s.
story.说起来，我的女儿其实也很喜欢这些东西……如果把那些品质最好的寄一些过去她也会高兴: Honestly, my dear daughter actually loves these things... She'd be happy if I sent some of those best quality ones over, wouldn't she? Please deliver 30 crates of Pearl to %s.
story.这是海角城相当贵重的贸易品，每一笔订单都需要谨慎对待，请运送31箱单晶硅至%s。: These are valuable traded products in Cape City, and each shipment must be treated with caution. Please deliver 31 crates of Monocrystalline Silicon to %s.
story.只有极少数列车长有资格获得单晶硅的贸易权限，请不要辜负我们的信任，请运送62箱单: Only a select few conductors are eligible for transporting monocrystalline silicon, so don't let us down. Please deliver 62 crates of Monocrystalline Silicon to %s.
story.请务必妥善送至管理人手上，请运送54箱单晶硅至%s。: Please make sure to deliver this cargo properly. Please deliver 54 crates of Monocrystalline Silicon to %s.
story.把宴席变得豪华高档的秘诀！只需要一盘龙虾就能做到！请运送21箱大龙虾至%s。: The secret to making a banquet luxurious and upscale? All it takes is a plate of fried lobsters! Please deliver 21 crates of Lobster to %s.
story.有人说过我们的制服给人的感觉很像龙虾来着……请运送35箱大龙虾至%s。: Someone said our uniforms look like lobsters... Please deliver 35 crates of Lobster to %s.
story.龙虾非常神秘莫测，它们给人一种只要不被人吃掉就能一直活下去的感觉……请运送80箱: Lobsters are very mysterious, and they give the impression that they can live forever as long as they are not caught and eaten... Please deliver 80 crates of Lobster to %s.
story.龙虾在海角城很受欢迎哦，讲人鱼故事的动画片里还有会说话的龙虾，不知道海角城以外的: Lobsters are very popular in Cape City, and even those mermaid animations have talking lobsters. I'm not sure if anyone outside of Cape City has seen them. Please deliver 40 crates of Lobster to %s.
story.老板说我每次发布订单时的废话都太多了，但我觉得还好吧！请运送43箱大龙虾至%s。: My boss says I talk too much nonsense every time I place an order, but I don't think I'm that bad, right? Please deliver 43 crates of Lobster to %s.
story.这是我们与学社的合作事项之一，他们认为知识需要更加谨慎的保管，请运送50箱学会书: These books are included in our cooperation with the Citadel, and those scholars believe that knowledge must be stored safely. Please deliver 50 crates of Citadel Books to %s.
story.学社并不想亲自经办那些商会的手续，也许对他们来说太世俗了，请运送32箱学会书籍至: The Citadel doesn't wish to personally handle those mundane formalities. Please deliver 32 crates of Citadel Books to %s.
story.为了表示诚意，学社也送了我们几本这样的书，不过我才看了没几页就睡着了，请运送78: As a gesture of goodwill, the Citadel also sent us a few of these books, but I fell asleep within a few pages. Please deliver 78 crates of Citadel Books to %s.
story.龙骑士阿佐特老师再一次在截稿日之前失踪了！根据他在社交账号上的信息，我怀疑他去了: Once again, Dragon Knight Master Azot has gone missing before the deadline! Based on his message on his social account, I suspect he's gone to the CDCA Bureau, and I'm going to pack my luggage and go look for him. Please deliver 38 crates of Luggage to %s.
story.之前的行李箱因为装了一些不太好的东西洗不干净了，我得重新买一些以备不时之需，请运: My old luggage bags just won't wash because they were filled with some awful stuff. I've got to some new ones just in case. Please deliver 66 crates of Luggage to %s.
story.就算是我这样铁血无情的男人也会有想被大自然治愈身心的时候啊，据说那是个艾露☆茜娅: Even for someone as tough as me, there are moments when I crave for some nature therapy. Elulu Cecilia recommended a campground in a magazine, so I decided to crash there for the night. Please deliver 35 crates of Luggage to %s.
story.海角城的行李箱包物美价廉，非常受欢迎，请运送39箱行李箱包至%s。: Cape City's luggage bags are popular for their good quality and low price. Please deliver 39 crates of Luggage to %s.
story.我们决定多进一些新款的产品，请运送47箱行李箱包至%s。: We've decided to stock more new luggage bags. Please deliver 47 crates of Luggage to %s.
story.最近我的很多朋友迷上了户外运动，我决定也和大家一起尝试一下，请运送41箱户外用品: Lately, many of my friends have gotten into outdoor sports, so I've decided to give it a shot myself. Please deliver 41 crates of Outdoor Gear to %s.
story.听说有个地方出现了品质优秀的山珍，我决定亲自前往采集，作为厨师，为了食材做到这份: I heard there's a spot where you can score top-notch ingredients, so I'm heading there to gather them myself. As a chef, that's a non-negotiable! Please deliver 21 crates of Outdoor Gear to %s.
story.我最喜欢用这个牌子的户外用品啦，请运送77箱户外用品至%s。: This is my favorite brand of outdoor products. Please deliver 77 crates of Outdoor Gear to %s.
story.妈妈让我寄一些带鱼给住在其他篝火城的亲戚，请运送53箱带鱼至%s。: Mom asked me to send some Hairtail to my relatives who live in other Bonfire Cities. Please deliver 53 crates of Hairtail to %s.
story.海角城的带鱼是最好的，请运送74箱带鱼至%s。: Cape City has the best Hairtail. Please deliver 74 crates of Hairtail to %s.
story.带鱼……炸的，好吃……请运送42箱带鱼至%s。: Fried Hairtail... delicious... Please deliver 42 crates of Hairtail to %s.
story.我坚持认为只有海角城的鱿鱼最适合我的料理风格，请运送69箱鱿鱼至%s。: I insist that only Cape City's squid best suits my style of cooking. Please deliver 69 crates of Squid to %s.
story.阿佐特老师喜欢鱼，鱿鱼应该也算吧……如果我把鱿鱼放在门口，他会带着画好的原稿出现: Master Azot loves fish, so squid should do the trick, right...? If I drop off this gift at his doorstep, maybe he'll swing by with his manuscripts. I've gotta do this, or I'll get fired... Please deliver 20 crates of Squid to %s.
story.我最喜欢刷上酱汁的烧烤鱿鱼了，请运送36箱鱿鱼至%s。: My favorite is BBQ squid with sauce on it. Please deliver 36 crates of Squid to %s.
story.海角城的辣椒特别棒，我最喜欢了！可惜茜茜娅觉得太辣了，只能我一个人吃……请运送6: The chili in Cape City is especially great, my favorite! Too bad Cecilia thinks it's too spicy, and I'll have to enjoy it alone... Please deliver 67 crates of Chili to %s.
story.我实在是不太擅长吃辣，但是艾露露很喜欢，我想让她开心……请运送55箱辣椒至%s。: I'm not really into spicy food, but Eruru loves it, and I want to make her happy... Please deliver 55 crates of Chili to %s.
story.吃饭要是没有辣椒还叫吃饭吗？请运送37箱辣椒至%s。: What's a meal without chili? Please deliver 37 crates of Chili to %s.
story.我们发射中心的运送铁轨出现了断裂，情况危急，需要大量的铁轨用特种钢材修补铁路。请: We have detected Corrodes in the delivery rail at our launch center. The situation is critical, and we require a substantial quantity of special steel for railway to repair the track. Please deliver 50 crates of Special Steel for Tracks to %s.
story.列车轨道年久失修，已经严重影响通行啦，我们需要大量的钢筋混凝土轨枕修补轨道。请运: The train tracks are in poor condition, severely impacted by wear and tear. To address this issue, we urgently need a substantial quantity of reinforced concrete sleepers to repair the tracks. Please deliver 31 crates of Reinforced Concrete Sleepers to %s.
story.扩建宿舍，广纳贤才，需要更多的建材用于建造员工宿舍和食堂。请运送46箱建材至%s: We require additional building materials for the construction of the researcher's dormitory and cafeteria. Please deliver 46 crates of Building Materials to %s.
story.发射中心要建造大型观赏石头假山？不不不，我们需要大量的石材用于铺铁路。请运送47: Someone says we're gonna put up these big fancy stone wigwams at the launch center? Nah, not at all. We actually need a bunch of stone to lay down for the railroad. Please deliver 47 crates of Stone Materials to %s.
story.为了荒原地区的稳定！请在荒原站作战中心完成10个作战计划。: For the stability in the Wilderness region, please complete 10 battle plans in Wilderness Station.
story.荷塞市长已经与负责人打好招呼，前往商会通过正式流程接取他的订单。: Mayor Jose has already arranged with the person in charge. Proceed to COLUMBA to officially accept his order.
story.根据委托内容，请将行车路线调整至地下铁路。: According to the commission details, please adjust the driving route to the underground railway.
story.“鼹鼠帮”居然埋伏在地下通道中，这里没有回头路，只有前进！: The MoleGang is ambushed in the underground tunnel. There's no turning back, onwards!

story.请运送76箱日化用品至%s。: Deliver 76 boxes of Daily Care Products to %s
story.请运送42箱橄榄油至%s。: Deliver 42 boxes of Olive Oil to %s
story.请运送42箱高端护肤品至%s。: Deliver 42 boxes of Premium Skincare Products to %s
story.是时候该从过去的梦中醒来了……: It's time to wake up from dreams of the past...
story.我们公司购入了一批游戏机摆放在门店内作为试玩机，请运送76箱游戏机至%s。: Our company purchased a batch of gaming consoles to place in the store for trial. Please transport 76 crates of Gaming Consoles to %s.
story.突然出现在交易所门口的眼熟青年唐突地发起了挑战，需要考虑一下怎么应对。\\n如果: A familiar young man suddenly challenged you at the trading center entrance. Need to think about how to respond. \nUsing [Purchase Appl.] to increase the transaction of specialty products should quickly secure victory.
story.关于如何更好地利用交易所赚取资金，莉薇娅的想法是多交易一些修格里城的特产品——红: To better utilize the trading center to earn funds, Livia's idea is to trade more specialty products from Shoggolith City — Black Tea and Ward Roast Chicken.
story.根据曼德矿场交易所老板图浩的情报，两姐妹难忘的美食在KEEP炸鸡店可以找到。: According to the information from Wealt, the owner of Mander Mine trading center, the two sisters' unforgettable food can be found at KEEP Fried Chicken.
story.这一次西蒙没有出现在交易所，难不成出了什么意外？: Simon didn't appear at the trading center this time. Could something have happened?

story.往来七号自由港的列车近段时间事故频发，调查显示问题出在火箭发射基地的旧址。: Trains from and to Freeport Ⅶ have had frequent accidents recently, and investigations show the problem is at the site of the old rocket launch base.
story.桦树生物的活动严重扰乱了修格里城周遭的气象，唯有查明问题的源头才能阻止灾害进一步: Chaos Remains' activity has severely disrupted the weather around Shoggolith City. Only by identifying the source of the problem can we stop the disaster from spreading further. Head to the Observatory near the route from Shoggolith City to Freeport Ⅶ to investigate!
story.鸣爆虫母的大量繁殖引发了虫灾，铁安局迫切需要可靠的人手帮忙解决问题的源头。这就前: The mass spawning by Blastbug Matriarch has caused an swarm plague. BCRL Agency urgently needs reliable hands to deal with the source of the problem. Head to the broken bridge near the route from Shoggolith City to BCRL Outpost and clear the nest!
story.贡露城铁安局的卡莲希望你能帮她消灭巨型桦树生物魔沼之刃，清除污染的源头。: Karen of the BCRL Agency in Gronru City is hoping you can help her take down the Venom Scythe and clear out the source of the contamination.
story.就算是御宅族，也有外出的需求。请运送5名乘客至澄明数据中心。: Even homebodies need to go out. Please transport 5 passengers to the CDCA Bureau.
story.听说最近澄明数据中心开了几家品牌的快闪店……请运送5名乘客至澄明数据中心。: I've heard the CDCA Bureau has recently opened several pop-up shops... Please transport 5 passengers to the CDCA Bureau.
story.有些旅客希望瞻仰一番沿途的废墟。请运送10名乘客至澄明数据中心。: Some passengers hope to admire the ruins along the way. Please transport 10 passengers to the CDCA Bureau.
story.本天才倾注心血研发的全新产品——曼德工具箱！无论价值还是实用性都是当之无愧的完美: This genius has poured heart and soul into creating the new Mander Toolbox! It's the perfect combination of value and practicality — simply irresistible! Please procure 18 crates of Mander Toolboxes and sell them at the Trading Center in %s.
story.年轻的时候我曾经觉得在这种地方喝红茶假惺惺的，但现在看来别有一番滋味。请运送38: When I was young, I used to think drinking black tea in a place like this was pretentious, but now it's quite the experience. Please transport 38 crates of Black Teas to %s.
story.这年头不是什么地方都能吃得上新鲜水果的，这种时候罐头就是个好东西了。请运送60箱: Nowadays, not every place can offer fresh fruit, so Canned Fruits are a good option. Please transport 60 crates of Canned Fruits to %s.
story.最近在荒原驻扎的兄弟们弄……买到的一批成色不错的二手车需要更换发动机，有的事还是: Recently, my brothers stationed in the Wilderness bought a batch of decent second-hand cars needing engine replacements. Some things can't be done carelessly. Please transport 57 crates of Engines to %s.
story.用于一些你能猜到的用途，请运送25箱枪械至%s。: Guess its uses. Please transport 25 crates of Firearms to %s.
story.曼德矿场有一批工人希望回到曾工作过的地方看看……请运送10名乘客至淘金乐园。: Some workers from Mander Mine hope to return to the place they used to work... Please transport 10 passengers to ONEderland.
story.随着两地贸易关系日渐紧密，人员往来也会变得更加频繁。请运送5名乘客至修格里城。: As trade relations between the two places become closer, personnel exchanges will also become more frequent. Please transport 5 passengers to Shoggolith City.
story.看多了海边风景，或许也想去繁华的都市里逛一逛？请运送5名乘客至修格里城。: After seeing the seaside scenery, you might want to visit the bustling city. Please transport 5 passengers to Shoggolith City.
story.请把这些支援矿场的技术工人带到目的地。请运送10名乘客至曼德矿场。: Please take these technical workers supporting the mine operations to their destination. Please transport 10 passengers to Mander Mine.
story.我们的车需要经常检修，修格里城的汽配零件是最靠谱的，为此特意跑一趟采购也没什么，: Our cars need frequent maintenance. The car parts from Shoggolith City are the most reliable, so running a special trip for procurement is worth it. Please transport 70 crates of Car Parts to %s.
story.这没什么奇怪的，有人的地方就有家用电器的需求，除非他们不想解放双手。请运送76箱: This isn't surprising. Where there are people, there is a demand for household appliances unless they don't want to free their hands. Please transport 76 crates of Home Appliances to %s.
story.荒原地区可不产水果，因此我给在那里干活的兄弟们订购了点慰问品，请运送78箱罐头至: The Wilderness doesn't produce fruit, so I ordered some treats for my brothers working there. Please transport 78 crates of Canned Fruits to %s.
story.最近我们在荒原开了家分店，即使是在环境比较恶劣的地区，也要保证顾客的体验感，请运: We recently opened a branch in the Wilderness, ensuring customer experience even in harsh environments. Please transport 77 crates of High-End Tablewares to %s.

story.为什么能源研究所需要这么多高档餐具？可能是因为在那里工作的高材生们对吃饭有特殊要: Why does the Energy Research Institute need so much high-end tableware? Maybe the high achievers there have special dining requirements, and I don't quite understand... Please transport 30 crates of High-End Tablewares to %s.
story.为了给能源研究所代理所长的又研制出的一项新技术开办庆功会，研究所向修格里城订购了: To celebrate the development of a new Tech by the acting director of the Energy Research Institute, they ordered a large batch of roast chicken from Shoggolith City. Please transport 67 crates of Ward Roast Chickens to %s.

story.各类小型电器能使新开办的淘金乐园酒店变得更加舒适与便利，请运送54箱家电至%s。: Various small appliances can make the newly opened ONEderland hotel more comfortable and convenient. Please transport 54 crates of Home Appliances to %s.
story.修……破烂……请运送47箱汽配零件至%s。: Repair... Scrap... Please transport 47 boxes of car parts to %s.

But why eat Ward Roast Chicken even after traveling out of town? Is it because the ONEderland has no local delicacies? Please transport 69 crates of Ward Roast Chickens to %s.

story.觉得这个地方需要发动机很奇怪？我们可都是深入调查过才决定供货的，请放心。请运送2: Do you find it strange that this place needs engines? We have thoroughly investigated and decided to supply them, so rest assured. Please transport 28 crates of Engines to %s.
story.他们要这些总不会是想做射击游戏吧！真要是这样，说不准我女儿会感兴趣，请运送64箱: Are they planning to make a shooting game with these? If so, my daughter might be interested. Please transport 64 crates of Firearms to %s.

story.我听说这个地方是游戏公司吧，要汽配零件做什么呢……请运送75箱汽配零件至%s。: I heard this is a game company. What do they need car parts for? Please transport 75 crates of Car Parts to %s.

story.艾玛前辈把这桩订单交给我……但，我实在不明白，开发游戏的公司为什么需要这么多罐头: Senior Emma handed this order to me... but I really don't understand why a game development company needs so many Canned Fruits? Anyway. Please transport 40 crates of Canned Fruits to %s.

story.把新建造的货厢装配上去吧。: Let's deploy the newly built freight carriage.
story.要想装配新的车厢，提高运输能力，目前列车组的电力系统亟需强化。\\n\\n可以通:
The power system of your train requires reinforcement to accommodate new carriages and improve transportation capacity.

You can access the power system via [Central Control Panel] or [Train – Modify].
The Chaos Glands required for the upgrade can be obtained from the second series of eviction quests at the BCRL Agency or purchased from local store.
story.为了拉取更多的交易品提高贸易效益，建造货厢吧。\\n要是资金紧缺的话，去铁安局转:
To increase trade efficiency by hauling more goods, let's build a freight car. 
If funds are tight, check out the BCRL Agency or use [Purchase Appl.] to trade specialty products in larger quantities to quickly accumulate wealth.

Access the carriage construction menu via [Train].
story.曼德矿场的铁安局似乎积累了不少委托，去看看吧。: The BCRL Agency in Mander Mine seems to have accumulated a lot of commissions. Let's go check them out.

story.和朵拉弥丝一起做好参赛准备。: Get ready for the competition with Doraemon.
story.和朵拉弥丝一起迎接第一轮赛事。: Welcome the first round of competition together with Doraemon.
story.继续协助安菲娅测试武器吧。: Continue helping Anfiya with her weapon test.

des.使用【弃牌】指令时，每丢弃1张卡牌，释放1枚【星石】\\n【星石】对生命值最高的: When using [Discard] action, for each card discarded, release 1 [Astralite].
des.每丢弃1张卡牌，【星石】造成的伤害提高1%，上限200%: For each card discarded, [Astralite] DMG +1%, up to 200%.
des.任意我方生命值低于90%/70%/50%/30%/10%时，释放1枚【星石】，各: When any ally's HP's below 90%/70%/50%/30%/10%, release 1 [Astralite], limited 5 for each. [Astralite]: Deal Reverengy DMG once to enemy with highest HP, all allies -1000 HP.
des.每抽到3张卡牌，释放1枚【火焰陨星】，对随机敌方造成1段火焰伤害，同时触发【点燃: For every 3 cards drawn, release 1 [Flame Meteor], dealing Fire DMG once to a random enemy and inflicting [Ignite].
des.我方【护盾】每次受到攻击时，对伤害来源进行反弹，反弹伤害为【护盾】耐久的30%: When allies' [Shields] are attacked, deal DMG equal to 30% of the [Shield's] durability to the attacker.
des.我方使用3费及以上自身技能牌时移除自身2%生命值并释放1枚【秘法陨星】，对随机敌: When any ally uses a skill card of 3 Cost or more, they lose 2% of Max HP and release 1 [Arcane Meteor], dealing Reverb DMG once to a random enemy and inflicting [Erode].
des.任意1名我方生命值低于50%时，回复其50%生命值，同时抽3张牌，且能超出手牌上: When any ally has their HP fall below 50%, heal them for 50% of Max HP and draw 3 cards. Cards gained this way can exceed hand size. Release a number of [Arcane Meteors] equal to the total Cost of the drawn cards. Each [Arcane Meteor] deals Reverb DMG once to a random enemy. This effect can be triggered only once.
des.每丢弃3张卡牌，释放1枚【闪电陨星】，对随机敌方造成1段电磁伤害，同时触发【落雷: For every 3 cards discarded, release 1 [Lightning Meteor], dealing Electro DMG once to a random enemy and inflicting [Lightning].
des.每丢弃1张卡牌，随机1名我方攻击力+0.3%，上限30%: For each card discarded, increase the ATK of a random ally by 0.3%, up to 30%.
des.每【销毁】3张卡牌，释放1枚【秘法陨星】，对随机敌方造成1段混响伤害，同时回复我: For every 3 cards [Destroyed], release 1 [Arcane Meteor], dealing Reverb DMG once to a random enemy, and heal all allies for 2000 HP.
des.每生成3张卡牌，释放1枚【秘法陨星】，对随机敌方造成1段混响伤害，同时使我方全体: For every 3 cards generated, release 1 [Arcane Meteor], dealing Reverb DMG once to a random enemy, and increase all allies Max HP by 2%.
des.任意我方生命值低于20%时，我方全体【无敌】5秒，同时立刻激活【队长技】指令，限: When any ally has their HP fall below 20%, all allies gain [Invincible], lasting 5 seconds, and immediately activate [Leader Skill]. This effect can be triggered only once.
des.牌库每有1张卡牌，我方全体受到的最终伤害降低0.5%，上限50%: For each card in your deck, reduce all allies' Final DMG taken by 0.5%, up to 50%.
des.打出红卡/紫卡时，对随机敌方造成1段100%卡牌持有者已损失生命值的负能伤害: When using a Red or Purple card, deal Reverengy DMG once to a random enemy. The DMG equals 100% of the card holder's HP lost.
des.每抽到1张卡牌，【弃牌】指令冷却缩短3秒: Whenever you draw a card, [Discard] CD -3S.
des.我方全体生命值上限+10000，任意我方生命值高于/低于50%时，每秒移除/回复: Increase all allies' Max HP by 10000. When any ally's HP is above or below 50%, remove or recover their HP by 500 per second respectively.
des.每次战斗开局时，移除我方全体50%当前生命值，抽2张牌，同时使我方全体攻击力和防: At the start of battle, remove 50% of all allies' current HP, draw 2 cards, and increase all allies' ATK and DEF by 15%.
des.每丢弃1张卡牌，随机1名我方防御力+0.3%，上限30%: For each card discarded, increase a random ally's DEF by 0.3%, up to 30%.
des.每丢弃7张卡牌，生成1张【奇异火花】加入手牌并直接打出: For every 7 cards discarded, generate 1 [Strange Spark] in your hand and use it immediately.
des.使用【弃牌】指令时，生成1张【新星】加入手牌并直接打出: When using [Discard] action, generate 1 [Nova] in your hand and use it immediately.
des.敌方全体生命值+20%: Increase all enemies' Max HP by 20%.
des.获得2个同下潜策略的推力时，激活该策略共振天赋1: When gaining 2 Ascents of the same Tactic, activate Talent 1 of that Tactic.
des.获得3个同下潜策略的推力时，激活该策略共振天赋2: When gaining 3 Ascents of the same Tactic, activate Talent 2 of that Tactic.
des.我方全体造成的火焰伤害提高20%: Increase all allies' Fire DMG dealt by 20%.
des.【无休之所】所有商品价格提高20%: Increase all items' price in [Around-the-Clock] by 20%.
des.强化推力时，所需【尘埃】数量提高20%: Increase the [Dust] required for enhancing [Ascents] by 20%.
des.获得4个同下潜策略的推力时，激活该策略共振天赋3: When gaining 4 Ascents of the same Tactic, activate Talent 3 of that Tactic.
des.获得6个同下潜策略的推力时，激活该策略共振天赋4: When gaining 6 Ascents of the same Tactic, activate Talent 4 of that Tactic.
des.打出蓝卡时，基于该卡费用对随机敌方触发等量【冻结】: When using a Blue card, inflict [Chill] on a random enemy a number of times that equals to the Cost of the card.
des.使用【庇佑】后，本场战斗【庇佑】的治疗量+20%: When using [Benediction], [Benediction] healing +20% in current battle.
des.打出黄卡时，基于该卡费用对随机敌方触发等量【落雷】: When using a Yellow card, inflict [Lightning] on a random enemy a number of times that equals to the Cost of the card.
des.弃牌区每有1张卡牌，我方全体造成的最终伤害提高0.5%，上限50%: For each card in the discard pile, increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 0.5%, up to 50%.
des.每秒回复我方全体1%生命值\\n我方处于【异常】状态时，每秒额外回复1%生命值: Heal all allies for 1% of Max HP per second. When an ally is under abnormal effects, increase the healing effect by 1%.
des.任意我方每有10000点生命值，造成的最终伤害提高2%: For every 10,000 HP an ally has, increase their Final DMG dealt by 2%.
des.每生成1张卡牌，回复我方全体1000点生命值，且能超出生命值上限: Whenever a card is generated, heal all allies for 1000 HP. HP gained this way can exceed Max HP.
des.打出红卡时，基于该卡费用对随机敌方触发等量【点燃】: When using a Red card, inflict [Ignite] on a random enemy a number of times that equals to the Cost of the card.
des.使用带有【生命值回复】效果的卡牌时，使我方全体【净化】，同时对敌方全体造成20%: When using a card with healing effects, [Purge] all allies, and deal Reverengy DMG for 20% of the sum of all allies' Max HP to all enemies.
des.打出紫卡时，基于该卡费用对随机敌方触发等量【蚀灭】: When using a Purple card, inflict [Erode] on a random enemy a number of times that equals to the Cost of the card.
des.使用带有【生命值回复】效果的卡牌时，我方全体攻击力和防御力+5，上限150: When using a card with healing effects, increase all allies' ATK and DEF by 5, up to 150.
des.每拥有1个【推力】，我方全体生命值上限+10%: For each [Ascent] you have, increase all allies' Max HP by 10%.
des.任意我方生命值低于20%时，对敌方全体造成100%我方全体最大生命值之和的负能伤: When an ally's HP falls below 20%, deal Reverengy DMG that equals 100% of the sum of all allies' Max HP to all enemies, and inflict [Erode]. This effect can be triggered only once for each ally.
des.每丢弃1张卡牌，回复我方全体500点生命值，且能超出生命值上限: Whenever a card is discarded, heal all allies for 500 HP. HP gained this way can exceed Max HP.
des.我方持有【护盾】或处于【格挡】/【隐形】/【无敌】状态时，每秒回复1%生命值: When an ally has a [Shield] or is under [Block], [Invisible] or [Invincible] effect, heal them for 1% of Max HP per second.
des.使用【队长技】时，对敌方全体造成30%我方全体最大生命值之和的负能伤害，同时触发: When using a [Leader Skill], deal Reverengy DMG that equals 30% of the sum of all allies' Max HP to all enemies, and inflict [Erode].
des.使用带有【生命值回复】效果的卡牌时，我方全体生命值上限+2000: When using a card with healing effects, increase all allies' Max HP by 2000.
des.我方使用技能牌造成伤害时，额外造成30%自身最大生命值的负能伤害: When an ally deals DMG with their skill card, additionally deal Reverengy DMG that equals 30% of their Max HP.
des.每生成1个【护盾】，有30%概率释放1枚【霜冻陨星】，对随机敌方造成1段冰冻伤害: Whenever a [Shield] is generated, there is a 30% chance to release 1 [Frost Meteor], dealing Frost DMG once to a random enemy and inflicting [Chill].
des.【磐石之垣】为我方全体抵御25%伤害: [Bedrock Bastion] now absorbs 25% of all allies' DMG taken.
des.每次战斗开局时，我方全体获得【护盾】，护盾耐久为目标已损失生命值的20%，持续1: At the start of battle, all allies gain a [Shield], lasting 10 seconds. The durability equals 20% of their HP lost.
des.我方【护盾】消失或引爆时，有30%概率生成1张【新星】加入手牌并直接打出: When allies' [Shields] vanish or are detonated, there is a 30% chance to generate 1 [Nova] in your hand and use it immediately.
des.我方【护盾】解除时间限制: Allies' [Shields] no longer have time limits.
des.打出绿卡时，基于该卡费用对随机敌方触发等量【炽地】\\n丢弃绿卡时，基于该卡费用: When using a Green card, inflict [Blaze] on a random enemy a number of times that equals to the Cost of the card.\nWhen discarding a Green card, inflict [Thunder] on a random enemy a number of times that equals to the Cost of the card.
des.每次战斗开局时，移除我方全体10%当前生命值并转化为双倍量耐久的【护盾】，持续2: At the start of battle, all allies lose 10% of current HP and gain a [Shield], lasting 20 seconds. The durability equals 20% of their current HP.
des.使用【队长技】时，回复我方全体5000点生命值，且能超出生命值上限: When using a [Leader Skill], heal all allies for 5000 HP. HP gained this way can exceed Max HP.
des.我方持有【护盾】时，造成的最终伤害提高15%: When an ally has a [Shield], increase their Final DMG dealt by 15%.
des.任意我方获得【护盾】时，回复3%生命值，同时获得0.15点费用: When an ally gains a [Shield], heal them for 3% of Max HP, and gain 0.15 Cost.
des.使用【弃牌】指令时，使我方前排获得【护盾】，护盾耐久为目标生命值上限的20%，持: When using [Discard] action, frontline allies gain a [Shield], lasting 10 seconds. The durability equals 20% of their Max HP.
des.我方持有【护盾】时，受到的最终伤害降低15%: When an ally has a [Shield], reduce their Final DMG taken by 15%.
des.每拥有1个【推力】，我方全体攻击力+15: For each [Ascent] you have, increase all allies' ATK by 15.
des.我方处于【无敌】状态时，每秒对随机敌方造成1段100%当前【负压】的负能伤害: When an ally is [Invincible], deal Reverengy DMG once per second for 100% of current [Subpressure].
des.任意我方生命值低于20%时，消耗20000点【负压】使随机1名我方【无敌】，持续: When an ally's HP's below 20%, -20000 [Subpressure], grant [Invincible] to a random ally, lasting 2S. CD 6S. Won't trigger when [Subpressure] is insufficient.
des.任意我方濒死时，消耗50%【负压】获得等量耐久的【负能护盾】，触发间隔12秒\\: Whenever an ally takes lethal DMG, convert 50% [Subpressure] to a [Reverengy Shield] for all allies. CD 12S. When the shield vanishes, deal Reverengy DMG for 500% of current [Subpressure] to all enemies.
des.每拥有1个【推力】，我方全体防御力+15: For each [Ascent] you have, increase all allies' DEF by 15.
des.使用【队长技】时，使生命值最低的1名我方获得【护盾】，护盾耐久为目标生命值上限的: When using a [Leader Skill], grant a [Shield] to the ally with the lowest HP, lasting 10 seconds. The durability equals 10% of their Max HP.
des.打出蓝卡时，我方全体攻击力+0.5%: When using a Blue card, increase all allies' ATK by 0.5%.
des.任意我方生命值低于50%时，获得【护盾】，护盾耐久为目标生命值上限的20%，持续: When an ally's HP falls below 50%, grant them a [Shield], lasting 10 seconds. The durability equals 20% of their Max HP. This effect can be triggered only once for each ally.
des.打出红卡时，我方全体防御力+0.5%: When using a Red card, increase all allies' DEF by 0.5%.
des.【识海下潜】开始时，可招募队员数量+1: You can enlist 1 more member at the start of diving.
des.每累计使用卡牌消耗3点费用，释放1枚【溶蚀弹】，对随机敌方造成1段负能伤害，同时: Whenever you consume 3 Cost in total by using cards, release 1 [Lysiorb], dealing Reverengy DMG once to a random enemy, and inflict [Erode].
des.每获得5张卡牌，释放【原初之火】，对敌方全体造成1段火焰伤害，同时触发【炽地】: Whenever you gain 5 cards, unleash [Primordial Flame], dealing Fire DMG once to all enemies, and inflict [Blaze].
des.弃牌区每增加5张卡牌，释放【辟天之雷】，对敌方全体造成1段电磁伤害，同时触发【轰: Whenever 5 cards enter the discard pile, unleash [Genesis Bolt], dealing Electro DMG once to all enemies, and inflict [Thunder].
des.牌库每减少5张卡牌，释放【亘古之冰】，对敌方全体造成1段冰冻伤害，同时触发【冻伤: Whenever 5 cards leave the deck, unleash [Aeon Ice], dealing Frost DMG once to all enemies, and inflict [Frostbite].
des.每次牌库抽光触发洗牌时，抽3张牌，且能超出手牌上限，基于抽到卡牌费用之和释放等量: When shuffling the deck, draw 3 cards, can exceed hand size. Release a number of [Lysiorbs] that equals the total Cost of the drawn cards, each dealing Reverengy DMG once and inflicting [Heartblaze] and [Erode].
des.费用上限+1，开局获得1点费用: Increase max Cost by 1, and gain 1 Cost at the start of battle.
des.打出黄卡时，获得0.3点费用: When using a Yellow card, gain 0.3 Cost.
des.所有红卡所需费用+1，红卡造成的伤害提高50%，得意技能牌除外: Increase the Cost of all Red cards by 1 and their DMG dealt by 50%. Ultimate cards are excluded.
des.衍生卡所需费用+1，使用/丢弃时获得0.5点费用: Increase the Cost of Derivative cards by 1, and gain 0.5 Cost when using or discarding them.
des.每次牌库抽光触发洗牌时，获得1点费用: Whenever the deck is emptied and triggers a reshuffle, gain 1 Cost.
des.每丢弃1张卡牌，获得0.1点费用: Whenever a card is discarded, gain 0.1 Cost.
des.打出红卡时，每拥有1点费用，造成的伤害提高3%: When using a Red card, increase its DMG dealt by 3% for every 1 Cost you have.
des.每累计使用卡牌消耗9点费用，抽1张牌: Whenever you consume 9 Cost in total by using cards, draw 1 card.
des.手牌达到7张时，立即刷新【弃牌】指令: Active [Discard] action when you have 7 cards in hand.
des.每累计使用卡牌消耗9点费用，我方全体攻击力+1%: Whenever you consume 9 Cost in total by using cards, increase all allies' ATK by 1%.
des.每使用1张卡牌，获得0.1点费用: Whenever using a card, gain 0.1 Cost.
des.每拥有1个【推力】，每秒获得0.02点费用: For each [Ascent] you have, gain 0.02 Cost per second.
des.我方造成【打断】/【击晕】/【击退】/【击飞】/【弹射】/【破盾】/【斩裂】/【: Whenever allies inflict [Interrupt], [Stun], [Knockback], [Launch], [Ricochet], [Break], [Slash], [Rend], [Scorch], [Corrupt] or [Injure], gain 0.05 Cost.
des.手牌上限+1，开局抽1张牌: Increase hand size by 1, and draw 1 card at the start of battle.
des.开局消耗所有费用，每消耗1点费用，使我方全体造成的最终伤害提高2%: Consume all Cost at the start of battle. For every 1 Cost consumed, increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 2%.

des.【识海下潜】的行动回合上限+1: You gain 1 more Action Point in the diving.
des.我方全体生命值+3000: Increase all allies' Max HP by 3000.
des.我方全体生命值+5000: Increase all allies' Max HP by 5000.

des.我方全体造成的物理伤害提高20%: Increase all allies' Physical DMG dealt by 20%.
