des.【识海下潜】开始时，获得【直觉·渡越】: Gain [INT·Stride] at the start of diving.
des.【识海下潜】开始时，获得50点【尘埃】: Gain 50 [Dust] at the start of diving.
des.手牌补充冷却时间缩短0.5秒: Your hand cards replenish 0.5 seconds faster.
des.我方生命值比率越低，造成/受到的最终伤害越高/越低，最高40%: The lower all allies' HP percentage, the more Final DMG dealt and the less Final DMG taken, up to 40%.
des.我方每持有1个【护盾】，每秒获得0.03点费用: For each [Shield] allies have, gain 0.03 Cost per second.
des.任意我方获得【护盾】时，防御力+0.5%: When an ally gains a [Shield], increase their DEF by 0.5%.
des.任意我方获得【护盾】时，攻击力+0.5%: When an ally gains a [Shield], increase their ATK by 0.5%.
des.【弃牌】指令冷却时间缩短2秒: Reduce the cooldown of [Discard] action by 2 seconds.
des.敌方全体造成的最终伤害提高20%: Increase all enemies' Final DMG dealt by 20%.
des.敌方全体受到的最终伤害降低20%: Reduce all enemies' Final DMG taken by 20%.
des.与【位面奇点】战斗时，我方开局【队长技】无法使用，持续20秒: During the battle with [Singularity], disable [Leader Skill] in the first 20 seconds of the battle.
des.敌方全体【普通攻击】攻击速度+50%: Increase all enemies' [Basic Attack] speed by 50%.
des.禁用【弃牌】指令，同时手牌补充冷却时间增加1秒: Disable the [Discard] command, and your hand cards replenish 1 second slower.
des.每6秒触发1次，使敌方全体回复2%生命值: Heal all enemies for 2% of Max HP every 6 seconds.
des.开局失去5点费用: Lose 5 Cost at the start of battle.
des.开局敌方全体【霸体】，持续20秒: All enemies gain [Hyperarmor] at the start of battle, lasting 20 seconds.
des.每次使用【队长技】后，减少2点费用: When using a [Leader Skill], lose 2 Cost.
des.禁用【队员复苏】功能，同时我方全体生命值上限-20%: Disable [Member Reviving], and reduce all allies' Max HP by 20%.
des.使用【队长技】时，获得0.5点费用: When using a [Leader Skill], gain 0.5 Cost.

intensifyDes.每抽到2张卡牌，释放1枚【火焰陨星】，对随机敌方造成1段火焰伤害，同时触发【点燃: For every 2 cards drawn, release 1 [Flame Meteor], dealing Fire DMG once to a random enemy and inflicting [Ignite].
intensifyDes.我方【护盾】每次受到攻击时，对伤害来源进行反弹，反弹伤害为【护盾】耐久的50%: When allies' [Shields] are attacked, deal DMG equal to 50% of the [Shield's] durability to the attacker.
intensifyDes.我方使用2费及以上自身技能牌时移除自身2%生命值并释放1枚【秘法陨星】，对随机敌: When any ally uses a skill card of 2 Cost or more, they lose 2% of Max HP and release 1 [Arcane Meteor], dealing Reverb DMG once to a random enemy and inflicting [Erode].
intensifyDes.任意我方生命值低于50%时，回复其100%生命值，且能超出生命值上限，同时抽5张: When any ally has their HP fall below 50%, heal them for 100% of Max HP and draw 3 cards. Cards gained this way can exceed hand size, and healed HP can exceed Max HP. Release a number of [Arcane Meteors] equal to the total Cost of the drawn cards. Each [Arcane Meteor] deals Reverb DMG once to a random enemy. This effect can be triggered only once.
intensifyDes.每丢弃2张卡牌，释放1枚【闪电陨星】，对随机敌方造成1段电磁伤害，同时触发【落雷: For every 2 cards discarded, release 1 [Lightning Meteor], dealing Electro DMG once to a random enemy and inflicting [Lightning].
intensifyDes.每丢弃1张卡牌，随机1名我方攻击力+0.5%，上限50%: For each card discarded, increase the ATK of a random ally by 0.5%, up to 50%.
intensifyDes.每【销毁】2张卡牌，释放1枚【秘法陨星】，对随机敌方造成1段混响伤害，同时回复我: For every 2 cards [Destroyed], release 1 [Arcane Meteor], dealing Reverb DMG once to a random enemy, and heal all allies for 2000 HP.
intensifyDes.每生成2张卡牌，释放1枚【秘法陨星】，对随机敌方造成1段混响伤害，同时使我方全体: For every 2 cards generated, release 1 [Arcane Meteor], dealing Reverb DMG once to a random enemy, and increase all allies Max HP by 2%.
intensifyDes.任意我方生命值低于20%时，我方全体【无敌】10秒，同时立刻激活【队长技】和【弃: When any ally has their HP fall below 20%, all allies gain [Invincible], lasting 10 seconds, and immediately activate [Leader Skill] and [Discard] action. This effect can be triggered only once.
intensifyDes.牌库每有1张卡牌，我方全体受到的最终伤害降低1%，上限50%: For each card in your deck, reduce all allies' Final DMG taken by 1%, up to 50%.
intensifyDes.打出红卡/紫卡时，对随机敌方造成1段200%卡牌持有者已损失生命值的负能伤害: When using a Red or Purple card, deal Reverengy DMG once to a random enemy. The DMG equals 200% of the card holder's HP lost.
intensifyDes.我方全体生命值上限+16000，任意我方生命值高于/低于50%时，每秒移除/回复: Increase all allies' Max HP by 16000. When any ally's HP is above or below 50%, remove or recover their HP by 800 per second respectively.
intensifyDes.每次战斗开局时，移除我方全体50%当前生命值，抽3张牌，同时使我方全体攻击力和防: At the start of battle, remove 50% of all allies' current HP, draw 3 cards, and increase all allies' ATK and DEF by 25%.
intensifyDes.每丢弃1张卡牌，随机1名我方防御力+0.5%，上限50%: For each card discarded, increase a random ally's DEF by 0.5%, up to 50%.
intensifyDes.每丢弃5张卡牌，生成1张【奇异火花】加入手牌并直接打出: For every 5 cards discarded, generate 1 [Strange Spark] in your hand and use it immediately.
intensifyDes.使用【弃牌】指令时，生成1张【超新星】加入手牌并直接打出: When using [Discard] action, generate 1 [Supernova] in your hand and use it immediately.
intensifyDes.打出或丢弃蓝卡时，基于该卡费用对随机敌方触发等量【冻结】: When using or discarding a Blue card, inflict [Chill] on a random enemy a number of times that equals to the Cost of the card.
intensifyDes.打出或丢弃黄卡时，基于该卡费用对随机敌方触发等量【落雷】: When using or discarding a Yellow card, inflict [Lightning] on a random enemy a number of times that equals to the Cost of the card.
intensifyDes.弃牌区每有1张卡牌，我方全体造成的最终伤害提高1%，上限50%: For each card in the discard pile, increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 1%, up to 50%.
intensifyDes.每秒回复我方全体1.5%生命值\\n我方处于【异常】状态时，每秒额外回复1.5%: Heal all allies for 1.5% of Max HP per second. When an ally is under abnormal effects, increase the healing effect by 1.5%.
intensifyDes.任意我方每有10000点生命值，造成的最终伤害提高3%: For every 10,000 HP an ally has, increase their Final DMG dealt by 3%.
intensifyDes.每生成1张卡牌，回复我方全体1500点生命值，且能超出生命值上限: Whenever a card is generated, heal all allies for 1500 HP. HP gained this way can exceed Max HP.

intensifyDes.打出或丢弃紫卡时，基于该卡费用对随机敌方触发等量【蚀灭】: When using or discarding a Purple card, inflict [Erode] on a random enemy a number of times that equals to the Cost of the card.

intensifyDes.每拥有1个【推力】，我方全体生命值上限+15%: For each [Ascent] you have, increase all allies' Max HP by 15%.

intensifyDes.使用【队长技】时，对敌方全体造成50%我方全体最大生命值之和的负能伤害 ，同时触: When using a [Leader Skill], deal Reverengy DMG that equals 50% of the sum of all allies' Max HP to all enemies, and inflict [Erode].

des.连续进入3次同色方块时，获得1个随机金色【推力】: When you enter 3 tiles of the same color consecutively, gain 1 random Golden [Ascent].
des.每次获得黑色【蕴念骰子】时，获得1个随机金色【蕴念骰子】: Whenever you gain 1 Black [Dice], gain 1 random Golden [Dice].
des.转动魔方时，有25%概率获得1个随机【蕴念骰子】: When you rotate the Cube, there's a 25% chance to gain 1 random [Dice].
des.转动魔方时，有25%概率强化1个随机【推力】: When you rotate the Cube, there's a 25% chance to enhance 1 random [Ascent].
des.每次获得【灵感】时，我方全体等级+3: Whenever you gain 1 [Inspiration], all allies level up 3 times.
des.每次战斗开局时，立刻激活【队长技】: At the start of battle, immediately activate [Leader Skill].
des.每次获得橙色【蕴念骰子】时，强化1个随机【推力】: Whenever you gain 1 Orange [Dice], enhance 1 random [Ascent].
des.转动魔方时，获得20点【尘埃】: When you rotate the Cube, gain 20 [Dust].
des.连续进入2次紫色方块时，有50%概率强化1个随机蓝色【推力】: When you enter 2 Purple tiles consecutively, there's a 50% chance to enhance 1 random Blue [Ascent].
des.每回合开始时，获得当前【尘埃】数量的5%: At the start of each turn, gain 5% of your current [Dust].
des.【尘埃】数量≥150时，每次战斗开局获得1点费用，同时抽1张牌，优先得意技能牌: When you have at least 150 [Dust], gain 1 Cost and draw 1 card at the start of each battle, prioritizing Ultimate cards.
des.【无休之所】所有商品价格降低10%: Reduce all items' price in [Around-the-Clock] by 10%.
des.战斗事件获得的【尘埃】数量提高40%，非战斗事件获得的【尘埃】数量降低20%: Battle events grant 40% more [Dust]. Non-battle events grant 20% less [Dust].
des.每回合开始时，获得10~30点【尘埃】，生效3次后该骰子损毁: At the start of each turn, gain 10-30 [Dust]. Destroy this Dice after 3 activations.
des.每回合开始时，获得当前位面已行动回合数双倍量的【尘埃】: At the start of each turn, gain [Dust] equal to twice the number of completed turns in the current Plane.
des.每次进入黄色方块时，获得当前【尘埃】数量的5%: Whenever you enter a Yellow tile, gain 5% of your current [Dust].
des.强化推力时，所需【尘埃】数量降低10%: When you enhance an [Ascent], reduce the [Dust] required by 10%.
des.每次进入紫色方块时，获得5点【尘埃】: Whenever you enter a Purple tile, gain 5 [Dust].
des.每次获得金色【蕴念骰子】时，强化1个随机【推力】: Whenever you gain 1 Golden [Dice], enhance 1 random [Ascent].
des.战斗胜利后，额外获得5点【尘埃】: When you win a battle, gain 5 more [Dust].
des.停留在角块时，我方全体造成的伤害提高20%: When you stay on a corner tile, increase all allies' DMG dealt by 20%.
des.所有位面的行动回合上限-2: All Planes have 2 less Action Points.
des.敌我双方全体造成的治疗效果降低50%，同时敌我双方防御力-50: All units on the field deal 50% less healing and have DEF reduced by 50.
des.每12秒触发1次胎动，移除我方队长10%生命值并生成1张【负能】加入手牌: Trigger a fetal movement every 12 seconds, causing your leader to lose 10% of Max HP and generating 1 [Reverengy] in you hand.
des.每回合开始时，我方全体所有概率触发机制概率±5~10%: At the start of each turn, allies get a 5-10% increased or decreased chance to trigger all effects.
des.每次战斗开局时，我方全体随机触发【攻击力+50，防御力-50】/【防御力+50，: At the start of battle, all allies randomly have [ATK increase by 50, DEF decrease by 50], or [ATK decrease by 50, DEF increase by 50]. Destroy this Dice after 3 activations.
des.每次战斗开局时，随机丢弃1~3张手牌并生成等量的【负能】加入牌库，生效3次后该骰: At the start of battle, randomly discard 1-3 hand cards and generate an equal amount of [Reverengy] in your deck. Destroy this Dice after 3 activations.
des.每次战斗开局时，失去2点费用并生成1张【负能】加入手牌，生效3次后该骰子损毁: At the start of battle, lose 2 Cost and generate 1 [Reverengy] in your hand. Destroy this Dice after 3 activations.
des.每次战斗开局时，移除我方全体10%生命值，生效3次后该骰子损毁: At the start of battle, all allies lose 10% of Max HP. Destroy this Dice after 3 activations.
des.每回合开始时，我方全体防御力-10: At the start of each turn, reduce all allies' DEF by 10.
des.每回合开始时，失去10点【尘埃】: At the start of each turn, lose 10 [Dust].
des.每次战斗开局时的生命值越低，造成的最终伤害越高: The lower the HP at the start of battle, the higher the Final DMG dealt.
des.手牌数量≤1时，抽1张牌，基于该卡费用抽取等量的卡牌，且能超出手牌上限，每场战斗: When you have only 1 hand card or no hand cards, draw 1 card, and draw a number of cards equal to the Cost of that card. Cards gained this way can exceed hand size. This effect can be triggered only once a battle.
des.每次进入橙色方块时，我方全体攻击力+10: Whenever you enter an Orange tile, increase all allies' ATK by 10.
des.连续进入2次红色方块时，我方全体造成的最终伤害提高2%: When you enter 2 Red tiles consecutively, increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 2%.
des.停留在中心块时，我方全体造成/受到的伤害提高/降低20%（魔方的中心位置的地块）: When you stay on the central tile, increase all allies' DMG dealt by 20% and reduce DMG taken by 20%.
des.任意我方濒死时，【无敌】5秒，各限1次\r我方处于【无敌】状态时，每秒攻击力和防: When an ally takes lethal DMG, grant them [Invincible], lasting 5 seconds. This effect can be triggered only once for each ally. When an ally is [Invincible], increase their ATK and DEF by 2 per second.
des.\"每次战斗开局时，我方全体获得【护盾】，持续至战斗结束\\n\r【护盾】耐久为: At the start of battle, all allies gain a [Shield], lasting until the end of the battle. The durability equals 30% of their HP.
des.每回合开始时，回复我方全体5%生命值: At the start of each turn, heal all allies for 5% of Max HP.
des.每次战斗开局时，我方全体攻击力+20%，生效3次后该骰子损毁: At the start of battle, increase all allies' ATK by 20%. Destroy this Dice after 3 activations.
des.每次战斗开局时，获得5点费用，生效3次后该骰子损毁: At the start of battle, gain 5 Cost. Destroy this Dice after 3 activations.
des.每次进入绿色方块时，我方全体生命值上限+2000: Whenever you enter a Green tile, increase all allies' Max HP by 2000.
des.连续进入2次蓝色方块时，我方全体受到的最终伤害降低1%: When you enter 2 Blue tiles consecutively, reduce all allies' Final DMG taken by 1%.
des.每次战斗开局时，我方全体防御力+20%，生效3次后该骰子损毁: At the start of battle, increase all allies' DEF by 20%. Destroy this Dice after 3 activations.
des.每次战斗开局时，回复我方全体10%生命值，生效3次后该骰子损毁: At the start of battle, heal all allies for 10% of Max HP. Destroy this Dice after 3 activations.
des.每次进入蓝色方块时，我方全体防御力+10: Whenever you enter a Blue tile, increase all allies' DEF by 10.
des.停留在棱块时，我方全体受到的伤害降低20%: When you stay on an edge tile, reduce all allies' DMG taken by 20%.
des.每失去1点【尘埃】，我方全体造成的最终伤害提高0.05%: Whenever you lose 1 [Dust], increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 0.05%.
des.每失去1点【尘埃】，我方全体受到的最终伤害降低0.05%: Whenever you lose 1 [Dust], reduce all allies' Final DMG taken by 0.05%.
des.每拥有1点【尘埃】，我方全体造成的最终伤害提高0.05%: For each 1 [Dust] you have, increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 0.05%.
des.每回合开始时，失去30点【尘埃】，我方全体攻击力+10: At the start of each turn, lose 30 [Dust], and increase all allies' ATK by 10.
des.每拥有1点【尘埃】，我方全体受到的最终伤害降低0.05%: For each 1 [Dust] you have, reduce all allies' Final DMG taken by 0.05%.
des.位于第三位面时，我方全体等级+10: When you're on [Connotation Plane], all allies level up 10 times.
des.每次战斗开局时，立刻激活【弃牌】指令: At the start of battle, immediately activate the [Discard] action.
des.战斗胜利后，我方全体攻击力+10: When you win a battle, increase all allies' ATK by 10.
des.战斗胜利后，我方全体防御力+10: When you win a battle, increase all allies' DEF by 10.
des.战斗胜利后，回复我方全体5%生命值: When you win a battle, heal all allies' for 5% of Max HP.
des.基于当前位面进入黄色方块的次数，与【位面奇点】战斗开局时获得等量费用: For each Yellow tile you've entered in the current Plane, gain 1 Cost at the start of [Singularity] battle.
des.转动魔方时，有50%概率获得1个随机【推力】: When you rotate the Cube, there's a 50% chance to gain 1 random [Ascent].

bookDes.看来这里需要一名更加称职的图书管理员。: It seems that a more competent librarian is needed here.
bookDes.做向光的飞蛾，或是举着灯的人。: Be a moth drawn to the light, or the one holding the lamp.
bookDes.一只右手，代表平等、给予和互助的法则。: A right hand, representing the laws of equality, giving, and mutual aid.
bookDes.“我于遥远之地歌唱，我正呼唤着……让我的手成为山的臂膀，让我的枝桠成为我的歌。”: "In a distant land, I sing, I call... Let my hands become the arms of the mountain, let my branches become a song."
bookDes.向喷泉中投下什么的话，愿望就能实现了吗？: If you throw something into the lake, will your wish come true?
bookDes.“让我愿望成真，让我回到故乡”。: "Make my wish come true; let me return to my hometown."
bookDes.无论怎么敲也不会有人来为你打开的一扇门。: A door that no one will come to open for you, no matter how much you knock.
bookDes.“你好！我是你的昴昴朋友，有什么需要吗？”: "Hello! I'm your Tauree friend. What do you need?"
bookDes.这就是全自动化的魅力啊！: This is the charm of full automation!
bookDes.有了合适的设计，才有完美的成果。: Only with the right design can there be perfect results.
bookDes.如果是在一个不必受形态污染影响的城市里……: If it were in a city that was not affected by Morphic Field Pollution...
bookDes.一只左手，代表交换、奉献和获得的法则。: A right hand, representing laws of exchange, contribution, and gain.
bookDes.“来，换件新衣服改善一下心情吧！”: "Come on, put on some new clothes to lift your spirits!"
bookDes.什么样的基石筑成了这座塔？: What is this tower made of?
bookDes.开箱即得。: Open the box, claim the rewards.
bookDes.不想被吞下去的话应该赶紧跑吧？: Guess you should run if you don't want to be swallowed.
bookDes.为你奏响这支乐曲，无论多少次……: I play this melody for you, no matter how many times...
bookDes.空间的模拟或是微缩。: A simulation or miniaturization of the space.
bookDes.在台球规则中，这是一次决胜球。: In billiards rules, this is a ball that determines victory.
bookDes.拾级而上，将视野逆转。: Ascend step by step, and invert your view.
bookDes.真的要相信脸也不愿意露的人吗……: Do you really have to believe someone who won't even show their face...?
bookDes.你有没有觉得眼睛不太舒服？: Do your eyes feel a bit uncomfortable?
bookDes.空间的闭锁或是解放。: The enclosure or liberation of the space.
bookDes.空间的映像或是本像。: A reflection of space, or its true form.
bookDes.一个选择。一个关于你、他，以及余下的一切的选择。: A choice. A choice about you, him, and everything else.
bookDes.还有什么能比光明和学识更让人安心呢？: What could be more reassuring than light and knowledge?
bookDes.多存多取，诚信经济！: Deposit more, withdraw more, integrity economy!
bookDes.电闪雷鸣这种词，应该不是用来形容人的吧？: Can I even describe a person as a "thunderstorm"?
bookDes.选择她的名字，选择她的意识，选择她的躯体。: Choose her name, choose her mind, choose her body.
bookDes.又是最熟悉的昴宿机器人——等等，你说小星星机器人是什么意思？: It's that most familiar Tauri robot again — wait, what do you mean by the Stars robot?
bookDes.只要虔诚许愿，你的愿望就将得到回应。这是每个帝国居民的期许，亦是审判庭的承诺。: As long as you make a sincere wish, your wish will be answered. This is the expectation of every resident of the Empire, and also the promise of the Tribunal.
bookDes.即使化为非人之躯，亦会坚守心中火焰。: Even if transformed into a nonhuman body, he shall guard the flame in his heart.

des.雪花捎来消息，在寒霜的彼端，那恐怖之物已然降临。: The snowflakes tell a story. The abomination has descended. On the land, across the mist of frost.
des.在瞬息万变的空间之中，过往以并不友好的方式浮现。: In the rapidly changing space, the past emerges in an unfriendly manner.
des.书架没有倒塌或被碰撞的痕迹，但本该待在架子上的的书籍却乱七八糟地堆放散落在地上。: There are no signs of the bookshelf collapsing or being bumped, but the books that should have been on the shelf are piled messily and scattered on the floor. Perhaps a librarian is needed here... or maybe a reader?
des.这只漂浮着的指引机器人正悬停在半空，处于等待指令的状态。只需命令其“跟随”或“引: The floating guidance robot is hovering in mid-air, in a waiting status. Simply command it to "follow" or "lead," and it will take the corresponding action.
des.前方转角处透出明亮的灯光，不知为何令人感到十分亲切……甚至让人感觉像是“家”。但: Bright light shines from the corner ahead, for some reason making you feel very familiar... even giving a feeling of being "home." But why is there such warm lighting in this kind of space?
des.在林立的书架之间徘徊着一个半透明的身影……从着装风格看来，似乎是隶属于索思学会的: Between the towering bookshelves, a translucent figure wanders... It seems to be someone from Source Citadel. But strangely, you cannot see her appearance clearly. There's only a faint sense of nostalgia, as if you've seen this scene long ago.
des.钢铁的右臂从墙壁中深处，手臂的表面布满了划痕和凹痕，手掌向上摊开微微晃动，似乎在: A steel right arm protrudes from the wall, its surface covered with scratches and dents. The palm is open and slightly shaking, as if waiting for something — perhaps a weapon, an important object, or a person's hand.
des.周围并没有水，却能听到淙淙水声。你循着声音找过去，发现是一块巨大的奇妙石头。它似: You hear the gurgling sound of running water, yet there is no water in sight. Following the sound, you stumble upon a massive, wondrous rock. It seems to weave an unparalleled exquisite melody from all manner of natural sounds. You can't help but pause and linger, lost in its tune.
des.越是接近这个流淌的水池，你心中的疑惑就越是增加。为什么这样的地方会出现一个精致的: The closer you get to this lake, the more your doubts increase. Why would such a place have an exquisite lake? Why does it seem to be glowing? And why is there a hastily written note next to it saying "You can jump into or drink from it"...?
des.走在通道之中时，你突然听见了远方传来的悠扬琴声。奇怪的是，这首曲子在各人听来的旋: As you walk through the passage, you suddenly hear a melodious sound drifting from afar. Strangely, the melody of this tune seems different to each listener, yet one thing is the same — it makes everyone long for the past and their hometown.
des.面对一扇紧闭不开的门，如果必须要通过，一般人能想到的方法只有两种……\\n准确地: Faced with a tightly shut door, if one must get through, there are only two methods an ordinary person can think of...\nTo be precise, there is only one.
des.你看见断裂的电缆末端垂在地面上的积水中，还时不时泛着危险的电火花……为什么会有这: You see the severed end of the cable hanging down into the water on the ground, occasionally crackling with dangerous electrical sparks... How could there be a safety hazard this serious?! Who on earth did this?!
des.前方的岔道中一片漆黑。和普通的断电不同，紧急光源并未亮起，粘稠的黑暗中散发出令人: The fork ahead is pitch-black. Unlike a normal power outage, the emergency lights have not come on, and an unsettling presence emanates from the thick darkness... Do you want to choose this path?
des.虽然此前有过几次和雷比斯掌管的这些昴宿机器人打交道的经历，但能投影出一个可爱笑脸: Although there have been several previous encounters with these Tauri robots under Rebis's control, this is the first time seeing one that can project a cute smiling face. In Rebis's own words, "I can have my little ones lead you around or help you out."
des.一座仍在运行的古老生产设施，但该设备的生产过程似乎陷入了某种死循环。通过简单的研: An ancient production facility still in operation, but its production process seems to have fallen into some kind of infinite loop. Through simple research, you restart the production process, and now you have complete control over this machine.
des.再次置身于熟悉的空间之内，你的心中充满了安宁。或许这是一段某位和汇流塔相当熟悉的: Once again in a familiar space, your heart is filled with peace. Perhaps this is a memory belonging to someone quite familiar with the Confluence Tower. Every scene is exactly the same as in your memory.
des.再次置身于熟悉的空间，你的心中却有些许不安。或许这是一段某位和汇流塔相当熟悉的人: Once again in a familiar space, you feel a slight unease. Perhaps this is a memory belonging to someone quite familiar with the Confluence Tower. The furnishings and the books on the shelves have not changed in the slightest, but this place is clearly "missing" something.
des.前方的道路像是曾遭受了某种重击，塌陷的地板露出了一些危险的管线。看上去地面状况还: The path ahead looks as if it has once suffered some kind of heavy blow, and the collapsed floor exposes some dangerous pipes. It seems that the ground is still stable enough to support your passage, but you need to tread as lightly as possible.
des.这似乎是一个被遗弃许久的工坊，里面设施材料一应俱全，杂乱地放着许多图纸。你好奇地: A workshop that has been abandoned for a long time. Many blueprints are scattered about in a mess. You see some extremely advanced designs among them, but they seem unable to be realized due to technical limitations.
des.一辆古老的交通工具出现在你面前，你曾经在培训学校的历史书里读过，得知这是一种暂被: An ancient vehicle appears before you. You once read in a history book that it was named a "tram," and that after the Morphic Moon incident, it was abandoned before it could be widely adopted. You want to take a closer look at it.
des.高悬于天空中的黑暗空洞，不断向外喷涌着金色的火焰，勾勒着如同太阳的边界。你仰望太: A dark void hanging high in the sky continuously spews golden flames outward. You look up at the sun, and an indescribably beautiful melody reaches your ears. Mist shrouds everything around you; only the lighthouse in the distance flickers with a faint light.
des.一截枯槁的左臂从斑驳的墙体内突兀地伸出，这只手稳稳托着一架青铜天平，左侧托盘高高: A withered left arm abruptly juts out from the mottled wall. The hand steadily holds a bronze balance scale, the left tray is raised high, flashing with a metallic sheen in the dim light; the right tray sinks slightly, and bright red liquid is circulating in the tray.
des.你出现在了一座熟悉的服装店中，一只装饰华丽的眼球从天花板垂下，你在它的眼中看到了: You find yourself in a familiar clothing shop, a lavishly decorated eyeball hanging from the ceiling. In its eye, you see a gorgeously dressed witch looking at your outfit up and down. The clothes around you are all yours to take.
des.一个精致的高塔模型摆放在桌面上，根据它顶端奇异的光芒，你可以看出这是一件巧夺天工: An exquisite model of a tall tower sits on the tabletop. Judging by the strange glow at its top, you can tell that this is a masterfully crafted miniature replica of the Wishing Tower. You wonder whether this scaled-down replica also has the magical ability to grant wishes?
des.空房间的中央放着一个精美的箱子，促使你走进查探。然而在你的脚踏入这个房间的瞬间，: In the center of the empty room sits an exquisite box. The moment you enter the room, the sound of mechanisms echoes, and countless holes appear in the ceiling, walls, and floor. You throw something toward the center of the room, and it is immediately pierced by sharp blades shooting out from the holes.
des.浓厚的雾气弥漫在周围，让你完全无法看清周围的状况。雾中隐隐传来令人不快的诡异声响: A thick fog hangs all around. From within the fog comes a faint, unsettlingly eerie voice. That extremely unpleasant singing, almost like a shriek, nearly pierces your eardrums... It seems to be a huge HowlingBox, with much dust scattered around it, completely blocking your path.
des.为什么这个空间内部会有这样一面墙？为什么这面墙上会有这样一张深不见底的大嘴？\\: Why is there such a wall inside this space? Why is there such a bottomless gaping mouth on this wall? Looking into that gaping mouth, you vaguely feel that it could devour anything... At the same time, some legends about the gaping mouth surface in your mind.
des.一束微光在尘埃中浮动，指引着你走向前方的架子。架子上摆放着一份乐谱和一把造型古典: A faint glimmer floats in the dust, guiding you toward the shelf ahead. On the shelf rest a sheet of music and a violin. They appear to have been well maintained over the years. That sheet of music seems somewhat different from the ones on the surface.
des.魔方旁有一块铭牌，正面写着“转动后可影响当前骰数空间”，背面写着“向左迎接试炼，: There is a plaque beside the Cube. On the front it says, "Rotate it to affect the space," and on the back it says, "To the left, face the trial; to the right, abandon wealth."
des.这间房间里陈设着一个像是游戏机一样的奇怪装置，根据旁边的说明，这是一款供学会御敌: This room is furnished with a strange device that looks like a gaming console. According to the description beside it, this is a simulated combat training device for internal use within the Destroyer, but it is still in the debugging stage.
des.一阵刺耳的警报声，边上的屏幕显示着系统错误的乱码，机械音提醒你发生防御系统故障事: A piercing alarm blares, and the screen beside it displays garbled letters indicating a system error. A mechanical voice warns you that a defense system malfunction has occurred, and the out-of-control defense robots are about to approach.
des.映入眼帘的是你所熟悉的物件，只是不知这次的台球是真东西还是出于兴致制造的赝品。你: A billiard ball comes into view. Just as you are about to pick it up, it slips from your fingertips and rolls away. In the very next second, Rebis appears out of thin air. "Young one, did you drop this golden ball, or this silver ball? Of course, whichever one it is, retrieving it will cost you."
des.远处好像有一群正在修缮设施的工人，然而你走近一看，惊讶地发现这些人都是熟面孔……: In the distance, there seems to be a group of workers repairing the facilities. You are surprised to find that these people are the "long-term residents" of Yunxiu Bridge. Of course, they recognize you as well, so they surround you, wearing sinister smiles.
des.你循着长长的阶梯向上，却发现这楼梯将你引入一座古怪的塔，塔内的天地完全颠倒，墙壁: You follow the long staircase upward, only to find that it has led you into a weird tower, where everything inside is completely upside down. When you try to turn back, you see an incredibly heavy door with a strange keyhole blocking your way.
des.一名衣袍褴褛的人蹲在角落，兜帽完全裹住了这个人的身体，你看不清此人的体态面容，亦: A ragged-robed figure crouches in the corner, the hood completely shrouding their body. You cannot make out their build or face, or perhaps there is nothing at all beneath the robe... After noticing you, the robe stirs slightly, revealing a box of food from within. Is this meant for you?
des.一颗硕大的眼球漂浮在空中，眼珠转动的模样莫名让人有些不快……它似乎在搜寻着什么，: A gigantic eyeball floats in the air, and the way its eye moves is somehow unsettling... It seems to be searching for something, wanting to delve into the depths of whatever its gaze falls upon.
des.魔方旁有一块铭牌和两把钥匙。铭牌的正面写着“插入钥匙转动后可影响当前骰数空间”，: Beside the Cube, there is a plaque and two keys. The front reads, "Insert the key and turn them to affect the space," and the back reads, "If you want to gain something, you must first pay the price."
des.镜子旁有一块铭牌，正面写着“取出魔方后可影响当前骰数空间”，背面写着“心诚则能把: There is a plaque beside the mirror. The front reads, "Taking out the Cube can affect the current space," and the back reads, "With a sincere heart, you can seize opportunities."
des.这个制作精良的巨大沙漏仿佛被遗忘在这个地方，外表已经蒙上了一层灰尘。但是里面红色: A well-crafted giant hourglass. Its exterior already covered with a layer of dust. But the red crystal inside have not lost their luster. It appears to be some kind of crystal, and stranger still, the crystals in the upper part have not diminished at all.
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。已重现场景：寒潮浮囊体引起的极寒天气。请注意保暖。: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Recreated scenario: extremely cold weather caused by the Coldwave Bladder. Please keep warm.
des.不要让任何敌人阻拦你继续探索的决心；不要被幻象打败，坚持下去。: Do not let any enemy hinder your resolve to continue exploring; do not be defeated by illusions, keep going.
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。已重现场景：修格里城帮派火拼，请注意安全。: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Recreated scenario: gang shootout in Shoggolith City. Please stay safe.
des.不是已经在模拟战斗系统里打败它了吗？！怎么他还在狂飙啊——: Didn't we already defeat him in the simulated combat system?! Why is he still speeding wildly —
des.为什么出发之前没人说过意识海的边缘也会冒出这么多虫子？: Why did no one say before that there are so many bugs at the edge of Unbewusstes?
des.前方的似乎是一名身材高大的青年，脸隐藏在阴影中，像是脑海中的意识告诉自己不要看清: Ahead is a tall young man, his face hidden in shadow. Strangely, you feel an inexplicable sense of closeness. "My blood kin, being mysterious is not my intention... but the time for choice has arrived." He extends a strange arm toward you.
des.你受到温暖而熟悉的光亮吸引，发现光芒来自司书瓦伦汀手中的提灯。“虽然在撰文迷宫之: You are drawn by a warm and familiar light, and discover that the glow comes from the lantern in Valentine's hand. "Although I cannot guide you outside the Fabricate, I may be able to offer some other help." She opens the lantern's shade, and the flame inside flickers, as if it needs some fuel...
des.瓦伦汀仍然与她的提灯为你提供令人心安的守候。“我也不知道为什么，那些尘埃在提灯里: Valentine still keeps a reassuring vigil for you with her lantern. "I don't know why either, but when that dust was used as fuel in the lantern, unprecedented phenomena occurred. If I get the chance, I'll look for answers in the Fabricate"
des.这一次遇到瓦伦汀，她好像已经在书中找到了答案。但是当你好奇地想要追问时，她露出了: When you meet Valentine this time, she has already found the answer in a book. But when you curiously want to press further, she says that it is difficult to express it in plain language. "You only need to remember that this is the blessing the Fabricate bestows upon seekers of knowledge."
des.你揉了揉眼睛，似乎不敢相信眼前的景象：这种地方居然也有交易所！？而出现在你面前的: You rub your eyes, seemingly unable to believe the scene before you: there's actually a trading center here!? And standing before you is Forton, who warmly invites you to make a deal with him, such as trying his latest financial product. The next time you meet he will repay you with both principal and interest.
des.再遇包浮，你立马问起上次理财的事情，要求他兑现承诺。然而包浮表示收益没那么快到手: When you run into Forton again, you immediately ask about the previous investment and demand that he honor his promise. However, he hopes you can wait patiently a little longer; he definitely will not go back on his word. At the same time, he hints that if you invest more money, you can get greater returns.
des.你还没出声叫住包浮，他就在看到你的瞬间掉头就跑。你立刻明白，你们之间已经没有什么: Before you can call out to stop Forton, he turns and runs the moment he sees you. You immediately understand that there is nothing left for the two of you to talk about; force is the only solution. But he is prepared as well, with several bodyguards around him.
des.一位骑士正在对面前的空气不断挥剑，应该是在模拟和敌方的战斗。见你靠近，她立刻停止: A knight is continuously swinging her sword at the air in front of her, apparently simulating a battle with an enemy. Seeing you approach, she immediately stops practicing, sets her sword heavily to one side, and gives you a gentle smile.
des.你再次遇见了那位骑士。她的身姿依旧坚定挺拔，所持的那柄重剑看起来也依旧非常可靠。: You run into that knight again. At the sight of you, she seems even happier than you are. "Fancy meeting you again! Training with you before benefited me greatly — thank you so much! This time, I hope I can be the one to offer some help — please don't hesitate; if there's anything you need, just ask!"
des.见你伸手，对方倾覆手掌，闪烁着微光的尘埃形成一股细流落入你的掌中。但是那些尘埃好: Seeing you hold out your hand, the man turns over his palm, and dust shimmering with a faint glow falls into your hand, piling into a small mountain, then overflowing and falling to the ground... Only then do you realize that this is not dust at all, but a kind of pitch-black, chaotic crystalline substance.
des.没等你有拾起那两枚扭蛋的机会，扭蛋里突然爆发出一阵可怕的声响……其中冒出了敌人！: Before you have a chance to pick up those two capsules, a terrifying sound suddenly erupts from them... Enemies emerge from inside!
des.出现在面前的装置，从外形判断是一个……扭蛋机？扭蛋机里装满了各种各样的礼品，但仔: The device before you appears, judging by its shape, to be a... gacha machine? It is filled with all kinds of prizes, but upon closer inspection, you notice that something seems to be writhing inside some of the capsules...
des.克洛伊看见你捧出的尘埃，咂咂嘴。\r“还行吧，不过没想到你居然收集了这么多……嗯: Chloe sees the dust you hold out and clicks her tongue. "Not bad, though I didn't expect you to have collected so much... Hmm, I also made some preparations on the way here, so pick what you want from these."
des.通道内突然刮起了大风——接着，伴随一阵可怖的电闪雷鸣之声，一个娇小的身影从凭空出: A sudden gale whips up, accompanied by a terrifying crash of lightning. A petite figure emerges from a small storm that appears out of thin air. "Glad you're still breathing! I'm here to help, believe it or not. But you'll have to give me something in exchange, or we'll all be trapped here, and that's not in my schedule."
des.克洛伊看见你列出的交换条件，眼睛一亮。\r“这个不错嘛，没想到你还挺有品味的！来: Chloe's eyes light up when she sees the exchange conditions you list. "This is pretty good. I didn't expect you to have such good taste! Come on, hurry up and give it to me!"
des.少女迷茫地念着一些你无法理解的喃喃自语。与此同时，你发现她的身体正逐渐扭曲变形，: The girl mutters in confusion, uttering words you cannot understand. At the same time, you notice that her body is gradually twisting and deforming, transforming into a nonhuman shape, yet she herself seems completely unaware of it!
des.一堆乱七八糟的实验器材围成的空地中间，有一位白发的少女静静地坐在那里。从外貌来看: In the middle of an open space encircled by a heap of cluttered experimental equipment, a white-haired girl sits there quietly. Judging by her appearance, she is undoubtedly the Jalhay you know, but she radiates a terrifying aura... The girl slowly raises her head. "Who am I?" she asks.
des.伴随着阵阵热闹的（或者说过分热闹了）的声响，雷比斯再次闪亮登场了。只是这次，她似: Amid bursts of lively sound, Rebis makes another dazzling entrance. She seems a little different... Maybe her limbs look a bit strange, or perhaps she looks younger? "Huh? Who are you? Where the hell am I? Did something go wrong — never mind, come help me try this out!" Well, that's Rebis for you.
des.你接住被抛来的那枚骰子。正当你犹豫着要不要收钱干活的时候，雷比斯就指挥一个机器人: You catch the dice thrown at you. Just as you hesitate over whether to take the money and do the job, Rebis orders a robot to charge at you... accompanied by her maniacal laughter and shouting! "Don't run, just stand right there!"
des.待在这些人之间，你感到了一种安宁和平静……很快，你发现你奉献的尘埃增加了。\r“: Being among these people, you feel a sense of peace and tranquility... Soon, you notice that the dust you dedicated has increased. "What you reap shall exceed what you give. However, to leave is also an act of honesty, and no one shall blame you."
des.在温暖的光芒中，你看见一群跪地祈祷之人……在他们身后，丽桑德拉静静站立着，不知是: In the warm glow, you see a group of people kneeling in prayer... Behind them, Lissandra stands quietly, as if unsure whether she is watching over them or praying alongside them. Seeing you arrive, Lissandra in red turns around. "Are you here to make a wish too?"
des.伴随着你献出的尘埃，周围的光芒变得更加耀眼明亮——在其中浮现出了你所需之物。: As the dust you offer is given, the surrounding light becomes even more dazzling and bright — and within it appears what you need.
des.战斗愈发艰难，即使和达斯廷合作也没能解决所有的敌人。这时，达斯廷突然看向了你。\: The battle grows increasingly difficult; even working together with Dustin, you still can't deal with all the enemies. At this moment, Dustin suddenly looks at you."If there's no better way to break through, then we can only fight to the death. But if you wish to leave on your own, I will clear a path for you —"
des.与大量敌人战斗的声响从不远处传来，建筑内部被刺眼的火光照亮。高大的钢铁身躯拦在如: The sounds of battle come from nearby. A towering steel figure stands in the path of the enemies pouring out like a tide — that is Dustin and his weapon, "Celestial Fire." However, as far as you know, Dustin could not possibly be here. But if that really is him...
des.也许这片幻象是意识海泄露的结果。从他的命令内容中你听出来，这是关于多年前某次作战: Perhaps this illusion is the result of a leak from Unbewusstes. From the content of his orders, you can tell that this is a memory of a battle from many years ago; he was the leader of the operation and was persuading the other members to leave him behind to cover their retreat.
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。对象：大型桦树生物鸣爆虫母。目的：测试对桦树生物群: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Target: Blastbug Matriarch. Objective: test combat capability against CR groups.
des.打倒它，就是打败了自我束缚的命运。: Defeating it means defeating the fate of self-imposed constraints.
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。已推算场景：费尔德里奇号事故（再现）。: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Calculated scenario: Phildridge incident.
des.你还是第一次知道人可以为了抢夺物资而走这么远，甚至超过了你。: It is the first time you realize that people could travel so far just to rob supplies, even farther than you.
des.母亲沉溺于无法触及的温暖中，她不允许任何人打扰她的梦境。: The mother is immersed in unreachable warmth, and she allows no one to disturb her dream.
des.荒原霸主汤姆的权威不容挑战！！你说哈依玛之骰？那是什么？: The authority of Tom, the overlord of the wasteland, cannot be challenged!! You say Haima Zaria? What is that?
des.你无论如何也不可能让她停止运行——那么，要怎么办？: No matter what, you can't make her stop running — so, what should you do?
des.你无论如何也不可能将它叫醒了。那么，要怎么办？: You can never wake it up no matter what. So what will you do?
des.复合了多种奇异身体组织的桦树生物，出现在满是幻觉和梦境的空间之中正合适。: A Chaos Remain compounded from many kinds of bizarre bodily tissues appears perfectly suited to a space filled with hallucinations and dreams.
des.直视它空洞的双眼时，你能感觉到自己的体温正越来越低。: When you look directly into its hollow eyes, you can feel your body temperature dropping lower and lower.
des.有效的承重计算能保持建筑物的稳定性，但这只超重的昏恶巨象显然来错了地方……它的体: Effective load-bearing calculations can maintain a building's stability, but this overweight Chaos Behemoth has obviously come to the wrong place... Is it getting bigger and bigger?
des.探索时视野不清可是冒险的大忌。不过走到现在，显然也只能硬着头皮迎沙尘暴而上了。: Poor visibility while exploring is a major no-go for adventurers. But having come this far, you can only grit your teeth and press on into the sandstorm.
des.“咦？玉敌枢扭战斗模拟系统……什么呀？朱迪，我们轰了它！”: "Huh? This drawer come back some some...tion... what is this? Jude, we blow it up!"
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。对象：黑月执行人镇雷鸣。目的：测试对人类个体战斗能: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Target: Night Chains Executor Raimei. Objective: test combat capability against individual human being.
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。对象：黑月执行人无明火。目的：测试对人类个体战斗能: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Target: Night Chains Executor Mumeika. Objective: test combat capability against individual human being.
des.意识海的泄露越发严重，无机物也像是拥有了自我意识一般行动起来。: The leakage of Unbewusstes is becoming increasingly severe, and even inorganic matter has begun to act as if it possessed self-awareness.
des.回望遥远的过去，她的手中唯有无法守护之物。: Looking back on the distant past, all she held in her hands were things she could not protect.
des.“北阵的机械时隔数十年仍能运行”，这点常常被北阵的支持者引申，用于论证其跨时代的: "N.A.'s machinery can still operate after several decades," and this point is often cited by N.A.'s supporters to argue for its outstanding industrial capabilities ahead of its time.
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。对象：昏恶巨象。目的：测试对巨型桦树生物个体战斗能: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Target: Chaos Behemoth. Objective: test combat capability against giant CR individuals.
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。对象：混厄石芝。目的：测试对复合桦树生物个体战斗能: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Target: Chaos Ganoderma. Objective: test combat capability against composite CR individuals.
des.“列车长，我们在哈依玛之骰外围发现了被破拆的部分临时设施，似乎是劫掠者留下的痕迹: "Conductor, we found some temporary facilities on the outskirts of Haima Zaria that had been forcibly dismantled, seemingly traces left behind by looters. ...Conductor?"
des.剑刃依然锋利，持剑的双手仍然坚定；只是被放逐者再也回不到出发之地，再也望不见故乡: The blade remains sharp, and the hands that wield it remain steady. Yet the exiled can never return to where they began, never again glimpse their homeland...
des.她的决心已然碎裂，无法捍卫任何事物。没有人能够责备她，但她仍然煎熬着自己的心灵。: Her resolve has already shattered, leaving her unable to defend anything. No one could blame her, yet she still torments her own soul.
des.行车手册上明确表示，目前没有桦树生物能够制造天气的例子；不过你一路上的每一环节都: The driving manual clearly states that there are currently no examples of Chaos Remains being able to alter weather; however, none of what you've encountered along the way can be explained by common sense, so...
des.“那边那边！那就是老夫说的长得像个鸟的东西，哎对对，你看见没？”: "There, over there! That's the thing I was talking about that looks like a bird. Ah, yes, yes — do you see it?"
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。对象：裂首骨龙。目的：测试对骨龙亚种个体战斗能力。: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Target: Crusher Skeleton. Objective: test combat capability against individuals of Bone Dragon subspecies.
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统生成完毕。对象：裂首骨龙。目的：测试对血影骨龙个体战斗能力。: Destroyer combat simulation generated. Target: Crusher Skeleton. Objective: test individual combat capability against individuals of Bone Dragons.
des.以救赎为目的被制作之物。如今它已然失去施行救赎的资格与可能。: Created for the purpose of redemption. Now it has lost both the right and the chance to redeem.
des.义举的恶果，虚无的回声，无法完满的骑士故事。: The backwash of a righteous deed, the echo of the void, an incomplete knightly tale.
des.“您说看见了头发长到脚跟的我？可是要变成那样，应该还要过上数十年吧……！”: "You say you saw me with hair grown down to my heels? But for me to become like that, it would still take several decades...!"
des.攀登真理天梯之人。如今她已然坠落，向识海的深处……: She who climbs the ladder of truth. Now she falls deep into Unbewusstes...
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统已下线。检测到隶属于屠戮者的危险个体靠近，请注意安全。: Destroyer combat simulation offline. Dangerous Slayer individual detected nearby. Please stay safe.
des.既然索思学会制造了一台超强的防卫机械，那么它当然会被放在最适合发挥作用的地方。: Since Source Citadel has built an ultra-powerful defensive machine, it would naturally be placed in the location where it can function most effectively.
des.显然是一只骨龙。不过它的两个脑袋，究竟是压力之下你看错了，还是它真的有两个脑袋呢: Clearly, it is a bone dragon. But it has two heads — did you mistake them under pressure, or does it really have two heads...
des.它发誓要让你流干最后一滴鲜血，即使你不知这仇恨从何而来。: It swears to drain your very last drop of blood, even if you do not know where this hatred comes from.
des.理论上这架巨型装置不该是你的敌人，但它的核心正发出尖锐的运转声。: In theory, this gigantic device shouldn't be your enemy, but its core is emitting a sharp whirring sound.
des.御敌枢纽战斗模拟系统已下线。检测到索思学会高权限成员靠靠靠近——: Destroyer combat simulation offline. High-ranking Citadel member appppppppproaching-ing-ing-ing—
des.一场失败的计划，一次索思学会保密行动，一次实验。幸好它不存在于此外的世界。: A failed plan, a confidential operation by the Citadel, an experiment. Fortunately, it does not exist in any other world.
des.跨越世界线的证明。即使明知我们终将分道扬镳，现在你是否依然会伴我身侧？: Proof of transcending world lines. Even knowing full well that we are destined to part ways in the end, would you still remain by my side?

des.在场上召唤1个【辉蚀之月】，使用【队长技】时，释放1枚【星石】\\n【星石】对生: Summon 1 [Eclipse Moon] on the field. When using a [Leader Skill], release 1 [Astralite].\n[Astralite] deals Reverengy DMG once to the enemy with the highest HP, and all allies lose 1000 HP.
des.在场上召唤1个【司命一】，每8秒生成1张【庇佑】加入手牌，且能超出手牌上限: Summon 1 [Fateward I] on the field. Generate 1 [Benediction] in your hand every 8 seconds. Cards generated this way can exceed hand size.
des.在场上召唤1个【磐石之垣】，为我方全体抵御10%伤害，并将伤害积累转化为【负压】: Summon 1 [Bedrock Bastion] on the field to absorb 10% of all allies' DMG taken, and convert the absorbed DMG to [Subpressure].

Summon the shadow familiar [Nyx] to possess the enemy, lasting 10 seconds. During this period:
Randomly inflict <color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Blaze]</color> or <color=#7AB2FF>[Frostbite]</color> to the target every second.
Whenever the target is inflicted with a negative effect, deal DMG once to it.
[Nyx] can respond to:
<color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color>, <color=#FFB800>[Bolt]</color>, <color=#FFB800>[Magnetize]</color>, <color=#FFB800>[Paralysis]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Blaze]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Wildfire]</color>, <color=#7AB2FF>[Frostbite]</color>, <color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Slash]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Rend]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Scorch]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Interrupt]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Stun]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Knockback]</color> and <color=#FF6666>[Launch]</color>.
[Nyx] is [Familiar].

Each stack increases their [Familiar]'s DMG dealt by 10%, and their Ultimate card's DMG dealt by 10% if that card doesn't have the [Familiar] term, up to 5 stacks.
If the target already has 5 stacks, draw 1 card instead, prioritizing the target's skill cards.
When targeting another ally, remove all stacks.
This card is [Destroyed] when used.

After 3 attacks, [Phlegethon] transforms into [Cocytus], inflicting <color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color> to all enemies and absorbing DMG for all allies.

des.由铁盟统一下发的特殊列车武装改造特许文件，内含总体布局、外部结构、内部布置、所需: Special train weapon modification permit issued by B.C.R.L., containing overall layout, external structure, interior arrangement, required equipment, construction requirements, operation steps, etc. Please complete the train weapon modification under the guidance of the document.
des.标准格式的列车武装改造凭证，已由综合管制中心盖章完成批复。列车长可凭此许可证进行: A standard format train weapon modification certificate, duly stamped and approved by the Comprehensive Control Center. Conductor can use this permit to carry out train weapon modification operations.
des.《西大陆列车涂装标准色卡》登记的1号涂料，由暮光坚壳研磨加工制成，如同暮色深沉的: Registered as paint #1 in the Western Continent Standard Color Card for Train Livery, processed by grinding Twilight Shell, resembling the deep twilight sky.
des.“远祖的果报”头部生长的根系状组织，与一般深眠者身上掉落的素材外形相近，但强度远: The root-like tissue that grows from the head of Ancestor's Retribution, resembling the materials extracted from typical Deep Sleepers but considerably tougher.\nThe research states, "Don't eat it for your digestive and dental health, because it has a flavor reminiscent of vomit mixed with alcohol."
des.“远祖的果报”手持的武器。考虑到它经历的漫长时间，这对武器保存得相当完好。经相关: The weapon wielded by Ancestor's Retribution, remarkably well-preserved despite its extensive history. Recognizable for its distinct Mundus Empire style, it carries an inscription, "My remorse. My bloodland. My distant homeworld."
des.由深眠者相关素材中提纯获得的物质，提取难度较大，十分珍贵。某位研究员在品尝后提交: Substances extracted from materials associated with Deep Sleepers, possessing significant value due to the challenging extraction process. A particular researcher tasted it and submitted a report stating, "Eating this substance will lead you into a deep slumber where your wishes come true in your dreams, but it will render you unconscious for a day. It has a sweet taste."
des.变异骨龙的头骨，似乎使骨龙变得更加奸诈。报告上写着：“食用后无任何异常，但我的另: The skull of a mutant bone dragon, giving the bone dragon a sinister appearance. The report states, "Nothing unusual happened after I consumed the skull, but my other head disagrees. I need to take a week off."
des.变异骨龙的胸骨，赋予了骨龙变化的能力。报告上写着：“食用后长出了两心三肺，精神百: The sternum of a mutant bone dragon that grants transformation abilities. The report states, "After consuming it, I ended up growing two extra hearts and three more lungs. I felt so rejuvenated that I request three all-nighters in a row."
des.使用了形态场控制技术制造的航天元器件。: An aerospace component created using morphic field control technology.
des.祸链囚徒身上剥落的部分，摆在桌面上可以当支架放置零碎物品，必要时还可用来投掷，非: A flayed part from Chainbane Jailer. It can serve as a convenient holder for miscellaneous items on your desk or be used as a throwing weapon when necessary.
des.祸链囚徒身上剥落的部分，看起来很容易点燃。据说用柴火和用电饭煲煮出的米饭风味截然: A flayed part from Chainbane Jailer, appearing highly flammable. There are rumors that rice cooked with firewood has a distinct flavor compared to that cooked in a rice cooker. So, would using this as fuel result in a unique taste?
des.从劫掠者的武器上掉落的零部件，用来拆快递意外地方便。: A part dropped by a looter, remarkably handy for unwrapping courier packages.
des.从屠戮者手中缴获的重型武器，凭一般人的力气甚至无法稳定地举起它。能用于切割素材，: A hefty weapon taken from Slayer, demanding considerable strength to wield. Although it is capable of slicing through materials, using it in such a manner would squander its tremendous power...
des.配发给部分黑月执行人的斗笠，有助于在黑暗环境中隐藏身形。本质上是外形独特的迷彩生: A specialized hat provided to selected Night Chains Executors to aid in concealment during darkness. It's essentially a camouflage tool with distinct appearance.
des.以耐高温材质铸造的双刃，配发给擅长使用与火相关的升构能力的黑月成员。刀上的铭文是: Twinning blades crafted from heat-resistant materials, allocated to Night Chains operatives specializing in fire-related abilities. The inscription on these blades reads, "Illuminate the night with candlelight."
des.冥霆仪者被击败后掉落的大型碎片。报告上写着“无法直接食用，但我们发现它可以用来煲: An enormous shard dropped by Nether Envoy. Report states, "Although this shard is inedible, we used it to prepare soup, and it had a marvelous taste! Note: Consuming the soup induces full-body paralysis for 12 hours."
des.冥霆仪者被击败后掉落的碎片。报告上写着“无法直接食用，各种加工方式均难以使其软化: A shard ropped by Nether Envoy. Report states, "This shard is inedible, and despite various attempts, we couldn't soften it. However, one guy licked it and found it surprisingly tasty."
des.荒古桦树生物掉落的素材之一。报告上写着“还行，花椒味儿”。: A material dropped by Primal CR. Report states, "Has a peppery taste. Not bad."
des.荒古桦树生物掉落的素材之一，外形与其他种类爆虫掉落的囊袋类似，但似乎涌动着雷电的: A material dropped by Primal CR, resembling sac from other Blastbugs but infused with electro energy. The report states, "May cause slight numbing in the mouth! Remember to drink milk after consumption."
des.荒古桦树生物掉落的素材之一，涌动着雷电力量的内脏团。 报告上写着“可生食，但导致: A material dropped by Primal CR, a visceral component filled with potent electro energy. Report states, "Although this ingredient is edible in its raw state, the researcher who consumed it was shocked unconscious. Taking a week's leave."
des.毛绒联盟成员四处分发的海报，上面写着“欢迎加入毛绒联盟”。这张是狂象主题的。: A Fluffy Union poster featuring a Ramphant, accompanied by the invitation, "Welcome to join us in the Fluffy Union."
des.桦树生物在正常环境死后，只有这个腺体比较容易以负片中微子的物质形式保存。所以被当: After Chaos Remain dies in a normal environment, only this gland is relatively easy to preserve in the form of Negative Neutrinos. Therefore, it is used as the basic resource for crafting Negative Neutrino materials.\n[Chaos Gland] is an important material for upgrading train's power engine.
des.桦树腺体中精炼出的物质，一种负片有机体。\\n【桦树原质】是制造特殊炮弹的重要材: The substance refined from Chaos Gland, a negative organism.\n[Chaos Essence] is an important material for crafting special shells.
des.毛绒联盟成员四处分发的海报，上面写着“欢迎加入毛绒联盟”。浣熊还是幻熊？傻傻分不: A Fluffy Union poster featuring a Raccoon, accompanied by the invitation, "Welcome to join us in the Fluffy Union." However, the raccoon on the poster looks like a Miraccoon.
des.毛绒联盟成员四处分发的海报，上面写着“欢迎加入毛绒联盟”。这张是恐兔主题的。: A Fluffy Union poster featuring a Creeppit, accompanied by the invitation, "Welcome to join us in the Fluffy Union."
des.强大的深眠者死后会化成木头，其上掉落的枯叶。对桦树生物的形态场能产生轻微的克制作: Powerful Deep Sleepers turn into wood after death, leaving behind fallen leaves. These leaves slightly counter the morphic field of Chaos Remains.
des.<size=25><color=#FFB800>使用后可增加4000点装备经验值: <size=25><color=#FFB800>Use it to increase Equipment XP by 4000 points.</color></size>\nIt appears as a gel-like substance resembling a nebula, which, when attached to an object, can be assimilated by the object's morphic field, becoming similar in nature to the attached object. Commonly used for repairing and welding equipment.
des.强大的深眠者死后会化成木头，其较完整的枝条。对桦树生物的形态场能产生有效的克制作: Powerful Deep Sleepers turn into wood after death, leaving behind relatively intact branches. These branches effectively counter the morphic field of Chaos Remains.
des.强大的深眠者死后会化成木头，这种木头的性质之一是对桦树生物的形态场能形成较强的克: Powerful Deep Sleepers turn into wood after death. One of the properties of this wood is it moderately counters the morphic field of Chaos Remains. It's almost like a final resistance of Deep Sleeper against Chaos Remain.

Although the collected simulated signals often have significant distortion, they are extremely effective as a means of reviewing and summarizing experiences.

des.毛绒联盟成员四处分发的海报，上面写着“欢迎加入毛绒联盟”。这张是疯熊主题的。听说: A Fluffy Union poster featuring a Madbear, accompanied by the invitation, "Welcome to join us in the Fluffy Union." Rumor has it that wild bears sometimes wave to climbers like humans in an attempt to lure unsuspecting prey closer.
des.某位强大深眠者身体上生长出的手部外骨骼。她是否已背弃了曾许下的誓言？: An arm exoskeleton sprouting from a formidable Deep Sleeper. Has she broken her past oath?
des.某位强大深眠者身体上生长出的头部外骨骼。她是否从此就要和她珍视之人离别？: A head exoskeleton sprouting from a formidable Deep Sleeper. Will she be separated from her cherished ones?
des.<size=25><color=#FFB800>角色共振所需要的必要材料。</c: <size=25><color=#FFB800>Material required for character resonance.</color></size>\nProduced through the technology of direct mental resonance with other organisms via a resonance environment. Even enemies exhibit outstanding traits in battle. These traits leave imprints in the morphic field, which can be collected to enhance the user's various abilities.

<size=25><color=#FFB800>Material required for character resonance.</color></size>\nProduced through the technology of digitizing the thoughts of organisms via a resonance environment. It inherently enhances the user's abilities to some extent. However, it primarily serves as a "solvent" for stabilizing and diluting the recycled fragments of Primitive Thinking.
des.桦树空间中发现的长宽高为1：2：3的黑色石板的一部分。其发射的形态共振能促进激发: Part of a black slab found within the chaos space, with dimensions of 1:2:3. Its emitted morphic resonance can stimulate the potential of humanity, facilitating comprehensive evolution, though the specific principles remain unknown.
des.死去的桦树生物如果放置不管，其体内就有可能形成一种类似桦石的物质。这些物质已经被: If left unattended, deceased Chaos Remains may form a substance similar to Chaos Stone within their bodies. These substances have already been influenced by the morphic field of reality and lack the potential to be crafted into other materials. However, they can still be used as a source of energy.\n[Chaos Residue] is a crucial material for upgrading train's power engine.
des.使用后可增加500单位口粮，\\n每日宠物亲密度获取+8。: Use it to increase Pet Food by 500 units.\nDaily Pet Intimacy increases by 8.
des.使用后可增加500单位口粮，\\n每日宠物亲密度获取+10。: Use it to increase Pet Food by 500 units.\nDaily Pet Intimacy increases by 10.

des.使用后可增加8点宠物好感。\\n适用宠物：猫，狗，猪，狐狸。: Use it to increase Pet Intimacy by 8 points.\nApplicable pets: cat, dog, pig, fox.
des.使用后可增加3点宠物好感。\\n适用宠物：狗，兔子。: Use it to increase Pet Intimacy by 3 points.\nApplicable pets: dog, rabbit.
des.使用后可增加5点宠物好感。\\n适用宠物：鸟。: Use it to increase Pet Intimacy by 5 points.\nApplicable pets: bird.
des.使用后可增加3点宠物好感。\\n适用宠物：鸟，兔子，狗，猪，狐狸。: Use it to increase Pet Intimacy by 3 points.\nApplicable pets: bird, rabbit, dog, pig, fox.
des.使用后可增加5点宠物好感。\\n适用宠物：蜥蜴，青蛙。: Use it to increase Pet Intimacy by 5 points.\nApplicable pets: lizard, frog.
des.使用后可增加8点宠物好感。\\n适用宠物：兔子，猪。: Use it to increase Pet Intimacy by 8 points.\nApplicable pets: rabbit, pig.
des.只有足够强大或基底桦树生物体内才存在的器官。以未知原理向外输出辐射能。因为不了解: Organs that only exist within sufficiently powerful or base Chaos Remains. They emit radiation energy through unknown principles. Due to a lack of understanding of their operational principles, they can only be crudely used as a semi-perpetual heat source.\n[Chaos Kernel] is an important material for upgrading train power engines.
des.学会某位天使在骰数空间内创造的物质，能连通到其它时空。作为弹药使用能将击中的物体: A substance created by an Angel of the Citadel in the dice space, capable of connecting to other dimensions. Used as ammunition, it can tear and banish struck objects.
des.ANITA科技用形态共振技术将园丁的意志转化成实体物质的技术，因为园丁视桦树生物: Anita Tech uses morphic resonance technology to convert the will of Gardeners into tangible substances. Since Gardeners view Chaos Remains as livestock, this substance has a powerful countering effect on Chaos Remains. The more powerful the Gardener, the stronger the effect of this substance produced.
des.强大的深眠者死后会化成木头，其在地下的根须。对桦树生物的形态场能产生轻微的克制作: Powerful Deep Sleepers turn into wood after death, leaving behind underground roots. These roots slightly counter the morphic field of Chaos Remains.
des.许愿塔顶的太阳掉落的灰尘，其中蕴含的发光发热的愿望虽不够再充当恒星，烧尽地表一切: The dust dropped by the sun at the top of the Wishing Tower, contains glowing and heating desires. Though insufficient to reignite as a star, it is more than enough to incinerate all surface life forms.
des.黑月收容的噪音精神病脊髓的分泌液，以医疗目的取出。但其扰乱形态共振的性质对桦树生: The secretion of noise psychotic's spinal cord contained by Night Chains, which is extracted for medical purposes. Its disruptive nature to resonance properties effectively counters the Chaos Remains, making it useful in weapon crafting.
des.<size=25><color=#FFB800>使用后可增加500点装备经验值。: <size=25><color=#FFB800>Use it to increase Equipment XP by 500 points.</color></size>\nIt appears as a gel-like substance resembling a nebula, which, when attached to an object, can be assimilated by the object's morphic field, becoming similar in nature to the attached object. Commonly used for repairing and welding equipment.
des.一种能量转换效率更高的劣桦石。\\n【重桦石】是升级列车核心引擎的重要材料。: A type of Chaos Residue with higher energy conversion efficiency.\n[Heavy Chaos Stone] is a crucial material for upgrading train's engine cores.
des.黑月收容的噪音精神病肾上腺的分泌液，以医疗目的取出。但其扰乱形态共振的性质对桦树: The secretion of noise psychotic's adrenal gland contained by Night Chains, which is extracted for medical purposes. Its disruptive nature to resonance properties moderately counters the Chaos Remains, making it useful in weapon crafting.
des.黑月收容的噪音精神病下丘脑的分泌液，以医疗目的取出。但其扰乱形态共振的性质对桦树: The secretion of noise psychotic's hypothalamus contained by Night Chains, which is extracted for medical purposes. Its disruptive nature to resonance properties greatly counters the Chaos Remains, making it useful in weapon crafting.
des.<size=25><color=#FFB800>使用后可增加2000点装备经验值: <size=25><color=#FFB800>Use it to increase Equipment XP by 2000 points.</color></size>\nIt appears as a gel-like substance resembling a nebula, which, when attached to an object, can be assimilated by the object's morphic field, becoming similar in nature to the attached object. Commonly used for repairing and welding equipment.
des.<size=25><color=#FFB800>使用后可增加1000点装备经验值: <size=25><color=#FFB800>Use it to increase Equipment XP by 1000 points.</color></size>\nIt appears as a gel-like substance resembling a nebula, which, when attached to an object, can be assimilated by the object's morphic field, becoming similar in nature to the attached object. Commonly used for repairing and welding equipment.
des.桦树生物身上常见的器官，能使桦树生物在形态场中“游动”。地联和ANITA想要复制: An organ commonly found in Chaos Remains that allows them to "swim" in the morphic field. Attempts by the Earth Union and ANITA to replicate its operation mechanism have ended in failure. The report states: "Inedible."
des.爆虫桦树生物身上的器官，里面的溶液在接触外部形态场后会立刻爆炸。报告上写着“爆炸: An organ from the Blastbug Chaos Remains that explodes upon contact with an external morphic field. The report states: "The residue after the explosion is extremely spicy and can be used as a seasoning."
des.《西大陆列车涂装标准色卡》登记的0号涂料，由漆黑矿渣研磨加工制成，漆黑如深夜。: Registered as paint #0 in the Western Continent Standard Color Card for Train Livery, made from finely grounded Black Slag, and appears to be as dark as midnight.
des.桦树生物身上常见的器官，能使桦树生物在形态场中“游动”，同时较为粗壮可以抓握物体: An organ commonly found in Chaos Remains that allows them to "swim" in the morphic field. It's also sturdy enough to grasp objects. The report states: "It will curl up when roasted, but it's inedible."
des.触须桦树生物身上的器官，能使桦树生物在形态场中“漂浮”。该器官能一定程度违背热力: An organ from Tentacle Chaos Remains that allows them to "float" in the morphic field. This organ can partially defy the second law of thermodynamics, absorbing heat within a certain range. The report states: "It tastes icy cold and can be mixed into shaved ice. When heated, it turns into a lime-like substance, inedible."
des.寒潮浮囊体身上的器官，较为粗壮可以抓握物体，同时吸收物体的热量。报告上写着“会冻: An organ from Coldwave Bladder, sturdy enough to grasp objects while absorbing heat from them. The report states: "It will freeze on the tongue and continuously absorb heat, extremely dangerous and inedible."
des.大型爆虫桦树生物身上的器官，里面的溶液在接触外部形态场后会剧烈爆炸。报告上写着“: An organ from large Blastbugs that explodes upon contact with an external morphic field. The report states: "The residue after the explosion is similar to hot pepper flavored popping candy, suitable for making cocktails."
des.爆虫桦树生物身上的器官，用于储存爆炸溶液，非常结实且化学性质稳定。报告上写着“吃: An organ from Blastbugs, used for storing explosive solution. It's very tough and chemically stable. The report states: "What is eaten in comes out the same."
des.鸣爆虫母身上的器官，用于储存爆炸溶液，非常结实且化学性质稳定，同时也是发声器官。: An organ from Blastbug Matriarch, used for storing explosive solution. It's very tough and chemically stable and also serves as a vocal organ. The report states: "Quite amusing to use as tableware."
des.部分桦树生物体内的类似软骨的组织，表面光滑韧性较强。报告上写着：“加入爆虫囊液后: Cartilage-like tissue from certain Chaos Remains, with a smooth and tough surface. The report states: "It can be used for soup after adding Blastbug Sac Fluid, but is not recommended for consumption."
des.部分桦树生物的尾部器官，有类似桦树鞭毛的作用，但明显结构更复杂运动能力更强。报告: A tail organ from certain Chaos Remains, functioning similarly to Chaos Flagellum but with a more complex structure and stronger mobility. The report states: "It turns sour rapidly upon contact with air."
des.部分桦树生物的骨架，非常坚固。报告上写着：“加入爆虫囊液后用70度白酒浸泡，喝了: A very sturdy skeleton from certain Chaos Remains. The report states: "Soak in 70% liquor after adding Blastbug Sac Fluid, drink to strengthen the body."
des.尘鸣游磷的骨架，非常坚固，从一端吹气会发出响声。报告上写着：“磨成粉泡水能治嗓子: A very sturdy skeleton from Sand Phosphor that emits a sound when blown from one end. The report states: "Grinding it into powder and dissolving in water can treat sore throats."
des.扬沙骸龙体内的类似脊椎的结构，在特定形态场中质量会减轻。报告上写着：“加入爆虫囊: A spine-like structure inside Sandbone Wyrm that lightens in mass in specific morphic fields. The report states: "Soak in 70% liquor after adding Blastbug Sac Fluid, drink to improve sleep."
des.扬沙骸龙体内的类似头骨的结构，在特定形态场中质量会减轻。把头伸进去后会看到桦树空: A skull-like structure inside Sandbone Wyrm that lightens in mass in specific morphic fields. When inserting head, one can see illusions of the chaos space. The report states: "Strong hallucinogenic effects, with visions of Chaos Remains dancing hand in hand."
des.扬沙骸龙体内的类似尾骨的结构，在特定形态场中质量会减轻。报告上写着：“长期食用会: A tailbone-like structure inside Sandbone Wyrm that lightens in mass in specific morphic fields. The report states: "Long-term consumption can cause the body to glow."
des.从废弃机械上回收的残破零件。: Tattered parts salvaged from discarded machinery.
des.从废弃机械上回收的仍具有使用价值的零件。: Valuable parts salvaged from discarded machinery.
des.黄金的形态场较为稳定，使用镀金零件可以有效防止形态污染。但成本偏高。: The morphic field of gold is relatively stable; using Gold-Plated Parts can effectively prevent morphic field pollution, but the cost is high.
des.黄金的形态场较为稳定，一些关键零件必须使用纯金制造。: The morphic field of gold is relatively stable; some crucial components must be crafted from pure gold.
des.学会产物，原理不明。其效果是能在大型机械中传输动力。: A product of the Citadel, the principle is unknown. Its effect is to transmit power within large-scale machinery.
des.学会产物，原理不明。其效果是给大型机械的武器提供能量。: A product of the Citadel, the principle is unknown. Its effect is to provide energy to weapons of large-scale machinery.
des.学会产物，原理不明。能在不消耗桦石的情况下产生巨大的动力。: A product of the Citadel, the principle is unknown. It can generate immense power without consuming Chaos Stones.
des.学会产物，原理不明。能一定程度预测敌人行动，并控制武器开火。: A product of the Citadel, the principle is unknown. It can predict enemy movements to a certain extent and control weapon firing.
des.使用了形态场控制技术制造的高导体电容。: A high-conductivity capacitor created using morphic field control technology.
des.使用了形态场控制技术制造的超导体线圈。: Superconducting coil manufactured using morphic field control technology.
des.部分桦树生物产生的孢子，会使人注意力涣散，产生脑雾症状。报告上写着：“无味，食用: Spores produced by certain Chaos Remains. They may cause inattention and brain fog symptoms. The report states, "Odorless. After I consumed it, I felt completely unmotivated to write the report. I need to take three days off."
des.部分桦树生物身上类似刺茎的器官，被刺中后会使人意识不清，报告上写着：“之后我好像: A thorn-like organ from certain Chaos Remains. When it stings a victim, it causes them to lose consciousness. The report states, "I can't remember what happened when I consumed it. It seems like I fell unconscious for three days."
des.部分桦树生物的甲壳，直视其上的花纹会产生晕眩感。报告上写着：“食用后接连摔倒扭伤: The armor of certain Chaos Remains. Its dazzling pattern may cause dizziness to those who directly gaze at it. The report states, "After consuming it, I experienced a series of falls and sprained my arms and legs. I need to take a week off."
des.部分桦树生物头部的花冠状器官，作用不明。遭遇过这类桦树生物的人在几天内都变得厄运: A corolla-shaped organ on the head of certain Chaos Remains, with its purpose unknown. Encountering these Chaos Remains is said to bring extreme misfortune within the following days. The report states, "I accidentally bit my tongue while consuming it. I need to take three days off."
des.部分桦树生物头部类似鸟喙的器官，用来攻击敌人，面对这类桦树生物时会直接在脑中听到: A beak-shaped organ on the head of certain Chaos Remains. These Chaos Remains can provoke piercing screams directly in the minds of their targets, rendering them unable to focus. The report states, "After I consumed it, a sour flavor attacked my mind and gave me the most terrible headache. I need to take three days off."
des.部分桦树生物的爪子，触摸后会产生伤心欲绝的情绪，从而失去反抗意志。报告上写着:“: The claws of certain Chaos Remains. When touched, they inflict overwhelming grief, leading to a loss of motivation and willpower. The report states, "It was salty, like tasting my own tears. I'm feeling utterly miserable now. I need to take three days off."
des.部分桦树生物头部的花状结构，目视后会在视野中产生旋涡状图形的错觉，逐渐占据整个视: A flower-shaped organ on the head of certain Chaos Remains. When observed, it creates an illusion of vortex in the observer's vision, gradually leading to a state of stupor. The report states, "Its taste was a constant cycle of bitter, sweet, and sour. After that, I drifted into a dream world of giant vortex and slept for three days."
des.部分桦树生物的甲壳，会发出特殊频率的光线使人昏昏欲睡。报告上写着：“仿佛不断在口: The armor of certain Chaos Remains, capable of emitting rays of a specific frequency, which can induce drowsiness in those exposed to them. The report states, "After I consumed it, my mouth exploded with tastes, and I started seeing light spots dancing in front of my eyes. After that, I slept for three days."
des.部分桦树生物身上木片状组织，会产生香味的幻觉，但无法分清香味来源从而失去方向感。: Flake-like tissue from certain Chaos Remains. It produces hallucinations of scents, yet the affected individuals are unable to determine the source of the aroma, resulting in a loss of direction. The report states, "After consuming it, I smelt the aroma but completely lost the sense of direction. I don't think I can work now. I need to take three days off."
des.昏恶巨象身上的带刺硬壳，会使人看不起其轮廓。报告上写着：“比花椒还麻。食用后无法: The spiky shell on Chaos Behemoth with an intriguing feature of having a blurred outline. The report states, "After I consumed it, my tongue went numb, worse than when I eat crazy hot peppers, and I couldn't tell the difference between doors and windows. I don't think I can go out in this state, so I need to take three days off."
des.昏恶巨象头部的硬壳，会使人不断耳鸣难以思考。报告上写着“咸酸味。食用后听觉被耳鸣: The hardened shell on the head of Chaos Behemoth. It causes constant noises in the ears and hampers thinking. The report states, "It has a salty and sour flavor. After I consumed it, my mind got bombarded with tinnitus and I couldn't sleep at all. I didn't even hear my alarm clock the next day and ended up late for work. I need to take a day off."
des.会使混厄石芝周围光线变暗的器官，方便桦树生物隐藏自身。报告上写着：“无味，但口感: This organ has the ability to dim the light surrounding Chaos Ganoderma, aiding Chaos Remains in concealing themselves. The reports stats, "Odorless with a cool aftertaste. After I consumed it, my computer went all haywire with a mysterious blank screen, and I can't get any work done like this. I need to take three days off."
des.会在混厄石芝附近产生浮游光点的器官，触碰后会灼伤皮肤。报告上写着：“味道辛辣带苦: This organ emits floating light spots near Chaos Ganoderma, causing skin burns upon contact. The report states, "Pungent with a bitter taste. After consuming it, I started seeing light spots, and I could actually gather them with my mind. Later, a mysterious explosion occurred where the light spots gathered. My entire group needs to take three days off."
des.与桦树生物鞭毛类似功能的器官，能使桦树生物在形态场中“游动”。但力量更为强劲，速: This organ serves a similar function to the flagellum of Chaos Remains, enabling its possessor to "swim" in the morphic field with greater power and speed.
des.能使桦树生物在形态场中“游动”的器官，并不知道其运作原理。但直接拆下来也能使用。: This organ allows Chaos Remains to "swim" in the morphic field. Although its principles remain a mystery, one can directly extract it from a Chaos Remain and use it.
des.7号自由港附近冰川出没的桦树生物的头骨。能让附近气温迅速降低。不知是喜好在寒冷地: The skull of a Chaos Remain that inhabits a glacier near Freeport Ⅶ, possessing the power to rapidly lower the temperature in its surroundings. It remains uncertain whether this creature had a preference for cold environments or if its presence played a role in the formation of the glacier.
des.7号自由港附近冰川出没的桦树生物的脊骨。能让附近气温迅速降低。不知是喜好在寒冷地: The spine of a Chaos Remain that inhabits a glacier near Freeport Ⅶ, possessing the power to rapidly lower the temperature in its surroundings. It remains uncertain whether this creature had a preference for cold environments or if its presence played a role in the formation of the glacier.
des.7号自由港附近冰川出没的桦树生物的尾骨。能让附近气温迅速降低。不知是喜好在寒冷地: The tailbone of a Chaos Remain that inhabits a glacier near Freeport Ⅶ, possessing the power to rapidly lower the temperature in its surroundings. It remains uncertain whether this creature had a preference for cold environments or if its presence played a role in the formation of the glacier.
des.从二向之触身上完整剖取的中枢系统结构，看起来有种诡异的熟知感……部分研究者认为这: The central system structure fully dissected from Dual Vector, appears to have a strange sense of familiarity... Some researchers believe that it will become the key to solving the mystery of Chaos Remains. The report states, "the taste is too elastic and requires cold mixing, and should not be consumed excessively."
des.昴宿系列机器人身上掉落的零件，由异想机关设计并制造。: Robot parts extracted from Tauri series robots, designed and produced by the Imaginary.
des.昴宿系列机器人身上拆下的管线，由异想机关设计并制造。: Tubing extracted from Tauri series robots, designed and produced by the Imaginary.
des.制造学会提灯的关键部件。学会提灯是使非升构者也能使用升构能力的神奇道具，当然，使: A crucial component for crafting Citadel Lanterns. Citadel Lanterns are miraculous items that allow non-ascenders to utilize ascension abilities. However, becoming proficient in using the Lanterns requires long-time practice.
des.从屠戮者装甲上取下的头盔，相当沉，令人怀疑在保护头部的同时是否也会损害颈椎健康。: A helmet salvaged from Slayer's armor, notably weighty. While it offers ample head protection, concerns arise regarding potential strain on the cervical spine. Some crew members suggest it is more than sufficient for a rugby match.
des.以高导电材料铸造的巨剑，配发给擅长使用与电相关的升构能力的黑月成员。刀上的铭文是: A claymore crafted from exceptionally conductive materials, allocated to Night Chains operatives specializing in electro-related abilities. The inscription on these blades reads, "Divine lightning."
des.配发给部分黑月执行人的头盔，有助于在混乱的战斗环境中保护自己。本质上是强度极高的: A specialized helmet provided to selected Night Chains Executors for shielding themselves in intricate combat scenarios. Essentially, it is a highly durable alloy helmet.
des.御险对策机械·艾尼的中枢系统，学会最前沿技术的结晶。除去对策机械自身的强大计算能: The core system of Counter-Risk Unit: Enni developed by Citadel, epitomizing Citadel's most advanced technology. In addition to the machine's potent computing capabilities, it also receives remote operational guidance.
des.<size=25><color=#FFB800>使用后可增加9999999点装备: <size=25><color=#FFB800>Use it to increase Equipment XP by 9999999 points.</color></size>\nIt appears as a gel-like substance resembling a nebula, which, when attached to an object, can be assimilated by the object's morphic field, becoming similar in nature to the attached object. Commonly used for repairing and welding equipment.
des.从反曲桦树生物身上取得的桦树生物核心，外形与其他桦树生物的核心类似，但光泽不同。: Chaos Remain cores obtained from CR: Recurve, similar to the cores of other Chaos Remains but differring in luster. The report has "DON'T EAT!" written in large letters with a marker.
des.从反曲桦树生物身上取得的桦树生物蜕皮层。研究报告上写着“吃了有点扎嘴，还是煮软点: Chaos Remain's shedding obtained from CR: Recurve. The report states: "A bit prickly in the mouth when eaten, it's better to cook it softer... otherwise, it could cause oral ulcers like mine. Taking a day off."
des.从反曲桦树生物身上取得的羽毛状素材，很难说这种物质真的拥有实体。研究报告上写着“: Feather-like material obtained from CR: Recurve, it's hard to say if this substance truly has a tangible form. The report states: "Baby is tasting the flavor of nothingness"... What does it mean?
des.自血影骨龙骨架上取得的素材之一，硬度较高。研究报告上写着“需要更大的烹饪……研究: One of the materials obtained from Sanguine Skeleton, characterized by its tough texture. The report states: "A larger cooking po... A larger research device is necessary for further analysis."
des.自血影骨龙骨架上取得的素材之一，具有独特的外形特征。研究报告上写着“适合做菜，但: One of the materials obtained from Sanguine Skeleton, characterized by its unique appearance. The report states: "While it can be used for cooking, the color of the final product appears to have a negative impact on consumer's appetite."
des.扇面被异常纹路侵蚀的折扇，曾是苍叶的随身武器之一。“春阳暖吹息，夏时化骤雨。”: A folding fan with corrupted patterns on its surface, once carried by Aoba as a concealed weapon. "Spring's sun, a gentle breath, warms the earth beneath; Summer's rain, a sudden dance, quenches the land's thirst in advance."
des.折断的簪子，曾是苍叶的随身武器之一。“秋至落叶纷，碎成一冬雪。”: A broken hairpin, once carried by Aoba as a concealed weapon. "Autumn dances in with leaves in flight; Winter whispers softly, snow blankets white."
des.嚎虎箱被打倒后神秘出现的纸箱，相比嚎虎箱的外貌要更方正可爱，也更像个平凡无奇的纸: A mysterious cardboard box dropped by a defeated HowlingBox. This box resembles a standard container, possessing a more square and charming appearance than a typical HowlingBox. Rumors suggest that upon opening this container, some may catch a glimpse of the ■■■■■■, while others vanish without a trace...
des.泥嚎箱被打倒后自动变成的崭新硬纸板，似乎仍散发着纸浆的香气。这种硬纸板折成的箱子: A brand-new cardboard transformed from a defeated HelloBox, emitting the scent of paper pulp. This cardboard can be fashioned into a sturdy box that offers excellent protection for its contents, thus making it a highly sought-after packaging material.
des.以神秘材料制成的弦状素材，触摸它时，耳边仿佛回荡着技艺精湛的乐声。: A string-like material made of mysterious material. It seems to echo exquisite music in your ears when you touch it.
des.以神秘材料制成的弦状素材，触摸它时，耳边仿佛回荡着即使时光流逝也不曾丝毫改变的乐: A string-like material made of mysterious material. It seems to echo music in your ears that remains unchanged despite the passage of time when you touch it.
des.以神秘材料制成的弦状素材，触摸它时，耳边仿佛回荡着多种经过缜密编排的乐声。: A string-like material made of mysterious material. It seems to echo meticulously arranged music in your ears when you touch it.
des.从冥灯桦树生物身上取得的素材，拥有与多肉植物叶片相似的外观，但其上却跳动着不会熄: Materials obtained from Nether CR, have an appearance similar to succulent leaves, but with flames that never extinguish dancing on them. The report states: "It seems they can't be stir-fried; the pan was damaged by the heating. I'll try a different pan next time."
des.从冥灯桦树生物身上取得的素材，在脱离主体后显得格外像是从禽类身上取下的部分。研究: Material obtained from Nether CR, appears particularly similar to parts taken from birds once separated from the main body. The report states: "Makes a nice soup! After drinking it, I felt warm all over, which is suitable for rest. Taking a fifteen-hour leave."
des.从桦树生物“仗剑乌”身上取得的素材，靠近耳边，能听见其中似乎仍然流动着电流。研究: Material obtained from Chaos Remain "Golden Crow". When held close to ears, it seems you can still hear the flow of electric current. The report specifically notes that insulated gloves must be worn when handling it.
des.从桦树生物“仗剑乌”身上取得的素材，即使在脱离本体后仍然保持着极高的温度。研究报: Material obtained from Chaos Remain "Golden Crow", maintains an extremely high temperature even after being separated from the main body. The report specifically notes that it needs to be stored separately and must not come near flammable or explosive items.
des.英武机甲Ⅶ型的部分装甲，采用特殊合金打造，坚固异常。据说这部机甲在设计过程中得到: Part of the armor of Herald Mecha VII. Made of special alloy, making it extraordinarily strong. It is said that the design process of this mecha was assisted by internal personnel from a certain large corporation.
des.英武机甲Ⅶ型的火炮，设计经典，火力强劲。据说这部机甲的武器部分和黑月执行人配发的: The cannon of Herald Mecha VII. Classically designed and has powerful firepower. It is said that the weapon part of this mecha is remarkably similar to the weapon issued to Night Chains' executors... Why?
des.由“哀怜魔女”身上脱落的不明组织，散发着清晨露水或是眼泪的味道。“谁来发现迷途的: An unknown tissue that fell from "Mournful Witch". Exudes a scent of morning dew or tears. "Who will find her who is astray? Who will weep for her?"
des.由“哀怜魔女”身上脱落的不明组织，触感和绢花或者孩子们的折纸花类似。“谁来为她献: An unknown tissue that fell from "Mournful Witch". Has a texture similar to silk flowers or the paper flowers folded by children. "Who will offer her flowers? Who will bury her?"
des.打倒化物后出现的纸片，不知为何是对应化物的形状。据说将其贴在别的物品上就可以为其: The paper that appears after defeating the creature. No one knows why it's in the shape of the corresponding creature. It is said that sticking it onto other items can bestow them with the "priceless" attribute. Uh, so basically it's very expensive?

The paper that appears after defeating the creature. No one knows why it's in the shape of the corresponding creature. It is said that sticking it onto other items can bestow them with the "soft and cute" attribute. Punch it!

The paper that appears after defeating the creature. No one knows why it's in the shape of the corresponding creature. It is said that sticking it onto other items can bestow them with the "wealth lost, disaster avoided" attribute... What use is this?

The paper that appears after defeating the creature. No one knows why it's in the shape of the corresponding creature. It is said that sticking it onto other items can bestow them with the "invigorated" attribute. Palm slap!
des.《西大陆列车涂装标准色卡》登记的12号涂料，由孔雀石研磨加工制成，造价相对较高。: Registered as paint No.12 in the Western Continent Standard Color Card for Train Livery, made from malachite grinding and processing, resulting in a relatively high cost.
des.《西大陆列车涂装标准色卡》登记的47号涂料，由青金石研磨加工制成。据说这种颜色的: Registered as paint No.47 in the Western Continent Standard Color Card for Train Livery, made from ground Lapis Lazuli. It is said that the dye for this color was once affordable only by nobles in the Mundus Empire.
des.《西大陆列车涂装标准色卡》登记的25号涂料，由铁矿石和树脂凝炼制成，可谓工业文明: Registered as paint No.25 in the Western Continent Standard Color Card for Train Livery, made from iron ore and resin, can be considered a crystallization of industrial civilization.
des.《西大陆列车涂装标准色卡》登记的99号涂料，由钛矿石和深眠者素材加工制成，透着一: Registered as paint No.99 in the Western Continent Standard Color Card for Train Livery, made from Titanium Ore and Deep Sleeper materials, exuding an exceptionally beautiful whiteness.
des.《西大陆列车涂装标准色卡》登记的77号涂料，由银矿石和树脂凝炼制成，颜色更胜皎洁: Registered as paint No.77 in the Western Continent Standard Color Card for Train Livery, refined from silver ore and resin, with a color that surpasses the brightness of moonlight.
des.《西大陆列车涂装标准色卡》登记的50号涂料，由桦树生物身上提取的素材为主要原料制: Registered as paint No.50 in the Western Continent Standard Color Card for Train Livery, made primarily from materials extracted from CR, seems capable of igniting any night.
des.一把威力强大的武器，但离开意识海泄露的范围后已经失去了它应有的威力。尽管如此，它: A powerful weapon, but it has lost its due power after leaving the range of Unbewusstes leakage. Despite this, it still vibrates from time to time... as if it still desires to fight.
des.“归墟”的披风的一部分，又或是它本身的一部分。天空何以被染成红色，又是什么将其割: A part of the cloak of "Guixu," or perhaps a part of Guixu itself. Why is the sky dyed red, and what has shattered it?
des.从魔沼之刃身上取得的前肢素材，即使脱离了本体，它仍旧异常锋利……甚至足以腐蚀、切: Material from the forelimbs obtained from Venom Scythe, remains exceptionally sharp even when separated from the main body... enough to corrode and cut through steel.
des.从魔沼之刃身上取得的头部素材，研究者们仍在讨论它的实际作用。坚韧的程度与其看起来: Head material obtained from Venom Scythe; researchers are still discussing its practical function. The level of toughness is completely inconsistent with its appearance of elegance and fragility.
des.从沼泞桦树生物身上取得的素材，外形与一些海洋生物的外壳有类似之处。研究报告上写着: Materials obtained from Venom CR, resemble the shells of some marine creatures. The report states: "You won't hear the sound of the sea by holding it to your ear, so don't try."
des.从沼泞桦树生物身上取得的素材，外形与鸟类的头部器官有类似之处。研究报告上写着“味: Material obtained from Venom CR, resembles a bird's head organ. The report states: "The taste is not as good as braised duck heads and is not suitable as a snack with drinks. I need to take leave tonight to go out and buy food."
des.从沼泞桦树生物身上取得的素材，外形与一些植物的根系有类似之处。研究报告上写着“泡: Material obtained from Venom CR, has a shape similar to some plant roots. The report states: "Making tea with it is good for health." Could this be an opportunity for the commercialization of CR materials?
des.从沼泞桦树生物身上取得的素材，一份性状粘稠而令人作呕的物质。研究报告上用大字涂鸦: Material obtained from Venom CR, a sticky and nauseating substance. The report is scrawled with large letters: Witch's Poison?!... Really?
des.从“捕人达鱼”身上取得的嘴部素材，能吞噬人类、甚至是船只和建筑物的巨型牙齿。谁敢: The mouth material obtained from the "Capturing Fish" has gigantic teeth capable of devouring humans, and even ships and buildings. Who would dare approach?
des.从“捕人达鱼”身上取得的头部素材，显然不能食用。不过研究员们正在尝试从中提取致其: Head material obtained from the "Buran Dayu" is obviously inedible. However, researchers are trying to extract the luminous ingredients from it and are committed to developing some of its "special uses."
des.以神秘材料制成的弦状素材，触摸它时，耳边仿佛回荡着万物最原始的低语。: A string shaped material made of a mysterious matter. When one touches it, the origin of all existence whispers in their ears.
