name.旧书签: Go Gentle into that Good Ending

detail.【晶簇】生成时，每层回复我方全体3%生命值: When generating a [Crystal Cluster], each stack heals all allies for 3% of Max HP.
detail.使目标冰冻，【普通攻击】攻击速度减半，持续6秒\\n有10%的概率触发【冰封】: Halve the target's [Basic Attack] speed, lasting 6 seconds.\n10% chance to inflict [Freeze].
detail.取消目标当前攻击，并将目标向后方击退一段距离，对大型敌方无效: Cancel the target's current action and knock them back, ineffective against large enemies.
detail.取消目标当前攻击，并将目标击飞至后排，对大型敌方无效: Cances the target's current action and launch them to rear line, ineffective against large enemies.
detail.每次受到亚莉奈技能牌治疗的我方目标攻击力和防御力+1.5%，上限60%: When an ally is healed by Arina's skill card, increase their ATK and DEF by 1.5%, up to 60%.
detail.形成【力场】，使我方全体受到伤害降低，时间可叠加: Generate a [Force Field] that reduces all allies' DMG taken. Its duration stacks.
detail.使用紫卡或绿卡时，“黑莓”有50%概率出没，对敌方射出5把匕首并将造成伤害的50: When using a Purple or Green card, there's a 50% chance to summon "Blackberry" that hurls 5 daggers at enemies and heals self for 50% of the DMG dealt.
detail.使目标变得萌萌哒，持续5秒，变萌后的目标攻击力和防御力降低1%，可叠加: Make the target cute, reducing their ATK and DEF by 1%, lasting 5 seconds. This effect stacks.
detail.使范围内敌方防御力减半，同时受到的冰冻和物理伤害增加25%，持续6秒: Halve the DEF of nearby enemies, and increase their Frost and Physical DMG taken by 25%, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.展开【屏障】，使范围内我方受到伤害降低，持续5秒，时间可叠加: Generate a [Barrier] that reduces nearby allies' DMG taken, lasting 5 seconds. Its duration stacks.
detail.使目标防御力降低30%，持续5秒: Reduce the target's DEF by 30%, lasting 5 seconds.
detail.攻击可以在敌方之间弹射2次: Attacks bounce between enemies up to 2 times.
detail.急速燃烧，立刻结算范围内【点燃】和【炽地】的伤害: Burn rapidly. Immediately settle the DMG dealt by [Ignite] and [Blaze] within the target area.
detail.使目标每次受到伤害时额外受到1段伤害，持续5秒，伤害类特殊效果除外: Whenever the target takes DMG (excluding DMG effects), take 1 more hit, lasting 5 seconds.
detail.对目标额外造成1段伤害，如目标处于【冻结】/【冻伤】/【冰封】/【封冻】造成的伤: Deal 1 more hit to the target. If the target is under [Chill], [Frostbite], [Freeze] or [Megafreeze] effect, increase the DMG by 50%, 75%, 100% or 100% respectively.
detail.无敌期间，免疫所有伤害，驱散并免疫控制和伤害类特殊效果: Nullify all DMG taken, dispel and gain immunity to crowd-control and DMG effects.
detail.使目标昏睡失去战斗能力，昏睡期间受到的最终伤害增加10%，持续5秒: Make the target sleep, incapacitating them. Increase the target's Final DMG taken by 10%, lasting 5 seconds.
detail.【莱格爆爆】被丢弃入弃牌区时，视为使用\\n【莱格爆爆】被正常使用时，【弃牌】指: When [Legge Bomber] is discarded, it is considered as used.\nWhen [Legge Bomber] is used normally, reduce the cooldown of [Discard] action by 5 seconds.
detail.使目标晕眩失去战斗能力，持续2秒: Stun the target, incapacitating them, lasting 2 seconds.
detail.每次使用【暗艺】时，额外造成1段负能伤害\\n我方全体生命值上限之和/平均攻击力: Each time [Shadowcraft] is used, it deals an additional hit of Reverengy DMG.\nThe higher the total max HP/average ATK of all allies, the higher the DMG.
detail.格挡期间，抵御自身受到伤害的80%，但无法进行【普通攻击】\\n同时期间免疫【打: Reduce DMG taken by 80% and disable [Basic Attack]. Gain immunity to [Interrupt] and [Stun]. End the effect by using self skill cards.
detail.使全场燃烧，对敌我双方全体每秒造成1段伤害，持续6秒\\n同时驱散敌我全体的【冻: Set the battlefield on fire, dealing DMG to all units on the field once per second, lasting 6 seconds. Dispel [Chill] and [Freeze] effects from all units.
detail.使目标每次【普通攻击】时受到1段毒性伤害，有效5次: When using [Basic Attack], take Toxic DMG once, up to 5 times.
detail.使目标燃烧，每秒造成1段伤害，持续6秒: Set the target on fire, dealing DMG once every second, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.使目标区域范围燃烧，对范围内敌方每秒造成1段伤害，持续6秒: Set an area on fire, dealing DMG once every second, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.粉尘燃爆引发剧烈爆炸，立刻1.5倍结算范围内【点燃】，【炽地】和【燎原】的伤害: Trigger a violent explosion, immediately settle the DMG dealt by [Ignite], [Blaze], and [Wildfire] within the target area by 150%.
detail.每次命中有20%概率触发1道落雷，造成1段伤害: Each hit has a 20% chance to trigger a lightning, dealing DMG once.
detail.当前可以变化的卡牌颜色有：<color=#F81532>红</color>，<c: The current available colors for transformation are: <color=#F81532>Red</color>, <color=#026AED>Blue</color>, <color=#63C65E>Green</color>.
detail.使正对区域大范围燃烧，对范围内敌方每秒造成1段伤害，持续6秒: Engulf a large area in flames, dealing DMG once every second, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.释放后，对范围内敌方造成1段伤害，同时触发【点燃】\\n【天火】为【爆炸物】\\: Deal DMG to nearby enemies once and inflict [Ignite].\n[Celestial Fire] is [Explosive].\nWhen you have 18 [Celestial Fire], newly generated [Celestial Fire] is automatically used.
detail.本卡可以被敌方技能响应，引起爆炸伤害: This card can be detonated by enemy skills.
detail.使目标【普通攻击】的攻击速度提高至最大，同时使目标【普通攻击】造成的伤害加倍，持: Maximize the target's [Basic Attack] speed and double their [Basic Attack] DMG, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.使目标无法使用【技能攻击】，只能使用【普通攻击】，持续6秒: The target can only attack with [Basic Attack], lasting 6 seconds.
detail.使用任意紫卡后，抽1张牌，优先【寻梦】，限1次\\n使用得意技能牌时，从牌库将1: After using any Purple card, draw 1 card, prioritizing [Dreamseek], This effect can be triggered only once.\nWhen using a [Leader Skill] or Ultimate card, add 1 [Star Arc] from the deck to your hand.
detail.使目标每次攻击时，有50%的概率取消此次攻击并对自身造成1段精神伤害，持续6秒: When attacking, there's a 50% chance to cancel this attack and deal Psychic DMG to self once, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.1道落雷，对目标造成1段伤害，同时触发【引雷】: Summon a lightning on the target, dealing DMG once and inflicting [Electrify].
detail.使目标无法受到新的治疗效果，攻击和防御类增益效果，持续6秒: Prevent the target from receiving newly applied healing effects, offensive and defensive buffs, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.3道落雷，对目标造成3段伤害\\n同时触发【引雷】: Summon 3 lightnings on the target, dealing DMG over 3 hits and inflicting [Electrify].
detail.五雷轰顶，对目标造成5段伤害\\n同时触发【引雷】: Unleash fiery lightnings, dealing DMG to the target over 5 hits and inflicting [Electrify].
detail.使目标受到的最终伤害增加15%，持续5秒: Increase the target's Final DMG taken by 15%, lasting 5 seconds.
detail.使目标进入隐身状态，不会被当做攻击目标，叠加刷新时间: The target becomes invisible and untargetable for attacks. Duration resets when stacked.
detail.霸体期间，驱散并免疫控制效果: Dispel and gain immunity to crowd-control effects.
detail.使目标受到【引雷】的概率加倍，持续6秒: Double the chance to inflict [Electrify] on the target, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.自身处于【格挡】或【隐形】状态时，【无相·鸾回麟返】追加4段伤害: When Nabi is in [Block] or [Invisible] status, [Muso: Hokai Rinhen] deals DMG over 4 more hits.
detail.使用【磁弦脉冲】后，【磁弦脉冲】有30%概率返回手牌: After using [Pulse Arrow], there is a 30% chance for [Pulse Arrow] to return to the hand.
detail.生命值低于20%时，直接使用【净化】，限1次: When HP is below 20%, directly Use [Purge], limited to x1.
detail.打出红卡后，有10%概率回收1张牌，优先红卡: Playing a Red card has a 10% chance to retrieve a card, prioritizing a Red one.
detail.每获得1张黑卡，获得1点费用: Upon obtaining a Black card, restores 1 Cost.
detail.每把飞斧有25%概率额外打出1次: Each throwing axe has a 25% chance to strike one more time.
detail.解除目标的【护盾】，【屏障】和【力场】，同时打断目标的【格挡】状态: Remove the target's [Shield], [Barrier], [Force Field] and [Block] effect.
detail.连续打出2张【煽风】或【点火】时，面前区域触发【炽地】\\n连续打出3张【煽风】: When playing 2 consecutive [Fanning] or [Kindling], triggers [Blaze] in the front area.\nWhen playing 3 consecutive [Fanning] or [Kindling], triggers [Wildfire].\nWhen playing 4 consecutive [Fanning] or [Kindling], triggers [Inferno].
detail.【雪崩】的雪球初始耐久提高: Increase the initial durability of the snowball generated by [Avalanche].
detail.使用【人气大回转】后，我方前排防御力+2%，可叠加: When using [Big Comeback], increase frontline allies' DEF by 2%. This effect stacks.
detail.使用【雪崩】后，下1张蓝卡回复自身10%生命值: When using [Avalanche], the next Blue card heals self for 10% of Max HP.
detail.当【灵蝶环舞】对同一目标连续使用时，每秒回复效果提升至4%: When [Butterfly's Blessing] is continuously used on the same target, increase healing effect to 4%.
detail.使用【原初之梦】回收的卡牌，下1次使用时所需费用-1: Reduce the Cost of the card retrieved by [Primordial Dream] by 1 when using it next time.
detail.【强愈弹】和【爆炎弹】有30%概率额外打出1次: [Healing Shot] and [Heat Shot] have a 30% chance to trigger one more time.
detail.【煽风】可以对我方目标使用，使命中的我方目标下1次【普通攻击】触发【点燃】: [Fanning] can be used on allies, causing their next [Basic Attack] to trigger [Ignite].
detail.【断火】追加效果：\\n【急燃】成功结算燃烧伤害时\\n每结算1个【点燃】回复自:
Cut Flames Bonus Effect:
When Flare successfully deals burning damage,
each Ignition inflicted heals this character for 5% of Max HP;
each Blaze inflicted heals this character for 10% of Max HP.
detail.【震撼弹】的爆炸范围增大，同时触发【破盾】\\n【震撼弹】为【爆炸物】: [Stun Grenade] strikes enemies in a larger area and inflicts [Break].\n[Stun Grenade] is [Explosive].
detail.使用【强行突破】时，注射肾上腺素，回复自身15%生命值，同时自身【普通攻击】攻击: When using [Forceful Breakthrough], inject Adrenaline to heal self for 15% of Max HP and maximize [Basic Attack] speed, lasting 10 seconds.
detail.使用【震撼弹】后，抽1张牌，优先【震撼弹】: After using [Stun Grenade], draw a card, prioritizing [Stun Grenade].
detail.使用【快速上弹】时，注射肾上腺素，回复自身15%生命值，同时自身【普通攻击】攻击: When using [Quick Reload], injects Adrenaline to heal this character for 15% of Max HP and increases [Basic Attack] speed to maximum, lasting 10 seconds.
detail.【咕咚弹】有30%概率额外打出1次: [Plop Bomb] has a 30% chance to be played one more time.
detail.使用【大红按钮】引爆的【爆炸物】造成的最终伤害提高30%: The Final DMG of [Explosive] detonated by [Red Button] increases by 30%.
detail.【爆破作业】追加效果：\\n此卡被卡牌效果丢弃时，被丢弃的那张【爆破作业】本场战: [Demolition] Bonus Effect:\nWhen this card is discarded by a card effect, reduces the cost of the discarded card by 1. This effect stacks.
detail.使用【背包整理】时，抽1张牌，优先带有【爆炸物】词条的卡牌: When using [Backpack Check], draw 1 card, prioritizing cards with the [Explosive] term.
detail.使用【彩虹瓶】后，有25%概率再来一瓶: Using [Rainbow Flask] has a 25% chance to get an additional flask.
detail.使用【彩虹瓶】后，下1张绿卡治疗量提高100%，可叠加: After using [Rainbow Flask], the healing of the next Green card is increased by 100% and can be stacked.
detail.使用【奥义·里镰鼬】后，从弃牌区回收全部的【镰鼬】加入手牌: After using [Ogi: Ura Kamaitachi], retrieves all [Kamaitachi] from discard pile into your hand.
detail.每次使用【镰鼬】后，自身【普通攻击】攻击速度+10%，上限100%: Each time [Kamaitachi] is used, [Basic Attack] speed +10%, up to 100%
detail.使用【强打】后，下1张红卡所需费用-1: Using [Kyoda] reduces the cost of the next Red card played by 1.
detail.使用【强打】后，本场战斗【光害强打】的攻击段数+1，限8次: Using [Kyoda] enables [Kogai Kyoda] to strike one more time during this battle, up to 8 times.
detail.使用【强打】后，我方全体攻击力+0.5%，可叠加: Using [Kyoda] increases all allies' ATK by 0.5%. This effect stacks.
detail.若【旋羽】丢弃的是红卡，这张红卡本场战斗伤害提高20%: If a Red card is discarded by [Plumed Feather], the red card deals 20% more damage during this battle.
detail.使用【旋羽】后，自身防御力-5%，攻击力+15%，持续10秒: After using [Plumed Feather], DEF -5%, ATK +15%, lasts 10s
detail.使用【逆风】后，本场战斗【秘剑·鼠返】的攻击段数+3，限12次: Using [Gyafuu] enables all [Hiken: Nezumi Kaeshi] to strike 3 more hits during this battle, stacking up to 12 times.
detail.【回天】追加效果：\\n若翻到的不是红卡，则额外再翻1次: [Kaiten] has additional effect:\nIf the card flipped is not Red, flip an additional card.
detail.【秘剑·鼠返】追加效果：\\n追加1段突刺，对敌方造成1段伤害并回复自身20%生: [Hiken: Nezumi Kaeshi] deals one more thrust attack, dealing DMG to the enemy once and healing this character for 20% of Max HP.
detail.“The girl is so dangerous”\\n使用【真棒】后，本场战: "The girl is so dangerous"\nAfter using [Bad], increase the DMG of [Bad] by 10% in this battle.

detail.每次获得自身紫卡或者使用【MEGA混沌加农】时，朱迪发射2枚玉米炸弹，每枚对随机: Whenever obtaining Shire's Purple card or using [Chaotic Cannon MEGA], Jude launches 2 Corn Bombs, each dealing DMG to a random enemy once and inflicting [Corrupt].
detail.每次使用【MEGA混沌加农】时，朱迪发射1枚急救弹，治疗生命值最低的我方，回复其: Whenever using [Chaotic Cannon MEGA], Jude launches a Healing Bomb that heals the ally with the lowest HP for 10% of their Max HP.\nIn addition, add one of Shire's skill cards from the deck or discard pile to your hand.
detail.使用【拟态】后，使我方后排攻击力+6%，可叠加: After using [Mimic], increase all rearline allies' ATK by 6%. This effect stacks.
detail.将自身造成伤害的13%，回复自身生命值: Heal Lissandra for 13% of her DMG dealt.
detail.使用自身技能牌时【霸体】2秒: When this character uses a skill card, gains [Hyperarmor], lasting 2 seconds.
detail.使用【无尽】或【无厌】后，下1张【暗艺】不消耗费用: After using [Avarice] or [Infinity], reduce the Cost of the next [Shadowcraft] to 0.
detail.使用【暗艺】后，下1次【队长技】伤害提高50%，可叠加: After using [Shadowcraft], increase the DMG of the next [Leader Skill] by 50%. This effect stacks.
detail.使用【盛夏泡影】后，使我方全体回复5%生命值\\n驱散场上的【炎热】/【酷热】/: When using [Summer Mirage], heal all allies for 5% of Max HP.\nDispel [Burning], [Melting] and [Boiling] weather.\nDispel [Blaze], [Wildfire] and [Inferno] from the ally field.
detail.每次使用【连涌】和【盛夏泡影】后，使我方全体【狂暴】: When using [Burst Surge] or [Summer Mirage], grant [Berserk] to all allies.
detail.每隔10秒触发1次，被【知觉干预】标记的目标队友受到攻击时，从牌库或弃牌区将1张: When the ally marked by [Perception Intervention] is attacked, add an [Induced Awakening] from the deck or discard pile to your hand. This effect is triggered once every 10 seconds.
detail.【契约】持续期间，我方全体受到的治疗量加倍\\n【契约】持续期间，自身濒死时【无: When [Pact] is in effect, all allies receive doubled healing.\nWhen [Pact] is in effect, this character gains [Invincible] when taking lethal DMG, lasting 3 seconds. In addition, generate a Black card [Reverengy] in your deck.
detail.使用【精神风暴】后，持续6秒内，每打出1张牌，【伴生体】消耗10点精力值释放1次: Within 6 seconds after using [Psychic Storm], for each card used, [Symbiont] consumes 10 Energy to unleash a Psychic Pulse, dealing DMG to all enemies once, reducing all enemies' ATK by 1% and increasing self ATK by 1%, up to 60%.\nPsychic Pulse is [Wave].
detail.使用【元素核·冰】后，使生命值最低的1名我方目标获得【护盾】，持续10秒，【护盾: After using [Element Core: Frost], grant the ally unit with the lowest HP a [Shield] for 10s, with the durability of the [Shield] being 2000% of own DEF.\nIn addition, Wensheng becomes immune to [Chill] / [Frostbite] / [Freeze] effects.
detail.【铁幕】存在时，帕拉笛获得【霸体】并使我方前排免疫【打断】/【击晕】: When [Iron Curtain] is present, Paladi gains [Hyperarmor] and grants all frontline allies immunity against [Interrupt] and [Stun].
detail.【铁幕】击破时，直接打出1次【火墙】\\n同时使我方全体防御力+3%，可叠加: When [Iron Curtain] is destroyed, cast 1 [Firewall] immediately, and increase all allies' DEF by 3%. This effect stacks.
detail.使用【高压镇暴】后，【A-2SO】全面锁定敌方区域，进行高强度扫射，对随机敌方目: After using [Riot Suppression], [A-2SO] locks down the enemy's field and strafes the area, dealing DMG to random enemies over 6 hits.\nAfterward, 1 more [A-2SO] will participate in the next [Riot Suppression] and provide [Basic Attack] support, up to 4.
detail.每30秒触发1次，受到伤害时，若场上没有【铁幕】，从牌库或弃牌区将1张【铁幕】加: When taking DMG, if there is no [Iron Curtain] present, add 1 [Iron Curtain] from the deck or discard pile to your hand. This effect is triggered once every 30 seconds.\nWhenever using a Blue card, increase self ATK by 2%, up to 30%.
detail.使处于【燎原】下的目标，受到的最终伤害增加20%\\n每施加1层【燎原】，受到的: Enemies affected by [Wildfire] take 20% more Final DMG.\nFor each [Wildfire] stack, the targets take 5% more Final DMG, stacking up to 6 times.
detail.使用【蓄力】后，抽1张牌，优先自身技能牌: Use [Charge] to draw 1 card, prioritizing self skill cards
detail.【贯筒射击】和【爆裂射击】有30%概率额外打出1次: [Penetrating Shot] and [Explosive Shot] have a 30% chance to hit an additional x1 time.
detail.使用【蓄力】后，使【贯筒射击】和【爆裂射击】伤害提高10%，上限150%: After using [Charge], increases the damage of [Tsuranuki Shot] and [Burst Shot] by 10%, up to 150%.
detail.使目标攻击力和防御力下降10%，持续6秒，持续期间目标的精力值每秒下降1%: Reduce the target's ATK and DEF by 10%, lasting 6 seconds. The target loses 1% of Energy per second.
detail.【磁力阱】消失后，使1名生命值最低的我方获得【磁力盾】，持续10秒，【磁力盾】的: When [Magnetic Trap] expires, the ally with the lowest HP gains a [Magnetic Shield] for 10 seconds, with the shield's durability being 2000% of own DEF.\nWhen [Magnetic Shield] is present, it reduces Electro DMG taken by 50%.
detail.每积累十万【伏特值】，生成1张【十万伏特】加入手牌\\n每积累一百万【伏特值】，: For every 100K [Volt] accumulated, generates a [100K Volts] in your hand.\nFor every 1M [Volt] accumulated, generates a [1M Volts] at the top of your deck.
detail.每积累一万【伏特值】，【蓄电磁场】持续期间，我方全体受到的最终伤害降低1%，上限: For every 10K [Volt] accumulated, all allies take 1% less Final DMG while [EM Field] is in effect, stacking up to 50%.
detail.【磁力阱】持续期间，我方每造成5次【引雷】，攻击力+1%，可叠加: While [Magnetic Trap] is in effect, whenever any ally inflicts [Electrify] over 5 times, increases ATK by 1%. This effect stacks.
detail.【伏特值】获取额外+500\\n使用【百万伏特】后，使我方所有带有【引雷】词条的: Generates 500 more [Volt].\nAfter playing [1M Volts], all allies' [Electrify] cards deal 15% more damage. This effect stacks.
detail.【昴宿七】消失时，生成1张【新星】加入手牌: When [27 Tauri] vanishes, generate 1 [Nova] in your hand.
detail.每有1张黑卡在牌库或手牌中时，每秒获得0.05点费用\\n从牌库抽到【负能】时，: For each Black card in the deck and your hand, gain 0.05 Cost per second.\nWhen you draw [Reverengy] from the deck, retrieve 1 card from the discard pile to your hand.
detail.使用【新星】后，每秒获得0.1点费用，持续8秒\\n使用【超新星】后，每秒获得0: After using [Nova], gain 0.1 Cost per second, lasting 8 seconds.\nAfter using [Supernova], gain 0.5 Cost per second, lasting 8 seconds.
detail.我方全体【波】造成的伤害提高50%: [Waves] dealt by allies deal 50% more DMG.
detail.对目标额外造成1段负能伤害: Deal Reverengy DMG once more to the target.
detail.使用【队长技】或得意技能牌时/【掘金二号】使用【淘金】时，额外发射1枚金子火箭飞: When casting [Leader Skill] or using Ultimate cards or when [Nugget Mech 2] uses [Gold Rush], launches an additional rocket fist that punches a random enemy, dealing DMG once and [Electrify] them.
detail.使用【蝶舞】后，从牌库将1张【鬼舞】加入手牌\\n使用【鬼舞】后，从牌库将1张【: After using [Butterfly Dance], adds 1 [Ghost Dance] from the deck to your hand.\nAfter using [Ghost Dance], adds 1 [Butterfly Dance] from the deck to your hand.
detail.使用【蝶舞】后，本场战斗【蝶舞】的攻击段数+2，限6次\\n使用【鬼舞】后，使下: After using [Butterfly Dance], [Butterfly Dance] deals 2 more hits, lasting the entire battle. This effect can be triggered up to 6 times.\nAfter using [Ghost Dance], the next [Ephemeral Dance] deals 50% more damage. This effect stacks.
detail.使用【队长技】或得意技能牌时，自身攻击力+3%，上限99%: Whenever using [Leader Skill] or Ultimate card, increases this character's ATK by 3%, up to 99%.

detail.使用【电光石火】时，有50%概率触发天气【雨】/【大雨】/【暴雨】，限触发1次\: Using [Boltrain] has a 50% chance to trigger the weather [Drizzle], [Rain], or [Rainstorm]. This effect can be triggered only once.\nWhile the weather [Drizzle], [Rain], or [Rainstorm] is in effect, all allies deal 10% more Electro DMG.
detail.使用【富氧大气】时，有50%概率遇到天气【炎热】/【酷热】/【炙热】，限触发1次: Using [Oxygen-Rich Atmosphere] has a 50% chance to trigger the weather [Burning], [Melting], or [Boiling]. This effect can be triggered only once.\nWhile the weather [Burning], [Melting], or [Boiling] is in effect, all allies deal 10% more Fire DMG.
detail.使用【开尔文笑话】时，有50%概率遇到天气【雪】/【大雪】/【暴雪】，限触发1次: When using [Kelvin Joke], there is a 50% chance to trigger the weather [Snow], [Snowstorm], or [Blizzard]. This effect can be triggered only once.\nWhile the weather [Snow], [Snowstorm], or [Blizzard] is in effect, all allies deal 10% more Frost DMG.
detail.每秒对目标造成1段负能伤害，同时目标受到的治疗效果下降50%，持续5秒: Deal Reverengy DMG once per second to the target and reduce their healing received by 50%, lasting 5 seconds.
detail.使用【奇异火花】后，使我方全体攻击力和防御力+1%，上限15%: After using [Strange Spark], all allies' ATK and DEF increase by 1%, up to 15%.

detail.每有1张【新星】/【元素新星】/【超新星】被生成时，使随机我方攻击力+1%，上限: Whenever a [Nova], [Elemental Nova], or [Supernova] is generated, increase the ATK of a random ally by 1%, up to 30%.

detail.使用【寻径】后，基于当前手牌数量和费用数量强化自身\\n每张手牌使我方全体攻击力: After using [Pathfind], enhance allies based on the current amount of cards and Cost.\nFor each card in your hand, increase all allies' ATK by 0.5%, up to 50%.\nFor each Cost you have, increase all allies' DEF by 0.5%, up to 50%.
detail.使用【家虎】后，我方全体防御力+15%，持续6秒: Using [Ietora] increases all allies' DEF by 15% for 6 seconds.

detail.【自然回声】持续期间，每秒回复随机我方1%生命值: When [Natural Echo] is in effect, heal a random ally for 1% of Max HP every second.
detail.【回旋飞斧】释放期间，有25%概率【格挡】受到的攻击: While [Whirling Axe] is in effect, this character has a 25% chance to [Block] incoming attacks.
detail.使用【无明】后，下1张【一发入魂】造成的伤害提高100%: After using [Avidya], the next [Homerun] deals 100% more damage.
detail.每次获得【磁弦脉冲】，自身攻击力+0.5%，上限50%: Upon gaining [Pulse Arrow], increases ATK by 0.5%, up to 50%.
detail.【开尔文笑话】持续期间，我方造成的【斩裂】/【撕裂】伤害提高50%: While [Kelvin Joke] is in effect, all allies deal 50% more [Slash] or [Rend] damage.
detail.【富氧大气】持续期间，每次自身造成【点燃】时，获得0.1点费用: While [Oxygen-Rich Atmosphere] is in effect, whenever Kaleya [Ignite] an enemy, restores 0.1 Cost.
detail.每有1张【焚心余烬】被【销毁】时，使我方后排攻击力+5%，上限50%: Whenever a [Scorched Embers] is [Destroyed], increases all rear allies' ATK by 5%, up to 50%.
detail.使用【舒卷】时，使自身随机触发【无敌】/【霸体】/【隐形】，持续2秒: Casting [Tayutau] randomly grants Aoba [Invincible], [Hyperarmor], or [Invisible] for 2 seconds.
detail.开局生成1张【暗耀斩钢】加入手牌\\n【暗耀斩钢】在手牌中时，持续【销毁】手牌中: Generate 1 [Umbral Fulgor] in your hand at the start of battle.\nAs long as [Umbral Fulgor] is in your hand, all Black cards and [Shadowcraft] in your hand will be [Destroyed]. For each card [Destroyed] in this way, [Umbral Fulgor] deals 10% more DMG for the rest of the battle, up to 200%.
detail.【致幻】使目标命中率和造成的伤害降低20%，持续5秒\\n每次受到【致幻】的目标: Reduce hit rate and DMG dealt by 20%, lasting 5 seconds. When gaining [Hallucinate], gain 1 stack of [Mental Pollution], each stack granting a 20% chance to randomly trigger [Confuse], [Corrupt], [Sleep] or [Scorch] when gaining [Hallucinate], up to 5 stacks.
detail.【新音】持续期间，我方全体造成的最终伤害提高10%\\n非【新音】持续期间，我方: During [Neotune], all allies' Final DMG dealt is increased by 10%.\nWhen not in [Neotune], all allies take 10% less Final DMG.
detail.【圣痕】持续期间，每秒获得0.1点费用: During the duration of [Stigmata], gain 0.1 Cost per second.
detail.使用【圣痕】后，自身获得【蚀界之帷】，持续6秒\\n持续期间，每秒对附近敌方触发: After using [Stigmata], gain [Veil of Eclipse], lasting 6 seconds.\nDuring this period, inflict [Erode] on nearby enemies once per second and heal for 100% of the DMG dealt.\nDuring this period, whenever triggering [Stigmata Disintegration], increase the duration by 1 second.
detail.【链爆雷】爆炸时，有50%概率伤害加倍\\n触发该效果时，有50%概率将【多重装: When [Chained Grenade] explodes, there is a 50% chance for it to deal double DMG.\nWhen this effect is triggered, there is a 50% chance to enhance the effect inflicted by [Multiple Charges] to <color=#FFB800>[Thunder]</color>, <color=#FF6666>[Blaze]</color> or <color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color>.\nWhen both effects are triggered, there is a 50% chance for [Chained Grenade] to deal 10% more DMG, up to 150%.
detail.【无常】有33%概率对敌方目标附加随机1种【八苦】状态\\n每存在1种状态，敌方: [Anitya] has a 33% chance to inflict one random [Suffering] status on the target.\nFor each status present, increase the target's Final DMG taken by 8%.\n[Sufferings] include: Birth, Old Age, Illness, Death, Parting of Lovers, Meeting of Foes, Unfulfilled Longings, Blazing of Five Aggregates.
detail.【致幻瓦斯】被丢弃入弃牌区时，视为使用\\n使用【致幻瓦斯】后，使我方后排【隐形: When [Hallucinogenic Gas] is discarded, it is considered used.\nAfter using [Hallucinogenic Gas], grant rearline allies [Invisible], lasting 5 seconds.
detail.敌方每附着1枚【黏胶炸弹】，受到其他爆炸物伤害时，受到的爆炸物伤害增加15%，可: For each [Sticky Bomb] attached to the target, when the target takes DMG from other [Explosives], increase the DMG by 15%, stacking up to 100%.\nWhen this effect is triggered, the owner of that [Explosive] has their ATK increased by 1%, up to 50%.
detail.【致幻瓦斯】持续期间：\\n使我方前排受到的最终伤害降低25%\\n使我方【机械:
When [Hallucinogenic Gas] is in effect:
Reduce frontline allies' Final DMG taken by 25%.
Increase rearline allies' Final DMG dealt by 25%.
Grant [Berserk] to all ally [Mech Units].
detail.每只【机械狼】持续期间，为我方全体抵御12%伤害，可叠加\\n使用【队长技】或得: Each [Robotic K-9] reduces all allies' DMG taken by 12% when its on the field. This effect stacks.\nWhen using a [Leader Skill] or Ultimate card, gain [Invisible] and deploy one more [Robotic K-9], lasting 5 seconds.
detail.驱散目标受到的控制和伤害类特殊效果: Remove crowd-control and DMG effects from the target.
detail.使用【茶时法则】时，场上每存在1个【使魔】，额外获得0.5点费用: When using [Teatime Principle], for each [Familiar] on the field, additionally gain 0.5 Cost.
detail.使用【茶时法则】抽到的卡牌，卡牌持有者攻击力+3%，上限60%: When using the card drawn by [Teatime Principle], increase the card holder's ATK by 3%, up to 60%.
detail.【热应力】/【冷缩力】层数越高，敌方受到的火焰/冰冻伤害越高，最高50%: The more [Thermal Stress] or [Contraction Force] stacks, the more Fire or Frost DMG the enemy takes, up to 50%.
detail.【彗尾姬】跟随期间，目标队友造成的最终伤害提高20%: When followed by [Lady Cometrail], increase the target ally's Final DMG dealt by 20%.
detail.每层【注视】使敌方目标造成的最终伤害降低3%，上限10层: Each [Gaze] stack reduces the target's Final DMG dealt by 3%, up to 10 stacks.
detail.【星星】/【月亮】/【太阳】持续期间，每秒回复我方全体3%生命值: When [The Star], [The Moon] or [The Sun] is in effect, heal all allies for 3% of Max HP per second.
detail.使用【命运之轮】后，生成1张【奇异火花】加入手牌，且能超出手牌上限\\n【元素尖: After using [The Wheel], generate 1 [Strange Spark] in your hand, and it can exceed your hand size.\nWhen both [Elemental Spire] and [Mors] are present, all [Supernova] and [Strange Spark] in your hand automatically fuse into [Antediluvian Light], and it can exceed your hand size.
detail.对目标施加1层【冻伤】，每层【冻伤】使目标受到/造成的最终伤害增加/降低3%，持: Apply 1 [Frostbite] stack to the target. Each stack increases/decreases the target's Final DMG taken/dealt by 3%, lasting 6 seconds. When reaching 3 stacks, trigger [Shattered Crystal], dealing DMG once to the target, inflicting [Freeze] and removing all [Frostbite] stacks.
detail.使目标技能牌造成的伤害提高50%，持续6秒: The target's skill cards deal 50% more DMG, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.使目标内部灼烧，每秒造成1段火焰伤害，持续6秒，持续期间目标的精力值每秒下降1%: Burn the target from within, dealing Fire DMG once per second, lasting 6 seconds. The target loses 1% Energy per second and takes 36% more Fire DMG.
detail.【烬灭】使目标焚烧烬灭，每秒造成1段无视防御的火焰伤害，持续6秒: Burn the target to ashes, dealing Fire DMG once per second while ignoring their DEF, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.【封冻】使范围内目标完全静止，同时精力值和生命值停止增长，持续6秒，持续期间目标: Immobilize the target, prevent them from gaining Energy and HP, and reduce their DEF by 50%, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.每秒造成1段伤害，持续7秒，持续期间目标防御力下降7%: Deal DMG once per second and reduce the target's DEF by 7%, lasting 7 seconds.
detail.吸噬目标能量，获得0.1点费用并造成1段伤害，若目标为大型敌方时，额外获得0.2: Devour energy from the target, gaining 0.1 Cost and dealing DMG once. If the target is large, gain 0.25 more Cost.
detail.对目标造成1段伤害，并忽略目标50%的防御力，若目标生命值低于50%，则此伤害提: Deal DMG once to the target while ignoring 50% of their DEF. If the target's HP is lower than 50%, increase the DMG by 200%.
detail.每次【流光】造成回复时，同时使目标攻击力+0.5%，上限50%: Each time [Radiance] restores, it simultaneously increases the target's attack power by 0.5%, up to 50%.
detail.每秒对目标造成3段伤害，持续3秒: Deal DMG to the target over 3 hits per second, lasting 3 seconds.
detail.目标行动时受到1段无视防御的精神伤害并【击晕】，有效3次，对生物单位伤害加倍: When the target takes action, deal Lux DMG that ignores DEF to them once and inflict [Stun]. The DMG is doubled for non-Mech Units. This effect can be triggered 3 times.
detail.基于目标身上【牵魂】层数，每层对目标造成1段精神伤害；目标身上的非伤害类异常状态: For each [Soul Tether] stack the target has, deal Psychic DMG to them once. The more non-damage negative effects they have, the higher the DMG.
detail.对敌方目标造成1段虚光伤害，当前费用越高，伤害越高: Deal Lux DMG to the target once. The more current Cost you have, the higher the DMG.
detail.基于手牌数量对敌方目标造成等量段数虚光伤害: For each card in your hand, deal Lux DMG to the target once.
detail.使目标命中率降低30%，持续6秒: Reduce hit rate by 30%, lasting 6 seconds.
detail.每层【牵魂】使敌方目标受到的精神伤害增加10%，上限18层: Each stack increases the target's Psychic DMG taken by 10%, up to 18 stacks.
detail.使目标攻击力和防御力降低25%: Reduce the target's ATK and DEF by 25%.
detail.使目标无法进入【隐身】/【无敌】状态: Prevent the target from gaining [Invisible] or [Invincible] effect.
detail.使敌方目标受到的伤害增加50%，持续5秒: The target takes 50% more DMG, lasting 5 seconds.
detail.每8秒触发1次，对目标造成1段精神伤害，【退化】层数越高/弃牌区卡牌数量越多，伤: Deal Psychic DMG once to the target every 8 seconds. The more [Degeneration] stacks and cards in the discard pile, the higher the DMG, up to 198 stacks.
detail.每4秒触发1次，对目标造成1段精神伤害，【劣化】层数越高/手牌越多，伤害越高，上: Deal Psychic DMG once to the target every 4 seconds. The more [Deterioration] stacks and cards in your hand, the higher the DMG, up to 198 stacks.

entryDes.处于形态污染区谐响度增加: Increase Resonant level while in areas under Morphic Field Pollution.
entryDes.处于形态污染区谐响度增加（百分比: Increase Resonant level by a percentage while in areas under Morphic Field Pollution.
entryDes.处于非形态污染区威慑度增加: Increase Deterrence level while in areas without Morphic Field Pollution.
entryDes.处于形态污染区域时：列车最高时速增加: Increase max train speed while in areas under Morphic Field Pollution.
entryDes.行车遇袭概率增加（百分比: Increase enemy attacks by a percentage.
entryDes.列车耐久增加百分比: Increase train durability by a percentage.
entryDes.列车速度提高百分比: Increase train speed by a percentage.
entryDes.对桦树生物的调查距离增加: Increase investigation distance on Chaos Remains.
entryDes.处于磁气线路时，列车最高时速增加: Increase maximum train speed while in magnetic lines.
entryDes.自动拾取货物: Automatically collect goods along the way.
entryDes.宝箱拾取距离增加: Collect treasures from a greater distance.
entryDes.诱饵气球使用成功率增加: Increase the success rate of Decoy Balloons.
entryDes.撞击脱离成功有概率收获战利品: You may obtain loots after a successful Ram Disengage.
entryDes.使用撞角撞击路障时，有概率不消耗列车耐久值: When using Ram, get a chance that the train's durability is not consumed.
entryDes.使用撞角撞击路障时，有概率不消耗列车长疲劳值: When using Ram, get a chance that Conductor Fatigue is not consumed.

eventTypeDes.来一场公平的交换吧，他已经等候多时。: Let's have a fair exchange, he has been waiting for a long time.
eventTypeDes.奇妙空灵的旋律回荡在空间内，仿佛能治愈身心，洗去疲惫。: The ethereal melody echoes in the space, as if it can heal your body and mind.
eventTypeDes.每一步前行都在骰数空间引发特定的共振，未知的命运正在等待……: Every step forward triggers a resonance in the space. Unknown fate awaits...
eventTypeDes.一些被遗忘在角落的记忆，成为了如今珍贵的馈赠。: Some memories forgotten in the corner, now a precious bestowal.

prisonerBuffDesc.你发动所有警力将越狱囚犯成功截获，%s。: You mobilized all forces and intercepted the escaped prisoner, %s.
prisonerBuffDesc.你对产生争执的囚犯进行了严厉的处罚，%s。: You administered severe punishment to the troublemaker, %s.
prisonerBuffDesc.你对霸凌他人的囚犯进行了严厉的处罚，%s。: You imposed harsh punishment on the bully, %s.
prisonerBuffDesc.你两眼一瞪，拍了拍该囚犯的工作台，该囚犯及周围囚犯%s。: You reprimanded the prisoner at the workbench. Target prisoner and surrounding prisoners %s.
prisonerBuffDesc.你没收了这些囚犯的赃物，%s。: You confiscated the stolen goods from the prisoner, %s.
prisonerBuffDesc.你与该囚犯进行了心灵的沟通，该囚犯%s。: You had a heartfelt conversation with the prisoner. The prisoner %s.
prisonerBuffDesc.你走上前想加入，却发现他们哄笑着散开了，该囚犯及周围囚犯%s。: As you approached to join them, the prisoners laughed and left. Target prisoner and surrounding prisoners %s.
prisonerBuffDesc.你顺势整顿了监狱的作风，该囚犯%s。: You enhanced the discipline within the prison. The prisoner %s.
prisonerBuffDesc.你对积极的囚犯进行了嘉奖，该囚犯及周围囚犯%s。: You rewarded the proactive prisoner. Target prisoner and surrounding prisoners %s.

prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯非常易怒，容易与他人发生摩擦，需多加关注。: This prisoner is highly irritable and prone to conflicts with others. Special attention is required.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯一有空就拿着勺子比划，虽暂无违规举动，但仍需注意。: This prisoner always swings a spoon. Although this one poses no immediate threat, special attention is recommended.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯心思活跃、不服管教，喜欢撺掇他人，需重点关注。: This prisoner is disobedient, adept at instigating others. Special attention is required.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯总是唯唯诺诺，被人欺负也不敢反抗。: This prisoner is always obedient and does not dare to resist when bullied.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯一抓到机会就偷懒怠工，建议多加督促。: This prisoner is lazy and often neglects work when given the chance. Special attention is recommended.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯对财富抱有极强的欲望，有可能做出偷窃行为，建议严加看管。: This prisoner displays a strong desire for wealth and may be at risk of stealing. Special attention is recommended.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯不喜欢与他人交往，更喜欢独立活动或思考。: This prisoner prefers independent activities and thinking, avoiding socializing with others.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯对食物的热爱超乎常人，进食后工作效率暴增！: This prisoner has an overwhelming love of food, and productivity skyrockets after eating a hearty meal!
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯总是情绪很低落，对什么事都提不起兴趣。: This prisoner is always in a low mood and has no interest in anything.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯做事前缺乏理性思考，凭感情或冲动行事，思考不考虑后果。: This prisoner never thinks before acting, always driven by impulses without considering the consequences.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯是整顿中心的开心果，总是逗得众人哈哈大笑。: This prisoner is known as the jokester in the Reforming Center, always making everyone laugh.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯对生活抱有美好的期待，这份热情总是可以感染其他人。: This prisoner has a positive outlook on life, and this enthusiasm is contagious.
prisonerPersonalityDesc.这名囚犯干活专心致志，引得其他囚犯纷纷效仿。: This prisoner's dedication has inspired other prisoners to follow suit.

prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.在囚犯牢房的海报后发现一个通往下水道的大洞，而囚犯则不知所踪……: A large hole leading to the sewer has been found behind a poster in the prisoner's cell, and the prisoner is now nowhere to be found...
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.一名囚犯在用餐时段因其他囚犯离席时先迈左脚，将菜盘扣在了对方的脸上。: A prisoner snapped a dish in another prisoner's face during mealtime because the latter took the left foot first when leaving the table.
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.在个别囚犯的煽动下，部分囚犯起哄闹事，要求减刑或提高待遇。: At the instigation of some particular prisoners, several inmates have caused a disturbance, demanding a reduction in term or improved treatment.
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.个别囚犯在放风时间被刻意针对，遭到多名囚犯的欺凌，心情沮丧。: A specific prisoner has been bullied by multiple inmates during break time and become depressed.
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.在工作车间中传来了不合时宜的鼾声，声音来源似乎是几名喜欢偷懒的囚犯。: An untimely snoring sound comes from the workshop, originating from a few prisoners who enjoy slacking off.
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.监狱的马桶刷已经连续丢失了三把，最终都在几名囚犯的床底下找到了。: Three toilet brushes in the prison have gone missing, all of which were eventually found under the beds of several prisoners.
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.该囚犯避开了监狱里的纷争，独自一人默默工作着。: This prisoner has been avoiding conflicts within the prison and silently working alone.
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.因为在今天吃到了加餐，囚犯工作时干劲十足，效率与平日里判若两人。: Having had an extra meal for the day, this prisoner works with great efficiency and enthusiasm.
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.最近有人在囚犯中鼓吹一种理论，那就是“不必真的干活，装装样子就行了”。: Recently, some prisoner have been advocating a theory that "you don't have to actually do the work; you just need to pretend to be working."
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.欢声笑语间，囚犯们的工作效率也大大增长，虽然他们讲的笑话听上去不是很体面。: The prisoners' productivity increases with laughter, even if the jokes they tell may not sound very decent.
prisonerPersonalityFetterDesc.“好好改造，重新做人！”在几名个性积极的囚犯带动下，不少囚犯燃起了对未来的希望，: "Work hard and make a new life!" Motivated by a few enthusiastic prisoners, many prisoners have ignited hope for the future and work feverishly.

desc.【时雨】增强为：\\n向目标区域施展【雨见之术】并<color=#FF6666>: [Shigure] enhanced to: \nCasts [Tsuyu] on the target area and inflicts <color=#FF6666>[Blaze]</color>, striking all enemies within the area over 3 hits per second for 5 seconds.\nThere is a 25% chance to trigger <color=#FF6666>[Ignite]</color>.
desc.【知觉干预】增强为：\\n标记目标队友，每秒回复其5%生命值，持续6秒\\n持续:
Enhance [Perception Intervention]:
Mark an ally and heal them for 5% of Max HP per second, lasting 6 seconds.
During this period, they take 50% less DMG.
[Basic Attack] will heal the target ally.
Reduce the Cost of their next card by 1.
desc.若开局没有自身技能牌时，将牌库中所有的【时雨】加入手牌: If there are no Yoizuki's skill cards at the start of battle, adds all [Shigure] cards from the deck to your hand.
desc.【契约】持续期间，我方全体受到的治疗量加倍\\n【契约】持续期间，自身濒死时<c: When [Pact] is in effect, all allies receive doubled healing, and Ithos gains <color=#7AB2FF>[Invincible]</color> when taking lethal DMG, lasting 3 seconds, then generate 1 [Reverengy] in your deck.
desc.使用【时雨】后，抽1张牌，优先【春花】或绿卡: After using [Shigure], draw 1 card, prioritizing [Shunka] or Green card.
desc.当【焚心余烬】在手牌中时，【凝心针】和【攻心针】所需费用-1\\n若使用【凝心针: When [Scorched Embers] is in your hand, reduces the cost of [Healing Syringe] and [Scorching Syringe] by 1.\nIf [Healing Syringe] is used, [Destroy] a [Scorched Embers] card, causing the target of [Healing Syringe] to become <color=#FF6666>[Berserk]</color>.\nIf [Scorching Syringe] is used, [Destroy] a [Scorched Embers] card, causing the target of [Scorching Syringe] to become <color=#FF6666>[Corrupt]</color>.
desc.【奥义·流虹】增强为：\\n施展【奥义·流虹】，基于弃牌区中红卡的数量，每张红卡: Enhance [Ogi: Nagaruniji]:\nCasts [Ogi: Nagaruniji]. Generates [Jakurei] equal to the number of Red cards in discard pile, and each generated [Jakurei] deals 1 hit to the target enemy.\n<color=#FF6666>[Ignite]</color> the affected enemies.
desc.生命值越低，受到的最终伤害越低，上限50%: The lower the HP, the lower the Final DMG received, up to 50%.
desc.每隔10秒触发1次，被【知觉干预】标记的目标队友受到攻击时，从牌库或弃牌区将1张: When the ally marked by [Perception Intervention] is attacked, add 1 [Induced Awakening] from the deck or discard pile to your hand. This effect is triggered once every 10 seconds.
desc.我方<color=#7AB2FF>【护盾】</color>消失或引爆时，回复<c: When allies' <color=#7AB2FF>[Shields]</color> vanish or are detonated, heals the <color=#7AB2FF>[Shield]</color> holder for 5% of Max HP.
desc.使用【火力掩护】时，注射肾上腺素，回复自身15%生命值，同时自身【普通攻击】攻击: When using [Covering Fire], injects Adrenaline to heal this character for 15% of Max HP and increases [Basic Attack] speed to maximum, lasting 10 seconds.
desc.使用【陷阵】时，每秒回复自身5%生命值，持续5秒: When using [Unyielding Will], heals this character for 5% of Max HP per second, lasting 5 seconds.
desc.【铁幕】存在时，帕拉笛获得<color=#7AB2FF>【霸体】</color>: When [Iron Curtain] is present, Paladi gains <color=#7AB2FF>[Hyperarmor]</color> and grants all frontline allies immunity against <color=#FF6666>[Interrupt]</color> and <color=#FF6666>[Stun]</color>.
desc.我方全体存活时，受到的最终伤害降低20%: When all allies are alive, takes 20% less Final DMG.
desc.【灵鸟夜曲】和【终幕的圆舞曲】可以共鸣成黄卡: [Spirit Nocturne] and [Finale Waltz] can consonate into Yellow cards.
desc.【火墙】增强为：\\n【A-1SO】朝地面喷射汽油并点火，使敌方场地触发<col: Enhance [Firewall]:\n[A-1SO] sprays gasoline on the ground and ignites it, triggering <color=#FF6666>[Wildfire]</color> on the enemy's field, reducing all enemies' [Energy] by 3%, and ATK and DEF by 2%.\n[A-1SO] is [Mech Unit].
desc.【灵鸟夜曲】所需费用-1: Reduces the cost of [Spirit Nocturne] by 1.
desc.【汲取】增强为：\\n对敌方目标造成1段伤害并<color=#B383FF>【诅: Enhance [Drain]:\nDeal DMG once, inflict <color=#B383FF>[Curse]</color> and reduce the target's DEF by 3%. This effect stacks.\nHeal the ally with the lowest HP for 50% of the DMG dealt.
desc.【铁幕】击破时，直接打出1次【火墙】\\n同时使我方全体防御力+3%，可叠加: When [Iron Curtain] is destroyed, cast 1 [Firewall] immediately, and increase all allies' DEF by 3%. This effect stacks.
desc.使用【无底之核】后，随机生成1张【果核】，【新星】或【奇异火花】加入手牌: After using [Abyssal Seed], randomly generate 1 [Seed], [Nova], or [Strange Spark] in your hand.
desc.使用自身技能牌后，丢弃手牌中的【果核】，每丢弃1张，抽1张牌: After using Margiela's skill card, discard all [Seed] in your hand, and draw a card for each [Seed] discarded.
desc.【旋羽】增强为：\\n从弃牌区回收1张牌加入手牌，优先红卡\\n丢弃右数第1张手: Enhance [Plumed Feather]: \nRetrieves a card from discard pile to your hand, prioritizing Red ones.\nDiscards the rightmost hand card and strikes the target over 3 hits.
desc.使用【旋羽】后，自身防御力-5%，攻击力+15%，持续10秒: After using [Plumed Feather], DEF -5%, ATK +15%, lasts 10s
desc.使用【高压镇暴】后，【A-2SO】全面锁定敌方区域，进行高强度扫射，对随机敌方目: After using [Riot Suppression], [A-2SO] locks down the enemy's field and strafes the area, dealing DMG to random enemies over 6 hits.\nAfterward, 1 more [A-2SO] will participate in the next [Riot Suppression] and provide [Basic Attack] support, up to 4.
desc.【刃羽】增强为：\\n释放刃羽，对敌方全体造成总共8段伤害\\n全力俯冲对敌方全: Enhance [Bladefeather]:\nUnleashes Bladefeather, dealing DMG to all enemies over 8 hits.\nLaunches an additional 1 hit dash attack against all enemies and <color=#FF6666>[Ignite]</color> them.
desc.每次命中回复自身0.3%生命值，伤害类特殊效果造成的命中除外: Whenever this character hits a target (excluding hits dealt by damage effects), heals this character for 0.3% of Max HP.
desc.【鸟狩】增强为：\\n遁入阴影，使自身<color=#7AB2FF>【隐形】</: Enhance [Torikari]:\nBlends into shadow and becomes <color=#7AB2FF>[Invisible]</color> for 5 seconds.\nIf Maruha is already <color=#7AB2FF>[Invisible]</color>, retrieves up to 2 Red cards from discard pile to hand.

desc.自身和【帕姆】每次命中获得【同调】点数\\n每获得5点【同调】点数，获得0.33: Self and [Pam] gain [Resonance] points with each hit\nEvery 5 [Resonance] points gained, gain 0.33 Costs\nEvery 50 [Resonance] points gained, immediately activate own [Leader Skill]
desc.【共生】的目标使用技能牌时，【帕姆】协同攻击，基于该卡费用对敌方目标造成双倍量段: When the target of [Symbiosis] uses a skill card, [Pam] performs a coordinated attack, dealing double DMG segments to the enemy unit based on the Cost of the card, excluding [Leader Skill].\nThe higher the HP/attack power of the [Symbiosis] target, the higher the DMG.
desc.仅生命值低于50%时，每秒回复自身3%生命值: When HP is below 50%, restore 3% of your HP per second.
desc.使用【虹吸保卫者】后，从弃牌区将1张带有【无人机】词条的卡牌加入手牌，此卡除外: After using [Siphon Defender], add 1 card with the [Drone] term from the Discarded to your Cards, this card is excluded.
desc.我方场上每存在1架【无人机】时，每秒获得0.1点费用: Gain 0.1 Costs per second for each [drone] on our field.
desc.释放【急冻磁星】后，回复自身10%生命值\\n同时自身获得<color=#7AB: When using [Frost Magstar], heal the enemy for 10% of Max HP, and grant her <color=#7AB2FF>[Hyperarmor]</color>, lasting 5 seconds.
desc.全场不论敌我，每次触发<color=#7AB2FF>【冰封】</color>时，: Whenever a unit on the field inflicts <color=#7AB2FF>[Freeze]</color>, the enemy gains 6 Energy.
desc.释放【急冻磁星】后，使我方全体获得<color=#7AB2FF>【护盾】</co: When using [Frost Magstar], grant all enemies a <color=#7AB2FF>[Shield]</color>, lasting 10 seconds. Its durability equals 1000% of self DEF.
desc.每次牌库抽光触发洗牌时，生成1张【锐锋】加入手牌: Whenever the deck is emptied and triggers a reshuffle

noDataString.我的眼光无需怀疑，你只需要担心钱包是不是足够饱满。: My judgment needs no doubt, you only need to worry if your wallet is full enough.
noDataString.我很乐意见识一下你能带来什么好东西。: I am very happy to see what good things you can bring.
noDataString.这些都是精挑细选的好货，商品限量供应，可别错过了。: These are carefully selected quality goods, available in limited supply, so don't miss out.
noDataString.一切买卖我都欢迎，买卖买卖，有买就有卖——这次你打算给我看点什么好东西？: I welcome all trades, trade trade, where there's buying, there's selling—what good stuff do you plan to show me this time?
noDataString.咱可不会干以次充好的事情，那不是自砸招牌么！: I won't do anything as shoddy as passing off inferior goods as good ones! Wouldn't that ruin my reputation?
noDataString.哪有什么没价值的东西，只是价值多少的问题罢了！: There's nothing without value. It's just a matter of how much it's worth!
noDataString.我其实不太能理解来七号自由港买列车模型当纪念品带回去的行为，不过这个确实卖得不错: I actually can't quite understand the behavior of buying train models as souvenirs to take back from Freeport VII, but they do sell well.
noDataString.在这地方书籍保管是个问题，毕竟很容易受潮，不过阿妮塔的那些人总有自己的对策。: Book storage is an issue in this place, as it tends to get damp easily. However, Anita and her team always have their own strategies.
noDataString.说到修格里那就少不了要提他们的家电，听说连希斯·戴维家里用的电视机都是修格里出产: Speaking of Shoggolith, their home appliances are a must-mention. I heard that even the television set in Heath Davis's house is produced by Shoggolith.
noDataString.最近修格里的农产品协会正在讨论是否要制定新的土豆出口标准……我已经闻到了商机的味: Recently, the Shoggolith Agricultural Products Association has been discussing whether to establish new potato export standards... I can already smell the scent of opportunity.
noDataString.这里出产的钢材造就了北大陆的这些铁轨，这一点毋庸置疑！: The steel produced here has undoubtedly created these railroad tracks of the Northern Continent!
noDataString.巴克斯特那老小子和咱说那个深夜的诡异声音似乎在铁安局那个方向，但甘雅小妹说她从来: That old fellow Baxter told us that the eerie sound at midnight seemed to come from the direction of the BCRL Agency, but young sister Ganya said she had never heard it. He got even more scared after hearing that, haha!
noDataString.美食、流行、奢侈品……这可是一座非常适合有格调的淑女享受生活的城市。: Fine cuisine, fashion, luxury goods... this city is truly made for a lady of refined taste to enjoy life to the fullest.
noDataString.在人家眼里，现在音乐厅上演的剧目都达不到弗威尔先生的高度，真是可惜……这么多年了: To my eye, none of the productions playing at the concert hall these days come close to Mr. Verwell's caliber... what a shame. Has Gronru really produced no finer playwright in all these years?
noDataString.炒蛋是淘金乐园的名菜，据说第一位在此发迹的淘金者就很喜欢吃蛋炒培根。: Scrambled eggs are a ONEderland specialty. It's said that the first gold digger who struck it rich here loved eating eggs with bacon.
noDataString.都说咱们这个站的怪人多，要我说，哪有什么怪人？不过是得不到世人的理解罢了。: This station is rumored to have lots of weirdos, but if you ask me, that's just nonsensical. They're simply a bunch of people not understood by the world.
noDataString.听说那个什么，代站长？所长？又研究出了什么新发明，惦记着让你去呢。: They say that the acting station master, or is it the director, has created some kind of new invention again and wants you to go over.
noDataString.那个词怎么说的？欲购从速！我这暂时只有这些，断货了可想买也买不到了。: How do you say that word? Buy now while supplies last! This is all I have for now; once it's out of stock, you won't be able to buy it even if you want to.
noDataString.与其再到别的地方乱跑，不如卖给我？我给你这个数。: Instead of running around elsewhere, why not sell it to me? I'll offer you this amount.
noDataString.这个地方啊，从前可是阿妮塔航天研究的中心。可要是说实验成功，估计还有很长的路要走: Oh, this place? It used to be where Anita did their aerospace research. But it's likely still a ways to go before their experiment works out...
noDataString.我在这里就是图个清静。实验场太吵？呵呵，我说的是人间纷纷扰扰……: I'm here simply for the peace and quiet. The testing ground is too noisy? (chuckles) I mean peace from people problems.
noDataString.总会有你中意的货，今天不买，明天也迟早会买，那不如趁现在就买。: You'll always find something you like, so why not buy it now instead of waiting until tomorrow?
noDataString.放心吧，不论是什么，总能有点价值的。: Don't worry. There's a price to everything.
noDataString.这里虽然是新兴技术汇集的地方，但也藏着许多秘密。如果有心，或许能发现些什么。: Even though this is where emerging technologies foregather, it also has many hidden secrets. You might just find a little something if you really look for it.
noDataString.远离家里那些琐碎的事务真开心……啊，您别介意，我就随便说说。: The joy of getting away from those trifling household matters... Ah, don't mind me. I'm just running my mouth.
noDataString.荒原站周边的桦树生物一直很多，您在这一带活动可要当心。: There are many Chaos Remains around the Wilderness Station, so be careful when you're in this area.
noDataString.在流民营地偶尔也能见到一些孩子，据说有些人从祖父那一辈就是流民了。: Occasionally, you can also see some children in the refugee camp. It is said that some people have been refugees since their grandparents' generation.
noDataString.淘金乐园的创办人背后是一个有头有脸的大家族，在曾经的修格里城非常有名望。: The founder of ONEderland is backed by a prominent family that was very prestigious in the former Shoggolith City.
noDataString.铁盟哨站是附近铁安局队伍的主要屯驻地，这里的安全等级很高。: The BCRL Outpost is the main garrison for nearby BCRL Agency forces, and the security level here is very high.
noDataString.哨站的客户大多是这里的铁盟士兵……他们的订单很有特色，一眼就能看出来。: Most of the customers at the outpost are BCRL soldiers... Their orders are quite distinctive and can be recognized at a glance.
noDataString.这可是阿妮塔的研发重地。据说不少新兴武器都从这里出产……: This is Anita's research and development hub. It is said that many emerging weapons are produced here...
noDataString.阿妮塔的员工里，怪脾气的人还挺多的。……不不，我什么都没说，老板！: There are quite a few people with peculiar tempers among Anita's staff. ...No, no, I didn't say anything, boss!

text.每周新闻\\n\r\r\r\r【玩法说明】\\n\r\r\r\r新闻报道将反映本:
Weekly News
[Gameplay Description]
The news report will reflect this week's trade trends, passenger trends, material retrieve, and group order revenue changes. Some goods and stations will enjoy a week-long bonus.

[Event Time]
Refresh Time: Every Monday at 5:00

[Gameplay Content]
Trade trends: Changes occur weekly, and the prices of goods related to the news will be adjusted as follows this week:

Buy price minimum fluctuation range is 50%~65%

Buy price maximum fluctuation range is 100%~120%

Sell price minimum fluctuation range is 80%~95%

Sell price maximum fluctuation range is 135%~150%

Material recycling: Based on the news report content, the recycling price of certain materials will occasionally increase to 150%.

Passenger industry: Train trips with destinations related to the news will receive bonuses. This includes gaining numbers of high-level passengers, free leaflet acquisition, various train rating scores, seat ticket prices, and various ratings, all of which have chances to gain enhancement.

Group Order: According to the news report content, some order revenues may occasionally increase by 10%.

text.据7号自由港的形而上研究所发布的最新数据显示，西大陆铁路环线东部沿海地区全线的桦: According to the latest research report from the Metaphysical Particles Institute in Freeport Ⅶ, there has been an unusual increase in Chaos Remains activity along the entire eastern seaboard of the Western Continent Railway Loop compared to the same period last year. Mr. Eliade, the Institute's administrator, mentioned that this activity change has not yet affected daily production and life. However, the research report has sparked panic among coastal fishermen and farmers, leading them to suspend operations, resulting in reduced seafood supply at major stations and subsequent price hikes.

Just to clarify, this is not an advertisement! But if you have any questions or would like to make a reservation, please feel free to give us a call!
text.如果列车长对七号自由港的发展史感兴趣，本机很乐意解答。目前本机储存了官方介绍版、: Conductor, if you're interested in learning about the history of Freeport Ⅶ, I'm pleased to provide some insight. Here are stored official brief, folk brief, and a brief for underage users. Please feel free to choose the version that suits you best.
text.总有人对七号自由港的管理者是本机这件事感到惊讶，本机认为他们应该去海角城看看！: It may come as a surprise, but I'm actually responsible for managing Freeport Ⅶ. We recommend a visit to Cape City to experience it!
text.也许我们曾经有一些小误会，但希望那些并不会成为你我之间的隔阂。既然来了，就让我们: Let's not let any past misunderstandings come between us. Since you're here, let's make the most of our time together.
text.诚意，这是个令人愉快的词，它能促成很多事。对于你的付出和支持，修格里自然也会拿出: Sincerity is a wonderful thing. With it, one can achieve a lot. With your dedication and support, Shoggolith will reciprocate it with equal sincerity.
text.我注意到你似乎与黑月的成员也有来往，啊，请不要误会，我并不是想刺探你的隐私。这代: I noticed that you have some connections with the Night Chains. Ah, please do not misunderstand. I don't want to intrude on your privacy, but it shows you have a unique charm, which is good.
text.听说你对曼德矿场很有兴趣，事实上，作为修格里赖以生存的重要地点，我也对这里情有独: I heard that you are interested in Mander Mine. In fact, it is an important place for Shoggolith's survival, and I have a soft spot for it, too. It's great that we have this in common.
text.何必总是摆出如此拘谨的态度呢，还是说你从海因里希先生那里得到了一些“忠告”？他总: Why do you always maintain such a formal demeanor? Did Mr. Heinrich 'advise' you to be so strict? He's always so strict with himself, but that is how he is. You could afford to relax a bit more.
text.聊天？没关系，我懂，你这样的年轻人正是对一切充满好奇的时候。我会注意在不让你惹上: Chatting? No worries — I get it. You're at an age where curiosity reigns supreme. I'll be mindful only to share information that is safe and appropriate for you.
text.是否使用<color=#FEC032>%s</color>获取新的订单？: Do you want to use <color=#FEC032>%s</color> to get new orders?
text.消耗<color=#FFB800>%d</color>桦石，恢复<color=#: Spend <color=#FFB800>%d</color> Chaos Stones to restore <color=#FFB800>%d</color> Clarity. <color=#FFB800>%d</color> times remaning today.
text.是否消耗 <color=#FFB800>%d</color> %s 兑换 <co: Do you want to spend <color=#FFB800>%d</color> %s to exchange for <color=#FFB800>%d</color> %s and recruit?
text.哦，是你啊。……也没有高兴，只是觉得把任务交给你的话可以更放心些。: Ah, it's you... I am not exactly thrilled, but I feel more at ease handing the task to you.
text.老实说，最开始我觉得你看起来不是靠得住的类型……果然看人不能光凭第一印象，对吧？: Honestly, my first impression of you was that you weren't dependable... But we should never judge a book by its cover, right?
text.怎么了？姑且提醒一下，就算讨好我，要我徇私什么的也恕难从命哦。: What's wrong? To let you know, I cannot play favourites even if you try to flatter me. Doing anything like that would be a lost cost.
text.身为姐姐，我理应对那孩子多加照顾，比如推荐一些适合的业务和人手给她……只是把麻烦: As the older sister, I feel a deep sense of responsibility for that kid. This includes introducing suitable commissions and helpers to support her... But doesn't it feel unfair to dump all the problems on her? It may sound harsh, but this is obviously meant to toughen her up.
text.你是来抱怨我对待你太刻薄的？明明……已经特别关照列车长了啊……好过分啊，（啜泣）: Are you here to complain about me being too hard on you? Conductor, I... have been showing you extra care and concern... This is outrageous! (sniffles) Alright, enough with the theatrics. Please get back to work.
text.免费网球场无人维护，所以我只能去付费的体育中心打球了。啊，场地损坏的原因是年久失: The free tennis court has been neglected, forcing me to play at a paid sports centre. Oh! The damage to the court is due to years of neglect, not a powerful serve. Please don't jump to conclusions.
text.无论作为下属还是同为女性，会长都值得我足够的敬意。她不仅经商手段高明，还颇有识人: Whether as a superior or a female, the President deserves my utmost respect. She possesses brilliant business acumen and a sharp eye for people. It seems like Signora Medici rarely experiences fatigue during work, except when she hired you.
text.多考虑一下自己能否胜任这份任务并不是坏事，请慎重抉择哦。: It's a good idea to take a moment to consider whether you're up for this task. So, choose wisely, alright?
text.看到你勤勉对待工作我就放心了——不过对于一位列车长来说，这应该是最基本的事项呢。: It's great to see how dedicated you are to your work — as a Conductor, dedication should be a given.
text.想必你已经将状态调整到了最好，那么让我们开始工作吧。: I hope you have updated your status to its best. Let's get started with work.
text.这些订单更适合你目前的业务能力，啊，这只是为了我自己的评价考虑而已，可别想多了。: These orders align better with your current business abilities. Oh, this is just for my assessment. Please don't read too much into it.
text.我可以理解为，这种程度的订单对你来说已经不会出什么岔子了，对吧？: I understand that orders at this level shouldn't pose any problems for you, correct?
text.非常期待你能如约完成订单，但愿我不会收到针对你的投诉信。: I eagerly anticipate the successful completion of these orders, and I hope to receive zero complaints regarding your service.
text.又见面了，你看起来还不错，那再好不过了……这样会大概率降低你在完成订单时犯错误的: It's nice to see you again! You seem well, and that's reassuring... Hopefully, this will reduce the likelihood of errors when completing orders.
text.列车长精力充沛，无需消除疲劳值: You're full of energy and don't need to reduce Fatigue.
text.装备已可升至满级: Equipment can now be upgraded to the maximum level.
text.已经没有更多任务可以交给你去做了，为什么不去好好休息呢？我可不想看到你明天一脸疲: There are no more tasks to assign you to now. Why don't you get some rest? I wouldn't want to see you coming to me tomorrow looking exhausted.
text.啊……也许我该表扬你尚有自知之明？: Ah... perhaps I should commend you for possessing some level of self-awareness?
text.真让人高兴，比起你搞砸一笔订单后帮忙善后花去的精力，这点被你浪费的时间不算什么…: It's pretty heartening. Compared to the energy you've put into cleaning up after messing up an order, the time you've wasted isn't much... Of course, I am the only one cleaning up after you, right?
text.是否应用该预设？: Do you want to apply this preset?
text.你和静流应该不是普通的旧识吧？我从没见过她那副模样，还挺意外的。: You and Shizuru... seem to share a deeper relationship, right? I've never seen her react like that, and it's rather surprising.
text.作为铁盟的士兵，会定期收到来自靛红五月的配给。居然会有如此美味又便宜的巧克力，真: As members of the B.C.R.L., we regularly receive supplies from Carmine May. It's impressive that such delicious chocolate is also affordable.
text.废话不多说，今天是有什么事吗？: Enough with the small talks. Is there anything you need assistance with today?
text.选择你力所能及的任务就可以了。: Just select tasks within your capabilities.
text.深思熟虑未尝不可，毕竟你还要对列车上的其他人负责。: It would not hurt to consider this carefully. After all, you're responsible for the safety of others on the train.
text.疲劳值过高无法行动，请先消除疲劳值: Fatigue too high. Please reduce Fatigue first.
text.列车长，你的列车上似乎有很多工作人员，你们会有吵架的时候吗？: Conductor, it appears that your train has many staff members. Have you ever had disagreements with them?
text.如果你让列车上的其他人生气了，你通常会怎么做？: What do you normally do when you've made someone in your train crew mad?
text.总问你关于人际关系的问题，只是想稍微做点参考而已……可以的话，你要是顺路去贡露城: I merely asked you those questions about interpersonal relationships for a little insight... If possible, it would be best if you could drop by Gronru City and check up on my little sister.
text.就算你的穿搭看起来不怎么样，但作为科伦巴商会的成员，可以享受3个点的税收优惠！可: Thanks to the cooperative relationship between the city and COLUMBA, COLUMBA members receive 3 point tax credits regardless of the quality of their outfit.
text.我不反感和列车长做生意，因为四处奔波的你们总比普通人有见识些。: I don't mind doing business with Conductors, as you travellers always seem to have more insight than the common folks.
text.我其实不太能理解来七号自由港买列车模型当纪念品带回去的行为，不过这个确实卖得不错: I don't understand why people buy train models as souvenirs in Freeport Ⅶ, but they do sell well.
text.在这地方书籍保管是个问题，毕竟很容易受潮，不过阿妮塔的那些人总有自己的对策。: Due to high humidity, book storage is a challenge, but Anita's team always finds solutions.
text.我的眼光无需怀疑，你只需要担心钱包是不是足够饱满。: There's no need to question my judgment. You just have to worry if the cash in your wallet is adequate.
text.今天的打折商品是<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>，考: Today's item on sale is <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>. Considering its cost-effectiveness, I recommend purchasing it for future needs.
text.打折可是个好东西，人只要一看到降价两个字就会产生消费冲动。: Discounts are irresistible. Whenever people see that something is on sale, they will immediately have the urge to purchase it.
text.于我而言这绝对是没有损失的选择。: I consider this a decision without any potential losses.
text.……我还以为你只会买打了折的商品呢。: ...I thought you only bought items on sale.
text.我的商品一定会让你满意而归。: Rest assured that my products are designed to exceed your expectations and satisfy you.
text.究竟是眼光问题还是财力问题让你做出了这样的选择？反正不会是我的问题。: Is it a matter of taste or financial capability that led you to this decision? Either way, it's none of my concern.
text.一般般吧……但也不是毫无价值。: It is average... but it is not entirely worthless.
text.哟，这倒是相当不错，我对你有些另眼相看了。: Well, this is pretty good. I'm starting to see you in a different light.
text.……你不会就打算给我看这种玩意吧？: ...You're not planning to show me this kind of thing, are you?
text.我很乐意见识一下你能带来什么好东西。: I'd like to see what good things you can bring to the table.
text.<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>今天的行情相当不错，: The demand for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> is high now, so it is recommended that you sell it.
text.唉，反正就算你无数遍取消交易，下一次走进交易所时我还得笑脸相迎。: Well, even if you cancel the deal multiple times, I'll still greet you with a smile at the Trading Center the next time.
text.老实说比我预期的要强一些，与你的合作值得维系。: I must say, it has exceeded my expectations. Our collaboration is valuable and should be continued.
text.你确实有点本事——就这样吧。: You're really something — let's just leave it at that.
text.我猜你在想，“如果把这家伙揍一顿，是不是就能不花一分钱把店里的东西打包带走。”: I bet you're thinking, 'Could I leave with everything in the store without spending a dime if I beat this guy up?'
text.我今天心情不错，就多让你几分好了。: I am feeling generous today, so I will cut you some slack.
text.我口袋里的钱可没那么容易掏出来。: It's not easy for me to reach into my pocket and pull out money.
text.你在七号自由港的活跃我也有所耳闻，继续好好干吧。: I have heard about your work in Freeport Ⅶ. Keep up the excellent work!
text.欢迎，就算是在我的投资生涯中，和你的交易也绝对称得上成功。: Welcome. In my investment journey, trading with you has undoubtedly been a success.
text.你的名气在这里几乎是无人不知，我猜在别的城市你也干得不错。: Your reputation precedes you here. I bet you're doing well in other cities, too.
text.也许你的眼界已经超过我了？我可期待着你能给我见识些有趣的东西。: Could it be that you perceive things differently than I do? I'm excited to see what you'll come up with.
text.……咳，列车长，根据你的行驶路线来说，之后大概率会经过贡露城吧？: ...Ahem, Conductor. Based on your route, you'll probably pass through Gronru City later, right?
text.你要是去了贡露城，也去一趟那里的交易所吧。什么？你这话说的，怎么能叫惦记你的钱呢: If you visit Gronru City, you should also check out their Trading Center. What? How could it be considered caring about your money!
text.不过是……嗯，那儿的老板娘和我是从小一起长大的朋友，咱这不是关心朋友的近况么。: It's just... Well, I am childhood friends with a landlady there, so I am checking in on a friend's well-being.
text.这里有着全世界最好喝的饮料: Here, we have the best drinks in the world.
text.这里可是有着全世界最稀有的商品哦: Here, you can find the rarest items in the world.
text.列车长，看起来你身上的%s不太够啊: Conductor, it seems like you don't have enough %s.
text.超人气饮品，列车长快来选择吧: Popular drinks, Conductor, come and make your choice.
text.是否使用<color=#FEC032>%s</color>刷新当前商店的商品列表: Do you want to use <color=#FEC032>%s</color> to refresh the current store's item list?

The more Lower Price attempts, the lower the success rate. After each transaction, the success rate resets. Current Success Rate: %s

The more Raise Price attempts, the lower the success rate. After each transaction, the success rate resets. Current Success Rate: %s

text.等你很久了哦，列车长~: I've been waiting a long time, Conductor...
text.呵呵呵……把人家的爱……都喝下去了呢~: (chuckles) You've gulped down... all my love...
text.{playername}，你知道人工晶花吗？现在很流行将这个送给恋人。实际上比起: {playername}, do you know about Artificial Crystal? It's a trendy thing to give them to your lover these days. But in actuality, what's more important than the gift itself is the thought behind it, which is also the hardest to come by...
text.究竟要怎么做才能让列车长一直留在这里呢？: What exactly should I do to make the Conductor stay?
text.饮料已经喝不下了吗？那么……别的呢？: You can't drink anymore? Then... how about something else?
text.列车长想要的，人家都为你备好了哦~: I've prepared everything you wanted, Conductor!
text.只要跟人家讲一声，人家什么都会拿来给你。: Just tell me whatever is it you need, and I'll bring it to you.
text.亚莉奈的飞刀除了用来投掷，还可以雕刻苹果哦。亚莉奈在苹果上刻了很多很多……呵呵呵: Other than throwing them, my throwing knives can also be used to carve apples. I've carved lots of... (chuckles)... on apples... They will taste much nicer this way when you consume them as drinks, Conductor.
text.无论是商会还是铁安局的负责人，列车长都和她们好熟悉啊~明明亚莉奈也可以做到很多，: Why are you so close with both the COLUMBA and the BCRL Agency's administrators, Conductor? I can accomplish lots of things too, way more than they can...
text.不用在意人家哦，人家只是想多看你一会呀~: It's okay. Don't mind me. I just want to see you a bit longer...
text.原来列车长喜欢这种款式呀？: So, this is the kind of design you like, Conductor?
text.有列车长想要的吗？没有的话就告诉亚莉奈吧，人家会为了你想办法的~: Is there anything you want? If not, let me know, and I'll think of something for you.
text.我为什么会出现在这里？列车长还真喜欢问这个问题呢，难道说是对亚莉奈的事情感兴趣？: Why am I here? You sure like asking this question, Conductor. Are you perhaps interested in my affairs? That makes me so happy!
text.人家调查了列车长身边的那些人，所以列车长更喜欢那种类型的？人家会想办法的……当然: I've run a check on those people around you. So, you prefer people like them, huh? I will come up with a plan... Of course, I will absolutely never do anything that ruffles your feathers.
text.欢迎光临~啊……让我们度过一段美好的时光吧~: Welcome! Ah... Let's have a wonderful time together...
text.许多修格里企业的标志在设计时都会把沃德山脉作为重要元素，毕竟沃德山对修格里人来说: Many Shoggolith companies incorporate the Ward Mountain as a fundamental element in the design of their logo, as it holds a special significance to the people of Shoggolith. It's the same as how special you are to me, Conductor.
text.这是为列车长特别准备的独家秘方哟，关于里面加了什么……就请列车长用自己的舌头好好: This is a secret recipe prepared exclusively for you. As for what's added to it... you will have to taste the sweetness with your own tongue, Conductor.
text.关于“银枝之水”奇妙的效果，亚莉奈只是对它施加了一点点爱的魔法哟……这样的话，列: About the amazing effects of the 'Silver Branch Water,' I simply added a tinge of love magic to it... This way, you will keep coming to see me from now on, yeah?
text.自从被人用磨尖了的金属勺子攻击，那位负责人先生就把工人们的餐具全换成塑料的了，真: That manager guy changed all the workers' cutlery to plastic ones ever since he was attacked by someone with a sharpened metal spoon. Interesting, huh?
text.诶，列车长，那位铁安局的静流小姐和你又是什么关系呢？明明碍眼的人已经够多了……哈: (sighs) Conductor, what exactly is your relationship with Miss Shizuru of the BCRL Agency? There are already more than enough pests as it is... Haa... Seriously...
text.人家想知道更多关于列车长的事情，虽然已经调查了很多，但是那样还不够啊。: I may have investigated a ton, but it's not enough. I still want to know more about you.
text.人家亲手调制的爱意已经填满列车长的胃了~: I've filled your stomach with the glass of love I personally mixed.
text.修格里的红茶因为香气优雅所以非常有名，列车长似乎也买了很多，是为了那位莉薇娅小姐: Shoggolith's Black Tea is especially renowned due to its sophisticated aroma. You seem to have bought quite a bit of it. Are they for Miss Livia? You sure are thoughtful toward your subordinates... Conductor.
text.列车长有想过，为什么会经常接到往曼德矿场运输工人的订单呢？对人力的无止境需求什么: Have you ever wondered why you keep receiving orders to transport workers to Mander Mine every now and then? It's somewhat odd, right? As if they have an endless need for manpower.
text.这座城市能有如今的繁荣，市长先生自然是功不可没。不过呢，事业成功的男人在家庭上却: Mr. Mayor's contribution to the prosperity this city now has is naturally indisputable. Nevertheless, a man with a successful career may not necessarily have a happy family... Ah, I just thought about some things from the past.
text.列车长要是对人家准备的东西有不满，一定要告诉人家啊。人家会变成列车长最喜欢的样子: If you're unhappy with the things I prepared, you gotta let me know, okay? I will become whatever you like, Conductor...
text.虽然人家也想让列车长喝更多~但是不行呢，要一步一步来……: I'd love for you to drink more too, but it isn't right. We gotta take it one step at a time...
text.希望“银枝之水”的效果可以指定？如果是列车长的愿望的话，亚莉奈会努力的！那么下次: If only the effects of 'Silver Branch Water' can be determined? If that's your wish, I'll work on it! Next time, I'll add something even stronger... Look forward to it, Conductor!
text.怎么样，苹果的芬芳香气有没有让列车长放松呢？每一颗苹果都经过了人家的精心挑选，毕: How is it? Did the sweet taste of apples help you relax? I picked every single apple meticulously since they are meant for you to drink!
text.怎么样，这种饮料只有在人家这里才能喝到哦~: How is it? This is a drink you can't find anywhere else but here!
text.列车长的喜好，已经被我完全掌控了~: I remember every little thing that you like, Conductor~
text.人家可以为你做到更多事，所以多看看我，好吗？: I can do way more things for you, so pay me more attention, okay?
text.真勤奋啊。好，我也不能输给你。: How hard-working. All right, I can't lose to you either.
text.每次都能把任务完成得这么出色，你也一样是对自我要求很高的类型？: You never fail to complete your tasks impeccably. Clearly, you have really high standards for yourself too, huh?
text.感觉要是哪天开始你不来了我还会不习惯……啧，这种依赖心态不可取。: Feels like I might even find it strange if you stop showing up someday... Tsk, this sense of dependency needs to be curbed.
text.单方面受你照顾不是我的风格，如果有需要不用遮遮掩掩，尽管开口。: It isn't my style to not reciprocate one's assistance. Don't hesitate to let me know if you ever need anything.
text.铁盟食堂的1号窗口永远排队的人最多，因为那个窗口专门出售铁盟A套餐，那可是所有套: The line at the first window of B.C.R.L.'s cafeteria is consistently the longest because it sells B.C.R.L.'s Set Meal A exclusively. That is the most unbeatable value-for-money set meal of all.
text.和那种过分精明的人打交道让我很头疼，比如商会的那位露珀特小姐。说起来……她总给我: Dealing with those overly shrewd people never fails to give me a headache. Take the COLUMBA's Miss Ruperto for instance. In fact... she always makes me feel like I can never hide anything from her. I hope I'm just overthinking it.
text.觉得我看起来眼熟？可能是铁盟的征兵宣传海报上看过我的照片吧。: You find me familiar? I guess it's probably because my face is plastered on BCRL's recruitment posters.
text.女儿偶尔会拜托我采购一些修格里的汽配零件寄给她，虽然不愿意过多干涉，但我难免也会: Every once in a while, my daughter asks me to purchase some car parts from Shoggolith and send them to her. I don't wish to interfere too much with her affairs, but I can't help worrying if she's doing some kind of dangerous experiments again...
text.鼹鼠帮对于修格里的治安是一个难以根除的隐患，铁安局多次试图围剿他们，成果仍不理想: MoleGang is a challenging conundrum for Shoggolith's security. BCRL Agency has tried multiple times to shut them down but to no avail. They seem to always receive some form of help at critical junctures to get away.
text.修格里的市长虽然对我总是非常客气，但于公于私，我都不应该与他过往甚密。他颇有手段: Although Shoggolith's mayor has never been anything short of polite to me, I shouldn't have too close a relationship with him, be it at work or in private. He is a calculating man. You ought to be cautious when dealing with him, too.
text.之前妻子打来电话，她问我为什么电视机无法开启了。我问她是不是插头松了，检查后发现: My wife called to ask me why the television couldn't be turned on anymore. I asked her if the plug had come loose. Indeed, that was the case when she checked on it.
text.修格里有各种错综复杂的势力，如果太瞻前顾后，反而无法利落地处理这些任务。: There are all kinds of intricate, complex forces in Shoggolith. Being too prudent might cause one to be unable to handle these missions deftly instead.
text.胜利不会拘泥于某一种形式，你可以尽管选择自己擅长的。: Victory isn't limited to a specific form. You are free to pick whatever your forte is.
text.如果打算来处理任务相关事宜，那么你更要调整好自己的状态。: If you're here to handle mission-related matters, then you should all the more compose yourself.
text.你看起来已经比第一次走进铁安局时得心应手许多。: You look much more in your element now than when you first stepped into BCRL Agency.
text.你一直以来的表现确实亮眼，请继续努力，优秀的年轻人。: Your performance has been undeniably notable all along. Keep working hard, gifted one.
text.能做出这样的成绩已经很了不起了，不过你的眼神告诉我，你的志向不会仅限于此。: It's already impressive that you've achieved so much, but your gaze tells me that you are far from attaining your goals.
text.把事情交给你，我很放心。: I trust you to take care of the matter.
text.既然在工作时间来访，你是要求助，还是接受委托？: Seeing as you're here while on the clock, do you need help, or are you here to take on commissions?
text.任务委托栏在这边……或者你有其他事情要和我谈吗？: The commission board is over here... Or do you perhaps have something else to talk to me about?
text.你今天也很守时。: You're right on time today too.
text.列车长的工作应该并不清闲，你竟然还能每天完成这样大量的事务。如果有什么时间管理的: I doubt a conductor's job is languorous, and yet you still complete so much work every day. If you have some kind of time management tips, I'm all ears.
text.有你在感觉我突然轻松了不少，还有点不习惯……: Having you around almost immediately lessens my workload. What a foreign feeling this is...
text.除了漂亮地完成任务，也要注意让自己得到必要的休息。: Other than completing the missions immaculately, you have to make sure you get adequate rest as well.
text.这里总是不缺任务。: There is never a lack of missions here.
text.合理安排你的时间，选择最有效率的做法。: Manage your time reasonably and select the most efficient method.
text.在曼德矿场，走进铁安局的人永远是寻求帮助的多于提供帮助的。所以像你这样的可是相当: In Mander Mine, there are perpetually more people seeking help from the BCRL Agency than people providing aid. Hence, someone like you is truly hard to come by.
text.拜恶劣的治安环境所赐，大部分列车长都尽可能回避此地的运输任务，就算真的到这里，也: Thanks to the terrible state of security here, the majority of conductors do their best to avoid taking any jobs located in this region. Even if they do come, they will rather not step foot off the carriage.
text.我对这里倒是没什么别的看法，既然安排我负责此处的事务，那我唯有完成分内之事。: I don't have any particular thoughts about this place. Since I've been assigned to manage things here, I'll just do my part.
text.其实，曼德矿场这个地方也不是那么糟……这里总有很多篝火城内难以见到的大型机械，它: If I'm being honest, Mander Mine isn't really that bad of a place... There are always loads of large machinery here that can't be found in other Bonfire Cities. It's entertaining to watch them work.
text.……曼德矿场的午夜哭嚎传说？我、我没听说过，这一听就知道是无稽之谈吧。: ...Legend of Mander Mine's midnight cries? I-I've never heard of that. That's clearly made-up nonsense.
text.本关卡无法更换队员: Unable to change crew members in this stage.
text.本关卡无法清空编队: Unable to clear the squad formation in this stage.

text.退出后议价幅度将重置，是否继续？: Bargain range will reset after exiting, continue?

text.城市声望等级达到1级后才可进入，完成【铁安局驱逐任务】可提高城市声望。: Require City Reputation LV1. Complete [BCRL Eviction Quests] to gain Reputation.
text.是否使用<color=#FEC032>%s</color>追加投资额度？: Do you want to use <color=#FEC032>%s</color> to add investment quota?
text.当前无需使用追加注资申请书: No need to use Extra Invest Appl. at the moment.
text.咨询城市投资业务请按1……错误！错误！本机没有按键！将直接执行功能指令！: For city investment inquiries, please press 1... Error! Error! No keypad on this device! Function command will be executed directly!
text.人类认为对美的感知是感性的能力，但是本机也对美有自己的理解——梅蒂奇女士就是美！: Humans perceive beauty as a sensory ability, but I also have my own understanding of beauty — Signora Medici is beauty!
text.列车长，看起来你身上的铁盟币不太够啊: Conductor, it seems like you don't have enough BCRL Coins.
text.列车长，这是当前城市的投资选项: Conductor, these are the current investment options for the city.
text.感谢你的心意，这会是修格里发展道路上不可或缺的一块砖石。: Thank you for your kindness, this will be an indispensable part of Shoggolith's development.
text.感谢列车长对七号自由港的支持！: Thank you, Conductor, for supporting Freeport Ⅶ!
text.该笔资金的用途需要进行模拟演算再决定。: The use of this fund needs to be simulated and decided.
text.辛苦了！需要用到资金的地方有很多！: Good job! There are many places where funds are needed!
text.对于一般人类来说似乎是一个大数目，但是和本机的定期维护费用相比不足挂齿！: It seems like a large amount to the average human, but it's insignificant compared to my regular maintenance costs!
text.请选择以下一种方式恢复澄明度: Please choose one of the following ways to restore Clarity.
text.请选择以下一种方式消除疲劳值: Please choose one of the following ways to reduce Fatigue.
text.列车长疲劳值过高！是否使用<color=#FEC032>%s</color>消除: Your Fatigue is too high! Do you want to use <color=#FEC032>%s</color> to reduce Fatigue?
text.能在修格里的市政厅见到你着实让人喜悦，我有预感，我们能在一些事情上达成一致。: It's a pleasure seeing you in Shoggolith's City Hall. I have a feeling we can both see eye to eye on certain things.
text.对于你的热诚，我也应当展示自己应有的诚意，让你不会后悔为修格里做出的每一笔投资。: In response to your ardor, I should also demonstrate my sincerity so that you won't regret any investment you made in Shoggolith.
text.看到了吗，修格里城确实因为你的贡献产生了改变，即使还很微小，但你值得为此感到骄傲: See? Your contribution is truly changing Shoggolith City, albeit still just minimally. It is something to feel proud about.
text.真的不考虑一下留在修格里城为我做事吗，我会开出你无法拒绝的条件——只是玩笑罢了，: Will you really not consider staying in Shoggolith City to work for me? I'll make you an offer you can't say no to... Just kidding. We've spent enough time for me to know that you will surely turn me down.
text.我向你保证，它们会被用在刀刃上。: I assure you they will be used where it needs most.
text.对于你的慷慨解囊，修格里城不胜感激。: Shoggolith City is beyond grateful for your generous contribution.
text.当然，我会给予你令人满意的回报，这也是你期待的，不是吗？: Of course, I'll give you satisfactory returns. This is also what you're looking forward to, no?
text.之后我会让负责官员将资金的使用明细寄送给你，毕竟开诚布公是维系住这份信任最有效的: I will have the managing officer send you the funds' usage breakdown afterward. After all, being transparent is the most efficient means to maintain this trust, a key element.
text.无须为得到的优待抱有怀疑，谁也无法忽视你对修格里做出的贡献，我只是以市长的身份给: Worry not about the privileges you're receiving. No one can disregard your contribution to Shoggolith. I'm merely responding in kind as the mayor. There is no personal agenda behind this.
text.等你决定好了再叫我吧？我很忙的，而且干等着你下决定很无聊啊。: Let me know when you've made up your mind, okay? I'm busy, and it's boring to wait for your decision.
text.嗯嗯，尽管慢慢看吧，老师说过要给头脑不够灵活的人更多时间去思考。: Hmm, take your time to read through it. My teacher always said that people who aren't quick on the uptake need more time to think.
text.我的“老师”是什么人？这个嘛，其实没有什么老师啊，只是老师的话给人感觉比较有说服: Who's my teacher? Well, there isn't really a teacher. using the term just makes what I say sound more convincing. Even if people don't like what's said, they can't really blame a teacher.
text.我的姐姐……那个女人……应该有很多列车长觉得她说话很刻薄吧。虽然给人感觉是这样，: My sister... that woman... probably comes across as rather harsh to many conductors. Although she may give that impression, she's actually better than me at controlling her emotions.
text.关于指派到各个站点的负责人人选，会长都是经过了深思熟虑的。也就是说她觉得我适合在: When it comes to appointing responsible individuals to various stations, the president makes careful consideration. That means she thinks I'm suited to work in Shoggolith... The president is quite formidable, so I trust her judgment.
text.我买了那种纯白色没有任何图案的拼图，里面有一千片，应该可以玩上很久了。等拼完了我: I bought one of those pure white jigsaw puzzles with no patterns on it, a thousand pieces in total. Should keep me occupied for a while. Once I finish it, I'll go buy a black one to play with.
text.这样聊天没关系吗？你应该还有事情要做吧。: Here for a chat? I suppose you still have work to do, right?
text.好的好的，订单负责人那一栏已经把你的名字更新上去了。: Alright, alright. I've updated the order manager column with your name.
text.就是这样，老师说勤能补拙，你就用你的勤快来弥补你的不足吧。: That's it, my teacher says diligence can make up for deficiencies, so use your diligence to make up for your shortcomings.
text.欸……真麻烦……啊？我刚才什么也没说呀，听老师说越是心里有鬼的人才越容易出现错觉: Ugh... What a hassle... Huh? I didn't say anything. My teacher said that the guiltier you are, the more likely you are to have illusions.
text.要是实在决定不了就考虑一下这些订单吧，这可是认真考虑过的，才不是胡乱安排的。: If you really can't decide, look at these orders. They had undergone careful consideration, not randomly arranged.
text.今天可以做的工作都做完了，就算你要加班，我也不奉陪了。: I've finished all the work for today. Even if you want to work overtime, I won't accompany you.
text.嗯，你现在看起来终于像个科伦巴的一员了，但愿一切都还不算晚。: Well, you finally look like a COLUMBA member now. Hopefully, it's not too late for everything.
text.意外地能干啊……哎呀，是终于开窍了吗？还是说初见那会是单纯装傻呢？感觉不论哪种都: You're unexpectedly competent... Oh? Did you finally get it? Or were you just pretending to be clueless when we first met? Either way, it's kind of annoying, isn't it?
text.你的表现很优秀，请继续保持。我当然也是会真心实意夸赞别人的，别那么惊讶。: Your performance is excellent. Keep it up. Of course, I'll praise others when they deserve it. Don't look so surprised.
text.欢迎，“科伦巴的明日之星”——这是揶揄还是夸奖，就请自己判断吧。: Welcome, COLUMBA's Future Star — Is that mockery or praise? You decide.
text.浏览当日订单的话请自便，应该不会有这以外的事来找我了吧？: Feel free to browse through today's orders. I don't think you'll look for me for something other than this, right?
text.放心吧，你不用愁在这里找不到活干的。: Don't worry. You won't have trouble finding work here.
text.是你啊……你可要好好努力哦？毕竟不是所有人都像我这么亲切随和的，见到七号自由港的: It's you... You'd better work hard, okay? After all, not everyone is as friendly and easygoing as I am. Just wait till you meet that woman at Freeport Ⅶ.
text.你有好好干活啊，真棒真棒。: You're working hard, huh? That's great, really great.
text.哎，你是不是有点努力过头了？你这样拼命冲业绩居然不会感觉厌烦么？: Hey, aren't you overdoing it a bit? Even if you're chasing performance, shouldn't you feel a little bored doing it so relentlessly?
text.很多人取得了目标成就之后马上就松懈了，你呢，会是这种类型吗？: Many people slack off right after achieving their goals. Are you such a person?
text.放心，我可不会用这笔投注了热情和心意的资金做中饱私囊的事。: Don't worry. I won't use this fund, filled with enthusiasm and goodwill, for my own gain.
text.如果希望这笔资金有具体的用途，请尽管说。: If you have a specific purpose in mind for this fund, please feel free to say so.
text.一个中规中矩的数目，这样的选择很合理。: A moderate amount, that's a reasonable choice.
text.难得的投资额，半点都不想花掉……不过为了让那些家伙老实点，偶尔还是要给点甜头。: My, this amount of investment. If only there's no need to spend any penny... Alas, it's necessary to give out some benefits from time to time to keep those people in check.
text.你的样子好像在说，更大的数目也不在话下。: Your demeanor seems to suggest that even a larger sum wouldn't be out of the question.
text.既然你走进了这里，就意味着我们可以达成双方都满意的合作。这样理解应该没问题吧？: Since you're here, it means we can reach a mutually satisfying cooperation. My understanding is correct, right?
text.啊，当然，我早就知道像你这样年轻有为的列车长一定会给人带来惊喜。: Ah, of course, I knew that a promising young conductor like you would surely bring surprises.
text.欢迎，欢迎，您可是曼德矿场的大恩人。我的语气如果让您感到不快，还请大人有大量别计: Welcome, welcome. You are the great benefactor of Mander Mine. If my tone has offended you, please forgive me.
text.如此慷慨地为曼德矿场投资大笔资金，也许我应该为您建一座纪念铜像？: Such generous investment in Mander Mine. Perhaps I should erect a statue for you.
text.维持与您的合作果然是正确的选择，我很擅长抓住那些有利可图的机遇，哪怕需要使用一些: Maintaining our cooperation with you was indeed the right choice. I'm good at seizing profitable opportunities, even if it requires some less-than-pleasant methods.
text.还请继续维持这份良好的关系，您应该不会做出目标利益到手后就翻脸不认人的事情吧？: Please continue to maintain this good relationship. You wouldn't turn your back on us after achieving your goals, would you?
text.暂无队员可供选择: No crew members available for selection.
text.客人您一进门我就知道，今天是个适合做买卖的好日子。: As soon as you walked in, I knew today was a good day for business.
text.看我手上这指环，不错吧？尽管多看几眼，这成色可不多见。: Take a look at this ring in my hand. Isn't it nice? Feel free to take a closer look. This quality is hard to come by.
text.你来了？我进了些好货，就特别给你先看吧！: Look who's here. I brought in some good stuff. You'll be the first to see them!
text.你这段时间可是相当活跃啊，有关你的事情我听得耳朵都快起茧子了。: You've been quite active lately. My ears are almost calloused from hearing about you.
text.哎哟，咱们的大忙人来了？看你忙得脚不沾地，要不要坐下喝点茶？: Oh hey, the busy person is here? You look hectic. Want to sit down and have some tea?
text.“银枝气泡水”的功效消失了: The effects of Silver Bubble Soda have expired.
text.该家具不能摆放在当前车厢: This furniture cannot be placed in the current carriage.
text.经过大量样本分析，处理列车长<color=#b45e01>{playername: After extensive sample analysis, the time required for processing the investment business of Conductor <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color> has been reduced by 0.3 seconds!
text.为了更有效的执行专人业务，本机考虑申请升级语言模块。: To execute specialist business more effectively, the system is considering upgrading the language module.
text.嗨这不是我最聪明能干的列车长吗好久不见今天也是来给七号自由港投资的吗surpri: Hey, isn't this the smartest Conductor I know? Long time no see! Are you here today to invest in Freeport Ⅶ too? surpriseРадость&gfp3f2#16$%... Warning, language module patch α has crashed. Please refrain from use!
text.语言模块补丁已初始化完成，欢迎咨询城市投资业务。: The language module patch has been initialized. Welcome to inquire about city investment business.
text.欢迎，列车长<color=#b45e01>{playername}</color: Welcome, Conductor <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>! While you contribute to Freeport Ⅶ, the conversation function of the system has been upgraded, making communication with humans a breeze!
