text.投资金额十万元整已入账。: The investment of one hundred thousand has been credited.
text.当前已损失%d点车厢耐久，需要花费%d铁盟币进行维修。: Your train has lost %d durability. Repairing it will cost %d BCRL Coins.
text.每月一号%02d:%02d刷新: Refreshes on the first day of each month at %02d:%02d.
text.是否需要保存鱼缸编辑？: Do you want to save the fish tank edits?
text.是否消耗%d联盟币购买%s？: Do you want to spend %d Alliance Coins to purchase %s?
text.字数不足，请输入名字: Not enough characters, please enter a name.
text.急行弹丸不足，请到站后购买: Insufficient Rapid Bullet, please purchase after arrival.
text.不论什么时候造访修格里，我都会给予你应有的礼遇，只要我们这来之不易的合作关系能够: Whenever you visit Shoggolith, I will always give you the proper treatment, as long as our hard-won cooperative relationship can be maintained.
text.是否退出当前账号？: Do you want to log out of the current account?
text.平时多亏了你照顾我的生意，有什么我帮得上忙的？: Thanks for taking care of my business. Is there anything I can help you with?
text.说到修格里那就少不了要提他们的家电，听说连希斯·戴维家里用的电视机都是修格里出产: Speaking of Shoggolith, it's impossible not to mention their home appliances. I heard even the television at Heath David's house is produced by Shoggolith.
text.最近修格里的农产品协会正在讨论是否要制定新的土豆出口标准……我已经闻到了商机的味: The Agricultural Association of Shoggolith is discussing whether to establish new export standards for potatoes... I can already smell business opportunities.
text.多谢惠顾，等补货了再来啊！: Thanks for your patronage. Come back when we have restocked!
text.这些都是精挑细选的好货，商品限量供应，可别错过了。: These are carefully selected goods. Supply is limited. Don't miss out.
text.<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>今天大促销！这么划算: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are on sale today! With such a good price, why not take some?
text.过了这个村可就没这个店了！: If you miss this opportunity, you won't come by it again!
text.价格绝对公道，有需要就带一些吧！: The price is absolutely fair. Take some if you need!
text.哟，今天出手挺阔绰啊，难怪你一进门我就闻到一股冤大……我是说贵客的气息！: Oh, you're making quite a lavish purchase today. No wonder I smelled something rich as soon as you walked in... I mean, the aura of a distinguished guest!
text.超级优惠价，亏本买卖不赚你一分，闭着眼买就对了！: Highly discounted price. I won't make a penny off this deal. You can buy it with your eyes closed!
text.交易愉快，下次有需要记得还找我啊！: Happy trading. Remember to come to me next time you need something!
text.一切买卖我都欢迎，买卖买卖，有买就有卖——这次你打算给我看点什么好东西？: I welcome all transactions, buying and selling, buying and selling. When there's buying, there's selling — What good stuff are you planning to show me this time?
text.别的店可不一定能出到我这个价，你再好好想想吧。: Other stores might not offer you the same price. Think about it carefully.
text.这个啊……一口价，这个数如何！放心，绝对童叟无欺！: This one... a fixed price, how about this amount! Rest assured, absolutely fair and square!
text.你运气不错，这个现在很受欢迎，我愿意加钱买下。怎么样，不会高兴过头了吧？: You're lucky. This item is very popular right now. I'm willing to pay more for it. How about it? Aren't you happy enough?
text.这玩意今天的行情可不好，你想清楚了？: The market for this item isn't doing well today. Have you considered it carefully?
text.唉……为了长远的发展，有的时候也不得不退让三分。: Sigh... for the sake of long-term development, sometimes you have to make concessions.
text.砍价留一线，日后好相见！真要那个价卖你，我只能喝西北风了。: Bargain leaves room for future meetings! If I sell it to you at that price, I'll be out of business.
text.看在成色的份上，成交！下次有好货记得咱家就行！: For such quality, it's a deal! Remember to come back next time with good stuff!
text.不是我不给您面子，换了谁都只能出这个价。: It's not that I'm disrespecting you. Anyone would only offer this price.
text.对了，如果你手里有<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>，: By the way, if you have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>, don't hesitate to bring them out.
text.欢迎欢迎，这位列车长！来买点什么吧！: Welcome, welcome, Conductor! What would you like to buy?
text.咱身上可能有点机油味，别介意哈！经常鼓捣那些玩意在所难免。: I might smell of oil. Don't mind it! It's inevitable when I often tinker with those things.
text.正好，我折腾了个厉害的新家伙，交易之前要不先来看看？: Perfect. I've created an impressive new gadget. Do you want to take a look before we trade?
text.看你那么卖力，咱也不能落下，一定要准备一个让你大吃一惊的道具出来。: Seeing you work so hard, I can't be left behind. I must prepare an item that will surprise you.
text.看来你的工作相当顺利，正巧，咱的研发进程也是如此。: It seems your work is going quite smoothly. Fortunately, our research and development process is the same.
text.看到你如今的成功，就证明咱当初果然慧眼如炬，哈哈！研发成果？那个还是先别问了……: Seeing your success now proves that I had a keen eye from the beginning, haha! Research results? Let's not talk about that for now...
text.贡露城，贡露城是个好地方啊！最重要的是，咱的心上鱼也在那里！: Gronru City. Gronru City is a good place! Most importantly, my beloved fish is there!
text.咱也知道自己的竞争对手多，但不争取下怎么知道能不能成呢？相信咱一定能打动她的！: I know we have many competitors, but if we don't try, how do we know if we'll succeed? I believe I can impress her!
text.话又说回来，上次她生日，咱专门打造了个镶金的电动扭力扳手送她，结果被退回来了，到: Speaking of which, I made a gold-plated electric torque wrench just for her on her last birthday, but she rejected it. Why!
text.这里出产的钢材造就了北大陆的这些铁轨，这一点毋庸置疑！: The steel produced here has made the iron rails of the northern continent. There's no doubt about it!
text.巴克斯特那老小子和咱说那个深夜的诡异声音似乎在铁安局那个方向，但甘雅小妹说她从来: Baxter said that the eerie noises at night seemed to come from the direction of the BCRL Agency, but Ganya said she had never heard them, and that made him even more afraid, haha!
text.买之前和你说一声，<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>今: Before you buy, I want you to know that <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are on sale today. Don't miss out. Give it priority consideration!
text.咱可不会干以次充好的事情，那不是自砸招牌么！: We wouldn't do things like passing off substandard goods as high-quality ones, that would be ruining our own reputation!
text.有句话怎么说的来着，不买可以节省百分之一百……: There's a saying, not buying can save you one hundred percent...
text.哈哈，咱当然不介意多赚点！: Haha, of course I don't mind making a little more money!
text.这就对了！能省就省！: That's right! Save where you can!
text.咱出价必定公道，下次再来啊！: My offer is definitely fair. Come back next time!
text.来来来，今天咱这大力欢迎<color=#b45e01>{goods}</colo: Come on! Let's give a warm welcome to <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> today.
text.哪有什么没价值的东西，只是价值多少的问题罢了！: There is no such thing as worthless; it's only a matter of how much value it holds!
text.改主意了？也行，那就下次再交易吧！: Changed your mind? That's fine. Let's trade next time!
text.嚯，你确定？有这么缺钱？: Oh, are you sure? Are you that short on money?
text.成，就给个友情价！: Alright, I'll give you a friend's price!
text.哈哈，抱歉了，咱总不能让自己亏损吧！: Haha, sorry, I can't let myself lose money!
text.多出来的，就当是对你未来的投资了！: Take the extras as an investment for your future!
text.一分钱一分货，咱也只能出这么多。: You get what you pay for. This is all I can offer.
text.<color=#b45e01>{station}</color>对<color=: The demand for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> has skyrocketed at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. Why don't you consider selling there?
text.在<color=#b45e01>{station}</color>，<color: At <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>, there's simply no market for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>. I suggest you trust my information network. Don't suffer losses from trading with the wrong partners.
text.说到7号自由港的桦石发财树，那可是在曼德矿场卖得最好的东西。: Freeport Ⅶ's Chaos Money Tree? That's the best-selling item in Mander Mine.
text.曼德矿场的图形加速卡在7号自由港一向供不应求，这可是个很拿得出手的好东西。: Mander Mine's GPU is consistently out of stock in Freeport Ⅶ. After all, it's the pick of the litter.
text.哦，你既然有这个为什么不早点拿出来呢？我这就准备新的商品。: Oh, since you had this, why didn't you bring it out earlier? I'll prepare new merchandise right away.
text.今天已经没有更多商品了，很遗憾，毕竟库房的容量也是有限的。: We're out of stock today, sorry. After all, the warehouse capacity is limited.
text.面对您这样大气的客人，我当然没有把商品藏着掖着的理由！: Facing such a generous guest like you, I certainly have no reason to hide the goods!
text.哎呀，客人这么豪爽，我却没有更好的东西招待，实在惭愧！请务必让我明天来弥补这份遗: Oh, you're so generous a customer, but I don't have anything better to offer. I'm really sorry! Please allow me to make up for it tomorrow!
text.最近<color=#b45e01>{station}</color>一笔关于<c: Recently, a transportation order concerning <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> went wrong at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. Now, the price of it over there is continually rising.
text.听说了吗，有商会在<color=#b45e01>{station}</color: Have you heard? There's a COLUMBA selling a large quantity of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. I don't recommend selling there. It's wiser to find another place to sell them.
text.我们这儿的弹丸加速装置在阿妮塔战备工厂卖得特别火爆，听说都快赶上硬通货了。: Our Bullet Accelerators are incredibly hot selling in Anita Weapon Factory. I heard it's almost to the point where it's regarded as hard currency.
text.纯金线材可是个好东西啊……你要是有不妨考虑卖给我，在这里没人不喜欢。: Pure Gold Wires are good stuff... If you have some, I'll gladly take them off your hands. No one here will say no to it.
text.咱这就准备新的商品！: Let me prepare new merchandise right away!
text.这下糟了，咱的库房可是空空荡荡了！: Oh no, our warehouse is empty now!
text.<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>你有吗？这个在<co: Do you have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>? It's selling pretty well at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>.
text.等等，你听说了没，今天千万别去<color=#b45e01>{station}<: Wait, have you heard? Don't sell <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> today, or you'll definitely lose money! Don't be polite. Please take care of our business in the future.
text.桦石发财树在这儿非常受欢迎，其实咱也喜欢。: Chaos Money Trees are very popular here. Frankly, I like them too.
text.如果是为您这样出色的列车长提供更多选择，乐意之至。: If it means offering an outstanding conductor like yourself even more choices, it would be my utmost pleasure.
text.贵安，今天的天气相当美丽不是吗？对人家来说，只要有生意做的日子就是美丽的好日子。: Good day~ Isn't the weather simply lovely today? To me, any day there's business to be done is a lovely day indeed.
text.虽然人家的追求者确实很多，但是与其来搭讪，我更希望你能和我谈谈商业话题。: I do have quite a number of admirers, it's true, but rather than flirtation, I'd much prefer you speak with me about business matters.
text.美食、流行、奢侈品……这可是一座非常适合有格调的淑女享受生活的城市。: Fine cuisine, fashion, luxury goods... this city is truly made for a lady of refined taste to enjoy life to the fullest.
text.在人家眼里，现在音乐厅上演的剧目都达不到弗威尔先生的高度，真是可惜……这么多年了: To my eye, none of the productions playing at the concert hall these days come close to Mr. Verwell's caliber... what a shame. Has Gronru really produced no finer playwright in all these years?
text.最近<color=#b45e01>{station}</color>一笔关于<c: There's been trouble lately with a shipping order for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>, and the price of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> has climbed rather steeply as a result.
text.听说了吗，有商会在<color=#b45e01>{station}</color: Have you heard? Some merchant house has been dumping large quantities of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. Might be wiser to unload elsewhere.
text.就算是人家这样出色的淑女，在感情中也有许多身不由己。只是……我还是无法原谅哥哥。: Even a fine lady such as myself has little say in matters of the heart. It's only that... I still can't quite bring myself to forgive my brother.
text.如果是哥哥拜托你打探，人家无可奉告，毕竟人家不想说一些人们表达负面情绪时用的口语: If it's my brother who put you up to prying, I'm afraid I have nothing to say on the matter—I simply refuse to resort to the sort of coarse language people use when venting their negative feelings. It would hardly become a lady.
text.他曾对人家说过，无法为儿女情长驻足停留……但是，忘却谈何容易？: He once told me he could never afford to linger over matters of romance... but then, how easily does one simply forget?
text.<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>正好在清仓，这么优惠: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> happens to be on clearance right now—a deal this good doesn't come along often.
text.十分感谢您的关照。: Many thanks for your continued patronage.
text.无论看追求者还是看商品，人家的眼光都是一流的，请尽管放心挑选。: Whether it's suitors or merchandise, my eye for quality is second to none—feel free to browse with complete confidence.
text.认清自己的消费实力也不是一件坏事。: Knowing one's own means isn't such a bad thing, you know.
text.眼光独到的选择——虽然无论你买了哪件商品，人家都会这么说就是了。: A discerning choice—though, of course, I'd say that no matter what you bought.
text.有的时候，买东西看中的是当下的心情，这就是所谓的附加价值。: Sometimes what you're really buying is a feeling, in the moment. That's what they call added value.
text.从各种方面来说，人家都十分推荐购买这件商品。: By every measure, I'd wholeheartedly recommend this item to you.
text.对于有价值的物品，人家自然也很感兴趣，请不要吝于展示您手中的物品。: Naturally, I take quite an interest in items of real value—please, don't hesitate to show me what you're holding.
text.好吧，无论如何人家也无法责备你在决断时更加谨慎。: Well, I suppose I can hardly fault you for being cautious when it comes to making a decision.
text.看起来还不错，这个数你看如何？: This looks rather nice—how about this price?
text.哎呀，这不是……请一定要卖给我，当然，价钱上人家也不会亏待你的。: Oh my, isn't this... you simply must sell it to me. And of course, I won't shortchange you on the price.
text.这个人家不是很有兴趣……但是看在你的面子上，我可以勉强收购。: I'm not terribly interested in this one... but seeing as it's you, I suppose I could bring myself to take it off your hands.
text.为了长远的发展，今天稍微让步一点也不是不可以哦。: For the sake of a long and lasting relationship, I suppose I could afford to give a little ground today.
text.你提出的那个价格就算是人家也会觉得为难啊。: Even I would find the price you're asking rather difficult to swallow.
text.这样也无妨，价格还在合理的范围内。: That'll do just fine—the price is still within reason.
text.人家只能给出商品对应的真正价值，这是为商者的本分。: I can only offer what an item is truly worth—that's simply the duty of a merchant.
text.补货？当然可以，只要您把采购券带来！: Restock? Sure thing, provided that you've brought the purchase voucher!
text.欢迎来到海角城！看你这样，是初来乍到？要不要我给你介绍介绍？: Welcome to Cape City! It's got to be your first time here, huh? Want a tour?
text.要有什么想吃的东西尽管问我，我可是当地的美食通！: Feel free to ask me if you have any cravings. I'm the local foodie, after all!
text.<color=#b45e01>{station}</color>出货的<colo: The price of <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>'s <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> has been skyrocketing lately. Better not miss this opportunity, Conductor.
text.我听说<color=#b45e01>{station}</color>附近<co: Rumor has it that the price of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> near the <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> has been plunging. Maybe it's a good time to get into it?
text.真要说起来，我倒是对贡露城的著名餐厅更熟悉些，但海角城也有不少不逊于他们的店，店: If I'm being honest, I'm frankly more familiar with the popular restaurants in Gronru City, but Cape City has quite a few equally good ones too. They're so successful that the owners refuse to advertise. I'll tell you about them on the down-low next time!
text.您要有什么看中的东西想买但不知道买哪个，不妨都买下来吧？有时纠结于更一个合适的选: If there's something you want to buy but you're not sure which to choose, try getting them all. Sometimes, nitpicking on which one's more suitable will make you miss out on many other stuff instead.
text.好嘞，我这就让学徒几个把货都给您调过去！: Okay! I'll go get my apprentices to move the goods over for you!
text.随便瞧随便看，我这里的东西可都是好货。: Don't hesitate to take a look around. All my stuff is top-tier.
text.不买我可下班了啊，真不买吗？: If you're not buying, I'm knocking off. Any second thoughts?
text.这价格……中规中矩吧！: This price... is average, I guess!
text.我是没什么意见，但你要不再看看这价格？: I'm fine with that, but maybe you should double-check the price?
text.这价格挺划算的，真有眼光！: This price is quite a steal. You've got a keen eye!
text.成交！合作愉快，列车长！: Deal! Nice doing business with you, Conductor!
text.海角城的市场最近十分活跃，您要不要考虑来和我一起做生意？: Cape City's market has been booming nowadays. How about you consider coming to do business alongside me?
text.您要是今天没什么做生意的心情，倒也可以我先请您吃顿饭。: If you're not in the mood to do business today, I can buy you a meal.
text.中规中矩吧，您要是为了清库存的话，倒也可以。: Average, I guess. It'll do if you're simply trying to offload your inventory.
text.行，我愿意多付一点儿！: Sure, I'm willing to pay a bit more!
text.哎，这价格对您来说可不太划算。: (sighs) This price won't be that good of a deal for you.
text.嘶……勉勉强强给你降点儿。: (inhales sharply) Fine, I'll lower it a little more just for you.
text.不行不行，不能再低了！再低我就亏本了！: No way, I won't go any lower! Any more and I'll be making a loss!
text.这是为了我们长期的合作关系着想。: This is for the sake of our long-term partnership.
text.依我看，您带来的东西抬不到那个价……: In my opinion, what you brought isn't worth that high of a price...
text.你先慢慢想，杯子空了，我再去倒点喝的。: Take your time to consider. The cup's empty, and I'll go get something to drink.
text.我看看……没什么，我只是在看还有多久下班。: Let's see... Nothing, I'm just checking how long it is until I get off work.
text.这里的活可不怎么有意思，现在后悔还来得及。: The work here isn't very interesting. It's still not too late to change my mind.
text.哎哟喂……嘶……只是肩周炎犯了，先别管我……嘶……: Oh my... ouch... Just my shoulder acting up, don't mind me... ouch...
text.如你所见，我正在拍蚊子，你说这世界被折腾成这样了，这玩意怎么还能存活啊？: As you can see, I'm swatting mosquitoes. With the world in such turmoil, how can these creatures still survive?
text.你说你，三天两头往这边跑，我就是有偷懒的心也没这个机会。: You come here every other day. Even if I wanted to slack off, I didn't have the chance to.
text.工作也好闲谈也罢，大叔我都奉陪到底。大家都随意点，这儿没什么规矩。: Whether it's work or idle chatter, I'll keep you company all the way. Everyone, feel free, as there are no rules here.
text.又来了？哎呀其他事放一边，陪大叔我玩两把牌先！: Here again? Put everything else aside, and play some cards with me first!
text.咱们说句心里话，你一直以为大叔我杯子里的是酒对吧？其实里面是仙人掌饮料，我喜欢啤: Let's have a few honest words. You've always thought I have alcohol in my cup, right? It's actually cactus beverage. I love beer, but ever since I got gout, well... sigh.
text.会长……会长她是个好女人啊，全商会的小姑娘小伙子都很尊敬她吧，你一定也是……嗯，: The president... the president is a good person, isn't she? All the young men and women in the COLUMBA respect her a lot. I'm sure you do too... Well, forget it. Forget about it.
text.有时候也感觉我在你跟前是不是太啰嗦了，不过嘛，上了年纪的大叔呢难得有个能说说话的: Sometimes I feel that I talk too much in front of you, but well, an old uncle like me rarely has someone to talk to, so forgive me.
text.我、我、我不知道怎么开口，但是，偶尔，在曼德矿场的深夜我会听到凄厉的哭嚎……而且: I-I-I don't know how to say this, but I hear eerie cries occasionally late at night in Mander Mine... and I'm the only one who hears them! It's very scary, really scary...
text.我特别喜欢《异星人大战史前桦树生物》这部电影，结果其他人对这部电影的评价都是负面: I love the movie 'Chaos Remains: Alien Warfare Prehistoric Birch Creatures' a lot, but everyone else's reviews are negative. I wrote a rave review to the movie magazine before, and it was mistaken as a sponsored post.
text.好好干吧，搞砸了也不会有人说什么，毕竟这地方就这样。: Do your best. If you mess up, no one will say anything. After all, that's just how it is here.
text.曾经我也像你这样意气风发的……不过……不提了。: I used to be as energetic as you... but... let's not talk about it.
text.唉，我理解，我十分能理解！人总有感觉累了的时候。: Sigh. I understand. I understand very well! People always feel tired at some point.
text.说实在的，这里的活本来就没多少人愿意干……: Honestly, there aren't many people willing to do the work here...
text.年轻人有干劲是好事，但是大叔我呢，实在是能力有限，今天就算了吧。: It's good that young people are enthusiastic, but for an old uncle like me, my abilities are limited. Let's call it a day.
text.虽说是给你推荐了，不过也就是一堆烂菜叶子里找点没那么烂的，别抱太大期待。: Although I recommended it to you, it's just picking something slightly less terrible from a pile of rubbish. Don't expect too much.
text.巴克斯特那家伙还是一如既往地老实本分，踏实乏味的生活很适合他。: Baxter is still as honest and boring as ever, so the simple and steady life suits him.
text.别觉得我是个对下属刻薄的家伙，要知道人永远不知满足，以他们付出的水准也只能得到这: Don't think I'm harsh on my subordinates. People are never satisfied, and they only deserve this much from the level of effort they put in.
text.我可不是对谁都那么耐心，如果对所有人都摆出一副亲切热情的态度，这种手段就会贬值。: I'm not so patient with everyone. If I put on a friendly face for everyone, it would depreciate the value of such an expression. In other words, you're worth my warm welcome.
text.第一印象是重要的一环，所以我时刻注意让我的皮鞋保持锃亮的状态。要在这种地方维持这: First impressions are important, so I always make sure my shoes are polished. It's not easy to maintain this in a place like this, you know?
text.这里只对列车长出售一种饮品，比起其他的饮料，它能帮到你更多哦。: There's only one type of beverage sold to Conductors here. Compared to other drinks, it can help you more.
text.列车长好像很喜欢人家精心调制的饮料，是不是意味着人家对列车长来说是不可或缺的呢~: You seem to really like the artisanal beverages. Does that mean I'm indispensable to you, Conductor~
text.“银枝之水”无论是名字还是效果给人的感觉都很不错吧？人家随时为你准备着哟。: The Silver Branch Water gives a very nice feeling both in name and effect, doesn't it? I'm always ready to prepare it for you.
text.列车长当前精神正佳，是否仍继续喝一杯: You are fully energetic! Would you like another drink?
text.欢迎光临“火烈鸟宠物店”，本店出售宠物、植物、鱼类以及相关用品。: Welcome to "Flamingo Pet Shop." We sell pets, plants, fish, and relevant supplies.
text.虽然会定期联络，不过这次店长真的外出了很长时间。他还没有找到那位重要的伙伴吗？: Although we'll stay in touch, the shopkeeper has been away for a long while this time. Hasn't he found that important partner yet?
text.您可以慢慢考虑要购买的商品，有需要请随时吩咐我。: Take your time to consider your purchase. Feel free to let me know if you need anything.
text.如果想不好带谁回家，可以尝试和它们互动一下增进彼此的了解。店主说过，不是人单方面: If you can't decide which one to take home, try interacting with them to get to know each other better. The shopkeeper once said, humans don't merely choose pets unilaterally — the final choice is mutual.
text.植物因为能给人带来平静放松的感觉一直很受欢迎，无论作为列车内的装饰还是送人的礼品: Plants have always been popular for bringing peace and relaxation. They make wonderful decorations for train decorations, or great gifts for others.
text.装满观赏鱼的水族箱现在也成为了一种流行的室内装饰，也许是因为对生活在陆地上的人们: Aquariums filled with ornamental fish have also become a trendy interior decoration lately. Perhaps it offers a unique viewing experience for those who live on land.
text.如果想要照料好这些鲜活的生命，相关物品是必不可少的。: If you want to take good care of these living creatures, dedicated supplies are absolutely essential.
text.店里正好到货了一批新商品，如果您有兴趣，我这就领您去看。: We've just restocked a batch of new goods in the shop. If you're interested, I can show you right away.
text.欢迎，您看起来很忙碌，不介意的话要不要先喝点什么？: Welcome. You look quite busy. Would you like something to drink first, if you don't mind?
text.我有听说关于您的一些事。隔壁店铺的老板说过，多亏了您，我们这一带的环境比以前好了: I've heard a few things about you. The owner of the shop next door said it's all thanks to you that our neighborhood has become much nicer than before.
text.之前久违地收到了店长的联络，一向不爱管闲事的他居然特地叮嘱我要好好招待您，还真让: I heard from the shop manager after a long while. He's never one to meddle in others' business, yet he specifically told me to treat you well. It really took me by surprise... though I already planned to do so anyway.
text.若是您遇到了棘手的事情，我很乐意助您一臂之力，毕竟我的本职不是店员，而是女仆。我: If you ever run into any troublesome matters, I'd be glad to lend you a hand. After all, my true occupation isn't shop assistant — I am a maid, especially skilled at all kinds of cleaning work, so please don't hesitate to ask if you need help.
text.您发觉我是帝国人了？原来如此，您的助理与我是同乡啊……说不定我们曾经见过，毕竟我: You noticed I'm from the Empire? I see. Your assistant is my fellow countrywoman... We might even have met before. I've worked in the manors of many noble households, after all.
text.原本我并不擅长照顾这些活物，一切的知识都是店长教给我的。不过正如宝石越是打磨越是: I wasn't originally good at taking care of living things. All my knowledge was taught to me by the shopkeeper. But just as a gem grows more beautiful with polishing, anything you're bad at can be mastered with constant practice.
text.曼杜斯帝国流传着各种各样传说故事，有很多都是随着口耳相传逐渐歪曲了，然而一般人能: All kinds of legends circulate across the Mundus Empire, and many have been distorted as they passed down by word of mouth. Ordinary people have very few ways to learn the truth. If you're interested, I could tell you the original versions of some tales when we get the chance.
text.……抱歉，我竟然走神了。只是刚才在想，为我起了这个名字的人现在是否过得还好。: ...Sorry, I zoned out just now. I was just wondering if the person who gave me my name is doing well now.
text.该造景已被占用，是否需要卸下并使用？: The scenery has been occupied, do you want to remove it and use it?
text.列车状况良好，无需维修: The train is in good condition and does not need maintenance.
text.%s和%s的羁绊会消失，宠物亲密度等级将会降至7级，是否确定解除饲养关系?: The bond between %s and %s will be broken, and the pet's Intimacy level will drop to 7. Are you sure you want to proceed?
text.是否使用<color=#FEC032>%s</color>获取新的悬赏任务: Use <color=#FEC032>%s</color> to get new bounty quests?
text.先去其他地方逛逛吧！: Let's go somewhere else for now!
text.是否消耗%d铁盟币修理列车。: Would you like to spend %d BCRL Coins to repair the train?
text.是否消耗%d铁盟币保养列车。: Would you like to spend %d BCRL Coins to maintain the train?
text.当前列车清洁度为%d%%，清洁状态良好，暂时不需要清洗。: Current Cleanliness is %d%%. The train is in good condition, no cleaning needed for now.
text.当前列车清洁度为%d%%，清洁状态一般，有不少乘客对列车的清洁感到不满，乘客收益: Current Cleanliness is %d%%. The train is okay. Many passengers are unhappy with the cleanliness, reducing Passenger Revenue by %d%%. The train needs cleaning.
text.当前列车清洁度为%d%%，清洁状态糟糕，已经无法招揽乘客了，列车需要清洗。: Current Cleanliness is %d%%. The train is poor condition and can no longer attract passengers. The train needs cleaning.
text.当前口粮槽所有口粮会丢失，是否确定换粮？: All food in the current food slot will be lost. Are you sure you want to change the food?
text.源自阿妮塔航天科技的车载小型化推进器，使用一次性形态场催化剂——“急行弹丸”激活: Derived from Anita's aerospace tech, the onboard miniaturized thrusters use morphic field catalyst — "Rapid Bullet" to activate. It converts Chaos Stone or Chaos Residue powder into high-temperature and high-speed hydrogen and helium. For %d seconds, increases speed by %dkm/h.
text.是否消耗%d铁盟币清洗列车。: Would you like to spend %d BCRL Coins to clean the train?
text.是否放弃当前任务？: Would you like to abandon the current quest?
text.是否消耗%d铁盟币购买%d个急行弹丸。: Would you like to spend %d BCRL Coins to purchase %d Rapid Bullet?
text.当前宠物别墅饲养数量已达上限: The current number of pets in the pet villa has reached its limit.
text.今日投喂零食次数已用尽: Today's snack feeding limit has been reached
text.工坊空置中，暂无建造任务: Workshop vacant, no construction quests available
text.施工已完成，等待列车长提取: Construction completed, waiting for you to collect
text.是否使用%d铁盟币扩建车厢仓库？: Would you like to spend %d BCRL Coins to expand garage?
text.已达到列车节数上限，提升电力等级可增加节数上限: Carriages maxed out. Please increase power level.
text.列车长喜欢曼德矿场对吧，所以亚莉奈也喜欢。列车长喜欢的就是我喜欢的，啊，除了一些: You like Mander Mine, right, Conductor? I like it too. Whatever you like, I'll like. Oh, except for some bugs that hinder us and confuse you~
text.呀，列车长的头发上都沾到尘土了，让亚莉奈帮你擦干净吧？呵呵呵，可以靠得更近一些哦: Oh, the conductor's hair is all dusty. Let me help you clean it up? Hehehe, you can lean a little closer~
text.列车长莫非是累了吗？那就枕着亚莉奈的大腿，在旁边好好休息一下吧~: Are you tired, Conductor? Rest your head on my thigh then, and have a good rest~
text.要是有困扰的话，就请呼唤亚莉奈的名字吧。人家会努力的，直到呼唤我成为列车长的本能: If you have any trouble, just call my name. I'll do my best until calling me becomes instinctive for you...
text.列车长与这座城市之间有奇妙的过往，亚莉奈对这一点略有耳闻。当时那个插手的家伙莫非: There's a wonderful past between you and this city. I've heard a little about it. Could the person who intervened back then be... hmm, a real annoyance...
text.列车长奔波于各个城市，一定对不同的货品有所了解吧？那么可以帮亚莉奈选一下买哪种香: You travel between various cities, Conductor. Surely you have some understanding of different goods, right? Then can you help me pick a perfume? Come on. I sprayed a bit on my wrist here. Have a sniff~
text.列车长可以叫亚莉奈的名字吗？温柔的，或者是责备的都可以。: Can you call my name, Conductor? Tenderly or reproachfully. Both are fine.
text.这里的很多人都非常感谢阿妮塔，毕竟他们的科研成果为这座城市带来了许多利益。不过…: Many people here are very grateful to Anita. After all, their research results have benefitted this city a lot. But... well, they did a decent job of covering their tracks, so I won't badmouth them~
text.今天稍微调整了一下眼妆哦，列车长能告诉人家感想吗？要注视着人家的双眼仔细观察，不: I changed my eye makeup a bit today. What do you think? Look into my eyes carefully, and don't look away~
text.请选择对应人数的队员: Please select the corresponding number of crew members.
text.前方遇袭，护卫队准备迎击！: Frontal attack detected! Escort ready to engage!
text.该编队人数未齐: The squad is not fully manned.
text.商会任务交易品暂不可存储: The COLUMBA quest items cannot be stored at the moment.
text.列车长，这是你的私人仓库区域: Conductor, this is your private warehouse area.
text.这周<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>可是硬通货了，如: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are in high demand this week. If anyone wants to make a good profit, it's best to seize on this opportunity.
text.透露给你也无妨，近来<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>: There's no harm telling you this. <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have been in short supply recently. All the store owners I know regret not stocking up more.
text.你听咱说，眼下<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>是紧缺: Listen, <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are in short supply right now, but it's also important to sell at the right time!
text.欢迎光临，有什么能帮到您的？: Welcome! How can I assist you?
text.想看点什么？我来给您介绍下吧？: What would you like to see? I can recommend some options.
text.您来的正是时候，眼下的货可都是最好的！: You've come at the perfect time. Our current stock is the best!
text.最近还顺利吧？您的事在这周围可都传遍啦。: Have things been going smoothly lately? Your affairs are the talk of the town around here.
text.哎呀，列车长，想喝点什么？别客气，生意还要托您关照。: Oh dear, Conductor, would you like something to drink? Don't stand on ceremony. We rely on your patronage for business.
text.您的光临简直让我们这蓬荜生辉，还有什么需要的我来帮您留意。: Your visit truly brightens our day. Is there anything else you need me to keep an eye out for?
text.没问题，这就为您备货！: No problem. I'll get that stocked up for you!
text.抱歉，确实没有存货了，欢迎您明天再来！: Sorry, we're out of stock. Feel free to come back tomorrow!
text.近来<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>的市场相当火爆，: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are in high demand recently. Too bad there's no way to get more stocks in...
text.多谢惠顾，品质请放心，您尽管拿去就是了！: Thank you for your patronage. Rest assured of the quality. Please take it with you!
text.您尽管挑选，我家的价格绝对公道。: Feel free to take your pick. Our prices are absolutely fair.
text.物美价廉，童叟无欺！: Good quality at a fair price. No hidden clauses!
text.不麻烦，只是您有什么需要的记得再来啊！: No trouble at all. Just remember to come back if you need anything!
text.您还需要看看别的什么吗？: Do you want to look at anything else?
text.价格也是没办法的，最近的行情您也知道！: The prices can't be helped. You're well aware of the recent trends!
text.这件正在甩卖，买了包您不亏！: This item is on clearance sale. It's definitely a worthwhile purchase!
text.感谢您的关照，还请多多光顾。: Thank you for your patronage. Please come back again soon.
text.如果您正打算脱手，我们很乐意收购。: If you're looking to sell, we're happy to buy.
text.欢迎欢迎，列车长您又带什么宝贝来啦？: Welcome, welcome, Conductor! What treasures have you brought with you this time?
text.啊，可惜，期待下次与您的交易。: Oh, what a pity. Looking forward to doing business with you next time.
text.这是我们给的价格，不知您意下如何？: This is our offer. What do you think?
text.啊，居然是……拜托您务必卖给我家，我一定给您最好的价格！: Oh, it's... Please, you must sell it to me. I'll definitely offer you the best price!
text.现在这样的商品行情可不好，只能给您这个数。: The market price for such products isn't good right now. I can only offer you this much.
text.成交！就当是给您的特别优惠。: Deal! Consider it a special discount for you.
text.实在抱歉，给的价格已经很实惠啦，确实不能再让了！: I'm really sorry. The price we're offering is already quite reasonable. We really can't go any lower!
text.您的货实在不错，那就这么说定了。: Your goods are really good. Let's settle on this then.
text.我也是按照商品的价值给出的价格。: I've priced it according to the value of the goods.
text.已经两天未清理过垃圾了，列车清洁度上限降低了20%: It has been two days since the trash was last cleaned. Max Cleanliness reduced by 20%.
text.压缩垃圾块已经超出暂存上限了，列车清洁度上限降低了20%: Compacted trash blocks exceed storage limit. Max Cleanliness reduced by 20%.
text.是否需要消耗%d铁盟币清理所有垃圾压缩块。: Do you want to spend %d BCRL Coins to clean up all compacted trash blocks?
text.工作经验丰富，尽职尽责的工人。: An experienced worker, who is diligent and responsible.
text.让人难以猜透内心的想法，喜欢一个人就能享受的活动。: Activities that one can enjoy just by liking someone, making it hard to guess one's inner thoughts.
text.励志回家继承家业的平凡富二代: The typical rich kid who strives to inherit the family business when they return home.
text.负责人不在，先去其他地方逛逛吧！: The person in charge is not around. You might want to shop somewhere else first!
text.为了更好地宣传七号自由港，本机正在试图创作一首朗朗上口的广告歌曲，机会难得，就让: To better promote Freeport Ⅶ, this unit is attempting to compose a catchy advertising song. Since it's a rare opportunity, I'll let you listen to the first line. Cough — Freeport Ⅶ~ It's so amazing~~~ Huh, why are you covering your ears?
text.阿妮塔科技对于七号自由港各方面的发展有着不可磨灭的贡献，包括本机的硬件维护也是！: Anita Tech has made invaluable contributions to all aspects of Freeport Ⅶ's development, including hardware maintenance by this unit!
text.将桦石原石的边角料加工成装饰品……本机其实有些难理解，果然我与真正的人类之间还有: Processing the leftovers of Chaos Stones into decorations... I find it somewhat difficult to understand. Is there still a gap between me and real humans? But why do I feel a circuit heating up upon seeing Signora Medici's image?
text.我听说你表现得很积极，我不反感这一点，要知道安于现状是无法应对突然降临的危机的。: I've heard you're quite proactive, and I don't mind that. After all, being complacent won't help when crises strike suddenly. Ha, just be careful not to get burned.
text.你列车上的“波克士”似乎十分有个性啊，不过说到底机器人就是机器人……: BOX on your train seems quite unique, but in the end, a robot is still a robot...
text.那群流民，居然宁可生活在那种鸟不拉屎的地方也要和我作对，真不知道怎么想的。简直就: Those refugees chose to live in such a desolate place and oppose me. I really don't understand what they're thinking. It's just like that... no, it's nothing.
text.修格里与曼德矿场之间一直是互帮互助的亲密关系，我同样关心矿场的发展，只可惜分身乏: There has always been a close relationship between Shoggolith and Mander Mine, and I also care about the mine's development. Unfortunately, I'm unable to spare any more time. As luck would have it, Peter is an excellent manager. If you're willing to support Mander Mine like you support Shoggolith, I believe he'll treat you well.
text.我坚信仅凭当前规模来断言一家商会的实力是很轻率的，有的时候我更愿意给那些更有成长: I firmly believe it's rash to assess a COLUMBA's strength solely on its current scale. Sometimes, I prefer to support those with more growth potential in exchange for long-term and substantial returns. You should understand, considering your investment in Shoggolith serves a similar purpose.
text.听闻你的得力助手莉薇娅小姐非常钟爱本市的红茶，作为你慷慨解囊的回报，有机会让我手: I've heard that your capable assistant, Miss Livia, has a strong liking for the city's black tea. As a token of gratitude for your generous contributions, would you like my staff to deliver some to your train? ... You're asking how I know this? I join those bosses for afternoon tea some times, that's all.
text.那么，再向您确认一下，是要把这孩子送回来对吗？了解了，不必为难，鉴于您时常奔波的: Let me confirm once more — you're sending this little one back, correct? Understood, no need to feel awkward. Given your busy, traveling work schedule, it's perfectly understandable. Please accept this refund.
text.修格里城的天气的确更适宜生长，我会妥善照料它的，这是退返您的金额。: The weather in Shoggolith City is indeed more suitable for its growth. I'll take proper care of it, and here is your refund.
text.虽说有着让人赏心悦目的外表，但也有不少顾客反映让它们健康地生活相当困难。按照规定: Though they have a pleasing appearance, many customers have mentioned that keeping them healthy is quite difficult. Per our store regulations, we will refund you a portion of the payment. If you need it later, I'd be happy to explain some care tips to you in detail.
text.是暂时闲置的用品吗？好的，这是我店给您的回收价格。欢迎下次光临。: Are these idle supplies you're looking to sell? Very well. This is our shop's buyback price for them. Please come again next time.
text.宠物暂未入住无法喂食，请先安排宠物入住: Pets have not yet moved in and cannot be fed. Please arrange for pets to move in first.
text.首充赠送%d桦石: Get %d Chaos Stones with your first recharge
text.暂存区暂无压缩垃圾块: No compacted trash blocks in temporary storage
text.淘金乐园的景点之一，欢迎所有来到此处的人。: This is one of the ONEderland's attractions. Welcoming all who are here.
text.空间不大但功能齐全，可提供餐饮和娱乐服务，是旅客们的好去处。: Not spacious but well-equipped, provides meals and entertainment. A great spot for tourists.
text.想要体验淘金乐趣的人必经之处，机器人们在此提供工具与服务。: A must-go stop for those who want to experience the fun of gold digging. Robots provide tools and services here.
text.当前执照无法申请该线路: The current license cannot apply for this route.
text.达到对应等级可解锁丰厚奖励: Reach the corresponding level to unlock great rewards.
text.包含本期【开拓手册】<color=#FFD567>全部奖励</color>: Includes <color=#FFD567>all the rewards</color> for the Trailblaze Brochure.
text.环游手册等级立即提升<color=#FFD567>10级</color>: Immediately upgrades the Brochure by <color=#FFD567>10 levels</color>.
text.根据铁盟的最新消息，受桦树生物活动影响，行车段目前封闭维护中。列车暂时无法离站，: According to the latest news from B.C.R.L., railway is currently closed for maintenance due to the activity of Chaos Remains. Conductor, why not take a stroll around the city?
The bandits have left, causing a loss of some BCRL Coins and goods...
The Chaos Remains have left, causing damage to the vehicle and a loss of some durability...
text.爱心便当超过保质期后可自动转化为宠物口粮。: Love Bentos will automatically convert into pet food after expiration.
text.列车长，已经帮你把过期的爱心便当转化成%s。: Conductor, I've converted the expired Love Bentos into %s for you.
text.目标站点任务难度较高，是否继续前往？\\n推荐等级：%d级\\n（建议进行铁安局: High difficulty quest. Do you wish to continue?\nRecommended level: %d\n(Suggested BCRL eviction quests for leveling up)
text.距离过远，无法拾取，需要配备运输无人机: The distance is too far to pick up. You need to equip a transport drone.
text.当前关卡难度过高，是否仍要继续挑战?: The difficulty of this stage is too high. Do you still want to continue the challenge?
text.早已退役的地联旧制式的全功能移动工程平台不知为何流落至此，被改造后摇身一变成为了: A retired retro Earth Union all-purpose mobile engineering platform somehow ended up here, transformed into the Wilderness King. Ignoring the taste of the person who gave it this name, it's crucial to point out that professionals still call it the all-purpose mobile engineering platform.
text.周围并没有港湾，它为何会搁浅于此？: How can it be stranded here when there are no ports nearby?
text.这些流民选择了一个并不宜居的地点，这意味着他们如果想要获得必要的物资就需要依靠掠: These vagrants chose an uninhabitable location, meaning they relied on looting for necessities. Many appeared to be registered Mander Mine workers. Why did they abandon construction to choose destruction?
text.与周边环境格格不入的一块土地，形状过分平整且拥有不可思议的地表物质层。因其方正平: A piece of land that doesn't fit the surrounding environment. Overly flat and with an unbelievable surface material layer. Due to its square and smooth appearance, locals call it Cheese Slice. Areas with strong Resonance will form such unique landscape. There are tales of unusual sights in the ground crevices of Mander Mine.
text.在原地陷入沉眠的荒原帝王号，等待它的主人将它再度唤醒。: The Wilderness King lies rooted in deep sleep, awaiting its master to awaken it again.
text.这艘搁浅于漫漫黄沙中的船曾经迷失于时空的缝隙中，它经过了漫长的岁月，如今终于回航: This ship stranded in the endless sands was once lost in the space-time rift. After ages had passed, it finally returned.
text.您的桦石不足，是否前往商店获取更多桦石？: You don't have enough Chaos Stones. Would you like to go to the store to get more?
text.暂存区垃圾已清空: The trash in the storage area has been cleared.
text.点击频率过快，请稍后再试: Tapping too frequently, please try again later.
text.当前关卡进行中，暂无法进行挑战: Current stage in progress, you're unable to challenge at the moment.
text.列车的损伤程度很轻，暂时不需要担心消耗……不过还是小心点吧，列车长。: The train is lightly damaged, so there's no need to worry about consumption... But still, be cautious, Conductor.
text.列车严重损坏，建议呼叫拖车至附近站点修整。: The train is severely damaged. It is recommended to call a trailer to the nearest station for repairs.
text.该角色值班中，无法休息: The character is on duty and cannot rest.
text.是否消耗%d{Diamond}桦石立刻完成建造？: Do you want to spend %d Chaos Stones to instantly complete the construction?
text.已安全抵达车站，是否立即检修列车？: The train has arrived safely at the station. Shall we inspect it immediately?
text.哔！桦树生物袭击预警！前方发现不明形态污染源，正在启用列车紧急制动程序。: Beep! Unknown Morphic Field Pollution source detected ahead. Initiating emergency braking.
text.哔！碰撞预警！前方发现不明障碍，正在启用列车紧急制动程序。: Beep! Collision alert! Unknown obstacle detected ahead. Initiating emergency braking.
text.当前关卡进行中，暂无法进行取消分享操作: Current stage in progress, you cannot cancel sharing.
text.车厢存在乘客无法卸下: The carriage contains passengers and cannot be unloaded.
text.我和阿妮塔的其他实习生没有什么不同。和老师的其他学生也……没有什么不同……别继续: I'm no different from other Anita interns. No different from... mentor's other students... Don't ask further.
text.不要盯着我的装备和手提箱看。事情有时和你的想象并不一样……但随你怎么想都无所谓。: Don't stare at my equipment or suitcase. Things are sometimes not what you imagine... but think whatever you want.
text.偏振计数器的形态污染威胁指数偏高？可能是附近的特殊环境导致。也可能是……: The polarimeter's Morphic Field Pollution threat index is high? Maybe it's due to the special environment here. Or perhaps...
text.和我聊天？……好啊。要聊什么？桦树生物的特性？嗯，他们会发出不同的声音……诶？你: Chat with me? ...Sure. What do you want to talk about? Chaos Remains' traits? Hmm, they have different voices... Huh? You've never heard them?
text.我在武器设计上有些天赋……但，这箱子里的装着不是武器。它其实是……我的朋友。: I have some talent in designing weapons... but what's inside this box isn't a weapon. It's actually... my friend.
text.这里是阿妮塔能源公司设置的观测站以及作战中心。我是驻守这里的安菲娅。有什么事？: This is Anita Energy's Observatory and Battle Center. I am Anfiya, a staff stationed here. How can I help?
text.请不要紧张。我不是闯入这里的桦树生物，也没有纵容桦树生物在此作乱。一切都在可控范: Please don't be nervous. I'm not an intruding Chaos Remain, nor have I let Chaos Remains run rampant here. Everything is under control...
text.是列车长啊……又见面了。到这里来，是为了什么呢？: Oh, it's you, Conductor... we meet again. What brings you here?
text.你好……辛苦了，稍等，我正在登记数据……: Hello... you've worked hard. Wait a moment. I'm logging data...
text.途径那么多地方来到这里，你的目的……是什么呢？……这是你计划的一部分吗？: After passing through so many places to get here, what's... your purpose? ...Is this part of your plan?
text.你从哪里来的？“这个人身上有同类的味道”？好，我知道了。……不用回答我了，像平时: Where did you come from? "This person smells like one of us"? All right, I got it. ...You need not answer me anymore. Just act as usual.
text.这些都是亟待处理的任务……选吧。: These are tasks that need immediate attention... Take your pick.
text.觉得能完成的就承接下来。只是，不要错估自己的实力。: Accept the ones you think you can complete. Just... don't overestimate your abilities.
text.武器和装备有没有异常？出发前注意检查。我也可以帮你检查。: Are there any anomalies with your weapons and equipment? Check them before departure. I can help with the inspection.
text.你们有收集桦树生物数据的习惯吗？有的话……希望能够交给我一份。是为了推进研究。: Do you collect data on Chaos Remains? If so... I hope you can provide me with a copy. It's for advancing research.
text.附近的环境并不安全，因此才有这座设施以及我守在这里……因为，与其他人相比，我是最: The surrounding environment is unsafe, hence the presence of this facility and me... because, compared to the rest, I am the most suitable one.
text.有什么需要我进行额外检查的物品吗？: Do you need me to conduct additional checks on anything else?
text.订单事项……这个啊。那你直接交付就好了……和我没有太大关系。: Regarding an order...? I see. Go ahead and do the handover, then... It doesn't really concern me.
text.要交付货物，就在这里。: You can deliver the goods here.
text.居然跑了这么远……你很厉害。: Amazing... You actually came this far.
text.货物和订单内容确认无误。……感谢。: Goods and order contents confirmed... Thank you.
text.接下来的工作处理就交给我吧。这些事项由我负责。: Leave the rest to me. It's my job to handle these matters.
text.……你们很有实力。继续这样努力吧。: ...All of you are very capable. Keep up the good work.
text.列车耐久不足，车厢无法卸下: The train durability is insufficient, and the carriage cannot be unloaded.
text.列车最低保留一节乘客车厢: At least one passenger carriage must be retained on the train.
text.列车长，本次拖车费用为%d铁盟币: Conductor, the towing service for this time costs %d BCRL Coins.
text.重要的商业场所，大大小小的商人都是此处的常客。: An important commercial venue frequented by merchants of all sizes.
text.有些冷清的博物馆，但是从事相关研究的学者和学生常来光顾。: A rather quiet museum where scholars and students engaged in related researches often visit.
text.比起室外十分整洁，能力优秀的人才在此接待那些合作对象。: Very clean compared to the exterior. Highly capable individuals come here to host their collaborative partners.
text.矿场分配的住所，大多数矿工都住在这里。: Residences allocated by the mining site. Most miners live here.
text.一尘不染且安保完善，是财力雄厚的人放置一些额外收入的首选地。: Spotless and secure. It is the top choice for wealthy individuals to store their extra earnings.
text.方便购买书刊杂志的小店，不少旅客会顺路购买一本作为消遣。: A convenience store for buying books and magazines, where many travelers stop by to buy a book and pass the time.
text.颇负盛名的男子高中，学生们在这里度过充实的校园生活。: A prestigious boys' high school, where students spend a fulfilling school life.
text.可以轻松俯瞰城市景观，总是聚集了各种各样的旅客。: You can easily overlook the cityscape here. Never fails to attract various travelers.
text.当地有名的电子产品一条街，挤满了相关从业者和爱好者。: A street famous locally for electronic products. Filled with industry workers and enthusiasts.
text.当地的大型博物馆，是诸多游客和铁路爱好者的首选景点。: The large local museum is a prime destination for many tourists and railroad enthusiasts.
text.研究着当下最重要的能源材料，是大型商会和政府的重要合作对象。: Researching the most important energy materials, they are key partners for CoC and government.
text.车站常见的连锁便利店，各种各样的乘客会在这里消费。: A convenience store chain commonly found in train stations, frequented by all kinds of passengers.
text.修格里高中附近有名的小吃一条街，美食爱好者和学生们喜欢光顾。: A famous food street near Shoggolith High School, popular among food lovers and students.
text.作为修格里最大的电影院，不仅是影迷的乐土，也是情侣的圣地。: As the largest cinema in Shoggolith, it's not only a paradise for movie fans but also a haven for couples.
text.涵盖植物、宠物、水族相关商品的综合商店，爱宠人士的首选。: A comprehensive store providing plants, pets, and aquatic-related products. The preferred choice for pet lovers.
text.繁华的商业街，不少行色匆匆的商人往来于此。: A bustling commercial street, with many busy businessmen coming and going.
text.黑月旗下的奢华酒店，众多政界商界的贵客喜欢下榻此处。: A luxurious hotel owned by Night Chains, favored by numerous political and business guests.
text.如你所见，已经一点库存都没有了。: As you can see, there's no stock left.
text.列车目前无法继续行驶，请先修复损坏部位。: The train cannot continue to operate at the moment. Please repair the damaged parts first.
text.当前案件已完成，无法进入挑战: The current case is completed and cannot be challenged.
text.请选择一张技能牌加入手牌: Please select a skill card to add to your hand.
text.初始车厢不可卸下: The initial carriage cannot be unloaded.
text.案件已过期，无法进行挑战: The case has expired and cannot be challenged.
text.当前案件已取消分享，无法进入挑战: The current case sharing has been canceled, and cannot be challenged.
text.无垠号车组标准64座客车车厢，可提供更高的载客能力。: The Eternal's standard 64-seat car, provides greater passenger capacity.
text.科伦巴制式轻型货厢，可提供一定的载货能力。: COLUMBA standard, provides moderate cargo capacity.
text.科伦巴制式中型货厢，可提供更大的载货能力。: COLUMBA standard, satisfies daily freight transport needs.
text.科伦巴制式重型货厢，可提供最大的载货能力。: COLUMBA standard, provides increased cargo capacity.
text.铁盟拖挂式武器平台车厢，可提供武装搭载能力。: BCRL towed weapon platform carriage provides armed loading capability.
text.无垠号车组标准护卫队车厢，可提供更大的生活空间。: The Eternal's standard guard crew car, provides larger living space.
text.是否使用<color=#FEC032>银枝</color>让亚莉奈再制作一杯银枝: Do you want to use the <color=#FEC032>Silver Branch</color> to let Arina make another cup of Silver Bubble Soda?
text.报案成功，请列车长前往%s查看: Report successful. Please go to %s to check.
text.有其他更优先事项的话，请去吧。: If there are other more pressing matters, please attend to them.
text.还不错呢，你费心了！: Not bad, you've put in the effort!
text.超级无敌美味！下次还想吃！: Super good! Would love to have it again!
text.放置失败！超出当前车厢床位数量上限！: Placement failed! Exceeds the current carriage bed capacity limit!
text.获得重复头像，已转化为海豹券: The duplicate avatar has been converted to Seal Voucher.
text.每一桩订单都很重要。这是其他人，同事，说的……我？我的意见吗……？……我没什么想: Every single order is important. That's what others, colleagues, said... Me? My opinion...? ...I have none.
text.如果你也有特别的“研究伙伴”就好了……那样的话，工作会轻松一些。: If only you had a special "research partner"... That would make the work a lot easier.
text.“在其他的道路上一路顺风”……唔……我也是这么希望的哦。: "Safe travels on other paths"... Hmm... I wish the same for you too.
text.“订单项目与客户需求不匹配”……好的，我记下了。之后会向商业部门反馈的……: "Order items do not match customer needs"... Alright, I've noted it down. I'll report it to the commerce department later...
text.请不要试图在终端屏幕上模拟将纸质订单扯下来的动作……列车长。: Please do not simulate tearing off paper orders on the terminal screen... Conductor.
text.外壳有明显受损。下一步……有计划吧？: The outer hull is visibly damaged. Regarding the next step... you have a plan in mind, right?
text.……再这样下去，就要更换好几个部件了。接下来的战斗，加油。: ...If this continues, several parts will need replacing. Good luck with the upcoming battles.
text.列车的损耗状况很严重。只是还能开的程度……: The wear and tear to the trains is rather serious. But it's at least still operational...
text.列车长，无垠号的状态不容乐观，继续行驶风险极大，我建议立刻前往安全区域进行维修。: Conductor, The Eternal's condition isn't looking good. It's very risky to continue further. I recommend heading to a safe area for repairs immediately.
text.你好，很高兴，又能见面，无垠号的列车长。: Hello, nice to see you again, Conductor of The Eternal.
text.感谢你，一直以来，为淘金乐园重建，所做的工作。: Thank you, for your continuous efforts, toward the reconstruction of the ONEderland.
text.列车长，又见面了。来帮忙了，吗？: We meet again, Conductor. Here to help, are you?
text.金子，欢迎无垠号列车长的到来。希望你，继续，协助淘金乐园的，建设。: Welcome, Conductor of The Eternal. I hope you will, continue to assist, in the construction of the ONEderland.
text.（超大声）摇滚！！（正常音量）这是，黄彼得，教给我的。你不吃这套？好的。: (Yelling) Rock 'n' Roll!! (Normal voice) This is what, Peter Hwang, taught me. You don't buy it? Fine.
text.你是真正的，列车长，为淘金乐园的重建，作出了重大贡献。我将你在本机系统中的评级，: You truly are, Conductor, making significant contributions, to the reconstruction of the ONEderland. I've upgraded your system rating, to the highest level.
text.请看，这是最新登记的作战任务。: Please have a look. This is the latest registered combat mission.
text.守护淘金乐园，是，所有掘金机器人的使命。想要与我们，一同分担，这种使命吗？好的，: Guarding the ONEderland, is the mission of all Nugget Mechs. Would you like, to share this mission, with us? Alright, Conductor.
text.请直接选择，最适合自己的任务。剩下的部分，可以十分放心地，交给我。: Please choose, the task that suits you best. As for the rest, you can leave them to me.
text.我虽然，能够解决，不过也不是，所有的都能解决。很多时候，不得不拜托人类。: Although I, can solve some things, not everything can be resolved. Many times, I have to rely on humans.
text.破坏者，无法原谅。破坏淘金乐园的行为，无法原谅！: Destroyers, are unforgivable. The act of destroying the ONEderland is unforgivable!
text.带来了，什么，新奇的货物？淘金乐园，需要新鲜的货物。: What, new and interesting goods, did you bring? The ONEderland, needs fresh supplies.
text.正在检查车厢的损坏程度。请自由活动。: Checking the carriage's damage. Enjoy some free time now.
text.正在检查货物标签以及内容物……确认无危险。: Checking the cargo labels and contents... Safety confirmed.
text.检查目标矿工的损坏程度……这是一个，玩笑。因为，我是掘金机器人，不能检查，人类。: Checking the damage to the target miner... This, is a joke. Because, I am a Nugget Mech. I can't check humans. Some say, having a sense of humor, is important.
text.感谢您对，淘金乐园，建设，作出的贡献。: Thank you, for your contribution, to the construction of the ONEderland.
text.感谢……是的，这是初始程序中，设定的内容。需要一些，新台词的话，就要动用更多运算: Thank you... Yes, this is part of, the initial programming. If you need, new lines, use more computational resources. That's quite tiring.
text.这些货物能够使淘金乐园恢复生机！使我们的家焕发活力！……这样的感觉，怎么样。不太: These goods can revitalize the ONEderland! Bring vitality back to our home! ... How does, that sound? Not quite right? Very well, I will, process it again.
text.订单成功交付。有没有觉得，很开心，列车长？金子，希望你开心。: The order has been delivered. Do you feel, delighted, Conductor? I hope you're happy.
text.有没有觉得，淘金乐园，逐渐变得漂亮了？希望你的答案是，有。: Don't you think, the ONEderland is, gradually becoming more beautiful? I hope your answer is, yes.
text.其他的掘金机器人，是我的，属下。手下。“小弟”？不，金子和他们，不是兄弟姐妹。机: The other Nugget Mechs, are my subordinates. 'Little brothers'? No, they and Gold, are not siblings. Robots, don't have siblings.
text.金子，很喜欢，极光。没有现实稳定装置，没有人，没有极光，的时候，不好……: I, like the aurora, very much. The time, without reality stabilizer, without people, without aurora, isn't good...
text.黄彼得说，我在程序运行错误，的时候，说话很吓人。但是，金子，一点也不记得。很吓人: Peter Hwang said, when my programming runs into errors, I speak in a frightening manner. But, I don't remember at all. Is it, really scary?
text.过去，曾经有一个，超级巨星，在淘金乐园的酒吧，唱歌。金子，记录损坏，无法查询，是: In the past, there was, a superstar, who sang in the bar at the ONEderland. My memory is damaged, unable to retrieve, who it was. Only remember, the song title &*%! Until the ￥#% End.
text.金子，也觉得这个订单，不太好。: I also feel that this order, isn't really good.
text.一不小心，把好生意吹了，这样的例子，二十年前，就经常有。不过，列车长，应该不会。: Accidentally, blew off, good business. Such cases, happened frequently, twenty years ago. However, Conductor, you probably won't.
text.注意甄别，订单的内容。当心，被骗走。: Be careful, in examining, the order details. Be wary, of being deceived.
text.嗖。嗖嗖。这是模拟，订单飞出去的声音。: Shoo. Shoo shoo. This is the simulated sound, of an order flying away.
text.正在挑选，更加符合您要求的，订单……: Selecting orders, that better suit, your requirements...
text.叮叮！已经加入，待办事项。: Ding ding! Added it, to the to-do list.
text.请将此订单，登记在您的数据库……于人类来说，数据库究竟是什么？: Please register this order, in your database... For humans, what is a database?
text.需要搭把手扶你进来吗？开个玩笑，这里是虚拟的空间，若有心，就能不存在门槛和阶梯。: Do you need a hand to come in? Just kidding. This is a virtual space. As long as you're determined enough, any kind of obstacle can cease to exist.
text.啊，我们的交易关系在这里依然得以延续，不觉得高兴吗？: Ah, our transactional relationship will still be valid here. Aren't you happy about it?
text.请原谅，我擅自分析了你的喜好数据，因为我希望准备的物品能合你心意。: Pardon me. I studied the data of your preferences in private, as I was hoping to prepare some items that you'd fancy.
text.叮叮！已经从，待办事项中，删除此项目。: Ding ding! This item, has been deleted, from the to-do list.
text.为什么，要取消标记这项？是因为，它不够摇滚吗？: Why, remove this tag? Is it because, it's not rock 'n' roll enough?
text.合同并没有，规定，不能延后完成此项订单。请放心，列车长。: The contract doesn't, specify, that this order cannot be delayed. Don't worry, Conductor.
text.请继续支持淘金乐园的工作。金子金子。哦，这是，新客户建议的，“口头禅”。据说，可: Please continue to support the work of the ONEderland. Gold, Gold. Oh, this is a catchphrase suggested by a new client. It's supposed to, make robots, seem cute.
text.喜欢积极参与社交，对新鲜和可爱的事物充满兴趣。: Enjoys active social participation, full of interest in new and cute things.
text.总是关注流行，最中意可爱又漂亮的东西。: Always keeps up with trends. Prefers cute and pretty things.
text.乖巧又认真，享受青春的同时不忘重视学习。: Obedient and serious, enjoys youth while valuing studies.
text.兢兢业业的白领，工作之余不忘享受生活。: Diligent white-collar workers, who don't forget to enjoy life outside of work.
text.为人低调的白领，工作之余不忘享受生活。: Low-key white-collar workers, who don't forget to enjoy life outside of work.
text.喜欢独处的白领，工作之余不忘享受生活。: Loner white-collar workers, who don't forget to enjoy life outside of work.
text.热衷社交的白领，工作之余不忘享受生活。: Social-butterfly white-collar workers, who don't forget to enjoy life outside of work.
text.负责运输工作的机械工人，对工作以外的事情不是很关心。: Mechanical workers responsible for transportation, not very concerned with matters outside of work.
text.负责加工工作的机械工人，对工作以外的事情不是很关心。: Mechanical workers responsible for processing, not very concerned with matters outside of work.
text.负责探测工作的机械工人，对工作以外的事情不是很关心。: Mechanical workers responsible for inspection, not very concerned with matters outside of work.
text.负责统筹工作的机械工人，对工作以外的事情不是很关心。: Mechanical workers responsible for coordination, not very concerned with matters outside of work.
text.想象力丰富，在自己喜欢的东西上很舍得付出时间和金钱。: Rich in imagination, willing to spend time and money on interests.
text.总是不停喜欢上新的虚拟角色，兴趣转移的速度非常快。: Always liking new virtual characters. Interests change quickly.
text.认定自己唯一的“本命”后就再也不会改变心意。: Once they identify their 'one true love', they never change their mind.
text.总是活力满满的为喜爱的偶像送上自己的支持。: Always full of vigor, supporting their favorite idols.
text.沉浸在拼装和收藏模型的乐趣之中，动手能力很强。: Immersed in the joy of assembling and collecting models, very good at hands-on work.
text.身体健康的老先生，年龄没有成为他出行的阻碍。: An elderly gentleman in good health. Age is no obstacle to his travels.
text.文质彬彬的老先生，年龄没有成为他出行的阻碍。: A well-mannered elderly gentleman. Age is no obstacle to his travels.
text.性格和善的老先生，年龄没有成为他出行的阻碍。: A kind elderly gentleman. Age is no obstacle to his travels.
text.英气的年轻女性，对旅行充满了期待。: A spirited young woman, full of anticipation for travel.
text.悠闲的年轻女性，对旅行充满了期待。: A leisurely young woman, full of anticipation for travel.
text.理性的年轻女性，对旅行充满了期待。: A rational young woman, full of anticipation for travel.
text.活泼的年轻女性，对旅行充满了期待。: A lively young woman, full of anticipation for travel.
text.对自己的工作充满热忱，喜欢乘坐洗得干净的列车。: Passionate about their work, enjoys riding in clean trains.
text.资产累积到这个程度的话，对很多事情就不那么在意了。: With assets accumulated to this extent, many things don't matter as much.
text.总是很镇定的女性，对待工作的态度无可挑剔。: A calm woman, impeccable in her attitude toward work.
text.看起来洒脱的女性，对待工作的态度无可挑剔。: A seemingly carefree woman, impeccable in her attitude toward work.
text.反应机敏的女性，对待工作的态度无可挑剔。: A quick-witted woman, impeccable in her attitude toward work.
text.因为还在培训期，所以把一切当作对自己的磨练。: Still in training, hence treats everything as a way to hone oneself.
text.运输作业用小型辅助机BOI3号，可不是只会淘金而已。: Small auxiliary machine BOI3 for transportation operations, not just for gold digging.
text.Keep炸鸡店的老板，对炸鸡有着认真的态度和纯粹的热爱。: The owner of KEEP Fried Chicken, with a serious attitude and pure love for fried chicken.
text.Keep炸鸡店的店员，甜美的笑容下是对炸鸡不能让步的原则。: An employee of KEEP Fried Chicken, with a sweet smile and unwavering principles on fried chicken.
text.垃圾处理机器人莱斯特，最喜欢橙红奶酪。: Trash disposal robot Lester, loves orange-red cheese the most.
text.垃圾处理机器人布雷斯，最喜欢蓝纹奶酪。: Trash disposal robot Breese, loves blue cheese the most.
text.鼹鼠帮的老大，人称“狂飙焚尽”，本名就叫鼹鼠。: MoleGang leader, nicknamed 'Inferno Maelstrom'. Their real name is Mole.
text.Keep炸鸡店的店员，坚信酥脆的外皮才是炸鸡的灵魂所在。: An employee of KEEP Fried Chicken, believes that the crispy skin is the soul of fried chicken.
text.Keep炸鸡店的店员，认为柔嫩多汁的炸鸡才是好炸鸡。: An employee of KEEP Fried Chicken, thinks that juicy fried chicken is the best fried chicken.
text.英俊的男子，十分注重自己的穿着是否跟得上潮流。: A handsome man, very conscious of whether his attire is up-to-date with trends.
text.热情的男子，十分注重自己的穿着是否跟得上潮流。: An enthusiastic man, very conscious of whether his attire is up-to-date with trends.
text.黑月的执行人，背负着秘密的任务。: Executor of Night Chains, carrying out a secret mission.
text.曼德矿场的管理人，处事圆滑，让人捉摸不透。: Manager of Mander Mine, slick and hard to figure out.
text.刚刚加入工作，对未来充满热情与期待的工人。: A new worker, full of enthusiasm and expectations for the future.
text.工作经验丰富，对未来没什么想法的工人。: An experienced worker, with no particular thoughts about the future.
text.领取失败，冰箱容量不足: Operation failed. Insufficient space in your refrigerator.
text.有些严格的教师，非常重视自己的学生们。: A somewhat strict teacher, very dedicated to the students.
text.亲切温柔的教师，非常重视自己的学生们。: A kind and gentle teacher, very dedicated to the students.
text.频繁表达自己对现状的不满，积极参与抗议活动。: Frequently expresses dissatisfaction with the status quo, and actively participates in protests.
text.宣扬降临会思想的人，完全不在意世人的目光。: A preacher of the Advent doctrine, completely indifferent to the views of the world.
text.海豹奶茶店的店员，不管客人要几分甜都会做五分甜。: An employee of Seal's Tea Shop, always makes the tea with half the sweetness regardless of customer requests.
text.“毛绒会”成员，兔型毛绒玩偶，希望大家都能明白毛绒的美妙。: Part of the Plush Club, a bunny plush toy, hoping everyone can understand the beauty of plush.
text.“毛绒会”成员，熊型毛绒玩偶，希望大家都能明白毛绒的美妙。: Part of the Plush Club, a bear plush toy, hoping everyone can understand the beauty of plush.
text.“毛绒会”成员，象型毛绒玩偶，希望大家都能明白毛绒的美妙。: Part of the Plush Club, an elephant plush toy, hoping everyone can understand the beauty of plush.
text.“毛绒会”成员，鸟型毛绒玩偶，希望大家都能明白毛绒的美妙。: Part of the Plush Club, a bird plush toy, hoping everyone can understand the beauty of plush.
text.“毛绒会”成员，浣熊型毛绒玩偶，希望大家都能明白毛绒的美妙。: Part of the Plush Club, a raccoon plush toy, hoping everyone can understand the beauty of plush.
text.野外移动拉面摊的师傅，热衷研发各种拉面。: Chef of the outdoor mobile ramen stall, enthusiastic about developing various ramen.
text.富有叛逆精神的电视人，喜欢热闹的气氛。: A rebellious TV person, loves lively atmospheres.
text.海豹奶茶店的店员，认为果茶不能算奶茶。: An employee of Seal's Tea Shop, thinks fruit tea is not milk tea.
text.行程满满的游客，认为旅游胜在去的地方够多。: A tourist with a packed schedule, believes that the more places visited, the better the travel.
text.请选择要保留的卡牌: Please select the cards to keep.
text.前方发现不明障碍！全员一级戒备。: Unknown obstacles detected ahead! All personnel on alert level one.
text.哔！碰撞预警！前方发现不明障碍！根据本机计算，使用撞角将会损毁，列车即将启用紧急: Beep! Collision warning! Unknown obstacles detected ahead! According to my calculation, ram will cause damage. The train is about to initiate emergency braking procedures.
text.根据本机精密计算，本次完美撞击成功率为 %d%%: Based on precise calculations, the success rate of this perfect ram is %d%%.
text.本次撞击损失列车耐久%d，剩余列车耐久%d: This ram resulted in a loss of %d train durability, leaving the remaining train durability at %d.
text.是否立即返航，回到 <color=#b45e01>%s</color> ？: Would you like to return immediately to <color=#b45e01>%s</color>?
text.该武装已装备，是否需要卸下？: The weapon is already equipped. Would you like to unequip it?
text.检测到账号在其他设备登录，请重启游戏。: Detected account login on another device. Please restart the game.
text.当前案件挑战已超时，暂无法继续进行: The current case challenge has exceeded the time limit and cannot proceed further.
text.消耗<color=#FFB800>%d</color>桦石，消除<color=#: Consumes <color=#FFB800>%d</color> Chaos Stones to reduce <color=#FFB800>%d</color> Fatigue. You can still reduce <color=#FFB800>%d</color> times today.
text.请选择一种方式消除疲劳: Please select a method to relieve fatigue.
text.为游客提供食宿的地点，物美价廉是此处最大的优势。: Provides lodging and meals for tourists, offering good value for money as its biggest advantage.
text.抵达下一个城市之后在整备吧: Let's recuperate in the next city.
text.完美撞击！本次撞击未损失列车耐久！: A perfect ram! No durability loss for the train this time!
text.列车长，我们先看看别的地方，之后再来铁安局吧！: Conductor, let's explore other places first before heading to BCRL Agency!
text.如果你每天都像这样来完成一些任务的话，七号自由港附近的行车路段也会太平不少吧。: If you complete quests like this every day, the traffic around Freeport Ⅶ will be much smoother.
text.我想你也注意到了，修格里城附近出现的敌人不外乎这几种，只要像这样坚持对他们予以打: You may have noticed that the enemies near Shoggolith City are limited in variety. By consistently striking against them, they will become more docile.
text.针对某些敌人展开行动的话，可以有效地让他们收敛些，这样曼德矿场往来的列车也能更安: Taking action against specific enemies can effectively make them more subdued, ensuring safer passage for the trains traveling to Mander Mine.
text.需要先停车，才可以主动出击！: You need to stop first before initiating an attack!
text.你好，年轻人，能走进来说明你眼光不错，毕竟我这里卖的东西在别处可买不到。: Hello, young one. The fact that you walked in here means you have good taste. After all, what I sell can't be found elsewhere.
text.是新面孔啊，多瞧瞧多看看，我这里可都是些高科技玩意，准能让你长见识。: A new face, huh? Have a look around. What I have here are high-tech gadgets, sure to broaden your horizons.
text.跑得够勤的，我见过的列车长可多了，看你的样子倒像是真能干出什么名堂的。: Admirable diligence you have there. I've met plenty of conductors, but you seem to really be capable of making a name for yourself.
text.这么说，最近小有名气的就是你吧？很有我年轻时候的劲头嘛。多光顾这里的话，我不介意: So, you're the one who's been rather famous lately, right? You have the energy I had when I was young. Come here often. I don't mind sharing some business experience with you.
text.是你啊，有阵子不见了，其他地方有什么新鲜东西吗？说来听听？作为回报，我可以给你些: Ah, it's you. Haven't seen you for a while. Any news from elsewhere? Tell me about it. In return, I can give you some special discounts.
text.诶呦，贵客登门啦。不着急，先坐下来尝尝这个巧克力奶吧，独家配方，别人想要也没有！: Ah, an honored guest is here. Take your time, sit down and try this chocolate milk first. It's a unique recipe, not available anywhere else!
text.听说<color=#b45e01>{station}</color>一家稳定供货: Word has it that a stable supplier at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> is closing down their business, so <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have become a top seller there lately.
text.别没头没脑地跑了，你要是还有<color=#b45e01>{goods}</co: Don't run around aimlessly. If you still have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>, go sell them at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>. My insider news is never wrong!
text.那个词怎么说的？欲购从速！我这暂时只有这些，断货了可想买也买不到了。: What's the phrase? Act quickly if you want to buy! I only have these for now, and once they're gone, you won't be able to get them even if you want to.
text.今天<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>有限时折扣！我也: Today's <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are on a time-limited discount! I occasionally do promotions to attract customers.
text.想要就快拿走吧，你来得再晚会儿可就一点也见不到了。: If you want it, grab it now. If you come any later, you won't find a single one.
text.嗯，我欣赏你的豪爽，要知道，做生意时豪爽的人总是格外受欢迎的。: Hmm, I appreciate your directness. Straightforward people are always especially welcomed in business, you know.
text.至少你没有浪费太多我科研的时间，而且我也得说，买东西谨慎点不是什么缺点。: At least you didn't waste too much of my research time, and I have to say, being cautious when buying things is not a flaw.
text.嗯，中规中矩，我这里倒是也收的。: Hmm, pretty standard. I do accept it here.
text.得啦，我这儿的库存可都被你掏空了。看在你出手还算大方的份上，下次有好东西我倒是可: Well, you've cleared my inventory. Considering your generosity, I'll save some good stuff for you next time.
text.挺机灵的嘛，不瞒你说，我还真有些存货，给你拿出来就是了。: You're quite sharp. To be honest, I still have some stock. I'll bring it out for you.
text.不错，和我相处久了，你也变得精明了，这就是近朱者赤！: Not bad, you've become smarter after spending time with me. You're the sum of people you spend the most time with!
text.嚯，这东西现在可没那么值钱。: Whoa, this thing isn't worth that much now.
text.与其再到别的地方乱跑，不如卖给我？我给你这个数。: Instead of running around to other places, why not sell it to me? I'll give you this amount.
text.你要是现在有<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>，我这可: If you have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> right now, I can buy it all.
text.如果这是你的最终决定，那好吧。: If this is your final decision, then so be it.
text.看来咱们的合作关系值得长期发展？: Our cooperation looks worthy of long-term development, doesn't it?
text.给你拿走吧，不过下次有什么新鲜商品也得先拿给我瞧瞧。: Take it, but bring me any new and exciting goods first in the future.
text.你到哪里也找不到比这更好的价格了。: You won't find a better price anywhere else.
text.现在的年轻人真是难缠，最开始的价格咱也没让你吃亏，不过，就按你说的算吧。: Young people are rather stubborn nowadays. The price I gave is very reasonable, but, let's go with what you asked for.
text.我已经是看在咱们的交情的份上给的价格了。: The price quoted has already been adjusted to account for our friendship.
text.30分钟内，队员参与战斗可获得默契度加成。: Within 30 minutes, crew members participating in combat will receive a bonus to Rapport.
text.30分钟内，列车长获得“激情驾驶，Passion”的加成。: Within 30 minutes, you will receive a "Rev up the passion!" bonus.
text.是否确认使用该道具获得1条新的替换词缀？: Are you sure you want to use this item to obtain a new affix?
text.是否确认替换该词缀？: Are you sure you want to replace this affix?
text.你带来了材料？新的任务？新的研究机会？……还是只有你自己？: Did you bring materials? New mission? New research opportunity? ...Or just yourself?
text.搞不懂为什么是我负责和你交涉……难道他们认为我们关系很亲近吗？: I don't understand why I'm the one negotiating with you... Do they think we're close?
text.目前来看，你和能源研究所缔结了良好的合作关系。你还能再进一步，我知道。: From what I can see, you've established a good working relationship with Anita Energy Institute. But you can still go further. I'm sure of it.
text.我已经收到了你的货物清单和报告，看起来还不错……好了，开始工作吧。: I've received your inventory list and report. It looks good... Alright, let's get to work.
text.单论来这里的访客的话，你算是最让我顺心的一个了。: Among all the visitors who've been here, you're the most pleasing one I've met.
text.只带来了你自己也没关系。坐吧，今天的晚饭我会让他们安排点土豆泥。: It's fine if you just brought yourself today. Have a seat. I'll have them prepare some mashed potatoes for dinner tonight.
text.希望你完成这些任务，然后把战斗数据带回来给我。这将会大大推进实验进程。: I hope you can complete these tasks and bring back combat data for me. It'll help immensely with the progress of the experiment.
text.搬运桦树生物的遗体……虽然困难，但也并非不可能，对吗？: Transporting Chaos Remain carcasses... though difficult, it isn't impossible, right?
text.停止活动的桦树生物能够成为宝贵的研究材料。我不倾向于用“死”这种形容，既不具科学: Inactive Chaos Remains can become valuable research materials. I prefer not to describe them as "dead" as it's neither scientific nor accurate.
text.要把我的武器借给你吗？可以调整成杀伤模式。: Want me to lend you my weapon? It can be adjusted to lethal mode.
text.这项作战任务不是我提交的，不过目的显而易见。全部歼灭就行了。: I didn't submit this combat mission, but the objective is clear. Just eliminate everything.
text.哦……有带来什么有价值的货物吗，或者指定要给我的货物？: Oh... Did you bring anything valuable, or goods meant for me?
text.篝火城里发生了什么有趣的事呢……啊，新款毛绒玩具发售？: Is there anything interesting in Bonfire Cities? Oh, we have some new plushies?
text.什么时候能让无垠号专门运送我的实验物资呢……虽然现在的运力也能满足需要，但我还有: When can I have the Eternal as the exclusive transport for my experimental supplies... Although the current capacity meets the needs, I have higher requirements.
text.这次的随车补给里有土豆罐头啊。我可以拿阿妮塔配发的高级口粮包和你们换，二换一。: There are canned potatoes in the supplies this time. I can exchange Anita's high-quality rations for them, two for one.
text.应该能成为研究的助力……: This should be helpful for research...
text.我看看——没有给我的货物？看来下次必须亲自去城里买……算了，还是叫人代劳吧。: Let's see — no goods for me? Looks like I'll have to head to town myself next time... Never mind. Better to let someone else do it.
text.谢谢。……怎么了，你认为我不该向你道谢吗？: Thank you... What's wrong? You think I shouldn't thank you?
text.我忙着写实验结论呢。东西放卸货区域就好……你，过来。: I'm busy writing the conclusion for an experiment. Just leave the items in the unloading area... You, come here.
text.看，新买的毛绒玩具，很可爱吧。看一眼就可以了，不是要给你摸的意思，我还要抱呢。: Look, newly bought plushie, very cute, right? Just have a look, but don't touch it. I want to keep hugging it.
text.争吵声？是外面的动静，无所谓了。你在这里陪着我就不会被波及。: Sound of arguments? It's just noise from outside. Don't mind it. As long as you're here with me, you won't be affected.
text.我和阿妮塔其他人的关系啊……可以说是没有关系。嗯？就是没有关系，怎么一副复杂的表: My relationship with the others from Anita... We have no relationship. Huh? I mean it. Why the weird expression?
text.做数独没有技巧。无非是把最底层逻辑锻炼为下意识反应，随后依靠自己的脑子进行推演，: There's no skill in playing Sudoku. It's just training the lowest-level logic to become a subconscious response, then deducing with your own brain. It's a piece of cake for me.
text.我的武器输出功率是可控的。虽说更高的破坏力或许会带来更高效率，但有时破坏过度只会: My weapon's power output is controllable. While greater destructive power might be more efficient, sometimes excessive power would only destroy the target...
text.需要我帮你挑一个新的吗？我会像买毛绒玩具时那样热心的。: Need me to help you pick a new one? I'll be as enthusiastic as when buying plushies.
text.下一个……怎么感觉战斗的时候我也说过这话。: Next... Didn't I say the exact same thing during battle?
text.我会把配得上你的机会提供给你，可别错失了啊。: I'll provide you with opportunities that suit you. Don't miss out.
text.正确的判断。你该先做好事前准备。: Correct judgment. You should be well prepared beforehand.
text.准备出发了？那我回实验室继续研究了，下次见。: Ready to set off? I'll go back to the lab to continue the research. See you next time.
text.看来你并不需要我来指手画脚。去吧。: Looks like you don't need my meddling. Off you go.
text.你居然能记住这些订单的发布者和收货人？真不可思议，我一个都没印象。……哦，你说这: You actually remember the senders and recipients of these orders? Impressive. I don't remember any of them... Oh, that's supposed to be someone I know?
text.有需要的话，我也会登上无垠号与你……哦，这次还是算了。手头这个项目比较紧急。: If need be, I'll board the Eternal with you... Oh, not this time. This project is quite urgent.
text.你对日程安排还挺有心得的。: You're pretty good at arranging the schedule.
text.虽然不知道列车长的工作都是什么……但好吧，听你的。: Though I'm not sure what a conductor's job entails... But, very well, I'll go along with you.
text.很好，既然不急着做你的工作的话，就来协助我的工作。: Great, since you're not in a hurry to finish your work, come assist me instead.
text.嗯？决定先帮我跑一趟了？: Hmm? Decided to help me make the trip?
text.哎呀，我突然有个新想法……你会协助我的实践吧。: Oh yeah, I have a sudden idea... You'll assist me executing it, right?
text.比起这样交易，我更希望能亲手将物品交到你手上。: I'd much rather hand the item to you personally than have such a transaction.
text.不错的选择，你所做的决断依然让人着迷。: Decent choice. Your judgment is as fascinating as always.
text.感谢你为了我的委托如此努力，这是你应得的奖励。: Thank you for going out of your way for my commission. This is the reward you deserve.
text.{playername}，非常遗憾，您持有的铁盟币不足，无法达成本次投资数额要求: {playername}, unfortunately, you don't have enough BCRL Coins to meet the investment requirement!
text.年轻人热心是好事，不过我可不希望失去你这个重要的投资人，先把自身的财务状况整理好: It's great that young people are enthusiastic, but I hope I won't lose an important investor like you. Get your finances in order first, and I'll welcome you anytime.
text.看来这次你的投资不太顺利？没关系，等下次再来也无妨。比起金钱，更难能可贵的是你对: Looks like your investment didn't go smoothly this time? It's okay. Come back next time. Your feelings for Shoggolith are more valuable than money.
text.钱不够？没关系，亚莉奈愿意请列车长喝，别说一杯，无数杯都可以哦。只不过，作为回报: Not enough money? No problem, Conductor. I will buy you drinks, not just one. Any amount is fine! But in return, quit your job and stay with me. How about that?
text.运送更多游客来淘金乐园游玩，赚取收益吧！: Transport more tourists to ONEderland for profit!
text.本月票价为最低值: This month's fare is at its lowest.
text.本月票价稍微有点起色: This month's fare is showing some improvement.
text.票价达到中等水平了，加油！: Fare has reached a moderate level, keep it up!
text.完美，本月票价值已经达到最高值！: Perfect, this month's fare has reached its maximum value!
text.具备最新的设备和最全面的游戏，街机爱好者梦寐以求的地方。: Latest tech and most comprehensive selection. Arcade enthusiast's dream come true.
text.已存在替换词缀，无法使用词缀道具。: An affix for replacement already exists, cannot use affix items.
text.若是下次有机会再以这样的方式接触，我会多准备一些的。: If we ever get to meet this way again, I'll make sure to prepare more.
text.赚取利润提升贸易等级，可以增加讲价幅度，提高贸易效益。: Earn profits to boost your trade level, which increases Bargain range and trade efficiency.
text.提高当地的城市声望，可以增加交易所的讲价次数，成功率和单次买入交易品的数量，提高: Raising local Reputation can increase the number of Bargain attempts, success rates, and the quantity of goods purchased in a single transaction, improving trade efficiency.
text.一些护卫乘员的生活技能，可以增加交易所的讲价次数，成功率和单次买入交易品的数量，: Certain crew members' profession skills can increase the number of Bargain attempts, success rates, and the quantity of goods purchased in a single transaction, improving trade efficiency.
text.这里是隶属于阿妮塔的列车武器制造工厂，我是负责人苔妮。这里提供的技术支持都是合乎: This is the Train Weapon Factory under Anita. I'm Tennie, the person in charge. All technical support provided here complies with BCRL regulations... at least the public ones do!
text.唉，铁盟那些死脑筋的家伙，总是这个不许，那个不许的！那种安全的东西有什么好玩的！: Ugh, those stiff-necked BCRL guys are always banning this and banning that! What's so fun about "safe" stuff anyway?!
text.你来得正好，帮我看看这几行字说的是什么玩意啊？……你说这是初中的历史知识？那我怎: You came at the right time. Can you help me figure out what these lines even mean? ...Wait, you're telling me this is junior high history? How am I supposed to know that? I never even paid attention in history class!
text.战斗什么的麻烦的要死，只要你的火力够强不就行了！考虑那么多做什么！: Fighting is such a pain. All that matters is your firepower. Why overthink it?!
text.你想看看玛格丽特的照片吗？你说什么？她可不是我的宠物，是我最重要的朋友！喏，就是: Do you want to see Margaret's photo? What? She's not my pet—she's my most important friend! Look, she that teddy bear in the photo. Cute, right?
text.看到那些做事慢吞吞的人我就急得不行，恨不得帮他们把事情做了！: I get so annoyed watching people do things so slowly, I feel like just doing it for them myself!
text.需要【商用列车组武装改造特许】: Requires Commercial Train Weapon Upgrade License.
text.是否确认需要删除该替换词缀？: Are you sure you want to delete this affix?
text.著名的银制品店铺，许多游客和商人都会光顾这里。: A well-known silverware shop frequented by many tourists and merchants.
text.位于下客点的观赏性花坛，不少来往的游客会驻足欣赏。: A decorative flower bed at the drop-off site that many passing tourists stop to admire.
text.不少颇有经济实力的人会选择来这里消遣，度过闲适的时光。: A place where many affluent individuals choose to spend their leisure time.
text.愿意来我们这种偏远地方的列车长可是稀客，我要好好招待一番才行。: It's not every day that we get conductors who are willing to come to this godforsaken place. I've got to be a good host and take care of you.
text.路上有没有遇见什么好玩的事儿？哎呀，我也要保持与时俱进嘛。: Did you come across anything fun while on the road? Aha, I have to keep up with the times too.
text.来啦？我刚刚正锻炼呢，要不你也跟着我打一套太极，我们再谈生意？: Ah, you're here. I was just working out. How about you try a hand at Tai Chi with me before we talk shop?
text.做生意的秘诀？我也年纪不小了，早跟不上时代咯，不知道不知道。: The secret to doing business? Nope, no clue. At my age, I've long fallen behind the times.
text.钱乃身外之物……不过你还年轻，有点冲劲是好的，我很欣赏你。: Money is simply worldly possessions... But you're still young, so being a little driven is all right. You impress me.
text.只有踏踏实实做过的工作不会骗人，我都看在眼里呢。我看你必是栋梁之材。: What doesn't lie is the honest work one has done. I see it all. You are undoubtedly destined for greater endeavors.
text.要说<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>近段时间在哪卖得: If I have to name a place that <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have been selling out like hot cakes in recent times, it can only be <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>.
text.<color=#b45e01>{station}</color>的<color=: The market price of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> has plummeted. Those people who stocked up to sell there are most likely regretting their life choices now.
text.我记得还有一些……你等等我啊。: I remember there are some left... Hang on.
text.谢谢惠顾，有空常来啊。: Thank you for your patronage. Come again soon.
text.<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>今日打折，要进货不妨: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are on sale today. Consider stocking up.
text.总会有你中意的货，今天不买，明天也迟早会买，那不如趁现在就买。: There will always be goods you like. If you don't buy them today, you'll eventually buy them tomorrow, so why not take advantage of the present and buy them now?
text.总会这样的，明明已经把东西放进了购物车，却突然没了买回去的心思。: This always happens — adding something in the shopping cart and then suddenly losing the desire to buy it.
text.不坏。多少人忙忙碌碌风风火火，最后只求一个中规中矩。: Not bad. Many people rush around and end up just going for something average.
text.这就对啦，打折就是为了让你们买的。: That's right. Sales are meant to make you buy.
text.以后也务必要保持合作啊。: Be sure to maintain our cooperation in the future as well.
text.你手头有<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>的话可以考虑: If you have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>, consider selling them to me. I can offer you a better price than usual.
text.放心吧，不论是什么，总能有点价值的。: Don't worry, no matter what it is, it always has some value.
text.觉得还是自己留着更好吗？: Prefer to keep it for yourself?
text.这正是市场急需的。: This is exactly what the market urgently needs.
text.货架和仓库都空咯，明天再来吧！: The shelves and warehouse are empty. Come back tomorrow!
text.这次就按这个价成交吧！: Let's settle on this price this time!
text.真是抱歉，这个价格没法再降了。: I'm really sorry, but we can't lower the price any further.
text.无妨无妨，多赚几块少赚几块又有什么差别？: No worries. A few extra bucks don't make much difference.
text.就算去问别家，也只能出到这个数了。: Even if you ask around, other places won't offer more than this.
text.啊啊，还不行……明明人家好想现在就把列车长灌到吐出来为止……: Ahhh, it's not enough... I really want to drink till you puke, Conductor...
text.就这样喝下去了，不担心人家在里面加了什么吗？……只是开个玩笑嘛，就算有，也只会是: You just downed it? Aren't you worried that it might be spiked? ...Just kidding, even if there is something, it would only be something beneficial.
text.我的日常生活和其他人没什么不同啦。不适应的地方肯定是有……我会要求自己适应，没关: My daily life isn't very different from others. There are definitely things I'm not used to... but I'll push myself adapt. No worries.
text.选吧选吧，在我看来你还有值得榨取的空间哟。: Go on and choose. I still see some potential to squeeze out of you.
text.那个监控摄像头虽然有点碍眼，但是在分享情报上还是挺大方的，亚莉奈就只好对他睁只眼: That surveillance camera is a bit of an eyesore, but it's generous in sharing information, so I turn a blind eye~ At least it's more easy-going on the eye than that sneaky guy.
text.觊觎列车长的害虫多得让人讨厌，人家不在的时候，列车长可要好好保护自己呀？: There are many pests eyeing you, Conductor. Take good care of yourself when I'm not around.
text.列车长在饮食上可要格外留神，总有心怀不轨的人会为了一己私欲对你下手的。不过你可以: Be extra cautious with your diet, Conductor. Some people with ill intentions might target you. But you can always trust me. I would never harm you~!
text.那个游戏公司的总部就在这个地方，列车长见识过他们的繁荣了吗？果然大家更愿意沉溺于: The headquarters of that game company is right here. Have you seen their success, Conductor? Sure enough, people would rather indulge in the loveliness of the virtual world than face the harsh reality.
text.列车长觉得澄明数据中心最大的秘密就是10 Rounds的总部吗？其实在这地底下，: Conductor, are you thinking that 10 Rounds' headquarters is the CDCA Bureau's biggest secret? In truth, there are more interesting things kept under here that just might be way livelier than the resorts aboveground.
text.列车长有没有变得比以前更喜欢人家呢？啊……只是，觉得差不多该下一个阶段了，稍微问: Have you grown fonder of me, Conductor? Ah... just feeling like it's time for the next stage, so I wanted to ask... hehe...
text.听说有个自称列车长宿敌的家伙一直在纠缠列车长，需要的话只要和人家说一声就好了哦！: I heard someone claiming to be your nemesis has been pestering you, Conductor. If you need help, just let me know! As a member of Night Chains, Arina is quite skilled in certain methods~
text.列车长想不想尝试一下调制饮品的附加服务呢？想知道是什么的话，就再靠过来点~: Would you like to try our drink-mixing service? If you're curious, come a little closer~
text.在这个城市见面的感觉也不错，对吧，列车长~: Meeting in this city feels nice, right, Conductor?
text.或者，列车长想要看看亚莉奈的私藏？只为列车长特供的那种哦。: Or would you like to see Arina's private collection? The kind that's only offered to you.
text.人家已经猜到列车长会怎么选了哦，因为列车长的一切，人家都了如指掌呢。: I already guessed what you would choose because I know you all too well.
text.请用，列车长~哎呀，刚才碰到列车长的手了，好开心，感觉身上都有些发热了呢~: Enjoy, Conductor~ Oh my, I just touched the Conductor's hand. I'm so happy, and I feel a bit warm all over~
text.呵，有必要想这么久吗？去做、去争取就可以了，犹豫只会让机会溜走。: Heh, do you need to think for so long? Just do it. Go and fight for it. Hesitation will only let opportunities slip away.
text.嗯？你傻站在这里做什么？: Hmm? Why are you standing there dumbfounded?
text.这段时间工作交接下来，你还凑合吧。怎么，你不会觉得我会就这样对你改观吧？哈哈哈哈: You're managing the handover work rather well. What? You don't think I'll change my opinion of you just like that, do you? Hahahahaha, that's hilarious!
text.有付出才能有回报，只要你能证明自己的价值，无论要我给你端茶倒水还是变着法夸你都可: You're only rewarded when you put in the effort. As long as you can prove your worth, I'll do anything for you, whether it's serving you tea or showering you with all sorts of praises. If you can't, then disappear as soon as possible. Don't embarrass yourself~
text.像你这样的列车长太多了，我没有义务每个都上前打招呼吧？不过能坚持到这个程度，已经: There are too many Conductors like you. I'm under no obligations to greet each of you, right? But to have persisted to this extent, you're already a bit better than useless fools.
