text.哎呀哎呀？你比我想象中的还要能干呢。: Oh my, oh my? You're more capable than I imagined.
text.衷心欢迎您的到来，列车长{playername}。我雷齐娅将竭力为您提供服务——: A heartfelt welcome to you, Conductor {playername}. I, Reizia, will do my best to serve you — Not used to it? But this is what you deserve. I keep my word.
text.你想要的话，有时候给你预留高收益的订单，或是其他方面行个方便都没问题。当然这些不: If you want, I can occasionally reserve very profitable orders for you or make things convenient in other ways. Of course, these don't come free. You'll need to compensate in some way — such as the latest product from Night Chains Lesage.
text.啊啊，你大概觉得我是个很势利的女人，但我并不否认这一点。可是这反而意味着我很可靠: Ah, you probably think I'm a very opportunistic woman. I don't deny that. However, it also means I'm reliable because I'm driven by profit. People who are easily swayed by emotions are the hardest to control.
text.可以让我获利的人就笑脸相迎，不能让我获利的人就冷脸相对，只要遵循这个准则，你就能: I greet people who can make me profit with a smile and treat those who can't with a cold face. By following this principle, you can quickly filter out the quality resources that will help you grow. I hope you're among the former, otherwise, our conversation is just a waste of time.
text.有的人居然觉得我的行事风格和那个七号自由港的村姑很像？哈，这真是我听过的最垃圾的: Someone dares to compare my style to that peasant woman from Freeport Ⅶ? Haha, that's the worst joke I've ever heard! How can that rustic woman compare? Besides, she's too weak to accomplish anything significant.
text.商会的大家都很尊敬梅蒂奇女士，当然，我不否认她的能力。只是我觉得他们的吹捧有时候: Everyone in the COLUMBA respects Signora Medici, and I naturally don't deny her abilities. I just think their praise can sometimes be too misguided. One day, I will... ah, never mind, it's not the right time to say it yet.
text.没错没错，好好干，尽情发挥你仅有的价值吧~: Yes, yes, work hard and fully utilize your limited value~
text.这样才对嘛~不然你身为列车长还有什么用处呢？: That's the way it should be~ Otherwise, what's the use of being a Conductor?
text.哈……你也就这种程度而已。: Ha... you're only at this level.
text.不错不错，就要这样，把能拿到的机会一个不剩全部吃光，你是个好孩子~: Good, good. Seize every opportunity you can get. Don't leave any behind. You're a good kid~
text.根据我的分析，这个订单能将你的价值发挥到最大。呵呵呵，在这方面，你可以信任我的眼: Based on my analysis, this order will maximize your value. Hehehe, you can trust my judgment when it comes to this.
text.我还挺喜欢吃肉的……好，我不说了，不然一定会引起不知情者的恐慌！我喜欢的只有全熟: I'm like meat quite a lot... well, I'll stop talking, otherwise I might scare people. I only like well done meat, don't mistake me for a real wolf.
text.奇怪的目光当然也有，但也有不少人愿意相信我，所以我才能在这儿和你说话。真不知道要: I've attracted some strange looks, but there are also many willing to believe in me. That's why I'm standing here talking to you. Who knows if we are the fools or they are... still the world is sometimes driven by a foolish persistence.
text.听说这边地下有历史遗迹，你要不要考虑去采掘一下？什么形式的啊……我就是因为不知道: I heard there are ancient ruins underground here. Wanna to excavate them? What kind of...? I don't know, and that's exactly why I'm encouraging you to do it!
text.多亏了海因里希先生的担保，我才留在了铁安局。像当时那样身无分文、形迹可疑地出现…: Thanks to Mr. Heinrich's guarantee, I was able to stay with the BCRL Agency. Appearing penniless and under suspicious circumstances... hahaha, if I had been an officer back then, I would have immediately thrown my past self into a temporary holding cell.
text.叫我莱卡吉亚就行。先说好，可不许给我起随随便便的外号啊，“狼人”肯定不行。: Just call me Lycagia. Let's make this clear, don't give me any random nicknames. Werewolf is definitely unacceptable.
text.哦！来了啊。我是不会突然摘下头套变回人类的，你就放心吧。: Oh! You're here. I won't suddenly take off my mask and turn back into a human. Rest assured.
text.铁安局的任务就是……就不对你背诵那些章程条款了，你也都知道。: The BCRL Agency's duty is... I'll skip the rules and regulations. You already know them.
text.我其实挺喜欢自己亲自上阵的……但也不能只靠我一个人每天带队出城。就靠你了。: I prefer taking the field myself... but I can't lead the team out of the city alone every day. So I'll need to rely on you.
text.有你常来以后这儿的情况好多了，怎么样，以后还来吧？: Things have improved a lot since you've started coming here often. So, will you come again?
text.最近过得怎么样？有没有想念你的狼脑袋朋友……我们当然是朋友了！现在就算你叫我狼人: How have you been lately? Do you miss your wolf buddy... Of course, we are friends! Even if you call me werewolf now, I won't beat you up.
text.量力而行是很重要的，不过我觉得你肯定潜力无限！当年也有人和我这么说过。: Knowing your limits is important, but I believe you have unlimited potential! Someone said the same to me back then.
text.这里的所有任务都很重要，不过……我还是建议你从最能胜任的开始做起，不然就堆着做不: All the tasks here are important, but... I still suggest you start with what you're best at, otherwise, they'll just pile up unfinished.
text.原来如此，这次投资时您的姿态是这样的……我会好好记录下来的。: I see. This is how you handled the investment... I'll make a detailed record.
text.能得到您的投资实在是一件美妙的事情，我总觉得我得到了比金钱更有价值的事物。: It's a wonderful thing to receive your investment. I feel I've gained something more valuable than money.
text.别看我这副模样，也会有喜怒哀乐。在我心情沮丧的时候，就会反复想着与您见面的那些时: Don't be fooled by my appearance. I also experience joy, anger, sorrow, and happiness. When I'm feeling down, I repeatedly think about the times we shared, which quickly lifts my spirits.
text.虽然我不介意您对我的看法，但既然您有这个疑问，我就会解答：我对您没有任何其他的企: Although I don't mind your opinion of me, I'll answer since you asked: I have no other intentions toward you. I'm satisfied with just observing you.
text.您是怎么让这个数字流入数据中心官方账户的，我看得清清楚楚。: How did you get this number into the data center's official account? I saw it clearly.
text.亲爱的<color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>，我: Dear <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>, the number of times we've met has risen to an exhilarating figure, hasn't it? Oh, I certainly don't get tired of it. I never will.
text.果然还是在这里与您会面更令人愉快。虽然我也一直想办法观察您在其他地方的动向，但那: It's indeed more pleasant to meet you here. Although I've been trying to observe you elsewhere, it's a bit troublesome.
text.是的，我当然听说了您在此处的活跃，毕竟我一直看着您。: Yes, I've heard about your activities here. After all, I've been watching you.
text.<color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>，我想是时: <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>, I think it's time to close the distance between us — I want to observe you more closely. Please, don't step back, I absolutely won't harm you.
text.又见到您了，<color=#b45e01>{playername}</color: It's great to see you again, <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>. If there's anything better than this, it's being able to see you all the time.
text.这笔钱可以用于扩充电脑的数据容量，毕竟命名为<color=#b45e01>{pl: The money can be used to expand the computer's data capacity. After all, the folder named <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color> has taken up all the storage space. It's just a little joke, of course. I wouldn't misuse the City Hall's account money for personal use.
text.很可惜，市政厅的账户除了足够数额的货币，什么也不收。它还真是不解风情，您不这么觉: Unfortunately, the City Hall's account only accepts sufficient currency and nothing else. It's quite unromantic. Don't you think?
text.请您仔细阅读并确认是否同意“用户协议”与“隐私保护政策”: Please carefully read and confirm whether you agree to the 'User Agreement' and 'Privacy Policy'.
text.在澄明数据中心有许多有意思的观察对象，可能在一般人的道德标准里，有些人谈不上令人: There are many interesting subjects to observe at the CDCA Bureau. By general moral standards, some might not be considered likeable. But it's their unique personalities that make them valuable to observe.
text.您似乎对我的外貌有些好奇，但要说为什么会长成这样……只是因为我想。我想要更好地看: You seem curious about my appearance, but if you ask why I look like this... it's simply because I want to. I wanted to observe you better, so I took on this form. Is this reason satisfactory?
text.您问我能看得有多透彻？那可就是一个非常有趣的话题了，不过我可以诚实地告诉您，我的: How deep can I see? That's a very interesting question, but I can honestly tell you that my head doesn't have X-ray vision.
text.也许您会好奇为何我执着于称呼您的名字，但这不难理解。我只是透过了您的身份看到了您: Perhaps you're curious why I'm so persistent in calling your name, but it's not hard to understand. I see you for who you are, beyond just your title of Conductor. There are many Conductors, but only one dear <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>.
text.您好，亲爱的<color=#b45e01>{playername}</color: Hello, my dear <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>. From the moment you arrived at the CDCA Bureau, I've been eagerly awaiting your visit.
text.对于我的态度，有的人猜疑，有的人恐惧，有的人好奇……但是我并不在意你们怎么看我，: Regarding my attitude, some people are suspicious, some are fearful, some are curious... but I don't care what you think of me, as long as I can watch you all.
text.让我们再多聊聊吧，我的<color=#b45e01>{playername}</: Let's chat some more, my <color=#b45e01>{playername}</color>. As for why I say 'my', it's because my view of you is different from others'. But it's the same for everyone else, as the same object appears differently to each person. Everyone can consider you theirs.
text.这真是一个足够慷慨的数字。让我有这个一睹您豪爽风采的荣幸，实在是感激不尽。: This is indeed a generous number. I'm deeply grateful for the honor of witnessing your magnanimity.
text.很遗憾，哪怕我心里想将物品直接奉上，也无法违抗这里的交换规则……: Regrettably, even though I wish nothing more than to give it to you, I'm unable to go against the trading rules here...
text.如果要永远住在这里，列车长会考虑将这个空间装饰成什么样的风格？啊，别紧张，我只是: How would you consider decorating this space if you were to live here forever, Conductor? Ah, don't be nervous. I'm purely trying to gain some interior design inspiration from others.
text.买入卖出时的纳税，都会提高当地的城市声望。: Taxation during buying and selling will increase the local Reputation.
text.建造并装载货厢可以大幅提高载货量，提高贸易效益。: Constructing and loading freight cars can significantly increase cargo capacity, enhancing trade efficiency.
text.交易品的卖出价格，会受到运输距离和城市喜好的影响。: The selling price of goods is influenced by transportation distance and city preferences.
text.本地交易品如在本地卖出，卖出价格将会减半，不建议在本地出售本地交易品。: Selling local goods within the same area will halve the selling price; it is not recommended to sell local goods locally.
text.交易品行情会受到来往列车长们交易活动的影响。: Market prices are influenced by the trading activities of conductors.
text.遗失货物中拾取的交易品的进货成本为零。: The procurement cost of picked up goods from lost cargo is zero.
text.售价高的交易品，砍价抬价之后，有更高的利润空间。: Goods with high selling prices have higher profit margins after Bargain.
text.进度达到100%时可领取: Rewards can be claimed upon reaching 100% progress.
text.提高列车的速度，可以在行情来的时候提高贸易效率。: Increasing the train speed can improve trade efficiency when market conditions are favorable.
text.行情好的时候，适当进货采买书，买入更多低价交易品获得更大利润。: During good market conditions, consider procuring more low-priced goods with Purchase Appl. for greater profits.
text.特产交易品往往利润更高，适当使用进货采买书，买入更多特产获得更大利润。: Specialty goods often yield higher profits; consider procuring more specialties with Purchase Appl. for greater profits.
text.交易所的每日库存总量有限。: The daily inventory of the Trading Center is limited.
text.卖出价格行情不好的时候，可以将交易品暂存在当地的私人仓库，周转更加灵活。: When the selling price market is unfavorable, you can temporarily store the goods in the local private warehouse for more flexible turnover.
text.当连接城市的行车段发生形态污染事件时，当地交易所的行情也会受到影响。: When a morphic field pollution incident occurs in the railway section connecting cities, the market at the local trading center will also be affected.
text.投资城市可以解锁当地高价值交易品的贸易许可，提高贸易效益。: Investing in cities can unlock local high-value trade permits, enhancing trade efficiency.
text.亲爱的玩家，根据国家最新发布的游戏防沉迷规定，不满18岁的未成年人仅能在周五、周: Dear player, according to the latest national regulations on anti-addiction in games, players under 18 years of age can only log in to the game from 8:00 PM to 9:00 PM on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays. Please arrange your time reasonably for your physical and mental health.

text.<b>压缩机升级</b>\\n1 压缩机升级至LV6后，将额外开启一条压\\n缩: Upgrade Compactor 1. When your compactor reaches level 6, an additional compaction channel becomes available. 2. When your compactor reaches level 11, an additional compaction channel becomes available. In addition, the automatic trash collection function will be activated.
text.<b>垃圾溢出</b>\\n1 当有车厢超过48h未收取过垃圾或暂存\\n区垃圾: Trash Overflow 1. Trash overflow occurs when you have not collected trash from any carriage for more than 48 hours or when the stored trash blocks exceed the repository's limit. 2. Trash overflow will decrease the Max Cleanliness, affecting passenger expenditure desires. Therefore, it is important to regularly clean up the trash.
text.<b>垃圾清理</b>\\n1 在垃圾暂存区花费铁盟币清理所有垃圾\\n块。\\: Trash Cleaning\n1. You can spend BCRL Coins to clean up the trash blocks stored in the repository.\n2. At the Wilderness Station's trash recycling station, you can exchange compacted trash blocks for BCRL Coins.
text.<b>垃圾压缩机</b>\\n1 每天5:00刷新后，可以在这里收取每节\\n车: Trash Compactor\n1. Here, you can collect the trash produced by all the carriages after 5:00 daily.\n2. The compactor compresses the trash into compacted blocks at regular intervals and stores them in the repository.

text.<b>词缀数量</b>\r1.武器和护甲词缀上限基础为4条，挂件上限基础为6条。: <b>Affixes<b>\n1. Weapon and Armor can have up to 4 affixes initially, and Accessory 6 affixes.
text.<b>词缀获得</b>\r1 装备每升10级可以获得一条新的词缀。\r2 使用词: Affix Acquisition1. Every 10 levels gained by equipment grant a new affix. 2. Using affix items can also grant new affixes.
text.<b>替换词缀</b>\r1 当装备词缀数量达到上限时，新获得\r词缀全部转化为: Affixes for Replacement1. When the maximum affix limit is reached, newly acquired affixes are converted into affixes for replacement. 2. Affixes for replacement can replace random affixes on equipment except for fixed affixes. 3. Equipment cannot have two identical affixes; therefore, only affixes of the same type can be replaced.
text.整体状况极佳。本系统建议您充分利用此机会，集中处理工作。行车状况卓越，感谢你的辛: Overall condition is excellent. The system suggests making the most of this opportunity and concentrating on tasks. The train is in excellent condition, and your hard work as the conductor is appreciated.
text.整体状况一般。本系统建议您适度安排工作，预留充分的休息时间。在疲惫状态下继续行车: Overall condition is fair. The system advises scheduling work reasonably and allowing adequate rest time. Continuing to operate the train in a tired state is discouraged according to the Conductor's Manual. Train conditions are normal, but remember to balance rest and work.
text.整体状况较差。本系统建议您在完成必要工作之后立刻休息。在列车及乘员状况不佳时继续: Overall condition is poor. The system recommends resting immediately after completing essential tasks. Operating the train and crew in poor condition is strictly prohibited by the Conductor's Manual. It's not advisable to continue operating the train. Please rest appropriately and remain vigilant for potential risks of morphic field deviation.
text.<b>词缀替换次数</b>\r1 每件装备可替换次数有限，可替换次\r数归0后，: Affix Replacement Limit1. Each piece of equipment has a limited number of replacement times. Once the limit is reached, no further affix replacements can be made.
text.没有比这里更适合的私密空间了，愿意的话，你可以谈谈关于你的事，当然，我也可以谈谈: There isn't any other private space more appropriate than here. If you're willing, you can talk about your matters, while I, too, will talk about mine.
text.{playername}，此行还愉快吗？不论是外面，还是这里。我想听听你的回答。: Has this trip been fun for you, {playername}? Regardless if it's in here or out there. I'd really like to know.

text.欢迎使用垃圾回收服务！: Welcome to the waste recycling service!
text.明明，铁安局也大力支持，但是来这里的人还是很少……: Despite the strong support from the BCRL Agency, very few people come here...
text.邊翫莥！您已经是这里最常来的客人……之一了！之一哦！: Welcome! Of all the visitors here, you're already... one of the most frequent...! One of!
text.就算发出去的一百封广告邮件都没起效，我也不会忘记初心的！就算没有顾客，列车长还是: Even if sending out a hundred advertising emails didn't work, I won't forget my original intention! Even if there are no customers, you'll keep coming!
text.不仅是列车长，最近也有一些其他人来光顾了。……到垃圾站来，是不是不说“光顾”比较: Not just you, but some others have also been patronizing lately. ...Perhaps 'patronizing' isn't the right word for a trash dump?
text.宣传好像起效了，最近来这里的人变得比以前都多！薶郗，无垠号的列车长，以后也要来这: The promotion seems to have worked. More people are coming here than before! Thank you! Conductor of The Eternal, you'll be coming here to handle trash in the future too, right?
text.嘟嘟嘟——嘟嘟——嘟嘟嘟！欢迎来到垃圾回收环节……你觉得这种欢迎仪式效果怎么样？: Doo doo doo—doo doo—doo doo doo! Welcome to the trash recycling segment... What do you think of this welcome?
text.列车长一定是为了支持我们的工作才带来这么多待处理垃圾吧！好感动……: Conductor, you must be bring so much trash to support our work! I'm so touched...
text.太好了！我们的处理站终于派上用场了！莱斯特——快来工作——！: Great! Our processing station has finally found some use! Lester — Get to work —!
text.垃圾处理器运行的声音简直是世界上最动听的声音……这可和粉碎、压缩处理机不一样！列: The sound of the trash processor running is the most beautiful sound in the world... it's different from the shredder and compactor! Conductor, you understand, right?
text.列车长，务必收下这些鉲……礼物！就是礼物！因为很感谢你，所以考虑到你听不懂，忍着: Conductor, you must accept these ka... gifts! Yes, gifts! I was so full of gratitude, so I was worried you wouldn't understand, and stopped myself from speaking in my native tongue!
text.垃圾分类压缩回收能使得世界变得更加美好。这是列车长让世界变得更美好而应得的奖励！: Sorting, compressing, and recycling trash can make the world a better place. You deserve this reward for making the world better, Conductor!
text.如果要说~世界上最好吃的东西~那就是~蓝色的~奶酪~~呜呼~~~这是我灵光一现想: If I had to say, the best thing in the world is blue cheese~~ woohoo~~~ This is a tune that came to my mind. Isn't it great?
text.我讨厌红色的家伙摆出一副炫耀的样子，主要是他炫耀的东西都特别难看！: I hate when the red guy shows off, especially since the things he shows off are utterly horrid!
text.关于我的故乡，其实我也知道的不太多，因为我是在地表长大的，没想到吧！不过总有一天: As for my hometown, I don't know much about it either. I grew up on the surface. What a surprise! But someday, I'll go back to see it!
text.哎，商业宣传真的很难。我觉得我的海报做得很有艺术气息啊，但红色的家伙非要让我去掉: Oh, commercial promotion is really hard. I think my posters are very artistic, but the red guy insists I remove the blue cheese icon... Why? Don't customers like cheese?
text.垃圾处理站必须建在远离城市的地方，铁盟当时是这么要求的。据说这是临界前就有的规定: The trash processing plant must be built far from the city, as it was B.C.R.L.'s requirement back then. It's said this rule existed before the Solstice... No wonder nobody wants to come here...
text.该角色暂时没有共振皮肤^_^: This character does not have any Resonance skins.
text.1.传单及广告投放券用于在指定地点招揽乘客，将乘客运送至目的地，从而获取客运收益: 1. Leaflets and Advt. Licenses are used to attract passengers at designated locations, transport them to their destinations, and earn passenger transport revenue.2. When distributing leaflets, first select the destination, then choose the distribution location. Passengers attracted from different locations have different preferences and expenditure capabilities.3. When using Advt. Licenses, first select the destination, then choose the advertising channel. Passengers attracted from different channels have different preferences and expenditure capabilities.4. The number of passengers attracted is influenced by the distance to the destination.
text.1.列车评分可在营运总览里查询，具有8个指标：\\n\r舒适度，清洁度，美味评分:
1. Train ratings can be checked in the Operations, with 8 indicators:
Comfort, Cleanliness, Delicacy Rating, Fun Rating, Pet Rating, Aquatic Rating, Plants Rating, and Medical Rating. 

2. The ratings are based on the condition of related train furnishings and decorations. 

3. Passengers will spend according to the train ratings, and passenger transport revenue will be settled upon arrival.
For example, passengers who prefer aquariums are more likely to spend on trains with a high Aquatic Rating.
Similarly, elderly passengers who prefer comfort are more likely to spend on trains with high Comfort and Medical Rating. 

4. Train furnishings can be purchased from the COLUMBA's train furniture store.
text.1.每日5:00可以获得免费的传单，工作日50张，节假日100张。\\n\\n\:
1. You can receive free leaflets every day at 5:00, with 50 leaflets on weekdays and 100 leaflets on holidays.

2. Leaflets can be printed, with a weekly limit of 250 copies, reset every Monday at 5:00.

3. The maximum storage limit for leaflets is 450 copies.

4. Advt. Licenses can be purchased from the Night Chains Shop in the resting area.
text.本次投资次数已用完: Investment attempts have been used up.
text.1.商会订单具有三种类型：货运订单，采购订单及客运订单。\\n\\n\r\r\r:
1. The guild orders have three types: cargo orders, purchase orders, and passenger orders.

2. Cargo orders require cargo capacity to accept. Transport the target cargo to the destination to complete.

3. Purchase orders require going to the Trading Center to purchase the corresponding Goods and sell them at the objective Trading Center to complete.

4. Passenger orders require having available passenger seats to accept. Transport the passengers to the destination to complete.

5. Guild orders refresh at 5AM daily, replenishing up to the limit.

6. Using an Order Request, you can immediately gain one guild order.

7. The guild's Furniture Store allows you to purchase onboard furniture to improve train ratings. The furniture sold by COLUMBA in different cities will have regional differences.
text.低买高卖，是赚取利润的核心。\r寻找低价行情交易品砍价买入，寻找卖出行情高的贸易: Buying low and selling high is the core of profit-making. Look for low-priced goods to bargain for purchase and sell them at higher-priced trading locations to gain extra investment returns. Specialty goods often yield higher profits. Proper use of Purchase Appl. to buy more specialty goods can lead to greater profits. The inventory of goods is limited for a single purchase and requires a round trip to another city to refresh. If you want to continuously purchase certain goods locally, you can use a Purchase Appl. to refresh the goods inventory. The daily total inventory of local goods is limited and refreshes at 5:00 daily. Selling local goods within the same area will halve the selling price, so it is not recommended to sell local goods locally. Investing in a city can unlock the trade permit for high-value local goods and improve trade efficiency. Taxes incurred from buying and selling will increase the local city's reputation. Increasing the local city's reputation can increase the number of Bargain attempts, success rate, and quantity of goods purchased in a single transaction, improving trade efficiency.
text.交易品买入之前可进行砍价，卖出之前可进行抬价。\r议价成功率受城市声望、角色生活: You can bargain for better prices before buying and selling products.The success rate of Bargain is influenced by your Reputation, your character's profession skills, and the number of Bargain attempts.The more times Bargain is conducted, the lower the success rate becomes. The success rate resets at the end of each trade.Bargain range is affected by your trade level and your character's profession skills.Once your Bargain attempts are used up, you can use Negotiation Appl. to gain additional attempts.After accumulating sufficient profits and increasing your trade level, you can expand the Bargain range, enhancing the profitability of your trades.Certain crew members' profession skills can increase the number of Bargain attempts, success rate, and the quantity of products that can be bought in a single transaction at the Trading Center, resulting in increased benefits.
text.交易品名字下方的百分比数字标记了当前交易品的行情。\r灰色100%表示行情处于市: The percentage number below the goods' names marks the current market situation. Gray 100% indicates the market's original price, red 80% means the buying or selling price is below the original price, at 80% of the original price, and green 120% means the buying or selling price is above the original price. The selling price of goods is influenced by transportation distance and city preferences. Goods' market conditions are influenced by the trading activities of conductors on incoming and outgoing trains. When a morphic field pollution event occurs in the railway section connecting cities, transportation disruptions cause shortages of goods, and the market at the local trading center is also affected.
text.遗失货物中拾取的交易品的进货成本为零。\r建造并装载货厢可以大幅提高载货量，提高: The procurement cost of picked up goods from lost cargo is zero.Constructing and loading freight cars can significantly increase cargo capacity, enhancing trade efficiency. Goods with high selling prices have higher profit margins after Bargain. Increasing the train speed can improve trade efficiency when market conditions are favorable.During good market conditions, consider procuring more low-priced goods with Purchase Appl. for greater profits.When the selling price market is unfavorable, you can temporarily store the goods in the local private warehouse for more flexible turnover.
text.1.这里是每个城市的特色打卡店。邀请队员体验后，队员们可以在战斗中获得默契加成，:
1. These are the signature shops in each city. After inviting crew members to experience them, crew members can gain Rapport bonuses in combat, and you can gain the "Rev up the passion!" bonus.

2. Check the menu at the bar's welcoming NPC to select items and invite your crew members to participate.

3. The menu is divided into Duo Sets and Team Sets. The Duo Set is when you invite one crew member to join. The Team Set is when you invite the entire team, but it cannot exceed the maximum squad size of 5 people.

4. Each character has different preferences for the meals. When inviting crew members, their facial expressions indicate their preferences. Choosing a meal they particularly like will inspire them, granting higher Rapport bonuses in combat!

5. After experiencing the meal together, you can gain the "Rev up the passion!" bonus. This either increases the train's maximum speed or improves its braking and acceleration performance, greatly increasing the speed of travel between cities!

6. More expensive meals are more popular and offer greater bonuses.

7. All bonuses last 30 minutes.

8. You can continuously invite different crew members to these experiences, with the effect of "Rev up the passion!" based on the most recent experience. The same crew member cannot experience it continuously; they must wait until the Rapport bonus effect ends before experiencing it again.

text.1.行车区域发生共振形态污染时，区域内的桦树生物和深眠者会异常活跃，此时导航地图:
1. When morphic field pollution occurs in the driving area, the Chaos Remains and Deep Sleepers in the area will be unusually active. At this time, the navigation map will mark the pollution index of the area.

2. The pollution index is divided into 12 levels:
Levels <color=#92d050>1-3</color> are marked in <color=#92d050>green</color>, Levels <color=#f8e71c>4-6</color> are marked in <color=#f8e71c>yellow</color>, Levels <color=#f88825>7-9</color> are marked in <color=#f88825>orange</color>, Levels <color=#de3c36>10-12</color> are marked in <color=#de3c36>red</color>.
The higher the pollution index, the more dangerous the Chaos Remains and Deep Sleepers in the area become. The frequency of occurrence of attack events also increases.

3. When morphic field pollution occurs, please plan your driving route reasonably according to the pollution index.

4. When pollution levels 10-12 occur, the area will be severely polluted. Please avoid the polluted area or strengthen the security forces of the train.

5. When morphic field pollution occurs, transportation disruptions cause material shortages, and the market of nearby trading centers will also be affected.

6. Due to obstruction, lost cargo in polluted areas will also increase with the pollution index.
text.1.行车遭遇袭击，护卫队员迎击失败后，列车将会损失耐久，同时损失一定数量的铁盟币:
1. When the train is attacked, if the escort fails to counterattack, the train will lose durability and a certain amount of BCRL Coins and goods. Sometimes even passengers may go missing.

2. After a failed counterattack, you can report the case to the BCRL Agency. You can find this case in the nearest BCRL Agency's case processing, take the initiative to strike and clear the case, and retrieve lost items.

3. If you are unable to handle the case, you can also post the case online and offer rewards for kind-hearted people to help retrieve the lost items.

4. After multiple attacks, when the train's durability drops to 0, the train will be destroyed, and it will be unable to continue its journey.

5. When the train is destroyed, you can call the 24-hour paid rescue towing service of the B.C.R.L., and the train will be towed back to the departure station.

6. After the destroyed train is towed back to the station, repairs need to be carried out during the train's preparation period before it can continue its journey.

7. Deterrence Level: The higher the Deterrence level, the lower the probability of encountering bandit events.

8. Resonant Level: The higher the Resonant level, the lower the probability of encountering Chaos Remains and Deep Sleepers events.
text.1.有时会在污染区内发现巨大的【混响浮标】，它是造成污染事件的主要原因之一。\\:
1. Sometimes, you might encounter massive [Reverb Buoy] within contaminated zones, which are one of the main causes of pollution events.

2. Actively taking down [Reverb Buoy] can reduce their pollution levels, subsequently lowering the pollution index of the area.
This action also grants you significant resources such as [Duty Medals] and [Sacrifice Medals].
Additionally, eliminating [Chaos Buoys] and [Chaos Remains Along the Line] can also contribute to reducing pollution in the area.

3. When the pollution level of [Reverb Buoys] drops to zero, the morphic field pollution in the area will vanish. However, achieving this requires coordinated efforts from numerous conductors.

4. You can always check the coordinates of [Reverb Buoys] on the navigation map.

text.1.有时会在行车沿线发现【异构厄枝】，它通常引聚着大量深眠者和桦树生物，威胁着附:
1. [Heteromorphyes] may occasionally appear along train route, attracting large numbers of Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains, threatening transportation safety.

2. By eliminating [Heteromorphyes], Conductors will receive rare resources, as well as [Duty Medals] awarded by BCRL Agency.

3. When the eradication progress of a [Heteromorphy] reaches 100%, that [Heteromorphy] will disappear.

4. Conductors can check the coordinates of [Heteromorphyes] on the map at any time.

5. Statistics show that new [Heteromorphyes] appear every other week, presumably due to the influence of Morphic Moon.
text.不用太在意我……啊，这里应该自我介绍？我是安菲娅，来自阿妮塔……这样就没问题了吧: Don't mind me... Oh, should I introduce myself? I'm Anfiya, from Anita... That's it. Is it okay?
text.毕竟只是临时出行，我身上没有带太多东西，要是你有其他需求，我也爱莫能助。: Since it's just a last-minute trip, I didn't bring much with me. If you have other needs, I can't help much.
text.我只是路过这里而已，没什么特别的理由……硬要说的话，这边的桦树生物很有研究价值。: I'm just passing through. No special reason... If I must give one, the Chaos Remains here are very valuable for research.
text.要不要之后常驻这里研究桦树生物的生态呢……: Should I consider staying here to study the Chaos Remains ecosystem...
text.你在做一些很危险的事情吧？能为了其他人做到这份上，与其说是了不起，不如说……感觉: You're doing something very dangerous, right? To be able to do this much for others, rather than remarkable, it feels... strange.
text.距离过远，无法调查，需要配备调查无人机: Distance too far to investigate. A survey drone is required.
text.1.彼得·黄对你开放了淘金乐园的投资权限，现在的你可以招揽游客运送至淘金乐园游玩:
1. Peter Hwang has granted you the investment authority for ONEderland. You can now attract passengers to transport to ONEderland and earn a share of ticket revenue.

2. Each time you visit ONEderland, you can choose an investment project to invest in.

3. Depending on the type of investment project, you can receive the following returns:
Improvements in construction, increased share of ticket revenue, tax benefits on ticket revenue, and increased base ticket prices.

4. Bring more tourists to ONEderland and earn profits!
text.1.制定方针，经营乐园周边设施，提高门票外收入。\\n\\n\r告示：根据乐园目: 1. Formulate strategies to operate surrounding facilities and increase non-ticket income.\n\nNotice: Operation strategy has not been implemented due to insufficient development.
text.如何获取城市声望：\\n\\n\r\r1.当前城市的商会任务。\\n\\n\r\:
How to Earn Reputation:

1. Complete quests from the CoC in the current city.

2. Complete quests from the BCRL Agency in the current city.

3. Pay trade taxes at the Trading Center in the current city and satellite cities.

4. Invest in the current city through municipal authorities.
text.载货量不足，本次加工产物超出部分将被销毁，是否继续加工？: Insufficient cargo capacity. Excess processed goods will be destroyed. Continue processing?
text.1.宠物是队员们的好朋友，绑定一名饲养员，培养亲密度并达到一定等级后，可解锁羁绊:
1. Pets are great companions for crew members. By binding a pet to a breeder and nurturing their intimacy to a certain level, you can unlock bonds to enhance the combat abilities of the breeder. Additionally, having pets in carriages increases the pet rating, boosting the spending revenue of pet-passengers during the journey.

2. The pet market restocks only three pets per week. Choose your desired pets and accommodate them. Nurture intimacy by supplying pet food and feeding them snacks.

3. Purchase pet supplies at the pet market, including an integrated pet villa, pet food, and pet snacks, essential for caring for your pets.

4. The integrated pet villa, or pet bed, when placed in a carriage, accommodates purchased pets. Upgrading the pet bed allows more pets to reside, with each pet bed accommodating up to five pets.

5. Pet food is the basic sustenance consumed daily by pets in their beds. By replenishing it daily, you can increase intimacy. Higher-grade pet food provides greater daily intimacy boosts. The higher the level of the pet bed, the higher the maximum stock of pet food.

6. Pet snacks provide additional nourishment, directly increasing intimacy. Each pet can only be fed snacks up to three times a day. Feeding a pet its favorite snack results in an additional 50% intimacy boost.

text.是你啊……你一定是拿到了我想要的东西才来的，对吧？: It's you... you must have brought something I want, and that's why you're here, right?
text.所有装备都自带使用说明，要是你看不懂就自己再想想办法，别缠着我解释给你听。: All equipment comes with usage instructions. If you can't understand them, figure it out yourself. Don't bother me for an explanation.
text.对我漂浮起来的样子很在意？嗯——不过凡人的话是不可能漂浮起来的，愚蠢是很沉重的东: You're bothered by me floating? Well — ordinary people can't float, as stupidity is a heavy burden.
text.原来你养了猫啊……不，我没有兴趣，别说要抱来给我看这种蠢话！要是被赖上头疼的可是: So you have a cat... No, I'm not interested. Don't show it to me! If it gets attached, it'll be a headache for me!
text.听说你被雷比斯那个老不死坑过，果然你也觉得她很烦人……你那是什么眼神，我可没上过: I heard you were tricked by that old hag Rebis, so you find her annoying too... What's that look? I've never been fooled by her.
text.我困了，接下来就算我倒在你身上也要乖乖接受，不许抱怨。: I'm tired. If I were to collapse on you, you must accept it quietly, no complaints allowed.
text.话说回来，这里的沙尘有够大的，就算是我也不想扑在沙地里睡觉啊。: Speaking of which, there's a lot of dust here. Even I don't want to sleep in the sand.
text.您好，妾身名为富子，此地的商会负责人……有何贵干？: Hello, I am Plutessa, head of the trading center here... What can I do for you?
text.在各个交易所之间的人里，可很难见到您这样的人。您一定会成大器的。: People like you are hard to come by in all the trading centers. You will certainly make it big.
text.哎，可真想找空闲休息一下。不过既然列车长来了，妾身即使不休息也没什么……: Oh, I really want to find some time to rest. But since you're here, Conductor, it's okay even if I don't rest...
text.有您常来以后，这儿就变得热闹多了。: With your frequent visits, this place has become much livelier.
text.您早已是我重要的生意伙伴了，以后可千万要多照拂妾身的生意呀。: You've long been a key business partner. Please continue to support my business in the future.
text.妾身能获得现在这番成就，全是沾您的福气啦。: I owe all my current achievements to you.
text.据我的分析，<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>近日在<: According to my analysis, the recent market for <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> should be very good...
text.您如果手头还有<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>，不妨: If you still have <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> on hand, you might want to try your luck at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>, and you might make a profit.
text.妾身作好了充足准备，就等您提呢！这就为您取来新的货物单。: I've made thorough preparations. All's left is for you to pick it up! I'll get the new order forms right away.
text.呀，真是抱歉，仓库已经清完了……拜托您明天可一定要再来，好吗？: Oh, I'm so sorry. The warehouse is empty... Please make sure to come back tomorrow, okay?
text.请慢慢挑选，列车长，毕竟慢工出细活嘛。: Take your time to choose, Conductor. After all, slow work yields fine products.
text.哎呀……列车长，您真是独具慧眼，您看上的商品没有一件是不涨价的。: Oh my... Conductor, you have such a keen eye, as everything you pick ends up increasing in price.
text.这次您为我们带来了什么稀奇货物，能让我看看吗？: What rare goods have you brought us this time? May I have a look?
text.只要是您带来的货物，妾身都是绝对信赖的。: I have complete trust in anything you bring.
text.您眼光真好，这件恰好是我们的折扣商品，快请下手吧。: You have great taste. This happens to be one of our discounted items. Please go ahead.
text.呀，要不要再考虑一下？这件货物的价格不低呢……: Ah, do you want to reconsider? This item is quite pricey...
text.没事的，您能想着到妾身这儿来做生意，已经令妾身感到无限光荣。: No worries. The fact that you came to do business with me already makes me infinitely honored.
text.感谢您的支持，希望您运货送货都能像这样顺利。: Thank you for your support. I hope your cargo deliveries continue to be as smooth as this.
text.此时将货物出手或许价格会稍低些，不过您这么打算肯定是有您自己的道理。: Selling the goods now might fetch a slightly lower price, but I'm sure you have your reasons.
text.列车长真是相当精于经商之道呀。: You're truly adept in the art of business, Conductor.
text.刚刚好的价格，不过扣除种种成本……呀，您肯定不需要妾身提醒吧？: The price is just right, but after deducting various costs... ah, I'm sure you don't need me to remind you.
text.您另有打算？那么，我就在这儿等您回心转意了。: You have other plans? Well then, I'll be here waiting for you to change your mind.
text.请您放心吧，这些货物一定都会被妾身安排去最需要它们的地方。: Rest assured, these goods will all be allocated to where they are needed most.
text.我当然理解您的难处，列车长，稍低一些也完全可以哦。: I certainly understand your difficulties, Conductor. I'm absolutely fine with lowering the price a little.
text.真的不能再降了……列车长，您难道忍心看妾身血本无归吗？: I really can't go any lower... Conductor, can you really bear to see me make a loss?
text.您真是能言善道，我都愿意多付钱买您的点子了，呵呵。: You're quite the smooth talker. I'd even pay extra for your ideas, haha.
text.真抱歉，可您带来的货物的确不能以太高价格出售……: I'm sorry, but the goods you've brought can't be sold at a high price...
text.感谢您使用本游戏,您使用本游戏前应当阅读并同意<color=#EAAA06>《用: Thank you for using this game. Before you begin, you should read and agree to the <color=#EAAA06>User Agreement</color>, <color=#EAAA06>Privacy Policy</color>, <color=#EAAA06>Children's Privacy Policy</color>, and <color=#EAAA06>Third-Party Information Sharing List</color>. By clicking agree and starting to use the product, you indicate that you understand and agree to the terms, which will be legally binding. If you refuse, you will not be able to enter the game.
text.请阅读并同意用户协议与隐私条款后，再开始使用游戏。: Please read and agree to the user agreement and privacy terms before starting the game.
text.阿妮塔的员工餐厅，部分窗口也对外开放，品质保证。: Anita's employee cafeteria. Some windows are open to the public. Quality assured.
text.阿妮塔为前来出差的人提供的住宿地点，风格简洁。: Accommodations provided by Anita for business travelers. Minimalist style.
text.拿好了，想要更多的话，就再努力一些吧。: Take it. If you want more, work a little harder.
text.虽然不是老夫亲自制造的，但也是好东西，广告词怎么说的来着……雷比斯认证，值得信赖: Although I didn't craft it personally, it's still a good item. What's the tagline... Rebis-certified, worthy of your trust.
text.非质量问题概不退换，不过老夫怎么可能犯这种错。: No returns unless there's a quality issue, but how could I make such a mistake?
text.能和我碰上面可是千载难逢的好机会，有什么问题尽管问，不过不一定全都能回答你就是了: Meeting me is a rare opportunity. Feel free to ask any questions, though I might not answer them all.
text.说起来老夫也算得上桃李满天下吧，大家都是我引以为傲的弟子。你这什么眼神，怀疑我吹: Speaking of which, I've taught many students over the years. They're all my proud disciples. What kind of look is that? Do you doubt me?
text.费尔德里奇号是在旧七号自由港建造出来的，那会真是声势浩大……结果现在呢？船和城都: The Phildridge was built in the old Freeport Ⅶ. What a grand event that was... And now? Both the ship and the city are gone.
text.在你眼里桦树生物是什么样的生物？大多数人都觉得它们是没有意识的怪物，但也不尽然，: What kind of creatures do you think Chaos remains are? Most people see them as mindless monsters, but that's not entirely true. Otherwise, they wouldn't be such a headache.
text.放心，我可不会赖账，但是那么一大笔钱老夫也不会带在身上啊……再说了，这台球没准还: Don't worry. I won't renege on a deal. However, I won't carry such a huge sum of money with me either... Besides, this cue ball might have other uses. Don't rush to a decision.
text.未满足装备该武装所需的核心条件: Core requirements for equipping this weapon are not met.
text.成群的桦树爆虫正在跟随虫后“鸣爆虫母”朝费奇号的方向迁徙，当它们感应到威胁时，会: A swarm of Blastbugs is following the Blastbug Matriarch toward the Phiggy. When they sense a threat, they will self destruct, emptying their venom sacs on intruders to protect the Matriarch. These creatures are weak against electro, fire, and frost.
text.这些徘徊在费奇号附近的深眠者是遭受形态污染之后，丧失了理智的人类个体，他们擅长制: Those Deep Sleepers wandering around the Phiggy are humans who lost their sanity after being exposed to Morphic Field Pollution. They excel at creating confusion and curses. The Deep Sleepers have trunks that sprout birch-like structures, and like trees, they are weak against fire.
text.或许你会觉得接纳所有乘员是包容的体现。但我在你身上闻到了一些熟悉而令人厌恶的气息: You may think that being accepting of all crew members shows tolerance. But I smell a familiar and loathsome scent on you... Heh.
text.你好。或许你认为这是巧遇，但世上并没有那么多巧合可言，不是吗？: Hello. You might think this is a coincidence, but there aren't so many coincidences in the world, are there?
text.希望你好好使用它们。……哦，也希望它们能对你有所帮助。: I hope you use them well... Oh, and I hope they'll be helpful.
text.我不会提供什么有效情报。我出现在这里，只是因为对你身上的气味感兴趣而已。: I won't provide any useful information. I'm here simply because I'm interested in your scent.
text.这些都是由我研发或调整过的商品，请随意挑选。质量与效果均有保证。: These are all items I've developed or modified. Feel free to take your pick. Quality and efficacy guaranteed.
text.希望我研制出的喷雾产品能应用到更多的地方。如果你能协助我进行实验，就更好了。: I hope my spray products can find application in more areas. If you could assist with experiments, that would be even better.
text.香味如何影响人的魅力从而提高交涉与经营的效率？我写过三篇相关论文，你可以去读。: How does fragrance affect one's charm and improve negotiation and management efficiency? I've written three papers on this topic. Feel free to read them.
text.黑月是个相当具有包容性的企业，至少在研究经费和商业分成上是的。: Night Chains is quite an inclusive company, at least in terms of research funding and commercial revenue sharing.
text.活动尚未达到开启时间，敬请期待: Event has not started yet, please wait.
text.这些爆虫桦树生物似乎受到了什么力量的吸引，正在不断地接近费奇号。: These Blastbug Chaos remains seem to be drawn to something and keep approaching the Phiggy.
text.不瞒你说，咱这特产品利润高的吓人，行情来的时候，使用【进货采买书】加量补仓特产品: Between you and me, the profit from our specialty goods is incredible. With the right timing and using Purchase Appl. to buy extra specialty goods, you could be as wealthy as me in no time. Seriously!!!
text.老板吩咐我让您多多购买特产，合理使用【进货采买书】加量交易特产品的话应该能快速积: The boss told me to remind you to buy more of our specialty goods. If you use Purchase Appl. wisely to increase trading volume, you should be able to accumulate wealth quickly.
text.咱们这的特产【曼德工具箱】那可是远近闻名呐，行情好的时候要不用【进货采买书】多倒: Our specialty, the Mander Toolbox, is famous far and wide. During good market conditions, why not use Purchase Appl. to trade more?
text.我听说有列车长倒腾我们这的【桦石发财树】一夜暴富了。不过这玩意产量可不多啊。: I heard there's a conductor who struck it rich overnight trading our Chaos Money Trees. But the production of these things is quite limited.
text.1.有时会在野外发现外观漆黑如骨状的【桦树浮标】，它通常寄宿着强大的桦树生物。\:
1. Sometimes, in the wilderness, you may come across jet-black, bone-like [Chaos Buoys], which are often inhabited by powerful Chaos Remains.

2. Actively engaging these [Chaos Buoys] can yield a wealth of resources, including [Duty Medals], and there's a chance of obtaining [rare equipment].

3. New [Chaos Buoys] are discovered along the railway lines every day, with those in polluted areas being even more active.

4. [Duty Medals] can be exchanged for essential strategic supplies such as [Train Armament] at [BCRL Outpost] and [Anita Weapon Factory].
text.服务器已更新，请重新登录: The server has been updated. Please log in again.
text.资源已更新，即将重启游戏！: Resources have been updated. Game will restart shortly!
text.客户端版本过低，请前往更新！: Client version is too low. Please proceed to update!
text.1.已经获得【铁盟治安协力资格证】的你，可以帮助铁安局清缴行车沿线的各种威胁，获:
1. With your qualification as a member of the B.C.R.L. Security Alliance, you can assist the BCRL Agency in clearing various threats along the railway lines and receive rewards.

2. Each city's BCRL Agency usually offers three different sequences of eviction quests. Completing all three series in a city yields:
10 Laplace Protocols, 300 Chaos Stones, 600,000 BCRL Coins, and 1,000 Reputation.
Sequence 1: Targets typically involve local insurgents.
Sequence 2: Targets usually consist of Chaos Remains along the train route.
Sequence 3: Targets are often challenging composite threats.
Upon completing all eviction quests in a city, the local BCRL Agency will assign a Duty Quest, consisting of three consecutive tasks usually located along the train route. Upon completion, you'll receive exclusive [Honor Furniture] and rare equipment for that city.

3. Cities with BCRL Agency include Freeport Ⅶ, Shoggolith City, Mander Mine, and CDCA Bureau.

4. BCRL Agency quests are vital for crew members to gain combat experience and resonance materials. They are also an effective means for Conductors to accumulate raw capital and Reputation.

5. Eviction quests offer adjustable difficulty levels. Higher difficulty levels consume more clarity during combat but correspondingly increase rewards.
text.1.当地铁安局定期会发布重大威胁悬赏通告，需要当地城市声望达到5级才可接取。\\:
1. The local BCRL Agency periodically issues bounties for major threats, requiring a minimum Reputation level of 5 to accept.

2. Bounty quests are challenging but offer substantial rewards and more Reputation. There's also a chance to obtain rare equipment.

3. Increasing the current city's Reputation will increase the number of bounty quests issued daily, up to 3.

4. Using Task Commissions allows for the immediate acquisition of a new bounty quest.

5. Bounty quests refresh daily at 5:00.
text.1.行车遭遇袭击，护卫队员迎击失败后，可进行铁安局报案处理，你可以在最近的铁安局:
1. In the event of a train attack where the escort fails to repel, you can file a report with BCRL Agency. You can find this case in the nearest BCRL Agency's Case, take the initiative to strike and clear the case, and retrieve lost items.

2. If you are unable to handle the case, you can also post the case online and offer rewards for kind-hearted people to help retrieve the lost items.

3. Each BCRL Agency only handles cases reported locally, and cases are typically kept for 7 days.

4. Daily occurrences of train robberies during transit can be checked in the online case database.

5. Assisting in resolving online cases may earn appreciation and rewards from the assisted Conductor.
text.1.在黑月旗下的休息区可以喝一杯【银枝气泡水】恢复列车长50点疲劳值。\\n\\:
1. In the Night Chains' rest area, you can have a drink of [Silver Branch Soda] to restore 50 points of fatigue.

2. Due to limited materials, the city's rest area provides only six free cups of [Silver Branch Soda] daily for Conductor. If you have the raw material [Silver Branch], you can invite Arina to prepare an additional cup for you.

3. Drinking [Silver Branch Soda] will bring you special [Business Luck], lasting 30m each time.

4. Cities currently with rest areas include: Freeport VII, Shoggolith City, Mander Mine, CDCA Bureau, Cape City, Ranshin City, Gronru City.
text.1.休息区通常配有【黑月商店】，拥有大量商品可供列车长选择。您可以买到来自黑月渠:
1. Rest Areas typically feature a [Night Chains Shop], offering a wide range of products for Conductors to choose from. You can purchase any item available through the Night Chains channel.

2. For Conductors with certain commercial capabilities:
The Night Chains Shop is an essential channel for spending [BCRL Coin] to purchase [Chaos Stone] and [Laplace Protocol].
The Night Chains Shop is also crucial for spending [BCRL Coin] to buy [Resonance Material], [Equipment], and other Escort Crew items, as well as [Purchase Appl.] and other commercial goods.

3. Most cities' Rest Areas have their own local shops, while the headquarters shop has a global connection.

4. Typically, local shops refresh their product list weekly, while the headquarters shop has its own refresh mechanism.

5. Currently, cities with a local Night Chains Shop in their Rest Area include Freeport VII, Shoggolith City, Mander Mine, CDCA Bureau, Cape City, Ranshin City, and Gronru City. Some Rest Areas do not have a local shop.

text.看来你就是那名最近经常出现在同僚们口中的列车长……你好，我是拉妲，负责铁盟哨站的: It seems you are the Conductor that my colleagues have been talking about frequently... Hello, I am Rada, in charge of various management tasks at the BCRL Outpost.
text.新的待办事项？好，我知道了。我稍后会处理的，感谢你的提醒。: New pending task? Okay, I got it. I'll handle it later. Thanks for the reminder.
text.你看上去好像……有点怕我？其实我没有看上去那么不好接触。有什么需要帮助的事，可以: You look... somewhat afraid of me? Honestly, I'm not as unapproachable as I look. If you need help, come talk to me anytime.
text.因为总是在各个站点之间调动，我被锻炼得很擅长处理各种各样的突发事件。……可以说是: I'm constantly shuffling between different stations, so I've become very good at handling various emergencies... I guess it's a blessing in disguise.
text.……怎么会这样？下次就去总部把他们都……哦，你来了。今天有什么事吗？: ...How could this happen? Next time, I'll go to headquarters and... Oh, you're here. What's up?
text.本以为在这里也干不长久……不过，现在看来，因为有了你这样的共事者，我的工作能变得: I thought I wouldn't last long here... But now it seems that with colleagues like you, my job has become easier.
text.哨站似乎有关于我过去经历的传闻。“招安”和“金盆洗手”之类的词，有些言过其实了…: There are rumors about my past at the outpost. Claims of 'amnesty' and 'washing my hands of it' are somewhat exaggerated... But I indeed wasn't a B.C.R.L. soldier back then.
text.实话说，我经常和总部的上司争吵。该说没被开除就是好运了吗……不过，我不认为忍耐对: To be honest, I frequently argue with my superiors in the headquarters. I suppose it's lucky I haven't been fired... but I don't think tolerance is good for work.
text.哦，心情不好的时候我会选加倍工作。看见工作成果后我会放松一些。: Oh, when I'm in a bad mood, I choose to double my workload. Seeing the results of my work helps me relax.
text.士兵们的安全是最重要的。在情势没有那么紧急的时候，更应该谨慎作出判断，防止无谓的: The safety of the soldiers is paramount. When the situation isn't that urgent, it's even more crucial to make careful decisions to prevent unnecessary sacrifices.
text.加班太多？我不否认。不过，我看你们列车上的部分乘员，以及你本人……都不像是有在好: Too much overtime? I don't deny it. However, I've noticed that some of your train's crew, including you, don't seem to be getting proper rest either. Why not take a break here with me?
text.呀吼~！好久不见呀列车长，现在我可是这儿的老大……咳，负责人啦！: Yahoo~! It's been a long time, Conductor. Now I'm the boss here... I mean, the person-in-charge!
text.哼哼！队长总担心我会闯祸，但列车长你看，我在这里不是适应得超级好吗！: Hmph, Captain is always worried that I'll cause trouble, but look, Conductor, I'm adapting here just fine!
text.……昨天在做实验的时候不小心把宿舍的墙炸了个洞~☆！哎嘿，没关系的，我回去就补上: ...I accidentally blew a hole in the dorm wall while doing an experiment yesterday~☆! Oh well, I'll fix it when I get back. Don't tell anyone!
text.列车长列车长，你在路上有没有碰到什么好玩的事？快和我说说，闷在这里无聊死啦——: Conductor, Conductor, did you encounter anything fun on the way? Quick, tell me about it. I'm bored stiff here —
text.你说伊洛娜会不会比我适合这种工作呢……既然不用出门的话……啊？她应该做不来？为什: Do you think Ilona would be more suitable for this job than me... If it doesn't require going out... Huh? She probably can't handle it? Why?
text.这里偶尔也有好事嘛，比如出去打打劫匪炸炸路障什么的……列车长你来了！我们一起出去: There are some good things here occasionally, like going out to fight bandits and blow up barricades... Conductor, you're here! Let's find something to do together!
text.哦！这些~都是~我精心准备的好~货！对呀，我在学我们抓来的军火贩子说话，像吧！: Yo, check out my stuff. Top-notch, real deal. You won't find them anywhere else. Yeah, I'm mimicking the arms dealer we caught. Do I sound like him?
text.选这个选这个！列车长！这个炸起来特别爽！: Pick this! Pick this! Conductor! This one explodes really spectacularly!
text.说起来……你对武器的视觉效果有什么要求吗？我最近在研究一款可以炸出多彩烟雾的雷格: Speaking of which... do you have any requirements for your weapons' look? I've been working on a Legge Bomber that can produce colorful smoke!
text.嗯嗯，虽然想要推荐适合你的，不过我觉得列车长能把这里的所有装备都用得很好！: Hmm, although I want to recommend what's best for you, I think you can make good use of all the equipment here!
text.要买吗？买吧买吧买吧列车长~！: Want it? Buy, buy, buy, Conductor~!
text.车长您真是好眼光！这是我们这里最~好的货，包响！: You have a good eye, Conductor! This is the best~ item we have, and it'll blast!
text.要好好使用哦！拿它们去打击坏蛋吧！: Use them well! Use them to fight the bad guys!
text.这是我做过改装的新型产品，效果肯定特别惊人！: This is a newly modified product I made. I'm sure the results would be stunning!
text.老板大气！大获全胜哦老板！: You're so generous, boss! Wish you a resounding victory, boss!
text.队长在海角城，副队长在7号自由港，卡莲在……卡莲应该跟着队长呢吧！: Captain is at Cape City. Vice Captain is at Freeport Ⅶ. Karen... Karen should be with Captain, I think?
text.不知道这周的烤肉派对能不能拉动伊洛娜来。伊洛娜已经十天没有和我一起参加集体活动了: I wonder if I can get Ilona to come to this week's barbecue party. Ilona hasn't joined a group activity with me in ten days! Being too introverted isn't good!
text.嗯？对抗铁盟哨站附近恶徒和劫匪的经验？当然是——和他们爆了！☆~！: Huh? My experience in dealing with villains and bandits near the BCRL Outpost? Of course, it's — blowing them up!☆~!
text.想要无拘无束地活着！当然不是说这里不好的意思，但我还是想多去外面跑一跑呀啊啊啊啊: I want to live a carefree life! Of course, I'm not saying this place is bad, but I still want to go out more, ahhh—
text.管理处的拉妲姐有点可怕？一开始我也觉得！不过她能很镇定地和我一起观察爆炸气浪，肯: Rada in the management office is a little scary? I thought so too at first! But she is able to observe the explosion waves with me calmly. This definitely means she's a great person!
text.哇……这可是稀客！需要我帮忙做些什么吗？: Wow... A rare visitor! Do you need any help?
text.出发前做好完全准备。列车长说不定很适合当探路者呢……: Make full preparations before departure. You'll make a great pathfinder, Conductor...
text.希望这些列车武装能在行程中帮上你的忙！: I hope these train weapons can assist you on your journey!
text.哈啊……好无聊！为什么让我这样的外勤人员来守摊子啦！: *Yawn* So boring! Why did they make a fieldworker like me man a booth?
text.不知道下次探索任务是去哪里呢？哎呀，反正也是和叶珏一起……: I wonder where the next exploration mission will be? Oh well, it will be with Yejue anyway...
text.代理所长……我们和她完全不熟哦所以没有八卦。不过上次好像看她吃水煮土豆吃得很开心: Acting director... We don't know her well, so no gossips about her. But she seemed really happy eating boiled potatoes the other time. I don't get it.
text.如果无垠号能开进桦树空间里，我们的探索进度大概会快上很多吧？: If only the Eternal can enter the Chaos Space. That'll speed up our exploration a lot.
text.桦树空间里唯一的优点就是没有普通的虫子了吧！嗯？你说毒爆虫……啊啊啊啊别提醒我！: The only good thing about the Chaos Space is that you don't get to see bugs in it! Huh? Blastbugs... ahhh stop saying that!
text.1.在垃圾暂存区花费铁盟币清理所有垃圾块。\\n\\n\r\r\r\r2.在荒原:
1. You can spend BCRL Coins to clean up the trash blocks stored in the repository.

2. At the Wilderness Station of Apoaster Bridge's trash recycling station, you can exchange compacted trash blocks for BCRL Coins.
1 compacted trash block can be exchanged for 250 BCRL Coins, while also earning Environment Pts.
text.1.每天5:00刷新后，可以在这里收取每节车厢产出的垃圾。\\n\\n\r\r2: 1. Here, you can collect the trash produced by all the carriages after 5:00 daily.\n\n2. The compactor compresses the trash into compacted blocks at regular intervals and stores them in the repository.
text.1.当有车厢超过48h未收取过垃圾或暂存区垃圾块超出上限时，会导致垃圾溢出。\\:
1. Trash overflow occurs when you have not collected trash from any carriage for more than 48 hours or when the stored trash blocks exceed the repository's limit.

2. Trash overflow will decrease the Max Cleanliness, affecting passenger expenditure desires.
Therefore, it is important to regularly clean up the trash.
text.1.压缩机升级至LV6后，将开启第二条压缩通道。\\n\\n\r\r2.压缩机升: 1. When your compactor reaches level 6, an additional compaction channel becomes available.\n\n2. When your compactor reaches level 11, a third compaction channel becomes available. In addition, the automatic trash collection function will be activated.

text.身份扫描中……已录入数据，非淘金乐园人员，CBCRR23列车长{playerna: Identity scan in progress... Data recorded. Non-ONEderland personnel, Conductor CBCRR23 {playername}, welcome.
text.金子小姐？检索中。本机没有关于她的更多数据，只有……不好，再说下去，就被她发现了: Miss Gold? Searching. No more data on her... oh no, if I keep talking, she'll find out.
text.金子小姐对我们很好。绝对没有强迫我们替她战斗。: Miss Gold treats us well. She definitely doesn't force us to fight for her.
text.淘金乐园的重建，多亏了列车长的帮助。: The reconstruction of the ONEderland is thanks to the Conductor's help.
text.摇滚！！！！什么是摇滚？本机也不知道，但金子小姐很喜欢这个词。: Rock 'n' Roll!!!! What is Rock 'n' Roll? This unit doesn't know, but Miss Gold really likes the term.
text.掘金机器人也负责存储关于淘金乐园的报道和记录。不过本机的这部分数据已经损坏了。: The Nugget Mech is also responsible for storing reports and records related to ONEderland, but the relevant data of this machine has already been corrupted.
text.请列车长选择心仪的武装。注，本商店售卖的工具不适合淘金用途。: Please select your desired weapon, Conductor. Note: The tools sold in our store aren't suitable for gold mining usage.
text.感谢您对淘金乐园的支持。我们下次再见。: Thank you for supporting the ONEderland. See you next time.
text.我最近在协助继续研发更多新武装。如果有需要，可以多来看看。: I'm currently assisting with continued development on more new armaments. Come by more often if you need anything.
text.我是阿妮塔的……是你啊列车长，那么不需要自我介绍了。: I'm from Anita, and my— oh, it's you, Conductor. No need for introductions, then.
text.有什么需要的列车武装？我可以提供全面的实验数据。: Is there any train armament you need? I can provide complete experimental data.
text.员工宿舍里的贩卖机经常缺货，不过西柚果汁总是不缺。: The vending machines in the staff dorms are often out of stock, though the grapefruit juice never runs low.
text.响立逃和……游戏机？是的，早期的响立逃是游戏机改装的。不过似乎不是我手上这款。: Flee Alarm and... a game console? Yes, the early Flee Alarms were converted from game consoles. Though it doesn't seem to be this particular model I have here.
text.新型无人机的研发进展很顺利。目前我驻留这里，也是为了工作方便。: Development on the new drone model is going smoothly. I'm stationed here for the time being, which makes the work more convenient.
text.上次在桦树空间中遇到危险……多亏卡莱雅的锚定能力，我们才勉强脱身。: We ran into danger in the Chaos Space last time... it was Kaleya's anchoring ability that barely got us out.
text.我看论文里说，积分制度能够提高用户重复光顾的热情。这样的话，我可以准备一些剪纸小: I read in a paper that point systems increase how willing users are to come back. In that case, I could prepare some paper-cut flowers for you as points.
text.相信这些武装能起到保护作用。不过如果感觉累了的话请务必让我来照顾您哦。: I believe these weapons can offer protection. But if you ever feel tired, please let me take care of you.
text.列车长！一路上一定辛苦了吧，要不要来休息一下？: Conductor! You've had a long journey. Want to take a break?
text.这样就没问题了……！好，请让这些武装暂时替我保护您的安全吧！: That's fine then...! Very well, let these weapons protect you on my behalf for now!
text.在这边值班……虽然很清净，不过实验时传来的震动总是让我担心我的收藏品会摔坏呢。: Being on duty here... Although it's very peaceful, the vibrations during experiments always make me worry about my collectibles breaking.
text.列车长，请加油哦。不是让您给列车加油的意思，毕竟列车也不是用油……哈哈、哈哈哈！: Conductor, keep going. I'm not asking you to keep the train going, as train can't run forever... haha, hahaha!
text.航天半导体、航地半导体、航海半导体……嗯嗯……这个要怎么编成笑话比较好呢……: Space-Grade Semicon, ground semiconductors, marine semiconductors... Hmm... how to make a joke out of these?
text.我现在还在持续学习最新的医学知识呢，毕竟我想更好地照料大家。: I'm still upskilling with the latest medical knowledge since I want to take better care of everyone.
text.据说航天中心要推出一系列火箭主题的纪念餐具。我想第一时间购入整套！: I heard the aerospace center is launching a series of rocket-themed commemorative tableware. I want to snap up the whole set as soon as it's available!
text.该界面%d天%d小时后关闭: This interface will close in %dd and %dh.
text.确定要放弃吗，主动放弃不会有补偿金: Give up? There will be no compensation.
text.虽说这里离修格里城不远，但对列车进出的限制比较严格。补给就拜托你了。: Although this place isn't far from Shoggolith City, the entry restrictions for trains are rather strict. We'll have to rely on you for supplies.
text.如果你愿意帮忙的话，能很大程度上减轻我的工作负担……: If you're willing to help, it would greatly lighten my workload...
text.不用强求。方便的时候帮忙带些物资来就可以。: No need to force it. Just bring some supplies when it's convenient.
text.恰巧有物资能分给我们的话……: If there happen to be extra supplies you can share with us...
text.谢谢你对铁盟哨站的帮助。: Thank you for helping the BCRL Outpost.
text.太好了，能松口气了。: Wonderful. I can relax a little.
text.其他订单也拜托……啊，还是别太过劳累。: Other orders too... Ah, don't overwork yourself.
text.哨站的大家都会感谢你的。: Everyone at the Outpost appreciates you.
text.很好的工作习惯。循序渐进吧。: Great work habits. Gradual progress, I guess.
text.在出发之前做好规划能够有效节约时间。: Planning ahead before departure can save time effectively.
text.择优吗……很务实的选择。: Prioritizing eh...? A very practical choice.
1. The B.C.R.L. provides three free meals to the conductor each day, which can be used to reduce Fatigue.

2. Meals are delivered at 5:00, 12:00, and 18:00 daily.
text.1.默契度高于3级的队员将有概率制作爱心便当赠送给列车长，使用后可消除疲劳值。\:
1. Crew members with a Rapport level higher than level 3 will have a chance to make Love Bentos for the Conductor, which can be used to reduce Fatigue.

2. The Conductor can receive up to three different Love Bentos each day. The bento cabinet can store up to nine Love Bentos.

3. Each crew member has different cooking skills, and using more delicious Love Bentos will reduce more Fatigue for the Conductor.

4. Love Bentos have a shelf life, and expired ones will be converted into corresponding quality pet food by Box.

5. After using a Love Bento, the Conductor can choose to rate the crew member's cooking, which will directly affect their motivation to give Love Bentos next time.
text.1号窗口的A套餐声名远播，物廉价美。外来访客也可以在此用餐。: The Set A meal at Window 1 is renowned for its quality and affordability. Visitors can also dine there.
text.方便购买书刊杂志的小店，在这里可以买到很多铁盟发行的刊物。: A convenience store for buying books and magazines, where many B.C.R.L. publications are available.
text.靛红五月为铁盟提供的专属配给点，铁盟士兵\r可以在此以优惠的价格购入商品。: Carmine May's exclusive rations point for B.C.R.L., where B.C.R.L. soldiersCan make purchases at a discounted price.
text.重要的商业场所，在此处进行商业活动需要铁盟的许可证。: An important commercial venue where conducting business activities require a B.C.R.L. permit.
text.阿妮塔科技下属的战备工厂，许多相关合作人士在此进出。: The weapon factory affiliated with Anita Tech, serving as a hub for numerous collaborators.
text.战备工厂的管理中心，在此处出入的都是内部人员和重要客户。: The Management Center of the weapon factory where insiders and important customers frequent.
text.我这里有全面的物资储备，兑换你需要的物资就好。: I have comprehensive supplies here. Just exchange for whatever you need.
text.除了铁盟配备物资之外的东西……不，我是不会给你违禁品的。: Besides supplies allocated for B.C.R.L.... no, I won't give you contraband.
text.又见面了，你看起来和之前差别不大嘛！: We meet again, and you look about the same as last time!
text.看我今天和平时有什么区别？……我的刘海可是比平时右偏了20度，这都看不出来？: Spot anything different about me today? ...My bangs are angled twenty degrees further right than normal. You really can't tell?
text.你看了客如丝新推出的联名卫衣吗，我正在犹豫白色好还是蓝色好……嗯，要不都买了吧！: Have you seen the new collab hoodie Kerisee just dropped? I can't decide between the white and the blue... mm, maybe I'll just get both.
text.诶诶诶，怎么现在才来？那些人的理解能力和效率都太差了，事情还是交给你省心。: Hey, hey, hey, what took you so long? Those people have terrible comprehension and worse efficiency. Handing things to you is so much less trouble.
text.你这次过来有没有给我的包裹？距离我下单已经过了好久，再等下去就要错过拍照发布的最: Have you got a package for me this time? It's been ages since I ordered it. Any longer and I'll miss the peak window for posting the photos!
text.突然觉得你看上去品味好了不少，肯定是因为和我相处的时间久了！: You know, your taste is looking a lot better lately. Has to be all the time you've spent around me!
text.对了，有机会能不能顺便帮我带点东西？放心，不是那种要排好几个小时的店！: Oh, right, could you pick something up for me while you're out there? Don't worry, it's not one of those places where you line up for hours!
text.要准备这么多东西还是挺烦人的，不过委托你这样的列车长就方便多了。: Pulling all this together is kind of a pain. Though it's a lot easier when I can just hand it off to you, Conductor.
text.有些东西不看名字也猜得到是谁在要，个人特色很鲜明。: With some of these I can guess who asked for it without even checking the name. People around here have very distinct tastes.
text.有什么疑问吗？做事之前先问清楚会比较好哦。: Anything you want to ask? Better to have it all clear before you head off.
text.这些正好可以应付当下的需求，真及时。: This is exactly what we needed right now. Perfect timing.
text.好像没看到我的包裹……是这次不顺路吗？: I don't see my package anywhere... was it not on your route this time?
text.东西放那就行，辛苦你了。: Just set it down over there. Thanks for making the trip.
text.这里的大多数研究员都更喜欢闷在实验室里，就把我推来管理中心了，果然论门面担当还得: Most of the researchers here would rather shut themselves in the lab, so they pushed me out to the management center. Naturally — if anyone's going to be the face of this place, it's got to be a handsome guy like me!
text.前几天有人测试武器的时候把下水道炸了，脏的要命……现在想起我还是会头晕想吐……: Someone blew out a sewer line testing a weapon the other day. It was filthy... I still get dizzy just thinking about it...
text.说真的，你不想给自己来个形象改造，提升时髦值吗？交给我的话绝对能让你焕然一新！失: Seriously, don't you want a makeover? Get your style points up? Leave it to me and you'll come out a whole new person! And if it flops, that's on— ahem, I'll buy you cake.
text.这是铁山城的同事回家探亲以后带来的特产，你要不要尝尝？说来我很久没回去了，不过我: A colleague from Fortress City brought these back from visiting family. Want to try some? Come to think of it, I haven't been home in a long while. Nobody in my family minds, though. As long as we know the others are doing all right, that's enough.
text.我觉得在阿妮塔的一众园丁里，本帅哥已经是难得的亲切了。你明白这其中的含金量吗！: Out of every Gardener at Anita, I'm about as approachable as they come, and that's rare, believe me. Do you have any idea what that's worth?!
text.既然这样的话，我想想选哪些订单给你好呢……: In that case, let me think about which orders to give you...
text.这样选吗？也不错。: Going with this one? Not a bad pick.
text.居然想到一块去了，我刚才也觉得选这个好！: Huh, same page — that's the one I was leaning toward too!
text.改变主意也是常事。: People change their minds all the time.
text.随便选吧，无论是功能还是外观，我们阿妮塔的东西都值得考验哦。: Take your pick. Function or looks, Anita's stuff holds up either way.
text.我想到一个主意，在这些物品里添加本帅哥的签名照怎么样？什么？不要？拒绝的太快了吧: I've got an idea. What if I tossed a signed photo of yours truly into these packages? What? No? That was a fast no!
text.消息灵通如您，想必也听说有人正在<color=#b45e01>{station}: As well-informed as you are, you must have heard about someone currently purchasing <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> at a high price at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>, right?
text.最近<color=#b45e01>{station}</color><color: The price of <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> has plunged at <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> of late. You'd best not go there to sell!
text.荒原站周边的桦树生物一直很多，您在这一带活动可要当心。: Around the Wilderness Station, there have always been many CRs, so you should be careful when moving around this area.
text.在流民营地偶尔也能见到一些孩子，据说有些人从祖父那一辈就是流民了。: Occasionally, some children can be seen in the refugee camp. It is said that some have been refugees since their grandparents' generation.
text.炒蛋是淘金乐园的名菜，据说第一位在此发迹的淘金者就很喜欢吃蛋炒培根。: Scrambled eggs are a signature dish at ONEderland, and it is said that the first prospector to strike it rich here really enjoyed eating egg-fried bacon.
text.淘金乐园的创办人背后是一个有头有脸的大家族，在曾经的修格里城非常有名望。: The founder of ONEderland comes from a prominent family in the former Shoggolith City.
text.铁盟哨站是附近铁安局队伍的主要屯驻地，这里的安全等级很高。: The BCRL Outpost is the main garrison of the nearby BCRL Agency, and the security level here is very high.
text.哨站的客户大多是这里的铁盟士兵……他们的订单很有特色，一眼就能看出来。: Most of the customers at the outpost are B.C.R.L. soldiers... Their orders are quite distinctive and easy to recognize at a glance.
text.这可是阿妮塔的研发重地。据说不少新兴武器都从这里出产……: This is Anita's research and development hub. It is said that many emerging weapons are produced here...
text.阿妮塔的员工里，怪脾气的人还挺多的。……不不，我什么都没说，老板！: There are quite a few quirky people among Anita's staff... No, I didn't say anything, boss!
text.虽然荒原站的物资不多，但是绿松石可是其他产地的同类商品也无法替代的。: There may not be many resources at Wilderness Station, but Turquoise is something that even similar products from elsewhere can't replace.
text.沙金一直都是淘金乐园非常受欢迎的商品。: Gold Sand has always been a top-selling product of ONEderland.
text.绿松石一向卖得很好，想必您在其他地方有多少听说过一点吧？: Turquoise is constantly in high demand. I'm sure you've heard a thing or two about it elsewhere, yes?
text.说起淘金乐园出口量最大的商品，毫无疑问就是沙金。: Without a question, Gold Sand is the most exported product of ONEderland.

text.从修格里商会墨伊拉处得知最近出现了一个新的红茶供应商，准备推广他们全新培育和制作:
Moirai of the Shoggolith Chamber of Commerce has shared information regarding a new black tea supplier and their promotional campaign for their newly cultivated black tea. The current prices for purchasing black tea are at their lowest ever. To learn more details, please visit COLUMBA in Shoggolith City and talk with Moirai.

Event Instructions
1. All registered Conductors will participate in the event once it starts. During the Black Tea War event, the buying price of black tea in Shoggolith City will fluctuate between 50% and 90%, while the selling price in other regions will fluctuate between 110% and 150%. This presents a lucrative opportunity for trading and profit-making. Additionally, new purchase orders for black tea will be available at COLUMBA in Shoggolith City.

Individual and Server Progress
By trading black tea, Conductors can accumulate individual and server progress. As the progress reaches certain levels, Conductors can claim the Black Tea War commemorative cards, "Key of Syzygy" along with other rewards. Meanwhile, you will enjoy server-wide business bonus effects.
The server progress will be updated every hour.

Event Achievement
By trading black tea and completing main event stages, Conductors can unlock event achievements. As achievement progress reaches certain levels, Conductors can claim Black Tea War commemorative cards and other rewards.

Black Tea War Commemorative Cards
Black Tea War commemorative cards can only be obtained from the Black Tea War event. There are a total of 7 commemorative cards (Key of Syzygy), and Conductors can collect them all by unlocking rewards and achievements. These keys will have future uses in upcoming versions, so please stay tuned for updates.

Pts Collection
All participants can obtain Allowance Pts by completing black tea purchase orders and repeatedly challenging event battles. Once you have collected enough Allowance Pts, you may use them to exchange for various rewards in the event exchange shop, including Eliot's skin "Free Time," Laplace Protocols, crew member equipment, train weapons, Purchase Appl., Slab Shards, and more.
text.欢迎光临——我是本次兑换处的接待员墨伊拉……欸？是你啊。太好了，加油吧。: Welcome — I'm Moirai, the receptionist for this Exchange... Oh? It's you. Awesome, keep up the good work.
text.嗯嗯，列车长真棒！下次也要带很多集章来哦。: Yeah, you're amazing, Conductor! Remember to bring lots of stamps next time too!
text.有什么想要的东西就和我说，虽然我也不会负责进货，所以其实没有办法带来给你哦。: Tell me what you want. However, I'm not responsible for order stocks, so there's actually no way I can bring it in for you.
text.感觉你逐渐成为具有商业头脑的列车长了呢……: You seem to be developing quite the business acumen, Conductor...
text.有什么中意的商品就下手吧，防止被其他努力过头的列车长抢先了。: Get the items you like first, so other overly hardworking conductors don't beat you to it.
text.感谢您对科伦巴商会工作的支持。呀，好像你理论上算是我的同事？: Thank you for supporting COLUMBA's work. Hey, you're technically a colleague of mine, right?
text.感谢您对科伦巴商会工作的支持，但您选择的商品已经售罄了哦。还是考虑下其他的好啦…: Thank you for supporting COLUMBA's work. However, the item you selected is sold out. You'd better choose something else...
text.让我看看……啊，你根本没凑到足够的兑换材料呢。别想着蒙混过关哦。: Let me see... Oh, you didn't gather enough exchange materials. Don't try to bluff your way through.
text.哈啊……这里的工作比在商会的要清闲一些。该把我没拼完的拼图带来了……: Yawn.. The work here is a bit less hectic than in the COLUMBA. Maybe I should bring the unfinished puzzle...
text.会长说“这次的活动很重要”，所以派我来这里了。我这次算是赢过那女人了吧……下次见: The president said ,'This event is very important.' So she sent me here. This time I might have outdone that woman... Next time I see her, I'll have to show off a little.
text.听说最近修格里的地下帮派斗争很激烈。我之前见过鼹鼠帮的首领……真受不了，那种……: I heard the underground factions in Shoggolith have been in fierce fighting lately. I've met the leader of MoleGang before... Seriously can't stand it, that kind of... Mole.
text.梅迪奇女士似乎很欣赏你最近的工作成果，列车长。请再接再厉。: Signora Medici seems to appreciate your recent work, Conductor. Keep up the good work.
text.之前的签到簿奖励也是我负责发放的。当时同事还说我是“修格里商会的明星”所以把我印: I was previously in charge of distributing the attendance rewards. Back then, my colleagues even called me the 'star of the Shoggolith COLUMBA' and so they put my face on the signpost at the entrance... Uh, as annoying as that is, it's also how we met, right?

text.听说最近修格里的什么平价红茶卖得可热闹了，但要我说还是品质最重要。: I heard through the grapevine that Shoggolith's affordable Black Tea has been flying off the shelves. Still, quality matters most in my opinion.
text.来看看新货？哎呀，不管流行趋势怎么样，生意还是得做嘛！: Come check out what's new? Well, no matter what's in trend, business has to go on!
text.修格里城的红茶好像是什么特殊发酵罐做的，感觉真有意思，你要不要也研究一下？: The Black Tea of Shoggolith City seems to be made via some kind of special fermenter. Interesting, yeah? Why don't you look into it?
text.欢迎欢迎。您一定已经知道修格里城发生的事了吧！要不要去那边看看？: Welcome, welcome. I bet you already know what has happened in Shoggolith City, right?! Want to go check it out together?
text.啊哈哈，大家都被那个新世代红茶迷得团团转了！说不定喝了以后会觉得整个人都焕然一新: Ahaha! Everyone has lost their minds over that New Gen Black Tea! Who knows, maybe drinking it might just make you feel revitalized!
text.红茶啊，真不错……闻到那个香气，我也在想要不要来一杯……: Black Tea, huh? Not bad... That fragrance also makes me consider if I should get a cup...
text.“红茶畅销的内幕”？您在说什么呢，妾身一点儿都听不明白……: "The inside scoop of what makes Black Tea sell?" What are you talking about? I don't understand...
text.都说咱们这个站的怪人多，要我说，哪有什么怪人？不过是得不到世人的理解罢了。: People often say that there are many weirdos at our station. But if you ask me, where are the weirdos? It's just that they aren't understood by the world.
text.听说那个什么，代站长？所长？又研究出了什么新发明，惦记着让你去呢。: I heard that the acting station chief or director has come up with some new invention and is thinking about getting you involved.
text.图浩那小子，打小就跟着我学东西。听说他现在干得不错？也算是青出于蓝胜于蓝吧。: That kid Wealt was trained by me from when he was a mere child. He is said to be doing pretty well nowadays, huh? I guess he has outshined his teacher.
text.哎哟，今天这腰，腿……疼疼疼疼。年纪大了？吃药？我不吃！: Argh, what's with my back today? And legs... Ow, ow, ow! I'm getting old? Take medication? No way!
text.年纪大了就好吃点甜的。年轻人，你晓得哪里能买到那个什么，红色包装的巧克力吗？: The older one gets, the more of a sweet tooth one has. Young one, any idea where to get that, um, chocolate in red packaging?
text.这里虽然是新兴技术汇集的地方，但也藏着许多秘密。如果有心，或许能发现些什么。: Even though this is where emerging technologies foregather, it also has many hidden secrets. You might just find a little something if you really look for it.
text.远离家里那些琐碎的事务真开心……啊，您别介意，我就随便说说。: The joy of getting away from those trifling household matters... Ah, don't mind me. I'm just running my mouth.
text.<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>最近很抢手，您务必要: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> are being snapped up lately. Make sure to seize the opportunity, Conductor.
text.说来有趣，我自幼就被父亲说，要背负家族产业……可是家族的产业当真轮到我来传承吗？: Interestingly enough, since I was young, my father always told me I would have to take over the family business... But is it really my turn to succeed it?
text.您说符渝姐和符游大哥又吵了一架？啊呀，这可真是……关我何事。: You said Goldiana and Richmont fought again? Goodness, how... does it concern me?

text.1）本游戏是一款融合了列车经营、冒险、即时卡牌策略和贸易要素的的角色扮演游戏，适: 1) This game is a role-playing game that combines train Management, adventure, real-time card strategy, and trade elements. It is suitable for users aged 12 and above. Minors are advised to play this game under parental supervision.2) This game takes place in a near-future setting and offers rich content, including strategic lineup and deck configuration, interactive development, and a story-driven plot to engage players.3) This game features an identity authentication system. Minors are subject to the following restrictions:[In-game Purchase Limitations]Certain in-game features or items require payment. Minors under 8 years old cannot make payments. Minors between 8 and 16 years old can only pay up to $50 per transaction and up to $200 per month. Minors above 16 years old can only pay up to $100 per transaction and up to $400 per month.[Game Duration Limitaions]Minors can only play this game from 20:00 to 21:00 on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and other holidays.4) In this game, players can progress through main quests and immerse themselves in the world of Resonance. With over 500 types of character cards, more than 100,000 combat strategy combinations, and a wide variety of game modes, this game features refreshing combat experiences and stunning skill effects, providing ultimate satisfaction for card-game enthusiasts!
