text.“我们的路，我们自己造！”\r\r\\n\r\r阿妮塔发射中心预备再次向外界开放:
"We build our own way!"
As Anita Launch Center prepares to reopen to the public, please head to Freeport Ⅶ and assist B.C.R.L and Anita in rebuilding the railroad to the Launch Center, Conductor!

Gameplay
With the pacification of the Western Continent, the Launch Center is now ready to open to the public.
Thanks to the Conductor, the turmoil in the Western Continent has gradually subsided, at least on the surface. Anita Launch Center, previously closed for various reasons, is set to be reopened to the public. However, the construction of the bridge to the Launch Center must be completed for this to happen... "Vostok", an Anita employee, has appeared in Freeport Ⅶ and entrusted the Conductor with a task.

Complete quests to advance the Construction.
By completing quests assigned by Vostok, Conductors can advance the Construction of the bridge.
Orders: Head to Freeport Ⅶ and deliver essential materials to construction sites to earn rewards and gain Construction Pts.
Eviction Tasks: Eliminate monsters that impede the construction to earn rewards and gain Construction Pts.

Advance the server-wide progress and establish a brand new city!
"This Road that I Build" Phase 1 features both server-wide progress and individual progress.
When the server-wide progress reaches its maximum, a new city called "Anita Launch Center" will be unlocked. Upon completing the final phase of your individual progress, you will receive a Launch Center Pass and gain access to the new city.

Glory to the most diligent Conductors!
To encourage Conductors to participate in the construction, Anita will track the Construction Pts of all Conductors and reward those who diligently contribute.

Construction Rewards
Advancing individual progress grants you the following rewards: Simulated Stars, Mobius, "This Road that I Build Phase 1" Card Packs, Chaos Stones, and Nebula Matter. Upon completing your individual progress, you will receive a Launch Center Pass.
Advancing server-wide progress grants you the following rewards: Duty Medals, Sacrifice Medals, "This Road that I Build Phase 1" Card Packs, Armament License, EX Armament License, and NC Vouchers.
text.有什么我能帮忙的吗！啊，您先看着，先看着……: Can I help you with anything? Ah, please, take your time to look around...
text.需要什么的话随时来和我说哦……！: Don't hesitate to let me know if you need something...!
text.……列、列车长？！居然……还能见到其他活人……我在这里等了好久了……呜呜呜哇啊啊: ...C-Conductor?! I can't believe... I can still get to see other living people... I've been waiting here for ages... (wails)
text.抱歉！之前失态了！我、我是卢米娜，虽然现在说这话有点没有可信度……但请相信我！我: Sorry you had to see that earlier! I-I am Lumina. I know I don't sound very credible saying this now, but please believe me! I will finish my job with dedication!
text.发射中心是个很有年代的站点……它的历史比我的年纪还大好几倍呢。在这里工作，总觉得: The launch center is an archaic station... Its history is multifold that of my age! There isn't a day that goes by where I don't feel nervous working here...!
text.列车长！我觉得最近的工作都非常顺利，这其中肯定有您的一份功劳吧！: Conductor! I feel like work has been going extremely smoothly these days. I'm sure you have a part to play in this!
text.呜呜……果然{playername}不在的时间很难熬……我时刻都在担心，如果大桥: (sobs) Sure enough, things are tough without {playername} around... I keep worrying about what to do if the bridge is destroyed by Chaos Remains again...
text.列车长！我已经下定决心了！不论出现什么情况，我都会继续坚守在发射中心……我一定会: Conductor! I've made up my mind! Regardless of what happens, I will continue safeguarding the launch center... I vow to become an outstanding receptionist!
text.季卡先生经常过来找我聊天，还说让我放轻松之类的……但是要怎么才能变成他那样呢？感: Mr. Jika often comes to chat with me, telling me things like how I should relax and so on... But what do I have to do to be like him? Feels like it will require a lot of effort to appear relaxed...
text.沃斯托克小姐是个信念坚定的人呢。我觉得我还没有达到她那样的境地，所以我应该加倍努: Miss Vostok is someone with unwavering faith. I don't think I've reached her level yet, so I gotta work extra hard at it!
text.发射中心的档案系统非常复杂……从手写和打印的资料，到资料库系统里的电子档文件……: The filing system of the launch center is exceptionally complicated... From handwritten to printed materials, and then digital files in the database system... It's truly... not an easy job. Ahaha...
text.我一直想换一副新眼镜！但是总是没空去篝火城里……您觉得什么样的眼镜比较时髦呢？我: I've been thinking of getting a new pair of glasses since forever! But there was never time for me to visit the Bonfire City... What kind of glasses do you think are more trendy? I'd like to hear everyone's opinions before getting a pair when I'm free!
text.我会画海报哦！其实我还蛮擅长画各种各样的东西的，你看，这是我涂鸦的仙人掌……就是: I can draw posters! To be honest, I'm pretty good at drawing all sorts of things. See, this is a cactus I doodled... It's the mascot of that chewing gum! So cute, right?!
text.好的！我会在这里等您回来！: Okay! I will wait here for your return!
text.希望您顺利完成订单。: May you complete the order without a hitch.
text.欸？是、是突然不想干了吗？！: Huh? Y-You don't wanna do it anymore?!
text.请不要把我丢在这里啊——！！: Please don't leave me alone hereeeee!
text.今天的工作已经全部完成了！明天……明天您还会到这里来吗？: Today's work is fully done! Tomorrow... Will you come again tomorrow?
text.好的！您是想看点新订单对吧！: Sure! You wanna check out New Orders, right?
text.太好了！有人来给我们帮忙了！你一定是来帮忙的，对吧？: Awesome! Someone is here to give us a hand! You must be here to help, correct?
text.7号自由港虽然好，但我还是想快点回去继续做研究啊。所以列车长，帮帮我们发射中心吧: Freeport Ⅶ may be nice, but I'd still rather get back to my research sooner. So, Conductor, please help with our launch center...!
text.嗯……发射中心是个什么样的地方？不算很新，不算很先进，但绝对绝对很有趣！要和我一: Mm? What is the launch center like? Well, it's not very new or advanced, but it's 100% interesting! Fancy a tour with me, Conductor?
text.我所从事的研究是航天学——你说航天学不存在了？不存在了又怎么样！我还是在研究啊！: My field of study is astronautics. Astronautics no longer exist? So what if it doesn't? I'll still study it!
text.篝火城也有好的地方，比如能随时去饮料店买靛红五月的各种饮料……哎，可惜货架上没有: There are good places in the Bonfire City too. For example, I can go to the beverage store to get all kinds of Carmine May beverages at any time... It's such a shame they don't carry Pear Soda, though. Times are really changing....
text.不知道我那个研究无线电的朋友现在又跑到了哪里……要是她能来帮忙做指挥调度工作，说: I wonder where my friend, who studies radio waves, has gone to now... If she could come to help with directing and dispatching, perhaps the reconstruction would take much less time.
text.欸？！原来你真的是来参加建设计划的！我太开心啦——之前也没有不指望你的意思哦！: Huh?! So you're really here to join the construction project! This is fantastic! I totally had faith in you before this too!
text.我就说嘛！这位看起来就很可靠的列车长肯定会帮忙的！好，接下来也要继续支持我们哦！: See! As I said, this incredibly reliable-looking conductor will definitely pitch in! All right, don't forget to keep supporting us after this too!
text.呀呼！又见面啦，无垠号的列车长~还是说，现在应该叫你“发射中心大桥援建人”更好呢: Yahoo! We meet again, Conductor of The Eternal! Or is it better if I call you the "Builder of the Launch Center's Bridge" now?
text.和桦树空间探索不同，建设工作总是要和人打交道……但变数倒也不比桦树空间里的少。毕: Construction work requires constant human interaction, unlike exploration of the Chaos Space... but the variables aren't any fewer either, considering Vostok had me take a shift here without any prior warning...
text.这段时间听说了不少关于你的传闻，看来你逐渐成为一名成熟可靠的列车长了呢。就保持这: I've heard plenty of rumors about you recently. Looks like you've slowly become a mature, dependable conductor, huh? Keep it up!
text.好久没逛街了，等下班后我要去商业区逛逛，买点儿东西。你要不要和我一起呀？: It's been forever since I last went shopping. I'm gonna go downtown to get some stuff after work later. Would you like to join me?
text.工地的灰尘真是对头发不好。唔，等苔妮来了，我要和她交流一下护发秘诀。: The dust on the construction site is seriously awful for my hair. Hmm, once Tennie comes, I'll have to ask her about haircare tips.
text.发射中心附近的形态场其实不太适合频繁的火箭实验。不过他们好像不打算放弃，甚至还有: The Morphic Field near the launch center is actually unsuitable for regular rocket testing, but I don't think they're planning to give up yet. They even have a comprehensive response plan... No way I can turn down their request for help, right? Especially when there's a reward for it.
text.我也会尽力给你提供技术援助的，放心吧！: Don't worry! I'll do my best to provide technical assistance too.
text.检查完了，没有问题！谢谢你带来货物。那么下一个安排什么好呢……: All checked and cleared! Thanks for bring the goods. Hmm, what should be next...?
text.你好！我是季卡！铁安局局长？不在这里哦，他出去了，我只是一名小小的售票员……你说: Hello! I'm Jika! The BCRL Agency's bureau chief? He has left the office. I'm merely an office clerk... Oh, I'm the face of the bureau chief in the files? Heheh, you caught me.
text.这下我不会跟你乱开玩笑了！我保证，我们家族对列车长超友好的！: I won't pull your leg this time anymore! I promise, my family is extremely fond of conductors!
text.貂亚人也能在铁安局工作的，别见外。我觉得我算是铁安局里很努力的类型哦！: Wereferrets are also allowed to work in the BCRL Agency too. Don't be surprised. I reckon I'm considered incredibly hard-working in here!
text.呀，我刚刚接到通讯，说是大桥又被桦树生物阻断了！——嘿嘿，逗你玩儿的，最近我们可: Gah, I just got word that the Chaos Remains have obstructed the bridge again! Heheh, just kidding! We have intensified the monitoring of the Chaos Remains' activities recently.
text.嗯……嗯嗯……（嗅嗅）最近有了您常来帮忙，这里的空气都清新多了。多谢啦，{pla: Mm... Mm-hmm... (sniffs) With you coming over to help out lately, even the air here has gotten much fresher. Thanks a lot, {playername}!
text.列车长，您最近的表现值得我的敬意……嘿咻——敬礼！: Conductor, your recent performance has left me in awe... Salute!
text.要看看有什么能干的活儿吗？: Wanna check out the tasks up for grabs?
text.你能来帮忙简直太好了！这里从前一直是没什么人的站点，说实话挺无聊的……: It will be fantastic if you help out here! This has always been an unfrequented station. Truth be told, it's pretty boring...
text.如果你能常来的话，大桥的安全应该也不用担心了吧。: If you can come often, I think the bridge's safety is basically assured.
text.哇啊！我刚从桌底下钻出来，怎么外面又一阵乒铃乓啷轰隆轰隆的？！又是在做什么实验呀: Woah! I just crawled out from under the desk. What's with all the commotion out there again?! Is it another experiment?
text.我的工作还挺闲的，有桦树生物就打，打不过的话就让大家都回来避难躲着呗……但现在呢: My job is quite laidback. I fight Chaos Remains when they appear. If I can't defeat them, I'll just get everyone back to hide out until it's safe... But now, without Chaos Remains, I have to learn to find some stuff to do. Come on, let's go see what Lumina is doing and prank her a little.
text.你要不要吃海盐冰棍儿？味道很清爽的！还是海豹奶茶店前几年的限定款呢，我把活动结束: Want a Sea Salt Popsicle? It tastes so refreshing! And it's even the limited-edition menu item of Seal's Tea Shop a few years back. I bought all of their leftover inventory after the promotion ended and stored them all in Vostok's cutting-edge freezer. She gave me permission!
text.我是在地联快完蛋那会儿在北边出生的！一个小村里的人给我起了名字，意思是“星星”。: I was born in the North when the Earth Union was about to be dead in the water! The people of a small village gave me my name, which means 'star.' I wonder how that village is doing now. There's been no information about them in the records so far... (sobs)
text.好像哪儿的新奇东西好卖，叫什么来着……对了，<color=#b45e01>{go: There's this novelty item that has been flying off the shelves. What's it called again...? Ah, right, <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>. Did you stock up on it? Let me see!
text.这个地方啊，从前可是阿妮塔航天研究的中心。可要是说实验成功，估计还有很长的路要走: This place used to be the center of Anita's space research. But if we're talking about a successful experiment, there's probably still a long way to go...
text.我在这里就是图个清静。实验场太吵？呵呵，我说的是人间纷纷扰扰……: I'm here just for some peace and quiet. Is the testing ground too noisy? Haha, I'm talking about the hustle and bustle of the human world...
text.啊呀，不知道符渝那孩子最近过得好不好。她不会亏着自己，我知道，可……哎。: (sighs) I hope Goldiana is doing all right. I know she won't let herself suffer, but... Haa...
text.我现在最想见到的场面，是我们一大家子能和和气气坐在一起吃顿饭。: What I want to see most now is our entire family sitting down for a meal harmoniously.
text.最近天气不好，括卓那老家伙肯定又要叫着腰疼腿疼了。叫他锻炼，他也不听，只会在屋里: The weather has been terrible lately. I bet that geezer Luxorian is going to complain about back and leg pains again. I already told him to start working out, but he refuses and rather stays in the house.
text.仓库的风水也很重要的，你要是不介意，我给你俩摆件摆上。: The geomancy of a warehouse is also of the essence. If you don't mind, I can give you two ornaments to put up.
text.您该不会想在仓库里小睡一觉吧？呵呵，只是开玩笑。: Don't tell me you're planning to take a nap in the warehouse? (chuckles) Just joking.
text.年轻人要学会有舍有得……: Youngsters really need to learn to give and take...
text.你尽管看，只要你提，我能用货把你这仓库都给装满了！: Feel free to look around. As long as you say the word, I'll stuff your warehouse full with goods!
text.让货物流转起来才是生财之道，别囤着了。: Keeping the goods moving is the only way to make money. Quit stockpiling them.
text.打算把仓库清理出来好从我这进货是吧？欢迎！: Intending to clear out your warehouse to get your stock from me, huh? Welcome!
text.咱们这儿的蜂窝防热烧蚀材料可好使了，你不整点儿？: Our HTPA Materials are top of the line. Are you not getting some?
text.咱们这儿的高导热陶瓷可好使了，你不整点儿？: Our HTC Ceramic are top of the line. Are you not getting some?
text.咱们这儿的航天半导体可好使了，你不整点儿？: Our Space-Grade Semicon are top of the line. Are you not getting some?
text.咱们这儿的太阳电池阵可好使了，你不整点儿？: Our Solar Cell Array is top of the line. Are you not getting some?
text.澄明数据中心的扬声器最近在各地都很畅销呢。: The CDCA Bureau's Speaker has been selling out everywhere these days.
text.澄明数据中心的银矿石最近在各地都很畅销呢。: The CDCA Bureau's Silver Ore has been selling out everywhere these days.
text.澄明数据中心的游戏机最近在各地都很畅销呢。: The CDCA Bureau's Gaming Console has been selling out everywhere these days.
text.澄明数据中心的游戏卡带最近在各地都很畅销呢。: The CDCA Bureau's Game Cartridge has been selling out everywhere these days.
text.哟呵！初次见面初次见面，我是沃斯托克，算是这里的……呃，头目吧！只要打倒我和身后: Yoohoo! Nice to meet you. I'm Vostok, basically the... uh, boss of here! You are free to run this place, provided that you defeat me and the big gun behind me. Come on in, adventurer!
text.欸？上次说的话是开玩笑的。无论如何我都不会把发射基地的管理权限拱手让人的，毕竟这: Ah? I was only joking previously. There's no way in hell I'll give up the launch base's management right to others when this is the most beloved place of mine! Still, you are welcome to visit anytime!
text.好困啊今天……昨天熬太晚了我都不记得我睡了多久。但是我还是会好好工作的，嗯嗯，嗯: I'm so sleepy... I don't even remember how much sleep I got after staying up last night. Regardless, I will do my job well. Mm-hmm, mm... (dozes off)
text.谢谢你协助我——们的工作！我觉得你是个非常优秀的列车长哦，真的真的。: Thank you for assisting my... our jobs! You are truly a one-of-a-kind conductor.
text.你又来啦！太好了，我这里有最新的试验成果，你要不拿去看看？作为交换，我也想看看你: You're here again! Wonderful. I've got the newest test result. Do you want to take a look? In exchange, I'd like to see your navigation log!

Event Rules
I. Complete the Storyline and Explore the "Haunted" Apartment
CDCA is bustling with tourists during the CDCA Carnival, yet an unexpected incident unfolded when 10rounds releases its latest horror game "Dreamless City." As the event progresses, a total of eight "Dipped in Flat" stages will unlock, and Conductors can re-challenge these stages for rewards. Later on, new "Dive in Deep" stages will unlock, offering engaging battles and generous rewards.

Participate in the event and clear stages to obtain Redundant Data, which can be exchanged for various items including Laplace Protocols, Silver Branches, Purchase Appl., Self-Observe Films, and character skins at the Haunted Bazaar.

This event introduces an event quest system "Bizarre Tales." By completing event quests, Conductors can obtain splendid rewards, including Chaos Stones, Cactus Lollipops, and Commemorative Pack: Haunted CDCA.

Crew Anecdotes are personal stories about specific crew members. To unlock these stories, you need to complete all the prerequisite main quests. Only one crew anecdote can be progressed at a time.

You can suspend an ongoing anecdote in order to start a new one or resume a suspended anecdote.

When an anecdote is suspended, the game progress will be saved at the latest checkpoint, and you can resume your progress at any time. However, if an anecdote is suspended between multiple consecutive combats, the combat progress will not be saved, and you will need to start from the first combat after resuming.

You can review a completed anecdote by selecting it and pressing Rewind, or review any specific anecdote via the Train Log interface.

text.一、承包内容\\n\r\r\r\r整顿中心及生产车间的管理、生产及运营。\\n\:
I. Scope of Contracting
Party B shall be responsible for the management, production, and operation of the Reforming Center and workshops.
II. Rights and Obligations of Party A
1. Party A shall provide Party B with suitable production facilities, <color=#cc6e0a>including a production workshop, a working area consisting of two rows, a dormitory, two living areas, six sewing machines, and an onboard sewing machine.</color>
2. Party A shall provide Party B with the necessary site, water, electricity, and security services.
3. Party A shall provide assistance to Party B when Party B conducts management, production, sales, and other activities in compliance with laws and regulations.
4. Party A shall supervise Party B's management, production, sales, and other activities in accordance with laws and regulations. If Party B violates the terms of the contract or laws and regulations, Party A reserves the right to revoke the management authority of the Reforming Center and production workshop.
III. Rights and Obligations of Party B
1. Party B shall pay Party A a leasing cost of 1,280,000 BCRL Coins for the workshop and the dormitory, and an operation and maintenance cost of 2,000,000 BCRL Coins for the Reforming Center, <color=#cc6e0a>totaling 3,280,000 BCRL Coins</color> as the contracting cost.
2. Party B shall develop production plans, carry out production and sales activities in compliance with relevant laws and regulations, and accept supervision from Party A.
3. Party B shall manage criminals in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations, and report to Party A through the formal process.
4. Party B shall assume full responsibility for all profits and losses arising from the production and sales of the workshop.

Suppliers interviewed have mentioned their plans to replenish their stocks as soon as possible, although the market price is expected to rise accordingly. The exact rate of increase, however, remains 'difficult to determine.'
text.多种矿石呈现涨价态势 多家供应商上调对外报价: Ore Prices on the Rise: Suppliers Respond with Higher Offers
text.多种矿石的价格连日来持续上涨，市场分析师指出该现象与西大陆对矿石需求量的增长有关: Prices for several types of ores have been steadily increasing over the past few days. Market analysts attribute this phenomenon to the growing demand for ores in the Western Continent. Some investors express their intention to closely monitor the downstream processing industry, as well as market supply and demand changes, in order to gauge the market outlook and seize potential investment opportunities.
text.最新环保政策出台 合金价格上涨: Environmental Policy Effects Cause Alloy Prices to Soar
text.因各大篝火城最新环保政策的出台，多家合金企业面临生产成本的增加，不得不上投入更多: Due to the implementation of the latest environmental protection policy in various Bonfire Cities, several alloy companies are facing heightened production costs. Consequently, they have had to allocate additional resources to research and development to enhance their production processes, resulting in a temporary shortage of supply in the alloy market. Industry insiders affirm their commitment to promptly completing transformations and upgrades to restore market order.
text.西大陆铁路建设稳步推进: Steady Progress in Western Continent Railroad Construction
text.铁盟于近日组织召开关于西大陆铁路建设的工程研讨会，会上，与会人员纷纷表现出对于推: The B.C.R.L. recently organized an engineering seminar on the construction of railroads in the Western Continent, where participants expressed confidence in advancing the project. Representatives from the technical departments of the B.C.R.L., Anita Tech, and third-party surveying companies shared their insights on maintaining and upgrading railroads, as well as prioritizing the development of new routes to expedite railroad construction in the Western Continent.
text.新一轮篝火旧城改造规划正式启动: New Renovation Project for Revitalizing Bonfire Cities
text.一直以来，各大篝火城高度关注城市综合居住质量，坚持统筹推进旧城区升级改造，已顺应: Bonfire Cities have consistently prioritized comprehensive urban development, placing emphasis on the revitalization and renovation of older urban areas. Several renovation projects have already been completed in response to public demands and future development plans. The current project focuses on enhancing public service facilities, improving living conditions, enhancing safety measures, and meeting other public needs.
text.全新扶持政策出台 新能源产业前景一片大好: New Policies Usher in a Promising Era for the New Energy Industry
text.各大篝火城纷纷推出对新能源产业的扶持政策，包括但不限于税费减免、运输商会补贴等，: Bonfire Cities have implemented policies to support the new energy industry, such as tax breaks and subsidies for transportation CoC. These policies effectively stimulate consumption within the new energy market. Many interviewees express optimism regarding the future of the new energy market and anticipate impressive performance in the coming years. Please note that specific policies may vary among different Bonfire Cities, and it is advisable to visit the town hall for more detailed information.
text.原油出产地限制出口 各地燃油价格上涨: Export Restrictions: Fuel Prices Seethe Worldwide
text.由于几个主要的原油出产地开始限制原油的出口量，各地的燃油产品价格不得不进行上调。: Fuel prices have risen as a result of export limitations imposed by several major crude oil producers. Reports suggest that these producers are dissatisfied with the current prices offered by buyers, leading them to increase the prices of their crude oil exports.
text.电子产品技术升级 市场竞争力稳步上升: Technological Advancements Drive Market Competitiveness in Electronics Industry
text.随着电子产品企业对技术研发创新的持续投入、与其他领域高新技术的融合，各领域的电子: The electronics industry is currently undergoing a new wave of product upgrades across various sectors, driven by ongoing investments in Tech development, innovation, and the integration of high Tech with other fields. This has effectively increased the value added to products and enhanced market competitiveness. The recent research conducted by Anita Tech in this field has garnered significant attention, further bolstering the positive prospects of the industry.
text.近日，知名游戏公司Ten Rounds发售了一款新作。该作早在研发阶段就备受瞩目: Recently, 10Rounds, a prominent game company, released a highly anticipated new game. The game generated significant attention throughout its development phase and, upon its official launch, received praise for its exceptional gameplay experience. It swiftly gained recognition as the game of the year among gamers. Notably, the game's popularity transcended the gaming community, inspiring non-gamers to invest in consoles and partake in the excitement, resulting in an unprecedented surge in the gaming industry.
text.篝火联赛再开 酒水销量暴涨: The Bonfire League Ignites Alcohol Sales Boom
text.备受体育爱好者们关注的篝火联赛开幕，作为最受欢迎的体育盛事之一，成千上万的爱好者: The Bonfire League, one of the most popular sports events, has commenced, captivating thousands of enthusiasts who eagerly follow the matches. Concurrently, sales of alcoholic beverages have reached their peak levels, as many fans choose to purchase large quantities of alcoholic products to enhance their viewing experience or gather with friends to create a festive atmosphere. Reports indicate that liquor sales consistently experience a steady increase each time the Bonfire League begins.
text.修格里城多家本地车企与科伦巴商会达成合作: Local Car Companies in Shoggolith City Forge Partnership with COLUMBA
text.修格里城多家本地车企与汽车零件供应商与科伦巴商会签订合作协议，修格里汽车商业联合: Several local car companies and auto parts suppliers in Shoggolith City have signed a cooperation agreement with COLUMBA. A spokesperson for the Shoggolith Automotive Business Association highlighted COLUMBA's professionalism, integrity, and abundance of talented individuals. The collaboration aims to foster mutual benefits and improve the overall industry. When asked about the connection to Mayor Jose, the spokesperson stated, 'Mayor Jose always prioritizes the interests of the citizens of Shoggolith City.'
text.阿妮塔与多家材料制造企业展开技术帮扶工作: Anita's Technical Assistance Empowers\nMaterial Manufacturing Companies
text.在铁盟、各大篝火城、阿妮塔与各地商会的积极促成下，共同发起“三个一技术帮扶计划”: The Tech Support Project has been launched through the joint efforts of the B.C.R.L., Bonfire Cities, Anita, and various CoC. This initiative aims to facilitate the transfer of high-tech knowledge from Anita Laboratory to numerous enterprises, rejuvenating the manufacturing industry with advanced technologies under the core principles of "wholehearted teaching, meticulous learning, and leading-edge skills."
text.民众疯抢抗共振产品 专家呼吁理性消费: Anti-Resonance Products Call for Rational Consumption
text.共振污染一直以来是人们高度关注的问题，近日，西大陆出现大量污染区，导致不安的情绪: Resonance pollution has emerged as a significant concern among the public. Contaminated areas in the Western Continent have caused unease among citizens, leading many to rush and stockpile anti-resonance products. However, experts emphasize that the current level of resonance pollution does not pose a widespread risk. They assure residents of Bonfire Cities that the market supply of anti-resonance products is adequate to meet their daily needs.
text.名人效应为玩具市场注入新鲜血液: Celebrity Influence Revitalizes the Toy Market
text.多年来，玩具市场的消费量与消费群体一直趋于稳定。而在一次文娱访谈中，人气组合艾露: The toy market has experienced stable consumption patterns and consumer groups over the years. However, after the popular group Elulu☆Cecilia expressed their love for toys in an entertainment interview, a significant number of fans actively purchased toys to emulate their idols. This injection of enthusiasm from fans has brought new vitality to the toy market. Toy manufacturers have noticed the power of celebrity influence and are considering enlisting spokespersons who align with their brand image to enhance their promotional efforts.
text.女性消费力逐步提升 新消费热点不断出现: Women's Purchasing Power Seethes, Unleashing Emerging Consumption Trends
text.根据第三方数据机构显示，女性消费力逐年提升，高消费能力增长显著。女性群体多元化的: Market data from third-party research organizations indicates a continuous increase in women's purchasing power, particularly among those with high disposable incomes. The diverse consumption preferences of women have given rise to new consumption trends in the market. In response, major retailers have launched promotional campaigns to cater to the evolving demands of female consumers.
text.岚心文化巡展开幕 收藏家群体出现全新趋势: Trendsetting Exhibition: Ranshin Culture Tour Sparks Collector Community Buzz
text.由岚心城文化博物馆主导，西大陆其他篝火城博物馆共同参与的岚心文化巡展在西大陆开幕: The Ranshin City Culture Museum, in collaboration with other bonfire city museums in the Western Continent, has launched the Ranshin Culture Touring Exhibition. This exhibition allows residents of the Western Continent to experience the unique cultural charms of Ranshin City without leaving their homes. It has also inspired many individuals to start collecting items with distinct Ranshin-style characteristics, setting off a new trend among collectors.
text.一纤维材料基地发生火灾 纤维市场价飙升: Fiber Market Price Seethe Triggered by Fire at Material Base
text.一大型纤维材料基地发生火灾，导致纤维在多地市场出现断货现象，纤维的价格也在短时间: A fire at a major fiber production base has caused a shortage of fibers in various markets, resulting in a rapid increase in fiber prices. The local BCRL Agency has ruled out deliberate arson, while a production manager speculated that the fire might have been caused by aging circuits. The exact cause is still under investigation.
text.黑月匠造新一季度服装带动面料需求: Night Chains Lesage's Fashion Line Drives Demand for Fabrics
text.鉴于黑月匠造新一季时装发布后在业内引领的时尚风潮，多款服饰所需的面料需求大量增长: Following the release of Night Chains Lesage's new seasonal fashion line, there has been a substantial increase in demand for fabrics required for various apparel. As a result, several mainstream production enterprises have raised their fabric prices. Some fabrics are even experiencing a 100% utilization rate. A representative from a textile enterprise mentioned that they are working overtime to fulfill the current orders.
text.服装消费券大量分发 多家服饰品牌迎来销量增长: Apparel Coupons Fuel Sales Growth for Multiple Brands
text.为活跃服装消费市场、加快释放消费潜能，多家商会与服饰品牌联合向广大消费者分发服装: In a bid to stimulate the apparel consumption market and tap into its full potential, various chamber of commerce and apparel brands have collaborated to distribute apparel consumption coupons to consumers. This campaign encompasses a wide range of brands, catering to both affordable and high-end segments, and has garnered significant consumer interest. Many brands have also introduced additional enticing activities in conjunction with the consumption coupons.
text.又见面了，{playername}，你看起来一切安好，我便放心了。: It's good to see you again, {playername}. You look well, and that puts my mind at ease.

text.{playername}，你看上去有些体力不济，如果有需要，我可以带你去我常去的: {playername}, you're looking a little short on stamina. If you'd like, I could take you to my usual gym and you could try one of the training sessions.
text.最近，我的好几位学生比以前更频繁地拜访此处，到底是真的对追求知识燃起热情，还是听: Lately, several of my students have been visiting far more often than they used to. Have they truly caught fire over the pursuit of knowledge, I wonder — or did word get around that a certain someone can be found here?
text.你对我饮用的东西感兴趣？啊，与阿妮塔无关，只是我个人自制的鸡胸肉奶昔……果然，你: Curious about what I'm drinking? Ah, nothing to do with Anita, just a shake I make myself, blended from chicken breast... Just as I thought. You're wearing that same baffled look as everyone else.
text.形而上粒子研究所最初是一家医院……很意外？我想，如果我的那位旧友还在，这里也许仍: The Metaphysical Particle Institute began as a hospital... Does that surprise you? I imagine if that old friend of mine were still alive, this place might still be a hospital, and there'd be no call for my skills here.
text.负片中微子也是形而上粒子的一种，准确来说，形而上粒子……看起来你有些困了，那么这: Negative Neutrinos are a kind of Metaphysical Particle as well. To be precise, Metaphysical Particles are... Ah, you look a bit sleepy. In that case, let's leave the rest for next time.
text.因乙方对生产活动进一步扩大规模的需求，双方根据《联合宪章》、《铁路安全管理条例》: In consideration of Party A's requirement for expanded production activities, the Parties, in accordance with the Earth Union Charter, Railway Safety Management Regulations, Bonfire City Security Agreements, and other applicable laws and regulations, and guided by principles of legal compliance, honesty, trustworthiness, and mutual benefit, have agreed to the following terms and conditions. Party B, acting as an independent contractor within the limits permitted by Party A, shall engage in the expansion of the workshop, as stipulated in this contract.
text.一、承包内容\\n\r\r\r\r整顿中心及生产车间的管理、生产及运营。\\n\:
I. Scope of Contracting
Party B shall be responsible for the management, production, and operation of the Reforming Center and workshops.
II. Rights and Obligations of Party A
1. Party A shall provide Party B with suitable production facilities, <color=#cc6e0a>including a workshop, a working area consisting of two rows, a dormitory, two living areas, six sewing machines, and an onboard sewing machine.</color>
2. Party A shall provide Party B with the necessary site, water, electricity, and security services.
3. Party A shall provide assistance to Party B when Party B conducts management, production, sales, and other activities in compliance with laws and regulations.
4. Party A shall supervise Party B's management, production, sales, and other activities in accordance with laws and regulations. If Party B violates the terms of the contract or laws and regulations, Party A reserves the right to revoke the management authority of the Reforming Center and production workshop.
III. Rights and Obligations of Party B
1. Party B shall pay Party A a leasing cost of <color=#cc6e0a>600,000 BCRL Coins</color> and provide <color=#cc6e0a>600 units of Power</color> for the workshop.
2. Party B shall develop production plans, carry out production and sales activities in compliance with relevant laws and regulations, and accept supervision from Party A.
3. Party B shall manage criminals in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations, and report to Party A through the formal process.
4. Party B shall assume full responsibility for all profits and losses arising from the production and sales of the workshop.

text.您还是那么准时，希望我们能继续维持长期稳定的合作关系。: You're as punctual as always. Hopefully, we can maintain a stable, long-term partnership.
text.我只是黑月中再普通不过的一名成员，像我这样的人在黑月要多少有多少。: I'm merely a run-of-the-mill employee of Night Chains. There are tons of others like me.
text.以我的权限无法告知您什么信息……听说您与亚莉奈大人、宵月大人、闻笙大人等都有来往: With my purview, I'm unable to provide you with any information... but I heard you're associated with Miss Arina, Miss Yoizuki, and Mr. Wensheng. Compared to me, they will definitely have much more valuable answers for you.
text.我很荣幸能得到这次外派机会，您的工作能力哪怕在黑月中也是出类拔萃，相信无论是鹭大: I'm very honored to manage this station here. Your competence is exceptional even in Night Chains. I have no doubt both Mr. Sagi and Mr. Goethe will be more than glad to take you under their wings.
text.我的名字……？不，那种事情不重要。不过，您可以用您喜欢的方式称呼我。: My name...? No, it's nothing worth mentioning. But you may call me whatever you like.
text.宵月大人一直是如此优雅和美丽……是否做到像苍叶大人这样强大，才有资格随侍在她身侧: Miss Yoizuki is always so elegant and beautiful... Do I have to be as strong as Miss Aoba to stay by her side?
text.欢迎光临！您看要吃些什……呃，抱歉，在家里打工习惯了还没改过来！嘿嘿，您要选购些: Welcome! What would you like to hav— oh, sorry, force of habit from working at home, haven't shaken it off yet! Hehe, let me know what you'd like, just ask me anything!
text.列车长，您又来啦！上次都忘记自我介绍了，我是小麦！还是之前那样，要什么叫我就好—: Conductor, you're back again! Oh wait, I forgot to introduce myself last time—I'm Komugi! Same as before, just call me if you need anything—
text.今天屋子里好闷……哈啊……哎！列车长！没有偷懒哦，我刚刚在纳凉！: It's so stuffy in here today... haah... Oh! Conductor! I wasn't slacking off, I was just cooling down for a sec!
text.虽然之前见过很多次面，但好像一直没有多说些话的机会……嘿嘿，能和您成为朋友就太好: We've run into each other so many times, but somehow we never really got to talk much... hehe, I'm really glad we get to be friends.
text.感觉列车长的工作很有趣！如果能和您一起在列车上工作，应该很有意思吧……: Your job seems so interesting, Conductor! If I could work on the train with you, I bet that'd be a lot of fun...
text.喏！这是铁盟拖车的特别预约券！您一直照顾我这里的生意，我想找个方法报答您——只要: Here! A special reservation voucher for the BCRL towing car! You've been so good to my little shop here, so I wanted to find some way to pay you back—just call this number and I'll come running!
text.感觉人类真厉害啊……不过我听说，很多亚人拒绝使用人类的高科技装备，为什么呢？: Humans are really impressive... though I hear a lot of demihumans refuse to use high-tech human gear. I wonder why that is?
text.虽然没法给您打折，但我可以帮忙介绍介绍！: I can't give you a discount, but I can help point out the good stuff!
text.比起厉害的武器，应该是适合的武器更重要。嗯，我听前辈们都这么说！: I always figure it's not about how powerful the weapon is, it's about whether it actually suits you. That's what all the veterans say, anyway!
text.说起来，这里好像有件什么装备被拿去作为实验品了来着……: Come to think of it, I heard some piece of gear here got taken away to be used as a test sample...
text.来咯！这是您选购的装备，已经请帕拉笛小姐的机器人帮您搬运到车上啦！: Here you go! This is the gear you picked out, I already had Miss Paladi's robot carry it to your train!
text.您真是好眼光，这件装备的评价一向很好呢！: Great eye! This piece has always had really good reviews.
text.请让乘员在工作范围内规范安全使用！啊，我只是在读规范上的说明……我相信列车长不会: Please make sure crew members use it safely and within regulations! Ah, I'm just reading off the manual... I'm sure you'd never misuse it, Conductor!
text.好香……列车长您今天吃了什么好吃的……啊，这、这是工作时间对吧！不好意思！我走神: Mmm, something smells good... what'd you eat today, Conductor? Oh—wait, we're on duty right now, aren't we! Sorry, I got distracted!
text.在这里工作挺好的，大家都很照顾我！但大家老和我说注意安全、小心不要走火……唔，我: Working here's really nice, everyone looks out for me! But they keep telling me to be careful, watch out for accidental discharges... I'm already a proper soldier, why's everyone still so worried about me?
text.大部分时候我都在开拖车……来这儿值班，只是偶尔。前辈说让我们注意安全驾驶，但我一: Most of the time I'm out driving the towing car... coming here for duty is just once in a while. The veterans always tell us to drive safe, but I'm always careful! I was even last year's BCRL Model Driver!
text.前几天我去拍了铁盟的亚人士兵宣传照。照出来看着还挺威风的……不知道家里人会不会看: I went to get my photo taken for the BCRL demihuman recruitment poster the other day. I actually looked pretty cool in it... I wonder if my family will ever see the finished poster?
text.我家在岚心城开饭馆。等您有空去岚心城的时候，一定要去我家吃点儿东西！最好、最好带: My family runs a little restaurant in Ranshin City. Next time you're free and passing through, you have to come eat something! And—and you have to bring me along, I can get you a discount—
text.要是有机会去您的列车上上值班就好了！我一直坐在前头的拖车里，都没看过无垠号里面什: I really wish I could get a shift on your train sometime! I've always been stuck up front in the towing car, I've never even seen what the inside of the Eternal looks like...

text.云岫桥基地的运作模式和其他站点很不一样，希望您不会感到不适应。如果有什么需要了解: The operation style of Base Yunxiu Bridge is markedly different from other stations. I hope you'll be able to adapt to it. Just ask me if you have any questions.

text.我之前没有其他管理工作经验。不过，据说和我同批次的人选都自愿退出了竞争……所以我: I had no other management experience prior to this, but word has it that the candidates who applied at the same time I did all willingly pulled out of the race... That is how I got the job of managing the entire Base Yunxiu Bridge.
text.最近铁盟似乎发起了各个站点的管理水平打分……如果问卷发到您手上……不不，我不是要: BCRL has been rating the management standard of each station these days... If you get the survey... No, no, I'm not asking you to give me high ratings! text.虽然很想帮忙，但站点人力实在有限。请谨慎行动，列车长。: Even though I really wish to help, the station is seriously short on manpower. Please act with caution, Conductor.
text.整顿中心的物资需求量很大，请量力而行，列车长。: There is a significant need for supplies at the Reforming Center. Please do your best, Conductor.
text.我统计了其他同僚的需要，列出了近期急需的物资清单。: I've tallied the needs of the staff and made a list of the most urgently required supplies for now.
text.我相信您是个很有经营水平的人。: I have no doubt that you're someone with excellent management skills.
text.因为项目很杂乱，或许会有些看着奇怪的要求……: As the project is really disorganized, there may be some rather strange-looking requests...
text.这些物资帮大忙了，谢谢。: These supplies will be of great help. Thank you.
text.我会委托监视机器人帮忙运输的，它们的卸货效率很高。: I will engage surveillance robots to help transport them. They are incredibly efficient at unloading goods.
text.一路赶来辛苦了。要先休息一下吗？: It must have been a long journey here. Would you like to get some rest first?
text.路过整顿中心的时候听见帕拉笛小姐在大呼小叫？……我知道了，今天换班时我会去问问怎: You heard Miss Paladi screaming when you passed by the Reforming Center? ...Got it. I'll find out about it during the shift change later. But since she didn't ask us for help, I guess it should be nothing out of the ordinary...
text.我这里总是接到关于乾图先生的投诉，说他看起来居心不良。幸好列车长不是以貌取人之辈: I'm constantly receiving complaints about Mr. Qiantu that claim he looks malevolent. Thank goodness you're not one to judge people by their appearance, Conductor.
text.我在回看作战记录。在每天重复的巡逻和驱逐任务录像中，经常能发现一些有趣的、吸引人: I'm watching combat records. You can frequently find interesting, eye-catching clips in the videos of the standard patrol and eviction quests. I tend to crop them out and send them to the people in the clips as a surprise.
text.来了——啊，列车长，刚刚他们叫我“余导”的话……请别当真，是同事间的玩笑而已。: Coming... Ah, Conductor! About them calling me "Director Yu" earlier... please don't take it seriously. It's purely an inside joke.
text.不久前我协助了铁盟一部宣传短片的拍摄，现在或许已经在四处播放了吧……是一部叫《喧: A while back, I helped with the shooting of a short BCRL advertisement that's probably already being played everywhere as of now... It's a film called "Tumultuous Drama." Have you seen it?
text.了解了，我这就为您换一个订单事项。: Understood. I'll get you another order right away.
text.这恰好也不是急需物资，请别介意，列车长。: This doesn't happen to be at the top of the list anyway. Don't worry, Conductor.
text.出发前请妥善检查装备和物资。: Please conduct a thorough check of your equipment and supplies before setting out.
text.祝您一路顺风。: May you have a safe trip.
text.我理解您的工作十分繁忙。: I understand you have a lot on your plate.
text.按照您方便的顺序安排就好。: Just arrange according to your convenience.
text.铁盟出品的装备均有质量保证，请放心挑选。: All equipment produced by BCRL is quality-assured. Feel free to pick whatever captures your fancy.
text.按照规定，云岫桥基地的任何交易处都不能以物易物。假如我的其他同僚提出类似的要求，: Per the regulations, bartering isn't permitted in any of Base Yunxiu Bridge's trading places. If any of my colleagues ever make such a request, please turn them down prudently.
text.呵呵呵呵呵……想必你就是那位传闻中的无垠号列车长。快，快请进来坐，我想我们一定有: Hehehehehehe... You must be that legendary conductor of the Eternal. Here, come on in and take a seat. I bet we'll have lots to talk about... Heh...
text.我知道我的外貌看起来不讨喜。希望您不要因此而对我产生偏见……哈哈。: I'm aware I don't look amiable. I hope you won't view me differently because of it... Haha.
text.做生意和做人一样，都要付出真心，但决不能盲信他人……您不这么认为吗？: Doing business is no different from being a decent person; they both require sincerity. However, it is imperative not to trust anyone blindly... Don't you agree?
text.您说我和您做生意一直十分诚信、从来没有欺骗过您？嘻嘻，您要是想这么认为的话，我也: I've been utterly genuine and truthful while doing business with you, you say? Heh, I can't stop you if that's what you want to believe.
text.桀桀桀桀桀……！我是这里的……！（吸气）（咳嗽）……不，没什么。您来了，列车长。: Heeheeheeheehee...! I am the...! (inhales) (coughs) ...No, nothing. Welcome, Conductor.
text.我认为您是交易所最值得尊敬的客人。我会竭尽全力为您取得想要的商品……嘻嘻……: You're the most honorable customer of the trading center, in my opinion. I'll do everything to help you obtain whatever product it is you'd like... Heheh...
text.……我自幼就因为外貌被家族中的其他孩子看不起。无法拥有他们那样光鲜亮丽的人生，也: ...My appearance has made the other kids of my family look down on me ever since I was young. It's only to be expected that I can't have the kind of glamorous lives they have...
text.听说您前段时间被铁盟通缉过？我很理解……因为我也有过险些误入歧途的时刻……什么，: It's said that you were wanted by BCRL sometime ago. Is that right? I totally get it... I also had times when I nearly strayed from the straight and narrow... What? It was a misunderstanding? Oh... Forget I said anything... then... Haha... Ha.
text.我领悟了，自己的命运应当由自己掌握。如今，我打算不再依附家族的支持……为什么您要: I understand now. One must take hold of one's own destiny. I don't plan to depend on my family's support anymore... Why are you making that face? I'm only making small talk...
text.按照我获得的情报来看……<color=#b45e01>{station}</co: Based on the intel I received... <color=#b45e01>{station}</color>'s <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> should sell pretty well...
text.呵呵，我告诉您一条好消息。<color=#b45e01>{goods}</col: Heheh, I've got a piece of good news for you. If you bring <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> over to <color=#b45e01>{station}</color> to sell, you'll surely make a killing.
text.最近……<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>在各地都是抢: Recently... <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have been selling out like hotcakes everywhere... Heheh, this information is free of charge. I won't lie to you.
text.您知道吗？听说这里的管理人会对所有人发号施令……我？我当然不会被那个孩子使唤了。: Did you hear? Rumor has it that the manager of this place will bark out orders at everyone... Me? Of course, I won't be bossed around by that kid.
text.虽然我无法进入整顿中心参观，但我知道一些制作过程中的秘密……您假如有意……: I may not be able to enter the Reforming Center for a tour, but I do know some of the secrets of their production process... If you're keen...
text.这是您的个人仓库，随意支配吧……嘻嘻。: This is your personal warehouse. Use it as you see fit... Heheh.
text.多谢。嘻嘻，这样的话，今天的收入就……: Thanks a lot. Heheh. Now, my earnings for the day will be...
text.尽管挑选您喜欢的商品就好。呵呵……: Don't hesitate to pick whichever product you like. Heehee...
text.您在选择货物的时候有什么样的偏好呢？我只是随便问问……: What do you look out for when you're selecting goods? Just a random question...
text.……？不买了？没能让您满意，真是太遗憾了。: ...? You've changed your mind? I'm sorry we didn't meet your expectations.
text.中肯的选择……不过，您肯定不是忘记考虑运输成本和损耗了吧……: Solid choice... But you did not forget about the costs of shipping and losses, right...
text.……要不要再看看？虽然我是不介意您高价买下……嘻嘻……: ...Would you like to reconsider? Though I certainly do not mind you shelling out extra money for it... Heheh...
text.啊，您果然慧眼如炬。: Ah, you sure do have a discerning eye.
text.我会妥帖地分配这些货物的……绝不让它们去到不合适的地方……: I will distribute these goods accordingly... They will absolutely not be taken to anywhere inappropriate...
text.不论什么样的商品，在这里都有销路……毕竟封闭的环境之中，人们也没得选，不是吗？呵: There's always a market for any type of product here... After all, people have no choice in this closed environment. Hahaha...
text.您带来的各种好消息总是让人精神一振啊。: The good news you bring never fails to inspire people.
text.遗憾，遗憾……您还会来我这里卖货的，对吗?: What a shame... You will still sell me your goods in the future though, yeah?
text.我愿意买下。这是出于对您和商品品质的信任，嘻嘻……: I will buy it out of trust in you and the product quality. Heheh...
text.您果然比我更有经商头脑，和您合作看来是正确的选择。: You're definitely better at doing business than I am. Looks like working with you is the right decision.
text.这桩生意可没得赚……您想好了吗？: You won't be making any profit from this deal... Are you sure about this?
text.实在是没有存货了……我会想办法弄来的。当然，是用合法的手段……: It's out of stock for real... I promise I will think of a way to get more. Through lawful means, of course...
text.……要是为了我珍贵的合作伙伴，似乎也不是不行。: ...Well, I guess I can compromise if it's for the sake of my esteemed business partner.
text.再降价，我就要亏得无家可归了……: Any lower and I will have to sell my property to make up the difference...
text.呵呵……我愿意让您从这笔交易里获得更多的利益……: Hehe... All right, I will let you benefit more from this deal...
text.您也不想因为压缩利润空间而失去我这个合作人吧？: You wouldn't want to lose me as a partner because of reducing my profit, would you?
text.补货？当然，当然，只要是为了让您满意……呵呵……: Restock? Sure, sure. As long as you'll be happy... Hehe...
text.需要什么东西的话，记得常来这里看看！: Remember to check here out often whenever you need anything!
text.在这里可以搬一台缝纫机回去自己踩……唔，那个话叫什么来着，整顿中心体验卡！没错！: You can get a sewing machine here and bring it home to try... Hmm, what's that called again, ah, Reforming Center trial edition!
text.这里提供的家具和摆件，和整顿中心内部使用的完全一致！品质保障，安全放心哦！: The furniture and decorations for sale here are 100% identical to those used in the Reforming Center! Worry not, everything is quality-assured!
text.需要搬运大件商品的话，请委托我的监视机器人！: If you need delivery services for bulky items, please engage my surveillance robots!
text.这里的工作不辛苦哦，完全不辛苦，真的。我只是稍微有一点点点点不想干而已。: The work here isn't tough, not at all. Really. I'm just a li~ttle sick of doing it.
text.啊，我在研究这个。只要拨一下这个开关……整个监狱就会响起一级警报哦……很刺激吧！: Ah, this is my current project. With just one flip of this switch... code red alarm will ring throughout the prison... Exciting, right! Wanna give it a try?
text.给整顿中心提供生产材料，大功一件！: Massive kudos for providing production materials for the Reforming Center!
text.这样就能执行新的工作安排了，谢谢你啦，{playername}！: Now I can move on with new work arrangements. Thanks, {playername}!
text.要不要派一个监视机器人给你当助手？: Shall I assign you a surveillance robot as your assistant?
text.我们什么时候能帮索思学会加工点东西啊……啊！多嘴了！我刚刚什么都没说哦，什么都没: When will we get to process something for Source Citadel...? Ah! I didn't say anything. Nothing at all!
text.这些货物里有你的一份功劳，高高兴兴地拿去卖吧！: You've had a hand in making these goods. Go ahead and sell them as you please!
text.你钱不够！下次再来吧！……真可惜，之前被警告了，不然还想让你替我买学会周边抵货款: You don't have enough money! Come again next time! ...Ah, I already got a warning before, or else I would've asked you to help get me some Citadel merch as payment for the goods...
text.嘎哈、哈、哈！你刚刚在入口的地方我就发现你啦！快进来吧——: Gah-ha-ha! I spotted you the moment you reached the entrance! Quick, come on in!
text.大家上！啊是你呀，好险，差点让监视机器人对你动手。不好意思！我改一下判断条件！: Guys, charge! Ah, it's you! That was close. I nearly had the surveillance robots take you down. Sorry! I'll adjust the detection system!
text.你来啦！太好了，我最近研究了全新的监视机器人行动程序——你站在门口不要动哦，我让: You're here! Fantastic. I recently developed a new surveillance robot program. Stand still at the doorway, let's see if they can avoid you!
text.请先完成前置关卡的刻录: Please complete the previous stage first.
text.当前仓库可购买容量数不足，提升整顿中心等级可以提高可购买容量上限。: Insufficient purchasable slots. Please upgrade your Reforming Center.
text.完成前6日签到即可解锁: Unlocked by completing the sign-ins of the first 6 days.
text.刚刚翻新完毕的无垠号，外壳仿佛还在闪闪发光，可不能让它受到损坏。: The newly refurbished Eternal Train. Its exterior almost still seems to be glinting. Make sure it's kept safe from damage.
text.足以阻拦列车行进的大型路障，是鼹鼠帮抢劫活动中的“最佳拍档”。有部分带着冲撞的痕: A large barricade that can obstruct a train's path. The "best helper" in MoleGang's robberies. It's not hard to picture a train once being completely robbed clean upon failing to break through its obstruction.
text.鼹鼠帮的罪行罄竹难书，他们恐吓居民、打劫商会、在广告牌上黏口香糖……甚至连铁盟的: MoleGang has committed so many crimes that one can write an entire book about them. They terrorize residents, rob CoC, stick chewed-up gum on advertisement boards... and even dare to steal B.C.R.L.'s supplies!
text.不愧为全功能移动工程平台，哪怕退役了，那种无与伦比的机械美感也难以被代替。: As expected of the All-Purpose Mobile Engineering Platform. Even though it's already retired, its incomparable mechanical beauty can never be replaced.
text.这里的守备很薄弱，门上装备了样式熟悉的锁。地上扔了一些易拉罐和食物包装纸，看来那: This place's defense is incredibly weak. A familiar lock is installed on the door, while some drink cans and food packaging are littered all over the floor. It appears those Marauders like making merry here every now and then.
text.这个吊机似乎进行了一些改造，让它能够搬运超出原本重量限制的物品。: This crane appears to have been slightly modified so that it can bear the load of items that used to exceed its weight limit.
text.总控室外的走廊守着不少拾荒者，他们大多面露警惕之色，留意着任何不寻常的动静。但是: Many Marauders stand guard outside the walkway of the main control room, their expressions mostly wary as they watch out for anything unusual. But there are also a few of them in the corners letting out soft snores.
text.站在这里的时候不能随意开口，否则风会把沙子送进嘴里。: You mustn't have your mouth open while standing here, or be prepared to be fed sand by the wind.
text.拜服吧！此处正是这荒原上唯一的王者——荒原王的至尊座驾！荒原王大人与他无敌的荒原: Impressive, huh? This is the phenomenal vehicle of the wilderness' only ruler—Wilderness King! The imposing, awe-inspiring king and his vehicle will always prevail. Make sure never to call him Tom.
text.只是试图接近这艘船，“响立逃”的警报声就一直响个不停，加重了令人不安的氛围。: "Flee Alarm" immediately rings non-stop if you so much as try to approach this ship, intensifying the unsettling atmosphere.
text.除了“荒原帝王号”造成的损坏，船体表面并没有明显的损伤，也许最大的问题出在内部。: Aside from the damage caused by "The Wilderness King," there is no obvious damage on the exterior of the hull. The biggest problem might be an interior one.
text.曾经有许多心怀梦想的研究者带着笑容在甲板畅谈未来的无限可能性，如今这里只剩下一群: Once upon a time, numerous ambitious researchers stood on the deck and discussed the infinite possibilities of the future with a smile, but now, this is a place left only with a bunch of lost souls who can never be woken up again.
text.遍布着生锈的痕迹和一些难以辨明的污垢，已经看不出原本的样子。: Filled with rust and some indiscernible filth to the point that it no longer bears any semblance to its original appearance.
text.在她们的记忆中，那个温柔可靠的人总是待在这里，那么现在呢？: In their memories, that gentle, reliable person was always here. What about now?
text.污损的过道并不适合作为拍照的背景，再怎么在镜头前摆出漂亮的姿势也是白搭。: A defaced walkway isn't a suitable background for photos, no matter how stunning a pose you have in front of the camera.
text.在附近居民的印象里，这个脚手架在很多年前就是这个样子，完全没有变过。: Based on what the nearby residents remember, this scaffold has been in this state since many years ago. It has remained totally unchanged.
text.车主早就不知所踪，顺着车牌号也查不到所有者，可能是一辆没有出厂记录的车……: The car owner has long been missing. Even the license plate number yields no information about who possessed it. May be a car with no factory records...
text.因为这里没人管，附近的商户和居民为了方便把垃圾不分类就全部丢在这个地方。神奇的是: As nobody manages this place, the nearby merchants and residents all throw their trash here. What's amazing is that all the trash vanishes in a few days despite no one having ever seen anybody clearing it up.
text.考虑到澄明数据中心是地下城市，这些水绝对不可能是雨水。: Considering that the CDCA Bureau is an underground city, this water definitely did not come from rain.
text.不知道是谁还在坚持为这种地方的广告牌供电和更新内容……: Who could still be supplying power to and updating the advertisement boards of this place after all this time...?
text.锈迹斑斑的卷帘门，看似不堪一击。它的背后是无数篝火城赖以维护稳定的基准。: A rust-covered roller shutter that looks like it could give out at any time. Behind it is the benchmark that countless Bonfire Cities rely on to maintain stability.
text.不禁让人想到这座篝火城的管理者，它应该没在运行了，对吧？: Tends to remind people of the overseer of this Bonfire City. It's no longer operating though, correct?
text.这个巷子里最新的物件，原来那个据说是失窃了。: The newest object in this alley. The previous one is said to have been stolen.
text.那个贡露城最有名的餐厅之一，据说一次只招待十名以内的客人，预约已经排到了明年……: One of the most popular restaurants in Gronru City that reportedly only accepts a maximum of ten customers at one go. Bookings are filled all the way to the following year... Is there even a point to advertise in such a place?
text.澄明数据中心的出入口，巨大的标识无言彰显了阿妮塔在这个篝火城的影响力。: The entryway of the CDCA Bureau. Its massive logo wordlessly exhibits the influence Anita has on this Bonfire City.
text.废弃许久的工地，依稀能猜到最初这片区域是打算按照地上篝火城的模式来建造的。: A construction site that has been abandoned for ages. One can somehow tell that this area was originally meant to be built according to the layout of the Bonfire Cities aboveground.
text.旧七号自由港事故的纪念碑，时刻提醒人们切勿忘记这惨痛的教训。有几块砖被人刻了字，: A monument of the old Freeport Ⅶ incident. Someone carved "Underground city is safer. Bonfire Cities should be abolished" on it. Those people caught vandalizing the monument have all been fined by the BCRL Agency.
text.不仅有神出鬼没的桦树生物，此处还是新北阵余党选择的据点。为了民众的安全，铁安局严: Not only are there Chaos Remains here, but this is also the base of the remaining New Northern Alliance members. BCRL Agency strictly prohibits civilians from entering the hilly area and has increased patrols.
text.浑浊的水池里散发出一股不祥的气息，要是掉进去就糟了，还是离远点吧。: A murky pond that emanates an ominous vibe. Best stay away from it, or it will be terrible if you fall in.
text.似乎是茶厂员工的生活区域，是这个陈旧破败的地方唯一还算新的设施。: Seems to be the living quarters of the tea factory's employees. The only relatively new facility in this dilapidated place.
text.总觉得一点也不想知道从里面排出的都是什么。: Somehow, it feels like it will be better not to find out what exactly is being pumped out of this.
text.这处破坏的痕迹还很新，应该是最近才造成的。底下隐约传来了让人不太舒服的声音。: The traces of damage here are fairly new, likely created recently. One can subtly hear some unsettling sounds underneath.
text.门前有两棵树，一棵是正常的，另一棵不是。: Before the door stands two trees—one normal, one not.
text.很新颖的绿化，值得铁盟嘉奖一张监狱城的单程票。: A very novel way of greening. Deserves a one-way ticket reward from B.C.R.L. that leads to prison.
text.荒废了不知多少年的无名建筑，因为利益和欲望再度迎来访客。: A nameless building that has been deserted for an unknown number of years. Benefits and desires have brought it visitors once again.
text.空白录像带不足，是否前往黑月商店购买？: Insufficient Blank Videotape. Purchase from HQ Shop?
text.转动切换下一个核心: Rotate to switch to the next core.
text.仓库可购买容量数增加: Increases the number of purchasable slots.
text.虚演刻录需要玩家30级开启: Calculation Recording is unlocked at level 30.
text.首次完成即可开启自动战斗: Clear the stage for the first time to unlock auto-combat.
text.挑战次数不足，无法开启自动战斗: Insufficient challenge attempts. Cannot start auto-combat.
text.请输入邮件验证码: Please enter the verification code sent to your email address.
text.请再次输入新密码: Please enter the new password again.
text.每10次招募必得 SR 或以上队员: Recruit x10 guarantee SR or higher
text.请选择拍照次数: How many snapshots would you like?
text.可使用追加注资申请书进行刷新: Use Extra Invest Appl. to refresh the items.
text.“你知道，有时候这种事情也是难免的。”你边掏钱边笑着说。: "You know, it happens." You chuckle as you take out the money.

text.拆除车厢将返还一定的建造消耗的铁盟币，是否拆解？: Removing the carriage will return a portion of the BCRL Coins invested in the construction. Remove the carriage?

text.（奇奇）欢迎来到海角城市政厅，我是市长秘书奇奇，相关事务将由我代为办理。我身边这: (Kiki) Welcome to Cape City's City Hall. I'm Kiki, the mayor's secretary. I'll be handling the relevant matters. This is Mr. Aleister, Cape City's mayor.
text.（奇奇）感谢您对海角城建设的支持……阿莱斯特先生也是这么说的。: (Kiki) Thank you for your support toward Cape City's development... This is what Mr. Aleister says as well.
text.（阿莱斯特）喵呜……（奇奇）嗯？阿莱斯特先生居然主动打招呼，还真是少见。: (Aleister) Meow... (Kiki) Hmm? Mr. Aleister's actually saying hi of his own accord. This is unexpected.
text.（奇奇）您在海角城的活跃事迹已经在市政厅传遍了，衷心希望您能与海角城保持良好的合: (Kiki) Your rousing deeds in Cape City have already made the rounds in the entire City Hall. We genuinely hope to maintain a good working relationship with you. (Aleister) Meow!
text.（阿莱斯特）嘿，人类。这什么表情，我这样有诚意地打招呼，你该感到荣幸。: (Aleister) Heh, human. What's with that expression? You should feel honored that I'm greeting you so sincerely.
text.（阿莱斯特）我承认你是个很有本事的人类……不过我是不可能让你像抚摸普通家猫那样触: (Aleister) I admit that you're a very capable human... but I will never let you pet me the way you do other ordinary house cats.
text.（奇奇）这些资金将会被用于海角城最新的公共设施建设工程。: (Kiki) These funds will be used in the construction project of Cape City's latest public facility.
text.（阿莱斯特）我觉得你不妨多加点直接投资五十万，这不上不下的数字真让人心痒。: (Aleister) You know, why don't you just add a little more and invest 500,000 at once? This in-between figure is seriously irritating.
text.（阿莱斯特）干得不错，人类，像你这样的家伙我很欢迎哦？: (Aleister) Good job, human. People like you are more than welcome here.
text.（阿莱斯特）喵？喵喵喵！喵喵！喵！（奇奇）阿莱斯特先生！请不要仗着人家听不懂就…: (Aleister) Meow? Meow meow meow! Meow! Meow! Meow! (Kiki) Mr. Aleister! Just because they can't understand you doesn't mean you should...! Um, Conductor, this is a misunderstanding. Mr. Aleister doesn't mean anything by it. Anyway, please come back again after you've prepared the sufficient amount.
text.（奇奇）我的造型完全由阿莱斯特亲自设计，他对外形要求极高，作为站在他身边的人，我: (Kiki) My fashion style is fully designed by Aleister. He has exceptionally high standards for appearance. As someone who stands beside him, I, of course, can't embarrass him.
text.（奇奇）当年我只是个什么都不懂的学生，毕业后一直找不到工作，无比落魄……是阿莱斯: (Kiki) Back then, I was purely an ignorant student without a penny to my name, as I couldn't get a job after graduation... My life was only changed after Mr. Aleister picked me.
text.（奇奇）糟、糟糕了！列车长！阿莱斯特先生突然开始呕吐！难道是之前在诺玛餐厅的餐食: (Kiki) S-Shoot! Conductor! Mr. Aleister has suddenly started throwing up! Don't tell me something was wrong with the food in Norma's?! Gronru City's conspiracy... What? He's just throwing up a furball? Ah... I'm so sorry for losing my composure... Anything concerning Mr. Aleister tends to make me overly anxious and freak out...
text.（奇奇）您饲养了猫咪吗？这里有个黏毛筒，请先清理一下，稍后请用这里的安全香氛……: (Kiki) You have a cat? Here's a lint roll. Please tidy up and then use this safety fragrance... That's right. Mr. Aleister absolutely loathes the scent of other felines. Sorry for the inconvenience.
text.（阿莱斯特）我与奇奇拥有相同的升构能力，能帮助我用人类的语言沟通。不过这么做非常: (Aleister) Kiki and I have the same Ascension Ability that can help me communicate in humankind's language. However, it's an incredibly troublesome thing to do, so I don't normally do that for no reason. You better feel honored!
text.（阿莱斯特）没错，“阿莱斯特”就是我亲自设计的品牌，你应该也在其他城市见过我设计: (Aleister) That's right. "Aleister" is a brand of mine. You've probably seen the clothes I designed in other cities as well. Feel free to pile on the compliments. You need not keep them to yourself.
text.（阿莱斯特）奇奇那小子看着稳重，其实是个神经过度纤细的男人，很容易因为一些事情歇: (Aleister) Kiki may look level-headed, but he's truthfully an excessively anxious man who would easily lose his marbles over some stuff...
text.（阿莱斯特）从品牌设计师到海角城的市长，很了不起对吧？但是我的目标不仅限于此，世: (Aleister) From a brand designer to Cape City's mayor... Impressive, huh? But my goal isn't just that. There are still numerous interesting things in this world for me to try out. When the time comes and you get sick of being a conductor, I can find you a suitable position as well.
text.咳，别太在意朱利安她们的问东问西，女孩子们有时候就会有些八卦，不……不包括我。: Ahem. Don't be too bothered by Julian and the others' incessant questions. Girls tend to be slightly gossipy at times, though not... not including me.
text.据说在地联时期海角城也曾是最繁华的港口城市之一，那时每夜的港口都灯火通明。: It's said that during the Earth Union period, Cape City was also one of the most bustling port cities that existed, their port consistently illuminated every night.
text.在这里尽量不要去招惹学会的人。好啦，没有觉得你会惹麻烦，只是额外的提醒。: Try not to mess with the Citadel people here. Come on, I'm not saying that you'll cause trouble; it's purely an extra reminder.

text.有什么需要帮忙的吗？啊，列车长！你怎么在这里？……咳，没事，就是在想你有没有正、: Need a hand with something? Oh, Conductor! What are you doing here?! ...Ahem, never mind, I was just wondering if you'd happened, purely by chance, to run into our captain anywhere?
text.哦？看来我今天可以轻松点啦。: Oh? Guess I can take it easy today, then.
text.欢迎欢迎，上次干得不错哦！: Welcome, welcome! Nice work last time, by the way!
text.列车长精力真的有够旺盛的，呵欠——我恐怕就做不来。: Your energy really never runs out, does it. *yawn* I don't think I could keep up.
text.来得正好，先喝杯茶再看看任务？: Perfect timing—want some tea before we get into the mission?

text.其实人家本应在贡露城轮值的，在这里纯粹是为了给静流顶班。不过人家可是自愿的！这点: I'm technically supposed to be on duty in Gronru City, but I'm covering Shizuru's shift here. Not that I minded, mind you—I volunteered! It's really nothing, honestly~
text.人家是医疗兵嘛，所以会在包里带上备用的医疗用品……咦，粉底和唇釉？当然也有啊，这: I'm a medic, you know, so I keep spare medical supplies in my bag at all times... hm? Foundation and lip gloss? Of course I've got those too, that's essential gear for any girl.
text.嗯，为了让休假归来的队长认可人家的努力，我要好好工作才行！话虽如此，要不先去喝杯: Right, I need to work hard so the captain sees how much effort I've put in once she's back from leave! ...Though, that said, maybe tea first?
text.海角城的风景还不错，街道也很宽阔，但果然还是比不上贡露城。金钱堆成的狂欢之地，列: Cape City's scenery isn't bad, and the streets are wide enough, but it still can't hold a candle to Gronru City. A city built entirely on money, one big celebration—you've heard of it, right, Conductor?
text.为了让静流玩得开心点，我们蜜獾小队的其余成员凑钱给她买了一份大礼哦。嗯？想知道是: To make sure Shizuru has a good time, the rest of us in Team Ratel pooled our money to get her a big present. Hm? Curious what it is? Go ask Shizuru yourself.
text.喏，这是今天的任务，要我说，倒也不用太为难自己……: Here, today's mission. Honestly, don't push yourself too hard over it...
text.快点随便挑一个吧，我可还要忙别的事情呢。: Go on, just pick one already, I've got other things to deal with.

text.海岛活力源，沙滩排球热！\r\r\\n\r\r\\n\r\r繁忙之余，和乘员们来:
Island Vitality Springs from Beach Volleyball Fever!

After a busy day, unwind with a thrilling beach volleyball game alongside your crew members!
Release your passion on the volleyball court, break a sweat, and revel in the boundless joy of sports!

[Requirement]
This feature is unlocked when your island reaches level 5.
To participate, tap the island facility "Beach Volleyball" or access it through "Beach Volleyball" on the event screen!

[Instructions]
You can choose between Training Mode and Match Mode.

Training Mode: Hone your skills at any time to get ready for the Match Mode.

Match Mode: Each participation consumes a match reward chance. Rewards will be determined based on the outcome of the match.
You can redeem Beach Volleyballs daily at Authority and use them to replenish daily reward chances.
To replenish daily reward chances, either tap "+" in the Match Mode or use the item in your inventory.

[Event Description]
At the beginning of each match, you can select your favorite characters to participate in the contest.

Once both sides have selected their members, the match will start with the attacking side randomly decided.

Catch: Tap the tile in your half where the volleyball lands before it touches the ground to have your character catch it.
Attack: As the attacker, when the ball moves to the front court, your character will automatically launch the ball. If your character's strength surpasses that of the opponent defender, the attack will be successful, leading to victory.
Defend: When your opponent attacks, your characters will automatically defend. If your defender's strength is greater than that of the opponent attacker, your defender will block the attack and gain possession of the ball.
Save: When the ball is about to land on your side, your character will automatically try to save it, but success is not guaranteed. Therefore, please stay alert at all times.
Result: The first team to reach 5 points secures victory in the match.
text.1.制造生产线是布置于无垠号列车上的小型车载工厂，通过制造生产线可以将对应材料制:
1. "Manufacturing Product" feature operates as a small factory on the Eternal, allowing you to craft materials into more advanced materials and finished products.

2. Crated products typically fetch high prices. They can be sold at Trading Centers, Material Retrieve or Group Order for significant returns.

3. Crafting tools can be unlocked by various methods such as progressing through the main story.

4. You can exchange for recipes in various cities. Upgrading crafting tools unlocks more efficient recipes for products.

5. Crafting items increases your Fatigue. In addition, some recipes consume Clarity.
text.1.【引擎核心】是配方生产制造时的核心条件，高等级的制作配方也需要更高级的【引擎:
1. [Engine Cores] are essential for crafting items, with higher-level recipes necessitating more advanced [Engine Cores].

2. You can access [Engine Cores] through the "Upgrade" button located at the bottom left of the crafting tool interface. Currently, [Overload Core], [Furnace Core], [Condensation Core], [Reverberation Core] and [Reverengy Core] are available.

3. Upgrading [Engine Cores] demands a specific power level and successfully overcoming the associated challenges. Once the challenge is complete, your [Engine Cores] will be automatically upgraded based on the results.

4. Each time an [Engine Core] is upgraded by 10 levels, you will receive 100 Chaos Stones as rewards. Subsequently, you will need to use materials to raise their level cap.
text.1.【制造等级】是列车长使用制造生产线熟练度的体现。经常制造可以有效提升【制造等: 1. Your [Craft Level] indicates your proficiency with the Manufacturing Product feature. Crafting items raises your [Craft Level].\n\n2. A higher [Craft Level] grants you a increased chance of obtaining additional products from crafting.

text.1、建造整顿中心里的房间并提升其等级，可以提升各房间内的功能。同时还可以获得整顿:
1. Construct and upgrade rooms within the Reforming Center to enhance their functions and further boost the productivity and efficiency in your Reforming Center.

2. To construct and upgrade rooms, you need to upgrade your Reforming Center or Research Center to a specific level.

3. Constructing rooms costs BCRL Coins and Power and takes time. You can use Support Ticket to speed up or Chaos Stones to immediately complete the construction.
