text.1.原料车间生产制造是整顿中心生产链中的重要一环，用于生产各种原料。\\n\\n:
1. Material Workshop is the place where various raw materials are produced, playing a vital role in the production chain of the Reforming Center.

2. Once you have configured prisoners and selected a recipe, you can start the production at a cost of BCRL Coins.

3. Material Workshop can store a maximum of 2.5M BCRL Coins.

4. Production consumes the stored BCRL Coins. The produced raw materials will be placed in Material Warehouse when claimed.

5. Only one type of raw material can be produced at each workshop at a time.

6. Certain recipes will only be unlocked after your Research Center reaches a specific level.

7. Production requires time. You can use items to accelerate production.

8. Upgrading Material Workshop increases the chances of extra production, providing a 1% bonus for each additional level.
text.1.提升研发中心等级可以解锁更多配方。\\n\\n\r2.提升研发中心等级可以解:
1. Upgrading Research Center unlocks more recipes.

2. Upgrading Research Center raises the level cap of sewing machines.

3. Upgrading Research Center raises the level cap of Material Workshop.
text.1、这是黑月商贩所开的订单站，专门收购整顿中心配方相关制造的产物。将制造好的对应:
1. This order station, established by Night Chains, purchases products crafted in the Reforming Center. Fulfill these orders to upgrade your center and earn rewards.

2. As your Reforming Center levels up, you will unlock more orders with more challenging requirements.

3. You can delete orders as you please. Deleted orders will be replaced by new ones in 5 minutes.

4. You can check your previous orders in the order log within the production workshop.
text.1.棉花哥哥定期在整顿中心发布原料采购订单，列车长可用货物向棉花哥哥换购生产所需:
1. Cotton Bro regularly issues orders for raw material orders in the Reforming Center. You can trade products for raw materials.

2. Purchase orders refresh daily at 5:00. You can use items to unlock additional orders.

3. Complete orders to receive various raw materials.
text.1、转运中心可以安排车队，按指定线路运输货物或者囚犯。其中车队和线路需要解锁。\:
1. Transit Center is where you can organize convoys to transport products or prisoners along specific routes. These convoys and routes need to be unlocked.

2. Transporting products involves moving products from the Reforming Center warehouse to the designated city via unlocked routes, which costs BCRL Coins and time. Your convoys will leave the Reforming Center and return once the transport is complete. The transportation time includes both delivery and return durations.

3. Transporting prisoners involves bring prisoners from other cities to your Reforming Center via unlocked routes, which costs BCRL Coins and time. Your convoys will depart from the Reforming Center, pick up the prisoners, and return. The transportation time includes both pickup and return durations.
text.1.整顿中心原料仓库是整顿中心存放生产原料的重要场所。\\n\\n\r2.采购获:
1. Material Warehouse at the Reforming Center is where all the raw materials for production are stored.

2. Raw materials bought or crafted at Material Workshop are automatically stored in this warehouse. Additionally, you can transfer goods from your carriages to this warehouse for production purposes.

3. It is crucial to keep an ample stock of materials in this warehouse to maintain smooth production at the Reforming Center.

4. As your Reforming Center levels up, you can purchase new slots to increase the capacity of this warehouse.
text.1.整顿中心成品仓库是整顿中心存放生产成品的重要场所。\\n\\n\r2.普通车:
1. Product Warehouse at the Reforming Center is where all the finished products are stored.

2. Final products crafted at ordinary workshops are automatically stored in this warehouse.

3. You can use products from this warehouse to fulfill orders and transport them to other cities for trade.

4. As your Reforming Center levels up, you can purchase new slots to increase the capacity of this warehouse.
text.1.表现良好的囚犯会向列车长上缴假释金，并提前出狱。\\n\\n\r2.提升假释: 1. Well-behaved prisoners can pay parole fees for early release.\n\n2. Upgrading the parole room reduces the minimum Behavior Pts required for parole.
text.囚犯看起来病恹恹的，已经无法再工作了: The prisoner appears unwell and is no longer able to work.
text.1、在任意包含人形单位的关卡胜利后，可以使用逮捕令逮捕相应的敌方单位作为囚犯。\:
1. Upon completing levels with humanoid units, you can use Arrest Warrant to arrest enemies units as prisoners.

2. Arrest Warrant are available from BCRL Agency in various cities, as rewards for upgrading the Reforming Center, or from Research Center.

3. You can review or release arrested prisoners from your carriage.

4. Once you check-in a prisoner at the Reforming Center, they become a part of it, and can no longer be released.
text.1.玩家每提高1级整顿中心等级，整顿中心仓库会开放更多的库存容量供玩家购买。\\:
1. Whenever your Reforming Center level raises, more slots in the Reforming Center warehouse will become available for purchase.
2. The warehouse is split into material warehouse and product warehouse. Inventory capacity needs to be purchased separately.
3. You can use BCRL Coins to purchase Reforming Center warehouse, or spend Chaos Stones to purchase more.
text.1.提升研发中心等级可解锁更多兑换道具。\\n\\n\r2.消耗整顿中心工票和铁: 1. Upgrading Research Center unlocks more items available for exchange.\n\n2. You can use Reforming Voucher and BCRL Coins to transport the research products to your train.
text.---健康度---\\n\r1.囚犯的健康度属性反应了囚犯的身体健康状况\\n\:
—Health—
1. A prisoner's Health reflects their overall physical health.
2. Prisoners in poor Health may fall ill. Additionally, those involved in negative events may also fall ill.

—Hygiene—
1. Hygiene reflects the overall health condition of the Reforming Center. Every day at 5:00, all prisoners lose Health based on the center's hygiene level.
2. Improving Hygiene reduces the chances of prisoner illnesses.
text.1.生病的囚犯可以进入医务室进行治疗。\\n\\n\r2.床位不够时囚犯需要排队:
1. Sick prisoners receive treatment in the Infirmary.

2. When there is a shortage of beds in the Infirmary, prisoners must wait for treatment. Those in line for treatment are unable to work.

3. Upgrading the Infirmary increases its capacity and reduces treatment time.

4. After receiving treatment, prisoners recover their Health, enabling them to resume production activities.
text.1.在车间生产时发生恶性事件的囚犯将进入禁闭室接受惩罚。\\n\\n\r2.提升:
1. Prisoners who cause negative events during workshop production will be put into the confinement room for punishment.

2. Upgrading the confinement room reduces the time needed for prisoners to rectify themselves.

3. Frisking prisoners in confinement rooms might uncover hidden products.
text.1.铁盟律师协会的律师们会为整顿中心的囚犯们提供帮助。\\n\\n2.聘用律师可: 1. BCRL attorneys offer diverse support to the prisoners in the Reforming Center.\n\n2. Hiring attorneys enables you to secure additional parole from prisoners.
text.1、整顿宿舍用于容纳囚犯，可以在这里看到未工作囚犯的日常生活。可以扩建更多的整顿:
1. Dormitory is where prisoners reside when they are not working. You can expand it to house more prisoners.

2. The dormitory or living areas can only be expanded when your Reforming Center reaches a required level.

3. Each living area contains 6 beds, and each expansion allows for 6 additional prisoners.

4. Sick prisoners may be located in the dormitory. Tap to send them to the infirmary for treatment.
text.1.车间生产制造是整顿中心生产链中的重要一环，用于将各种原料加工成成品。\\n\:
1. Workshops are where materials are crafted into finished products.

2. Once you have configured prisoners and selected a recipe, you can start the production at the workshop.

3. Production consumes the materials stored in material warehouse. The finished products will be placed in product warehouse when claimed.

4. You can schedule multiple production tasks simultaneously based on your needs.

5. Certain recipes will only be available for exchange once your Research Center reaches a specific level.

6. Production requires time. You can use items to accelerate production.

7. The final production rate is determined by: ① basic production rate ② extra production rate, and ③ production rate granted by buffs.
text.1.每个车间可设置一名车间组长，车间组长设置后新设置的生产计划将会根据车间组长的:
1. You can assign a workshop leader for each workshop. The leader will offer bonus effects depending on their skills.

2.Workshops currently in production cannot have their leaders changed.

3. Workshop leader skills include:
        Security Supervisor: Reduces production violation rate.
        Labor Contractor: Significantly increases extra production rate.
        HR Manager: Reduces production time.
        Quality Supervisor: Slightly increases extra production rate.
text.1.每名囚犯都拥有一个特长。\\n\\n\r2.囚犯在进行特长对应类型生产时会获:
1. Each prisoner possesses a specialty.

2. Prisoners gain a 2% boost in extra production rate when working on tasks aligning with their specialty.

3. Specialty Types:
        Prisoners with the Tailoring specialty receive a bonus when working on textile production.
        Prisoners with the Weaving specialty receive a bonus when working on fabric production.
text.---囚犯性格---\\n\r1.每名囚犯都拥有一个性格。\\n\\n\r2.不:
—Prisoner Trait—
1. Each prisoner has a trait.

2. Prisoners of different traits might trigger special events during production.

3. Feral, Rebellious, Greedy, Obsessive, Gluttonous, Depressed, Timid, and Impulsive are Bond traits.

4. Unsociable, Lazy, Humorous, Enthusiastic, and Meticulous are Aura traits.

—Special Events—
1. Prisoners might trigger special bond events during production.

2. Some events can lead to production halting, prompting your intervention to resume it. If there is no enough time left for another production batch after the production resumes, you will not receive a production.

3. Prisoners who trigger negative events will be sent to the confinement room with a deduction in their Behavior Pts. Victims will receive treatment in the infirmary and receive event bonuses.

4. When a prisoner leaves in an event, you can tap their sewing machine to assign a reserved prisoner. The original prisoner's stats will be inherited.
text.该装备正在占用囚犯载量，无法卸下: This equipment is occupying prisoner load and cannot be removed.
text.导入错误，请复制正确配置编码: Incorrect configuration for import. Please enter the correct code.
text.痕迹还很新，杂乱的分布可以看出驾驶员十分慌乱。: The traces are still new. The cluttered spots indicate that the driver was quite flustered.
text.进入站点后才可以更改贴图选项: Please enter a station before adjusting textile options.
text.<b>收益降低！！！</b>\\n1.入侵生物出现后，如果超过48小时（红色感叹: Revenue Reduced!!! 1. If invaders appear and stay on your island for more than 48 hours (as shown by a red exclamation mark), your revenue from tourists will drop by 20%. 2. If you fail to clean the trash on your island within 48 hours or if the trash exceeds the capacity, your island's Cleanliness will gradually decrease, impacting your revenue. 3. To return to the normal status, you need to eliminate all the invaders and restore your island's Cleanliness to 100%. 4. Invaders will no longer appear once your island's Stability reaches its maximum level.
text.距离海角城不远，一座未开发的小岛，即将在您的规划下化身充满夏日气息和奇幻冒险的度:
Not far from Cape City, there is an undeveloped island awaiting transformation into a summer-themed resort brimming with fantasy adventures under your guidance. As a skilled conductor, you surely can make money while on vacation! Build your island and set out on this exciting new journey!

Event Instructions
Construct Your Island
Complete diverse quests from the Island Authority to develop your island, unlock new facilities, and oversee the transformation from a deserted land to a bustling vacation spot.

Manage Your Island
Strategically place greenery, decorations, and store amenities. Complete quests to gather construction materials and unlock fresh island areas. Devise unique marketing tactics to draw more tourists, boosting your island's rating and income.

Island Patrol
Unexpected guests have arrived on your island, which is currently in the process of becoming a vacation hot spot. Maintain peace and progress by repelling these intruders! Conquer event stages for fantastic rewards! All stages can be challenged multiple times! It's time to showcase your prowess, Conductor!

Island Commemorative Cards
Island commemorative cards can only be obtained from the Island event. There are a total of 7 cards, and Conductors can collect them all by completing quests and upgrading your beach hut to the highest level. These keys will have future uses in upcoming versions, so please stay tuned for updates.

Event Rewards
All Conductors can obtain Shell Tokens by completing island missions and repeatedly challenging event instances. In addition, you can earn Volleyball Coins by participating in volleyball matches. Once you have collected enough tokens and vouchers, you may use them to exchange for various rewards through the Island Authority, including Fran's skin "Darkness There & Nothing More," Laplace Protocols, crew member equipment, train weapons, Purchase Appl., Slab Shards, and more.
text.请先选择生产人员和配方: Please select production personnel and recipe first.
text.可用电力不足，请提升电力中心等级: Insufficient power. Please upgrade the power center.
text.车间人员变动，请重新进入: Workshop personnel has been changed. Please re-enter.
text.订单共享后只能获得部分收益，是否继续？: Only partial rewards can be obtained from shared orders. Continue?
text.不在活动时间内，不能使用: This item can only be used during the event.
text.需要前往海岛收取: Please head to the island for collection.
text.已经超过两天未清理过垃圾了，海岛清洁度上限降低了%d%%: You have not cleaned up trash for more than 2 days. Your island's maximum Cleanliness has reduced by %d%%.
text.您离开的这些日子，我们都很想念您，还好终于等到您回来啦！为了庆祝您的回归，无垠号: We missed having you around, and we're thrilled that you're back! To celebrate your return, the Eternal crew has prepared a gift for you! Please accept it as we embark on our journey together once again!
text.洗心革面，改过自新。铁盟整顿中心，帮助迷途知返者重获新生。: BCRL Reforming Center, where strayed individuals undergo mental reshaping and soul purification to start anew.
text.只有在海角城才能投资！: Investment is only available in Cape City.
text.只有在海角城才能收钱！: Money collection is only available in Cape City.
text.报告会记录从列车长上次离开禁闭室至回到禁闭室的情况，可反复查看，离开禁闭室后重置: This report tracks the period from your last check of the confinement room until your return. It can be reviewed and resets upon leaving the room.
text.当前车间所有囚犯均在生产中，无法上阵: All prisoners in the current workshop are working, cannot change lineup.
text.要不要来和鱼进行一场辩论？这可是非常难得的机会，会说话的鱼在世界上可不多。: Fancy a debate with fish? This is a one-in-a-million opportunity. There aren't many fish in the world that can speak.
text.鱼的身体没办法承受过于复杂的思想，只能通过梦境让意识外显，在我的视角里这个世界只: The bodies of fish are unable to handle overly complex thoughts; they can only let their consciousness manifest via dreams. In my perspective, this world is merely a dream of a fish. Maybe you're currently in one of yours too, Conductor.
text.我尝过各种各样的鱼饵和饲料，虽然营养丰富，但并不怎么好吃……大多数鱼是不会喜欢的: I've tried a plethora of fish bait and feed. They might be nutritious, but they don't taste good... Most fish wouldn't like them, even though we must rely on these foods to survive.
text.你已经有了狼脑袋的朋友，机械脑袋的朋友，现在又多了鱼脑袋的朋友——显然，能决定我: You already have a wolf friend, a robot friend, and now a fish friend... Clearly, what decides who we are isn't our appearance but our free will, albeit it isn't really free.
text.生活就是生活，不要在生活中寻找意义。这是我作为一条普通的鱼所得出的结论。: Living is living; no need to look for a purpose. This is the conclusion I've arrived at as an ordinary fish.
text.欢迎光临！这里是海角城水族馆，同时提供参观、导览和水族交易服务。: Welcome! This is the Cape City Aquarium, where you can look around on your own, go on a guided tour, or participate in aquarium trading.
text.有什么问题尽管问我，没有人比我更懂水族！: Let me know if you have any questions. No one knows aquatic life better than me!
text.不妨多在这里转转吧，毕竟人类可是很难潜到海底的。: Feel free to wander around here. After all, it's tough for humans to dive to the bottom of the sea.
text.您不是鱼，您当然不会知道鱼在想什么，但我是鱼，我可以帮你问他们。: You're not a fish; obviously, you won't know what the fish are thinking. But I'm a fish. I can help you ask them.
text.如果有一天我不想开店了，可能会选择去您列车上当一条无忧无虑的鱼？: If I no longer want to do business someday, I might just choose to be a happy-go-lucky fish on your train.
text.欢迎你，我亲爱的列车长。你看，我还记得你呢，鱼的记忆可不止七秒。: Welcome, my dear conductor. See, I still remember you. Fish's memory lasts way longer than just seven seconds.
text.今天的鱼和昨天的鱼可不是同样的鱼了，请多看看吧。: Today's fish and yesterday's fish aren't the same. Please take a closer look.
text.又有一些新朋友来到这了，如果您有兴趣，可以让它们去你那里住。当然，钱是要付给我的: More new pals have joined us. If you're interested, you can take some to live with you. Of course, you will have to pay me for it.
text.每种生物都有适合它生存的环境，不同的水质、温度、压力，在挑选的时候也请多加注意。: Every creature has its own proper living environment. Different water quality, temperature, pressure, and so on need to be taken into account. Please take note of this while making your selection.
text.你喜欢它吗？稍等，我去问一下它的意见。……没问题，它愿意和你走。: Has it caught your eye? Hold on, I'll ask what it thinks... No problem, it's willing to leave with you.
text.贩卖同类？不不不，对这些水族来说，我只是帮他们换了一个住所，他们不会有意见的。: Trafficking my own kind? No, no, no. To these aquatic creatures, I'm simply helping them move to a new home. They won't mind.
text.送它回来吗？没问题，把它交给我吧，它之前鱼缸还空着呢。: You want to send it back? Sure, let me take care of it. Its previous fish tank is still vacant.
text.看来你们的契合度不太好。如果列车长也可以和鱼交流的话，说不定能解决这类问题……: Looks like you two aren't that good of a match. If you could also communicate with fish, perhaps such issues could be resolved...
text.尊敬的列车长，现将医务室情况作报告如下: Here is the report for Infirmary:
text.仓库容量即将达到上限，领取后将丢失部分物品: Warehouse almost full. Claim now and you'll lose part of the products.
text.仓库已满，无法领取: Warehouse is full. Unable to claim.
text.获得“发射中心大桥通行证”前往阿妮塔发射中心: Advance Construction to Get the Pass
text.火箭基地位于西大陆铁道环线最西部的一座岛屿之上，曾被划归为阿妮塔的最高级机密设施: With Morphic Moon's descent, spaceflight development ceased, presenting unprecedented challenges to spacecraft progress.
text.铁道环线主路与火箭基地的大桥遭到大型桦树生物破坏。请协助运送资材、重修大桥，重新: Please assist us in transporting materials, reconstructing the bridge, and reestablishing the connection to Rocket Base.
text.报告会记录从列车长上次离开医务室至回到医务室的情况，可反复查看，离开医务室后重置: This report tracks the period from your last check of the infirmary until your return. It can be reviewed and resets upon leaving the room.
text.欢迎欢迎，您又来了！在海边玩得怎么样，还开心吧？: Welcome, welcome! You're back again! How was the beach? Did you have fun?
text.海角城很漂亮吧？当年我也是爱上了这里的景色，所以才决定定居这里的。: Cape City's beautiful, isn't it? Back then, I fell in love with the scenery here too, which was why I made the decision to settle down here.
text.海边好就好在随时有海鲜吃。要我去那种内陆站点，我肯定受不了！: The good thing about the beach is the never-ending seafood available to eat. I definitely won't be able to tolerate those inland train stations!
text.这不是列车长嘛，欢迎欢迎！您要是有空的话，我们谈完生意以后请您吃顿好的？: Aha, isn't it the greatest conductor of all time? Welcome! If you have no other plans, how about I buy you a meal after we're done talking shop?
text.我这儿的顾客大多眼光挑剔……所以你就放一万个心吧，我不会以次充好的！: The majority of my customers are fussy... So, worry not. You won't find any inferior goods here!
text.只要您提供的东西好，我一定买下！: As long as what you have is good, I'll buy it!
text.看来库存是一点儿都没了，您不介意的话，明天再来看看？: Seems like I'm completely sold out. If you don't mind, how about coming back tomorrow?
text.仓库这边走——那边的冷藏柜里是刚进的冰鲜龙虾，新鲜着呢！: This way to the warehouse. The freezer over there has newly stocked frozen lobsters. They're incredibly fresh!
text.<color=#b45e01>{goods}</color>这段时间销路可好了，: <color=#b45e01>{goods}</color> have been flying off the shelves these days. Aren't you going to seize the chance to make some money and treat your crew to something nice, Conductor?
text.……列车长，你有喜欢的人吗？如果有的话，可千万别和对方分开，也别吵架……: ...Conductor, do you have anyone you like? If you do, you mustn't separate or fight with them...
text.我都好久没和家里人联系了，你在其他篝火城里是不是也多多少少和他们打过交道？……那: It's been a long time since I got in touch with my family. You've probably interacted with them when you visited other Bonfire Cities... Um, when you go to Gronru City's Trading Center, you'll be able to see Goldiana, right?
text.我现在的追求只有美食！自从离婚……哎，不提也罢。都是我的错，当时不该贪小便宜……: The only thing I'm after now is food! Ever since getting divorced... (sighs) Forget it. It was all my fault. I shouldn't have been miserly... It's so lonely to eat by myself...
text.新的一天，挺胸抬头，打起精神来啊！: It's a new day! Chin up, chest out, and perk up!
text.呦，很准时，那么就来看看任务吧。: Oh-ho, right on the dot. Come check out the missions, then.
text.看起来蛮像样的嘛，不过还不是能得意忘形的时候。: Not bad, but it's not the time to be complacent yet.
text.上次做得不错，看起来这次也可以放心交给你喽？: You did well the last time. I guess I can leave everything to you again this time, too?
text.唔……最近的表现可以打个99分，可别松懈了。: Hmm... I'll give your recent performance a score of 99. Better not start skiving.
text.呼……谢天谢地，看到你来了我就能喘口气了。: Phew... Thank goodness. I can finally take a breather now that you're here.
text.正好你来看看，（指）这里，还有这里，都有问题不是吗？你说这些人，怎么工作都能这样: You're just in time. Come take a look at this. (points) Here and here. They're all not up to scratch, correct? Geez, how could these people be so negligent with their work? This isn't something to horse around about.
text.不得不承认，你确实越来越靠得住了。嗯哼，我都这样说了，你还推脱什么？坦诚点接受好: I must admit, you're truly becoming more and more reliable. Mhm, I've already said so. Why are you still trying to be humble? Just accept it as is. It's not like I'll actually hand you a prize.
text.来尝尝这个，新鲜出锅，你可是第一个试吃的。啊，喂！你怎么样了？快喝口水（递），什: Come try this; it's fresh out of the pot, and you're the first tester. Huh? Hey! You okay? Quick, drink some water. (hands over water) What the? You're so bad with spice? Then what do you even eat in Cape City for sustenance?
text.休假，这个世界上还存在那种东西的吗？…… 当然是开玩笑的了，我又不是能24小时不: Does a vacation break even exist in this world? ...Of course it's just a joke. It's not like I'm a robot that can function without any rest. Still... Wait a sec. Hey, you two over there! Stop slacking!
text.你说最近压力很大？我倒是知道家不错的攀岩俱乐部，你可以去放松一下——工作完成的前: You've been under a lot of stress lately? Well, I know of a pretty good rock climbing club. You can go let loose a little... on the premise that your work is completed. Don't look so startled. Of course, I have my own hobbies as well.
text.有什么可犹豫的，选力所能及的事情然后大胆去做就好了！: What's there to hesitate? Simply pick whatever's within your ability and then do your damnedest!
text.我先忙着，你考虑好了再叫我吧，但可别在这步耽误太多时间。: I'll carry on with my work for now. Let me know when you've made up your mind, but don't waste too much time on this.

text.<b>垃圾压缩机</b>\\n1 每天5:00刷新后，可以在这里收取海岛每片\\: Trash Compactor Station\n1. Here, you can collect the trash produced by all the carriages after 5:00 daily.\n2. The compactor station compresses the trash into compacted blocks at regular intervals and stores them in the repository.
text.<b>垃圾溢出</b>\\n1 当有海岛区域超过48h未收取过垃圾或暂存\\n区: Trash Overflow\n1. Trash overflow occurs when you have not collected trash from any carriage for more than 48 hours or when the stored trash blocks exceed the repository's limit.\n2. Trash overflow will decrease the Max Cleanliness. Therefore, it is important to regularly clean up the trash.
text.<b>垃圾清理</b>\\n1 在垃圾暂存区花费铁盟币清理所有垃圾\\n块。\\: Trash Cleaning 1. You can spend BCRL Coins to clean up the trash blocks stored in the repository. 2. When your train arrives at a garbage dump, you can exchange trash blocks for BCRL Coins. 3. You can transfer trash blocks stored in the island repository to the one on your train.

text.一、承包内容\\n\r\r\r\r整顿中心及生产车间的管理、生产及运营。\\n\:
I. Scope of Contracting
Party B shall be responsible for the management, production, and operation of the Reforming Center and production workshop.
II. Rights and Obligations of Party A
1. Party A shall provide Party B with suitable production facilities, <color=#cc6e0a>including a prisoner dormitory and two living areas,</color> in accordance with the funds provided by Party B.
2. Party A shall provide Party B with the necessary site, water, electricity, and security services.
3. Party A shall provide assistance to Party B when Party B conducts management, production, sales, and other activities in compliance with laws and regulations.
4. Party A shall supervise Party B's management, production, sales, and other activities in accordance with laws and regulations. If Party B violates the terms of the contract or laws and regulations, Party A reserves the right to revoke the management authority of the Reforming Center and production workshop.
III. Rights and Obligations of Party B
1. Party B shall pay Party A a leasing cost of <color=#cc6e0a>600,000 BCRL Coins</color> and provide <color=#cc6e0a>400 units of Power</color> for the dormitory.
2. Party B shall oversee the dormitory in compliance with pertinent regulations, encompassing staff deployment, sanitation upkeep, among other aspects, and shall acknowledge Party A's oversight.
3. Party B shall manage criminals in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations, and report to Party A through the formal process.
4. Party B shall install fire-fighting apparatus in accordance with the stipulations of Party A and the local jurisdiction.

text.1、整顿中心属性分为安全度、稳定度、服从度、卫生度。达到一定值后，会产生对应的效:
1. Reforming Center stats include Security, Stability, Obedience, and Hygiene. When these values reach specific thresholds, certain effects will be triggered.

2. Increasing Security decreases the success rate of jailbreak and increases the extra production rate.

3. Increasing Stability reduces the jailbreak occurence rate and increases the extra production rate.

4. Increasing Obedience reduces the production violation rate and increases the extra production rate.

5. Increasing Hygiene reduces the prisoner illness rate and increases the extra production rate.

Only unlocked routes can be used for transit. As your Transit Center levels up, you can spend BCRL Coins to unlock additional routes.

text.1.列车长需要派遣5名护卫乘员承接委托任务。完成委托后可获得相应的奖励。\\n\:
1. You need to dispatch 5 crew members to undertake the patrol commission. Upon completing the patrol, corresponding rewards can be gained.

2. Completing quests in BCRL Terminal can increase the amount of BCRL Coin rewards.

3. Completing all BCRL Agency eviction quests in Mander Mine allows you to take on more types of patrol at the same time.

4. On BCRL Day, which is Wednesday, double rewards can be claimed upon patrol completion.

5. By activating Trailblaze Brochure, you can take on more types of patrol at the same time.

6. By activating Eternal Brochure, you can claim double rewards upon patrol completion.

7. Each crew member can only engage in one patrol at the same time.

8. You can set the duration for each patrol. The longer the duration, the richer the rewards gained upon completion.

9. Dispatching crew from the recommended faction and with higher levels will increase the base amount of BCRL Coin rewards for each patrol.

10. Dispatching crew from the recommended faction will increase the base amount of material rewards for each patrol.

11. If you cancel a patrol during its process, you can quickly release the occupied crew, but you will not gain rewards.

text.---羁绊事件---\\n\r装腔作势：发生事件两名囚犯停止生产，处理后继续生产:
—Bond Events—
Goldbricking: Two prisoners temporarily stop production. After intervention, both resume production with increased yield.

Quarrel: Two prisoners temporarily stop production. After intervention, both are put into the confinement room and have their terms extended.

Bully: Two prisoners temporarily stop production. After intervention, the bullied is sent to the infirmary, and the bully is put into the confinement room and has their term extended.

Theft: Two prisoners temporarily stop production. After intervention, both are put into the confinement room and have their terms extended.

Riot: Two prisoners temporarily stop production. After intervention, both are put into the confinement room and have their terms extended.

Rebellion: Two prisoners temporarily stop production. After intervention, both are put into the confinement room and have their terms extended.

—Aura Events—
Lone Wolf (Unsociable): The prisoner temporarily stops production. After intervention, they resume production with increased yield.

Slacking (Lazy): The prisoner temporarily stops production. After intervention, they resume production with increased yield for both themselves and nearby prisoners.

High Spirited (Humorous): After intervention, both the prisoner and nearby prisoners gain a slight bonus to their yield.

Motivated (Enthusiastic): After intervention, both the prisoner and nearby prisoners gain a moderate bonus to their yield.

Dedicated (Meticulous): After intervention, both the prisoner and nearby prisoners gain a significant bonus to their yield.

text.你好。我是罗洁尔的模拟人格影像，代替她处理一些汇流塔的接待事务。她不在的期间，请: Greetings. I'm Raziel's simulation hologram, filling in at the tower's front desk while she's away. Please feel free to ask me any questions while she's out, and I'll do my best to assist you.
text.“是机器人”？不是哦，模拟人格影像就相当于停留在这里的另一个罗洁尔。我会完全遵循: A robot? No, think me as a replica of Raziel here. I'll perfectly replicate her memory and way of thinking, rest assured.
text.咦？你又来啦。我很开心哦，毕竟获得汇流塔访问权限的人本就不多，常来这里的人更是其: Oh? You're back. I'm so glad. Few people have the access to Confluence Tower, and even fewer would pay a visit. Thank you for visiting me.
text.多谢你一直对汇流塔这么上心……呼，有了你在，我的工作好像都变得轻松了不少呢！: Thank you for your concerns for Confluence Tower... Phew, with your presence, everything seems to run a lot smoother around here.
text.接下来播放的是罗洁尔本人的录音。“做得很好哦，{playername}，请就这样: Here's a voice recording from Raziel herself: "You're doing great, {playername}. Keep up the great work."
text.看来你已经成为独当一面的列车长了……我很高兴。希望你的旅途一路顺风……如果需要我: Looks like you're a capable conductor already... I'm happy about it, and I wish you a smooth journey ahead... If you ever need my help, swing by here anytime.
text.我分析了周围的环境后，整理出这些讨伐委托。: I've analyzed the situation around here and organized these commissions.
text.汇流塔附近也不太平呢……: Things aren't peaceful even around Confluence Tower...
text.决定出发战斗的话，一定要小心啊。: If you're heading into a battle, please stay safe.
text.战斗中的要点我都标注在任务详情中啦。: I've highlighted the key info in the details for you.
text.多亏了有你帮忙，我才能在这里安心读书。: Thanks to your help, I can focus on my studies here without any worries.
text.一路上辛苦了吧？要不要先休息一下？: Must've been a tough journey. Need a breather?
text.我准备了零食哦！不过是超级辣的，你吃得消吗？: I prepared some snacks! They're super hot, though. Can you handle it?
text.保持物资储备充足是很重要的工作哦。: It is crucial to keep ample stock of supplies.
text.看见了奇怪的订单的话，也不用勉强自己去做的。: Don't force yourself if the order seems weird to you.
text.谢谢你，辛苦啦。: Thank you, you've been so helpful.
text.嗯，这些货物我收下了！: Yeah, I'll take care of this cargo!
text.有点像是第一次遇见的时候，你们帮我搬东西的场景呢……: This reminds me of you helping me move stuff when we first met...
text.我自己也可以搬得动！啊，不过我只是个幻影，好像还是没办法……: I can carry these things myself! Oh wait, I'm just a hologram. I can't actually do that...
text.看来你觉得这项订单值得重视……: Looks like you're taking this order seriously...
text.我相信你会合理安排工作的。: I'm sure you'll handle your tasks with finesse.
text.好呀，我替你找一个其他的。: Sure, I'll get another one for you.
text.过去看过的书上说，“灯塔是伫立在海浪上的房子”，汇流塔在我看来也是一样。咦，这么: I once read in a book that "a lighthouse is a house standing on the waves." Confluence Tower feels like that to me, so... I guess I'm the towerkeeper here!
text.在外面遇见了什么危险的事情吗？你的衣服都染上灰尘了……别动哦，我来替你拍一拍。: Did you run into any trouble out there? Your clothes are all dusty... Let me give you a pat.
text.嗯……我的“心智漫步”，这种看起来很有意思的升构能力，有时却能对他人造成意料之外: Well, my Ascension Ability is intriguing, but it can have unexpected effects on others, so I must use it with caution. That's the deal with most Ascension Abilities, right?
text.学会的许多研究项目连我和丽桑德拉也不一定了解……所以无法全面地为你介绍，对不起哦: Some of Citadel's research programs are top secret, even Lissandra and I are kept in the dark... Sorry, can't tell you everything. But as long as it's something I can tell you, I won't keep them secret.
text.汇流塔的高处很适合看夕阳，当然也很适合看日出。如果你愿意在这里多待一会儿，我很乐: It's a perfect spot for enjoying sunsets and sunrises up on the tower. If you'd like to stay a while longer, I'll be delight to show you, Conductor.
text.欢迎光临，请问需要点什么？: Welcome! What can I help you with today?
text.这里都是顶尖的学会装备，可以随便挑选。话说我的对货单放哪去了……: We've got top-notch Citadel equipment here. Take your pick. Oh, where did I put that shipment list...?
text.很高兴为您提供帮助。只要是为了人类的安全，我——哈欠。抱歉，我昨晚没睡好……: I'm here to help. As long as it's for the sake of humanity, I— *Yawn* Sorry, didn't sleep well last night...
text.被迫加班？不，完全没有，索思学会的加班制度是纯自愿的。当然紧急情况除外。: Forced overtime? Nope, not at all. Overtime at Source Citadel is completely voluntary, except in emergencies.
text.啊……果然还是在这里工作心情会比较好……走到露台上就能看见一望无际的大海，简直就: Ah... I love working here. It feels like a vacation stepping out onto the terrace and gazing at the endless ocean...
text.不知道罗洁尔小姐怎么样了呢？上次偶遇的时候她还说要约我一起去城里逛街。不过一直没: I wonder how Miss Raziel is doing. Last time, she said she wanted to go shopping in the city together, but I haven't had the chance to catch up with her since then...
text.汇流塔里的“住客”……我有听说哦。不过以我的职级不能向你透露，抱歉啦。: The "residents" inside the Confluence Tower... I've heard about them, but I'm now allowed to tell you that info. Sorry about that.
text.之前瓦伦汀小姐来过，给我带了一些零食，说是看书的时候可以吃……结果我一边翻文件一: Valentine brought some snacks for me earlier, said I can enjoy them while reading... and well, I finished them all while going over the files. Hopefully, I didn't leave any crumbs in those important files, ahaha...

text.我很期待你会用它谱写怎样的新章。: I'm looking forward to seeing the new journey you'll embark on with it.
text.我并没有忘记作为黑月员工的本职：诚心交易，钱货两清。: I haven't forgotten my role as a Night Chains employee. I trade honestly and ensure fair exchanges.
text.在很多冒险故事中，对物品的选择也会成为影响故事走向的重要环节。: In many adventures, the items you choose can steer the story in interesting directions.
text.你带来了怎样的故事呢？: What kind of stories have you brought to the table?
text.每一件旧物都承载了一段往事。: Each ancient artifact holds a fragment of history within it.
text.存在于你眼前的器物是“故事的结局”，在它诞生的过程中不知有多少名角色参与其中。: The artifact before you represents the end of its story, with numerous characters contributing to its creation.
text.如果早知道会有这样有趣的发展，我就应该在接受此次外派时多准备一些带上……: If I knew things would get this intriguing, I should have packed more when I accepted this task...
text.你应该不会想着用武力方式获得之类的事情吧？: You're not considering a violent approach, are you?
text.你很好奇我在面具下的真容？也许……打开以后里面是空的呢？: Curious about my face beneath my mask? But what if... it's just emptiness inside?
text.除了文字类书籍，我也很喜欢漫画书，想到用这种形式来讲故事的人可真了不起。: Besides novels, I'm also a fan of comics. The idea of storytelling in that format is simply impressive.
text.我从未真正抵达过曼杜斯帝国，如果能得到允许，我会很乐意前往……那里一定有许多可以: I've never set foot in the Mundus Empire. If I ever get the chance, I'd be thrilled to explore it... I can only imagine the countless stories just waiting to be discovered there.
text.身上有故事的人我一眼就能看出来，比如像{playername}你这样的。反过来的: I have this knack for picking up on people who hold fascinating stories, just like you, {playername}. On the flip side, there are people like Alcyon, I suppose.
text.我的上司是一位很懂得享受美与乐趣的人，这也是我追随他的重要原因。如果有机会，你可: My boss appreciates beauty and fun, and that one of the crucial reasons I chose to follow him. If you ever find yourself in Night Chains Land, you might bump into him, and he'd be delighted to meet you.
text.遵循谜题的指引抵达乐园所在之地，在门扉的另一侧是否有你期望的一切？\r\r\\n:
Follow the clues to uncover the legendary ONEderland. Will you find everything you seek beyond the gate?

Event Rules
I. Complete the Storyline and Discover the Secrets Within the Hotel
The construction of ONEderland is progressing, with one of the key projects, the ONEderland Hotel, finally completed. This hotel, closed for many years, has been surrounded by rumors—such as its previous owner hiding a significant fortune within. During its trial operation, unexplainable events have occurred... Accept the generous invitation of Peter Hwang, the current owner of ONEderland, and explore the ONEderland Hotel to uncover its hidden secrets.

II. Enjoy New Challenges in New Stages
As the event progresses, a total of eight "Induction" stages will unlock, and Conductors can re-challenge these stages for rewards. In the event's second phase, new "Deduction" stages will unlock, offering engaging battles and generous rewards for all Conductors.

III. Solve Puzzles, Collect Clues
Participate in the event and clear stages to obtain Clues, which can be exchange for various items including Laplace Protocols, Silver Branches, Purchase Appl., Self-Observe Films, and mysterious equipment at Gray Market.

IV. Complete Event Achievements
This event introduces an event quest system "Investigation Objects." By completing event quests, Conductors can obtain splendid rewards, including Chaos Stones, Cactus Lollipops, and Commemorative Pack – Knocking on Estranger's Door.※ Commemorative Pack – Knocking on Estranger's Door can only be obtained from Knocking on Estranger's Door event. There are a total of 7 unique cards, and Conductors can collect them all by unlocking rewards and achievements. These unique cards will have future uses in upcoming versions, so please stay tuned for updates.

text.调整视野距离。此项设置越高，大世界的加载和显示距离越远: Adjusts sight distance. A higher level allows a larger portion of the world to be loaded and displayed.

text.诚邀您进入由澄明数据中心负责人摩尔改造的虚演空间！在虚演空间中，护卫乘员可以不受: CDCA Bureau invites you to the calculation space developed by Administrator Moore! You can engage in simulated battles to earn splendid rewards.
text.收藏配方数量已达上限: Unable to add more recipes to favorite.

text.调整实时阴影的最大渲染距离。超过设定值的阴影将不再被渲染: Adjusts the maximum rendering distance for real-time shadows. Shadows exceeding the set value will not be rendered.

text.装设多种先进设备的垃圾处理中心。: A trash disposal center equipped with advanced equipment.
text.黑月锁链驻远星大桥的特殊办事处。: Night Chains' special office at the Apoaster Bridge.
text.远星大桥管理中心，负责桥梁的日常管理。: The management center of the Apoaster Bridge, responsible for the daily affairs of the bridge.
text.哈里弗克斯打捞公司的办事处，承接多种近海远洋打捞委托。: The office of HaliFox Salvage, handling a wide range of offshore salvage commissions.
text.欢迎使用垃圾回收服务！……布雷斯？不，我叫莱斯特，您认错精了！: Please feel free to utilize the trash recycling service! ...Breese? No, I'm Lester! You've gotten the wrong one!
text.请您收下，这是我的名片……我真不是布雷斯。: Please take this. It's my name card. ...I'm really not Breese.
text.感谢您对垃圾回收服务的支持。为了创造更舒适的列车运营环境，这是我们应该做的。: Thank you for your support of the trash recycling service. It's what we should do to create a better environment for train operation.
text.看来最近我在各地投放的商业广告卓有成效，来这里的列车长比平日更多了。: Looks like the business advertisements I placed everywhere have been beneficial. More conductors have been coming here than normal.
text.垃圾处理站采取特殊方式压制和处理垃圾，将其分为可利用和不可利用……啊，说多了！今: The trash disposal center utilizes special methods to compress and sort trash into usable and non-usable ones... Ah, I've talked too much! What can I do for you today?
text.感谢您对垃圾回收服务的一贯支持，希望和您继续保持良好合作关系！: Thank you for your continued support of the trash recycling service. We hope to maintain a satisfactory partnership with you!
text.看来您的列车垃圾箱急需清理！别担心，交给我吧！: It seems your train's trash bin needs cleaning right now! Don't worry. Leave it to me!
text.布雷斯！……啊，忘了他不在这……抱歉，请您别在意。: Breese! ...Ah, I forgot he's not here... Sorry, please don't mind me.
text.垃圾处理器的声音对我们来说就像工作的背景音乐一样，一天也少不了。: The sound of the trash processor is just like background music to us. There isn't a day that goes without it.
text.多谢您的帮助，请务必收下这些我们准备的礼物！: Thank you so much for your help! Please accept these gifts we prepared!
text.垃圾回收是很重要的一项工作，您的所作所为值得收到这些奖励。: Trash recycling is exceedingly important. You deserve these rewards for your contributions.
text.您看，这是我从铁盟那里新收到的“环保回收标兵”奖章……没有炫耀的意思，就是想和您: Look, this is the "Environmental Guardian" medal I just got from BCRL... I'm not trying to show off. Just wanted to share the news with you!
text.喜欢的东西？呃……很多啊，什么高尔夫、马术、篝火城散步……还有……奶酪。奶酪是最: Things that I like? Uh... A lot, like golf, equestrianism, Bonfire City strolls... and... cheese. Cheese is ranked last on the list!
text.故乡？在我的故乡的确流传着一个“雪夜信使”的故事，据说我们曾经是给人带来希望和美: Hometown? Indeed, there's a "Winter Night Messenger" story well-known in my hometown. It's said that we used to be a clan that brought hope and well wishes to humanity... But now, all I want is to succeed in my profession.
text.商业宣传的要诀就是时尚、鲜明、抢眼，至于把个人爱好过度融入商业宣传是绝对不行的，: The keys to business marketing are trends, distinctiveness, and to be eye-catching. Incorporating too much personal preference into it will never work out, but Breese simply likes doing that. It's a pain to get along with him, right?
text.这处垃圾处理站是新建成的，设施相比仅凭改造的熔炉号处理站要先进一些。多亏投资人的: This trash disposal center is newly built, with more high-tech facilities compared to the Furnace. This is all thanks to the support of our investor! ...But there has to be more to that investor...
text.这还是第一次见面吧？不用拘谨，叫我“墨瑟”就行了！: This is the first time we're meeting, yeah? No need for formality. Just call me "Mercer"!
text.吓到你不是我的本意，放心好了，我这头盔下面是个实实在在的人类。: It wasn't my intention to scare you. Worry not. I am indeed a human underneath my helmet.
text.你看起来总是很忙碌，太勉强自己可不好。: You always seem so busy. It isn't good to push yourself too hard.
text.哦，你看上去对我的造型适应得很快……不，我不仅没有烦恼，还很高兴，只是这种事很少: Oh, you seem to have gotten used to my getup rather fast... No, I'm not anxious, I'm actually ecstatic. It's just these things rarely happen.
text.你处理这些工作的样子很熟练，我那时可比你差远了。: You're very proficient with these tasks. I wasn't even half as good as you back then.
text.和你共事的感觉确实让人感到很舒心，我想你已经听过无数次这类评价了。: Working with you genuinely makes people feel at ease. I reckon you must have heard feedback like this countless times.
text.落星大桥总是不太平，还需要请你多多帮忙。: The Fallen Star Bridge is constantly in a state of unrest. It would be greatly appreciated if you could help out.
text.麻烦事很多……希望你能帮把手。: There are tons of troublesome matters to deal with... Could you lend a hand?
text.这里有不少任务都很危险，可要小心行事。: Many of the tasks here are highly dangerous. You ought to be on your guard.
text.无论什么时候安全都是第一位的，你可以仔细考虑。: Safety is always the priority no matter what. You can spend some time and think it through.
text.自从我被派遣到这里，落星大桥就一直是这样了，也许它会因为你发生好的转变。: The Fallen Star Bridge has been in this state ever since I was posted here. Maybe you could be the one to turn things around.
text.落星大桥工程持续期间，会一直存在大量的物资需求。: There will be a huge demand for supplies for as long as the Fallen Star Bridge project lasts.
text.只有少数列车长有能力往来落星大桥，我很高兴你是其中一位。: Only a handful of conductors are capable of coming to the Fallen Star Bridge. I'm glad you're one of them.
text.有些需求并不是那么紧急，尽管选择你认为合适的就行。: Some needs aren't that urgent. Just go ahead and choose whatever you think would be appropriate.
text.我其实不是特别擅长整理工作，如果有混乱的地方记得及时告诉我啊！: To be honest, I'm not that good at organizing. Remember to let me know promptly if anything is mixed up!
text.我会马上通知他们接收这些物资。: I will inform them to collect these supplies right away.
text.这么多物品也能整理地井井有条送过来，实在是帮大忙了。: My, there's so much stuff, yet you still managed to deliver them in apple-pie order. This would save us so much time!
text.愿意的话，你可以在这里坐坐，休息一会再出发。: Feel free to take a seat here if you'd like. Get some rest before setting off again.
text.我明白我的外表很吓人，但比起我面具下的面容……还是戴着对大家更好。: I know my looks are frightening, but rather than the face beneath my mask... it's better that I keep my mask on.
text.除了黑月为我安排的工作，我还会在儿童剧场扮演被英雄打倒的坏人。正因为有邪恶，正义: Aside from the work Night Chains assigns me, I also act as bad guys defeated by heroes in children's play. Righteousness is only noble because evil exists. So long as I can make the children smile, it doesn't matter how many times I'm beaten as the villain.
text.当我骑上摩托时，就会暂时忘记那些扎根于脑海的烦恼，总是驾驶着列车的你能明白这种感: When I'm riding the motorcycle, all of those deep-rooted worries in my head will vanish temporarily. Do you also relate to that since you're always driving the train?
text.我的斧子是用消防斧改造的，斧头可是非常好用的工具，便携、快速、致命、无声无息……: My axe is adapted from a fire axe. Axes are excellent tools. Handy, swift, lethal, inaudible... Hang on, I probably shouldn't be saying these. Please forget that.
text.听说最近发生了几起列车上的消防事故，你可要多加小心，我可以告诉你一些消防安全方面: I heard through the grapevine that there have been several fire accidents aboard trains. Make sure to be more careful. I could share with you about some fire safety know-how. Hopefully, they will be useful for you.
text.有的时候，舍弃一些多余的东西是有必要的，我可以理解……: It's necessary to give up some extra stuff at times. I can understand that...
text.无需为自己的选择感到后悔。: No need to regret the decision you made.
text.选中某个目标并为之努力，听上去正像是正义的伙伴们会做的事情。: Choosing a goal and working hard for it. Sounds precisely like what righteous people would do.
text.就算是正义的伙伴，也会有迷茫的时候……: Even righteous people have times when they feel lost...
text.那就来看看有没有更适合你的选择吧？: Let's see if there's anything more fitting for you, then?
text.黑月一向很擅长制造出令人喜爱的商品，相信你能找到最合心意的那个。: Night Chains has always been excellent at creating products that people love. I'm sure you'll find the one you like most.
text.下决定确实是一件困难的事，你可以慢慢来。: It is indeed tough to make decisions. Take your time.
text.哦，来了啊。进来说话吧，外面风很大……这可是海上。: Oh, you're here. Let's talk inside. It's windy outside... We're on the sea, after all.
text.你好。……无论你想说什么都无所谓，但请说吧。: Hello. ...It doesn't matter what you're going to say, but you may go ahead.
text.我在的职务？从前算是个打鱼的。在黑月里做的事也差不多。: My job? Used to be akin to fishing. What I do in Night Chains is similar to that.
text.被派到这里来是由于我熟悉附近的环境和状况，也对海洋有所了解……这是我个人的推测，: I was assigned here because I'm familiar with the surrounding environment and situation, and the sea... At least that's what I deduced. Most people in Night Chains don't really need a reason to do what they do.
text.我的出生地是贡露城，但我可不想回去……哈，那地方从根子里都烂透了，只有表面上光鲜: I was born in Gronru City, but I would never want to go back there... Tch, that place is rotten all the way through. It just looks glamorous on the outside. You better keep your eyes peeled if you visit it.
text.我的脾气不算好，说话也不是很中听，你……啊？你感觉还好？……行吧。: I don't have a good temper, nor do I have nice things to say. You... Huh? You think I'm all right? ...Okay then.
text.这个站点没有餐馆餐厅之类的，因为实在离城市太远。假如你哪次在这边恰巧饿了，可以来: There are no restaurants or diners in this station because it's simply way too far from the city. If you happen to be hungry when you're here, come find me. I know one thing or two about cooking.
text.要什么就自己选吧，我在这儿只是看门的。: Just take whatever you want. I'm purely the doorman here.
text.喏。有的货箱很沉，我可以帮忙搬——你需要的话。: There. Some crates are really heavy. I can help you carry them... if you need.
text.你认识罗洁尔？！你……见过老师吗？她——她还好吗？: You know mentor Raziel?! Have you... seen her? I-Is she okay?
text.我曾经是罗洁尔的学生。但现在，如你所见，只是因为无用被抛弃的……有谁能来给我新的: I used to be a student of Raziel, but as you can see now, I'm abandoned due to my uselessness... Who can give me new orders...
text.抱歉，之前的样子……是我失态了。我会试着打起精神的，现在请您对我下令吧。: Sorry, I... lost my composure earlier. I'll try to pull myself together. Now, please command me.
text.嗯，谢谢你这段时间经常来看我。我已经基本了解情况了，接下来应该做的就是……认清现: Mm. Thank you for coming to see me regularly these days. I'm caught up on the situation now. What I have to do next... is to accept the reality, I guess.
text.啊，您又来了……就像之前那样就好。只要能派上用场，您让我做什么都可以。: Ah, you're back... Please treat me as usual. I will do anything for you as long as I can be useful.
text.这些都是我无法独力完成的作战。: These are battles that I can't fight on my own.
text.但愿作战过程中不会遇见什么危险……: Hopefully, the battle will go smoothly with no danger...
text.我还没有获得和无垠号乘组并肩作战的资格。抱歉。: I haven't yet earned the right to fight alongside the Eternal crew. I'm sorry.
text.如果战前准备阶段有什么我能帮上忙的，请尽管告诉我。: Don't hesitate to let me know if there's anything I can help you with during the preparation phase.
text.抱歉，没能帮上您的忙。: I'm sorry. I wasn't of any help to you.
text.来的路上很辛苦吧？: It must have been a long journey here.
text.你真的很厉害。简直就像是不会感到疲倦一样……: You're truly impressive. It's as if you'd never feel tired...
text.有些订单可能会不合常理。……不接取也没关系，我会想办法代您解决。: Some orders might seem absurd. ...It's fine if you don't accept them. I'll find a way to handle them for you.
text.谢谢。真的很感谢……: Thank you. Thank you so much...
text.如果我能变得像你一样坚定的话…: If I could become as resolute as you...
text.请务必命令我为您帮忙搬运！拜托了……: You must command me to help you with transportation! Please...
text.我这就去清点货物！……谢谢您愿意给我这个机会，我正需要做些什么……: I'll go take stock right away! ...Thank you for giving me this chance. I really needed something to do...
text.老师还在塞纳诺尼克的时候，我是她的学生，也是她的助手之一。……也许都怪我没能帮上: When mentor was still in Senanonic, I was her student and also one of her assistants. ...But I was never helpful to her. Perhaps that's why she... No, nevermind. I've said too much.
text.管理这里是件很简单的事。只是坐着处理订单和委托事务而已，再加上一些杂事……根本不: Managing this place is incredibly simple. All I need to do is to handle the orders and commissioning at the desk, as well as run some errands... It's nothing worth mentioning at all. But if this will be of help to someone...
text.模拟人格影像……虽然人们有各种各样的观点，但我不介意我的意志被复制。说到底，我也: Personality simulation... People have all kinds of opinions about it, but I don't mind having my consciousness replicated. After all, I'm just an insignificant nobody. But if it were her... I wouldn't know how to face that...
text.感谢您对我的关心，但……不，还不行。我还有要做的事……只有我，不应该休息。我只想: Thank you for your concern, but... no, not yet. There are still things I have to do... I am the only one who shouldn't rest. All I want are new commands, any command will do...
text.“管家”先生？他的确……是个说话很动听、也很有城府的人。是他给了我可做的事，也给: Mr. "Butler"? Yes, he's indeed... someone very affable and sophisticated. He's the one who gave me temporary emotional support and something I could do. I must thank him for that.
text.我相信您的安排是正确的。: I believe you made the right decision.
text.嗯，我想您自有决断。: Mm, I'm sure you have your own considerations.
text.希望您的旅途中不会遇见什么烦心事。: I hope you can have a smooth trip without any trouble.
text.要出发了吗……: Are you about to set out...
text.您有别的安排吗？真希望能为您分忧……: Do you have other plans? I wish I could share some of your burden...
text.我不会妄议您的决定。祝您一切顺利。: I won't question your decision. All the best to you.
text.如果这些物资中有您心仪的，可以由我代为搬运。: If there's anything you like, I could transport them for you.
text.……有什么别的需要吗？要不要我为您更新一批货物？: ...Do you need anything else? How about I get you some new goods?

text.内容概况\r\r\\n\r\r一、完成活动剧情\r\r\\n\r\r通往岚心城的:
Event Rules
I. Complete the Storyline
A new breed of Deep Sleepers has surfaced near the railway leading to Ranshin City, encircling the city's vicinity. Meanwhile, a mysterious visitor has arrived on the Eternal CBCRR23...Complete the event storyline "Hayajiro Beyond Grenzlinie" and eradicate the scourge of the crisis!

II. New Challenges in Recollect Stages
During the event, seven "Afterglow" stages will unlock, allowing players to challenge them repeatedly for an unlimited number of times and get rewards. Upon clearing all "Afterglow" stages, new "Mumyou" stages will unlock, providing even greater rewards.

III. Collect Ranshin Koban and Exchange for Supplies
Complete "Recollect Stages" on the event screen to earn Ranshin Koban, which can be exchanged for Silver Branches, Purchase Appl., Self-Observe Films, mysterious equipment, and other items at the Supply Service.

IV. Complete Event Quests to Get Splendid Rewards
This "Hayajiro Beyond Grenzlinie" event features exclusive event tasks, accessible through the Task List on the event screen. Complete these tasks to earn rewards including Chaos Stones, Cactus Lollipops, Commemorative Pack – Hayajiro Beyond Grenzlinie, and more.
※ Commemorative Pack – Hayajiro Beyond Grenzlinie can only be obtained from the "Hayajiro Beyond Grenzlinie" event. There are a total of 7 unique cards, and conductors can collect them all by unlocking rewards and achievements. These unique cards will have future uses in upcoming versions, so please stay tuned for updates.

V. Special Commission: Mission Kabaneri
The regions affected by the "Hayajiro Beyond Grenzlinie" event are overrun by ironhearted mutants. To safeguard the railway, BCRL has issued special annihilation commissions. Accepting these quest requires Annihilation Permits and Fatigue points, and completing these quests yields special supplies and BCRL Coins.

1. You can like other conductors up to 3 times a day.
2. Liking another conductor grants you a random gift from the B.C.R.L.
3. Liking chances are replenished daily at 22:00.
4. Purchase Chaos Stone Tree Incubator to gain an additional daily chance.

text.1、囚犯刑期内概率产生越狱事件，越狱成功者将离开整顿中心，越狱失败者将被关入禁闭:
1. Prisoners may try to escape from the Reforming Center. A successful jailbreak results in the prisoner leaving the center, while a failed attempt leads to confinement and reduces the chance of another escape.

2. Prisoners with longer term have an increased chance of escaping.

3. Prisoners with a higher rarity have an increased chance of escaping and a higher success rate.
text.%s前不能重新接取该订单: Unable to re-accept this order before %s.
text.由于多次放弃共享订单，本周无法接取新的订单！: Unable to accept new orders due to an excess of abandoned shared orders.
