text.哈喽~好，我的热情欢迎就到这里，接下来请自便吧。: Hello~ All right, that's all to my enthusiastic welcoming. Please help yourself now.
text.这里的工作还真是没劲呢。无聊的时候只能在室外看着天空上的飞鸟经过……简直就像是被: The work here is seriously dull. When I'm bored, all I can do is to go outside and watch the birds fly in the sky... Feels like I've been exiled!
text.感谢您的对本店生意的支持~以后也请多多光顾哦~！: Thank you for supporting the shop~ Do come back often!
text.啊，原来你是来消费的啊。那还是比“来看看魇小姐风采”的那群笨蛋好多了，我就破例为: Ah, you're here to shop. That's much better than those idiots who "come to admire Miss Maruha." Well, I'll make an exception and play the enthusiastic employee this time.
text.唔？黑月近期动向？要找我打听情报可是要付出很高代价的，你准备好了吗？: Hmm? Night Chains' recent activities? There's a high price to pay when getting intel from me. Are you ready for it?
text.这是情书请收下~！啊，当然不是情书了，你打开看看，是重要的调查情报哦。这样你就欠: Please take this love letter~! Ah, of course it's not a love letter. Take a look. It's crucial intel. Now, you owe me a favor.
text.听说岚心城内的局势风云变幻……别误会，我对权力可没什么兴趣。只是，这样的话，或许: Word is, the circumstances in Ranshin City are unstable... Don't get me wrong. I have no interest in authority. It's just, this might give me more "hunting opportunities"... Hehe.
text.近期的计划啊……嗯，继续打击大坏蛋！就像我一直以来做的那样，没什么问题吧？: Recent plans...? Hmm, continue crushing bad guys! Just like what I've always been doing. Nothing wrong with that, right?
text.{playername}，妾身在此等候多时了。客人您看，我这新衣服还算合适吧？: O' {playername}, my lord, you had me waiting for ages. What do you think of my new outfit, dear customer?
text.您还习惯被称作“客人”吗？毕竟这是岚心城嘛！人家也会想要些不一样的体验。: How do you like being called "dear customer"? This is Ranshin City, after all! I figured it would be nice to try something different.
text.岚心城这边的穿衣风格还真有趣呢。光是眺望着街上来来去去的人群，就会想着“我也想试: The fashion sense in Ranshin City is truly intriguing. Just looking at the people on the streets makes me want to try their getup... How about you, Conductor? Wanna try on the outfit that matches my current one?
text.不是要说东家的坏话，但岚心城毕竟是黑月的主要据点之一，列车长还是要多警惕对你特别: I don't mean to badmouth my organization, but Ranshin City is one of Night Chains' headquarters. You need to be more vigilant of those who treat you especially well... Huh? Are you suspecting me? If that's so, why don't you come check me up?
text.宵月小姐是个非常有才能的人呢，黑月匠造每个季度的新品都有她亲自参与。这样工作一定: Miss Yoizuki is an exceptionally capable person. She's personally involved in every new product of Night Chains Lesage's seasonal collection. That's gotta be a difficult job~
text.岚心城有新年许愿的传统……在新年钟声响起的时候和心爱之人共同许下的愿望，一定会在: Ranshin City has a tradition of making New Year's wishes... If one makes a wish with their lover as the clock strikes twelve, it will definitely come true in the coming year... Do you have any wishes to make, Conductor? Could you bring me along?
text.这个小家伙？呵呵，是妾身在此结识的“朋友”。猫头鹰在岚心城被认为是能带来幸运和福: This little one? Hehe, It's a "friend" I made here. In Ranshin City, owls are regarded as animals that can bring luck and fortune. I hope it'll bring you good luck too, Conductor. Wanna pet it?
text.上次走在路上被星探发了名片，说什么“适合当明星”……人家才不要。人家只要和列车长: One day, I was walking on the street when a talent scout gave me a name card and said I'm "celebrity material" or something... Fat chance. I just want to be together with you!
text.列车长见到商会的那个孩子了吗？……她背后可是有着不少故事……呵呵，这座城市吃人的: Conductor, have you met that kid from COLUMBA? ...There's a lot about her to know... Hehe. This city doesn't care if it's an adult or a child when it devours people.
text.请随意挑选~妾身精心准备的这些商品，如果能帮上客人您的忙就太好了。: Please pick whatever pleases you~ It would be my honor if these products I carefully prepared could be of use to you, dear customer.
text.岚心城的商业贸易是很发达，可总有东西不会在市面上流通——所以妾身替您把这些好东西: Ranshin City's commercial trade is very prosperous, but there are always items that won't be for sale on the market. So, I've gathered them here all for you~
text.喝一杯吗？当然可以，请允许妾身亲自为您倒上！: Want a drink? Sure thing! Allow me to pour it for you!
text.滋味如何呢，客人？: How does it taste, dear customer?
text.您好像已经喝了不少了……需要妾身自己送您回去吗？保证把您完完整整地放回房间。: You've drunk quite a bit... Do you need me to take you home? I promise to return you to your room in one piece.
text.列车长{playername}。早对你的事迹有所耳闻，眼下总算是见面了……呵呵，: Conductor {playername}. I've heard a lot about you. Looks like I finally get to see you in the flesh... (chuckles) I'm Toki, governor of Ranshin City. Here's to a solid partnership.
text.不必拘束。有什么事但说无妨。: No need to be uptight. You can speak your mind.
text.1. 完成该地块的投资，即可提高当前城市地块投资等级。: 1. Invest in a city to increase its investment level.
text.哦？怎么又来了？: Oh? Why are you here again?
text.看来你还真是一位有野心的年轻人……哈！别担心，这不算什么坏评价。: It seems you're truly an ambitious youngster... Ha! Don't worry. This isn't a criticism.
text.最近城中关于你的传闻不少，列车长。再多努力一些吧，年轻人有这样的进取之心是好事。: There have been quite a lot of talk about you in the city lately. Keep it going. It's a good thing for youngsters to be this proactive.
text.{playername}。在外奔波辛苦，既然回到了这儿，就先好好休息一阵再谈生意: {playername}, it must be exhausting to constantly be on the road. Since you're back, get some rest before we talk business.
text.这把佩刀可不是装饰，我每天都精心保养它……是啊，我也仍算是一名寻求武道之人，怎可: This tachi isn't for decoration. I take meticulous care of it daily... That's right. I'm considered a seeker of martial arts. How could I let the weapons that are virtually my life become dull?
text.坊间不少传闻都将我描述得如修罗恶鬼一般可怖，可流言无论如何都是除不尽的。既然这样: Lots of rumors out there make me sound as terrifying as a Shura or Oni, but they can never be fully dispelled no matter what. In that case, it's best I just walk my own path... That's all.
text.黑月匠造的新品最近似乎在城中又流行起来了。宵月特意给我送来几件，似乎和外头卖的那: Night Chains Lesage's new products seem to gain traction in the city recently. Yoizuki sent a few pieces to me specially. They look different from those designs sold elsewhere. She most likely designed them herself. You can have them if you're keen.
text.岚心城的世家之间有个传统。为家族的继承人培养一个容貌、体格、本领相似的孩子，不暴: There's a tradition among the elite families of Ranshin City—cultivate a child that's kept hidden from outsiders, with similar appearance, physique, and abilities to the family's successor. Such individuals are called Kagebusha, the "Shadow Dancer".
text.你是经历过磨炼的人。这世上空有武力而内心羸弱的人不少，可你——我能感觉到，你比那: There are plenty of people in this world who are physically strong yet mentally weak, but you... You're someone who has been through trials. I can sense that you're much stronger than those people.
text.能在岚心城立足的，无一不是极端聪慧或谨慎的人。遇人遇事不要全信，尤其是那些待你良: Anyone who can establish themselves in Ranshin City is undoubtedly either radical, shrewd, or cautious. Do not take anybody's word at face value, especially those who you treat amicably... Me? Hahahaha! You're truly one clever kid!
text.北辰流以一刀流闻名世间。心定、气定、手定，出过刀便是结束。为人处世要这样才好，于: Hokushinryu is renowned for Itto-ryu. Steady one's heart, breath, and hands; all's over once the blade's out. This is how people should conduct themselves. I guess this is just how it's going to be for me.
text.{playername}，你诚实对我说，在你眼中的岚心城究竟是个怎样的地方？在这: {playername}, be frank with me. What exactly is Ranshin City like to you? What have you observed in this city?
text.多谢。你很谨慎，这在当下的世道中很少见。: Thanks. You're very cautious. This is hard to come by in this day and age.
text.这虽已不算小钱了……我作为城主不该说什么，但作为前辈，我想你有更大的能耐。: Although this isn't considered a small sum anymore... I shouldn't be saying anything as the governor, but as an elder, I believe you're capable of more than this.
text.哈哈，怎么是这不上不下的金额？要是在大场面上，这数量可是压不住阵的。若有胆识，不: Haha! Why such an awkward amount? This sum will be negligible on the big stage. If you have the guts, how about adding more?
text.有胆量。岚心城定当回应你的慷慨，我也是同样。: Very bold of you. Ranshin City will certainly reciprocate your generosity, and same goes for me.
text.哦，钱不够啊……哈哈，在年轻人之间是常事。一时窘迫不算什么，下次再来便是。你不会: Oh, insufficient funds... Haha! That's normal among youngsters. Being hard up for a while isn't a big deal. Just come again next time. You won't accept my beneficence, so I won't even try to offer!
text.哟，来啦。按惯例还是自我介绍一下，我是伏见，以后就要麻烦你了。: Hey, you're here. As usual, I'll start by introducing myself. My name is Fushimi. Looking forward to working with you.
text.坐吧，别客气！岚心城的室内格局和别处不太相同，但你能习惯吧？: Here, take a seat! Ranshin City's interior layout is quite different from elsewhere, but you can get used to it, right?
text.你目前对岚心城的观感如何？就当是收集一下市民意见，和我说说呗。: What do you think about Ranshin City so far? I'm curious. Just take it as a public survey.
text.看你跑得这么勤快，总感觉你比我更适合当铁盟士兵……哎哎，说笑的说笑的，别走啊！: My, seeing how diligent you are, I guess you'd make a better soldier than me... Hey, hey! I was just kidding. Don't go!
text.岚心城的局面……就不对你抱怨了。好在最近有你帮忙，否则我们不知要多组织几次“特别: Ranshin City's situation... I won't rant about it to you. Thank goodness for your help lately, or else we would have to organize more "special ops."
text.哟，来啦。和平时一样，接下来还要多仰仗你了，{playername}！: Hey, you're here. I'm counting on you as usual, {playername}!
text.放轻松放轻松，俗话说平常心才能得胜，是不是？: Relax, relax. As the saying goes, victory can only be realized when the mind is at peace. Isn't that right?
text.打人的委托有，打桦树生物的委托当然也有，你选哪个都行。: There are commissions for fighting people and of course for fighting Chaos Remains. Choice is yours.
text.光从这些委托看，我还是能给你一些简单的作战建议的。: Based solely on these commissions, I can still give you some simple combat advice.
text.我？哈哈，我这人没什么特别的啊。你就当我是靠嘴甜又勤快一路爬到这个位置，好不好？: Me? Haha! There's nothing special about me. You can just take it that I climbed up to this position with my sweet tongue and diligence, all right?
text.想摸摸尾巴啊……哎。也是，我俩都认识这么久了，也算一起经历了好些事了，过命的交情: You want to rub my tail... Ha. Well, we've known each other for so long, and we've been through quite a lot together, a friendship forged through life and death, sworn friends, so I guess it's okay... Huh? You don't want it anymore? Come on—
text.听说外头那家居酒屋的烧鸟串味道不错，局里的大伙经常下班后去那儿聚会，有时我也去…: I heard that Izakaya outside has pretty good yakitori skewers. The guys in the agency often get together there after work. I'd join them sometimes too... How about you come with us the next time? I've been saving you a seat.
text.在岚心城街头没碰上小混混或是找你麻烦的人吧？嗯？没什么，我就问问……没有是最好: Have you run into any thugs or troublemakers on the streets of Ranshin City? Hmm? Nothing. I'm just asking... It would be best if you haven't.
text.之前听同僚提起你，只觉得是个相当厉害的年轻人，见到本人以后反倒觉得挺适合当朋友的: When I heard the others talking about you before, all I thought was that you were a fairly impressive youngster, but after seeing you in the flesh, I thought you'd be a great friend... Hiss, we're friends, right? We got to be.
text.2.提高城市地块投资等级可以提高当前城市产出以及产出资金的储存上限。: 2. Higher investment level grants higher yields and storage limits.
text.给。轻拿轻放，小心摔着。: Here. Handle it with care. Don't drop it.
text.请使用手机版本游戏进行充值: Please use the mobile version for recharging.
text.请随意挑选。当然，我也可以为您介绍一下目前各地的情况。: Feel free to select whichever one you like. Of course, I can also tell you about the current situation of each place.
text.有您中意的订单吗，列车长大人？: Are there any orders that catches your eye, Conductor?
text.您好，欢迎来到岚心城科伦巴商会！叫我小铃就可以了，我去为您倒茶！: Hello. Welcome to COLUMBA Ranshin City branch! You may call me Kosuzu. I'll get you some tea!
text.咦？别的负责人？您指的是年纪更长的人吧，没有哦……这里只有我一个负责人哦，有什么: Huh? Other administrators? You mean someone older? Sorry... I'm the only one here. Please let me know if you have any feedback or suggestions.
text.其实小铃……啊、我还不算成熟，所以各方面都还要请您多指教了，列车长！: Honestly, Kosuzu... Ah, I'm not exactly matured yet, so I'll have to count on you for many things, Conductor!
text.是{playername}大人！您又来了！啊，抱歉，我是不是逾越了……还请您不要: Dearest {playername}! You're back! Ah, sorry, have I overstepped...? Please pardon me.
text.您一直对我十分亲切，真是……言语无以为报，我只能用努力工作来回报您了。: You've been so gentle with me... Words genuinely can't express my appreciation. I can only repay you by doing my best at work.
text.感谢您一直支持岚心城的商业发展。……那，以后也都拜托您了！列车长大人！: Thank you for continually supporting Ranshin City's business development. ...Um, I'm counting on you in the future too, Conductor!
text.我是土生土长的岚心城人哦。这座城市虽然繁华又美丽，但也充斥着居心不良之人……这就: I was born and raised in Ranshin City. Even though it's gorgeous and prosperous, it's also packed with malicious people... I guess this is exactly what it means by "all that glitters is not gold."
text.我从梅迪奇女士那里听说了不少您的事迹，一直很期望能和您见一面……现在能和您面对面: I heard a lot about you from President Medici and always hoped to meet you in real life... It's almost unbelievable that I get to talk to you face to face and hang out with you as friends now.
text.这个铃铛吗？是很多岚心城孩子都会戴着的、用于祈求孩子平安幸福的铃铛。不过我这颗里: This bell? It's something that many Ranshin City children wear, meant to pray for the kids' safety and happiness. Mine doesn't have a clapper in it, though. That might be why I... Ah, nothing. Please don't worry.
text.头发长得太长了……说实话，每天早上都要梳理、编发，有些耗时间呢。列车长大人看过黑: My hair's getting too long... Truth be told, it takes a lot of time to brush and plait my hair in the morning every day. Conductor, have you seen those cool, short-haired women in movies produced by Night Chains? Kosuzu wants to be like them.
text.家人？……小铃已经没有家人了呢。但还是多谢列车长大人的关心，我会坚强起来的。……: Family? ...Kosuzu no longer has one, but thanks for the concern, Conductor. I'll be strong. ...Will you still come help Kosuzu in the future? There's still so much I don't know...
text.相信您一定没问题的。小铃在这里等您回来！: I have faith in you. Kosuzu will wait here for your return!
text.列车长大人……是累了吗？要不要在后面休息一下？: Conductor... are you tired? Why don't you get some rest in the back?
text.请稍等，我确认一下……今日的订单已经全部处理完毕了哦。要不要等明天再来看看呢，列: Please give me a second to check... All of today's orders have been dealt with. How about you come back tomorrow, Conductor?
text.在手头的订单里……嗯！应该这个比较合适！: The orders at hand... Mm! This should be good!
text.这个站点的居民和来往旅客都很少，工作其实很清闲。: There are few residents and travelers in this station, so the work here is frankly rather laidback.
text.听说索思学会的人都很聪明……是真的吗？难道他们真的会拯救世界？: Word has it that everyone in Source Citadel is highly intelligent... Is that true? Can they really save the world?
text.这附近有个很出名的湿地公园！经常有很多观鸟爱好者聚集在附近，希望能碰见稀有的鸟类: There's a very famous wetland park nearby that many bird-watchers love visiting in hopes of encountering rare bird species.
text.栖羽站的名字很诗意吧！但是经常有其他地方来的人表示名字很难读也很难记……: Sumihane means perching birds, beautiful, isn't it? But visitors often talk about how hard it is to pronounce or memorize...
text.本地交易所经常收到来自哈里弗克斯打捞公司的投资，真是太感谢他们了！: Our trading center frequently receives investment funds from HaliFox Salvage. We truly owe them a ton!
text.这座桥有很多地方都适合观景，不过相对地，在海上刮风暴的日子，桥上的景象也很可怕…: There are many spots on this bridge ideal for sight-seeing, but conversely, the view on the bridge is also terrifying on stormy days at sea...
text.嘿嘿，其实我们还负责一部分整顿中心里的物资供应，不过肯定不会和您抢生意的，您就放: Heh! In fact, we also supply part of the Reforming Center's material needs, but fret not, we definitely won't get in the way of your business!
text.在云岫桥站点工作的铁盟员工大多是勤勤恳恳的普通人，只是没法出去购物而已。这种时候: The majority of the B.C.R.L. employees working at the Yunxiu Bridge Station are hard-working common folks who just can't go out to shop. This is when your help is greatly needed!
text.你好你好，咱是理茂——对对，礼貌、狸猫、理茂！: Hi, hi. I am Tanuki. Yes, yes! Tender, nice and kind!
text.变形？咱的确略懂，但这功夫不能教给人类的。别说那个，快来吃点咱新买的点心！: Shapeshift? I do know a little, but this can't be taught to humans. Enough about that. Come taste the snacks I just bought!
text.最近室内空调开得太凉快，咱的脖子毛都厚了不少……是该梳梳了……: The air-conditioner has been turned too low these days, the hair on my neck has thickened... Time to brush it...
text.咱在这岚心城也是经营多年……全靠诚信待人才站稳脚跟。哎，胖是胖了点，可你看我还有: I've run this place in Ranshin City for many years... It's all thanks to my integrity in business. (sighs) Yeah, I am a bit round, but I still have my hands and feet. I'm holding on.
text.今天这天气真舒服！这太阳，这风……哎！别摸咱脑袋上的叶子，会出事的！: The weather's so good today! This sun and breeze... Hey! Don't touch the leaf on my head. Bad things will happen!
text.嚯嚯，您也算是咱这儿的熟客了。闲话不多说，今天要点儿啥？: Hoho, you're basically a regular here now. We'll skip the pleasantries then. What are you looking for today?
text.快来，品品咱刚进的当季新茶！您说家里的事？呵呵，咱一直老老实实待在岚心城里，怎么: Hurry! Come try the seasonal tea I just stocked! You're asking about my homeland? Ha, I've been staying put in Ranshin City. How would I know?
text.想看咱的真身？这就是真身了，咱就是长得和别的娃娃鱼不一样！: You want to see my true form? This is it. I don't look the same as those salamanders!
text.咱每隔段时间就会订些漂亮的衣服、家具之类，给富子还有符渝送过去。哼，照咱的看法，: From time to time, I'll order some pretty clothes, furniture, and so on and have them delivered to Plutessa and Goldiana. Hmph! If you ask me, young ladies absolutely should doll themselves up... How could they stay with those toads who aren't even willing to get curtains!
text.听说{station}那边，{goods}的销路非常不错！: Rumor has it that {goods} are selling pretty well at {station}!
text.据咱的了解，{goods}最近在{station}卖得很好，你可别错过这种机会啊: From what I know, {goods} have been in high demand at {station} lately. You better not miss such an opportunity.
text.容咱看看……对，看来{goods}最近在各个地方都很抢手。假如你车上还有，不妨好: Let me see... Yes, {goods} have been selling like hotcakes everywhere lately. If you still have stock aboard, you should consider cashing them in!
text.城里的趣事啊……有，有。篝火点评必吃榜上第一家那个拉面店的老板，据说从前是道上的: Interesting things in the city...? Certainly. It's said that the owner of the ramen store ranked first on the Bonfire Must-Eat List was a yakuza. Did you know that? ...Actually, that rumor is false. Teehee!
text.街上流行的东西往往几十年一个轮回，喏，你看这不又是咱年轻时候很多人穿的款式。唔，: The things popularized on the streets tend to come back in fashion every few decades. See, isn't this the style that many people wore when I was younger? Hmm, but I'm merely a tanuki. I guess it's not really my place to discuss fashion...
text.仓库这边请！随便看~: This way to the warehouse! Feel free to look around!
text.咱这儿的可都是好东西，你就放心吧。: Everything I have is good stuff. Don't worry.
text.没事没事，多看看多选选！: It's okay. Good to keep your options open!
text.中规中矩吧，也不算坏。: Average, I guess. It's not so bad.
text.有眼光，这可是好东西……嘿嘿，就是贵了点儿。: Fine choice. This is good stuff... just a bit expensive.
text.辛苦了，来坐来坐！: Good work! Come, take a seat!
text.给咱带来了什么好东西呀？: What good stuff did you bring me?
text.不着急，您考虑清楚再出手也行！: No worries. You can always decide after thinking it over!
text.不亏也不赚……还行还行。: Hmm, so-so. Neither a gain nor loss...
text.嗯？这东西现在正紧俏呢，咱愿意高价买下！: Hmm? This thing is all the rage nowadays! I'll pay a premium for it!
text.这东西现在卖的话不划算……哎，不过你说了算！: It's not worthwhile to sell this right now... (sighs) But as you wish!
text.咱这儿实在是没货了，要不您过会儿再来看看？: I'm really all sold out. How about you come back later?
text.好吧，就给您这个价！: All right, you can have it!
text.咱一直是良心价，不能再低了。: Our prices have always been reasonable. This is the lowest it can go.
text.看在您带来的确实是好东西的份上，咱同意了！: Sure, seeing as what you brought is indeed good stuff!
text.哎，我也想给您高价，可是……: (sighs) I wish I could offer you more too, but...
text.好嘞，这就安排一批新货物！: Okay! I'll go get you new goods right away!
text.你眼光很不错嘛，不愧是经验丰富的列车长。: You've got a good eye. As expected of an experienced conductor.
text.这些东西都卖，除了我本人——开玩笑的。: All of these are for sale, except for myself... Just kidding.
text.听响声我就知道你带的岚纹小判还不够。走，我们一起给铁盟打打工去？: Just by the sound of it, I can tell you didn't bring enough Ranshin Koban. Come on, let's go do some odd jobs for BCRL?
text.这些突然出现的敌人可真够难缠的……说实话，幸亏有那个了解它们弱点的年轻人帮忙。: These enemies who popped up out of nowhere are seriously a pain to deal with... Truthfully speaking, we're fortunate to have that young one who knows their weakness.
text.岚心城本来就是有很多怪谈的地方，拜外面的危险情况所赐，最近城里的各种离奇流言更是: Ranshin City has always been a place with all sorts of folktales, but thanks to the perilous situation out there, even more outlandish rumors have been making rounds in the city...
text.听说你是铁山城人？说起来，我有个老朋友应该在那边做生意——哦，你离家好几年了，那: I heard you're from Fortress City? I have an old friend who's probably doing business there. Oh, you've been away from home for years. I guess you won't know either.
text.想摸尾巴？这多不好，我们才认识几天！等你以后来铁安局帮忙了再说。: You want to rub my tail? That's not appropriate, we've only known each other for a few days! We'll see how things go when you come help out in BCRL Agency.
text.这次真要谢谢你及时赶到……等事态平息以后，我一定还你这个人情。: Thank you so much for getting here in time... Once everything is resolved, I swear to return you the favor.
text.哟，来啦。之前我们应该打过照面了，而且现在又是紧急情况中……不如先省略一些礼节？: Oh, you're here. We've met already, and things are critical now... How about we just skip the pleasantries?
text.这些物资有岚心城本地调取的，也有铁盟和黑月突破了重重危险送来的……也算是八方支援: Some of these supplies were provided by Ranshin City, while some were painstakingly sent by BCRL and Night Chains... Pretty much everybody chipped in.
text.按需交换就好，剩余的物资还很充足。: Just trade what you need. There are still a lot remaining.
text.虽然很想从身后变一个出来给你，但这个实在是没有了！: I wish I could magically make one for you, but we're really out of stock!
text.亲爱的列车长，正值澄明数据中心嘉年华如火如荼展开之际，我衷心希望您也能参与到节日: CDCA Carnival is in full swing, and I sincerely invite you to join the festivities for a good time. I will be waiting for you in CDCA Bureau.
text.最近修格里城内似乎流行起了一种新型红茶，而且坊间还开始流传一些红茶的“神秘功效”: Recently, a new type of black tea seems to be trending in Shoggolith, and there are even some "mysterious effects"... If you're interested, please make sure to visit Shoggolith tomorrow.
text.该好友收到的\\n请求数量已满: Target friend's request list is full.
text.清剿许可不足，无法前往，建议前往补给处兑换: Insufficient Annihilation Permits. Please obtain from Supply Service.
text.由一对犬亚人夫妇经营的拉面店，连续多年登上岚心篝火城必吃榜前十。: A ramen store managed by a dog demi-human couple, top ten popular food joints in Ranshin.
text.过去岚心城主的住处，如今只是一介旅游名胜。: What was once the residence of the Lord of Ranshin is now a tourist attraction.
text.结合岚心古韵与现代风格的居酒屋，总是坐满了客人，其中偶尔会有出现在电视和报纸上的: A pub that merges Ranshin's traditional allure with a modern touch.
text.由时尚地标901大楼而得名的街道，充满追逐潮流的时尚弄潮儿。: A lively street named after 901 Building landmark, frequented by trendsetters.
text.岚心城的铁路调度中枢，也起到城内客货运枢纽的作用。: Railway dispatch center in Ranshin City, also the primary hub for internal transportation.
text.知名高端设计品牌“黑月匠造”的门店，穿上一件这里的衣服，就是荣升地位的最佳证明。: An outlet of the luxury brand "Night Chains Lesage," its attire symbolizing elevated social standing.
text.*每次挑衅提升%d级: * Each provocation increases the enemy's level by %d.
text.*难度越高奖励越多: * The higher the difficulty, the greater the rewards!
text.栖羽站主要的货物装卸区。: The primary cargo loading and unloading area in Sumihane Station.
text.为初步处理栖羽站养殖厂产出的原料而设的加工厂。: A processing facility to manage the raw materials sourced from farms in Sumihane Station.
text.西大陆铁路环线规模最大的禽类养殖场之一，产出鹅绒、鸭绒等重要服装填充材料。: One of the largest poultry farms along the Western Loop, specializing in essential clothing stuffing materials.
text.历史悠久的观鸟地点，候鸟和观鸟客源源不断地拜访此处。: A renowned bird-watching location that has drawn numerous migratory birds and bird-watchers.
text.列车进击，冲破阻拦！\\n\\n\r列车的冲击力大于被撞敌方生命值时，即可成功碾:
Break through the barrier!

If your train's Impact Force is higher than the enemy's HP, you will crush the enemy outright and earn points.
If your train's Impact Force is lower than the enemy's HP, your train will sustain damage, and you will only earn a small number of points based on the enemy's remaining HP.
Boosting your train's speed and equipping [Ram] enhances its Impact Force.
Equipping train weapons bolsters your train's armor and reduces DMG taken.

Equipping turrets allows your train to automatically target airborne and massive enemies up ahead.
Turrets consume ammunition, which can be replenished by purchasing the [Bullets] item at BCRL Outpost Trading Center.
Each [Bullets] item provides 30 units of ammunition.

Upon completing the elimination, you will receive basic rewards along with extra rewards based on your points.
Mission Kabaneri costs [Annihilation Permit] and Fatigue.
Mission Kabaneri yields rewards including [Ranshin Koban], [Duty Medals], [Sleeper Root], and a large amount of [BCRL Coins].
text.确定要放弃挑战吗？放弃后本次行动中无法再次挑战: Cannot rechallenge in this turn if you give up.
text.由于不在车站，无法自动修理并补满弹丸，是否继续前往清缴: Not in station. Can't auto repair and refill. Continue anyway?
text.您没有报名，中途加入游戏需要花费以下资源购买门票: Not registered. Joining midway requires following items.
text.你能想到的我早都想到了！哎呀，兑换处这东西我十年前就见过了，简单简单。: I've long thought about whatever you can think of! Exchanges were already a thing a decade ago. Piece of cake.
text.搞点东西卖而已，对我来说还不是小菜一碟？: It's just taking some stuff to sell. This is child's play for me.
text.所在位置为城市，无法使用此道具: Unable to use this item while in a city.
text.使用对象错误，请重新选择: Invalid target. Please select another target.
text.距离海角城不远，一座未开发的小岛，即将在您的规划下化身充满夏日气息和奇幻冒险的度:
Not far from Cape City, there is an undeveloped island awaiting transformation into a summer-themed resort brimming with fantasy adventures under your guidance. As a skilled conductor, you surely can make money while on vacation! Build your island and set out on this exciting new journey!

Event Instructions
Quest
Complete diverse tasks issued by the "Island Authority" to develop your island, raise its level, unlock new facilities, and attract new visitors.

Manage Your Island
Strategically place greenery, decorations, and store amenities to increase the overall rating of your island, raising its level and unlocking new areas. Devise unique marketing tactics to draw more tourists, boosting your island's rating and income.
You can review investments, operations, and collect operation income via Island Authority – Operation Revenue.

Unlock New Stores and Decorations
You can obtain [Material Vouchers] from Island Patrol and Quest. These vouchers can be used for purchasing island facilities and decorations via Island Authority – Decoration Store.

Island Revenue, Cleanliness, and Invaders
Island facilities and decorations accumulate trash over time, requiring regular cleanup of both trash and trash blocks. Trash unhandled for 48 hours reduces your island's Cleanliness, thus impacting the your revenue.
Invaders may show up on your island, impacting your revenue if not eliminated within 48 hours.
Keep an eye on your island's Cleanliness and promptly eliminate invaders.
text.请注意，离开后下次行动前无法再次进入商店: Once you leave, you cannot enter again.
text.请选择要购买的商品: Please select the items to purchase.
text.持有道具数量已达上限: Unable to hold more of this item.
text.你的失败次数已经用完，无法重新挑战: Unable to retry. Challenge attempts used up.
text.未参与本期游戏: You have not participated in this event.
text.请选择骰子并使用: Please select a dice to use.
text.1.在“咕噜噜大冒险”中，列车长可以通过战斗和事件等途径获得各种各样的奇妙道具，:
1. In Rumbling Monopolis, you can gather various magical items from battles and events, which can prove invaluable during your journey.

2. Only one item can be used per turn.

3. There is a limit to the number of items you can carry. You cannot carry more items if the limited is reached.

4. Drag items onto the target to use them. Certain items are only usable on specific targets, while others don't require target selection.

5. Traps can only be placed on non-city tiles. Placing a new trap on a tile with an existing one will replace the original trap. Traps set on the starting tile have no effects.

6. After an item is used, its icon will be displayed on the UI. Tap on the icon to check item effects, durations, and remaining uses.
text.1.每天中午12:00，地图上都会刷新出一位娃娃鱼：【财深】或【贫琼】。\\n\:
1. Each day at 12:00, a random salamander will appear on the map, which could either be [Reech] or [Poar].

2. Upon stopping at the salamander's tile, you will receive its blessings. After that, the salamander will follow you.

3. The salamander's blessings will expire at 12:00 the next day.
text.1.每局游戏内都会存在1个【嚎虎箱】，需要同1局游戏内的各个玩家齐心协力才能击败:
1. In every round, a [HowlingBox] will appear on the map, and all players need to collaborate to defeat it.

2. Each player can challenge the [HowlingBox] once per day.

3. Upon a successful challenge, the [HowlingBox] will lose 5% of its Max HP. When its HP is reduced to 0, all players in the round will receive rewards.

4. Failing the challenge grants rewards based on the HowlingBox's remaining HP in the fight, and [HowlingBox] loses HP proportionate to its remaining HP in the fight.

5. You can seek assistance from another player who has participated in Rumbling Monopolis to confront the [HowlingBox].

6. Every day, each player can assist up to 3 friends in challenging the [HowlingBox].
text.1.每局“咕噜噜大冒险”，地图上都会刷新若干【泥嚎箱】。\\n\\n\r2.玩家:
1. In every round, several [HelloBoxes] will appear on the map.

2. Players need to stop at their tile in order to challenge them.

3. Players can use the item [Noise Kinase] to provoke them and raise their level. Higher level grants better rewards.

4. Players can use the item [Metaplasia Bait] to generate a [HelloBox] at a random location on the map.

5. [HelloBoxes] only vanish when defeated.
text.1.“咕噜噜大冒险”是由科伦巴商会倾情打造的沙盘经营游戏，每局至多8名玩家同时进:
1. "Rumbling Monopolis" is a sandbox management game passionately created by COLUMBA Chamber of Commerce, with up to 8 players per round, featuring asynchronous interaction between players.

2. At the start of round, each player has a starting fund of 100,000 and 10 dice.

3. After participating in the current round, players can obtain a certain number of dice daily during the game period, with more dice available on weekends.

4. Players can obtain additional dice from 12:00 to 15:00 and 18:00 to 21:00 daily, with more dice available on weekends. Dice have a holding limit.

5. By rolling the dice, the player's train moves according to the points rolled.

6. Each time a player rolls the dice, the game map is refreshed in real-time, including the coordinates of all players and item usage status.

7. Players can only choose a direction to travel when they cannot move forward or are at a station. Direction can also be changed by using certain items.

8. The map contains numerous railway tiles, each with corresponding events.

9. When stopping on a city tile, players can invest in the city, increasing the city's investment level, thereby boosting the city's Funds yield.

10. The Funds generated by the city have a storage limit and must be claimed while on the city tile.

11. "Rumbling Monopolis" lasts 4 rounds, each lasting one week, with rewards settled based on the investment leaderboard across the server. The investment amount does not reset after each round.

12. The rewards for each round of "Rumbling Monopolis" can only be claimed during the next round. After the fourth round ends, the current event's rewards can be claimed from 5:00 on the game ending day until the event page closes.

text.内容概况\r\r\r\r\\n\r\r\r\r\r一、参与域外联合 加入行动\r:
Overview
I. Join Uncharted Ops
Participating in Uncharted Ops allows you to earn substantial BCRL Coins. Players need to defeat as many enemies as possible within the limited time to gain more Coins.

II. Exchange for Supplies
Participate in Uncharted Ops, and after completing stages or quests, you can obtain "Ops Bonus Pts." Use these points at Redemption to exchange for various rewards such as Silver Branch, Purchase Appl., Self-Observe Film, Train Livery - Demonic Eye and more.

III. Complete Event Quests
This event has event quests that can be viewed through the "Sequence" interface. Complete these quests to gain Chaos Stones, Cactus Lollipops and more.

text.距离海角城不远，一座未开发的小岛，即将在您的规划下化身充满夏日气息和奇幻冒险的度:
Not far from Cape City, an undeveloped island is about to transform into a summer-themed and fantastical adventure resort under your planning. As an excellent Conductor, you can surely enjoy both vacation and earnings! Build your exclusive island and embark on this unknown adventure!

Friend Island Instructions
Go to Friend Island
On the left side of the island, there is a friend button. Click it to open the friends list, which will show information about friends who have already opened their islands. You can click to visit your friend's island.

Friend Island Activities
(1) You can like a friend's island to increase its popularity.
(2) If there are invasive creatures on a friend's island, you can help drive them away. Your friend will receive rewards, and you will receive 50% of the rewards as compensation. There will be a limit on the number of times, refreshing daily at 5 am.
(3) If a friend's trash bin is full, you can help clean it up for a chance to gain some trash blocks. The chance decreases with the number of successful gains, and your friend's pet will also reduce the probability of gaining trash blocks. The higher the pet's rating, the greater the reduction in probability. Click the button next to the success rate to view details. Each day, there will be a certain number of cleaning opportunities for each friend, refreshing at 5 am daily.
The success rate of gaining trash blocks = base success rate (1) * repeated cleaning reduction rate * pet watching reduction rate.
Repeated cleaning reduction rate = 1 - success reduction rate (0.3) * number of successful cleanings.
Trash blocks gained from cleaning are directly sent to the temporary storage area of the train trash bin.

Visit Records
You can view the history of friends' visits and today's visit records through the visit records in the friend island list.
Today's visit records refresh daily at 5 am.

text.在铁轨近侧突然出现的神秘构造物，其中孕育着某种令人不安的形态场———那些本不应该: The mysterious being that suddenly appeared harbors an unsettling Morphic Field—enemies have made an unexpected comeback in unforeseen forms. Who is recreating the past, attempting to bring crisis back to the Western Continent?
text.暂无茶歇祝福，请前往喝茶屋或花园！: No Teatime Blessing. Please obtain from Teahouse or Garden!
1. Gain gems from buildings, floats and shops.\n2. Set off fireworks at the castle with different gems to earn powerful buffs against the witch!
text.“多抓了几个，送你了。”: Caught a few more, all yours.
text.你的队伍全都被击败了，是否重整队伍继续挑战: Your team has been wiped. Retry?
text.欢迎来到我的乐园，唱歌跳舞，欢笑流泪……在这里尽情挥洒你的美吧！: Welcome to my paradise, where you can sing, dance, laugh, and cry... Feel free to showcase your beauty here!
text.你今天来的有点迟，是什么绊住了你的脚步？在这乐园之中有太多引人注目的事物……要是: You arrived a bit late today; what held you back? In this paradise, there are too many fascinating things... If you're only focused on the wonders before you, you might miss your step and fall into the rabbit hole.
text.越是打磨，你的光彩就越是耀眼！: The more you polish, the more dazzling your brilliance becomes!
text.来抽一张牌吧，嗯……我猜你抽到的是黑桃6，这并不是你以为的那种魔术，而是既定的命: Come draw a card, hmm... I guess you drew the six of spades. This isn't the kind of magic you think it is; it's predetermined fate. Take it; this is a good card that matches your efforts.
text.这孩子从刚才开始就有些兴奋，看来是提前感知到你会过来……能得到它的青睐，是一件可: This child has been a bit excited since just now, it seems to have sensed in advance that you would come over... Being favored by it is something you can boast about, okay?
text.啊……我实在是越来越好奇，你还可以怎样蜕变得更加美丽……既然如此，就不应该让你再: Ah... I'm really getting more and more curious about how you can transform to become even more beautiful... Since that's the case, you shouldn't be held back in place anymore... This feeling of contradiction and joy is truly spine-tingling.
text.战斗，是一种多么禁忌又摄人心魄的残酷美学啊。: Battle, what a forbidden and captivatingly cruel aesthetics it is.
text.你是哪一种类型呢？酣战至浑身浴血？还是双手不沾染一丝尘埃？: What type are you? Fighting fiercely until you're covered in bloodbath, or do your hands remain completely spotless?
text.从糖果和糕点的甜味中，依稀能闻到金属和火药的气味……真美啊。: From the sweetness of candies and pastries, one can faintly smell the scent of metal and gunpowder... It's truly beautiful.
text.有机会让我亲眼欣赏一番吧？你领导他们战斗的模样。: Give me a chance to see for myself, will you? The way you lead them in battle.
text.你落败的模样一定也十分美丽……啊，不过一般人更喜欢听“祝你凯旋归来”这种话吧？: Your defeated appearance must also be very beautiful... Ah, but most people prefer to hear something like "wish you a triumphant return," right?
text.人类就是被各种各样的欲望所驱使的生物。: Humans are creatures driven by various desires.
text.从这些需求可以轻而易举判断出这个人的需要，进而抓住对方的弱点……这些技巧对你来说: From these needs, it is easy to determine this person's requirements and thus seize their weaknesses... These techniques might be useful for you as well, right?
text.“感觉有些奇怪的东西”？因为我总是希望尽可能去搜集美丽的事物……: "Something that feels a bit strange"? Because I always hope to collect beautiful things as much as possible...
text.虽然不是人类，但是这孩子也会有想要的东西哦？: Although not human, this child will also have things it wants, you know?
text.让我也用惊喜来回应你吧！比如用这顶帽子变出什么？: Let me surprise you in return! For example, what can I conjure up with this hat?
text.哦呀，这孩子……看它的模样，也在肯定你的成果呢。: Oh, this child... looking at its appearance, it seems to be affirming your achievements as well.
text.哦呀哦呀，如此的完美，让我都想现在就抓住你的手共舞一支，沉浸在欢欣的韵律中了！: Oh my, oh my, so perfect that it makes me want to grab your hand right now and dance a piece together, immersed in the joyful rhythm!
text.我曾经也尝试过占卜师的工作，看着脆弱的羊羔们就这样向陌生人敞开心门，还真是让人把: I once tried working as a fortune teller, watching the vulnerable lambs open their hearts to strangers like that, it was truly hard to resist... This easily attainable pleasure is not bad to enjoy occasionally.
text.你想摸摸这孩子吗？那就请尽管试试吧。……它躲开了？是的，那孩子不怎么喜欢触摸……: Do you want to touch this child? Then feel free to try... Did it dodge? Yes, that child doesn't really like being touched... Haha, your disappointed expression is really interesting.
text.听说你在列车上喝红茶比较多，要试试这杯加了糖霜奶油顶的红茶吗？嗯，看来你对新事物: I heard you drink a lot of black tea on the train. Would you like to try this cup topped with frosted cream? Hmm, it seems you're quite open to new things. There used to be someone who only drank green tea made in the most traditional way and never got tired of it.
text.不管是用于休闲竞技还是魔术表演，都要确保能完全掌控手中的牌才行。你也是，要牢牢握: Whether it's used for casual competition or magic performances, you must ensure complete control over the hand cards. You too should firmly hold your own cards and make sure not to lose them.
text.黑月游乐城的草莓味雪山芭菲合你心意吗？隼每次来都会吃个不停……就是他向你提起的？: Does the strawberry-flavored Snow Mountain Parfait from Night Chains Land suit your taste? Hayabusa can't stop eating it every time he comes... Is he the one who mentioned it to you? It seems he really likes you. But as for Arina, she would probably only let you eat things she's made herself.
text.你在追求你心目中的完美吗？: Are you pursuing the perfection in your mind?
text.不需要的东西就将其舍弃……你是个效率主义者呢。: Unnecessary things should be discarded... You are an efficiency expert.
text.就像猎人击中猎物一样迅捷凛然！: As swift and imposing as a hunter striking its prey!
text.就像爱神的箭矢一样不容抗拒！: Just like the irresistible arrows of Love!
text.呵呵，没有关系，因为这里是魔法有效的地方，所以开弓也可以有回头箭。: Hehe, it doesn't matter, because this is a place where magic is effective, so once an arrow is shot, it can still turn back.
text.如果可以，我真想将所有美丽之物在此奉上！但我的能力还不足以和野心匹配啊……: If possible, I truly wish to offer all beautiful things here! But my ability is still not enough to match my ambition...
text.你做出的选择可以显示出最迫切的需求，你的欲望是何等的姿态呢？真让人好奇啊。: The choices you make can reveal the most urgent needs, and what form does your desire take? It's truly intriguing.

text.1.在魔女创造的空间中不断前进，收集美梦徽记和宝石提升自身战斗力。\\n\\n\:
1. Navigate through the space created by the Witch. Collect Dream Emblems and Gems to strengthen yourself.

2. Chase down the Float Parade to earn random but generous rewards and Gems.

3. Set off fireworks with Gems to gain buffs, and defeat the final boss "Mournful Witch·Serena."

text.1.每局开局可以选择自己的行动点数。\\n\\n\r2.每行动一次消耗5行动点。:
1. You can select your AP at the beginning of each round.

2. Each movement costs you 5 AP.

3. Failed battle costs you 20 AP.
text.1.黑月游乐城中包含10大固定建筑：糖果屋、占卜屋、喷泉、摩天轮、扫把训练营、旋:
1. There are 10 facilities in Night Chains Land: Candy House, Divination Room, Fountain, Ferris Wheel, Broom Academy, Carousel, Garden, Teahouse, Witch's Home and Castle. Each facility offers a certain event and a Gem of a random color (except for Castle).

2. Events:

— Candy House / Divination Room: Polishing.

— Fountain: Treasure and random Tracker.

— Ferris Wheel: A 3-minute consecutive battle.

— Broom Academy: A 3-minute consecutive battle.

— Carousel: 5 consecutive battles.

— Garden / Teahouse: An Encounter and a Teatime Blessing.

— Witch's Home: A Boss battle with limited HP.

— Castle: A Boss battle with unlimited HP. Higher DMG grants higher score, which will be recorded in the Leaderboard.
text.1.共有9种游玩项目，其中包括：战斗、特殊战斗、徽记、擦亮、珍宝、邂逅、商店、扫:
1. There are 9 types of events, including: Battle, Special Battle, Emblem, Polishing, Treasure, Encounter, Shop, Broom, and Worn-out Broom.

2. Events:

— Battle: Win to claim rewards. Failure will cost you 20 AP.

— Special Battle: Win to claim tradable goods. Failure will cost you 20 AP.

— Emblem: Obtain [Dream Emblem] and [Dream Shard].

— Polishing: Upgrade [Dream Emblem].

— Treasure: Obtain random rewards.

— Encounter: Obtain random rewards or assistance, and unlock content in the "Cocoon of Memories" gallery.

— Shop: Use [Dream Shard] to purchase [Treasure Box Item].

— Broom: Widen the movement range to 5 tiles in front and reduce the AP cost for this movement to 0. Gain a [Box of Dreams].

— Worn-out Broom: Randomly move to 1 of the 5 tiles in front and reduce the AP cost for this movement to 0. Gain a [Box of Dreams].
text.1.花车每局会随机出现在移动轨迹上的任一格，并向随机方向开始移动，玩家和花车同步:
1. The Float randomly appears on any tile along its route in the current round and moves in a random direction. When you move, the Float moves as well.

2. The Float consists of 5 carriages which take up 4 tiles. It moves by 2 tiles every time. Move to one of its tiles to access the Float.

3. You can obtain a Gem and other rewards when accessing the Float.

4. You can only obtain rewards from the Float once in a round.
text.1.美梦徽记主要从战斗和徽记中获得，是重要的战力道具,请尽量收集。\\n\\n\:
1. Dream Emblems can be obtained mainly from Battles and Emblem events. They are important for your combat power, so please collect as many as possible.

2. Dream Emblems must be activated for their buffs to take effect.

3. Dream Emblems can be upgraded to enhance their buffs.

4. Their levels do not reset after finishing a round of game.

5. There a chance for Dream Emblems to appear in shops.
text.1.固定建筑（城堡除外）和花车必定掉落宝石，其他可通过普通事件随机获得。\\n\: 1. Events in facilities (except for Castle) and the Float guarantee Gems. You may also randomly gain Gems from other events.\n\n2. You can set off fireworks with Gems in front of Castle and gain buffs (exclusive to Castle Boss fight). Buffs vary based on the gem colors.
text.1.珍宝匣道具通过商店使用【梦的一角】购买或珍宝等奖励中获取。\\n\\n\r2: 1. Treasure Box Items can be bought from shops with [Dream Shards] or obtained from rewards.\n\n2. Treasure Box will be reset after each round of the game. Please use the items in time.
text.1.活动期间，周一至周四每日赠送1张邀请函，周五至周日每日赠送2张邀请函，赠送的:
1. During the event, you can claim 1 Invitation daily from Monday to Thursday, and 2 Invitations daily from Friday to Sunday. Unused free Invitation will be removed the next day.

2. When starting a round, the Invitation you use will randomly turn into a Snowflake Invitaion, Tinder Invitation or Blitz Invitation.

3. Snowflake Invitaion, Tinder Invitation and Blitz Invitation have different buffs.
1. The map has 4 starting points, and you will start from one of them randomly.

2. The map consists of 20 stages, and you can only move to the three tiles right in front of you in the next stage.

3. There are 10 facilities and many random events in the map. You will always pass through Witch's Home and end up in Castle, where you need to defeat the final boss "Mournful Witch·Serena."

4. The events in the facilities are always the same, but other random events vary from round to round. You can check the map for details.
text.1.活动期间通过充值获得桦石达到指定数量后可以领取对应奖励。\\n\\n2.桦石: 1. During the event, you can claim corresponding rewards after gaining a specified amount of Chaos Stone through recharging.\n\n2. Chaos Stone Tree Incubator only counts the Chaos Stones gained immediately; daily reward Chaos Stones will not be included in the count.
text.擦亮徽记\r\r\\n\r\r\\n\r\r内容概况\r\r\\n\r\r一、关:
Polishing

Overview
1. About Polishing
When you have a polishable Emblem and arrive at the Candy House, Divination Room, or encounter a Polishing event, you will gain 1 attempt to polish an Emblem.

2. How to Polish
The Polishing interface will display the polishable Emblems you own. You can choose one to polish, which will deduct 1 attempt and consume materials.

3. Leave the Event
Your Polishing attempts will be cleared once you leave the Polishing event.
text.美梦徽记\r\r\\n\r\r\\n\r\r内容概况\r\r\\n\r\r一、如:
Dream Emblem

Overview
1. How to Use Emblems
Dream Emblems you own are shown in this window. Click on an Emblem to paste it on the board. Its details are shown on the left. You can rotate and move the Emblem to place it on unoccupied blocks.

2. Emblem Buffs
Once the Emblem is pasted on the board, its effect will be activated. You can view all activated buffs in Emblem Buff menu.
text.1.在城堡击败最终BOSS塞蕾娜，将根据伤害梯度获取奖励。\\n\\n\r2.奖:
1. Rewards will be distributed based on your DMG dealt to the final boss "Mournful Witch·Serena."2. Details:
DMG 20M: 1 Gacha Coin, 100,000 BCRL Coins
DMG 100M: 2 Gacha Coins, 200,000 BCRL Coins
DMG 500M: 3 Gacha Coins, 300,000 BCRL Coins
DMG 1B: 4 Gacha Coins, 400,000 BCRL Coins
DMG 5B: 5 Gacha Coins, 500,000 BCRL Coins
DMG 10B: 6 Gacha Coins, 600,000 BCRL Coins

3. Your highest DMG during the event will be recorded in Parade Ranking. Top 500 conductors will receive special rewards.

text.1.“悖论之茧”每次被剿灭后，将会提升形态污染浓度重生，变得更为强大，上限15层:
1. Every time the "Paradox Cocoon" is eradicated, it will respawn with increased Depth, up to 15 times.

2. You can deploy 4 teams which join the battles in sequence. If a team is wiped, it can no longer join future battles. When all teams are wiped, you can Reorganize the teams once per day, reviving all teams to continue the battle.

3. Even if a team is wiped, the HP of "Paradox Cocoon" will not be reverted to its initial value.

4. You can earn "Paradox Points" after eradicating the "Paradox Cocoon," which can be used to exchange for rewards in the shop.

text.1.完成主线任务\"前往塔图站\"后可参与活动\\n\\n\r2.在“识海深潜”:
1. Complete Story "7-12 To the Tattle" to participate in the event.

2. In "Unbewusstes Diver," Conductors need to choose the appropriate depth and tactic, and dive with multiple crew members. During the diving, equipment will not take effect.

3. Collect Ascents, Dice, and use "Intuitives." Use Move and Rotate action to approach and defeat the Singularity and earn great rewards.
1. "Unbewusstes Diver" offer 7 depths, which need to be completed and unlocked in sequence.\n\n2. There are 4 tactics available, each corresponding to a different combat style. Conductors must choose one of them to start diving.
text.1.初始可携带5位角色进入，所有角色将会统一拉至60级\\n\\n\r2.每次下:
1. You can start with 5 characters, and all characters will be leveled up to 60.

2. You can only use the characters you start with. Their HP will change based on events and battles and will carry over.

3. During the dive, you can recruit other characters at the "Plane Interval."

4. During the diving, equipment will not take effect.
text.1.开始下潜、进入魔方位面地图时，需要选择1枚蕴念骰子以及获得1枚直觉·渡越道具:
1. At the start of diving, you will select one Dice and gain one INT·Stride item. Conductor will be positioned at the top center of the Cube.

2. Singularity (Boss) will be positioned at the bottom center of the Cube.

3. Defeat the Singularity in the current Plane to enter the next Plane.

4. The diving will succeed after completing 3 Planes.
text.1.每个位面都会有行动回合的限制，列车长需要在规定的几轮内移动追击并击败Boss: 1. Each Plane has a certain turn limit. Conductor need to defeat the Singularity within limited turns.\n\n2. The diving will fail if Singularity is not defeated within limited turns.
text.1.红/橙色格子：位面奇点/普通/精英战斗事件格，直接进入战斗，战斗完成后可获得:
1. Red/Orange Tile: Singularity Battle, Elite Battle, Battle. Start a battle, and earn Dust and Ascent after victory.

2. Blue Tile: "Around-the-Clock." Enter a shop that sells Ascents, Dice, and Intuitions.

3. Yellow Tile: "Trinket." Gain random Ascent, Dice, and Intuition.

4. Green Tile: "Rebirth Hollow." Heal or enhance your team.

5. Purple Tile: "Unknown Vortex." Trigger a random event.

6. White Tile: Blank. No events will be triggered in this tile.
text.1.回合开始时，列车长先开始行动\\n\\n\r2.每一回合中，列车长需要完成移:
1. Conductor acts first in a turn.

2. Conductor needs to use Move and Rotate actions in any order.

3. Move: Move to an adjacent tile.

4. Rotate: Rotate the current row in 90 degrees.

5. Singularity's Turn: After Conductor finishes the actions, Singularity will also use Move and Rotate once. And when Singularity moves, the previous tile will be destroyed, and Singularity will gain a buff.

6. An Action Point is consumed when both Conductor and Singularity finish their turns.
text.1.击败了对应位面的位面奇点Boss后，即可进入位面间隙。在该区域中，可以招募队: 1. Enter after defeating a Singularity. You can enlist new members, revive members and enhance Ascents.
text.1.推力：在下潜途中通过各种方式获得的战斗增益，随策略的变化，会有不同的推力产生:
1. Ascent: Buff gained in various ways. Ascents can be enhanced. Ascents correspond to different Tactics. Gain a certain number of corresponding Ascents to unlock an Orange Ascent.

2. Dice: Items with special effects.

3. Intuition: Consumable item that triggers special effects when used.

4. Inspiration: A special item scattered on the Cube. Move to its tile to obtain it. Inspirations will be converted into "Dredge Skills" after finishing the diving, which can be used to unlock Dredge Techniques.

text.下客点附近最为宽阔的综合月台，从车站处向城市方向眺望，现代化的景色一览无余。: The most spacious integrated platform near the drop-off site, offers a view of the modern scenery.
text.绵延数公里的观海步道，适合散步也适合骑行和长跑锻炼，风景颇佳。: Stretches for several kilometers, suitable for walking, cycling and running exercises.
text.贡露城外的诸多小型港口之一，以供游艇和私人船只停泊为主要职能。: One of the many small ports outside Gronru City for yachts and private vessels.
text.为提升特殊项目的施工效率与安全性，并满足特定高强度、轻量化需求，现面向各商会征集: To enhance the efficiency and safety of special projects, and to meet specific requirements, we are now seeking titanium steel rail from each CoC. This project is crucial for the Western Loop. We need your strength!
text.制造等级达到20级且科伦巴商会声望达到500的列车长可领取对应的制造配方。拼单单: Conductors who reach Craft LV20 and COLUMBA reputation of 500 can claim the corresponding recipe. Limited group order for titanium steel rail collection is available. Accumulate server and personal progress and gain a boost.

Submit titanium steel rails to advance the server-wide and personal collection progress and gain corresponding stage bonuses.
text.您好……！太好啦，有您在，小铃就用不着担心了！: Hello...! That's great, with you here, Kosuzu doesn't need to worry!
text.暂时无法使用直觉跳转至其余地格，请先完成当前地格的事件: Can't move to other tiles. Please finish the event first.
text.喏，这玩意现在是你的了。倒是可以“啪”地给你送回车上，不过我不保证安全哦？: Here, this thing's yours now. Could just "poof" it straight back to your train if ya want, but no guarantees it makes it there in one piece, got it?
text.真是少见，无垠号的列车长居然会亲自大驾光临……别那么看着我！偶尔想模仿人类的样子: Well ain't this rare, the Conductor of the Eternal comin' all the way here in person... don't look at me like that! Can't I try playin' human an' run a lil' shop every now an' then?

text.祝您商运亨通。小铃会尽力帮忙的！: Wishing you smooth business operations. Kosuzu will do her best to help!
text.是没有中意的吗？稍等，小铃帮您看看别的……: Is there nothing you like? Hold on, Kosuzu will help you look at others...
text.嗯？原来听说要来的人是你啊……那看来这次会轻松很多了。当然是说你很有用的意思哦。: Huh? So the person I heard was coming is you... Well, it seems like this will be much easier. Of course, I mean that you're very useful.
text.没问题，你挑合作伙伴的眼光倒是一如既往地好呢。: No problem, your eye for choosing partners is as good as ever.
text.系统里已经登记了您的名字了，希望您与他们合作愉快。: Your name has already been registered in the system, hope you have a pleasant cooperation with them.
text.列车载货量不足，超出的货物需再次领取。请确认是否领取？: Insufficient capacity, the excess cargo needs to be claimed again. Proceed?
text.仅可踢出交付物资不足20%的队员，确认要踢出该队员吗？: Only crew members who have delivered less than 20% can be kicked out. Confirm?
text.确认要退出该队列吗？物资与保证金将返回。: Quit this queue? The materials and deposit will be returned.
text.已接取的订单刷新后仅返还一半保证金，请确认是否刷新？: Accepted orders only refunds half of the deposit after refreshing. Proceed?

text.商会发邮件给我，说你会来蜃息岛协助建设和清理工作……虽然这儿活不少，但报酬绝对不: COLUMBA emailed me, saying you would come to Mirage Island to assist with the construction... Although there's quite a bit of work here, the rewards are great!
text.啪啪啪啪鼓掌~!恭喜您获得整顿中心的承包资格，大家都在云岫桥蓄势待发啦!为您准备: Clap clap clap clap~! Congratulations, you can now contract Reforming Center. The gift pack prepared for you has been sent via email—We are waiting for you at Yunxiu Bridge!
text.淘金乐园重建工作颇有成效，淘金大酒店的建设翻新工作也已告一段落。在此特别邀请CB: The reconstruction of ONEderland has been successful, and the renovation of ONEderland Hotel has also been completed. We invite the conductor of the Eternal CBCRR23 to attend the opening ceremony.
text.批量仅支持铁盟币购买的商品: Batch purchase supports only items bought with Coin.
text.内容概况\r\r\r\r\\n\r\r\r\r\r一、参与全桦树狂潮 加入行动\:
Overview

I. Join FULL CHAOS PANIC
Participate in FULL CHAOS PANIC to gain generous BCRL Coin rewards. Conductors need to defeat as many monsters as possible within a limited time to gain more rewards.

II. Exchange for Items
Conductors can use Fantasy Gacha Coins to pull for rewards at Fantasy Gacha Machine.

III. Event Quests
Complete the event quests in Task List to earn rewards including Chaos Stones.
text.科伦巴商会将在拼单单<color=#FFB800>【高价收购】</color>制: COLUMBA purchases goods <color=#FFB800>[at a high price]</color>.

text.淘金乐园重建工作颇有成效，淘金大酒店的建设翻新工作也已告一段落。在此特别邀请CB: The reconstruction of ONEderland has been successful, and the renovation of ONEderland Hotel has also been completed. We invite the conductor of the Eternal CBCRR23 to attend the opening ceremony.
text.每日可解锁%d抽取次数，最大可获得%d抽取次数。: Unlock %d draws daily, %d draws at max.
text.总觉得和你好久没见了，但你肯定一直在努力工作吧？所以我也不能松懈。: Feels like it's been a long time since we last met, but you must have been working hard, right? So I can't slack off either.
text.终端设置了远程跳转功能，即使不在对应的站点，也能直接开始执行任务……当然，可不会: The terminal is set with a remote redirect function, allowing you to start executing quests even if you're not at the corresponding site... Of course, it won't just directly send you to the corresponding station.
text.完成任务后，你也可以选择在终端上一起领取奖励。我认为这个系统还是非常人性化的……: After completing the quests, you can also choose to claim the rewards on the terminal. I think this system is very user-friendly...
text.最近还好吗？由我来和你介绍一下，这是铁安局最新发布的协同终端功能，在这里可以方便: How have you been lately? Let me introduce you to this, the latest Coordinate Terminal released by the BCRL Agency. Here, you can conveniently confirm the completion status of various BCRL Agency quests.
text.铁安局的治安任务协同终端，完成作战任务可以获得大量桦石并提高委托派遣的铁盟币奖励: Complete challenges for Chaos Stones and increase the BCRL Coin rewards for Patrol Commission.
text.有什么需要帮忙的吗？还是来帮帮我们？: Need a hand with something? Or have you come to help me?
text.看看这是谁，我们的明日之星。: Well, well, look who it is—our rising star.
text.你看这个，是上次和静流约会一起挑的发卡哦，很适合人家吧？: Take a look at this, it's the hairclip Shizuru and I picked out together on our last date. Suits me, doesn't it?
text.贡露城的服务水平还蛮让人满意的，就是治安有点不尽人意……但还在掌控之内啦，这点事: Gronru City's service is quite satisfactory, really. Security leaves a little to be desired, though... but I've got it well in hand. Hardly a challenge for someone like me.
text.走开走开，为了被静流多多夸奖，人家最近打算做个认真敬业的人呢，禁止闲聊！: Shoo, shoo. I'm trying to be a diligent, hardworking woman these days, so Shizuru will praise me more. No idle chatter allowed!
text.贡露城很漂亮，是不是？毕竟是用金钱堆起来的城市……怎么突然说话这么深沉？没有啊，: Gronru City is beautiful, isn't it? Wealth built these very streets, after all... Why do I suddenly sound so deep? No, I mean, I've spent quite a bit here myself, that's all.
text.列车长，你说，如果我邀请静流和我一起去狂欢节的话，她会答应吧？什么？！我们不放假: Do you think Shizuru would go to the carnival with me, if I asked her? ...Wait, what?! We don't get any time off?!

text.完成引擎核心挑战可领取奖励: Complete engine core challenges to claim rewards
text.你好，很高兴与你共事，请注意，必要的文件请预先提交，这样有助于节约我们双方的时间: Hey, nice to be working with you. Just a heads up, try to submit any necessary documents ahead of time—saves us both some time that way.
text.上次你提交的文件我已经检查过了，完全没问题。市长已经签过字了，接下来麻烦你在这边: I already checked the documents you turned in last time, everything looks good. The mayor's already signed off, so if you could sign here too, that'd be great.
text.和你当同事很愉快，但我觉得似乎你对我有些小小的误解……不用一直用那么有礼貌的语气: It's been nice working with you, but I think you might have a bit of a wrong idea about me... you don't have to keep talking to me so formally. I'm probably not that much older than you, feel free to relax a little.
text.居然这么快就又能见到你……这办事效率简直想让我为你鼓掌了。你要是我的下属该多好。: Wow, back again so soon... your efficiency's honestly making me want to give you a round of applause. I wish you worked under me.
text.接下来的工作流程你都已经很熟悉了，不需要我的介绍吧？不过在等待办理手续的时候，你: You already know the process by now, right? Don't think I need to walk you through it again. But while you're waiting on the paperwork, feel free to sit in the VIP lounge for a bit.
text.……话说回来，你在贡露城有什么想吃的吗？等今天的工作结束以后我们一起去吃顿饭吧，: ...Speaking of which, is there anything you'd like to eat in Gronru City? Once we're done with work today, let's grab a meal together, my treat.
text.无论投资额是大是小，我们都会对其善加利用。: Whether the investment's big or small, we'll put it to good use either way.
text.在贡露城这不算是一笔惊人的投资，但我也不会因此看轻了这笔钱的分量。: It's not exactly a jaw-dropping amount for Gronru City, but that doesn't mean I take it lightly.
text.这是收据。市政厅会定期公开投资额的使用情况，到时也会制作成公开报告发送给你，请多: Here's your receipt. City Hall publishes reports on how the investment funds are used on a regular basis, and we'll send you one too when it's ready, so keep an eye out.
text.投资已达到单笔市政投资的上限额度……大手笔呀，感谢。: Your investment's hit the cap for a single contribution... quite the sum. Thanks for that.
text.没想到列车长还会遇见账户余额不足这种困窘的情况……好了，我开玩笑的。这情况不算常: Didn't expect a conductor to run into something as embarrassing as insufficient funds... okay, I'm just kidding. Doesn't happen often, but I'm sure you'll be back soon enough with plenty to invest.
text.不用特意大声和我说话，我虽然戴着耳机，但并没在听音乐。你也不想在进行远程会议的时: No need to talk extra loud with me, I've got earphones on but I'm not actually listening to music. You wouldn't want to be yelling into your communicator during a remote meeting either, right? Yeah, that's basically it.
text.业余生活？呃……我没有什么……兴趣爱好的。硬要说的话，最近我试着去参加了一些交友: Free time? Uh... I don't really have any... hobbies to speak of. If I had to say something, I've been trying out some social mixers and cocktail parties lately—a-and no, I definitely didn't drink too much, and I absolutely did not pass out on the side of the road! What are you even thinking!
text.这个胸针啊……戴了好几年了，在我还是一个市政厅普通职员的时候就戴着，是那时一个朋: This brooch... I've had it for years, been wearing it since I was just a regular City Hall employee. A friend gave it to me back then. Though... we're not really in touch anymore.
text.虽然工作的确重要，不过也别因此忽视了和身边的人相处的时间啊。我说真的，没什么比你: Work matters, sure, but don't let it eat into the time you spend with the people around you. I mean it, nothing's more important than the people you care about.
text.我最近在考虑换一把办公椅……现在的椅子坐着稍微有点腰酸背痛的，不过也有可能是因为: I've been thinking about getting a new office chair lately... this one's giving me a bit of back and shoulder pain, though it might just be from sitting and reading paperwork too long.
text.鉴于我们已经建立了互信信赖的合作关系，我可以为你提供一些我力所能及的便利。休息室: Since we've built up a good working relationship based on trust, I can offer you a few conveniences within my means. There's snacks and coffee in the lounge, want to try some?
text.贡露城的商业非常发达，不过你应该还不熟悉这里的城市结构吧？如果你想去某间奢侈品店: Gronru City's commercial scene is pretty developed, but you're probably still not too familiar with how the city's laid out, right? If you want to check out a luxury store or book a table at some restaurant, feel free to just use my name.
text.……嗯？啊，抱歉，刚刚我在想别的事。我会在上班的时候走神，怎么了？也没那么让人意: ...Hm? Oh, sorry, I was thinking about something else. I do space out sometimes at work. Not that surprising, is it?
text.伊卡菈，作为翠境联盟的代表，以及将来的实习列车长前来。 ……旅行的时候有人告诉我: Ikala, as the representative of the Emerald Alliance and the future intern Conductor, is coming. ……Someone told me during the journey that I should refer to those who graduated earlier at school as seniors…… Should I call you that too?
text.我知道啦，这是你要的东西。等等，在出去之前，你稍微整理一下头发吧，现在有点乱哦？: All right, here's what you wanted. Wait— fix your hair a little before you go out, it's a bit of a mess. ...I'm not saying I'm concerned about you!
text.你好。……什么嘛，是前辈啊。呼，这样我就用不着紧张了，来看看需要什么吧？: Hello. ...Oh, it's you, senior. Phew, then I don't need to be nervous. Let's see what you need, shall we?
text.伊卡菈的学生风格装束，她称你为“前辈”是理所当然的事。 于她来说，这段记忆就像是: Ikara's student uniform—of course she calls you "Senior." To her, this memory lingers like frosting dusted ever so lightly over time, delicate, sweet, and never quite melting away.
text.总会有合适的，对吧？: Rest assured, something suitable will always come along.
text.列车长谨慎的样子真的很可靠，我随时等着你的决定哦。: Your care and deliberation are truly reassuring, Conductor. Take your time—I'll await your decision.
text.这就准备开始工作了吗？真是勤劳啊。: Getting straight to work already? How diligent of you.
text.在这里见到你真是太好了，我们正缺人手呢！: What a pleasure to find you here—we happen to be short-handed at the moment.
text.看到你让人觉得自己的负担也减轻了不少呢。啊？心理作用吗？但能给人这种感觉也是你的: Simply seeing you seems to lighten my burden somehow. Oh? Perhaps it's only in my mind? Still, that you inspire such a feeling speaks well of you.
text.实在辛苦了，商会有你这样出色的人才一定会变得越来越好吧。: You've worked so hard. With someone of your caliber, the guild is bound to flourish all the more.
text.有能帮上忙的地方尽管告诉我好了，怎么会麻烦？一直以来都受到了你很多关照啊。: Please, don't hesitate to ask if there's anything I might assist with. You've shown me a great deal of kindness over the years, after all.
text.（哈欠）这样的好天气会让我想起小时候在暖洋洋的山坡上打盹的日子，躺在草地上能感受: (yawn) Weather like this always brings back memories of napping on a sun-warmed hillside as a child, lying in the grass and feeling the distant train rumble along the tracks... oh, forgive me, did I drift off for a moment?
text.今天的心情很好呀，看来你上次的烦恼已经解决了吧？这可不用感谢，我主要只是当个听众: You seem in rather good spirits today. I take it whatever was troubling you last time has been resolved? There's no need to thank me, though—I was merely lending an ear.
text.会长是位让人敬佩的女性，只是我常常担心她会不会太过操劳…既然把这份工作交给了我，: The president is a woman most worthy of admiration, though I do often worry she takes on too much. Since she has entrusted this work to me, I ought to shoulder more of it myself, if only to spare her some of that burden.
text.贡露城是座很适合定居的城市，是啊，很多人都这么说。我也很喜欢那些盛大、热闹的活动: Gronru City is truly a fine place to settle. Indeed, many say as much. I'm quite fond of its grand, lively festivities as well... how lovely it would be, if one day everyone could raise a glass at the carnival without a single care in the world.
text.等一下，要洗手的话不如用这个吧。很好闻吧？贡露城特制哦，喜欢的话就拿去用吧，没关: Do wait a moment—if you'd like to wash your hands, perhaps try this instead. Pleasant, isn't it? A specialty of Gronru City. Please, take it if you're fond of it—I have plenty more to spare.
text.那么，就交给你啦，相信你一定可以顺利完成的。: Very well, I shall leave it in your capable hands. I trust you'll see it through without difficulty.
text.呀……果然是选择这个吗，刚开始就觉得列车长可以胜任呢！: Ah... so this is the one you've chosen. I rather suspected, from the start, that you'd be equal to it.
text.不要有负担，下次准备好再来吧。: No need to trouble yourself—do come back once you're ready.
text.这样吗？好的，我知道了。不过我真的觉得你可以试试的哦~: Is that so? Very well, I understand. Though I do believe you might find it worth a try~
text.你已经做得足够多了，剩下来的时间好好休息一下吧！: You've already done more than enough. Do take the time remaining to rest properly.
text.唔，我看看……列车长你的话，不如考虑下这些订单吧？: Let me see... for someone of your standing, Conductor, perhaps these orders would suit you better.

text.欢迎来到好友的车厢！\r\r\r\r\\n\r\r\r\r\\n\r\r\r\r:
Welcome to the Friends' Carriage!

Friends' Carriage Instructions
Visit Friends' Carriage
Above the avatar in your carriage, there is a button [Visit Friends' Carriage]. Click it to open the friends list, where your friends will be displayed. You can click the button [Go to Carriage] to access the friend's carriage.

What can you do in the Friends' Carriage?
(1) You can swipe left or right to view the layout of the Friends' Carriage.
(2) If the trash bin in the Friends' Carriage is full, you can help clean it up and have a chance to gain some trash blocks. The probability decreases with the number of successful gains, and the friend's pet will also decrease the probability of gaining trash blocks. The higher the pet's rating, the greater the decrease in probability. You can click the button next to the success rate to view details. Each friend has a certain number of cleaning attempts daily, which refreshes at 5 am every day.
Success rate of gaining trash blocks = Base success rate (1) * Probability reduction for repeated cleaning * Probability of pet guarding
Probability reduction for repeated cleaning = 1 - Success reduction rate (0.3) * Number of times cleaned successfully
Trash blocks gained from cleaning are directly sent to the temporary storage area of the train garbage bin.

Visit Records
You can check the friends' visit records through the cleaning record in the friends list.
Today's visit records refresh at 5 am every day.
text.欢迎光临。……希望列车长在这贡露城玩得开心，当然，如果能多来看看人家就更好了~: Welcome in. ...I do hope you have a lovely time here in Gronru City, Conductor. Though, of course, it'd be even lovelier if you came around to see me more often~
text.您喜欢吗？这里还有很多哦。: Do you like it? There's plenty more where that came from.
text.来吧，这是亚莉奈为了庆祝您的到来特别准备的~: Come now, this was specially prepared by Arina to celebrate your arrival~
text.可能是为了满足市民需求，贡露城有很长的海滨步道，旅游杂志说是“最美”的呢。列车长: Might be to keep the locals happy, but Gronru City has quite the long seaside promenade—the travel magazines call it "the most beautiful" one around. If you're looking to clear your head, Conductor, that'd be a fine place to start... and of course, I'd be more than happy to walk it with you!
text.市政厅的奈芙小姐虽然看起来不好相处，不过她其实对每个人都一视同仁呢。她在下班后偶: Miss Neph at City Hall may seem hard to get along with, but she's honestly fair to everyone. She stops by my place every so often after work to drown her sorrows in a drink... hehe, don't worry, I always make sure she doesn't overdo it—no need to worry about her on my account~
text.符渝女士对时尚的品味很先进……她是奢侈品店铺的常客，从她的打扮就能看得出来。那么: Miss Goldiana has such forward-thinking taste in fashion... she's a regular at the luxury boutiques, you can tell just by looking at her. So tell me, Conductor, what do you think of her style? If Arina dressed like that too... would you like it?
text.最近亚莉奈总是在思念您……列车长正在成为越来越多人心中重要的人，也就是说，您会离: Lately, Arina's been thinking of you an awful lot... you're becoming more and more important to more and more people, which means you'll be away from Arina's side even longer. ...Just thinking about that makes me terribly sad. But you'd never abandon Arina, would you?
text.人家从上级那里听说了一些风声……不过由于目前还没有定论，所以还不能和列车长说。不: I caught wind of something from my superiors... but nothing's settled yet, so I can't say just what to you, Conductor. It's not bad news, mind you, but something's about to shift with the situation around the railway loop—do keep an eye out.
text.按照贡露城的传统，每年这里会举行西大陆规模最大的狂欢节，参与的人可以尽情享乐，不: By Gronru tradition, the largest carnival on the Western Continent is held here every year—everyone's free to indulge without a shred of restraint... people usually come with friends, or with someone special. If you're thinking of joining in, Conductor, you simply must invite Arina!
text.列车长，您今晚有空吗？有哪家想去的餐厅吗？不用担心价格和预约呀，只要您想的话，不: Conductor, are you free tonight? Any restaurant you've had your eye on? Don't worry yourself over the price or a reservation—wherever you'd like, Arina will get you the very best seat in the house.
text.我收到了一瓶新的香水，是由黑月匠造免费提供的，说是想在它上市前让我预先试用……列: I just received a new perfume, a gift from Night Chains Lesage—they wanted me to try it before it hits the market... would you like a whiff, Conductor? I'm sure you'll love this scent❤
text.自从西大陆铁路环线正式复苏，货品的选择也变得更丰富了呢。: Ever since the Western Continent railway loop got back up and running, the selection of goods has grown so much richer.
text.这些货物能安全抵达，其实都是多亏了列车长您保证了线路安全……果然您是最厉害的！: That these goods make it here safely, well, that's all thanks to you keeping the routes secure, Conductor... you really are the best there is!
text.还要喝的话——啊，不对！您好像说过了要克制自己，所以亚莉奈会监督您的❤今天就到这: Care for another drink—oh, wait, no! Didn't you say you'd hold back a little? Arina will keep an eye on you then❤ That's enough for today—do come back tomorrow, Conductor~

text.哎呀，欢迎光临。我暂时成为了这间小铺的主人哦。至于开店的水平，鉴于孩子们在待人接: Oh, welcome. I've temporarily become the owner of this little shop. As for my shopkeeping skills, considering that I've taught the children all about social etiquette, I don't think there should be any issues... Conductor, what do you think?
text.这都是我从窟灵族那里正当收购来的物品。小家伙们也逐渐有了“货币”和“货物”的概念: These are all items I acquired legitimately from the Kuling tribe. The little ones are gradually developing a concept of "currency" and "goods."
text.货物的品质不用担心，毕竟我已经亲自检查过了。: No need to worry about the quality of the goods, after all, I have personally inspected them.
text.来，请拿好。嗯？想要我亲手包好递给你？当然可以啦。: Come, please take it. Hmm? Want me to personally wrap it up and hand it to you? Of course, I can do that.
text.要不要从奥莉薇恩那里借点使魔来替你搬运？: Do you want to borrow some Familiars from Olivien to help you with the move?
text.这商品上施加了一点点能让人运气变好的魔法祝福哦。: A little magical blessing has been applied to this product to improve luck.
text.看来这件已经售罄了……不过你实在想要的话，我日后或许还能为你找一些来。: It seems this item is already sold out... However, if you really want it, I might be able to find some for you later.
text.嗯？钱没带够呀……来，用我的——呵呵，开玩笑的。我不会无缘无故给你提供援助的，毕: Hmm? Didn't bring enough money... Here, use mine—haha, just kidding. I won't provide you with assistance for no reason, after all, I'm not the kind of elder who spoils children unconditionally. Learning to manage finances is also very important.
text.随着小家伙们的理念和行动变化，这个村落的样貌也会不断改变……看来即使是没有生命的: As the little ones' ideas and actions change, the appearance of this village will constantly transform... It seems that even tiny, lifeless Familiars can develop a social nature similar to humans.
text.你要是对魔法感兴趣的话，不如让莉薇娅来做我的学生吧？魔法由不同的人来使用也会出现: If you're interested in magic, why not let Livia become my student? Magic can yield different results when used by different people, and I'm looking forward to her learning progress.
text.你也想跟着我学魔法吗？……很遗憾，我暂时没法教你魔法方面的知识。不过我敢说，你身: Do you also want to learn magic from me? … Unfortunately, I can't teach you knowledge about magic at the moment. However, I dare say, your potential is no less than anyone else's... It is a power that can even change the world.
text.这间小铺的工作很轻松，窟灵族的小家伙们分担了很大一部分……剩下的部分我就用魔法解: The work in this small shop is very easy; the little Kulings take on a large part of it... and I handle the rest with magic.
text.“不老魔女和她的孩子们”……？哈哈，我知道，这是地上流传的所谓“曼杜斯帝国童话”: The 'Ageless Witch and Her Children'...? Haha, I know, this is the so-called 'Mundus Empire Fairy Tale' circulating above ground. I've even seen it in a bookstore in Bonfire City. I can only say it's quite far from the truth, isn't it?
text.布罗斐忒，吾等的先知——\\n\r自天外而来的多角之影啊\\n\r祂将重塑器具，:
Brofete, our prophet—
The multi-horned shadow from beyond the heavens
He shall reshape tools, giving new life to old things,
Leading people to build roads and channels, reorganizing order.

—Wait, who did you say burst out from underground!?

Content Overview
1. Complete event storyline and compose "Exodus de la Terre"
Accompanied by earth-shattering sounds, a mysterious Outlander breaks the peace of a "dwarf" village. Hot springs, new friends, seven-colored magic; mysterious races, unexplored places, shadows lurking underground, and the so-called "prophet"… Step by step, approach the truth and compose an "Exodus de la Terre"!

2. New battle stages open for a fresh challenge
During the event, "Exodus de la Terre" will offer 8 "Papal Tour" collaboration limited-character trial stages, where Conductors can experience the charm and strength of the Outlander "Slokai" in advance. Additionally, 8 "Mecha Arrival" recurring stages will be available for Conductors to repeatedly challenge and gain rich rewards.

3. Overcome stages to gain rewards
Conductors participating in the "Exodus de la Terre" event can gain "Dwarf Coins" by tackling battle stages. With "Dwarf Coins," exchange them at the Grotto Spirit Shop for collaboration-limited draw tickets, collaboration-limited UR, collaboration-limited avatars, Laplace Protocol, Silver Branch, Purchase Appl., Self-Observe Film, and other various rewards.

4. Complete event achievements to gain abundant rewards
The "Exodus de la Terre" event features an event quest system called "Prophet's Oracle." By completing the quest conditions during the event, you can claim Dwarf Coins, Self-Observe Film, Cactus Lollipop, and Memorial Card Pack: Exodus de la Terre as rewards.
※The "Memorial Card Pack: Exodus de la Terre" can currently only be obtained during the "Exodus de la Terre" event. The card pack contains 7 newly designed cards, which can be collected after completing all stage rewards and achievements. The cards will have new uses in future versions, so Conductors, please look forward to it.

text.下次休假的时候，我想去找那些喜欢和我一起玩的孩子，给他们表演魔术。最近因为工作繁: Next time I have leave, I want to go see the kids who like playing with me and do some magic tricks for them. Been too busy with work lately, haven't gone in a while. Do you... want to come with me?
text.原来和你一起工作是这样的感觉……没什么，只是之前猜想过可能出现的情况。: So this is what it's like, working alongside you... it's nothing, I'd just imagined how this might go, before.
text.按照学会的规定，需要用等价的物品来进行交换……: Per Citadel regulations, an item of equal value is required for the exchange...
text.稍等一下，我结束手上的工作就来。: Give me a moment, I'll be right there once I finish this.
text.你好像还有点没习惯这里站着的是我。需要用障眼法暂时让你忽略这一点吗？: Seems you're still not quite used to seeing me standing here. Want me to use a bit of illusion so you can look past it, for now?
text.……你说我身上没有“血的味道”了？嗯，从那以后我稍微做了一些处理。现在应该再也不: ...You're saying I don't smell like blood anymore? Mm. I took care of that, some time ago. It shouldn't linger anymore.
text.之前我已经学习过这套系统的操作了，所以没问题。: I've already learned how to operate this system, so it shouldn't be a problem.
text.你在途中遇见什么麻烦的话，请和我说。我会解决的。: If you run into any trouble along the way, let me know. I'll take care of it.
text.……不过有你在的话，我大概没有擅离职守的必要吧。: ...Though with you here, I suppose there's not much need for me to leave my post.
text.必要的时候我也会离开管理中心，去处理一些“外面的问题”。: When it's necessary, I'll leave the management center too, to deal with certain "matters out there."
text.你最近有见到过先生和索玛吗？……啊，就随便一问……我有段时间没回去了。: Have you seen Mr. Dustin or Sommer recently? ...Ah, just asking. It's been a while since I've been back.
text.稍后我会安排机器人去搬。: I'll have a robot come collect it shortly.
text.辛苦了。你需要休息的话，后面的区域已经收拾干净了。: Good work today. If you need to rest, the area up ahead has already been cleared out.
text.这里的生活和在外活动的时候不太一样。虽然作为交通要冲有很多人员往来，但意外地也是: Life here is a bit different from being out in the field. It's a major transit hub, so there's a lot of traffic coming through, but oddly enough, it's also a good place to just... clear your head.
text.远星大桥是重要的转运地点，所以订单种类非常丰富。: The Apoaster Bridge is an important transfer point, so the range of orders here is quite extensive.
text.抱歉之前为了配合丽桑德拉大人的行动而把你带去危险的境地。……我尽量不会让这种事再: Sorry, about leading you into danger before, for the sake of following Lady Lissandra's orders. ...I'll try to see that it doesn't happen again.
text.一起吃饭？……这里没有什么做饭的条件，也没有什么好吃的东西，只有口粮和盒饭而已…: Eat together? ...There's not much of a kitchen here, and nothing particularly good to eat, just rations and boxed meals... no, wait. Give me a moment. I'll put something together for you.
text.我不会在工作场所睡觉的。要休息的话我会去休息室。……你说无垠号上也可以……确实。: I don't sleep on the job. If I need rest, I'll go to the break room. ...You're saying I could do that on the Eternal too... true enough. Understood. Next time I'm tired, I'll come find you.
text.你好。从今天起到接下来的一段时间，我会接手远星大桥的工作事务。……需要重新自我介: Hello. Starting today, and for the time being, I'll be taking over operations at the Apoaster Bridge. ...Do you need me to introduce myself again? ...Ahem. I'm Nayuta. I look forward to working with you from here on.

text.1、列车长可以消耗铁盟币进行“交易品投资”，来提升指定交易品在当前城市的进货和库:
1. Conductor may consume BCRL Coins to perform Goods Investment, which increases the purchase quantity and stock capacity of designated goods in the current city.

2. When performing Goods Investment, Conductor will also gain Reputation for that city.

3. Goods Investment starts at Level 0, with a current maximum investment level of 20.

4. The maximum investment amount at one time is affected by the city's Reputation. The investment capacity can be reset by re-entering the city.

5. The upgrade effects only apply to the city where Goods Investment has been performed.

6. Goods Investment at each station will be unlocked in multiple phases. The second phase will unlock after all investments in the first phase reach Level 10, and so on for subsequent phases.

7. Conductor must meet the specific Reputation requirements of the corresponding city before being able to invest. If the requirements are not met, clicking the corresponding Goods Investment button will display the required Reputation conditions.

8. For every 100 million BCRL Coins cumulatively spent on Goods Investment, the purchase quantity of all goods in all cities will increase by 1%.

text.唔唔唔……不懂……算了！什么度假村新运营计划就交给列车长他们考虑就好了！——啊，: Hmm... don't get it... ah, forget it! I'll just leave all this new resort operation plan to Conductor! —Oh, Conductor, there you are!
text.游客中心为您服务！啊，可是，我只是兼职耶……如果卖错了应该也不会有什么问题吧，嗯: Visitor Center, at your service! Ah, though, I'm only part-time here... it should probably be fine even if I ring something up wrong, right?
text.斯洛卡伊小姐最近待在村里的时间变长了呢，而且好像总是在想事情的样子……真的没事吗: Miss Slokai's been spending more and more time in the village lately, and she always looks like she's got something on her mind... is she really okay?
text.香菜酱、香菜牛奶、香菜拿铁，香菜炸鸡……啊，没什么，我在做市场统计啦！等窟灵族们: Cilantro sauce, cilantro milk, cilantro latte, cilantro fried chicken... oh, it's nothing, I'm just doing some market research! Once the Cave Spirits finish up the samples, I'll bring them over for Monday to taste-test!
text.哼哼，因为我来守着游客中心了，所以巡视浴场和刷地的工作就交给米莉还有新来的服务生: Heh heh, since I'm holding down the fort at the Visitor Center, I've handed the bathhouse patrol and floor-cleaning duties over to Millie and the new server!
