word.你手上拿着的是什么玩意儿？晃来晃去的，老夫看着头晕。: What's that you're holding? The way it's swing makes me dizzy.
word.咳、咳。是“形态共振污染指数计数器”。: Cough, cough. It's "Morphic Resonance Pollution Index Counter".
word.嘿，说得这么高大上的，不就是“响立逃”吗，游戏机一样的玩意。: Hey, you make it sound so high and mighty. Isn't it just "Flee Alarm"? A gaming console sort of thing.
word.不过没关系，老夫不会笑你们幼稚的，知道学会以外的人都在用这玩意呢。: But it's alright. I won't mock you for being childish. Everyone outside of the Citadel is using this, you know.
word.不过你还是别拿着晃了，老夫要真带了什么危险品，你也甭想着靠这玩具就测得出来。: You better stop swinging it around. Even if I carried any dangerous goods, there's no way you'd be able to detect them with that thing.
word.走个流程还是需要的……: We still need to go through the procedures...
word.咳，既然响立逃没反应，那咱们这就装货上车吧。: Ahem, since the Flee Alarm didn't react, we'll load the cargo onto the train.
word.作为列车最重要的大脑，莉薇娅小姐的最佳搭档，未来世界的统治者——: As the crucial brain of the train, Miss Livia's best partner, ruler of the future world —
word.不朽者波克士，欢迎各位光临无垠号！: BOX the Immortal welcomes everyone aboard The Eternal!
word.哈哈哈哈，我说，你手底下的人都挺有意思的啊。: Hahaha, I must say, your subordinates are quite interesting.
word.纠正，本机不是人类这种孱弱的物种，本机是超越现有一切物种的——: Correction. This unit is not a fragile human being. This unit surpasses any existing species —
word.好了，烦人的玩意儿消停了，雷比斯大人，您请，我带您参观一下无垠号。: Alright, the annoying thing has quieted down. Miss Rebis, this way please. Allow me to show you around The Eternal.
word.是啊，承蒙这位的惠顾。: Oh yes, thanks to this customer's patronage.
word.那么，请出示货物清单……我需要完成清点工作……: If so, please show me the cargo list... I need to do an inventory check...
word.老夫会在这里盯着，货真的有什么问题老夫会自己负责。: I'll keep an eye on it here. If there are any problems with the goods, I'll bear the responsibility.
word.——咳咳，没事，听这位的。: —Ahem, no worries, listen to this fellow.
word.那么，您的货物如果有什么额外的保管需求，我们也会尽力满足的。: Well, if your cargo has any special storage needs, we will do our best to accommodate them.
word.嗯？啊，用不着，老夫和这几个铁疙瘩在这儿看着就足够了。: Hmm? Ah, no need. I'll stay here and watch over them with these metal lumps.
word.在这儿？我们有专门的乘客车厢的，您不用特意在这里——: Stay here? We have a dedicated passenger carriage, and there's no need for you to stay here —
word.就这儿就行，这环境还挺朴实的，老夫很喜欢。: It's fine here. I'm rather fond of this simple environment.
word.这里就是乘客车厢，请随便坐，妮蔻拉小姐。: This is the passenger car. Make yourself at home, Miss Nicola.
word.安菲娅小姐和星花小姐提供的资料也放在这里了。: The files provided by Miss Anfiya and Miss Stella have been placed here as well.
word.欢迎乘坐无垠号列车，本机是列车辅助管制系统仿生技工十代波克士。: Welcome to The Eternal. I am BOX, an Bionic Operator X that serves as a train regulation assistance system.
word.你怎么这么老实，我是不是出幻觉了？: Why are you being so honest? Am I hallucinating?
word.你不应该乱七八糟说一堆什么列车统治者、世界大脑、朽木不可雕也之类的吗？: Aren't you supposed to be saying nonsense like how you're the ruler of the train, the world's brain, or how mortals are inadequate?
word.纠正！本机说的是列车最重要的大脑、未来世界的统治者，不朽者波克士！: Correction! What I said was that I am the cardinal brain of the train, the ruler of the future world, the immortal BOX!
word.以及请不要忽略莉薇娅小姐的最佳拍档这重要的一条！朽木不可雕也的是列车长！: And please do not forget the significant title of Miss Livia's Best Partner! The Conductor is the inadequate one!
word.本机只是见到这位女士后，觉得自己有必要更改一下风格。: I simply feel that I ought to switch up my style ever since I laid eyes on this lady.
word.我看你就是怕了只敢夹着尾巴说话吧！: More like you got scared and dared not toot your own horn!
word.BionicOperatorX，现在在铁路系统中被投入使用最多的型号。: Bionic Operator X, the most used model in the present day railway system.
word.不过这台波克士好像和其他的波克士有不同之处，你有给它特殊定制语音吗？: But this BOX seems different from other BOXes. Did you give it a specially customized voice?
word.啊？问我吗？我可没有闲到给这家伙去做个性化定制……: Huh? Me? How could I be that free to personalize this fella...
word.算了，现在有更有研究价值的对象。: Never mind. Now, there's something that's more worthy of my time to look into.
word.哇，店里看起来比外面还有意思！: Wow! The interior of the store looks way more interesting than the exterior!
word.那件不是挺好的？和弗兰平时的风格完全不同吗，有尝试一下的价值哦！: That one is pretty good, no? Completely different from your usual style. It's worth trying on!
word.可是既然想彻底变成另一个人，就要做大胆的尝试嘛！: But if you want to become an entirely different person, you have to make bold choices!
word.这件衣服好像很适合莉薇娅。: This one seems to suit Livia perfectly.
word.真的吗？列车长不要拿我开玩笑了……: Really? Don't pull my leg, Conductor...
word.说起来好像没看见店长，店里没有人吗？: By the way, why haven't we seen the store owner? Is no one around?
word.抱歉抱歉，只是看到你们沉浸在人家设计的衣服里，就忍不住没出声一直在旁边看了。: Sorry, sorry! I couldn't help watching quietly when I saw you guys losing yourselves in the clothes I designed.
word.这条路还没走过，觉得景色很好。: I haven't walked here before. The scenery is lovely.

His voice is smooth and fluent, providing an immersive experience that makes you feel as if you've already embarked on a long journey.

basic.所属园丁的结晶开采专家，现以合作条款暂驻科伦巴商会，提供科研·后勤支援。: A crystal mining expert currently stationed in COLUMBA on cooperative terms to provide scientific and logistical support.
basic.BOX，仿生技工十代，即Bionic Operator X的简称，由铁盟科研部门: BOX (Bionic Operator X) is a multi-functional android developed by B.C.R.L. Research Department and Anita Tech to assist humans in various technical tasks. It has many derivative models, but due to its high cost, it hasn't been widely adopted. BOX equipped on the train can assist the conductor in operating the train, temporarily taking over in special circumstances using pre-set programs.

battleDes.“挨揍宝”2000系列搭载了比前系列更为稳定完善的数据分析系统，便于测试工作人员: The "Punch Me MK.II" series is equipped with a more stable data analysis system, facilitating easier testing of changes in the attacker's power level.
battleDes.从系统设计上来说，超越机器人的承伤系统阈值，意味着参训者的实力已进入了全新的阶段: When the robot's damage tolerance threshold is surpassed, it indicates that the attacker's power has significantly exceeded the standard level.
battleDes.从现实角度来说，机器人的制造和修复都需要时间……但对于乘员们来说，可能是“怎么又: Producing and repairing robots takes time... but for the crew, it feels like, 'Why are we fighting those robots again? Didn't we just do this yesterday?!'
battleDes.想必列车长作为战斗指挥者已经对单纯的进攻异常熟练了吧！来，试试看！: As a commander, you must be a pro at handling enemy's straightforward attacks, right? Come on, give it a shot!
battleDes.挨揍宝2000系列已经完成了最后一次版本更新。击败它，让后续系列挨揍宝都不敢登上: The Punch Me MK.II series has completed its final update. Let's wreck it and ensure no more 'Punch Me' series ever dare to set foot on The Eternal again!
battleDes.掘金机器人的领袖，能够驱动所有掘金机器人一同释放技能。: The leader of the Nugget Mechs can drive all Nugget Mechs to release their skills together.
battleDes.铁盟根据需求和考评情况，为每列列车都配备了专属的维修技师，乘组需要和维修技师进行: The B.C.R.L. assigns technicians to each train based on demand and assessment. All crew members are required to train in combat with these technicians... But why does Haruka's training record bear the number '1000'?
battleDes.“挨揍宝”型机器人都搭载了稳定完善的数据分析系统，便于测试工作人员的攻击力水准。: The "Punch Me" series robots are equipped with a stable data analysis system, facilitating the testing of the attacker's power level.
battleDes.从现实角度来说，机器人的制造和修复都需要时间，参训乘员们也需要吃饭睡觉……所以还: Producing and repairing robots takes time, and the crew members need to eat and sleep... So let's just wrap up the battle in a flash.
battleDes.不能小看不会还手的挨揍宝，毕竟单纯进攻也是需要一定指挥技巧的。: Don't underestimate this Punch Me robot that doesn't fight back. After all, even simply launching attacks requires a certain level of commanding skills.
battleDes.挨揍宝1000系列已经完成了最后一次版本更新。击败它，让挨揍宝（和上面的波克士）: The Punch Me MK.I series has completed its final update. Let's wreck it and let 'Punch Me' (and the Box above it) know who's the boss here!
battleDes.铁盟根据需求和考评情况，分配到符合使用要求的列车上的练习用机器人，用于工作人员的: A training robot assigned by the B.C.R.L. for daily training sessions with crew members on the train.
battleDes.由铁盟根据需求和考评情况全面升级后的练习用机器人。用于工作人员进一步的日常训练。: A state-of-the-art training robot upgraded to the latest generation by the B.C.R.L., designed for more advanced training sessions with crew members on the train.

birthday.不明/商议后定为年终之日: Unclear/determined as the end of the year

birthdayMessage.黑铁之主！此乃随数十次月相盈亏而至的深渊之祭礼！品尝吧！: Lord of Black Iron! This is the rite of the abyss that takes dozens of moon phases to form! Have a taste!
birthdayMessage.除了靛红五月的巧克力之外，这样的巧克力蛋糕我也很喜欢。和你分享了。: Other than Carmine May's chocolates, I love chocolate cakes like this too. Let's share it.
birthdayMessage.外面好吵。看在我的份上，今天你应该不会过度使用列车了吧，我想请假一天休息一下……: It's noisy out there. For my sake, you won't be using the train much today, right? I'd like to take a day off...
birthdayMessage.人类的生日对我来说毫无意义……就连这蛋糕也是莫名其妙出现在桌上的。不过想必这一切: Human's birthday is completely meaningless to me... And this cake... It appeared out of nowhere too. But I'm sure there is a reason for that. How about you eat it for me?
birthdayMessage.我不喜欢太甜的蛋糕，它的苦味正好。机会难得，我给你冲一杯咖啡搭配吧……对我的所有: I'm not a fan of cakes that are too sweet. This is perfectly bitter. Since it's a unique occasion, I'll make you a cup of coffee to go with it... It's only natural for me to show this degree of care toward someone who belongs to me.
birthdayMessage.下次带你去吃黑月游乐城的草莓芭菲吧，那儿做的味道比任何其他地方都要好。现在就先用: I'll take you to try the strawberry parfait in Night Chains Land next time. It's taste is simply unparalleled. But for now, try imagining it with this cake... Prank? No, it's definitely not.
birthdayMessage.虽然我的身体已经无法再摄入食物，但希望你们能开开心心地分享这个蛋糕。: Though this body of mine can no longer take in food, I do hope you will enjoy sharing this cake together.
birthdayMessage.按照书上看到的方法改良了烤蛋糕的配方，减少了其中的糖分……来一起尝尝劳动成果吧？: I adjusted the cake recipe according to the method stated in the book and lessened the amount of sugar used... Shall we try the fruit of my labor together?
birthdayMessage.您今天会来看我吗？亚莉奈非常想和您一起度过这个特殊的日子……请允许我为您做些什么: Will you come and see me today? I truly yearn to spend this special day with you... Please let me do something for you! Anything!
birthdayMessage.有点苦了，但味道很醇厚。多谢你一直以来的照顾。: It's a bit bitter but incredibly rich in flavor. Thank you for taking care of me all this time.
birthdayMessage.蛋糕店拒绝了我订购西柚味蛋糕的请求。有些遗憾……但这个蛋糕也不算难吃，是同事推荐: The cake shop declined my request for a grapefruit-flavored cake. A little disappointing... though this one isn't bad either. A colleague recommended it.
birthdayMessage.虽然看起来平平无奇，不过这可是施加了魔女的祝福的蛋糕哦。至于具体的效果嘛……就请: It may not look like much, but it's a cake that comes with the witch's blessing. As for its actual effect... you can experience it yourself after tasting it, Dear Conductor!
birthdayMessage.能和您一起登上无垠号真是太好了。接下来的一年也请多指教，列车长！: Being able to board The Eternal with you has been nothing short of wonderful. Looking forward to another great year ahead, Conductor!
birthdayMessage.果然地面上的烹饪工艺比较先进……真希望过去的伙伴也能尝到它。不过今天还是先不说这: The culinary skills aboveground are way more advanced... How I wish my old buddies could taste this too. But now isn't the time to talk about this. After having this cake, I'll take you out for a ride!
birthdayMessage.库克说它更想吃烤鸡肉串，但按照习俗还是先花钱订个蛋糕吧……我们一会儿就回来哦。: Cook says it would rather have grilled chicken skewers, but based on tradition, it's better to order a cake... We'll be back in a bit!
birthdayMessage.老妹喜欢的! ——老哥也很喜欢哦。: My sister likes this! — My brother too.
birthdayMessage.不觉得草莓被切开的颜色很吸引人吗？希望您也能领会到这种颜色的魅力。: Don't you find the color of cut strawberries captivating? I hope you'll understand the charm of such a color as well.
birthdayMessage.这种蛋糕味道纯净，没有杂质，很适合不需要被干扰味觉的人品尝……但小心别吃多了。我: Cakes like this taste refreshing and free from impurities. They're ideal for people who don't want their taste buds affected... But take care not to eat too much. I brought mouthwash; remember to use it.
birthdayMessage.送你的。在外面碰见这种蛋糕千万别吃，或者得先交给我检查，里面说不定藏了什么危险的: It's for you. If you ever see such a cake outside, do not eat it, or at least let me inspect it first. It might just have something dangerous concealed within!
birthdayMessage.黛丝莉买了一个最最漂亮的蛋糕，而且花了少少的钱！列车长也要一起吃！: I bought the most super duper pretty cake, and it barely even cost anything! You gotta eat it with me, Conductor!
birthdayMessage.骑士屋特制蛋糕，请用！虽然我只负责了用樱桃点缀的部分，但买来的蛋糕应该味道还不错: Enjoy this exclusive Knight's Hall cake! Even though the only thing I did was decorate it with cherries, a store-bought cake should taste all right, I guess...?
birthdayMessage.……帮宵月订蛋糕时，顺便给你定了一个。就当是对平时照顾的答谢了。: ...I ordered you a cake when I went to get Yoizuki one. Take it as appreciation for your usual kindness.
birthdayMessage.……我没有想到篝火城里的畅销款会是这个，和学会中常见的蛋糕风格完全不一样……不过: ...I didn't expect the best-seller in Bonfire City to be this—completely different from the usual cake styles at the Citadel... Still, I hope you like it.
birthdayMessage.试着……给蛋糕，做了一圈装饰……还算好看吗？: I... tried decorating... the cake... How does it look?
birthdayMessage.往蛋糕上多撒了好几袋不同口味的劲爆跳跳糖！放心啦，我绝对不会进行什么口腔环境爆炸: I sprinkled several packets of different flavored popping candy on the cake! Don't worry. I absolutely will not conduct any explosive oral experiment.☆
birthdayMessage.本来想委托蛋糕店做一套瓷器形状的蛋糕，但它们说什么都不肯。不过这样也不错，请尝尝: I was going to get the cake shop to make a porcelain-shaped cake, but they adamantly refused. Regardless, this is all right too. Give it a try! Be careful not to chip your teeth!
birthdayMessage.我自己亲手做的。第一次试着做尺寸这么大的蛋糕，看着还不错……吧？应该也很好吃，希: I made it by myself. It's my first time making such a large cake. Looks okay... right? Should taste good too. Hope you like it...
birthdayMessage.我拜托甜品店用了低糖的材料，如果可以，请给列车上的小动物也分一些。: I requested the dessert shop to use ingredients with low sugar. If possible, please share some with the animals onboard.
birthdayMessage.如果把这样的蛋糕带回曼德矿场，一定几分钟就会被大家瓜分干净……在那之前，我希望你: If I were to bring a cake like this back to Mander Mine, it will without a doubt be snatched clean by everyone within minutes... But before that, I'd like you to eat it first. It's a gift to you for the kindness you've always shown me.
birthdayMessage.特意选了个造型独特的蛋糕，这可是杂志上最流行最难订到的超华丽翻糖款！: I went out of my way to pick a cake with a really striking design. This is the most sought-after fondant showpiece in the magazines, and next to impossible to get a reservation for!
birthdayMessage.生日当然就要和大家一起分享蛋糕啦！列车长，我们今晚开派对吧！: Naturally, birthdays can't be spent without sharing a cake with everybody! Let's have a party tonight, Conductor!
birthdayMessage.虽然我不怎么吃甜食，但偶尔试试也好！这是公司发的生日蛋糕，你也来尝尝吧！: Although I don't really eat sweets, it's still good to have it once in a while! This cake was given out by the company. Come try it!
birthdayMessage.我从篝火城的甜品店购得了这份礼物。不足以表达更多情感，但很适合与友人们一同分享。: I purchased this gift from a dessert shop in a Bonfire City. While it may not fully convey my feelings for you, it's a lovely treat to share among friends.
birthdayMessage.似乎是其他人买了送来的，不过我还是更喜欢落雁的口味……姑且先转赠给您吧，希望您喜: Seems like someone bought it and had it sent here, but I still prefer the flavor of Rakugan... So, you can have it for now. Hope you'll like it.
birthdayMessage.大家给我办了生日派对。不想去但还是被拖着去了……偶尔去一次，也不是太坏。……请你: They all threw a birthday party for me. I said I didn't want to go, but they still dragged me there... It's honestly not too bad going once in a blue moon, though. Here, have some cake...
birthdayMessage.高中的时候，商业街的咖啡厅总是卖这种蛋糕，我们却总是买不起。现在终于能放心地用自: During high school, we could never afford such cakes sold in the commercial street cafés, but now, I can finally buy them with my salary at any time. Consider this my treat.
birthdayMessage.虽说早已忘记日期……但吾还记得吾出生于春回大地之时。今天恰好有空，于是试着按帝国: Though I have long forgot the exact date... yet I bear in mind I drew breath when spring returneth to the earth. This day I am at leisure, so I baked a cake after the fashion of the Empire, and wove a touch of magic therein for adornment.
birthdayMessage.今天好像不止我一个人过生日……把大家聚在一起吃个饭吧，我来下厨。: If I'm not wrong, I'm not the only birthday girl today... Let's get everyone together for a meal. I'll do the cooking.
birthdayMessage.人家特意买来和你分的蛋糕哦，怎么样，人家心里除了小静流以外还是有其他人的吧~: This cake—I bought it specially to share with you, you know. See? There's room in here for someone other than Shizuru after all~
birthdayMessage.嘿！大姐二姐和大家给我和朱迪订购的大！蛋！糕！！！回来了叫我一起吃！: Hey! My sisters and the others bought me and Jude this giant cake!!! Let's all eat it together when we're back!
birthdayMessage.订了我家附近蛋糕店的畅销款式，味道应该不错。记得和列车上的其他乘员一起分享啊。: I bought the bestseller from the cake shop near my house. It should taste pretty good. Don't forget to share it with the rest of the train crew.
birthdayMessage.本来想选小熊款式的，可惜没有那种选项……不过这个的味道也还不错！: I wanted a teddy bear styled one, but sadly, they didn't have that option... This one tastes great, though!
birthdayMessage.里面的樱桃让人想起鲜血呢……但是我更喜欢这种甜甜的味道，我会选馅料最多的那块分给: The cherries in it remind me of fresh blood... But I like this sweetness more. I'll give you the slice with the most filling.
birthdayMessage.明年我会订个更好吃的星空镜面蛋糕的，今年就先把这个作为谢礼啦。: I'll order a nicer galaxy mirror cake next year. For now, just treat this as my gift of appreciation!
birthdayMessage.不小心加了好几样新型调味试剂，现在的口味非常丰富呢！: I accidentally added several new flavoring reagents. It tastes ultra-rich now!
birthdayMessage.尝试了一下据说成熟女性会喜欢的口味！可是感觉还是冰激凌更好吃……: I tried going with the flavor that's said to be enjoyed by mature ladies! But I still think ice cream tastes better...
birthdayMessage.定了这个看起来很新潮的蛋糕，味道还不错！等我升职加薪以后会经常请你吃的哦！: I got this trendy-looking cake that tastes not bad! After I get my pay raise and promotion, I'll treat you to it more often!
birthdayMessage.这是苏恩大人赐给你的生日蛋糕！想一起吃的话，要来求我哦！: This is a birthday cake gifted to you by the noblest Suen! If you want to eat it together with me, you will have to beg me for it!
birthdayMessage.列车长，蛋糕是白桦和我一起订购的。感谢您愿意同我和白桦交谈。: I bought this cake with White Birch, Conductor. Thank you for willing to chat with us.
birthdayMessage.生日蛋糕这种东西还没快餐店月卡实用……但好歹也买了，要一起吃吗？: Fast food subscription cards are way more practical than birthday cakes... But still, it's already been bought. Wanna eat it together?
birthdayMessage.在常去的那家巧克力专门店买的。谢谢你一直对我很好，以后我还会带其他谢礼回来的。: I bought it from the chocolaterie I frequent. Thank you for always being nice to me. I'll bring other presents in the future.
birthdayMessage.“度假胜地”纯天然原料定制蛋糕 贡露城制作 当日达 邮费寄付: "Holiday Resort" 100% additive-free customized cake, made in Gronru City. Same-day postage, paid delivery available.
birthdayMessage.本机收到了由科伦巴商会寄送的生日蛋糕，鉴于本机无法摄入人类食物，请列车长代为一口: I have received a birthday cake sent by COLUMBA. As I am incapable of ingesting human food, please eat it all on my behalf, Conductor.
birthdayMessage.在下任务途中偶然经过蛋糕店，回忆起您平时对在下的照顾，不胜惶恐，特购此蛋糕以表达: I thought about how kind you have been to me when I happened to pass by a cake shop while on a mission, and so I especially purchased this cake to express my gratitude. It looks utterly delicious...
birthdayMessage.忍者应该对一切外来食物心存警惕！话虽如此我才没有在蛋糕里塞手里剑。: Ninjas ought to be vigilant against any food made by others! That being said, I certainly did not stuff a shuriken in the cake.
birthdayMessage.和从前一样的蛋糕，你的口味应该还没有变吧？很高兴能和你一起度过夏天……下次，等什: It's the same cake as before. Your taste hasn't changed, right? I'm glad to spend this summer with you... Let's plan another trip when we get the chance.
birthdayMessage.在篝火城里拍照的时候看见了可爱的蛋糕，感觉味道一定会很好……<color=#8e: I found this cute cake when taking photos in city. Must be delicious... <color=#8e8e8e>It's super sweet!</color>
birthdayMessage.黑巧克力被证实对维护人类的循环系统健康有一定益处。希望你平时多注意保持身体健康，: Dark chocolate has been proven beneficial for maintaining human health. Please prioritize your overall well-being and try to minimize visits to the medical room.
birthdayMessage.这种蛋糕酸甜复杂的口感和神秘莫测的魔女很搭吧？车长亲要不要再猜猜蛋糕里的樱桃有什: The complex sweet and sour taste of this cake really matches the mysterious witch, doesn't it? Would you like to guess what the cherries in the cake symbolize, Dear Conductor? There are rewards if you get it right~
birthdayMessage.列车长，我选了店里花样最多、最复杂、最可爱的大蛋糕！等今天的工作结束以后，大家一: Conductor, I picked out the cake with the most decorations, the most complicated design, the cutest one in the whole shop! Once today's work is done, let's all gather in the car and share it together!
birthdayMessage.汇流塔特产蛋糕~！其实是我自己照着食谱做的，多谢你之前带来的原材料。要尝尝味道吗: Confluence Tower special cake! Well, I made it myself following the recipe. Thanks for bringing me the ingredients earlier. Want to have a taste? It's really good!
birthdayMessage.动员整顿中心的大家一起做的蛋糕，估计味道会五花八门的……但你可一定要尝尝，这是珍: Everyone at the Reforming Center had a hand in baking this cake, so I bet it's bursting with all sorts of flavors... You've got to taste it! It's a special treat from all of us!
birthdayMessage.虽然球球不会做蛋糕，但还是去蛋糕店里买了一个！感觉很好吃，列车长也分享一些吧！: Ballie doesn't know how to bake cakes, so she bought one from the store! It's going to be delicious! Enjoy it, Conductor!
birthdayMessage.像梦想一样金灿灿的蛋糕！好吃，很甜。人类会喜欢甜的东西，对吗？: A cake golden like dreams! Sweet, delicious. Humans love sweet, right?
birthdayMessage.普通尺寸的蛋糕对我来说完全不够！而且，为什么不能加进烤肉呢？我觉得加肉的蛋糕应该: A regular-sized cake isn't nearly enough for me! And why can't I add grilled meat to it? I bet a cake with meat mixed in would taste pretty good too.
birthdayMessage.好像是我在没睡醒的时候打电话定的蛋糕！虽然被星期一警告了不会好吃，不过我们要敢于: I think I ordered the cake while I was half-asleep! Monday may have warned that it won't taste good, but we need to be adventurous, right? So, shall we try it?
birthdayMessage.谢谢你接纳新生的我。未来的时光……都一起记住吧。: Thanks for embracing the new me... Let's treasure the time we have ahead together.
birthdayMessage.和乌刹娜的帽帽一样颜色的蛋糕~救世主大人也来一起吃！: This cake matches my hat's color~ Have a taste, Master Savior!
birthdayMessage.真不知道生日有什么好过的，干脆你帮我吃吧。不过鉴于这是我大发慈悲买的，你最好全吃: Seriously don't get what's so great 'bout birthdays, might as well have you eat it for me. But since I was generous enough to buy it, ya better finish every last bit! Or it's back to mush next time!
birthdayMessage.这种蛋糕又可爱又好吃，上面的草莓亮晶晶的，就像红宝石一样……列车长可以选草莓最漂: This cake is both lovely and delicious. The strawberries on top glisten just like rubies... Conductor, you can pick the piece with the prettiest strawberry.
birthdayMessage.这是之前试作品小蛋糕的成品版。……你愿意和我一起尝尝的话……就来站台上找我吧？: This is the final version of the little trial cake from before... If you'd be up for tasting it together... you can find me on the platform.
birthdayMessage.我亲自做的蛋糕，希望你能和大家一起品尝。虽然这不是我真正的生日，但对于地表人来说: I made this cake myself. I hope you'll share it with everyone. It isn't my true birthday, but for surface-dwellers this should be the eve of a new year, when all things begin again... Thank you for choosing this day for me, senior.
birthdayMessage.我不怎么尝试这类食用后需要付出更多精力去消耗热量的食物呢。不过，我想，列车上应该: I don't often try this sort of food, the kind that takes extra effort to burn off afterward. Still, I expect there's someone aboard who'd enjoy it?
birthdayMessage.年龄什么的，对于身为机械神代理的我来说可没有什么意义呢，不过……给，这一块就当是: Age and such things have no meaning for me as the proxy of the Mechanical God, but... here, take this as a reward for you... and a little bit of thanks.
birthdayMessage.找熟悉的蛋糕店买的，换成了柠檬慕斯口味，我最喜欢吃了！你也尝尝看？: Bought it from a familiar cake shop and changed it to lemon mousse flavor, my favorite! Would you like to try some?
birthdayMessage.稍微花了些心思做的蛋糕，如果主家愿意和我一同品尝就再好不过了。: I put a little thought into making this cake, and it would be perfect if master is willing to taste it with me.
birthdayMessage.和窟灵族的小家伙们一起去选了块造型很有趣的蛋糕，大家都很喜欢。等你今天稍后有空了: Went with the little ones from the Kuling tribe to choose a cake with a very interesting shape, and everyone liked it. When you have some free time later today, let's enjoy it together.
birthdayMessage.和大家一起做了一个像朋友的蛋糕。一起过生日吧……列车长。: Made a cake like a friend with everyone. Let's celebrate the birthday together... Conductor.
birthdayMessage.这是我尽力做的。希望您能喜欢。虽然生日对我来说不值得纪念，但我想说……谢谢您的帮: This is my best effort. I hope you will like it. Although birthdays are not worth commemorating for me, I want to say... thank you for your help and companionship.

des.自深渊之帝国而来的神秘少女卡塔斯，背负（怎么看都是斧子的）魔剑暗耀斩钢，与行在地: A mysterious girl from the Empire of Abyss, carrying the Spellblade Umbral Fulgor (that is an axe no matter how you look at it). Locked in battle against the endless forces of dawn. The journey ahead will lead to the ultimate battle to destroy the old world! — If Katas were the main character of an adventure comic, the above would most likely be its synopsis, though it's all because of her insistent request. Each of her appearances is like a comic character coming to life, though reality can't craft a ring of focus lines around her to emphasize the effect... Nay, given her adventure spirit, she'd find a way to make even more impactful entrance in no time.
des.铁盟所属蜜獾小队的副队长，承担一部分指挥和交涉职责，待人处事的态度十分冷静。无论: B.C.R.L. Team Ratel's vice-captain, responsible for part of the command and negotiation duties. Has a very calm demeanor, assumes the role of pouring cold water on others during negotiations and combat. Appears to be the most reliable person in Team Ratel, at least on the surface. During missions, she's the first to assess the overall situation, making her a good deputy to Captain Shizuru, and tempers the two crew members' enthusiasm and affection. Skilful, fast runner, and probably a hard hitter, but seems to prefer guns.
des.无垠号名副其实的“幽灵乘员”，供职于科伦巴商会的列车维修师，蓝猫“兜兜”的主人。: A famous ghost crew member of The Eternal, working as a COLUMBA train repair technician, and the owner of the Blue Cat, Dodo. These three identities make up Haruka's exceptionally simple life. Her lack of presence and non-existent social initiative make her someone that is overlooked. But she has no complaints about it and is content with the status quo. When it comes to repairing trains, Haruka is the most reliable partner.
des.小小冒险队的领导者，承担了领队责任的少女，然而年龄看起来是一行人中最小的，似乎只: Leader of the little adventure party, a girl who takes on leadership responsibility, but seems the youngest among the group, looking only twelve or thirteen. She speaks in an unusually mature tone and carries herself like an experienced traveler and has the unquestioned trust of her party members. She always wears a fluffy white outfit regardless of the season, and somehow it neither gets dirty nor needs frequent changing. Sometimes, Arcana speaks in the tone reminiscent of an elderly, perhaps as a result of the strong influence of her elders?
des.字面意义上的轻飘飘乘员，隶属于学会的“天使”，大部分日常行动都是漂浮在空中完成的: Literally a floating crew member from the Citadel, an "Angel". Goes about most daily activities floating in the air. This individual used to be called Joshua, but now that has become a code name — after all, feedback from some former colleagues and friends claims that the current Joshua is completely different from the one they knew. Also, all information about the Angel must remain confidential, and any written material unvetted by Joshua is considered invalid. Thus, this archive entry refers to Joshua as "they" and "the individual". Kindly note this.
des.阿妮塔能源研究所负责人，桦石与能源领域的专家，阿妮塔内名下拥有最多项专利的发明家: Head of Anita Energy Institute, an expert in the fields of Chaos Stone and energy, and the inventor with the most patents in Anita. However, Nicola is not bothered by these titles, so she doesn't take action as the Head, doesn't attend research meetings, and even stuffs her patent applications into a safe, never to open them again. If she's spotted outside, it must be to pursue something truly close to her heart... such as newly released plush toys and new flavors of potato products, or indispensable research collaborators.
des.充满神秘气息的青年，来无影去无踪，是众多坏事以及少量好事的始作俑者——善与恶的定: A mysterious young man who comes and goes without a trace. Perpetrator of many bad deeds and a few good ones — good and evil are so ambiguous to him that all accusations against him seem weak and meaningless. Simply classifying him as a cunning enemy is not quite right, but treating him as a friend too soon is recipe for exploitation with worse consequences. No matter how strong or mysterious a person is, one would have a past and weaknesses. What secrets lie in Hayabusa's past? And what unimaginable weakness does he have?
des.学会的核心人物，御敌枢纽先导——达斯廷。如果仅从外观判断，很难断定他是否还能被称: The Citadel's core personnel and leader of the Destroyer. Based on his appearance, it is difficult to determine if he's still human. His limbs, skin, and even some organs have been replaced by machinery, leaving only a few traces of his human identity. If everything has a reason, then Dustin sacrificed so much to survive and continue fighting to create a peaceful world for the children — Thus, he's willing to pay any price to guide and accompany the children he loves toward the future.
des.瓦伦汀是学会的司书之一，在撰文迷宫中负责为图书编目，简单来说就是图书管理员——但: Valentine is one of the Citadel's scribes, responsible for cataloguing books in the Fabricate, essentially a librarian — She has an almost photographic memory when it comes to books, making her a walking book retrieval system. Whenever a visitor needs a book, she can find it quickly. She has also created a mini-library within the sea of academic books, specifically for books not included in the Fabricate.
des.亚莉奈似乎能以黑月成员的身份出现在任何地方，但只要稍加观察就会发现，她总和列车长: Arina seems to be an ever-present member of the Night Chains, but on closer inspection, it's clear her actions are in sync with Conductor's. When Conductor returns to The Eternal, she would often be waiting on the train with a smile. Arina's Ascension Ability allows her to summon three mirror images. Customers are often startled by multiple Arinas when they first enter the rest area — however, the drinks she prepares are delicious, making it easy for people to let their guard down and open up to her. Whether this is a prelude to getting close to her or falling into a trap... only time will tell.
des.身为黑月执行人的奈弥，其直接效忠的却并非黑月这一庞大的组织本身。对她来说，在执行: Nabi, the Night Chains Executor, doesn't serve the large organization directly. She has another identity that she prioritizes over her role as Executor, and that is Hayabusa's bodyguard, even though it's a role assigned by someone else. She dresses simply and does things in a straightforward manner. She rarely engages in unnecessary interactions. You might occasionally see Nabi sitting by a window, sketching with a pencil — one of her few hobbies.
des.专注于无人机开发的伊尔不同于那些长期驻扎某个实验室的园丁，她时常往返于各个实验基: Yer specialises on drone development. Unlike gardeners who stay in a lab for extended periods, she travels frequently between research bases to assist with everyone's research and operations, establishing good relationships with many colleagues. As one whose action speaks louder than words, Yer comes across as competent and reliable. Although she maintains appropriate distance from others, it does not stop her from being a trusted figure.
des.马吉拉平时自己经营着一家cos专营店，店铺规模虽小，但细致周到的待客方式和定制品: Margiela runs a cosplay costume store. Although it is a small operation, it provides thoughtful service with attention to detail and custom products that earned it a good reputation and loyal customer base. As a Night Chains member, she would close the shop if she's needed for a mission. Margiela's true passion lies in cosplay, particularly dressing up as a little witch from an animation.
des.车长助理。因多年前遭遇的一场事故，莉薇娅身受重伤，之后虽被科伦巴商会的负责人梅迪: Conductor's assistant. Livia suffered critical injuries in an accident many years ago and was rescued by Signora Medici, head of COLUMBA. Upon regaining consciousness, Livia had lost most of her memories, other than the Mundus Empire being her birth place. To repay Signora Medici, Livia joined COLUMBA after passing the crew exam and, by pure chance, teamed up once again with her training school classmate — the Conductor.
des.柯娜是莉薇娅的旧识，据她本人和莉薇娅所言，她曾经是帝国的士兵。柯娜以出色的实力和: Connor is Livia's old acquaintance. According to both her and Livia, she was once an Empire soldier. She stands out among mercenaries with her outstanding skills and valiant bearing, and has earned a good reputation. Her chivalric demeanor makes it easy for people to trust her, and many Imperials with mercenary experience on the surface have been under her care. After encountering many experiences, Connor has had one thing in mind. How should she change for the happiness of those important to her?
des.与小小冒险队偶遇并且经历一系列突发事件后，干脆加入旅行队伍一同行动的少女。和一只: After experiencing a series of unexpected events with the adventure team, the girl decided to join them. She travels with a large eagle-like bird named Cook. With simple attire and a petite frame, she appears relaxed and carefree. Hailing from the Mundus Empire, she seems to have no bias against the surface world and is interested in sceneries. She's a tiny traveler in search of someone. Her current goal in life is to find her father, who left home for years, and give him a good beating.
des.常有人以“违和感”来形容狮鬃。因为“她”身上有太多让人觉得奇怪的地方：狮鬃的身体: People often use the word "disharmony" to describe Solum because "she" is strange in many ways: While Solum has a feminine body and a young girl's voice, her mannerisms and tone are unlike that of a "young girl". If you underestimate this guard because of her petite stature, you would suffer — Hmm, perhaps it's a disguise to confuse enemies?
des.作为黑月酒店的侍应生，魇那充满亲和力的笑容给大家留下了深刻的印象。虽然偶尔有冒冒: As a waitress at the Night Chains Hotel, Maruha's friendly smile leaves a deep impression on everyone. Although she makes occasional clumsy mistakes, her friendly attitude allows her to maintain good relationships with colleagues and guests. However, if she were just a friendly and gentle waitress, how could Maruha establish herself in an organization like Night Chains? There seems to be something hidden behind that smile...
des.性格冷静强硬的研究员。塞西尔天生对气味异常敏感，她也从小就对气味研究展现出了极大: Calm and firm researcher, Cecil has a innately acute sense of smell and a great interest in studying scents since young. After joining Night Chains, her research has achieved considerable success. While it isn't tough approaching Cecil, you'll definitely face her disdain if you've come into contact with something pungent. Long-time Night Chains members also agree: when Cecil shows particular interest and closeness to someone, that person should be on guard.
des.铁盟所属狐獴小队的爆破手，是个毒舌孤僻的女孩。如果说雷火在爆破方面展现出的能力和: B.C.R.L Team Meerkat's Demolitions expert, a sharp-tongued loner. While Reika's skills and precision in demolitions score full marks, her interpersonal skills and teamwork are unfortunately in the negatives. Even if you've known her for a long time, you might suddenly wonder if she ever intended to get along with you. Since none of her current teammates is overly outgoing, Reika is quite satisfied with the status quo.
des.与科伦巴商会签订了长期合约的护卫乘员。生活中的黛丝莉十分活泼，纯真的发言总会让身: A guard crew member under a long-term contract with COLUMBA. Desiree is spirited and always brings joy with her innocent remarks. However, once she enters combat, her ruthless and precise archery instills fear. Her marksmanship can almost be described as unfailingly accurate. The stark contrast between her youthful appearance and her proficient use of ascension abilities, which are nearly on par with B.C.R.L veterans with at least five years, hints at an extraordinary past.
des.一手创办了“骑士屋”的夏洛蒂不仅出身贵族，曾经还是军人，因此无论是剑术、审美乃至: Charlotte, who single-handedly founded the Knight's Hall, not only comes from a noble family but was also a soldier. As a result, she has impeccable swordsmanship, aesthetics, and etiquette. Charlotte is known for her gentle and courteous demeanor, as well as her eager and responsible attitude. Everyone knows that if they need help, they can count on her. In addition to accepting security assignments, the Knight's Hall also offers swordsmanship training. Due to the professional security and reasonable prices, it is popular among the commoners.
des.来自黑月的护卫人员，但没有随身携带任何武器，通常不会独自搭乘列车。苍叶平时沉默寡: Night Chains security crew member, she isn't armed and doesn't usually ride the train alone. Aoba is quiet and doesn't interact much with others on the train. Her sole duty is to protect her younger sister, Yoizuki, the future head of Mugenryu. A more Night Chains-style codename for Aoba would be "Shadow Dancer of Yoizuki". She obeys her sister's orders without question. Standing alone in the shadows, Aoba is like a shade unwilling to exist.
des.来自索思学会的神秘访客，平日里寡言少语的年轻人。他的行踪成谜，行事方式似乎也和学: Enigmatic visitor from the Source Citadel, a young man of few words. His whereabouts are a mystery, and his actions seem different from most of the Citadel members. Nayuta values efficiency and secrecy, and always operates alone. Through observing his daily life, it's apparent that he shares a close, almost familial relationship with Dustin and Sommer from Source Citadel. According to BOX's combat data analysis, Nayuta's tactics against human enemies are more sophisticated than those for dealing with Chaos Remains...
des.索思学会所属，御敌枢纽成员。幼时觉醒升构能力，但由于能力波动而险些变成深眠者。学: A member of the Destroyer, Source Citadel. She awakened her Ascension Ability at a young age. However, due to its unstable nature, she faced the risk of becoming a Deep Sleeper. Thanks to timely treatment by the Citadel, her condition was stabilized. However, her mutant left hand remains unhealed. Currently, she serves as a frontline combatant and shares a familial relationship with Dustin and Nayuta, who are also members of the Destroyer.
des.铁盟所属蜜獾小队成员之一，在队伍中担任爆破手的角色。与“爆破手”这一职责相匹配的: Dorothy is a BCRL Team Ratel member, serving as the demolition expert. Her fiery and boisterous personality is a perfect match for her role. Her laughter and voice can usually be heard from a carriage away. Be it at work or in daily life, she's a lively girl who keeps everyone on their toes. If you bump into her out in the field with a detonator switch in hand, duck immediately when she takes action, to avoid being caught in the blast.
des.略显年幼的长相加上平日的装扮，卡莱雅时常被不了解的人误以为是初入阿妮塔的实习护士: With her youthful appearance and usual outfit, Kaleya is often mistaken by those who don't know her as a new intern nurse in Anita. In reality, she is a capable Gardener familiar with the Chaos world's environment, and often provides her comrades with environmental support. Gentle, generous, and knowledgeable, Kaleya is popular and trusted by her colleagues. Perhaps to compensate for the regret of being unable to use her physician's license, Kaleya is always eager to offer medical support when needed.
des.身为黑月执行人的霖给人的印象是一个颇为内向的女孩，平时几乎不与他人交流合作，也看: As a Night Chains executor, Lin comes across as a very introverted girl. She rarely communicates or cooperates with others and shows little emotional fluctuation. This isn't surprising in a group like Night Chains where many prefer working alone. Her exquisite albeit low-key fashion sense, her occasional emotional outbursts that startle those around her, and her calm demeanor when facing bloody scenes suggest that Lin is quite a unique girl.
des.“火烈鸟宠物店”在修格里城的宠物爱好者之间拥有良好的口碑，作为店主的伽罗尔对于宠: Flamingo Pet Store is well-regarded among pet lovers in Shoggolith City. The owner, Galore, is known for his gentle and meticulous care of pets. It might be hard to imagine such kindness and patience existing under his cold and gloomy exterior, but he has undoubtedly earned praise from customers and trust from animals. Occasionally, Galore would suddenly showcase his magic tricks. Though judging from his level of expertise, it's clear that magic is more than just a hobby for him. Galore avoids communication as much as possible and rarely talks about himself.  However, his calmness and efficiency indicate he has the combat experience to handle any unexpected situations.
des.铁盟狐獴小队队长。与更富机动性的蜜獾小队不同，狐獴小队的工作内容以后勤支援与特殊: Captain of B.C.R.L. Team Meerkat. Unlike the more mobile Team Ratel, Team Meerkat deals with logistics and special situations. Ganya was chosen as Team Meerkat's captain for several reasons: she is from Mander Mine, excelled in training camp, and has performed well in her job. She is responsible and steady. Amongst the problematic Team Meerkat, Ganya stands out as the normal one. However, Rachel, Ilona, and Reika all trust and like this captain, though Reika may never admit it.
des.阿妮塔首屈一指的人气大帅哥、引人瞩目的时尚先锋、善解人意的完美天才、玉树临风的滑: Anita's most popular heartthrob, a striking fashion icon, a perfect, empathic genius, and a graceful skiing prince. Yes, this is Akira's... one-sided story. If you ask those who know him, you'd probably hear things like, "he's talented but always messes up at critical moments," "always concerned with looking cool in combat," and "honestly, he's a bit noisy"... comments that are far from glamorous and, according to Akira, totally uncool.
des.与科伦巴商会签订了长期合约的护卫乘员，目前于无垠号上常驻，与弗兰关系很好。虽然平: A guard crew member under a long-term contract with COLUMBA, currently stationed on The Eternal, and has a good relationship with Fran. Although she usually seems lazy, her observation and sensitivity are exceptionally keen, always sensing danger early. She's an excellent hunter, so you'd better be careful if targeted by her crossbow. At critical moments, Eliot becomes serious and is an indispensable help.
des.来自阿妮塔能源公司的探路者，年级尚轻但眼神十分锐利，手持的旗帜状探索信标，身后跟: Pathfinder from Anita Energy Company, young and sharp-eyed, holding a flag-shaped exploration beacon, with a polite robot dog following behind. Compared to her mature and cautious partner, Caroline is livelier, though that's an understatement. From Yejue's complaints and helpless comments from other Anita employees, it's clear that Caroline trusts her first instinct over extensive planning and hours of waiting for instrument results. Maybe this is also a way of following her heart — Caroline's dream is to keep venturing into uncharted territories.
des.御敌枢纽的（名誉）战斗先导，众多御敌枢纽成员乃至其他机构成员的指导者和前辈，年龄: As a Vanguard (honorary) of the Destroyer at Source Citadel, Lissandra is a mentor and predecessor to many members within the Destroyer and other Citadel departments, with her age undisclosed. Sporting a perennially dependable smile, she holds strong beliefs and excels in philosophical contemplation and debate. Notably, she is renowned for engaging in a three-day discourse with a peer mentor of equivalent standing. While she is a trustworthy ally in times of peril, it is advised to steer clear of deep philosophical discussions on topics like humanity, society, and life with Lissandra, as those who have attempted this have learned their lessons the hard way.
des.宵月是梦玄流的下任家主，同时也是黑月匠造的总负责人。仅仅静立着就美得像是一树盛放: Yoizuki is the next head of the Dream Profound Style, and is also the overall person-in-charge of Night Chains Lesage. Her mere presence is as beautiful as a blooming night cherry tree, causing other passengers on The Eternal to mistake that they boarded the wrong train. She is kind and skilled in communication and negotiation, showing no airs of a family head, always wearing a gentle, proper smile on her face. Whether the train is attacked or receives sudden unknown communications, she handles it all with unmoving grace with no hint of fear. Additionally, the crew's manifest lists a bodyguard, who occasionally appears beside her like a shadow.
des.铁盟所属狐獴小队的狙击手，远近闻名的家里蹲，行动宗旨是能不出门就绝不会踩上地面。: Sniper from B.C.R.L Team Meerkat, well-known recluse whose motto is to never stepping outside unless absolutely necessary. Ilona frequently misses lively group events and often disappears during missions, with team members saying she hides in a concealed spot. Fortunately, her shooting skills are excellent, and she has various means of providing support to ensure she isn't forgotten. When B.C.R.L. members and other train passengers mention her, they always ask, "Did she go out today?"
des.铁盟所属蜜獾小队的队长，年纪尚轻但很有实力。综合实力不如蜜獾小队的其他队员，但反: Young but capable captain of BCRL Team Ratel. Although her overall abilities are not as good as other Team Ratel members, her quick reflexes, grasp of command, and tactical planning make her a convincing leader. The Conductor's friend for many years, although their communication has mostly been limited to long-distance.
des.\\n小时候加丽娜曾为了保护妹妹达莉娅身受重伤，因此昏睡了数年。\r\\n等她再:
When she was young, Galina suffered critical injuries protecting her younger sister, Daria, and fell into a deep sleep for several years.
When she woke up, the long loss of memory led to anxiety and Confuse.
Despite her efforts to muster the courage to face it all, post-traumatic symptoms made communication difficult.
As a result, she became shy and hesitant to open up to others, giving an illusion of calmness. Due to her young mental age, Galina's thoughts are still very immature and pure, with rich mental activity.
Besides her sister and Katas, who brought her to the Citadel, everyone else found it hard to gain Galina's trust. She is still working to adapt to her current self.
des.波克士经过改装后的全新外形，暂称其为圣剑波克士（注：其武器不具有任何与“圣”相关: After modification, BOX is now called Box Excalibur (note: its weapon has no holy attributes). Equipped with a large close-combat weapon, the connection point is fortified to prevent the sword-shaped weapon from loosening or falling off, allowing flexible wielding in combat. Additionally, it has been upgraded with the latest multi-functional android mechanic upgrade disk from B.C.R.L., enabling it to adapt to more complex battlefield environments and better assist in combat.
des.与科伦巴商会签订了长期合约的护卫乘员，目前于无垠号上常驻，与艾略特关系很好。挥舞: A guard crew member under a long-term contract with COLUMBA, currently stationed on The Eternal, and has a good relationship with Eliot. Fran is a shield bearer at the front line, appearing steady and reliable in combat. She is well-balanced in all aspects, both physically and mentally resilient. Filled with a strong sense of responsibility, she always leads the charge and protects teammates with her shield. Her back is a reassuring sight for her companions.
des.铁盟所属蜜獾小队的成员。卡莲出身于一个富裕的商人家庭，所以即使在训练营中磨炼了不: A member of Team Ratel under BCRL. Karen comes from a wealthy merchant family, and though she's toughened up quite a bit since training camp, there's still a trace of that high-society air in the way she talks—something everyone around her has long since gotten used to, and no one holds it against her or treats her as some kind of untouchable young lady. It was her admiration for Shizuru, and her determination to follow in her footsteps, that led Karen to enroll at the BCRL training camp in the first place, and she genuinely worked hard enough to make it through. These days, if there's anything at all that could trouble a young lady who otherwise finds most things beneath her notice, it's probably just this: how to get a little closer to Shizuru.
des.相比大多数升构者，薇尔岚的升构能力拥有更为独特的表现以及作用方式，从她身边伴随的: Unlike most Ascenders, Verlaine's Ascension Ability has a unique expression and functionality, as seen in the hound-like creature accompanying her. The hound Monday is not a real animal or a man-made companion robot but an extension of Verlaine's ability. Her companion. This uniqueness leads to some issues — she is destined not to blend in with ordinary people and lacks common ground with most Ascenders. However, her lively and cheerful personality seems unaffected. According to her, it's all because of the precious friends by her side.
des.身为铁盟科研人员的瑞秋，本来是没有作战的必要的，但为了能得到第一手的数据，更好地: As a Bonfire City Railways League researcher, Rachel is not required to engage in combat. However, to obtain firsthand data and improve her development of the supply reagent kit 'Rainbow Flask', she applied to join Team Meerkat. By working with Team Meerkat, which primarily handles support and special missions, Rachel was able to conduct experiments and collect data on the battlefield. Rachel's research is progressing well juding from the new colors she has developed for the 'Rainbow Flask'.
des.沙盗团成员，出身、升构能力、真实身份均不明……综上，此类人员本应被划入“危险人员: A member of the P.U.S., her origin, Ascension Ability, and true identity are shrouded in mystery. Typically, she would be classified as a potential threat and subject to permanent surveillance. However, due to her exceptional contribution in resolving an incident involving the Eternal CBCRR23 train crew, she has been temporarily designated as part of the crew's support staff and granted licensed crew member access. As she may not possess full civil capacity yet, the rest of the crew is encouraged to exercise tolerance and supervise her conduct to support her healthy development.
des.在拜访修格里城的铁安局之前，认识海因里希的最快途径是指着那张著名的铁盟征兵宣传广: Before visiting the BCRL Agency in Shoggolith City, one can easily discover Heinrich's reputation by pointing to the renowned BCRL recruitment poster and asking, "Ohh! Who's that?" The question would yield various responses. Some would identify him as the head of the BCRL Agency in Shoggolith City, while others would describe him as a war hero and a model soldier from the old days. However, upon meeting this living legend in person, one would be impressed by his down-to-earth attitude, as well as the restraint and friendliness commonly found in a typical soldier, as he is always ready to extend help as part of his duty.
des.只要是经常出入曼德矿场的列车武装工厂的人，都会对这位金色头发的女孩儿有点印象。对: Anyone who frequently visits the Mander Mine's Train Weapon Factory is bound to remember the girl with golden hair. Her striking long golden hair—far too vivid for the soot-stained technicians of the rail industry—along with bold streaks of color, flamboyant and avant-garde fashion, and a voice that carries without effort, all make Tennie an unmistakable presence and something of a living signboard for the Train Weapon Factory. And yet, she is also its top engineer. With a single call, she can be found emerging from piles of tools and half-assembled machinery, ready to solve any problem a visiting conductor might bring.
des.来自索思学会的少女，最令人难忘的特征是其遍布身体的奇异纹路。虽然从年龄上来看还只: Girl from the Source Citadel, remembered for the strange patterns covering her body. Though she's just a child in terms of age, all test results show she has adult-like qualities, leading her to always act as an adult. Whether in the Citadel or on the train, the very friendly Suen can talk anyone's ear off. If someone shows curiosity about the patterns on her body, Suen will proudly and openly display them.
des.瑞瓦，这名来自曼杜斯帝国的“恶魔捕手”，目前正在西大陆铁路环线各地的篝火城中接取: Reeva, a "Devil Hunter" from the Mundus Empire, is currently taking on various "devil hunting" commissions in Bonfire Cities across the Western Continent Railway Loop. Whether it is an unknown creature discovered inside or outside the city, or an unexplained anomaly found within a residence, it seems to fall within the scope of this Devil Hunter's services. As long as the client can provide a specific location of the incident, Reeva will go there to track it down and deal with it. With such extraordinary abilities, she should, in theory, be able to achieve great things from a much higher position. However...
des.阿妮塔的桦树结晶研究员，年纪轻轻就拥有了自己的独立研究室，无论何时都神采奕奕的天: An Anita researcher studying Chaos Crystals. Stella had her independent lab at a young age. She is always full of energy, and is a young girl with aspirations. Occasionally boarding the Eternal while entering and exiting the Chaos Space and exploring new areas, she exudes an aura of perfection like a pampered girl refined down to every strand of hair. However, just like how beautifully maintained long hair requires a lot of care, Stella's life hasn't been smooth-sailing — though this might need time with her to comprehend fully.
des.菲妮娅的父母都是学会的学者，可以说，学会的学馆和巨大浮空舰——学会城“塞纳诺尼克: Fenia's parents are Citadel scholars, making the Citadel's libraries and the giant airship Senanonic her hometown. As her parents hoped, Fenia became an Ascender early on and was exceptionally talented. Growing up in the Citadel, she has the purest love for humanity and an undeniable hostility toward Chaos Remains. To achieve the goal of annihilating all Chaos Remains and protecting the world, Fenia joined the Destroyer and took the initiative to venture into the battlefield.
des.来自阿妮塔能源公司的探路者，手持探索用装备，从桦树空间返回阿妮塔宿舍的途中有时会: Pathfinder from Anita Energy Company wielding exploration equipment, she occasionally boards The Eternal on her way back to her Anita dormitory from the Chaos Space. She maintains a cheerful older sister demeanor in both work and life, a contrast to her partner Caroline's temperament. As a pragmatic doer, her dream is to become a successful person who can afford a big house, making her very concerned about salary, promotions, raises, and other material things... According to her, all her efforts are to make money. However, this honesty is reassuring. At least once paid, she completes her work earnestly — provided she doesn't argue with her partner midway.
des.阿妮塔能源公司实习生安菲娅，应特殊要求，档案中的部分个人信息设置为“不公开”。另: Anfiya, an intern at Anita. Part of her personal information is marked as "inaccessible for public" upon special request. Additionally, the two special devices she carries have successfully passed testing and have been approved for use as "research aid gadgets," provided they do not present a threat to others. Polarization detectors may set off alarms when near Anfiya and her research devices. In such cases, inspect the surrounding area for potential threats and deactivate the polarization detectors when there are no identified threats. Currently, Anfiya has been granted special permission to serve as a temporary crew member on the Eternal.
des.阿知波是阿妮塔能源公司的实习生，需要频繁往来于桦树空间与现实世界进行探索和开拓工: Anita Energy Company intern Achiwa frequently travels between the Chaos Space and the real world for exploration and pioneering work. Her work mostly involves... rock crushing, so it seems. She carries an exploration tool resembling both a bat and a hammer, functioning as a weapon and tool. The weapon has significant explosive power and has been well-modified by its wielder. Based on the outer casing and additional components, it might also have advanced technological features — why does an intern's weapon have such latest tech? Did she pay for it herself?
des.作为黑月酒店的“安全总监”，闻笙给人的第一印象就是“难以接近的危险人物”。毕竟虽: As Safety Director of Night Chains Hotel, Wensheng gives the impression of a dangerous and unapproachable person. Although the job might seem glamorous, everyone knows the shady business behind Night Chains Hotel and has the tacit understanding — "Being in post requires brains, strength, and guts." Hence, most are baffled when they see Wensheng expressionlessly playing a claw machine at a street corner store...
des.冯·里奈很容易给人一种类似于“是个厉害人物”之类的印象，毕竟她为学会工作着，对各: It's easy for Rina Von to come across as a powerful figure, given that she works for the Citadel, well-versed in various organizations' intelligence, and can provide rare social data. However, she claims recording such information is just a hobby and discourages exaggeration of her abilities. Though not a workaholic, Rina Von is a reliable doer, always completing tasks systematically.
des.\\n埃兹拉从小就为了成为一名优秀的帝国骑士而不断努力，等到了合适的年龄便前往帝:
Ezra has been working hard to become an excellent imperial knight since young, and joined the capital's imperial knights training camp when he was of age.
His toned body from long-term vigorous training, and prowess as a Reverberator secured his quick admission.
However, there are two sides to everything. Ordinary weapons couldn't withstand his wild combat style and wore out quickly.
Seeking more durable weapons, Ezra left his fellow knights and eventually decided to master weapon forging himself.
His single-mindedness and dedication led him to develop a passion for forging and his skills kept advancing rapidly.
When Ezra saw weapon blueprints from the surface, he was deeply impressed by the unprecedented Tech and resolved to seek new breakthroughs on the surface.
des.BOX，仿生技工十代，即Bionic Operator X的简称，由铁盟科研部门: BOX (Bionic Operator X) is a multi-functional android developed by B.C.R.L. Research Department and Anita Tech to assist humans in various technical tasks. It has many derivative models, but due to its high cost, it hasn't been widely adopted. BOX equipped on the train can assist the conductor in operating the train, temporarily taking over in special circumstances using pre-set programs.
des.作为活跃于暗处的忍者，跳鼠懂得利用千变万化的姿态将锋芒藏匿于暗处。她擅长变装和易: As a ninja active in the shadows, Tobinezumi knows how to hide with various guises. She excels in disguise and impersonation, playing different roles to infiltrate or gather information. Her excellent skills and unpredictable appearance mean few know this quiet, shy girl is a skilled ninja.
des.\\n米莉作为以古老优雅闻名的贵族世家小姐，偏偏对成为帝国骑士充满兴趣。她得到父:
As a lady from a family famed for ancient elegance, Millie is keen to become an Imperial knight. With her parents' support, she apprenticed under an old knight and progressed rapidly in combat.
At her first martial arts tournament, Millie abandoned knightly etiquette, biting her enemies to defeat them, shocking the audience.
After formally graduating and receiving an axe from her mentor, Millie soon left the nobility's red tape for the surface.
Her strong competitive streak and reckless passion quickly made her famous in the Bonfire City's arenas.
Millie now works as a bodyguard, highly trusted for her strength.
des.梦玄流未来的免许皆传、隐于市井之人、侦探所的栋梁——织姬，即山岚大人是也！无论是: The future inheritor of Mugenryu, hidden in the city, the pillar of the detective agency — Shiki, also known as Lord Yamaarashi! Whether honing ninja skills or detective work, it must be the best, in particular, better than her rival Tobinezumi! To this end, no matter the obstacle before her, she advances resolutely on the path of justice... Can I become an action movie star?! Why would Lord Yamaarashi want to b-become an action star?! Surpassing Tobinezumi in ninja skills is enough, and nothing else matters for the sole inheritor of Mugenryu! Forget what I said!
des.铁盟模范小队“蜜獾小队”的队长。在她的带领下，蜜獾小队从一支新人队伍迅速成长为铁: The captain of Team Ratel, a model squad of the BCRL. She has overseen her squad's rapid transformation from a rookie unit to one of BCRL's most promising teams. Her tactical skills have also shown steady improvement. However, even the most accomplished commander needs breaks from time to time. At the request of her team members, she has finally accepted a well-deserved respite. Building a deeper understanding of her could lay the groundwork for ongoing relationship in the future.
des.关于丽桑德拉的过去，学会并没有很明确的记载，只有被置于学会藏书深处的残破书卷中，:
There are no clear records in the Citadel about Lissandra's past, except for fragmented mentions in the deep archives of the Citadel's library. Any traceable records of Lissandra are recent, but as one who can clearly describe the Citadel's origins, she is believed to be one of its early members.
As someone who can compare with Dustin in terms of combat power, Lissandra is the Citadel's trump card for special situations. The Citadel has granted her maximum freedom and respect alongside Dustin.
As a researcher of psychology-related courses and a mentor, she embodies the principle of learning by doing, often roaming the major bonfire cities, making her one of the most well-known Citadel members.
Within the Citadel, Lissandra's actions are seen as a more humane interpretation of the Citadel's principles compared to Dustin's benevolence.
des.该收容对象SC-002的外表表现为一位约16岁的人类女性，有着灰白色的长发（长度: Subject SC-002 appears as a female human approximately 16 years of age, sporting lengthy grayish-white hair (extending to the upper arm's length). Currently rated as ████, indicating permission for "interaction with the external world and humans" and "independent action". SC-002 must be accompanied by a qualified guarantor and guardian. In any circumstances, the subject must wear a ████ device provided by the guarantor ████ or maintain a connection to the ████ device in a way. Note: As per the request from the guarantor and other related parties, the subject can be addressed as "Jalhay" in unspecified settings.
des.升构学派是索思学会中重要的学术派别。但和他们的同僚相比，升构学派的研究者们似乎在: The Ascension faction is a cardinal academic faction of Source Citadel, but in comparison with their colleagues, the Ascension's researchers seem to be even more radical when it comes to means and viewpoints. By the standards of society, they are without a doubt unscrupulous. As a scholar in this faction, Ithos doesn't exactly have an amiable demeanor, which makes it understandable why he isn't well-liked by others. Still, there are some unsettling rumors that surround him - a researcher who used his family as lab rats, an amoral, horrifying murderer... But he has never once responded to these accusations.
des.自称是“甲铁城”的列车整备员，努力向无垠号乘组介绍了自己的经历和来历，然而他解释: A self-proclaimed mechanic of Koutetsujou, Ikoma did his best to share his background and experience with the Eternal crew, but everything he disclosed was beyond anyone's comprehension. He fought alongside the Eternal crew and provided loads of technical and combat assistance during the events occurred near Ranshin City. At present, Ikoma is temporarily traveling with the Eternal while searching for a way to return to his train.
des.作为黑月的执行人，作为“瞳仁”的店主，马吉拉在不同的身份场合都得到了大家的肯定和: As an executor of Night Chains and the owner of "Pupil's Fashion", Margiela has gained recognition and trust from everyone in various roles. She no longer needs to play the idealized role she once craved, for she has truly become a witch herself. Still, this never means she abandons her fondness for role-playing. The touching warmth she brings to others by briefly embodying different characters and making them real is a miracle that even magic can never replace.
des.正如列车长和铁盟的成员们所了解的，拖车驾驶员可谓铁盟中最辛苦的“道上工作”之一。: As the Conductor and BCRL members well know, towing car driving stands among the most grueling of all road duties within BCRL. Even under the semi-compulsory assignment system, this line of work rarely finds many eager volunteers—for who, after all, would willingly choose to endure such long stretches of solitude, only to shoulder work so tedious and so fraught with danger? Against such a backdrop, Komugi's arrival was like a ray of golden, fragrant sunlight; wherever her furry little face appeared, every hardship and peril seemed, somehow, to simply melt away. So the next time you find yourself stranded or broken down out in the wilds, be sure to call for towing car driver Komugi over the comms!
des.索思学会导师罗洁尔，曾于浮空城塞纳诺尼克担任驻舰导师一职。近年主动申请成为收容对: Raziel, a mentor of Source Citadel. Used to be the resident mentor aboard the airship Senanonic. In recent years, she volunteered to become the guardian of entity SC-002 (commonly known as "Jalhay"). From then on, to ensure the safety and stability of SC-002, she and SC-002 moved to the Confluence Tower. On account of her stellar reputation within Source Citadel, her living and research environments were specially retained in recognition of her contribution. May Raziel complete her guardianship duties toward SC-002 as swiftly as possible, alongside her relevant research, and return to Senanonic soon.
des.进入整顿中心大楼后，首先会给人留下深刻印象的恐怕就是众多沿走廊和房间布设的摄像头: Upon entering the Reforming Center, any visitors will be impressed by a multitude of cameras lining the corridors and rooms, complemented by surveillance robots patrolling various areas. The architect of this extensive network is Paladi, a long-haired girl sporting a cloak and oversized hat. Easily recognizable by her distinctively loud voice and rowdy laughter, she stands out in any setting.
des.兹证明我司佩罗塔女士（出生日期■■■■年9月5日，已成年），从事园丁特别派遣专员: This document certifies that Pelota (born on September 5, ■■■■, adult) currently holds the position of Special Agent within Gardener. She has been a regular employee of our organization for the past two consecutive years. Effective immediately, Pelota is designated as a crew member aboard the Eternal for a period of ■■ days. During her assignment, she will comply with the laws and regulations of bonfire cities and the Eternal. We undertake to indemnify her against any accidental damages within the scope of the contract. The terms of this arrangement are detailed in the document titled "Memorandum on Matters Concerning Pelota's Special Dispatch."
des.旧型号掘金机器人，出厂时间约为二十五年前。曾于淘金乐园及其周边地区服役，主要负责: An old nugget mech model manufactured around 25 years ago that used to serve ONEderland and its surrounding areas. Primarily in charge of the other nugget mechs' work as a whole. Owing to her adorable appearance, she was widely celebrated as "Miss Gold" by the workers during the gold rush. Although ONEderland fell into decline for two decades, she continued maintaining the operation of the station and its nearby facilities. Her components and exterior are in various degrees of disrepair due to her excessive length of service and perpetual exposure to morphic field pollution. After undergoing partial maintenance and upgrading, she is now working as a crew member on The Eternal as a COLUMBA employee.
des.自称来自“甲铁城”的神秘少女。在岚心城周边发生的一系列事件中，许多人都已见识到了: A mysterious girl claiming to have come from "Koutetsujou". During the events occurred near Ranshin City, numerous people witnessed her combat ability no weaker to that of an Ascender, but her identity, background, and the truth behind her ability remain a mystery. At present, Mumei is temporarily traveling with the Eternal while searching for a way to return to her train.
des.\\n仿生技工十代，由铁盟科研部门与阿妮塔科技共同开发的多功能仿生机器人，一般被:
Bionic Operator X, developed by B.C.R.L. Research Department and Anita Tech, generally referred to as BOX, assists humans in various technical tasks with many derivative models, though expensive and not widely adopted.
BOX equipped on the train can assist the driver, temporarily taking over in special circumstances using pre-set programs. BOX is equipped with multimedia interfaces to connect to the train's multimedia system, playing various media.
To better communicate with users and alleviate loneliness and fatigue during long journeys, BOX is equipped with an android dialogue system based on a database. BOX responds in real-time, like a human, though some drivers report feeling inexplicably annoyed during conversations with them. The database provider is working on addressing these feedback issues.
— From BOX product introduction

Bionic Operator X, developed by B.C.R.L. Research Department and Anita Tech, generally referred to as BOX, assists humans in various technical tasks with many derivative models, though expensive and not widely adopted.
BOX equipped on the train can assist the driver, temporarily taking over in special circumstances using pre-set programs. BOX is equipped with multimedia interfaces to connect to the train's multimedia system, playing various media.
To better communicate with users and alleviate loneliness and fatigue during long journeys, BOX is equipped with an android dialogue system based on a database. BOX responds in real-time, like a human, though some drivers report feeling inexplicably annoyed during conversations with them. The database provider is working on addressing these feedback issues.
— From BOX product introduction
BOX onboard The Eternal has undergone some custom experimental modifications for more efficient train operation and to handle unexpected situations.
BOX on The Eternal uses a more rational android dialogue database and logic to assist the Conductor.
However, when the Conductor's and Livia's data was entered and analyzed, BOX correctly identified the Conductor but regarded Livia as the highest-ranking person on the train. Even after several people joined the train as permanent crew members, BOX's respectful attitude toward Livia remained unchanged.
des.失败天使个体罗洁尔，于LRA-00事件中被判定转化失败，并在哈依玛之骰内部引发■: Failed Angel entity, Raziel. Determined to be a failed transformation subject during LRA-00 and precipitated a ■-level incident and a series of dangerous events within Haima Zaria. However, with the efforts of CBCRR23 the Eternal's conductor and Source Citadel members who made it in time, LRA-00 was successfully resolved and did not cause any additional casualties. As this entity was once a Source Citadel mentor and is acquainted with CBCRR23 the Eternal's conductor, she has received special approval to stay on the Eternal, provided her mental state remains stable, and to be kept under observation and accept regular treatments.
des.失败天使个体“乌刹娜”，曾有数次失控经历，被判定为极高危险个体；但介于其近年基本: Failed Angel entity, "Ushana." Has been known to lose control multiple times and is hence determined to be a highly dangerous entity. However, as she has remained virtually lucid in recent years, she is specially approved to be deployed as an ordinary Citadel member. During the LRA-00 incident, this entity exhibited extraordinary admiration and devotion toward CBCRR23 The Eternal's conductor, thus leading to a series of consequences, including damage to the restriction system, but the matter did not negatively affect the entity's state of mind. After the incident, the entity passed basic stability tests and received special approval to stay on CBCRR23 The Eternal, on the condition that she put on specific equipment and kept the SOAP system activated at all times.
des.特殊天使个体克洛伊，于转化过程中发生意外，导致哈伊玛之骰失控，因此被中止转化流程: Chloe, a special Angel subject who experienced an unforeseen accident during the transformation process, resulting in the loss of control over Haima Zaria and the subsequent termination of the procedure. In light of the subject's stable and irreplaceable connection to the Unbewusstes, as well as her currently unimpaired sense of ego, the Citadel has determined that she is, in substance, to be recognized as an Angel. At the subject's own request, the Citadel has waived the use of any special Angel designation or codename and has instead appointed her as a Special Vanguard responsible for disaster response operations.
des.经由马吉拉引介而加入黑月锁链的年轻女孩。原本，真咲在年龄上并不满足黑月正式员工的: A young girl who joined Night Chains on Margiela's referral. Masaki originally fell short of the age requirement for full-time staff at Night Chains, but with Goethe's strong recommendation and support, this special girl was granted the title of "part-timer". Today, this lovely and courteous girl can often be seen weaving through the various facilities of the Night Chains Land, offering help to visitors with a warm smile. Everyone's spirits lift at the sight of Masaki's sweet smile — who can deny that this is the most wonderful kind of magic?
des.一位年轻的黑月执行人，装束风格颇具个性。如果忽略她手上看起来分量不轻的武器，这似: A young Night Chains executor with a uniquely styled outfit. If you overlook the seemingly hefty weapon in her hand, she might just appear to be an ordinary girl enthusiastic about fashion. However, as she engages in more battles, it quickly becomes apparent from the extent of destruction in her surrounding environment that she's far from an "ordinary girl." How should one treat her to bring her peace?
des.从帝国远道而来的神秘萃境联盟成员。自从她来到无垠号的第一天起，关于她身份的各种好: A mysterious member of the Verdant Realm Alliance who's come a long way from the Empire. From her first day aboard the Eternal, the curiosity and quiet inquiries about who she is have never let up. Her appearance marks her plainly as a citizen of the Empire— a Reverberater, even— and her combat ability is beyond belief, yet almost no one else from the Empire knows anything of her past. Every piece of information about her is classified at the Eternal's highest security level, and those cleared to read it can be counted on one hand... and you are the only one here who has witnessed her true form.
des.声名在外的形而上粒子研究者，阿妮塔能源公司第二部门“园丁”的重要成员，同时也是一: A renowned researcher of Metaphysical Particles, a key member of Anita Tech's Second Division — the "Gardeners" — and a mentor besides. No small number of the younger generation among the Gardeners have benefited from his guidance and support, and the students he has trained himself have steadily become mainstays of one research project after another. Contrary to what his youthful, handsome appearance suggests, he has in fact already reached middle age. He joined Anita years ago, back when the Western Railway Loop had yet to be built, and it was that very opportunity that placed him at the Freeport VII accident and changed the course of his life. What is it, in the end, that has kept him going all this way? And what is it that he truly seeks?
des.自称是赛瑟尼克军统帅、教廷第七任枢纽的神秘女孩。经CBCRR23号列车长以及车长: A mysterious girl claims to be the commander of the Saisannik army and the seventh cardinal of the Holy See. After being guaranteed and certified by the conductor of CBCRR Train No. 23 and the conductor's assistant, she is temporarily identified as a special individual from another world. She was initially discovered in the vicinity of the village of Yinlin (tentative name) and was experiencing severe rejection of her morphic field, even exhibiting physical dissociation phenomena. After a series of events, this individual's morphic field has now stabilized; currently, with the individual's voluntary consent, she is temporarily registered as a guard crew member of The Eternal.
des.身材高大的狼亚人，性格直爽外向。即使在士兵素质普遍出众的铁安局之中，莱卡吉亚也算: A tall wolf demi-human with an outgoing and straightforward personality. Even among the BCRL Agency, where soldiers are generally of outstanding quality, Lycagia stands out for his exceptional physical fitness and combat abilities. By fully leveraging the superior physical qualities of a demi-human, he has achieved remarkable results in both team-led and solo combat operations. Additionally, through years of work at the BCRL Agency, he has gained extensive experience dealing with various forces. When encountering problems that are difficult to solve independently, one can confidently seek his assistance.
des.奥莉薇恩，与无垠号签订了特殊雇佣合同的护卫乘员。在此之前，她是火烈鸟宠物店的代理: Olivien, a guard crew member who signed a special employment contract with the Eternal. Before this, she was the acting manager of Flamingo Pet Shop and also managed a maid café; looking further back, her resume and experiences are simply glossed over as "several employment experiences." What exactly fills this suspicious gap? — To ask this question, one must first contend with black tea at the perfect temperature, freshly baked pastries, and a comfortably arranged sofa...
des.来自曼杜斯帝国的神秘魔法师，自称目前正在旅行的途中；她同时也是一位资产颇丰、财力: A mysterious magician from the Mundus Empire, who claims to be currently on a journey; she is also a mature business investor with substantial assets and owns a gemstone shop, along with numerous other ventures not accounted for. During interactions with a mysterious race residing in Yinyan Village (tentative name), she provided consultation and assistance to the crew of The Eternal and a certain mysterious outlander. After experiencing a series of subsequent events with the Conductor of The Eternal, Miss Helena chose to register as a crew member of The Eternal.
des.■■■■，前阿妮塔第二部门成员（后借调至第五部门），在遭遇了一连串事故后个体形态: ■■■■, a former member of Anita's second department (later seconded to the fifth department), experienced significant changes in the individual Morphic Field following a series of incidents. Currently, according to their (or the individual's) wishes, this individual will henceforth be referred to by the code name "Doramis." Special attention is required, as this individual has developed a new self-awareness and cognition; therefore, it is necessary to respect the individual's judgments, decisions, and actions, and not to interact with them using past social methods.
des.切茜娅，索思学会的年轻学者，同样也是曾作为学者、如今作为失败天使个体之一的罗洁尔: Chelsea, a young scholar of the Source Citadel, is also a student of Raziel, who was once a scholar and is now one of the fallen angel individuals. In the past, she accepted a transfer to the Apoaster Bridge under Raziel's support and encouragement, but since then, she has been despondent. Upon learning that Raziel personally became a participant in the Angel Plan and failed in the transformation, Chelsea even fell into a breakdown for a time—these events and their outcomes compounded and influenced each other, ultimately becoming the inducement for her drastic change in personality and committing mistakes that require Judgment.

getCharacter.吾即咒魔剑姬卡塔斯！被深渊侵蚀带来万世终焉的使者！......好，发挥不错！: I am Jumakenki Katas!! Harbinger of eternal doom brought by the abyssal corruption! ...Good, that was good.
getCharacter.朱利安。善攻不善守。进攻就交给我吧。: Julian. Good at attacking, not defending. Leave the attack to me.
getCharacter.……遥，我的名字。维修有我，你只管做好你的事就行。: ...Haruka, that's my name. Maintenance is my job, and you just focus on yours.
getCharacter.吾名阿尔喀娜。一个随处可见的旅行者而已。: My name is Arcana. Just a traveler you find anywhere.
getCharacter.我是约书亚。作为学会的天使，我可以给你讲授凡人无法理解的深奥学识。“老师~这是什: I'm Joshua. As an Angel of the Citadel, I can teach you profound knowledge that ordinary people can't understand. Please refrain from asking, "Teacher, what does this mean~" or other similarly silly questions.
getCharacter.我是妮蔻拉。别害怕，这些装备都已经被我调整到了非杀伤模式。: I'm Nicola. Fear not, these weapons are in non-lethal mode.
getCharacter.哟，我是隼。不欢迎一下我吗？: Hey, I'm Hayabusa. No welcome for me?
getCharacter.我是索思学会的达斯廷，向世人揭示希望即是我的使命。今后请多多关照，列车长。: I'm Dustin of Source Citadel. Revealing hope to the world is my mission. I look forward to working with you, Conductor.
getCharacter.你好，我叫瓦伦汀，在学会中担任“司书”一职。: Hello, I'm Valentine. I serve as a Scribe at the Citadel.
getCharacter.又见面了，列车长，我是侍应生亚莉奈呀。: We meet again, Conductor. I'm Arina, the bartender.
getCharacter.我是奈弥，受命来此协助你的工作。请下令吧。: I'm Nabi, tasked to assist you with your work. Orders, please.
getCharacter.你好，列车长，我是来自阿妮塔的伊尔，请给我一间单独的工作间，并且工作时间内请叮嘱: Hello, Conductor. I'm Yer from Anita. I'd like a workroom to myself, and during working hours, please remind the other crew not to wander in.
getCharacter.我叫马吉拉。本职是cosplay服装店的店长，请多关照啦。: I'm Margiela, manager of a cosplay costume shop. Nice to meet you.
getCharacter.原来我们已经一起经历过那么多了，但是路还很长……出发吧，我就在你身边，列车长。: We've already been through so much together, but the road ahead is still long... Let's go. I'll be by your side, Conductor.
getCharacter.原曼杜斯帝国士兵，柯娜。现在因为一些缘故在当保镖，请多指教。: Former Mundus Empire's soldier, Connor. Working as a bodyguard now for some reason. Pleased to meet you.
getCharacter.我是塔拉，这是库克。: I'm Tara, and this is Cook.
getCharacter.我叫狮鬃，由于一些原因，现在只能借我妹妹的身体活动。多指教啊！: I'm Solum. Due to some reasons, I can only move through my sister's body now. Nice to meet you!
getCharacter.我是魇。我会把坏人统统打跑哦。: I'm Maruha. I'll chase away all the bad guys.
getCharacter.我是气味学研究员，塞西尔。……你的味道，我不讨厌。请多指教。: I'm Cecil, a Scent Researcher... I don't dislike your scent. Nice to meet you.
getCharacter.我叫雷火。工作之外，我喜欢一个人待着。千万别跟我搭话！: I'm Reika. I prefer to be alone off-work. Don't ever talk to me!
getCharacter.我是黛丝莉哦！梦想是“无论去哪里都能够以笑容可爱的单纯女孩子姿态融入其中”！请多: I'm Desiree! My dream is to be a pure and lovely girl who can smile wherever I go! Nice to meet you!
getCharacter.你好，我是夏洛蒂，现在在地表经营“骑士万事屋”。请多指教。: Hello, I'm Charlotte, currently managing the "Knight's Hall" on the surface. Nice to meet you.
getCharacter.我是苍叶。我只会听从宵月的指示行动。: I am Aoba. I only follow Yoizuki's orders.
getCharacter.我是那由他，作为索思学会的一员，将为您带来希望与光……嗯，这种事情我其实是做不到: I'm Nayuta. As a member of the Source Citadel, I'm here to bring you hope and light... hm, that's not really something I can actually do. In any case, I look forward to working with you.
getCharacter.我是……索玛……我，我会……努力的……: I'm... Sommer... I'll... try my best...
getCharacter.呀吼~~！我是多萝西！今后就麻烦你啦！: Yahoo~~! I'm Dorothy! I'll be counting on you from now on!
getCharacter.您好，我是来自阿妮塔的卡莱雅，要是有什么需要我帮忙的，请不要客气直接开口吧。: Hello, I'm Kaleya from Anita. If there's anything I can help you with, feel free to ask.
getCharacter.霖，这是我的名字……唔，这样就够了吧……: Lin. That's my name... Um, that's about it...
getCharacter.我是伽罗尔，如果有看到“火烈鸟”的话，请一定要告诉我……不，不是我头发颜色的那种: I'm Galore. If you see "flamingo", you must let me know... No, not the kind with the color of my hair...
getCharacter.铁盟所属狐獴小队队长，甘雅。我没准备什么见面礼，你也不需要搞什么欢迎仪式，让我们: Captain of B.C.R.L Team Meerkat, Ganya. I haven't prepared any gifts, so don't plan some welcome ceremony. Let's just get down to work.
getCharacter.哼哼哼！咱是山岚，忍界未来的女王就是咱，敬请见证吧！哈哈哈！: Hohoho! I am Yamaarashi, the future queen of the ninja world. Bear witness! Hahaha!
getCharacter.噔噔噔~阿妮塔的人气大帅哥——晃，闪耀登场！: Ta-daaa~ Anita's most popular heartthrob, Akira, making his dazzling entrance!
getCharacter.我是艾略特，该干的活我会干的。: I am Eliot, I will do the work that needs to be done.
getCharacter.你好啊列车长，我是阿妮塔的探路者卡洛琳。这段时间就麻烦你多多关照啦！: Hello, Conductor, I'm Caroline, Anita's Pathfinder. Nice to meet you!
getCharacter.我是丽桑德拉。光辉也好，黝黯也罢，只要您的信念坚定，我终将会抵达您的身畔。: I am Lissandra. Be it light or darkness, as long as your belief is firm, I shall eventually reach your side.
getCharacter.我是黑月的宵月。往后还请您多多指教。: I am Yoizuki of Night Chains. I look forward to working with you in the future.
getCharacter.我是静流，请多指教......不会吧，我可没想到会在这种地方再见到你。: I'm Shizuru. Nice to meet you... No way, I didn't expect to meet you again at such a place.
