getCharacter.您好，我是加丽娜。此前我和妹妹蒙您照顾了。……那么，应该说……好久不见。: Hello, I am Galina. My sister and I were under your care before, so... it's been a while.
getCharacter.仿生技工十代启动。请从设定中选择仿生对话系统的声纹。: Bionic Operator X activated. Please select the voice profile for the android dialogue system from the settings.
getCharacter.我是弗兰，请多指教，列车长.......顺带一提，您知道艾略特在哪里吗？: I'm Fran, pleased to meet you, Conductor. By the way, where's Eliot?
getCharacter.贵安，列车长大人。在下名为卡莲，请多关照。: Good day to you, Your Conductor-ship. I'm Karen. Nice to meet you.
getCharacter.你好呀列车长，我是铁盟的研究员，负责研发……啊对了，名字！我叫瑞秋，请多指教~: Hello, Conductor. I am a researcher from BCRL, responsible for development... Oh, right, my name! I'm Rachel, pleased to meet you~
getCharacter.啊！那个很吓人的列车长？！你怎么在这里？！……哦，我知道了！你正打算转行，要来当: Ah! That terrifying Conductor! Why are you here?! ...Oh, I got it! You're submitting to the mighty Lord Shire, right?
getCharacter.我是海因里希，修格里的铁安局负责人，于无垠号上临时驻留。就我们之间的信赖关系而言: I am Heinrich, administrator of Shoggolith's BCRL Agency. Temporarily staying on the Eternal. I'm sure you need no further introduction, considering the mutual trust we have.
getCharacter.我是苔妮，今后的工作就请多多指教了——列车武装能不能打折？笨蛋，那个不是我能决定: I'm Tennie. I look forward to working with you from now on. ...Can you get a discount for train armament? That's not for me to decide!
getCharacter.人家是学会美少女苏恩！迷恋我也好崇拜我也好都OK啦！但是！跟踪什么的可不行哦！: I am the Citadel's pretty girl Suen! It's fine whether you're infatuated with me or admire me! But stalking is not okay!
getCharacter.我是“恶魔捕手”，看见无垠号有一个预约订单……您说列车上没有需要抓的恶魔？那么就: I'm a "Devil Hunter." I saw an order from the Eternal... There aren't any devils on the train that need catching? Then just think of me as an ordinary passenger.
getCharacter.你就是列车长？看起来不太靠谱的样子呢……算了。我叫星花，请多指教喽。: You're the Conductor? You don't look very reliable... Oh well. My name is Stella. Pleased to meet you.
getCharacter.我是菲妮娅！为了世界和平冲冲冲！: I'm Fenia! Charging in for world peace!
getCharacter.我是来自阿妮塔全球能源公司的派遣员工叶珏。你就是列车长、对吧？多指教啊！: I'm Yejue, dispatched by Anita Global Energy. Conductor, right? Nice to meet you!
getCharacter.我是安菲娅，正在游学中……箱子？箱子里是安菲娅的朋友，所以别在意。: I'm Anfiya, and am currently on a study tour... The box? It's my friend in it. Please don't mind.
getCharacter.你好啊，我是阿知波，一个休学中的问题儿童。请多指教。: Oh hello, Conductor, I'm Achiwa, a dropout with issues. Nice to meet you.
getCharacter.闻笙，奉鹭先生之命与你同行。唔，你的气味……不，别在意。: Wensheng, accompanying you at the behest of Mr. Sagi. Hmm. Your scent... No, don't mind me.
getCharacter.我是学会的冯里奈。被派遣至此协助工作……那个，听说这边可以按时下班，是真的吗……: I'm Rina Von from the Citadel. Dispatched here to help... Um, is it true that you clock out on time here...?
getCharacter.先说好，我干活的时候别来打扰我，懂了吗？: Let's be clear. Do not disturb me when I'm working, got it?
getCharacter.在下幻羽流诗羽，代号“跳鼠”，请多指教啦！: I'm Shiu, code name "Tobinezumi", from Genuryu. Nice to meet you!
getCharacter.我叫米莉！只要负责把接近你的人统统打跑就行了，是吧？！: My name is Millie! I just need to be responsible for driving away anyone who approaches you, right?!
getCharacter.咱是梦玄流忍术的继承者——织姬，又名山岚。跳鼠的宿敌，就是咱山岚大人！哦吼吼！: I am the inheritor of Mugenryu Ninjutsu, Shiki, aka Yamaarashi. The archenemy of Tobinezumi is me, Lord Yamaarashi! Ohohoho!
getCharacter.我看起来不太一样了吗？但无论如何我都还是静流……总之，即使是这副样子也请多指教了: I don't look the same anymore? But I'm always going to be Shizuru regardless... Anyhow, I'm pleased to see you, even while in this state.
getCharacter.我是雅莱，是学会的……嗯，收容对象。赫尔的……妹妹……: I'm Jalhay, a... a subject of the Citadel. <color=#8e8e8e>Harle's sister...</color>
getCharacter.我是伊索斯，你车上有很多值得采集的样本。不可以？无所谓，我总会争取到你的同意。: I'm Ithos. You have a lot of specimens on your train worth collecting. Not allowed? It's all right. I'll earn your approval eventually.
getCharacter.我是生驹。……什么？还要其他介绍？那就不用了吧……！我会努力工作，也会努力战斗的: My name is Ikoma. ...What? Share more about me? I'd rather not...! I will work hard and fight to the best of my ability. After all, I still have dreams to fulfill!
getCharacter.车长亲车长亲！嗯~？我没有在cosplay啦，这就是魔女马吉拉真正的样子！: Dear Dear Conductor! Hmm~? I'm not cosplaying, this is the true form of Margiela the Witch!
getCharacter.列车长，我是小麦——不不不，今天我不是来开拖车的！咳咳！——从今天开始，我是无垠: Conductor, it's me, Komugi—no wait, I'm not here to drive the towing car today! Ahem! Starting today, I'm officially crew on the Eternal! Nice to meet you!
getCharacter.我是罗洁尔。虽然不确定我在无垠号上究竟能帮上什么忙……但我希望至少能稍稍为你减轻: I am Raziel. Though I'm not sure what exactly I can do on the Eternal... I hope I can at least lessen the burden on your shoulders a little.
getCharacter.帕拉笛报道！从今天开始，我就是无垠号的乘员——咦？整顿中心？没关系没关系，监视机: Paladi reporting for duty! I will be part of the Eternal crew from now on... Huh? Reforming Center? No worries, my surveillance robots will keep everything in check!
getCharacter.我是佩罗塔！但是你愿意的话，也可以叫我球球。我很厉害的，一定能派上用场！……对了: I'm Pelota, but you can call me Ballie if you'd like to! I'm pretty awesome and definitely useful!... Oh, by the way, are all the electronic devices on your train insured?
getCharacter.我是金子。什么？你认识我？可是我们，这是，第一次见面。……开玩笑哒！没错，我，学: I am Gold. What? Know me? But this, first meet. ...Just joking! Yes. I learn, jokes, Conductor. Happy, be your friend.
getCharacter.我是无名，暂且在这里担任保镖——啊，酬金就不用了，你给我提供充足的食物还有睡觉的: I'm Mumei, temporarily serving as a bodyguard here. Ah, payment won't be necessary. Just provide me with adequate food and a place to sleep.
getCharacter.你好，我是薇尔岚，目前正在旅行的途中，这趟算是搭个便车！……说起来，我的朋友在这: Hi, I'm Verlaine, I'm actually traveling right now, this is just a bit of hitchhiking along the way! ...Speaking of which, is my friend around here somewhere?
getCharacter.正在进行对象识别……无垠号列车长，评级为：普通，正在切换行动模式。: Initiating object recognition... The Conductor of The Eternal, rated as: Ordinary, currently switching action modes.
getCharacter.我是罗洁尔，他们是这样告诉我的。好像之前给你添过麻烦，虽然我已经记不清了……: I'm Raziel. That's what they told me. It seems I have caused you trouble before, though I no longer remember it...
getCharacter.属于我和救世主大人的冒险故事，要开始啦！: The adventure story of me and my Master Savior is about to begin!
getCharacter.克洛伊，学会的天使，这是我的档案，拿去自己看。: I'm Chloe, Angel of the Citadel. Here's my file. Read it yourself.
getCharacter.您好。之前还没有自我介绍过，我的名字是神代真咲。“魔女”？也一同在这里哦。但是，: Hello. I haven't properly introduced myself yet. My name is Kamishiro Masaki. The "Witch"? She's here with me too. But I'd prefer you call me by my current name. Mm... just call me Masaki.
getCharacter.你好，我是涟。……麻烦把我安排到人最少的区域。: Hello, I'm Ren. ...Please assign me to the area with the least people.
getCharacter.伊卡菈，作为翠境联盟的代表，以及将来的实习列车长前来。……旅行的时候有人告诉我，: Ikara, here as the representative of the Verdant Realm Alliance and a future conductor in training. ...Someone told me that at school you call those who graduated before you "senior"... Am I to call you that as well?
getCharacter.我是来自阿妮塔的伊利亚德，任何能力范围内的问题，我都很乐意为你答疑解惑。: I am Eliade, of Anita. Any question within my competence, I'll gladly answer.
getCharacter.我就是在人间行走的机械神！拜倒在我的力量之下吧！: I am the mechanical god walking among humans! Bow down to my power!
getCharacter.莱卡吉亚报道！从今天开始，我就是无垠号的一员了。至于理由……哈哈，以后再和你说明: Lycagia reporting in! Starting today, I'm officially one of the Eternal crew. As for the reason... Heh, I'll tell you another day. Looking forward to the work here, Conductor!
getCharacter.我是奥莉薇恩，从现在开始会在无垠号上工作。我应该怎么称呼您呢——“主家”？: I am Olivien, and I will be working on the Eternal from now on. How should I address you — "master"?
getCharacter.贵安，我是海伦娜，一位来自曼杜斯帝国的宝石魔法师——这是推荐信，这是见面礼，请收: Greetings, I am Helena, a gem mage from the Mundus Empire—here is a letter of recommendation and a meeting gift, please accept them without hesitation.
getCharacter.啊，又见面了……好高兴。: Ah, we meet again... I'm so happy.
getCharacter.是的，我终于获得了和无垠号乘组并肩作战的许可。……接下来的旅途中，如果有什么需要: Yes, I finally gained permission to fight alongside the crew of The Eternal. ... On the journey ahead, if there is anything that needs to be done, please don't hesitate to give me orders directly.

identity.黑月锁链·黑月匠造负责人: Night Chains - Night Chains Lesage Overseer

letter.于永劫烈火中诞生的深渊之飨宴，就赐予你吧，黑铁之主——: Born from the eternal flames, the Feast of the Abyss is bestowed upon you, Lord of Black Iron —
letter.不管有多忙也要好好吃东西，顺手做的，记得趁热。: No matter how busy you are, you need to eat well. I whipped this up. Eat it while it's still hot.
letter.修整完列车以后就适合吃这个……要不要一起吃？: After repairing the train, this is the perfect meal... Wanna join?
letter.尝试着复刻了帝国的传统甜点，是孩子会喜欢的口味呢。: Attempted recreation of a traditional Empire dessert, a flavor kids would like.
letter.在烤的中途不小心睡着了，但是好像没烤坏，就别挑剔了。: Dozed off while baking. But it doesn't seem burnt, so don't be picky.
letter.咖喱块随便买的，但我加了大量土豆，绝对不会难吃。: I just bought some random curry cubes, but don't worry, I added loads of potatoes, so it'll taste awesome.
letter.爱吃甜的不是什么丢脸的事。哦，里面没有惊喜，尽管放心。: There's no shame in being a sweet tooth. Oh, no surprise inside. Don't worry.
letter.这是那两个孩子都很喜欢的餐点。趁此机会，休息片刻吧。: Those two children love this. Take this opportunity to rest for a while.
letter.我很中意这款点心，可以在看书的时候慢悠悠品尝。: I love this snack. It can be slowly savored while reading.
letter.其中满满都是我的心意哦~请列车长务必全部都吃掉~: These are filled with my deepest feelings~ You must finish them, Conductor~
letter.这是迅速补充能量的方法之一，味道也下了一些功夫。吃吧。: This is one way to replenish energy rapidly, and I put some effort in the taste too. Eat up.
letter.食谱上的烹饪方法和我以往学的不太一样，这是两者结合的成果。: The method in this recipe wasn't quite the same as what I'd learned before. This is the result of combining the two.
letter.魔女制品，食用不当可能会使身体产生形变~开玩笑的！: Made by a witch, improper consumption may cause deformities~ Just kidding!
letter.工作辛苦了，列车长。接下来的旅途也请打起精神哦。: You've worked hard, Conductor. Please stay lively for the journey ahead.
letter.地上的食物真不错啊，你也尝尝这个？: The food on the surface is really good. Want to try this?
letter.库克也帮了一些忙，不过主要还是塔拉的功劳哦！: Cook has also helped a bit, but most of the credit goes to Tara!
letter.在老妹指导下做的，有家的味道。: Made under my sister's guidance. Reminds you of home.
letter.吃完这份特别套餐以后就和我一起去打击邪恶吧~: After finishing this special meal, let's fight evil together~
letter.口味过重的食物也会损害嗅觉，所以我偏好这种清淡的食物。: Overpowering flavors can damage the sense of smell, so I prefer this kind of bland food.
letter.有得吃就足够了，别对外形挑三拣四。吃！: It's a blessing to even have food. Don't be picky about how it looks. Eat up!
letter.请用！这是给列车长的礼物！一定好吃！: Here! A gift for you, Conductor! Definitely delicious!
letter.这份点心的卖相不及蒂斯塔尔做的，但应该足够充饥。请尝尝看。: This dessert might not look as yummy as the ones Tistar made, but it should still fill the stomach. Try it.
letter.厨艺也不是我擅长的领域……希望至少能入口……: Cooking isn't my thing... Hope this is at least edible...
letter.……索玛和先生很喜欢，也给你一份。: ...Sommer and Mr. Dustin liked it. Here's some for you.
letter.努力……做了……希望你收下……: I tried... my best... Hope you'll accept it...
letter.感受肉汁在嘴里爆炸的感觉吧！注：不是说真的会爆炸的意思。: Feel the burst of juicy meat in your mouth! Note: it doesn't actually burst.
letter.不能一直在您身边照顾您真是太遗憾了，请务必享用这个……！: It's such a pity I can't always be there to take care of you, so please enjoy this...!
letter.外观是精心设计过的，制作过程拍进了视频里。看起来非常可爱对吧？: This awesome creation is featured in a video that showcases how it was made. Looks super cute, right?
letter.煮的时候差点把宠物吸引过来偷吃……但没让它们吃到，放心。: When I was cooking, the pets were attracted and almost ate sum... Don't worry. I didn't let them eat it.
letter.爷爷从前总和我说，人是铁饭是钢。记得按时吃饭。: My grandpa always used to say, make sure to eat on time, because if you don't, your stomach will give you a hard time.
letter.从卖相到口味都无懈可击，收下吧！天才帅哥就算做菜也那么完美无缺！: Looks flawless, tastes flawless. Go on, take it! A handsome genius makes it look easy in the kitchen too!
letter.在咖喱里加入了新鲜出炉的鸡肉，味道很不错哦~: Added freshly baked chicken to the curry. It tastes really good~
letter.加热的时候不小心烧焦了一点，但应该还能吃！: I accidentally burnt it a bit while heating it up, but it should still be edible!
letter.无需在意味蕾一时的感受，确保你的身体获得了所需所求。: Pay no mind to the passing whims of your taste buds. Make sure your body gets the nutrition it needs: that's what truly counts.
letter.选择了与“落雁”味道相近的甜点，不知列车长是否喜欢？: I chose a dessert that tastes like "Rakugan". I wonder if you'll like it, Conductor?
letter.车厢里只有这些材料了，不想出门，将就着做了。: These are the only materials left in the carriage. I didn't want to go out, so I made do with them.
letter.和从前做的口味一样，希望你还喜欢。: Tastes the same as before. I hope you still like it.
letter.持剑机械臂灵活度不足，导致加热状况不佳。下次一定改进。: Sword-wielding arm lacks flexibility, resulting in poor heating conditions. Make sure to fix that up next time.
letter.吃了这个应该就能恢复力气了。尽管吃吧，别客气。: Eating this should restore your strength. Eat up, don't be a stranger.
letter.新学的，以后想做给静流吃，这个是实验品~要告诉人家感想哦！: Just learned this new recipe. I want to make it for Shizuru next time. This is a test~ So remember to give feedback!
letter.果酱采用了我最新试验出的超美味（无毒性）配方~: The jam uses my latest super delicious (non-toxic) formula~
letter.不知道为什么它就变成这样了！……是朱迪干的！: I'm not sure how it ended up like this!... It must be Jude's doing for sure!
letter.是简单的家常做法，能填饱肚子。趁热吃。: A simple, homemade dish that provides nourishment. Enjoy it while it is still hot.
letter.哎呀做饭太麻烦了！弄熟就差不多行了吧！: Ahhh, who needs all that fuss with cooking! Just heat it up, and we're good to go, right?
letter.不是特意给你做的，可别误会了！: I didn't make this specifically for you. Don't get the wrong idea!
letter.这种食物还挺神奇的，虽然有菜，但肉比较主要。好吃。: Such food is rather amazing. Although it comes with vegetables, meat is the main ingredient. Delicious.
letter.按照最优秀配比做的蛋糕！尝了以后要记得给我改进意见哦？: Made with the best ratio! Remember to give me feedback to improve after you've tried it, okay?
letter.据说这是成熟女性会擅长的甜点！请试试看，列车长！: It's said this is a dessert mature ladies excel at! Please try it, Conductor!
letter.这可是得到许多同事好评的美味加班餐哦，吃吧！下次还给你做。: This is a delicious overtime meal that many colleagues gave high praises. Eat up! I'll make it for you again.
letter.我不太擅长，但是营养配比应该没问题……: I may not be a skilled cook, but the nutritional balance should be alright...
letter.去买薯条的时候顺路买了这个，我自己吃不完，分给你了。: I bought this while getting fries. I can't finish it myself, so here's some for you.
letter.累的时候来吃点暖和好入口的东西吧……: When you're tired, have something warm and easy to digest...
letter.因加班到深夜而饱受创伤的心灵需要美食治愈！: A heart traumatized by working late at night needs good food to heal!
letter.对速食甜点进行了加热，能满足三天的热量需求。: Heated instant dessert, provides enough calories to sustain for three days.
letter.忍者的食物必须便携易食用，不过在那之外……请用，列车长。: Food for Ninjas must be very portable and easy to consume. Beyond that... Here you go, Conductor.
letter.把我最喜欢的肉饼煎熟了夹进去的！吃肉才有力气嘛！: I cooked my favorite meat patties and stuffed them in! You need meat for strength!
letter.无垠号上的厨具也太不好用了，根本没法做得好吃嘛！: The kitchenware on The Eternal is so hard to use. I can't make anything tasty!
letter.我试着在调味上做了些变动，偶尔试一下新的风格也不错吧？: I've tweaked the flavors a bit. It's good to try something new every now and then, right?
letter.我努力按照食谱上说的去做了……大家一起吃会更好吃吧？: I did my best sticking to the recipe... Food always tastes better when shared, right?
letter.有没有感觉比以前更好吃了？制作过程注入了奇妙的魔法哦！: Does it taste better than before? I used some wonderous magic in the process!
letter.这是我家店里的做法，希望列车长喜欢吃！下次也可以去我家尝尝呀！: This is how we make it at my family's restaurant, hope you like it, Conductor! You should come try it at our place sometime too!
letter.稍微加了一点辣的咖喱哦，适合作为简餐。下次要一起去吃炸鸡吗？: I added some spicy curry. It's great for a simple meal. How about we have some fried chicken next time?
letter.监视机器人帮忙烤的冷冻品，但应该好吃，尝尝！: Frozen food grilled by surveillance robots. Should be delicious! Give it a shot!
letter.妈妈从前教过我做饭~下次，列车长也教我怎么做好吃的吧！: My mom taught me how to cook before~ When you're free, show me your cooking skills too, Conductor!
letter.过去的淘金者们最喜欢的餐后点心。甜的！金子做的。: Gold diggers used to love this dessert most. It's sweet! Gold made it!
letter.我和星期一一起做的地上食物，感觉会很好吃！: I made this surface food with Monday. It's going to be great!
letter.试着做了……不好吃的话要告诉我……: I've tried... Let me know if it doesn't taste right...
letter.乌刹娜发现了这个很香的蛋糕，就拿过来给救世主大人了！: I found this super yummy cake! I brought it for you, Master Savior!
letter.能吃饱就行，别要求那么多，糊糊不也挺好的么。: Long as it fills ya up, don't be so picky, mush's just fine too.
letter.我借鉴了一些“过去的经验”，尤其是肉排的味道很有自信。: I drew on some "past experience," and I'm especially proud of how the steak turned out.
letter.按教程做的……希望你可以尝尝。不喜欢的话不要勉强……: I made it by the tutorial... Have a taste, but don't push yourself if you don't like it...
letter.汉堡里的肉饼可是我亲自煎熟的，前辈要好好品尝哦？: I cooked the patty in that burger myself, senior. So do savor it properly, won't you?
letter.我没有用油炸的方式处理肉饼，控制了一下它的热量，放心吃。: I didn't deep-fry the patty, and I've kept the calories in check. So eat up — there's no need to worry.
letter.不用机械神的赐福的话，也就只能做出这么简单的料理了，你可要心怀感激地吃完哦。: Without the blessing of the Deus Ex Machina, I can only make such simple dishes. You should be grateful and finish it all.
letter.适合出勤的时候带在背包里当午饭，很香！: Suitable to carry in your backpack for lunch when attending work, very delicious!
letter.主家，工作辛苦了。准备了一些简单的餐食，如需其他请随时吩咐。: Master, you've worked hard. I've prepared some simple meals; please feel free to instruct if you need anything else.
letter.用魔法做出的甜品，要尝尝吗？加入了一点能带来好心情的成分。: Desserts made with magic, would you like to try some? A little ingredient that brings good vibes has been added.
letter.食物的定义是什么？这样算吗？: What is the definition of food? Does this count?
letter.按照您吃惯的方法做了汤面。下次我会试着做番茄口味……: I made noodle soup the way you're used to. Next time, I will try making a tomato flavor...

safeInformation.全副武装的劫掠者，火焰喷枪的特殊之处在于能够锁定被眩晕的敌人集中喷射火焰。: A heavily armed looter, with a flamethrower capable of locking onto stunned enemies to unleash a concentrated stream of flames.
safeInformation.比较常见的黑月成员，会灵活地投掷手里剑，也会隐身后突然发起攻击。: A common member of Night Chains, adept at throwing shurikens with agility and launching sudden attacks from stealth.
safeInformation.能使形态污染逐步扩散的桦树生物，对受影响的敌人威胁较大。: A Chaos Remain capable of gradually spreading morphic field pollution, posing a significant threat to affected enemies.
safeInformation.拥有复数核心的桦树生物，能抑制升构者升构能力的发挥。: A Chaos Remain with multiple cores that can suppress the abilities of Ascenders.
safeInformation.能够减少我方费用的桦树生物，技能会造成范围伤害。: A Chaos Remain capable of reducing your cost, with skills causing area damage.
safeInformation.较强的桦树生物，能够抑制升构者的升构能力发挥。: A powerful Chaos Remain capable of suppressing the abilities of Ascenders.
safeInformation.经过一定进化的桦树生物，能召唤其他小型桦树生物协同作战。: An evolved Chaos Remain that can summon other smaller Chaos Remains to fight alongside them.
safeInformation.阿妮塔能源公司下属能源研究所代理所长，她引以为傲的发明足以让她将大部分桦树生物都: The acting director of the Energy Research Institute under Anita Energy Tech. She's proud of her inventions, which are sufficient to make her look down on most Chaos Remains.
safeInformation.颇具资历的冒险者、旅者，小心她手上那把有年头的拐杖。: A seasoned adventurer and traveler. Beware of her old staff.
safeInformation.打算在结束战斗以后和库克一起去买点儿好吃的改善伙食。: Plans to buy some good food with Cook after the battle ends.
safeInformation.带着仙人掌的拾荒者，武器是钢管。能通过蓄力提升攻击威力和效果。: A marauder carrying a cactus and wielding a steel pipe. He can charge up to enhance his ATK and effects.
safeInformation.带着仙人掌的拾荒者，武器是榴弹发射器，弹药品质不齐，因此爆炸效果也时好时坏。: A marauder carrying a cactus and wielding a grenade launcher with inconsistent ammunition quality, which results in unpredictable explosion effects.
safeInformation.带着仙人掌的拾荒者，武器是燧发手枪，有时会投掷燃烧瓶作为武器。: A marauder carrying a cactus and wielding a flintlock pistol. Sometimes he throws Molotov cocktails as weapons.
safeInformation.带着仙人掌的拾荒者，身躯壮硕、动作迅猛，以火焰喷枪作为主要武器。: A marauder carrying a cactus, featuring a towering stature and swift movements, wielding a deadly flamethrower.
safeInformation.荒原王汤姆的座驾。使用充能装甲枪械对目标进行射击并击晕，还能在造成我方角色破盾后: Tom the Wilderness King's vehicle. Uses the recharge armored firearms to shoot and stun the target, and after breaking your character's shield, uses a drill attack to inflict an injure effect.
safeInformation.来自阿妮塔能源公司的探路者，手执长旗帜为人们开辟道路。当对手时肯定不好对付。: An explorer from Anita Energy Tech, wielding a long flag to pave the way for people. She is not easy to deal with when confronted.
safeInformation.持有两把手斧的暴徒，会来回斩击。: A mob wielding two hand axes, swing back and forth.
safeInformation.莫名吸引目光的黑月成员。交手时务必小心她的剑法，以防不慎魂飞魄散。: A Night Chains member who attracts attention for unknown reasons. Be careful of her swordsmanship during combat to avoid a fatal blow.
safeInformation.如同背负着结晶的巨大爬虫一般，相比一般桦树生物攻击手段比较单一，但是自爆的时候会: Resembling a giant reptile carrying crystals on its back, it has relatively simple attack methods compared to other Chaos Remains but releases dangerous energy when self-destructing.
safeInformation.常见的浮游型桦树生物，实力较弱。: A common floating-type Chaos Remain, relatively weak in strength.
safeInformation.繁衍和统领着毒爆虫们的女王，不仅破坏力和攻击范围远超一般个体，还能召唤大量子嗣进: The queen who breeds and commands the Blastbugs, not only has destructive power and an attack range far exceeding ordinary individuals, but can also summon a large number of offspring for self-destruct attacks.
safeInformation.外形类似昆虫的桦树生物，具有隐身能力，巨镰般的肢干外甲能够迅速瓦解目标防御。: A Chaos Remain with an insect-like appearance, able to become invisible. Its scythe-like limbs can swiftly dismantle target defenses.
safeInformation.经过鼹鼠帮改造的动力甲，通过引雷方式进行攻击。: A power mecha modified by the MoleGang, employing Electrify attacks as its primary offensive tactic.
safeInformation.经过鼹鼠帮改造的动力甲，多使用物理手段攻击。: A power mecha modified by the MoleGang, employing physical attacks as its primary offensive tactic.
safeInformation.经过鼹鼠帮改造的动力甲，多使用手持型火炮进行攻击。: A power mecha modified by the MoleGang, employing a handheld cannon as its primary offensive tactic.
safeInformation.“狂飙焚尽”，鼹鼠帮的老大。通过投掷燃烧瓶进行攻击，会使唤喽啰摆放地雷路障，还能: The leader of the MoleGang, known as "Inferno Maelstrom." It attacks by throwing Molotov cocktails, and commands minions to set up landmine barricades. Capable of summoning a fleet of vehicles to cause disturbances.
safeInformation.依存于仙人掌的拾荒者，依靠轮椅勉强行动。经过培育的仙人掌有传导疼痛至敌人身上的效: A marauder reliant on a wheelchair, who relies on a specially cultivated cactus for support. This cactus has the ability to transmit pain to enemies.
safeInformation.带着仙人掌的拾荒者，武器是秘能属性的长杖，在长杖能量耗尽后会与其他旗手一同攻击，: A marauder carrying a cactus and wielding a staff imbued with arcane energy. Once the staff's energy is depleted, he joins other flag bearers in combat or uses flag semaphore to signal the arrival of reinforcements to the battlefield.
safeInformation.以长枪进行远距离破盾攻击的拾荒者。: A marauder armed with a spear, capable of long-range shield-breaking attacks.
safeInformation.以火枪进行远程点燃攻击的拾荒者。: A marauder armed with a firearm for dealing Ignite damage.
safeInformation.军事规格的外挂式机甲，强化了上臂力量，能够锤击地面或投掷物体以击晕敌人。: A military-spec exoskeletal mecha with enhanced arm strength, capable of smiting the ground or hurling objects to stun enemies.
safeInformation.军事规格的外挂式机甲，双臂能够进行放电攻击。攻击方式灵活多样。: A military-spec exoskeletal mecha, equipped with dual arms capable of unleashing electric attacks. It boasts versatile attack methods, offering flexibility in combat.
safeInformation.军事规格的外挂式机甲，强化了火力支援能力，能够发动导弹和或火炮攻击。能锁定眩晕敌: A military-spec exoskeletal mecha with firepower support capabilities, capable of launching missiles or cannon attacks. It can lock onto stunned enemies for shooting.
safeInformation.出现于形态污染严重地区的深眠者，能发动秘法属性的攻击，也能禁锢一定范围内目标行动: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to launch arcane attacks and imprison targets within a certain range.
safeInformation.出现于形态污染严重地区的深眠者。能发动冰霜属性攻击并造成冻结效果。还会为其他敌人: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to launch frost attacks and inflict a Chill effect. Also has the ability to restore health and reduce DMG taken by other enemies.
safeInformation.出现于形态污染严重地区的深眠者，能对武器附加电磁伤害，并且会发动格挡。格挡反击能: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to deal Electro DMG to weapons and block incoming attacks. His counterattacks during blocking can imprison targets within the area.
safeInformation.出现于形态污染严重地区的深眠者，能对武器附加火焰伤害，并造成急燃。: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to imbue weapons with Fire DMG, causing a Flare effect.
safeInformation.神出鬼没的沙盗团成员，能够对我方造成点燃和撕裂伤害。: A member of the elusive P.U.S., able to inflict Ignite and Rend damage on crew members.
safeInformation.神出鬼没的沙盗团成员，能够对我方造成点燃伤害和破盾效果。: A member of the elusive P.U.S., able to inflict Ignite and Break on crew members.
safeInformation.名为夏尔的沙盗团成员，与外表完全不同，是一名十分难对付的升构者。身边形影不离的大: A member of the P.U.S. named Shire, who is completely different from her appearance, a very formidable Ascender. The big goose that never leaves her side is her good partner.
safeInformation.外形类似鸟类的桦树生物，头部外甲有类似眼睛的结构。会对范围内目标造成负能伤害。: A Chaos Remain with an avian-like feature and eye-like structure on its head exoskeleton. It inflicts Reverengy DMG on targets within the area.
safeInformation.外形类似植物的桦树生物，外甲能够聚拢形成护盾，保护自身。: A Chaos Remain resembling a plant. Its exoskeleton can converge to form a shield for protection.
safeInformation.外形类似鸟类的桦树生物，头部外甲能够展开。充能完成后会对范围内目标造成负能伤害。: An avian-like Chaos Remain with an expandable head exoskeleton. It inflicts Reverengy DMG on targets within the area after charging.
safeInformation.外形类似海生珊瑚的桦树生物，能散发粉末状物质、对其中目标持续产生影响，还能制造火: A Chaos Remain resembling coral. It emits a powdery substance that continuously affects nearby targets and can also generate flames.
safeInformation.外形类似植物的桦树生物，外甲能够聚拢形成护盾，保护自身；蓄能后可以释放波纹状扩散: A Chaos Remain resembling a plant. Its exoskeleton can converge to form a shield for protection. After charging, it can release telekinetic attacks that ripple outwards.
safeInformation.拥有改变周围气候，使环境变得寒冷的能力。并对敌人不断施加冰冻伤害和晕眩效果。随生: Has the ability to change the surrounding climate, making the environment cold. Continuously applies Frost DMG and a stun effect to enemies. Increases DEF as HP decreases.
safeInformation.掘金机器人的领袖，在场上有其他掘金机器人时无法被伤害。能够驱动所有掘金机器人一同: The leader of the Nugget Mechs, cannot be inflicted with DMG when other Nugget Mechs are on the field. It can drive all Nugget Mechs to release skills together.
safeInformation.普通的掘金机器人，能造成电磁与物理伤害。受到过量伤害时会获得护盾并陷入瘫痪。: A common Nugget Mech that can inflict electro and Physical DMG. When it sustains excessive damage, it gains a shield and becomes paralyzed.
safeInformation.比较常见的黑月成员，使用刀剑作为武器，威胁度较低。: A common member of the Night Chains, wielding swords as weapons. He appears unassuming and poses a seemingly low threat.
safeInformation.武技精湛的黑月成员。攻击造成物理与火焰伤害，有独特的见切姿态，见切姿态结束后会对: A Night Chains member with exquisite martial skills. Attacks deal physical and Fire DMG, possessing a unique Migiri stance that, upon ending, delivers a powerful counterattack to enemies.
safeInformation.步入非人阶段的深眠者。抛弃人类的武器，成为桦树之森的一部分。每一根枝条都是她的力: A Deep Sleeper who has forsaken humanity, abandoning human weapons to become one with the Chaos Forest. Every branch is a part of her strength.
safeInformation.进行强大冰属性攻击的海龙桦树生物。能造成冻结、枷锁和晕眩等多种负面效果，会不断释: This CR: Marine releases powerful frost attacks. It inflicts a variety of debuffs including Chill, Fetter, and Stun, and it releases "Dragon Might" that reduces DMG taken. It summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously.
safeInformation.坚固的路障，破坏后才能继续前进。: A sturdy barricade that must be destroyed to proceed.
safeInformation.来自阿妮塔能源公司的实习园丁，致力于一锤解决桦石，最好也能一锤解决战斗。: An intern gardener from Anita Energy Tech, dedicated to swiftly dealing with Chaos Stones with a single hammerfall, preferably in combat.
safeInformation.来自阿妮塔能源公司的园丁，控制多架无人机协助工作以及战斗。: A gardener from Anita Energy Tech, controlling multiple drones to assist in both work and combat.
safeInformation.来自阿妮塔能源公司的园丁，多次往返于桦树世界并没有让她生疏于实战。: A gardener from Anita Energy Tech, her frequent travels to the chaos world haven't made her rusty in combat.
safeInformation.身体结构复杂的桦树生物，具有多种攻击手段。受到威胁时会钻入地面恢复体力并制造小型: A complexly structured Chaos Remain, possessing multiple attack methods. When threatened, it burrows into the ground to recover health and summons small clusters of bombardier beetles, launching self-destructive attacks at targets.
safeInformation.夏尔的左膀右臂，名为朱迪的大鹅。不仅仅是一只可爱的宠物而已，能在战场上发挥出恐怖: Jude, the right-hand of Shire. More than just a cute pet, she unleashes terrifying power on the battlefield.
safeInformation.能释放庞大能量对敌人造成负能伤害，在沙尘中时能够与环境共振，免疫所有负面效果。: Can release immense energy to inflict reverengy DMG on enemies, and can resonate with the environment when in dust, immune to all negative effects.
safeInformation.通常与利喙体桦树生物一同出现，主要起防御作用，也能高速撞击敌人。: Usually accompanied by avian-shaped Chaos Remain, primarily serving a defensive role, capable of high-speed ramming into enemies.
safeInformation.尚未完成实战测试的雷暴波克士，性能有待考量。: The Thunder Punch Me yet to undergo field testing, its performance remains to be evaluated.
safeInformation.“毛绒会”成员，熊型毛绒玩偶。会使用冲锋枪对敌人造成高频率伤害，榴弹爆炸后会给地: A member of the Fluffy Union, a bear-shaped plush doll. It wields a submachine gun to deal high-frequency damage to enemies, and its grenade explosions leave the ground scorched.
safeInformation.尚未完成实战测试的冷凝波克士，性能有待考量。: The Ice Punch Me yet to undergo field testing, its performance remains to be evaluated.
safeInformation.强化了性能的雷暴波克士，战斗能力提升！: The enhanced Thunder Punch Me, its combat capabilities have been boosted!
safeInformation.比较常见的黑月成员。枪支可以发射出电磁炮弹，对多个目标造成伤害，并具有引雷效果。: A common member of the Night Chains. His firearm can launch electromagnetic shells, dealing DMG to multiple targets and inflicting Electrify effects.
safeInformation.武技精湛的黑月成员。攻击造成的引雷效果能够有效地吸引敌方注意力。出色的防御力让他: A skilled member of the Night Chains, whose Electrify effects from his attacks can effectively draw enemy attention. His excellent defense makes him a formidable opponent.
safeInformation.进一步强化性能的雷暴波克士，战斗能力进一步提升。: The further enhanced Thunder Punch Me, with its combat capabilities significantly improved.
safeInformation.完成了一系列实战测试的雷暴波克士，正准备动真格。: The Thunder Punch Me having completed a series of combat tests, it is now preparing to go all out.
safeInformation.收集了大量战斗数据的雷暴波克士，蓄势待发。: The Thunder Punch Me having collected a large amount of combat data, it is ready to pounce.
safeInformation.雷暴波克士的完成体，噼里啪啦，电闪雷鸣！: The completed form of the Thunder Punch Me, crackling with electricity and thunder!
safeInformation.尚未完成实战测试的燃焰波克士，性能有待考量。: The Flame Punch Me yet to undergo field testing, its performance remains to be evaluated.
safeInformation.收集了大量战斗数据的燃焰波克士，蓄势待发。: The Flame Punch Me having collected a large amount of combat data, it is ready to pounce.
safeInformation.无垠号列车技师，掌管车厢大权者（之一），战斗结束以后要赶紧把她送回车厢里。: The technician of The Eternal, (one of) the authorities in charge of the carriages. She must be quickly returned to the carriage after combat.
safeInformation.倚仗水域而生的桦树生物，普通攻击有几率附加冻结效果。能以多种方式造成大范围的伤害: A Chaos Remain that thrives in aquatic environments. Its Basic Attacks have a chance to Chill targets. It poses a high threat as it can deal area damage in various ways.
safeInformation.强化了性能的燃焰波克士，战斗能力提升！: The enhanced Flame Punch Me, its combat capabilities have been boosted!
safeInformation.燃焰波克士的完成体，熊熊燃烧，火力十足！: The completed form of the Flame Punch Me, blazing with flames, it is fully armed and operational!
safeInformation.进一步强化性能的燃焰波克士，战斗能力进一步提升。: The further enhanced Flame Punch Me, its combat capabilities have been further improved!
safeInformation.完成了一系列实战测试的燃焰波克士，正准备动真格。: The Flame Punch Me having completed a series of combat tests, it is now preparing to go all out.
safeInformation.外形类似爬行动物的桦树生物，造成负能伤害。能够为自身以及同伴减轻伤害，还能解除同: A Chaos Remain with a reptilian appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG. It can reduce damage for itself and allies and remove their Ignite effects.
safeInformation.外形类似昆虫的桦树生物，造成负能伤害。能躲避攻击以及回复其他桦树生物生命值。: A Chaos Remain with an insect-like appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG. It can dodge attacks and restore the HP of other Chaos Remains.
safeInformation.外形类似飞虫的桦树生物，造成大范围负能伤害，攻击方式多样。能使其他桦树生物狂暴。: A Chaos Remain with a flying insect-like appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG in a large area with various attack methods. It can also make other Chaos Remains Berserk.
safeInformation.身着阿妮塔制服的深眠者，能够在防御蓄力后造成负能伤害。可以治愈自身并消除自身的负: A Deep Sleeper clad in Anita's uniform, who can cause Reverengy DMG after charging up its defense. He can also heal himself and dispel his own negative effects.
safeInformation.身着阿妮塔制服的深眠者，攻击造成物理或负能伤害。部分攻击会造成斩裂效果。: A Deep Sleeper clad in Anita's uniform, whose attacks can deal Physical or Reverengy DMG. Some attacks may cause a Slash effect.
safeInformation.菲妮娅保证会掌握下手轻重的，作为御敌枢纽的新星，她有这样的实力。: Fenia assures she knows when to strike. As a rising star in the Detroyer, she possesses such strength.
safeInformation.在荒原上的搁浅货轮上游荡的深眠者，已经开始进一步深眠化，十分危险，但似乎并没有主: A Deep Sleeper roaming on the stranded freighter in the wilderness. She has begun to enter a deeper state of slumber, which is extremely dangerous but does not seem to actively attack humans.
safeInformation.莫名令人感到熟悉的深眠者。通过附加”心魔共鸣”并引爆的方式造成伤害，能制造幻影与: An inexplicably familiar Deep Sleeper. Deals DMG by inflicting "Devil Inside Consonance" and detonating it, and can create mirror images to act alongside her.
safeInformation.致力于研究气味学以及相关领域的黑月成员，能以独特的方式占领战场。: A Night Chains member who's dedicated to the study of aromatology and related fields. She can dominate the battlefield in a unique way.
safeInformation.形状奇异的桦树生物，能抑制升构者升构能力的发挥。: A peculiar Chaos Remain capable of suppressing the Ascenders' abilities.
safeInformation.强化了性能的冷凝波克士，战斗能力提升！: The enhanced Ice Punch Me, its combat capabilities have been boosted!
safeInformation.“毛绒会”成员，象型毛绒玩偶。拳击会使单个目标眩晕，狂暴状态下拳击的攻击频率极大: A member of the Fluffy Union, an elephant-shaped plush doll. Its punches can stun a single target, and its punching frequency increases dramatically while in a berserk state.
safeInformation.“毛绒会”成员，兔型毛绒玩偶。针管会对敌人造成混乱和崩坏效果，狂暴状态下攻击力提: A member of the Fluffy Union, a rabbit-shaped plush doll. Its syringe can inflict Confuse and Corrupt effects on enemies, with increased ATK and decreased DEF while in a berserk state.
safeInformation.以火焰类型攻击为主的始源桦树生物，能力强大，形态场与一般的桦树生物有所区别。: An Origin CR with a focus on flame-type attacks, powerful and has a Morphic Field that differs from regular CRs.
safeInformation.进一步强化性能的冷凝波克士，战斗能力进一步提升。: The Ice Punch Me with further enhancements, it has elevated its combat capabilities.
safeInformation.完成了一系列实战测试的冷凝波克士，正准备动真格。: The Ice Punch Me having completed a series of combat tests, it is now preparing to go all out.
safeInformation.收集了大量战斗数据的冷凝波克士，蓄势待发。: The Ice Punch Me having collected a large amount of combat data, it is ready to pounce.
safeInformation.冷凝波克士的完成体。它拿着的不会真的是改造后的冰箱吧？: The completed form of the Ice Punch Me. Is that really a modified refrigerator it's holding?
safeInformation.山野桦树生物中极度强大的个体，能够影响人类的精神，施加【灼心】【狂暴】等效果。其: A highly formidable individual among Wilds CR, capable of influencing human minds and inflicting effects such as [Scorch] and [Berserk]. Its armor provides defense and can rebound attacks. Extra caution is required when it enters a defensive stance.
safeInformation.穿戴阿妮塔制式防护设备的守卫，能展开能源护盾，也能造成附带击晕效果的范围伤害。: A Guard equipped with Anita's standard protective gear, capable of deploying an energy shield and causing area damage with a Stun effect.
safeInformation.穿戴阿妮塔制式防护设备的守卫，长杖既能展开能源护盾也能造成破盾效果。: A guard equipped with Anita's standard protective gear, capable of deploying an energy shield with a long staff and inflicting a Break effect.
safeInformation.能够造成近程物理伤害与范围混响伤害，并施加诅咒和破盾的效果。随生命值降低提升混响: This entity deals both melee Physical DMG and area Reverb DMG. It also curses its enemies and shatters their shields. Keep in mind that it deals increased Reverb DMG as its HP decreases.
safeInformation.倚仗水域而生的桦树生物，普通攻击有几率附加冻结效果。发出的特殊声波会消除目标的冰: A Chaos Remain that thrives in aquatic environments. Its Basic Attacks have a chance to Chill targets. It emits special sound waves that can remove Freeze effects from targets and deal additional damage.
safeInformation.倚仗水域而生的桦树生物，普通攻击有几率附加冻结效果。能够隐身。: A Chaos Remain that thrives in aquatic environments. Its Basic Attacks have a chance to Chill targets. It also has the ability to turn invisible.
safeInformation.倚仗水域而生的桦树生物，喷吐泡沫进行攻击。泡沫能造成伤害和冻结效果，也可为其他敌: A Chaos Remain that thrives in aquatic environments. It attacks by spitting foam, causing damage and inflicting a Chill effect. The foam can also share damage with other enemies and has the ability to turn Chill into Confuse.
safeInformation.狡黠的对手，在战场上更是强敌。“嘘……”: A cunning opponent and a formidable enemy on the battlefield. "Shh..."
safeInformation.旧式作业用机械，会喷射寒气造成冰冻伤害，并造成冻结效果。防御会随时间逐步降低，但: Old-fashioned operational machinery that emits cold air to inflict Frost DMG and inflict [Chill] effect. DEF gradually decreases over time, but DMG increases.
safeInformation.劫掠者的头领，以多功能轮锯作为武器。能造成电磁和火焰伤害，伴有多种负面效果。战斗: The leader of the looters armed with a multi-purpose wheel saw. This enemy can deal Electro and Fire DMG, as well as inflict various negative effects. When taking lethal DMG, this unit triggers Eternal Spark.
safeInformation.冲在前排的泥嚎箱，会一口吞掉太过接近的人和物。: A HelloBox acting as a frontline vanguard, swiftly devouring anything or anyone in close proximity.
safeInformation.进行强大冰属性攻击的海龙桦树生物，骨龙的亚种。能造成冻结、枷锁和晕眩等多种负面效: This CR: Marine, categorized as a variant of bone dragons, releases powerful ice attacks. It inflicts a variety of negative effects including Chill, Fetter, and Stun, and it releases Dragon Might that reduces incoming DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously. Its frequent and powerful attacks make it a formidable opponent.
safeInformation.强大的深眠者，以锁链和重锤作为武器。会为我方附加标记，通过使用手牌方可解除。: A powerful Deep Sleeper armed with chains and hammers as weapons. This enemy can mark crew members. The mark can be removed by using cards.
safeInformation.荒古桦树生物的一种，生理结构与爆虫类似，能造成电磁属性范围伤害。生命力顽强，陷入: A variant of Primal Chaos Remain that shares similarities with Blastbugs in physiology. It deals Electro DMG to enemies in the target area and displays remarkable resilience. Upon taking lethal DMG, it remains on the battle for a period of time.
safeInformation.以电磁类型攻击为主的始源桦树生物，能以多种方式触发电磁伤害，还会生成反伤护盾。形: An Origin CR primarily using electro attacks, can trigger Electro DMG in multiple ways and also generate a shield that reflects damage. Its Morphic Field differs from that of regular CRs.
safeInformation.“毛绒会”乘员，浣熊型毛绒玩偶。通过投掷针管的方式对我方造成诅咒或禁锢效果，还能: A member of the Fluffy Union, a raccoon-shaped plush doll that hurls syringes to curse or immobilize its foes while healing its allies.
safeInformation.索思学会的“天使”，优哉游哉地漂浮着……等等，祂身后出现的是什么啊？！: The "Angel" of Source Citadel, emanating grace in their ethereal movements... Wait, what's that stuff behind them?!
safeInformation.能造成多种元素属性、伤害，会优先以与角色身上负面效果不同的属性进行攻击。形态场与: Can inflict a variety of elemental attributes and DMG, prioritizing attacks with attributes different from the negative effects on the character. The Morphic Field differs from the general CR, and it can reduce the DMG received to a certain extent.
safeInformation.荒古桦树生物的一种，能造成【引雷】【轰雷】效果，还能触发提高其他荒古桦树生物伤害: This Primal Chaos Remain Electrifies its targets and triggers Thunder. Additionally, it activates Thunder Flare, enhancing the DMG dealt by other Primal CR.
safeInformation.荒古桦树生物的一种，驱动电磁球，有多种以【引雷】为主的强力攻击手段。: This Primal Chaos Remain manipulates electromagnetic orbs and unleashes various potent attacks that Electrify its targets.
safeInformation.永生者。对我方角色附加多种负面效果，能够以秘法飞弹发起攻击。【唯此永存】状态下，: The Immortal can inflict various debuffs on crew members and launch arcane missiles as attacks. While in the [Immortal Being] state, the Immortal takes less Final DMG. This state can be dispelled by inflicting crowd-control effects on her.
safeInformation.能够发动全体攻击的骨龙亚种，极度危险。能够对我方施加多种负面效果，此外，还能丢弃: A variety of Bone Dragon, capable of attacking all crew members, posing a significant threat. In addition, it can inflict various debuffs that discard your cards or modify your Cost.
safeInformation.将身边一切平凡物件化为武器，某人的护卫。来去如影。: Turning every mundane object around her into a weapon. A certain person's bodyguard. Comes and goes like a shadow.
safeInformation.安安静静的黑月忍者。忍之道在于静而不在于外。: Quiet NC Ninja. The way of the ninja lies in silence, not in the external show.
safeInformation.戴着头盔的黑月门卫，看起来非常拽，实际上也非常拽。: Helmet-wearing Night Chains guard, as swagy as she looks.
safeInformation.荒古桦树生物中极为强大的个体，能够改变战场环境，在【闪灭典式】与【暗曜典式】间切: An immensely powerful Primal Chaos Remain capable of altering the battlefield environment. Nether Envoy can switch between Darkness Ritual and Radiance Ritual, inflicting different damage types and debuffs accordingly.
safeInformation.强大的深眠者，外形与帝国故事中一位剑士相似。会根据我方所有红卡与蓝卡的数量决定战: A formidable Deep Sleeper bearing a striking resemblance to a legendary swordsman from the Empire's lore. This entity formulates strategies based on the quantity of Red and Blue hand cards. Its sword waves can deal massive damage and inflict debuffs.
safeInformation.制裁恶徒只是爱好，但战斗时常属于工作。当她的对手不意味着你是大坏蛋哦。: Punishing villains is just a hobby, but fighting is usually work. Being her opponent doesn't mean you're a bad person.
safeInformation.吵吵闹闹的黑月忍者。其疾如风！其烈如火！: Noisy NC Ninja. As swift as the wind! As fierce as fire!
safeInformation.将手中一切有利机会作为筹码，未来的家主。皎洁如月。: Uses every opportunity as a bargain chip, future family head, radiant as the moon.
safeInformation.星花无论做什么事都一副自信满满、势在必得的模样，而她确实有这个底气。: Stella exudes confidence and determination in everything she does, and backs it up with real ability.
safeInformation.用棒球棍攻击的暴徒。: A mob wielding a baseball bat for his attacks.
safeInformation.举着防爆盾的暴徒，主要起掩护同伴的作用。: A mob holding a riot shield, who primarily acts as cover for his companions.
safeInformation.全副武装的劫掠者，使用钉锤，蓄力后对地面释放锤击，能使范围内敌人陷入眩晕。: A heavily armed looter wielding a mace. When charged, he releases a powerful smite, stunning enemies in the area.
safeInformation.用消防斧攻击的暴徒。: A mob attacking with a fire axe.
safeInformation.用改装过的狙击步枪攻击的暴徒。小心远处！: A mob attacking with a modified sniper rifle. Watch out from afar!
safeInformation.用改装过的电磁枪进行攻击和辅助的暴徒。: A mob attacking and assisting with a modified electromagnetic gun.
safeInformation.为了奖金、绩效、加班费……御敌枢纽的薪资构成是如此复杂，最终导致冯·里奈主任站到: For bonuses, performance, overtime... the salary structure of the Destroyer is so complicated that it led Director Rina Von to step onto the battlefield.
safeInformation.携带霰弹枪、燃烧瓶的暴徒，远近距离均能造成威胁。: A mob carrying a shotgun and Molotov cocktails, threatening from both close and long distances.
safeInformation.同时持有棒球棍与手斧的暴徒，可以灵活切换武器。: A mob wielding both a baseball bat and a hand axe, capable of switching weapons flexibly.
safeInformation.同时持有棒球棍与盾牌的暴徒，近距离较为棘手。: A mob wielding both a baseball bat and a shield, who is particularly tricky at close range.
safeInformation.同时持有枪支与盾牌的暴徒，远近距离兼顾。: A mob wielding both a firearm and a shield, who is effective at various ranges.
safeInformation.同时持有霰弹枪与盾牌的暴徒，远近距离兼顾。: A mob wielding both a shotgun and a shield, who is effective at various ranges.
safeInformation.同时持有电击枪与狙击枪的暴徒。多对策双枪！: A mob wielding both a stun gun and a sniper rifle. A double-threat duo!
safeInformation.穿着自制外置装甲的暴徒，是队伍中的主力。遇到危险时能收起电锯、展开护盾进行防御，: A mob clad in homemade exoskeleton armor, who is the backbone of the team. When danger arises, he can retract his chainsaw and deploy a shield for defense, while also calling in small drones to airdrop explosives for crowd control.
safeInformation.两人一组搭档行动的暴徒，一边高速行驶一边高速扫射，也能投掷燃烧瓶。: A mob fighting in pairs who speed along while shooting rapidly and throwing Molotov cocktails.
safeInformation.在被恐怖分子们“回收”以后被改造成了高效且强力的兵器，原本用于清障的多功能前臂现: After being "retrieved" by terrorists, it was transformed into an efficient and powerful weapon. The multifunctional forearm originally used for obstacle clearing has now deviated from its original function, possessing greater lethality in combat.
safeInformation.拥有坚实外甲的普通桦树生物。: A common Chaos Remain with a solid exoskeleton.
safeInformation.全副武装的劫掠者，使用大剑。臂甲可以对敌人起控制效果。: A heavily armed looter wielding a greatsword. His arm armor enables a firm grip on enemies.
safeInformation.全副武装的劫掠者，能够使用与闪电有关的升构能力。: A heavily armed looter, capable of utilizing electrokinetic ascension abilities.
safeInformation.旧时代某个北方大国的残部，能够投掷机械斧造成斩裂伤害。: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, capable of throwing mechanical axes to cause slashing damage.
safeInformation.旧时代某个北方大国的残部，将多发重机枪作为手持武器使用。: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, wielding a heavy machine gun as a handheld weapon.
safeInformation.旧时代某个北方大国的残部，能够通过榴弹发射器发射的榴弹造成点燃伤害。: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, capable of using a grenade launcher to inflict Ignite damage with grenades.
safeInformation.冷冽简洁的涂饰、破坏力极强的武装，以及极高的结构稳定性，这些特征揭示了眼前这辆战: The cold, austere markings, formidable armaments, and exceptional structural stability indicate that the armor before you must have served in the ranks of the N.A..
safeInformation.不慎对上就会造成大麻烦的“冷角色”，散发着生人勿近的气息。战斗失败应该不会导致他: The type that spells trouble if encountered, emitting an aura of stay-away. Hopefully, losing in combat won't lead to him being arrested by the BCRL Agency?
safeInformation.昴宿系列的守卫型机器人，以物理攻击作为主要攻击手段。生命值较低时会分摊队友伤害，: A guard robot from the Tauri series, specializing in physical attacks. When its durability is low, it shifts focus to protecting allies by absorbing incoming damage. If it suffers lethal damage from sharing, it will enter a standby mode before eventually breaking down.
safeInformation.昴宿系列的哨戒型机器人。技能会造成弃牌效果，还会根据手牌数量按一定百分比给予全体: A sentinel robot from the Tauri series. Its abilities force you to discard cards and deal DMG to all your characters based on the number of hand cards.
safeInformation.索思学会御敌枢纽的名誉先导。有她在，就无人能够逃过她决心执行的审判。: The honorary Vanguard of the Destroyer of Citadel. Her presence ensures that none can escape the judgment she is committed to deliver.
safeInformation.索思学会御险枢纽研发的大型对策机械，代号“艾尼”。能造成多种负面效果，还会按受到: A large-sized countermeasure machine devised by the Destroyer of Citadel, codename "Enni." It can inflict various debuffs on its enemies and gains a damage reduction bonus whenever it takes Physical DMG. In addition, it periodically removes all buffs from your characters.
safeInformation.挡在中间的泥嚎箱，可爱的外形很治愈。: An adorable HelloBox that serves as a healer in the middle line for its companions.
safeInformation.使用大型武器的深眠卡巴内，相比其他同类更加难以应付。: A Deepsleep Kabane who wields large weapons, presenting a more formidable challenge than its smaller counterparts.
safeInformation.植物般的美丽桦树生物，会造成眩晕。: A beautiful plant-like Chaos Remain, capable of causing stun.
safeInformation.装设了混响核心的波克士，会造成多段混响伤害。: Box equipped with a reverberation core, capable of dealing Reverb DMG over multiple strikes.
safeInformation.神秘的剑型桦树生物，被一部分研究者视为极度重要的研究素材。会在以雷电状态与以火焰: A mysterious sword-shaped CR, considered extremely important research material by some researchers. It switches between an electro status and a fire status, dealing different types of DMG and skill effects.
safeInformation.缩在后排的泥嚎箱。为什么一个箱子里能装下那么多武器啊！: A HelloBox that hides in the rear. How can such a small box hold so many weapons?
safeInformation.装设了负能核心的波克士，会造成大范围负能伤害。: Box equipped with a reverengy core, capable of dealing reverengy core damage within a large area.
safeInformation.一位“魔女”所化成的深眠者。能使用多种魔法对我方造成元素伤害、触发多种负面效果。: A Deep Sleeper transformed from a "witch". Capable of using various magic to deal elemental DMG to your allies and trigger multiple negative effects.
safeInformation.屠戮者的首领，体格巨大，具有升构能力。能造成物理伤害和范围混响伤害，会为我方牌库: Leader of Slayers possessing Ascension Abilities. He deals Physical DMG and area Reverb DMG. In addition, he inflicts [Crack] on your cards, causing the user to suffer damage. This effect can be nullified by using [Crack] cards.
safeInformation.“化物”的一种。会变出各种武器进行攻击，还会发出惊天动地的咆哮。打倒后可获丰富奖: A type of "Metaplasia." It can summon various weapons to attack and emits an earth-shattering roar. Defeating it grants abundant rewards.
safeInformation.以冰冻类型攻击为主的始源桦树生物，可以生成屏蔽冰冻伤害的护盾，形态场与一般的桦树: An Origin CR which primarily uses frost-type attacks, can generate a shield that blocks frost DMG. Its morphic field is different from that of common CRs.
safeInformation.以远距离支援攻击为主要进攻手段的深眠卡巴内，难以打倒。: A Deepsleep Kabane using long-distance shots as its primary offensive method, presenting a formidable challenge.
safeInformation.植物般的美丽桦树生物，解放核心后会进行高强度光束攻击。: A beautiful Chaos Remain resembling a plant. It unleashes high-intensity beam attacks upon releasing its core.
safeInformation.以近距离攻击为主要进攻手段的深眠卡巴内，难以打倒。: A Deepsleep Kabane using melee attacks as its primary offensive method, presenting a formidable challenge.
safeInformation.全称“英明神武毛绒会终极机甲七号机”的钢铁机甲，火力强劲。会在一定时间后陷入无法: Full name: "Herald and Mighty Fluffy Union Ultimate Mecha Unit Mark VII,"  a steel mecha with powerful firepower. It will enter an immobile status after a certain period of time.
safeInformation.经过改装的波克士1000型，只会挨揍。: The modified Box MK.I model, only good for taking a beating.
safeInformation.化为“黑烟”之核的苍叶。能于我方手牌区生成【侵蚀】，当【侵蚀】的费用降为零时将导: Aoba, serving as the core of "Kuro Keburi". She generates the card [Corrosion] in your hand, and when the cost of [Corrosion] is reduced to 0, the corroded character will become unable to cast any skills.
safeInformation.一位失控天使个体。能够造成大范围的负能伤害以及多种负面效果，还会生成【元素核】加: A failed Angel entity, capable of dealing Reverengy DMG within a large area and inflicting various debuffs. In addition, she can generate [Elemental Core] in your hand.
safeInformation.经过改装的波克士2000型，会释放大范围剑气。: The modified Box MK.II model, unleashes a sword energy wave in a large area.
safeInformation.擅长操纵火焰的桦树生物，能为我方附加多种火焰相关的负面状态。: A Chaos Remain excelling in flame manipulation, capable of inflicting various flame-related debuffs.
safeInformation.擅长操纵火焰的桦树生物，能为我方附加多种火焰相关的负面状态，还能在短时间内禁止我: A Chaos Remain excelling in flame manipulation, capable of inflicting various flame-related debuffs and disabling your leader skill for a short period of time.
safeInformation.以操纵毒类能力为主的沼泞桦树生物，能够叠加【毒蚀】以及造成【击晕】。: A Venom CR primarily manipulates venom abilities, can stack [Toxic] and cause [Stun].
safeInformation.以操纵毒类能力为主的沼泞桦树生物，能够叠加【毒蚀】以及造成负能伤害，还有概率触发: A Venom CR primarily manipulates venom abilities, can stack [Toxic] and cause Reverengy DMG, and has a chance to trigger [Sleep].
safeInformation.以操纵毒类能力为主的沼泞桦树生物，能够叠加【毒蚀】以及造成【击飞】，还能通过扩散: A Venom CR primarily manipulates venom abilities, can stack [Toxic] and cause [Launch], and it can also reduce your crew's attack speed and DMG through spreading mucus.
safeInformation.以操纵毒类能力为主的沼泞桦树生物，能够叠加【毒蚀】以及通过喷吐黏孢造成多种负面效: A Venom CR primarily manipulates venom abilities, can stack [Toxic] and cause various negative effects by spitting slime spores.
safeInformation.曾于北阵服役的战车，如今似乎已转变为截然不同的另一存在。以能够造成负能伤害的激光: An armor that once served in the N.A., now seem to have transformed into a completely different existence. It uses lasers capable of inflicting Reverengy DMG to dominate the battlefield.
safeInformation.屠戮者的成员之一，双手持握长柄钉锤，在近距离战斗时极具威胁。: One of the members of the Slayers, wielding a long-handled warhammer with both hands, poses a significant threat in close combat.
safeInformation.屠戮者的成员之一，以能喷射火焰的喷枪作为主要武器。: One of the members of the Slayers, using a flamethrower as the main weapon.
safeInformation.屠戮者的成员之一，能够使用一定程度的升构能力。: One of the members of the Slayers, able to use certain Ascension Ability.
safeInformation.屠戮者的成员之一，持用大剑，在近距离战斗时极具威胁。: One of the members of the Slayers, wielding a greatsword, poses a significant threat in close combat.
safeInformation.沼泞桦树生物中的强大个体，以为敌方附加【毒蚀】为主要攻击手段。: A powerful individuals among Venom CR, applies [Toxic] to enemies as its main attack method.
safeInformation.以冰冻类型攻击为主的始源桦树生物，可以生成屏蔽冰冻伤害的护盾，形态场与一般的桦树: An Origin CR which primarily uses frost-type attacks, can generate a shield that blocks frost DMG. Its morphic field is different from that of common CRs and can reduce the DMG it receives to a certain extent.
safeInformation.始源桦树生物中极其强大的个体，能造成多种负面效果，另外，还能造成独有的【元素侵蚀: An extremely powerful individual among Origin CR, capable of causing various negative effects and also causing a unique Elemental Erosion status. The Morphic Field is different from that of regular CR.
safeInformation.大天帝时代的“剑圣机”，只有当代剑圣才可以驾驭它。该机搭载超热离子引擎，可以轻易: The "Sword Saint Machine" of the Great Heavenly Emperor Era can only be piloted by the contemporary Sword Saint. This machine is equipped with a super hot ion engine, allowing for the effortless execution of a variety of fantastic sword techniques.
safeInformation.这架恐怖的怪物有着臭名昭著的传说，会吞噬它的驾驶者。有人怀疑这是驾驶舱打不开的夸: This terrifying monster has a notorious legend of devouring its pilots. Some suspect this is an exaggerated way of saying the cockpit won't open. A certain Outlander showed an incredible desire for this machine.
safeInformation.不明实体，“归墟”，拥有异常强大的力量，甚至能够改变和控制对手的战斗策略。: Unknown entity, "Guixu", possesses exceptionally strong power, even capable of changing and controlling the opponent's battle strategy.
safeInformation.体型巨大的深海桦树生物，各方面的情况都亟需进一步调查。目前能够确定的信息仅有该个: A gigantic deep-sea CR, the situation in all aspects urgently requires further investigation. Currently, the only confirmed information is that this individual's appearance pattern is attracted by certain human activities. It poses a great threat to coastal vessels and residents.\nIt can summon bait with the ability to "taunt" to attract attacks. Additionally, it has skills that can cause various negative effects such as [Interrupt] and [Knockback], as well as skills that can increase the Cost of hand cards.

unitInformation.全副武装的劫掠者，体型健硕，以能喷射火焰的喷枪作为主要武器。非法改装后的喷枪可以: A heavily armed looter featuring a towering stature and wielding a deadly flamethrower. The flamethrower has been modified illegally, granting it the ability to lock onto stunned enemies and unleash a devastating fire beam. However, it cannot lock onto non-stunned enemies.
unitInformation.比较常见的黑月成员，会灵活地投掷手里剑，也会隐身后突然发起攻击。: A common member of Night Chains, adept at throwing shurikens with agility and launching sudden attacks from stealth.
unitInformation.有着形似指爪的外甲的桦树生物，它能够将形态污染的效果进行扩散传播，并使形态污染效: A Chaos Remain with a claw-like exoskeleton. It has the ability to spread and intensify morphic field pollution, posing a great threat to affected enemies.
unitInformation.有着形似击锤的外甲的桦树生物。除了能够利用锤体猛击敌人外，还能通过精神攻击，使敌: A Chaos Remain with a hammer-like exoskeleton. It not only strikes enemies with brute force but also disrupts enemy ascension abilities through psychic attacks.
unitInformation.更具威胁性的桦树生物，能够吸取敌人的能量，通过减少我方费用的方式影响战局。技能会: A more formidable Chaos Remain that can absorb enemy energy and influence the battlefield by reducing your cost. Its skills cause area damage.
unitInformation.更具威胁性的桦树生物，需要至少小队级别的武装才能正面对抗。拥有极其特异的力量，能: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. Possessing extraordinary strength, it can suppress Ascenders' abilities.
unitInformation.经过一定进化的桦树生物，通常与其他桦树生物一同行动，能从较远距离发起攻击，还能召: An evolved Chaos Remain that typically operates alongside other Chaos Remains. It can launch attacks from a distance and summon other smaller Chaos Remains to assist in combat.
unitInformation.全副武装，张扬地将装甲涂成红色的拾荒者。携带着能够提供抗污染效果的仙人掌。以不知: A fully armed marauder, flaunting red-painted armor and carrying a cactus for pollution resistance. Wielding a steel pipe scavenged from unknown sources as a weapon, he can charge up to enhance his ATK and effects.
unitInformation.穿着醒目的红色运动服，戴着防毒面具的拾荒者。携带着能够提供轻微抗污染效果的仙人掌: A marauder wearing striking red sportswear and a gas mask, with a cactus that provides slight pollution resistance. Although he's equipped with a grenade launcher, the quality of the ammunition varies, making each shot a gamble.

A marauder wearing striking red sportswear and a gas mask, with a cactus that provides slight pollution resistance. Armed with a flintlock pistol, he sometimes uses Molotov cocktails as supplementary attack methods.
unitInformation.全副武装，张扬地将装甲涂成红色的拾荒者。身材十分壮硕却并不影响其动作的迅猛。携带: A fully armed marauder flaunting red-painted armor, boasting robust bodies and agile movements. He carries a cactus that provides pollution resistance and can be used as a weapon. His primary weapon is a flamethrower, capable of emitting devastating flames.
unitInformation.地联时代遗留下来的全功能工程辅助动力甲，从设计到制造风格都彰显着旧时代产物的气质: A versatile mecha left over from the Earth Union era, its design and manufacturing styles reflect the characteristics of that time. While the B.C.R.L. has become the dominant power, some power mechas are still in use, while others have been abandoned or resold for various reasons. One such power mecha fell into the hands of an ambitious marauder, who gave it a fancy name "The Wilderness King." However, this document refers to it as the "Power Driller."\nIt is equipped with powerful firearms that launch charged attacks, striking and stunning the target. Additionally, it can unleash drill attacks after breaking any crew member's shield, dealing DMG to the target and inflicting Injure.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护装备的暴徒，斗志昂扬。双手皆持有手斧，会对敌人发起左右手交替来回的斩: Clad in basic protective gear, this spirited mob wields axes in both hands and can launch alternating attacks from left to right, making him a formidable opponent.
unitInformation.小型桦树生物中较大的个体，通常多只或成群出现，会普通攻击，也会在死后发生爆炸。相: Among the smaller Chaos Remains, it's larger in size and often appears in groups. It typically launches Basic Attacks and explodes when taking lethal DMG. It can cause greater damage than common Blastbugs and can even exhibit abnormal growth, increasing damage with size.
unitInformation.小型桦树生物，通常多只或成群出现，缺少一般有效攻击方式，但会通过自爆方式进行攻击: A small Chaos Remain usually appearing in groups. It lacks effective attack methods but can attack through self-destruct. The energy released upon explosion causes significant damage to humans.
unitInformation.常见的浮游型桦树生物，实力较弱，仅能进行远程攻击，但经常跟随在其他较大型桦树生物: A common floating-type Chaos Remain, weak in strength, capable only of ranged attacks. It often accompanies larger Chaos Remains.
unitInformation.毒爆虫中无论是实力与体型都十分巨大的个体，是繁衍和统领着毒爆虫们的女王。最显著的: The largest and most powerful individual among Blastbugs, she is the queen who reproduces and leads them. The most prominent feature is her ability to summon swarms of Blastbugs for large-scale collective attacks.
unitInformation.更具威胁性的桦树生物，需要至少小队级别的武装才可能正面对抗。外甲形态与部分昆虫类: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. With an exoskeleton resembling certain insects, its scythe-like limbs can dissolve target defenses with multi-stage attacks. It can instantly approach targets while invisible and launch powerful attacks, capable of breaking through front lines in an instant. It's a highly threatening enemy.
unitInformation.经过鼹鼠帮改造的动力甲，必须由驾驶员进行操控。与其他擅长造成物理打击的机甲不同，: Modified by the MoleGang, this power mecha requires manual control by a driver. Unlike other mechas proficient in physical attacks, it specializes in its Electrify ability, capable of widespread interference on the battlefield.
unitInformation.经过鼹鼠帮改造的动力甲，必须由驾驶员进行操控。此件动力甲的上肢部门经过了特殊强化: Modified by the MoleGang, this power mecha requires manual control by a driver. Its upper limbs are specially reinforced and can even destroy fragile structures, hurling large debris as projectiles for attacks.
unitInformation.经过鼹鼠帮改造的动力甲，必须由驾驶员进行操控。此件动力甲经过了手部改造，能够持用: Modified by the MoleGang, this power mecha requires manual control by a driver. Its hands have been modified to wield a large handheld cannon for area attacks.
unitInformation.“狂飙焚尽”，鼹鼠帮的老大，一般带领着鼹鼠帮活跃于修格里城的地下区域。要说鼹鼠帮:
The leader of the MoleGang, known as "Inferno Maelstrom." He and his gang members operate in the underground area of Shoggolith City. When it comes to their style, it is like...
"We rock them top brands, we're lookin' fly! We roll deep, packin' weapons, super badass high! Don't sleep on our Molotov, they're ready to ignite! Underestimate us, we'll send you soaring, takin' flight!"
"Hey boss? Why do we have to introduce ourselves in a rap flow?'
"You idiot! Because that's COOOOOOOL!"
He throws Molotov cocktails at his enemies. Additionally, he can summon MoleGang minions to join the battle, and some of these minions are equipped with claymore landmines that deal explosive damage. Such is the power of MoleGang, the most badass crew in Shoggolith City!
unitInformation.使用轮椅移动的拾荒者，身侧挂着吊瓶，怀中则抱着培育的特殊仙人掌，这种仙人掌除了抗: A marauder who moves using a wheelchair, with an IV drip attached and holding a specially cultivated cactus. This unique cactus not only purifies pollutants but also secretes substances that can heal external wounds. Additionally, the marauder can induce self-harm with the cactus, transmitting his own pain to inflict psychological attacks on enemies.
unitInformation.背有旗帜的拾荒者，为确保行动时的灵活度，只穿戴了简易防护道具。携带着能够提供轻微: A marauder with a flag, equipped with minimal protective gear for enhanced agility, and carrying a cactus that provides slight pollution resistance. Typically not seen alone, they serve as flag bearers for the marauder organization, commanding fleets of marauders in battle. Initially, they use a staff to channel arcane energy. Once the energy is depleted, one of them will wield the flag to signal others for close combat or use flag signals to guide an incoming fleet charge.
unitInformation.穿着醒目的红色运动服，戴着防冲击面具的拾荒者，由于手持长柄武器所以能从较远距离发: A marauder wearing striking red sportswear and an impact-resistant mask, able to attack from a distance due to his long-handled weapon. His specially treated spear can break through defenses, featuring a shield-breaking effect.
unitInformation.穿着醒目的红色运动服，戴着防冲击面具的拾荒者，通过手持的火枪进行攻击。能够对我方: A marauder wearing striking red sportswear and an impact-resistant mask. He attacks with a firearm, inflicting Ignite damage on crew members.
unitInformation.明显经由军事生产线生产的外挂式机甲，偏重于正面对抗的型号，双臂加装了碳钢护甲和震: Clearly manufactured from military production lines, this exoskeletal mecha is designed for frontal engagements. It features carbon steel armor and shock modules on both arms. It can stun nearby enemies by activating the shock modules to smite the ground or momentarily increase output to hurl objects and incapacitate foes.
unitInformation.明显经由军事生产线生产的外挂式机甲，偏重于灵活性与压制作战的型号。双臂配有高压电: Clearly manufactured from military production lines, this exoskeletal mecha emphasizes agility and suppression in battle. Featuring high-voltage output ports on both arms, it can unleash electric attacks. Equipped with a basic intelligent analysis system, it can deftly assess and respond to enemy behavior.
unitInformation.明显经由军事生产线生产的外挂式机甲，偏重于远程火力支援的型号，装配了重型火炮和导: Clearly manufactured from military production lines, this exoskeletal mecha is designed primarily for long-range fire support. It is outfitted with heavy artillery and missile launchers. Its missile attacks can inflict significant damage on enemies and have a stunning effect. Additionally, it can lock onto stunned enemies and unleash devastating firepower, causing immense damage.
unitInformation.多出现于形态污染严重地区的深眠者。其人类外形没有受到太大影响，但内在早已完全变质: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper retains a human appearance but has deteriorated internally, especially his hands. Primarily uses arcane attacks to damage targets from a distance and can imprison targets within a certain range.
unitInformation.多出现于形态污染严重地区的深眠者。即使变成现在的外形，仍以帮助同伴为己任。通常攻: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper remains dedicated to aiding her companions despite her altered appearance. Her attacks typically inflict Frost DMG and apply a Chill effect. Additionally, she can restore health to other Deep Sleepers and use force fields to reduce DMG taken by her companions.
unitInformation.多出现于形态污染严重地区的深眠者。该深眠者会为武器附加可持续的电磁伤害，还会利用: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper can apply sustainable Electro DMG to weapons and use them to block attacks. The DMG taken during blocking enhances his counterattack, which inflicts Electro DMG and can imprison targets within the area.
unitInformation.多出现于形态污染严重地区的深眠者。已被解构的身体部分重新长出，形成类似短刀的型态: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper has regenerated body parts into dagger-like forms. He can swiftly slash targets with flaming daggers, inflicting significant Fire DMG on a single target and causing a Flare effect.
unitInformation.戴着厚重防晒面具的沙盗团成员，在荒原与沙漠地区神出鬼没，谁也不知道他们是怎么做到: Clad in a heavy sun protection mask, this member of the P.U.S. roams the wilderness and desert regions with uncanny stealth. He strikes from a distance with thrown axes, inflicting Ignite and Rend damage on crew members.

Clad in a heavy sun protection mask, this member of the P.U.S. roams the wilderness and desert regions with uncanny stealth. He can inflict Ignite damage and use a long spear to execute powerful charges, applying Break on crew members.
unitInformation.体型、外表乃至嗓音都会让人觉得“只不过是个孩子”的升构者，沙盗团成员。使用与外形: A member of the P.U.S., Shire's small stature, childlike appearance, and soft voice make her seem like a harmless child. Armed with a shotgun that sharply contrasts with her innocent look, many are initially fooled, mistaking her weapon for a toy. Underestimating her as merely an "adorable child" often proves perilous, leading to harsh reprimands. Shire is frequently seen conversing with her goose companion, and it is said that their communication is genuine.
unitInformation.形态与鸟类相似的桦树生物，对单体和集体均能造成一定威胁。头部周围的“眼睛”会发出: A Chaos Remain resembling a bird, posing a threat to both individuals and groups. The "eyes" around its head emit a glowing light, causing those caught in their gaze to suffer Reverengy DMG and become immobilized. It is crucial to be wary of their attack signs.
unitInformation.形态与部分植物类似的桦树生物，放松状态下的瓣叶型外甲盛放如花。将头部瓣叶聚拢成团: A Chaos Remain resembling certain plant species. Its petal-shaped exoskeleton blooms like flowers in a relaxed state. It attacks by clustering its head petals together. When facing danger, it releases its petals to form a shield in front of it to ward off threats.
unitInformation.形态与鸟类相似的桦树生物，由其特殊性质而命名为“渡鸦”，头部外甲能够发光。大部分: Named "Raven" due to its avian-like nature, this Chaos Remain has luminescent head exoskeleton. While most of its attacks pose minor threats, it can inflict Reverengy DMG on a large area of enemies after prolonged charging. When it's suspended in the air, its charging status must be closely monitored.
unitInformation.头部形态与珊瑚相似的桦树生物。其攻击方式主要分为两种：其一是散发粉末状物质，对身: A Chaos Remain with a head resembling coral. It emits a powdery substance, inflicting ongoing effects on those within its vicinity. Additionally, it can unleash flames with a large range, and the longer it charges, the stronger the generated flames become.
unitInformation.更具威胁性的桦树生物，需要至少小队级别的武装才可能正面对抗。形态与部分植物相似，: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. Resembling certain plant species, its attacks typically inflict psychic damage and can drive petals to converge in front of itself as a defensive measure. After charging, it releases telekinetic attacks that ripple outwards, affecting targets within its range.
unitInformation.完美的不完整球体。像是皮球一样弹跳着出现，像是气球一样舒展开触手、漂浮于空中，瑰: A perfect yet incomplete sphere, bouncing like a ball, extending tentacles like a balloon, it's a magnificent Chaos Remain. With special Chaos Glands, it can rapidly lower the surrounding temperature, even causing nearby areas to experience blizzards. Despite its beauty, it brings nothing but coldness, like neon lights shining in the snow.
unitInformation.金闪闪的金子小姐，淘金乐园的守护者。慧眼如炬，颇具领袖气质，两条手臂都可以随意拆: Miss Gold, the guardian of ONEderland, possesses keen insight and leadership qualities. Both her arms can be detached to become rocket fists, and even each finger can be dismantled. As the leader of the Nugget Mechs, she can motivate her subordinates physically and mentally, creating chaos on the battlefield. When protected by other Nugget Mechs, she is invincible.
unitInformation.运输作业用小型辅助机BOI3号，是由阿妮塔与前地联联合开发的仿生技工系列机器人的: BOI3, a small auxiliary robot designed for transportation tasks, represents an early model of the Android Mechanic series jointly developed by Anita and the former Earth Union. Due to its widespread use in gold panning operations, it has affectionately been nicknamed the "Nugget Mech."
unitInformation.比较常见的黑月成员，使用刀剑作为武器，看起来低调内敛，貌似威胁度较低。: A common member of the Night Chains, wielding swords as weapons. He seems reserved and low-key, giving off an impression of low threat.
unitInformation.深眠者，只是向“她”投去眼神都会让人浑身战栗。无论是可怖的外表、巨大化的盾牌还是: This imposing Deep Sleeper evokes unease with just a glance. Her terrifying appearance, towering shield, and constant whispering instill fear in her adversaries. Among the known Deep Sleepers, she stands out as a formidable opponent with a deep-seated obsession.\nHer fighting style triggers a sense of deja vu. When did she take the oath she has now broken?
unitInformation.“深眠者”……如果还能这样称呼她的话。各项数值上已经超越了迄今为止所有有记录的“: This "Deep Sleeper"... Well, this classification no longer applies to her, as her attributes have surpassed those of all previously recorded Deep Sleepers. Her mutation extends beyond her mask, revealing woody tissues on her limbs and enhanced abilities that intensify the ferocity of her attacks. Her constant murmuring echoes like an omen of disaster, causing mental and physical torment for her opponents.\nWhat obsessive pursuit compels her to forsake all she once held dear?
unitInformation.技艺精湛的黑月成员。抛弃了制式刀剑，转而使用长度与重量惊人的双头剑，只为追求无与: A skilled member of the Night Chains, he has forsaken conventional swords in favor of massive dual-bladed swords, aiming for unmatched attack performance and efficiency. Prioritizing lethality over the traditional Migiri art, he sometimes even harms his allies. When he finds an opening to counterattack, his fluid sword movements swiftly target his enemy's throat. Against him, impatience and complacency are equally fatal.
unitInformation.全身四肢与躯干都已被木质纤维形成的甲壳覆盖，头部原本的面具已扩张为覆盖整个头颅的: Her entire body is covered in armor made of wooden fibers, with her original mask expanding into a helmet that covers her entire head. Her muscles and bones have undergone severe distortions. The initial shock of seeing her may turn into nightly nightmares — if one survives that long.
unitInformation.名为骨龙，但实际上与“龙”毫无关联的大型桦树生物，外甲呈现出某种幻想生物骨架的形: This large-sized Chaos Remain showcases an exoskeleton resembling a bone dragon, although it is not related to actual "dragons" at all. It possesses the unique ability to conjure phantoms resembling its own form, while its resonating chamber produces resounding roars that reverberate through the sky. In the face of this creature, one can understand why it earns the moniker "dragon," as its breath and power rival those found in fictional tales.\nIt inflicts a variety of debuffs including [Chill], [Fetter], and [Imprison], and it casts "Dragon Might" that reduces DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously and has a chance to inflict [Chill], and its powerful attacks can shatter the target's [Shield].
unitInformation.坚固的路障，破坏后才能继续前进。: A sturdy barricade that must be destroyed to proceed.
unitInformation.更具威胁性的桦树生物，需要至少小队级别的武装才可能正面对抗。具有复杂的护甲和身体: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. With its complex armor and body structure, it employs various attack methods. When enraged, it enters a berserk state, greatly increasing its speed. It restores health by burrowing into the ground and summons small clusters of bombardier beetles underground, launching highly dangerous self-destructive attacks at targets.
unitInformation.被夏尔称呼为朱迪的大鹅。除了种族天赋自带的啄技外，也掌握了一些令人感叹林子大了什: This goose is referred to as Jude by Shire. In addition to the innate pecking skills of its species, it has also mastered some ridiculous special skills, thanks to Shire's ascension abilities. Its lethality far exceeds that of rural guard geese. Try not to provoke it, or its owner.
unitInformation.拥有动物骨架般诡异的外形的大型桦树生物，无论是行动造成的冲击还是自体内释放出的庞: This large-sized Chaos Remain presents a distinctive appearance resembling the skeleton of an animal. It poses a greater threat than regular Chaos Remains due to its brutal movements and the substantial energy it emits.\nIt deals Reverengy DMG to crew members. When it operates within sandy and dusty environments, it triggers a powerful resonance with the surroundings, making itself immune to all negative effects. However, this ability fails in rainy weather. It can also turn invisible and disengage through a molting process, resulting in the explosion of its original form and the birth of a Bony CR Remain. While in the bombardment mode, it unleashes a barrage of reverengy shells upon random targets.
unitInformation.桦树生物，其盾形外甲能有效抵御战斗时的伤害，会通过高速冲撞迅速接近敌人并造成伤害: A Chaos Remain with a shield-shaped exoskeleton that effectively deflects damage in combat. It swiftly approaches enemies and causes damage through high-speed collisions. Often appearing alongside sword-shaped Chaos Remains, the two seem to have a symbiotic relationship, enabling a combo attack.
unitInformation.与装设了雷暴核心的战斗系统进行连接的波克士，增加了复杂的电击发生装置，能对大范围: Connected to the combat system equipped with a Electro Core, Thunder Punch Me features a sophisticated electrical discharge device. It can damage a large area of crew members and inflict Electrify effects.
unitInformation.“毛绒会”成员，乍一看非常恐怖的巨型毛绒玩偶，知道装在壳子里的是人以后恐怖程度倍: A member of the Fluffy Union, this giant plush doll looks terrifying at first glance, but the horror doubles when you realize there's a person inside its shell. \nWithin its massive plush body, there seem to be many hidden pockets containing an astonishing arsenal of weapons such as machine guns, bullets, grenade launchers, and more. The metal ring on its head may symbolize its ability to send enemies physically to heaven. To emphasize its cuteness, even the smoke shapes after the grenade explosions have been specially designed to be adorable.
unitInformation.与装设了冷凝核心的战斗系统进行连接的波克士，特别加装了冷冻舱，内置大量急冻瓶，能: Connected to the combat system equipped with a Condensation Core, the Ice Punch Me is specially equipped with a cryogenic chamber and a large number of cryogenic bottles, capable of adding a chill to its weapons. By the way, has anyone seen where the refrigerator from the train went?
unitInformation.比较常见的黑月成员，不知为何身着白衣，显得有点特殊。特制的枪支可以发射出电磁炮弹: A common member of the Night Chains. For some reason, he's dressed in white and appears somewhat unique. His specially modified firearm can launch electromagnetic shells, dealing DMG to multiple targets and inflicting Electrify effects.
unitInformation.技艺精湛的黑月成员。抛弃了制式武器，手持特别改装过的电磁力场剑与盾牌，能达成攻守: A skilled member of the Night Chains who has abandoned standard weapons, instead wielding a specially modified electromagnetic force field sword and shield. This combination achieves a perfect balance between offense and defense. The sword and shield's excellent Electrify effects greatly restrict enemy movement. Additionally, after energy storage is complete, the shield releases a large-scale electromagnetic attack. With superb defensive capabilities, once given a chance to catch his breath, he becomes even more formidable. Don't linger in battle!
unitInformation.与装设了燃焰核心的战斗系统进行连接的波克士，增加了超有威慑力的喷火功能和额外燃料: Connected to the combat system equipped with a Flame Core, this Flame Punch Me features an extremely intimidating flamethrower function and additional fuel tanks, capable of dealing DMG to a large area of crew members and applying Ignite effects.
unitInformation.倚仗潮湿环境以及水域而生的桦树生物，普通远程攻击有几率附加冻结效果和混乱效果。会: A Chaos Remain that thrives in damp environments and water. Its normal ranged attacks have a chance to Chill and Confuse targets. It inflicts damage to all crew members based on the number of Chilled targets. Additionally, it launches large-scale attacks to remove Chill effects from crew members, dealing significant Reverengy DMG.
unitInformation.外形与爬行动物相似的桦树生物，能够造成负能伤害，通过吸取并聚集附近的沙尘对我方形: A Chaos Remain with a reptilian appearance, able to cause  Reverengy DMG. It gathers nearby sand particles to threaten crew members and protect itself. It can also throw energy bombs to remove the Ignite effects from its fellow Chaos Remains and provide them with shields.
unitInformation.外形与昆虫相似的桦树生物，能够造成负能伤害。独特的身体构造使其能够跃起并躲避攻击: A Chaos Remain with an insect-like appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG. Its unique body structure allows it to leap and evade attacks, as well as restore the HP of other Chaos Remains.
unitInformation.外形与飞虫相似的桦树生物，能够造成大范围负能伤害，拥有多种攻击方式。此外，还能够: A Chaos Remain with a flying insect-like appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG in a large area with various attack methods. Additionally, it can damage other Chaos Remains and make them Berserk.
unitInformation.身着阿妮塔能源公司制服的深眠者，或许曾是有志于桦树空间探索之人。手持重型盾牌与锤: Clad in Anita Energy Tech uniform, this Deep Sleeper may have once been an explorer of the chaos space. Wielding a heavy shield and hammer, he boasts excellent defense and healing abilities. The bandage-like tissue wrapped around his body seems to be the main conduit for his healing abilities, so his status should be monitored closely.
unitInformation.身着阿妮塔能源公司制服的深眠者，或许曾是有志于桦树空间探索之人。将简朴但实用的手: Clad in Anita Energy Tech uniform, this Deep Sleeper may have once been an explorer of the Chaos Space. Wielding a simple yet practical hand axe, he sometimes launches spinning attacks to cause Reverengy DMG to targets within a certain range. He seems capable of tossing the axe into the air and using it to slash the ground.
unitInformation.在荒原地区的搁浅巨轮上游荡的深眠者，已开始进入深眠者的下一阶段，非人外形中残留的: Roaming on the stranded behemoth of a ship in The Wilderness, this Deep Sleeper has transitioned into the next stage of her slumber. Some remnants of her former attire are barely distinguishable amidst her inhuman form.\nUnlike typical Deep Sleepers, she lingers only in certain fixed areas of the vessel. Her movements are so predictable that conflicts can easily be avoided with a bit of caution, suggesting no intent to actively attack humans. Why does she still linger in this world?She can inflict [Devil Inside Consonance] mark on crew members, causing damage at regular intervals. When charged, she can trigger [Devil Inside Consonance] marks on crew members with a claw swipe. The phantoms she summons possess the same abilities as her, acting alongside her and unleashing powerful attacks on all fronts.
unitInformation.于形态污染严重地区出现的深眠者，不知为何散发出令人怀念的气息……据部分目击报告声: Found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper emits a nostalgic aura for some reason. According to some eyewitness reports, seeing such Deep Sleepers is "like seeing one's mother." This phenomenon may be related to her ability to summon phantoms.\nShe can inflict [Devil Inside Consonance] mark on crew members, causing damage at regular intervals. When charged, she can trigger [Devil Inside Consonance] marks on crew members with a claw swipe. The phantoms she summons possess the same abilities as her, acting alongside her and unleashing powerful attacks on all fronts.
unitInformation.“毛绒会”成员，乍一看非常恐怖的巨型毛绒玩偶，知道装在壳子里的是人以后恐怖程度倍: A member of the Fluffy Union, this giant plush doll looks terrifying at first glance, but the horror doubles when you realize there's a person inside its shell. Its elephant-like head is reminiscent of a very old animation from a bygone era. Its punches pack a serious punch, mainly using physical means to beat people down. If one round of punches is not enough, then go with another round. The more it fights, the more ferocious it becomes.

A member of the Fluffy Union, this giant plush doll looks terrifying at first glance, but the horror doubles when you realize there's a person inside its shell. Although unarmed, its fighting spirit is fierce, wielding a mysterious small syringe as a weapon. Being pricked by its needle seems to have severe consequences, whether real or imagined.
unitInformation.具有强大威胁性的桦树生物，始源桦树生物的高级生命形态，形态场与一般的桦树生物有所: A highly threatening CR, an advanced life form of Origin CR, has a Morphic Field that differs from that of a regular CR. Other characteristics remain to be studied—currently, the only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to the Morphic Moon at its origin.\nIt primarily uses flame-type attacks, capable of igniting our crew and enhancing its own Fire DMG; it can also create large areas of burning ground, causing DoT to our characters within the area.
unitInformation.外形奇异的桦树生物，其反弹伤害的能力得益于那身近似于拼凑而成的护甲。为此强大个体: A grotesquely shaped Chaos Remain that possesses the ability to reflect incoming damage, owing to its makeshift armor. While naming this formidable creature, researchers encountered some controversy regarding the naming rules for Chaos Remains...\nIts attacks inflict various negative effects including [Slash], [Scorch], and [Interrupt].
