Its skill [Rampant Ripples] deals Reverengy DMG while inflicting [Berserk] or [Confuse], and drains energy from crew members based on the number of crew members under [Berserk] effect. It can assume a defensive stance by curling up. While in this state, whenever it takes a certain number of hits, it gains a stack of Fury, reducing its DEF and increasing its ATK. When it accumulates a certain number of Fury stacks or when its defensive stance expires, it deals Reverengy DMG to all crew members based on the Fury stacks and inflicts [Injure].
unitInformation.穿戴阿妮塔制式防护设备的守卫，多出现于阿妮塔设施附近。手持的短杖可在身周展开能源: A guard equipped with Anita's standard protective gear, often found near Anita's facilities. His short staff can deploy an energy shield around him and cause area damage with a Stun effect during attacks.
unitInformation.穿戴阿妮塔制式防护设备的守卫，多出现于阿妮塔设施附近。持有强化了攻击能力的长杖，: A guard equipped with Anita's standard protective gear, often found near Anita's facilities. His long staff can deploy an energy shield and cause area damage with a Break effect.
unitInformation.极易暴怒的超大体型桦树生物。外甲结构异常复杂，材质比大部分桦树生物都更为坚固。即: A towering Chaos Remain prone to sudden fits of rage. Its intricately armored exterior boasts exceptional strength. Even in a calm state, its strikes and stomps are formidable, posing significant threats. When enraged, it becomes even deadlier, unleashing devastating attacks. The horn on its head can harness reverberation energies to afflict various debuffs on the target or even render them unconscious.
unitInformation.倚仗潮湿环境以及水域而生的桦树生物，普通近战攻击有几率附加冻结效果。会发出特殊的: A Chaos Remain that thrives in damp environments and water. Its normal melee attacks have a chance to Chill targets. It emits special sound waves that, upon contact with frozen targets, remove their Freeze effects and deal additional damage.
unitInformation.倚仗潮湿环境以及水域而生的桦树生物，普通远程攻击有几率附加冻结效果。偶尔会发动短: A Chaos Remain that thrives in damp environments and water. Its normal ranged attacks have a chance to Chill targets. Occasionally, it can briefly turn invisible, making it untargetable during that time.
unitInformation.倚仗潮湿环境以及水域而生的桦树生物，采用喷吐泡沫的方式进行攻击。泡沫能在造成伤害: A Chaos Remain that thrives in damp environments and water. It attacks by spitting foam. The foam splits into several parts after causing damage and inflicting a Chill effect, further damaging and Chilling other targets. It can also heal enemy targets and grant them immunity to one hit of damage. It can summon clusters of small Chaos Remains from its chest, turn Chill into Confuse.
unitInformation.无论从时代还是环境角度考虑都不应该出现在此地的作业用机械。\r这架伐木机械应该是: Neither from the era nor the environment perspective should this logging machine appear here.\nThis logging machine seems to have belonged to the N.A. model. Despite being a logging machine, its destructive power is considerable; moreover, its cooling module seems to be overexerting, resulting in frequent sawdust and ice chips flying together. The reason why a machine from the N.A. appears here years after its dissolution remains a mystery.
unitInformation.劫掠者团伙的首领，装备了精良的外部装甲，具有强烈的战斗意志。与其他劫掠者相比，他: The leader of the looters, equipped with exceptional external armor and possesses a strong determination to engage in combat. Compared to other looters, his armor is even more prominently exaggerated. The weapon he wields is a modified Chaos Stone mining device manufactured by Anita. His primary attack method involves using his multi-purpose wheel saw to strike multiple targets. When the wheel saw is spinning at high speeds, it launches impact bolts that deal Electro DMG to all crew members and Electrify them. When used as a melee weapon, the wheel saw deals Fire DMG to crew members and launches them into mid air, with a chance of Igniting them.\nEternal Spark: When taking lethal DMG, this unit becomes Invincible, fully restores his HP, and inflicts Inferno on the entire battlefield. While under the effect of Eternal Spark, the unit is immune to all control effects and casts skills more frequently, but loses HP over time. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times, with the amount of HP restoration decreasing each time.
unitInformation.“化物”的一种，俗称泥嚎箱。没人知道这个名字是怎么流行起来的，可能是因为读起来很: A type of Metaplasia known as HelloBox. No one knows where this name came from. Maybe because it sounds funny?\nActing as a frontline vanguard excelling in melee attacks, it swiftly devours anything or anyone in close proximity.
unitInformation.凛川骨龙的亚种，成因不明。有学者认为此种桦树生物是由单体的凛川骨龙分裂而来，也有: A variant of Glacial Skeleton, originating from an unknown source. Some scholars propose that it split from a single Glacial Skeleton, while others argue that it is a chimera formed by multiple dragons attempting to devour each other.\nIt inflicts a variety of negative effects including Chill, Fetter, and Imprison, and it releases Dragon Might that reduces incoming DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously and may Chill them, and its powerful attacks can shatter the target's shield. Compared to regular bone dragons, this variant exhibits a higher frequency of attacks, thus making it a more formidable enemy.
unitInformation.强大的深眠者，受到形态污染的严重影响，身体的大部分组织都异变为类似桦树生物的结构: This Deep Sleeper has undergone severe corruption due to morphic field pollution, resulting in extensive mutation of his body tissues resembling a Chaos Remain structure. Rumors suggest that he once served as a jailer in a remote prison, and now he still grips his chains.\nWhenever you use a card, Chainbane Jailer gains Energy. Chainbane Jailer marks crew members, and marks can be removed by using cards. Remaining marks will deal DMG after a period of time. When a mark fails to trigger, Chainbane Jailer enters [Hunger] state and marks an additional target.
unitInformation.荒古桦树生物的一种，生理结构与爆虫类似，但外壳性质和结构与其有所不同。能够发起强: A variant of Primal Chaos Remain that shares similarities with Blastbugs in physiology but features a distinct shell composition. It launches more potent Electro attacks against enemies in the target area and displays even greater resilience. Upon taking lethal DMG, it remains on the battle for a period of time.
unitInformation.具有强大威胁性的桦树生物，始源桦树生物的高级生命形态，形态场与一般的桦树生物有所: A highly threatening CR, an advanced life form of Origin CR, has a Morphic Field that is distinct from that of common CRs. Other characteristics remain to be studied—currently, the only known information is that this type of CR is closely related to the Morphic Moon at its origin.\nIts attacks have a chance to trigger the Electrify effect and can slightly restore its own HP; it can consume its own HP to generate a counter-damage shield, ensuring that its next attack will definitely trigger the corresponding Status effect. Additionally, it can create a large electromagnetic field, with a certain probability of inflicting the [Magnetize] effect on enemies within the area.
unitInformation.“毛绒会”成员，乍一看非常恐怖的巨型毛绒玩偶，知道装在壳子里的是人以后恐怖程度倍: A member of the Fluffy Union, this over-sized plush doll appears menacing, especially when one realizes that a human operator resides within. It hurls syringes to curse foes and heal allies, occasionally imprisoning targets with its attacks.
unitInformation.具有强大威胁性的桦树生物，原始桦树生物的高级生命形态，形态场与一般的桦树生物有所: The CR with a powerful threat, an advanced life form of Origin CR, has a Morphic Field different from that of general CRs. Other characteristics are yet to be studied—currently, the only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to its origin on the Morphic Moon; however, according to other research reports, it seems the Empire also has legends about similar "monsters"...\nThe Vortex Eye can target the enemy's weaknesses and even increase corresponding attribute output when it receives certain attribute DMG. Thanks to this characteristic, it poses a great threat to squads, enough to destroy an entire team in an instant.
unitInformation.荒古桦树生物的一种，被海角城的居民戏称为“避雷针”。能造成【引雷】【轰雷】效果，: Known as the "lightning rod" by Cape City residents, this Primal Chaos Remain Electrifies its targets and triggers Thunder. Additionally, it activates Thunder Flare, enhancing the DMG dealt by other Primal CR. This entity protects other Chaos Remains, absorbing their incoming damage. When it takes lethal DMG from damage sharing, it activates Thunder Flare to strengthen its allies.
unitInformation.荒古桦树生物的一种，形似一颗长出枝条的心脏。周围漂浮的电磁球是它的强力攻击手段，: This Primal Chaos Remain resembles a heart with branching appendages. It utilizes the electromagnetic orbs surrounding it to assault enemies, creating a lightning field and releasing multiple lightning bolts rapidly.
unitInformation.一个人能够以何种形式达成永生？假使她能，她会在这永远的时间中作出什么样的选择？\: How does one attain immortality? And if she can make it, what choices would she make throughout eternity?\nThe Immortal can inflict various debuffs on her enemies and launch arcane missiles as attacks. Some of her skills deal True DMG. When she evokes her full power, she enters the [Immortal Being] state, gaining multiple stacks of [Immortal]. When she takes a crowd-control effect, remove a stack. The more stacks, the less DMG taken.
unitInformation.被称为“骨龙”的大型桦树生物，外观呈现出某种幻想生物骨架的形态。与其他骨龙亚种不: A large Chaos Remain known as the Bone Dragon, although it is not directly related to actual dragons. Unlike other subspecies, this particular Bone Dragon boasts a unique purplish-red hue. In folklore in certain regions, it is rumored to sustain itself on human flesh and blood.\nThis creature can inflict various debuffs including [Fetter], [Curse], and [Imprison]. Its attacks discard your cards, and its abilities modify the Cost of your cards. In addition, when your character is defeated or reaches low HP, it unleashes a potent AOE attack instantly.
unitInformation.荒古桦树生物中极为强大的个体，体型庞大，出现时会携来遮天蔽日的乌云，造成局部地区: An immensely powerful Primal Chaos entity featuring a towering form. Upon its arrival, dark clouds envelop the sky, leading to localized weather changes, although its exact purpose remains a mystery.\nThe Nether Envoy can manipulate the battlefield environment, adjusting its abilities and damage types accordingly. While in the Radiance Ritual environment, it deals Electro DMG and increases the card costs in your hand. While in the Darkness Ritual environment, it deals Reverengy DMG, reduces the card costs in your hand, and heals your characters. In addition, it possesses skills that reduce Final DMG taken, and when afflicted by debuffs, it sacrifices its HP to nullify them. Please note that its skills inflict various debuffs and deal massive damage to all your characters.
unitInformation.强大的深眠者，身体的大部分组织已经异变，但仍紧握武器。外形与曼杜斯帝国的故事中某: This formidable Deep Sleeper, with most of its body tissues mutated, bears a resemblance to a long-haired warrior from the legends of the Mundus Empire. In the conclusion of the legend, the warrior, having lost everything, self-exiled from the homeland.\nAt the start of battle, it examines the number of in your hand, the deck and the discard pile and adjust stance accordingly. If there are more Red cards, it adopts a defensive stance, becoming immune to crowd-control effects and taking less damage. In addition, Red cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If there are more Blue cards, it adopts an offensive stance and deals more damage. In addition, Blue cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If the numbers of Red and Blue cards are equal or at 0, it adopts a balanced stance. In this case, its attacks deal additional True DMG, and all cards have their cost randomized when drawn.\nIt unleashes potent sword waves and inflicts various debuffs including [Scorch] and [Slash].
unitInformation.躯体出现高程度异化，战斗能力得到极大增幅的深眠者。在过去的某个时刻，她是我们的朋: A Deep Sleeper whose body has undergone a high degree of mutation, enhancing her combat abilities. Previously recognized as your friend Connor, she is now a mere husk abandoning her former self and seeking a higher existence. Nothing matters anymore. Not her oath, her guardian, nor "herself."\nShe grants "Sanctuary" to your characters while improving her skills. Typically, she unleashes attacks that deal DMG to all your characters.
unitInformation.北阵早年研发的哨戒炮型号，为了提升机动性而加装了四只灵活的机械腿。以发射弹仓中的: This Sentry Turret was initially developed by the N.A. during the early phases of the war and later equipped with four flexible mechanical legs for enhanced maneuverability. Its primary method of attack involves firing shells at the target.\nHistorical records document a Sentry Turret squad marching across the parade ground while singing.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护装备的暴徒，使用棒球棍进行攻击，威胁度较低。: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob wields a baseball bat for relatively low threat attacks.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护装备的暴徒，使用破旧的防爆盾，为背后的同伴进行掩护。: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob uses a worn-out riot shield to cover his comrades.
unitInformation.全副武装的劫掠者，体型健硕，双手持握长柄钉锤，仅从外观上就能感受到危险，蓄力后对: A heavily armed looter featuring a towering stature and wielding a long mace, posing a serious threat merely by his appearance. When charged, his powerful smite unleashes shockwaves that strike nearby enemies and stun them.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护装备的暴徒，以手斧作为武器，近身时会造成一定威胁。: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob wields a hand axe as a weapon, posing a certain threat up close.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护装备的暴徒，持有自行改造的步枪，通常会在远处进行狙击，能造成高额伤害: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob is equipped with a self-modified rifle and usually snipes from a distance to deal massive damage.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护装备的暴徒，以不知道从何处获取的电磁枪作为武器，使用电磁枪进行攻击或: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob wields an electromagnetic gun acquired from unknown sources and uses it for attacks or generating electromagnetic shields to aid his companions.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护装备的暴徒，持有自行改装的霰弹枪以及燃烧瓶，近身时会用霰弹枪进行射击: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob is equipped with a self-modified shotgun and Molotov cocktails, suppressing with shotgun fire up close and throwing Molotov cocktails from afar.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护装备的暴徒，双手分别持握着棒球棍和手斧，战斗时会灵活选择其中一种武器: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob, with one hand holding a baseball bat and the other a hand axe, can dynamically choose which weapon to use in combat, making him a formidable opponent.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护服的暴徒，一手持盾，一手握着棒球棍，兼顾防御的同时也具有一定的进攻性: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob, with one hand holding a shield and the other a baseball bat, is adept at both offense and defense. Getting hit by the bat puts one in a stunned state, making him a quite formidable opponent.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护服的暴徒，一手持盾，一手持枪，兼顾防御的同时也具有一定的进攻性，拥有: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob, with one hand holding a shield and the other a firearm, is adept at both offense and defense. Possessing rudimentary tactical skills, he can utilize the shield to gain advantages, making him a formidable opponent.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护服的暴徒，一手持盾，一手持有霰弹枪，进攻性十足的同时也有一定的防御能: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob, with one hand holding a shield and the other a shotgun, is adept at both offense and defense. He can use the shield as cover for sustained gunfire, making him a formidable opponent.
unitInformation.穿着简易防护服的暴徒，随身携带了两把枪械，分别为狙击枪和电击枪，在战斗中会判断局: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob is armed with both a sniper rifle and a stun gun. He can assess situations in combat, flexibly employing one of the firearms for attacks or providing cover for allies, which makes him a formidable opponent.
unitInformation.穿着自制的外置装甲的暴徒，手臂的延展部分加装了电锯，在团体中往往是领导者和主力身: Clad in homemade exoskeleton armor, this mob features saws on extending arm parts, often assuming a leadership role in groups. In critical moments, he can retract the saws, activate a shield for defense, and call in small drones to airdrop explosives for crowd control.
unitInformation.驾驶着改装过的吉普车，以驾驶员和机枪手两人一组的搭档形式进行战斗的暴徒。除了在高: A mob fighting in pairs, driving a modified jeep with a driver and a gunner. Besides using machine guns while speeding, they can also throw Molotov cocktails, making them formidable opponents.
unitInformation.地联在篝火城计划初期为了更方便地铺设轨道而设计的大型清障工程车，在轨道上可以进行: Originally designed by the Earth Union for the early stages of the Bonfire City project, this large-scale clearance vehicle was intended for efficient track laying. It can operate efficiently on tracks and can also operate off-track in emergencies, although its performance may be affected.\nAfter being "retrieved" by terrorists, it was transformed into an efficient and powerful weapon. The multifunctional forearm originally used for obstacle clearing has now deviated from its original function, possessing greater lethality in combat.
unitInformation.覆盖着坚韧外甲的桦树生物。当它移动时，看起来就像是包裹在岩石中的、不断变幻着的虹: A Chaos Remain covered in a resilient exoskeleton. When in motion, it resembles constantly shifting rainbow-colored liquid sealed in rocks — beautiful yet highly perilous.\nSpecializing in defense, its heavy exoskeleton can withstand most firepower.
unitInformation.全副武装的劫掠者。使用大剑劈砍敌人，经过改装的臂甲可以强力地控制住敌人，使其动弹: A heavily armed looter armed with a greatsword. His modified arm armor enables a firm grip on targets, effectively immobilizing them.
unitInformation.全副武装的劫掠者，是劫掠者中难得一见的升构者。未持有武器，但可以使用升构能力发起: A heavily armed looter who stands out as a rare ascender among their peers. Despite being unarmed, this ascender launches attacks using their ascension ability, primarily through lightning bolts.
unitInformation.旧时代某个北方大国的残部，仍然穿着款式陈旧、笨重不堪的动力装备。能够投掷机械斧造: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, still clad in outdated and cumbersome power armor. Able to throw mechanical axes to cause slashing damage.
unitInformation.旧时代某个北方大国的残部，仍然穿着款式陈旧、笨重不堪的动力装备。这套装备使得普通: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, still clad in outdated and cumbersome power armor. This armor enables an ordinary soldier to wield a heavy machine gun as a handheld weapon.
unitInformation.旧时代某个北方大国的残部，仍然穿着款式陈旧、笨重不堪的动力装备。能够通过榴弹发射: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, still clad in outdated and cumbersome power armor. Able to use a grenade launcher to inflict Ignite damage with grenades.
unitInformation.无论从时代还是环境角度考虑都不应该出现在此地的战车。\r冷冽简洁的涂饰、破坏力极: An armor that shouldn't be present here, neither in time nor in environment.\nThe cold, austere markings, formidable armaments, and exceptional structural stability indicate that the armor before you must have served in the ranks of the N.A.. The appearance of N.A. machinery here, years after its dissolution, remains a mystery.
unitInformation.“化物”的一种，俗称掀人掌。不是仙人掌啦！\\n能造成物理伤害以及【击飞】【打断: A type of Metaplasia. Commonly known as Cacturn. Not Cactus!\nIt can deal Physical DMG and inflict [Launch] and [Interrupt].
unitInformation.昴宿系列的守卫型机器人，拥有强大的近距离镇暴能力。物理攻击是它的主要攻击手段。当: A guard robot from the Tauri series, specializing in physical attacks in close-range engagements. When its durability is low, it shifts to protecting allies by absorbing their incoming damage. If it suffers lethal damage from sharing, it will enter a standby mode, refraining from further attacks or skill usage before eventually breaking down.
unitInformation.昴宿系列的哨戒型机器人，负责对敌人的性质作出迅速分析判断、进行初步的限制性攻击。: A sentinel robot from the Tauri series assigned to swiftly analyze enemy behavior and execute restraining attacks. Its abilities force you to discard cards and deal DMG to all your characters based on the number of hand cards.
unitInformation.索思学会御险枢纽研发的大型对策机械，代号“艾尼”。由后半部上方的胶囊形状对策系统: A large-sized countermeasure machine devised by the Destroyer of Citadel, codename "Enni." Its actions are controlled by a capsule-shaped countermeasure system located at the rear upper part and can receive remote commands.\nEquipped with various special weapons, it can inflict multiple negative effects, including [Knockback], [Imprison], [Fetter], and [Confuse]. It can also deal significant DMG to all allies through its flame jet device. Each time it receives Physical DMG, the amount of all DMG it takes is reduced. Once DMG reduction hits the limit, it will forcibly discard all Red cards from your hand and reset the DMG reduction effect. Additionally, it clears all allies' buffs at regular intervals.
unitInformation.“化物”的一种，俗称泥嚎箱。没人知道这个名字是怎么流行起来的，可能是因为读起来很: A type of Metaplasia known as HelloBox. No one knows where this name came from. Maybe because it sounds funny?\nAn adorable HelloBox that serves as a healer in the middle line for its companions.
unitInformation.心脏部位出现变异的深眠者，目前学界暂称此现象为“卡巴内化”。此种深眠卡巴内的攻击: Deep Sleepers with a mutation in their hearts, referred to as "Kabanized" creatures in academic circles. This Deepsleep Kabane displays heightened aggression and combat proficiency. Special caution is advised.
unitInformation.纤长的桦树生物。当它移动时，看起来就像是包裹在岩石中的、不断变幻着的虹色液体，美: A slender Chaos Remain. When in motion, it resembles constantly shifting rainbow-colored liquid sealed in rocks — beautiful yet highly perilous.\nIt attacks with beams formed from concentrated arcane energy, capable of piercing through and stunning targets.
unitInformation.与装设了混响核心的战斗系统进行连接的波克士，还为了增添气氛让遥小姐挑选了一张希斯: Box connected to a combat system integrating a reverberation core, accompanied by a play list of Heath David's classic songs carefully selected by Haruka to intensify the battle ambiance.\nAt least three crew members from the Mundus Empire recognize the shield it wields. "It must have been snatched from some imperial knight!"
unitInformation.“化物”的一种，俗称破财树。在它面前就算破财也不一定能消灾，所以还是保护好你的钱: A type of monster, commonly known as Noney Tree. In its presence, losing money might not necessarily avert disaster, so it's best to protect your wallet.\nIt can cause Reverengy DMG.
unitInformation.“化物”的一种，俗称拳花。人们通常用“一拳打在棉花上”形容无力感，但为什么现在棉: A type of Metaplasia. Commonly known as Puntton. People usually use "a punch hitting cotton" to describe a sense of powerlessness, but why is it that now the cotton has become the one doing the punching?\nIt deals Physical DMG.
unitInformation.神秘的剑型桦树生物，外形与东大陆传说中的“金乌”有些相似，因此被一部分研究者作为: A mysterious sword-shaped CR resembling the "Golden Crow" from Eastern Continent legends, leading some researchers to consider it as evidence that the form of CR is related to the human collective unconsciousness. However, due to insufficient data, this theory has not been verified to date.\nIt switches between the [Blazing Sun] Status, primarily using electro abilities, and the [Solar Flame] Status, primarily using fire abilities, causing different type of DMG and skill effects.
unitInformation.“化物”的一种，俗称泥嚎箱。没人知道这个名字是怎么流行起来的，可能是因为读起来很: A type of Metaplasia known as HelloBox. No one knows where this name came from. Maybe because it sounds funny?\nA HelloBox that hides in the rear. How can such a small box hold so many weapons?
unitInformation.与装设了负能核心的战斗系统进行连接的波克士。\\n雷比斯大人特别提供改装和额外装: Box connected to a combat system integrating a reverengy core.\nMiss Rebis has implemented modifications and additional equipment that offer entirely whimsical and wondrous effects, albeit not quite reliable.
unitInformation.一位魔女，一位迷途者，一位母亲。塞蕾娜所化成的深眠者，似乎已经没有恢复人形的可能: A witch, a lost soul, a mother. Serena, who has become a Deep Sleeper, seems to have no chance of returning to human form... Let her slumber forever in this star-filled dream.\nAble to use various kinds of magic to inflict elemental DMG on crews and trigger multiple negative effects.
unitInformation.屠戮者的首领之一。穿戴一身由球类运动防护具改装而来的护甲，体格异常庞大，看不清面:
One of the Slayer's leaders, clad in armor fashioned from rugby protective gear, stands tall with a faceplate concealing his visage... Could he have fallen to morphic field pollution?
Most of his attacks deal Physical DMG. His Ascension Ability enables him to deal Reverb DMG within a large area and [Stuns] his targets.
Whenever a card enters your deck, he inflicts a stack of [Crack] on it, stacking up to 3 times. Whenever a card with [Crack] is drawn, it deals DMG to the card owner based on the [Crack] stacks. Using a card with [Crack] removes a stack.
After the [Crack] effect deals DMG 30 times, he immediately unleashes his Ultimate skill, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies once and inflicting [Slash]. In addition, triggers all [Crack] effects on all of your cards.
Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, he becomes [Invincible] for 10 seconds. After that, each time he deals DMG, he restores a large amount of HP. This effect lasts the rest of the battle.
unitInformation.“化物”的一种，被称为嚎虎箱。也许是因为它会咆哮，也许是因为它长得像老虎，也许是: A type of Metaplasia known as HowlingBox, perhaps named from its distinctive roar, or its box shape, or both.\nThis Metaplasia boasts superior combat prowess compared to its lesser counterparts, capable of extracting more weapons from within. Despite its adorable appearance, it presents a grave challenge for conductors, yet the rewards for defeating it are irresistible.
unitInformation.具有强大威胁性的桦树生物，始源桦树生物的高级生命形态，形态场与一般的桦树生物有所: A highly threatening CR, an advanced life form of Origin CR, with a Morphic Field that differs from that of general CRs. Other characteristics are yet to be studied—currently, the only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to the Morphic Moon at its origin.\nAttacks have a chance to inflict Chill on your crew and can summon a large area of blizzard. Additionally, it can generate a curtain like the aurora in front of itself, reducing the DMG it takes and blocking all frost DMG.
unitInformation.心脏部位出现变异的深眠者，目前学界暂称此现象为“卡巴内化”。此种深眠卡巴内以远距: Deep Sleepers with a mutation in their hearts, referred to as "Kabanized" creatures in academic circles. This Deepsleep Kabane uses long-ranged shots as its primary attack method, making it more dangerous than ordinary Deep Sleepers.
unitInformation.将核心隐藏，可以变形的桦树生物。普通状态下外膜包裹住核心，且不会做出任何行动。解: This Chaos Remain is capable of transforming by concealing its core. In its common state, the outer membrane envelops the core, remaining motionless. Once the core is unleashed, it continuously unleashes high-intensity beam attacks.
unitInformation.心脏部位出现变异的深眠者，目前学界暂称此现象为“卡巴内化”。此种深眠卡巴内以强力: Deep Sleepers with a mutation in their hearts, referred to as "Kabanized" creatures in academic circles. This Deepsleep Kabane uses potent melee attacks as its primary attack method, making it more dangerous than ordinary Deep Sleepers.
unitInformation.被称为“骨龙”的大型桦树生物，外观呈现出某种幻想生物骨架的形态。与其他骨龙亚种不: A large Chaos Remain known as the Bone Dragon, although it is not directly related to actual dragons. Unlike other subspecies, this particular Bone Dragon boasts a unique purplish-red hue. In folklore in certain regions, it is rumored to sustain itself on human flesh and blood.\nThis creature can inflict various debuffs including [Fetter], [Frenzy], and [Imprison]. Its attacks discard your cards, and its abilities modify the Cost of your cards. In addition, when your character is defeated or reaches low HP, it unleashes a potent AOE attack instantly.
unitInformation.全称“英明神武毛绒会终极机甲七号机”，简称英武机甲Ⅶ型。什么？鹦鹉？不，本设计虽: Full name: "Herald and Mighty Fluffy Union Ultimate Mecha Unit Mark VII," abbreviated as Herald Mecha VII. What? Parrot? No, although this design is based on the appearance of a specific bird species, it is definitely not a parrot! It's Herald!\nA steel mecha with fierce firepower and a very high attack frequency, but due to design issues, its active time is limited. Holding out for a certain period and waiting for it to fall into an immobile status might provide an opportunity to defeat it.
unitInformation.由无数卡巴内以及周围缠绕的不明黑烟形成的融合体，远看是大小堪比楼房的团块，接近后: A monster comprised of numerous Kabanes enveloped in black smoke. From a distance, it resembles a towering building, but closer inspection reveals intricate glowing patterns composed of veins and hearts from smaller Kabanes. How are you supposed to take down an enemy like this?
unitInformation.与战斗系统1000型进行连接的波克士，没有什么战斗能力，只会一味躲在战斗系统后挨: Connected to Combat System MK.I, this Box lacks combat abilities, simply cowering behind the combat system and taking hits.
unitInformation.破除卡巴内的外壳后，发现了化为“黑烟”之核的苍叶。她曾是一位与我们有所交集之人，: Breaking through Kabane's outer shell unveils the core of "Kuro Keburi", Aoba, once a familiar face now transformed into a mutant with a heart of steel. To save her and everything she holds dear...\nShe can summon a tornado that strikes in a large area and reduces your ATK. She generates the card [Corrosion] in your hand, and when the cost of [Corrosion] is reduced to 0, the corroded character will become unable to cast any skills. You will need to play [Corrosion] to dispel this debuff. Note that [Corrosion] cannot be played when Ironhearted Aoba channels her ultimate skill Ogi: Arashi.
unitInformation.天使计划执行过程中不可避免的一步。如今在我们面前的是一位失控天使个体，失去了原有: As an inevitable result of the Angel Project, Raziel has transformed into an Angel of immense power at the expense of her original memories and behavior.\nShe can deal Reverengy DMG within a large area and inflict various debuffs. In addition, she generates [Elemental Core] in your hand at regular intervals.
unitInformation.与战斗系统2000型进行连接的波克士，增加了战斗元件与颇具复古风格的武器，只会…: Connected to Combat System MK.II, this Box gains combat components and a retro-styled weapon, only to... Wait, what's with this super-powered sword wave?!
unitInformation.擅长操纵火焰的冥灯桦树生物，拥有如同群聚植物般的外形。能以火焰为我方角色附加多种: A Nether CR excelling flame manipulation, resembling a cluster of plants and capable of inflicting various flame-related debuffs, including [Wildfire].
unitInformation.擅长操纵火焰的冥灯桦树生物，拥有如同灯台般的外形，据说是为了起到保护自身的拟态目: A Nether CR excelling in flame manipulation, resembling a lampstand purposed for self-protection, capable of inflicting various debuffs and disabling your leader skill for a short period of time.
unitInformation.以操纵毒类能力为主的沼泞桦树生物，有着类似海洋中贝壳类生物的外形，然而多了一些“: A Venom CR primarily manipulates venom abilities, has an appearance similar to shellfish in the ocean, yet with some "unnecessary parts."\nIt can stack [Toxic] and cause [Stun].
unitInformation.以操纵毒类能力为主的沼泞桦树生物，有着类似鸟类的外形，只是空洞的眼眶中已经长出了: A Venom CR primarily manipulates venom abilities, has a bird-like appearance, except that fungi-shaped foreign objects have grown in its hollow eye sockets.\nIt can stack [Toxic] and cause Reverengy DMG, with a chance to trigger [Sleep].
unitInformation.以操纵毒类能力为主的沼泞桦树生物。身体表面的黏液和身体组织可怖地蠕动着，难以辨别: A Venom CR primarily manipulates venom abilities. The mucus on the surface of its body and body tissues writhes horrifically, making it difficult to discern its original form.\nIt can stack [Toxic] and cause [Launch], and it can also decrease your crew members' attack speed and DMG by spreading mucus.
unitInformation.以操纵毒类能力为主的沼泞桦树生物，有着类似动植物残骸聚合体的外形。这些残骸究竟为: A Venom CR primarily manipulates venom abilities, has a form similar to an aggregate of animal and plant remains. Why exactly do these remains merge with each other?\nIt can stack [Toxic] and inflict various negative effects by spitting slime spores.
unitInformation.无论从时代还是环境角度考虑都不应该出现在此地的战车，尤其它似乎还……被桦树生物“: An armor which should not appear here from the perspective of time or environment, not to mention it has been "corroded" by Chaos Remains.\nFrom its appearance, it can be determined that this is a scorpion-type armor once served in the N.A., but its connecting parts and shell are already covered with substances similar to the liquid tissue of Chaos Remains. Could this be proof that Chaos Remains are trying to control mechanical creations?\nIn addition to ordinary close-range attacks, it can also fire lasers to inflict Reverengy DMG. It can absorb energy from your characters and cause overall Reverengy DMG. Once charging is complete, it will fire a large-scale laser beam to sweep all your characters.
unitInformation.全副武装的屠戮者，体型健硕，双手持握长柄钉锤，仅从外观上就能感受到危险，蓄力后对: A fully armed Slayer, with a robust build, wields a long-handled spiked hammer in both hands. The mere appearance exudes danger, and after charging power, the ground strike released can cause all nearby enemies to suffer intense shock and become stunned.
unitInformation.全副武装的屠戮者，体型健硕，以能喷射火焰的喷枪作为主要武器。非法改装后的喷枪可以: A fully armed Slayer with a robust build using a flamethrower as the primary weapon. The flamethrower has been modified illegally, granting it the ability to lock onto stunned enemies and unleash a devastating fire beam. However, it cannot lock onto non-stunned enemies.
unitInformation.全副武装的屠戮者，是屠戮者中难得一见的升构者。未持有武器，但可以使用升构能力发起: A fully armed Slayer, a rare Ascender among slayers. Not holding a weapon, but can use Ascension Ability to launch attacks.
unitInformation.全副武装的屠戮者。使用大剑劈砍敌人，造成物理伤害。近距离攻击武器使得该敌人极具威: A fully armed Slayer, uses a greatsword to slash enemies, causing physical DMG. The melee weapon makes this enemy extremely intimidating.
unitInformation.沼泞桦树生物中的强大个体。在以毒为攻击手段的沼泞桦树生物中，使用大范围毒素对人类: A powerful entity among Venom CR. Among the CRs that use venom as a method of attack, its ability to impact humans with large-scale toxins is particularly notable.\nIt primarily attacks by applying [Toxic] to opponents. After stacking a certain number of layers of [Toxic], it will convert into [Death Impending], temporarily reducing the target's maximum HP and received Healing effects.
unitInformation.始源桦树生物中极其强大的个体，拥有与其他始源桦树生物不同的外形特征。与其同类一样: An extremely powerful individual among Origin CR, possessing different physical characteristics from other Origin CR. Like its counterparts, it belongs to the advanced life form of primitive CR, with a Morphic Field that differs from standard CR, while other traits are yet to be studied. The only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to the Morphic Moon at its origin.\nIt can inflict various negative effects such as Curse, Wet, and Heartblaze. Additionally, it can cause a unique Elemental Erosion status, which increases specific DMG dealt by your side and reduces Healing effects you provide.

An Origin CR of exceptional power, possessing distinct physical characteristics compared to other CR. Like its counterparts, it belongs to the advanced life forms of Origin CR, and its Morphic Field differs from that of regular CR. Other attributes are yet to be studied—what is currently known is that this type of CR is closely linked to the Morphic Moon at its origin.\nIt can inflict various negative effects such as [Wet] and [Curse]. Additionally, it can cause a unique [Elemental Erosion] status, increasing specific DMG dealt by your side and reducing the Healing effect you cause.
unitInformation.大天帝时代的“剑圣机”，只有当代剑圣才可以驾驭它。该机搭载超热离子引擎，可以轻易: In the era of the Great Heavenly Emperor, the "Sword Saint Machine" could only be piloted by the contemporary Sword Saint. This machine is equipped with a super thermal ion engine, allowing it to easily perform various magical sword techniques.\n——The above content appeared inexplicably in the Box database as "machine information." Based on its performance during its appearance, it is estimated that its actual combat power could even rival the mechanical tank lineup of the former N.A..
unitInformation.这架恐怖的怪物有着臭名昭著的传说，会吞噬它的驾驶者。有人怀疑这是驾驶舱打不开的夸: This terrifying monster has a notorious legend of devouring its pilot. Some suspect this is an exaggerated way of saying the cockpit can't be opened.\n——The above content is mysteriously found in the "machine information" in the Box database. Based on its performance in actual combat when it appeared, its estimated actual combat power might even rival the mechanical tank lineup of the former N.A.; however, a certain Outlander showed an incredible desire for this machine...\n"Mortals! I will claim that machine and show you the true strength of its rightful owner! Of course, you'll be fighting alongside me, won't you?"
unitInformation.“化物”的一种，俗称金快。世界上不存在比光还快的东西，如果有，那就是金子价格的涨: A type of Metaplasia. Commonly known as Gold Noget. Nothing can move faster than light. If there has to be one, then it'll be the price fluctuation of gold!\nIt deals Electro DMG and inflicts powerful DMG effects.
unitInformation.最初出现于哈依玛之骰意识海泄露事故后的不明实体，“归墟”。索思学会的学者们没有按: First appeared after Unbewusstes leakage incident in Haima Zaria. Scholars from Source Citadel did not follow the usual practice of naming this entity. Instead, they chose a code name from ancient tomes that means "Seas and lands are ever-changing, but all end up in ruins."\nA mysterious humanoid entity accompanied by a sword-shaped weapon, lacks communication ability but is clearly not purely inorganic. It possesses exceptionally powerful strength, capable of even altering and controlling opponents' combat strategies.
unitInformation.体型巨大的深海桦树生物，各方面的情况都亟需进一步调查。目前能够确定的信息仅有该个: A gigantic deep-sea CR requires further investigation in all aspects. Currently, the only confirmed information is that this individual's appearance pattern is influenced by certain human activities.

SkinDesc.冯里奈的默认形态: The default form of Rina Von.
SkinDesc.神盾波克士的默认涂装: The default paint job of BOX Aegis.
SkinDesc.菲妮娅的宽松日常装束（其实是睡衣）。手握捕梦网，抓住甜蜜美梦。: Fenia's casual everyday attire (actually pajamas), while holding a dreamcatcher to capture sweet dreams.
SkinDesc.莉薇娅踏足某处奇境时所穿着的装束，轻盈精致，如同落在水面上的雪花。: The attire Livia wears when she steps into a wonderland, light and delicate, resembling snowflakes gently falling on water.
SkinDesc.圣剑波克士的默认涂装: The default paint job of Box Excalibur.
SkinDesc.薇尔岚的宽松居家服。传说食梦貘吃掉人的噩梦来填饱肚子……希望你能做个好梦。: Verlaine's loose-fitting pajama, known in legends as Yumekui that consumes nightmares to satisfy its hunger. Wishing you pleasant dreams.
SkinDesc.让人觉得熟悉又陌生的艾略特的度假装扮。工作辛苦了，放松一下吧~: Eliot's vacation outfit, familiar yet peculiar. Thank you for your hard work, and now it's time to relax.
SkinDesc.亚莉奈为了与你共度假日而作的精心打扮。无论多么繁忙，总要为特别的人空出一日时间。: Dressed up attractively for your attention, Arina always prepares to spare her time and stay with someone important and special.
SkinDesc.卡塔斯在女仆咖啡店打工时所穿的女仆裙。由担保人签字保证后，她得以扛着她心爱的暗耀: Katas's maid dress for her part-time job at the Maid Café. With a guarantor's signature, she can now work at the café while carrying her beloved Umbral Fulgor.
SkinDesc.夏洛蒂在海边度假时所着的优雅裙装。如夏日的高积云一般洁白，如大海一般美丽。: Charlotte's elegant dress for a beach vacation, as white as a high cumulus cloud in summer and as beautiful as the sea.
SkinDesc.让莉薇娅爱不释手的睡衣，非常可爱，但是穿着睡衣的样子被别人看到时会格外害羞……: Livia's beloved pajamas, very cute. However, she becomes extremely shy when others see her wearing them...
SkinDesc.约书亚在漫长旅行途中的模样。立于一个帝国的废墟之上，天使向远方的高塔眺望——: Joshua's appearance during their long journey. Standing atop the ruins of an empire, the Angel gazes into the distance at a towering spire.
SkinDesc.甘雅执行监视任务时的装束。任务已经结束，不必紧绷神经，在炉边休息片刻吧。: Ganya's attire during a surveillance mission. Now that the mission is over, she can finally relax and rest by the fireside.
SkinDesc.受邀来到黑月游乐城游玩的阿尔喀娜。乐园的酒店甚至贴心提供了其故乡风格的睡袍。: Arcana was invited to the Night Chains Land. Sweetly, the local hotel offered a nice pajama for her, it bears nostalgic pattern to Arcana.
SkinDesc.卡莱雅打扫房间、清点她珍爱的收藏时所穿的裙装。她毫无保留地爱着她的珍藏品。: Kaleya's dress when she cleans her room and takes inventory of her cherished collection. She loves her collection wholeheartedly.
SkinDesc.柯娜的休闲装扮。拧下油门，戴上头盔，驱车前往新的天地，命运与此刻的我们无关。: Connor's casual attire. Turn the throttle, put on the helmet, and ride toward new horizons beyond the grip of destiny.
SkinDesc.妮蔻拉的休闲装束，静谧，优雅，充满神秘气息。绽放于暮光中的睡莲也绽放于她的发间。: Nicola's casual attire, quiet, elegant, and mysterious. Her hair is adorned with water lilies that bloom in the twilight.
SkinDesc.马吉拉在大型展会中穿着自制服装登台演出时的装扮。曾经被藏于衣柜深处的梦想，如今终: Margiela's outfit when she performs on stage in a homemade costume at a grand show. A dream once hidden in the depths of her closet now takes center stage.
SkinDesc.■■■的形态之一。脆弱的永恒。: One of the forms of ■■■■■, representing fragile eternity.
SkinDesc.虽然是黑月的一员，却被黑月的娃娃机连锁店列入了黑名单——有的时候，太擅长了也会让: To see it as a Night Chains being on the blacklist of a claw machine chain store — owned by the same company feels irritating to me.
SkinDesc.叶珏参加东大陆文化体验节时的装束，似乎是她脱离简朴实用穿搭的一次尝试。金玉其响，: Yejue's graceful attire when she attended the Eastern Continent Cultural Festival, deviating from her usual simple and practical wear.
SkinDesc.霖参加澄明嘉年华时的装束。她对这套服装所代表的职业适应良好，甚至就地支起了一间占: Lin's attire when she attended the CDCA Carnival. She adapted well to the role represented by the costume and even set up a divination booth on the spot.
SkinDesc.奈弥的夏日装扮。为了融入环境而作的打扮是必要的，但她总与环境相疏离。: Nabi's summer costume that allows her to blend in, but she always remains detached from her surroundings.
SkinDesc.夏尔大人和家人们一起在篝火城里度过幸福时光时所穿的装束。外套是一位重要的朋友为她: The attire the mighty Shire wears while having a blessed time with her family in Bonfire City. The jacket was bought by someone important, and so she treasures it dearly.
SkinDesc.比你低一年级的同校生安菲娅，品学兼优，人际关系良好。在这间学校里，她是被爱着的孩: Anfiya, a schoolmate one grade lower than you and a well-liked star pupil. She's absolutely loved in this school.
SkinDesc.在喝下那杯“特制家族饮料”之前，苔妮和你都不知道它的真实效果究竟是什么……直到第: Prior to drinking the "Family Special Beverage," neither you nor Tennie had any idea what its true effect really was... That was until the first massive, fluffy teddy bear materialized before your eyes.
SkinDesc.冯·里奈在海角城度过短暂夏休时所穿的休闲服装。树影摇曳，阳光洒下；总是过于忙碌的: A casual outfit Rina Von wears while having a brief summer break in Cape City. The shadows of trees sway under the bright sun; an overtaxed boat drops its golden anchor for a short rest.
SkinDesc.静流·逐夏的默认形态: The default form of Shizuru the Summer Chaser.
SkinDesc.菲妮娅的海底探险装束。无需艳羡任何一位陆地上的公主，她就是海底最美丽的宝石。: Fenia's undersea exploration attire. There's no need to be envious of any princess on land, for she's the most beautiful gem at the bottom of the sea.
SkinDesc.妮蔻拉在某个岛屿度假时选择的清凉泳装。她似乎扮演海盗舰队的船长，正要去掠夺那份心: A cooling swimwear Nicola picks while vacationing on a certain island. She seems to be role-playing as a pirate fleet's captain and is about to plunder the treasure of her dreams.
SkinDesc.亚莉奈在海岛上的度假装束。到底是谁醉了，她抑或是她的爱人？: Arina's vacation attire on the island. Who's really the one who's intoxicated? Her or her lover?
SkinDesc.夏尔在海岛上的度假装束。孩子当然需要一个超可爱的游泳圈——在夏尔的强烈要求下，她: Shire dressed as a quaintrelle in a summer resort. A children's ring fits her well, doesn't it? Of course, Shire got one for her little pal.
SkinDesc.卡莱雅在海岛上的度假装束。暂时将桦树空间传送的危险抛之脑后……等等，为什么海滩上: Kaleya's vacation attire on the island. The dangers of Chaos Space teleportation have been temporarily put behind her... Hold up. Why did a swordfish fly onto the beach?!
SkinDesc.弗兰的度假装扮，让人觉得熟悉又陌生。有她撑着这条船，就不必担心任何风浪。: Fran's vacation outfit, gives off a vibrant summer vibe, exotic while familiar. With her being the pilot, one fears the storm no more.
SkinDesc.丽桑德拉解决海岛事件后换上的度假装束。很难说面前的她究竟是不是一团甜美的幻觉。: Lissandra changed to her casual outfit in the wake of the island incident. Staring at her, you may feel yourself in a daydream.
SkinDesc.卡塔斯在海岛上的度假装束。据她本人所说，这是“掌握了破晓圣光之力、由死地而复生的: Katas's vacation attire on the island. To quote her words, this is the "attire of Jumakenki who has arisen from the dead and mastered the power of Divine Dawnlight"...
SkinDesc.伊洛娜于城市街头开始首场即兴演奏前的装束。汉堡店的赠品T恤，地毯上淘来的音响，满: Ilona's outfit before starting her first solo show on the city streets. A gift shirt of a burger shop, a stereo bought from a road-side stall; a bass covered in stickers, her breath and trembling fingers.
SkinDesc.莉薇娅在海岛上的度假装束。她如一阵微风。: Livia's vacation attire on the island. She looks like a breath of breeze.
SkinDesc.伊索斯在生灵节的装扮。他扮作传闻中一座古老庄园的主人，听说那是被罪孽束缚在这片土: Ithos's Fantasma Eve outfit. He dresses as the master of an ancient manor, as described in legends. It's said he's a grudge-bound spirit, tethered to this land by sins.
SkinDesc.莉薇娅的列车乘员制服，由科伦巴商会为优秀护卫乘员量身定做，复原了几十年前的旧款式: Livia's train crew uniform, meticulously crafted by COLUMBA, reflecting a vintage style reminiscent of bygone eras. Livia will always be your steadfast companion throughout your journey, regardless of the era.
SkinDesc.多萝西在生灵节的装扮。杂糅了多种怪物特征的她，号称自己是今晚的魔怪女王！在被魔怪: Dorothy's Costume for Fantasma Eve. Behold, everyone! Dorothy is the queen of tonight! Before falling victim to her charm, take her hands and join the party~
SkinDesc.安菲娅的生灵节变装。无需他人陪衬，魔女一个人即是一支狂欢的队列——当然，魔女的使: Anfiya's attire for the Fantasma Eve. The witch stands as the epitome of the gathering, accompanied by her loyal entourage.
SkinDesc.达斯廷在生灵节的装扮。从画中拾级而下的引路者，跟随着他的烛火，就能回到这座庄园尚: Dustin's Costume for Fantasma Eve. The navigator in the descent from the painting on the wall. Following the ill-lit fire, one can enter the golden age of this mansion...
SkinDesc.约书亚的生灵节装扮。当祂沉眠之时，常有过往景象浮现。记忆如花朵次第盛放，随后凋零: Joshua's Fantasma Eve outfit. When they descend into slumber, visions of the past often emerge. Memories bloom like flowers, only to wither away shortly after.
SkinDesc.苏恩为更好地“服务”列车长而特意换上的裙装。不知得到了谁的协助，这位女仆居然还给: The dress Suen wears to better "serve" Conductor. Thanks to the help of an unknown someone, she even added a pair of floppy cat ears...
SkinDesc.大热偶像STELLA的新专《闪耀之路 ~Shining Way~》发售中！购买即: Grab the latest album "Shining Way~" by the popular idol STELLA! Purchase the album now and receive a special poster!
SkinDesc.静流在篝火城的步道等候时，总会习惯性接住飘落的叶子。风撩起她的头发，恰如学生时代: When Shizuru waits along the trail, she often catches falling leaves. The wind tousles her hair, just like how she were back in school days.
SkinDesc.根据无名的描述复原的服装，据说是驿中与骏城上的孩子们常穿的款式，剪裁得体，便于行: An outfit recreated based on Mumei's description, said to be a common style worn by children in Hayajiros and Ekis, tailored for enhanced mobility. Wear this outfit and plunge into battle, transcending life and death like an ethereal butterfly.
SkinDesc.罗洁尔更年轻时的形象。往昔总被封存，正如夹在书中不再使用的旧书签。: Raziel in her younger days. The past has always been sealed close, stuck in between lines like an old bookmark.
SkinDesc.妮蔻拉的岚心风格装束，采用最昂贵的岚心锦制作，此乃献给上宾的大礼。然而，对于受邀: Nicola was dressed up in the most fashionable Ranshin style. The Ranshin silk honored the production of this extravagant cloth, also the token for the most distinguished guest. However, for a lead researcher like Nicola, she yearns for more exotic experience.
SkinDesc.罗洁尔尝试驾驶为她设计的赛车时所穿的赛车手装扮，独一无二。踩下油门，化作赛场上目: The racing suit Raziel wears when she drives the racing car designed for her. Hit the throttle and speed into the stars!
SkinDesc.佩罗塔被安排成为“无垠号一日清洁专员”时的装扮。经此一役，她表示再也不要在车厢里: Pelota's outfit as the "One-Day Cleaning Officer" aboard the Eternal. After this experience, she declared she would never overuse her powers inside the carriages again.
SkinDesc.索玛参加东大陆文化体验节时的装束，闪亮的银饰与她十分相配。纵然蝶翼柔，乘龙可攀云: Sommer's attire at the Eastern Continent Cultural Experience Festival, with its shiny silver ornaments, suits her perfectly. Butterfly wings might be fragile, but one can climb the clouds on dragon's back.
SkinDesc.苏恩的星祷节新装。曼杜斯帝国的子民过去曾在这个节日祈求未来一年的喜悦与安康，而苏: Suen's new attire for the Star Prayer Festival. The people of the Mundus Empire used to pray for joy and well-being in the coming year during this festival, and Suen has decided to personally deliver a share just for you.
SkinDesc.亚莉奈在新年伊始之日换上的岚心城传统装束。与穿着这身服装的她共同漫步的时光，将被: Arina donned the traditional attire of Ranshin City on the first day of the New Year. The time spent walking with her in this outfit will be forever frozen on this silent first snowy day.
SkinDesc.索玛在放学后等待校园祭彩排开始的装束。她拥有不被作为异类看待的幸运，也拥有向更多: Sommer hums to herself while waiting for the rehearsal of the school festival to begin. Having been lifted from being looked down on for her strangeness, Sommer hums not only to herself but also to the rest of the universe.
SkinDesc.苍叶的岚心风格装束。与平时的护卫装不同，在宵月的要求和帮助下，她换上了更为繁复华: A Ranshin style outfit of Aoba. Unlike her usual guard attire, at the request and with the help of Yoizuki, she changed into a more intricate and gorgeous dress - of course, this outfit was personally made for her by Yoizuki.
SkinDesc.宵月的岚心风格装束，由她自己亲自设计并改良。有时执扇，有时握铳；为了达成梦寐以求: A Ranshin style outfit of Yoizuki personally designed and refined by her. Sometimes she wields a fan, other times a gun; to achieve her long-cherished dream, let the blood buds before her bloom even more vividly.
SkinDesc.夏洛蒂的星祷节新装。在这个互相赠送美好祝愿的节日，夏洛蒂选择的礼物是……一套以她: Charlotte's new outfit for Astrum Ora. The gift Charlotte chooses is... a set of track assembly models (Astrum Ora edition) for which she serves as a promotional model?
SkinDesc.乌刹娜在列车长的建议下，学习融入同龄人的方法，在逛街的时候，她迷上了潮玩“手手喵: Ushana tries to blend in with her compeers. She gets dipped into Super Catopus while hanging out with Conductor.
SkinDesc.卡洛琳的特别扫除装扮。尘封已久的度假别墅中灰尘弥漫，好在其中还有这样一束足以作为: Caroline's special cleaning attire. Dust is everywhere in the long-unvisited vacation villa, but fortunately, there is still such a bouquet of roses that can serve as decoration.
SkinDesc.星花受邀参与一场重要舞会时的高级定制礼服裙。来宾发言时间将近，宴会厅中最闪耀的那: A haute couture gown Stella prepared for an important ball. As the time for guest speeches approached, the most dazzling gem in the banquet hall was nowhere to be found — she was right beside you. Where else would she need to be?
SkinDesc.苔妮成为曼德矿场KEEP炸鸡店特邀店员时的装扮。比特辣炸鸡更加打动人心的，当然是: Tennie's attire when she became a special guest employee at the Mander Mine KEEP Fried Chicken. Her passion is even more impressive than extra hot chicken!
SkinDesc.隼的变装之一，“飞鸟”的样子。若无法飞翔，不如将其羽翼折毁——这是他的真心话吗？: One of Hayabusa's disguises, in the form of "Songbird." If one cannot fly, it would be better to break the wings - is this truly what he believes?
SkinDesc.苍叶的岚心风格装束，由黑月匠造的主理人亲自设计。“将藤花的薄紫赠予她的肩头，使其: Aoba's Ranshin style attire, personally designed by the curator of Night Chains Lesage. "Wisteria's pale violet graces her shoulders, casting an elegant fleeting shade."
SkinDesc.伊卡菈的学生风格装束，她称你为“前辈”是理所当然的事。于她来说，这段记忆就像是漫: Ikara's student-style outfit. It follows naturally that she calls you her senior. For her, this memory is like white frosting spread slowly over everything, never melting.
SkinDesc.多萝西的夏季度假装束。海上的风总会如约而至，成熟的水手知道不必惊慌；在出发之前，: Dorothy in her telltale swimsuit. The wind from the sea raises no panic in an experienced sailor. Before embarking on an adventurous voyage, it never hurts to lay your hands on snacks.
SkinDesc.园丁导师就算拿起画笔也是一派大师风范，会有怎样惊世绝艳的作品诞生于那副画布？: Even with a brush in hand, the Gardeners' mentor is every inch a master. What work of astonishing beauty will emerge on that canvas?
SkinDesc.瑞瓦和朋友们一同在篝火城打工时所穿的衣服。旅行的安排重在随心所欲，既然如此，停下: The outfit Reeva wears when working together with her friends in Bonfire Cities. Travel is meant to be free-spirited, so why not stop occasionally to earn some funds?
SkinDesc.“爱丽”的学生装束，一位再普通不过的少女应该穿的服装。斯洛卡伊允许你偶尔这样称呼: "Ellie's" school uniform, the outfit a most ordinary girl should wear. Slokai allows you to occasionally call her by this name. What exactly does it mean, though?
SkinDesc.朵拉弥丝的特殊装束。穿成这样不管去哪儿都不太方便，虽然她本人不太理解，不过还是别: Doralice's special outfit. It's not very convenient no matter where she goes dressed like this, although she doesn't quite understand that herself. Still, make sure she doesn't wander off.
SkinDesc.真咲平日会穿的学生制服。经过家门前的坡道时撑起一把小伞，飘落的花瓣便会在伞面上跳: Masaki's everyday school uniform. Open her small umbrella while walking down the slope near her home, and falling petals dance across its surface.

State2Desc.冯里奈的共振形态: The Resonance form of Rina Von.
State2Desc.甜梦捕手的共振形态: The Resonance form of The Dreamcatcher.
State2Desc.莉薇娅踏足某处奇境时所穿着的装束，轻盈精致，如同落在水面上的雪花。: The attire Livia wears when she steps into a wonderland, light and delicate, resembling snowflakes gently falling on water.
State2Desc.黑色的雨，红色的天空，痛苦的微笑。孤独的安菲娅。: Black rain, red sky, bitter smile, lonely her.
State2Desc.牵起毛茸手掌，钻进温暖怀抱。捏捏耳朵拍拍手，小熊永远好朋友。: Hold their furry hands, crawl into their warm arms. Pinch their ears and make them clap. Teddy bears are forever friends.
State2Desc.静流·逐夏的共振形态: The Resonance form of Shizuru the Summer Chaser.
State2Desc.假如一名海盗船长打定主意要夺走什么，那即使有一整支舰队也无法阻拦她。: When a pirate captain is determined to plunder something, not even an entire fleet can impede her.
State2Desc.宴席行将终结，魔女偷吃了甜甜圈。即使今夜的狂欢消散于明日的晨曦之中，也请你永远不: As the carnival draws to a close, the witch playfully snatches a donut. Even as the carnival night fades with the arrival of dawn, the memories linger on.
State2Desc.从漫长沉眠中醒来的天使需要进食。餐叉挑出灵魂，盘中盛放回忆。若这苦酒是不能避开—: The Angel awakening from a long slumber is in need of sustenance. The fork gathers souls, the plate holds memories. If this bitter wine must be tasted...
State2Desc.双面偶像的生活一如既往地忙碌。但至少在演出结束后的夜晚，陪伴这颗星星稍作休息吧。: The life of the dual-faced idol remains hectic. Nevertheless, taking a moment to relax alongside this star post-show never hurts.
State2Desc.等到她完成学业、迈入她梦想的地方以后，她还会回忆起这段静谧的日子吗？等到她步入一: When she concludes her academic journey and enters her dream career, will she reminisce about these tranquil days? When she ushers in a brighter future, will she return from the light?
State2Desc.乌刹娜给救世主大人准备了特殊礼物。偷看的人会被天罚！: Ushana has prepared a special gift for Master Savior. Peeking will be punished!
State2Desc.没关系，大师的作品就是如此令人费解，想必这就是艺术的门槛。: That's all right. A master's work is simply this hard to fathom — no doubt this is where art sets the bar.

environDetail.电磁伤害提高30%，使用黄卡时自身触发<color=#FFB800>【麻痹】</: Increase Electro DMG by 30%. When using a Yellow card, inflict <color=#FFB800>[Paralysis]</color> on the card holder.
